localizedTextIdText: Protostar's plan to offer housing on Nexus sounds dangerous, but it's your big chance to claim a piece of the world for your very own. If you intend to put down roots, you'd better speak to the Protostar Housing Specialist in Algoroc or Celestion as soon as you can!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist in Algoroc or Celestion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Participate in Protostar's innovative housing plan and own a piece of Nexus! The benefits of home ownership far outweigh the risks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Step right up! Protostar has the plot of land you've been waiting for, so long as you don't mind using a little elbow grease to make it livable!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find a Protostar Housing Specialist to claim your very own slice of heaven!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Interact with the handy Housing Model and teleport to your new plot of land!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken with a Protostar Housing Specialist about your claim to land on (or, at least, above) Nexus. To pay your new slice of heaven a visit, please use Protostar's teleporter technology by activating the holographic housing model near the Protostar Housing Specialist.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist

localizedTextIdTitle: Refine Yellow Ore to Duralumin Alloy (Minigame Analogue)
localizedTextIdText: Refine materials by interacting with Urn and completing the placeholder minigame.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Refined 100 Yellow Ore to 1 Duralumin Alloy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest is a minigame analogue for Refining.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This quest refines Yellow Ore to Duralumin Alloy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: This placeholder quest is repeatable to refine more mineral materials.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to the neighborhood! When you are done here, use this handy Spatial Relocator to return to Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to the neighborhood! When you are done here, use this handy Spatial Relocator to return to Thayd.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll use the relocator when I'm done.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll use the relocator when I'm done.

localizedTextIdText: According to Ema, chompacabra swarms breed fast and if preventative measures aren't taken immediately the ranch will be overwhelmed. She's willing to sacrifice her herd of goats in order to lure the chompacabras to the surface so that they may be slain.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Swarms breed fast. If we don't start preventative measures immediately they will overwhelm us. Guess we'll be sacrificing more goats...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Chompacabra are a bane to the ranchers of Malgrave. Once they establish a foothold in your ranch, it's nearly impossible to get rid of them.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll start hitching the goats up.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Glad I could help the M.R.A. !
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The goats certainly lured the chompacabras to the surface. Although many chompacabra were slain, it appears as if the swarm still occupies the caverns beneath the ranch.

localizedTextIdText: Momma Kestus at the Bingberry Orchard must harvest bingberries. Momma's son bought her one of Protostar's Gravitic Destabilizer, so she could harvest berries more easily. She asked for your help. Use the Gravitic Destabilizer to jump into the trees and harvest bingberries.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Momma Kestus at the Bingberry Orchard
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My son bought me a fancy Protostar gadget to help me harvest bingberries. He's a sweet boy, but I don't trust the machine. How'd you like to help me, instead?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm too old to go bouncing around the bingberry orchard on some newfangled Protostar gizmo.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I guess that destabilizer works! I could see you jumping around from over here! Now... let me reward you as best I can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll find a gravitic destabilizer near the bingberry trees. Get to picking.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: How'd you like to pick more bingberries for me?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Gravitic Destabilizer to harvest bingberries for Momma Kestus at the Bingberry Orchard.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: As you like. You don't look like much of a farmer, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: The unrest at the gates of Hycrest is indicative of the fear that the lowborn are experiencing, so Governor Aluviel would like to address the public to assuage their concerns. To this end, the Governor has asked you to activate hologram terminals around Lower Hycrest to spread his message of hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lord Benevolo at Greenfield Estate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Like children, the lowborn require constant reassurance. Take my messages to hologram terminals throughout Hycrest and assuage their fears.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your delivery of my messages to the lowborn adds a somewhat personal touch to the act, does it not?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You are on an important mission, ensuring the people hear the Governor's words. Speak to me when you are finished.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These peasants have been in such a state since this whole plague thing started. It means a great deal to me that you have eased their worries somewhat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You do the lowborn a great service by taking my words to them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm sure. Perhaps now they will get some work done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Governor Aluviel messages have gone out to the people of Lower Hycrest, thanks to you. Only time will tell if his words will bring them reassurance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have made a mistake.

localizedTextIdText: Justice Varen has recommended that you go to the Sand Storm Pub in Fiera Bluff. You should be able to learn more about the current events in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully arrived at the Sand Storm Pub in Fiera Bluff.

localizedTextIdText: Mayor Caskle is thankful that you stopped the destruction of trees in Fiera Grove. In gratitude he has gotten you a reward that you can find at the Last Gas.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Sallup at the Last gas
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The explosions have stopped! Our forest is preserved! I can never thank you enough, $2n, but I did leave a substantial reward with Sallup at the Last Gas for you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I'm sorry, $2n. I had Sallup place an order for your reward and it hasn't arrived yet. You can go to the Last Gas and get it, though.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Reward? Yeah, Caskle mentioned that. Here, this is the only thing I could save from when the marauders attacked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived at the Last Gas to find that your reward was stolen during a marauder raid.

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Rand has asked you to kill groups of krogg slaves at the krogg slave camp at the large farm in Gildgrass Province.  The slaves are no longer themselves, and are being controlled by the krogg via a creature attached to their face.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Farmer Rand at his farm in Gildgrass Province
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: They've made slaves of the ones they've captured.  There's something on their face that makes them as if they're dead walking!  You must end their suffering.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: They've set up some kind of slave camp at the farm down the road.  You'll be doing them a favor by killing them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can't imagine what it must be like for those poor souls who they did that to.  Thank you for saving them from that fate.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Farmer Rand thanked you for putting the krogg slaves out of their misery, and killing their krogg masters.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looking for a fight? Try the Soldier background!  You'll be completing military objectives and securing control points in each zone.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Head up that ridge to the northeast and plant the Defiance flag in its base. But watch out - the Crowe don't appreciate us trying to muscle in on what they consider their territory!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yes, I want to be a Soldier!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Are you inquisitive and want to catalogue the wonders of Nexus? Then the scientist background is for you! Everything from strange creatures to ancient ruins will provide scientific finds!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take this Biological Scanner and use it on the corpses of Vulcarrion and Pumera. We need all the information we can get on them if we are going to understand Nexus!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That sounds like me! I'll be a Scientist!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Are you looking for a way to reach the heights of the world? Try the Explorer background on for size! Map the wilds of Nexus and find treasures or exotic places off the beaten path!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As you explore Nexus, you will see glowing spots in the world. These spots are where you will need to place satellite uplinks that will send us pertinent information for making a global map.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do you want to help your community? The Settler is all about helping the citizens of Nexus establish settlements as well as developing your own!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Throughout the towns and colonies of Nexus, you'll see things that need to be fixed or people that need help. Pitch in and soon your name will be known far and wide as the go-to guy!

localizedTextIdText: The final battle to rid Algoroc of the Crowe Gang is about to begin. General Carg leading Carg's Commandos an elite militia will undertake the assault. Due to the scale of the battle Carg is in need of someone who has fought the Crowe Gang before to lead one of the attack plans.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with General Carg
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've heard of your exploits against the Crowe Gang. I need one such as yourself who has gone toe to toe with them to lead one of the assaults on the Crowe's Nest. Are you ready to do what it takes to defeat these brigands?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well you're certainly got gall. Perhaps you will live up to your reputation. Speak with my Lieutenants they will bring you up to speed with our plan for the assault. I will go and rally our troops.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what I wanted to hear! I've got no time for weaklings.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good Luck!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's finish them once and for all.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We will crush the Crowe Gang.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Carg has directed you speak with his Lieutenants Malkrone and Grimlowe. Each lieutenant will brief you on one half of the assault plan. It is up to you to decide which plan of attack you will lead.

localizedTextIdText: Having been initially briefed by General Carg you have been directed to speak to his Lieutenants Malkrone and Garlowe. Lieutenant Grimlowe has informed you that one half of the assault plan would have you lead the main assault against the Crowe's Nest while the two lieutenants lead a covert mission at the rear entrance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lieutenant Grimlowe
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need you to lead our main assault force while Lieutenant Malkrone and I lead a covert mission at the rear of the fortress. Speak with me again if you are ready to take this mission. If you have your own squad speak with Malkrone and he will brief you on a mission more suitable for your team.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You will command a company of soldiers to attack the main entrance of the Crowe's Nest. The bulk of the enemies defenses will be concentrated here so it won't be a picnic. However, our superior firepower and training will ensure our victory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excelent! Good to be working with you $2(class).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I will lead the frontal siege.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have spoken with Lieutenant Grimlowe and you have volunteered to lead the main assault force against the front gate of the Crowe's Nest. You will lead a company of Carg's Commandos against the primary defenses at the fortress.

localizedTextIdText: You have volunteered to lead the main assault force to siege the front gate of the Crowe's Nest. Now is the time to rally the troops and begin the final battle against the Crowe Gang.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Carg
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The path to the front gate is clear.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With superior tactics and firepower you have defeated the overwhelming number of the Crowe Gang defending the main entrance to the Crowe's Nest. Now it is time to break through and clean out the fortress.

localizedTextIdText: Having been initially briefed by General Carg you have been directed to speak to his Lieutenants Malkrone and Garlowe. Lieutenant Malkrone has informed you that one half of the assault plan would have you lead your team of elite soldiers on a covert mission at the rear entrance of the Crowe's Nest while the two lieutenants lead the primary assault force to siege the main entrance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lieutenant Malkrone
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need you to lead your team on a covert mission while Lieutenant Malkrone and I lead the main assault force to siege the fortress. Speak with me again if you are ready to take this mission. If you have you do not have your own squad squad speak with Grimlowe and he will brief you on a mission suitable for a single leader.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You will command your elite team to covertly attack the rear entrance of the Crowe's Nest. The path you will take will be lightly guarded but those guards will be the strongest of the Crowe Gang has. However, I trust your superior skills and ability will ensure your victory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's reassuring to have a unit led by such an experienced $2(class).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I will lead the covert mission.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have spoken with Lieutenant Malkrone and you have volunteered to lead your team of elite soldiers on a covert mission at the rear entrance of the Crowe's Nest.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find the missing weapon pieces
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find the missing weapon pieces.

localizedTextIdText: You've been asked to help unlock the secret of a mysterious Eldan device. It has four terminals which must all be activated but so far the proper sequence has eluded even the best minds of the D.A.S.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to [TEST] Scientist Prototype
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've located a dormant eldan device, but we're not sure how to turn it on. It has 4 terminals that must be activated in the proper sequence, but we're not sure what it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm impressed! Our best minds couldn't figure it out, but you did.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: All 4 terminals must be on at the same time. But, when you turn a terminal on or off, others also turn on or off. We haven't been able to figure out the sequence- good luck!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can work it out
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Whatever it was, it must have been important
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You correctly deduced the proper activation sequence for the eldan terminals. Now that the device is active, the D.A.S. can begin to study it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Who knows what secrets could be revealed if we could only activate this device!

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza is determined not to let the Exiles to escape. Now that you've knocked out their communications, he wants you to destroy their ship. Collect explosives from around Jagged Rock Cove and blow up the Exile ship.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Clanlord Makaza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles keep their ship close, ready to flee at the first sign of danger. Find explosives to destroy their ship, and they'll be unable to run.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not allow the Exiles a means of escape. Destroy their ship and leave them trapped like cornered jabbits.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. Now they cannot call for help. They cannot flee. They can only sit and await the coming slaughter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They will regret the day they trespassed on Bloodfire lands!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Exiles' own explosives to blow up their ship. Without communications or transport, the Exiles of Jagged Rock Cove now have no means of escape.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me again. How many times has Arkos escaped you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Do as you're told, and do not ask impertinent questions! Ask again, and I will have my huntresses include you in their bounty list for the Great Hunt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare refuse me? I should eviscerate you for your defiance.

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza wants to ensure you cut off all means of escape for Mercenary Arkos and his fellow Exiles. He's ordered you to disable the Exile Communications Relay located in Jagged Rock Cove.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Clanlord Makaza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Arkos is many things, but he is not a fool. I'm sure he has allies lying in wait. Disable their communications so no one will hear their cries for help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I will not allow Arkos to escape again. Disable their communications line, and he will be unable to call for backup.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well. There is but one final step. Then the fate of Arkos and these thieving Exiles will be sealed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Arkos will not escape my sword this time. This hunt of many years will finally be at an end!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: There will be no call for help.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm ready to finish this hunt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully disabled the Exile Communications Relay. Now the Exiles at Jagged Rock Cove will be unable to call for aid.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: For many years, I served the Dominion by hunting its enemies across the stars. Arkos was one such enemy, a lawless mercenary who sold his sword without honor. It was my pleasure to deliver imperial justice to one such as him!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Silence! There is no more to be told. Time and time again, that slippery Granok eluded my grasp. Before Arkos, there had been none who escaped me. Now honor demands I finish the hunt!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I cannot tell if your brash insolence is the result of fearlessness or stupidity.

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza is impressed with your capture of the Granok mercenary Arkos. You've been called back to Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Clanlord Makaza in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thanks to you, my old enemy is now in my power. Since you were so crucial to his capture, I think it only fitting you witness his end. Return to Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Luminai should be here soon. I look forward to the coming... entertainment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall parade this victory before the Luminai lord.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned to Bloodfire Village to witness Mercenary Arkos' fate at the hands of Clanlord Makaza.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will you do with Arkos?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have a special fate planned for the Granok mercenary, one that is fitting, especially during the Great Hunt. Arkos will serve as prey for a new hunt! Yes! I will announce it in honor of Councilor Vaelen's arrival.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would do well to heed my command, $(player.class).

localizedTextIdText: Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village asked you to hunt Pumera and Razortail in Bloodfire Savannah.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Huntress Kezzia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I seek a fearless hunter. Might that be you? The savannah is full of deadly predators. Spill their blood and prove your worth to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for gnarlfoot razortail and whitepaw pumera on the eastern savannah. They're lethal predators, but I'm sure you can handle them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now you know the bloodrush... the thrill of the chase, the clash of predators, the ecstasy of triumph as your foe's blood drains away!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Revel in the kill.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Are you, now? We shall see. Yes, we shall see.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll prove my worth as a hunter.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm ready for a greater challenge!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your skills at hunting in Bloodfire Savannah have impressed Huntress Kezzia.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not ready for the hunt? How disappointing.

localizedTextIdText: Firewalker Jarrok is trapped in a cage in the Jagged Rock Mine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Elder Torvak in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: PRISONER: FIREWALKER JARROK - CAPTURED IN BATTLE\n\nSTATUS: DANGEROUS - DO NOT RELEASE!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: PRISONER: FIREWALKER JARROK - CAPTURED IN BATTLE\n\nSTATUS: DANGEROUS - DO NOT RELEASE!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I think my son Jarrok was captured. If you find him tell him to return to his people, in shame.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I suspected my son might have been captured. Do not feel guilt. Jarrok was always a warrior first. You have granted him an honorable death.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your actions have allowed me to pass these claws on within the clan. Thank you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Is this really the only way?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Firewalker Jarrok trapped in a cage in the Jagged Rock Mine. When freed, he demanded a warrior's death and attacked. After he was slain, he asked you to bring his ceremonial claws to his father, Elder Torvak.

localizedTextIdText: Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village needs you to track and kill two pumera who have begun hunting Draken in Bloodfire Savannah.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Huntress Kezzia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A pair of deadly pumera have cut a swath of death across the savannah. The one who takes their hides as trophies will bathe in the glory of Bloodfire!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Slaughter the pumera called Kifo and Kivuli. They are cunning hunters, but I doubt they are as dangerous as you are.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hmm. Your skills are impressive. Only one with a hunter's heart could have overcome such vicious beasts. Are you ready for your final challenge?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Strike quickly, and strike true.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The time to truly test your mettle has come.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Huntress Kezzia is impressed with your skills as a hunter after you successfully tracked and killed two murderous pumera in Bloodfire Savannah. She believes you are ready to hunt Zonaga!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yes, those pumera are truly frightening. Perhaps your mother will protect you.

localizedTextIdText: Huntress Kezzia needs you to join her in hunting the giant gorganoth Zonaga in Bloodfire Savannah.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your hunting prowess is unquestionable, but now you must face the ultimate prey. Meet me at the lair of the mighty gorganoth Zonaga.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The hunt must go on!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done! Zonaga's head rests on the altar... and your name will live forever among the legends of Bloodfire's Great Hunt!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't keep me waiting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your prowess as a hunter saved Kezzia's life! When you arrived at Zonaga's Lair, Kezzia was unconscious after trying to take on Zonaga by herself. You managed to slay the beast and bring its head back to Bloodfire Village as a trophy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will regret refusing this challenge.

localizedTextIdText: You discovered a datachron containing information regarding a possible Aurin presence in Deradune. Agent Lex asked you to locate the Aurin camp and eliminate their leader, Ullana Shadeleaf. According to the datachron, the Aurin have established a hidden camp on the banks of the Ungala River.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The datachron appears to hold coordinates and a message. Accessing this data will allow you determine the purpose and whereabouts of the Aurin camp in Deradune.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find out where these Aurin spies are located and eliminate them. Their presence in this territory will not be tolerated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your swift eradication of the Aurin was impressive. The ICI takes a great interest in capable individuals like yourself.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I live to serve the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Shadeleaf camp near the banks of the Ungala River and dispatched their leader. Agent Lex will be pleased to learn the Aurin problem in Deradune has been dealt with so swiftly.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Agent Lex via Datachron

localizedTextIdText: You encountered Game Hunter Joresh at his favorite garr hunting location by the Ungala River. He mentioned that if you bringHunt Mistress Kivia enough garr hides, she will exchange them for garr-skin gear.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the Girrok Hide to Hunt Mistress Kivia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Huntin' for garr can be a real fun. It's also worth the effort. I made a deal with the hunt mistress. If you bring her garr hides, she'll craft you somethin'.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Still lookin' for something to do? Hunt yourself some garr and bring their hides to Hunt Mistress Kivia when you have enough. Good hunting to ya!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes? Do you have something for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, garr hides. You must have been speaking with that hunter Joresh. He's practically a poacher, but he hunts well for one who is not Draken.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ya know, I used to fight garr with nothin' but a knife and a couple sharp sticks!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure. I'll collect some garr hides.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Thanks, I can definitely use this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Hunt Mistress Kivia is a skillful leatherworker. In exchange for the Girrok Hide, she gave you some unique handcrafted garr-skin gear!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the Girrok Hide to Hunt Mistress Kivia
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: I thought only Draken and their allies were allowed to hunt on these savannahs.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Does Hunt Mistress Kivia know that you're here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I don't know about that. What the hornheads don't know won't hurt them, eh?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You're hurtin' this poor hunter's feelings, friend. The Draken are hunters, and so am I! What's a few animals between fellow hunters?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Kivia? We're old friends... in a manner of speakin'. Let's just say, I stick with my garr, and she doesn't stick me with her sword. She never says no when I bring her garr hides, now does she?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself. The savannah is crawling with garr, if you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: For Game Hunter Joresh, hunting doesn't always involve killing animals. Artifact rustling can present an equal challenge. Joresh suspects that the Moodie totems in Deadwind Hollow are crafted from accelerite. He wants you to pinch a few of the more elaborate specimens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver Elaborate Moodie Totems to Hunt Mistress Kivia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have you seen the totems near the Moodie village? They're studded with accelerite crystals! I'll make it worth your while if you fetch me a few.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go to the Moodie village and steal several of those elaborate totems they're so fond of using. I can think of several better uses for the accelerite in 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That lying, no-good excuse for a hunter! Joresh told me he was here for the garr! No matter. He will not profit from his lies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're as ugly as the day is long, but they should sell for a hefty sum.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take this for your trouble. I have no quarrel with you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He didn't say anything to me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Just as you finished collecting totems for Game Hunter Joresh, you received an angry call from Hunt Mistress Kivia, who was less than thrilled to learn of your task. Kivia confiscated the Moodie totems, but let you off easy. Joresh better watch out next time he tries to hunt on Bloodfire Savannah!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the totems to Hunt Mistress Kivia
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: This isn't going to get me in trouble, is it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Perish the thought! The Draken only care about hunting and fighting, Moodie totems don't exactly fall in either category, now do they?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Besides the fact that it sells for a ludicrous amount on the Nexus black market? I suppose it has some interestin' properties. It speeds you up for a while and such. Very unstable stuff, but some Chua will pay a fortune for it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought you'd be up for a little challenge.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've been such a huge help out here. To be honest, I'm not sure where this operation would be without you. The boys and I all chipped in to get you a token of our appreciation.

localizedTextIdText: On Bloodfire Beach, you find a Coastal Runt being attacked by a Zomclaw Blubber Eater. A Upgraded Cortex{p: Upgraded Cortexes} is nearby. With it, you can choose to trump natural selection and decide who dies and who lives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Elder Torvak in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Before you there is a Coastal Runt and a Zomclaw Blubber Eater. It's up to you to decide whether to save the runt or sacrifice it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've experienced the inner conflict all hunters face. When you kill your prey, you change fate.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have made your choice regarding the Coastal Runt fate. This experience has left you thoughtful. You now view the cycle of life with a different perspective.

localizedTextIdText: You've received a call from a frantic Chua named Scout Furlo on Bloodfire Savannah. He's been swallowed by a wandering Stonetusk mammodin and needs your help to escape before he's digested. Kill Stonetusk mammodin until you find the one that swallowed Scout Furlo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Scout Furlo in Bloodfire Savannah
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your assistance required! Mammodin swallowed me whole! Hurry! Locate beast! Get me out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Rescue successful! Gratitude forthcoming. Smell inside mammodin worse than smell outside mammodin!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Digestion imminent! Quickly!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I collect acid! Acid that burns! You want for reward?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Stonetusk mammodin with Scout Furlo in its stomach and set him free. The relieved Chua thanked you in his own distinctive fashion before scampering away.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How did you get swallowed by a mammodin?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Testing crypsis device. Camouflages a little too well! Mammodin not see difference between me and foliage. Experiment success! Except now stuck in mammodin stomach.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Please reconsider. Not want to die before brother Farlo.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: For facing the inner battle of a hunter and making a choice, I present you with this reward. Remember to honor your prey as you honor yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you've face the primal conflict of a true hunter, Elder Torvak has granted you a gift as a reminder of what you've learned.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: For facing the inner battle of a hunter and making a choice, I present you with this reward. Remember to honor your prey as you honor yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: For having faced the primal conflict of a true hunter, Elder Torvak has granted you a gift as a reminder of what you've learned.

localizedTextIdText: The Moodies that inhabit Deadwind Hollow practice a type of magic considered blasphemous, according to the ancient Draken Blood Covenants. Acting on orders from her master Akilos, Apprentice Laveka has asked you to wipe them out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Apprentice Laveka in Spearclaw Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Master Akilos fears the dark magic of these Moodies, but I do not share his archaic superstitions. Obey his command to destroy them... for now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I feel there is much to be learned from these Moodies, but you must hunt them if we are to discover the truth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Moodies do not seem to fear death, despite their small stature. This tells me much about them, but we must learn more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope to learn more of their powers during your hunt. You shall be my eyes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You decimated the ranks of the Moodies in Deadwind Hollow. Their profane magic will no longer blaspheme the Blood Covenants.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why does Akilos fear the Moodies?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What have you heard about the Moodies' powers?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Akilos is a hidebound fool! Like so many, he lacks the courage to seize true power when he stumbles upon it. I, on the other hand, am much more open-minded.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Only strange whispers - rumors of the dead rising to live again. Another Draken might reject such rumors as black necromancy, but I, for one, am intrigued.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A foolish choice... one you will regret.

localizedTextIdText: The secret of the Moodies' power must lie with their leader, Tamolo, in Deadwind Hollow. Fight him and retrieve $(vitem=74) for Apprentice Laveka.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return $(vitem=74) to Apprentice Laveka at Spearclaw Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If these Moodies truly wield dark and forbidden magic, their leader will possess an artifact to channel it. Kill him, and bring the artifact to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Moodie leader is called Tamolo. I believe he possesses a powerful artifact used to channel dark magic. I must have it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This staff... it calls to me... I can feel the dark powers coursing through it. Thank you for this gift.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I have heard others call the leader "Tamolo." Find him!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Gift? I don't like the sound of that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Tamolo, the Moodie leader, and found $(vitem=74). Apprentice Laveka has shown great interest in your find and wants to study the Moodies' strange magic further.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You fear such a creature? Bah! I will find another to help me!

localizedTextIdText: Bloodshaman Akilos wants you to destroy the Moodies, a group of heretical savages who have settled in Deadwind Hollow. Their days of blasphemous necromancy must end, so he has sent you to aid his apprentice Laveka at Spearclaw Post.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Apprentice Laveka at Spearclaw Post outside of Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bah! Moodies! Their dark, primitive magic is a blasphemy against the sacred Blood Covenants. Aid my apprentice in sweeping them from our lands!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why are you still here? The profane rituals of the Moodies cannot be tolerated! Find my apprentice and aid her in destroying them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Akilos sent you? My master is a blind old fool... but it seems he can still recognize strength. I have need of someone with your talents.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Apprentice Laveka awaits you in a camp outside of Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You offered your services to Apprentice Laveka in fighting the Moodies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do the Blood Covenants say Moodie magic is blasphemous?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Blood Covenants teach us to value strength and life. Moodie magic deals only with weakness and death. Such practices are similar to the forbidden Dark Rites. They must be stamped out wherever they are found!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Dark Rites are practiced only by those who would betray the old ways. We revile them as necroshamans. They also swear oaths and pray to our gods, but they have perverted their powers for their own dark purposes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you fear to strike at creatures such as this, you have no place in Bloodfire Village.

localizedTextIdText: Bloodshaman Akilos needs you to place the trophy skull on the skull pile in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bloodshaman Akilos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The sacred ceremony of the Bloodfeast honors the season of the Great Hunt. When enough trophy skulls are placed on the skull pile, my rituals can begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Place the trophy you recovered on one of the skull pikes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This Bloodfeast will be glorious! A hunter such as you will certainly claim more skulls. Return them to the skull pile, and soon, the ancient rites can begin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not fail me. This ceremony is vital to our people.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll place this trophy on the skull pile.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The gleaming white skull makes a fine addition to the bone pile in Bloodfire Village. When enough skulls are collected, the Bloodfeast will begin.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about the Great Hunt.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Clanlord Makaza has called hunters far and wide to participate in the first Great Hunt on Nexus! It is a celebration of the great gift of Deradune bestowed upon us by Emperor Myrcalus. He has recognized the Draken for their service to the empire!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: There is great strength in blood. To drink of the blood of an enemy, to eat of their flesh, is to take their strength for our own! During the Great Hunt, a Bloodfeast celebrates the strength of the village, as hunters pile their kills sky high and blood runs like wine!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are weak and pathetic. Get out of my sight.

localizedTextIdText: The Luminai noble, Councilor Vaelen, will soon arrive in Deradune for the Great Hunt. Clanlord Makaza has asked you to join him in greeting the Luminai at the Bloodfire Village landing pad.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Clanlord Makaza at the landing pad in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've received word that Councilor Vaelen has arrived. I must go to welcome him to the Great Hunt. You have earned the right to stand by my side.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We must hurry. The Luminai will be arriving soon, and I will not insult him by being late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You should consider this a great honor. It is not every day that a Luminai deigns to visit. Ah! Here he comes now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He is arriving at the village landing pad.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You accompanied Clanlord Makaza and welcomed Councilor Vaelen as he arrived in Bloodfire Village. The Luminai was impressed with the captured Mercenary Arkos. He looks forward to hunting him for sport.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Meet Clanlord Makaza at the Bloodfire Landing Pad
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so special about Councilor Vaelen?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So what is he doing here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Should we be worried about security?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Silence, fool! Do not speak so disrespectfully to one of the Luminai. The blood of the Eldan runs in their veins!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I admit that I wondered the same thing myself. The Luminai seldom show themselves in public. I was... surprised to hear of Councilor Vaelen's intent to join us on our Great Hunt.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Security? Ha! Don't make me laugh. The Bloodfire Clan boasts of the fiercest warriors and most cunning hunters. The village sits in the middle of a vast savannah, where any enemy can be seen approaching from far away. The ICI has sent its best operative, Agent Lex, to ensure nothing threatens my sovereignty. There is no place on Nexus safer than here for a Luminai.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Only a fool refuses a clanlord.

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza has heard of your efforts to bring about a successful Great Hunt and wants to meet with you in the Bloodfire Village Clan Hall.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Clanlord Makaza in the Clan Hall in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Clanlord Makaza has heard of your feats during this Great Hunt and demands your presence in the clan hall. I would not refuse him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The clanlord awaits. I do not recommend that you make him wait long.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My people esteem you as a hunter. Let us see. Help bring the Great Hunt to a successful end, and I shall sing your praises to the emperor himself!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will find him in the great clan hall, seated among his huntresses.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: How can I assist you, Clanlord?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Clanlord Makaza in the Bloodfire Village Clan Hall. He complimented you on your hunting skills and asked you to help him bring the Great Hunt to a successful end.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Surely you jest. Who has not heard of the great Clanlord Makaza, whom the emperor himself has recognized for his service to the Dominion? A fierce warrior and cunning hunter, he governs the territory of Deradune. He has brought great honor to Clan Bloodfire!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare refuse? The old gods do not smile upon such insolence.

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza has heard of your efforts to bring about a successful Great Hunt and wants to meet with you in the Bloodfire Village Clan Hall.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Clanlord Makaza in the Bloodfire Village Clan Hall
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have spoken to Clanlord Makaza about your strength and prowess. He wants to see for himself. I would not keep him waiting.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The clanlord awaits. I do not recommend that you make him wait long.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My people judge you as a hunter. Let us see. Help bring the Great Hunt to a successful end, and I shall sing your praises to the emperor himself!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will find him in the great clan hall, seated among his huntresses.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will report to the clanlord.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: How can I assist you, Clanlord?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Clanlord Makaza in the Clan Hall of Bloodfire Village. He complimented you on your hunting skills and asked you to help him bring the Great Hunt to a successful end.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will report to the clanlord.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't make me laugh. Clanlord Makaza is one of the most powerful Draken in the Dominion, second only to the great General Warbringer! That is why the emperor entrusted him with the territory of Deradune, so he could oversee it on behalf of the Dominion. He has brought great honor to Clan Bloodfire!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are foolish to disobey the wishes of the clanlord.

localizedTextIdText: While on your way to the savannah, you found a perfectly decent skull lying conspicuously on the path. Perhaps Bloodshaman Akilos in Bloodfire Village will know more about this object.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Bloodshaman Akilos in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've found an out-of-place skull lying on the path to the savannah. Perhaps someone in Bloodfire Village will know its purpose.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Perhaps someone in Bloodfire Village will know this skull's purpose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where did you find this? This is a Bloodfeast trophy! Such tribute belongs on a pike at the sacred bone pile.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Bloodfeast is an important rite to sanctify the Great Hunt in the eyes of the Gods.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this skull to the village.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought the $(vitem=696) to Bloodshaman Akilos, who says it's a trophy used for the Draken Bloodfeast ritual.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take this skull to the village.

localizedTextIdText: Bosun Redmark needs able-bodied new arrivals to help rescue other survivors from the yeti north of the crash site. After that, report to Deadeye Brightland at the refugee camp beneath the Ancient Tower.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland at the Ancient Tower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Head down the hill toward that tower. If you find any survivors, help 'em out. And take care. That crash riled up the local yeti somethin' fierce!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Help anyone you can on your way down the mountain. We all gotta pull together now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's still people out there that need savin'! Come back after you've lent 'em a hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to see another Exile up on two feet. We're gonna have to pull together if we're gonna get out of this alive.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Check in with Deadeye Brightland when you're done.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't ever give up. It ain't the Exile way.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll do what I can to help out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it through the storm to the Ancient Tower after rescuing many survivors.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll do what I can to help out.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're big, mean, hairy critters. Not sure how they act normally, but right now, they're stirred up like a swarm of angry buzzbings.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Beats me, but I reckon there ain't as many as I'd like. Help the ones you can. We'll get to the dead soon enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You gotta be kiddin' me!

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has asked you to assist with rescuing survivors from yeti in the woods. Afterwards, report to Deadeye Brightland at the base camp near the Ancient Tower.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland at the Ancient Tower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Crash survivors are scattered all around here. The yeti are killing and eating 'em. You gotta get out there and keep 'em safe!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Need me to hold your hand? Get outta here! I don't wanna lose any more survivors to those damn yeti!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's still people out there that need savin'! Come back after you've lent 'em a hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a sight for sore eyes! We sure could use your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you're done, check in with Deadeye Brightland.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't ever give up. It ain't the Exile way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your efforts, many survivors made it to safety. Since then, you've arrived at the Ancient Tower and reported to Deadeye Brightland.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Sir, I'm on my way, sir!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll be back in a bit.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're an indigenous species in Northern Wilds. They're big, mean, and, worst of all, hungry. You gotta show 'em who's boss.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We don't have an accurate count, but the longer you sit here jawing at me, the more of 'em will get eaten by those blasted yeti!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You think you got some kinda choice? Huh?

localizedTextIdText: The malfunctioning control panel appears to contain damaged crystals. Perhaps following these cables to their source outside Exo-Lab 729 will lead to a suitable replacement.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Interact with the Master Control Panel inside the Ancient Tower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Several power cables snake their way outside of the tower. Perhaps following these cables to their source will reveal a cache of replacement crystals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The master control panel needs replacement crystals, so it can activate the tower's weather controls.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The crystal shards click into place in the control panel. With the turn of a single dial, the temperature begins to rise.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That should warm this place up!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured to Exo-Lab 729 and collected $m(vitem=206) to restore the Ancient Tower. With the tower stabilized, the weather around it has quickly changed! The survivors should have an easier time now that the weather around Settler's Reach is warming.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll need to find some crystals.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Interact with the Master Control Panel

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland plans to lead a desperate frontal assault against the Dominion forces targeting Settler's Reach. Penetrate the Dominion lines and destroy Dominion Cannon in Camp Icefury, so Brightland's charge will succeed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion's made this personal, and they're goin' to pay for it in blood! You reckon you can get behind their lines and take out them cannons?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sadie's blood ain't even cold, and you're standin' here jawin' at me? Best get on them cannons 'fore I get angry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did a helluva job on those cannons. They'll be chokin' on their own blood soon enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll organize a frontal assault, and we'll be ready for your signal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You snuck behind enemy lines and destroyed Dominion Cannon in Camp Icefury, allowing Deadeye Brightland to lead a successful assault against the Dominion in Northern Wilds.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the cannons.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are you going to be okay?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Those cannons are the only thing keepin' us from runnin' 'em outta Northern Wilds. They'll fight like demons to keep 'em firin'!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The ashes of my son and my wife are scattered across this frozen hellhole. Now look me in the eye and ask me that question again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sadie's blood ain't even cold yet. Care to rethink that?

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Tongo of a nearby Chua collective has heard of your abilities and could use your help. You can find him in the Feralplain Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Overseer Tongo at the Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've made big name here. Yes, big name! And big skills! We require your skills. Come to Feralplain Collective. Promise you lots of work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Am overseer of this collective. Make sure work gets done. You help us, more work gets done. Now get to work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make haste! No time for smelling flowers!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Research must be researched. Tasks must be completed. Death must be avoided. If you're lucky, that is.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've agreed to help the Feralplain Collective. Between running a wildlife preserve (strictly for testing purposes) and typical Chua experiments, they have their hands full.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Meet Overseer Tongo at the Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Disappointing. Very disappointing.

localizedTextIdText: Huntress Kezzia mentioned the Feralplain Chua collective could use some help. Head to the Feralplain Collective and speak to Overseer Tongo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Overseer Tongo at the Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Feralplain Chua collective to requires aid. I do not have the time for Chua problems, but you might. Speak with Overseer Tongo when you get there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Kezzia sent you? Draken huntress not so useless after all. Much work to be done! Lots of testing! Lots of research. Some explosions, too.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will offer them a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've agreed to help the Feralplain Collective. Between running a wildlife preserve (strictly for testing purposes) and typical Chua experiments, they have their hands full.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Very well. I am not particularly fond of the Chua.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex wants to know what the Aurin are doing in Deradune. Venture into Wildwood Grove and kill any Aurin you encounter. The datachrons you collect from their bodies will be used for data analysis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must learn what the Aurin are doing here. Venture into Wildwood Grove and target the Aurin there. Collect datachrons from their bodies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must collect as much intelligence as possible from these Aurin. Kill them and take their datachrons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. I will have these datachrons analyzed immediately. In the meantime, I have more work for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The key to any successful mission is reconnaissance.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They will regret ever coming here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected datachrons from Aurin in Wildwood Grove and turned them over to Agent Lex for analysis.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: An unfortunate choice.

localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is the map data we're looking for. Soon we'll have all of Northern Wilds mapped.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll show Stern Forester the map.

localizedTextIdText: You received a call from Bloodshaman Kuraz asking for your help. He is concerned that not all is well inEndless Vigil, the sacred Draken boneyard in Deradune. He has asked you to speak withCairnguard Drakuz in the Ancestral Cairns to learn more about recent disturbances.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Cairnguard Drakuz in the Ancestral Cairns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have heard your name spoken many a time, $(player.name). Your help is needed in Endless Vigil. Speak with Cairnguard Drakuz there. He will know more.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak with Cairnguard Drakuz in Endless Vigil. He knows more of the darkness I speak of. Find him and aid him if you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Kuraz sent you? Yes, the old bloodshaman feels it too. A nameless darkness lies heavy over Endless Vigil. And then there are the Moodies....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I fear for the worst.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have spoken to Cairnguard Drakuz in the ancestral cairns. He, too, feels that something is wrong in Endless Vigil.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dishonor the dead with your refusal.

localizedTextIdText: DRED Tech Farlo was inspired by the surrounding tar pits and has created new DRED technology called the Glop Gun. He's asked you to test it on creatures in Leviathan's Rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to DRED Tech Farlo near Leviathan's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Something very wrong here. Skeletons turned into robots. So I think of way to slow skeledroids down. Made Glop Gun. Shoots tar! Go on, test out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Glop Gun great for slowing down enemies. Point, pull trigger. See? Easy! Even for idiot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glop Gun success! Guess being stuck in tar pits not so bad. Except for homicidal skeletons. I find solution for that too. Eventually.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stick it to the skeledroids! Are they dead? Are they alive? Doesn't matter. Still slowed down!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bah. Found only one drawback of Glop Gun: nozzle pain in tail to clean properly!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: DRED Tech Farlo Glop Gun proved to be a handy tool as you navigated through the tar swamps nearLeviathan's Rest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not help? Then maybe I test gun on you!

localizedTextIdText: It looks as if thieving Moodies have accidentally scattered Draken bones all around Witchwake Ridge. Find any other bones and return them to their proper resting place in the Ancestral Cairns.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Cairnguard Drakuz in the Ancestral Carins
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This bone looks like it was taken from the cairns at Endless Vigil. Cairnguard Drakuz will appreciate it if you return it, along with any others you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You say you found Draken bones lying discarded outside Endless Vigil? This cannot be! Collect the bones and return them to me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have returned the remains of our dead to their proper resting places. For that, I am thankful.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have recovered a number of bones from Witchwake Ridge and returned them to their proper resting places at Endless Vigil.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland, a survivor who has taken charge at the crash site, asked you to find a way to shut down the Ancient Tower that seems to be causing the massive snowstorm!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Interact with the Master Control Panel inside the Ancient Tower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That tower's at the eye of the storm. I'm guessin' it's causin' this weather. See if you can shut that thing down before my pregnant wife freezes to death!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get to the tower. That thing's sittin' smack in the eye of the storm. It's gotta be the cause!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This control panel appears damaged.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The control panel is not functioning. Several power-regulating crystals appear to be missing. You'll need replacements.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: See if you can get this sussed out, friend.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have to find some crystals.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Upon your arrival at the Ancient Tower, you discovered its inhibitor systems had broken down. You have to find a way to shut it down!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Interact with the Master Control Panel
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How can you be sure the tower's causing this?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Folks call me Deadeye. I used to be a gunslinger on the Fringe, but I've settled down a touch since I got married.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I can't be, but just look at the thing. It's got "trouble" written all over it. We need to get this storm under control.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't the time to be givin' me lip.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland sent a survivor named Scientist Lusk to find supplies in the forest outside Settler's Reach. Shortly afterward, Lusk reported finding a tribe of feral Skeech near Coldburrow Cavern, but since then, he hasn't checked in.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Bartol Sunward at Settler's Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Friend a' mine named Lusk went out to gather supplies from the forest, but he ain't checked in since reportin' a big tribe of Skeech nearby. You wanna check it out?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Just find out what those blasted Skeech did with Lusk. This whole thing gives me a bad feeling.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Can't say just how grateful we are. These folks owe their lives to you. You'll be well remembered, my friend.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lusk's not one to miss a comm call. Somethin' stinks.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find out where Lusk is.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I only wish I could have saved more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were too late to save Scientist Lusk from the monstrous Skeech, but you were able to rescue most of his companions from being cooked and eaten.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: He's a scientist... studied biology or some such nonsense. I figured he'd know better'n most folks what's edible and what ain't.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Hell no. I sent a group of survivors with him. If it was just one man, I wouldn't be so worried, but a group of folks? That's somethin' else.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You ain't heard of Skeech? They're ugly little monsters that'll cook 'n' eat anyone they can get their grubby little hands on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You want to try answerin' that question again?

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland is taking the fight to Camp Icefury, the main Dominion garrison in Northern Wilds. He's asked you to meet him there just as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland at Camp Icefury
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion's cut its own throat. I'm gonna make damn sure they're all layin' in frozen graves 'fore this day's out. You with me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I'm takin' the fight to the Dominion. They're gonna answer for what they done to Sadie and my boy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm takin' the fight to the Dominion. They're gonna answer for what they done to Sadie and my boy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You finally made it. Good. It's time to give these Dominion maggots a taste of their own medicine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then get your keister over here, and make it quick.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Deadeye Brightland near Camp Icefury and offered him your help in avenging the death of his wife and child.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The cowards are holed up in a place called Camp Icefury. They've got lots of artillery and troops... even an Ultrabot! It's gonna get messy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I'm workin' on it. Should have the details sussed out by the time you get your butt to my location. Speakin' of which, you comin' or not?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I ain't askin' again, friend. I'll do it by myself if I got to.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland at Settler's Reach would like to speak to you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Deadeye Brightland at Settler's Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that things are warmin' up, we should make camp and get ready for the worst. No tellin' how long a rescue party might take to get here.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Like I said, we sure could use a hand setting up camp at Settler's Reach.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Like I said, we sure could use a hand setting up camp at Settler's Reach.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad you're still willin' to help out. We got a lot of work ahead of us if our people are gonna pull through this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I sure do appreciate your help.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not afraid of hard work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Deadeye Brightland has asked for your help setting up a temporary camp in the Northern Wilds that can protect the survivors until rescue arrives.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You think they'll send a rescue?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There's a lot of work that needs doin' and not enough able bodies to get it done. I'll give you details when you get to Settler's Reach.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I'm sure they will. The kicker is, they need to know we're here if we ever want to get out of this winter wonderland.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you want us all to get outta here alive, you better change your tune.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland at Settler's Reach wants you to set off the Signal Flare at the landing site outside of camp, signaling the rescue ships from Thayd that it's safe to land.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Finally got through to Thayd. Rescue ships are on the way. I need you to set off the signal flares and give 'em the all-clear to land.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The signal flares are just outside the camp. Set 'em off so the ships know it's safe to land!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The signal flares are just south of the camp. Set them off so the ships know it's safe to land!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: No! Damn the Dominion! Damn 'em all to hell! Sadie... my wife... was aboard that ship!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry! I don't want these folks on the ground any longer'n they need to be.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll set off the signal flares.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The Dominion will pay for this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Disaster has struck! The Dominion initiated a cowardly sneak attack against the escaping survivors, destroying their shuttle seconds after takeoff! Sadly, Deadeye Brightland wife, Sadie Brightland, and her unborn child are numbered amongst the dead.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll set off the signal flares.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll set off the signal flares.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What are the odds of that?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Soon enough, but it can't land unless we light the flares 'round the landin' zone. Last thing we need is that rescue ship crashin', too.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Given our luck of late, pretty damned high. I need to see to my wife. She's in a motherly sort of way. Get out there and do your job.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't the time or place to be shirkin' your duty.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A recent avalanche overwhelmed many survivors in this area. You see a hand emerge from the snow, grasping for help. Save the survivor before it's too late!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get you out of there!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll get you out of there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and rescued an Exile who was buried by an avalanche in Northern Wilds.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This soldier's corpse is badly battered and completely frozen. In his journal, he wrote about his wife and their hopes for settling down on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Trooper Renzo, an Exile survivor who apparently succumbed to exposure in Northern Wilds, left behind a journal. It speaks fondly of the young widow he has left behind. Will she ever know of his fate or how he met it?

localizedTextIdText: Test NPC wants you to collect 3 Eggs
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do me a favor...please gather up 3 eggs for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still waiting...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great!  Thank you for these.

localizedTextIdText: NPC wants you to kill 3 Groups of Girrok
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Let NPC know of your deed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Please... Kill the 3 packs of ...those...things...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please don't tell me you're quitting?!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The village will be happy to hear of your achievement.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Anything I can do to help.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek needs you to gather supplies that were lost in the crash. He believes they're scattered on the ground outside of Settler's Reach.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Durek at Settler's Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Word is we got rescue ships on the way, but we need supplies for the wounded right now. Head out to the debris field and see what you can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: See if you can scrounge up some supplies in the debris field. It'll be a while before a rescue party gets here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll make sure these people get what they need. I don't want anyone else dying on my watch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You got a lotta folks countin' on this. Don't screw it up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your efforts, the crash survivors now have some badly needed blankets and supplies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My name's Commander Durek. I'm in charge of FCON and the rest of the Exile military, and that means I'm leadin' this rescue mission. Got it, recruit?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't no picnic, cupcake. You either help, or we all get slagged.

localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A Dominion base? This is bad, $2n. Oh, we'll fight 'em, make no mistake, but by the stars, it won't be easy.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Marcus suspects that interviewing the people of Hycrest in Auroria will reveal clues about the plague's origins. You should speak to citizens throughout the city.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Marcus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's up to us to learn the truth. Your best bet is to start with the citizens of Hycrest. Speak to them and see what they know. I'll do the same.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Well? Have you found the source of these rumors? Speak to the people of Hycrest and see what you can learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well? Have you found the source of these rumors? Speak to the people of Hycrest and see what you can learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Something is definitely wrong. It is as if there are outside forces working against us....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will contact you soon. Marcus, out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I think it is time we met to compare notes.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can dig up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Agent Marcus questioned several Hycrest citizens about rumors of the plague in Auroria. Marcus wants to meet and compare notes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That was not a request.

localizedTextIdText: A mysterious figure, Master Rodaeus, has been captured after a failed attempt to assassinate you and Agent Marcus in Auroria. Rodaeus has been taken to the Hycrest Barracks in Hycrest to be interrogated. Perhaps you could convince him to confess.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Governor Aluviel in the Hycrest Interrogation Center below the barracks in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good job getting that louse to surrender. He'll be taken to the barracks for interrogation. Why don't you go question him while I clean up here?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you interrogated the prisoner yet? What are you waiting for? Time is short, and our people are dying!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you speaking to me, citizen? Your prisoner is awaiting his... interview... at the barracks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a filthy business that was... but a necessary one. At least he revealed the basis for a cure. Soon, the people of Hycrest will be well again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Have no mercy. The lives of thousands hang in the balance.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are a true hero of the Dominion. I will not forget your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Under interrogation deep within the Hycrest Barracks in Hycrest, Master Rodaeus has revealed the basis for a cure to the plague sweeping through Auroria. Good work!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will interrogate him, never fear.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will interrogate him, my lord.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Even after all this, you are a useless worm.

localizedTextIdText: Chua collectives are usually run by a Chua inventor. Sergeant Kormak thinks that if you take him out, the collective will have a tough time operating in Algoroc. You should be able to find the Chua inventor inside the cave in DREDplex: Skyhammer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Kormak at Jeric's Claim
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: No Dominion science operation gets by without a big inventor runnin' things. I want you to find the Chua givin' the orders and put a bullet in him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find and grease the Chua inventor runnin' their collective. I'd do it, but someone's gotta stay behind to fill out registration forms for your graves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find and grease the Chua inventor runnin' their collective. I'd do it, but someone's gotta stay behind to fill out registration forms for your graves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I like yer style, pal. Bet those fuzzy little creeps didn't expect that!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Without a leader, those stinkin' slanks are sure to fold!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Too bad the day isn't over.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took out Inventor Hoom and disrupted his collective to the point of collapse. Good work getting some payback for the Exiles in Algoroc!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You afraid of some overgrown slank, $(player.name)?

localizedTextIdText: Your allies are reporting sightings of an incoming Marauder ship just outside Deadstar Ravine. It looks like your business with the Deadstar Marauders wasn't quite finished.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What the... you hear that? Hit the deck!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What the hell you doin' here?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's Thokov's ship, the Skull's Eye. Looks like he's back to settle the score. I figure he's landin' to load ammunition, but it won't take long.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We got incoming!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I've got a bad feeling about this!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Captain Thokov and the Deadstar Marauders are back... and they want revenge!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't the time to slack off!

localizedTextIdText: You've been asked to test a weapon that uses loftite as ammunition. A field test against Dominion forces in the Crystal Shards should do the trick.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kormak via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Up for a little shootin'? I got this new gun I need tested. Uses experimental loftite ammo. I ain't sure what to expect, but it should be interesting!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: How's the loftite gun handle? You done any testin' yet? I can't wait to hear yer results, champ.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Whatcha got there, $(player.name)? Is that some kinda experimental gun? I hope you're testing it on the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did Grimdred let you try out that loftite railgun? Hot damn! How'd it work for ya? I've been wantin' to try out that baby for weeks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Try it out on some of the Dommies in the Crystal Shards. See what happens!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I ain't never seen anything like this before. Ha!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've figured out how to use the Skug Pheromone Gland on Dominion troops in the Crystal Shards. You might say it was an uplifting experience... for, uh, them, that is, and only for a little while.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine. Tell ya what, pal... I'll test it and get all the credit.

localizedTextIdText: Get aboard the Skull's Eye! Find Thokov, the ship's captain, and stop him before he destroys Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Deadeye Brightland in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen! I can get us on board that ship if you can meet me there. I'd recommend you get movin'.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We ain't got time to discuss this. Now get on that ship, and do it now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What the hell you talkin' to me for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As you might've guessed, there was some bad blood 'tween me and Thokov. Someday, I'll tell you the story. For now, you mind your own business, and I'll just say thanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'd better be right about how quick you move. Now get goin'!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Captain Thokov and drove the Deadstar Marauders from Tremor Ridge. Good work!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Chill out. I'm on top of it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm about ready to put one between yer eyes, friend.

localizedTextIdText: The Chua inventor has the designs for some kind of secret weapon stored in his laboratory. Find the datacenters holding all data connected to DREDplex: Skyhammer and steal the plans; otherwise, the weapon may pose a serious threat to the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kormak via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown:
Project Sky Hammer welcomes you!
Network currently unavailable.
Project details viewable at terminals throughout laboratory.
DRED eyes only!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Network currently unavailable!\nUse other terminals in facility to view project details.\nDRED watching!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Chua are storin' some kinda secret weapon plans on their network, huh? The brass will wanna see that. Better get in there and steal it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll be damned. That Sky Hammer project was for real! The commander'll be happy to have these plans - and happier the Chua don't know we got 'em.
