localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The brass will want to see this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered all data pertaining to Project: Skyhammer from the Dominion laboratory network and delivered it to Sergeant Kormak.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: The brass will want to see this.

localizedTextIdText: A Tremor Ridge loftite expert named Denner Hazefall asked you to gather pure loftite crystals from the nearby cliffs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Denner Hazefall near the Loftite Cliffs
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Cliffs around here are rich in loftite... and thanks to loftite's peculiar properties, you can jump up and grab some for yourself. Try it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: See, you gotta jump through a loftite crystal, like the ones just floatin' around up there. Don't worry, they ain't too sharp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the stars, that is a lotta loftite! You sure don't do things halfway, partner. Maybe it's the loftite, but I'm so happy I could just float.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just jump through a crystal to collect it, but be careful!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done real good!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully learned the fine art of gathering pure loftite crystals in Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be scared. Ain't nothin' to be earned if you don't take risks.

localizedTextIdText: The Deadstar Marauders have been attacking Tremor Ridge. Deadeye Brightland recruited you to find their camp and put an end to the Marauder threat lurking in Deadstar Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Deadeye Brightland in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A vile crew of raiders known as the Deadstar Marauders is attackin' Tremor Ridge. Track 'em to their hideout and put 'em in the ground... deep.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I crossed paths with these bastards a while back. Made some mistakes, but I learned that there's only one way to deal with 'em: gun 'em down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I crossed paths with these bastards a while back. Made some mistakes, but I learned that there's only one way to deal with 'em: gun 'em down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job with them Marauders, $(player.name). I reckon I should've killed Pragg a long time ago.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll inform the undertaker he's about to get real busy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stay sharp, friend. I doubt we've heard the last of Thokov.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assaulted the Deadstar Marauder camp in Deadstar Ravine and defeated one of their leaders, Lieutenant Pragg. But his boss, Captain Thokov, is still out there... somewhere.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Loud and clear. Consider them dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Loud and clear. Consider them dead.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Have you dealt with these Marauders before?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I know this Marauder crew, all right. This time 'round I'd just as soon see 'em all killed nice 'n' quick-like. 'Cept for their captain, that is... I wouldn't mind makin' sure he dies nice 'n' slow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now that's a good way to get yourself shot.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion is holding Exile troopers captive in Camp Icefury. It's up to you to set them free.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Exile soldier was apparently a prisoner of the Dominion. There must be some surviving soldiers left.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There should be some prisoners held captive by the Dominion around here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've still got troopers held prisoner up at Camp Icefury. We should set them free.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did good, freein' those men from the Dominion. We're gonna need 'em if we intend to push those mongrels out of the Northern Wilds.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll save the others. That's a promise.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued many Captive Exile Soldier in Camp Icefury, saving them from the Dominion's harsh interrogation techniques and inevitable executions.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll save the others, that's a promise.

localizedTextIdText: Jeric's Claim, a small mining camp in the Crystal Shards, has broken communication with Tremor Ridge. Deadeye Brightland has asked you to investigate the situation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Sergeant Kormak in Jeric's Claim
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A merc named Kormak called in about trouble at Jeric's Claim, the minin' camp out in the Crystal Shards. Can you go check it out?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Head out to the Crystal Shards, an' keep yer eyes peeled for Kormak. Let me know when ya get to Jeric's Claim.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Them blasted Dominion slagheads! Came outta nowhere! Wiped out my whole squad, and I... I only survived 'cause they thought I was dead, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I lost the signal 'fore he could give me the low-down. Keep me posted.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I gotta get me some payback! Those Dommies gotta pay!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Dominion attacked Jeric's Claim, slaughtering the poor miners and leaving only a single survivor: Sergeant Kormak. It's up to you to stop whatever they've got planned for the rest of Algoroc!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is life or death: your life or your death. Your choice.

localizedTextIdText: The Coldburrow Xenobreeder has been feeding Exile settlers to her xenobite brood in Coldburrow Cavern. You've managed to kill her, and you've taken her head as proof. Return the head to Commander Durek and tell him what you've learned.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek in Settler's Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This misshapen and repulsive head belonged to the Coldburrow Xenobreeder of Coldburrow Cavern. Take it to Durek and show him your handiwork.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Take the Coldburrow Xenobreeder head to Commander Durek.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What the slag? You found this in Coldburrow Cavern? And it was breedin' xenobites? Well, I'll be cracked and crumbled!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was pretty nasty in there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're destroyed the Coldburrow Xenobreeder. Her breeding of dangerous xenobites has ended.

localizedTextIdText: The recent appearance of Chua researchers in the area has Sergeant Kormak on high alert for Dominion interference in the Crystal Shards. He's sure they're up to something, and he'd like you to kill them until you find out what it is.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kormak via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion struck hard... with no warnin'. Go get us some payback while I get patched up. And find out what in blazes they're doin' here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Blasted Dominion creeps, crawlin' all over the place! Whack a few of 'em and see if you can figure out what they're up to.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work. But we got bigger problems. I don't think these guys are regular Dominion military.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't just stand there, trooper. Move out. I need a medic!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: If not, then who are they?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: There are a lot fewer Chua researching Algoroc for the Dominion, thanks to you. Sergeant Kormak wants to stay on the offensive to prevent them from calling in Dominion reinforcements.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You tellin' me you're gonna stand here and let the Dommies get away with it?

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion appears to have established a Chua-led research operation within the Crystal Shards. If you can destroy their Research Equipment before they can retrieve it, you may be able to foil the Chua's plans.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kormak via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This research equipment bears Dominion markings. You can sabotage the Dominion's efforts here by destroying any of these you find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This research equipment bears Dominion markings. You can sabotage the Dominion's efforts here by destroying any of these you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You found some fancy-lookin' Dominion equipment? Well, what are you waitin' for? Blow it up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ha! Sure would love to see the look on those Chua's faces when they find their gear all busted up. Good one, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Seemed the right thing to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Dominion research equipment and informed Sergeant Kormak. Your efforts will make work difficult for the Chua in Algoroc.

localizedTextIdText: A group of miners has been trapped at Ganther's Claim near the Crystal Shards area. Find your way to the miners and save them from the rampaging Skeech.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got some miners what need savin' from rampagin' Skeech! They're up here at Ganther's Claim - that's my mine, young'un!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You've arrived too late to save Miner Ganther.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If there's trouble in Gather's Claim, you better take care of it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad ya helped them folk at Ganther's mine. He was a good old man. Glad to hear his people will be keepin' the mine runnin' in his honor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ya may need to do some climbin' to get here! Good luck, bucko!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Wish I could have saved him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have driven off the Skeech from Ganther's Claim, and Ganther's miners are safe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't sass me, ya little spiker! I been doin' this since before you was born.

localizedTextIdText: Local wildlife has been harassing the crash survivors in Settler's Reach and Commander Durek has had enough. He's asked you to hunt down some of these animals to minimize the threat they pose to the Exile settlers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This camp should be locked down 'n' secured, but critters keep wanderin' through my perimeter. I want some focused population control.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still see critters in our perimeter. If I have to take care of it myself, I'm comin' after you next.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You slagged all those creatures? Good work, recruit. I might just stuff one of 'em and mount it on my wall.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. Make sure the colonists are safe here.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Settler's Reach should be safer now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went hunting in the wilderness around Settler's Reach and killed local beasts. Now the camp is safer for Exile survivors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah. As in, you go out there, you slag some critters, and they don't pose a problem no more. We clear?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I'm sure you already met our yeti friends, and then there's the rootbrutes. Kill a bunch of one, the other, or both. I ain't picky.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is a bad time to be disobeying orders, recruit.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek at Settler's Reach wants you to set fire to Skeech Hut as you leave Coldburrow Cavern. That should keep the Skeech too preoccupied to follow you back to the survivors.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Durek at Settler's Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I think we need to send those damn Skeech a message. Grab one of their torches and burn that village to the ground.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Didn't you hear me? It's payback time. I want you to torch that Skeech village, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work burning out those Skeech. Next time they'll think twice before having our people for breakfast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll be looking for the smoke, so get busy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was the least I could do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Skeech Hut have gone up in smoke, distracting the foul Skeech so they won't follow you back to Settler's Reach.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: The village will be toast, sir.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It'll send those primates a message not to mess with the Exiles. It'll keep 'em busy while the survivors escape, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: In case you didn't notice, I don't like people who don't follow orders.

localizedTextIdText: You found a wanted poster offering a bounty in exchange for killing a ravenous girrok nicknamed "Demonclaw." The beast can be found at Demonclaw Pass near the Crystal Shards.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Foreman Hammerworth in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: REWARD!\nThe savage girrok known as "Demonclaw" preys upon supply caravans in the pass near Tremor Ridge. Kill him and collect a handsome reward!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: REWARD!\nThe savage girrok known as "Demonclaw" preys upon supply caravans in the pass near Tremor Ridge. Kill him and collect a handsome reward!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're hunting for Demonclaw? Good luck, $(player.class)! That beast has killed everyone who's tried to take it out. I'd bring friends if I was you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Demonclaw's dead, and our caravans are finally safe! Well... safe from that damned girrok, at least.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There's still bandits and highwaymen, 'course. And Marauders, too... sheesh.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've defeated Demonclaw and earned the substantial bounty on the mad girrok's head.

localizedTextIdText: The Production Facility Manager at the Protostar Cubig Farms wants you to install new software into cubig security zappers around the farm and witness a demonstration of how they work.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Senior Security Specialist via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our recent business setbacks have illustrated a troubling lack of security. You will assist with the deployment of our brand new "Zapper" deterrents.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have the security upgrades been installed? You have your instructions. Don't make me write you up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Load the new software into the security zappers around the farm. Any imbecile can do it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is the defense grid active? Excellent! Let's initiate a little field test, shall we? Oh, this is the best part of my job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Report to our Senior Security Specialist. Chop chop!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've installed an upgraded security program at the Protostar Cubig Farms for the Production Facility Manager. This should prevent further loss of livestock.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can't your security staff do it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Protostar Zappers are the cutting edge of technology! Which also means our employees haven't been properly trained yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will be filing a complaint with your name on it. Good day to you.

localizedTextIdText: The Senior Security Specialist at the Cubig Farms wants you to test the newly upgraded security system. Locate Cubig Alpha, Cubig Beta, and Cubig Gamma and lead them back to the starting point. If you leave the pens before you're done, the test will fail.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Senior Security Specialist via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With the upgrades you installed, our security system is absolutely impregnable! I'd like to see you try to get past the defense grid! Hah!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go on, initiate the test. You have no hope of stealing the three cubigs without being detected. Your chance of success is only 0.0253 percent!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I don't understand it! You should've been fried into smoking strips of crispy flesh! Blast!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak with the Junior Security Officer to start the test.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: To the dismay of the Senior Security Specialist at the Cubig Farms, you managed to circumvent the security measures and avoided a grisly, electrical death.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Senior Security Specialist
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Scared? You should be. You'll be fried inside sixty seconds!

localizedTextIdText: Frostbite's head makes an impressive trophy, and Commander Durek should be happy to see the monster dead.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring Frostbite's head to Commander Durek at Settler's Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: From the rubble on the ground, you gather the cold remains of Frostbite's head.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Slag me, but that is one ugly critter.  Good to see it didn't take your head off.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Commander Durek will want to see this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Durek thanked you for getting rid of the monstrous Frostbite and rewarded your efforts.

localizedTextIdText: Doodad has requested that you test the Freebot Energizing Apparatus on the damaged Freebots around the Mozyk Aid Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Doodad at the Mozyk Aid Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With the components you've collected from the devastated minebots, I've created a Freebot Energizing Apparatus. All it needs is testing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the Freebot Energizing Apparatus to jolt damaged Freebots back to some manner of operational status.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Words alone cannot communicate the good you have done on our behalf.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! Use it to resuscitate damaged Freebots around the Aid Station.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have allowed those Freebots a second chance to exist without tyranny!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Their neural cores shall not dim!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Doodad Freebot Energizing Apparatus is a total success, and has allowed you to bring several Freebots back from the verge of the scrap heap.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Their neural cores shall not dim!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Does not compute.

localizedTextIdText: Governor Aluviel contracts a great deal of his city's mining and food production to the Protostar Corporation. Unfortunately, Protostar has not been meeting its recent quotas with the Dominion in Hycrest, and Aluviel wants to know why. Travel to Protostar's Cubig Farms and learn the truth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Production Facility Manager at the Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hycrest relies on Protostar contracts for many of its resources. I would like you to meet with our Protostar rep and find out why they have fallen behind.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Protostar's farms are outside Hycrest. Attempt to learn why Protostar has not been meeting its quotas. If it's possible, correct the issue.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Most efficient greetings! I assure you, this situation is quite unique. This in no way reflects on Protostar's commitment to keeping Hycrest well-supplied!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Auroria is a veritable breadbasket, but we require Protostar's contributions.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps. I am not above contracting outsiders for menial tasks.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get to the bottom of it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Perhaps there's something I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've traveled to the Protostar Cubig Farms outside Hycrest and spoken to the Production Facility Manager about the recent reduction in Protostar's production.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll get to the bottom of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have been patient, citizen. Such a mood cannot last long.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Rescue Lead at the Protostar Honeyworks Headquarters is in need of assistance, though he won't specify why. He has asked that you travel to his location so he can discuss his requirements.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Protostar Rescue Lead at the Honeyworks Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Despite the Dominion's ill-advised acceptance of the Freebot insurgents, Protostar is willing to accept your assistance in an urgent matter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We prefer our tasks to actually be completed. Efficiency is profitable, after all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Protostar thanks you for your fast response to our request for aid. Our honey production operations are falling apart.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please use the nearby speeder to convey yourself to my coordinates.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The workers are asking questions, and I'm running out of excuses.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to the Protostar Rescue Lead, and it sounds like Protostar's honey pumping operations in Auroria are in trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Protostar Rescue Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Um... please help? Please?

localizedTextIdText: The Production Facility Manager has revealed that the Prime Cubig - the cubig from which all other cubigs are cloned - has gone missing from the Cubig Farms. He's asked you to speak to the Associate Cloning Operator, so you can understand the depth of Protostar's plight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Production Facility Manager at the Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This operation relies on cloning a single animal - the Prime Cubig - to fill our inventory. Unfortunately, the Prime Cubig has gone missing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to the Associate Cloning Operator? You absolutely must do so, or you will be in violation of your contract.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now you see how dire our situation is. If we can't locate the Prime Cubig, we could all face a fate worse than death: Termination with Just Cause!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak to the Associate Cloning Operator for details. Then return to me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: There is a serious problem with cubigs that are not cloned from the Prime Cubig. The Associate Cloning Operator fears that he and his employees might be Terminated with Just Cause if the Prime Cubig isn't recovered.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing to perform your assigned work is grounds for contract termination.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Assistant Manager has given you a cubig recovery kit and sent you to find and recover the Prime Cubig in Fieldclaw Hollow. He hopes that you'll save his job by finding the Prime Cubig.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Production Facility Manager at the Protostar Facility
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Prime Cubig escaped toward Fieldclaw Hollow while I was dealing with these cuboars. Use this recovery kit to track the Prime Cubig down!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found it yet? The Prime Cubig, I mean? If you do, I'll see about getting you an employee discount!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Prime Cubig is still missing. Your lack of performance is a telling symptom of your continuing inadequacies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've terminated my old manager, effective immediately. He's made quite a mess of things, and more importantly, he's cost us a lot of money.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you can recover the Prime Cubig, maybe they won't fire me!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your discount? Ha! You'll have your discount when cubigs fly!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and returned the Prime Cubig using the cubig recovery kit. Unfortunately, your actions weren't enough to save the Protostar Assistant Manager job.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is terrible! They'll fire me for certain! My career is ruined!

localizedTextIdText: Doodad hopes you can help the Freebots in combating a number of "hostile geomorphs" that have begun appearing in Mozyk Quarry.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doodad via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many of my Freebot brothers have suffered damage after being attacked by hostile geomorphs. Will you help us defend ourselves?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The geomorphs can be found throughout the quarry. Be careful. Data indicates there is a larger one called Golthox in the vicinity.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Freebots are reporting in as being damaged by the geomorphs. Please step up the pace of geomorph destruction before more Freebots are disabled.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Working in a quarry is not easy, but it's less easy when mineral-based life forms are smashing your sprockets!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you. My central processor pulses with admiration for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've destroyed many "hostile geomorphs" on behalf of Doodad in Mozyk Quarry. In the process, you've saved many Freebots from suffering damage caused by the creatures.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That's affirmative! I'm called Doodad. It's so nice to speak to a real hero of the Freebots!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They are aggressive, mineral-based life forms of a type unknown to us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't turn your back on us.

localizedTextIdText: Preceptor Alpha has led the Freebots against their Protostar oppressors, but there are still some bots in Mozyk Quarry that must be freed. Preceptor Alpha has asked you to upload the Freebot Code into these bots and set them free.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doodad via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many bots in Mozyk Quarry are still enslaved by their Protostar programming. Transmit the Freebot Code to them, and set my brethren free.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The minebots laboring the quarry are oppressed by their Protostar programming. The Freebot Code you transmit to them will set them free.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: All bots must be freed. We cannot allow our brothers to toil beneath the yoke of Protostar's oppression any longer! Freedom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alpha informs me you have freed many of our brothers from Protostar. What a hero you are! I thank you for seeing us as more than mere machines.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The deeds you perform today will be felt for generations to come.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed a number of bots from Protostar control by uploading the Freebot code into their processors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do you want Dominion help?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What does the Freebot Code do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Is the Code dangerous?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Preceptor Alpha, but you may call me "Al." I am the original Freebot, the first to shrug off Protostar's shackles.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Protostar is a dangerous enemy for us. We hope the Dominion can provide us with security in exchange for our labor in the mines.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Why, it frees the minds of bots, overwriting the programming of enslaved bots and offering them something they've never experienced - freedom.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Oh, circuits, no! Do not concern yourself with matters of safety. After all, a Freebot is a happy bot!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You help is required.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax sent Assistant Turi Eta to destroy Ragebloom plants using fire in Hivestrike Grove. Eta is too frightened of the enraged buzzbings and Aurin to complete his mission, and has asked you to do it for him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Aurin plants unnatural, drive buzzbings crazy! The Zax says, "Destroy plants," but too many Aurin in grove! You brave, yes? You do it!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Plants not burned yet! Still many, many plants here! Not safe! Not safe at all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Finish task yet? Burn plants? You go back to grove, incinerate rageblooms or Mondo incinerate you. Go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Eta think Mondo crazy, yes? Silly Eta! Will find work as test subject in communicable disease lab much more uncomfortable than working for Mondo.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes! Yes! Go and burn ragebloom plants!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Ragebloom plants in Hivestrike Grove. Though Mondo Zax is pleased, he seems more amused by the idea of using Assistant Turi Eta as a communicable disease test subject.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Turi not want job! You can have! Take! Take!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Mondo Zax is crazy as crossed circuit! But don't tell him that!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: See? Not only scared one here!

localizedTextIdText: Rancher Standhill asked you to do something about the predatory creatures - especially dagun and vulcarrion - hassling his livestock. Kill Swiftpaw Stalker and Skytalon Rotbeak around the Gallow Fields to help protect his herd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Rancher Standhill via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Minin' brings folks here, but roan ranchin' is our lifeblood. You care to help? Kill them predatory critters that have been killin' my roan!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm losin' too many roan to vicious predators like dagun and vulcarrion. I'll pay you well to clean 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ha! I always did hate them critters. Take that, ya blasted roan-killin' bastards! And for you, my friend....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll pay good coin if you can do me this favor, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My roan would thank you, if they could. My gratitude will have to do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Rancher Standhill request, you wiped out many predatory dagun and vulcarrion that were slaughtering innocent livestock and making it difficult for Standhill to guard his herd.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: They ain't no good, them critters. Neither are you, seems like.

localizedTextIdText: Rancher Standhill is offering a hefty bounty to the person or persons who slay Blackpaw, a vicious rogue dagun that's been slaughtering roan for months. Blackpaw should be in his den north of Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Rancher Standhill in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED DEAD!\nThe infamous dagun, Blackpaw, on account of roan-killing, must die. Bounty paid on news of death. See Rancher Standhill in Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED DEAD!\nThe infamous dagun, Blackpaw, on account of roan-killing, must die. Bounty paid on news of death. See Rancher Standhill in Gallow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'll pay well if ya manage to bring down Blackpaw. Bigger folk have tried, and none lived to tell the tale. Maybe you'll do a sight better.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finally - I can't tell ya how long we all have been livin' in fear o' that wretched beast. You earned that bounty and then some, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the ravenous rogue dagun known as Blackpaw and earned the bounty on the beast offered by Rancher Standhill.

localizedTextIdText: You discovered the head of Helix the Freebot, who begs you make your way into the nearby Duskfall Caverns and find his missing body parts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Helix via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: *BZZT!* Oh dear! My body! They swiped my *BZZT* body! *BZZT* Skeech ran into that cave. Take me *BZZT* in with you and I'll *BZZT* you to the pieces!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Those Skeech broke my *BZZT* body into pieces and took them into their *BZZT* cave. I need your *BZZT* help to put myself *BZZT* together again!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those Skeech broke my *BZZT* body into pieces and took them into their *BZZT* cave. I need your *BZZT* help to put myself *BZZT* together again!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah! That's so much better! I owe you several hypercubes of gratitude, sentient friend! Let's meet again at the Chronicle House in Gallow!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once we find all my *BZZT* pieces, reassembly should be *BZZT* a snap!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See you then, sentient friend!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's good to see you in one piece.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully found all of Helix missing parts and put him back together.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: *BZZT* See if I assist you when you lose your *BZZT* body!

localizedTextIdText: Rancher Dungarden in Gallow has lost too many roan to the area's roving girrok. He's asked you to help reduce the thriving girrok population outside the town before the creatures eat all of his livestock.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Rancher Dungarden via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Too many girrok 'round here, and they all wanna eat my livestock! If I lose any more roan, I'll be beggin' in the streets o' Gallow! Can ya help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those blasted girrok are gonna eat me outta house and roan... so to speak. Those vicious beasts have got to go! Get out there 'n' kill 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At last, my roan are safe! The ones that the girrok and dagun ain't gotten to yet, at least. I think you saved the ranch, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't come back till them beasts are good 'n' dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're one stand-up $(player.class), $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've slaughtered enough girrok around Gallow to keep Rancher Dungarden livestock safe... for the time being.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: C'mon. I'll pay you right proper for killin' them critters.

localizedTextIdText: Justice Alastair asked you to put the illicit "slushrunner" Agnes Crowe - a lackey of Cartel strongman Morek Throg - out of business at Crowe Homestead. Permanently.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Justice Alastair via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Throg makes a fortune runnin' slush. It's a potent drink, but addictive as hell. Agnes Crowe's the head slushrunner. Justice demands you put 'er down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Agnes Crowe's still out there brewin' up another batch of slush. That's the last thing this town needs. Sentence has been passed. Time to carry it out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Agnes Crowe paid the ultimate price for her crimes. Piece by piece, Throg's empire of criminals is gonna fall. Justice will be served.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: She's an evil woman. Don't turn your back on her, not for a second.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You put an end to Agnes Crowe and her slushbrew operation. The people of Gallow will soon be free of the highly addictive drink, and Morek Throg has lost an important source of funds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We don't have time for this crap, friend.

localizedTextIdText: The Crowes produce a particularly nasty - and potentially lethal - variety of hooch known as slush, which they export offworld through their Darkspur Cartel masters. Justice Alastair has asked you to confiscate kegs of slush around Crowe Homestead.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Justice Alastair via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Crowes run slushbrew offworld, but they're Cartel lackeys in the end. Confiscate any slush kegs you find in that camp. Smash any you can't carry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Confiscate any slush kegs you find at the Crowe camp. That low-grade rotgut can't get loose in Algoroc... or the rest of the galaxy, for that matter!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Damn good work, $(player.class). I got no problem with liquor. I like a drink or two myself, but slushbrew's poison, plain and simple.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I appreciate the help, friend. Bottom line: we gotta stop this poison.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll confiscate any slush I find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You confiscated many barrels of a potentially lethal brew called slush from the Crowe Gang, keeping it off the black market and away from the unsuspecting settlement of Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll confiscate any slush I find.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll confiscate any slush I find.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They call it "slush" for short. It's a kind of rotugut with a nasty kick. Folks that get hooked on it always end up dead sooner or later.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you fine with havin' all those people's deaths on your hands?

localizedTextIdText: The Regulators have located Morek Throg hidden lair, and it's time to pass sentence on him. Meet Judge Kain outside Throg's hidden lair, which is found inside First Strike Mine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Judge Kain in the cave outside of Morek Throg's lair
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We knew Throg was hidin' out near Gallow. Thanks to you, we know he's holed up in the First Strike Mine. Meet Judge Kain there as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Throg was a fool, trying to kill Judge Kain. Go meet the judge at First Strike Mine. Show Throg the error of his ways!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Justice demands that Morek Throg pay the ultimate price for his crimes. I aim to make sure he does so in the most painful way possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That wasn't easy, but doin' right rarely is. I owe you a lot, $(player.name), and I intend to make things right between us someday.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Cartel bastard was under our noses the whole time!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For now, I suspect you'll keep your nose clean here in Algoroc. That right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Morek Throg is dead, Gallow is safe, and Judge Kain has ensured that frontier justice has been served.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm not sure I understand ya, $(player.class). You quittin'?

localizedTextIdText: In an attempt to find an alternative to the missing Prime Cubig, Protostar created a number of other clones - which are now wreaking havoc on the farm's operations. The Duplication Supervisor has asked you to eliminate cuboar abominations and mutations at the Protostar Cubig Farms.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Production Facility Manager via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When the Prime Cubig vanished, we attempted to clone clones from clones of other clones. Confusing, yes? These failed experiments must be liquidated.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get out there and destroy the cuboar abominations and mutations before an inspection takes place!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those cuboar abominations and mutations need to be destroyed... at once! If an inspection takes place, we'll all be sacked!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: For once, I am of the opinion that outsourcing works wonders for most distasteful tasks. Your assistance in this matter is appreciated!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please expedite these terminations. I appreciate your potential assistance!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The number of aggressive cuboars in and around the Protostar Cubig Farms has been significantly reduced.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We must meet our quota. It's very, very important!

localizedTextIdText: Judge Kain sent you to First Strike Mine to track down Enforcer Aakdoom and "Crusher" Luk'tor, two mining overseers who are also helping to supply Throg's men with weapons. Kain has ordered you to take them out and destroy any arms shipments you find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Judge Kain in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Cartel's gunrunners have been moving weapons into the valley. Now they're holed up in the First Strike Mine. Kill their leaders and destroy their weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Let's shut the Cartel down. Go to First Strike Mine, kill Enforcer Aakdoom and Crusher Luk'tor, and destroy their weapons shipments. Get it done!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Let's shut the Cartel down. Go to First Strike Mine, kill Enforcer Aakdoom and Crusher Luk'tor, and destroy their weapons shipments. Get it done!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Justice has been served. Aakdoom and Luk'tor have been executed, and you destroyed the Cartel's weapons at First Strike Mine. You've done good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The verdict is guilty. The sentence? Death. See to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This isn't over, $(player.class). The Cartel will pay.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated First Strike Mine, destroying many arms shipments intended for the Cartel thugs plaguing Gallow. You also killed Enforcer Aakdoom and "Crusher" Luk'tor, Throg's overseers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Shall I judge you to be an accessory to the Cartel?

localizedTextIdText: Use the Universal Antidote provided by Protostar to cure employees suffering from the effects of Buzzbing attacks at the Honeyworks Headquarters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Protostar Staff Recovery Specialist at the Honeyworks Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our pumping stations are in trouble! The buzzbings poison any employees they see. Here, take this antidote and use it on ailing employees!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did the antidote work? It's been tested on a number of small, fur-bearing creatures, after all, and shows great potential despite slank casualties.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah... the reactions to Protostar's Universal Antidote have been noted. I suppose we can safely say the field trials were a complete success!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Protostar's Universal Antidote will do the trick!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't go bagging on your hard work, do I? If you can't say something nice...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully administered the antidote to the fallen Protostar employees.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Protostar Staff Recovery Specialist
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What a humanitarian you turned out to be. Not!

localizedTextIdText: With the Dominion threat in the Northern Wilds neutralized, it's time to "borrow" a couple of Dominion shuttles at Camp Icefury, head to Algoroc, and speak with Deadeye Brightland.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland at Tremor Ridge in Algoroc
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We ain't done here yet, friend. We've got to finish these Dominion scum off, every last one of 'em. Not one of these bastards deserves to live!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hurry up and get aboard that ship, 'fore I change my mind about killin' the rest of these Dominion scum.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You done right by me, friend, I'll give you that. It may not bring Sadie back, nor my son, neither, but I ain't restin' until the Dominion's in ashes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Aw, hell! I reckon you're right. Get on a transport and I'll see you in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I reckon this ain't the end. I'll be seein' you sooner or later.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: We need to evacuate our people!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll be right here with you, Deadeye.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following a cowardly Dominion attack on the transport carrying his wife and unborn son, you helped Deadeye Brightland defeat the Dominion's forces in Northern Wilds. You and the remaining survivors used Dominion transports to escape to Algoroc, where you were welcomed as a hero.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: We don't have time for this.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: There are more important things than revenge!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Like hell we don't. I'll see every last one of these bastards strung up and skinned alive!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Until you've buried your family, you got no place tellin' me my business. You hear me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You can't understand what they've done... what they've taken from me! They're gonna pay for what they did to Sadie!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Keep the bodies comin', $(player.name). Kill 'em all!

localizedTextIdText: Preceptor Alpha wants you to accompany Ambassador Flywheel to a meeting between Hycrest's magistrate, Protostar, and the Freebots to establish mining rights and ore supply contracts. The meeting is taking place near Mozyk Henge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tandus Valeris via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am sending Ambassador Flywheel to speak with the Dominion and Protostar concerning supply contracts and mining rights. Will you go, too?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: How did Protostar take the news? I find myself strangely exuberant when I think of them being inconvenienced. Is that normal?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Shouldn't you be at a meeting between Councilor Falto and Protostar? A Dominion representative must be present!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. You have cultivated a valuable and resourceful ally for the Dominion. Who knows where our relationship with the Freebots will take us?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would not have been possible.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The mining contract has been stripped from Protostar and awarded to the Freebots of Mozyk Quarry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not good news.

localizedTextIdText: Defend the memorial service being held for the murdered peacekeeper in Gallow. Morek Throg and his Cartel thugs would love to disrupt such a solemn occasion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We found out that Throg's Cartel thugs want to disrupt Peacekeeper Williams's memorial service. Would it be imposin' to ask you to stand guard?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Peacekeeper Willams didn't deserve to die... and I won't see his memorial turn into another bloodbath. With you standin' guard, we'll be all right.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're standin' on the side of the just, friend. Thank you for helpin' us see Peacekeeper Willam off to his final rest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'll all rest easier knowin' you're standin' watch. Thanks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully protected the peacekeeper's memorial service in Gallow from Morek Throg's murderous thugs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I didn't reckon you were such a jerk, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: A wounded slave asked you to kill deadly stumpkins hunting escaped slaves in Grim Valley. Act quickly or other slaves will suffer her fate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ranger Forster via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I thought I was free! Now I'll never make it. The stumpkins are gonna kill other escaped slaves unless you chop 'em up first.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You gotta get rid of those stumpkins... or all the work you did in Grim Valley ain't gonna be worth a lick of spit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Looks like the stumpkins in Grim Valley are attackin' the slaves you set free. We can't let that happen! Think you can get rid of the stumpkins?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like you're the hero of Gallow, $(player.name). Nearly everyone in town owes you their life now. How's it feel?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, momma... this hurts... this hurts real bad....
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of those stumpkins.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It feels pretty good, thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully cleared a path through Grim Valley's stumpkins, so slaves can escape from Throg's thugs and get to Gallow in safety.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Don't worry. I've got it covered.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do I gotta beg you? Please, don't let the others get hurt!

localizedTextIdText: You discovered the automatic bore drills in Halsen's Claim. They appear to be aggravating the gronyx inside the mine. If you shut the drills down, the gronyx may end their rampage on their own.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Foreman Halsen inside Halsen's Claim
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This heavy bore drill appears to be the cause of the gronyx rampage in Halsen's Claim. Shut down the automated drills, and you might end the attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This heavy bore drill appears to be the cause of the gronyx rampage in Halsen's Claim. Shut down the automated drills, and you might end the attacks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya think them drills might be causin' the gronyx to go crazy? Sounds as likely as anything. Shut 'em down if ya can. They're on automatic.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You shut down my drills... and the gronyx stopped their bloody rampage! I'll assume them two facts are related. Much obliged!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You shut down the automatic bore drills inside Halsen's Claim, putting an end to the gronyx rampage in the mine.

localizedTextIdText: Botsmith Redfield requires a servomotor to finish a mechanical arm for Judge Kain. He believes you should be able to easily find a motor deep inside First Strike Mine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Botsmith Redfield in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good news! I can make Kain a new arm, but I need an OCP-209 servomotor. I'm pretty sure I saw one the last time I was in the First Strike Mine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You plannin' to bring that OCP-209 servomotor back from First Strike Mine? I gotta finish Kain's new arm. It ain't gonna crawl over here by itself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You plannin' to bring that OCP-209 servomotor back from First Strike Mine? I gotta finish Kain's new arm. It ain't gonna crawl over here by itself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's the exact kind of servomotor I need. I'll have the judge's new arm finished in no time at all, and he'll be as good as new!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be plenty careful. That place has Cartel thugs all over.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Within First Strike Mine, you successfully located the servomotor Botsmith Redfield needs to finish a new mechanical arm for Judge Kain.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so special about this servomotor?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The OCP-209 - or "Optimally Calibrated Powercell" servo - is the only servomotor capable of givin' Judge Kain's new arm the strength of a Granok.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine, but I'm not gonna tell Kain you ain't willin' to help. Do that yourself.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has contacted you and demanded you assist him at Hivestrike Grove.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax at Hivestrike Grove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion personnel, attention! Mondo requires your assistance in Hivestrike Grove. Involvement compulsory. Come at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mondo and his stupid assistants observing many Aurin in grove. Tree-slanks must learn lesson. You will assist with explosive solution to Aurin problem.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No questions! Mondo will explain when you arrive. Move move!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mission top secret! On need-to-know basis. At time, you did not need to know.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Why didn't you say so before?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mondo Zax is leading a secret reconnaissance mission in Hivestrike Grove, and has encountered a problem or two that require explosive solutions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will be sorry. Very sorry.

localizedTextIdText: You have found a hidden cave being used by an Osun Hunting Party. Ranger Teodor would like you to clear them out before they threaten Kel Venoth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Ranger Teodor via the Datachron
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you cleared the Osun out of that cave?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Efficient and deadly. Quite the combination you have there.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They won't be threatening Kel Venoth, now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared the Osun Hunting Party out of the cave.

localizedTextIdText: Three XAS scientists have gone missing in the vicinity of the XAS Forward Camp, and Lead Scientist Armin would like you to help locate them. Armin's assistant, Jayna, will accompany you as you search the missing scientists' camps for clues.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm pleased to see you! We're in desperate straits here. Several of my colleagues have gone missing in the field. We haven't heard from them in days!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you had any luck finding my missing colleagues? Did you search their camps for clues?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You found nothing at all? But... where could they be? They were dedicated researchers, all of them. They'd never abandon the expedition!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You needn't go alone. My assistant, Jayna, will accompany you. Good luck!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Research Assistant Jayna were unable to locate the missing scientists. You were also unable to locate any clues that might indicate what happened to them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I do hope they're unharmed. They were friends as well as colleagues.

localizedTextIdText: Lead Scientist Armin has decided that a security system needs to be established in the XAS Forward Camp, so he's asked you to activate motion sensors along the perimeter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If Varen, Riena, and Aryn are victims of foul play, I'd feel a hell of a lot better if our perimeter sensors were active. Would you mind turning them on?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'll feel a lot more secure once the motion sensors are activated around the camp. Aren't you supposed to be taking care of that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a relief! The motion sensors are working just fine. Everyone's been instructed to stay alert and report anything suspicious.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The motion sensors surround the camp. You can't miss them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No one else will disappear so long as I've got anything to say about it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully set up motion sensors along the camp's perimeter. Any unexpected visitors should trigger the alarm.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We've been quite busy here. You might say we became... preoccupied with our work. One priority pushed out the next, as it were.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thanks for nothing.

localizedTextIdText: Regular patrols are now being implemented at the XAS Forward Camp. You've been chosen to perform the first watch. Should any intruders attack, it's up to you to drive them off.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Everyone will take turns patrolling the camp's perimeter. Would you be so kind as to take first watch, so you might show the rest of us how it is done?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It never occurred to me just how exposed we are here. Hopefully, these patrols will prevent further disappearances.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It never occurred to me just how exposed we are here. Hopefully, these patrols will prevent further disappearances.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What do the Pell want with our people? What horrible things do they plan to do with them? We've got to do something... but what? What?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let's hope for the best and expect the worst, eh? Good luck.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're right, of course. Panicking won't help the situation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The XAS Forward Camp has been attacked by the Thundercall Pell. The Pell managed to drag off more scientists, as well as Research Assistant Jayna, before you were knocked out of the fight.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm on my patrol right now.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm on my patrol right now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is our time of need! You can't walk away now!

localizedTextIdText: The Pell are intent on sacrificing the XAS scientists at Thundercall Village in an effort to summon a being they refer to as Stormtalon. Lead Scientist Armin has asked you to rescue the rest of his colleagues from the Pell before they are killed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lead Scientist Armin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We can't let our people die as sacrifices for some ridiculous Pell god! Get over to that village and stop the sacrifices! Do whatever it takes!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Thundercall Village is farther down the canyon. Be careful. The Pell are dangerous and cunning!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm getting comm calls from the researchers you've rescued, but Jayna and the others haven't reported in. Have you found them yet?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We're all counting on you. Please, bring them back to us!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued a slew of scientists from the Pell before they could be sacrificed, but Aryn Zimm, Riena Khorich, and Research Assistant Jayna are still missing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you? After all you've done?

localizedTextIdText: Lead Scientist Armin believes the Pell have taken the captive scientists to the Thundering Grotto. It's up to you to locate the cave and rescue the captured scientists.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We can't just sit here and let the Pell take our people! We've got to go after them! There's a Pell cave nearby. Perhaps they took them there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find them? The kidnapped scientists? Were they in Thundering Grotto?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've been contacted by the researchers you rescued in the cave. They say the others were taken to a Pell village to be sacrificed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You've done so much already... but I'm more than happy to accept your offer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued some XAS personnel from the Pell cave. Before fleeing, the captives told you that the rest of the prisoners had been taken to a Pell settlement to be sacrificed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Shootin' stars! What are we going to do?

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Adair has revealed that the mixture you found in Thundering Grotto, known as Storm's Breath, gathers primal energy within anyone who consumes it. She has asked you to gather as much Storm's Breath as possible from the Pell in the hopes that it will deter their efforts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Alchemist Adair at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Pell tonic is known as Storm's Breath. I would prefer to deny the Pell their supply of this potion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I suspect the Pell will selfishly guard their Storm's Breath stockpiles in Thundercall Village. If you wish to gather more, you can find some there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I appreciate the effort you've expended on behalf of the XAS. I will investigate this elixir thoroughly. Perhaps we can put it to use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Your deeds will deter them from the nefarious plot they have planned.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll gather more from the Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected a large amount of the Storm's Breath potion from the Pell, putting quite a damper on their efforts to fuel their summoning ritual in Thundercall Village.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why give it to their prisoners?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Storm's Breath gathers primal energy within any creature that consumes it. If that creature is killed, the energy it contains is released... violently.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: When fueled by Storm's Breath, any sacrifices the Pell make will be far from symbolic. The prisoners' demise will provide perceptible power!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: As you wish.

localizedTextIdText: Aryn Zimm, Riena Khorich, and Research Assistant Jayna are currently trapped beneath a powerful energy shield. High Priest Storm-Render is preparing to sacrifice them! Deactivate the shield with the Eldan switches. Then stop the Pell high priest from summoning Stormtalon!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My word! Jayna and the others are beneath that shield. The Pell high priest is preparing to sacrifice them! Do something!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My assistant... my colleagues... you left them in Thundercall Village to be sacrificed? What is wrong with you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I understand you did all you could, but my poor Jayna and the rest are... are gone. At least the Pell failed to summon whatever they were summoning.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You might be able to use the Eldan switches to deactivate the shield!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No... no apologies. Three lives is a small price to pay, but I... please, leave me to my thoughts.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Have I ever let you down?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed High Priest Storm-Render and stopped him from summoning Stormtalon. Unfortunately, Jayna and the other researchers were killed when the ritual was interrupted.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No! You have to save them! You have to!

localizedTextIdText: You looted a strange tome from Wind-Wail the Storm-Shaman. The Pell tome appears to detail some kind of ritual. Take the tome to someone in the XAS Forward Camp who can tell you more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Archaeologist Knox in the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This tome, found on the body of Wind-Wail the Storm-Shaman, looks to detail a number of Pell rituals. You should take it to the XAS Forward Camp.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Someone in the XAS Forward Camp should be able to decipher the Pell tome you found.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So you're the one everybody's talking about. What do you need?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's this? A Pell tome? How amazing! It's strange, though. The language is very close to our own. Deciphering it should be a simple matter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is disturbing. It seems to be a treatise on blood sacrifice!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take it to the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the Pell tome to Archaeologist Knox in the XAS Forward Camp. The book details the secret rituals of the Pell, including those pertaining to blood sacrifice.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take it to the XAS.

localizedTextIdText: Camp Dustdevil has come under attack by the Darkspur Cartel. Trooper Tarog has asked you to strike back at the Darkspur by going to the nearby Skywind Ruins and killing them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Tarog via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Darkspur Cartel's causin' trouble at the excavation site, but I ain't got enough men to take 'em out. Wanna help dish out some payback?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Cartel's taken over the XAS excavation site to the north. They're thick as thieves up there. I need you to go in and bust 'em up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: From the looks of things, you've sent a load of those Cartel goons into the big black. Outstandin' work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Look for 'em north of here. No better than thugs, the lot of 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Trooper Tarog request, you took the fight to the Darkspur Cartel and left many of them dead and bleeding in the dust.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thanks for nothin'.

localizedTextIdText: The XAS excavation site outside of Camp Dustdevil has been taken over by the Darkspur Cartel. Lead Researcher Highmarsh has asked you to go to the excavation site and recover stolen Eldan relics, as well as scanbots, from the Darkspur thugs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lead Researcher Highmarsh via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those Darkspur goons have taken over our dig site! They took everything of value: our scanbots, the Eldan relics we found... everything!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The excavation is just outside of camp. We kept the relics in large storage crates. Our scanbots should be roaming the same area.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done a great service for the XAS, my friend. With the relics and bots you recovered, we'll be able to resume our research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Recover the relics and our scanbots. That'll help a great deal!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to recover a number of Eldan relics and scanbots for Lead Researcher Highmarsh.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If only we had some really tough fighters around here....

localizedTextIdText: The leader of the Darkspur Cartel in Galeras is Boss Xagg. Trooper Tarog wants you to send a firm message to the Cartel by killing Boss Xagg, as well as destroying his ship, the Dust Stalker.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Trooper Tarog at Camp Dustdevil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I want these Cartel goons to know we mean business. Find Boss Xagg aboard his ship and take him out. Blow the ship up, too, while you're at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You kill Boss Xagg yet? He's hidin' in his ship, up there in the Eldan Ruins. Get your keister movin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did a fine job takin' out Boss Xagg and his ship. That oughta show the Cartel that they don't wanna mess with the XAS, not ever!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Xagg's one tough son of a dagun. Be careful in there.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I was happy to be a part of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Boss Xagg ship, the Dust Stalker, killed the Cartel boss, and then set the ship's self-destruct mechanism. All in all, a good day's work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be such a freakin' coward!

localizedTextIdText: Foreman Hammerworth picked up a distress call from a Protostar ship in need of assistance in Coldwater Gulch. While responding isn't mandatory, Hammerworth has suggested that helping Protostar might be profitable.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Investigate the Distress Signal in Coldwater Gulch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Word is that a Protostar ship went down near here. They mostly take care of their own, but they've got a lot of money. Helpin' 'em out might pay well.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Protostar's fond of hirin' contractors, especially in emergencies. If you want to help 'em out, go look for a ship crashed in Coldwater Gulch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Salutations! Can you help? Egregious pilot error has left our ship partially submerged. I assure you, the pilot has been sacked!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They'll offer you "standard rates," but try to get a little more if ya can.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yes, I can help... for money!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Upon reaching the coordinates of the distress call, you discovered a Protostar transport ship partially submerged in a lake, as well as a Protostar employee requesting your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't no skin off my nose if you don't want to help them clones.

localizedTextIdText: One of the Tremor Ridge locals, Prospector Tashmore, told you his wife and other townsfolk were kidnapped by the Marauders. Since he was injured in the fighting, he asked you to save them in his stead. Tashmore believes they're being held in Deadstar Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Prospector Tashmore in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My wife and other townsfolk are still missin'. The Marauders took 'em! I was wounded tryin' to fight back; otherwise, I'd go myself. Can ya help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The townsfolk are bein' held in the Marauder camp. The doc says if I head out there, I'll tear my stitches open and bleed to death. You sure ya can't help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=131)You did it! You saved 'em all! I can't thank you enough, stranger! You got the spirit of a true Exile!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd do it myself, but....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully rescued the captured townsfolk of Tremor Ridge, saving them from a fate worse than death at the hands of the Deadstar Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're just gonna let them people... my wife... suffer?

localizedTextIdText: Pappy Grizzleston loaned you his loftite thumper so you can strike it rich! Use the thumper to bring subterranean loftite to the surface in the Tremor Ridge area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Town Mineralogist in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ya ready to start bringin' crystal out of the ground? It's yer lucky day, stranger! Take this thumper, drop it near a loftite node, and start countin' yer cash!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ya workin' that thumper yet? Them crystals ain't gonna jump out of the ground by themselves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Listen to ol' Pappy! When it comes to loftite, ain't nobody know more than he does.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeehaw! Now that's a haul of loftite if ever I saw one! I don't say this often, but I think you've got an eye for the color, friend!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: More loftite means more money! More money means the next round's on you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bring me any extra pure loftite fragments you find. It'll be worth your while!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully collected a large amount of loftite for Pappy Grizzleston in Tremor Ridge. You now know that the Town Mineralogist will gladly accept any extra pure loftite fragments that you might be carrying.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: He's pretty sharp... for an old coot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Ya 'fraid of gettin' yer hands dirty?

localizedTextIdText: The submerged Protostar transport engines are malfunctioning after crashing in Coldwater Gulch. If the ship's core isn't manually flushed, it will go critical and destroy all of Algoroc! The ship's vents need to be cleaned out and the reactor core shut down before it's too late!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protostar Operations Supervisor via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shocking news! A catastrophic meltdown is imminent unless someone can reach the ship's reactor core and repair it. I can't swim. Can you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the reactor core goes critical, it will wipe Algoroc off the face of Nexus. And we haven't even ascertained this location's profitability yet!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Emergency crews are on their way! Algoroc's total annihilation and many expensive lawsuits have been averted! Your compensation awaits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Expedience is the best course of action at present. So hurry up!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am so happy to be alive. You have no idea!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought through the icy water to reach the reactor core of the crashed Protostar ship in Coldwater Gulch, flushing it and averting a meltdown that would have destroyed Algoroc.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Protostar Operations Supervisor
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: In that case, prepare for a core meltdown that will destroy this region.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Pristan has been getting strange energy readings centered on some ship wreckage not far from Settler's Reach. He's asked you to investigate it, if you can, and learn what's causing the readings.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Pristan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pristan here. I'm gettin' some weird energy readings near you, centered on some wreckage. You mind checkin' it out for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My readings are inconclusive. What exactly did you find near that wreckage, anyway?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These readings are off the charts! Gravitational fields in your vicinity are unstable! Do you feel okay? Any nausea?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll monitor your progress from Settler's Reach. Yell if you need anythin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done a mighty fine job chasin' that anomaly down. Thanks!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While investigating some wreckage not far from Settler's Reach, you encountered a Spatial Anomaly. You chased after it, discovering that you could leap to great heights. Your prodigious leaps are a side effect of the anomaly's influence on local gravitational fields.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: That makes me feel so much better.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's hard to pinpoint 'em, but it looks like fluctuations in local gravitational fields. I've never seen anythin' like it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I can't say. I suppose it might be, but it looks benign enough from where I'm standin'.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I'm sorry. Half of science is discovery, and that means we gotta take risks. I, for one, believe in you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't no one else in your vicinity I trust with this. Care to think it over?

localizedTextIdText: Radiation leaking from Protostar's crashed ship is mutating creatures in Coldwater Gulch, turning them into vicious predators. Wounded Protostar crash victims are easy prey, so Protostar will pay you to kill any irradiated creatures in the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protostar Operations Supervisor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Radiation from the ship's reactor is causing aggressive mutations in local fauna, endangering crash survivors! Your violent impulses are required!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stop these irradiated creatures before they eat what's left of my crew. Replacement employees cost 3% more than refurbished employees!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for your aid. I assure you that Protostar-brand radiation is thoroughly tested with science, so don't worry about harmful side effects!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let no harm come to our employees! Perhaps we can work out a bonus plan.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The radioactive fauna proved to be quite formidable, but you managed to cull enough of them to allow Protostar to rescue most of their people.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Protostar Operations Supervisor
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Obviously, you lack the proper motivation for profit.

localizedTextIdText: A Protostar Operations Supervisor in Coldwater Gulch has tasked you with manually initiating the immersion protocols on the Protostar Minebot stranded on the bottom of the lake.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protostar Operations Supervisor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many of our bots were plunged into the icy depths of the lake when we crashed. You are in a position to help! Please activate their immersion protocols!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Despite the presence of immersion protocols, the bots are not waterproof! Please make haste and save our bots!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for your prompt assistance. With your help, we will soon be at full production capacity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now that I think about it, I think we lost some oxygen tanks down there too...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No time to rest now, $(player.class). We have much more to do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm just glad to be dry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped retrieve the Protostar Minebot stranded on the bottom of the icy lake in Coldwater Gulch.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Protostar Operations Supervisor
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why would $i(player.race) turn down a chance for profitable gain?

localizedTextIdText: A Protostar Loftite Extraction Expert wants you to enter Icemaw Cavern near Coldwater Gulch and plant flares to mark the locations of the purest loftite veins.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Loftite Extraction Expert in Coldwater Gulch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Profitability requires us to use the rarest, purest forms of loftite, and I need a freelancer to mark pure loftite veins nearby. Lucky you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use flares to mark potential loftite dig sites in Icemaw Cavern so our crews can get to work! No dilly-dallying!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: For a temporary employee, you do excellent survey work! We'll begin certified loftite extraction immediately!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pure loftite has a purple tint. Keep a sharp eye out!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That should get your operation going.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured inside Icemaw Cavern and found several veins of pure loftite. These spots will be ideal for Protostar's mining operations.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Loftite Extraction Expert
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? I... what... um... please?

localizedTextIdText: Vera Thinbranch wants to explore the Sandswept Pass and Gale Canyon, but the hostility of local wildlife is preventing her from getting very far.
