Kill some of the more aggressive creatures, such as razorbeak gribbons, shaleclaw scrab, and stonespike rockhordes, so that Vera can do what she does best.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Vera Thinbranch via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm trying to explore this area to get a look at these giant fossils, but the critters around here aren't having any of it. I wish they'd just shoo!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I just need to get a peek at those fossils, but the gribbons, scrab, and rockhordes won't leave me alone!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yep, it looks like the coast is clear. Thanks! I hope you didn't have to hurt the little critters too much.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Try not to hurt the animals too much. They're just doing what comes naturally.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Whew! That's good... I'd hate to have that on my conscience!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've cleared out much of the hostile wildlife in the Sandswept Pass. It should be safe enough for Vera Thinbranch to do some exploring now.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of those critters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe they'll end up leaving on their own... then again, maybe not.

localizedTextIdText: Vera Thinbranch is attempting to map the Sandswept Pass, but Gust Elemental are hindering her progress. Eliminate some of them so she can finish her map.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Vera Thinbranch via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Explorers Union sent me here to map the Sandswept Pass, but elementals are getting in my way. Can't they find something else to do?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The gust elementals are still out there! I thought you said you were going to blow them away for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It'll be a lot easier to map the Sandswept pass without all those silly elementals trying to kill me. You're a real hero, you know that?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'd do that for me? That's really sweet of you! Yes, and thanks!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And so modest, too!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Want me to blow them away?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Gust Elemental that were preventing Vera Thinbranch from mapping the Sandswept Pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I did? Oh, yeah... I did.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hm. I wish my sister was here. She could get rid of them for sure!

localizedTextIdText: You found $(vitem=338) scattered near the camp of one of the missing scientists. The researchers at the XAS Forward Camp would be thankful if you returned their equipment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the $(vitem=338) to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This looks like an expensive piece of testing equipment. You see more pieces scattered around. You should return this one to the XAS.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The equipment is plainly marked: "Property of the Exile Academy of Science."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Not only are some of my researchers missing, but we've also lost most of our equipment. If only it could be recovered....
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our missing field equipment! How did you know we were looking for it? To be honest, I thought I'd have to write it off as a loss.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned the scattered $(vitem=338) to Lead Scientist Armin, who was very grateful.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.

localizedTextIdText: A Protostar Loftite Extraction Expert wants you to enter Icemaw Cavern and kill any Icemaw Yeti you find there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Loftite Extraction Expert in Coldwater Gulch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to forcibly remove the yeti from Icemaw Cavern before our mining operations begin or we'll be buried in injury compensation forms!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The yeti are making our operations dangerous, and danger is inefficient. Exterminate them, and you'll be paid in genuine money!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Icemaw Cavern is clear, and we have unfettered access to some of the purest loftite veins I have ever seen. Remarkable results for a mere contractor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Less yeti! More profit! From Protostar!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No offense intended... by Protostar!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You drastically reduced the number of Icemaw Yeti in Icemaw Cavern.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Loftite Extraction Expert
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You aren't one of those yeti rights activists, are you?

localizedTextIdText: Shoveljaw Boulderback are eating up all the loftite in the Crystal Shards. Miner Harlow wants you to kill those boulderbacks before they eat up all his profits.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Miner Harlow via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Loftite ain't hard to find - but gettin' past them ornery boulderbacks is a trick. Better get rid of 'em before they eat all the loftite!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The boulderbacks don't like sharing the Crystal Shards. They keep eating up the loftite and killin' our workers. Go on in and put 'em down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the stars, I'm back in business! Too bad some boulderbacks had to die, but they won't be goin' extinct anytime soon. Many thanks, friend!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I wouldn't mind 'em if they wasn't hungry. Damn things is eatin' my profits!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully reduced the number of Shoveljaw Boulderback in the Crystal Shards region, thereby protecting Miner Harlow profits.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're kiddin', right? I can make it worth your while.

localizedTextIdText: Many researchers have been consumed by the local girrok. Kill Grimstone girrok in Demonclaw Pass and search the corpses for the Mining Brazier, which could provide valuable intelligence for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kormak via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This datapad belonged to a Chua researcher before he was devoured by a girrok. Try to recover more datapads, as they may contain valuable intel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dominion datapads? Some of 'em been found near Demonclaw Pass. Hell, I'll take any you can find. The brass is always lookin' out for fresh intel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where'd ya find so many Dominion datapads? Judgin' from the smell, I probably don't wanna know.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll get 'em to the right people. Thanks for the assist, trooper.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though it was grisly work digging them out of the corpses of slaughtered girrok, you recovered many Mining Brazier that will provide important intel to Exile agents.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland has called you back to Tremor Ridge. Looks like you're needed once more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Deadeye Brightland in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you're through sightseein', I could sure use your help back in Tremor Ridge. I'll give you the lowdown when you get here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to see you, friend. Wish I had good news, but I fear we've got a heap of trouble headin' this way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sooner would be better'n later.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No one ever cuts us Exiles a break.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Deadeye Brightland has told you there's more trouble brewing in Tremor Ridge, and he's hoping you'll be able to help him out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You better have a good reason for turnin' me down.

localizedTextIdText: Denner Hazefall asked you to use seismic disruptors to calm the tremors in the Loftite Cliffs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Denner Hazefall near the Loftite Cliffs
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These quakes make it tricky to scale the cliffs. If you set a seismic disruptor at the epicenter of any recent tremors, it'll put an end to the shakin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those tremors keep a-comin'. Weren't you gonna do somethin' about 'em with the seismic disruptors I gave you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Damned fine work, $(player.name)! Oh, those quakes may return tomorrow, but you've sure helped us get to that loftite today!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They call it 'Tremor Ridge' for a reason, partner.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Usin' explosives to stop quakes. Who woulda thunk it?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully quieted the quakes on the Loftite Cliffs of Algoroc for Denner Hazefall.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I figured you had a stiffer spine.

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Tognar suggested you might help disarm the land mines the Deadstar Marauders scattered about the southwestern part of Tremor Ridge... if you feel lucky, that is.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Tognar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Watch yer step. Damned Marauders set mines all over the place. You can disarm 'em, but be careful. You can't be a hero if you're dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Gave up on those mines, huh? Can't say I blame ya. Blowing yourself up makes for a bad day.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Will ya look at that? You disarmed the mines! Some of 'em, anyway. You got stones, no doubt about that. Thanks for stickin' yer neck out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep yer wits, and you'll keep yer limbs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared a safe path through the mine field with a minimal loss of rowsdowers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought I smelled a loser. Didn't reckon it was you, though.

localizedTextIdText: NKT-PH q4578: This is the summary
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: NKT-PH q4578: Comp Obj Text
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With the Sheriff gone, the citizens need reassurance they will be safe. I'd like you to visit the outer farms and see if there's any way we can assist them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew I could count on you. Be careful.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go check on those farms.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: NKT-PH q4578: This is the COMPLETED summary
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We could really use your help. Come back if you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: NKT-PH: This is the summary
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: NKT-PH: This is QG's intro
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: NKT-PH: This is QG's acceptance
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Don't worry. I'll help prepare your traps.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: NKT-PH: This is the COMPLETED summary
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fooey - I could really use your help.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: NKT-PH q4582: This is QG's Intro
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get the seeds as fast as I can.

localizedTextIdText: NKT-PH q4605: This is the summary
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Trap Bait to Farmer Nedal
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: NKT-PH q4605: This is the intro
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: NKT-PH q4605: This is the QG Acceptance
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: NKT-PH q4605: This is the quest acceptance
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: NKT-PH q4605: This is the COMPLETED summary
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: NKT-PH q4605: Decided to decline, have you?

localizedTextIdText: You found the body of an XAS researcher named Koryn Surne near Thundercall Village. His datachron, an important piece of gear for every researcher, was conspicuously absent. Perhaps you can find it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver Koryn Surne's Datachron to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The name tag on this body identifies it as Koryn Surne, an XAS researcher. The case where he would carry his datachron is conspicuously empty.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Koryn Surne is dead, and his datachron is missing. Perhaps it's located somewhere in Thundercall Village.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Another researcher has failed to report in. His name is Koryne Surne. Have you seen him?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Koryn Surne was a brilliant scientist, and he will be sorely missed. At the least you recovered his datachron. It contains all his notes.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps they will, though his observations of the Pell are... disturbing.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope they come in handy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Koryn Surne's Datachron and delivered it to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the Datachron to Lead Scientist Armin

localizedTextIdText: Pappy Grizzleston said that if you want to learn about loftite, you should find his friend, Denner Hazefall, near the Loftite Cliffs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Denner Hazefall at the base of the Loftite Cliffs to the west of Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Want to know about loftite? You gotta do two things. First, do everything I tell ya. Second, talk to my friend Denner. He's one sharp fella!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you still standin' here for? Didn't I tell ya to do everything I said? Get movin' and find Denner near the loftite cliffs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How goes, stranger? Let me guess. Ol' Pappy sent you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Denner knows the color of crystal better'n most. He'll set ya straight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That old coot can be a pain, but no one knows more about the crystal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Denner Hazefall near the Loftite Cliffs, just where Pappy Grizzleston said he'd be.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Won't do what I tell ya, eh? Then get outta my face, buck.

localizedTextIdText: The Pell were using some manner of alchemical concoction on their prisoners. You found a cauldron of the stuff and took a sample, which you plan to return to one of the researchers at the XAS Forward Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $(vitem=434) to Alchemist Adair at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Pell cauldron is brimming with a noxious, glowing mixture the creatures have probably been using on the captive researchers.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The mixture in the Pell cauldron is foul-smelling and potent. Perhaps someone at the XAS Forward Camp will be able to discern its purpose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What is this? A gift? Or a Pell potion, purloined from those pestilent pillagers? I find the latter more likely. Give it to me. Gently, please.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This liquid seethes with primal air energies. Most disturbing.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take a sample of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gave a sample of the mysterious mixture you collected to Alchemist Adair, a Mordesh alchemist at the XAS Forward Camp.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take a sample of it.

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Morrik feels that the best defense is a good offense. He's asked you to head to Thundercall Village and take the fight to the Thundercall Pell on behalf of the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corporal Morrik at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I don't like the Pell. Never have. Now that they're a real threat, we oughta take the fight to them. Why sit around waitin'? Answer me that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You take out any of those Pell at Thundercall Village yet? Make 'em pay in blood, I say.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How many confirmed kills did you get? I hope you left enough for me... except I'm stuck here until they send another trooper to take my place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Of course it is! Head to Thundercall Village and put those Pell in the ground!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks. You aren't half as soft as I took you for, pal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the fight to the Pell of Thundercall Village, killing many of them before you returned to Corporal Morrik at the XAS Forward Camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take the fight to the Pell.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you smelled like a coward.

localizedTextIdText: Trainer Jaryd at the XAS Forward Camp has given the surviving researchers rifles so they can defend themselves against future Pell attacks. However, the researchers are inexperienced and could use a little bit of help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Trainer Jaryd at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I managed to rustle up some surplus rifles, and I'm tryin' to show these scientists how to use 'em. They'll be lucky if they don't hurt themselves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How're they coming along with the weapons trainin'? I notice none of 'em have been shot yet. That's a good sign.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did a good job showin' those pencil-pushers how to use their weapons. They're actually hittin' what they're aimin' at!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Most of these people have never shot a gun before, so be careful.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No doubt! Thanks for givin' me a hand!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped train the researchers at the XAS Forward Camp how to use, load, and maintain their weapons. They should be more than ready to face further attacks by the Pell.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's okay. I'll figure somethin' out.

localizedTextIdText: You found a wounded farmhand who informed you of the raid taking place here at Deathwood Ranch. Mammy Yockum, the finest breeder of Warboars, is being attacked and needs your help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Locate Mammy Yockum near the farmhouse.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Raiders are invading the farm!  Run and find Mammy Yockum up by the farm house.  She'll know just what to do.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you find Mammy Yockum?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You showed up just in time. These sneaky Marauders tried to get the drop on us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go quickly! There isn't much time!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mammy Yockum's the name.  Pleased ta meet ya.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What can I do to help?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued Mammy Yockum from the raiding Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you gonna leave us like this?

localizedTextIdText: Pappy Yockum needs your help at the barn.  Find him and make sure that he is alight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Pappy Yockum near the barn.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: SNIFF SNIFF. Dag nabbit!  They must have lit the barn on fire.  They're tryin' ta cook my babies?  Pappy was near the barn holding them off, he must need help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you find Pappy near the barn?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head on over to the barn.  If it's burning then Pappy must be overrun.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: WHEW! That fire's hotter'n ghost chili pie!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Pappy Yockum and kept him from being overrun by the attacking marauders.

localizedTextIdText: Fire is blocking your path to get into the barn and help the Warboars. Grab a water bucket and get those fires out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Pappy Yockum.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fire's blockin' the entrance to the barn.  Mammy'll tan my hide if I let those piggies fry.  We gotta get those Warboars outta there!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Is the entrance to the barn clear yet?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Grab an extinguisher over there by the water tower!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nice work sonny! The barn door is clear!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to put out the fires that were blocking the entrance to the barn .

localizedTextIdText: Head into the barn and use the Pork Prodder to get the Trapped Warboars out.  Be careful, the fire has the pigs spooked and they will attack anything in their way to get out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Head back to Mammy Yockum so she knows her Warboars are safe.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that the fire's not blockin' the door its time to get those Piggys to safety.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you get those Warboars out?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head into the barn and use this Pork Prodder to get them to run out of the door.  Be careful though, the fire has them spooked and they may attack.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Friend...you really saved our bacon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to unlatch the gates to the Warboar pens and get them out of the burning barn.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mammy Yockum and let her know her tree is safe.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that the farm is safe I need someone to go check on my special Bingberry tree.  This tree is one of a kind and without it I can't make my special tonic.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Much obliged.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: One of my farmhands told me he some raiders headed for the Bingberry tree.  Keep them dirty raiders from touchin my tree!

localizedTextIdText: Mammy Yockum needs you to gather the some of the ingredients she uses to make her special Bingberry Tonic.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to M4ammy Yockum with the gathered supplies.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The fire in the barn burned up some of my special Yockum's Bingberry Tonic. With all the cleanup here I ain't got time to go gather what I need.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Here's a list of everything you need.  You should be able to find the Snuff
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Here is what you asked for.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the ingredients Mammy Yockum needs to make her special Bingberry Tonic.

localizedTextIdText: Mammy Yockum asked you to meet their Boar Whisperer Omah Verris  at the low land plateaus for further instructions on how to get Otis back.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Omah Verris.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those dang raiders made off with my prize hog!  It was to be gift for the Luminai Emperor himself and now he's gone.  Can you get Otis back?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I sent my boar whisperer Omah Verris ahead to track which way they went.  Omah can track down a cold in summer time.  Find him and he will find you Otis.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mammy sent you?  Hmm...I guess you will have to do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find Otis not to worry.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Just point me in the right direction.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You meet with Omah Verris and he told you that Otis is being held in a cave compound at the top of the Deathwood Plateau.

localizedTextIdText: The marauders are using blood samples from Otis to try and replicate the Bingberry Tonic.  Find their research and take it to ensure the recipe remains a Yockum family
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the lab research back to Mammy Yockum at Deathwood Ranch.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The marauders are obsessed crackin' Mammy's recipe for Bingberry Tonic.  They're takin' blood samples from Otis to see they can figure the ingredients.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If they find out the recipe Mammy will skin us alive.  Collect any research you can find in the cave and return it to Mammy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Liquid Smoke, HEH! Those morons will never figure out my secret ingredient HAHAHA!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the research notes in the marauders cave and gave them to Mammy Yockum.  The Bingberry recipe is now save thanks to you.

localizedTextIdText: Cpt. Ralok Bender of the Deadstar Marauders is holding Otis in a cage in the cave located above the plateau.  Kill Cpt. Bender and get the key to free Otis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Mammy Yockum at Deathwood Ranch.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stealing Otis is the last straw!  We are gonna take these marauders down!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Cpt. Ralok Bender has Otis chained up and only he has the key to unlock them.  Get the key from him and take out groups Deathwood Marauders along the way.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't believe you got Otis back.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Cpt. Ralok Bender, took his key and opened the cage holding Otis.

localizedTextIdText: Mammy Yockum has sent you to Pappy Yockum to reward you for saving Deathwood Ranch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Pappy Yockum.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If it wasn't for you, who knows what might have to the ranch.  We can't thank you enough for all your help...or maybe we can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head on down to see Pappy near the barn.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Otis looks like he is doing just fine.  I got just the right thing to rest those tired feet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You meet up with Pappy Yockum to pick out a Warboar mount.

localizedTextIdText: Talk to Pappy and receive your Yockum's Warboar mount.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Pappy and receive your Yockum's Warboar mount.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fer savin' the ranch and keeping our secret tonic recipe safe, Mammy and I would like to give you one of our Warboars
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just remember, with great power....and all that what not.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy the ride!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pappy gave you a Warboar mount for all your help at Deathwood Ranch.

localizedTextIdText: A Dominion raiding party has crossed Gale Canyon and is attacking Skyler Farm. Sergeant Royce has asked you to do what you can to help Wounded Farmer while taking out some of the Dominion Advance Scout.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Royce via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion's sent some troops to raid Skyler Farm, and they're butcherin' our people! Get over there and do what you can to help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still gettin' calls for help from Skyler Farm. You been over there yet? If you don't hurry, there won't be anyone left to save!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's just like the Dommies to target innocent civilians. That sort of thing turns my stomach.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Some of those folks are going to be wounded. Try and get 'em on their feet!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You did what you could to help the Wounded Farmer at Skyler Farm.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You yellow-bellied son of a roan! People are dyin'!

localizedTextIdText: No one's heard from Redstone Farm and Sergeant Royce is concerned that the Dominion may be behind their silence. Travel to Redstone Farm and check on the farmers there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Royce via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're not out of the woods yet. Redstone Farm, another agricultural community, has gone silent. It's probably the Dommies again. Can you check it out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's the word from Redstone Farm? Are those people okay? Why the hell are you talking to me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're tellin' me somethin' killed both the farmers and the Dominion troops? That makes about as much sense as a raincoat on a rowsdower.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm hopin' those people got out in time, but I ain't holdin' my breath.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hold up. I'm gettin' a call from Corporal Darby. Patchin' it in to you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That's the way it is, though.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: When you arrived at Redstone Farm, you discovered that both the Dominion attackers and the Redstone farmers had been killed by a mysterious third party. Their bodies were marred with deep slash marks, likely made by talons.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got no stomach for this kind of work, do you?

localizedTextIdText: With an impending Dominion attack en route, Sergeant Royce has asked you to warn the farmers at Clearfield Farm to leave their fields. It may take some convincing to get the farmers to leave willingly.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Royce via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion will be here soon, so we've got to evacuate the farmers. Head northeast to Clearfield Farm, and tell 'em to get out while they can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Any luck gettin' those farmers to evacuate from Clearfield Farm? There ain't much time left!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good deal! Farmers from Clearfield are tricklin' into camp. Your next stop is Skylar farm, so listen up.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Some of 'em may not want to leave. You'll need to talk 'em into it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite their reluctance, you were able to convince the farmers at Clearfield Farm to evacuate their fields before Dominion forces could attack.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wrong answer.

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Darby has reported that the rest of the Dominion attackers are holed up in some kind of temple complex. He's requested that you help clear the area for Commander Durek and his men.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Commander Durek at the Temple of Osiric
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My assistant Trooper Vog has located the rest of the Dominion raiders. Rendezvous with him at the staging grounds for further instructions.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You better move it to that temple before things get messy! That area still needs to be cleaned out, and you're the only one in place to do it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't disappoint me, Soldier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So we meet again! It's time for us to slag a few more Dommies. You on board, recruit?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Dominion's thick as thieves down here. Be careful!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll sweep the area for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Durek is on the ground, and he's called all Exile military personnel to the Temple of Osiric.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll sweep the area for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Dommies are holed up in some kind of temple complex. I've never seen anythin' quite like it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Royce told me so many good things about you. Guess it was all crap.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has ordered an orbital strike on the Temple of Osiric to kill the Dominion troops hiding there. Before Durek can call in the strike, you'll need to deactivate the Dominion's satellite scramblers located throughout the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Durek at the Temple of Osiric
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Here's the plan, trooper. We're gonna bring this whole place down on top of 'em. Disable their satellite jammers, so I can call in an orbital strike.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're sittin' here with our stones flappin' in the breeze! Take those scramblers out, now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll pay any price to see the Dominion destroyed. Now grab yourself some cover!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Today, we're gonna call down the thunder, boys and girls!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Let's hope the price isn't too high.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You deactivated the Dominion's satellite scramblers, allowing Durek to call in his orbital strike on the temple complex. However, the act angered an alien god named Osiric, as well as the bird-like aliens who worship him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: When I give an order, I expect it to be obeyed!

localizedTextIdText: Mechanic Grumshot has assigned you a hoverbike equipped with a powerful rocket launcher. Ride the hoverbike to the gates of Stormwing Fortress and use the rockets to destroy the Murgh and their huts in Mudraker Roost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corporal Dax at the entrance gate to Stormwing Fortress
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Here ya go! One of my best hoverbikes. Jump on and ride it to the gates of Stormwing Fortress, but don't get lost. I expect to hear lots of explosions!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Take the bike to Stormwing Fortress. Once ya get there, bring down a whole lotta hurt on those bird-brains!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you're our reinforcements, I'm going to file a complaint with Command.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Shootin' stars! Am I glad to see you! We're up to our necks in this, and that ain't the half of it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I don't loan my babies to just anyone, understand? Take good care of her.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your successful assault on the Murgh in Mudraker Roost, you received a distress call from an Exile named Corporal Dax.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got a problem with rocket launchers?

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Corporal Dax, an Exile sergeant assigned to assault Stormwing Fortress. He and his comrades have been scattered, are sorely outnumbered by the Falkrin, and could use your help. Proceed to Stormwing Fortress and hit the Falkrin where it hurts!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Dax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've dropped into a meat grinder! Stormwing Fortress is not under our control! The troops are scattered... outnumbered! We need help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If it wasn't for the wind shear, we would've landed with more cohesion. You've got to help us out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sergeant Kara's going to hear about how you came to the rescue today, just like the cavalry. Thanks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hopefully, we can hold out until you take the Falkrin down a few notches!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assisted Corporal Dax and his men in their assault on Stormwing Fortress.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: You need it, you got it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you were here to help!

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Kara, Durek's second-in-command, has asked you to clear the way for an Exile landing force. To do so, you'll need to use a targeting flare to mark Stormwing Catapult in Stormwing Fortress as targets for an artillery strike.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kara here. I'm about to drop in on your position with some troopers, but I need you to destroy the Stormwing catapults down there first. Care to help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mark those catapults, or my men will be butchered when they land! Get movin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like the LZ's clear. Thanks for the assist!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use a targeting flare to mark the catapults. The artillery will do the rest.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to you, the Stormwing Catapult were properly marked and targeted for a successful artillery strike.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't a request, buddy.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Kara and her men are dropping in to join the final Exile push into Stormwing Fortress. She's asked you to secure safe landing zones by placing flares in the pre-designated areas - spots marked with an 'X' - in Stormwing Fortress.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Kara in Stormwing Fortress
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're about to drop into Stormwing Fortress, but I need you to place some flares for our guidance systems to key on. You game?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you don't place those flares on the X's, my men're gonna have a real rough landing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hope you saved some bad guys for the rest of us!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The assault troopers have designated safe landing zones with X's. You wanna place the flares there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Outstanding! Let's win this war!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You placed flares so that Sergeant Kara and her troopers could safely drop into Stormwing Fortress.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't the time to muck things up, sweetheart.

localizedTextIdText: If the Stormwing Falkrin are to be defeated, their spiritual leader, Bride Osprea, must first be killed. Sergeant Kara has ordered you to destroy the Stormwing Banner in Stormwing Fortress in order to lure Bride Osprea into the open.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In order to beat the Falkrin once and for all, we gotta take out their spiritual leader. Destroy Falkrin banners and maybe it'll lure her out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Bride Osprea's the one we want. Destroying those banners should anger her enough to draw her out of hiding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bride Osprea's the one we want. Destroying those banners should anger her enough to draw her out of hiding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's done it! The Falkrin are in full retreat now. You did quite a number on Osprea, my friend!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we don't kill Osprea, the Falkrin will never give up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You lured Bride Osprea out into the open and killed her, throwing the Stormwing Falkrin into disarray. Though the Falkrin are retreating, there's little doubt that the war against them is far from over.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're testing my patience, buddy.

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Argoz squad was sent to take out Breog the Bonebreaker, the Murgh guardian of Boneshatter Yard in Stormwing Fortress. Unfortunately, Trooper Argoz was wounded and his team was wiped out. He's asked you to take Breog the Bonebreaker out in his place.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Argoz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I gotta... gotta get on my feet. Everyone else... they didn't make it! We gotta take out Breog... failure's not an option!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Breog's one of them Murgh... big, ugly, 'n' stupid. Be careful... he's called 'Bonebreaker' for a reason.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got stones as big as the Moons of Gnox, friend... thanks for pullin' my mission outta the toilet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He's in... in Boneshatter Yard. I'd go with ya if I wasn't so messed up...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh... I dunno. I figure they'll send a medic to patch me up... eventually.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed Breog the Bonebreaker, significantly weakening the Falkrin forces in Stormwing Fortress.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe I can do it... just lemme catch my breath... *groan*

localizedTextIdText: Game Hunter Joresh wants you to hunt down and kill the massive ravenok known as Kuriktalon. The fearless feathered beast roams in the ruins of Kel Vishal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Game Hunter Joresh near Kel Vishal
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ever heard of Kuriktalon? Biggest ravenok in Galeras... maybe in all of Nexus. Roosts in Kel Vishal. So ya know what? I want him dead. What do ya say?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Killed Kuriktalon yet? He roams around Kel Vishal. I hear tell his feathers are worth a small fortune!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've returned! And with Kuriktalon's feathers, no less! You're quite the hunter, aren't ya?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're a brave one, aren't ya? But you'll need it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked down and killed the elusive Kuriktalon for Game Hunter Joresh. Perhaps he know where more prey can be found...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want him dead?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ya don't ask a mountain climber why he climbs the mountain, do ya? He just does it! It's the same with me!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Look. That big ugly bird's got feathers that are worth a fortune. Bring 'em to me, and I'll give you a fair share. Savvy?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Huntin' ain't for everyone, I guess.

localizedTextIdText: The bulk of Corporal Darby men are on their way to the rally point in Crosswind Fields, but the Falkrin are in hot pursuit. The corporal has asked you to take out the Falkrin attacking his troops.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corporal Darby at Crosswind Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Most of my men made it out of the temple, but the Falkrin are chasin' 'em down. We need your help if those troopers are going to make it out alive.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're makin' a stand here, so don't go wanderin' off! Speak with my assistant when you're ready to join the fight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Most everyone's here. I'm gonna form 'em up and move 'em out. We're fallin' back to Skywatch while we've got the chance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good to hear it! Speak with my assistant when you're ready.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Assisted by Corporal Darby and his men, you successfully eliminated the Falkrin pursuers. Your next move is to fall back and defend Skywatch outpost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've got to be jokin'!

localizedTextIdText: Following Commander Durek orbital strike upon the Temple of Osiric, the Falkrin god has declared war upon the offworlders and ordered the Falkrin people to cleanse Nexus of their enemies. Durek has ordered you to assist in the Exile retreat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corporal Darby at the Crosswind Fields rally point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These bird-brains are comin' on too strong! We gotta fall back! Support the retreat, will ya? And take some of those Falkrin out while you're at it!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What the hell are you doin' here? I said to cover our retreat! Move it, trooper!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We still have men in the field gettin' chopped up by the Falkrin! Shouldn't you be helpin' 'em?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a sight for sore eyes. Did everyone make it out okay?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you're done, meet up with Corporal Darby at the rally point. Good luck!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think so... it's a mess out there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You held off the Falkrin and assisted Exile troops in their retreat from the Temple of Osiric. Despite this, the Falkrin are not far behind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is an argument you're gonna lose, recruit.

localizedTextIdText: You and Deadeye Brightland intercepted a distress call from Widow Goldcastle in Gallow, a nearby mining settlement. They're having trouble with the nefarious Darkspur Cartel. Head to Gallow and see what you can do to help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Widow Goldcastle in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Widow Goldcastle called me, says the Darkspur Cartel's makin' a move against the town of Gallow. Might be they could use some help from you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You talk with the widow yet? She wouldn't call unless there was real trouble in Gallow. The Darkspur Cartel are bad folks... real bad.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Things are bad, friend. Morek Throg - a Darkspur Cartel crime boss - is sendin' thugs to torment the folk of Gallow. Can you help us?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch yourself out there, friend. The Darkspur are like a pack of mad dogs.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sounds like I can help out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Widow Goldcastle of Gallow has asked for your help fighting off the vicious thugs of the Darkspur Cartel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't help out Widow Goldcastle, I'm gonna be real unhappy.

localizedTextIdText: Morek Throg of the Darkspur Cartel is looking to take over the mining town of Gallow, and his thugs are making life a living hell for the townsfolk. Hit the streets and help anyone you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Throg's not afraid of anything or anybody. While he was gettin' the drop on you and Kain, he sent his thugs to attack folks in the streets. Help 'em if you can!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Throg's Cartel thugs are terrorizin' the people o' Gallow. They killed the peacekeeper, and we got no one else. Can you help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Throg's boys aren't finished, but folks know someone's standing up for the town now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You've got courage, friend. More than me, and that's my shame to bear.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, $(player.class). I hope you've got the stomach for more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You stood up to the Cartel thugs threatening the people of Gallow, and you showed Morek Throg he won't have an easy time if he wants to take over.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Those poor folks are gonna pay for what you and Kain were gonna do.

localizedTextIdText: Justice Graybank has advised you to check in on Doc Moonwell, who's working on the injured Judge Kain in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Doc Moonwell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kain's hurt bad, $(player.class), but I'd bet my favorite rifle he's gonna recover. The Doc's back there workin' on him right now.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You find Doc Moonwell yet? How's Kain doing?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I wanna help Judge Kain, and stars know we need him, but the Cartel confiscated my medical supplies when they overran the town.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I never seen anything that could kill Kain. Go see for yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You bet I do. This is where you come in, $(player.race).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Doc Moonwell wants to help the wounded Kain, but Throg's men stole her medical supplies. If you can get them back, she'll do what she can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get out of my sight. I'll find an Exile worth my time.

localizedTextIdText: Sabotage the Cartel's Slush Still at the Crowe Family Homestead.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Justice Alastair via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Cartel uses these stills to make slushbrew. The stills could be sabotaged, which will prevent the Crowes from making any more of their poison hooch.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Cartel uses these stills to make slushbrew. The stills could be sabotaged, which will prevent the Crowes from making any more of their poison hooch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those Cartel slush stills have gotta go, $(player.class). If you stop up their vent tubes, they're sure to blow sky high!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job! Blowin' up the Cartel's slush stills will put those creeps out of business, at least for a bit. You done right by your people, Exile.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was a messy job, but someone had to do it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully sabotaged the Cartel's Slush Still, hampering Morek Throg's efforts to spread toxic slushbrew throughout the Gallow area.

localizedTextIdText: Doc Moonwell, Gallow's resident healer, is ready to help Judge Kain, but the Darkspur Cartel's goons made off with her medical supplies. You'll need to kill some Cartel thugs to get those supplies back.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Doc Moonwell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Blasted Cartel thugs took my medical supplies, and I need 'em if I'm gonna patch up the judge. You'll have to get 'em back by force, I reckon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm gonna need those medical supplies if I'm gonna help Judge Kain. But Throg's men took 'em, and they ain't givin' 'em back without a fight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With these medical supplies, I can patch up the judge in no time. I reckon he'll be none too pleased about losin' that arm, though.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Forget my oath! I want you to make those goons suffer!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully recovered Doc Moonwell medical supplies from the Darkspur Cartel. Now she should be able to get Judge Kain back on his feet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd do it myself, if I could. Would that make you look bad?

localizedTextIdText: Prospector Burk, a Granok mine owner, has asked you to save his miners from the Darkspur Cartel's goons in Burk's Claim. The Cartel is muscling in on Prospector Burk claim, and they don't care how many people they hurt.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Prospector Burk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Blasted Darkspur! They're musclin' in on my claim. I'll survive, but ya gotta do somethin' about the boys in the mine. They're defenseless!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Cartel is movin' in on my claim, and my miners are in trouble. Do somethin' about those Cartel thugs before they murder my whole blasted crew!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for savin' my boys, $(player.name). They're good fellas, and most of 'em got families. You done a lotta good today.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go save my boys!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now maybe we can get rid of those lowdown Cartel bastards once and for all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took care of the Darkspur Cartel thugs that were attacking the miners in Burk's Claim.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why are they giving you a hard time?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Them boys are miners, not fighters! That's your job! Now go 'n' save 'em! Be sure to damage those scumbags real good, ya hear?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: How should I know? They're pesterin' everybody in Gallow. Damn savages! They think they've got a claim to everything in the damn universe!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not very neighborly of ya, pal.

localizedTextIdText: With the Darkspur Cartel neutralized, Trooper Tarog wants you to check up on the scientists at the XAS Forward Camp. When you arrive at the camp, speak to Lead Scientist Armin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You did a helluva job on the Cartel. If you're willin', I'd like you to take a hike to the XAS Forward Camp to the south. See if they're doin' okay.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you checked in at the XAS Forward Camp yet? It's not real far from here. Tell Armin I said hello!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I must apologize, but I'm rather busy at the moment. Could you come back later?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pell banners in the canyons? That's odd. We haven't had any run-ins with the Pell. None at all! It's probably nothing, but....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep an eye out for anything out of the ordinary. I'll be in touch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Some of our field researchers are missing. I hope the Pell aren't involved.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On your way to the XAS Forward Camp, you discovered signs that the Pell are staking claim to land that is well outside of their usual territory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thanks for nothin', chum.

localizedTextIdText: Search the Crowe Homestead for hard proof of the Crowes' involvement in the slush ring.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Justice Alastair via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've found out how the Crowe gang has been producing slush. Search for additional information and deliver it to Justice Alastair.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You've found out how the Crowe gang has been producing slush. Search for additional information and deliver it to Justice Alastair.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need documented proof of what the Crowes are up to in Algoroc. If you found somethin' in that Crowe camp, there might be something we can use against 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew it! This evidence is further proof that the Crowes are plannin' to fund the Cartel with the money they make from slushbrew. Now we can really nail 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for bringin' this to me, $(player.name). You're a straight shooter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found internal documents describing the Crowes' plan to acquire the tools and machinery to produce and distribute their own brand of slush.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can dig up.

localizedTextIdText: Judge Kain has been stabilized, but he lost an arm in Throg's treacherous ambush. He demands you find Botsmith Redfield to craft him a new one. Look for Botsmith Redfield in Halsen's Claim.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Foreman Halsen in Halsen's Claim
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm only half a judge without a shootin' arm. Get me... a botsmith. I need a replacement arm, and I reckon Botsmith Redfield's the only chance I got.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The doc's done all she can for me. Now I need Botsmith Redfield to help me replace my missin' arm. Should be able to find him in one of the mines.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Redfield? Good luck there. He headed deep into the mine, and I ain't seen him since those monsters drove everyone else out! Far as I know, he's dead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Look for Redfield doin' upkeep on drills in one of the loftite mines.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived at Halsen's Claim, only to find Botsmith Redfield missing in action after strange creatures emerged from the mine. Foreman Halsen believes the botsmith is still inside the mine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't stand in the way of justice, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Retrieve Patron Purdo stolen dyes from the Skeech cave near Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Patron Purdo in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A splendid greeting to you, best friend of the future! The Skeech-men took my provisions, and I don't know what to do. But I bet you do!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: An enthusiastic and manic hello, friend of me! The Skeech-people appear to have taken my dyes. I'd love to get them back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My provisions! My specially packed, extra-bright dyes! We are great friends now, I think. Now I share with you my wealth!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Retrieve my goods, and I'll happily offer you a one percent discount!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You retrieved Patron Purdo dyes from the Skeech cave near Gallow, apparently earning a friend for life.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you will not help me, I'll be forced to spread nasty rumors about you.

localizedTextIdText: Thanks to you, the Falkrin attack on Skywatch outpost has been beaten back. Sergeant Royce has asked you to speak to Mechanic Grumshot at the Skywatch Motor Pool in order to rustle up some extra firepower for the Exile counterattack.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mechanic Grumshot at the Skywatch Motor Pool
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to hit our feathered friends while they're still reelin'. Check in with Mechanic Grumshot. See if she's got some extra firepower for us.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What's the word from Grumshot? You did talk to her, didn't you? We ain't got much time to turn this situation around.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're the one who taught the Falkrin how to die today, hmm? Everyone here owes you one... even me. So, how can I thank you properly?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Grumshot's a swell lady and a wicked good hoverbike mechanic. She'll treat you right.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're right... and I have! Meet the Mark IX Rocket Bike! Ain't she a beaut?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sure you'll think of something.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Mechanic Grumshot, and she's offered you an upgraded hoverbike with an integrated rocket launcher. The Falkrin won't know what hit 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What's wrong? You too busy to do the right thing?

localizedTextIdText: Madeline Forster asked you to search the area outside Gallow for her husband, Ranger Forster. He went missing around the same time the Darkspur Cartel arrived in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Via Datachron, report to Madeline Forster in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My husband, a ranger, went huntin' outside of town a few nights ago and hasn't come home. I'm worried sick, but no one will go look for him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found any sign of my husband? I don't know if it was a beast or man that got to him, but I know somethin' must have happened out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You found his camp site and his journal? That's somethin', at least... maybe he had to run. Yes, he... he could still be alive....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I sure do hope Devin's okay. He's all I've got left!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Are you willin' to help me some more?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Ranger Forster campsite, but not the man himself. You passed along the sad news to his grieving wife, Madeline.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: When did you see him last?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Like I said, it's been a few nights now. He went out huntin' about the same time the Cartel arrived here. I hope they didn't hurt him!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're a real piece of work, you know that?

localizedTextIdText: You found the body of an XAS researcher named Cale Stone near Whimflower Grove. His notes indicate that he was attempting to complete an Osun ritual to summon a powerful being known as the Ravager. The Ravager killed Cale, but you are convinced you can defeat it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Place Offerings in front of the Ravager Idol near Whimflower Grove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This dead researcher's notes describe an Osun ritual to summon the Ravager. It seems that the Ravager was too strong for him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The researcher's ID card identifies him as Cale Stone of the XAS. Whatever he summoned at the Osun idol tore him to pieces.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered the components necessary to complete the Osun ritual and summon the Ravager. All that remains is to test yourself against this powerful foe.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Place Offerings in front of the Idol

localizedTextIdText: You placed the ritual offering before the Ravager's idol in Crosswind Fields. You must now sound the Vishal Thun ritual drum to summon the Ravager and defeat it!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Mallix in Skywatch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ritual offering has been placed before the Ravager's idol. All that remains is to beat the ritual drum and call the Ravager forth!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Cale Stone's notes indicate that the ritual drum must be sounded in order to complete the summoning ritual.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Keep an eye out for Cale Stone. He's an XAS researcher who went missing out in the Crosswind Fields.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's sad when we lose anyone, but Cale knew he was takin' a risk. At least the thing that killed him is dead, too... thanks to you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I guess it's time to face the Ravager.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Cale's a fool to fight that alone.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You vanquished The Ravager and avenged Cale Stone death.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I guess it's time to face the Ravager.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll keep an eye out for him.

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Darby has asked you to clear the way for his troops' withdrawal to Skywatch outpost. When you arrive in Skywatch, you're to help defend the base from the Falkrin if necessary, then report to Sergeant Royce.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Royce in Skywatch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Head back to Skywatch and make sure the way is clear for us. Depending on what's goin' on there, you may need to pitch in right away.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't wait for us... get movin' to Skywatch, and make it snappy. We'll be right behind you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where did all these bird-men come from? We've got to hold 'em off and get the AA guns workin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I ain't happy, but that's nothin' new. At least you showed up to pull our buns out of the fire, and I'm thankful for it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: All right. Get movin'. I'll see you soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Falkrin attack was already underway in Skywatch when you arrived there ahead of Corporal Darby troops. With your help, the military outpost's defenses were raised and the Falkrin were pushed back... but for how long?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Damn. You're one heck of a disappointment, friend.

localizedTextIdText: Cartel slavers have tethered captured Exiles in Grim Valley. An escaped slave named Ranger Forster wants you to set the other slaves free.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ranger Forster via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Cartel slavers got our people, and they're workin' 'em to the bone. I tracked 'em up here, but they caught me too. You gotta set our people free!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Their chains are what keeps 'em on a leash. Break the fetters and they'll make a break for it, like I did. Just watch 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Their chains are what keeps 'em on a leash. Break the fetters and they'll make a break for it, like I did. Just watch 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it! I'm tellin' ya from personal experience, you've saved those people from a fate worse'n death. Thank you, friend!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I barely got away. I can't be any help. But you, you'll save 'em, right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully freed many captured Exiles from Hilda Grim and her Cartel slavers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you turn your back on your own kind?

localizedTextIdText: Ranger Forster, having recently escaped from Cartel slavers, has told you where more Exiles are being held in slave pens. They're kept in Grim Valley prior to being shipped off-world. Break the slave pens open and set them free!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ranger Forster via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's more of our folk penned up not far from here. Break 'em out before the Cartel ships 'em off-planet to some fringe world slave market!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Those Cartel slavers are holding our people caged like livestock! That's no way for an Exile to live! You gotta break 'em outta there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those Cartel slavers are holding our people caged like livestock! That's no way for an Exile to live! You gotta break 'em outta there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You saved a lotta people from lives of slavery today, $(player.name). The people of Gallow are in your debt... and so am I. Thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're all countin' on you, even if they don't know it yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully freed captured Exiles from the Darkspur Cartel's slave pens in Grim Valley!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't got time to waste talkin' to a coward!

localizedTextIdText: Use the incendiary grenades you discovered to burn the Cartel's slave camp to the ground.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ranger Forster via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The incendiary grenades inside this crate could burn this entire slaver camp to the ground. Time to get to work!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The incendiary grenades inside this crate could burn this entire slaver camp to the ground. Time to get to work!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You found incendiaries? You could burn down the whole blasted slaver camp with those! I certainly wouldn't stop ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I heard - and saw - what you did with those incendiary grenades. Did my Exile heart good to see them slavers suffer, $(player.class). Real good!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll burn the slaver camp down.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You burned the Cartel's slaver camp to the ground with their own incendiary grenades, and you made Ranger Forster really happy in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll burn the slaver camp down.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll burn the slaver camp down.

localizedTextIdText: Tempest Refuge is running low on supplies, which are usually brought up from Nibben's Ranch. Provisioner Clayfield is concerned that something might have happened to Jed Nibben and his family, and she'd like you to go to Nibben's Ranch and check on them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Jed Nibben at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The latest shipment from Nibben's Ranch is late... that's the second this week! I don't suppose you'd go down there and check on things, would you?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We need those supplies, but I'd be happy just knowing the Nibbens are alright.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did Clayfield send ya? We're in a real bad way around here, if ya get my meanin'. Can ya lend us a hand, stranger?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Jed and Fannie are good, decent folk. I hope nothing's happened to 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Nibben's Ranch and spoke with Jed Nibben.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? You won't help? Well... okay... moron.

localizedTextIdText: Poison Gas Canister have been dropped all over Nibben's Ranch by the Crimson Legion. Jed Nibben has asked you to find the Poison Gas Canister and seal them using industrial glue. He'd also be obliged if you would escort Poisoned Farmer to the safety of his barn.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Clyde Nibben in the barn at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Them Dommie bastards! Droppin' poison gas on my farm, hurtin' my farmhands! Someone's gotta seal them canisters up and save my people!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you gonna do about them poison gas canisters? And my farmhands? Huh? They ain't gonna last long out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This isn't everyone. There've got to be more farmhands out in the fields... best head back out and see if you can save more of 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Why'd the Dominion do that? Try 'n' poison us like that? We're just farmers, plain and simple. We ain't hurtin' no one.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: By the stars, you're a blessin'. Go out there and save my boys!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Jed Nibben by saving Poisoned Farmer and sealing up Dominion Poison Gas Canister.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you leave my boys out there to die like that? How?

localizedTextIdText: Mack Elkhart at Nibben's Ranch hates buzzbings, especially when they're angry. He's asked you to exterminate any buzzbings you find buzzing around the Whimwood Hives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mack Elkhart at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I love honey, but I hate buzzbings. All this action's stirred the bugs up, and now they're buzzin' around the fields, out for blood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Check the Whimwood Hives if you're lookin' for buzzbings. Don't get stung!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You killed yourself some buzzbings, and you're still alive. I guess you ain't got the allergies I got, eh? You lucky devil, you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Some of 'em, sure. Not all of 'em! Gotta leave some for the honey, yeah?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed a bunch of buzzbings for Mack Elkhart at Nibben's Ranch.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm allergic to the bastards. Just one of 'em stings me and I'll be deader 'n' Dominus!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yep... I sure hate big, mean, stingin' bugs. I surely do.

localizedTextIdText: The citizens of Tempest Refuge rely on supplies from Nibben's Ranch, including honey harvested from buzzbing hives. Fannie Nibben has asked you to gather honey from buzzbings at Nibben's Ranch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Fannie Nibben at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Things may be bad here, but they're worse in Tempest Refuge. I want to send those folks some supplies. Can you pitch in and gather some honey?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you're scared of the buzzbings, I can't say as I blame you... but that honey still needs harvested. Best get a move on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got the honey! That's great! Did you get stung at all? Let old Fannie have a look, now. I've got a salve that'll take the swelling down.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful around those buzzbings, now! They pack quite a wallop!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered Immature Skug Pheromone Gland from the nearby buzzbings for Fannie Nibben and the citizens of Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Scared of buzzbings? Well, I can't blame ya... but we could use the help.

localizedTextIdText: Following the Dominion's attack on his ranch, Jed Nibben roan herd has scattered into the fields. Jed's asked you to venture into the fields and give the beasts a prod so they'll return to Nibben's Ranch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Jed Nibben at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With all the bombs 'n' excitement, my roan herd's done run off. We've got to get 'em back here before they get hurt. Think you can help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You find the roan herd yet? We need to get those critters back here, and fast.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work roundin' up the roan. Looks like we'll have enough meat to feed our fightin' men 'n' women. You done good again!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use this prod 'n' give 'em a jolt... they already know the way back here.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm all too happy to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to restore Jed Nibben roan herd following the Dominion's attacks in Galeras.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Them roan are my lifeline, $(player.name). Without 'em, I'll be ruined.

localizedTextIdText: With your help, the Nibbens have managed to put together a shipment of supplies for Tempest Refuge. Jed Nibben would like you to escort the Pack Kurg{p:Pack Kurg} to Tempest Refuge and ensure it remains safe.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Provisioner Clayfield in Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've got enough supplies loaded up on our kurg now. Might as well take 'em to Tempest Refuge. Care to cover my boys on the trip?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have the supplies reached Tempest Refuge yet? Those poor people need food, badly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're in a bad way here, make no mistake. Folks are goin' hungry! If they got food at Nibben's Ranch, it needs to get here, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a good thing you came along when you did. Our food situation was starting to look dire. Thanks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect the Dommies won't be happy about us takin' supplies to Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Pack Kurg{p:Pack Kurg} was ambushed by Imperial agents, but you were able to defend the supplies and ensured they reached Tempest Refuge safely.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is your chance to be a hero. You wanna be a hero, don't ya?

localizedTextIdText: The Chua have managed to tunnel past the barricades and are now wreaking havoc in Tempest Refuge. Mayor Crofton has asked you to seal the Chua Tunnel Entrance and kill the Chua Operatives, Medics, and Sappers that are terrorizing the town.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mayor Crofton near the town's Landing Zone
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Chua are inside the walls! They tunneled in somehow, and they're killin' everyone! Please, stranger, you've got to do somethin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's Chua everywhere! You need to kill 'em and destroy the tunnels they're usin' to get in!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Chua won't let up! How in blazes are we going to make it through this? We need help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please, hurry! We won't last much longer with so many of 'em comin' at us!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's time to bring out the heavy guns.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've sealed many of the Chua Tunnel Entrance in Tempest Refuge, and put even more Chua attackers in shallow graves. Despite your progress, the Chua appear to be far from beaten.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've got to be kiddin' me!

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Kara has asked you to infiltrate and search the Chua basecamp at Kendra's Roan Ranch, northwest of Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a Chua camp outside of Tempest Refuge. We need to find out what those slanks are up to. Looks like you got the duty, sweetheart.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What's goin' on with those Chua, $(player.name)? We ain't got all day.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's goin' on with those Chua, $(player.name)? We ain't got all day.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Chua are gonna drill beneath Tempest Refuge and destroy it from below? It's not inspired, but it's definitely somethin' those rodents would do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't get yourself killed by a bunch of rodents, you hear?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully infiltrated the Chua basecamp at Kendra's Roan Ranch and discovered the Dominion is planning the complete destruction of Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're needed here, pal. Best get with the program.

localizedTextIdText: The Chua Inventors, Migo and Mogi, plan to destroy Tempest Refuge from below. Sergeant Kara has asked you to sabotage Groundswell Drillbomb and kill Dominion troops at Kendra's Roan Ranch in order to hinder the Dominion Operation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Chua are gonna use drillbombs as part of their subterranean attack on Tempest Refuge. Find those drillbombs and sabotage 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Be sure and sabotage all the drillbombs you find. Don't leave nothin' for the Chua!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Impressive work, but you ain't done yet. There's one more thing to do, and it's a doozy...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take out some of those Dommie soldiers while you're at it. Give 'em what-for!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep on your toes, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully sabotaged Groundswell Drillbomb in the Chua base camp at Kendra's Roan Ranch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Durek's gonna be disappointed when he finds out what a coward you really are.

localizedTextIdText: Thanks to the Chua, Tempest Refuge in Galeras is on fire. Firefighter Wardell needs your help to douse the flames if there is to be anything left of the town.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Firefighter Wardell in Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Chua have been driven off, for the most part, but the vermin left our town in flames. You need to help me put these fires out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the fire extinguisher to put out fires and to save burning citizens before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We owe you a big debt, friend. You're welcome in Tempest Refuge any time you like.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks in advance! Here! Use this fire extinguisher to douse the flames!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Firefighter Wardell bring the fires in Tempest Refuge under control.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: There won't be anything left without your help.

localizedTextIdText: Mayor Crofton has asked you to plant Target Dummy along the paths leading to Mount Tempest in order to fool the Dominion attackers. The Mayor's hope is that the Dominion will be tricked into believing there is a larger Exile force in the region.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mayor Crofton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If planted around Mount Tempest, these target dummies may fool the Dominion into thinking there are more Exile defenders than there actually are.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: These target dummies don't do much good if they're left lying around. Maybe you can find a use for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you plant any of those target dummies on the mountain?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work with those target dummies. We're hearin' that the Dommies think we've got five times as many men on the mountain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You planted Target Dummy along the paths leading to Mount Tempest, causing the Dominion no small amount of confusion.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll plant target dummies on Mount Tempest.

localizedTextIdText: Communication systems are down, so Commander Kriton has ordered you to check on the new recruits outside Kriton's Command Post - Kit Brinny near the barricades, Matthias Black at the generator, and Daniel Bronson on the wall - in person, and offer them any assistance you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Kriton at Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Comms are on the fritz. It's up to you to hoof it out there and check on the troops, see if they need any backup.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You check on the troops yet? Get movin' and do what you can, on the double!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You held the line, cleared the skies, and even got the comms back up. Good work. Too bad about Bronson, though. That boy was primed to be a great soldier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soldiers need good NCOs on the line. See that you make me proud.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll mourn him later, along with Renzig and the rest of the dead.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided the new recruits, but Daniel Bronson was killed during a Dominion airstrike. Despite the casualty, Commander Kriton was pleased with the outcome of your mission.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see who else needs help.
