localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: She's been assigned to gate duty. That lady's one tough cookie, but I'm sure she'd be happy if you were there to watch her back.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Our power generator was knocked out when that Dommie bomber crashed. He's gonna get it runnin' again.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: He's up on the wall, manning an anti-aircraft turret. Once the gate's clear and the power's restored, I have a feelin' he'll have his hands full.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Excuse me?

localizedTextIdText: Leara Seaspray is overwhelmed by the number of wounded soldiers flooding her medical station. She's asked you to help out by using medspray to treat wounded patients and shock paddles to keep critically-wounded patients alive.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Leara Seaspray at her Medical Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Can you please help me with all these patients? I'm overwhelmed here! Medspray for the wounded ones, shock paddles for the critical ones! Stat!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Shock paddles should keep the critical patients alive, and medspray will make the wounded ones feel better.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm sure a lot of these soldiers would've died if you hadn't come along. Thanks so much for your help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, bless you! I'm just a veterinarian! I'm not trained to treat people!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You employed both shock paddles and medspray to excellent effect and saved many lives in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't save them all by myself! I just can't!

localizedTextIdText: Daniel Bronson has been seriously wounded by a Dominion rocket. He's asked you to initialize the Automated Targeting Console to activate the automated anti-aircraft defenses on the wall.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Daniel Bronson on the wall
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm... not... not going to make it. You're going to have to power up the guns for me. Think you can do that, Sarge?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If those bombers lock onto their targets, everyone will die. You need to hurry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: T-thank you... at least my life was given... given for something important. Remember me, Sarge!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry! You have to get the turrets online before... before it's too late....
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Tell Cordelia... my wife... how much I love her....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Even though Daniel Bronson has been killed in action, you were able to activate Thayd's anti-aircraft guns to defend against the attacking Crimson Attackship.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nice try, Sarge... but I can feel it already. There's nothing... nothing anyone can do. Just get those guns up and running!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you just stand there like that?

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a crate of land mines. Planting the mines in the path of the advancing Crimson Siege Tank near the Overrun Outpostwould certainly put a crimp in the Dominion's attack plans, as well as relieve some of the pressure on Thayd's Exile defenders.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kriton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This crate contains antitank mines. It'd be a simple task to place these mines in the path of the Dominion tanks that are assaulting Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Placing these mines in the path of a Dominion tank would certainly put them to a better use.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dominion armor's choppin' my boys up! There's gotta be somethin' we can do about it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work out there. Many victories are built upon usin' the tools of the enemy - like his antitank mines - against him.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I know the perfect place for these.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You planted mines in the path of a Crimson Siege Tank, destroying the tank and striking a blow for the Exiles!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I know the perfect place for these.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I think I have an idea!

localizedTextIdText: Thugs working for Morek Throg of the Darkspur Cartel tortured Gallow's lone peacekeeper to death, then left him pinned up for all the townsfolk to see. Widow Goldcastle, one of the Gallow locals, has asked you to take down the peacekeeper's body.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Widow Goldcastle in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those monsters tortured Williams... the town peacekeeper... to death. Then they... they just left him there. Please, stranger. Get him down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: All Williams wanted to do was serve and protect the people of Gallow... and they... they killed him for it. We can't leave him out there like that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll see to the body now. Thank you, friend, for your kindness to a stranger.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He tried to stop 'em. He tried to save us! We owe him better'n this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've taken down the lifeless body of Gallow's peacekeeper, who was killed by the Darkspur Cartel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I reckon you're no better than them Darkspur monsters.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Kriton has ordered you to proceed to the Ravaged Front, near the main gate, and help out any wounded Exile soldiers you find beyond the breach in the walls. Concentrate on healing wounded soldiers and assisting Exile soldiers in combat against the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kriton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You know what, kid? I like you. That's why I'm sendin' you to the front lines. Your mission's to fix up wounded soldiers. Help 'em in any way you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in blazes have you been up to? Quit dawdlin' and get your butt to the Ravaged Front! Those boys need medical attention!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work! You saved plenty of lives out there today. Now, it's time to take the fight to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Aid the wounded. Got it? Now move out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Before we launch a counterattack, though, we gotta smash their anti-air gun.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've been instrumental in delivering vital aid to Exile soldiers at the Ravaged Front in Galeras.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got some nerve refusing a direct order.

localizedTextIdText: Assist Mesmer Radu in his interrogation of the Captured Crimson Airman so that you can learn more about the Dominion's plans in Galeras. Mesmer Radu can be found in his camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Kriton at Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that we've got that airman under wraps, we need to squeeze him for intel. How about you go to Mesmer Radu's camp and lend him a hand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go on, head over to Mesmer Radu's camp. Give him a hand pullin' out toenails or whatever it is he does.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Tempest Refuge is the Dominion's real target? Slag it! That ain't what I wanted to hear, but now that we know, we better do somethin' about it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Radu's methods aren't conventional, but they're usually pretty effective.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We haven't heard a peep outta Tempest Refuge since the comms went offline.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While interrogating the Captured Crimson Airman, you revealed that the Dominion's real target in Galeras is not Thayd, but Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wanna save lives? Better get with the program, then.

localizedTextIdText: In light of the information given to you by the Captured Crimson Airman, Commander Kriton has ordered you to board a Stinger and fly to Tempest Refuge. Once you arrive, speak to Mayor Crofton and see what you can do to help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mayor Crofton in Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We gotta send someone to Tempest Refuge pronto, and I know the perfect person for the job.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: When you get to Tempest Refuge, talk to the mayor and find out what's goin' on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Who are you? I don't believe we've met, stranger.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lords and liars, am I glad to see you! We've had to hold the Dominion back all by ourselves. Speaking of which, you're not... alone... are you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pack your bags. There's a Stinger waitin' for you at the landing pad.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't know what one $(player.class) can be expected to accomplish.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully reached Tempest Refuge and spoke to Mayor Crofton.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a village here in Galeras. A lot of our supplies are routed through Tempest Refuge, so it's a pretty important place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you still got things to do here, get 'em done, but be quick about it.

localizedTextIdText: Power up the Inactive Demolitionbot to break up pure loftite formations in First Strike Mine. Pure loftite formations can be distinguished from normal loftite by their purple color.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Town Mineralogist via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When activated, this demolitionbot targets and breaks up pure loftite formations into crystals the people of Gallow use for power production.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: When activated, this demolitionbot targets and breaks up pure loftite formations into crystals the people of Gallow use for power production.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get a demolitionbot to bust up some o' the loftite in the First Strike Mine. Gallow can make use of the crystals. To hell with Throg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work with that demolitionbot. Nothin' more invigoratin' than bustin' rocks, eh, $(player.class)?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully used Inactive Demolitionbot to destroy loftite formations throughout First Strike Mine.

localizedTextIdText: The town of Gallow is in trouble, and Widow Goldcastle has sent you to speak with Chronicler Herrick Grenfell. He can fill you in on how to help desperate townsfolk, should you be so inclined.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Gallow's always been a rough and tumble place, but since Throg showed up, the folks have been fightin' for their lives. Maybe you can you help us?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are ya waitin' for? Go find Chronicler Grenfell. He'll be able to tell you what needs doing and how best to do it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If you're lookin' to help the folk of Gallow, then you'll need to do somethin' about Morek Throg and the Darkspur Cartel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Talk to Herrick, our chronicler. He'll set you straight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: By the stars, those bastards cut up a peacekeeper! They're killers!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have spoken with Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in the Gallow Chronicle House.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why would you want to turn your back on us?

localizedTextIdText: Crystal Shardigan would like you to collect 5 Initiate Crystals for her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bob the Builder with news of your success.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been collecting Initiate Crystals for a couple of days, but I need a couple more to finish my collection. You wouldn't mind bringing some back for me, would you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The crystals are scattered throughout the forest past the lumber workers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh thank you so much, these look so pretty.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I've been collecting Initiate Crystals for a couple of days, but I need a couple more to finish my collection. You wouldn't mind bringing some back for me, would you?

localizedTextIdText: After hearing of the trouble in Gallow, Judge Kain and Justice Graybank have asked to meet you at Kain's Camp outside of town.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Inspect Judge Kain's Arm outside Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was just about to lift off. I'd heard rumors of the Cartel, but I was told to pay 'em no mind. Come meet me, and we'll handle this one together.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Meet me on the hills outside town. We'll deal with these killers. If you'd like to see justice done, I reckon you can join me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It looks like that grenade got the best of Judge Kain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll see you outside Gallow. Kain out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After traveling to Kain's Camp to meet with the justices, you were all ambushed by the Darkspur Cartel. Though you survived, Judge Kain was horribly wounded and his life now hangs by a thread. Hopefully someone in Gallow can mend his wounds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hide, then. I don't need the likes of you anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Rampaging gronyx have Botsmith Redfield trapped inside Halsen's Claim. Cut a path through the rocky monsters and rescue him, or he won't be able to help the grievously injured Judge Kain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Judge Kain in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These gronyx are all over my claim, but Botsmith Redfield's still down there somewhere. If you need him, you'd better go get him before it's too late!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Good luck findin' Redfield in the mine. I'll stay here and keep an eye out for other survivors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't need a doctor. I need a new arm. Get me Botsmith Redfield, or my judgin' days are over. I heard he was workin' in Halsen's Claim.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did well savin' Redfield. He'll serve the cause of justice when he makes me a new arm. And he'd better not take too long, 'cause justice can't wait.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He's a brave son of a gun, but these gronyx ain't messin' around.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Botsmith Redfield trapped in Halsen's Claim and helped him escape. With luck, he'll be able to help replace Judge Kain missing arm.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're right. He's probably dead already. He was a good botsmith.

localizedTextIdText: Chronicler Herrick Grenfell suggested you create a distraction with riderless hot-wired speeders, so you can safely bring Kain to the Chronicle House in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Throg's men will never let you get Kain back here without a diversion. Maybe... yes! Those speeders parked outside! Start 'em up and put 'em in gear!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gotta distract Throg's boys with those rogue speeders, or we'll never get the judge to Gallow. Hurry! He's bleedin' out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You pulled it off, $(player.class). We got Kain back here alive! Now we gotta make sure he stays that way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A few riderless hunks of speedin' metal should work! Instant distraction!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad the judge made it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You distracted Throg's thugs with hot-wired speeders, allowing the severely injured Judge Kain to arrive safely at the Chronicle House in Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Kain's going to die if you don't do something!

localizedTextIdText: Throg's attack on Judge Kain's Regulators has left Kain in bad shape. Hopefully, Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in Gallow can help figure out how to get the critically injured Kain to a doctor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kain needs a doctor, but you don't dare move him without help. You should speak with the Chronicler in Gallow to decide your next course of action.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Kain needs a doctor, but don't dare move him without help. You should speak with the Chronicler in Gallow to decide your next course of action.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Throg ambushed Kain? Stars! There's no low that gangster won't sink to! Look... I'll send help, but I'm stayin' here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Did you see what they did to that peacekeeper? I ain't endin' up like that!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll talk to Grenfell in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Herrick Grenfell reluctantly agreed to send people to bring the injured Judge Kain back to Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll talk to Grenfell in Gallow.

localizedTextIdText: You've arrived at the rendezvous point to begin operations, but Sergeant Kara needs you to clear the area of Crimson Legion soldiers and their bots first. You can find them prowling around Windspire Vigil.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sergeant Kara at Windspire Vigil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Support troops are on the way, but we got Dominion scouts and bots all over the place. Show 'em what happens when they come sniffin' around my backyard.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You take care of those scouts yet? You better. There's nothing like a surprise Dominion attack to ruin your day.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work keepin' this spot secure. Now we can get this party started properly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I saw some of those bastards on the other side of this windmill.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we're ready for the next stage of the mission.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've cleared out the Dominion's advance patrols nearWindspire Vigil in order to keep the location secure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now, now. Don't make me ask twice.

localizedTextIdText: You noticed all the poison canisters lying around the Crimson Base of Operations. Use their own poison against them, by sabotaging the Crimson Legion Medical Stations!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Maybe you should put these poison canisters to work for the Exiles. The Crimson Legion medical stations look like a good place to start...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Just imagine all the havoc you could cause by mixing some of this poison into the Dominion's medical stations...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Part of a good offense is usin' the enemy's stores against 'em, like puttin' poison in their medical stations. Give 'em a taste of their own medicine!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm pretty sure the Dommies won't like how bitter that medicine tastes! Good thinkin', $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You slipped poison into all the Crimson Legion Medical Stations at the Crimson Base of Operations with unfortunate results for the Crimson Legion Forces.

localizedTextIdText: If you give the loaded Cargo Lifters in the Crimson Base of Operations a push, you should be able to blow up the Crimson Legion weapon supplies. The explosives stacked on top of the lifters will do the rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Well look at that. You may be able to use this remote to give those cargo lifters a push... into the Dominion's weapon supplies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What the heck are you lookin' at me like that for? Ain't you got somethin' to do?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Uh-oh. Those damn cargo lifters went and destroyed all the Dominion's weapon supplies. It's a cryin' shame, ain't it? Boo hoo hoo.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe we should send 'em a card or somethin'? Then again, nah. Let 'em cry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Crimson Legion learned an important lesson in fire safety - don't leave explosives lying around for an Exile to find. You successfully used their own Galeras Cargo Lifter to blow up Dominion weapon supplies in the Crimson Base of Operations.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Kara wants you to eliminate Crimson Legion battlebots and spiderbots in the Crimson Base of Operations and collect Ancient Statue from them for analysis. She believes there must be some way to decommission the bots without having to fight all of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: See all the Dommie bots walkin' around? They're gonna be a problem. Crack a few open and rip out their circuits. Maybe we can use 'em to hack their controls.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you get those circuits from those Dommie bots yet? Knock a few of 'em down and see what you can salvage. Hopefully, it'll come in handy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You get those circuits from those Dommie bots yet? Knock a few of 'em down and see what you can salvage. Hopefully, they should come in handy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should do the trick. Now that they've been reprogrammed, those Crimson Legion bots won't be attackin' you anymore. Score one for the Exiles!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Check 'em all, both spiderbots and battlebots. Good luck.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Crimson Bot Circuitry{p:Crimson Bot Circuitry} you collected proved quite useful. Using the Dominion's own technology, you were able to hack into the sentrybot control panel in the Crimson Base of Operations and reprogram the bots to no longer attack.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're wastin' time we don't have, buddy.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Kara has identified three high priority targets within the Crimson Base of Operations and has given you orders to take out Chief Medical Officer Terentius, Chief Arms Officer Voski, and Chief Engineer Fippi.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Intel says they got some fancy muckety-mucks stationed down below. Take 'em out, and their command structure should sink faster than a sack of rocks.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You kill those officers yet? Someone needs to fry Fippi, Terentius, and Voski. The sooner the Dommie troops are without leadership, the better.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You kill those officers yet? Someone needs to kill Fippi, Terentius, and Voski. The sooner the Dommie troops are without leaders, the better.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those Dominion stiffs can't wipe their noses without a direct order. They'll be scramblin' for days trying to sort this one out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Target the following officers: Fippi, Terentius, and Voski. Got it? Good!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The whole base is in an uproar.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully eliminated the three high-ranking Crimson Legion officers in the Crimson Base of Operations. Without proper command, the Crimson Legion forces have fallen into chaos and are vulnerable to attack.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're not real good at making the right decision, are you?

localizedTextIdText: The Black Hoods have revealed that Chief Cannoneer Nox carries the Crimson Legion $(vitem=340) with him. Kill him and use the $(vitem=340) to disable the Crimson Legion's Cannons firing on Thayd from the northern section of the Crimson Base of Operations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The chief cannoneer at the Dommie base is an idiot who constantly carries a copy of his cannon codes. Get 'em from him and shut down those cannons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You can get the cannon codes from Nox, their chief cannoneer. That'll allow you to shut the Dominion cannons down. We ain't got a lotta time for this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can get the cannon codes from Nox, their chief cannoneer. That'll allow you to shut the Dominion cannons down. We ain't got a lotta time for this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work, Soldier! Those cannons won't be firing anytime soon. I love it when a plan comes together!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Did I mention what an idiot this guy is? Have fun with him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Chief Cannoneer Nox and obtained the $(vitem=340) from him. You then overloaded the Crimson Legion's Main Cannon in the Crimson Base of Operations and caused irreparable damage to their artillery.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get out of my face before I throw up.

localizedTextIdText: One of the Exile mercenaries is trying to break into an ICI-run prison camp, but has suffered injuries in the process. Sergeant Kara wants you to go help him. Corporal Fellrock is up the hill near Noxbane Prison Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Locate Corporal Fellrock outside Noxbane Prison Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Just got a call from one of my men near Noxbane prison camp. He was tryin' to rescue his wife, but the rockhead got himself shot. Can you help him?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What's the status on Fellrock? He might be a slaghead, but we ain't gonna leave him to rot. Head over to Noxbane Prison Camp and give him a hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm bleedin'... but I suppose I'll bleed less as I lose more blood. Ugh.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Keep your head down! They'll see you! I went down there to get my wife out, but they spotted me and started firin'. Damn good shots, too!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Boys. Always trying to play the hero. Am I right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We gotta rescue my wife. There are other Exile prisoners in there, too.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help him if I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've met up with Corporal Fellrock outside of Noxbane Prison Camp.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll help him if I can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can you still say "no" after I bust your jaw?

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Fellrock has asked you to liberate the Exile prisoners within the ICI's Noxbane Prison Camp and help him find his wife.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Fellrock via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've had some time to observe the camp, and I don't like what I see. Prisoners keep disappearin'. You gotta get in there and rescue those men!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waitin' for? Get in there and set those folks free! And keep an eye out for my Kendra, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How can my wife and I ever thank you, stranger? She's a little worse for wear, but otherwise, she's okay.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope my wife is okay. She's tough, but I don't trust those Dominion bastards!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You did good work, friend. We owe you!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I couldn't let them just sit there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were successful in liberating prisoners from their cages in Noxbane Prison Camp, found Kendra Fellrock unharmed, and reunited Corporal Fellrock with his wife.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What the hell did Kara send you out here for, then?

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Fellrock has recommended that you kill Noxbane forces in Noxbane Prison Camp as a distraction to let the prisoners escape safely.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Fellrock via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If those prisoners are gonna make it out alive, you'll need to cause a big ruckus! Take out their sentries and dreadbots... that should distract 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are those ICI sentries and dreadbots too much for you to handle? C'mon, get in there 'n' smash 'em good! It don't take much, trust me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah! That's what I like to see. They can't keep us Exiles down! I'm gonna tell everyone about you. Where did you say you were from?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks! I wish I could be out there with you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I guess that's why I can't remember, huh?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully created a distraction by eliminating Noxbane Prison Camp guards and personnel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd do it myself if I weren't wounded. Some help you are.

localizedTextIdText: Kendra Fellrock believes the Dominion are conducting terrible experiments on Granok prisoners in the ICI-run Noxbane Prison Camp and has asked you to rescue them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kendra Fellrock via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: They kept takin' away the Granok prisoners. I overheard a guard talkin', and I think they're testing poison on 'em! We have to do something!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: They're gonna poison the Granok prisoners. It ain't right! You have to do somethin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: They're gonna poison the Granok prisoners. It ain't right! You have to do somethin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can't believe the ICI would go so far as to test weapons on helpless prisoners. Will we ever be free from Dominion tyranny?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't bear to think what they're doin' to those poor prisoners.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll never be able to repay you, friend.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put a stop to these experiments.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We'll stop them someday, I swear.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've rescued the Granok prisoners from the experiment chambers in Noxbane Prison Camp and reported your success to Kendra Fellrock.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You ain't got a heart, do you?

localizedTextIdText: Noxbane Prison Camp's Warden is protected in his floating control room, but Corporal Fellrock believes if you contaminate the artificial air supply of his room, he'll emerge and become vulnerable.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corporal Fellrock outside Noxbane Prison Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Look up there. You see that floatin' control room? That's where the prison warden hides out. If we could only smoke him out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The warden's control room relies on an artificial air supply. Mess with that, and he should come runnin' out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ha! That was brilliant! Honestly, I wasn't even sure the stunt would work, but he fell for it, all right. Good riddance to bad eggs, I say!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That room relies on an artificial air supply. Mess with it, he'll come runnin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged for your help, friend.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I like the way you think.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located poison gas and pumped it into the air supply for the warden's control room in Noxbane Prison Camp, forcing him to descend. You then took him out, ensuring he'll never torture anyone ever again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You afraid of that fella? How can you be?

localizedTextIdText: You've completed your reconnaissance of the Dominion compound. Sergeant Kara has received orders to move on to the Staging Point. Meet up with her when you're ready to launch a full assault on the Crimson Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Kara at the staging point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time to launch our counterattack! We're movin' on out to our drop zone to stage our next push. Meet us there when you're ready.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What you waitin' for, trooper? Get your boulders in line. We're gonna take the fight to the Dominion this time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad you could make it. You've more than earned your spot on the front lines, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't take too long. You don't want to miss this, trust me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've joined with Sergeant Kara and the rest of Durek's Destroyers at the Staging Point. The time's come to launch a full assault on the Crimson Legion occupying the nearby Eldan ruins.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't back down now. The fun's just getting started.

localizedTextIdText: You've been chosen to lead the attack on the Dominion in Galeras. Enter the Focus of Air Control Site and replace the Crimson Battle Standard with the Exile Battle Standard to signal the troops to begin the attack.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Trooper Rowe at the Focus of Air Control Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nobody plants a flag in my territory. Tear down those Crimson battle standards and replace 'em with our own, then we'll send our boys.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Tearin' down the Dominion's banners and raisin' our own colors will signal our main force to attack. Get in there and make it happen!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Remember what Kara said. The attack's gonna begin once you swap out the Dommie banners for ours. So what in the hell are you waitin' for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: After everything you put 'em through, it don't look like the Crimson Legion's got much fight left in 'em. That's too bad, 'cause we ain't finished yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't wait to see those Exile colors flyin' proud.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You ready for some real fun, friend?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You swapped out the Crimson Battle Standard with the Exile colors, signaling Durek's Destroyers to begin their offensive on the Focus of Air Control Site. First phase complete!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Nothin' ever changes. Orders is orders, and cowards is cowards.

localizedTextIdText: Durek's Destroyers have managed to corner Colonel Audax, the infamous leader of the Crimson Legion, at the top of the Crimson Command Post. Strike him down before reinforcements can break through. Sergeant Kara will join you for this battle.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Rowe via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Colonel Audax should be right up ahead. We've just cut off all Crimson Legion reinforcements, so he'll be alone. Go on now... I'll hold the line here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Audax ain't dead yet, friend. I suggest you rectify that problem... immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You took Colonel Audax out, and you didn't even break a sweat. Next time we need to kick the Dominion's ass, I'll be callin' you for sure!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful with Audax! He's got a reputation as a nasty fighter!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The war in Galeras may be over, but the Dominion won't give up that easy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Together with Sergeant Kara, you defeated Colonel Audax at the Crimson Command Post. The Crimson Legion has lost and is retreating from the field. Victory goes to the Exiles!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't believe this. You really gonna let Audax get away?

localizedTextIdText: You found a couple of cargo lifters lying around the Crimson Legion's Fuelfuze Depot. You've decided to appropriate some of the Dominion's fuel for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This cargo loader looks like it could prove useful. The Dominion will never notice if you "borrow" some fuel to send back.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If you could load this cargo lifter with Dominion fuel, you could send it back to the Exiles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've always got shortages of food, ammo, and fuel. I wonder if there's a way to appropriate some of that Dominion fuel? Might be worth lookin' into.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I got word of the fuel you stole from the Dominion's depot. You really know how to knock a girl off her feet, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Supplies are always better when they're denied to the bad guys.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully sent a cargo lifter fully loaded with stolen Dominion fuel to the Exiles. Thanks, Dominion scum!

localizedTextIdText: Now that the Security Warbot has been taken care of and you've gained proper authorization, Sergeant Kara wants you to try blowing up the Fuelfuze Depot's main fuel tanks again. Access the Fuel Control Panel to overload the tanks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Let's try this again. Blow those fuel tanks sky high using the control panels. Just don't get fried by the blast, 'cause it's liable to be a doozy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I ain't heard no explosions yet. Are you plannin' to blow up those fuel tanks today, or did you have something else in mind?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I ain't heard no explosions yet. Are you plannin' to blow up those fuel tanks today, or did you have something else in mind?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was one helluva boom, sweetheart. I'm guessin' the Dommies will be outta gas for a while.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Light 'em up, trooper. Don't waste any time!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That oughta slow 'em down good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to access the Fuel Control Panel and blow up the Crimson Legion Fuelfuze Depot's main fuel tanks. It looks like the Dominion will be out of fuel for a while.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take care of those tanks.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of those tanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I ain't got time for your lip, trooper. Get in there, or get out of the way!

localizedTextIdText: Dominion Saboteur are severing the power lines north of Kriton's Command Post. Someone needs to stop them before they can cut off power to the Exile defenders!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kriton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This power cable's been severed by a Dominion saboteur. The Exiles will suffer if the Dominion can cut off power to Kriton's Command Post. Stop them!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Someone needs to stop the Dominion saboteurs from damaging any more power cables.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's weird! Our power grid's showing some instability. I hope the Dominion's not behind it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It figures Dominion sabotage was responsible for all the power spikes we've been havin'. Good work sniffin' those Dommies out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You stopped the Dominion Saboteur from cutting off power to Kriton's Command Post.

localizedTextIdText: You found a Dominion Flight Recorder in the wreckage of a Dominion airship, and it may contain valuable intelligence. Tech Sergeant Prox in Tempest Refuge will know what to do with it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Dominion Flight Recorder to Tech Sergeant Prox in Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Dominion flight recorder probably contains valuable intelligence that the Exiles can use. You should find someone who can extract the data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Tech Sergeant Prox in Tempest Refuge should know how to extract data from this flight recorder.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's this? Looks like a Dominion black box from one of their blimps. That right? Let me crack this sucker open and see what she's hidin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Looks like we got a line on the Dominion's flight patterns in Galeras. Not bad, chum!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Good thing I found it then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You turned the Dominion Flight Recorder over to Tech Sergeant Prox in Tempest Refuge, who revealed it to be chock full of valuable information on the Dominion's plans in Galeras.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take it to Tech Sergeant Prox.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Dominion Flight Recorder to Tech Sergeant Prox

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker, who is inside an exo-lab running only on back-up power, believes her bots Bolt and Rusty can help you fix the power issue. The surly one, Bolt, has explained that you must recompile an AI neural core to fix $~(creature=23593).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bolt in Exo-Site 14
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Belle sent me to help you with this. You need to create an AI neural core to power up the exo-lab, but the external neural compiler needs power. Got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That neural compiler still needs power. You flip the big switch, close the broken circuit, and fix the rogue AI node right over there. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You weren't vaporized? Oh, I'm so glad, I think. Really. That means we can all go down to meet Belle in the exo-lab now that it's got power. Yay.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I warned Belle this would happen... thirty-two times! She never listens!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I couldn't be more thrilled. Really. Can't you tell?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You compiled a new AI neural core. Now you and the bots can join Belle Walker inside the exo-lab and repair the Caretaker.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't blame you. Helping Belle is a thankless task.

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker has gone into a nearby Eldan exo-lab, but she's having trouble getting the facility running at full power. She's asked you to speak with her bots, Rusty and Bolt, outside the exo-lab's entrance. They should be able to help you get the power running smoothly.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Rusty outside of Exo-Lab 14
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm down in the exo-lab, but this busted Caretaker's hangin' on tighter'n a Zorian star-snake. Talk to Rusty and Bolt and see if they can help out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Whoa there, sugar. You need to get together with Rusty and Bolt - my bots. The should be able to help you out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Belle is so smart! See? She left Bolt and me here to help you! So let's get started. What do you say?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Rusty and Bolt should be near the entrance to the lab, right behind you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You'll want to talk to Bolt. I think he has a plan of action.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Belle's scanbots, Rusty and Bolt, outside the exo-lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are ya really sure about that? Really?

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker asked you to retrieve an activation chip from the Security Avatar. It's being guarded by Eldan purifiers within Exo-Lab 14.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in Exo-Lab 14
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have a slight problem. You see, my security avatar is still misbehaving in the next room. To aid you, I require you to fetch his activation chip.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please enter the adjoining room and retrieve the activation chip from my dysfunctional security avatar. Sooner would be better than later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's much better! It's been a long time since I've felt so... rational. I thank you, sapient. I'm certain you and I will meet again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once I've reinitialized security protocols, I shall help with the Annihilator.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Miss Walker should know how to deal with the Annihilator now. Good luck!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully retrieved an activation chip from the Security Avatar secondary control panel inside Exo-Lab 14.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why is your security avatar malfunctioning?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: You mentioned something called the Nexus Project?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It appears that my primary neural core underwent a critical failure approximately 864 years ago. Since that time, the various avatars controlling my sub-systems have been acting independently. Some of them are more... rambunctious... than others.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That is an excellent question. Unfortunately, I don't currently seem to have the answer. Perhaps, as more of my systems are repaired across the planet, I will be able to access that information.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You're correct. I did indeed mention that. And I don't seem to be able to access any information concerning it. Forgive my confusion. As I'm sure you can imagine, it has been a trying time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without the activation chip, I am unable to help you with the Annihilator.

localizedTextIdText: Now that you've brought down the exo-lab's defense system, head out of the lab to Exo-Site 14 and access the Caretaker's Eldan weapon to destroy the Annihilator construct.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Belle Walker at the XAS Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Caretaker was kind enough to provide us with a big, bad cannon to take out that Annihilator. I'd say you earned the honors. Ready?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Now ain't the time to be draggin' your feet, darlin'. Get over to that cannon control panel and take the big boy out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Now ain't the time to be draggin' your feet, darlin'. Get over to that cannon control panel and take the big boy out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Shootin' stars! That big ol' hunk o' junk didn't stand a chance! This was quite an adventure. I was lucky to have you along, sugar. You take care now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The cannon control panel's on the other side of the site, near base camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, I know there was something else around here I wanted to mess with....
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sounds like fun. I'm on it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Belle Walker put an end to the Eldan Annihilator with help from the Caretaker and his powerful Eldan weapon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What do you mean? You don't want to fire a giant laser cannon?

localizedTextIdText: Chronicler Herrick Grenfell passed along a call for help from Trooper Gorok, a Free Company of Nexus soldier located at the Excavation Base Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Trooper Gorok at the Excavation Base Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An XAS camp called us not long ago... sounded like they got some trouble. They're excavatin' some Eldan ruins over there. You mind checkin' on 'em?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The XAS have gotten themselves in trouble. What else is new, right? You'd better get to that camp and help 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya comin' from Gallow? It's about time! Slaggin' Eldan are overrunin' the camp, and we need all the help we can get!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A Granok named Trooper Gorok made the call. Talk to him when you get there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Shoulda never come to this place, ya ask me. No one asked me. Shockin', right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made contact with Trooper Gorok at the Excavation Base Camp and offered to help FCON deal with the Eldan threat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Too tired to help 'em out, yeah? I suppose that's understandable.

localizedTextIdText: You've acquired some augmented remains. Perhaps you can use this unusual technology against other Eldan constructs in the area around Annihilator Silo 14. There's only one way to find out....
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This technology is unconventional and looks dangerous. Perhaps you could put it to good use against the Eldan constructs around the excavation site?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's no tellin' what we might be able to do with Eldan technology. If we're lucky, we might even be able to use it against the augmentor constructs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can't believe what you're tellin' me, sugar! Still, it's a good thing you put so many of those Constructs and critters down usin' their own tech!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A little more like that and we'll have this problem in the bag!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You turned the augmentors' own tech against them and destroyed several of the vile Eldan constructs in the name of the Exiles!

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Gorok has sent out a call for help. His troops are being overrun by Eldan constructs at the Excavation Base Camp. Hurry to his location and lend him a hand!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Trooper Gorok at the Excavation Base Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mayday! Callin' any and all Exiles in the area! This is Trooper Gorok of FCON! We're bein' overrun by Eldan constructs at the Excavation Base Camp!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hope you're ready for a fight. The XAS has made a mess of things here, and it's up to us to clean it up. Story of my fraggin' life!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ya better hurry up or there won't be anyone left to save! Gorok, out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I like your stone, $(player.class). Let's get ya to work.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hang on, I'll be right there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made contact with Trooper Gorok at the Excavation Base Camp in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What the hell didja answer my call for, then? Go and get slagged!

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Kerrika at the Excavation Base Camp has asked you to physically disrupt the Eldan power centers around Annihilator Silo 14. She hopes that this will power down the Annihilator.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Kerrika via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen up! We gotta disrupt the power centers around that Annihilator. You gotta jump through the cores to do it. That could buy us some time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stone up! Just jump inside each of the energy cores to disrupt the flow of energy. It probably won't hurt too much. Probably.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Crap! The Annihilator's still standin'! What's it gonna take to bring that bastard offline? On the plus side, though, it looks like you didn't die.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If this doesn't work out, I'll tell your next of kin you died like a hero.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We gotta take the silver linin' wherever we can get it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What have I got to lose?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I risked my tail for nothing?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At great personal risk, you managed to disrupt the Eldan power centers around Annihilator Silo 14 for Trooper Kerrika. Unfortunately, disrupting the power centers had no effect on the Annihilator.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well... conventional weapons don't seem to damage this thing. We need something biological to disrupt their energy flow. Namely... you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If we shut down the power centers, it should kill the flow of power to the Annihilator.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, you think you're funny?

localizedTextIdText: Sue Digstone has asked you to meet her at the XAS Excavation Site, further up the mountain, to help analyze the tissue samples you collected.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Sue Digstone at the XAS Excavation Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'd love it if you could lend me a hand with the tissue analysis up at my dad's camp. I can show you around, too. It'll be fun!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Head up the mountain to my dad's camp. Follow the path, you can't miss it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, what took you so long? Things here are... well, they're really weird! My dad's missin', and everyone's actin' downright strange! Just look at 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! I'll meet you up at the camp after I pack up the rest of my stuff.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They all look like they've undergone CSP. That's kinda bad!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived at the XAS Excavation Site. According to Sue Digstone, much has changed since she left. Not only is her father, Professor Digstone, missing, but the rest of the camp personnel are acting strangely and exhibiting signs of CSP augmentation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, his name's Maron Digstone, but everyone calls him the professor. He's a genius!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: There's an exo-lab up at the dig site. It's filled with all sorts of amazing Eldan technology - like this thing called "CSP." We just have to decipher it all!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It's short for "cerebro-suppression protocol," and we think it's a type of augmentation. We're still figurin' it out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, I'll be packin' up for a bit if you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: Sue Digstone has asked you for help in collecting tissue samples from augmented canimid and buzzbings on Winding Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sue Digstone on Winding Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Did you notice? The wildlife in this area's been augmented! I'm researchin' the augmentation process, so I could really use some good tissue samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Most've the augmented critters I've seen are canimid and buzzbings. They're all over Winding Ridge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These samples are great! Have you done this sort of work before? You're a real pro!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Really? That'd be swell! My dad's gonna be so impressed with my thesis!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I knew it! You're an expert! I can't wait to get 'em under a microscope!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Sue Digstone collect tissue samples from augmented canimid and buzzbings on Winding Ridge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, how rude of me! The name's Sue Digstone, junior researcher for the XAS! Great to meet ya!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I don't know. I figure it's got somethin' to do with the exo-lab my dad's studyin', up at our camp.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Ostensibly, it improves the base creature with implants, but no one really knows how or why. I figure it's 'cause of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's too bad. I guess you got more important things to do?

localizedTextIdText: You need to locate the Eldan teleport key to access the exo-lab. Sue Digstone has given you a CSP disruptor to impede the augmetics of whoever possesses the key, but you must use reverse logic to puzzle out which of the XAS Excavation Site personnel has it. Or, if you're the impatient type, you can just zap them all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Eldan Teleport Key to Sue Digstone at the XAS Excavation Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need the teleport key to get into the lab. Question the camp personnel, figure out who has it, zap 'em with this CSP disruptor, and take it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The camp personnel won't tell you outright who's got the key, but they might try using reverse logic to mislead you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got the Eldan teleport key! You're amazin', you know that? Simply amazin'!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you zap anyone, it'll short out their augmented enhancements for a little bit.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nothin' ever is for us Exiles, is it? But we'll make it. We always do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After interviewing the camp personnel, you used Sue Digstone CSP disruptor to force them to drop the Eldan teleport key. All that remains is to enter Exo-Lab 83 and confront Professor Digstone.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can learn.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Eldan Teleport Key to Sue Digstone
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I figure out who has the key?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I reckon the augmented folks'll use logical thought due to the cerebro-suppression protocol. Instead of lyin' to you creatively, they'll use reverse logic. Get me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Just ask 'em who has the teleport key, then assume they're tellin' you the opposite of what you really want to know.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I ain't sure of nothin', but you know what? If you get stuck, go ahead and zap 'em all with the CSP disruptor! That should learn 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't do this by myself, $(player.name)! Please help me!

localizedTextIdText: Having obtained the Eldan teleporter key, you can now enter Exo-Lab 83 through the Eldan teleporter pad at the center of the XAS Excavation Site. Once there, try to locate Professor Digstone and put an end to the mysterious augmentation that has afflicted the XAS team.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sue Digstone at the XAS Excavation Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Use the teleporter and see if you can find my dad in the exo-lab. If he's behind this, he's probably been augmented, too. I... I hope he's all right.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You've got to find my dad in the exo-lab. If he's been augmented, I hope he's not too far gone!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're back! I knew you did somethin', 'cause everyone up here started actin' normal again. Did you find my dad?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful! Whatever's been augmentin' folks is probably down there, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I... I understand. Thank you for tryin' to save him.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He was too far gone. I'm sorry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By the time you found him in Exo-Lab 83, Professor Digstone had been fully augmented and was too far gone to help. You destroyed him, along with the Damaged Eldan Augmentor that was responsible for the mysterious augmentation of both the Professor and the XAS personnel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What if he isn't all right?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I'll do what needs doing, then.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: He's been down there a long time, so there's no tellin' how much exposure he's had, or to what degree he's been augmented. If he's too far gone, you won't have much choice but to... to put him down.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I trust you'll end his misery. Despite all that's happened... my dad's still a good man. He doesn't deserve to be an augmented slave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're my only hope. Can't you understand that?

localizedTextIdTitle: Last One In, Shut the Door
localizedTextIdText: Rusty - one of Belle Walker scanbots - has provided instructions. Head into the exo-lab and help Belle Walker deal with the fractured Caretaker so she can shut down the Annihilator.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Go speak to Belle Walker at the Eldan Control Panel
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good news! Belle is waiting for you inside the exo-lab! Isn't she just the best? Go on, then. Onto the teleport pad! Don't keep her waiting!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you still doing here? Go see Belle right away! She's waiting for you inside the exo-lab!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey there, darlin'. Good to see ya! Shut down the control consoles on either side of the room. Then we'll reboot the Caretaker's neural core.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a bit too close for comfort! Now that the external systems are functionin', we can reboot the Caretaker's primary neural core. Here goes nothin'!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'll meet once you enter the lab. I just can't wait to see Belle again!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Kiss my asteroids! It worked! The Caretaker's neural core's all patched up!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reached Belle Walker inside the Eldan exo-lab and helped repair two of the fractured Caretaker AI nodes. Now to fix the Caretaker's core control node.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You make me sad. I know I'm a bot, but I'm still sad. I'd cry if I could!

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Gorok has asked you to protect the Excavation Base Camp from ongoing attacks by Eldan constructs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Gorok via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got Eldan rust buckets comin' outta every hole in this damn site. You wanna lend a hand and put some of these constructs down?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You better do what you can against the Eldan junk piles around this camp. Otherwise, this whole expedition is gonna be toast!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That oughtta do it... for now. I'm glad you came along when ya did, 'cause ya ain't half-bad in a fight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Belle Walker stirred up this Eldan dig, and now we gotta clean up her mess.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well. That's one less problem to deal with... until Walker stirs up another.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully pushed back the onslaught of Eldan constructs. Excavation Base Camp is safe... for now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Does that include that big annihilator?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Isn't your camp... a bit too close?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Belle Walker and her team were tinkerin' with some Eldan data network. I don't know what they were tryin' to do, but they let loose an avalanche of these Eldan bolt-heads.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: What do you think? If its foot wasn't jammed in the silo, we'd have been dust ages ago.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Look $(player.class), I'll take care of my mercs as I see fit. You gonna help us, or are you just here to waste my time?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why the hell did you come all this way if you ain't gonna help?

localizedTextIdText: Dominion forces in Galeras have employed chemical weapons targeting livestock. Corporal Brooks has ordered you to liquidate contaminated animals near Roan Roam Mills before they carry traces of these dangerous toxins into Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Brooks via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Be advised: The Dominion has deployed chemical weapons near Roan Roam Mills. You are hereby ordered to liquidate the affected animals with extreme prejudice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the contaminated roan make it into Thayd, we'll have a lot of sick people on our hands.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Recon elements are reporting that you've taken care of the contaminated roan up near the mills. If not for you, this might have ended poorly for us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember: Don't allow compromised livestock to spread toxins into Thayd. Got it? Good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to eliminate the contaminated roan near Roan Roam Mills before they could endanger the citizens of Thayd. Excellent work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Negative. The chemicals used by the Dominion have contaminated the roan, turning them into bovine killing machines.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You bet your backside they are. Who knows what'll happen if they contaminate the city's water or food supply?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Think of it as a mercy, both for the animals and the Exiles.

localizedTextIdText: You've located a brooch with the name "Foriana" engraved upon it. Obviously, the treasure didn't belong to the Dominion Looter you took it from. Locate Foriana Reedwhisper in Tempest Refuge and return her brooch to her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return Foriana's Brooch{p:Foriana's Brooches} to Foriana Reedwhisper in Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This brooch, taken from a Dominion looter, has the name "Foriana" engraved upon it. Perhaps it belongs to someone in Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This brooch, taken from a Dominion looter, has the name "Foriana" engraved upon it. Perhaps it belongs to someone in Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That brooch is mine! And look... it's covered in dried blood! How dare you! Give it to me this instant!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll have to disinfect this. You should be more careful with other people's property, you know!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned Foriana's Brooch{p:Foriana's Brooches} to Foriana Reedwhisper in Tempest Refuge. She was eager to have the brooch back, though she didn't seem particularly thankful.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return Foriana's Brooch{p:Foriana's Brooches} to Foriana Reedwhisper

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If there's one thing I can't stand... it's overgrown vermin, and that's what we got down in the valley. Get rid of them, and we can get our pioneers farming. You going to help us out, or just stand around?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Word up!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: All right then. Get to it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: *fist bumps bro*
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why carry a weapon if you don't use it?

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Combat Master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those Buzzbings are growing back faster than we can kill'em. Take out one of those Queens to help slow the growth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck. Don't get stung!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Dang Buzzbings are going to overrun this place.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nothing stings worse than a Medusa, and that lake is packed with 'em! Water won't be safe until they're gone. Wipe out a bunch, and grab some of those eggs while you're at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Round 'em up, and knock 'em down.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sound too tough to handle?

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Combat Master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen... do you smell that? That is the stench of Sunfish. The smell keeps most life forms away from the water, but it's time we cleaned them out. Interested in helping with that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get to it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? You scared of a fish?

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Combat Master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Garr... Note the huge jaws they use to crush their prey. They can eat a maskless Moodie in one bite. With some Moodie corpses, we could study how Garr attack. Since you're here, maybe you can help out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I'll clear out some Garr.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Watch your step, then.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Combat Master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ever seen spiders like this? They're clever, too. Seen them wrap a house with webbing so thick, you have to cut it with power tools. Better if we stop them here before they head into town. Are you up for that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hope to see you back in one piece.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Spiders are creepy. I'll stop them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I figured as much.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Combat Master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's nothing quite like a Dracus. Piles of living slime that burn to the touch. The bones of its prey stick to its body like magnetic trophies of death. There has to be a way to make them bleed. Want to give it a try?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Into the fray you go...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Dead Dracus? Leave it to me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hmph! I didn't think so.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Combat Master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Moodies be all up in my grill. Especially that Hexmaster. You should waste some fools.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: R0x0rsaurus Rex!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Totes bra!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: *Fistbumps*
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lame sauce, duder.

localizedTextIdText: You and Belle Walker have found the Caretaker inside the exo-lab. To proceed, you'll need to talk to the Caretaker.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker inside Exo-Lab 14
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You'd best go and talk to the Caretaker and see if he can help us turn off that blasted Annihilator. I hope he's a reasonable fella, but who knows?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go on, darlin'. We didn't do all of this hard work just to sit here and look at him. Go talk to the Caretaker and see if he can help us out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Greetings. I am the Caretaker. Activating sub-systems. Please wait.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My neural core has been damaged, so please forgive my behavior. Generally, I enjoy meeting organics before exterminating them. Ha! I'm joking of course.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get ready to run... just in case.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now... what could you possibly want with me?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to the Caretaker and learned how to proceed through the exo-lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me talk to him, honey. I'll get all tongue-tied!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stumpkins... they bite like a Garr, with toughened tree bark skin. Are they plants or animals? Either way, they are an alien NUISANCE. Smash them, so we can continue exploring the area.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't know what you're missing.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Combat Master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's no end to the Moodie bodies floating down the river. The bodies seemed to have been mauled more than the others. I suspect an elder garr. Take it out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Move along now...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take out the Garr Boss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What's the matter - chicken?

localizedTextIdText: You've been contacted by Jonah Skyreach, who claims that the Exile Academy of Science camp in Gale Canyon has been attacked by the Darkspur Cartel. Make your way to Camp Dustdevil and speak to Lead Researcher Highmarsh for more information.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lead Researcher Highmarsh at Camp Dustdevil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $?c/Mayday! Anyone! This is Camp Dustdevil in Gale Canyon! We've been attacked by the Darkspur Cartel! Please send help!/We need help, and fast. The Darkspur Cartel is attacking Camp Dustdevil in Gale Canyon. Will you help us?;
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you talked to Lead Researcher Highmarsh yet? He can tell you what you need to do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must be the one who answered Jonah's call for help. We have a serious situation here, one that threatens our entire expedition!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $?c/Hurry! These gangsters mean business, and we can't hold them all by ourselves!/Good! Get over there as fast as you can!;
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Camp Dustdevil in Gale Canyon and spoke to Lead Researcher Highmarsh about the Darkspur Cartel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're a ruthless group of Krogg gangsters who take what they want and kill anyone that complains!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you turn your back on us?

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker has come to Galeras to study the Focus of Air. Belle believes the Skywind Ruins near the Focus were designed to draw power from it, but she needs help testing her theory. You can help by turning on Eldan Switch{p:Eldan Switches} in the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker at the Stone Outcrop on Skywind Beach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've got me some theories 'bout these Eldan Ruins, but the Cartel's makin' it difficult to test 'em. You mind helpin' me out a little, sugar?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Meet me by the Focus of Air once you get those Eldan switches turned on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you get those Eldan switches turned on? No? Well, that explains why nothin's happenin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like I cranked the dial up a little too high! That's a whole lot of energy cracklin' in the air, and it can't be safe....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Locate Eldan switches in the area and turn 'em on. That's all I need you to do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've got a bad feelin' about this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you aided Belle Walker, her experiment resulted in dangerous levels of energy accumulating in the area. The fact that she's worried is a sure sign of trouble.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the switches.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Without gettin' too technical, I think the Eldan probably used the focuses to channel elemental energy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I don't know... yet. But I'm sure I'll make a breakthrough eventually. Just wait 'n' see.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I figured you'd be a bit more willin' to lend a hand. Guess I was wrong.

localizedTextIdTitle: If It Ain't Broke, Break It
localizedTextIdText: Primal air energy has accumulated near the Focus of Air. Belle Walker believes there could be a serious backlash if the Primal Air Anomalies aren't physically disrupted - say, by someone jumping through them. Luckily, nearby Power Converters in the Skywind Ruins can give your jumping abilities a boost!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Belle Walker at the Stone Outcrop on Skywind Beach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This whole thing's gonna overload if we don't do somethin'! Quick, jump through the anomalies! That should cause the energy up there to dissipate!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Run through a power converter, sugar! That allows you to jump much higher than normal, so you can reach those anomalies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Run through a power converter, sugar! That should allow you to jump much higher than normal, so you can reach those anomalies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice jumpin'! All I need to do now is calibrate the controls to maintain the energy levels with some degree of safety....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hot tip! Run through the power converters to give your jumps a boost!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've disrupted the Primal Air Anomalies that were accumulating, staving off a disaster of epic proportions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I figured you'd be a bit more willin' to lend a hand. Guess I was wrong.

localizedTextIdText: The Primal Air Anomalies have been dispersed. Unfortunately, all the activity has drawn the attention of a number of Angry Air Elemental. Protect Belle Walker on Skywind Beach while she attempts to shut down the control panel.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Belle Walker at the Stone Outcrop on Skywind Beach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Keep your eyes peeled for trouble while I fiddle with these controls. I need to see if I can shut things down without causin' another backlash.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Keep those damned elementals away from me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There! Easy as pie! I still don't know what the Eldan wanted with the Focus of Air, but I did learn a thing or two about how powerful it is.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can't rush perfection, honey. Just watch my back, all right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Will do! Thank you kindly for your help, friend. It made all the difference!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Try and stay out of trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Belle Walker has neutralized the dangerous accumulation of primal air energy, while you've destroyed more air elementals than you care to count.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I get killed, I blame you.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the combat master
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wow, I can't believe you took down that Elder Stemdragon all by yourself! Come see me so that I can reward you in kind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're quite the mercenary friend. I wonder if you really care about anything.. or anybody.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You needn't worry about your reward. If money is all that you love, then that's what you'll receive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good bye!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I expect to be well paid. I'm in it for the money.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine, suit yourself.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Kriton indicates that a number of Dominion airships were shot down by Exile air defenses, and one of the pilots may have survived his crash. Proceed to the crash site and capture the Crimson Airman so he can be interrogated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Kriton at Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our triple-A shot down a few Dominion airships, and one of the pilots survived the crash. I want you to grab him and haul him back here for questioning.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't just sit there. Go get that Dommie airman so we can put the screws to him. Try not to rough him up too much, alright?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work capturin' that airman. The Black Hoods are gonna have a field day extractin' that intel from him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This is all thanks to you. Things are lookin' up.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He didn't put up much of a fight.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully captured the Crimson Airman, who was subsequently escorted back to Kriton's Command Post for questioning.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's alphabet soup for 'anti-aircraft artillery.' Don't worry, recruit. You'll learn all the lingo soon enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Losin' your stomach for fightin'?

localizedTextIdText: Mayor Crofton feels that the town's only chance is to request help from the Exile arkship, the Gambler's Ruin. Speak to Technician Nanci behind the Chronicle House, find out if she's repaired Tempest Refuge's communicator, and then make the call.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Sergeant Kara at Tempest Refuge's Landing Zone
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've got a tech workin' on our comm system. If it's workin', I want you to call the Gambler's Ruin and request help. We're all out of options here!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find Technician Nanci behind the Chronicle House and see if our comm system is functional.
