localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did someone call an exterminator about a Chua infestation? Let's get to work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I think you've done a great job, all things considered, but we're in over our heads.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm Sergeant Kara. You asked for help, and Durek decided to send his best.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though the town's comm system failed catastrophically, you were able to contact the Gambler's Ruin to request help. In response, Commander Durek sent his second in command, Sergeant Kara.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't say no! It's just your pride talkin'!

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Sabbatha needs $m(vitem=336) for analysis, but they are only found high up along the cliff edges in Gale Canyon. To get up there, you'll need to find a path or hitch a ride on a passing tornado!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Sabbatha at Camp Dustdevil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We tried gettin' some of those gribbon eggs, but it's too dangerous. You look spry enough. Would you mind fetchin' an old lady some eggs?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The gribbons lay their eggs in nests, high up on the cliff edges. It's a long way down, so watch your step!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The gribbons lay their eggs in nests, high up on the cliff edges. It's a long way down, so watch your step!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew you'd get those eggs. I told Mikhah that. You got a look about you... a determined sort of look.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You be careful now! Poor Mikhah nearly killed himself tryin' to get some eggs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now maybe we'll crack the mystery of the gribbon life cycle.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can do that for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to collect the $m(vitem=336) that Scientist Sabbatha needs for her research.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want gribbon eggs?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The gribbon are an amazin' species. They've adapted to this environment remarkably well... almost like they're engineered specifically for it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sure you can't help an old woman out?

localizedTextIdText: Field Researcher Mikhah injured himself while gathering gribbon eggs for Scientist Sabbatha. As he lay wounded on the rocky ground, one of the gribbons swallowed his datachron. He's asked you to help him recover his datachron by scaling the cliffs in Gale Canyon and capturing the gribbon that ate it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Field Researcher Mikhah at Camp Dustdevil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Gribbons eat anything. In fact, one of them ate my datachron after I hurt myself! I really need to get it back somehow. All my notes are on it!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please don't hurt the gribbon that ate my datachron. Just bring it back to me. I'll take care of the rest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't hurt the gribbon that ate my datachron. Just bring it back to me. I'll take care of the rest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah, I bet he's still got more fragments in there. Time to feed him laxatives and wait for... yeah... lovely.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The gribbon is somewhere in Gale Canyon. I imagine it feels pretty sick right about now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: All right, little guy. Swallow these, nice and easy. Now the waiting game begins.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get that gribbon for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured the gribbon that ate Field Researcher Mikhah datachron and delivered it to him at Camp Dustdevil. You don't envy him the messy task of "recovering" the datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Like I said, all my notes are on it. All that work for nothing!

localizedTextIdText: The Stormwing Falkrin are retreating following the death of Bride Osprea, their morale in tatters and their spirits broken. As the action in Stormwing Fortress is winding down, Sergeant Kara has instructed you to take a stinger transport back to Skywatch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Royce in Skywatch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The spirit of the Falkrin seems broken enough. I'm pulling my men out, and that includes you. There's no sense in anyone else dying today.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: That stinger's not gonna wait for you forever. I suggest you take it to Skywatch right away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Falkrin may be demoralized, but there's still a lot in Skywatch that needs killin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I heard you made it out of that fortress in one piece. You made us all proud over there. I'm glad you're on our side!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's a stinger at the landing area. Take it to Skywatch and report to Royce.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't mention it. We'd all be goners if not for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Sergeant Kara orders, you returned to Skywatch. Though the battle against the Stormwing is over, the Falkrin War of Cleansing is far from finished.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine. Talk to me when you're ready to get outta this place.

localizedTextIdText: Galeras is teeming with dangerous animals, and Game Hunter Joresh wants you to help him hunt them down and kill them. He can be found near the entrance to the Osun ruins of Kel Vishal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Game Hunter Joresh near the Ruins of Kel Vishal
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've heard a lot about ya, and I think maybe we can help each other out. How'd you like to hunt some dangerous animals here in Galeras?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look who finally decided to show up. What kept ya?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You have no idea, friend! You're gonna love this stuff!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, don't ya worry. Old Joresh has plenty of fun in store for ya!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to Game Hunter Joresh, and he claims to have a lot of fun in store for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe next time.

localizedTextIdText: Game Hunter Joresh has asked you to kill Vishal-Thun Osun and take their "hair" as trophies. Vishal-Thun Osun can be found in Kel Vishal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Game Hunter Joresh outside Kel Vishal
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey... while you're in Kel Vishal, I'd be much obliged if you could kill some of those Osun and cut me some of their hair.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You cut any hair from them Osun for me yet? Any of the Osun in Kel Vishal should do! Just be sure to cut it real close to their shoulders! Ha!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So that's what the Osun pass off as hair, huh? Pretty weird, huh? I can't wait till it dries out some!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Well, it ain't really hair, but I don't care. It'll make a good memento!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yeah, 'cause then it won't stink so much anymore.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed many Vishal-Thun Osun and took their tentacle-like hair as trophies for Game Hunter Joresh.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want Osun hair?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I figure the stuff's got a hundred and one uses just waitin' to be discovered. If there's a market for it, I'll be rich in no time!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not much of a barber, are you? Ha!

localizedTextIdText: The Exile forces in Thayd are in sore need of new blood. Sergeant Renzig has instructed you to find and enlist Potential Recruit in Thayd's military and merchant districts before reporting to him outside the city's front gates.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Renzig via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The walls of these ancient ruins ain't gonna hold up forever. We'll need more troops if we wanna win this war. Do me a favor and get me some soldiers.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ya got rocks in your ears? Get me those recruits!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got rocks in your ears? Get me those recruits!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Slag it all! I've been hit, and we've got troops dyin' down here! We need help! Get yer keister down here and see what you can do, pronto! $(player.name)? Is that you? I ain't doin' too hot. Them spider drones are some mean, mean machines.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Commander Kriton's out there tryin' to fight off a whole damn army, and he needs help.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Get movin'! We ain't got much ti--! *ZZZRT!* You gotta take over now, kid! I ain't... I ain't gonna make it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Sir, yes, sir! Are you okay, Sarge?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found three new recruits for Sergeant Renzig, but have run into a bit of trouble en route to Commander Kriton's camp on the front lines.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You gotta be jokin'.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Kriton wants to take out the Dominion anti-aircraft cannon, which is positioned in an overrun Exile outpost. Meet the Commander's scout, an Exile Field Agent, in the Growling Forest, and protect him as he guides you to the outpost's rear entrance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kriton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a Dominion anti-aircraft cannon in our old forward base. We need to take it out. One of my agents in the Growling Forest can take you to the back entrance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find the field agent yet? He'll get you to the outpost's rear entrance. From there, you can take out the cannon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dammit! That field agent was a good man! Ah, well... looks like tip-toeing around won't do you any good now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Meet the field agent at his camp in the Growling Forest. You can trust him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We gotta change our plan of attack.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: An Exile Field Agent took you to the overrun outpost's rear entrance, but he was killed by Dominion defenses before you could make your entry. It looks like you'll have to fight your way in.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah. We keep a few agents in the field for this sorta thing. He knows Galeras like the back of his hand.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me pull rank, trooper.

localizedTextIdText: You stumbled upon an injured Protostar Crash Survivor whose fellow employees have been dragged off by predators in Coldwater Gulch. You've been promised adequate compensation if you can rescue them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Protostar Operations Supervisor at the entrance to Coldwater Gulch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's too late for this Protostar Employee, but there might be survivors out there that can still be saved from the local pumera.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Yep! Looks as if the local wildlife find Protostar employees to be tasty morsels. You should see about saving any others from similar fates.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Pumera, the strange feline organisms that prowl this area, have been hunting crash survivors. If you can help them, you'll be compensated!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By saving those employees, you have saved the Protostar Corporation the trouble and expense of cloning them again. On behalf of Protostar, I thank you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy this compensation! Please consider spending it on Protostar products!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You saved several Protostar employees from hostile wildlife and were compensated for your efforts at the standard market rate by the Protostar Operations Supervisor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Protostar Operations Supervisor

localizedTextIdText: A Dominion bomber has crashed near Thayd, and Sergeant Renzig has been killed in action. Daniel Bronson has contacted you, begging for help before your squad is overrun. Help your squad at the crash site, and destroy Crimson Spiderbot and Crimson Clanker while helping the wounded.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Daniel Bronson at the Dominion Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You gotta get down here! Sarge is wasted, and this place is crawling with Dommie spider drones and bots! We're all gonna die! We're all gonna die!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm doing my best to hold these things off! We gotta get out of here, or we're all gonna die!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is like a nightmare! We... we can't stay here! We gotta retreat! What do we do now, man? What do we do?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We won't last long against these drones!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sir! Yes, sir!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hold tight. I'm on my way.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Pull it together and follow me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you've successfully helped your squad out at the Dominion crash site, Sergeant Renzig was killed in action. It looks like you're next in line to assume command over the new recruits.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Don't give me that crap! What's your sitrep?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah! The drones... they just swarmed over him! He fought 'em hard but it wasn't enough! He was screaming... oh, stars! I can't do this!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're surrounded by Dommie bots, holding them off as best we can! Lotsa troopers are hurt... they're gonna die if they don't get help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're gonna leave us to die? What kinda Exile are you?

localizedTextIdText: Release the captured dagun from cages scattered throughout Deadstar Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Tognar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These poor dagun have been imprisoned, starved, and abused. Set them free, and they're certain to turn on their Deadstar captors.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: These poor dagun have been imprisoned, starved, and abused. Set them free, and they're certain to turn on their Deadstar captors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hear those Marauders got a bunch of dagun locked up. Maybe if ya set 'em free, they'll get some payback on those pirates.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job settin' those dagun loose. You saw an opportunity, and ya took it. That's what I call initiative, pal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serves the Deadstar right, after treatin' those creatures like that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You released the captured dagun from their cages in Deadstar Ravine.

localizedTextIdText: An Aurin named Nooks Barkbiter has been trapped in a tree in Demonclaw Pass by an enraged girrok. He's asked for your help in escaping this most embarrassing predicament.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Explorer Rokgore at Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Help! This hungry beast has me up a tree! I hate to see any animal die needlessly, but in this case, I'll make an exception!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Yes. Here I am, still up a tree with a hungry girrok waiting to eat me. Now be nice and kill that critter, so I can get down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: One of our men - an Aurin named Nooks - is lost. Last I heard, he was out near Demonclaw Pass. Maybe you can help us find him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like Nooks is in one piece, $(player.class). Thanks for helpin' him. He's new, and he's a handful. I'll keep an eye on him next time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you! By the Weave, thank you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I tell ya, Nooks has enough curiosity for three explorers.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of the beast!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He needs to be more careful next time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully saved Nooks Barkbiter from a hungry girrok.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll keep an eye out for him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thank you for... huh? Wait. You're just going to leave me here to die? Oh, c'mon!

localizedTextIdText: In order to destroy the Crimson Mobile AA Cannon at the Overrun Outpost, you'll need to recover the cannon's deactivation codes from Lieutenant Feraakh, the Dominion officer in charge. You may as well take out some Crimson Legionnaire while you're at it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Kriton at Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Alright, change of plans. Take off your dancin' shoes, get in there, and hit 'em hard 'n' fast. Priority one is knocking out that cannon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We can't launch our Stingers if you don't take out that cannon. Now get movin' before I lose my temper!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work out there. That cannon was the only thing keepin' us from securing air superiority in this sector. Nothin' can stop us now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Dommie in charge should have the cannon's deactivation codes. Get 'im!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good thing you're on our side, kid.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed Lieutenant Feraakh, destroyed the Crimson Mobile AA Cannon, and wiped out a good number of Crimson Legionnaire at the Overrun Outpost. Commander Kriton has ordered you to return to base.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Quit wastin' my time! Lives are at stake!

localizedTextIdText: You found a cache of prototype grenades that utilize loftite technology! Test them out on the Dominion forces that occupy DREDplex: Skyhammer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kormak via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This looks like an advanced prototype loftite grenade created by the Chua. You should test its capabilities on the Dominion forces nearby.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This looks like an advanced prototype loftite grenade created by the Chua. You should test its capabilities on the Dominion forces nearby.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Found a Chua grenade out there, did ya? No tellin' what it does. Well, why don't you pull the pin and test it out on some Dommies?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How'd it feel blowin' up those little Chua bastards with their own grenades? I tell ya, some people get all the fun.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're right, pal. I'm jealous.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what this hardware can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The forces of DREDplex: Skyhammer were perfect test subjects for the loftite grenades you found. The results were very uplifting!

localizedTextIdText: Dangerous Dominion weapons tests are taking place at DREDplex: Skyhammer not far from Tremor Ridge. Sergeant Kormak wants you to take out two of the leading scientists.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Kormak via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These guys are from DRED. Little Chua bastards are cookin' up new gear for the Dominion. Take out their lead scientists, Pazbo and Pizbo.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The scientists are gonna be down in that cave, and they're probably well-protected. Don't let that stop ya from killin' the little creeps.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll sleep easier now that those two Chua are takin' a long dirt nap. I really hate those little fuzzballs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They gotta be around there somewhere. Slag 'em!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take out the lead scientists.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took out the weapon scientists in DREDplex: Skyhammer that were threatening Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: DRED is the Dominion Research and Experimentation Division. These guys are responsible for developin' advanced technology and weapons for the empire. Devious little Chua bastards are always coming up with some new ways to kill people or blow stuff up. They usually work out of a DREDplex -  it's gotta be somewhere nearby.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: A DREDplex is a secret scientific facility where these guys do their work. Usually, they're focused on developing a certain kind of technology or weapon. You can't really argue with their results, but man I hate those dirty little rodents.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did you just tell me no? You better hope I heard ya wrong.

localizedTextIdText: Kit Brinny could use help defending the main gate of Kriton's Command Post against the Crimson Legion assault. Make sure she successfully pushes back the advancing Dominion troops.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Kit Brinny at Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thanks for stoppin' by. These Crimson jerks just don't know when to call it quits. Hang out for a sec. We could use your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How many of these Dommie bastards are there? We gotta hold 'em back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That'll teach 'em a lesson. I think I got it from here, but we still don't have power. Can you do somethin' about that?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: See that spot up ahead, where the boys have set up shop? That's where you wanna be.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Check with Matthias Black. He should be over by the generator.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Kit Brinny successfully held off waves of Crimson Legion soldiers at the main gate of Kriton's Command Post.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sure? You're gonna miss out on all the fun.

localizedTextIdText: Matthias Black has asked for your help in getting the power back online at the generators outside Kriton's Command Post. Activate the Generator Controls while he regulates the energy flow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Matthias Black outside Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Unless we get power to the guns up top, we're sitting ducks! I've almost got this fixed, but I need someone to activate the power control panels while I regulate the energy flow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What're you talking to me for? Hit those power control panels before I lose my train of thought!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We got power back! Now our anti-air guns can smack those Dommie bombers right out of the sky!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Timing is key here, so don't screw up!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Get to the top of the wall and let the boys know they can cut loose!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Matthias Black got the power generator back up and running, allowing the anti-aircraft guns to resume operations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought you were useful. Guess not.

localizedTextIdText: While you're down at the Crimson Legion's Fuelfuze Depot, Sergeant Kara wants you to take out the Chua fuel suppliers and their bot sentries.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Let's lock down the Dominion's refueling operations, $(player.name). Target the Chua workers in the depot, as well as their sentries.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You need to work a little harder gettin' rid of those Chua workers at the depot, as well as their sentries. Let's throw a wrench in their operation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You need to work a little harder gettin' rid of those Chua workers at the depot, as well as their sentries. Let's throw a wrench in their operation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job knockin' out those workers and sentries. It's only a matter of time until their entire logistics chain goes kaput.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If all their workers are dead, they'll have trouble fuelin' up their ships.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully taken out several supply operators and their guards, dealing a serious blow to fueling operations at the Crimson Legion's Fuelfuze Depot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sorry, sweetheart. You're all I've got down there... damn my luck.

localizedTextIdText: You're all that stands between Tempest Refuge and the Extreme Driller. Sergeant Kara has ordered you to go to Kendra's Roan Ranch and destroy it, as well as kill its inventors, Migo and Mogi, so that the machine's secrets die with them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Extreme Driller needs to be destroyed, and those little freaks, Migo and Mogi, need to be taken out. Think you can handle that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is the Extreme Driller still functional? How about Migo and Mogi? Get it done, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fine work, pal! Couldn't have done it better myself! Durek's gonna hear about this, and he's gonna be as happy as a cubig in manure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck. Tempest Refuge is countin' on you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go anywhere yet, I've got more work for a hotshot like you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Extreme Driller and killed both Migo and Mogi, securing the safety of Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Turnin' your back on the people of Tempest Refuge, eh? Weak.

localizedTextIdText: For once, transmissions are reaching the communications equipment in the XAS Forward Camp. One of these was a distress signal from Skywatch. If you'd like to help, travel to Skywatch and speak to Sergeant Royce.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Royce in Skywatch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All that Pell stuff is wrapped up, yeah? You know how I can tell? 'Cause the radio's workin' again, and I'm gettin' a distress signal from Skywatch.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you still doin' here? Sergeant Royce at Skywatch needs help! From what I hear, the Dominion's attacking!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Skywatch Outpost. The ranks are pretty thin here, and I can use all the help I can get.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get yourself to Skywatch outpost and talk to Sergeant Royce.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good, because we're in some deep trouble here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The people of Skywatch have been under near-constant attack by the Dominion. Sergeant Royce is more than happy to find something for you to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't wanna go? Suit yourself, friend. I just work here.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Free Companies need help in Galeras. Commander Durek has asked you to speak with Sergeant Renzig near the Spaceport Horizon in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Sergeant Renzig at the Spaceport Horizon in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Look alive! Galeras is a war zone. The Dominion want somethin' here, and we ain't gonna let 'em have it. You in?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You talk to Sergeant Renzig yet? Better get movin' before the war ends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you're the big hero everyone's talkin' about, huh? Durek said you'd be comin' to see me. Good timin', too. We're in up to our boulders in Dommies here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Outstanding. Talk to Sergeant Renzig, he'll fill you in. Time for some payback!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What can I do to help?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Sergeant Renzig in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't like your tone, recruit.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Renzig has been killed in action, and Commander Kriton still needs reinforcements. Lead your recruits to Kriton's command post, near the Dominion crash site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Kriton at Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I... I think Commander Kriton's camp is pretty close. That's where Sarge was gonna take us, right?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are we standing around for, sir? Shouldn't we get to Kriton's camp?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Report to my corporal. Then come talk to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Renzig didn't make it, eh? I always figured that tough old boulder was too stubborn to die. We'll raise a mug to him later.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We're right behind you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Congratulations, rookie. Looks like you've got Renzig's job now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The recruits have gone to their new posts, and you've spoken to Commander Kriton. It looks like Sergeant Renzig job now falls to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So... we just sit here and wait to get killed?

localizedTextIdText: You found a massive stone gronyx heart that hums with energy. Foreman Hammerworth in Tremor Ridge might be interested in such a strange discovery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Foreman Hammerworth in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This massive stone gronyx heart pulses with power. Someone interested in Tremor Ridge history or folklore might be intrigued by this find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where did you get this? You know, I got a friend in the XAS who'd be real keen to take a look at it... that is, if I can take it off your hands....
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged, friend. Here's somethin' to fill your pockets with.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take it to the foreman.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Foreman Hammerworth in Tremor Ridge said his friends in the XAS would be very interested in the humming gronyx heart you found. He happily took it off your hands and gave you a little something for your trouble.

localizedTextIdText: Inside a hidden grotto crawling with gronyx are some of the purest loftite veins ever detected, but miners can't get to the loftite veins unless some enterprising Exile clears out the gronyx first.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Been chattin' with the locals. They say there's a grotto packed with loftite they'd love to get. Trouble is, it's also packed with gronyx.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You cleared out that loftite grotto yet? The locals are gettin' restless. They say they ain't never seen loftite veins that pure before.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work. I had a bet with one o' the miners 'bout whether you'd even make it back. Naturally, I bet on you. Here's your share.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Figured you were the right $(player.race) for the job. Go get 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not quite. Enjoy it anyway.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared the hostile gronyx from the hidden grotto near Tremor Ridge, allowing the loftite miners access to the pure veins within and winning a bet for Deadeye Brightland. Despite his typical crankiness, he shared the winnings with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Come back when you got a more positive attitude.

localizedTextIdText: The town of Tremor Ridge will be pleased to hear that you eliminated a large beast that was threatening unwary travelers in the area. You should let Foreman Hammerworth in Tremor Ridge know about this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Foreman Hammerworth in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This shiny chunk of Stalagmight's shell broke off after you killed the beast. Someone in town may want to know of its downfall.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: They call the critter "Stalagmight." Sort of funny, I suppose... until ya figure in all the people he's done killed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is that a piece of Stalagmight? By the stars! Ya killed the critter? That's damn good news, make no mistake! Ya done us all a huge favor!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They'll be tellin' yer story for ages! Just you wait!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully eliminated the dangerous beast known as Stalagmight threatening Tremor Ridge.

localizedTextIdText: A Stranded Protostar Crash Survivor has tasked you with recovering a lost battery pack from the sea floor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the $(vitem=417) to the Stranded Protostar Crash Survivor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears I ejected from my ship prematurely and lost the battery to my extraction device in the water. If you recover it, I'll pay the going rate!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The battery pack should be on the lake bed. Unfortunately, Protostar employees cannot swim without an aquatic personality template.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The battery pack should be on the lake bed. Unfortunately, Protostar employees cannot swim without an aquatic personality template.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have my gratitude in the form of a fiduciary reward. Now stand back! This extraction device is known for its catastrophic malfunctions!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: As I'm trapped, I'll await your return here. Please hurry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Honoring your contract, you recovered the battery pack to a Protostar extraction device, making for one more happy Protostar employee.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Battery Pack to the Stranded Protostar Crash Survivor
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It appears as though I will remain trapped here until further notice.

localizedTextIdText: The XAS is offering a bounty to the Exile who kills the monstrous creature known as the "Dredger," which is threatening Belle's Field Lab in Algoroc. You've taken the job, but it's going to be dangerous - don't try it alone!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Trooper Mogra at Belle's Field Lab
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: REWARD!\nThe XAS is offering a reward for the death of a monstrous subterranean specimen - known as the Dredger - threatening the XAS camp in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: REWARD!\nThe XAS is offering a reward for the death of a monstrous subterranean specimen - known as the Dredger - threatening the XAS camp in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You want the bounty on that monster hasslin' the XAS? Ya gotta kill it first - and bring me some proof. I'd take friends along, too, if I was you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be dipped in gravel! You earned this bounty and then some. Do yourself a favor and don't spend it all in one place, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Given your windfall, maybe you can buy me a drink when I'm off-duty.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the monstrous "Dredger" that was lurking near Belle's Field Lab in Algoroc and collected the sizeable bounty for eliminating it.

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Rowe wants you to take out Crimson Legion forces in the Crimson Base of Operations near Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Rowe via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I ain't ever gonna forgive the Dominion for what they done in Galeras. I joined the Destroyers to take out as many of 'em as I can. Are you with me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This area's just crawlin' with Dominion troops. There's no shortage of targets, so get to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This area's just crawlin' with Dominion troops. There's no shortage of targets, so get to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stars! You practically took out a whole platoon of Dommie slanks by yourself. Nice work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find the Dominion and kill 'em. It's simple. Hit 'em and hit 'em hard.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You eliminated a large number of Crimson Legion troops in the Crimson Base of Operations and reported your success to Trooper Rowe, who was pleased by the news.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You really suck. You know that?

localizedTextIdText: You stumbled upon a ravenok roost near the Crimson Base of Operations. Ravenok are notoriously aggressive, especially when it comes to their eggs, which has given you a brilliant idea: Collect Ravenok Egg and toss them at Crimson Legion soldiers to sic Angry Ravenok Matriarch onto them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Rowe via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mother ravenok are notoriously protective of their eggs. Perhaps you could use their propensity for aggressiveness against the Dominion's troops...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: One livin' Dommie is one Dommie too many, if you ask me. I'd kill 'em all myself if I had unlimited ammo.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You used ravenok against the Dominion troops? That's hilarious! I'd never think of doin' anything like that!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Wait until Cavanaugh hears about this... man, it's so rich!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I bet I could put these to good use...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected Ravenok Egg in the Hidden Hills and tossed them at Crimson Legion troops, causing the Angry Ravenok Matriarch to become enraged and attack them.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I got a plan... using ravenok eggs...

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Gorok at the Excavation Base Camp wants you to clear a landing zone for the next wave of Granok mercenaries headed to Annihilator Silo 14.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Gorok via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need more mercs on the ground, and command has another squad ready to drop in. Go to the LZ and activate the beacon once it's safe to land.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are ya waiting for, gravel-brain? An invitation? Get down there and clear out that LZ before I bust your boulders!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are ya waiting for, gravel-brain? An invitation? Get down there and clear out that LZ before I bust your boulders!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that our mercs are here, we can get to work securin' the area. Good work, $(player.name)! I'm almost sorry I doubted ya.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure to keep that LZ clear. If I lose one merc, you're in for it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I guess you're made of tougher stuff than I thought.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No Eldan rust-bucket is going to stop me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You might have alerted every Eldan construct in the area, but you've successfully defended all the incoming drop pods at the landing zone in Annihilator Silo 14.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're a coward!

localizedTextIdText: Widow Starwick has asked you to collect $m(vitem=402) to lay on the grave of her dead husband, William. $m(vitem=402) can be found growing high on Mount Tempest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Widow Starwick in the Tempest Refuge Graveyard
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When the Dominion attacked, my husband sacrificed himself so I could escape. I wish I had a bouquet of starstem flowers to set upon his grave.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Starstems grow up on Mount Tempest. They were William's favorite flowers...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for helping to honor William's memory. He was a good man, my one true love... and my hero.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please, be careful! I can't take the weight of two deaths on my conscience...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye, beloved William. I'll never forget you, my husband...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a bouquet of $m(vitem=402) to lay on the grave of William Starwick, and shared a quiet moment remembering his life with his widow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So be it... no flowers for old William today...

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a dead merc whose final orders were to paint targets for Exile artillery - specifically, the Eldan repair constructs circling the giant Annihilator at Annihilator Silo 14. Finish his mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Gorok via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The dead merc's datachron describes his last mission: paint targets for Exile artillery, specifically the repair constructs circling the giant Annihilator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Use the Exile Targeting Laser to paint the repair constructs circling the giant Eldan Annihilator. Exile artillery will take care of the rest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You found the targeting laser? Good! Use it on those circling repair constructs up there, so our artillery can take 'em out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work! Things are bad enough right now. The last thing we need is that big Annihilator runnin' at full capacity.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully targeted the Eldan repair constructs attempting to bring the Annihilator back to full strength. This should give the Exiles in Algoroc a fighting chance.

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Kerrika at the Excavation Base Camp has asked you to search the Crashed Drop Pod around Annihilator Silo 14 for survivors.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Kerrika via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A wave of our drop pods ate a volley from that Annihilator on their way down. There's flamin' wrecks all over this site. Go and help any survivors!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for crashed drop pods. I'll bet good brew they've got mercs trapped inside, and we need all the fightin' bodies we can get. Now move!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You saved a lotta good mercs, $(player.name). The whole company's in your debt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We need every last merc we can get. These rust buckets just keep comin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As long as you're with us, you'll never pay for another brew again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were quick to act after Trooper Kerrika told you about the crashed drop pods around Annihilator Silo 14. You saved many Granok mercs from a fiery death.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Some hero you are.

localizedTextIdText: Mercenary Terek, wounded in action, asked you to make your way up the cliffs to a spot above the gronyx bombardiers at Exo-Site 14. Plant explosive charges there. Once they're in place, return to Terek and set off the explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mercenary Terek at Exo-Site 14
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been hit! I can't make it up that cliffside. You gotta help. Activate the charges up there, and we'll bring a mountain down on those blasted gronyx!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: When you got the charges set, come back here. Take cover near me before ya set 'em off. You don't wanna get caught in that blast, believe me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When you got the charges set, come back here. Take cover near me before ya set 'em off. You don't wanna get caught in that blast, believe me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a sight to see, $(player.name)! Those gronyx ain't never heard the old Granok saying: "There's always a bigger rock!"
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Set 'em active. Then come take cover here, and we'll set 'em off remotely.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The explosives brought the mountain down on top of the gronyx bombardiers, saving many Exile lives at the Eldan excavation site in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't an option, buddy.

localizedTextIdText: For the good of public safety, a reward is hereby offered for the death of the canimid alpha known colloquially as "Gnarls." Gnarls makes his lair in a large cave complex outside of Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mayor Crofton in Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nOn behalf of public safety, a reward is hereby offered for the death of the canimid alpha known colloquially as "Gnarls." Beware!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nOn behalf of public safety, a reward is hereby offered for the death of the canimid alpha known colloquially as "Gnarls." Beware!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hunting Gnarls, are you? Well, I wish you luck. You're going to need plenty of it - and some friends - if you expect to bring him down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you did it? You really killed Gnarls? Here's your reward. I don't suppose you found any sign of Professor Earp, did you?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's too bad. Earp was a local hero. He'll be missed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed Gnarls, but unfortunately Professor Earp had already perished.

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker asked you to take control of the spawners. They've activated an endless stream of deadly Eldan augmentors. And destroy the augmentor constructs, while you're at it!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Eldan modified livin' things with this augmentation. It ain't somethin' we've seen before, but now we've got augmentors popping up all over the place!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those augmentor constructs showed up when I triggered the security protocols. Reboot the Caretaker. Then I reckon we won't see any more augmentors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work, darlin'! Like my daddy used to say: technology's all well and good, so long as you always got one hand near the off switch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take care of them augmentor constructs, and don't forget the spawners!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully destroyed the augmentors flooding the Eldan excavation site in Algoroc. You also took control of the corrupted augmentor spawners that created them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why is the Caretaker augmenting everything?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm Belle Walker. I'm sure you've heard of my daddy, Dorian Walker. I don't explore or nothin', not like him, but I love findin' out about how Eldan technology works.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Reckon it's part o' them security protocols he won't stop blatherin' about. Makes sense, too. Rather than wipe out every threat, you can co-opt it for your own ends. I just wish it wasn't us gettin' co-opted. Not every security measure is a giant construct the size of a star cruiser.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, I do hope you change your mind. We need help!

localizedTextIdText: After killing the giant gronyx dubbed Stonemore, you recovered a glowing core stone from the rubble of his corpse. Trooper Gorok at the Base Camp may know what to do with it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Trooper Gorok at the Base Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've found a smooth, glowing stone in the heart of an augmented gronyx. Perhaps Trooper Gorok at the XAS camp can make something of it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What in hell is that? Pulled it out of that big gronyx, did ya? I'll make sure one o' those XAS eggheads takes a look at it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the glowing core of the gronyx called Stonemore to Trooper Gorok at the Base Camp.

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Gorok wants you to kill canimid and secure the area as you make your way into the ruins. He's requested that you join Belle Walker at the next XAS camp and assist her in her efforts to shut the Annihilator down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Belle Walker at the her camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Belle Walker took off without an escort. Clear out the wildlife and find her, will ya? She's real good at causin' trouble, but we still need her.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go find Belle and help her out, $(player.name). We've got everything under control here, but the wildlife is still causin' trouble.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did Gorok send you along? He's such a darlin'... always knows when a girl needs help. If you take care of those critters, maybe we can talk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, I hope y'all don't mind that I ran off here on my own. I just had to see this augmentation process up close. It's so... fascinating! Ain't it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: She was mutterin' somethin' about augmentation. That can't be good.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That's one word for it, I suppose.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed augmented canimid to secure the safety of the expedition, then joined up with Belle Walker further into the ruins.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: "No" isn't an option, buddy. Try again.

localizedTextIdText: Stickypaw has been stealing all the honey from the buzzbing hives near Nibben's Ranch. Fannie Nibben has posted a rich bounty for anyone brave enough to kill the beast and bring her proof of the deed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Stickypaw's Paw to Fannie Nibben at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This large paw is covered in blood and buzzbing honey. You should take it to Fannie Nibben and claim the reward for killing Stickypaw.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You should bring this paw to Fannie Nibben as proof that you've dealt with the girrok that was raiding her buzzbing hives.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That damn girrok's stealin' all our honey! We'll be ruined if that beast keeps up its shenanigans!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be dipped in honey! That's got to be Stickypaw's paw! How'd you kill the beast? Oh, never mind... here's the bounty on him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No, don't thank me... you did the work, you earned the reward fair and square.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the rampaging, honey-hungry girrok known as Stickypaw and earned a healthy reward from Fannie Nibben for your trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take Stickypaw's Paw to Fannie Nibben

localizedTextIdText: Exile farmers are unable to harvest their crops due the unrest in Galeras. Farmer Amos has asked you to gather ripe $(vitem=350) at Clearfield Farm, $(vitem=351) at Redstone Farm, and $(vitem=352) at Skyler Farm.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Amos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our crops are goin' to wither on the vine if we don't pick 'em soon. Trouble is, the Dominion and the local critters are makin' it hard to harvest our crops!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's the harvest comin' along? We got lots of mouths to feed in Skywatch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like you got a knack for pickin' veggies, friend. You ever want to settle down, let me know. We can use a hand like you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hey, that'd be great! Bring back all you can, 'cause we've got to feed the troops!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to harvest a bumper crop of tasty vegetables for Farmer Amos.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself, but you should still see if you're gonna be fed or not.

localizedTextIdText: The garr known as Jabbermaw that haunts the beach near the Skywind Ruins has become a nuisance and must be dealt with. Whoever brings proof of Jabbermaw demise to Trooper Tarog at Camp Dustdevil will receive a substantial cash reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Trooper Tarog in Camp Dustdevil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: JABBERMAW\nUse care when confronting the garr known as Jabbermaw! If destroyed, contact Trooper Tarog for your reward.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED: JABBERMAW\nUse care when confronting the garr known as Jabbermaw! If destroyed, contact Trooper Tarog for your reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That blasted garr's killed another researcher. How many times do I gotta tell these guys there's no swimmin' allowed?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You slagged Jabbermaw? I been hopin' someone would grow a backbone and take that monster out for good. Makes sense it'd be you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's your money. You deserve it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the garr known as Jabbermaw and brought proof of its death to Trooper Tarog.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Explorer Yorin Threeleaf in Roan Roam Mills
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thanks for the help, friend. I was just up here, checking on the status of the roan. They're all a mess, and that one nearly gored me to a pulp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm going to catch my breath before I head back to Thayd. I think I've done enough exploring for one day.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You saved Explorer Yorin Threeleaf from being killed by a Rumblehoof the Foul at Roan Roam Mills in Galeras. Chalk up another good deed!

localizedTextIdText: Rancher Wayland has posted a reward for the destruction of "Dribbles," his daughter's pet chompacabra. Should you be compelled to kill Dribbles, which lurks in the Windy Hollow, you should return to Rancher Wayland for your reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Rancher Wayland via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our family pet is on the loose! Compensation is offered for humane destruction of "Dribbles"! Contact Rancher Wayland to collect your reward!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Our family pet is on the loose! Compensation is offered for humane destruction of "Dribbles"! Contact Rancher Wayland to collect your reward!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dribbles was a good pet, but he went bad... real bad. Now he's cullin' my roan herds. I got no choice but to put him down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here's your reward for takin' care of Dribbles. He was a good pet... mostly. His death wasn't too painful... was it?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's good to know. My little girl misses him somethin' fierce...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the chompacabra known as Dribbles and received a reward from Rancher Wayland for your troubles. Why anyone in their right mind would want a chompacabra for a pet remains a mystery to you.

localizedTextIdText: The personnel at the XAS Excavation Site have all undergone CSP augmentation. Sue Digstone has asked you to learn what you can from the other researchers while she tries to contact Professor Digstone.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sue Digstone in the XAS Excavation Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The others aren't makin' any sense. It's like their brains are rewired or somethin'. Maybe you can get through to 'em. It's worth a try, ain't it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you talk to any of the other researchers? You gotta get through to 'em! You just gotta!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My dad won't answer his datachron. Did you have any luck with the others? Did you get 'em to snap out of it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: While you're doin' that, I'm gonna try to get my dad on the datachron. Where could he be?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I was afraid of that. It's totally sealed off! We can't get in... unless....
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They say your dad's in the exo-lab.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite your best efforts, all the researchers at the XAS Excavation Site, appear to have succumbed to their cerebro-suppression protocols and have little of value to say. To make matters worse, Sue Digstone has been unable to contact Professor Digstone.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How could they have been augmented with CSP?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: No one really knows, though I think we're gettin' a good look at it right now. It's like... it takes over their minds!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I have no idea! Same way as the canimid and buzzbings, I figure, while I was gone... I mean, I can't think of anything else!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I... I think so, as long as we get to it early enough. Otherwise, it takes root too deeply in the subject's nervous system.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know they're kinda creepy, but... what else can we do?

localizedTextIdText: You located a Scan Uplink Control Panel in Thayd and, curious, pressed a button to see what it would do. Sera Melfield, excited, ran off to a nearby holographic terminal to observe what effect your button-mashing had. Perhaps you should join her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sera Melfield in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This complicated control panel appears to be offline at the moment.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This complicated control panel features several blinking lights.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Wow! This is amazing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at this hologram! It's got to be a detailed schematic of the Focus of Air. That's an ancient Eldan artifact of immense power! Amazing!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Some people think the Dominion is attacking Galeras to get their hands on the Focus of Air. What big meanies!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I wonder what this button does...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By pressing buttons on a terminal you probably should have left well enough alone, you revealed an ancient holographic scan of the Focus of Air. This ancient Eldan structure is rumored to be a powerful artifact, but Exile scientists are still puzzled as to its function.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Where did that Melfield lady go?

localizedTextIdText: Morek Throg thugs keep handy munitions caches scattered throughout their camp. You should take this opportunity to destroy the munitions before they can be used against the innocent citizens of Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Justice Graybank via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Throg and the Darkspur Cartel plan to use these munitions against the people of Gallow. You'd better destroy them first.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Throg and the Darkspur Cartel plan to use these munitions against the people of Gallow. You'd better destroy them first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've got to get rid of the Cartel's offensive capability. If someone could get in there and destroy their munitions caches, it'd help a lot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That took quick thinkin' and real initiative, $(player.class). I'd have done the same thing if I was in your shoes.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'd better get rid of these.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the munitions caches scattered throughout the cartel camp, preventing the Darkspur Cartel from using them against the innocent people of Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'd better get rid of these.

localizedTextIdText: Speak to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing in Whitevale and see if he has any work for you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You! Yeah, you! Welcome to Thermock Hold and all that. Brewmaster Grok's been lookin' for help around town. You wanna lend a hand? Go see him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ain't you supposed to be talkin' to Grok? He's at the Last Man Standing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What is it? Oh... you're here to help out? Finally! A stone worth turnin' over. I've got too much to do, and not enough hands. I could use your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Have fun helpin' out!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll speak to him straight away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing and offered him your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll speak to him straight away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You probably couldn't hack it, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Ranch Hand Jelton asked you to poison the carcasses of the roan killed by dagun near their dens, thereby poisoning the creatures' food supply.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Rancher Standhill via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dagun are killin' all of Standhill's roan. I was gonna poison some of the roan carcasses, hopin' to kill the dagun, but the curs got the drop on me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Look for fresh-killed roan and put some poison on 'em. Those damn dagun'll come back to eat their kills before long, then they'll be dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where in blazes did Jelton get off to? He was supposed to deal with the damn dagun on account of 'em eatin' my roan!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Poisoned some of them dagun, did you? I'm much obliged to you. I do hope Jelton's alright. Those mongrels ripped him up good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're a lifesaver. I'm pretty tore up, else I'd help you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks again, friend. I owe you one.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully killed many vicious, roan-hunting dagun by poisoning the carcasses of their favorite prey. Maybe now Ranch Hand Jelton can get back to town and have his wounds tended.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I use this poison?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Just find roan carcasses and add some o' this poison. Dagun'll eat the roan and die. Leastways, I reckon it'll play out that way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Some kinda help you are, stranger.

localizedTextIdText: Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing has asked for your help in keeping the peace around his bar in Thermock Hold. Confront any hooligans you find and teach them some manners... with your fists, not your weapons!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Things are startin' to get out of control around here. Do me a favor and crack down on any troublemakers... with your fists, if you hafta.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You get a chance to walk 'round the bar yet? Some of these hooligans won't listen to reason. Only the taste of a good ol' knuckle sandwich'll do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work. That'll make those goons think twice before steppin' outta line again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's always some idiot who can't handle his brew.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll knock some sense into them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've beat down some of the rowdier hooligans around the Last Man Standing and restored some semblance of peace to Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are there so many mean drunks?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you mean, "blow off a little steam"?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Thermock's a kind of staging point for troops goin' to and from the battlefield. When they show up here, they just wanna blow off a little steam.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Too many bad things have been happenin' lately. Supplies goin' missin', lotsa funny accidents. Sure, we're a rough bunch 'round here, but all the same... I don't like it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then why you wastin' my time? Scram.

localizedTextIdText: The Last Man Standing is running low on brew. Brewmaster Grok has asked you to check with Distributor Barleyfield on the status of his order. Barleyfield should be in his brew shop in Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the Stolen Keg to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're runnin' low on brew, but our distributor still hasn't sent my last order. Track him down and find out what's takin' so blasted long!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Talk to Jeck yet? He's killin' me here! Don't he know no brew is bad for business?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Figures that scumbag Tragg would've jacked my brew. We've got enough problems in Thermock without him makin' more trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can find Jeck in his shop on the upper levels of Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ha! You wish, kid!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: So I get free drinks now, right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Distributor Barleyfield only to find "Money Baggs" Tragg made off with Grok's kegs. You found the kegs behind the gambling den and returned them Brewmaster Grok in time to avert a major crisis.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the Stolen Keg to Brewmaster Grok
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Scram, before I take my fist to your skull!

localizedTextIdText: In order to keep the hungry populace of Thermock Hold fed, Apprentice Puqik, Grollo the Butcher apprentice, has asked you to hunt Silversnout girrok and Whitespring swarmlings for their flesh. The creatures can be found in the fields outside of Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Grollo the Butcher in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Helpful stranger! Assistance required! Lopp is butcher's apprentice. Butcher needs meat or people starve. You please find meat for butcher?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Big person have meat yet? Remember, girrok and swarmling flesh is best! Many, many beasts outside town! Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I haven't got enough meat to keep these folks happy. I'm going to have a riot on my hands if these people don't starve first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at that meat! It's beautiful! Did Puqik put you up to this? He's a good fellow, even if he is so small.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Girrok and swarmlings plentiful, have tasty flesh. Hunt them outside Thermock for reward!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yup, sure is! I'd pay you in meat, but it looks like you can find your own.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He said there'd be a reward.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=168) and $m(vitem=169) from girrok and swarmlings in the fields outside of Thermock Hold. With his larder freshly stocked, Grollo the Butcher will be able to keep the people of the town well-fed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: People going hungry. People starving. Lopp not being trained properly. You not care?

localizedTextIdText: You arrived at the Gas 'n' Guzzle to find it under attack by crazed Freebots. Commander Raxen, the Granok in charge of the bikes at this fueling station, has asked you to help him fend them off.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Raxen at the Gas 'n' Guzzle
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey you! Yeah, you with the face! Mind helpin' me beat the livin' bolts outta these blasted Freebots?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We gotta push these blasted bots back, or else the Gas 'n' Guzzle is done for!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I dunno what's got into these Freebots. Normally they're annoyingly friendly, but these ones have been attackin' and takin' our supplies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Here they come now. Bring it on you worthless pieces of scrap metal!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Commander Raxen at the Gas 'n' Guzzle by fighting off the attacks of hostile Freebots. You learned they've been assaulting the fueling station constantly for the last few days, trying to steal supplies and inflict damage on the equipment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yeah, well thanks for nothin'.

localizedTextIdText: You discovered a mangled, half-eaten corpse, indicating that a large predator has been hunting captives near the Cartel slaver camp. Put this lurking terror down, once and for all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chronicler Herrick Grenfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This mangled body appears to be one of the captured slaves. A large predator has eaten most of the corpse. Someone should stop it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This mangled body appears to be one of the captured slaves. A large predator has eaten most of the corpse. Someone should stop it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've heard of a creature... folks call it the Lurking Terror. No one knows what it is, but it will kill you and eat you if it catches you. Be careful!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have never, ever heard of a stumpkin growin' to such an unusual size. That's a tale for the chronicles, make no mistake.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Glad you had the grit to stand your ground, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked down the lurking terror - a massive, overgrown stumpkin - and put an end to its reign of fear.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Raxen at the Gas 'n' Guzzle is concerned because the Freebots of Locus Dawn have become outwardly aggressive and hostile. He's suggested you investigate the Freebot colony and see what's behind the ruckus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Regulator Codec at Locus Dawn
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Look pal, these Freebots are becomin' a fraggin' nuisance. Maybe you could head over to their locus and have a word with 'em?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You talked to the Freebots at Locus Dawn yet? They're still comin' up here and causin' trouble. It's like they're beggin' us to slag 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Great Datacenters of Positron! You've got to help us! Our citizens have gone insane! We fear for both our structural cohesion and our sanity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I feel ten times better knowin' yer on the case, bub.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Freebots of Locus Dawn have been overcome by a strange affliction that renders them aggressive and hostile. Only a handful of "sane" Freebots remain, and they need your help!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If I knew that I wouldn't need to send you down to check on 'em... would I? It's like they've gone rock-blind crazy or somethin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself, mack, but don't expect me to cry when one of them bots slags ya.

localizedTextIdText: Regulator Codec fears that the crazed Freebots will either infect or destroy himself and his friend Wiretapp. He's asked you to deactivate crazed Freebots around Locus Dawn before this can come to pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Regulator Codec via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Freebots of this Locus have malfunctioned. They are dangerous! For our own safety, they must be deactivated at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Protect us from our erstwhile brothers before they destroy us or, worse, corrupt our processes with whatever madness they are infected with!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Amazing! Wiretapp and I owe our continued functionality to you! As regulator of this Locus, I would do well to analyze and emulate your combat subroutines!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not allow them to suffer unnecessarily. Our hope is that we can repair them later.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll scrap those bots for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped protect Regulator Codec and Wiretapp from the crazed Freebots of Locus Dawn.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll scrap those bots for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am called Codec. I am one of Locus Dawn's regulators... the last of them, actually. It is my duty to maintain order and protect the peace.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That is Wiretapp, my comrade. His programming is geared towards espionage and surveillance.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The cause of our plight is currently unknown. With your assistance, I feel that the probability of learning the truth increases dramatically.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not turn your back on us! There are only a few of us remaining!

localizedTextIdText: Wiretapp wishes to determine what's behind the sudden change in Freebot personalities in Locus Dawn. He has asked you to collect $m(vitem=256) from hostile Freebots so he can analyze them for traces of malicious code.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Wiretapp via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I would like a chance to analyze neural cores taken from the crazy Freebots. Can you assist me in collection of said neural cores?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If I am to analyze my brothers' neural cores, I will require that said neural cores be collected from them as soon as possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Analysis of neural cores commencing. Analysis... complete. Presence of malicious code confirmed. It is now obvious that Locus Dawn has been sabotaged!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once I have the cores, I will determine what is responsible for this disaster.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Negative. We must determine the source of this code and ensure it is eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That's not good news, is it?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=256) from crazed Freebots around Locus Dawn for Wiretapp. Upon further analysis, he determined that the Freebots are suffering from their instability due to an application of malicious code from an external source.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your reluctance to assist me in this endeavor does not compute. Please reprocess.

localizedTextIdText: Wiretapp has developed a cure which should counter the malicious code that has turned the Freebots of Locus Dawn into aggressive killing machines. He's asked you to weaken Crazed Freebots around Locus Dawn, then upload his hotfix into their central processors.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Wiretapp via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have developed a hotfix that should counter the malicious code that has affected my brothers. Will you upload the patch into their processors?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you had any luck with the hotfix? You must weaken the crazed Freebots, without deactivating them, before you upload it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Due to your diligent application of my hotfix, my brothers have been cured of their insanity! My gratitude subroutines are overwhelmed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember, you must weaken them before uploading the hotfix!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Wiretapp hotfix for the malicious code that's affected the Freebots of Locus Dawn has been a resounding success! Many Freebots have already been cured of their derangements, and it is only a matter of time before the remaining Freebot victims have returned to normal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Are you sure this hotfix will work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It should work like a charm, so long as their recovery subsystems are rerouting power from their internal firewalls.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Quite! To slip the patch past their firewalls, you must beat them to within a micrometer of deactivation. It is all quite technical.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This hotfix could cure my brothers of the malicious code that drives them!

localizedTextIdText: Uninfected Freebots are being taken to a cave near Locus Dawn. Avra Darkos has asked you to infiltrate the cave and install spy cams to allow the Black Hoods insight into what goes on there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Avra Darkos within the Botcave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is a cavern complex near Locus Dawn. We suspect the hostile Freebots are coming from these caves. You must set up spycams within the cave.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We are nearing the end of this little caper, you and I. Explore the cave and set up spycams so we may finally have answers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We are nearing the end of this little caper, you and I. Explore the cave and set up spycams so we may finally have answers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is as I suspected. The Dominion has been framing the Freebots for perpetrating their own pernicious plot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Someone altered those Freebots, but who?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must make the ICI suffer for its sins, wouldn't you say?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get to the bottom of this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: When you explored the Botcave, you discovered stolen foodstuffs and Thermock Hold's missing supplies! In addition, you discovered a room full of Dominion communications equipment. It appears the ICI has been behind these events all along.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Perhaps not, but I know you. I am Avra Darkos, the Widow. It is my business to know the hidden mind of our enemy so that we may counter his moves in the shadowy games we play.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing to acknowledge this assignment is not acceptable. I suggest you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos has ordered to you kill Equalizer Zyrio, as well as the Snowshadow personnel that follow him. Equalizer Zyrio and his Snowshadow agents can be found inside the Botcave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI running the Freebot operation must be hidden behind that door. I expect you to ensure their leader's end, along with any number of his agents.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The ICI is behind the troubles of the Freebots. I expect you to wipe their operation out, starting with Equalizer Zyrio.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The ICI is behind the troubles of the Freebots. I expect you to wipe their operation out, starting with Equalizer Zyrio.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I take great pleasure in observing the deaths of those who would destroy us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Display for me decisive and deadly efficiency - the hallmarks of a good agent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are a useful tool, $(player.name). I may have additional uses for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Equalizer Zyrio and the ICI agents under his command have been eliminated, and the Freebots of Locus Dawn are starting to return to normal. In addition, you've revealed that the missing supplies from Thermock Hold were somehow routed to the Botcave by the Dominion's secret agents.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Who - or what - are the ICI?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Imperial Corps of Intelligence is to the Dominion as the Black Hoods are to the Exiles. They are our deadly opponents in the covert game we play.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you are more of a liability than I gave you credit for.

localizedTextIdText: Speak to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing in Whitevale and see if he has any work for you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you are done here, my sources say Brewmaster Grok in Thermock Hold could use a troubleshooter like you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Grok can be found at the Last Man Standing, a bar in Thermock Hold. I am certain he will be glad to have your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah, I'm lookin' for help. Who sent you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Grok runs the Last Man Standing. You shall find him there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: She's one scary lady. Don't mess with her. Don't matter... I can use you, sure.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing and offered him your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is your prerogative whether or not you wish to help.
