localizedTextIdText: The ICI seem unusually interested in a strange plant. You spoke with Alchemist Vikmos who sent you outside Snowfade Grounds to collect samples for testing. There may be a connection with the recent poisoning of several Black Hoods agents.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Alchemist Vikmos at Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The malfrost blossom, as I've classified the plant, only grows in certain parts of Whitevale. I must determine its... properties... for myself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm afraid you can find fresh blossoms only in this protective bubble. For frozen ones, you will have to... venture out into the cold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, the malfrost blossoms. Thank you for finding them. Lady Darkos will be... pleased at our progress.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Field agents report the ICI is harvesting vast quantities of it. How curious...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We've lost several agents to a mysterious, unknown poison. Is this the connection?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope your research goes well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered samples of the malfrost blossom from the surrounding area. Now Alchemist Vikmos can determine what special properties the plant might have.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get samples of those flowers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: The ICI are interested in this plant?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Without samples, I cannot say for certain... but Lady Darkos sent me to study the flora of the region when Dominion... interest in the plant was observed. For now, I am calling it the malfrost blossom, in reference to its bleak appearance and... snowy origin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I was under the impression you were here to... assist.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Vikmos has a theory about the malfrost blossoms that he would like to test. He's asked you to procure cold and warm-weather jabbits and pumera from the fields surrounding Snowfade Grounds so he can confirm his suspicions.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Alchemist Vikmos at Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Please... procure cold and warm-weather fauna for me... so I can test a theory. The recent flash freeze should have caught those unused to such cold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you collected cold and warm-weather jabbits and pumera yet? I grow... convinced that I am on the path to truth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for bringing me the... test subjects.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not tell the Aurin... they would not be pleased...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Are you ready to assist me with ascertaining the accuracy of my hypothesis?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found several of the warm-weather creatures had been caught in the recent flash freeze. You chiseled them out, bringing them and their cold-weather counterparts to Alchemist Vikmos. Perhaps now you can find out what the ICI want with the malfrost blossom.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Warm-weather creatures, like us Exiles, are more recent arrivals to the region. They have not had time to adapt to the bitter cold. The thought occurred to me that perhaps the malfrost blossom react differently.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lady Darkos will be disappointed... that is dangerous, indeed...

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Vikmos has made all the necessary preparations for his test and would like you to feed the malfrost blossom compound to the test subjects in Snowfade Grounds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Alchemist Vikmos in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have made all the necessary preparations. All that is left is to feed the malfrost compound to the test subjects. Would you care to do the... honors?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please feed the malfrost compound to the creatures. Then let us... observe what happens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please feed the malfrost compound to the creatures. Then let us... observe what happens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It appears the ICI have developed a most devious poison, deadly only to newcomers to Whitevale... such as us Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not be squeamish. They will not feel... a thing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We need an antidote. I fear the ICI's poisonous plot is already underway.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fed the prepared malfrost compound to the test subjects and observed that it was fatal to warm-weather creatures while harmless to those creatures that had been in Whitevale long enough to adapt to the cold. As recent arrivals to Whitevale, the Exiles will be extremely susceptible to this seemingly innocuous plant's deadly toxin, a disturbing implication considering ICI interest in it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is Lady Darkos... aware that you are unwilling to help?

localizedTextIdText: Speak to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing in Whitevale and see if he has any work for you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've received word that there are... disturbances... in Thermock Hold. I suggest you go and speak with Brewmaster Grok at once.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why are you still here? You are needed... in Thermock Hold. Brewmaster Grok requires someone with your... talents.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I was told you'd be comin' my way. About blasted time, too. We're bound to have a riot!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now leave me so I may contemplate the meaning... of death.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing and offered him your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Grok will be... disappointed.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Vikmos, a Mordesh alchemist stationed at the Snowfade Grounds, has gotten word that there is some sort of disturbance at a nearby Freebot settlement. He suggests that you head to Locus Dawn and speak with the Freebots there about their situation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Regulator Codec at Locus Dawn
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've gotten word of a disturbance of sorts... in Locus Dawn. I suggest you go there and investigate... at once.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why are you still here? Should you not be in Locus Dawn, assessing the Freebot emergency?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Great Datacenters of Positron! You've got to help us! Our citizens have gone insane! We fear for both our structural cohesion and our sanity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now leave me. I must contemplate further the meaning... of death.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Freebots of Locus Dawn have been overcome by a strange affliction that renders them aggressive and hostile. Only a handful of "sane" Freebots remain, and they need your help!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Unknown. There are reports of hostile Freebots... insane Freebots. Such aggression is not the norm for them. I find it all to be... most curious.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I did not expect you to be so... craven. The Freebots can be useful allies.

localizedTextIdText: The sudden flash freezes in Whitevale have caught some creatures off guard. Scientist Marshmaul has asked you to thaw out the ones near Snowfade Grounds, using his frost melter device.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Marshmaul in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Several of the native Whitevale species are less well-adapted to the cold. I've built something to thaw them out, but I'm going to need your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You thaw those creatures out? I'm still trying to figure out why they haven't adapted, but in the meantime, keep defrosting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Like we Aurin say, all living creatures are part of the Weave. You did more than just help out a few animals.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These flash freezes aren't natural! Then again, this whole planet is weird.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I only wish we knew why the weather's so weird in Whitevale...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully thawed out many frozen creatures, helping the Aurin of Snowfade Grounds save wildlife in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you mean the flash freezes aren't natural?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The fact that so many Whitevale species are susceptible to the flash freezes tells me something's wrong. Normally, species evolve to adapt to the climate. But it looks like the climate's out-evolving them!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you turn your back on all those animals?

localizedTextIdText: Mitsy Grassdancer has a pet splorg named Mr. Wiggles who has become ill from the freezing cold of Whitevale. Mitsy has asked you to help collect ingredients for medicine for Wiggles. Gather fresh thermal water and swarmling shells at the thermal springs near Snowfade Grounds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mitsy Grassdancer in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This terrible cold is making Mr. Wiggles very sick. Please, help me gather some items from the thermal springs to make him well again. $(self.visual=7021)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please hurry and get the spring water and swarmling shells for Mr. Wiggles' medicine. I'm so worried! $(self.visual=1351)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're the best, you know that? Wiggles looks so much better now and is back to being energetic. $(self.visual=7693)
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please hurry, I think his sneezing is getting worse!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe he's a bit too energetic. But I know just the thing for that.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I can get those items.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went to the thermal springs on an errand for concerned splorg lover. You gathered the fresh thermal water and swarmling shells needed and returned to Mitsy Grassdancer, who was able to cure Mr. Wiggles of his bad cold.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll hurry and get what you need.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, please don't say no. Poor Wiggles is so sick.

localizedTextIdText: Now that Mr. Wiggles has recovered from his cold, Mitsy Grassdancer has asked you to protect him during a trip to dig up tundra truffles for the camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mitsy Grassdancer in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that Wiggles is all better, do you think you could go with him to gather truffles for the camp? He'll dig them up, you just need to stay close. $(self.visual=1351)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, aren't you supposed to be protecting Wiggles? Don't tell me you left him out there by himself! $(self.visual=1351)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you so much for all these delicious tundra truffles. Every morsel of food is important in these frozen lands. $(self.visual=7693)
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't let any hungry predators eat him!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Wiggles is happy now, too. He really needed the exercise.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought off all the would-be predators who were ready to pounce on Mr. Wiggles and collected many tasty truffles for the Aurin of Snowfade Grounds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But I thought you were our friend.

localizedTextIdText: Banther Windtracker, an Aurin hunter, is worried about the diminishing food supplies at Snowfade Grounds. He has asked you to hunt some of the local pumera and girrok, and gather tundra tubers from frozen plants in the surrounding area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Banther Windtracker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You there. You look like you can handle a snarling pumera or two. Can I trust you to do some hunting and gathering for us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need you to kill off some of the wild creatures and get tubers for the camp. People are counting on that food to survive.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, not bad. You've got the instincts of a hunter. Even with this cold, we'll eat well, thanks to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good! It takes guts to survive in a cold place like this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have more work for you, if you're interested.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You whittled down the number of predators in Whitevale and brought back plenty of tundra tubers for the Aurin camp. Nobody's starving on your watch!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And I thought I could count on you. I guess I was wrong.

localizedTextIdText: In an effort to maintain the delicate balance of nature in Whitevale, Banther Windtracker has asked you to cut down the number of boulderbacks, ringtails, and mammodin in the areas surrounding Snowfade Grounds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Banther Windtracker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This freezing cold has been wreaking havoc with the balance of nature. The only way to make things right is to remove certain creatures from the cycle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've got to do what's necessary to maintain the balance. Which means making sure there are less boulderbacks, ringtails, and mammodin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're alright, you know that? Thanks for helping to restore the balance of nature.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hate to do it, but this is the burden we hunters have to carry.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I just hope we can figure out what's causing this weird weather.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've slain several creatures at the request of Banther Windtracker. He was satisfied that the balance of nature in Whitevale has been restored - for now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me you haven't got the stomach for it, you dirty rotten liar!

localizedTextIdText: The Black Hoods are a covert organization that serves the interests of the Exiles. Black Hoods agents, disguised as bar patrons at the Last Man Standing, will only agree to speak with you after you've given them a secret code phrase - "The chompacabra meet at midnight" - as a signal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Walk with care - there's a double agent in our midst. Speak with our agents in Thermock usin' the code phrase - "The chompacabra meet at midnight."
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you made contact with our undercover agents at the Last Man Standin'? Well, why the hell not? Remember, "The chompacabra meet at midnight."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You should not speak to me until you have met with our agents in Thermock Hold. I do hope you have not forgotten the code phrase.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have located our agents in Thermock. Excellent. You must work closely with them in order to identify the double agent that plagues us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The agents'll be disguised as bar patrons at the Last Man Standin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Either you will adapt to the spy trade, or it will chew you up and spit you out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located two of Avra Darkoss Black Hoods agents and met up with each of them separately.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can you tell me about the Black Hoods?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We're the covert arm of the Exiles. By servin' us, you're doin' your duty like any loyal Exile. That's all you need to know.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you're not an asset, then you're a liability. Better get with the program.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lazilo has asked you to use the Covert-A-Tron Detection Device to eliminate the ICI Surveillance Unit that have been hidden in Thermock Hold by the Dominion's agents. The units are difficult to see, but they appear to be blue electric spheres.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lazilo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI has eyes and ears everywhere... in the form of surveillance units. If we're going to catch this double agent, we'll need to squash those bugs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you destroyed any of the ICI's surveillance units yet? You'd best get to work! Use the Covert-A-Tron to disrupt 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to see you, Agent $(player.name). I'm guessing you were successful in destroying the ICI's surveillance units...?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The bugs could be anywhere! Use the Covert-A-Tron to reveal and destroy 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Damn! How did our intel miss the presence of Dominion destructobots?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Covert-A-Tron Detection Device to eliminate ICI Surveillance Unit in Thermock Hold. Though destroying the bugs was a simple matter, you found yourself under attack by Skittering Destructobot at every turn... almost as if the ICI bots were waiting for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I locate these bugs?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That's easy. This here doohickey's a Covert-A-Tron Detection Device. It cuts through enemy stealth fields and disrupts listening devices! Zap!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your reluctance to serve the Black Hoods has been duly noted.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Zero has asked you to use the Covert-A-Tron Detection Device to reveal and eliminate Snowshadow Saboteur in Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Zero via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ICI saboteurs are using cloaking fields to move around Thermock Hold. You need to suss 'em out and neutralize 'em before they do more damage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the Covert-A-Tron to reveal the ICI's saboteurs, then kill 'em. You know how to use those weapons, don't you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Huh...? Oh... $(player.name)! I didn't expect to see you again... so soon. I guess you took care of the saboteurs, huh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This should be a pretty easy assignment, so try not to screw it up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't trouble yourself filing a report with the Widow... I'll take care of it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of the saboteurs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully used the Covert-A-Tron Detection Device to reveal Snowshadow Saboteur in Thermock Hold and handily killed many of them. Despite the saboteurs' best efforts, you were able to avoid serious injury at their hands.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the saboteurs.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I locate the saboteurs?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You can use a Covert-A-Tron Detection Device to scramble their stealth fields. I don't expect 'em to put up much of a fight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A coward, huh? I had you pegged as one all along.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos and the Black Hoods have identified a potential ICI informant. She has asked you to infiltrate the suspect's home in Thermock Hold and search for clues linking them to the double agent.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My agents have identified a suspected ICI informant in Thermock Hold. I would like you to infiltrate the informant's home and investigate further.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your presence is required elsewhere. I suggest you go to the informant's home at once and investigate his relation to the double agent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is not yet over. Be on your guard.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At first blush, the data you drew from the informant's terminal seems decisive. It must be thoroughly analyzed before we can solve our problem.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If this lead pays off, I anticipate the Dominion will respond forcefully.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Never fear. You will be the first to know what this information reveals.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm always up for a little B and E.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Let me know what you learn.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After breaking into the informant's house in Thermock Hold, you located a data terminal filled with compromising information. The Dominion attacked you in an attempt to foil the investigation, but you defeated them and returned the data to Avra Darkos. The information you collected should shed more light on the double agent's identity.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you know about the informant?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Only what my agents have drawn from them. Their methods, while unpleasant, are nonetheless effective.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Evidence of iniquity. Traces of treachery. Such things might be found in a coded chronicle or a data terminal. If they are there, you will unearth them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I shall add a notation to your file referencing your lack of loyalty.

localizedTextIdText: After analyzing the data you collected from the informant's data terminal, Avra Darkos has revealed a secret meeting was arranged between the informant and the double agent. Locate and follow the clues to unmask the traitor, but remember - time is of the essence.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've decrypted the data. The double agent has arranged a meeting with the informant outside Thermock Hold. You must be at that meeting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The enemy's location still remains a mystery, while your lack of initiative continues to be disappointing. Locate the meeting place at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent deductive work, Agent $(player.name). Now... we lie in wait for our quarry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The clues left by our enemy will appear innocuous so as not to attract attention.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be patient. The time to strike is close at hand.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: It's our turn to deal the cards.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed a number of innocuous clues through the wilds of Whitevale and eventually located the secret meeting place. The double agent's hours are numbered!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you turn your back on us now, you will never be forgiven.

localizedTextIdText: You discovered the location outside of Whitevale where the double agent was to meet with their informant. Avra Darkos has instructed you to enter the secret meeting location, expose the double agent, and eliminate him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The meeting location should be up those stairs in a nearby clearing. Make your way to the clearing, expose the double agent, and deal with him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you think the double agent will continue to wait at the meeting place for you to arrive and execute him? I think not.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did well to punish both Zero and Lazilo for their treachery. You had best search the area for clues that will reveal their motives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect you will teach this double agent a fatal lesson in accountability.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Even the smallest obfuscation may lead to an important discovery.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In a surprising turn of events, both Agent Lazilo and Agent Zero were revealed to be double agents! Despite their best efforts to silence you, you easily dispatched the two traitors!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you gone soft? Is the life of a traitor worth more than your own?

localizedTextIdText: The Tradeskill Hub Operations Relay describes the role of Brackworks in Exile pioneering and supply efforts and explains why a relationship with Brackworks would be beneficial to weaponsmiths.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Procurer Dunpepper regarding reputation with Brackworks Weapon Systems.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tutorial: Brackworks is an Exile exclusive company that supplies the majority of weapons to our forces. Building reputation is important for weaponsmiths.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A new member of the happy Brackworks family. Don't forget to talk to Ms. Strideward - she'll give you access to the Brackworks surplus inventory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Directive: Ms. Dunpepper detected. She can relay Brackworks information.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Procurer Dunpepper about building reputation with Brackworks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Interrupting protocol. Returning to main menu.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen has instructed you to start taking work orders. Find the Work Order Board in Gallow. The work orders it offers will reward you with crafting vouchers and crafting experience.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Examine the Work Order Board in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: People count on us to get them what they need. When they put out a work order, it better get done. Are you ready?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go check out the Work Order Board. It's full of vital jobs that need doing! It's right nearby, what are you waiting for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: NOTICE: Those who fulfill Work Orders will be rewarded with crafting vouchers and experience. These supplies are critical to our continued survival on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll get experience and crafting vouchers, which can be spent on useful craft stuff!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Work Order Board and learned how filling work orders can help your fellow Exiles on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you let me down now?

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Zeke tank is immobilized by honey outside East Gate, and aggravated Honeystrike buzzbings are swarming the vehicle. He needs help freeing the tank from the honey so he can reach his post at the top of the hill.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Zeke via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello? I've got a, er... sticky situation. I lost control of my tank and, well... can you lend me a hand? The buzzbings are startin' to worry me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I really appreciate the help. Just clear the honey out of my intakes, and I'll be on my way.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I really appreciate the help. Just clear the honey out of my intakes, and I'll be on my way.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks a bunch for helpin' me out of there. One last thing, though... don't mention this to Commander Kriton? Please?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Clear the honey away from my intakes, but watch out for the buzzbings.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Great. Thanks again!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Corporal Zeke, and his tank is now free of the buzzbings and their honey.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine, fine, have it your way. At least I'm safe in here... I think.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos has sent you to speak with one of her operatives, a Black Hoods alchemist by the name of Alchemist Vikmos, in the Aurin camp ground at Snowfade Grounds. She would like you to follow up on a project that may or may not be related to recent Dominion activity in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Alchemist Vikmos in the Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that we've resolved our Freebot problem, there's something I need you to check on for me at Snowfade Grounds. Speak with Vikmos, my agent there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Vikmos is a brilliant alchemist, although conversation with him requires patience. You'll find him at the Aurin camp of Snowfade Grounds.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, yes... the matter of the curious plant. There have been certain... incidents that have caused me to notice this unique... plant.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Dominion is devising a deadly plot. Vikmos can illuminate the issue.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us get to work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Alchemist Vikmos regarding a strange plant that, for whatever reason, has caught the attention of the Black Hoods spymistress.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall go see this Vikmos.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You should know, I can be deadly in my disappointment.

localizedTextIdText: Now that you've infiltrated Junction Snowshadow, Avra Darkos has instructed you to kill Snowshadow Scientist. In addition, she has asked you to sabotage the toxin flow control panels in order to trigger fatal accidents.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The enemy plans to use blimps to drop their poisons on Thermock Hold. Target the Chua scientists in the area, then sabotage the toxin flow controls.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sabotage the toxin flow control panels and kill any of the ICI scientists that stand in your way. We only have one shot at this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A fine job indeed, $(player.name). I love watching you work. It is obvious you relish the Dominion's suffering as much as I do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure the already unsafe working conditions are even more dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your liquidation of Snowshadow Scientist and sabotage of toxin flow control panels, Junction Snowshadow's effectiveness has been greatly reduced. It looks like the ICI won't be dropping poison on Thermock Hold any time soon!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You disappoint me.

localizedTextIdText: With your help, the Black Hoods are ready to make their move against the ICI and infiltrate their mountain base. Avra Darkos has given you orders to board the chopper at the Thermock Hold Landing Pad and travel to Junction Snowshadow. You'll report to her once you've landed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Avra Darkos in Junction Snowshadow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've located the ICI base high up in the mountains of Whitevale. Board the chopper at Thermock Hold when you are ready for revenge.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are your preparations complete? The chopper is waiting for you in Thermock Hold. The ICI must pay for their poisonous plans.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are your preparations complete? The chopper is waiting for you in Thermock Hold. The ICI must pay for their poisonous plans.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see you've come well-prepared. This will be a joint effort, as I will be directly coordinating our efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The time has come to reveal ourselves with a swift strike against our foes.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your mission is to deliver death and destruction to the enemy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully infiltrated Junction Snowshadow by air and have reported in to Avra Darkos.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not make me regret choosing you for this task, $(player.class).

localizedTextIdText: SAvra Darkos has instructed you to move into the Junction Snowshadow caves. Once there, kill the Dominion who are interrogating Exile prisoners.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many captured Exiles are being interrogated by the ICI in a nearby underground complex. Kill the interrogators before they can finish their work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must return to the ICI complex and put the enemy's interrogators to the blade. They have harmed our people, and they may know many of our secrets.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your quick actions have ensured that valuable intelligence remains out of the Dominion's hands. Good work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not allow our people to be compromised further by the enemy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I don't think they liked my answers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed many of the ICI's interrogation corps before they could extract valuable information from their Exile prisoners.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would leave our people to the tender mercies of the ICI's interrogators?

localizedTextIdText: With the ICI in disarray, Avra Darkos has directed you to head to the upper level of the Junction Snowshadow caves and eliminate the ICI's weapons experts - cannoneers, saboteurs, and grenadiers. In addition, you are to plant explosives at designated locations throughout the caves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You're doing well and making good time. Head to the upper levels of the ICI cave complex, plant explosives there, and kill their assault personnel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without their weapons experts, the ICI will be unable to mount any kind of tangible assault on Thermock Hold. Kill them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The explosives will detonate when you have reached a safe distance. If only I had an entire cadre of agents with your extraordinary capabilities!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now is the time to cut the ICI's claws here in Whitevale!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You laid waste to Junction Snowshadow, planting explosives on the upper levels of the Snowshadow cave compound while killing Dominion agents along the way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't act the fool, $(player.name). Now is not the time to betray my trust.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos has ordered you to take the Vind Gas Bag from Axis Venin - known as "the Snake" - inside the Snowshadow cave compound. Every ICI junction features an Info Column in a secure location, and it is more than likely that the Snake will be in close proximity to it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Axis Venin, known as "the Snake," is the ICI leader in Junction Snowshadow. He holds the access code to the Infocolumn, and I want it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Axis Venin should be near Junction Snowshadow's Infocolumn. Find him and terminate him with extreme prejudice!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Junction Snowshadow is as good as destroyed without its Axis. Despite this, there is still one more thing for you to accomplish before you can come home...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Every junction has an Infocolumn in a secure location. Look for Venin there.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The code is as good as yours.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Axis Venin in a secret back room bunker and relieved him of his Vind Gas Bag. You are nearly done, but Avra Darkos has one more task for you to complete.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do they call him "the Snake"?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Axis Venin is a monster who enjoys employing poisons. He feels they are the most efficient tools for dispatching large numbers of the enemy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you afraid of serpents? Why else would you eschew this last objective?

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos has instructed you to access the Snowshadow Info Column and download its data using the code you retrieved from Axis Venin - 6468. Once this is done, escape from Junction Snowshadow through the rear exit, return to Thermock Hold, and check in with Special Agent Boyd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Avra Darkos in her Secret Hideout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that Venin is disposed of, use his code to access the ICI Infocolumn. Retrieve whatever information you can, then escape through the rear exit.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Do not leave Junction Snowshadow until you have deprived the ICI of their data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to claim the ICI's data from the Snowshadow Infocolumn. Until this has been done, I have nothing to say to you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are a fine agent, $(player.name). Perhaps one of the finest I have ever worked with. The Black Hoods are in your debt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Agent Hawke will be waiting for you outside.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A day may come when I require your assistance once more. Be ready.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After relieving the ICI in Junction Showshadow of their Snowshadow Info Column data, you escaped back to Thermock Hold. Avra Darkos was pleased to see you and thanked you for your contribution to the ongoing struggle against the Dominion's spymasters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now is not the time for such dubious humor, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Matria Paleblossom would like you to speak with her watchers and naturalists to find out what they've learned from observing the forests of Whitevale. You should be able to find them patrolling the frozen wilderness near Snowfade Grounds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Matria Paleblossom in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If we are to save the forest, you must first speak with my watchers and naturalists. They might have a better idea of what is wrong.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My watchers and naturalists should still be out in the field. Have you spoken with them yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Creating protective wards will be difficult, and will take most of my strength. But with the land struggling to cope with the cold this might be our best solution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck, $(player.name). I'll be rooting for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I believe there's a way to ward the Elder Tree saplings.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Matria Paleblossom request, you spoke with the watchers and naturalists in the area, who believe that the sudden climate change in Whitevale is what's causing problems in the local ecosystem. They suggest you speak with Matria Paleblossom regarding protective wards for the Elder Trees to safeguard them from the fluctuating climate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider, we need your help.

localizedTextIdText: To help the struggling forests of Whitevale, Matria Paleblossom has asked you to place wards over Elder Tree saplings. These can be found growing near clusters of trees in the fields near Snowfade Grounds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Matria Paleblossom in the Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've made special wards for the Elder Tree saplings, to help ease their adaptation to the cold. Place them on the other sprouts, just like the one here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for other Elder Tree saplings and place the wards I've made near them. It's not a perfect solution, but it will have to do for now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done it! But I'm afraid it's not quite over yet. You've got one last ward you need to place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You've proven you are a true friend of the forest.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following Matria Paleblossom directions, you placed protective wards around the struggling tree sprouts in Whitevale. Thanks to you, the forests of Whitevale should be able to survive this cold spell.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is there anything I can say that will change your mind?

localizedTextIdText: Matria Paleblossom in the Snowfade Grounds has asked you to seek out the Wise One of Whitevale, an elder tree of the forest. Find it by following its musical voice towards Thermock Lake and place a special ward to protect it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Matria Paleblossom via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Wise Ones are the oldest trees on Nexus, but there is only one left in all of Whitevale. Follow its voice and place a ward around it before it's too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Follow the musical voice of the Wise One, it will lead you to it. Be careful though, the cold has brought out the more savage creatures of Whitevale.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done a great thing for the forests of Whitevale. A friend of the forest is always welcome amongst the Aurin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can use my bond with the forest to allow you to hear its voice, but you must hurry!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Wise One thanks you for saving its life and sends its blessing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed the musical voice of the Wise One the shores of Thermock Lake. After defeating the ice gronyx blocking your path, you placed down a protective ward to protect the Wise One of Whitevale from further harm.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me about the Wise Ones.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How is it you can speak with the Wise Ones?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Wise Ones are the oldest trees in all of the forest. They have gained much knowledge and seen many things, though it's difficult for them to express these in terms we can understand.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Even I don't "speak" with the Wise Ones so much as I sense things through them - impressions, vivid splashes of color, sometimes just emotions. Every matria is able to commune with the forest in some way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But we've come so far! You can't give up now!

localizedTextIdText: Pilot Byrdson has asked you to collect $m(vitem=61) from the walatusks in Frostdawn Bay. According to Byrdson, $m(vitem=61) are rich in nutrients and should help the crash victims survive their ordeal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Rescued Crewman{p:Rescued Crewmen} near the Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We ain't got no food. Everything went up in the ship crash. I saw some walatusks down by the bay, though, and their livers are good eatin'.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Quit messin' around! I can't do a blasted thing with these injuries, and these guys need some food before they get desperate!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Howdy. Nice weather we're havin', eh?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Byrdson...? Oh... yeah. He didn't make it. Sorry! But all that liver will come in handy once we get hungry again. So... thanks a lot!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do me a favor and hurry it up... I don't like how these guys are lookin' at me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What're you lookin' at me like that for? Knock it off.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll hunt walatusks for their livers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned to the crash survivors with enough $m(vitem=61) to feed an army, but Pilot Byrdson was nowhere to be found. You find his disappearance somewhat suspicious, especially considering how full and content the crash survivors appear to be.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Rescued Crewman{p:Rescued Crewmen}
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Say what you want, but they singled 'em out in survival trainin'. They're full of nutrients and will give us the energy we need to make it to Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, man... you've got to be kiddin' me...!

localizedTextIdText: You've arrived in Thermock Hold, only to find the town in a state of unrest. You've been directed to talk with Brewmaster Grok over at the Last Man Standing - he might have work for you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to Thermock Hold, stranger. You sure picked a bad time to show up. Check in with Grok over at the Last Man Standing, he'll fill you in.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Last Man Standing is on the lowest level of Thermock. You can't miss the sign. Be sure to talk to Grok when you get there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you're the new guy in town, huh? Boy, have I got some fun in store for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Supplies are runnin' low, fights have been breakin' out...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I heard you need a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Last Man Standing. After all, how could you miss the sign? Brewmaster Grok looks like he has his hands full, as the bar is full of rowdy drunks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself.

localizedTextIdText: Chua sappers have moved into the area around Tempest Refuge and are attempting to destroy the makeshift barricades that block the town's entrances. Check with Scout Cooper, at the Tempest Refuge Outer Wall, and see what must be done.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mayor Crofton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've got barricades at the town gates, but the Chua are workin' hard to knock 'em down. Go see if Cooper needs any help at the town gate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Scout Cooper's outside the gate. He can tell you where you're needed most.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're well on your way to earnin' the key to the town, stranger, but there's still more that needs doin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's only a matter of time before those rodents bust in here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed many of the Chua attacking the barricades, but it appears that something much, much worse has taken place inside Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Think it over, will you? We don't have much time.

localizedTextIdText: Brewmaster Krazog at the Gas 'n' Guzzle wants you to help him collect ingredients for his specialty beer - Gutpunch Brew! You'll need to collect $(vitem=258) from Ringtail razortails, $m(vitem=259) from Whitespring spikehordes, and fresh water from Frostdawn Bay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Brewmaster Krazog at the Gas 'n' Guzzle
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: How'd ya like to be part of an excitin', experimental, brewin' adventure? I just need you to get me a few more ingredients for my Gutpunch Brew...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya got what I need yet? The ingredients, ya know... for the Gutpunch Brew. Ain't ya never been told not to keep an artist waitin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I just need to simmer the gut linin' a lil' bit more... oh! You're a real pal! I'm givin' ya some of my reserve Gutpunch Brew to say thanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Real brewin' is all about experimentin'... and gettin' drunk. Mostly gettin' drunk.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Some advice - ya drink that stuff, stay away from mirrors. Just sayin'.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the ingredients that Brewmaster Krazog needed to create his Gutpunch Brew, and he rewarded you with a taste of it. Be sure to drink it very carefully... and stay away from mirrors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's the strongest beer ya ever had. Drinkin' a mug of Gutpunch is like gettin' punched in the gut by an angry gorganoth, only it makes ya really drunk.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Frozen Rockfruit, for one. Thawed don't work. Then there's humours taken from Whitespring spikehordes. And, of course, fresh water from Frostdawn Bay!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't wanna help get the ingredients for Gutpunch Brew? Fine. You don't get none.

localizedTextIdText: Brewmaster Krazog wants you to deliver a sample of his Gutpunch Brew to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing in Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the Gutpunch Brew to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that my Gutpunch is done, I gotta show it off a little bit! You there... take a growler of Gutpunch to Grok and see what he thinks!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: So? What'd Grok think? He's at the Last Man Standin', in Thermock. Get movin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can I help you with somethin', pal?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's this crap? More 'experimentation' from Krazog? Here, hold this bucket for me. I needed one the last time I tried one of his brews.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stones, Grok's gonna be impressed this time! You'll see!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Wow! That's fantastic! He's finally gettin' it! I'll hafta start servin' this stuff here!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll deliver your brew to Grok.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered a sample of Brewmaster Krazog Gutpunch Brew to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing in Thermock Hold. Despite Grok's misgivings, he declared Krazog's Gutpunch Brew to be incredible!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll deliver your brew to Grok.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the Gutpunch Brew to Brewmaster Grok
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought ya was useful.

localizedTextIdText: Mechanic Anxa tools and hoverbike parts have been scattered around the Gas 'n' Guzzle by hostile Freebots. She's asked you to help recover her tools and parts so that she can do her job.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mechanic Anxa at the Gas 'n' Guzzle
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those damned Freebots've scattered my parts and tools all 'round the Gas 'n' Guzzle. I need that stuff to do my job! Think you can help me out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look all around the Gas 'n' Guzzle for hoverbike parts and tools. Just watch out for those crazy bots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for helpin' me out. Maybe now I can get these hoverbikes fixed before the Commander puts my butt in a sling.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks! If I don't get these bikes fixed soon, Raxen's gonna have a seizure!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not so fast, chum! I got an idea...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assisted Mechanic Anxa recover her tools and hoverbike parts so that she can get around to repairing the vehicles at the Gas 'n' Guzzle.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Name's Anxa. I'm the one who's supposed to keep these hoverbikes workin', but the Freebots have thrown a wrench into my gears... so to speak.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: What do you think happened to 'em? The Freebots happened, that's what! Used to be you could trust the Freebots. I'm not so sure anymore.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're a real humanitarian, pal. That's sarcasm, in case you couldn't figure it out.

localizedTextIdText: Since the Freebots started attacking the Gas 'n' Guzzle, Mechanic Anxa is way behind on getting Raxen's hoverbikes repaired. She's asked you to give her a hand fixing some damaged bikes. How hard can it be?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mechanic Anxa at the Gas 'n' Guzzle
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm on a tight schedule, thanks to those crazy Freebots. How're you with a sprocket wrench? Care to try your hand at fixin' some bikes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How're them bikes comin' along? I hope you're not afraid of gettin' grease on those soft hands of yours.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finally! All the bikes are in workin' order! This should get Raxen off my case for a while... at least until those Freebots show up again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It ain't rocket science, and it's gotta get done before Raxen has kittens.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks again, pal. I owe you big time! How'd you like free rides from here to Thermock?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I'll help you fix bikes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You pitched in and helped Mechanic Anxa with her hoverbike repairs. In exchange, she's offered to give you free rides between the Gas 'n' Guzzle and Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't want to help? Fine. If you change your mind, though, I'm happy to train you.

localizedTextIdText: Cordelia Bronson, Daniel Bronson wife, must be told about her husband's death. See if you can break the news to her... gently.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Cordelia Bronson in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You're the one who convinced my Daniel to join FCON, aren't you? What do you want?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Daniel... is dead? No! It can't be! He... he promised me he'd be home for supper! How... how could you?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Daniel... he's been killed in action.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You broke the news of Daniel's death to Cordelia Bronson. She was understandably upset by the revelation.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Alemar order of Grismaran Fine Rum is missing. Take the skyboat to Smuggler Razok ship, which hovers above Thermock Lake, and recover Alemar's rum.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Give the Grismaran Fine Rum to Bartender Alemar at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This empty crate once held Bartender Alemar's rare and expensive rum. Smuggler Razok probably has it under lock and key aboard his ship.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Alemar's rum isn't going to magically appear in the empty crate. You should take a skyboat to the smuggler's ship and recover it for him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I won't ever deal with smugglers again, no sir. It might've been fine rum, but it's hardly worth the price I paid considering I never got it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have my Grismaran rum? How...? Oh, never mind! I'm happy to have it back, understand? You've done me a great favor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can wait here for a skyboat to take you to the smuggler's ship above Thermock Lake.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I owe you big, chum! You bet I do!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll bet I can find that rum.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered Bartender Alemar Grismaran Fine Rum from Smuggler Razok and brought it back to him at The Last Man Standing.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll bet I can find that rum.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Give the Grismaran Fine Rum to Bartender Alemar

localizedTextIdText: Mayor Crofton has asked you to go check on Windward Notch, a small settlement on the other side of Mount Tempest. They haven't been heard from in some time, and given the state of current events, the mayor is concerned.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mayor Crofton in Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that things have settled down, I'm worried about the folks on the other side of the mountain. Do you mind seein' if they're okay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you check on the folks of Windward Notch yet? We ain't heard from 'em in a mighty long time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those Dominion bastards! Those were people's homes... people's lives! But the Dominion don't care!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's a path 'round back of our Chronicle House that'll get you there easier. Good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The lives lost can't never be replaced. Dammit!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sorry I couldn't do more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Windward Notch has been completely ransacked, but the Dominion looters that remained were dispatched easily enough.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're puttin' me on, right? Right?

localizedTextIdText: Jed Nibben is concerned about ravenok preying on his roan herd. He's asked you to hunt and kill any Razorbeak ravenok you find in the vicinity of Nibben's Ranch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Jed Nibben via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ravenok - we call 'em 'razorbeaks' - have been gettin' pretty gutsy. They've been goin' after my roan, and I can't have that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You hunt down any of them ravenok yet? You need to show 'em who's boss.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You took care of my ravenok problem, eh? I don't know what I'd've done if you hadn't come along when you did. I can't hardly thank you enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A flock of ravenok can strip a roan down to the bone in less than a minute!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of the ravenok.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to kill a number of Razorbeak ravenok in the vicinity of Nibben's Ranch, ensuring that Jed's roan will be safe... for the time being.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the ravenok.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Them birds are mean, but I reckon $i(player.class) like you can handle 'em.

localizedTextIdText: Kanok the Giant Slayer has posted an ad on the Bounty Board in Thermock Hold. He's spotted a giant outside Thermock Hold, and he's willing to handsomely reward anyone who dares to kill the beast.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kanok the Giant Slayer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: HELP WANTED\nI, Kanok the Giant Slayer, have heard about a giant outside Thermock Hold. Anyone who helps kill the beast will be rewarded handsomely.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: HELP WANTED\nI, Kanok the Giant Slayer, have heard about a giant outside Thermock Hold. Anyone who helps kill the beast will be rewarded handsomely.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya killed that giant yet? Any infant could do it, so what's holdin' ya back? Ya scared? Bawk... bawk...!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's about time! Here's yer money, bub. Now... if anyone asks ya, I was the one who killed that giant, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's a little somethin' extra. Remember - ix-nay on the iant-jay. Tell 'em I did it!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: A giant? Whatever! I can take it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Hagus the Colossus and reported your success to Kanok the Giant Slayer. Kanok paid you well for the deed - as well as for your silence. It seems that he would like folks to think he did the giant-slaying, rather than you.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: A giant? Whatever! I can take it.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I ain't afraid of no giant.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Kanok the Giant Slayer

localizedTextIdText: According to Regulator Codec, there was an explosion near Locus Dawn just prior to the Freebots going crazy. He's asked you to investigate the cause of the explosion, as it may shed some light on what has turned the normally-peaceful Freebots into homicidal killing machines.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Regulator Codec via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There was an explosion just prior to the manifestation of my brother Freebots' insanity. Perhaps an investigation of this explosion would be prudent?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The explosion occurred not far from Locus Dawn. The Freebots sent to investigate it failed to return. I am unsure why I did not consider this earlier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Mechari who was overseeing my enslaved brothers can only indicate one thing. The Dominion must be involved somehow. Most distressing!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I predict there is a 96% chance you will find information relevant to our current crisis.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: To be honest, I had no great opinion about them until today.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure thing, Codec. I'll check it out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The Dominion... I hate those guys.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While investigating a mysterious explosion that took place just prior to the Freebots of Locus Dawn going crazy, you discovered a starship crash in the snow. More importantly, you discovered - and destroyed - a Mechari who seemed to be controlling the nearby Freebots.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I understand your trepidation, but if anyone can find out the truth, it is you.

localizedTextIdText: A group of Aurin, led by Matria Paleblossom, have set up camp to the south in Snowfade Grounds. Speak with Matria Paleblossom to find out why she and her followers have come to Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Matria Paleblossom in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have you come to help us? Will you listen to the story of Whitevale's forests?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The kindness of your sympathetic heart has given me renewed strength. I must consider what to do next.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's a rare person who will open their hearts to the forest.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There are others in our camp who require aid. Could you speak with them?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Matria Paleblossom of Snowfade Grounds was very upset over the plight of the Whitevale forests. You lent a sympathetic ear and made a connection with the Elder Tree in the Aurin grounds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I didn't think people could be so uncaring.

localizedTextIdText: You've helped out the Aurin ofSnowfade Grounds with various requests, and now Matria Paleblossom is ready to speak with you again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Matria Paleblossom in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thanks again for all your help, $(player.class). It looks like Matria Paleblossom is ready to speak with you again. Do you mind stopping by?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: After conferring with the dying forest of Whitevale, I feel that you're the one to help us with this task.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: She's waiting for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are going to save the Elder Trees of Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Matria Paleblossom. She is determined to save the forests of Whitevale and has asked for your help with this monumental task.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What could be more important than this?

localizedTextIdText: Agent Ostrow has directed you to scout the Crimson Base of Operations and intercept their satellite transmissions. Find their communications satellite transmitter and hack into it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Ostrow via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We believe the Dominion's operational headquarters is nearby. Gain access, locate their comm hub, and hack into their transmitter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your assignment is incomplete. Locate the Dominion comm hub in their headquarters and hack into their transmitter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It appears this base is considered a crucial control point for the Focus of Air... crucial enough they're willing to risk open war with us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Information is power. Never forget that.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They believe the Focus to be of military importance. We should, too.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get you the info you need.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully hacked into the Crimson Base of Operation's communications and intercepted important enemy transmissions indicating the tactical importance of their current location.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get you the info you need.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This decision reflects poorly on your dedication.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Ostrow has directed you to scout out the Crimson Legion's Fuelfuze Depot. She's asked you to locate the communications satellite transmitter and see if you can hack in to intercept any important calls.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Ostrow via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Crimson Legion's Fuelfuze Depot supplies most Dominion military operations in Galeras. Gain entry, then hack their communications satellite transmitter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Preliminary reports indicate the Dominion's satellite transmitter should be somewhere in the fuel depot. Locate it and hack your way in.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very well done, my friend. I find your results to be most fortunate, under the circumstances. Are you prepared for additional action?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With the proper effort, I'm certain we can learn something useful there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully scouted the Crimson Legion's Fuelfuze Depot and located the enemy's satellite transmitter, intercepting a call from Kezrek Warbringer - the commander of the entire Dominion military!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought we were going to have a beautiful friendship...

localizedTextIdText: Agent Ostrow wants you to investigate Noxbane Prison Camp, past the Crimson Legion Central Base. Once you're in, locate their communications satellite transmitter and hack it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Ostrow via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI are running a nearby prison camp. Rumor has it prisoners are being tortured and experimented on. You must verify these claims at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We cannot allow our personnel to be tortured and terminated by the Dominion. If this is taking place, we must know for certain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The rumors are true. Who knows what other dark deeds the ICI has perpetrated? We cannot stand idly by.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lives may be hanging in the balance. Quickly now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must do something to stop these atrocities.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've found the satellite hub in the ICI's Noxbane Prison Camp and hacked into the Dominion communications network, learning some disturbing news in the process. Apparently, the ICI have been torturing prisoners to death as part of their interrogation procedures.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you refusing to do your duty? Such decisions are not healthy ones.

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Gallow heard of your recent pursuit of weaponsmithing. He wants you to demonstrate your crafting skills so he can evaluate your progress. Naturally, you accepted his challenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nHowdy! Crafting Trainer Thorpe here! Seems like there's a lot of new weaponsmiths here. I've got a little job to see how you pioneers are comin' along.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nHowdy! Crafting Trainer Thorpe here! Seems like there's a lot of new weaponsmiths here. I've got a little job to see how you new folk are comin' along.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be! Not a bad start! Sure, yer still wet behind the ears, but yer off to a great start!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's good to see initiative in newcomers!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should give this a shot!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe was pleased to see that you'd accomplished a basic proficiency in weapons crafting. Your success proves that you have what it takes to pursue your craft further.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: While scouting the Crimson Legion's Fuelfuze Depot, you observed a number of fuel cells that are used to supply all of the Dominion vehicles in Galeras. Sergeant Kara has asked you to disable them, but to be wary of their security system.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Sergeant Kara via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got an idea. See if you can sabotage the Dominion fuel cells. But be careful. I bet they've got some downright nasty security measures in place!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are you gonna disable those fuel cells or what, Soldier? Don't make me go down there and show you how.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gonna disable those fuel cells or what, Soldier? Don't make me go down there and show you how.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A giant killer securitybot, eh? Sneaky bastards, those Dommies. It figures they'd have something like that up their sleeve.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This should stop the Crimson Legion right in their tracks.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You showed that bot who's boss, $(player.name). Good job.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tried to sabotage their fuel tanks, but accidentally tripped the security system. You were forced to fight the Crimson Legion Security Warbot, but defeated it and gained access to the depot's Security Station. Now you have the proper access clearance to try again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't like bein' disappointed. Just ask the Commander.

localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Gallow have been under attack by hostile factions, and the militia is in dire need of weapons. Acquire some weapons and deliver them to one of the local Logistics Officers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to one of the FCON Logistics Officers in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gonna get those weapons, or what? If I wait much longer, I'm gonna grow moss.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's that you got there? Weapons? Hell yea! I'll get these to front lines pronto. Man, you're rock solid, you know that?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Every gun counts on this hunk of rock. We owe ya one!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope they help you out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your handiwork, the local militia has its supplies. The officer you delivered them to was impressed with the quality and grateful to have more weaponry.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to one of the Gallow Logistics Officers

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills has asked you to deliver packages in the Academy Corner and FCON Headquarters areas of Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Coordinator Mills via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With the war goin' on, every shipment in Galeras is gettin' routed through Thayd. Mind helpin' me deliver some of the high priority packages?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those packages are destined for different locations all over Thayd. It's a real challenge gettin' everythin' where it needs to go.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for your help. To tell you the truth, these old ruins give me the creeps. I'll be glad to move on from here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't drop any of 'em, please. This stuff's fragile.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yeah, it's a bit weird here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered all of Coordinator Millss packages to the various districts of Thayd.

localizedTextIdText: While smashing them to bits near the Crash Site, you noticed that Crimson Spiderbot and Crimson Clanker have easily removable data caches. Surely someone will be able to find a use for any $m(vitem=283) you can collect.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mesmer Radu via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion bots, once smashed into bits, have easily removable data caches. Someone might be able to glean some intel from them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This bot's data cache has been removed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You possess data from the Dominion bots, do you? Amass additional data and I may reward you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Black Hoods desire the data you have obtained from the enemy's bots. Give it to me and I will ensure it is put to good use.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Black Hoods will remember your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a number of $m(vitem=283) from Crimson Spiderbot and Crimson Clanker, and were contacted by a member of the Black Hoods named Mesmer Radu who downloaded the data from your datachron.

localizedTextIdText: Sera Melfield in Thayd has asked you to collect flying whimfibers for her by leaping through them. Once you collect enough of them, you are to contact her with your whimfiber data.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Call Sera Melfield and transmit the Whimfiber data
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you're leaving Thayd, maybe you could help me. I'd love to get data pertaining to whimfiber specimens, but I can't leave the city.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you collected the whimfibers for my research? All you have to do is jump through them. It's easy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The data you've got shows that the whimwood trees generate their own air currents. That's why the fibers fly like they do. Wow!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will? Oh, that's so amazingly nice of you! You're the best!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I never, ever would have collected the data without you, my dearest friend!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help you collect the data.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've transmitted the valuable whimfiber data you collected to Sera Melfield, and she was quite pleased with it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why can't you collect it yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a fiber produced by the whimwood tree. The behavior of whimfibers, especially in this gusty landscape, is really quite interesting!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, I wish I could! The XAS stationed me here in Thayd, and I can't leave until my assignment is complete. It's so boring here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you? Hmmph!

localizedTextIdText: Collect $m(vitem=394) around the East Wall of Kriton's Command Post and return it to Supply Sergeant Cinderfall. $m(vitem=394) can be looted from Dominion troops, or found in Ammo Crate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Supply Sergeant Cinderfall at the East Wall of Kriton's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're going to need more ammo, and fast! Could you check the old bulwark? I'll bet the Dominion troops are carrying some, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The bulwark's near here - you can't miss it! It won't look like much, just a bunch of metal walls, but we've got ammo stashed there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the ammo you picked up, we'll be able to hold the Dommies off for quite a while!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make it quick! If we run out of ammo, we're all going to feel the sting!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=394) for Exile troops at Kriton's Command Post.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Man! What a jerk!

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a parcel of secret plans detailing the Crimson Legion's activity in Galeras.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The diversionary action in Thayd proceeds according to plan. The Crimson Legion can easily keep the forces in Thayd occupied until further notice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Exile resistance is organized, but futile. Their pride in Thayd will keep them blind to our true purposes in Galeras.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: According to the secret plans you found, the attacks on Thayd are a distraction on the part of the Crimson Legion... but a distraction from what?

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a parcel of secret plans detailing the Chua offensive against Tempest Refuge in Galeras.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Migo and Mogi have been deployed to Tempest Refuge with their latest invention. It is only a matter of time before Tempest Refuge is destroyed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: According to the secret plans you found, the Chua are planning to obliterate Tempest Refuge... but how?

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered secret Dominion plans detailing the use of deadly poison bombs to disrupt the Exile supply chain, starting with Nibben's Ranch.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nibben's Ranch is a rich source of Exile crops. By using toxic bombs to deny the Exiles access to their harvest, we can disrupt their supply lines...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've discovered secret Dominion plans detailing the use of deadly poison bombs to disrupt the Exile supply chain, starting with Nibben's Ranch.

localizedTextIdText: Tempest Refuge is under siege by the Dominion. Mayor Crofton wants the citizens to evacuate to the town's Chronicle House. Locate Tempest Refuge civilians and send them to the Chronicle House.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mayor Crofton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The townsfolk are scared. Can you blame 'em? We need to get 'em to the safety of the Chronicle House. Think you can spread the word?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yell at 'em if you need to, but make sure my citizens get their behinds to the Chronicle House before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks, stranger. You got folks to the Chronicle House in short order.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find my people, get their attention, and send 'em to the Chronicle House.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next, we need to see to the town's defenses.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I've told everyone to seek shelter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your efforts, the citizens of Tempest Refuge are safe in the town's Chronicle House.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why'd you come all this way if you're not going to help?

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade offers crafters work orders, which instruct them to craft items to supply the Granok Free Companies. You accepted the task to deliver weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed. Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gonna get me that weapon, or you just gonna stand there, lettin' the grass grow under yer feet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: 'Bout time you showed up! Lemme take a good look... yup, this oughtta do nicely! Much appreciated, friend! I'll make sure it's put to good use!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You did a good thing today! You know that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You did your part for the Free Companies and delivered weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper. She seemed impressed with your craftsmanship, promising to put the weapons to good use. You took that to mean "blow up a few Imperial heads."
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper
