localizedTextIdText: Chronicler Herrick Grenfell suggested you be the one to put in a call to Judge Kain. Gallow needs help, but any locals who try to contact a judge will see their families suffer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Use the Holographic Data Transmitter to contact Judge Kain in the Gallow Chronicle House
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Scuttlebutt says that Judge Kain landed outside of town. I'm sure he'll help us, but you need to contact him usin' our holographic transmitter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? Use the holographic data transmitter and put in a call to Judge Kain. He never backs down from a fight. Never!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: INITIATING COMMUNICATION.\nPlease wait... signal acquired.\nReal-time synchronization achieved. You may proceed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Tell him of our troubles. Kain will put all this to rights!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I need to talk to Judge Kain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully made contact with Judge Kain via a Holographic Data Transmitter in the Gallow Chronicle House.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: He's one of the judges. He never backs down from a fight, and he always sees justice done. I know he'll help us! I just know it!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I got me a family. If the Cartel finds out I contacted a judge for help... well, there's no tellin' what they'll do to my wife and kids.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We're doomed, then... all of us!

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Thayd lists a work order request for weapons crafted from local titanium to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their titanium weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the titanium weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for weapons crafted from local titanium to support the war against the Dominion. Bring weapons to Work Order Board in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for weapons crafted from local titanium to support the war against the Dominion. Bring weapons to Work Order Board in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you'd like to help out the troops, you'll need to craft me some weapons made from titanium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at this handiwork. Not bad... not bad at all. I suppose you might have what it takes to make weapons for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't thank me just yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee has accepted the titanium weapons you crafted with grudging approval.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the titanium weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills has put out a call for help in relieving the Exile supply shortage in Galeras. Aid the relief effort by crafting some weapons for Exile forces here in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the weapons to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: With the Dominion on our doorstep, able crafters are needed to relieve supply shortfalls. Please contact Coordinator Mills for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: With the Dominion on our doorstep, able crafters are needed to relieve supply shortfalls. Please contact Coordinator Mills for more information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're runnin' out of almost everythin'! I hope you can help us out before it's too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let me take these off your hands. Every little contribution helps, and I ain't seen someone pitch in like this for a good long while. Thanks!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Couldn't have done it without ya, friend!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy to be a part of this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some weapons for the Exile forces in Thayd and helped with the ongoing relief effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the weapons to Coordinator Mills
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The work order lists weapons as the primary need at the moment. Given the proximity of the Dominion to Thayd, this isn't surprising.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade is offering a contract that will aid in fending off the Dominion. Help the war effort in Thayd by crafting titanium weapons for the Free Companies of Nexus!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft weapons and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft weapons and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we don't get more weapons soon, we'll be in a heap of trouble.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's this? A new weapon? Thanks a bunch! We can't get enough of them right now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done your good deed for the day, sure enough.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some titanium weapons for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivered them to Weaponsmith Dunpepper.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll help the best I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper

localizedTextIdText: Dr. Blackstone camp has been under constant assault by ringtail razortails. After many attempts, he's decided that a scientific solution to the ringtail problem at his camp in Whitevale is impossible. He's asked you to kill as many of the beasts as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dr. Blackstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sometimes, a fella's just gotta admit when he's wrong. And I'm admittin' it now. Those ringtails need to die. How'd you like to kill 'em for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I didn't wanna kill the ringtails... not at first, anyways. But I done the math, see? And the math says they gotta die.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The equation's simple. No razortails around multiplies my productivity by a whole bunch. How's that for mathematics?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks, pal. I'd do it myself, but I got science stuff to take care of.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for killin' them critters. Let the Aurin worry about 'em, I say.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll kill those ringtails, no problem.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Dr. Blackstone by eliminating the ringtail razortails that have been plaguing his camp.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want the ringtails dead?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You're a scientist? But... you're a Granok?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I didn't always want 'em dead. But the critters won't give up! They been swipin' our equipment, our supplies... everything! I'm at the end of my rope here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: So what? You think just 'cause I'm a Granok I ain't got what it takes to be a scientist? Think again, chum. I got brains AND brawn.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't need no degree in biology to see what a slaggin' waste of space you are.

localizedTextIdText: Banther Windtracker has asked you to turn the tables on the Ikthian Dissector at Hydrospine Station in Whitevale and eliminate them before they can harvest more of the area's wildlife.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Banther Windtracker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ikthians are a terrible race with no regard for the sanctity of life or the balance of nature. Drive them back before they do more damage!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ikthian Dissectors are the worst. They cut up any animals they find. It's horrible. I'd target them first, if I were you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hope your actions will protect the wildlife of Whitevale. It's probably only a matter of time before the Ikthians return.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those freaks are cutting up any living thing they can get their fins on!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Aurin drive the Ikthians out of Hydrospine Station, but Banther Windtracker fears it will only be a matter of time before they return to perform more of their grisly experiments.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You've never heard of them? They're a detestable aquatic race that's known for performing horrible experiments on... well... everything.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Vivisections... implantations... mutations... you name it! They see all life forms as subjects for their little fishy lab kits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're scum, you hear me? Scum!

localizedTextIdText: Pilot Byrdson survived a ship crash near Locus Dawn. He's badly injured, and has asked you to return to the crash site and revive any of his crew members that might have survived before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Pilot Byrdson near the Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey... you got to help me, friend. My ship took a hit... 'n' crashed. Then these bots came out of nowhere 'n' attacked us. My crew's still over there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Some of my men made it back here... as you can see. Thanks for patchin' 'em up. We all owe you a lot, friend. Really.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will? Oh, thanks... those guys are like family to me! Send 'em back this way.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I won't forget this.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to save your crew.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though hostile Freebots attempted to bar your way, you managed to revive a number of Pilot Byrdson crew members. The crew members made their way back to Byrdson's location, but they're still in danger...
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll try to save your crew.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself... but I don't think I'm goin' to make it.

localizedTextIdText: Archaeologist Knox has discovered that three additional Pell tomes - the $(vitem=435), the $(vitem=436), and the $(vitem=437) - exist. He's asked you to return to Thundercall Village and recover copies of the other tomes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Archaeologist Knox in the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pell tome you found refers to three other Pell books. If I'm to fully decipher this one, I'll need the others, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's possible a specific caste of Pell, such as those who bind tomes, will possess copies of the other books.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did a great job gettin' me these tomes. Taking a quick glance, I get the impression the Pell have been sacrificin' folks for a long, long time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I figure they're somewhere in Thundercall Village. Watch your back out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now to completely decipher these tomes. That should only take a few weeks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've located copies of the other three Pell tomes for Archaeologist Knox.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find the tomes for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not much of a reader, are you?

localizedTextIdText: "Money Baggs" Tragg, Thermock's premiere loan shark, has asked you to collect money owed to him by Mercenary Runok, a Granok mercenary. Travel to Runok's house, not far from the Last Man Standing in Thermock Hold, and speak with him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to "Money Baggs" Tragg via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a no-good Granok merc name of Runok who owes me a good sum. Pay him a visit on my account, collect the debt, and I'll give ya a cut.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya done good work, pal. Hey, listen... how'd ya like a job? I got openings for folks like you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If ya gotta get rough with Runok or his old lady, feel free. He should know better.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hey, it's yer loss.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived at Mercenary Runok home to collect the debt he owes to "Money Baggs" Tragg, but Runok had been kicked out by his wife, Frega. After searching through Runok's Belongings, you found a sword you could pawn to pay his debts. "Money Baggs" Tragg was quite pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Ya too good for this kind of work? I'll be here if you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: "Money Baggs" Tragg has another job for you. This time, he wants you to collect payment from Ric Longshanks, a gambler with flighty tendencies. He's given you some Gambler's Glue to slow Ric down long enough for you to catch him. Ric can be found outside Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to "Money Baggs" Tragg via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ric Longshanks is bettin' he can outrun his gamblin' debt, so I need ya to step in. Ya might wanna use this. I call it Gambler's Glue... heh.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ha! That'll teach Longshanks to pull a fast one on me. I oughta chop one of his feet off... teach him a lesson, ya know?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ya can find Ric just outside Thermock Hold. He's a fast one, so keep the glue handy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cute, pal. Hey, ya ever need cash, I'll only charge ya eighty percent interest.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I thought you said he was fast?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Ric Longshanks about his debts. Not surprisingly, he took off, but you slowed him down with the Gambler's Glue "Money Baggs" Tragg gave you, caught up to him, and got the money he owed the bookie.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya know where to find me if you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: "Money Baggs" Tragg has asked you to help locate Bernie the Barfly, a client who's fled town to avoid ponying up. Apparently he's hiding out in a cave outside Thermock Hold. Help Tragg collect his money from Bernie.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to "Money Baggs" Tragg at his Gambling Den
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got one more job for ya. I'm tired of footin' Bernie's bar tab. Rumor has it, he's skipped town and is hidin' out in a cave outside of town.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I really should hire ya full time. My customers ain't been this up-to-date on their payments in a long, long time. What do ya say?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show him that he can't hide from ol' Money Baggs!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Admit it. Ya like this sorta work, don't ya? I can see it in yer hungry little eyes!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You convinced Bernie the Barfly to pay his debt after saving him from a ferocious Silversnout Patriarch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya change your mind, I'll be here. I ain't goin' nowhere.

localizedTextIdText: Tempest Refuge is safe for the time being, but the war in Galeras is far from over. Sergeant Kara has instructed you to meet her at the base of a nearby windmill.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Sergeant Kara at Windspire Vigil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Durek's ordered me to move further north. There's a group of Dommies there, holed up in some Eldan ruins. I'd like you to come with me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you still doin' here? The war's not gonna wait for your beauty sleep.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here we are. It's a little too quiet for my tastes. What say we shake things up a bit?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Glad to hear it, now get movin'. There's a windmill near here. I'll meet you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's what we're gonna do....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Sergeant Kara at a windmill that overlooks the entrance to a Dominion base. Things are about to get exciting.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Whatever it is, get it done if you gotta... but do it fast!

localizedTextIdText: A message was delivered to Brewmaster Grok while you were out, requesting your presence over at the Thermock Chronicle House.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A message came in for you while you were gone. Someone over at the Chronicle House wants to talk to you, but the message didn't say who.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What the hell's goin' on around here? No way I'm gonna believe that was an accident. Someone's tryin' to cause trouble in Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Chronicle house is up the hill. Better not keep 'em waitin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nobody messes with Thermock Hold on my watch.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I was thinking the same thing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went to the Thermock Chronicle House to answer a summons, but the entire building exploded as you entered! This was no accident; someone wanted to do some damage and take you out in the process!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself, pal.

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker asked you to rescue any XAS scientists you find in captivity within Exo-Lab 14. Even if the Caretaker is patched up, active security measures - such as Eldan constructs - must be shut down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Belle Walker inside Exo-Lab 14
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Even with the Caretaker on the mend, people might be trapped in the back of the exo-lab. If you see anyone back there, help 'em, if ya can.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Better get a move on, darlin'! If there's folks still back there, you better set 'em free real quick. We can't afford to lose anyone!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Better get a move on, darlin'! If there's folks still back there, you better set 'em free real quick. We can't afford to lose anyone!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did good settin' those folks free, $(player.name). You make me proud to be an Exile!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful. Once activated, these security measures don't stop. Ever.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't begin to thank ya enough, darlin'!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully released Belle Walker XAS colleagues from captivity inside Exo-Lab 14.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't you a shame?

localizedTextIdText: A Black Hoods Secret Agent has asked you to meet him regarding recent events in Whitevale and has sent the coordinates to your datachron. Travel to the designated location and see what he needs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Black Hoods Secret Agent via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've sent the coordinates to your datachron. Meet me there. Don't worry, I'm not far.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now you understand why we had to bring you in. We needed a free agent we could trust.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be quick, but try to look casual.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yeah, sorry 'bout that, but the Widow believes in takin' extra precautions.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Ow! Is this how you recruit folks?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: THIS INFORMATION HAS BEEN DEEMED CLASSIFIED BY THE BLACK HOODS.\n\nRECORD 234897-393A
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Black Hoods Secret Agent
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're makin' a serious mistake.

localizedTextIdText: You've noticed barrels of poison spread throughout the Focus of Air Control Site. In order to figure out what the Dominion is up to, it might be wise to collect samples of the poison for analysis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Ostrow via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These poison canisters look similar to the ones the Dominion have been dropping all over Galeras. Perhaps you can investigate further.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: These poison canisters look similar to the ones the Dominion have been dropping all over Galeras. Perhaps you can investigate further.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We are receiving reports of the Dominion using poisons on our people. Perhaps you might gather intel and help us widen our web?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These samples match the toxins we have been tracking across Galeras. This must be the singular source of the sickening substance.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The poison is positively pestilential... but there is always room for revision.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see if I can find more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've gathered data on the Poison Barrel around the Focus of Air Control Site and reported your findings to Agent Ostrow. She's confirmed that the poison used by the Dominion in other parts of Galeras came from the same source and that she wishes to improve the poison.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let's see if I can find more.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can dig up.

localizedTextIdText: With the information gathered from the Poison Barrel, Agent Ostrow suspects that the creator of the Dominion toxin may be nearby at the Focus of Air Control Site. Search the surrounding area and put an end to the Dominion's toxic campaign!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Ostrow via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We know the poison is being shipped from this location. Somebody nearby must be producing it. Find this individual and sanction him immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found the one responsible for the Dominion's poison? The more time you fritter away, the more people will die. Think on that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found the one responsible for the Dominion's poison? The more time you fritter away, the more people will die. Think on that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The toxin's creator has been silenced. No longer will the Dominion produce his pestilential poison. We, on the other hand... we may find a use for it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The mastermind behind this poison is rather brilliant. It is a shame he must die.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He won't be making any more poison.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to identify the maker of the poison - a Chua by the name of Toxicologist Poxic - who worked in the dark corners of the Focus of Air Control Site. You ended his deadly campaign, ensuring Galeras will be safe from his poisons.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Delaying the mission will simply cause more death.

localizedTextIdText: In need of a bit of rest after all your adventures in Algoroc, Belle Walker says there is a taxi in Gallow that can get you to the Exile capital city, Thayd, in no time at all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tour Guide Jakke in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I recon that with all this commotion, ya need to rest and refuel. Y'all should head to our capital city, Thayd, and take a load off. A taxi over in Gallow should get ya there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Well what'cha waitin' around here for? Bustlin' Thayd is just callin' yer name.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There you are! Welcome to Thayd. Belle told us you might wanna see the sights.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I got just the fella in mind to give y'all a tour of the place.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hope you're good with ridin' on a souped-up grinder.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll head to Thayd right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a taxi from Algoroc and flew all the way to the Exile capital city, Thayd. This bustling city will have all the amenities you could ever want.

localizedTextIdText: You've been directed to take a transport to Thayd, an ancient, abandoned city now used by the Exiles as their capital city in Galeras. Commander Durek has personally asked you to report for duty in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Tour Guide Jakke in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Heading to Thayd, eh? Fascinatin' place, Thayd. Lots of ancient architecture and the like. The flightmaster can get ya there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Need to get to Thayd? Talk to the flightmaster standin' right there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Thayd, $(player.class). Pardon the mess - we just started settlin' in. Hope you're here to help fight the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Have a good trip, buddy.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the transport to Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a transport to the ancient city of Thayd, which is currently being settled and fortified by the Exiles. Your transport took you on a flyover of the Galeras region.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take the transport to Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Tour Guide Jakke
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself. No slate off my nose.

localizedTextIdText: With the Dominion occupying the Focus of Air Control Site, the XAS is unable to continue their research. Xenoarchaeologist Blackhedge wants you to recover Eldan artifact fragments from the control site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Xenoarchaeologist Blackhedge via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Before the Dominion took over, we noticed a number of Eldan artifact fragments scattered through the ruins. Don't let 'em fall into their hands!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Eldan artifact fragments are scattered through the ruins. Don't let 'em fall into the Dominion's hands!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at all these Eldan fragments you've collected! The XAS and I thank you. If you get a chance, you should visit our camp at the excavation site.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please bring me back whatever you find. I sure hope those Dominion soldiers haven't messed with anythin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Every single one brings us to a closer understandin' of the mysteries of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped recover Eldan artifact fragments from the Focus of Air Control Site and brought them back to Xenoarchaeologist Blackhedge. Hopefully this will allow the XAS to continue their work, even with the ongoing war. In addition, Xenoarchaeologist Blackhedge suggested you pay the XAS Excavation Site a visit if you can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Good thing I didn't expect much, else I might be disappointed.

localizedTextIdText: "Loftite" Pike has asked you to help him set up his mining camp. If you do, he's promised you a share of a particularly rich loftite claim.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lookin' for some work? Well, that there's a massive boulder brimming with loftite. Help me set up my minin' camp, and we'll both be rich!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped "Loftite" Pike with many challenges while setting up his mining camp, but earned a share of the windfall from his rich loftite claim.

localizedTextIdText: Supply Officer Chet in Thermock Hold has been waiting on a shipment of Granok Cigars from Smoky Soka for quite a while, and he's asked you to find out what happened to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the Shipment of Granok Cigars{p:Shipments of Granok Cigars} to Supply Officer Chet near the transport pad in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm on a tight schedule, and I been waitin' for a shipment of Granok cigars from Smoky Soka for hours! You mind finding out what the hold up is?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I see you, but I don't see those cigars! Where are they? Did you check with Smoky Soka or what?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank the stars! Commander Durek would've pounded me good if I didn't get him his cigars on time. He gets edgy if he doesn't have his stogies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soka's shop is higher up in town, near the Chronicle House.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope Soka didn't put anything weird in these. You never know with her.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I bet. It's a dirty habit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Smoky Soka has been so unsettled by the unrest in Thermock Hold that she completely forgot about Supply Officer Chet cigar shipment. You picked up the last box of cigars and delivered it to Chet. Good thing you did, too, since the cigars were for Commander Durek himself!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the Shipment of Granok Cigars{p:Shipments of Granok Cigars} to Supply Officer Chet
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine! I'll find somebody who cares.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Ostrow wants you to access the Eldan data terminals in the Focus of Air Control Site to determine what the Dominion have learned about the Focus of Air.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Ostrow via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Eldan ruins were once a control point for the Focus of Air. Check the Eldan data terminals to see how much the Dominion have learned.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you checked the Eldan data terminals? We must know what the Dominion have learned from their occupation of the Focus of Air.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The XAS will be pleased to learn you have recovered all this information concerning the Focus of Air.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This entire war... all just to control the Focus of Air.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Until next we meet, $(player.name)...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find out what they've learned.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It needed to be done, agent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to recover data on the Focus of Air from the Eldan data terminals at the Focus of Air Control Site. The XAS will be able to use this information to understand more about the Eldan and the Focus of Air.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find out what they've learned.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have accomplished much. Now is not the time to quit.

localizedTextIdText: Regulator Codec has sent out a distress call from Locus Dawn. It seems something is very wrong at the Freebot settlement, and he requires your immediate assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Regulator Codec at Locus Dawn
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Regulator Codec here, transmitting to all sentient units in range! Locus Dawn is in distress! We need help! Please!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Great Datacenters of Positron! You've got to help us! Our citizens have gone insane! We fear for both our structural cohesion and our sanity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you! We will await your arrival, oh most munificent gentlebeing!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hold tight. I'm on my way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Freebots of Locus Dawn have been overcome by a strange affliction that renders them aggressive and hostile. Only a handful of "sane" Freebots remain, and they need your help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You mean you won't drop everything to save an entire community from an insidious evil?

localizedTextIdText: You discovered a bundle of dried flowers left behind by the double agents working for the Dominion. Avra Darkos has asked you to pay a visit to a Black Hoods alchemist working in Snowfade Grounds to determine the significance of this clue.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Alchemist Vikmos in Snowfade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This bundle of dried flowers seems out of place in the snowy landscape. Perhaps it is some sort of clue?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes... Lady Darkos said you'd be coming. A peculiar plant, with properties unknown...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have my... suspicions.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You paid a visit to the Aurin camp and spoke with Alchemist Vikmos regarding the peculiar bundle of dried flowers. It appears this is not the first time he has encountered this unusual plant.

localizedTextIdText: The walls of Thayd have been breached, and the Crimson Legion is pouring in from the Ravaged Front. Kit Brinny has asked you to help defend the command post so she and her men can restock, reload, and regroup.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kit Brinny via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Think you could help us defend the gate for a spell? We could really use some breathin' room... it's been non-stop Dominion since I got here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, whenever you're ready. We could really use the help keepin' those Dominion soldiers off our case.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your help made all the difference. We even managed to grab some chow while you were teachin' those Dommies how to die!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks! We're almost outta ammo and rations... now I can send someone to get more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped defend the breach in the wall so that Kit Brinny and her troopers could restock, reload, and regroup.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're just gonna let us get slaughtered, hm?

localizedTextIdText: Ravenok meat can provide the folk of Tempest Refuge with a tasty alternative to stale rations or starvation. Gather $m(vitem=396) in the vicinity of Nibben's Ranch, then take them to Fannie Nibben so that they can be added to supplies destined for Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Fannie Nibben at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ravenok drumsticks look as if they might provide tasty meals for the people of Tempest Refuge... if there were enough of them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The folks up at Tempest Refuge need food. We'll send them whatever you can find. If you can get some ravenok meat, it'll do a world of good.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've eaten a ravenok or two in my time on Nexus, so I know the folks at Tempest Refuge will appreciate these. Thank you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered $m(vitem=396) and delivered them to Fannie Nibben at Nibben's Ranch.

localizedTextIdText: Eldan mysteries abound in the Focus of Air. Scientist Linden wants you to figure out how to reactivate the Eldan circuitry that runs through the Focus of Air Control Site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Linden via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been trying to figure out how to reactivate the Eldan circuitry. Some of the switches and breakers here looked familiar. Wanna try turnin' it on?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You reactivate those switches yet? I think I'm on to something with this Eldan circuitry here! It's so excitin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was as easy as bingberry pie! Bet the Dominion never even thought to try it! All they're interested in is the Focus of Air.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The switches are scattered all over, so it might be a pain.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take care, now!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Eldan energy now flows through circuits at the Focus of Air Control Site. The energy reactivated a pod that can enhance your abilities for a short time.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, I got no idea! Excitin', ain't it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What was that? Was that a 'no'?

localizedTextIdText: Word has spread about your adventures and deeds. There are people in the Exile capital city of Thayd that are dying to meet you. There are lots of ways to get there, but the easiest would be to take a taxi from either Gallow or Belabog Containment Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Tour Guide Jakke in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there. I've been hearin' all about you. Thayd sounds like just the place for someone like you. There's a tour and everything.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hello, there! Been expectin' ya. I got a tour with your name on it. You're gonna need to know all there is to know about Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit! See if you can't find a taxi anywhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This here is our new home, and we're here to stay.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll come on by to Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Thayd looks like a big place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Word had spread about your adventures and deeds all the way to the Exile capital city of Thayd. You traveled there to check out the amenities and meet some people, though it's a very big place and there is so much to see.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Jakke
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if you don't wanna...

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos has asked you to eliminate the leaders of the ICI in Whitevale. To this end, you must find and kill Inventor Trappa, Cycler Kolo, and Equalizer Julius at Junction Snowshadow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now... for a little wetwork. I'm uploading three names to your Datachron. Find them in Junction Snowshadow and eliminate them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you neutralized the ICI leadership in Whitevale? Make it quick... and painful, if possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: An excellent effort. You have proven yourself to be proficient in the less-than-palatable art of distributing death.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It is time we gave the ICI a taste of their own bitter medicine.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Killing is one thing I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The ICI leaders in Whitevale have been neutralized. Looks like you've got this secret agent gig down!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will regret denying me.

localizedTextIdText: Exile prisoners are being held by the ICI in the Snowshadow cave compound. Avra Darkos has ordered you to rescue as many of these Exile prisoners from the Dominion as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am receiving reports that Junction Snowshadow is warehousing Exile prisoners. Look into it. If our people are in there, get them out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very well done, $(player.name). That is the sort of initiative I look for in the very best of my agents.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure you don't lose sight of our primary mission.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You released a number of Exile prisoners from their cages in the Snowshadow cave compound.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you turn your back on our people?

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered an unusual vein of loftite in the Tremor Ridge mine. Perhaps Pappy Grizzleston in Tremor Ridge can explain the crystal's strange, purple hue.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pappy Grizzleston in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You found an unusual specimen of loftite that glows with a strange purple hue. Perhaps a loftite expert could explain the phenomenon.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You found an unusual specimen of loftite that glows with a strange purple hue. Perhaps a loftite expert could explain the phenomenon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be jiggered! You say you found this loftite in Tremor Ridge? This color means it's about as pure as it gets! Can't believe I missed it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for letting me hold onto it. I'll take good care o' this baby.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is sure to interest someone.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You showed Pappy Grizzleston the strange purple-hued crystal you discovered in the Tremor Ridge mine. He informed you that the unusual color indicates it's the purest naturally occurring form of loftite. It's a spectacularly rare find!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: This is sure to interest someone.

localizedTextIdText: FCON forces near Exo-Site 14 are in a lot of trouble. Trooper Mogra has asked you to destroy augmented gronyx and augmented XAS scientists outside Exo-Site 14.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Mogra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Augmentors got to the scientists and gronyx around the exo-lab. Gronyx are tough enough, but augmented gronyx? I admit it... we could really use a hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My mercs are stuck out there, and those augmented gronyx are gonna make gravel out of 'em if you don't give us a hand. Get to it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was some fine rock-breakin' you did there. If you ever wanna give up the adventurin' life, there's a place for you in FCON.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew I could count on ya, bud. Go get 'em!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the augmented gronyx and augmented XAS scientists outside Exo-Site 14.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Seriously, pal? I thought you were supposed to be tough.

localizedTextIdText: A strange, bird-like statue stands at the edge of Redstone Farm. It looks to have sustained some damage, more than likely when the Dominion attacked.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Royce via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This statue depicts a bird-like figure. It looks like it's been damaged, probably during the recent Dominion assault on Redstone Farm.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This statue depicts a bird-like figure. It looks like it's been damaged, probably during the recent Dominion assault on Redstone Farm.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bird people? Yeah, right! I think I've heard just about everythin' now! Thanks for the laugh!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A bunch of angry bird-men attacked you for touchin' their statue? You think that's what killed everyone at Redstone Farm? That ain't fair!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As if the Dominion's not bad enough... now we've got to deal with bird people.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: A strange, bird-like statue stands at the edge of Redstone Farm. It looks to have sustained some damage, more than likely during the Dominion assault. After examining the statue more closely, you were attacked by angry Falkrin for desecrating their sacred idol.

localizedTextIdText: Scout Grekka and her squad were ambushed and enslaved by the Osun, but she managed to escape. She's asked you to help rescue her comrades by taking $m(vitem=70) from slain Vishal-Thun Soul Slaver and Vishal-Thun Overlord, and using them to free Osun Prisoner in Kel Vishal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Grekka via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We were scouting near Kel Vishal when the Osun ambushed us and took us prisoner. I managed to escape, but my comrades are still in chains.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Osun chain their captives to pillars. The slavers and overseers should have the keys you'll need.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for freeing my pals. I could care less about the Dommies, but I figure you've got a conscience... can't knock you for that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful! Those Osun are big and powerful... downright scary, if you ask me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed both Dominion and Exile captives from the Osun slavers in Kel Vishal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You just going to stand there and let my people die?

localizedTextIdText: Osun force their captives to imbibe Soulrot Elixir. This destroys their free will, creating slaves whose only escape from the Osun is death. Scout Grekka has asked you to put these mindless thralls out of their misery in Kel Vishal, while destroying the Osun's supplies of Soulrot Elixir.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Grekka via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun enslave their captives with a foul potion. We gotta make sure that elixir of theirs is destroyed before they can create more slaves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gotta go into Kel Vishal and destroy the Soulrot Elixir you find there. The slaves, too, if you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did those poor guys a favor, putting 'em down like that. Try not to feel too bad about it - there's nothing else you can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's a lot of slaves in there... it ain't pretty. Might wanna put 'em out of their misery, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed many Soulrot Slave, freeing them from their mindless devotion to their Osun masters, while also destroying the Osun's supply of Soulrot Elixir.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Exile are supposed to stick together, jerk.

localizedTextIdTitle: WANTED: The Osun, the Witch, and the Warlord [GROUP 2+]
localizedTextIdText: Scout Grekka has posted a bounty for the deaths of Darkwitch Hevika and Warlord Vogor, the Osun leaders of Kel Vishal. Anyone brave enough to face them and skillful enough to defeat them should speak to Scout Grekka to claim their reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Scout Grekka via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: REWARD OFFERED!\nFor anyone brave enough to face Darkwitch Hevika and Warlord Vogor of the Vishal-Thun Osun. - Scout Grekka
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: REWARD OFFERED!\nFor anyone brave enough to face Darkwitch Hevika and Warlord Vogor of the Vishal-Thun Osun. - Scout Grekka
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we kill the leaders of the Osun - Hevika and Vogor - I think we can shut down their slavery operation in Kel Vishal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm having a tough time believing you killed Hevika and Vogor... but it looks like your claim on the reward is legit. Good work out there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You faced and defeated Darkwitch Hevika and Warlord Vogor, the leaders of the Vishal-Thun Osun. Excellent work!

localizedTextIdText: The Osun methodically describe their strategies in large, elaborate tomes. You located such a book in Kel Vishal that described their plans to move their slaves south, meeting up with a larger Osun army in the south.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: From the look of this large book, the Osun are planning to move their slaves to join up with an Osun army in the south.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Osun methodically describe their strategies in large, elaborate tomes. You located such a book in Kel Vishal that described their plans to move their slaves south, meeting up with a larger Osun army in the south.

localizedTextIdText: Two of Corporal Dax troopers were tasked with special missions, and he wants you to check on them. Trooper Argoz can be found in Stormwing Fortress, and Trooper Riverbend should be up the ramp to the Fortress's second level.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Dax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got a couple troopers who were sent on priority missions. They haven't reported in. You mind finding 'em and lending a hand, if need be?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Argoz is around here somewhere, but Riverbend should be on the ramp to the second level.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Both Argoz and Riverbend have reported in. Thanks for checking in on 'em. It's good to know they're still alive.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll upload their coords to your datachron. Good luck finding 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located both Trooper Argoz and Trooper Riverbend and helped them complete their missions in Stormwing Fortress.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We could really use your help.

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Riverbend was sent into Stormwing Fortress to kill Broodlord Taran Stormwing, but her weapon was damaged when her pod landed. Without armament, she's unable to complete her mission. Locate her target in Stormwing Fortress and take him out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Trooper Riverbend in Stormwing Fortress
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: They sent me to take out Taran Stormwing, the Falkrin broodlord. And he'd be drawin' flies right now if the rough landin' hadn't busted my weapon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stormwing's up the way a bit, I think. Not like I'd go lookin' for him without something to kill him with.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Intel said that the Falkrin would fold without their leader. Thanks to you, we're goin' to find out if that's true or not.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You go right ahead. I'll stay here and hope no one sees me hidin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You want to be of service? How 'bout you try mendin' my rifle...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take him out for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and neutralized Broodlord Taran Stormwing for Trooper Riverbend, helping to break both the cohesion and morale of the Falkrin in Stormwing Fortress.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take him out for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A Falkrin war leader, I reckon. Sorta like Commander Durek... only with feathers and a beak.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you ain't goin' to help, at least give me your weapon.

localizedTextIdText: The Falkrin are creating bombs which they can use to horrible effect in their offensive against Exile forces in Galeras. Trooper Riverbend has asked you to find Stormwing Bomb Casing in Stormwing Fortress and set them on fire using Stormwing Torch{p:Stormwing Torches} before they can be armed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Trooper Riverbend in Stormwing Fortress
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Get a load of this, friend. The Falkrin, they've got bombs! The bombs ain't armed yet, so it's the perfect time to destroy 'em. What do you say?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: With the size of 'em, I hate to think what one of those Falkrin bombs could do to Skywatch outpost. We need to take 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Falkrin won't be blowin' up Skywatch outpost any time soon. And here I thought they was all just stupid bird-brains.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're made of wood. You should be able to burn 'em with a torch or somethin'.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You set fire to Stormwing Bomb Casing before the Falkrin could arm the devices and use them against the Exile forces.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah! They ain't fancy or nothin'... they're just these big things they're gonna fill up with who-knows-what and drop on us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Those bombs'll cause a lot of trouble if you don't take care of 'em.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Danella is researching Falkrin physiology and requires samples of Falkrin Bones in order to finalize her studies. She's asked you to collect Falkrin Bones in Stormwing Fortress.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Researcher Danella in Stormwing Fortress
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Falkrin skeletal structure is fascinating, as is the composition of their bones. I need more samples if I'm to finalize my studies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are plenty of Falkrin in here. Kill them, if you must, but get me those bone samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let me see those bones... I thought so! Hollow! Now if I can examine the structure of the osseous tissue in depth to determine its tensile strength...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh? Well... that's fine, but try not to contaminate them. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Look at this! When viewed at magnification, I expect to find compound osteoblasts...!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can collect bones for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected Falkrin Bones to aid Researcher Danella research.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I can collect bones for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: There are a lot of dead Falkrin here...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: How can a creature with so much mass maintain enough lift to fly? Their bones must be hollow and incredibly strong!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Perhaps to the uneducated, sure. But without some bones to analyze, I'm unable to reach a definitive conclusion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: My trigger-happy friend blasted them all into a fine red mist. I need bone samples that are intact!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sure there will be plenty of bones once the fighting's done.

localizedTextIdText: The Royal Collegium has come to an abandoned research site to investigate the previous activities of their enemy counterpart, the XAS. Director Faustius wants you to don a Dominion-issue hazmat suit and enter the gas-filled cave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Faustius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Before I send you in, acquaint yourself with the mechanics of our hazmat suits. You'll need to test-recharge the suit once you're inside the cave.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you tested the functionality of your suit yet? It is the only thing standing between you and a lingering, agonizing death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've always found the XAS to be incompetent. We found their camp abandoned upon our arrival. I must know what they discovered here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The toxins filling the caves would drive anyone mad in a few short hours.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The XAS fools must have triggered something in the depths of the cave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the hazardous cave and could barely see anything with the toxic fumes filling the air. You returned to Director Faustius and learned that the XAS may have disturbed something deep within the caverns' depths.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pah! The Royal Collegium has no use for laziness. Get out of my sight!

localizedTextIdText: Director Faustius wants you to venture into the Abandoned XAS Research Cave and retrieve XAS storage crates. Use one of the abandoned cargo pallets to send them back to the surface once you've recovered a sufficient number.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Faustius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must examine their materials to determine what the XAS learned here. Recover their storage crates and send them back to the surface for analysis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've yet to receive any of the XAS storage crates. What are you doing down there? I expect a cargo pallet stacked high with them - and soon!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased by your efforts, $(player.name). Our researchers will begin sorting through these crates immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use their abandoned cargo pallets to transport the crates to the surface.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We may find something useful, but knowing the XAS, I find that improbable.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to find several storage crates and sent them back up to the surface using an abandoned cargo pallet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I dislike your attitude, $(player.name). The Collegium will not forget this.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Tolben has located a wrecked X-82 cargo vessel and intends to salvage it. The captain has asked you to take a transport, located near Crosswind Post, to his ship, the Blue Sparrow so that you can help investigate the wreck.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Tolben on the Blue Sparrow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've located the wreck of an X-82 drifting in orbit, and I intend to salvage her. Maybe you'd like to help me out? I could sure use a hand, yep.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Everything's all set, yeah? We just need to check out the X-82 and make sure no one's aboard who can claim ownership. Know what I mean?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Docked right into the X-82. Now let's get to work salvaging the place, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great. Take this transport up to my ship, the Blue Sparrow. I'll be along soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a transport ship located near Crosswind Post and docked with the X-82 cargo vessel, ready to salvage its riches.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You plan to salvage the ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a cargo hauler. The X-82 series is one of the most popular ships in use today, as reliable as it is ubiquitous.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You betcha, so long as I can prove she doesn't have an owner. Everything from seat padding to alloy bulkheads can fatten a captain's purse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Let me know if you change your mind, okay?

localizedTextIdText: Director Faustius wants you to eliminate toxic fraz and frizlets within the Abandoned XAS Research Cave in order to make the caverns safer for his researchers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Faustius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can't have those disgusting creatures - the fraz and frizlets - attacking my researchers in the caves. Eliminate them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If any of my people are injured by those foul beasts, I'll consider you to be responsible. You had best kill them. Immediately!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's much, much better. We must remain focused on revealing the secrets of this cave without the undue distraction of hostile vermin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will brook no hindrance to our efforts here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed many of the toxic fraz and frizlets inside the Abandoned XAS Research Cave, thereby making it safer for Director Faustiuss researchers to work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I believe I misheard you. Could you speak up?

localizedTextIdText: Inventor Tazzo wants toxin samples from the Abandoned XAS Research Cave. Collect fresh samples from the toxic fraz and frizlets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Inventor Tazzo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Faustius too cautious, want creatures killed. Wants toxin samples from fraz. You collect samples so he can analyze them... for science!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Back to work! Now now! Collect toxin samples from fraz in caves before I get angry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Toxin samples taken from fraz in cave adequate. Require test subject for direct toxin injection. Interested?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If fraz poison powerful neurotoxin, may have military application!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Afraid of neurotoxin? Feh! Death likely painless.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected samples of the cave toxin from the fraz and frizlets, exciting Inventor Tazzo who believes there could be a use for such potent neurotoxin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Tsk. Your hazmat suit might have an... accident. Even small puncture deadly.

localizedTextIdText: Inventor Tazzo has requested you help him repair a localized matter transfer pod to help access the sealed area of the Abandoned XAS Research Cave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Inventor Tazzo in the Abandoned XAS Research Cave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: More work to do! No rest for lackey! Teleporter broken. Fix and we go deeper into caves. You help repair teleporter at once! Now now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fix teleporter so we can explore rest of cave. Must be lots of interesting things there. Do not keep us waiting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent! Eldan defense includes powerful elementals and deadly lasers! Perfect for future plans! Hahaha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Having fun working for us?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.name) scared? Just wait!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Inventor Tazzo clear out hostile creatures near the broken transfer pod. You then repaired the teleporter to the sealed lower levels of the Abandoned XAS Research Cave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hope for your sake "no" is new "yes."

localizedTextIdText: Inventor Tazzo is intrigued by the water and life elementals wandering through the lower levels of the Abandoned XAS Research Cave. He wants to you kill them and find out where they're coming from.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Inventor Tazzo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Great gears of Bezgelor! Look at elementals! Must be coming from somewhere. Must know more! Kill your way through them and find out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Elementals still blocking cave. Why delay? Go! Go kill! Find out where they come from!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You do good job killing. But did you find origins of elementals? Killing important, but finding more important.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go, go, go! No time to waste! Killing to do!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What else are you good at? Will find out soon enough!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed a number of water and life elementals for Inventor Tazzo, who wanted you to travel even deeper into the Abandoned XAS Research Cave to locate their origins.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can learn.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't like being told no. Answer again.

localizedTextIdText: You reached the lowest levels of the Abandoned XAS Research Cave and found a giant elemental rampaging and terrorizing the lesser elementals. Inventor Tazzo has given you a stunning device to help you defeat the monstrous creature so you can study the Eldan devices at the bottom of the cave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Inventor Tazzo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hm, big elemental down there. Might be problem. Use this - stunner. Brilliant invention! Mine! Use stunner, then get data on elemental source!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Big elemental keep us away from important finds at bottom of cave. Use stunner to stun elemental, then kill it! Kill it good!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Big elemental keep us away from important finds at bottom of cave. Use stunner to stun elemental, then kill it! Kill it good!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Peculiar! Eldan fused primal water and life to create elementals. Toxic gas unfortunate byproduct. Problem, yes, big problem.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stunner should buy you time. Do damage. Should work. Almost positive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Further research needed, yes. But by me, not you. Off with you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Uh, I'll get right on that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the stunning device Inventor Tazzo gave you, you were able to destroy the toxic elemental rampager at the bottom level of the Abandoned XAS Research Cave. You discovered an Eldan forge fusing primal water and life to create the elementals, which incidentally generated the toxic gas as some kind of byproduct.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No no no! Need data now!

localizedTextIdText: On reaching the other side of the sealed cave tunnel, you discovered the XAS had set up a number of research panels. Director Faustius would like you to recover the data logs from the research consoles in order to find out what the XAS was up to here.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Faustius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The XAS set up a network of research consoles in the caves' lower levels. I must know what they contain. Access the data logs and download everything!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you accessed the XAS data logs yet? Think of what they must contain! All the secrets of this place and more are waiting to be revealed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hmph. While I found Dr. Crowe's ambitions somewhat admirable, she failed to survive long enough to capitalize on her discovery. Typical Exile weakness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We will get to the bottom of this matter, one way or another.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will not fail as Dr. Crowe did. This will be my masterpiece!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Data log by data log, the disturbing tale of Dr. Alexis Crowe of the XAS and the disintegration of her mental sanity was revealed. Consumed by her desire to uncover the secrets of this buried Eldan research facility, she unwittingly sealed her doom by activating the Eldan elemental apparatus, locking herself in with the Eldan abominations and the toxic fumes that led to her demise.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You foolish $(player.class). You have come too far to reject these chores.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Sevina of the Radiant Legion has contacted you and requested your assistance. Make your way to her location at Camp Virtue.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Sevina in Camp Virtue
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Light and Glory be unto you, citizen. Come to Camp Virtue at once and speak with me, for the Radiant Legion has need of you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is good to see you. So much has been discussed concerning your ability, as well as the deeds you have accomplished in the Dominion's name.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall be waiting. May the Eldan guide your steps.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is an insidious cult that weighs heavily upon us. We must purge its heresy.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be there as soon as I can.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What seems to be the trouble?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You answered Captain Sevina request for help and met with her in Camp Virtue. It seems the Radiant Legion is having problems with cultists in Whitevale...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You should not dismiss your holy duty to the Vigilant Church, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Major Glacian Aurelius of the Gold Legion has been deployed to secure Palerock Post. He's ordered you to activate Dominion defense generators throughout Palerock Post, thereby strengthening the post's security.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Major Glacian Aurelius in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion has won Whitevale, but the Exiles fail to realize they have been defeated. You must help prepare for their inevitable insurgency.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Several defense generators still require activation in Palerock Post. You had best snap to it, citizen!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Outstanding work, citizen, and not a moment too soon. Exile rebels have been seen inside our perimeter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Activate defense generators throughout Palerock Post, then return to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Captain Phillip Aurelius, my son, will detail your next assignment.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Major Glacian Aureliuss request, you activated Dominion defense generators in Palerock Post and increased the post's security.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Exiles are vermin. Even when exterminated, they fight back with renewed vigor. Ergo, we must prevent them from disrupting our colonization efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You assume I was making a request, do you? How amusing.

localizedTextIdText: In order to bring Exile mining operations in Whitevale to a halt, Captain Phillip Aurelius, Major Glacian Aureliuss son, has ordered you to find and terminate the three Exile drill operators in Palerock Wilds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles control three drilling sites in Palerock Wilds. This cannot be permitted. I want you to find the drills' operators and terminate them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Reconnaissance reports indicate the drill operators are still alive. Why is this? I thought my kill order was perfectly clear.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you dispatched the Exile drill operators yet? See to your mission, citizen, or I will find someone else who will!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Exile terminations have been verified. There is, however, a problem. Captain Phillip Aurelius, my son, is not responding to his datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I, too, will be heading out into the field soon. Honor and glory, citizen!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I need you to find him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed the three Exile drill operators in Palerock Wilds. However, Major Glacian Aurelius reports that Captain Phillip Aurelius is no longer answering his communicator, and his current whereabouts - and condition - are unknown.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What are the Exiles drilling for?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Reports have been inconclusive on that fact. We have a mineralogist from the Collegium in Palerock Wilds to determine that very thing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My father will hear of your lack of initiative.

localizedTextIdText: In order to curtail the Exiles' mining efforts, Major Glacian Aurelius has ordered you to destroy Exile Drill Equipment{p:Exile Drill Equipment} in Palerock Wilds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Despite our claim on Palerock Wilds, the Exiles persist in mining our lands. Proceed to their drilling sites immediately and destroy their equipment.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I await your explanation. Why have you failed to destroy the Exile drill equipment in Palerock Wilds?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I await your explanation. Why have you failed to destroy the Exile drill equipment in Palerock Wilds?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The precious resources of Whitevale belong to the Dominion... even those we have not yet discovered. Your service today will not be forgotten.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The miscreants will be unable to continue mining if their equipment is denied them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, fret not, citizen. I am not done with you yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Major Glacian Aureliuss orders, you destroyed Major Glacian Aurelius in Palerock Wilds. The Exiles will be hard-pressed to continue their labors without functional equipment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will have you strung up for this.

localizedTextIdText: Bhaskar has nearly expired from the oppressive cold of Whitevale. He believes that if he eats the hearts of Ice-Crusted Boulderback in Palerock Wilds, he will gain their resistance to the cold so he can continue the hunt.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bhaskar in Palerock Wilds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I refuse to allow this infernal cold to kill me. With the hearts of boulderbacks, I can overcome the chill of Whitevale and resume my hunt!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ice-crusted boulderbacks can be mistaken for boulders from afar. You can find them throughout Palerock Wilds. I need their hearts!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ice-crusted boulderbacks can be mistaken for boulders from afar. You can find them throughout Palerock Wilds. I need their hearts!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have gathered the boulderback hearts? Yes... these will do! Now watch as my blood is thawed by their power!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am nearly frozen through, or I would lend my sword to the task.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get boulderback hearts for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the hearts of Ice-Crusted Boulderback for Bhaskar. The hunter consumed the hearts, declared them delicious, and went along on his way.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you want hearts for?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: On Mikros, Draken hunters would consume the hearts of great beasts to gain their strengths. It is no different on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If you bring me the boulderback hearts, you will see it with your own eyes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then I owe you no favors.

localizedTextIdText: Major Glacian Aurelius, enraged by the death of his son, has ordered you to root out and kill the Exiles hiding in Sunderstone Hold. Many Exiles have taken to lying in wait inside crates, barrels, and junk piles. Destroy these objects and see if any Exiles emerge, then kill them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: From your report, I can assume the Exiles specifically targeted Phillip. You will go, flush them out of their hiding places, and annihilate them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? Flush the Exiles in Sunderstone from hiding and cut them down like chaff!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Exiles sought to hurt me... and they have. Yet you have offered me some small comfort by taking their filthy little lives. For that, I thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If the Exile scum want a confrontation, we will give them one... yes, we will!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Exiles will continue to answer for it until I am satisfied they have suffered enough!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: His death could not go unanswered.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though many Sunderstone Coward attempted to hide in Sunderstone Hold, you managed to flush out and kill a large number of them on Major Glacian Aureliuss orders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You besmirch my son's memory with your insubordination.

localizedTextIdText: Major Glacian Aurelius, consumed by a desire to avenge his slain son, has ordered you to place Incendiary Turret in front of buildings in Sunderstone Hold and set the town alight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have another task for you, citizen. As you stalk the streets of Sunderstone, you will set up incendiary turrets in front of Exile buildings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Set up incendiary turrets in Sunderstone. You must make the Exiles pay for my son's life! I want to smell their burning corpses from here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Satellite imagery shows that Sunderstone blazes with a heat to match that of a small sun. You have done an excellent job of burning the vermin out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fire is the only effective weapon when cleansing filth. Burn them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I only wish I was there to smell the stench of their smoldering corpses.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With their homes and bodies burning, the Exiles in Sunderstone Hold have paid dearly for the death of Major Glacian Aureliuss son.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you will join the Exiles in death.

localizedTextIdText: Hidden in one of the buildings of Sunderstone Hold is Master Scribe Ernust. He's being held hostage by the Exiles, so you must find him and get him out alive. Don't forget to kill any Exiles that get in your way.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mineralogist Teraquartz near Sunderstone Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This key is marked with the words "Dommie Prisoner." While you're knocking Exiles around in Sunderstone, maybe you can find the lock this key opens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you speaking to me? Should you be here speaking to me, or should you be killing Exiles in Sunderstone Hold?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have received word that Master Scribe Ernust has escaped unharmed from the Exiles. Though incompetent outside of a library, he remains valuable.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You did well, $(player.name). Thank you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find where this key goes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Master Scribe Ernust was held hostage in Sunderstone Hold until you rescued him from the filthy Exiles.

localizedTextIdText: Major Glacian Aurelius has instructed you to locate his son, Captain Phillip Aurelius, who disappeared while on an assignment. Captain Phillip Aureliuss last known position was near the eastern walls of Sunderstone Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Major Glacian Aurelius at the Dominion Camp outside Sunderstone Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Captain Aurelius has not checked in for some time, and he does not answer his communicator. Go to his last position and verify his status.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Every moment you squander here is a moment you should have spent searching for my son!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Report at once on the condition of Captain Aurelius. Did you find him?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He is a fine officer. The Dominion will be at a loss if you cannot... cannot find him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dead? How... how can this be? Are you certain? Oh... Phillip... it cannot be true! $(self.visual=6984)
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the missing Captain Phillip Aurelius. Unfortunately, you found him in time to witness his execution at the hands of the Exiles. The typically taciturn Major Glacian Aurelius was less than pleased by the news of his son's death.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How can you be so cold? He's your son!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Phillip is a soldier. He knows the risks involved with his vocation, and he has faced them bravely. He wouldn't die without a fight.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You forget your place! I have had enough of your insubordinate questions. My personal matters are my own, not yours! Now get out there and find my son!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not a request, fool.

localizedTextIdText: The Exiles have revealed their secret weapon: the P-H2O Warbot, an engine of destruction fueled by primal water! The warbot will be dropped in the center of Sunderstone Hold, and it's up to you to destroy it before it can make its way behind Dominion lines.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles are deploying a warbot to Sunderstone Hold... their secret weapon! How pathetic! You will destroy it for the Dominion... for Phillip!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Should you fail to destroy the Exile warbot in Sunderstone Hold, only your failures will be remembered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My son would be awestruck by your prowess, much as I am. I regret that he... Phillip... is not here to celebrate your victory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Exiles fail to realize the futility of their position.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nexus is destined to be ours. Phillip's death will not have been in vain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Exiles' P-H2O Warbot before it could threaten the Dominion's forces in Whitevale. Glory to the Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Major Glacian Aurelius
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so special about this warbot?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Imperial Intelligence indicates it is fueled by primal water. Supposedly, this augments its systems.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are a stain upon the memory of my son.
