localizedTextIdText: Director Faustius has requested your presence at the XAS Research Cave. He requires your help to uncover the secrets left behind by the incompetent Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Director Faustius outside the XAS Research Cave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've uncovered an incredibly fascinating mess left behind by our XAS rivals. I require a field agent to explore a hazardous cave, and I've chosen you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At last, you've arrived. Together we can unravel the giant tangled knot those witless Exiles have left behind, hm?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You come highly-recommended. I expect you to live up to all the hype.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Director Faustius outside the XAS Research Cave, preparing to explore the toxin-filled cavern nearby.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It appears as if the fanfare surrounding your deeds has been overblown.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Pomi Vrizz is researching the sudden shift in Whitevale's climate. His main focus is on the animals of Palerock Wilds, including jabbits, pumera, girrok, and razortails, that have been frozen in the ice. These beasts can be freed using his Chua thawing laser.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Pomi Vrizz at his camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Animals frozen in ice after sudden climate shift. Must thaw animals, analyze metabolism, gauge effects of sudden glaciation! You help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Instructions unclear? Shoot frozen animals with thawing laser! Quick quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Animals thawed? Good good! Answers obvious now. Animals unable to acclimate to frozen environment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Here. Take Chua thawing laser, shoot frozen animals. Thaws in seconds!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes... but wanted to test thawing laser! Lasers fun!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You thawed a number of frozen animals for Scientist Pomi Vrizz and provided him with important data for his research concerning Whitevale's sudden climate shift.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Thaw animals with lasers. Got it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But... is laser! Thawing laser! Lasers fun, yes?

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Finazi Vrizz has asked you to acquire an Eldan Evolver so that he can study it. Use the Techno-Disabler Field to disable the bot located in the Palerock Wilds. If the bot doesn't come quietly, Finazi is fine with it being blown to pieces.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Finazi Vrizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strange construct roams Palerock Wilds. Is Eldan Evolver! Zaps animals, makes them better. I want Evolver! You use disabler field, bring it back. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use techno-disabler field, disable Eldan Evolver. That not work? Blow it up! Either way is okay with Finazi.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Techno-disabler field not work? Too bad! Was going to tear bot apart, anyway. Will pick up Evolver pieces later. $(player.class) can go away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If field not work, destroy Evolver. Make no difference as long as parts left over!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh yes. Thank you, and all that nonsense.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were forced to destroy the Eldan Evolver so that Researcher Finazi Vrizz could study its remains.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You not very smart, hm? Am talking to you.

localizedTextIdText: Mineralogist Teraquartz has politely asked you to collect $m(vitem=281) from the Exile drill sites outside Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mineralogist Teraquartz at her camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've heard encouraging things about you, so do not disappoint me. I require you to collect ore samples near the Exile drill sites.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find and collect a few ore samples from the ground near the Exile drill sites... and be quick about it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Allow me to analyze the samples you've recovered. Intriguing. This is solidified primal water, not ore. What might the Exiles require this for?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A prudent choice. I must learn what the Exiles are mining. Do not fail me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I trust you will learn more in time. For now, you have been a useful instrument.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected enough $m(vitem=281) from the Exile drill sites. This has allowed Mineralogist Teraquartz to determine that the Exiles are extracting solidified primal water from the ground.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am... disappointed. *sigh*

localizedTextIdText: Verton, a Mechari technician, has been working overtime to keep the Exiles from intercepting Dominion transmissions. He can't keep this up, so he needs you to go into Sunderstone Hold and destroy all the Exile Comm Scramblers you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Technician Verton near Sunderstone Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles have several communicator scramblers hidden in their structures. I need you to destroy them so they can no longer jam our signals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need you to destroy the Exile comm scramblers in Sunderstone Hold. You should find them in the buildings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well, $(player.class). With the scramblers down, our communications will be secure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will manually encrypt our signals until then. Alacrity would be appreciated.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Honor and glory, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Mechari technician Verton, was having a hard time keeping the Dominion airwaves safely encrypted. But with your help, the Exile scramblers were destroyed, making Dominion communications once again secure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How dare you turn your back on the Dominion.

localizedTextIdText: You have been contacted by Agent Lex, and he has asked you to report for duty at the edge of Murmurwood Forest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Agent Lex near Murmurwood Forest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI has need of you, citizen. Come to Murmurwood Forest at once and I shall fill you in on your mission parameters.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I have nothing to say to you... yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have nothing to say to you... yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Murmurwood. The soldiers you see here are part of a security detail assigned to protect Colonel Phelan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Move with all due speed, citizen. Under the current circumstances, I possess little patience.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No, they do not. Unfortunately for them, the Colonel... is missing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Agent Lex at the edge of Murmurwood Forest, where he informed you that Colonel Phelan - a prominent Dominion officer - is missing. From the sound of things, this will be an interesting assignment.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What is the nature of my mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That information is restricted at the moment. If you wish to know why I have use of you, I suggest you get moving. Immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal to serve the Dominion has been logged.

localizedTextIdText: Colonel Phelan, a Shatterforce officer, has been kidnapped by unknown parties in Murmurwood Forest. Fortunately, the Colonel is in possession of a tracking device and Agent Lex has given you a sensor array that you can use to locate it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Lex in Murmurwood Forest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Phelan is not among the dead, so the perpetrators must have captured him. Use this sensor array to locate the Colonel's tracking device.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The kidnappers cannot have gotten far. Use the sensor array to track the Colonel, but be sure to refresh it periodically or you will lose the trail.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The kidnappers cannot have gotten far. Use the sensor array to track the Colonel, but be sure to refresh it periodically or you will lose the trail.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is as I suspected. Phelan was warned that the Black Hoods were active in this area, but he chose to ignore my advice. We must act quickly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Every task is fraught with danger. Do not underestimate our enemies.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Phelan may be a fool, but he is still a Dominion officer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used Agent Lex sensor array to locate Colonel Phelan tracking device, but no other trace of the Colonel could be found. Recordings made by the tracking device indicate that the Black Hoods - the nefarious Exile spy organization - is likely behind the kidnapping.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How does the sensor array work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Colonel's tracking device emits a signal that the sensor array can detect. You must refresh the array periodically or you might lose the trail.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is no time for a lack of patriotism. The Colonel's life is in danger.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex has entrusted you with a stealth field generator, and ordered you to investigate an abandoned lodge that the ICI suspects of being the entrance to a Black Hoods enclave. The stealth unit should allow you to use cunning and guile in order to accomplish your objectives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am providing you with a stealth field generator. There is an abandoned lodge in the forest that I want you to investigate for signs of Exile occupancy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I need you to paint a clearer picture of the Black Hoods operation in Whitevale. You must use stealth in order to accomplish this task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need you to paint a clearer picture of the Black Hoods operation in Whitevale. You must use stealth in order to accomplish this task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have been monitoring your situation. You have done well. The data you retrieved will be invaluable in purging this land of the Exile disease.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If the lodge is a Black Hoods enclave, infiltrate it and gather intel.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soon the Black Hoods will rue the day they came to Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to locate the entrance to the Black Hoods enclave in Whitevale. You then accessed a Black Hoods Control Terminal inside the enclave to paint a compelling picture of the Exiles' operation in Murmurwood Forest. Now it's time to get down to business...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How does the stealth field work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is simple. You activate it, and it projects a stealth field around your body. It is not foolproof, but it should give you the edge you require for this assignment.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The ICI suspected the lodge of being a front for some criminal endeavor - pirates or smugglers. More likely, it is controlled by the Black Hoods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The time for your cowardice has long since passed.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex has ordered you to locate and assassinate Agent Tibor, the Black Hoods leader in Viscera Enclave. Once the enemy has been liquidated, you are to free Colonel Phelan from his captivity and escape the enclave's crumbling remains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Lex at the Shatterforce Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The explosives have been set. Now you must liquidate Agent Tibor - this enclave's leader - and free Colonel Phelan before the roof comes down.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Though Agent Tibor is only one of many Black Hoods leaders, his death will effectively destroy this enclave at its source.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Though Agent Tibor is only one of many Black Hoods leaders, his death will effectively destroy this enclave at its source.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Once more you prove your worth to the Dominion. Tibor has been killed, Viscera Enclave is in ruins, and Colonel Phelan is back amongst... friends.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I should let the Colonel rot in there, but how can I punish him if he is not rescued?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You will feature prominently in my reports to Axis Pheydra. Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've assassinated Agent Tibor, the Black Hoods leader in Viscera Enclave, and freed Colonel Phelan from a cell. Though the Colonel is free, it appears his willingness to ignore Agent Lex advice has brought him no small amount of disgrace.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: He's dead, he just doesn't know it yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: He's dead, he just doesn't know it yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can, if I so wish, detonate those charges right now. I suggest you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex has determined that planting explosive charges at key locations within Viscera Enclave will bring the entire cave down on itself. He has ordered you to do so while maintaining a stealthy profile.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Viscera Enclave must be brought down from within. Plant explosives at key locations in the cave complex and we will give the Exiles a surprise.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The explosive charges must be planted in Viscera Enclave before I will consider this mission a success.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The explosive charges must be planted in Viscera Enclave before I will consider this mission a success.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The bombs have been armed and time runs short. Now you must move forward with our original goal - freeing that fool, Colonel Phelan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Endeavor to plant these bombs quietly, if you can. Keep the fools in the dark.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They won't know what hit them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully planted a number of explosive charges inside Viscera Enclave. Soon, the Black Hoods' sanctuary will become their tomb.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It would be a shame if you experienced a tragic - not to mention fatal - accident.

localizedTextIdText: Dominion intelligence has revealed a small encampment of Exile insurgents in Murmurwood Forest. Agent Lex has ordered you to locate the Exile camp and destroy it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI has located a band of Exile insurgents in Murmurwood Forest. I want you to seek out this camp and burn it to the ground.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Exile camp in Murmurwood must be destroyed. We cannot allow the Exiles to gain any purchase in this frozen wilderness.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Exiles excel at hiding. Fortunately, it appears you excel at rooting them out and exterminating them. Congratulations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These Exiles must serve as an example to others. Show them no mercy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Agent Lex orders, you located the Exile insurgents' camp in Murmurwood Forest and burned it to the ground.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you afraid of fire, $(player.name)? Though destructive, it has its uses...

localizedTextIdText: The Black Hoods have been wiring animals with surveillance devices in Mumurwood Forest and using them to spy on the Dominion. Captain Daresh has asked you to hunt down and kill these creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Daresh at the Shatterforce Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Black Hoods are attaching surveillance devices - wires - to animals in Murmurwood. Neutralize those animals before they give our operations away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for animals that are equipped with strange devices, then kill them. We cannot afford to let even one of them in here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do you not feel remorse for killing all those poor little jabbits and pumera...? Ha! I am only jesting, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We've found wires on pumera, jabbits, and icetails in the forest. Happy hunting!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good hunting out there... I could not have done better myself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Captain Daresh request, you ventured into Murmurwood Forest and hunted down animals that had been wired with surveillance equipment by the Black Hoods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would probably make a mess of the mission, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Analysis of a Shatterforce Data Cassette you found in Viscera Enclave reveals it contains all manner of classified data concerning the Dominion's Shatterforces. If there are more $m(vitem=556) in Viscera Enclave, you must attempt to recover them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Daresh at the Shatterforce Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This data cassette contains reams of classified information regarding the Dominion's Shatterforces. This data can't be left in the hands of the Exiles!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This data cassette contains reams of classified information regarding the Dominion's Shatterforces. This data can't be left in the hands of the Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is it you want? I thought Agent Lex had given you an important assignment...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That the Exiles had this much classified data about the Shatterforces is disconcerting. You did well to recover it before it could be used against us.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have done well, and you should be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered all the $m(vitem=556) you could find inside Viscera Enclave and delivered them to Captain Daresh at the Shatterforce Outpost in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This data cassette is restricted to Shatterforce personnel of clearance level III or higher. Possession of this cassette by unauthorized personnel will result in summary execution.

localizedTextIdText: Clodius is the newly appointed warden of Deadrock Prison. It has a long established tradition whereby the warden himself fits shock collars to all new arrivals - a tradition that Clodius is determined to break. Why dirty his own hands when there are others to do the job?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Makaar Backbreaker in Deadrock Prison
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This facility's odious traditions require the warden, me, to fit shock collars onto new prisoners. I refuse to sully my hands by inducting these scum!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Who better than you to put collars on the new prisoners? You are certainly better suited to it than I am.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I find our Warden's lack of courage... disturbing. Collaring penned prey is a coward's hunt with little risk. How can he be so craven?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your willingness to dirty your hands in service to the Dominion speaks of loyalty. But are you ready to do butcher's work?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once you finish, report to my second, Makaar Backbreaker.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You earned the thanks of Warden Clodius by seeing to it that he didn't have to dirty his hands with the task of fitting shock collars to the new inmates of Deadrock Prison.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Blood of the Emperor! Do you understand nothing? Every inmate must be fitted with a shock collar upon arrival in Deadrock Prison.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Honestly! How else do you expect me to keep this filth under control?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I am the warden of this prison, a scion of a noble house - not some menial laborer! The traditions of my predecessors be damned!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You disappoint me, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Your contraband sweep of Deadrock Prison netted a surprising amount of medical supplies and empty weapons crates. Makaar Backbreaker believes the inmates have united under the leadership of one of their own, and he's set you the task of removing them from power.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Makaar Backbreaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: One of the inmates has risen to power. He must be hunted down and destroyed! As long as these beasts are united, they will remain a threat.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your blade is unbloodied. Why have you returned before your task is done? The Professor must be killed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You return victorious, covered in the blood of this 'Professor.' Today our foes taste defeat, and it is the salty flavor of their own blood!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: By my burning blood! I will see this 'Professor' destroyed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May honor guide your blade!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully defeated the man organizing the inmates of Deadrock Prison in Whitevale, one Professor McManus. Now leaderless, the inmates are without the ability to remove their collars and escape. Rioting, however, is a distinct possibility.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do you know it's one of the inmates?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This place is filled with the reek of fear. Only a strong presence could combat that.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Fellow guards have reported hearing about a 'Professor.' The inmates speak in whispers, but sharp ears can still hear.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: If I knew that, my blade would already be drunk with his blood!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You stink of fear!

localizedTextIdText: Animal Handler Akirak has requested your assistance in patrolling the southern quadrant of Deadrock Prison for escapees. Use one of his pumera to sniff them out!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Animal Handler Akirak in Deadrock Prison
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Prisoners will always attempt to escape. We must prevent them from doing so using trained pumera. Patrol the prison and ensure the Exiles do not get away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you return? Follow the keen nose of the pumera to the fearful stench of an Exile escapee and punish him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: After that demonstration, I expect the prisoners to think twice before attempting to escape again. You have done well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: How fitting to use the nose of a beast to sniff out other, hidden beasts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using your guard pumera, you were able to sniff out and stop the prisoners from escaping Deadrock Prison in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: No one will escape on my watch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your blood is not Draken. Your blood is weak.

localizedTextIdText: The prisoners of Deadrock Prison's maximum security section are rioting. Use Guard Zaggle Experimental Jet Pack to propel yourself towards the guard towers, then use the rocket launcher to help the guards quell the riot.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Guard Zaggle in Deadrock Prison
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Maximum security riot! Must test new experimental riot equipment - jet pack and rockets! Talk to guard, he give details.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get to guard tower, use jet pack and rockets before riot ends! If not, will have to wait hours for next riot!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You come down on inmates very hard. I approve. Equipment is worth weight in loftite!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go go go! Now now now! Before riot ends!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help you guys put down the riot.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The inmates didn't stand a chance.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You came down hard on rioting prisoners in Deadrock Prison, blasting several of the deadliest inmates into smithereens.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you want me to do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Test new rocket launcher. Safer testing from far away, so you test new jetpack, too! Fly to top of tower, blast rioters! Boom!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes yes! Must set strong example! Inmates cause trouble, get blasted! No more trouble, yes?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Afraid of heights? Silly! Jet pack safe! Fall is deadly part!

localizedTextIdText: The most dangerous inmate of Deadrock Prison is one Vox Strongblock. Warden Clodius has placed the inmate in solitary confinement and issued an execution order to anyone willing to take on such a challenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Warden Clodius in Deadrock Prison
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: EXECUTION ORDER ISSUED\nBy the authority vested in me by the Emperor, I, Warden Clodius, hereby order the summary execution of Vox Strongblock.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: EXECUTION ORDER ISSUED\nBy the authority vested in me by the Emperor, I, Warden Clodius, hereby order the summary execution of Vox Strongblock.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes? I do hope you haven't let that... thing... escape. Strongblock is to be executed, not handed a new lease on life!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your assistance in this matter is appreciated. I believe a monetary reward will best communicate my satisfaction.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Unfazed by the deadly reputation of Vox Strongblock, you entered the solitary confinement area of Deadrock Prison and defeated the prison's most infamous prisoner!

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Rezzo has discovered strange nanites in the partial samples you were able to extract from the Ascendancy kidnap victim before he exploded. Now the Chua wants you to use a stealthbot to discreetly scan Ascendancy cultists at the Truthbound Encampment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Rezzo in Camp Virtue
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Partial samples reveal trace amounts of strange nanites. You must use stealthbot 71-X to scan cultists in Ascendancy camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you here? Use stealthbot 71-X to scan cultists! Go! Learn truth about nanites or be punished!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Success! Very surprising! Scans very good, too. See there? Cultists infested with nanites... but that's not all. Nanite origin is Eldan!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good you're willing to follow orders. No other choice available.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So. Cultists inject themselves with nanites, augment organic systems. Very bad news.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll scan cultists with your stealthbot.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Why would they have Eldan nanites in them?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your surreptitious scans of the Ascendancy cultists have revealed that they are injecting themselves with Eldan nanites. What could it mean?
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll scan cultists with your stealthbot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nanite is machine, only very, very tiny. So tiny, cannot be seen without microscope. Naturally, Chua prefer huge machines. Like planet-reapers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're just as useless as my old assistant, only not dead yet.

localizedTextIdText: You found an Eldan terminal which contained information on Eldan technology. Find other terminals in the Truthbound Encampment to learn more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Rezzo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This terminal contains information on Eldan technology. Perhaps you should look for other Eldan terminals to uncover the truth about the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This terminal contains information on Eldan technology. Perhaps you should look for other Eldan terminals to uncover the truth about the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Answer in Ascendancy encampment somewhere! You! Go find answer! Do it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What what? Busy busy! You should be busy, too! You find something interesting? Show! Tell! Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Valuable information, yes yes! Must utilize in research!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You accessed the Eldan Terminals and discovered the truth behind the Ascendancy's augmentation process, gathering valuable data for Captain Sevina and Scientist Rezzo.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Rezzo has reprogrammed the nanites in the Omni-Plasm you collected. He has instructed you to deploy the reprogrammed nanites on the most recently-initiated Truthbound Convert in the Truthbound Encampment to test the nanites' effectiveness.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Rezzo in Camp Virtue
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There! Eldan nanites reprogrammed! Now... to test results. Deploy reprogrammed nanites on recent Truthbound converts, yes?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Nanites deployed? Augmentation reversal successful? You don't know? You must be lazy or stupid. Go find out, now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Nanites deployed? Augmentation reversal successful? You don't know? You must be lazy or stupid. Go find out, now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, well. So much for that! Cultist augmentation obviously irreversible. Too bad, so sad! But now, other work to do. Important work... urgent work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Test on recently-augmented converts. Other cultists too far gone for treatment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much happened while you were away. Test subjects escaped. Very dangerous now!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The augmentation process used by the Ascendancy to create their converts appears to be irreversible. Not only did the reprogrammed nanites fail to counteract the Eldan augmentation, the attempts resulted in intense pain, suffering, and death for the unfortunate Truthbound Convert you targeted.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Old assistant never said "no" and he still died.

localizedTextIdText: Since extracting nanite samples from living test subjects has failed so miserably, Scientist Rezzo has asked you to venture into the Truthbound Encampment and collect nanite samples - referred to as Omni-Plasm by the cultists - in their raw form.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Rezzo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Extracted samples useless. Require raw nanites from source reservoirs in cultist enclave. Go get samples. Cultists speak of "Omni-Plasm."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Simple. Omni-Plasm samples required. Go find samples. Laziness accomplishes nothing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finished? Good. You can keep your job. Now to analyze Omni-Plasm and reprogram nanites.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Omni-plasm may be source. May be nonsense. You find out.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get the samples for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected samples of Omni-Plasm from reservoirs in the Truthbound Encampment, and Scientist Rezzo has declared his intention to reprogram the nanites.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get the samples for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bad time to be lazy. Very bad time.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Sevina has decided that you have proven beyond any doubt that the Ascendancy cultists pose a serious - and heretical - threat to the Dominion. She has ordered you to kill Ascendancy cultists at the Truthbound Encampment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Sevina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have seen enough of the Ascendancy's filth to recognize the threat their heresy poses to the Dominion and the Vigilant Church. They must be purged.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We, the vigilant, must root out heresy wherever it rears its ugly head. It falls to you to kill these apostates and cleanse their filth with blood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We, the vigilant, must root out heresy wherever it rears its ugly head. It falls to you to kill these apostates and cleanse their filth with blood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The wicked have been destroyed by the strong hand of justice! Your actions have guaranteed that this blasphemous disease will spread no further!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Killing is never an easy task, but you must destroy this cult.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your vigilance is an inspiration to us all, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I shall purge the cultists for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Captain Sevina orders, you took swift and decisive action against the heretics of the Ascendancy and cleansed the cult's foul sacrilege with the blood of its members.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I fear not. Who but the Scions can peer into the heart of a cultist and discern whether there is any good left to salvage? For our own safety, we must act now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I should hope your reluctance to strike does not stem from your own heresy.

localizedTextIdText: Settler Cyros, one of the Ascendancy's victims, has escaped Camp Virtue and killed a number of guards in the process. Toric Antevian, the commander of the Radiant Legion, has asked you to hunt down Cyros in the Truthbound Encampment and put him out of his misery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Toric Antevian in the Truthbound Encampment
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Cyros, overcome by the Ascendancy's poison, has escaped. He must be found and released from his torment. Will you accept this holy undertaking?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: After his escape, Cyros killed a number of guards before fleeing towards the Truthbound Encampment. You'll likely find him there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: After his escape, Cyros killed a number of guards before fleeing towards the Truthbound Encampment. You'll likely find him there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've succeeded at your task, and poor Cyros has been laid to rest. The Radiant Legion thanks you, as does the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I know I can count on you. In the meantime, I have a... personal matter to attend to.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If only everyone possessed your resolve, we might all triumph against our demons.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put Cyros out of his misery.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was an honor to serve.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Toric Antevian orders, you tracked Settler Cyros to an Eldan Exo-Lab beneath the Truthbound Encampment and put an end to his blasphemous and tortured existence.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will find him and kill him.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will find him and kill him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Rezzo's best attempts to reverse the augmentation process have failed. Even Valeria, Cyros's sister, understands that he is too far gone. His only salvation lies in his death.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: After all you've done, I wouldn't think you'd lack the conviction that faith gives us all.

localizedTextIdText: After investigating Ranger Forster abandoned campsite, you uncovered clues indicating he abandoned his hunt after noticing mysterious activity in Grim Valley nearby. Now his wife, Madeline, has asked you to track down his whereabouts and verify his well-being.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Madeline Forster via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Please, help my husband. For him to abandon his camp like that... he must be in real trouble!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If my husband was tracking in the woodlands, you should be able to follow the trail he was on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank the stars you found Devin! I can't tell you how happy I am he's all right! Thank you! Thank you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll bring my husband back to me, won't you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Ranger Forster and discovered a hidden slave operation under way in Grim Valley!

localizedTextIdText: Ranger Forster, wounded during his escape from slavers in Grim Valley outside Gallow, has asked you to stop Headmistress Hilda Grim and the Darkspur Cartel's slave operation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ranger Forster via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I ain't worth a damn in a fight right now. I'm too banged up. You gotta deliver justice to the Cartel's slavemaster, a woman named Grim... Hilda Grim.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hilda likes to keep control up near the Grimstone Lumbermill. Look for her further up the hill, and be careful. She's one cruel harpy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hilda likes to keep control up near the Grimstone Lumbermill. Look for her further up the hill, and be careful. She's one cruel harpy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hilda's dead? I don't think I'll ever forget the terrible things she did. You were able to finish what I started... and almost died for.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I just want to get back to my wife... but I don't know if I'll make it....
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Madeline would be a widow if not for you. Thanks, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Those slavers are as good as dead.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed Headmistress Hilda Grim. That's a fitting end for such a despicable slaver.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll admit, killing's pretty harsh, but these folks are monsters!

localizedTextIdText: After arriving in Tremor Ridge, Trooper Campbell instructed you to report to Deadeye Brightland.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Deadeye Brightland in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Head on down into camp and report to Deadeye Brightland. He can brief you on the Marauder situation plaguing the folks of Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Head on down to Tremor Ridge and speak with Deadeye Brightland. He runs the show 'round here. He's kinda surly, if you get my drift.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Exiles in trouble always stick together, and the folk of Tremor Ridge need our help. You here to help us out?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Word is you're a hero. Let's see what you're made of.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Time to run these Marauders outta Algoroc on a rail... or in a box.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll speak with him right away.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I will do anything I can to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After speaking with Deadeye Brightland, you learned that the Exiles of Tremor Ridge are being threatened by a group known as the Deadstar Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll speak with him right away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess you aren't the hero we was lookin' for.

localizedTextIdText: You found the corpse of a fallen Dominion explorer, Sevrin Pageo. You should return his dogtags to Director Faustius outside the XAS Research Cave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Director Faustius outside the XAS Research Cave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears as though you were not the first person sent into the XAS Research Cave. You should return Explorer Pageo's dogtags to Director Faustius.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It appears as though you were not the first person sent into the drill site. You should return Explorer Pageo's dogtags to Director Faustius.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I... thank you. We lost contact with Sevrin immediately after he entered the caves. I didn't think it necessary to inform you of his disappearance.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll deliver these to Director Faustius.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned Explorer Pageo dogtags to Director Faustius.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll deliver these to Director Faustius.

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Ziggle is bemoaning the waste of expensive shock collars still attached to Exile prisoners who have died trying to escape through the shellark-infested waters near Deadrock Prison. Jump into the water and retrieve them from the dead inmates.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Doctor Ziggle near Deadrock Prison
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dead Exiles clutter up water. Shock collars they wear expensive, very expensive! Someone must retrieve them. Someone like... you! Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why loitering? Get shock collars before they rust. Too long under water ruins sensitive components. So go! Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Waste not, want not. After drying out, collars ready for next round of prisoners. You save Deadrock prison money, so I give you some for reward.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Would get collars myself, but I'm allergic to death.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Drying out and cleaning, actually. Smells like shellark poo. Disgusting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected shock collars from the dead inmates floating in the shellark-infested waters near Deadrock Prison and returned them to Doctor Ziggle so they can be recycled.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need the collars?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Collars very expensive! My own design! Stupid warden willing to let them rust. Waste of my talent!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bah! $(player.name) useless! Just like imbecile guards!

localizedTextIdText: To be seen as a true warrior amongst the Bloodfire Clan, one must be deemed worthy by the ancestors that have passed. You must go on a spirit journey at the Blood Altar in Bloodfire Village. Meet and defeat the spirits of three great Bloodfire Warriors.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bloodshaman Sorkan at the base of the Blood Altar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You desire the acceptance of the Bloodfire Clan? Then enter the spirit world. Sacrifice a warpig and defeat the three Bloodfire Warriors for their acceptance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Capture a warpig to sacrifice. Bring it to the Blood Altar to begin the ritual.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The great Bloodfire Warriors were extremely pleased with your skill. They have deemed you worthy of participating in the Great Hunt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once the ritual has begun, you cannot turn back!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now go on with your journey. Bring honor to Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll prove my worth to them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was an honor... and quite a trip.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were deemed worthy of becoming a Bloodfire Warrior by the spirits of three great Bloodfire Warriors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You are not of the Bloodfire Clan. If you wish to stay in our village and hunt on our savannahs, you must first prove your worth. To be seen as a true warrior, you must be deemed worthy by the spirits of the great Bloodfire Warriors that have passed on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Take this time to prepare yourself. Return when you are ready.

localizedTextIdText: You've killed the vicious beast known as Yihwa. You should return the creature's head to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return Yihwa's Head to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The head of this vicious beast would prove your hunting prowess to the inhabitants of Bloodfire Village. Return it to Huntress Kezzia and claim your reward!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You have yet to return the head of Yihwa to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You killed mighty Yihwa? Lesser hunters met death between its jaws. It will be my pleasure to display its head as proof of your great skill.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this head to Huntress Kezzia.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The head of Yihwa is now proudly displayed by Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.

localizedTextIdText: You've stopped Ook from causing any further mischief, and then some! Deliver Ook's head to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village and expand her trophy collection.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the head of Ook to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've taken the head of the mighty Ook. Perhaps Huntress Kezzia would cherish this fuzzy, albeit gory, gift.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What is this furry monstrosity? Is it the head of the mighty Ook? Your prowess in battle is... impressive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hmm. I might have underestimated you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think Kezzia might like this severed head.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: May your trophy collection grow large, Huntress.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The head of Ook is now prominently displayed next to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.

localizedTextIdText: The golden pumera, Kelfa, was in your sights. You decided to kill it and lay its pelt in front of Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return Kelfa's pelt to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kelfa, the golden pumera, lies dead by your hand. It is known that Huntress Kezzia desires its magnificent pelt for a rug.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The pelt of Kelfa? For me? What a remarkable gift, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What Draken warrior wouldn't want this fine piece?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Only the finest pelts for your rug, Huntress.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The golden pelt of Kelfa has been laid before Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.

localizedTextIdTitle: Crafting for the Exiles in Algoroc
localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow wants to teach you about tradeskills. Time to get to work!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Supervisor Arborgreen at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The frontier's a tough place, but we can be tougher! The settlements and fighters need supplies to keep fighting the Dominion, and you can help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Come on, let's get things done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With every product we deliver, we're one step closer to winning the fight with the Dominion once and for all! Are you ready to get started?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You want to help us out? Great!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Crafting Trainer Thorpe and I will get you all set up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found your way to the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow. Now you can pick up a tradeskill or two to help your fellow Exiles make a home on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Supervisor Arborgreen in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd rethink that answer if I were you.

localizedTextIdText: You helped Judge Kain by bringing justice to a lawless frontier. You also destroyed the dastardly Morek Throg, who - with the help of the Darkspur Cartel - nearly took over the town of Gallow. Chronicler Herrick Grenfell will be relieved to hear of your victory.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chronicler Herrick Grenfell in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Just because Algoroc is a lawless frontier don't mean we ain't got justice. Some bastards gotta learn that the hard way. Throg was one of 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You know as well as I do that Herrick Grenfell works in the Chronicle House in Gallow. He's a good man who abides by the law. Give him the news.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you... do you have any news about Judge Kain?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So Throg's dead, is he? That despicable reprobate had it comin', if you ask me. You've saved this town, $(player.class). You've got our thanks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Chronicler Grenfell oughtta know about today's events. Go and tell him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe you can give me the whole story sometime.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Gallow has survived because of your heroic efforts. You killed Morek Throg and destroyed the gangs of the Darkspur Cartel under his control, bringing justice to a lawless frontier. Now Chronicler Herrick Grenfell and the good people of Gallow can begin the process of rebuilding their lives here on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe I ought to smack some sense into you with my new arm.

localizedTextIdText: The inmates of Deadrock Prison are always looking for new ways to conceal contraband. Aid Makaar Backbreaker by performing a search of the facility and reporting what you find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Makaar Backbreaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Clodius believes these caged beasts lack the will to fight. But a predator does not so easily turn prey. Search their cells. Kill any prisoners that resist.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What makes you think our enemies would abandon their courage? They must be hiding something... somewhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the wings of Werza! This riddle is not so hard to make out. Medical supplies and weapons crates... this smacks of organization.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not feel this hunt is beneath you. These beasts are feral!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The prison may be in trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered a vast quantity of contraband stashed away in Whitevale's Deadrock Prison. Makaar Backbreaker is pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have chosen a coward's path.

localizedTextIdText: [DO NOT LOCALIZE] $?f(player)/ICI/Black Hoods/NSA
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: [DO NOT LOCALIZE] $?f/ICI/Black Hoods/NSA
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: [DO NOT LOCALIZE] $?f(player)/ICI/Black Hoods/NSA

localizedTextIdText: The guards of Deadrock Prison in Whitevale have noticed an unusually high percentage of hostile inmates. If left unchecked, their aggression may spread to other inmates and result in a riot. Makaar Backbreaker has requested that you eliminate the threat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Makaar Backbreaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are hostile inmates that must be butchered like beasts. This will serve as an example to the others while removing a threat to the prison.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hostile inmates still flood their cells with poisonous rhetoric. Cut them down before entire prison is infected!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You wield that weapon like a master. If you and I were enemies, you would be a truly worthy foe!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We cannot afford to let this aggression spread through the population.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll make an example of them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the request of Makaar Backbreaker, you dealt with the hostile inmates of Deadrock Prison. Permanently.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get out of my sight!

localizedTextIdText: Chua twins Engineer Giba and Engineer Biba are in need of assistants to test the latest iteration of their mind control device. The test is simple: take control of a mammodin and use it to destroy poachers in Bloodfire Savannah. The fate of their research rests on you!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Engineer Giba at Spearclaw Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mind control device. You see? Attached to mammodin. With explosives. Lots of explosives. You take for test drive, yes? Poachers make good target.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Talk to Biba! He show you! Take mammodin for a spin, then kaboom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Device functional! Mammodin exploded, blew poachers to bits! Do you... feel different?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Biba will show you. Speak to him! Control mammodin of mass destruction!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cozmotronic! Other test subjects not so lucky! Optimization successful!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This seems like an... interesting solution.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I saw the savannah through new eyes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your exploits as senior research assistant to Giba and Biba will go down in Chua history as one of the most explosive experiments of all time.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why are we doing this again?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Use puny brain to guide mammodin to poachers. Set off explosives, blow poachers to pieces. Remember! Explosives volatile! Avoid other wildlife!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Silence! Not minion's place to ask why, only do! Now go see my twin Biba! Mammodin not blow up by itself!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Device needs testing! You must test it!

localizedTextIdText: Exile forces in Sunderstone have set up proximity mines along the perimeter of their settlement. Corporal Vexus has asked that you dispose of these mines before they result in Dominion casualties.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Vexus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exile cowards have planted mines on the perimeter of their settlement, they have. If we don't dispose of 'em, we're bound to suffer more casualties.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have them proximity mines been disposed of? We got a patrol headin' down to Sunderstone soon, and I don't want 'em harmed. Nope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Strike a light! Good job disposin' of them mines, gov! The last squad reported the way's clear now. You saved a number of lives today, you did.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I like your attitude! Hike down to Sunderstone and take care of them mines.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope you can help out again sometime.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully disarmed the Exile proximity mines for Corporal Vexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So much for loyalty and honor, gov.

localizedTextIdText: Exile forces in Sunderstone have set up proximity mines along the perimeter of their settlement. Corporal Vexus is looking to contract the disposal of these mines before they result in Dominion casualties.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Vexus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nProximity mines have been placed around Sunderstone by the Exile cowards. A reward is offered to anyone who disarms these proximity mines.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: PLEASE NOTE\nCorporal Vexus will pay out a reward to any citizen who dares to disarm the Exile proximity mines outside of Sunderstone Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You daft or somethin'? Them mines ain't disarmed yet. You'd best answer the call of duty, gov, or there ain't no reward for the likes of you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did a fine job cleanin' up them mines, gov. Bloody Exile cowards'll be out there plantin' more mines soon enough, they will.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here, mate. Have a spot of coin for your trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully disarmed the Exile proximity mines near Sunderstone for Corporal Vexus.

localizedTextIdText: Acolyte Maros of the Radiant Legion has requested your aid. A group of men dressed in hoods have arrived in Palerock Post and have been preaching to the lowborn about "the truth" in Whitevale. Seek these Truthbound Preacher out and learn what you can from them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Major Glacian Aurelius in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Men have appeared in Palerock, preaching some heathen religion to the lowborn. I would ask you to speak with them and see who they serve.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to these preachers and learn what you can, then we will discuss your findings. We cannot afford to let them corrupt our lowborn citizens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am rather busy, citizen. This had better be important.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Maros is dead? How dreadful. He was investigating the Ascendancy. That bizarre cult is obviously becoming a threat to the Church and the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They preach about "the truth" as if the validity of the Radiant Church is in doubt! Feh!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Once the Exiles are defeated, we will teach these heretics a lesson.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to a number of Truthbound Preacher in Palerock Post and learned they serve the Ascendancy, but when you went to rendezvous with Acolyte Maros in Whitevale, you found he'd been murdered.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why don't you ask them yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Are you blind? I am a member of the Radiant Legion! These heretics would never reveal their purpose to me, for I am a sworn acolyte of the Vigilant Church!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Dominus will not be pleased with your apathy.

localizedTextIdText: Major Glacian Aurelius has posted a bounty on the Bounty Board in Palerock Post. A giant outside Palerock Post is threatening the Dominion's control of Whitevale, and the major is willing to reward anyone who dares to kill the beast.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nA giant known as Traggis threatens Dominion control of Whitevale. Join your comrades in service to the Emperor and destroy the wretched beast!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED\nA giant known as Traggis threatens Dominion control of Whitevale. Join your comrades in service to the Emperor and destroy the wretched beast!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have many pressing issues competing for my attention, not the least of which is a meddlesome giant. I trust you can take care of it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Reconnaissance units have reported the giant, Traggis, has met a swift end by your hand. Splendid. Your loyalty and bravery are worthy of commendation.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: We can take down a giant!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Traggis the Colossus and reported your success to Major Glacian Aurelius. The major paid you well for the deed, and commended you on your loyalty to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: We can take down a giant!

localizedTextIdText: Brewmaster Krazog at the Gas 'n' Guzzle has posted a job to collect ingredients for a batch of his specialty beer - Gutpunch Brew! You'll need to collect $(vitem=258) from Ringtail razortails, $m(vitem=259) from Whitespring spikehordes, and fresh water from Frostdawn Bay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Brewmaster Krazog at the Gas 'n' Guzzle
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: STANDING ORDER:\nBrewmaster Krazog needs Gutpunch Brew ingredients! Deliver any frozen rockfruit and whitesprings humours to Krazog at the Gas 'n' Guzzle!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: STANDING ORDER:\nBrewmaster Krazog needs Gutpunch Brew ingredients! Deliver any frozen rockfruit and whitesprings humours to Krazog at the Gas 'n' Guzzle!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya got what I need yet? The ingredients, ya know... for the Gutpunch Brew. Ain't ya never been told not to keep an artiste waitin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey! Ya got the good stuff for me... this'll make a good batch of Gutpunch Brew! It's sellin' faster than I can make it. This helps a lot!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll need more tomorrow! Just check the Jobs Terminal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected additional ingredients that Brewmaster Krazog needed to create his Gutpunch Brew, and he rewarded you with another taste of it. Lucky you!

localizedTextIdText: Trooper Gorok has asked you to gather Lore Runes{p: Lore Runes} from Fuel Cell scattered around Annihilator Silo 14. That should power the shield generator for Excavation Base Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deposit Lore Runes{p: Lore Runes} into the Eldan Shield Generator outside the Excavation Base Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need a shield that'll hold up to the Annihilator's blasts. We got a shield generator nearby, but nothin' to power it. Ya up for some scroungin'?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: That generator ain't gonna power itself. See if you can find any energy cores inside fuel cells. They're scattered all over the place.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This shield generator isn't currently active. It probably needs a power source, like energy cells taken from fuel cells.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This shield generator can project a field large enough to protect the entire XAS camp. All that remains is to load in the Eldan energy cores.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Look for energy cores inside the fuel cells that're scattered around.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Eldan shield generator bursts to life!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find something to power it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Lore Runes{p: Lore Runes} you collected fully powered an Eldan shield to protect the Excavation Base Camp. The FCON mercs are now safe from the Annihilator's laser blasts.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find something to power it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deposit Lore Runes{p: Lore Runes} into the Eldan Shield Generator
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get outta my sight, then! I can't stand cowards like you!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: adding max text because it is fun and because Alvin needs to test some stuff. Sentence M's and W's all around, but there doesn't seem to be many in this sentence, which kind of makes me a little sad. I wonder how much text I can put here before it breaks. Did it break yet? No? Damn. I still have a long way to go before reaching the maximum character limit. Just a few more. Moooooooooooooooore. Is that cheating? Should I change it? What? How you doin' buddy? Well that sucks. This is not at all useful to you
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm max sizing the player responses with lots of ms and ws because ms and ws are awwwwwsome. See? Mwmwmwmwmwmwmwmw. this is a sentence??

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker asked you to take some $m(vitem=324) from the augmented creatures in the excavation site, so you can learn more about their seemingly irreversible metamorphosis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Damn! This Eldan augmentation tech is turning our people into mindless zombies! Get me some tissue samples. Maybe I can reverse the process!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get a move on, darlin'. I need augmented tissue samples. If I can check 'em out, I can try to figure out a way to reverse the augmentation process.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blast it! I was afraid of this! That augmentation is changin' things at the molecular level. There's no way to fix that without killin' the host.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This whole situation's one big mess!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Can things get any worse?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered $m(vitem=324) from augmented creatures around the Eldan Excavation Site, providing the XAS with much-needed information about the augmentation process... though a cure is, as yet, a long way off.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you know about augmentation?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Do you understand how it works?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I probably know as much about it as you do, which is a fancy way of sayin' almost nothin' at all. Eldan technology can be awesome and scary at the same time. This is one of the scary parts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Looks to me like they inject some kind of fluid into people, resulting in rapid cybernetic enhancement... but I never seen anything like it before. We're in it up to our ears for certain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hate that we gotta kill our own folks for the samples, but it's necessary.

localizedTextIdText: You found a wanted sign that sent you after the Tooth of Chompy the Devourer on Bloodfire Savannah. Legends speak of an elusive creature with teeth that can pierce metal and a hunger that drives it to devour anything in its path. By defeating this monstrosity, you can claim recognition from Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Huntress Kezzia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: Tooth of Chompy the Devourer. Hunters speak of an elusive creature with teeth that can pierce metal and a hunger that drives it to devour anything in its path.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Chompy the Devourer has been spotted on the fringes of Bloodfire Savannah, north of Bloodfire Village. TRAVELERS BEWARE. It is always hungry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you hunting Chompy the Devourer? It is a worthy adversary. I wish you luck on your hunt.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have slain Chompy the Devourer! I thought such a thing was impossible, yet here you stand. I will spread tales of your hunt far and wide.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Now this is what I call a challenge!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Chompy the Devourer, a monstrous chompacabra that once terrorized Bloodfire Savannah.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Chompy the Devourer will eat anything, from jabbits to mammodin. It will devour mighty hunters and swallow their weapons whole. Other predators flee at its approach.

localizedTextIdText: You have slain Chompy the Devourer, a creature with teeth that can pierce metal and a hunger that drives it to devour anything in its path. Claim your trophy and your glory from Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Huntress Kezzia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have slain Chompy the Devourer. This is surely a worthy contribution to the Great Hunt. Bring his tooth to Huntress Kezzia and claim your glory.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still seeking worthy prey?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have slain Chompy the Devourer! I thought such a thing was impossible, yet here you stand. I will spread tales of your hunt far and wide.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This trophy will bring me glory.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Chompy the Devourer, a monstrous chompacabra that terrorized Bloodfire Savannah.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Rezzo isn't very forthcoming about the conditions of the Ascendancy's escaped kidnap victims. In fact, it's quite possible he doesn't know - yet. In order to learn more, he's asked you to utilize the Radiant Medical Station in Camp Virtue to extract tissue samples from the Ascendancy's victims.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Rezzo in Camp Virtue
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kidnap victims? New test subjects, you mean! Yes! Seems fine to me. Take samples from subjects to be sure. Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Extract samples from test subject. Can't answer questions witout samples! So take! Take!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Extraction failure! Maybe you did it wrong? Possible... but unlikely. Successful procedure will require more subjects.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes yes! Use others hard work to reveal the truth about the Ascendancy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Live subjects too few in number. Still, last extraction not a total failure.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Where do we find more subjects?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You attempted to extract samples from the Ascendancy's kidnap victims using the Radiant Medical Station in Camp Virtue, only to learn that the procedure is fatal. Scientist Rezzo does not appear to be bothered by this turn of events.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do I extract the samples?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ascendancy test subjects injected by mysterious substance. Nature of substance unknown. Must extract sample of substance - for science!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Use Radiant medical station. Push button, sample extracted. Very easy!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Who knows? Who cares? Not Rezzo! Now get samples before Captain asks more questions!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Come back! Last assistant's death not indicative of yours. Or maybe it is!

localizedTextIdText: A cult known as the Ascendancy has been kidnapping Dominion settlers. A handful of the victims have escaped, and are currently being treated by Scientist Rezzo in Camp Virtue. Captain Sevina has asked you to speak to Rezzo and learn more about the situation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Scientist Rezzo in Camp Virtue
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ascendancy - an insidious cult - is kidnapping Dominion citizens. Some victims have escaped, and are being treated by Scientist Rezzo.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Some of the victims appear to be unharmed. As for the others... you really should speak to Scientist Rezzo. He can tell you more than I can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What what? Busy! Always busy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My new assistant? Good! Previous assistant unfit for duty. Lazy. Left much undone. Don't make same mistake, you'll end up unfit for duty, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes, that would be prudent. He should be able to inform you more about their... conditions.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Minor accident. Still deadly, but minor. Might find him someday. Then again... might not.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Scientist Rezzo in Camp Virtue. The Chua has mistaken you for his replacement assistant, and he either doesn't understand or doesn't care that you aren't who he thinks you are.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is the condition of the victims?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They are psychopaths and heretics. They claim to know "the truth" to eternal life. Obviously, the only path to truth is through the Scions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Some appear untouched physically, but they still bear the mental wounds of those who have endured much at the hands of madmen. The others...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It is perhaps easier for you to see for yourself. Scientist Rezzo is a brilliant physician, and he is determined to learn the specifics of the Ascendancy's methods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What of your legendary skill, $(player.class)? What of your much-touted bravery? Were they lies?

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex has ordered you to hunt down and kill agents of the Black Hoods in Mumurwood Forest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Black Hoods skulk in these woods with impunity. I cannot allow them to observe or interfere with our operations. Your assignment is to kill them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find and eliminate the Black Hoods operatives in Murmurwood - immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find and eliminate the Black Hoods operatives in Murmurwood - immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Black Hoods have lost a number of valuable operatives today. The more of their experienced agents we can kill, the worse off they will be.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure that your methods are both deadly and efficient.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed a number of Black Hoods agents in Murmurwood Forest for Agent Lex.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll kill the Black Hoods agents.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll kill the Black Hoods agents.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you would be useful. My calculations were incorrect.

localizedTextIdText: The inmates of Deadrock Prison have begun to riot! What's worse, the Exile prisoners have somehow armed themselves with Dominion weapons and are attempting to take control of the facility. Guardsman Draxx has requested you kill the riot leaders and rescue any trapped Prison Guard you come across.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Guardsman Draxx in Deadrock Prison
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles have finally shown their teeth! Kill their leaders and they'll abandon their love of battle quick enough. Keep an eye out for fallen guards, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The leaders of this riot must be immediately put to the sword! Trapped prison guards must also be saved, for we will need them to mop up afterward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Victory is yours, $(player.name). Without their leaders, these honorless beasts will soon lose heart and surrender their blades.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not return until your targets have been eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the three inmates leading the riot at Deadrock Prison: Eli Redstone, Sergeant Kruka, and Zynian Bloodleaf. Without their leaders to unite them, the inmates should soon disperse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your fear is nauseating.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile prisoners are rioting, and Guardsman Draxx wants to teach them a lesson. Hop onto a Deadrock Patrol Copter in Deadrock Prison and drop tear gas onto the hostile prisoners as they rampage below you in the prison yard.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Guardsman Draxx in Deadrock Prison
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must bring the rioting prisoners to their knees! Board a patrol copter and drop tear gas on them from above! Make them regret their pitiful rebellion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I do not smell tear gas on the wind. Have you failed your mission to rain tear gas down on the Exiles, or have you merely failed to start?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent! There is a sublime joy that comes with seeing the Exiles weep bloody tears! I commend you, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Our Patrol Copter is not far. Go there at once and take to the skies!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rode a Deadrock Patrol Copter and dropped tear gas onto rioting prisoners in Deadrock Prison.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm headed to the copter now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool. If you will not serve, I will find someone who will.

localizedTextIdText: Personnel at Crosswind Post are being kidnapped, and Scout Grekka has contacted you requesting help. Speak to her to learn more about the situation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Scout Grekka at Crosswind Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We could use some help at Crosswind Post. Our people are being kidnapped, and we can't afford to forget about them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All our troubles stem from those ruins over there. Take a good long look - that's Kel Vishal!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do me a favor and hurry. I'd hate for there to be none of us left when you finally do show up.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be there as soon as I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to Scout Grekka at Crosswind Post.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Slag you, buddy.

localizedTextIdText: Archaeologist Wyn thinks that there are Eldan artifacts buried in the dirt mounds in Windy Hollow, but the native chompacabras won't let her get close enough to check. She's asked you to search the dirt mounds for Eldan artifacts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Archaeologist Wyn in the Windy Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm pretty sure there are Eldan artifacts in those dirt mounts, but the chompacabras won't let me get close enough. Think you can help a girl out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I think if you're real careful you can get artifacts from the mounds without angering the chompers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew there were artifacts buried in those mounds! It's too bad you had to kill some of those cute little chompers, though.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The chompers - they're too cute to kill - so be careful checking the mounds!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Behind those slavering jaws and razor-sharp teeth, I'm sure the chompers are super cuddly!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I found some Eldan relics for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to search the dirt mounds for Eldan artifacts on her behalf despite the constant chompacabra attacks.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're just a big meanie!

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Varen of the XAS has gone missing. His colleagues are offering a reward to anyone who can find the missing doctor. He was last seen in the vicinity of Stormtalon's Lair.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Locate Doctor Varen inside Stormtalon's Lair
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MISSING IN ACTION\nBe advised that Doctor Varen of the XAS is missing. Last seen in the vicinity of Stormtalon's Lair. Reward offered for proof of life.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MISSING IN ACTION\nBe advised that Doctor Varen of the XAS is missing. Last seen in the vicinity of Stormtalon's Lair. Reward offered for proof of life.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in Brightland's Beard are you doin' in a place like this? Don't you see all them murderin' Pell running around?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I appreciate the rescue, but I can't leave just yet. Need to make sense of what the Pell are doin' with all this primal air energy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What the Pell are doin' here is gonna be bad news all around for everyone.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Doctor Varen inside Stormtalon's lair, but he is unwilling to leave without learning more about what the Thundercall Pell are doing with their creepy ritual.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Locate Doctor Varen in Stormtalon's Lair

localizedTextIdText: The XAS scientists have a Captive Pell confined to a cage at the XAS Forward Camp. Interrogate the Captive Pell and see if you can learn more about the Pell and their intentions.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lead Scientist Armin at the XAS Forward Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The child of the gods will come forth soon! Stormtalon will be born, and you will be blown away by the tempest he brings!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It is too late for you! Stormtalon will rise! Stormtalon will kill you all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've been unable to make heads or tails of what that captive Pell is babbling about. Maybe you could have a go?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Pell we've captured certainly rants and raves, doesn't he? Still, you've been able to suss out what he's talking about, haven't you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Laugh while you can, outsider! Long have we waited for Stormtalon! His wrath will be unassailable!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No. No, it doesn't. I just hope we can stop whatever the Pell have planned.
