localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You learned much from the Captive Pell and reported your findings to Lead Scientist Armin.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: It's been so nice talking to you.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You will meet him soon enough, outsider, and you will despair! His coming will be as a storm that washes your kind away!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The god-seed has been fed with energy from the Focus of Air! Your puny souls will provide the final sustenance that will bring him forth!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You are outsiders! You do not belong! We have been given a mandate by the Makers, while you steal that which is not yours!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your ears are not ready for the truth, outsider! Go! Go away!

localizedTextIdText: You stumbled upon a cave hidden in the mountains near Deadwind Hollow and discovered a strange altar within it. You took it upon yourself to spoil whatever foul purpose it held.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bloodshaman Akilos in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This cave radiates dark energy from the mysterious altar within it. From the markings, it looks like it's used for Moodie rituals.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This cave radiates dark energy from the mysterious altar within it. From the markings, you guess it's used for Moodie rituals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The old gods watch over us, even here on Nexus. Do you wish for them to hear your petition?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, $(player.class). The Moodies dabble in the forbidden arts of necromancy, but never have I heard of them creating something so powerful.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is troubling.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's meddle with things we don't understand.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm just glad to be rid of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The strange Moodie altar you discovered within the caverns near Deadwind Hollow has been desecrated and its dastardly power dispersed. Bloodshaman Akilos was pleased to learn of the necromantic altar's destruction.

localizedTextIdText: You found an old, weathered Draken sword. There was no other sign of its owner nearby. Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Lost Sword to Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This old Draken sword is dirty and crusted with blood, but it is still very sharp. There is no sign of its owner nearby.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This old Draken sword is dirty and crusted with blood, but it is still very sharp. There is no sign of its owner nearby.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That sword! Let me see it! Yes! Vezaar cleaved many skulls with this blade! If he does not return, it shall be interred in honor of his deeds.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will see if anyone recognizes it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Hunter Kelzo recognized the sword as belonging to Vezaar, the lost Draken warrior. It will be placed in Vezaar's tomb.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will see if anyone recognizes it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Lost Sword to Hunter Kelzo

localizedTextIdText: You found a battered Draken shield. Though it shows signs of heavy use, the shield is still serviceable. It appears to have been abandoned for no reason. Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Lost Shield to Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This shield is of exceptional quality, but too battered to use. The Draken known as Kelzo might be interested in it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This shield is of exceptional quality, but too battered to use. The Draken known as Kelzo might be interested in it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah! That looks like Vezaar's shield. See the dents, the gashes, and blood along the edge? A shield is a weapon, and Vezaar knew how to use it!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will return it to the Draken.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He was obviously a great hunter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned the Shield of Vezaar to Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns. Though quick to educate you on the use of shields in battle, Hunter Kelzo was at a loss to explain why a mighty warrior like Vezaar would simply abandon his defenses.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will return it to the Draken.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Lost Shield to Hunter Kelzo

localizedTextIdText: You found a datachron assigned to someone named Vezaar. It is new, undamaged, and in perfect working order. Why would it be out here? Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns might know more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Datachron to Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This datachron is new and in perfect working order. The login screen says "Vezaar."
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This datachron is new and in perfect working order. The login screen says "Vezaar."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Vezaar's datachron? What was he thinking? He just tossed it on the ground and left? Vezaar is many things, but not feeble-minded!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Someone might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered Vezaar's datachron to Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns. He had no explanation as to why Vezaar would abandon such a device.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Datachron to Hunter Kelzo

localizedTextIdText: You've found the missing Draken, Vezaar. He has become feral, living like a wild animal and hunting with his bare hands. There can be no reasoning with him. Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns will want to hear of this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring news of Vezaar the Feral to Hunter Kelzo in the Lost Caverns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have found paradise in the taste of a fresh kill! I love the feel of rending flesh by claw, tooth, and horn! This is the meaning of life... and death!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Tell Kelzo to begone. I will not share my newfound paradise!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So Vezaar the Mighty has become Vezaar the Feral. I knew it! It is best not to begrudge him his choice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I have had enough of society. Tell Kelzo to begone! I will not share my hunting ground!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The other Draken are looking for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have located Vezaar the Feral in the Lost Caverns and brought word of his fate to Hunter Kelzo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring news of Vezaar the Feral to Hunter Kelzo
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sicken me.

localizedTextIdText: You received a call from Lord Voricus requesting your presence at Tall Rock Point. The Dominion is preparing to engage in diplomatic negotiations with the Falkrin and, apparently, Clanlord Makaza.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Emissary Autarka at Tall Rock Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am Lord Voricus, senior diplomat of the Falkrin Ambassadorial Unit. Report to me at Tall Rock Point at once.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I expect you here at Tall Rock Point. Now. It is an issue of galactic diplomacy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Protocol error. Lord Voricus is the senior diplomat. You must direct all inquiries towards him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lord Voricus may be lacking in some areas, but he is the designated leader of this diplomatic mission. I expect that we can rely on your aid in this matter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will give you further instructions when you are here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your reputation precedes you, $(player.class). With your help, I calculate a high probability of success.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Tall Rock Point and spoke with Lord Voricus. It's apparent Lord Voricus is only the nominal leader of this diplomatic mission. You and Emissary Autarka will be doing most of the heavy lifting.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Did I stutter? Yes, the Falkrin Ambassadorial Unit! The Dominion has seen fit to send me as their envoy to begin negotiations with the Falkrin of Deradune. Filthy creatures, more bird than men, always muttering about that Osiric of theirs. Nevertheless, duty calls. I am nothing, if not dutiful.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Think of it like this - as we lay down our terms, they must accept them. If they don't, we will destroy them. Dominion diplomacy is fairly straightforward.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Autarka - you'll meet her when you arrive - is the brains, I'm the beauty, and you... you are the muscle. And the Falkrin are the beasts! Beauty and the beasts! Aha! I'm so clever I impress myself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare refuse me? Swine!

localizedTextIdText: The members of the Falkrin Ambassadorial Unit in Tall Rock Point are preparing to initiate first contact with the Falkrin, a race of bird-men native to Nexus. Through Autarka, Lord Voricus has instructed you to collect feathers and stones as gifts for the Falkrin, as well as a mammodin horn to signal them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the goods to Emissary Autarka at Tall Rock Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lord Voricus believes stones and feathers will dazzle the Falkrin into negotiating. Carry out his request, but make sure you also pick up a mammodin horn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have the stones, feathers, and mammodin horn? I assure you, when Lord Voricus is thwarted, he acts more like... um, Lord Voricus.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. You have assembled the requested items. Of course, the only important thing is the mammodin horn. The Falkrin will not come to us without it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The horn may prove slightly more... useful in the negotiation process.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought the items back to Emissary Autarka. She was far less interested in the pretty feathers and stones than she was in the mammodin horn, which will be used to initiate a meeting with the Falkrin.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Who, or what, are the Falkrin?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why do you need a mammodin horn?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What of the other items?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Falkrin are avian humanoids native to Nexus. Though crude by our standards of civilization, they are one of the dominant martial forces on this planet.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Join? I dare say we'd prefer they serve. They haven't the intellect to act as proper citizens of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I have studied the ICI observational reports of the Falkrin. When two Falkrin broods call a meeting, it is initiated through the sounding of a ceremonial horn. We must craft a mouthpiece for the Falkrin ceremonial horn located nearby if we are to begin negotiations.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Lord Voricus believes stones and feathers will be accepted by the Falkrin as gifts. Ahem. It is not my place to second-guess him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It seems I misjudged the value you would add to the team.

localizedTextIdText: The preparations to summon the Falkrin for a meeting have been completed. Emissary Autarka wants you to travel to the Falkrin parleying grounds and sound the ceremonial horn. It is uncertain how the Falkrin of Bloodtalon Perch will receive diplomatic overtures, but you are prepared to resolve any complications that might arise.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Rendezvous with Clanlord Makaza at Tall Rock Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The preparations are now complete. Proceed to the Falkrin parleying grounds and initiate the summoning protocol using the ceremonial horn.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Proceed to the Falkrin parleying grounds and sound the horn. The Falkrin are certain to respond.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Voricus was a fool, but he was a well-connected one. Otherwise, he would never have been chosen to lead. But now, we do things the Draken way. To war!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lord Voricus and I will meet you there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Falkrin responded to your diplomatic efforts with violence, whisking away Lord Voricus and Emissary Autarka to Bloodtalon Perch. Clanlord Makaza has stepped in and declared war on the bird-men.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There is a clearing up near the cliffs where the Falkrin keep their ceremonial horn. Once you sound it, the Falkrin should respond, and then... who knows?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I have made some trinkets with them to satisfy Lord Voricus. Let us hope they will satisfy the Falkrin as well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have no time for your blatant disregard for our mission.

localizedTextIdText: In the wake of the Falkrin diplomatic disaster, Clanlord Makaza has taken control of the situation. He has instructed you to explore the Falkrin stronghold, Bloodtalon Perch, and learn the fate of Lord Voricus and Emissary Autarka.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find the missing Dominion diplomats in Bloodtalon Perch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Falkrin have likely taken Lord Voricus and Emissary Autarka to Bloodtalon Perch. Your first order is to go there and discover their fate.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found Voricus and Autarka? Are they in Bloodtalon Perch?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm pleased to hear Clanlord Makaza has taken matters in hand. It is unfortunate he did not do so before I was kidnapped and dismembered by savage birdmen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Voricus or Autarka have been harmed, we will exact a great vengeance!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For the first time since my activation, I find my emotional circuits unable to fully contain my fury.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered the missing diplomats near the entrance to Bloodtalon Perch. Lord Voricus is dead, and Emissary Autarka has been dismembered. Luckily, it takes more than that to kill a Mechari.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Coward! How can you fear these birdmen so?

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza demands that you find the strongest of the Bloodtalon Falkrin brood: Keeper Akhin, Warmonger Murali, and Crusher Zhong in Bloodtalon Perch. Exact payment for their transgressions in blood.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Clanlord Makaza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In war, one does not strike blindly. If we are to stop the Falkrin threat, we must first kill their greatest warriors. Find them and exact our vengeance!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Their strongest fighters are still scattered around the hold. Bring the fight to them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are Keeper Akhin, Warmonger Murali, and Crusher Zhong dead yet? Without them, the Falkrin offensive will be weakened considerably!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Once again, you have proven your worth. With their greatest warriors dead, the Falkrin will become weak and confused. They will be nothing more than prey.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Falkrin will be made to regret this day.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Falkrin will learn to fear the Dominion!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The Falkrin will pay. I swear it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You hunted down and killed the strongest of the Bloodtalon Falkrin in Bloodtalon Perch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you were worthy of standing beside me. I was wrong.

localizedTextIdText: You've received a call from Mondo Zax. Clanlord Makaza has called in some favors and brought some serious Chua firepower to the fray. Call down the thunder on Falkrin Hut in Bloodtalon Perch and teach the Falkrin not to mess with the Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Makaza call in favor. So Mondo brought aerial firepower. Burn Falkrin homes to the ground! Call in strike coordinates at huts when ready.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Gunners waiting for strike coordinates. Impatiently. Go to Bloodtalon Perch, locate huts, call in strikes. See? Easy! Even for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Burn burn burn! Yes! Moronic birds learn hard way: Dominion in charge!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Teach Falkrin lesson. Fiery painful lesson.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: At least they'll be prepared for winter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You called in aerial strikes on Falkrin homes in Bloodtalon Perch. The Falkrin will think twice before attacking the Dominion again!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: So what? Soon will be piles of smoking sticks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No fun! Aerial strikes make such nice boom. Hmm. Maybe I use on you instead....

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza has discovered Bride Vultura{p:Bride Vultura} lair on the face of a cliff in Bloodtalon Perch. Use the whirlwind inside of Bloodtalon Tower to get into Bride Vultura{p:Bride Vultura} lair. Then slay her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Clanlord Makaza at Tall Rock Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Falkrin are led by their priestesses, the Brides of Osiric. ICI analysts have found the nest of Bride Vultura{p:Bride Vultura}. Hunt her down and end this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find your way to Bloodtalon Tower. The way to Bride Vultura{p:Bride Vultura} lair is there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Vengeance is ours! Once again you are the instrument of our success. Now the Bloodtalon Falkrin will have no choice but to submit to Dominion rule.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The approach to Bride Vultura{p:Bride Vultura} lair is treacherous. Do not fail me!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The emperor will hear of your deeds! Know that you have honored the Dominion... with bloodshed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it to Bride Vultura{p:Bride Vultura} lair and demonstrated what happens to those who resist the Dominion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I get to her lair?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There's a primal air whirlwind inside Bloodtalon Tower. ICI analysts believe it will launch you to Bride Vultura{p:Bride Vultura} nest, hidden on a cliff side. As far as they can tell, there is no other way to get there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Only the weak falter at the killing blow.

localizedTextIdText: The dismembered head of Emissary Autarka has requested you make the necessary diplomatic response to the hostile actions of the Bloodtalon Falkrin. With Lord Voricus dead and Emissary Autarka dismembered, you are all that's left of the Falkrin Ambassadorial Unit. Protect the authority of the Dominion empire by killing Falkrin in Bloodtalon Perch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Emissary Autarka via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There can be only one response to this gross breach of diplomatic protocol: systematic destruction of the Falkrin!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Fool though he was, Voricus' death demands a response. Not to mention my dismemberment. Kill any Bloodtalon Falkrin that cross your path.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fool though he was, Voricus' death demands a response. Not to mention my dismemberment. Kill any Bloodtalon Falkrin that cross your path.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I had an optimal view of the carnage from up here. You have the makings of a fine Dominion diplomat, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I find I infinitely prefer this type of diplomatic "negotiating."
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will make the Falkrin pay!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I made sure to drive the point home.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed many of the Bloodtalon Falkrin. The bird men have paid in blood for daring to attack diplomatic representatives of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will make the Falkrin pay!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will make the Falkrin pay!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are fortunate I am currently indisposed, or you would not live to regret your refusal.

localizedTextIdText: Emissary Autarka has asked you to find the other missing pieces of her body in Bloodtalon Perch and return them to her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the missing Mechari body parts to Emissary Autarka's Head outside of Bloodtalon Perch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As edifying as this experience has been, I believe I've spent adequate time as a dismembered head on a spike. Retrieve the other pieces of my body.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Falkrin took the other pieces of my body away as trophies. If you search Bloodtalon Perch, it is probable you will locate them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see you've successfully retrieved the rest of my body. Excellent. Now get me down from here. I've had my fill of being a Falkrin ornament!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will be sure to repay the Falkrin for their generous hospitality once I am functional again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Emissary Autarka missing body parts and returned them to her.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will be more useful to you if I am completely functional.

localizedTextIdText: Clanlord Makaza has ordered you to break the spirit of the Bloodtalon Falkrin by destroying the Bloodtalon Totem scattered throughout Bloodtalon Perch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Clanlord Makaza at Tall Rock Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must do more than kill our foes. We must also break their spirits so they can be easily swept aside! Find and destroy Bloodtalon Totem in Bloodtalon Perch!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The totems still stand! Why? The Falkrin take strength in their primitive faith. Destroy it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The spirits of the Falkrin are nearly broken! Nothing will stand between the Dominion and the conquest of the Bloodtalon!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We will reduce these pathetic birds to a shadow of their former selves!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed many Bloodtalon Totem in Bloodtalon Perch, breaking the spirits of the Falkrin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you fear their false gods?

localizedTextIdText: The Falkrin of Bloodtalon Perch use Air Altar to channel the power of primal air, wielding it as a weapon to disrupt Dominion flights over their primitive settlement. Mondo Zax insists the Air Altar must be destroyed if Dominion flight operations are to continue unopposed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fascinating! But problematic! Falkrin manipulate primal air to disrupt aerial operations. Air altars likely source of power. Likely solution - destroy them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Air altars in Bloodtalon Perch still function! Why waiting? Just lazy? Or incompetent?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes yes! Seeing reduction in aerial interference. Dominion blimp flights unimpeded! Hm, wondering if weaponization of air altar technology possible...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Only Mondo reserve right to blast creatures out of sky.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Falkrin Air Altar, thereby allowing the Dominion unfettered control over the airspace above Bloodtalon Perch.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Prime essence of air, quite volatile. Falkrin use primitive magic to control it. Though rudimentary, Falkrin magic still bothersome.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You regret saying no. Maybe not now, but soon.

localizedTextIdText: Krag Studrok has loaned you his hoverbike so you can meet with Commander Raxen, the leader of the Exile's forces at Raxen's Holdout in Whitevale. From the sounds of things, Krag's buddies need help, but he's too busy to go to their aid.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Raxen at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yo. I'm supposed to hook up with Raxen's Raiders, but I got me a Draken hottie that needs my full attention. You mind goin' instead?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hey, now... this beautiful devil woman belongs to the Studrok. Better go find yer own.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where in the hell is Studrok? He's probably off chasin' skirts! When I get my hands on him, I'm gonna...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's Krag's hoverbike, but you ain't Krag. Where is that lousy shalehead, anyway?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go on, take my hoverbike. Tell Raxen I found somethin' else to ride. Heh heh.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That slaghead's chasin' tail again, ain't he? Well... I suppose you'll have to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After a wild ride astride Krag Studrok hoverbike, you reported to Commander Raxen at Raxen's Holdout and offered to help him out with his current predicament.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I guess he has more important things to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, what gives? I thought you was my wingman, buddy!

localizedTextIdText: Commander Raxen has requested you re-establish contact with Exile personnel who were in the vicinity of Outbreak Fen when the Whitevale Terraformer erupted. If you can, find Corporal Maxog and see what he can tell you about his missing comrades.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Raxen via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This whole situation sucks rocks, $(player.name). Since the Terraformer blew up, half my troopers are dead, and the other half ain't reportin' in.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya find Maxog yet? If he's still breathin', he'll know where the rest of the troopers are.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where's Maxog? Ya find him or what? Ask him where the troopers are then send him back to camp. I want his report, pronto.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find Corporal Maxog. Maybe he and the rest of the boys are still fightin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: He's dead? That ain't what I wanted to hear, but that flamethrower might come in handy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He's dead, but I have his flamethrower.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Under orders from Commander Raxen, you investigated Outbreak Fen for signs of Corporal Maxog. Though he was uncommunicative, you found Corporal Maxog flamethrower nearby...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Oh? Do tell.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah, it's some kinda Eldan tech. Outside of blowin' up, I don't know what it's supposed to do, so don't ask me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I got no idea. I figure the Dommies are behind it, though.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Am I talkin' to a wall? Like I said, half my troopers are dead, but that ain't the worst part.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: More than half of my troopers are MIA - missing in action. Like they just... disappeared.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: I doubt it. The Dommies got hit, same as us. I don't think they got the manpower to keep our boys under wraps.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: When I saw ya, I thought, 'This one's as flaky as shale.' Guess I was right.

localizedTextIdText: The discovery of Corporal Maxog untouched corpse - not to mention his flamethrower - has spurred Commander Raxen to demand the cremation of all corpses found in Outbreak Fen in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Raxen at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Maxog knew what he was doin'. The fact he took a flamethrower with him has me thinkin' maybe ya should burn any bodies ya find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use Maxog's flamethrower and burn any bodies you find out there. Who knows what'll happen if we leave 'em out for the squirg?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So, how'd the body burnin' go? I'm guessin' the dead guys didn't put up much of a fight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure there's nothin' left but ashes when you're done, just to be safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That was a nasty job to give ya, but ya pulled it off. You got stone, pal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using Corporal Maxog flamethrower, you incinerated all the corpses you could find in Outbreak Fen. Though there's no telling if it will have any effect, Commander Raxen felt it was the safest course of action.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why should we burn the bodies?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are you certain this will work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Look. I don't know what killed those guys. Could be a disease. Maybe the squirgs can use dead bodies as hosts. Doesn't matter. I just wanna play it safe.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I'm pretty sure the bodies'll burn if you set 'em on fire. How's that for bein' certain?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I ain't askin' ya, I'm tellin' ya.

localizedTextIdTitle: If You Can't Beat Them, Blow Them Up
localizedTextIdText: Commander Raxen has pinpointed the source of the squirg outbreak. He's ordered you to collect $m(vitem=163) from the overrun military outpost known as the Genesis Installation, find the entrance to the Squirg Cave on the edge of Outbreak Fen, then plant the munitions underground.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Raxen at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got a fix on where the squirg are comin' from, a cave on the edge of Outbreak Fen. I want ya to get some explosives together and blow 'em up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find some munitions in the Genesis Installation, and cobble together a bomb. Then find the squirg nest and blow it sky high!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a big explosion, pal. We felt it all the way over here. Ya can't imagine how happy I am that you're on our side.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Too bad we lost the boys from demolitions, but I think ya can handle this job.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: How'd you like to join the Riders? Just so happens we got openings.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll blow the squirg sky high!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected, deployed, and detonated a large explosive payload at the source of the squirg in the cave beneath Outbreak Fen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How'd you find the squirg cave?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How do I set off the munitions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I got scouts in the field, sneakin' around. One of 'em says it's out there, and I trust him. You should, too.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We had to leave a buncha battlefield munitions behind when we evacuated the Genesis Installation. Ya better check there first.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The battlefield munitions ain't the most stable things on the planet. A stiff breeze'd probably set 'em off. Failin' that, a pistol shot might do it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me you're too good for demolitions work, trooper!

localizedTextIdText: Mechanic Anxa says that the Exile's missing troopers are actually shambling around in Outbreak Fen. Unfortunately, these squirg 'zombies' don't differentiate between friend and foe, so Mechanic Anxa wants them eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mechanic Anxa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Raxen says we got missin' men, but I know what happened to 'em. They're out there, 'cept they got squirg on their heads. They gotta be stopped.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Would you wanna keep livin' if some parasite was stuck to your head, pal? You gotta help those men, and the only way to do that is to kill 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Outstanding work, $(player.name). I knew some of them guys. They was good mercs, every one of 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's a load offa my mind. Let's just hope whatever they got ain't catchin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done right by 'em... and the rest of us, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You eliminated a large number of squirg zombies in Outbreak Fen in Whitevale at Mechanic Anxa request.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Can't anything be done for them?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Little bouncy parasites is what they are. Big, bulbous eyes... they come hoppin' your way, best gun 'em down before they jump on yer head.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: As much as I'd like to think so, I tend to doubt it. Those things get close enough to ya, they'll show ya what I mean... and it won't be pretty.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Ya got rubble in your braincase, $(player.name)? With all our casualties, we ain't got enough folks to ride 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me you're leavin' us to handle this ourselves. You a coward?

localizedTextIdText: Mechanic Anxa has asked you to destroy the four strongest squirg zombies in Outbreak Fen. For whatever reason, these four - once demolitions team members - are larger, stronger, and need to be put down before they can pose a threat to Raxen's Holdout.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mechanic Anxa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm gettin' calls sayin' there's four of them things that're larger and stronger than the rest. Scuttlebutt is, they're what's left of the demolitions team.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those four super-squirg dead yet? Word is, they'll cause a lotta trouble in camp if they make it this far. Ya better lock 'n' load!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're handy to have around, seein' as you didn't break a sweat takin' out those four super squirgheads. Might be you got the makin's of a merc.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what you think. Those guys were somethin' else!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I got it where it counts, Anxa.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You exterminated the shambling remains of the squirg-dominated demolitions team members: four 'super' squirg zombies that might have been powerful enough to wipe out the remaining Exile troops in Whitevale. Good work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so special about those four?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why are they different from the rest?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well, one's big 'n' strong, and another one spits acid. There's one that hunts like a predator, and the last one, he spits bile. Disgustin'!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Beats the hell outta me. Maybe it's got somethin' to do with their host species or somethin'?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I s'pose if FCON issued diapers, you'd be waitin' at the QM for yours, eh?

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered an old hoverbike in the crumbled remains of the Genesis Installation, and it's still in working order. You could probably use the hoverbike to run down some squirg zombies, but it'll probably get messy...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mechanic Anxa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This damaged terminal can activate a nearby hoverbike for your use. One of those bikes would make a great weapon against slow-moving squirg zombies...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please refer to our indemnification policy and insurance documentation. Remember - driving safe is no accident!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sometimes I get to thinkin', maybe I'll take a hoverbike out and flatten me some squirgheads. Then I look at all the work I gotta do... *sigh*
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, that was one of my bikes! It makes this girl damn proud to see someone usin' it to turn squirgheads into paste!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember - pedestrians are people, not points! Drive safely!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take one for a spin!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was a lot of fun.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used an old hoverbike you found in the Genesis Installation to run down squirg zombies. It's not every day you get to use a turbo-charged hoverbike to flatten parasitical squirg and their hosts.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm going to have fun with this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please resubmit application for hoverbike rental.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Raxen at Raxen's Holdout has ordered you to squash any and all Squirg Egg you come across while in the Squirg Cave in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Raxen via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While you're in that cave, you might as well squash as many of those eggs as you can. Wouldn't want any of 'em hatchin' and gettin' loose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We gotta make sure the squirg don't spread any further than they already have, and that means stompin' 'em at the source.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good thing ya don't mind gettin' yer boots dirty. Some folks act like their combat boots is ballet slippers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Give 'em hell, kid!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Don't mind if I do, sir.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: These boots were made for squashin'.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You carried out Commander Raxen's orders to destroy any and all Squirg Egg in the Squirg Cave, and you did it with far more enthusiasm than was strictly necessary.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me you're some kinda humanitarian or pacifist or somethin'.

localizedTextIdTitle: Where Have All the Groomsmen Gone?
localizedTextIdText: Best Man Seba can't find the rest of the groom's wedding party. They left on a caravan to Thermock Hold to celebrate, but they never got there. Seba wants you to venture into Softsnow Meadows and find them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Best Man Seba in Softsnow Meadows
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This bad. Wedding so important! Stupid rock-lady! Her drink makes us all fooly-faces. Seba will be worst best man ever if we don't find groom.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please find groom and groomsmen. Maybe get lost in Softsnow Woods. Wigwalli will hate Seba forever if no groom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please find groom and groomsmen. Maybe get lost in Softsnow Woods. Wigwalli will hate Seba forever if no groom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Caravan broken. Groom still nowhere to be found. Where could Dawa be? This no good! No good at all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Caravan should be back from Thermock by now. Please find groom.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bachelor party disaster. Who attacked caravan? Where is groom Dawa?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After looking all over Softsnow Woods you found the missing groomsmen from the Lopp wedding party. However, the groom himself is still missing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, yes! The Princess Kamala from Skullcano Island fell in love with our humble Dawa. When they marry, our two villages will be united. Hurray!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Horribles! Princess Kamala never forgive Seba. Worst bachelor party ever!

localizedTextIdText: The Lopp wedding caravan was attacked by unknown persons in Softsnow Woods. Best Man Seba has asked you to recover the Wigwalli wedding shinies that are scattered throughout the woods. Some have even been swallowed by animals such as rootbrutes, snoglugs, and dawngrazers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Best Man Seba via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Caravan destroyed and precious shinies scattered in snow! Please gather them! Big-time important for wedding. Seba keep looking for groom.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please get shinies back. They in bellies of beasties, and scattered all over the ground in snow. Shinies very important for wedding!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please get shinies back. They in bellies of beasties, and scattered all over the ground in snow. Shinies very important for wedding!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks so much for getting shinies back. These are very, very important for wedding. Would be disaster without them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh! Some beasties ate wedding shinies! Cut shinies out of bellies, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We not finished yet. Much more to do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get your wedding shinies back.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered a number of the Wigwalli wedding shinies in Softsnow Woods. Best Man Seba was very pleased that you were able to find so many of the lost shinies, as they are a crucial part of the upcoming wedding.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Seba not know. Danger is everywhere. Must hop quietly and carry big spear!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aww, but Seba thought we friends!

localizedTextIdText: It turns out that the Lopp wedding caravan was attacked by the Darkice Skeech and Groom Dawa was taken away by them. Best Man Seba would like you to go to Darkice Village and save Dawa before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Groom Dawa in Darkice Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Seba looked and looked but no find groom Dawa. Seba did find out who attacked caravan, though. Skeechies! Seba bet they took Dawa!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We must find and free groom Dawa in meanie Skeechie village. Skeechies eat anything, even Lopp! Horrible, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dawa need help. Find key, let Dawa out. Skeechies always hungry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks much for saving Dawa! Think they were going to eat Dawa... or marry him to Skeechie queenie. Or both! Very scary!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Skeechies village just up way. Must save Dawa before Skeechies eat him up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Please don't tell Kamala about this. No give Kamala worry-times.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad to find you alive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully rescued Groom Dawa from the Darkice Skeech before they could eat him... or, worse, marry him off to the Skeech queen.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find a way to free him.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find a way to get you out.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes! Mean beasties! Small! Have bad queenies with badder magic!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That what big-folk call Skeechies? But Dawa in danger. Must save him!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That makes Seba sad. Dawa as good as Skeechie food now!

localizedTextIdText: With Groom Dawa freed from captivity, all that remains is to recover his engagement shiny from the Darkice Queen in Darkice Village and return it to him in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Groom Dawa in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Skeechie queenie can't get Dawa now, but queenie still has engagement shiny. Without that, there's no wedding!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please get engagement shiny back from the Skeechie queenie. Need it for wedding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please get engagement shiny back from the Skeechie queenie. Need it for wedding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is that Dawa's engagement shiny? Oh, thank you, thank you! Now Dawa can present this to lovely Kamala and be wed! Yippie!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks very much. Dawa will return to Kamala now so Kamala no worries.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dawa can't thank you enough!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get that engagement thing back.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy I could help so much.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to kill the Darkice Queen and recover Groom Dawa engagement shiny. With everyone found and everything as it should be, the wedding can now begin!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll pry it from her slimy hands.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll pry it from her slimy hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why you no help?

localizedTextIdText: Kamala's Unity Festival is in jeopardy without wedding blooms. She has requested that you gather deep floral essence in the Softsnow Woods and deliver it to Shaman Achal in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bride Kamala in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kamala must have lots of flowers at wedding, but they hard to find here. Shaman can make some grow, but she need floral essence. Find some, find some!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look in Softsnow Woods for the floral essence Shaman Achal needs. Then she make make wedding flowers grow. Will be perfect wedding then!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, thank you so much! If you take a look in festival area, you see flowers blooming now. How lovely!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Essence deep inside snowy flowers. Look real hard now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are closer to bright and beautiful Unity Festival.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll have to go see that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your efforts, the Unity Festival taking place in Wigwalli Village is sure to be full of the most beautiful wedding blooms Whitevale has ever seen!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take a look in the woods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But it's Kamala's wedding day! You ruin it!

localizedTextIdText: Bride Kamala of Wigwalli Village is busy preparing for her wedding to Groom Dawa. She's asked you to speak to everyone on her guest list so she knows if they are attending the wedding or not. To that end, you must speak to Shaman Achal, Hunt-Master Toshan, Kurg-Tender Gagan, Far-Trader Zopa, and Treasure Hunter Ram.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bride Kamala in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kamala might be princess, but not above basic manners. Could you be sweety-times and make sure wedding guests planning to come?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please talk to all Lopp on list, find out if they come to wedding or not. Very easy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Big happiness! Every Lopp is coming! Now there are presents in the wedding area. You should go and see.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yay! Here's the list. Most every Lopp in village. Some are far, near Kurg.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Kamala will have presents for wedding guests too, of course!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It should be quite the celebration.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Unity Festival in Wigwalli Village is filled to bursting with wedding guests thanks to your efforts. Bride Kamala is pleased with the attendance, not to mention the record number of wedding gifts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh yes! It called Unity Festival. Kamala's big day has come! Kamala has come from faraway island to find true love, Dawa. He so handsome!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But Kamala can't do all this on own. Too busy with wedding arrangements!

localizedTextIdText: Bride Kamala is depending on you to venture into Softsnow Woods and collect frostglow algae, snowstep stag horns, and frostshell fragments so that Far-Trader Zopa can create lanterns for her wedding. Once you have the necessary components, deliver them to Zopa in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bride Kamala in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kamala's wedding must be bright with colors. Must have lanterns. Will you kill wood beasties for lantern makings and take them to Far-Trader Zopa?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Gather materials needed for making of lanterns for wedding. Far-Trader Zopa will make them when you have enough parts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you so much! Now festival area is covered in lovely, magical lanterns. Soon, Dawa's handsome face will be lit by perfect lights!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You are so helpful! Kamala so happy to have big-folk here!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Kamala's wedding will be real soon. But still more to do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I shall have to go see them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to collect the proper materials so that Far-Trader Zopa could create beautiful lanterns for Bride Kamala wedding in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll help you make those lanterns.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please help Kamala with this! Please!

localizedTextIdTitle: Something Old, New, Eldan, and Blue
localizedTextIdText: Bride Kamala in Wigwalli Village needs you to collect four items required to build and bless a proper Lopp wedding altar: an old map, a new energy rod, an Eldan pylon fragment, and a burningblue energy shard. It's traditional - "Something old, something new, something Eldan, something blue."
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bride Kamala in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Something old, something new, something Eldan, something blue. Is Lopp tradition! Things needed for making of wedding altar. You get stuff for Kamala?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please find four lucky items needed to make and bless wedding altar. Something old, something new, something Eldan, something blue. It's tradition!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hurray! Holy altar is blessed and built in festival area. You go and see how pretty it is. All thanks to you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get things, take to Relic Holder Ramesh. He know what to do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Kamala will say vows with Dawa soon. Hearts him forever!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the four things needed to build and bless Bride Kamala wedding altar in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: I don't get it. What do you need?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Is easy. Something old - map! Something new - energy rod! Something Eldan - a pylon fragment! And something blue - a shard from a burningblue dawngrazer!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Talk to Treasure Hunter Ram. He give you something old!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're so mean!

localizedTextIdText: With Groom Dawa recovered and Bride Kamala errands done, the Lopp wedding - known as a Unity Festival - is ready to begin. You must bring the Relic of Dak-Buun to the altar in Wigwalli Village and watch the exchange of vows between Dawa and Kamala.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dak-Buun in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Everything ready now! Unity Festival begins! You invited, of course, as relic bearer. Bring Relic of Dak-Buun to holy altar. Go get from Ramesh.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please hurry and get Relic of Dak-Buun from Ramesh and bring it to holy altar. Unity Festival time is here, and Kamala cannot wait!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please do not interrupt me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Unity Festival is now complete. Dawa and Kamala are joined for eternity. My work here is done... as is yours, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come on, girls! Time for Kamala to tie love-knot!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I return to the ether now. May your shinies be the shiniest.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'd be honored to attend your wedding.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks in no small part to your contributions, the Unity Festival binding Groom Dawa and Bride Kamala went off without a hitch. Here's hoping Dawa and Kamala have found their happily ever after in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But today is Kamala's wedding. You can't say no!

localizedTextIdText: You've received a call for help from Director Kalea at Camp Reclamation. Kalea's Collegium research team has been overcome by aggressive canimid, and you come highly recommended.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Director Kalea at Camp Reclamation
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings. I am Director Kalea of the Royal Collegium. I have heard your name mentioned in regards to your "troubleshooting" abilities. Can we talk?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are you coming to Camp Reclamation? This is something of an emergency.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Just a moment, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, yes... you look much as I anticipated you would. Despite this, I am sure you are a capable individual.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Meet me at Camp Reclamation at once. Bring weapons with you. Lots of them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, do forgive me. Recent events have made me forget my manners.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Camp Reclamation and spoke to Director Kalea about her problems with the canimid.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A mutual acquaintance of ours who wishes to remain anonymous. I trust you understand the need for discretion?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Suffice it to say, you come highly recommended. I'm told you are well worth the price I will pay to secure your services.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My sources must have been wrong about you. How unsurprising.

localizedTextIdText: A Collegium dig site was overrun by canimid shortly after the researchers activated their seismic equipment. Director Kalea wants you to eliminate canimid at the Greystone Caverns in the hopes that reducing their numbers will make reclamation of the dig site a simple matter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Kalea via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our dig site was overrun by canimid shortly after we activated our seismic equipment. These creatures must be dealt with... permanently.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you eliminated the canimid yet? Perhaps my friend was not entirely truthful about your abilities.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, yes... our mutual acquaintance was quite accurate in his estimation of your abilities. You are a very deadly individual!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Our dig site is in a cave, but the disgusting creatures are absolutely everywhere.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You bet your boots I am.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you've killed a number of canimid at Greystone Caverns, there's still a lot of work to do before the Collegium dig site is reclaimed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Canimid are large, subterranean creatures. They burrow through earth and rock - and flesh - with equal vigor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't trifle with me. Do it, or don't.

localizedTextIdText: You located a barrel of moonshine marked with Hermit Bilvuss name. Maybe he'd be thankful to have his rotgut back. You should return it to him at Camp Reclamation and find out for certain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Moonshine to Hermit Bilvus at Camp Reclamation
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The homemade liquor in this barrel could strip the paint from a freighter hull, and the word "Bilvus" is roughly carved into the top of the cask.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You've already taken the moonshine from this barrel for Hermit Bilvus. You should return it to him as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What... what's that smell? My hooch! Hand it over right this instant! The likes of you couldn't handle the delectable potency of this stuff!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Old Bilvus is going to sleep like an angel tonight, oh yes...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Hermit Bilvus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Perhaps it was too much to hope that Hermit Bilvus at Camp Reclamation would express gratitude for the return of his homemade hooch. Nevertheless, he was probably as happy as you've ever seen him, which isn't saying much.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take it to Hermit Bilvus.

localizedTextIdText: Hermit Bilvuss supplies and equipment have been scattered about by the canimid, and he expects you to help him get it all back. Find pieces of damaged junk and return them to Hermit Bilvus at Camp Reclamation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Hermit Bilvus at Camp Reclamation
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those filthy, bleeding canimid! They keep raiding my camp, taking my stuff! I want it back, all of it! And you're going to help me, or I'll have your job!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You bring me my stuff back yet? No? Then get out of my face!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If you think I'm paying you full price for that stuff, you're insane. There's dents and scrapes all over everything! I'm lucky it weren't all ruined!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't just stand there! It's not like the canimid are going to bring it back!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And don't expect thanks, either. Nitwit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Always the gentleman, Hermit Bilvus at Camp Reclamation thanked you profusely for returning his damaged junk to him. Well, not really, but he did pay you. A little.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll have your job, I said! You'll be out of work within a fortnight!

localizedTextIdText: Hermit Bilvuss trusty equivar mount, Lucy, was frightened off when the canimid became a problem. Bilvus expects you to find Lucy and bring her back to Camp Reclamation in one piece.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Hermit Bilvus at Camp Reclamation
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My Lucy's gone... scared off! And it's the Dominion's fault for stirring up all the canimid! So you're going to find her and bring her back. Got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where's my Lucy? She's a gentle beast, but I doubt she'll like you very much. Can't say as I blame her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lucy! Is it really you, my dear? Did the horrible $(player.class) scare you very much? You poor sweetie!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get my Lucy back in one piece, or you'll never work in Auroria again. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't think you're off the hook, buddy. This disaster ain't over yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Lucy, Hermit Bilvuss faithful equivar, and rode her back to Camp Reclamation. You don't think you've ever seen someone as happy to see a smelly old equivar as Hermit Bilvus was.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine! I'm gonna talk to that lady over there. She'll see you're properly punished.

localizedTextIdText: Seismic thumpers were abandoned when the Collegium was driven out of Greystone Caverns. Director Kalea thinks they may tear Auroria apart if they're left active. Enter Greystone Caverns and power the seismic thumpers down before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Kalea via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When we were forced out of Greystone Caverns, we were unable to deactivate our seismic thumpers. We need to shut them down before it's too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The seismic thumpers are still active! What's taking you so long to shut them down? Wasn't I clear, citizen? Disaster is imminent!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The seismographs show the thumpers have been powered down. You have prevented a geological disaster of epic proportions!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My instruments indicate that we do not have much time. Get a move on!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to power down the seismic thumpers in Greystone Caverns, thereby averting a geological disaster of epic proportions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Do you feel the constant seismic disturbances in the ground? Those are caused by the thumpers. If left on, they could destroy Auroria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The destruction of Auroria is on your head, cretin!

localizedTextIdText: Canimid inside the Greystone Caverns have been seen playing with the $m(vitem=266) the researchers were forced to leave behind. Geologist Brooja has demanded that you recover his $m(vitem=266) from the canimid before they are irreparably damaged.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the $m(vitem=266) to Geologist Brooja at Camp Reclamation
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Very angry at stupid canimid! Drive us from cave, steal tools! Now canimid play with tools. Tools not toys for playing! You get tools back, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have tools yet? Why wait? Wait much longer, tools destroyed! Make haste!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Relieved you recovered tools. Thankful, very thankful! Will name subterranean mollusk after you someday.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry! Canimid ruin sensitive calibrations, break tools. Is total nightmare!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Welcome! Quite welcome!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've recovered all the $m(vitem=266) from the canimid in Greystone Caverns and returned them to Geologist Brooja at Camp Reclamation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You very ugly creature.

localizedTextIdText: You have cleared the way for the Collegium's reclamation of Greystone Caverns. Director Kalea believes that if the canimid alpha is found and killed, the rest of the creatures will become demoralized and leave the Caverns behind.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Director Kalea at Camp Reclamation
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Canimid are led by a powerful member of their pack - an alpha. If the canimid alpha is killed, the rest of the pack should abandon Greystone Caverns.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Has the canimid alpha been eliminated yet? Why do you delay? It is somewhere in Greystone Caverns, and I expect you to kill it! Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have dealt with the canimid alpha and its brood quite effectively. You have earned my appreciation... as well as my grudging respect.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Beware - the alpha will be stronger and more dangerous than the others.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nexus is our birthright. We cannot allow dumb animals to impede our progress.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With your successful neutralization of the canimid alpha, the other Greystone canimid have begun to abandon the caverns. It is only a matter of time before the Royal Collegium's research in the Greystone Caverns picks up where it left off.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't be serious!

localizedTextIdText: Chief Migisi of Wigwalli Village has asked you to search for her missing son. He's journeyed into the Roughwhite Wilds on his coming of age shinequest, but has failed to return. The encroaching presence of Redmoon marauders makes her worry more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Young Migisi near Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My son, he leave on Shinequest with no return, two moons now. This chief have big worry. You find him, please?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lately, Redmoon attacking relentlessly. Have become great danger to Lopp, those stinky pirates. My son maybe hit trouble there?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Migisi not scared! Gonna find big shiny, become greatest treasure hunter in Wigwalli. Just need find courage first.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We not usually trusting of big-folk, but Wigwalli in desperate need.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well... maybe a little bit scared.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Chief Migisi missing son, a young Lopp who'd journeyed into the neighboring wilds during his coming of age shinequest. Young Migisi had planned to enter the Redmoon's Dockyard in search of an epic shiny, but was too frightened.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But Lopp need heir! Help Lopp, please!

localizedTextIdText: While exploring the Roughwhite Wilds outside of Wigwalli Village, you received a datachron call for help from Young Migisi, a boy Lopp who'd run into trouble with marauders during his coming of age shinequest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Young Migisi near Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Great big gods! Somebody - come help quick! Migisi attending matter of big importance. No time to waste!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Migisi not scared! Gonna find big shiny, become greatest treasure hunter in Wigwalli. Just need find courage first.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry! Help Migisi on shinequest. Find at entrance, Redmoon Dockyard.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and spoke with Young Migisi, a boy Lopp who had journeyed into the Roughwhite Wilds during his coming of age shinequest. Son of the village chieftain, Migisi had run into a batch of trouble - he was too scared to enter Redmoon's Dockyard despite his desire to complete his shinequest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No! Do not leave Migisi all alone!

localizedTextIdText: Young Migisi, an ambitious Lopp on a shinequest, has asked you to hunt for and steal a treasure map from Redmoon's Dockyard so that he can retrieve a priceless item from the pirates' plunder.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Young Migisi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Migisi on big quest - bring back shiniest of shinies! Gonna steal Redmoon treasure for Lopp honor. But Marauders scary! Maybe you go in, steal treasure map?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Redmoon junk in storage chests. Map gonna be in there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You tougher than you look. Inspired Migisi to be brave so Migisi sneaked in camp - looked for map, too!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You not bad... for big-folk.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rummaged through chests in Redmoon's Dockyard until you located a treasure map pointing the way to their most valuable loot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You big stinky!

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax wants you to sabotage the Power Regulator in the vicinity of the Megatech Shield Generator.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Power regulators support Megatech shield generator. Destroy regulators, shield will fall. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Not understand language? Must destroy power regulators! Bring Exile shield down! Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: See? Mondo told you - no regulator, no shield. Simple! Now Dominion fleet can bombard Exiles, turn them into fine red mist.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mondo watching you. Give good show!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mondo love fireworks. Love fireworks that blow up Exiles even better!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disabled the Power Regulator supporting the Megatech Shield Generator. With the shield down, the Dominion fleet will be able to provide air support in combating the Exiles on Crimson Isle.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What happens when the shield is down?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That simple! Dominion send in blimps. Blimps carry demolition teams. Demolition teams destroy Exile cannons. Boom!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Megatech is Exile faction. Seek out powerful Eldan technology, use against Dominion. Stupid Exiles not understand! They will fail!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not useful. Not useful at all.

localizedTextIdText: You stole a treasure map from Redmoon's Dockyard for Young Migisi. Your bravery inspired the Lopp child to enter the Marauder's camp in search of his elusive shiny, but unfortunately he's found himself in trouble... again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Young Migisi in Redmoon's Dockyard
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Big trouble! Went searching for map and found scary Marauder instead! Now Migisi locked-up - need big-folk help, and fast!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Big-folk still help Migisi, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sweet shiny spirits! That was scary! Marauder camp no place for Lopp, even brave one like Migisi!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Big-folk the greatest! Migisi knew you would help!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Inspired by your show of bravery, Young Migisi ventured into the midst of the Redmoon Marauders' dockyard to complete his shinequest. Instead, he ended up trapped by Bosun Sprulo. Luckily for him, you were able to provide swift rescue.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why no help Migisi? Want Marauder to have Lopp soup?

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer wants you to sabotage the Power Regulator in the vicinity of the Megatech Shield Generator.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles are fools! The regulators powering their energy shield are exposed and lightly guarded. I want you to exploit this weakness at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The power regulators are still functioning. Are you frightened of a few worthless bots? Destroy those regulators, or I will split your belly open!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What news? Report at once!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Move out and destroy those regulators. Take pleasure in the purity of the kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Werza smiles on you! The shield is down! Now the fleet will sow this land with seeds of destruction!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The power regulators have been destroyed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disabled the Power Regulator supporting the Megatech Shield Generator. With the shield down, the Dominion fleet will be able to provide air support in combating the Exiles on Crimson Isle.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What happens when the shield is down?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Are you blind? I am Kezrek Warbringer, supreme commander of the Dominion military! I have never lost a battle, and this will be no exception.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Once the shields are down, we can send in airships loaded with demolitions teams. They'll destroy the Exile guns and pound some more nails in the Exiles' coffin.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Megatech is an Exile faction that seeks out powerful Eldan technology to use against the Dominion. In this, as in all things, they will fail.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will regret this day.

localizedTextIdText: Young Migisi isn't a Lopp to slink away after being rescued from the clutches of the Redmoon Marauders. He had the foresight to palm a number of stink bombs 'just in case.' Use all of Migisi's stink bombs on the Marauders in Redmoon's Dockyard.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Young Migisi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Phew! Migisi sure owe you big time! Now we have treasure map, but no-good Marauders get in the way! Good thing Migisi stole stink bombs during getaway.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hit Marauders with stinky bombs. Lopp's best weapon is always Lopp's brain!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Redmoon big danger to Lopp! But now we smell Marauders coming!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Give Marauders bad taste of own medicine - hit with big stink bombs!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The stinkiest of shinies... Migisi not desire that one, no.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Young Migisi stink bombs proved effective at disorienting the Marauders at Redmoon's Dockyard just long enough for you to close in for the kill. The resulting stench, however, has proven somewhat harder to remove.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll hit them with the stink bombs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You too scared of Marauders, or stink bombs?

localizedTextIdText: Chock full of confidence after his timely rescue from the Bosun's brig, Young Migisi is determined to use the Marauders own explosives against them. Ignite the kegs of gunpowder cached throughout Redmoon's Dockyard and ensure their destruction!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Young Migisi in Redmoon's Dockyard
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Redmoon deserve big lesson. Migisi notice lotsa explosives here. So this Lopp rigged splorg to make 'em blow, but now too scared to set them off...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Migisi help! Migisi indicate locations for you. "X" marks the spot, but not for treasure... for explosives!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it! Migisi sees the smoke from here! Lopp love the smell of gunpowder in morning!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You have better luck with Marauders. You release splorg for big bang boom!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew the Redmoon Marauders sky high by detonating their own gunpowder kegs. Suffice it to say that Redmoon's Dockyard has officially been ruined.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Marauders must learn! Must learn for good!

localizedTextIdText: Now that the Redmoon Marauders have been properly dealt with, Young Migisi is determined to complete his shinequest. The treasure map points to a nearby shipwreck. Help Migisi explore the Fortune's Fool in Whitevale and retrieve the shiniest shiny!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Young Migisi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Migisi more determined than ever! Scary Marauders learned big lesson. Now Migisi free to follow map! Find best treasure for shinequest!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still not have shiniest shiny! Must find it in sunken ship. Marauders call it Fortune's Fool. Migisi call it big junkheap.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You good friend to Lopp! Help steal best shiny ever! Migisi not soon forget it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Map leads to sunken ship! Migisi going in! You follow, help hunt treasure!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Alongside Young Migisi, you ventured into the submerged compartments of the Fortune's Fool, did battle with the nefarious First Mate Darugna, and returned the shiniest shiny to the Lopp in Wigwalli Village!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Migisi need big-folk like he need a hole in head.

localizedTextIdText: You helped Young Migisi find the shiniest of shinies for his shinequest. Return to Wigwalli Village to join in his coming-of-age festivities!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Chief Migisi in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Migisi very grateful for help stealing brightest pirate shiny! Serves Redmoon right. Now we go back to village! Big celebrate!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Happy Lopp share Loppstuff with big-folk friends! Visit us in Wigwalli for big party!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Son back safe! Who knew? He greatest treasure hunter of Wigwalli! We not need worry after all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now gotta show mother... er, chief... we great treasure hunters now!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll meet you in the village.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After all that shinequesting about, you accepted Young Migisi jubilant invitation and went back to the village for a shiny shindig.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You hurt Lopp's feelings.

localizedTextIdText: To prevent the Exiles from calling for reinforcements, Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to disable their communications towers at Megatech Station. Accomplish this by destroying the towers' control panels.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To prevent the Exiles from calling in reinforcements, you'll need to disable the control panels next to their communication towers. Are you ready?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your risk of failure - and death - increases with each moment those communication towers are active.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is done! Now the Exiles will hear the sobs of their orphans and the moans of the dying!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go on, then. Follow your orders. Nothing can stop us now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully sabotaged the Exiles' communications towers, preventing them from calling for reinforcements.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take care of the towers.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the towers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A great warrior knows when to seize victory. Now is such a time. Mark my words: there will be ample opportunities to test the mettle of our enemies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You shame yourself, coward.

localizedTextIdText: Hack terminals within the Megatech Gun Emplacement so you can listen to Exile communications.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is one of several data terminals in the vicinity. Hacking the terminal may provide an opportunity to listen in on Exile communications.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ERROR: YOU CANNOT ACCESS THE REQUESTED DATA FROM THIS TERMINAL.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Idiot! Exile terminals linked to Exile communications. Hack them, use ears to listen. No time to waste!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Eldan Annihilator nearly operational? Exiles plan utilization of weapon? Terrible news! Should have told me sooner!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We have to stop this Exile operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Intercepted transmissions suggest the Exiles are close to activating the Eldan Annihilator.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer wants you to clear a path to the Eldan Annihilator by killing Megatech forces and sabotaging Hellfire and Vindicator tanks inside Megatech Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles have tanks in Megatech Station. They think these tanks make them strong. Ha! Show them how weak their armor really is! Destroy those tanks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Exile tanks must be destroyed. You try my patience. Do not make me tell you again.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent hunting! With the tanks destroyed, there is one less threat between us and the Eldan Annihilator.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stand for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Exile tanks at Megatech Station and bolstered the Dominion assault. The path to the Eldan Annihilator is now clear!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I destroy the tanks?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Their armor is thick, but the wits of a warrior are sharp. Sabotage them where they're weakest and they'll fold like paper!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You had best fear me more than a handful of Exile tanks, fool.

localizedTextIdText: Arachnologist Borango wants you to rescue entangled Chua scientists and collect Venombite Fang in Venombite Pass, which is in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Venombite Fang to Arachnologist Borango in Bloodstone Canyon
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Spiders in pass very dangerous, very poisonous. Need fangs for weapons research. Sent assistants, none returned. Now you go, get fangs. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Venombite fangs needed! Important to research! Spiders in pass have fangs. Kill spiders, take fangs. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Assistants back. Happy to be alive until I reprimand them. Now very sore. You have fangs?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If found, send lazy assistants back. There is work to do... after I punish them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nicely done. Reward deserved. Maybe you teach assistants?
