localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You searched a Dreg camp overrun by spiders and brought the Chua inventors to safety. You also brought the Venombite Fang to Arachnologist Borango. With some Chua ingenuity, the fangs may yield new weapons for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Can't you just get venom from scrab?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Venom very potent! May be useful for bio-weapons research. DRED very interested in bio-weapons!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Number unimportant. Need at least three for current project. Others expendable.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Scrab venom insufficient. Is toxic, but lacks spider venom enzymes. Spider venom liquefies internal organs. Scrab venom does not! Crucial difference!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You worse than lazy assistants.

localizedTextIdText: Kurg-Tender Umeshanu of Wigwalli Village is getting on in years, and is no longer nimble enough to collect snow sprouts. She's requested your assistance in gathering enough feed to keep her kurg in tip top shape.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Kurg-Tender Umeshanu at Snow Sprout Farm
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Umeshanu raise kurg big and strong on snow sprouts. Solid diet. Good for kurg stamina. But Umenshanu not move fast like used to. You catch sprouts for Lopp?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Snow sprouts grow on Lopp farms. Easy pickings. Bring back to this old Lopp and you get shiny reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes! These fellas are just fine! Look mighty tasty. Kurg will be happy!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Umeshanu trade you good shinies for sprouts!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The kurg of Wigwalli Village have enough feed to last them some time. Thanks to you, Kurg-Tender Umeshanu can give her aging bones a nice, long rest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Kurg need sprouts for food. Lopp need kurg. Big-folk must help.

localizedTextIdText: The gelidar pearls scattered throughout Thermock Lake would fetch a pretty price from Far-Trader Diki in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Far-Trader Diki in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These pearls will fetch a fine price from one of the far-traders in the Lopp village of Wigwalli. If you gather more, you should make a pretty penny.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: These pearls will fetch a fine price from one of the far-traders in the Lopp village of Wigwalli. If you gather more, you should make a pretty penny.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Gelidar pearls good for big magic! You find special pearls in lake, bring them here. I buy them from big-folk. Pay top shiny! Okay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gelidar pearls? This very good find! Pay special price for big-folk's pearls! What say you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Far-Trader Diki of Wigwalli Village was suitably impressed by your collection of gelidar pearls.

localizedTextIdText: Far-Trader Diki has asked you to go to Redmoon's Dockyard and recover the shinies the Marauders have stolen from the Lopp of Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Far-Trader Diki in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Redmoon Marauders kidnap Lopp! Steal our shinies! Diki say, Marauders must pay! You help Lopp? Get shinies back and fill Redmoon graves?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Redmoon Marauders set up dockyard across from village. Too close for comfort, Diki say. Steal our shinies, hurt our people. Marauders must pay.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good. Maybe now Redmoon think twice about stealing from Wigwalli!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you, big-folk. You keep village safe!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll kill Marauders and get your shinies back.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Far-Trader Diki and the Lopp of Wigwalli Village can rest easy now that their shinies have been returned. Better yet, the denizens of Redmoon's Dockyard have paid a hefty price for their sticky palms!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then Lopp find someone braver than stinky coward!

localizedTextIdText: Avanti the Bright-Eyed in Wigwalli Village has asked you to help her build a snowlopp. You agreed to gather snow from the woods and then assemble the snowlopp for her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Avanti the Bright-Eyed in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Avanti making Snowlopp to outdo friends! Building big one sure be tough! Need more snow! You go out, get snow, then come back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Shiniest snow found in Snowsoft Woods at base of trees! Fall from leaves - mounds nice and fluffy! Get snow, bring back for building snowlopp!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whoa! Big-folk sure make big snowlopp! You best snowlopp builder in all Wigwalli!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Avanti stay here, start mound! Get best snow for snowlopp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yay! Yay!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You built a monstrous snowlopp in Wigwalli Village for Avanti the Bright-Eyed and her friends.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But this snowlopp must be biggest and best snowlopp!

localizedTextIdTitle: Mind the Mines, Scrap the Scrab
localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has tasked you to secure Mondo's Beachhead as part of a surprise Dominion attack on Crimson Isle. Head down the beach, disarm Exile Mine, and kill any Scrab Striker that get in your way.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Need expendable assistant. You sufficient. Clear path to Exile shield generator. Many mines! Many scrab! Death likely!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you here? Beach still mined, still crawls with scrab! Go! Now! Or Mondo will give you first-hand experience of scrab dietary requirements!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Reports show path up beach clear. Well done! Top priority to destroy Exile Shield Generator. Nothing stop you. Make it quick!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Why you wait? Stupid! Scrab not disarm mines for you! Go go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent response! Mondo keep you around a bit longer.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get on it right away!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully cleared Mondo's Beachhead of scrab and Exile mines. Now there's a safe path leading to the Exile shield generator.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get on it right away!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Why are we attacking?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You hit head? Drink too much Cozmogrog? I am Mondo Zax, supreme leader of all Chua! Well... not yet, but someday! For now, I lead Chua in attack on Crimson Isle.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You not remember? Forget already? Moron!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Secret mission! Very important! We destroy Exile defenses so Dominion fleet can attack. You like special forces, except more ignorant.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The Exiles here found Eldan Annihilator. Mondo wants it... for the Dominion, of course! Exiles not give it to us, so we take it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Idiot! Time important! Time precious! Yet you waste it! Maybe I waste you!

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer wants you to destroy the Megatech Warbot near the Eldan Annihilator. Then the Eldan Annihilator will be within your grasp!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Eldan Annihilator may be our final objective, but first we have to get to it. There's an Exile war construct in our way. Destroy it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: That warbot is the only thing between us and the Eldan Annihilator. Get moving!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That warbot is the only thing between us and the Eldan Annihilator. Get moving!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I saw the warbot explode... like a flower of blood rising into the sky! You have proven your worth in my eyes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Failure is not an option at this point. Victory or death!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It has been an honor. For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Time to get out of here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You overcame the last of the Exile's resistance and used the Eldan Annihilator to destroy Megatech Station!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: And what will we do with the Annihilator?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We will use its power to lay our enemies to waste! Nothing shall stand before us and our control of Nexus!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then I will find someone who can. Feel free to cower elsewhere until your execution.

localizedTextIdText: As part of a surprise Dominion attack against the Exiles on Crimson Isle, you have been tasked with securing the Savage Coast. Head down the beach, clear Exile mines, and kill any Scrab Striker that get in your way.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That Exile shield generator needs to be knocked out, but the beach is full of scrab and land mines. You're going to clear the route. Got it?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you cleared that beach yet? Or are you waiting for me to rip out your spine?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did Gorefang send you to clear the mines off that beach? Get to it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Kezrek Warbringer here. With the mines and the scrab taken care of, there's nothing between you and the shield generator.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Think you're tough? Just one of those mines will vaporize you, so watch it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Blood and strength!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully cleared the Savage Coast of scrabs and Exile mines. Now there's a safe path leading to the Exile shield generator!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why do we need to knock out the Exile shield?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Are you okay?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We've come as part of a secret mission to destroy the Exile defenses on Crimson Isle ahead of our main assault force.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Exiles have uncovered something of great power: an Eldan Annihilator. We cannot allow them to have such a weapon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The shield is the one thing between our fleet and a full-scale bombardment of the Exile positions on Crimson Isle.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I've been... stung... by these scrab. Do not concern yourself with me. I will be fine in a moment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare refuse my order? You are little better than prey!

localizedTextIdText: The blimp carrying the demolitions team sent to destroy the Exile's cannons has been shot down. Mondo Zax wants you to investigate the Blimp Crash Site and recover the team's explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exile shield off-line, but Exile cannons still function! Blimp sent to blow up cannons shot down! You find blimp crash site, recover explosives. Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You find blimp? You find explosives? No? Lazy! Why waste Mondo's time?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Crew dead? Explosives missing? No... explosives not missing, explosives stolen! Dirty Dreg scavengers steal anything unless bolted down!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use caution! Crash site crawls with indigenous beasts. Scavengers ruin your day!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Find explosives, top priority!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've located the crash site. Unfortunately, everything of value has been taken by local nomads called the Dreg.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Not bombs! Explosives! For use by demolitions team. Also carried scientists. Scientists not as volatile, but just as important!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Fool! Supply limited on restricted battle front. Waste not, want not! Though Mondo will make exception for you....
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Find use for you after Exiles dead. Reactor shielding, maybe.

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg have pilfered the demolition team's explosives from the blimp crash site. Mondo Zax has tasked you with retrieving the stolen $(vitem=364) from Scarhide Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg scum killed surviving blimp crew, stole explosives. Find Dreg! Kill Dreg! Recover explosives! No time to waste!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Allow Mondo to explain in small words. To blow up cannons, need explosives. No explosives, no explosions. You executed! Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Explosives located? Cozmotronic! Soon you teach Exiles lesson about Chua ingenuity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No room for error! Time running out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Only one more task! Apply explosives, blow cannons to smithereens!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You searched Scarhide Camp and recovered the stolen $(vitem=364).
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Dreg filthy creatures. Lower life forms, but cunning. Walk like men, think like beasts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You disobey Mondo's orders? You make huge mistake this time!

localizedTextIdText: The game huntresses of Bloodfire patrol Bloodfire Savannah and bear witness to the Great Hunt. Demonstrate your bravery by engaging in combat right before their eyes. The more impressive your performance, the greater your reputation will be throughout Deradune. Be bold!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mika in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I watch the savannah, observing the great hunt. Kill a beast before my eyes, and I will spread tales of your glory throughout Bloodfire.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is more to be seen from you, I suspect. Face foes within my view, and you will gain glory.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Game Huntresses on the savannah bring us stories of new hunters. Defeat your foes near them, and your glory shall increase.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, the mighty $(player.name)! The Huntresses speak well of you. Be welcome, and please examine my wares.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The better my view, the better my tale. Draw your foes in close to me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You faced dangerous foes before the proud game huntresses of Bloodfire Savannah. Tales of your glory now echo throughout Deradune, and the Draken of Bloodfire Village have extended you a warm welcome.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What kind of beasts should I hunt?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Simple prey is fine, I suppose, but I would be much more impressed if you brought down a more dangerous creature, one who hunts as you hunt them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes! Those who please the game huntresses will receive special rewards honoring their bravery and cunning. See Mika in the village once you have proven your worth. I look forward to seeing what you can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We all hunt in different ways.

localizedTextIdText: You found a tracking device implanted behind the eyeballs of a ferocious beast that was air-dropped into Deradune. You have no idea what to do with it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the Genetic Performance Tracker to Researcher Zeelo in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This curious device was implanted just behind the eyes of the creature you killed. It has a flashing red light and a button.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fight recorder fully intact. Extensive data tracking! Minion did well to return promptly. Now go away. Must study results!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned the Genetic Performance Tracker to Researcher Zeelo in Bloodfire Village.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax ordered you to use recovered explosives to destroy the Exile Anti-Air Cannon at the Megatech Gun Emplacement in Bloodstone Canyon. Once the cannons are destroyed, Dominion forces should be able to deploy troops properly.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Take recovered explosives, use them. Destroy Exile anti-air cannons so main Dominion force can deploy. Blow up everything!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Cannons still shooting! You not hear? Dominion deployment impossible until cannons destroyed! Now go, quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Cannons still shooting! You not hear? Dominion deployment impossible until cannons destroyed! Now go, quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Cannons blown to bits! Dominion ships bomb Exiles now! Too bad you survive, though. Mondo send you on more missions. You not survive them all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Explosives make big boom. Get too close, you go boom too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Is compliment!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Exile Anti-Air Cannon, allowing the main Dominion assault force to strike at Megatech Station.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes! Everything! Well... maybe not everything. Leave some pieces for research. Yes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No time for games now. You not blow up cannons, you suffer later.

localizedTextIdText: You joined up with Scout Malius at Jagged Rock Cove at the orders of Clanlord Makaza. Exile miners have moved into the area and are being protected by a Granok free company. Your mission is to take the Jagged Rock mercenaries out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Malius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exile miners are stealing accelerite from the Jagged Rock caves, protected by Granok guards-for-hire. Get rid of the mercenaries first.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Help me eliminate these Exile scum!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: These Exile miners believe they are safe surrounded by their Granok mercenaries. Kill off their guards and teach them a lesson.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. The honor of Clan Bloodfire has been upheld. Clanlord Makaza will be pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Their presence desecrates the Great Hunt. They will pay for this insult!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleaned up the Granok mercenaries around Jagged Rock Cove in preparation for driving the Exile miners out of the area.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How long have you served Clanlord Makaza?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My line has pledged our swords to Clan Bloodfire for many generations, but I fought for the clanlord when he was also known as General Makaza. Together, we hunted many honorless groups for the glory of the Dominion, much like that Granok free company down there. In fact, their leader is known to both me and the clanlord.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Be careful. Few who defy the clanlord's wishes survive.

localizedTextIdText: Scout Malius has tracked down Mercenary Arkos, the leader of the Granok free company protecting Jagged Rock Mine. He wants you to neutralize Mercenary Arkos so he can be teleported to Bloodfire Village to receive Clanlord Makaza justice.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Clanlord Makaza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've discovered the location of Mercenary Arkos. Makaza wants him taken alive. Weaken him in battle, and I will teleport him back to Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your prey still awaits. Find Mercenary Arkos and weaken him in battle. I will teleport him back to Bloodfire once he has been defeated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why have you come before me? Arkos still roams free!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mercenary Arkos, my old nemesis! You defeated and humiliated him in battle! Your victory will always be remembered by the Draken of Clan Bloodfire.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember... don't kill Arkos! Makaza wants him alive!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we await the arrival of the Luminai. This hunt will be to his liking, I think.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You battled Mercenary Arkos in Jagged Rock Mine, until he was weakened and unable to fight. He was teleported back to Bloodfire Village, where Clanlord Makaza will decide his fate.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where can I find Mercenary Arkos?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: He's overseeing the mining operations deep inside Jagged Rock Mine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you a fool? One does not displease a Draken clanlord lightly.

localizedTextIdText: The time has come to deal with the thieving Exile miners. Clanlord Makaza wants you to kill the Exile miners in Jagged Rock Mine. The Exiles must be taught that nobody steals from the Clanlord Makaza.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Clanlord Makaza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Not only does their presence pollute the Great Hunt, but these Exile miners are stealing what is mine! Slaughter them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you punished the Exiles for their insult against Clan Bloodfire? Do not wait another moment! Only through blood can we atone for this offense.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A great victory for Clan Bloodfire! Today, we have driven the Exiles out of Deradune. Tomorrow, the Dominion will conquer all of Nexus!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The ancient laws of the Draken demand that such an offense be paid in blood.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll show them what happens to thieves.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll make it more painful next time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have dealt with the Exile mining operation in Jagged Rock Mine. No more resources will be stolen from Clanlord Makaza lands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My Chua scientists tell me it is accelerite. They seemed extremely excited about a few red rocks, but then again, they are Chua. Why should I care? A few rocks? A blade of grass? What matters is that the Exiles dare to steal from me!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Your cowardice is a shame to the people of this clan!

localizedTextIdText: A captured Chua who's being roasted alive wants the Dreg to feel the Dominion's wrath. Take vengeance on behalf of the Roasting Chua{p:Roasting Chua} by slaughtering Dreg and burning Scarhide Camp to the ground.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Too late for me... nearly cooked through! But you... you make Dreg pay before they eat me!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I die... with scent... of tender Chua... in my nose....
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Left cooking Chua unavenged? Even Mondo squeeze out tear for cooking Chua!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dreg cooking Chua? Disgusting! Yet Mondo wonders... how Chua taste when slow-cooked? Never mind! You made Dreg pay for meal, yes?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make Dreg suffer! Avenge me! Dreg use too much salt!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent! Dreg savages must learn abject lesson in who not to eat!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You slaughtered Dreg and burned Scarhide Camp to the ground. The Roasting Chua{p:Roasting Chua} would be proud.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I haunt you! I haunt you forever!

localizedTextIdText: This Dreg Abomination's Skull is strange, as if it's the product of deliberate biological engineering. Deliver the Abomination's Skull to the hologram of Mondo Zax in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Abomination's Skull to Mondo Zax Hologram
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg Abomination's skull reveals disturbing things about its physiology. Mondo Zax would doubtless be interested in examining the creature's skull.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All Dreg heads ugly. But this one different. Big. Mutated or altered. Perplexing! Who modified Dreg? Why?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I keep skull. You get back to work or I keep yours, too.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this skull to Mondo.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated a Dreg Abomination and brought its skull to Mondo Zax. On further examination, Mondo believes the creature was a deliberate experiment of some kind.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Abomination's Skull to Mondo Zax

localizedTextIdText: There's been no word from Arvina Farmstead since the plague started, and Guard Captain Grachus is concerned about what it might mean. He's asked you to travel into the eastern farmlands and see if things are as they should be.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Flasia Arvina at the Arvina Farmstead
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some say silence is bliss, but I think it means trouble. The farms outside the city have been quiet... too quiet. Could you head that way and take a look?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Any word from the outlying farms yet? They're still not answering our comm calls, and I hate to think what that might mean.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Captain Grachus needn't worry. I've ordered the farm quarantined until the threat of plague has passed. What else did he expect me to do?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Until we get things cleaned up, we'll be as busy as Lopp in a veggie patch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, don't worry about us. I'm sure we'll be fine without you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Flasia Arvina at Arvina Farmstead has closed her farm up tightly, and she isn't allowing anyone in or out so long as there are still rumors of plague in Hycrest.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Can you tell me about Flasia?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Check the Arvina Farmstead first. Flasia Arvina oversees those particular acres.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: She's an independent sort. Beautiful in her way, and wealthy besides. But you needn't mention that to her.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bloody worthless, that's what you are.

localizedTextIdText: Plagued Strawgrazer Bull are wandering too close to the Arvina Farmstead. Vetina Casca has asked you to lend a hand in slaughtering the plagued animals before they spread their contagion to her farm workers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Flasia Arvina at the Arvina Farmstead
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Arvina is an optimist - she can use all the help she can get. Plagued strawgrazer bulls are wandering in from neighboring farms, and they should be put down.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you killed off the plagued strawgrazers yet? There's no time to lose! We can't risk their sickness spreading to Arvina's livestock!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've been meaning to have those infected bulls killed. Feel free to slaughter them yourself, if you like.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Vetina put you up to killing the bulls, did she? I know she means well, but this is my farm... not hers. Nevertheless, I suppose I should thank her.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If they get too close, they'll infect Arvina's livestock and workers.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put them out of their misery.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You put a number of Plagued Strawgrazer Bull out of their misery at the Arvina Farmstead for Flasia Arvina.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll put them out of their misery.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put them out of their misery.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Vetina Casca. Flasia is allowing me to stay on her land until the current troubles have passed Auroria by.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You mean you don't want to help?

localizedTextIdText: Vetina Casca fled from her family's farm before she could be infected by the plague. Though she is currently safe at the Arvina Farmstead, she is deathly afraid of what she will find when she returns home. She has asked you to return to the Casca Farmstead in her place and learn what has become of her family.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Vetina Casca via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When the plague came to my family's farm, I ran away and found my way here. I worry after my family, but I can't bear to return. Could you go for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you checked on my family yet? Are they well? Or has the plague... killed them? Or has it... oh, I can't bear to think on it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Exiles on my family's land? And my father and brother dead? The Exiles must pay!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, thank you! I only hope my parents are still alive! And my brother, too!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You searched the Casca Farmstead, and the news wasn't good. Her father had died, her brother had been driven mad by the plague, and her mother was delirious. In addition, Exile troops were patrolling the farmstead grounds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh... well. I suppose I can head back myself... someday.

localizedTextIdText: The Casca Farmstead has been ravaged by the plague, and Exiles might be responsible. Guard Captain Grachus wants you to find some clues leading to the plague's origin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guard Captain Grachus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It looks like you've uncovered something of importance with your heroics. Why not kill those filthy Exiles and see if they're carrying any intelligence?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still waiting for you to find something interesting on the corpse of a dead Exile.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at that! These aren't your typical, run of the mill Exile troops. These are members of the Black Hoods. You may be in over your head.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I realize that expecting Exiles to have intelligence is stretching things a bit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've discovered an entrance to the Poxbrew Enclave on the Casca Farmstead. The Exiles responsible are not only involved with the plague, but also belong to the infamous Black Hoods: the dark spies and assassins of the Mordesh!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do you know what I've found?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have been monitoring your progress. The source of the plague is still unknown, and it could return in a new form if we do not uncover the truth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're making a mistake, citizen.

localizedTextIdText: You've located the underground Mordesh enclave beneath Casca Farmstead. The Black Hoods are concocting additional plagues and testing them on victims taken from Auroria's populace. Collect Medical Components{p: Medical Components}, combine them to craft a cure, and test the cure on the Black Hoods' prisoners.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guard Captain Grachus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While we have a cure for the original plague, the Black Hoods have obviously continued to iterate on their design.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Locate medical supplies and use them to create a cure for the new plague. Then test it on the Exiles' prisoners.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well, citizen. With a cure for the plague's latest iteration, we can defeat the disease before it even begins to spread.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Agreed. Steal their medical components and see if you can concoct a new cure.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now it is time for you to put an end to this enclave's leadership.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've created a cure for the new strain of plague invented by Plaguebrew alchemists, and you've successfully tested it on the Exiles' prisoners in Poxbrew Enclave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are in the thick of things. Accidents happen.

localizedTextIdText: Though curing the plague is a worthwhile goal, denying the enemy the tools they need to create it is also a worthwhile pursuit. To this end, locate the supplies used by the Mordesh to manufacture the plague in Poxbrew Enclave and destroy them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guard Captain Grachus in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The table is stocked with supplies used to create diseases. Perhaps destroying these supplies, and others like them, will impede the Black Hoods' efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The table is stocked with supplies used to create diseases. Perhaps destroying these supplies, and others like them, will impede the Black Hoods' efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If only there were some way to destroy the Blacks Hoods' means of creating their plagues!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our enemies will likely find other sources with which to fuel their terrible diseases, but for now, you have denied them the supplies they require.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll smash and burn it all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've denied the Mordesh of Poxbrew Enclave the tools and supplies necessary to create another epidemic.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll smash and burn it all.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.

localizedTextIdText: Guard Captain Grachus has ordered you to find and capture the director of the Poxbrew Enclave. The Black Hoods must be brought to justice for their crimes!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guard Captain Grachus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mordesh enclaves always have a director present. Find and capture the director, so we can administer justice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in blazes are you doing here? If the Mordesh director escapes from Poxbrew Enclave, I'll have your head!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. With Director Ehlsa taken alive, we'll be able to extract information from her prior to her execution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am dispatching a unit to take the prisoner.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, neither can I, $(player.name)... neither can I.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Poxbrew Enclave is in a shambles. You captured Director Ehlsa, and she has been taken away to face her interrogation and inevitable execution.

localizedTextIdText: Governor Aluviel requests your presence in the town square of Hycrest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Governor Aluviel in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have done amazing work, $(player.name). Please let us meet in the center of Hycrest so I can express my gratitude.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Dominion owes you a great debt. As a sign of our eternal appreciation, we present you with this Hero of Hycrest holographic statue! Thank you, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will await you in Hycrest's town square.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Every citizen of Hycrest is honored by your presence!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have accomplished great deeds for the Dominion. You've been presented with a great honor: your own holographic statue in the town square of Hycrest!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You insult me!

localizedTextIdText: Agent Vivax of the ICI has informed you of a plague epidemic in Hycrest. If you are willing to help the ICI investigate this illness, travel there and speak with Agent Marcus, as well as Hycrest's governor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Marcus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A communique from Hycrest indicates a plague has broken out in Auroria. The ICI requests that you travel to Hycrest at once and speak to the Governor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Travel to Auroria at once. This plague is a dire threat to the citizens of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to the Governor? You had better do so. I am certain he has much to say about the current crisis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Governor is correct. We have very little time to get to the bottom of this situation. Every moment is precious when so many lives are at stake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak to Marcus, one of our agents, after you arrive in Auroria.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Agent Marcus in Hycrest, as well as Governor Aluviel, and you learned that there's a virulent plague sweeping through Auroria. Track the epidemic to its source.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I find your lack of initiative vexing. I strongly recommend you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Find Mondo Zax outside Megatech Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax near Megatech Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Invasion commences! Come to Megatech Station! Mondo will give you orders there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why waiting? Get to Megatech Station now, immediately! Time to fight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Time to continue assault! Maybe you even die for Dominion this time!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mondo can hardly wait.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You good lackey. Follow orders exactly!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Mondo Zax outside Megatech Station.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Station near gun emplacements. Listen for explosions and screams of dying, then follow ears.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mondo not wait forever. Leave you here for Dreg food.

localizedTextIdText: Minion Togor in Feralplain Testing Range wants you to use the Aggression Enhancer Beam on the Unmodified Pumera{p:Enhanced Pumera} in the pen nearby. Once the pumera have been enhanced, kill them to test their combat capabilities.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Minion Togor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You help test aggression enhancer beam. Modify pumera in nearby yellow pens. Then fight! After all, must test combat capabilities.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still need data from aggression enhancement tests. Zap pumera, then fight. Maybe survive. Get on it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Modified pumera improved, yes? Still, test subjects failed to kill you. Disappointing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Been running out of testers. Keep dying. Very inconvenient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Other tests to do! More data to collect!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Minion Togor in his research on the modified pumera at Feralplain Testing Range.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Feralplain Testing Range where Chua do all our animal testing! Make creatures bigger, meaner, stronger. Makes Draken happy when released onto savannah. Also do some weapons testing. Sometimes do both at once!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Zax won't like this.

localizedTextIdText: Minion Togor of Feralplain Testing Range has asked you to test his latest invention: the Carnivorizor. The Carnivorizor is theorized to transform peaceful herbivores into carnivorous, ravening predators. Test the device on the gentle dawngrazers in the green pen and observe the effects.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Supervisor Renla in central Feralplain Testing Range
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dawngrazers harmless creatures. In other words, useless! Much better if carnivorous. Enter the Carnivorizer! Zap dawngrazers with it, see what happens.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did Carnivorizor work on dawngrazers? Must know test results! Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sent you on errand, yes? Keeps you busy. Much more to do here. Finish testing, then come back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have Carnivorizor? Had malfunction before, testers ate fellow testers. Guess it works fine now, though. Lucky for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If theory correct, dawngrazers should crave flesh afterwards. Might even eat you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hmm? Why you look at me like that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Carnivorizor to turn the gentle dawngrazers of Feralplain Testing Range into slavering beasts hungry for the taste of meat. Mad science at its finest!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Test only dangerous if you get eaten. I promise!

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla needs your help freeing testers from razortail cages inFeralplain Testing Range. The last team of testers got trapped in the razortail cages after a successful experiment involving razortail intelligence enhancers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Supervisor Renla on the Feralplain Testing Range
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Recent razortail intelligence enhancement test success! Maybe too successful. After test, razortails locked testers in cage. Need someone to free them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Free testers from razortail cages yet? With low survival rates, need all the testers we can get!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! Team freed with very little physical trauma. Mostly psychological. Testers now exhibit irrational fear of razortails! Fascinating!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May have to work on tester intelligence enhancers next.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully freed testers trapped in razortail cages on the Feralplain Testing Range.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then who test experiments? You? Hope you like overtime. And probable death.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla has asked you to check up on Minion Togor, who was last seen near the High Security Pen on the Feralplain Testing Range.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Minion Togor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: New crisis! Lost contact with Togor, last seen near high security pen. Very troubling. Keep dangerous specimens in there. Find out what happened!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find any sign of Minion Togor, dead or alive? High security pen dangerous. Better you than me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You take care of problem in high security pen? What you wait for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Congratulations! First tester to survive Experiment 878! Power outage? Just story we cooked up to create blind test.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Togor dead, I next in line to become minion of the Zax. Will reduce life expectancy by at least two-thirds!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Zax will be pleased. Promoting you to full-time tester! Still no health benefits, though.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can find him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went to the High Security Pen and found Minion Togor, who was concerned that the experiment inside may have grown too dangerous. You killed Experiment 878, only to find your ordeal was all an elaborate test engineered by Togor and Renla.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll keep trying to find him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I didn't need you, would vaporize you.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Marcus wants to meet with you to compare notes on the cause of the plague in Auroria. He's waiting for you in Hycrest Cemetery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Marcus at the Hycrest Cemetery
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Come and speak to me. I will await you at Hycrest Cemetery behind the mausoleum. There is something I must show you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a close call. It's obvious we're stepping on someone's toes, but who could it be?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope you have a strong stomach. Marcus out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes. With some persuasion, he may offer us some additional insight.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Agent Marcus at the Hycrest Cemetery. Then assassins ambushed you. There's obviously some kind of conspiracy going on in Auroria, and someone doesn't want either of you revealing the plague's source.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My superiors will hear of your... reluctance.

localizedTextIdText: A Chua research team was sent into Feralplain Testing Range to test a new chemical weapon, but never returned. Supervisor Renla wants you to find the researchers and collect their data.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Supervisor Renla via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sent Chua research team to test new chemical weapon. None returned. Maybe dead, maybe not. Either way, not important. But still need their data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find Alpha team. Obtain test notes. Reproduction steps very important.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You find Chua researchers? Not interested in researchers as much as their data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Chemical experiment great success! Learned not one, but two important things! Chemical weapons effective. And hazmat suits defective. Cozmotronic!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Test data critical! Must know if chemical effective or just really stinky.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now must request new hazmat suits for second round of tests.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Chua researchers, who had all died while testing their chemical weapons due to faulty hazmat suits.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You make decision whether to vaporize you easy.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex is concerned with the giant trees that have seemingly materialized overnight on the Deradune savannahs. He asks that you scout Wildwood Grove and learn what you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A forest seems to have suddenly appeared in the middle of the savannah. Scout the area and learn the cause of this disturbing event.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must learn what is behind the sudden appearance of these trees.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: An Eldan terraformer is in the hands of the Aurin? That's a dangerous device to leave in the hands of nature-loving dissidents.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There is no precedence for such an occurrence.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must stop these savages before it is too late.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've scouted Wildwood Grove and discovered the Aurin have activated an Eldan terraformer, turning this part of Deradune into a verdant oasis.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is it with the Aurin and Deradune?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, it defies logic. Our best analysts are unable to speculate how the Aurin could have acquired such power. We suspect the worst.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Aurin are enemies of the Dominion, but they harbor an especial hatred for the cultural practices of the Draken. It is our belief they come to Deradune to stop the Draken from hunting savannah creatures. They hold the Chua responsible for the destruction of their homeworld. Their arrival may also be motivated by revenge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That was not a request, $(player.class).

localizedTextIdText: The Aurin have somehow gained control of an Eldan terraformer. Agent Lex has ordered you to take it down. Venture into Wildwood Grove and disable the Eldan terraformer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Lex at Outreach Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Allowing the Aurin to terraform the savannahs into forests would yield them a significant tactical advantage. That terraformer must be shut down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We cannot allow the Aurin to continue with their plan to terraform Deradune. Shut down that terraformer!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. You've averted the present crisis. It will take some time to drive the Aurin out of Deradune, but with the terraformer gone, they can never succeed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Act quickly. Every moment that passes brings the Aurin closer to their goal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will note your accomplishment in your ICI personnel file.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've shut down the Eldan Terraformer in Wildwood Grove and thwarted the Aurin plan to turn all of Deradune into forestland.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you know about Eldan terraformers?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What happens if the Aurin succeed in terraforming Deradune?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There have been several reports of similar Eldan structures across Nexus, but this is the first time I've encountered one. Undoubtedly, they represent one of the more powerful Eldan artifacts left behind on Nexus, but we can only speculate what the Eldan used them for.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is our mission to ensure that is a statistical improbability. The Aurin are most comfortable in biomes that resemble their forest homeworld. They've evolved to fight in the forest and draw power from the presence of plant life. We cannot allow them these advantages in our territories.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Unacceptable. You will reconsider that response.

localizedTextIdText: A formula for the cure is in hand, thanks to Master Rodaeuss confession. In order to process the cure successfully, samples will need to be taken from infected slanks in Auroria. Slanks are typically found in basements throughout Hycrest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Alchemist Pontiniain the Hycrest Barracks in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Rodaeus has given us a good starting point. Even so, our researchers will require samples of plagued slank flesh if they're going to create a cure.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Without the plagued flesh samples from the slanks, we will never create a cure of any effectiveness. Look for the samples in the city's basements.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can't begin production of a plague cure until I have some infected samples to work with. I believe slanks were supposed to be trapped throughout the city.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These samples will do nicely, thank you. I will get to work at once!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Traps have been set in many of Hycrest's basements. Check them for samples of flesh.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If this formula works, it will be the answer to Hycrest's prayers!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected a sufficient number of plagued flesh samples from slanks in Hycrest. You are one step closer to finding a cure for the plague epidemic.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you so faithless as to allow us to fail?

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Pontinia has asked for your help in creating and testing batches of a cure for the plague in Auroria. Create the treatment. Then test it on her research subjects just outside the Hycrest Barracks in Hycrest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Alchemist Pontinia in the Hycrest Barracks in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This cure can go any number of ways. First, we need to create a number of test batches. Then we'll have to test them out on infected subjects.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How is the chemistry going? I know it's a droll task, but you need to work hard if you're going to cure the people of Hycrest. The subjects are outside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I was concerned for a bit, but it looks like you have discovered a winning combination of ingredients.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will provide three test subjects, and you will test your treatments on them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soon this plague will be nothing but a bad memory.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After testing several iterations of plague treatment for Alchemist Pontinia, you found the ideal formula in the Hycrest Barracks. Now it's time to cure the citizens of Hycrest.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll test it on the subjects.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't expect me to do this all by myself, do you?

localizedTextIdText: Now that a treatment for the plague in Auroria has been discovered, the infected citizens who have taken refuge in the Hycrest Church must be cured.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Governor Aluviel at his home in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that we have a cure, we must see it given to those who need it most. Hycrest's nobles have taken refuge in the church. Tend to them at once!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you taken the cure to the church? High Priest Vallarus is expecting you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I heard that you've have cured the plague! Splendid! Have you treated the folk at the church yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hycrest's nightmare is almost over! Almost, but not quite. There is still much left for you to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pontinia will continue to manufacture this cure, but there isn't enough for everyone yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must regain order in Hycrest.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've used the first batch of treatment to cure the highborn citizens of the plague in Auroria who had taken refuge in the Hycrest Church.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We haven't enough of your medicine to see to the entire population, so we must treat the most deserving first.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Fear not. The peasants will have their turn, once we have seen to those citizens within the city walls.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you? Swine!

localizedTextIdText: The Lopp of Wigwalli Village in Whitevale are under attack by Marauders! Head there and help them!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chief Migisi in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wigwalli Village is under attack by Redmoon Marauders! Please come help Lopp! Big-folk like you are only hope!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We are under attack by Redmood Marauders! Please come help us and our village!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank the great Dak-Buun you've come! The Redmoon Marauders will ruin Wigwalli Village if not stopped!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, big shiny thank you! We wait for strong big-folk to come!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your way to the little Lopp settlement called Wigwalli Village in Whitevale. The Lopp there can really use your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But you must help Lopp! Think of Lopp children!

localizedTextIdText: Lowborn have gathered at the Hycrest gates to demand equal access to the cure for the plague sweeping Auroria. The guards have asked you to scan the assembled lowborn, separate the sick from the healthy, and send those with symptoms into the city to seek treatment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to a Gate Guard in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are enough doses of the cure remaining to treat a handful of the assembled lowborn. Scan these citizens. Then send the sickest to the church to be treated.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There are still some doses of cure left. Scan the lowborn near the gates. Send in the sickest to be treated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are still some doses of cure left. Scan the lowborn near the gates. Send in the sickest to be treated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At least we were able to save those who were the worst off.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: What else can we do? Until there are enough doses of the cure to go around, they'll have to wait.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've sent as many sick lowborn citizens into Hycrest as the current stocks of the cure will allow. Sadly, the rest will have to wait until more medicine can be produced for Auroria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So you'd rather let them die out here?

localizedTextIdText: Though a cure for the plague has been discovered, it will be some time before enough is produced to cure the entirety of Auroria's population. Governor Aluviel has learned that there are disturbances at the Hycrest city gates, and he has asked you to help keep order.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with a Gate Guard at any of Hycrest's Gates
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lowborn citizens, driven to dissent by their fears of the plague, are gathering at the city gates. Will you go to the gates and help keep things under control?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you reported to the gate guards yet? You should do so, before the situation with the lowborn spirals out of control.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for coming on such short notice. As you can see, the lowborn from the surrounding countryside have gathered to demand the cure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent. I cannot have the lowborn sowing chaos in my city.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If something isn't done soon, things are going to get ugly around here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You learned that lowborn citizens were gathering at the gates of Hycrest, demanding the cure for the plague sweeping Auroria.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I am on my way, my lord.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with a Gate Guard at the City Gates
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You fool. You cannot tell me "no."

localizedTextIdText: Lord Benevolo fields and the Southern Farms are infested with plague-infected animals. If the plague is to be contained, these beasts must be eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lord Benevolo at Greenfield Estate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Packs of infested wildlife roam my lands, spreading plague and terrorizing my lowborn. I would like you to eradicate them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The lowborn are still wailing about the plagued beasts in the fields. You do intend to destroy these animals, don't you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, yes. You have done a fair job of killing the infected beasts. I thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you succeed, it will be one less thing for the lowborn to whine about.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've destroyed a number of infected animals in the region of the Southern Farms, thus preventing further spread of the plague to Lord Benevolo lowborn subjects.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? No? You will pay for your refusal.

localizedTextIdText: Lord Benevolo investigation has revealed that the goods produced on the southern farms have been contaminated with disease. With your help, he plans to destroy the food storage silos irreparably tainted by the plague.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Benevolo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As much as it pains me, the silos used to store foodstuffs in the southern farmlands must be destroyed. This plague must end!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go now. Use fire to reduce the silos to ashes and debris... and do it quickly! We cannot afford to show weakness now, not with so much at stake!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sacrifices must be made. Once the lowborn have shrugged off the plague, they can keep busy rebuilding the silos you destroyed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Setting fire to these silos will ensure the plague is burned out of Hycrest.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope that takes care of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: All major food storage silos in the southern farms have been destroyed, wiping out the source of the plague in Hycrest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are a bigger fool than I originally took you for.

localizedTextIdText: The Aurin have brought over a forest giant to guard Wildwood Grove. Agent Lex has ordered you to kill the forest giant. Then you should destroy the Aurin's transportation portal, so that no more Aurin can arrive in Deradune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I neglected to mention the Aurin have brought a forest giant to guard the portal they used to travel here. Neutralize it. Then destroy the portal.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The forest giant guards the portal the Aurin are using to travel to Deradune. Kill the giant, then destroy the portal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A forest giant guards the portal the Aurin are using to travel to Deradune. Kill the giant. Then destroy the portal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm impressed you were able to take down that grove guardian so quickly. With the portal closed, we will be able to crush the remaining Aurin easily.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We will cut off their escape.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Once again, you have proven your value to the ICI.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've managed to kill Yirian, the forest giant guarding Wildwood Grove, and shut down the Aurin portal. That should prevent the Aurin from escaping or calling for reinforcements.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. We've confirmed that Aurin matria possesses the ability to connect forests to one another. It's a unique trait we believe is associated with their close bond to those forests. As you can imagine, this presents certain strategic difficulties for us.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Deradune is controlled by the Draken. It is difficult, but not impossible, for the Exiles to enter through the portal. Most likely, it connects to an Exile-controlled territory. The portal also allows them to transport far more soldiers than if they snuck in through conventional means.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why the sudden change of heart? Have you been turned?

localizedTextIdText: The workers and livestock of the Arvina Farmstead are under constant threat from a canimid colloquially known as Redsnout the Ravenous. Farmer Pelus, whose favorite redfeather was recently killed by the beast, has asked you to track Redsnout down and kill it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Flasia Arvina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good day to you. Least, it would be, if someone would put an end to Redsnout the Ravenous. He's the biggest, meanest canimid in these parts, he is.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You'd best get to searching the canimid burrows in the fields if you're ever to avenge me old Nan. Never was a better redfeather, eh?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Pelus tells me you're going to kill Redsnout. You'd best check the canimid burrows in the fields. Might need a larger weapon, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Word's spreading that you've done for old Redsnout. I guess you're welcome on the farm whenever you like. It's the least I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He killed Nan, me favorite redfeather! Still cry meself to sleep at night, I do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked down and killed Redsnout the Ravenous on behalf of the workers of the Arvina Farmstead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can't say as I blame you. Redsnout's a killer!

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Pelus at the Arvina Farmstead has asked you to find and pull out clumps of Strangleweed, a plant that literally chokes the crops the farmers are attempting to cultivate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Pelus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're getting behind on our work. Strangleweed, for instance. Ain't no one to pull it, so it's springing up all over. Lend me a hand, would you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can't walk ten paces without tripping over a clump of strangleweed, no sir. Look 'round the fields, you'll see it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a right good $(player.class) in me book, friend, helping to pull up some of the strangleweed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Glad to have you. Lots of folks are sick on account of the plague.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It'll be nice when everyone's back to work, won't it?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Farmer Pelus by removing several growths of Strangleweed around the Arvina Farmstead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, where are you going? Come back! There's work to be done!

localizedTextIdText: Agent Marcus has informed you that enough of the plague cure has been manufactured to treat the lowborn citizens of Hycrest. Travel to the plague-ravaged Grovewood Infirmary and administer the treatment to infected citizens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Marcus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Alchemist Pontinia has created enough medicine to cure the infected lowborn citizens of Hycrest's farmlands. See they are properly treated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you administered the cure to the lowborn in the southern farmlands yet? If they are not cured soon, it will cost the Dominion dearly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I believe the Hycrest epidemic is finally behind us. There is much that we must still reveal concerning its source, but for the time being... we are safe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am transmitting a batch of medicine to you now. Good luck.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've cured the lowborn citizens of Hycrest of a virulent plague.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You think this is a request? Think again.

localizedTextIdText: You have been ordered by Victor Lazarin to mark the fall back location for Exile troops still fighting in Whitevale. Once the flares have been lit, the evacuation can begin. There is a risk, of course, that any Squirg Zombies that remain in the Blasted Fields may be drawn to the bright lights.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I believe it is time to put this pestilent place behind us. Herald the evacuation by lighting signal flares, and utilize this flamethrower to defend yourself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have failed to light all the signal flares. Do not allow the squirg zombies to dissuade you from such an important task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The evacuation commences. Now we will put these wicked woes behind us and look to our future on this fantastic planet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The squirg zombies will likely be attracted to the bright lights. Beware!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Likewise. I expect to experience more of your endeavors before too much time expires.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You lit flares and signaled the start of the Exile evacuation of the Blasted Fields. The battle for the Blasted Fields is something everyone wants to put behind them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is our last push. How can you turn your back on all you have accomplished here?

localizedTextIdText: A number of Lord Benevolo lowborn subjects became ill after consuming produce gathered in the southern farmlands. He has asked you to go to the Sallec Farmstead and scan the produce sold there to see if it is contaminated with the plague.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lord Benevolo at Greenfield Estate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Several lowborn fell ill after consuming produce from the Farmer's Market. I suspect something is awry with the produce. Would you care to investigate?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you scanned the produce at the Farmer's Market for contamination? We need to confirm my suspicions!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew it! The produce being sold at the Farmer's Market festers with plague! It is time to bring this bothersome epidemic to an end!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Analyze produce using this scanbot... and don't eat anything!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The sooner my lowborn have recovered, the better this situation will be for my purse.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your examination of the produce at the Sallec Farmstead has revealed that it has been contaminated by the plague.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are worse than useless!

localizedTextIdText: Agent Marcus has contacted you. His investigations in Hycrest have revealed a suspect identified by Dealer Rakon as Demitrius Kole. Rakon is supposed to deliver a parcel of plague vials to Kole near the red barn in Grimsworth Downs in Hycrest's southern farmlands. You're going to show up instead.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Marcus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's been a development! Rakon has revealed the identity of the client who paid him to deliver an explosive crate to City Hall. It's Demitrius Kole.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Eliminate Demitrius Kole before he makes his escape! Find the red barn at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've eliminated your target. It's a shame he could not be taken alive, but I think we can live with his death. And now for some good news....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Listen closely to this comm call between Rakon and our person of interest.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You confronted Demitrius Kole near the red barn in Grimsworth Downs and put an end to his plague.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are a faithless dagun to turn your back on the Dominion.

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Titus claims he was wounded by a giant spider in Gravespinner Wood outside of Hycrest. Unless the creatures are dealt with, others will suffer the same fate as him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Titus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I don't know if I'll make it... so beware! There are giant spiders in the nearby trees! They wait to pounce on the unwary, and must be stopped! You hear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The people of Hycrest won't be safe so long as the shadows crawl with spiders! Big, nasty, venomous spiders!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done the impossible, you have! Those spiders didn't stand a chance against you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You should be, else you're a fool... a brave fool!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm still scraping 'em off my boots.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took to killing giant spiders in the trees outside of Hycrest, significantly reducing their numbers on behalf of Farmer Titus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If only some brave person would do away with those wretched beasts!

localizedTextIdText: The reason Farmer Titus ventured into the spider-infested trees was to look for several missing farmhands. He believes the spiders must be responsible for their disappearances, and would like you to search for them in the Gravespinner Wood.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Titus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A number of my farmhands have vanished. That's why I went into those trees, you see?  And now I fear for their lives! Keep an eye out for them, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found my farmhands? I'd be a broken man if anything's happened to them. They've all got families, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My friends have returned from the trees, and they've a lot to say about you saving them. You're a true hero, you know that?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I appreciate your help. If anyone can find them and save them, it's you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Farmer Tituss farmhands in the Gravespinner Wood and freed them from the spiders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got a lot of nerve turning me down, mate.

localizedTextIdText: Far-Trader Jo has contacted you and asked you to speak to Chief Migisi in Wigwalli Village. Jo seems to think that the Lopp of Wigwalli are in need of a hero.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chief Migisi in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello $(player.race)! Come with Lopp, meet Chief Migisi. Wigwalli Village need hero, and chief give hero welcome!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please take kurg to Wigwalli. Kurg smells funny, but move very fast for size. You'll see!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You come to Wigwalli? Why? Who send you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp welcome you! You honored guest of Lopp now. Honored guest can help Lopp in exchange for hospitality. Is good trade!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take kurg to Wigwalli. Smells funny, but is good animal for riding.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Chief Migisi in Wigwalli Village in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Our village is Wigwalli. It outside of terraformed lands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aww... big-folk sure? Wigwalli need hero right about now.

localizedTextIdText: The brood mother of the Grave Spiders, known as Gravespinner, must be exterminated. She can be found in Gravespinner Wood.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Farmer Titus near Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a rumor of a great spider brood mother in those trees somewhere. If she's not killed, she'll lay more eggs and the spiders will return.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find the brood mother? Gravespinner, they call her. Biggest and meanest of the lot, she is! Fangs like spears, she has!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The woods will be free of spiders now, thanks to your heroism. I know it's not much, but take this reward as well as my thanks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Seek her out in those trees, and be careful... she's like to be a mighty beast!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye, stranger! Dominus walk with you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Gravespinner, calming Farmer Tituss fears.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've done so much, only to turn craven now. Why?

localizedTextIdText: The Vandarins have been kidnapping sick citizens and executing them in a misguided effort to oppose the plague. Farmhand Julia has asked that you go to the Vandarin Orchard and put a stop to these atrocities. Rescue the kidnapped lowborn before they are killed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Farmhand Julia at the Vandarin Market
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's the Vandarins! They've been kidnapping our folk and executing them! They think they can stop the plague from spreading by killing people!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have the Vandarin atrocities been stopped? Have you saved any of the kidnapped lowborn? The highborn should be watchin' over us, not killin' us!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: They've been saved! I've seen them with my own eyes. They've all got your name on their lips! You're a right hero, you are!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you! Be quick, please! Stop the killings and save the farmers!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't express what your deeds mean to me! Thank you! Thank you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put a stop to it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've put an end to the Vandarin practice of kidnapping sick lowborn citizens and executing them. Farmhand Julia at the Vandarin Market is overjoyed at your success.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're a highborn family. As wicked as they come, they are. They have no problem with murderin' lowborn, whether they're sick or not!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can you turn your back on us? Really?

localizedTextIdText: You recovered a family crest from Contulius Vandarin after he attacked you. Perhaps Lord Benevolo at the Greenfield Estate can tell you more about the Vandarin family.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Vandarin Family Crest to Lord Benevolo at the Greenfield Estate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This family crest, marked as belonging to the Vandarin family, sparkles in the light. Perhaps Noble Benevolo can explain what it represents.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Run afoul of the Vandarin family, have you? They are a decadent, violent lot who treat their lowborn like chattel, caring little for the graces of polite society.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I know my lowborns' place, but I don't kill them for sport as the Vandarins do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lord Benevolo at the Greenfield Estate has taken the Vandarin Family Crest from you and explained a little about these decadent and evil nobles.

localizedTextIdText: You've noticed a strange spatial anomaly near a Strange Dirt Pile on Crimson Isle. You should follow the spatial anomaly and see if you can determine what secrets it holds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Researcher Zum atop the plateau
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've discovered a strange spatial anomaly. Things like this don't happen every day. An event like this warrants further investigation.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There was a strange spatial anomaly near this pile of dirt. Where could it be?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You see it? See anomaly? Amazing! Must find it! You help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Give anomaly readings to me! Yes. Yes! Highly unusual gravitational variances! Possibilities for practical use limitless! You go now. Much work to do!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Jump! Will harness anomaly, slow fall... maybe! If not, will examine tissue samples.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While pursuing the spatial anomaly, you discovered you could jump to great heights as a result of the anomaly's effect on local gravitational fields. Researcher Zum was ecstatic to have the readings you obtained from the anomaly.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Primm was conducting field tests with his sibling Researcher Zamm when the appearance of the Aurin disrupted their experiments. Now Researcher Zamm has gone missing - Scientist Primm would like you to go to Wildwood Grove to find him, and kill some Aurin along the way.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Primm in Outreach Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Running field test with sibling Zamm when moronic Aurin showed up. Now Zamm has gone missing and experiment ruined. You find Zamm and make Aurin pay, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Cannot continue work until Zamm returns! Hope you kill lots of Aurin to make up for interrupted science!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Zamm back. Very grateful. Plan to test new weapons on Aurin, yes! Then they will feel agony of Chua ingenuity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not waste time! Zamm is competent researcher! Very valuable!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped rescue Researcher Zamm and taught the Aurin a lesson for interrupting Chua experiments.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Am scientist, not soldier! What about Zamm?

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has asked you to recover $m(vitem=159) from the Blasted Fields. The troopers and scientists who died during the Terraformer's blast may have left behind recordings containing vital information, and he wants you to find it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The situation with the squirg seems to be stable. Now I would ask you to collect damaged datachrons in the Blasted Fields. They may reveal much.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mutated soldiers may still possess their datachrons. Others may have been abandoned entirely. Find them, collect them, and handle them with care.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is as I anticipated. Gridrock was behind the terraformer explosion. I assume he wished to spare the rest of Nexus from the squirg outbreak.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must learn what happened to Gridrock, and why the terraformer detonated.
