localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes... brave, but far from effectual. Now we must clean up the mess.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to recover $m(vitem=159) from the Blasted Fields for Victor Lazarin. After careful analysis, Lazarin has pieced together the events leading up to the Terraformer's blast. Recordings indicate that the Exiles destroyed the device rather than see it end up in Dominion hands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Who was in charge of the terraformer?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: General Gridrock. He was directed to defend the terraformer at all costs. He always did his duty rather diligently.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am unsure, but I have my suspicions. Locate the datachrons, and I deem the odds of discovering this secret to be high.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We must lay this mystery bare. Without your help, that will be difficult.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has ordered you to head to Hillscourge Station, where Scientist Twilo is supervising the containment of a terminite colony. From the sounds of things, Twilo needs as much help as he can get.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Scientist Twilo at Hillscourge Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Terminites problem in this part of Deradune. Sent Collegium researchers to Hillscourge, but reports not good. Go there. Speak with Researcher Twilo.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Collegium says terminite infestation growing. Speak with Scientist Twilo. See what needs doing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mondo sent only you? No one else? Insufficient! Not enough! Need many, many more to help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Spread of terminite infestation disrupt other experiments in area. Unacceptable!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Will make do with you. And flamethrowers.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Thanks for the vote of confidence.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Scientist Twilo at Hillscourge Station. You couldn't help but notice that there were bugs as far as the eye could see, and Scientist Twilo seemed less than confident that you could help stem the terminite tide.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Terminite like bug, only bigger. Breed rapidly, consume everything...including Chua. Terminites must be contained!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If containment fails, everyone dies. You die... Twilo dies... everyone dies! Most importantly, disrupt precious experiments in Deradune! All that important animal testing in Feralplain! Of course, Mondo will evacuate early.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Then guess what? Mondo know a place where lots of hungry terminites crawling around.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Ontus believes the answer to the terminite problem can be found in Exo-Lab 79. He would like you to enter the exo-lab and look for his assistant, Researcher Martinus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Ontus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With all these terminites around the exo-lab, exploration was much too dangerous. I sent in my assistant... uh, I mean he ventured in by himself, and he never returned!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I believe there is a connection between this exo-lab and the terminite infestation, but my assistant, Martinus, has yet to return. Please locate him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You found Martinus, you say? A pity he is dead. He was so useful. See if you can finish what he started.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I was delighted to find an Eldan exo-lab in Hillscourge. Perhaps the answer to the terminite problem is inside.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You searched Exo-Lab 79 for Researcher Martinus and found him dead, a victim of the terminites.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ah, yes! Where are my manners? I am Professor Ontus with the Royal Collegium. I specialize in studying the origins of Nexus creatures and their relation to the exo-labs across the planet. When I heard about the Hillscourge terminite infestation, I could hardly contain myself!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, yes. Martinus. Hmm. Capable enough fellow. Naturally an academic of my standing requires someone more active to facilitate the more difficult parts of research. I must say, it was very inconsiderate of him to go missing. I've no one to send for refreshments in the afternoon!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That wasn't a request, you know. Oh, the trials and tribulations of dealing with lesser minds!

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Martinuss journal makes notes of a missing datacube. He believed its fragments were scattered around Exo-Lab 79's Data Center. Collect the $m(vitem=34) and reconstruct them to learn the secrets of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Ontus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Martinus's body lies here, bereft of life and marked by savage wounds. A nearby bloodstained journal may offer some insight.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is a sketch in the journal which details a broken datacube, as well as a nearby Eldan console. A hastily scribbled note reads, "Pieces scattered nearby?"
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You cannot possibly be finished with your assignment in Exo-Lab 79.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A marvelous discovery, $(player.name)! The Eldan obviously anticipated the terminite problem and created a safeguard. Now we have a way forward.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A pity about poor Martinus... but we cannot make an omelette without breaking some eggs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the datacube fragments scattered around Exo-Lab 79's Data Center and reconstructed it using the Eldan Datacube Terminal. The datacube described a fail-safe built by the Eldan to eliminate the terminites, in case they began breeding uncontrollably.

localizedTextIdText: The Eldan fail-safe needed to solve the terminite problem is located deep inside Exo-Lab 79 in a sector called the Broodlab. You must repair any broken Eldan circuitry running into the Broodlab before you can activate it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Ontus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Eldan fail-safe appears to be deep inside the section of the exo-lab known as the Broodlab. Unfortunately, it has no power. You'll have to do something about that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fool! Your duty lies in the bowels of Exo-Lab 79! Repair the fail-safe circuitry, or we will all be killed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Eldan were wise to create such a powerful fail-safe. Our Chua friends could learn a thing or two from the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Look for Eldan circuitry running into the Broodlab. You may be able to repair it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You repaired the damaged Eldan circuitry and routed power back to the Broodlab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't quit now! We're so close.

localizedTextIdText: The Eldan Power Controller in the Broodlab sector of Exo-Lab 79 must be activated to charge the fuel rod that powers the Eldan fail-safe. Professor Ontus warns you that the terminites will be attracted to the power controller once it's activated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Ontus in the Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now all that's left is to charge the fail-safe. You can do so from the power controller, but be warned - the activity may attract more terminites.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Make sure you are prepared when you begin to charge the fail-safe. Terminites are typically attracted to power sources.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The power of the Eldan has always impressed me. Seeing the perdition they had in store for their scientific failures was humbling, to say the least.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I certainly hope so. I've run out of research assistants for the moment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now I must prepare a report for my Collegium colleagues. I think I shall call it "Terminite Terminations."
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That should take care of the terminite problem.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You activated the Eldan Power Controller and survived a massive terminite attack. Once the fail-safe was charged, you used it to incinerate the terminite nest and the colony's terminite queen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd advise you to reconsider. Death by terminite is a fate I believe we'd all like to avoid.

localizedTextIdText: You found a scanbot stuck in the gooey hills of Hillscourge. After freeing it, you were contacted by Scientist Argin, who thanked you for returning the scanbot and then asked you to find any others missing in the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Argin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A scientist scanbot is stuck to the terminite goo. It looks like it might belong to the Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A scientist scanbot is stuck to the terminite goo. It looks like it might belong to the Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Good work finding scanbot. Find others. Can make it worth your while.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not as stupid as you look. Like that about you. Take this for getting Collegium scanbots back online.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed Scientist Argin scanbots from the gooey hills of Hillscourge.

localizedTextIdText: Working with Scientist Twilo, Analyst Bungo is researching improvements for weapons to be used against the terminites. He's asked you to go to Exo-Lab 79 and collect tissue samples from energized terminites for analysis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Analyst Bungo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Working on improving Twilo's flamethrower. Need you to gather energized terminite tissue samples. Will use terminite's own physiology against them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: DRED philosophy: know your enemy, so can design weapon that hurts most! Bring me tissue samples from energized terminite, make improved flamethrower!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good samples, very good. Will test combustibility, toxin resistance, conductivity... and flavor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Only need energized samples! From terminites infused with energy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=35) from energized terminites inside Exo-Lab 79 for Analyst Bungo. Hopefully he'll be able to use them to create an improved weapon for fighting the terminites.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are you some kind of weapons tech?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Any kind fine, as long as exposed to energy of exo-lab. Better to get samples from terminites inside.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Only best kind! Belong to DRED, run by the Zax himself! DRED develop only the best, most painful weapons! When the Zax heard about terminites, send me with directive to make terminites suffer! The Zax not like when something interrupts his research, like possible destruction of Deradune at hands of terminites.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Too bad. Analysis could increase weapon efficiency by huge amount.

localizedTextIdText: The exploding Eldan Terraformer didn't just kill Dominion and Exile troops - it mutated some of them, warping them into horrific abominations with no memories of their former lives. Commander Raxen has ordered you to brave the Blasted Fields and kill these Mutated Soldier on sight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Raxen via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got a nasty job for ya. When the terraformer blew, it caused mutations in some of our troopers. They ain't pretty, and they need to be put down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I get it, pal. This ain't no picnic. But you gotta put them fellas down, before they hurt someone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for takin' care of them mutated troopers. Ya did the right thing, trust me. Not many people coulda pulled it off like you done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's the right thing to do, chum. Someone's gotta put 'em outta their misery.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They was all good troopers. We'll remember 'em as they were.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ended the tortured lives of the troopers who were mutated when the Eldan Terraformer exploded. Because of your merciful actions, the Mutated Soldier will pose no further danger to their former comrades at Raxen's Holdout.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Is the blast area safe to enter?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Let's just say it's bad, pal... real bad. If it was me out there, twisted 'n' warped, I'd be prayin' for someone like you to come along and put a bullet in me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Hell if I know, but it's a risk we gotta take. You know what it's like out here, chum. We ain't pickin' flowers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sorry ya feel that way. I guess ya lost your nerve, eh?

localizedTextIdText: The exploding Eldan terraformer didn't just kill Dominion and Exile troops - it mutated some of them, warping them into horrific abominations with no memories of their former lives. Major Hesperius has ordered you to brave the Blasted Fields and kill these Mutated Soldier on sight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Hesperius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some of the men caught in the terraformer blast suffered... mutations. They are no longer themselves, and must be dealt with appropriately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't consider these killings as "executions," per se. Instead, think of them as a form of euthanasia.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work, $(player.name). Few have the fortitude to carry out such a loathsome task.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mutation is a disgrace, and such horrors must be dealt with... permanently.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: You want me to kill them?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ended the tortured lives of the soldiers who were mutated when the Eldan terraformer exploded. Because of your merciful actions, the Mutated Soldier will pose no further danger to their former comrades at Inception's Stand.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Is the blast area safe to enter?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: These creatures have been warped. They can no longer be considered men. You must face these abominations - and your own fears - and do what is right.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If 'safe' is what you're looking for, I suggest you leave Nexus at once. We are at the front line, $(player.name). Danger is part of our job description.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What part of our conversation made you think following my orders was optional?

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has asked you to recover $m(vitem=159) from the Blasted Fields. The soldiers and scientists who died during the Terraformer's blast may have left behind recordings containing vital information, and he demands you find it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Squirg taken care of. Now Mondo will discover cause of Terraformer explosion. You will help by recovering datachrons from explosion victims, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dead soldiers and scientists have datachrons. Datachrons record communications, notes. Go get datachrons before you have accident.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Datachrons reveal Exiles purposely blew up Terraformer. Exiles smart to keep Terraformer from Mondo, but Mondo annoyed nonetheless.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Datachrons damaged, yes, but still contain relevant data. Do not damage further!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mondo have a plan. Plan requires reliable lackey. Like you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to recover $m(vitem=159) from the Blasted Fields for Mondo Zax. After careful analysis, the Zax has pieced together the events leading up to the Terraformer's blast. Recordings indicate that the Exiles set off the device rather than see it end up in Dominion hands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Idiot! Mondo does not know! If he did, he wouldn't need you to find datachrons, would he?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Is possible. Exiles sometimes painfully predictable. Other times, not so much. This one of those times.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You prefer short life of test subject to being Mondo's assistant? How curious!

localizedTextIdText: You found some $(vitem=280) while braving the dangers of Outbreak Fen. Collect as many as you can and deliver them to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You're certain someone back at camp - Victor Lazarin, maybe - could use these medical supplies. Collect them and return them to Raxen's Holdout.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You're certain someone back at camp - Victor Lazarin, maybe - could use these medical supplies. Collect them and return them to Raxen's Holdout.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our supply of medicines has been severely sapped by this situation. I require you to recover any that you find and return them to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have replenished our medical stations. If I were not a man of science, I would proclaim this a miracle.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mark my words - your actions today have saved many lives.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take these back to camp.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Just trying to do my part.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You did your part to aid the Exiles by scavenging abandoned $(vitem=280) and delivering them to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take these back to camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has enlisted your assistance in capturing a living squirg specimen in Outbreak Fen in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The squirg behave like parasites, and I believe they use mind control to possess their hosts. To confirm this, I require a living squirg specimen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Though it is a perilous project, I have specified that a living squirg is required for my studies. Please procure one posthaste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I recognize the risks you took on my behalf to acquire this stunning specimen. Thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The more we know about these creatures, the easier it will be to combat them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Against your better judgment, you successfully "captured" and delivered a living squirg specimen to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why so interested in mind control?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Is a live specimen strictly necessary?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If I can discern how the squirg dominate their hosts, I may be able to apply the lessons to the Exile art of warfare.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I have already dissected a plethora of dead squirg and learned painfully little from such specimens. A living squirg will reveal so much more!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I fear morality is always the first casualty of war. We do not have the luxury of allowing our foes to gain an edge over us in this conflict.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Our situation is dire. I expect you will reconsider your decision to decline?

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout has ordered you to find a jetpack and use it to gain access to the terraformer in the Blasted Fields so you can delete its data, then shut it down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is little else we can accomplish here. You must secure a jetpack, gain access to the terraformer controls, and wipe any data that remains.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Some troopers utilized jetpacks, and most of them did not survive the blast. Use one of those jetpacks to access the terraformer's terminal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Though it grieves me to destroy something we have worked so ardently to preserve, I would rather not see my work in the hands of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will need to shut the terraformer down. The result will be... spectacular.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used a salvaged jetpack to reach and shut down the malfunctioning terraformer above the Blasted Fields. You were also able to wipe the terraformer's databanks, thereby preventing the information from falling into the Dominion's hands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: If only Gridrock hadn't blown it up...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Many Exile troopers were issued jetpacks, allowing them to move freely around the battlefield. Find the remains of one and recover his jetpack.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Gridrock was following orders. He could not allow the Dominion to possess the terraformer's technology. Destroying the device was his only option.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Statistically speaking, our loss ratio would have fallen into acceptable margins had Gridrock not erred in his estimation of the blast's efficacy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not turn your back on the Exiles now. We need you more than ever.

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg have scavenged a large supply of military-grade weapons from downed blimps. Corporal Deraakh has asked you to recover the $(vitem=397) from the Dreg in Scarhide Camp before they can use it against Dominion troops.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Deraakh via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg are scavenging weapons from our downed blimps. We can't let them use those weapons against us! Go out now and get them back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dreg are dangerous enough in large numbers without the benefit of Dominion weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Once these weapons are cleaned and inspected, we can reissue them to our forces. You did well to secure them from our enemies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: While you're at it, kill the Dreg. Your instincts will grow with each kill!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The Dreg were no match for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered several pieces of $(vitem=397) from the Dreg in Crimson Isle and returned them to Corporal Deraakh.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I have better things to do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Where did the Dreg come from?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That's what they call themselves... at least the ones that can speak. Mutants of the desert scavenge whatever they can find - parts, supplies, weapons - and feast on the flesh of the weak. But they die like anything else does, as long as you shoot them enough.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You do, eh? I doubt it. I am certain Kezrek Warbringer would doubt it, too.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Horns of Hazak! You and your ceaseless questions! Do I look like an overly curious Chua to you? All I know is that the Dreg come from the dry wastelands of Nexus. Many are weak and useless, but some have mutations that lend them extraordinary strength and cunning. But such worthy foes are few and far between.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I smell a coward.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Twilo has been sent to contain the terminite infestation in Hillscourge, before it grows out of control and threatens all of Deradune. He wants you to enter Exo-Lab 79 and use his flamethrower to burn the bugs out!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Twilo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Terminites dangerous. But flamethrower even more dangerous! Burn terminites to crispy perfection! Take flamethrower to Exo-Lab 79 and incinerate them alive!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Flamethrower perfect for use in exo-lab. Narrow dark spaces, filled with killer insects! Oh yes, think you will have lots of fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! Flamethrower works beautifully, yes? Make terminites golden brown and delicious, yes?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: So fun! Almost jealous not going along. But too young and brilliant to die.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Too bad. Could be delicious! Now we never know.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not partial to roast terminite.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully used Scientist Twilo flamethrower to incinerate terminites in Exo-Lab 79.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about this terminite problem.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Recently discovered Hillscourge full of terminites! Much too full! Even more shocking, come from exo-lab underneath Hillscourge. Troubling, very troubling. Terminites breed fast, consume everything in sight. Disrupt Chua experiments in Deradune!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Don't know! Scanbots keep going missing. Field researchers keep dying. Most annoying. Suspect exo-lab may be home of terminite queen. Otherwise, why terminites make so much trouble?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Collegium knew for long time: terminite is hive species. Terminites in Hillscourge unusually annoying, hard to kill, breed quickly, slightly smarter. Slightly. Therefore, must have more evolved hive leader. Basic science.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What's wrong with you? Not like fire?

localizedTextIdText: Huntress Kezzia has loaned you her mount so you can meet with Major Hesperius, the leader of the Dominion's forces at Inception's Stand. From the sounds of things, the troops need help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Hesperius at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I received a call from some Dominion soldiers in serious need of help. Would you go to their aid so I can continue my hunt?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I would go to the aid of these soldiers if I were not otherwise occupied. A hunter's heart cannot be tamed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is this? Some manner of sick joke?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Kezzia sent you? My men are dying, and she's too busy hunting vermin to lend us a hand! Damn that woman!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take my mount, find these warriors, and lend them your strength. Swiftly!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So be it, then. You shall have to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After a wild ride astride Huntress Kezzia mount, you reported to Major Hesperius at Inception's Stand and offered to help him out with his current predicament.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm hunting the elusive Goldensun Dawngrazer. A Draken cannot simply turn her back on her quarry, and I'm certain you'll be up to the task.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Studrok, you mean? He's a pig, but he can be amusing... on occasion. If he really offends me, I'll make sure he never does it again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Let us hope you do not find yourself in need of aid in the future.

localizedTextIdText: Major Hesperius has requested you re-establish contact with Dominion personnel who were in the vicinity of Outbreak Fen when the Whitevale Terraformer erupted. If you can, find Lieutenant Jareus and see what he can tell you about his missing comrades.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Hesperius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Look around! This is a logistical nightmare! Aside from the dead and dying, we lost contact with most of the ground troops when the damned terraformer blew.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found Lieutenant Jareus yet? He should be able to point you to the locations of the squads we've lost contact with.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Give me a full report, $(player.name), immediately! And I expect Jareus is making his way back to camp for a debriefing as we speak?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lieutenant Jareus was leading Alpha Wave when all hell broke loose. Find him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A flamethrower? Those aren't standard-issue except for extermination squads!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He's dead, but I have his flamethrower.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Under orders from Major Hesperius, you investigated Outbreak Fen for signs of Lieutenant Jareus. Though uncommunicative, you found Lieutenant Jareuss flamethrower nearby...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Oh? Do tell.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Eldan tech. Supposed to change the environment and the terrain... what? Don't look at me like that - I couldn't make this stuff up. I'm sure Zax knows more.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Believe me, that's a question I want answered. But until we can get a handle on the current situation, I don't want anyone taking a closer look. Understood?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The situation's damned deplorable is what it is. But the dead and dying aren't the worst part...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: As near as I can tell, sixty to sixty-five percent of our forces are missing in action. Not KIA, not overcome by squirg, just... gone.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: I doubt it. The Exile troops got hit, same as we did. Frankly, if things were a little less dicey, I'd be giving you completely different orders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: By Dominus! Do you think this is a joke? I should have you strung up by your guts!

localizedTextIdText: The discovery of Lieutenant Jareuss untouched corpse - not to mention his flamethrower - has spurred Major Hesperius to demand the cremation of all corpses found in Outbreak Fen in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Hesperius at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Jareus was no idiot. He knew that fire cleanses any stain, so that's precisely what I want you to do. Burn any bodies you come across.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use Jareus's flamethrower to incinerate any corpses you find out there. There's no telling what will happen if we leave them for the squirg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's your report $(player.class)? Were you able to incinerate the bodies of our fallen soldiers?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good thing for you, no finesse is necessary. Just point and shoot.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I know from hard experience, battlefield burials are never easy.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I look forward to it, Major.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using Lieutenant Jareuss flamethrower, you incinerated all the corpses you could find in Outbreak Fen. Though there's no telling if it will have any effect, Major Hesperius felt it was the safest course of action.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll burn any corpses I find.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why should we burn the bodies?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are you sure this will work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm unsure of what killed them. Is some infection at work? Can the squirg use corpses as hosts? I don't know! And until I do, I want to take precautions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am only concerned with results, $(player.name). This is war. Burn them all and let Dominus sort them out!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why are you wasting my time? I have no time for such insolence!

localizedTextIdTitle: If You Can't Beat Them, Blow Them Up
localizedTextIdText: Major Hesperius has pinpointed the source of the squirg outbreak. He's ordered you to collect $m(vitem=163) from the overrun military outpost known as Inception's Hold, find the entrance to the Squirg Cave on the edge of Outbreak Fen, then plant the munitions underground.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Hesperius at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A drone has pinpointed the source of the squirg plague inside a cave near Outbreak Fen. You'll need to find some explosives and take out the target.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find some munitions inside Inception's Hold, our old base, then get down into that cave and blow those things to the Scions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I felt the ground move when the munitions went off. I take it your mission was a success? You really are a marvel, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pity we lost the demolitions team, but you seem competent enough for the job.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You really should consider joining my unit when we get out of this mess.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll blow the squirg sky high!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected, deployed, and detonated a large explosive payload at the source of the squirg in the cave beneath Outbreak Fen.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll blow the squirg sky high!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How do I set off the munitions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Not all scout drones were shot down during the disruption. I've ensured those that remain were wisely used to guarantee our success here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Battlefield munitions. A number of them were left behind in Inception's Hold when we were forced to evacuate. You had best check there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Those munitions can be a bit... unstable. You could probably set one off with pistol fire, though you're welcome to get creative should the mood strike you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Here's an idea. How about I give you to Mondo Zax and let him figure out why you're so insolent?

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Bell says that the Dominion's missing soldiers are actually shambling around in Outbreak Fen. Unfortunately, these squirg 'zombies' don't differentiate between friend and foe, so Sergeant Bell wants them eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Bell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've seen 'em, haven't ya? The missin' men... they're out there! 'Cept they got them damn squirg on their heads. Someone's gotta stop 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If ya don't take care of 'em, there's no tellin' what them squirgs'll do to the rest of us!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, well... if it ain't the people's hero! Figured them squirg'd get ya. For once, I'm right glad I was wrong.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure ya do that, $(player.name). Bury 'em right 'n' proper before they come for the rest of us!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad you were wrong, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You eliminated a large number of squirg zombies in Outbreak Fen in Whitevale at Sergeant Bell request.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the squirg.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: The men are MIA. They could be anywhere.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Can't anything be done for them?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Do I look stupid to ya, mate? The major, he ain't sayin' it, but we all know them blokes was taken by the squirg. And we're next, if somethin' ain't done!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Little bouncin' buggers. Look real oddlike outta water, but they breathe just fine. Should've been our first clue! That, and their fondness for headshots...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Don't let 'em get too close to ya! If one goes for your head, shoot it... and don't miss. Otherwise I'll be askin' someone else to put ya down.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Them chaps out there with the squirg on their noggins... they's as good as dead! I reckon they'd thank ya for puttin' em outta their misery!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you've got a death wish, I sure ain't gonna stop ya.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Bell has asked you to destroy the four strongest squirg zombies in Outbreak Fen. For whatever reason, these four - once demolitions team members - are larger, stronger, and need to be put down before they can pose a threat to Inception's Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Bell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ya ain't done yet. The scouts is sayin' there's four of those... things... what're larger 'n' meaner than the rest. Care to knock 'em off?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's the word on them four super-squirgheads? Put them lads outta their misery before they put us outta ours!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I won't be wishin' ya luck now, will I? Seein' as you've more than enough to spare. Maybe a little bit'll rub off on me... ya think?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They's likely what's left of the Demolitions team. Those lads was always a little off.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You exterminated the shambling remains of the squirg-dominated demolitions team members: four 'super' squirg zombies that might have been powerful enough to wipe out the remaining Dominion forces in Whitevale. Good work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so special about those four?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why are they different from the rest?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well one of 'em is as big as a tank! Another spits acid! Then, there's the one that vomits bile. The last one, he hunts like a bloody predator!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I ain't no sawbones nor scientist, so don't ask me... but maybe it's got somethin' to do with the host species...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, I get it, guv. I'd be stainin' me standard-issues, too, if I was you...

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered an old hoverbike in the crumbled remains of Inception's Hold, and it's still in working order. You could probably use the hoverbike to run down some squirg zombies, but it'll probably get messy...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Bell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This damaged terminal can activate a nearby hoverbike for your use, and a hoverbike would make a great weapon against slow-moving squirg zombies...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please refer to our indemnification policy and insurance documentation. Remember - driving safe is no accident!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I tell ya, guv... if we had more vehicles, we could run them squirg blighters down like dagun. That'd be a rush!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Usin' a hoverbike to flatten squirgheads? Good thinkin', that was! Not much as can withstand the force of a well-engineered Dominion war machine!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember - pedestrians are people, not points! Drive safely!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take one for a spin!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used an old hoverbike you found in Inception's Hold to run down squirg zombies. It's not every day you get to use a turbo-charged hoverbike to flatten parasitical squirg and their hosts.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm going to have fun with this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please resubmit application for hoverbike rental.

localizedTextIdText: Major Hesperius at Inception's Stand has ordered you to squash any and all Squirg Egg you come across while in the Squirg Cave in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Hesperius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Should you come across any more of those eggs, be a good $(player.class) and squash them. Understood?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sure the good sergeant would appreciate it if you'd stomp some more of those squirg eggs. He's a bit too squeamish to do it himself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've made quite a mess of your boots, hmm? Still, those damnable squirg eggs had to go. I do hope this lessens our trouble with the hatched variety.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We need to contain the squirg scourge. That means stopping it at its source.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You carried out Major Hesperius's orders to destroy any and all Squirg Egg in the Squirg Cave, and you did it with far more enthusiasm than was strictly necessary.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, then... perhaps I'll have to send Sergeant Bell. Bell, get over here!

localizedTextIdText: It's time to evacuate Inception's Stand. First, Mondo Zax wants you to light signal flares at the evac landing zones. The flares will probably attract the attention of hostile squirg zombies. Luckily, you'll have Mondo's flamethrower to keep you - and the squirgheads - warm.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Time to go! You light signal flares at landing zones. Mondo thinks flares will attract squirg zombies, so he loan you flamethrower.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Evacuation incomplete. Go incinerate squirg zombies, now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ahhh! Mondo love smell of napalm. Any time of day as good as any other! You do good work. Now give back flamethrower.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mondo say 'loan,' not 'give.' Mondo want flamethrower back.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mondo like you as much as Mondo like anyone. Not saying much, hm?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defended the Dominion from the squirg zombie hordes at Inception's Stand and allowed everyone to escape. Unfortunately, you had to give Mondo Zax his flamethrower back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Assistant not like fire? How does assistant like being SET on fire?

localizedTextIdText: You found some $(vitem=280) while braving the dangers of Outbreak Fen. Collect as many as you can and deliver them to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You're certain someone back at camp - maybe even Mondo Zax - could use these medical supplies. Collect them and return them to Inception's Stand.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You're certain someone back at camp - maybe even Mondo Zax - could use these medical supplies. Collect them and return them to Inception's Stand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Too many wounded, not enough medical supplies. Too bad for wounded... but good for Mondo! May as well use extra wounded as test subjects!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mondo notice you return with medical supplies. Lucky for wounded soldiers. Mondo planned to use them as test subjects. Hmph!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh... nothing. Mondo will find other test subjects. He has ways.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You did your part to aid the Dominion by scavenging abandoned $(vitem=280) and delivering them to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand in Whitevale.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has enlisted your assistance in capturing a living squirg specimen in Outbreak Fen in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Squirg behave like parasites, control hosts through mind control. Mondo wishes to further investigate squirg mind-control methods. You will help him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where is squirg specimen? You think Mondo will wait forever? Wrong! Now go, collect specimen, and bring it back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The specimen provided is beautiful, $(player.name)! You did not disappoint Mondo, so he will allow you to live!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mondo is sure you will figure it out. Go go! Now now! The squirg await you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, the secrets Mondo will reveal! The puzzles he will unravel!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Great. Have fun with that... thing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Against your better judgment, you successfully "captured" and delivered a living squirg specimen to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Is a live specimen strictly necessary?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Because Mondo says so! And because understanding of squirg may lead to effective military applications!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes! Dead squirg lacks physiological processes, natural behaviors, oozing of viscous fluids. Live squirg does not. You understand now?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Science not moral! Science is science! Mondo must learn how squirg control secondary cerebral cortex or Mondo will be very, very angry!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Too bad... but you may not be complete loss as mind-controlled test subject...

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand has ordered you to find a jetpack and use it to gain access to the Terraformer in the Blasted Fields so you can shut it down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Must shut Terraformer down. But first, must salvage technical data! You find jetpack and take care of business for Mondo. Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is easy. Find jetpack in Blasted Fields. Use jetpack. Fly to terraformer console. Deactivate console after gathering data. Understand? Now... go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Eldan data wiped by Exiles. Mondo not happy, but he is certain experiments can be replicated without proper technical specifications.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: To be honest, Mondo expects you to die painfully. But whatever.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used a salvaged jetpack to reach and shut down the malfunctioning Terraformer above the Blasted Fields. Unfortunately, any data that you might have recovered was wiped by the Exiles prior to your arrival.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Soldiers issued jetpacks, sent to investigate terraformer. Soldiers not return. Ergo, jetpacks must be near terraformer. You find!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mondo must be going deaf. Did assistant refuse?

localizedTextIdText: These mandibles, dripping with viscous venom, were taken from the maw of the Venombite Spider Queen corpse. Given his interest in all things arachnid, Arachnologist Borango should be very interested in this... interested enough to offer some kind of reward for your initiative.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Spider Queen's Mandibles{p:Spider Queen's Mandibles} to Arachnologist Borango in Venombite Pass
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These massive mandibles would be of great interest to Arachnologist Borango. He might even be willing to pay for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Such big mandibles! From spider queen, yes? Very potent venom. Kill twenty Chua with one drop! Leave with me, I study.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Want money, yes? Oh, why not? Here, take money. Leave mandibles. Now go.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Venombite Spider Queen and brought her mandibles to Arachnologist Borango for study.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, time to get to work. I'm gonna give ya some materials for crafting heavy armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll put the materials in your tradeskill bag and we can really get started!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an armorer, Armorer Thaako has given you the materials needed to make some heavy armor.

localizedTextIdText: You killed the Redmoon Marauder quartermaster An'dal and took his head as a trophy. Given the depredations perpetrated upon the Lopp of Wigwalli Village, you've decided to offer it as a gift to Chief Migisi.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chief Migisi in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've slain An'dal, the Redmoon Marauder's quartermaster, and taken his head as a trophy. Chief Migisi in Wigwalli Village may appreciate it as a gift.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hiya! What you have for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This good gift. This Lopp treasure. Wigwalli owe you big debt! We Lopp remember our friends, remember who helped us.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll give this to the Chief.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Chief Migisi was grateful for Quartermaster An'dal head, and has promised her tribe's favor to you in return. The Lopp of Wigwalli Village won't soon forget that you are their champion and friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I had a present for you... hmm.

localizedTextIdText: The city of Hycrest is offering a large reward for the destruction of Spithra, a giant spider that can be found on Gravespinner Overlook.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Governor Aluviel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: By Order of the Governor:\nA handsome reward will be paid to anyone that can kill the great spider Spithra. Spithra makes her lair on Gravespinner Overlook.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: By Order of the Governor:\nA handsome reward will be paid to anyone that can kill the great spider Spithra. Spithra makes her lair on Gravespinner Overlook.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you taken an interest in destroying Spithra? She has preyed upon Hycrest's citizens for far too long.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My people will laud your skill in spider-slaying, citizen. As promised, here is your reward. Take it and be proud.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: She died like a bug. A big bug.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Spithra on Gravespinner Overlook and collected your reward from Governor Aluviel.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Argin is fascinated with terminite venom and its effects. He'd like you to harvest venom sacs from the terminite in Hillscourge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Argin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Saw tester bit by terminite. Very impressive! Tester died in itchy agony! Want to replicate toxin, but need more venom sacs. Collect from terminites, yes yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Terminites everywhere. All have venom sacs. Kill terminites, collect sacs, bring me venom. Now go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Cozmotronic, so much venom! Say, want to be my first test subject?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Will distill concentrated venom, focus on agony more than itch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hm. Oh well. Guess still need you to avert terminite crisis. Next time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered terminite venom sacs for Scientist Argin. He promised to refine the venom into an even deadlier poison. Good thing he's on your side.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will you do with the venom?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Experiment with it, of course! When done, may pass off to me. DRED always find fun use for various toxins.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But venom has so many uses!

localizedTextIdText: Hillscourge is infested with terminites. Unless the spread of terminites can be contained, they will spread to every corner of Deradune. Scientist Argin believes that destroying terminite eggs in Hillscourge should stem the tide of terminites.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Argin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Terminites in Hillscourge breeding faster than jabbits. Threaten all of Deradune. Must control terminite population by blowing up eggs. Interested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Terminites come from eggs. No eggs, no terminites. Find egg sacs and blow them up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Terminite eggs destroyed? Excellent! Chance bugs devour Deradune now only 78%. Hm. Still better than nothing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: DRED make special grenades just for this purpose. Consider it high explosives fringe benefit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew up a number of terminite eggs in Hillscourge, hoping to prevent the terminites from spilling over and ravaging the rest of Deradune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Then what good are you?

localizedTextIdText: Watchman Decker at the Hycrest Cemetery is responsible for burning the bodies of plague victims. Unfortunately, the sight and smell of the burning corpses makes him sick, and he's asked for your help to complete his task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Watchman Decker in the Hycrest Cemetery
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can't bloody well stand it! We've got to burn all these bodies to keep the plague from spreading, but... I can't take it. The smell of it makes me vomit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you burn any of the bodies yet? They bring more all the time... we have to make room.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for the help. If there's anything I can do for you that doesn't involve corpses, disease, fire, or vomit, just let me know!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You... you'd do that? It's kind of you... and I won't say no. Take my torch.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Want me to burn them for you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You burned the bodies of a number of plague victims in the Hycrest Cemetery, which both helps Watchman Decker and further prevents the spread of the virulent infection.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's not your job, of course. You can do as you please.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Raxen is offering payment to any Exile citizen capable of destroying the Dominion Warmonger that patrols the Blasted Fields in Whitevale. The warbot poses a serious threat to Raxen's Holdout and cannot be allowed to remain fully operational.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Raxen at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: A bounty is offered for the immediate destruction of a Dominion warbot in the Blasted Fields! Report to Commander Raxen with any questions.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: A bounty is offered for the immediate destruction of a Dominion warbot in the Blasted Fields! Report to Commander Raxen with any questions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I wish someone would blow that blasted Dominion bot to bits. We could use that kinda break right about now, and I'm sure someone could use the money.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That warbot was a monster! Ya done good, pal. Real good. Here's your reward. Ya earned it and then some.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully deactivated the Dominion Warmonger that was patrolling the Blasted Fields in Whitevale, and collected a handsome reward as a result.

localizedTextIdText: Major Hesperius is offering payment to any Dominion citizen capable of destroying the Exile Ravager that patrols the Blasted Fields in Whitevale. The warbot poses a serious threat to Inception's Stand and cannot be allowed to remain fully operational.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Major Hesperius at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: A bounty is offered for the immediate destruction of an Exile warbot in the Blasted Fields! Report to Major Hesperius with any questions.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: A bounty is offered for the immediate destruction of an Exile warbot in the Blasted Fields! Report to Major Hesperius with any questions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Exile warbot undermines Dominion control of this detestable place. Find it in the Blasted Fields and destroy it at once, but don't try it alone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work dealing with the warbot. I believe you have a reward waiting for you. Glory to the empire and all that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully deactivated the Exile Ravager that was patrolling the Blasted Fields in Whitevale, and collected a handsome reward as a result.

localizedTextIdText: Senior Researcher Macopp has asked you to fight deathmite spiders in Exo-Lab 78 in Hillscourge. He believes they might be a natural solution for controlling terminite population growth, but he's unable to confirm his theory without more data.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Senior Researcher Macopp via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Deathmite spiders in Hillscourge may provide way to regulate terminites, but need more test data. Fight spiders, collect data for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need more data on deathmite spiders in Exo-Lab 78. Other other exo-lab in Hillscourge! Kill spiders, collect combat data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Based on combat behavior, clear that spiders and terminites natural enemies. May prove long term solution for terminite problem.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Wonder if Eldan created deathmite spiders as evolutionary regulator for terminites.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Still need way to deal with current overflow of terminites, but on right track.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought a number of deathmite spiders in Exo-Lab 78. In doing so, you provided Senior Researcher Macopp with reams of combat data to analyze.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so special about these deathmite spiders?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What caused the terminite population to grow?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Deathmite spiders discovered in Exo-Lab 78. Very close to Exo-Lab 79. Believed origin of Hillscourge terminites. Hypothesize Eldan created both species. One prey, other predator. Basic food chain.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Not sure. Maybe long time coming. Subtle shift in terminite behavior indicates leadership changed recently. New terminite hive leader may have increased breeding rates to outpace deathmite spider population. Only see deathmite spiders inside Exo-Lab 78, but terminites now all over Hillscourge!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bah! Would kill you but requires taking time away from research.

localizedTextIdText: A bounty is being offered to anyone who can slay the Hillscourge Horror, a large and dangerous terminite that resides in Hillscourge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: The Hillscourge Horror\n\nBEWARE: Extremely large and dangerous! Not your typical terminite!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED: The Hillscourge Horror\n\nBEWARE: Extremely large and dangerous! Not your typical terminite!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Only morons hunt Hillscourge Horror. Very large! Very poisonous! Very, very dangerous!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What you say? Killed Hillscourge Horror? About time someone take that nuisance out. Suppose you want bounty.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Should have at least brought Mondo a sample!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The bigger the bug, the bigger the crunch.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Hillscourge Horror and collected your bounty.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron

localizedTextIdText: You received a distress call from a Chua researcher trapped inside Exo-Lab 78. He's asked you to free him and other Chua researchers from their webbed prisons.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Senior Researcher Macopp via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Being digested alive! While fascinating, not ready to die yet! If you hear this, free Chua from web!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Field researchers keep disappearing. Okay, maybe dying too. Either way, very inconvenient. Seem to disappear near Exo-Lab 78 the most.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You say freed researchers from spider webs? Cozmotronic! Will speak with them right away. Must possess data on deathmite feeding habits!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed a number of Chua researchers in Exo-Lab 78 before the deathmite spiders could feast on their liquefied innards. Senior Researcher Macopp was pleased at this rare opportunity to collect first-hand data on deathmite feeding habits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If ever get out of this alive, you be first on list to be vaporized!

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Gallow posted a job for up-and-coming armorers to craft some basic steel weave pieces for his evaluation. Naturally, you took him up on the challenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nHowdy, pioneers! Crafting Trainer Thorpe here, with a job for you new armorers out there! Craft a few pieces for me, and I'll see how yer comin' along!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nHowdy, pioneers! Crafting Trainer Thorpe here, with a job for you new armorers out there! Craft a few pieces for me, and I'll see how yer comin' along!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let's have a look... oh, fine work you did here! You're comin' along just fine, friend! I look forward to what you're up to next!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You earned my respect, friend. Good luck craftin'!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe seemed pleased with the pieces you gave him for evaluation and praised your mastery of the basics of armor work. You got your armor crafting career off to a strong start.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdTitle: Class V Logistics: Steel Weave Armor
localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Gallow are hampered by local aggressors, and the militia is in dire need of armor. Acquire some and deliver it to the Logistics Officer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your steel weave armor to the FCON officer in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Got somethin' for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's that you got there? Steel weave armor? Hell, yeah! I'll get these to the front lines pronto. Man, you're rock solid, you know that?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That was some damn good work. Real nice, pal.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is right up my alley!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You resupplied the local militia in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your steel weave armor to the Gallow logistics officer

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't have time for chattin'. You got any gear for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, hey! Nice work! I'll ship this to the front line, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't usually say thanks... but, uh, thanks.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hope these help you guys out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've delivered steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Gallow. He seemed grateful to have it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako

localizedTextIdText: You've recovered a random assortment of valuables from the bandits that apparently belong to Hermit Bilvus. Bilvus, at Camp Reclamation, will likely be happy to have his personal items returned to him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Pilfered Valuables{p:Pilfered Valuables} to Hermit Bilvus at Camp Reclamation
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've found a random assortment of valuables, including a leather-bound book with the name "Bilvus" scrawled on the inside cover.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey! That's my stuff! Where did you get it? Give it to me! And don't try to convince me the bandits took it... I see right through your deception!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Help? Indeed! I've got my eyes on you, you hear? Scoundrel!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take these to Hermit Bilvus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned the Pilfered Valuables{p:Pilfered Valuables} you found to Hermit Bilvus.

localizedTextIdText: An Aurin spy captured on Bloodfire Savannah has been brought to Bloodfire Village for questioning. Having no luck with his usual interrogation techniques, Agent Lex has resorted to procuring outside assistance in an effort to learn the Aurin's purpose in Deradune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Lex in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We caught an Aurin spy, but attempts to extract information have failed. He may prove less intransigent with someone not affiliated with the ICI.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must discover what this Aurin spy was doing here. Do not waste any more time - unless you wish to take his place.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Aurin's defiance would be admirable if it was not so pathetic. Still, we must be vigilant. Inform me immediately if you learn anything more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It is essential we discover the nature of his mission here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though your attempts at interrogation met with failure, you nonetheless managed to impress the Mechari agent known as Lex. It is likely that Agent Lex will call upon your services again in the future.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What are you doing here in Deradune?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am the Lethality Efficiency Experiment, special agent of the ICI. You may refer to me as Lex.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Bloodfire Savannah is a newly created Dominion territory. Axis Pheydra has sent me here to ensure the establishment of Clanlord Makaza's authority goes...smoothly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: There are always enemies of the Dominion to be rooted out. Recent incidents on the arkship have led us to believe we may have gaps in our network. Or worse, moles. There must be no mistakes made in Deradune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal is both unwarranted and unwise.

localizedTextIdText: After you defeated the Moodies and killed Tamolo, Apprentice Laveka laid claim to the Necromojo Staff. She has asked you to report back to Bloodshaman Akilos in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bloodshaman Akilos in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Return to Bloodfire Village and inform Master Akilos that you have punished the Moodies. I will hold onto this staff for... safekeeping.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I told you. I am holding on to this staff for now. If my master does not like it, too bad!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well. In time, we will wipe those abominable savages from our new lands. What else did you discover?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go now! Do not keep my master waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What? That cursed staff must be destroyed! I must find Laveka immediately!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported your success to Bloodshaman Akilos in Bloodfire Village, but he seemed very concerned that Apprentice Laveka had kept the Necromojo Staff.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will you do with that staff?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well, since you've been so helpful, I suppose I can share a thing or two. I believe this staff allows the wielder to manipulate primal life energy directly. Akilos would brand this necromancy, but as I've said, he is a fool... and worse.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Now that I have this staff, I won't need that old fool anymore! He has held me back long enough!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would refuse me now? You are a strange creature, indeed.

localizedTextIdText: Locate Mondo Zax at the Forward Operating Base, past the Exiles' inoperative shield generator.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax at the Forward Operating Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shield down now. Come find rest of squad near shield generator. Datachron tell you where to go.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We wait for you at shield generator. The Zax grows impatient. Not so smart, are you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You finally here. About time. Now destruction can begin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: War will not wait forever. Make haste!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Kill them all! All must die!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Mondo Zax at the Forward Operating Base.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Always questions... too many questions! Come to Mondo. Learn what he has for you next.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bad idea! Mondo suggest you think again.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Time to get started, friend. I'm goin' to give you some materials. They're for craftin' some medium armor. Ain't that excitin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These materials are goin' in your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an outfitter, Outfitter Keynes has given you the materials needed to make some medium armor.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has ordered you to visit Feralplain Testing Range to assist with Chua experiments.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Minion Togor at Feralplain Testing Range
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You! You not currently in peril. Mondo fix that! Chua experiments in Feralplain need some help. Find my minion Togor. Get you up to speed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Zax sent you? Must not like you. Or maybe likes you lots. Either way, welcome to Feralplain Testing Range! Chua here do... SCIENCE!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Left Togor in charge. Feralplain his responsibility, but Mondo likes you little less. Now your problem.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Feralplain Testing Range at Mondo Zax request and spoke with his minion Togor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Knew you were dumb. Didn't know you were dumb enough to say no.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker was responsible for maintaining Augment Facility X426. That is, until a branch of the Ascendancy called the Soulcore Cell came and disabled all of his control panels. He asks that you enter the facility, destroy the Soulcore forces, and restore the first of his control panels.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in Augment Facility X426
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The majority of Caretaker panels are currently offline. Probable cause: Ascendancy experiments. Initiating panel restoration and Soulcore kill request.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Clarification Protocal Alpha - Power up the Caretaker panel and eliminate Ascendancy units. Do you require additional clarification?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Caretaker Panel reconnected with facility mainframe. Functionality at optimum levels. Please note that an Ascendancy presence is still detected.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Data synchronization complete. Basic scans and databank inquiries are now online. Note that full facility access has not yet been restored.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: All 'Soulcore' life forms within this facility must be purged.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soulcore Cell will likely reinforce using forcible conversion.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Well, at least we had a good start.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After conversing with the Caretaker in Augment Facility X426, you learned that the facility was responsible for pioneering augmentation technology. It also houses a vast supply of omni-plasm - a substance integral to the augmentation process. Though you managed to restore a secondary Caretaker control panel, the Soulcore still retain control of the facility.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Define 'discomfort.'
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Augment Facility X426 was responsible for the initial technological development of both the augmentation process and the failed recombination initiative.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Augmentation is the process by which life forms are biologically, chemically, and/or robotically improved. The process is initiated by the infusion of omni-plasm.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Omni-plasm is the mechanism by which microscopic nanites are transferred to the central nervous system of a subject. Data indicates that this process may cause some discomfort.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Statistics show a high probability of vocal utterances and involuntary movement. Self harm was also observed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Probability of miscalculation high. Please respond again.

localizedTextIdText: After restoring the first of the Caretaker's control panels within Augment Facility X426, his scans of the area have found the Ascendancy has several prisoners. To prevent the Soulcore Cell from indoctrinating these captives, he's asked you to free them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in Augment Facility X426
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Scans indicate the presence of tertiary life forms within the facility. Probability of forcible conversion high. Your direct intervention is requested.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Without your intervention, my projections indicate the Soulcore Cell will assume complete control of this facility. This outcome is unacceptable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without your intervention, my projections indicate the Soulcore Cell will assume complete control of this facility. This outcome is unacceptable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Behavioral analysis indicates this endeavor is not a final solution. The Soulcore Cell will return to forcible conversions if not actively prevented.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Reactivate the Caretaker panel once the area has been secured.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is not done quite yet, actually.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed the captives being held within Augment Facility X426 and denied the Soulcore Cell the chance to brainwash and indoctrinate additional troops.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do you know they're unaffiliated?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Unknown biologicals unaffiliated with the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Scans indicate these biologicals have not yet been augmented. Ergo, they are unaffiliated with the Soulcore Cell.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Logic string failure. Life form does not exhibit empathy for its peers.

localizedTextIdText: The Ascendancy has reprogrammed some of Augment Facility X426's equipment. The Caretaker wants you to take his Eldan mechanical converter and use it on the reprogrammed augmentors to reset them to their default programming.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in Augment Facility X426
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Facility augmentors have been reprogrammed by the Soulcore. You can use an Eldan mechanical converter to return them to their default settings.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Clarification Protocal Alpha - Use the Eldan mechanical converter to reset the reprogrammed augmentors in this facility.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Manual use of an Eldan mechanical converter should return all reprogrammed augmentors to a non-combative state.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All augmentors have returned to their default behavior. They should no longer pose a threat to you unless I indicate that they should.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Soulcore has violated facility protocols. This must be rectified.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soulcore units are currently in the omni-plasm reservoirs. How unfortunate.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Ascendancy took control of some of Augment Facility X426's augmentors, but you were quick to act and returned them to their default programming.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hesitation unexpecte. Perhaps  I can determine a way to motivate you?

localizedTextIdText: The Ascendancy has pumped an area of Augment Facility X426 full of omni-plasm, creating a deadly lake. The Caretaker wants you to hack into the core terminal and shut down the flow. Be careful though - his scans indicate the Soulcore Cell leader is close by.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in Augment Facility X426
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Unauthorized access in progress. The leader of the Soulcore Cell is re-routing omni-plasm stores for unknown purposes. This must be stopped - immediately!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This is an urgent task. Take control of the core terminal and shut down the flow of omni-plasm before the entire facility is flooded!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is an urgent task. Take control of the core terminal and shut down the flow of omni-plasm before the entire facility is flooded!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Scans indicate you have eradicated Soulcore's presence in this Exo-Lab. Full facility control restored. I believe you would classify this as a success.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Ascendancy will not jeopardize their control of the omni-plasm stores.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Deepfreeze containment security has been breached! Stasis fields deactivated!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll shut down Soulcore for good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though their numbers were great, you defeated the Ascendancy and their leader. In addition, you stopped the flow of omni-plasm and granted the Caretaker full control of Augment Facility X426. Even so, it doesn't appear as if your work is done....
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take care of the omni-plasm flow.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the omni-plasm flow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Calculating a justification for your continued existence. This may take some time.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker scans indicate the Soulcore Cell was interested in more than just omni-plasm. While in control of the facility, they tampered with the program protocols and stasis settings for an Eldan Project designated as "Metal Maw Prime." Proceed to deepfreeze containment inside Augment Facility X426 and investigate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Metal Maw Prime project has been tampered with. Proceed to deepfreeze containment and verify the structural integrity of the project's holding cell.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Access the control panel in deepfreeze containment to verify the status of Metal Maw Prime's stasis field. This task should be your highest priority.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Access the control panel in deepfreeze containment to verify the status of Metal Maw Prime's stasis field. This task should be your highest priority.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The stasis field is holding, but not for much longer. Containment circuits have sustained too much damage. This project must be terminated.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can gain access to deepfreeze containment by taking the proper elevator.
