localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Metal Maw Prime is extremely dangerous. I suggest you employ group tactics.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the deepfreeze containment section of Augment Facility X426 and discovered a corrupted monster known as Metal Maw Prime. The Soulcore's tampering has resulted in an aggressive and highly unstable beast that must be put down!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Metal Maw Prime is the genetic augmentation subject currently held in stasis within deepfreeze containment. The project was halted before reaching stage four.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Stage four - cerebral manipulation. The project called for increased intelligence and aggression and weapon splicing capability. Expected outcome - a world weapon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Deepfreeze containment is located atop Facility X426. Primal focus proximity is essential to maintaining proper stasis levels.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Metal Maw Prime will not eat me. You, on the other hand....

localizedTextIdText: You have been selected to participate in a Protostar contest to become Prosperity Junction's next Protostar Intern! Speak with the Game Show Host in Whitevale to begin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Prime Executive at Prosperity Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings... from Protostar! You have been selected to be our next contestant on "Who Wants to Be an Intern" (All rights reserved)!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you don't play, you can't lose! Speak to the game show host and let the fun begin!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have your completion form. It just needs a signature!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: All calculations point to success! Speak with my game show host to begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent! All paperwork is in order. Let's get down to business!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Congratulations! You won the "Who Wants to Be an Intern?" contest to become Prosperity Junction's Protostar Intern!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: And you need an intern because...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Just what, exactly, is Prosperity Junction?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Why build it way out here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: Just how many interns have you hired recently?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Attempting to carry out both the duties of Prime Executive and Protostar Intern is inefficient.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Prime Executive handles all high level contractual negotiations here in Prosperity Junction. Due to the time-consuming nature of the job description, all low-level responsibilities are handed off to the Prime Assistant.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Prosperity Junction is a master-planned community brought to you by your friends at Protostar. Why deal with extreme weather when you can buy a house here, in Prosperity Junction?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The Protostar Corporation has identified several untapped consumer bases in the wilds of Whitevale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: The number is immaterial. Only efficiency matters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I fear this will be going on your permanent record.

localizedTextIdText: For your first assignment as the Protostar Intern, the Prime Executive at Prosperity Junction wants you to rescue Protostar employees that have been abducted by the Ikthians at the Protostar Housing Initiative in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Prime Executive via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have a situation that requires immediate attention. Our housing initiative has experienced an organic setback. Your assistance is required.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Quickly! Without our valued employees, our housing initiative will not be nearly as profitable!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our housing initiative is saved! Protostar thanks you for your contribution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please be careful, otherwise I'll have to fill out Form 492DFS.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go and lend a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On your first assignment as the Protostar Intern, you rescued Protostar employees from Ikthians at the Protostar Housing Initiative in Whitevale!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the problem.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: An organic setback? What's that mean?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Who is this hostile consumer group?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: According to Form 39B, build efficiency has dropped an alarming 2.47% due to the presence of a hostile consumer group.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They register as Ikthians. Calculations indicate vast profit potential once marketing can be aligned.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're an intern now. You can't refuse an assignment, you know.

localizedTextIdText: For your second assignment as the Protostar Intern, the Prime Executive has tasked you with salvaging parts from the sabotaged fishbots in South Whitevale. They also request that you reactivate the Protostar fish collectors on Calmwater Lake.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Prime Executive at Prosperity Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This next task will be simplicity itself! It appears our fishing operations have been sabotaged by the natives. Salvage fishbots to recoup our losses.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our fishing production has already suffered a crushing blow. Without your intervention on Calmwater Lake, we might as well give up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Minimum losses equal maximum profit. Well done! I knew you were the right choice for an intern.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: While you're at it, fix our fish collectors that got busted.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On your second assignment as the Protostar Intern, you salvaged parts from the sabotaged fishbots and reactivated the Protostar fish collectors on Calmwater Lake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wasting time is a firing offense!

localizedTextIdText: For your third assignment as the Protostar Intern, the Prime Executive in Prosperity Junction wants you to boost sales by using the Protostar B.L.I.M.P. to airdrop promotional plushies on unsuspecting Ascendency members at Augment Facility X426 in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Prime Executive at Prosperity Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Profits are down and we need to boost sales. Take the Protostar B.L.I.M.P. and hand out some promotional plushies to Ascendancy cultists!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is a key opportunity to promote the Protostar brand to a heretofore untapped demographic! Board the B.L.I.M.P. and airdrop those plushies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our promotional plushie product has been delivered! You have my thanks... in triplicate!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those cultists are an untapped demographic with limitless profit potential!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: You've got to be kidding me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On your third assignment as the Protostar Intern in Prosperity Junction, you handed out promotional plushies to try and boost sales to Ascendancy cultists at Augment Facility X426.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Promotional plushies have been statistically proven to increase sales by 1.19% in most demographics.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Big, Large, Inexpensive Mobile Plane. What else would it stand for?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This won't look good on your file.

localizedTextIdText: For your fourth assignment as the Protostar Intern, the Prime Executive wants you to cut losses by firing a few Protostar employees in Prosperity Junction.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Prime Executive at Prosperity Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar profits are in danger, we must start cutting losses! Speak with Protostar employees around town and inform them they've been fired.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Downsizing is never pretty, but it's necessary for Prosperity Junction to remain... prosperous! So get out there and fire those bums!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now, let's talk. Failure is an occasional inevitability, and I regret to inform you that you are also fired.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please dispose of them quickly and efficiently.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On your final assignment as the Protostar Intern, you were forced to fire other Protostar employees in Prosperity Junction before being fired yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: When you refuse to do as I say, you're sabotaging your career.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Clerical Associate has asked for your assistance in picking up and delivering supplies around Prosperity Junction.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Clerical Associate or the Junior Clerical Associate in Prosperity Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have a mountain of paperwork. Can you do something for me? I need someone to pick up and deliver supplies around town.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Those deliveries must be completed post-haste! Don't you know? Time is money is time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those deliveries must be completed post-haste! Don't you know? Time is money is time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great! Any later and we would've dropped below acceptable inefficiency margins. I don't know about you, but I want to keep my job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Check in with me or my subordinate. Time is money... so I'll be timing you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Protostar by picking up and delivering supplies around Prosperity Junction.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Clerical Associate or the Junior Clerical Associate
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Consider this as just another black mark on your permanent record.

localizedTextIdText: The Exotic Resources Financier has requested you bring him wooly mammodin and yeti fur from the snowy fields of South Whitevale, near the Protostar Housing Initiative.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Exotic Resources Financier in South Whitevale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have a job for you! Research shows that fur is 22.4% more popular than before. We cannot pass up this opportunity to profit. Go out and get us some furs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Production cannot commence without the raw materials! Go forth and get those wooly mammodin furs before the price plummets! Yeti furs are good, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Allow me to offer you this comparatively paltry compensation for the killing you've done on Protostar's behalf.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fur from wooly mammodin is best. Good luck to you, and good fortune to us!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll be rich! Rich, I tell you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected wooly mammodin and yeti fur for the Exotic Resources Financier.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Exotic Resources Financier
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have disappointed me.

localizedTextIdText: The Exotic Resources Financier has requested you bring him crystallized rock from the colossal gronyx that roam the outskirts of Doomtide Village in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Exotic Resources Financier in South Whitevale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have a job for you! Testing reveals crystallized rock is crystallized! We can make a fortune if we get our hands on some. Gronyx are chock full of the stuff!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your efficiency is below projected estimates. Hunt down those gronyx and gather up some of that crystallized rock.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was most efficient! You're one giant pair of goggles away from being a true clone of Phineas T. Rotostar!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It may be dangerous; you'll need to sign this release form.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected crystallized rock for the Exotic Resources Financier in South Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Exotic Resources Financier
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What are you worried about?

localizedTextIdText: The Exotic Resources Financier has requested you recover the ZubbleBubble flavor crystals from the ZubbleBubble Crash Site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Exotic Resources Financier in South Whitevale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: One of our ZubbleBubble Cola ships has crashed and I want you to recover the ZubbleBubble flavor crystals from the wreck. They're quite valuable!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without those crystals, ZubbleBubble Cola will be far less flavorful! Focus group tests will be a disaster. You absolutely, positively have to get them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. Your efficiency level remained within acceptable parameters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: By my calculations, it shouldn't take too long.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Have an efficient day! This farewell brought to you by... Protostar!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the lost ZubbleBubble flavor crystals for the Exotic Resources Financier in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Exotic Resources Financier
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: ZubbleBubble Cola is a revolutionary taste experience brought to you by your friends at Protostar.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The newly designed ZubbleBubble flavor crystal is Protostar's answer to consumer feedback. Initial reports indicate a 100% increase in flavor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It appears I have miscalculated your enthusiasm level. Let's try again.

localizedTextIdText: The Prime Assistant has presented you with an opportunity to get even with your former Protostar boss. All you have to do is download the access codes from the master control panel in Prosperity Junction.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the new Prime Executive in Prosperity Junction via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good news friend, all is not lost! Want to get even? Download the access codes from the master control panel, and I'll do the rest!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I need those access codes in order to proceed with my plan. You can download them from the master control panel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need those access codes in order to proceed with my plan. You can download them from the master control panel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the old Prime Executive removed, I have assumed his position as the new Prime Executive. Ah, the delicious irony of it all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now we can both profit from your unfortunate termination!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good luck in the private sector, my friend!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Then my job here is done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Prime Assistant presented you with an opportunity to get even with your former Protostar boss. You downloaded access codes from the master control panel in Prosperity Junction and provided them toPrime Assistant, allowing him to assume your former boss' position as Prime Executive.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll get those codes for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get those codes for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the new Prime Executive
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How's this going to help you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: I still don't get it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: According to my calculations, holding the position of Prime Assistant for longer than strictly necessary will lead to termination.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Waste management is vital to maximizing our profits here in Whitevale. Regrettably, it is incompatible with the position of Prime Executive as it requires the completion of Form 24-T.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Application for transfer of Protostar personnel that includes subheading 55A: Instructions for Inclement Weather Postings.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Don't worry yourself. Comfort yourself with the knowledge that the Prime Executive will be completely and thoroughly sacked.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your resistance to progress has been noted.

localizedTextIdText: Though many of the hostile geomorphs have been dealt with, Doodad thinks the largest one, Golthox, will soon overcome the failing Seismic Suppression Emitter at Mozyk Quarry that has kept it at bay. Golthox must be destroyed!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Preceptor Alpha in Mozyk Quarry
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar was using a suppression device to keep the largest of the geomorphs at bay, but the device is failing. Something must be done!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Brave Freebots are gathering to support your action against the geomorph known as Golthox!  May positive probability influence the outcome!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please defend my brethren against the geomorphs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That geomorph was so large my dimensional processors were stretched to their limits. I am amazed by your limitless prowess and bravery!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We are sending all available Freebots to assist you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Preceptor Alpha is impressed with your handling of Golthox, but there's still something else that must be done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We Freebots face destruction without you!

localizedTextIdText: ((You've picked up the Weaponsmith tradeskill and now it's time to get to work. Grab some crafting materials and make something!))
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you want to become a better outfitter, you should earn reputation with us. Show me what you can make.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey there! Nexus outfitters can provide you  with new armor schematics, but you must have a favorable reputation with us to buy them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I like your attitude. If you need more mats, try salvaging some equipment or farming mobs.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can do something in Suede.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Show me what I can buy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: ((You've crafted your first weapon and gained some reputation with Brackworks! Getting cozy with them could earn you new schematics and materials later on..))
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider. The Exiles need skilled craftsmen supplying our troops with usable armor.

localizedTextIdText: Calmwater Commune has been recently attacked by the Pell of Doomtide Village. High Priest Rain-Caller has asked for your assistance in determining why these attacks are taking place.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to High Priest Rain-Caller via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We of Calmwater Commune have been attacked by the Pell of Doomtide Village. They take our people away. We do not understand why. Can you discover the truth?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Learn why the Doomtide Pell have been raiding our commune and taking away our people. We have done nothing to anger them. Something must be wrong.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Masters! What are these machines? Where have our people been taken? I do not understand this puzzle.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you, outsider. Perhaps you can do what the Disciples cannot.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can dig up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After some investigation, it appears that the Pell of Doomtide Village have sworn allegiance to the Ascendancy. To support their new allies, the Doomtide Pell have been bringing them non-believers from Calmwater Commune so that they can be shown the "truth."
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then leave this place before we drown you in the lake!

localizedTextIdText: The Pell of Doomtide Village are serving the Ascendancy. Machines around the village are instructing villagers to attack Calmwater Commune. Destroy the machines to disrupt the Doomtide Pell's link to the Ascendancy's cultists.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to High Priest Rain-Caller via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those machines are responsible! They deceive the Doomtide Pell! They must be shut off, and so you will deactivate them. The Masters command it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The machines whisper to the Doomtide Pell, encouraging them to attack us. They must be deactivated!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That one! Purifier Landes! The blame is squarely upon his shoulders! He will know where our people are kept! We cannot abide his blasphemy!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This corrupting influence must be removed from Doomtide Village!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Calmwater Commune by destroying the Ascendancy's propaganda machines in Doomtide Village. In addition, you learned that Purifier Landes has been ordering newly-initiated Doomtide Pell to capture the citizens of Calmwater Commune so that they can be converted to recognize the "truth" of the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then I will find another. Our work must continue.

localizedTextIdText: Calmwater Pell are being held in an offshoot of Doomtide Village. High Priest Rain-Caller has asked you to rescue his people and find the persons responsible for these events.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to High Priest Rain-Caller in Calmwater Commune
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our brothers must be held in an offshoot of Doomtide Village. Their minds will be twisted, their bodies torn! Free them and find their tormentors!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find our brothers in another of the Doomtide Pell's villages. Free them. Save them from the torments that haunt them, and send them home to us!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are whole again. No longer will we tolerate these atrocities. With your help, outsider, we will end this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Masters will guide you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let the Flow wash our enemies away!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get them back to you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: An Ascendancy Soulcore sect, along with Purifier Landes, has been kidnapping Calmwater Pell and forcing them to convert. In addition, the cultists are attempting to learn the secrets of the Focus of Water from the captives.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get them back to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Our brothers must be freed. The lies cannot stand.

localizedTextIdText: To prepare for their battle against the Soulcore Ascendants, the Calmwater Pell must perform a sacred ritual. Scales from the longsnouts of Calmwater Lake are to be used as offerings to begin the ritual, so you must go into the lake and some bring back.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to High Priest Rain-Caller in Calmwater Commune
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The time for our attack approaches, so we must prepare ourselves with a sacred ritual. Longsnout scales are required, and you must collect them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The longsnout's scales are its armor. They will protect us from harm when we take this fight to the Doomtide. Go now and collect them so we can begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now we will begin the ritual! Pay heed, outsider, for you, too, will be part of our vanguard!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you return, the ritual will begin. The Tide will gird our souls for war!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected ritual scales from the longsnouts of Calmwater Lake and returned them to High Priest Rain-Caller in Calmwater Commune. The ritual can now begin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The ritual must be performed if we are to have any chance of victory.

localizedTextIdText: The Calmwater Ritual will call forth a violent storm in Calmwater Commune, bringing rain and lightning. Those who brave the storm and remain within its bounds will be gifted with the temporary power of water. Those who cannot withstand it will perish.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to High Priest Rain-Caller in Calmwater Commune
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lay your hands on the ancient altars. Give the offerings to the summoners. Remain in the circle as the storm grows or you will be struck down by its power.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not leave the circle! Allow the Flow to wash over you, to spread through you, until you feel the power of the Masters in every fiber of your being!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Flow respects you now, outsider. Take its gifts and prepare for battle. We will destroy our enemies. The Tide will wash them away!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stand strong, outsider. You are the first non-Pell to attempt this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to survive the Calmwater Ritual. You are now gifted with the power of water, as well as the honor of the Calmwater Pell. It is now time to bring the attack. Join forces with the Calmwater warriors and put an end to the Purifier!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You will die, outsider. The Flow is a harsh master that punishes failure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are not worthy of the Flow! Begone!

localizedTextIdText: Chieftain Rain-Fighter of Calmwater Commune is leading a pack of Calmwater warriors to battle against Purifier Landes. Meet with them outside the village and help them destroy the Purifier.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to High Priest Rain-Caller via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Chieftain Rain-Fighter will lead us into battle. Join him outside the village, and join with us to defeat the Purifier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our time is now. Chief Rain-Fighter leads our warriors into battle against this so-called Purifier. Join him and earn us our rightful victory!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are a true warrior. The Calmwater Pell will speak of this for years to come. May the Flow guide the rest of your journeys in this land.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You have gained our respect, outsider, but this will earn our brotherhood.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Purifier is no more, and the Pell of Calmwater Commune can now live in peace. Though Purifier Landes will no longer disrupt the Calmwater Pell, the rest of the Soulcore Ascendants still occupy the Eldan facility.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then another will aid us in our time of need.

localizedTextIdText: The footpath to Zin's Landing must be made safe. Pilot Apex has asked you to plant flares along the path. Kill Seaspine and Stormcaller beasts plaguing the route.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Wingman Volaticus near Zin's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must take steps to secure the supply line to Artemis Zin's expedition. Light flares to mark the path, and eliminate hostile fauna threatening the workers.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you executed your task yet? Light flares along the road and kill any dagun or girrok you come across.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's this shirking? Don't come back until I can see some flares on the road, and for Scion's sake, kill some dagun or girrok while you're at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not bad work there, guv, but I'm afraid you've missed the show. Lady Zin has already left for Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Any drop in efficiency is unacceptable.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lady Zin's impulsiveness is well-known to the holo viewing public, it is.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Pilot Apex bidding, you killed Seaspine and Stormcaller beasts and lit flares along the footpath to Zin's Landing.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll light the flares and kill the creatures.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll light the flares and kill the creatures.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Silence. Do not question orders. The discovery of an Eldan facility in Levian Bay has prompted high-level authorization of this expedition. Artemis Zin will be leading it as a subject matter expert.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lady Zin has gone ahead to survey the area of interest. In the meantime, attend to your tasks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are fortunate I am too busy to see to your immediate termination.

localizedTextIdText: Wingman Volaticus has asked you to retrieve Artemis Zin Cambot Z-1n and Cambot AR-2ms and to kill some of the malverines responsible for dragging away the equipment. Bring the equipment and report to Artemis Zin overlooking Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Artemis Zin at Star-Comm Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lady Zin tasked me with finding her missing cambots, an errand I gladly turn over to you. They were dragged away by malverines, so you may have to kill a few first.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you find Lady Zin's lost cambots yet? And I wouldn't be opposed to a few more dead malverines. Just look at their teeth!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What do you mean you don't have my cambots? I specifically requested that Volaticus take care of the malverine problem and find my equipment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, good! My cambots. And the hired help! Remind me to commend Volaticus. You are just in time to witness one of the great moments in galactic history.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't keep Lady Zin waiting. She'll want her cambots quick, she will.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm about to uncover one of the greatest wonders of Nexus: the Elder Cube!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought your way to Artemis Zin camp above the dormant Star-Comm Station. What wonders does the Eldan facility hold? Artemis hopes to find the legendary Elder Cube inside it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you know about Lady Zin?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Zin's in charge of this expedition?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: You have got to be kidding me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Have you been living on an asteroid or something all this time? She's only the Dominion's most famous explorer! Oh, and she's distantly related to the emperor.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: She is, whether we like it or not. And let me tell you... I have opinions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We're here to assist Lady Zin with her task... whatever that is. I heard a rumor that even the emperor doesn't know we're here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I'm serious as an execution, mate. This mission wasn't sanctioned by Imperial decree. Apparently, Lady Zin just took off and ordered it by herself! Off you go now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're a blighter, you know that? Leaving me to find those bloody bots.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has instructed you to use the Eldan Terminal on top of Star-Comm Station in Levian Bay to deactivate the exo-lab's internal security. This will probably involve little more than pressing a button.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If we're going to enter Star-Comm Station, I'll need you to deactivate its internal security systems. The terminal on top of the station should do the trick.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Were my instructions unclear? Head down to the Eldan terminal in the center of the structure and use it to deactivate the station's security systems.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should be enough power core fragments, $(player.class). Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soon the wisdom of the Elder Cube will be at our fingertips!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Isn't it obvious?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What should I do with them?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected enough $m(vitem=20) to repair the Eldan Terminal on top of Star-Comm Station in Levian Bay, partially disabling its internal defense systems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: How could you not know who I am? I'm frighteningly famous, after all. My name is Artemis Zin, and I'm the finest explorer in the history of the empire. You don't get out much... do you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are likely to regret such insolence.

localizedTextIdText: Collect the $m(vitem=21) scattered along the shore of Seaspine Cove in Levian Bay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(vitem=21) to Scholar Valensa at Seaspine Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Eldan artifact is lying out in the open. Other artifacts, if found, would go a long way towards helping the Dominion learn the secrets of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You need to search for more Eldan artifacts in Seaspine Cove.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found any Eldan artifacts? I would be thrilled to study them. Bring them to me, and I'll make it worth your while.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have found a good selection of Eldan artifacts! Amazing! I must investigate them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May the Scions watch over you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find more of these artifacts.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope you find them interesting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found several $m(vitem=21) in Seaspine Cove. Scholar Valensa is very pleased.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker requires your assistance if it is to regain control of Star-Comm Station. Specifically, the facility's security nodes and hubs are malfunctioning. They require immediate repair. You can collect power crystals from Eldan constructs in Security Hub Sigma in Star-Comm Station and use them to repair the security hubs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Due to extensive damage throughout the facility, I am no longer in control of Star-Comm Station. I require you to perform repairs to restore my access.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can salvage power crystals from Eldan constructs to repair security nodes located on Security Hub Sigma.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The repairs you initiated have been quite effective. Star-Comm Station is once again under my control. I have also regained control of the remaining Eldan constructs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Salvage power crystals from Eldan constructs here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The constructs will now be harmless unless provoked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used power crystals recovered from Eldan constructs in Security Hub Sigma to repair security nodes and hubs. The Caretaker control of the Star-Comm Station has been restored.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where is that data being sent?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What information does the Elder Cube store?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Star-Comm Station is designed to transmit data from the Elder Cube into deep space.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That information is currently unavailable. Can I help you with something else?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Elder Cube is a data storage device. Like lesser datacubes, it stores information.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: All files and data pertaining to the Nexus Project are stored in the Elder Cube. Unfortunately, access to the Elder Cube is currently locked.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Our goals are in alignment. You seek knowledge, and I seek to reestablish control of this station. Shall we proceed now?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Until the security systems are repaired, I am unable to fully assist you.

localizedTextIdText: Repair Construct are trapped in Security Hub Sigma in Star-Comm Station. Free them, so they can complete the repairs required to access the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must initialize repair protocols using the station's maintenance constructs, yet they are confined within Security Hub Sigma. Once freed, they can begin necessary repairs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If I am to grant access to the Elder Cube, I'll have to free the repair constructs from captivity.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The constructs you freed have initiated and completed necessary repairs. The facility is nearly fully operational.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be wary of defense constructs within the sector. They pose a heavy threat.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Only one task remains before the Elder Cube is accessible.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed the trapped Repair Construct in Security Hub Sigma, so they could complete the repairs required to access the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: I thought I shut down the station's security outside.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That is affirmative. When active, they act as custodians for this station, repairing damage and maintaining a multitude of critical systems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Security Hub Sigma is where the majority of this station's security systems are kept.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Though power to some internal defenses has been interrupted, back-up systems have restored much of Sigma's functionality within the station.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Access to the Elder Cube will be impossible until this is done.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has fabricated the replacement access key, which grants Artemis Zin access to the Elder Cube. Give Artemis the key in the Elder Vault in Star-Comm Station, so she can meet her destiny.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Give Artemis Zin the Access Key in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The replacement access key has been successfully fabricated. Now Artemis Zin can use the cube's access panel to access the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your mistress awaits access to the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have been waiting for this my whole life. Why do you hesitate? Give me the key!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finally! The key! This is the moment I've been waiting for... the moment I've dreamed about! Soon, the knowledge of Nexus will be mine!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The secrets of the Eldan are not for weak minds. You have been warned.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cambots, zoom in! We've only got one take, so make it count!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of it at once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gave the newly fabricated access key to Artemis Zin, allowing her to unlock the Elder Cube's knowledge within the Elder Vault once and for all.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall give it to her then.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Give Artemis Zin the Access Key
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are you trying to be funny?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I assume you would give the key to Artemis Zin. Then again, I am only an advanced artificial intelligence. What could I possibly know about it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Funny? Me? Oh, no. Quite the contrary, in fact. Do all sapients need to have the obvious meticulously spelled out for them, or is it just you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your lack of initiative at this juncture is illogical.

localizedTextIdText: Analyst Spector is in the Elder Vault and should be quite interested in analyzing the head you took from the Skeech Hag.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Skeech Hag's Head to Analyst Spector in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You suspect Analyst Spector will be interested in the head you removed from the Skeech Hag's corpse.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A female Skeech, you say? Fascinating! I will commence analysis once I return to my lab. All results will be made available to the ICI and the Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will remember this kindness if I am ever assigned to execute you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Analyst Spector.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Skeech Hag in Levian Bay and brought her head to Analyst Spector in the Elder Vault for study.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Skeech Hag's Head to Analyst Spector

localizedTextIdText: Exile forces have established a beachhead on Greyshore. Kevo has ordered you to assault the Exile forces so Artemis Zin and the rest of the expedition personnel can evacuate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kevo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles knew we were here. Although we were caught off-guard, we are far from helpless. Assault their lines and help clear the way for our evacuation!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Exiles are preparing their assault. Attack them now before they can consolidate their forces. We have to evacuate the station!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glory to the Empire! You have shown the Exile scum you're $i(player.race) to be feared!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must ensure that Lady Zin is taken to safety. For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soon we will share tales of our exploits. For now, the fight continues!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The Exiles will fall before me!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They were no match for the might of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You caught Exiles in Greyshore as they were preparing to assault Star-Comm Station, and you helped clear the way for Zin's expedition to evacuate Levian Bay. Well done!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: The Exiles will fall before me!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Lady Zin's bodyguard. You may call me Kevo if you must. I have served House Zin for three generations.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Watch your tongue, $(player.name)! We're outnumbered and outgunned, but Lady Zin's safety is our primary concern.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know a coward when I see one.

localizedTextIdText: Beacons guide the drop pods the Exiles are deploying on Greyshore in Levian Bay. You can stall the Exile's assault by sabotaging Exile beacons, so their drop pods will fly off course.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's nothing left for us here now. We must leave. Go to the Greyshore beachhead and sabotage Exile drop pod beacons to clear the way for our evacuation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's no time left! Go to Greyshore at once and sabotage drop pod beacons! Then my personnel can evacuate Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! Exile drop pods have splashed down in the bay. I wonder. Do Granok sink or swim?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Everyone here is counting on you, $(player.name). Even me. Do not fail!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Listen. I have a plan to get us out of here, but I'll need your help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You sabotaged the Exile drop pod beacons on Greyshore, stalling the Exile assault on Levian Bay. That contributed to the successful evacuation of Artemis Zin personnel from Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What happened to the Elder Cube?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where was the Elder Cube teleported?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: The Exiles must pay for this!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: When the Exiles began their assault, security protocols initiated, teleporting the Elder Cube to a safer location.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I haven't the faintest idea. I found it once, though. I can find it again. Mark my words.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Oh, I'll make certain they do. At the present time, I'm afraid our only option is to evacuate and resume the search for the Elder Cube elsewhere. Are you ready?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you want to survive this, you will do as I command.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has located an Exile transport ship she can operate. Unfortunately, the ship is guarded by an Exile Warbot. if you're going to escape from Levian Bay, you'll have to destroy the Exile Warbot in Greyshore.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Artemis Zin in Ellevar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's an Exile transport located on the rise above Greyshore. I can use it to fly us out of here. Unfortunately, it's guarded by an Exile warbot.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you destroyed the warbot yet? If you haven't, you had best step to it. But if you have, we need to get off this island before Exiles tighten the proverbial noose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you destroyed the warbot yet? If you haven't, you had best step to it. But if you have, we need to get off this island before the Exiles tighten the proverbial noose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did an exceptional job eliminating that warbot. We all owe you a debt of gratitude. You have a bright future in service to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You've proven capable. I'm certain you can clear the way for our escape.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We will meet again. Until then, farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Exile Warbot in Greyshore and escaped from Levian Bay aboard a transport ship.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll turn their warbot into scrap metal.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll turn their warbot into scrap metal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Oh, that's no... wait. A warbot?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, don't be such a worrywart! Just be aware that if we're all killed or captured, it's your fault. No pressure!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you consign us to death or capture at the hands of the Exiles?

localizedTextIdText: To reroute power away from Star-Comm Station's security system, you must disrupt Eldan power pods. Do this by jumping through them. Though it may be dangerous, it's your best hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The power pods below the station entrance are routing energy to the internal defense systems. Leap through the pods to disrupt them and stop the flow of energy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The station's internal defenses are still online. If you can disrupt the power pods by leaping through them, it should weaken the station's defenses.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it! What a stellar performance! I doubt I could have done better myself... of course, I could have, but that's beside the point.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm fairly certain it should be safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The residual radiation shouldn't cause too much long term damage.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rerouted power away from Star-Comm Station, partially disabling its internal defense systems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I disrupt the flow of energy?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I expect you could do it physically. You're a smart one, $(player.name). I'm sure you'll figure something out.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I'm afraid the Eldan weren't concerned about your safety. Lucky for you, I am. I would never send someone as useful as you on a suicide mission.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is a big, strong $(player.class) like you afraid of a little bitty shock?

localizedTextIdText: Activate the Eldan Terminal near the teleporter, then to use the teleporter to meet up with Artemis Zin inside Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Artemis Zin in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The only thing left to do is activate that terminal. Thanks to you, it should have more than enough power for our needs.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Return to the terminal and ensure that it's functional. We'll meet you inside the station.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hurry up and get in here. Just step onto the telepad. The transition should be instantaneous.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have you ever seen anything so wonderful? This is far more beautiful... far more amazing than I had ever imagined!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's nothing to hold us back. The Elder Cube awaits us inside!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And my fans are going to get an eyeful of this on my next holovid!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Artemis Zin inside Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can my fame rub off on you if you don't lend me a hand?

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready to get started? First, take these materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The materials'll go into your tradeskill bag. Don't lose 'em!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a weaponsmith, Weaponsmith Dunpepper has given you the materials needed to make a weapon.

localizedTextIdText: ((You've decided to be a Miner and now it's time to get to work. This harvesting type tradeskill is a great way to gather materials for crafting professions, or to make some cash!))
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Prospector Gelka at Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: So you fancy yourself a miner? Well, get out there and find some ore! Show me some proof that you can be a miner.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for iron ore nodes near other rocks or mountainsides outside of town.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your technique's a bit rough, but gettin' the ore is what's important.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ore is more abundant near rocky out-croppin's, mountains, or cliffs. Unless you have a Laser Pickaxe, you're best off attackin' the nodes for ore.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: When you reach tier two, we'll have more work for you. Until then, keep rockin'.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll bring back some iron ore.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're getting the hang of being a miner. Keep practicing to reach tier two.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The miners in Exile could always use more help if you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: As a fellow Farmer, Bobbie has asked you to try harvesting some simple herbs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Farmer Bobbie
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You fancy yourself bein' a farmer? Well the first thing you should do is go out there and harvest either spirovine or bladeleaf. Yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for Spirovine and Bladeleaf in the wilderness outside of town.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As you're exploring the world keep an eye out for all sorts of different plants to collect. You never know what you might find.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I like the cut of your jib. Come back when you have some herbs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In the meantime, you can plant those seeds in your own garden. You do have a house already, right?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can find some spirovine or bladeleaf.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've learned to harvest herbs, and are now on your way to being a skilled Farmer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if you change your mind, I'll be here.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, time to get to work. I'm going to give you some materials. They're for crafting light armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The cloth and thread will go into your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a tailor, Tailor Wildspring has given you the materials needed to make some light armor.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Let's get down to business. I'm going to give you some materials you can use to craft your first medishot.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The omni-plasm will go into your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a Technologist, Supervisor Arborgreen has given you the basic supplies needed to make your first medishot.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, now it's time to use what you know. I've got some materials here that are just perfect for a first project.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The lumber will go into your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an architect, Supervisor Arborgreen has given you the crafting materials necessary to start your first project.

localizedTextIdText: The drills in the quarry have been deactivated. Sprocket has asked you to locate the $(vitem=23) and use it to start up the drills again. The $(vitem=23) was last seen stuck in the claw of a Viceclaw Pincer somewhere in Mozyk Quarry.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sprocket via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If we're going to bring the quarry up to full capacity, we have to restart the drills. Unfortunately, the drill booster is missing... though I know where it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You'll need the drill booster to start the drills. Last time I saw it, a scrab had run off with it. They bury themselves around the quarry, waiting for prey.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blazing biochips! With those drills running, production should ramp up right away!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It was last seen in a scrab's claws. You'll need it to start the drills.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I offer my sincerest gratitude to you for finding the drill booster.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the $(vitem=23) and used it to start the drills up in Mozyk Quarry.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's an ignition device that turns on the drills. Only one of them was ever requisitioned by Protostar, while the others were placed on back-order.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If the Dominion wants us to drill for ore, we'll need to turn on the drills first.

localizedTextIdText: Conservationist Caius needs some assistance in cataloguing the animals of Owanee Basin. He's provided you with tracking chips you can use to tag members of the more prominent animal species near Owanee Research Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Ari at the Owanee Research Station in Owanee Basin
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In the course of its conservation efforts, the Royal Collegium requires assistance. Care to catalogue the animals in Owanee? You'll need these tracking chips.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I cannot monitor the animal population in Owanee without a proper catalogue of creatures. Tag the animals listed in your datachron and return to Ari with the data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Finished cataloguing creatures in Owanee? Need tracking chip data! No? Caius makes poor choice in assistants!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Receiving data now! Don't tell Caius, but tracking chips double as remote controlled incendiary devices. Think of it as built-in population control!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I've listed the creatures in your datachron. Return the data to Ari when you're done.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not so fast! Have other task for you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm happy to lend a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used tracking chips to tag a number of animals near Owanee Research Station for Conservationist Caius.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Conservation? I thought it was all about hunting in Deradune.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What's the deal with that Chua over there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't be silly. Where do you suppose all the animals come from? Without proper conservation, the Draken would hunt until Deradune is barren... in a matter of days! Someone has to think about the future.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You must be speaking about Ari. He's a biologist... of the Chua variety. Slightly different from, um, what we'd think of as a typical biologist. A bit bloodthirsty, but in time, one does get used to his... proclivities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How typical. Some people simply don't understand the importance of conservation.

localizedTextIdText: The Doomtide Pell have forsaken centuries of loyalty to the Focus of Water and the Masters, and now follow the Ascendancy. High Priest Rain-Caller has asked you to defend his people by killing the Doomtide Pell in Doomtide Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to High Priest Rain-Caller via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Traitors! Heretics! The Doomtide Pell have forsaken the Masters, and turned their backs on their faith for these co-called Ascendants. They must die!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must wash away the Doomtide Pell in a tide of blood. Not only will your holy work prevent further attacks, it will also please the Masters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Heresy is unforgivable. To turn their backs on the Masters for this "Purifier" speaks of the Doomtide's corruption. No longer will they attack us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Such blasphemy cannot be forgiven! Show no mercy!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the war to the Doomtide.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed many of the Doomtide Pell before they could launch further attacks on Calmwater Commune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I knew we could not trust an outsider to help.

localizedTextIdText: Something is disturbing the rest of the Draken dead at Endless Vigil. Cairnguard Drakuz has asked you to pay a visit to the monuments of the fallen clanlords in the Ancestral Cairns to see if you can find out the cause.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Apprentice Laveka in the Ancestral Cairns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The souls of our honored dead have been restless lately. Perhaps you ought to pay them your respects and see what disturbs them for yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Something disturbs the tranquility of this sacred place. Pay a visit to the tombs of our fallen clanlords and see what you can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How do you like our little necropolis? Come speak with me once you've finished exploring.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do you feel it? This place is steeped in power... death and magic, indivisible!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I would begin with the monuments of the fallen clanlords.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Patience! In time, you will learn all you wish to know.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You said you had news for me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While honoring the three great Draken clanlords, you were ambushed by Moodies! You also ran into Apprentice Laveka. A strange coincidence? Perhaps not.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You said you sensed something is wrong?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What do you think it is?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: The Dark Rites? Necroshaman?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Endless Vigil is a sacred resting place. This is where Draken are interred once their spirits have been rent from their flesh in battle. Many of our greatest warriors rest here. Their bones were brought all the way from Mikros so that we could honor them, even here on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Blood Covenants honor strength and life, drawing power from the life force in every living thing. The bloodshamans call upon that power in their rituals. Endless Vigil should be a place of concentrated power!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: If I didn't know better...but no, that is impossible! The Dark Rites are forbidden. The last necroshaman was killed long ago. There's couldn't possibly be one on Nexus now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I loathe even to speak of them. A profanation of the sacred Blood Covenant, the Dark Rites are nothing but black sorcery and blood magic. Those who practice the Dark Rites call themselves necroshamans and use their powers to weaken and control others. Some could even raise the bodies of the fallen, polluting them for their own dark purposes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have no respect for the dead.

localizedTextIdText: Calmwater Pell are being tortured by the Soulcore, an Ascendancy sect. The Ascendancy hopes to extract knowledge of the Focus of Water from their prisoners. A captured Calmwater Pell has asked you to ease his people's suffering by destroying Soulcore interrogator constructs in Doomtide Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captured Calmwater Acolyte via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Masters' machines have been corrupted by the Purifier! They torment us... torture us. Even the strongest of us will succumb to the pain eventually.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Masters' machines must be destroyed. They have been corrupted by the Ascendants, so they must be cleansed. Do you understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: No longer will the Masters' constructs torture my people. You were sent by the Masters to save us, yes? All praise the Masters!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes! Destroy them! We must deny the Purifier the machines of the Masters!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the request of a Clearwater Pell captured by the Ascendancy, you destroyed a number of the Soulcore interrogator constructs in Doomtide Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The blasphemous outsiders wish to pry our secrets from us. They demand we tell them of the Focus of Water and detail the secrets of the Masters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The machines must be destroyed or the horror and pain will continue!

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Cowan, a ranking field agent with the XAS, has contacted you via your Datachron. She's requested your assistance with an investigation of high importance: namely, uncovering the agents behind Whitevale's cryogenic blast freeze. She's asked you to meet her at Profitorium 9.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Researcher Cowan at Profitorium 9
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need help with an ongoin' investigation. The information I've got is too delicate for an unsecured comm. If you're interested, we can talk in person.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We got no time to waste. Your job, reckonin' you accept, is to uncover the extent of Ikthian tamperin' in Whitevale's current glacial state.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll brief you when you reach my camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I made a hell of a compromise workin' with the critter over yonder.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm here to do what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Researcher Cowan fortified within Protostar's destroyed Profitorium 9 to conduct an investigation against the Ikthians of Silverscale Station. You've agreed to assist her research in the ongoing investigation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's downright unhelpful of you.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Benbazi, a ranking hydrophysicist with the Royal Collegium of Science, has contacted you via your Datachron. He's requested your assistance with an investigation of high importance: namely, uncovering the agents behind Whitevale's cryogenic blast freeze. He's asked you to meet him at Profitorium 9.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Researcher Benbazi at Profitorium 9
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Got a job for you. Must experiment on fishhead Ikthians. Pick their brains, dissect their livers. Hurry or I start without you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Took long enough. Big job to do. Gonna figure out if and how fish-brains managed to freeze Whitevale. Got an interesting theory spinning. You in?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come to crappy Protostar installation. We talk there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not fail. You not be happy if you fail. I not be happy, either.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm here to do what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Researcher Benbazi fortified within Protostar's destroyed Profitorium 9 to conduct an investigation against the Ikthians of Silverscale Station. You've agreed to assist his research in the ongoing investigation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: After all I hear, you are big disappointment.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Cowan suspects the Ikthians are behind the sudden and drastic climate change in Whitevale. She's asked you to gather samples of the crystallized water that the "fishheads" have been extracting in Silverscale Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Cowan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Once this land was lush with life. Now it's buried in ice, and our research fingers these fishheads. I aim to uncover the truth, but I need water samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you're hard up gatherin' samples, holler for my extractorbot to find a dig spot. Elsewise, ya can find 'em on the bodies of our fishy friends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is primal water! And it's been cryo-frozen! If them fishheads are usin' such a process on prime elements, it might've led to this massive freeze.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I built this bot for extractin'. Ought help in fetchin' the samples we need.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well, I'll be! The crystallization's suspended in a false state!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered samples of crystallized water for Researcher Cowan. After some analysis, she revealed that the samples consist of primal water that has undergone a blast-freezing process to convert it to a crystallized form. This might very well be the cause of Whitevale's frigid climate.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put the bot to good use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be like that.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Benbazi suspects the Ikthians are behind the sudden and drastic climate change in Whitevale. He's asked you to gather samples of the crystallized water that the Ikthians have been extracting in Silverscale Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Benbazi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Something fishy about water crystals found here. Ikthians extracting them like mad. Must be valuable. Get me many samples for analysis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You lack brain? Water samples not hard to find! Call extractorbot to dig for you. Or take from Ikthian bodies. Maybe fishbrain scientists carry them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What you find is primal water, blast-frozen. Who dumb enough to blast freeze primal energy? Fishbrains, that who. Could be cause of freeze in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use extractorbot. I give bucket of bolts overhaul. Should work fine.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Why Ikthians freeze Whitevale, ruin valuable resources? I will solve mystery.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered samples of crystallized water for Researcher Benbazi. After some analysis, he revealed that the samples consist of primal water that has undergone a blast-freezing process to convert it to a crystallized form. This might very well be the cause of Whitevale's frigid climate.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put the bot to good use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe you like being cut up for bait?

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Cowan has asked you to exterminate Ikthian personnel around Silverscale Station. The Silverscale scientists are incubating dangerous monstrosities, and can't be allowed to complete their task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Cowan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Them fishheads are incubatin' their soldiers into somethin' truly foul. We gotta wipe 'em out before their experiments get outta hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are two branches to this here facility: the Silverscale Research Station and the Needlefin Military Outpost. You'll find scientists in the station.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Brightland's beard, ya did it! That ought to set 'em back for a short moon, and buy us enough time to get to the bottom of things.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck, friend. Kill anything fishy-lookin' that moves.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This station's like a risin' tide, and I'm afraid we're runnin' outta time.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take out the Ikthian scientists.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Silverscale personnel for Researcher Cowan in an attempt to set back the Ikthian incubation experiments. Whatever the Ikthians are growing in Whitevale is dangerous, and ought not come to pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Don't worry. I'll take them out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Come back when you've got some grit about you.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Benbazi has asked you to exterminate Ikthian personnel around Silverscale Station. The Silverscale scientists are incubating dangerous monstrosities, and can't be allowed to complete their task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Benbazi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Not like to admit it, but fishy scientists big threat. Don't like competition. You get rid of fishbrains, or I get rid of you. Go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ikthians stupidly divide their facilities. One part Silverscale Research Station. Other part Needlefin Military Outpost. Makes scientists easy to find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good killing. Methods effective. Finally have time to decipher this whole primal water funny business. What fishbrains incubating, anyway?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If only half of fishbrains dead, then job only halfway done. Kill them all.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Killing Ikthians like spitting into sea. Not make difference, but fun to do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take out the Ikthian scientists.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Silverscale personnel for Researcher Benbazi in an attempt to set back the Ikthian incubation experiments. Whatever the Ikthians are growing in Whitevale is dangerous, and ought not come to pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Don't worry. I'll take them out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Silly $(player.name). You really think you can just leave?

localizedTextIdText: The Ikthian fleet at Silverscale Station has been mining the crystallized primal water and demineralizing it back into a liquid state. They use it to incubate their soldiers, growing them into massive Triton juggernauts. Researcher Cowan has asked you sabotage the incubators to hinder their army's growth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Cowan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The fishbrains cryo-blast underground pools of primal water, then extract, liquefy, and pump it into incubators to brew Triton spawn. We need to stop 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The stink-cubators in Silverscale Station look like large beakers with primal water bubblin' behind the glass. You want the ones with brood inside 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Just as I expected! They're usin' primal water to grow an army of Triton giants. Thankfully, we've put a hitch in their plans.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The brood they're growin' in that primal water is gonna be right lethal!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They've unsettled the Focus of Water, and we can't let 'em get away with it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed numerous Ikthian incubators to prevent an army of Triton juggernauts from being raised. You've slowed their production, but until the source of primal water has been exhausted, the land won't be safe from the Ikthian menace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please! People need yer help!

localizedTextIdText: The Ikthian fleet at Silverscale Station has been mining the crystallized primal water and demineralizing it back into a liquid state. They use it to incubate their soldiers, growing them into massive Triton juggernauts. Researcher Benbazi has asked you sabotage the incubators to hinder their army's growth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Benbazi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fishheads cryo-blast primal water. Extract it. Demineralize it. Pump into incubators to grow big, nasty monsters. So you go, destroy incubators.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Incubators like big test tubes. Have bubbling water inside, along with growing monstrosity. Look for incubators in Silverscale Station, then destroy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fishheads growing Triton giants with primal water. Impressive! Wish I had thought of it. Maybe adapt to Chua science later on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Building life with primal water... big problem. You go and fix.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Is proof. Ikthians disrupt Focus of Water. We must fix.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed numerous Ikthian incubators to prevent an army of Triton juggernauts from being raised. You've slowed their production, but until the source of primal water has been exhausted, the land won't be safe from the Ikthian menace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Patience wearing thin. Much like life expectancy of $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Cowan has asked you to kill the behemoths and leviathans that have been growing inside Silverscale Station. The Silverscale behemoths and leviathans are dangerous creatures bred for war, and they must be eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Cowan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Time to cull this army of Triton Guards the Ikthians are growin'. They're a danger to all sentient life on Nexus, includin' us. Kill any you can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: They're growin' their Triton Guards inside Silverscale Station. I reckon the place'll be crawling with fresh-hatched leviathans and behemoths.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Until we restore balance to the Focus of Water and reverse the primal water abundance in this area, they'll keep amassin' a regular ocean of critters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't get in over your head. Those are nasty critters.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Rebalancing the Focus of Water ain't gonna be an easy task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Silverscale behemoths and leviathans of the Triton Guard for Researcher Cowan, making Whitevale a much safer place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't the time to be jokin'. Nexus needs your help.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Benbazi has asked you to kill the behemoths and leviathans that have been growing inside Silverscale Station. The Silverscale behemoths and leviathans are dangerous creatures bred for war, and they must be eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Benbazi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fishheads growing Triton Guard. Must be stopped. Bred for war, huge, dangerous to Dominion. Time to target behemoths and leviathans. Time to kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Leviathans and behemoths incubate in Silverscale Station. Go there and kill them before I lose patience with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name) exceed expectations! Still, incubation continues. Must fix Focus of Water and deny fishbrains endless supply of primal water.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not fail. Job too important.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fixing Focus of Water will be messy. Fun, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Silverscale behemoths and leviathans of the Triton Guard for Researcher Benbazi, making Whitevale a much safer place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Guess you'll be first casualty of final conflict with fishbrains. Pity.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Cowan has instructed you to kill Prime Gillsting, Silverscale Station's Cortex Prime. With him out of the way, you can access his cortex analyzer and restore balance to the Focus of Water.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Cowan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Silverscale's top dog, the Cortex Prime, is usin' a cortex analyzer to control the Focus of Water. Kill the Prime an' get access to the analyzer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We gotta stop the Focus from going gangbusters! Kill Prime Gillsting so we can access the cortex analyzer. He's up near the Focus of Water.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You had me right worried for a minute there, but with the Prime dead we can nab control of the cortex analyzer!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go get 'em, partner. We need to set things right in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's invert the output on the hydronetic phenamplitude coupler... hang on!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The Cortex Prime is going down!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Cortex Prime of Silverscale Station and annihilated his Silverscale Dreadnaught.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Cortex analyzers are super-gadgets with incredible cipherin' capabilities. I reckon 'ol Gillsting is usin' it to keep the Focus of Water under wraps.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you had any sense at all, you'd change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Benbazi has instructed you to kill Prime Gillsting, Silverscale Station's Cortex Prime. With him out of the way, you can access his cortex analyzer and restore balance to the Focus of Water.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Benbazi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Big fishhead is Cortex Prime. Uses mega-brain controller called cortex analyzer to retune Focus of Water. Go, gut him like fish, then take analyzer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fishheads follow strict rank. Biggest fishbrain scientist is Cortex Prime. Gut him, then access cortex analyzer. Is near Focus of Water.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not bad. Could do better, but $(player.name) sufficient this time. Now you must take control of cortex analyzer, fix Focus of Water.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No one manipulates Focus of Water using science... except a Chua!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Invert output on hydronetic phenamplitude coupler. Should do trick.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The Cortex Prime is going down!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Cortex Prime of Silverscale Station and annihilated his Silverscale Dreadnaught.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Watch back. At risk of stabbing now.

localizedTextIdText: You've killed the Cortex Prime of Silverscale Station and gained access to his cortex analyzer. Researcher Cowan has asked you to use it to restore balance to the Focus of Water and put an end to the Ikthian's dangerous experiments in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Cowan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Access the cortex analyzer and restore balance to the Focus of Water! Lady Luck willin', Whitevale's snow will fade over time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The cortex analyzer's near the Focus of Water. You need to use it to restore balance to the Focus of Water or else Whitevale will be frozen forever.
