localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the stars, you did it! One day, when this place is warm and green again, all of Whitevale is goin' to be in your debt!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ready to settle this score? Get it done, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I owe you big, $(player.name). Thanks for helpin' me out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Ikthians of Silverscale Station were manipulating the Focus of Water to freeze primal water pockets, which they then used to produce their Triton army. Fortunately for the rest of Whitevale, you put a stop to their insidious plans.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're backin' out after comin' this far?

localizedTextIdText: You've killed the Cortex Prime of Silverscale Station and gained access to his cortex analyzer. Researcher Benbazi has asked you to use it to restore balance to the Focus of Water and put an end to the Ikthian's dangerous experiments in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Benbazi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Quickly! Access cortex analyzer! Restore Focus of Water! Only way to get rid of primal water abundance and thaw Whitevale.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You lack brains? Cortex analyzer all the way up there by Focus of Water! Big moment so close, I can taste it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Work so easy when hirelings do it for you. You enjoy making big impact? Soon, Whitevale thaws. Will be ripe for Chua exploitation!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go! Turn knobs and dials! Pull levers! Reverse controls! Do something!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You very useful. Decided not to dissect you. Should make you happy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Ikthians of Silverscale Station were manipulating the Focus of Water to freeze primal water pockets, which they then used to produce their Triton army. Fortunately for the rest of Whitevale, you put a stop to their insidious plans.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(player.name) has bad attitude. Makes me very angry!

localizedTextIdText: The Focus of Water is now restored to a stable state. However, there must be more information on how such a force is capable of freezing an entire countryside. A Pell tribe lives near Calmwater Lake, and they may know more about the Focus and its powers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to High Priest Rain-Caller near Calmwater Lake
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I spotted some Pell near Calmwater Lake. Maybe they'd know more about the Focus of Water. Mind checkin' 'em out?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I've been gettin' a distress signal from the vicinity of those Pell. I wonder if they need help? I guess you'll find out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sssss! An outsider! What is your business here, $(player.race)? Why do you come amongst these Disciples? There must be a reason!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Pell may be friendly... or not. Either way, be on your guard.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Help? Yes... we seek help, but did not expect it to come from an outsider.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Focus of Water is now restored to a stable state. However, there must be more information on how such a force is capable of freezing an entire countryside. A Pell tribe lives near Calmwater Lake, and you've gone to see if they know more about the Focus and its powers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can your belly get any yellower? Well? Can it?

localizedTextIdText: The Focus of Water is now restored to a stable state. However, there must be more information on how such a force is capable of freezing an entire countryside. A Pell tribe lives near Calmwater Lake, and they may know more about the Focus and its powers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to High Priest Rain-Caller near Calmwater Lake
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pell village near Calmwater Lake. Maybe Pell know more about Focus. Go, talk to Pell. Find out more about Focus!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Pell live near Calmwater Lake. You go there, speak to Pell. Maybe they answer questions about Focus of Water.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sssss! An outsider! What is your business here, $(player.race)? Why do you come amongst these Disciples? There must be a reason!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not let door hit hind end on way out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Help? Yes... we seek help, but did not expect it to come from an outsider.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Focus of Water is now restored to a stable state. However, there must be more information on how such a force is capable of freezing an entire countryside. A Pell tribe lives near Calmwater Lake, and you've gone to see if they know more about the Focus and its powers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Might dissect $(player.name), learn what makes you so stupid.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker suddenly went haywire while trying to access files on augmentation and has activated some kind of augmentation defense protocol. Whatever it is, it doesn't sound good. You must travel to the augmentation area of Exo-Lab A37 to manually override the defense system.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Accessing restricted files... WARNING! WARNING! UNAUTHORIZED DATA RETRIEVAL! EXO-LAB DEFENSES ACTIVATED. ACCESS MANUAL CONTROLS IN AUGMENTATION AREA FOR OVERRIDE.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: RELEASING AUGMENTED DEFENDERS! SOON! Unless, of course, you decide to manually override defense protocols in the augmentation area.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: RELEASING AUGMENTED DEFENDERS! SOON! Unless, of course, you decide to manually override defense protocols in the augmentation area.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My dear sapients, I must apologize. Accessing the augmentation files must have triggered an automated defense subroutine. I assure you, I am quite myself now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: SEE OVERRIDE CONTROLS IN AUGMENTATION AREA. ERROR. ERROR.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have finished compiling the files requested by Lady Zin in datacube format. You may retrieve it at your leisure.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I definitely like you better like this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the augmentation defense terminal and attempted to manually override the exo-lab's defense response. You had to survive the onslaught of several augmented defenders, but were finally able to override the system. When you returned, the Caretaker had returned to normal. He was able to compile the augmentation files into a datacube for you to retrieve.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Wait, what just happened? You were perfectly fine a second ago!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: But I thought we synced you with all your systems already?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: HA HA HA! Ha HA ha! Oh, were you saying something? INTRUDER! DESTROY! ANNIHILATE! DERESOLUTIONIFY! Thanks for playing!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: IRRELEVANT! Accessing restricted material BAD! VERY BAD! You did a NO-NO! Files on augmentation are for authorized personnel only. WHICH YOU ARE NOT! AHA! HA! HA!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Now class! Follow my instructions. If you were authorized personnel, WHICH YOU ARE NOT, you would go to the augmentation area AND SHUT IT ALL DOWN DOWN DOWN!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: AUGMENTED DEFENSE PROTOCOL WILL BEGIN! Your calculated survival chance is .003%. I rounded up.

localizedTextIdText: Now that the situation in the exo-lab is under control, Artemis Zin would like you to retrieve the datacube containing the augmentation files from the data vault within Exo-Lab A37.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Artemis Zin in Exo-Lab A37
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Well, that was quite eventful! However, I believe we can consider Exo-Lab A37 to be under our control. Now all I need is that datacube.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you retrieved that datacube yet? Just think what a sensation augmentation will be in the scientific community! Not to mention my role in discovering it....
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At last! News of augmentation will make quite the news splash. I can hardly contain myself! Rest assured, you will be compensated well for your services.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take care. Even under our control, I'm sure this exo-lab is full of little surprises.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you'll excuse me, the galaxy must hear of my extraordinary find!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was an honor, Lady Zin.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You overcame one final surprise while retrieving the augmentation datacube, but managed to successfully return to Artemis with it. News of augmentation will likely turn the heads of the scientific community at large, and Lady Zin will most certainly capitalize on the attention.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: After all we've been through? Asking you to do one last task is perfectly reasonable!

localizedTextIdText: The halls of Exo-Lab A37 are thick with hostile skeledroids. Kevo is concerned for the safety of Artemis Zin and has asked you to destroy some of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Kevo via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lady Zin's safety is priority. I will stay here and guard her as she speaks with the Caretaker. I need you to destroy other possible threats.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If not for my duty to Lady Zin, I would hunt these abominations myself. Destroy as many as you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I feel better knowing there are less of these creatures to harm my mistress. You have acquitted your duty to House Zin with honor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The sooner we leave this place, the better.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The number of skeledroids in Exo-Lab A37 has been significantly reduced by your efforts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How did you get in here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You may have the bold heart of a hunter, but you lack eyes that can see. I made my way here once I'd heard the little miss had gone ahead inside the exo-lab. I'm glad that I did. This place reeks of death and tar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You lack honor.

localizedTextIdText: You've been tasked with shutting down the emergency pressure valve at Honeyworks Station A-22.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Honeyworks Extraction Lead at Honeyworks Station A-22
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Blast! Our pipes are bursting at the seams with honey! OUR honey! Get to the emergency shut off switch and shut these machines down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hurry! You must shut down these pumping stations before they explode! Do you hear me! Explode!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So with all the debris in our honey now... we'll have to introduce a new flavor. Crunchy Honey from Protostar! An excellent plan!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: And don't step in the honey! We still plan on selling it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't suppose you're interested in our honey clean-up efforts?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully shut down Station A-22's pumping operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Honeyworks Extraction Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you please sign this disobedience form before you leave?

localizedTextIdText: One of Biologist Ari animals, Subject A43K, seems to have a malfunctioning tracking chip. Ari wants you to find the animal, retrieve its chip, and bring it back to him at Owanee Research Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Ari via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Several animals implanted with special chip. Subject A43K one of them, but chip no longer transmitting data. Find Subject A43K, bring back chip, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Subject A43K part of very important experiment. Need that data now! Find Subject A43K, bring back chip. Now now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hmm, appears Subject A43K tracking chip functioning as intended. Subject A43K, on other hand, is not.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Subject A43K very important to research. Find at once. Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Animal killed, stripped of parts. By who? For what reason? Most troubling.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No, it looks pretty dead to me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Subject A43K for Biologist Ari, but the beast was dead when you found it. Large sections of its hide were missing, along with its horn.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: So what is a Chua doing in an animal preserve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Not all Chua blow things up! Well, still blow things up, but for different reasons. Breed animals for Draken hunting grounds. Keep herds healthy. Study animals. Then blow things up!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not like your attitude. Maybe want special chip implanted? One that goes... kaboom?

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You seek to be an outfitter, $(player.class)? You should begin honing your craft immediately. Take these materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us not tarry in your work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were introduced to Outfitter Hokia. She offered to teach you the basics of being an outfitter.

localizedTextIdText: Biologist Ari prized Subject A43K has been killed and stripped of valuable parts by persons unknown. Ari has ordered you to return to Owanee Research Station and report your findings to Conservationist Caius.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to Conservationist Caius at the Owanee Research Station in Owanee Basin
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Only one possibility. Poachers! Caius must know. Hmm. Definitely won't be happy. Return to camp and let him know.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Poachers very bad news. Must tell Caius right away. On plus side, get to watch his face when you deliver news!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need to take matter into our own hands! You should search for other signs of poaching. The poachers may have left behind clues to their identity.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Marauders! I should have known! I won't stand idly by while these cretins cull the emperor's herds! By Dominus, no!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Owanee creatures under protection of emperor. Have to be pretty brave to steal from emperor. Or stupid.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can't say I blame you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: As you searched for more evidence of poachers in the area - as well as Lord Venator involvement in that poaching - Conservationist Caius has been doing his own research.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Dangerous to poach from Draken hunting grounds. Draken like hunting poachers even more than hunting animals. Poachers come here. Makes sense. Caius and Ari keep animals here very healthy, breed to keep up numbers. Finest animals in all of Nexus!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Not want to tell Caius either! Better you than me!

localizedTextIdText: Using the Marauder communications device you found, Conservationist Caius has triangulated the location of the poachers. Travel to those coordinates and see if you can find the poachers' camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Conservationist Caius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I think I may have located our poachers. Using the Marauder comm, I've triangulated all transmissions to one location, and I've sent the coordinates to you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Does this look like a poacher camp to you? Check your datachron for the coordinates I've sent you. I suspect that's where the poachers are hiding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blind my eyes! Look at the size of that camp! I do hope you're up for some mischief and mayhem, citizen, because you're about to cause some.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Contact me when you've discovered their camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Those filthy poachers will pay for their trespassing!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've located the poachers' basecamp at Grimvoid Landing. It looks like things are about to get ugly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you think is Lord Venator's involvement in all this?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What will happen to Lord Venator?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: As reluctant as I am to speak ill of another highborn, I suspect the motive is greed. Venator owes several debts of honor. Perhaps the chance to earn some easy Marauder cash has blinded him to his duties to the emperor. Or perhaps he's simply a ruffian. I never did like the fellow.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Dominion law is very clear on this point. If Venator is found actively colluding with the enemy, he is a traitor to the empire! The penalty for treason is death!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't give up. We're so close! Did Venator get to you somehow?

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Gim is asking anyone who can help to travel to the tar pits of Leviathan's Rest to aid a Royal Collegium expedition led by Artemis Zin. It appears the crew was attacked by mysterious skeledroids as soon as they landed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Kevo in Leviathan's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Need help! Expedition at Leviathan's Rest gone horribly wrong! Artemis Zin in trouble! Skeledroids attacked as soon as we landed. Many wounded, others missing!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why you still stand here! Royal Collegium in trouble! Artemis Zin need help! Already sent coordinates to datachron, now go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must be on the alert.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You say Gim sent you? Good. You look like you can handle yourself on the battlefield.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Transmitting coordinates for Leviathan's Rest to datachron. Hurry, go go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Another attack could come any minute. Be prepared.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Leviathan's Rest and spoke with expedition member DRED Tech Farlo. A number of the other expedition members are injured, while others are missing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Wait, slow down. What were you doing in the swamp?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is Artemis Zin doing with you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Explorer reports indicate Eldan exo-lab underneath tar pits of Leviathan's Rest. Royal Collegium sent expedition with Artemis Zin to investigate. Hoping to make big scientific discovery, instead dealing with tar and skeledroids!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lady Zin obsessed with finding Elder Cube. Insists on being included any time new exo-lab found. Royal Collegium can't say no - after all, Lady Zin is cousin to emperor. Doesn't help House Zin make generous endowments to Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If wasn't so desperate, would set you to explode.

localizedTextIdText: Kevo, Artemis Zin bodyguard and confidant, has asked you to help search for missing Collegium expedition members in the tar pits of Leviathan's Rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kevo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Several of the expedition members are still missing. Lady Zin has tasked me with finding them, but I will not leave her unprotected. Find them for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lady Zin will not be able to complete her research without her team. Find them in the tar pits and send them back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. The scientists you've rescued have made their way back. Preparations to resume the expedition are being made as we speak.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Little Miss will be disappointed if this expedition is a failure. Those scientists must be found.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can't wait to get started!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and saved a number of Lady Zin's research staff in Leviathan's Rest and sent them back to Kevo.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How did the scientists go missing?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: When we first landed in Leviathan's Rest, we were besieged by mobs of reanimated skeletons. Strange Eldan tech covered the frames of our attackers. Because this was to be primarily a scientific expedition, we did not bring sufficient forces to deal with such a threat. It was a fierce battle. The skeledroids managed to destroy the shuttle, and many were wounded. But we were victorious. I would die before I let a mere skeledroid injure my mistress!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: In the confusion, many fled before the onslaught of the skeledroids. They may be lost and in need of aid, for these tar pits are treacherous and the hostile creatures numerous. In Lady Zin's frequent dealings with the Collegium, I have found that scholars often lack crucial skills in other areas - such as common sense and the ability to wield a weapon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then you are useless to me. Begone.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has asked for your help in reactivating an Eldan construct in Leviathan's Rest. She think it may have something to do with the skeledroids.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Artemis Zin in Leviathan's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Look at this Eldan construct. I can't seem to get it to go, but I want to see what it does. Be a love and tinker with it, would you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm very curious what this Eldan construct will do. See if you can get it to work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: On the bright side, the construct didn't attack us. On the other hand, it reanimated those bones. Interesting! Very interesting.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't believe I'm saying this, but do be careful. I'm short on personnel as it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, but that's what makes it fun! Now I simply must learn more about these modifying constructs....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You activated the A37 Augmentor and watched as it reanimated a nearby bone pile, revealing itself as the source of the skeledroids in Levian's Rest. Fortunately, the Eldan construct overloaded before it could finish creating a skeledroid, destroying itself in the process.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why do you think it's connected to the skeledroids?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Do you think I got to where I am today by being wise? Nonsense! I believe this construct may have something to do with the skeledroid attacks. Only a theory, of course, but then again, I'm almost always right.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I don't know. That's the fun of it! Just in case, I should be prepared....
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Well, the skeletons that attacked us all had funny things attached all over them. Eldan-looking things. I've been seeing a few more of these constructs floating about the tar pits. They seem to be... doing something to the local fauna.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be such a baby. You're beginning to sound like Kevo. I'm fairly certain this will work.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin wants to learn more about the strange augmentor constructs. You can collect data cores from them in Leviathan's Rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If I'm going to learn more about these constructs, I'll need you to collect their data cores for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How many augmentor data cores have you collected? I will need to analyze them if I'm going to learn anything about these Eldan constructs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! I've already started analyzing the data from those cores. We should learn more in just a few short moments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I've never seen anything like this!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It appears the augmentors are being controlled from the very exo-lab we came to see!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected a number of augmentor data cores for Artemis Zin to study. By analyzing the augmentor cores, Artemis Zin has determined that the Eldan constructs are being controlled centrally from within the exo-lab beneath the tar pit swamp.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm not certain, but judging from the behavior we just witnessed, I'd say they're part of some kind of enhancement program. I've noticed other creatures in the area - living ones, I might add - that seem to carry the same modifications as the reanimated skeletons.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sorry, could you say that again? For a moment there, I thought you said no.

localizedTextIdText: To get inside the exo-lab controlling the augmentor constructs, Artemis Zin needs you to find its external access keys. Using your datachron, scan areas in Leviathan's Rest and locate the keys.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Artemis Zin in Leviathan's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To get inside the exo-lab, we'll need to find its external access keys. I've deciphered the first location and sent it to your datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The access keys were stored externally, but they've probably sunk into the muck by now. Use your datachron to scan for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The access keys were stored externally, but they've probably sunk into the muck by now. Use your datachron to scan for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I cannot wait to explore this new exo-lab. I fully intend to learn more of these strange augmentors and be the first to share it with the galaxy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: By now, I'm sure the access keys have sunk into the tar swamps, but I'm sure you'll manage... somehow.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now where is that Kevo? I think this expedition has been delayed quite long enough!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've located the access keys for the exo-lab in Leviathan's Rest. Now it's time to learn more about the mysterious augmentor constructs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did you just tell me no? I'm afraid I'm not familiar with that word.

localizedTextIdText: Conservationist Caius has instructed you to attack the Marauders at Grimvoid Landing and disable their communications relay. Once you've completed your assignment, report back to Conservationist Caius.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report back to Conservationist Caius via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I won't allow these poachers on the emperor's lands. Disable their comms. Then lay waste to everything in your path!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The poachers at Grimvoid Landing must be stopped! Lay waste to their camp. Teach them the dire consequences for stealing from the emperor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ari and I could hear the explosions from here, citizen. That brought a smile to my lips. There is one more thing you must do....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There'll be no escape for these criminals!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've delivered the Dominion's wrath to the Marauder poachers at Grimvoid Landing. In the process, you cheered Conservationist Caius up considerably.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you were with me on this! How could you desert me now?

localizedTextIdText: Conservationist Caius traced Lord Venator last transmission to Grimvoid Landing, indicating that Venator is working with the Marauders. You must find him and bring him to justice in the name of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Conservationist Caius at Owanee Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I went back and checked Venator's last comm signal. I found it had been broadcast from the Marauder camp! Find that traitor and bring him to justice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found Lord Venator? His last transmission came from Grimvoid Landing. Find him and bring him to justice!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Venator betrayed the trust of the emperor and consorted with space pirates. It is better that the Dominion has been wiped clean of his stain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Venator must have been working with the poachers from the beginning. A traitor, through and through!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fear not, citizen. My full report to the Collegium will mention you prominently.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought Lord Venator to justice. With his death, you've brought the poaching in Owanee Basin to an end.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You cannot let Venator walk free, not after what he's done!

localizedTextIdText: Plumclaw Prowler have been stealing provisions from Owanee Research Station. Biologist Ari wants to teach them a lesson, as well as testing his new prototype. Use his shock gun on the razortails and retrieve the stolen provisions.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Biologist Ari at Owanee Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Razortails steal provisions, poop on everything. Act like they own place. Test my new shock gun prototype on them. Teach them lesson.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: See Plumclaw razortails? Smelly, prowling, thieving razortails! Test shock gun on them! Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mmm, smells like fried razortail! Tasty! Returned provisions added bonus. Cozmotronic!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Would vaporize them, but Caius not let me. No fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Shock gun prototype still needs work. Instant death feature precludes pain and suffering.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tested Biologist Ari shock gun prototype on Plumclaw Prowler near Owanee Research Station.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then what good are you? Hold still. Maybe you make good weapons test subject.

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Laveka claims she has made an intriguing discovery in a nearby cave. She has asked that you meet her in Witchwake Cavern. She says she'll explain the details of her find later.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Cairnguard Drakuz via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've made an intriguing discovery in one of the nearby caves, but I cannot speak of it here. Will you meet me there?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Witchwake Cavern lies nearby. I'll meet you there. But watch yourself... the natives are restless.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you discovered the source of the disturbances in Endless Vigil?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ravok's Rage! A necroshaman? In Endless Vigil? I thought we'd hunted down every last one of them. This Laveka has signed her own death warrant.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You've impressed me. You know, $i(player.class) of your talents... I could do much with someone like you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And to think she was in league with the Moodies! Blasphemy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Apprentice Laveka has somehow gained the power to raise the dead. She lured you to Witchwake Cavern and attempted to turn you into her undead slave, but you defeated her reanimated servants. When you reported what happened to Cairnguard Drakuz, he was outraged to hear that a necroshaman was behind the disturbances in Endless Vigil.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Weren't you in Bloodfire Village? Where have you been?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Bloodshaman Akilos seems to think you are dangerous.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What are you doing in Endless Vigil?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, here and there. After the matter of that Moodie staff in Bloodfire Village, I felt it was time to cut ties to my old master Akilos and do a little... exploring on my own.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The bloodshamans fear anything they cannot control. I will not be bound by silly superstition! Do the Draken not live by strength? Why should I not seize power when I find it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Why, I'm paying my respects to my ancestors. After all, this is a very special place. There is much power in a place like this. And of course, I was also hoping to run into you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are such a fool.

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Laveka has betrayed you, revealing her complicity in the necromantic activities of the Moodies. Cairnguard Drakuz has asked that you rectify Laveka's crimes by destroying Witchwake Totem, killing Witchwake Necromancer, and laying risen Draken to rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Answer Apprentice Laveka comm call
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Laveka and her Moodies must be destroyed! Target the necromancers and destroy their totems! If they raise our dead against you, put them to rest.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you destroyed the Moodie necromancers and their totems? What of our dead? Have you brought them peace?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you really think you can challenge me? I have revived the Dark Rites! In this place of death, power courses through me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do you really think you've beaten me? Think again! You are little more than a minor annoyance. My ritual is nearly complete. You cannot stop me!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Necromancy is a violation of the Blood Covenants. All who practice it must be destroyed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ha! But I already have.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You won't get away with this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Witchwake Necromancer have been killed, and their Witchwake Totem have been destroyed. You've stopped their foul magic, at least for the time being. Despite this, Apprentice Laveka insists on challenging you further.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no honor? Such foul sorcery must be destroyed!

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Laveka has brought the legendary Draken clanlord Zhur back from the dead. She has challenged you to find her and face High Clanlord Zhur the Risen, if you can. Now is the time to bring Laveka's plans to a violent end.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Cairnguard Drakuz in Endless Vigil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My Moodies have retrieved the bones of none other than Clanlord Zhur! Soon, he will wake from his eternal slumber to serve me. Face him, if you dare!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Not so brave now, are we? Clanlord Zhur waits for you, if you can find your courage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By my burning blood, is it true? Laveka has raised High Clanlord Zhur? You must stop her at any cost, even if it means destroying Zhur's remains!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: For cleansing Endless Vigil of Laveka's foul sorceries, I thank you. The dark cloud has been lifted, and the dead can now rest in peace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once again, the necroshaman will rise!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is a pity Laveka did not meet her end at your hands. We will see her again, I fear.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have thwarted Apprentice Laveka plans and returned Clanlord Zhur to rest. You reported your success to Cairnguard Drakuz, who was grateful for all you've done to bring peace to the dead at Endless Vigil.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ignorant fool. I would think even you would have heard of the legendary last high clanlord of Mikros. Not since the Draken swore fealty to the Dominion has there been another who has held the title of high clanlord. Zhur was the last and the greatest.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Why? Because I can! For centuries, the Draken have forbidden the practice of the Dark Rites. But there is so much power in death... and undeath! Never again will I be shackled by laws for the weak and fearful. I revel in my freedom! And in your destruction!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have not the heart to face Zhur the Relentless!

localizedTextIdText: In order for Protostar to regain control over the Honeyworks, you must eliminate the now-enraged buzzbing population. Cut their numbers down to ensure the safety of Protostar's employees.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protostar Station Operator via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The buzzbings have grown rather irritated with us, given all this activity. Lend us a hand and get those buzzbings out of here! Kill them if you must!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What am I paying you for? Get back out to the Honeyworks and kill those buzzbings! Just make sure you leave enough buzzbings to produce honey later!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If I ever have another close call with a buzzbing, I may give up making money off of their honey... just kidding! I don't have any choice, you know.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's our honey now! They had their chance!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My associates will call if those buzzbings return.  You've been very cooperative.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They shouldn't bother you any longer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The buzzbing population around the Honeyworks has been cut significantly, but not enough to curtail their future production of honey.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Protostar Station Operator
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wouldn't dare!

localizedTextIdText: The Calmwater Pell collect rainwater, both to drink and to use in their rituals. Unfortunately, the Doomtide Pell have been seen tampering with the Commune's rain catchers. The Calmwater Cloud-Collector has asked you to inspect the rain catchers in the fields outside Calmwater Commune for tampering.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Calmwater Cloud-Collector via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We collect rain water to drink and for use in our rituals. The Doomtide have been skulking about our rain catchers. Go and ensure the water is still pure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our rain catchers contain the pure water of the sky. I fear the Doomtide Pell have tampered with them. Go and learn the truth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Tides of fury! Our rain catchers have been fouled with poison! Naught is sacred to the Doomtide! They must pay for this sacrilege!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Water from the sky, sent to us by the Masters, is sacred to us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The water within the Calmwater rain catchers has been poisoned by the Doomtide Pell. Calmwater Cloud-Collector, dismayed by this revelation, demands that the Doomtide Pell pay for this cowardly attack.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not balk now, outsider. You wish to prove yourself to us, yes?

localizedTextIdText: The remains of minebots, devastated by earth elementals, are scattered about Mozyk Quarry. Doodad has asked you to salvage operational components from these fallen bots and bring them to the Mozyk Aid Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Doodad at the Mozyk Aid Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This minebot has been devastated by one of the earth elementals that roams Mozyk Quarry. Perhaps someone could use his components.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This devastated minebot has no salvageable components. Perhaps other damaged minebots have useable parts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you located any additional components? I'm sure you can salvage some from devastated minebots in the quarry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The selection of salvaged components you've managed to accrue is impressive. Not only are these parts in good shape, but I need them badly.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for your help!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've delivered the salvaged components to Doodad at the Mozyk Aid Station.

localizedTextIdText: Two bots and a human female have been detected in Augment Facility X426. The Caretaker suggests that these captives may be different than the rest, and has asked you to save them from the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My scans have detected a familiar presence within this facility - a female human and two small constructs. You must free them from the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The human female and her constructs remain in the Ascendancy's custody. Is there a reason you have not yet freed them?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Belle Walker... yes, that name is familiar. I feel the ghost of a memory from my avatars in Galeras. Or was it Algoroc? Curious.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am certain one of my avatars has met this female before. Exercise caution.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: At least she was freed before the Soulcore could convert her.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find them and free them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to save Belle Walker and her trusty bots, Rusty and Bolt, from the Ascendancy in Augment Facility X426. Following your intervention, Belle appeared to be in great pain yet insisted she was fine. Hopefully she's alright.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find them and free them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Any idea who these guys might be?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My server connections with Galeras and Algoroc are badly severed, but from what I can access, my avatars in those areas have met them before.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I surmise you are making a mistake.

localizedTextIdText: You've been tasked with throwing jetpacks to Protostar employees who are mired in honey following the honey flood at the Protostar Honeyworks!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Did you see that honey flood? It tore through here, sweeping away all my staff! Throw these R-3000 jetpacks to them so they can escape!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How are those jetpacks working out? They'll lift those clones out of the honey and propel them safely... um... somewhere else!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I do hope I entered the landing coordinates properly for those jetpacks. Either way, our honey is now free of contaminants! Aside from all the dirt...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These jetpacks will propel my boys to safety!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, to begin bottling this honey. Where's my X500 auto siphon gotten to?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get these packs to them!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've rescued numerous Protostar employees from being permanently - and fatally - submerged in honey.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get these jetpacks to them!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We all make bad decisions now and again! Maybe you should reconsider!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You found a strange pile of junk that belongs to the Soulcore Ascendancy, but what is that putrid smell?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered a pile of discarded body parts left by the Ascendancy in Augment Facility X426. The sight and smell of the rotting flesh made you ill. The Ascendancy appears to store the leftover parts of people and animals like common office supplies. How revolting!

localizedTextIdText: You found a strange piece of data inside one of the Soulcore's X426 Probes. Destroy more X426 probes and collect additional X-D12 origin data, then locate a computer that will allow you to analyze it in Augment Facility X426.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Upload $(vitem=33) into the Nexonian Analyzation Unit in Augment Facility X426
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This strange piece of data came from one of the X426 probe constructs you destroyed. Perhaps you should gather more data and see if you can analyze it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Insufficient data. Please try again.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Data analysis commencing... analysis complete! Project 'Metal Maw Prime': Project unstable. Metal Maw Prime placed in stasis. Project locked.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I wonder what this data is?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You learned what the Eldan were experimenting on in Augment Facility X426. A top secret project, code named 'Metal Maw Prime,' was the facility's central focus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Upload $(vitem=33) into the Nexonian Analyzation Unit

localizedTextIdText: A mammodin known as Razorhorn has destroyed at least two supply trains in the Southern Owanee Basin. Conservationist Caius has posted a bounty on the beast and will handsomely reward anyone who can kill it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your bounty from Conservationist Caius at Owanee Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: Razorhorn Let it be known that a bounty has been placed on the mammodin known as Razorhorn. By order of Conservationist Caius
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED: Razorhorn Let it be known that a bounty has been placed on the mammodin known as Razorhorn. By order of Conservationist Caius
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You've decided to hunt Razorhorn, have you? The beast has decimated two supply trains so far. Be a smart citizen, and don't go at it alone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I don't like to see animals killed out of hand, but Razorhorn was a dangerous exception. Excellent work taking him down.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: How tough can a mammodin be?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully vanquished Conservationist Caius and claimed the bounty on the beast.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: How tough can a mammodin be?
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: How tough can a mammodin be?
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Collect your bounty from Conservationist Caius

localizedTextIdText: A creature named Razorhorn is responsible for the destruction of at least two supply trains in Southern Owanee Basin. Conservationist Caius has posted a bounty for whoever can kill the beast.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your bounty from Conservationist Caius in Owanee Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This massive horn was torn from the snout of Razorhorn, a particularly unruly mammodin responsible for much destruction in Deradune.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This massive horn was torn from the snout of Razorhorn, a particularly unruly mammodin responsible for much destruction in Deradune.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As much as I don't like to see animals killed out of hand, Razorhorn was a dangerous exception. Excellent work taking him down.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Someone might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully vanquished Razorhorn and received your reward from Conservationist Caius.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Someone might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Collect your bounty from Conservationist Caius

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered the local Moodies have been raiding the sacred boneyards of Endless Vigil. Cairnguard Drakuz was outraged to learn of the fact and has asked you to find the trespassing Moodies in Witchwake Ridge and kill them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report back to Cairnguard Drakuz via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WHAT? Moodies have been making off with bones from our sacred cairns? By Shezka's Blade, they will pay for this trespass with their lives!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How goes the slaughter against the Witchwake Moodies? Empty the caves of Witchwake Ridge of their foul presence!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All who dare to desecrate the sacred burial grounds of the Endless Vigil will meet the same fate as those wretched Moodies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find the foul creatures and make them pay! Make them suffer!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: On behalf of our dead, I thank you for avenging their honor.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Let's hope they learned their lesson.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Witchwake Ridge and slaughtered a great number of Moodies. Cairnguard Drakuz was satisfied to learn that the Moodie trespassers have been punished.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The dead cannot defend themselves. Will you not avenge them?

localizedTextIdText: You notice a hand sticking out of the tar in Leviathan's Rest. Whoever it is, they might still be alive and would probably appreciate a helping hand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Pull the hand's owner out of the tar in Leviathan's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a hand poking out from a large blob of tar with its fingers wiggling. Whoever's stuck in there seems to still be alive. Maybe they'd appreciate some help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The hand you found sticking out of the tar turned out to be an Aurin archaeologist who got stuck while nosing around. Despite being rescued by you, the Aurin attacked you on sight. Now that's gratitude for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Pull the hand's owner out of the tar

localizedTextIdText: Exile miners are trespassing on Clanlord Makaza lands. He wants you to meet up with Scout Malius near Jagged Rock Cove, so you can help drive the Exiles out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Scout Malius at his hideout near Jagged Rock Cove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My scout, Malius, has learned that Exile miners are trespassing on my lands. Seek him out and offer your aid. He keeps watch near Jagged Rock Cove.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Malius is waiting for you near Jagged Rock Cove. Once you meet with him, the slaughter can begin!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hail, $(player.class). I've heard a lot about you. You should know by now that Makaza has a special task in store for us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Malius reports the Exile miners have hired a Granok free company to protect them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Jagged Rock Cove where you found Scout Malius. Together, you will prepare to launch an assault against the Exiles in the area.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about these Exiles.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you know about this Granok free company?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How do you know Mercenary Arkos again?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Those cowardly Exiles think they can sneak upon my lands and strip away its riches! They come to mine the accelerite in Jagged Rock Cove. They've even hired a Granok free company to protect them while they act as thieves!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The ICI agents stationed in Bloodfire Village inform me the leader of the Granok free company is none other than my old enemy, Arkos. There is a history between that Granok mercenary and me, wounds of old battles that still ache when the savannah winds blow cold.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We have fought many times. When he was nothing but a space merc for hire, I led the Dominion patrol that hunted him and his crew to the far reaches of the Fringe. Each time, he eluded my grasp! However, now he is on my land. This time, I dictate the rules!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You do not refuse a clanlord. Perhaps removing your head will remind you who you serve.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Assistant Manager was on duty when the Prime Cubig disappeared. The Production Facility Manager suggests you travel out to the Cubig Farms and speak to him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find the Protostar Assistant Manager at the east end of the Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My former manager - demoted several cycles ago - was overseeing the Prime Cubig prior to these events. Talk to him and find out what happened.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you find the Assistant Manager? Don't waste time! It's inefficient!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Prime Cubig was here, sure enough, but it's escaped. I'm not authorized to use the equipment necessary to track and retrieve it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He's somewhere out on the Cubig Farms, probably preparing for his next demotion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What? From you? You can't fire me! You're not even an employee!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've found the Protostar Assistant Manager. He claims he isn't authorized to use the equipment required to track down and recover the Prime Cubig.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am uncertain. Should I berate you or beg you?

localizedTextIdText: The Prime Executive has requested you report to Profitorium 9 and check on the Interspecies Relations Liaison who was sent to improve commerce with the Ikthians of Silverscale Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Interspecies Relations Liaison at Profitorium 9
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ikthian-derived profits are low. They damage our clones and hardly buy our products. I sent a liaison to boost efficiency. You'll report to him now.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken with the relations liaison at Profitorium 9, near Silverscale Station? Sales targeting the Ikthians remain depressingly low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My campaign failed. Prominent individuals acquired this post for research. Now I maintain relations... between those two. Talk about a lost cause.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He's late filing his reports. So if you find him alive, be sure to fire him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's my job to ensure they don't kill each other before reaching their goals.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the Interspecies Relations Liaison at the destroyed Profitorium 9 and learned that his efforts to foster profitable relations with the Ikthians was an abject failure.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Interspecies Relations Liaison
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I think you know better than to refuse a task, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: The Prime Executive has requested you report to Profitorium 9 and check on the Interspecies Relations Liaison who was sent to improve commerce with the Ikthians of Silverscale Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Interspecies Relations Liaison at Profitorium 9
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ikthian-derived profits are low. They damage our clones and hardly buy our products. I sent a liaison to boost efficiency. You'll report to him now.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken with the relations liaison at Profitorium 9, near Silverscale Station? Sales targeting the Ikthians remain depressingly low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My campaign failed. Prominent individuals acquired this post for research. Now I maintain relations... between those two. Talk about a lost cause.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He's late filing his reports. So if you find him alive, be sure to fire him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's my job to ensure they don't kill each other before reaching their goals.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the Interspecies Relations Liaison at the destroyed Profitorium 9 and learned that his efforts to foster profitable relations with the Ikthians was an abject failure.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Interspecies Relations Liaison
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I think you know better than to refuse a task, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: After your defeat of Purifier Landes, High Priest Rain-Caller received a distress call coming from Augment Facility X426. The call originates from a source not heard from for some time. High Priest Rain-Caller has requested you investigate the source of this distress call.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find the source of the distress call in Augment Facility X426
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A voice, not heard in ages, comes from the Masters' fortress! The Ascendancy covets their power. Go at once and lend your aid, for the Masters have spoken!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The outsiders are deaf to the voice of the Masters. They seek to steal the Masters' power for their own ends. Go and ensure they do not succeed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Re-calculating probability of immediate assistance...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Power structure compromised. Augment Facility X426 now operating below minimum threshold.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Drive the outsiders from the Masters' fortress!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Calculations pinpoint the probability of a catastrophic outcome at 67.9%.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The distress call ultimately led you to the Caretaker of Augment Facility X426. Ascendancy forces have recently taken control of the facility, and the Caretaker has been cut off from several of the installation's key areas.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll go speak to the Masters.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Find the source of the distress call
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The voice of the Makers said you would come. They did not say you would serve.

localizedTextIdText: You notice a hand sticking out of the tar in Leviathan's Rest. Its owner is obviously dead, but you'll never know the owner's identity unless you pull out that hand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Pull the corpse from the tar in Leviathan's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This hand, poking out from a large blob of tar, is lifeless. Perhaps it would be the decent thing to see who it is.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The dead hand you found sticking out of the tar in Leviathan's Rest turned out to be attached to a very old body in an advanced state of decay. Along with the body, you recovered a tablet that contains a journal entry.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Pull the corpse from the tar

localizedTextIdText: Before any Dominion citizen can become involved in Protostar company business at the Cubig Farms, the Production Facility Manager demands that the citizen should submit a copy of Form 82-J9V for approval.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Production Facility Manager at the Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While Protostar appreciates the governor's concern, I cannot allow you to become involved unless you complete and submit Form 82-J9V.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not turn in Form 82-J9V until it has been completed. The form to appeal a rejected 82-J9V is twice as long!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What? A completed Form 82-9JV? Impossible! Err... I mean... that's astounding! Properly annotated, too. How... lucky... for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Impossible. Here is the requisite form. I wish you the best of luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If the Dominion insists, then I can find a use for such a talented employee.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your successful completion of Form 82-J9V, you've been accepted by Protostar as an authorized agent of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Form 82-J9V indemnifies Protostar of all culpability should you be injured or, Phineas forbid, killed in the pursuit of your goals.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you will not complete an 82-J9V form, I cannot allow you to assist me.

localizedTextIdText: You entered Exo-Lab A37, only to find everything offline. As the holder of the access keys, you'll need to speak with the exo-lab hologram known as the Caretaker before he can assist Artemis Zin with her inquiries.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in Exo-Lab A37
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been speaking with the Caretaker. He needs the access keys you found topside before he can help. Toddle on over and have a chat, would you?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak with the Caretaker. Apparently, he needs the access keys you're holding for authorization, or some such nonsense.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sorry, I am unable to process your request. Please insert your access keys to initiate authorization.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Access keys accepted. Authorization...complete. Hello, I am the Caretaker. How may I assist you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: From what I could gather, this exo-lab is in a bit of a sorry state.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I regret to inform you that parts of this facility have been damaged by tar seepage. Please excuse the mess.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with the Caretaker, who accepted your access keys. He informed you that Exo-Lab A37 has been damaged by seepage from the tar pits above, so it might not be fully functional.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, that's what he seems to call himself. Pleasant enough AI, for all his unwillingness to help. He insisted that he could only answer my questions once proper authorizations had been made.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How do you expect me to explore if we can't access the other areas of this exo-lab?

localizedTextIdText: A race of primitive creatures called the Skeech have overrun Engineering Sublevel Theta in Star-Comm Station. You'll have to fight your way through them to retrieve the Cassian access key, which Artemis Zin will need to access the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To access the Elder Cube, you'll require a proper access key. Unfortunately, the sublevel the key is stored on is infested with Skeech.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Cassian access key is on Engineering Sublevel Theta, as well as a great deal of Skeech.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The key fragments you retrieved from the Skeech should be sufficient for me to replicate a new key.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then proceed to Engineering Sublevel Theta to retrieve the access key.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Replication protocols are being initiated. Please stand by.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared a path through the Skeech invaders in Engineering Sublevel Theta and successfully retrieved the Eldan access key for Artemis Zin.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you mean by "a proper access key"?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Access keys are attuned to particular species. To access the Elder Cube, Artemis Zin will require a key that's attuned to the Cassian primal pattern.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: My masters created the Skeech to serve as household pets. They proved to be little more than annoying vermin, and the experiment was abandoned.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: That is affirmative. Had the creatures been exterminated, as per my recommendation, we would not be having this conversation right now. Now please be off on your task.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without the access key, your superior cannot access the Elder Cube.

localizedTextIdText: Skeech have overrun Engineering Sublevel Theta in Star-Comm Station, and their infestation is causing massive structural issues. The Caretaker has asked that you collapse the Skeech burrows and eliminate as many as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Skeech burrows have caused severe instability in the structure of Level Three. Collapse the burrows and destroy any Skeech you encounter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you're going to repair Level Three, you'll have to destroy the Skeech infestation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Repair constructs are being deployed as I speak to address the damage done by the Skeech.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Skeech may be diminutive, but they're dangerous in numbers. Be wary.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have done well, but your labors are not yet complete.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have eliminated most of the Skeech threat on Engineering Sublevel Theta inside Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can't you send constructs to kill the Skeech?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: At present, all security constructs are undergoing maintenance and refit. I am afraid you are the only viable weapon in my proverbial arsenal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You refuse? Artemis Zin will not be pleased.

localizedTextIdText: Analyst Spector in the Elder Vault should be quite interested in the Eldan AI Core you removed from the strange construct.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Eldan AI Core to Analyst Spector in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Analyst Spector will be very interested in the Eldan AI core you removed from the strange Eldan construct.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: An Eldan AI core! I have never seen one of these first-hand. You were wise to bring it to me. I will study it once I have returned to my lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am satisfied with your initiative, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should take this to Analyst Spector.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Eldan Augmentor in Levian Bay and brought its AI core to Analyst Spector in the Elder Vault for future study.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Eldan AI Core to Analyst Spector

localizedTextIdText: An Exploration Society expedition was attacked by malverines while surveying the Howling Hills. Explorer Vectra, the only survivor, has asked you to eliminate the malverines.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Vectra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My team was attacked by a large number of vicious beasts as we surveyed this area. My desire is that you find these beasts and destroy them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The creatures are feral, brutish, and quite dangerous. I recommend you exhibit caution when executing them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have made the beasts pay in blood for their hostility. Excellent.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I fear damage to my locomotive systems prevents me from assisting you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully reduced the threat of malverines on the Howling Hills.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My internal databanks indicate they are a species of malverine. However, malverines are not supposed to be indigenous to Auroria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are making a mistake. An astronomical one.

localizedTextIdText: An Exploration Society expedition was attacked by malverines while surveying the Howling Hills. Explorer Vectra, the only survivor, has asked you to locate her missing survey data.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Vectra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The datachron containing my team's survey data was lost as we fled from our camp. One of my dead team members probably has it. It must be recovered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My team was cut down as they fled from our camp, up the hill.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: None of the dead surveyors have the data? This is quite disappointing. Perhaps you will find it somewhere else, somewhere... unlooked-for.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we cannot find the data, my team's destruction will have been for nothing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were unable to locate the missing survey information for Explorer Vectra in Howling Hills.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The recovery of this data is required.

localizedTextIdText: None of the Fallen Surveyor possessed the datachron containing survey data. Explorer Vectra suspects it may still be in the Exploration Society camp at the far end of the Howling Hills.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Explorer Vectra in Howling Hills
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It is possible the datachron was left in our camp. Either that, or one of the beasts found and took the device.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head up the hill. Do not stop until you find the datachron. It must be here somewhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A malverine devoured the datachron? How fortunate you were able to recover it. Once I am suitably repaired, I will transmit the data back to base.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I find the latter to be unlikely. Proceed north and search my team's campsite.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My superiors will hear about your assistance in these matters.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the datachron that contained the survey data... in the belly of a massive malverine called Bloodhowler. Luckily, the datachron hasn't been digested yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you begging for destruction?

localizedTextIdText: Kevo has asked you to check on Artemis Zin. She should be somewhere near the destroyed shuttle in Leviathan's Rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Artemis Zin in Leviathan's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It would serve me well if you checked on Lady Zin. I've been overseeing recovery of the expedition, but I have not seen her in a while. That concerns me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you seen Lady Zin yet? I am always uneasy when she goes missing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can't you see I'm busy? Go find Kevo or something.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did Kevo send you? That dear fellow worries far too much. I'm more than capable of fending for myself. Now if you don't mind, I could use an extra pair of hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Knowing the little miss, she's probably off somewhere spitting in the face of danger.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I think I'm on to something! Something to do with those skeledroids....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Artemis Zin, safe and sound, tinkering with some kind of Eldan construct.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: He told me to find you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: I'm surprised you aren't with Artemis.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How is Artemis taking this setback?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I was at first, but she gave me a direct order to stay here and "get the show on the road," as she put it. I cannot disobey a direct order from my mistress, but I can send you to watch over her in my stead.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Little Miss has the fiery spirit of House Zin. It would take more than skeletons rising from the tar swamps to stop her. Despite the dangers we just survived, she is already eager to be exploring.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You leave me few options, $(player.class).

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Purification Lead has asked you to collect samples of ultra-rare "Necrohive Honey" for processing back at the Protostar pumping stations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Protostar Purification Lead at Pumping Station A-22
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: By Phineas T. Rotostar! Do you realize what you've found? A necrohive! Their honey possesses a truly exquisite flavor! Can you collect some for us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Necrohive honey is the best honey you can find. I mean... it's the best, hands down! Bring me as much as you can, and I'll reward you handsomely!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My my! This will be our most exquisite honey flavor yet! Protostar's Necrohive Honey! Now with Necro-Yum!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Collect as much as you can! I will ensure it is well worth your while!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And it's aged to just the right state! A truly wondrous find!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully collected more than enough Necrohive Honey for the Protostar Purification Lead back at the Protostar pumping stations.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Protostar Purification Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How about if I pay you slightly more than I originally intended to pay?

localizedTextIdText: You discovered a Protostar Records & Archives Overseer in the midst of a number of buzzbings. Afraid for his job, he's asked you to report to the Production Facility Manager on his behalf.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Production Facility Manager at the Protostar Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My boss can't think this was due to an error on my part. Oh, I know! Tell him the buzzbings made me do it! The punishment will be less severe that way!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Tell my manager anything! As long as he doesn't think I screwed up, I can keep my boring, menial, and unfulfilling job!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So that's where the missing cache disappeared! It's good to know it was due to a natural act, instead of something really serious, like a missing form.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You should also tell him I was stung... if he wants details, that is.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Despite his lack of ineptitude, Employee 2543-2A will still be terminated.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess that's good to hear.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've reported the Records & Archives Overseer location and circumstances to the Production Facility Manager.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't do this by myself! I'm not capable of independent thought!

localizedTextIdText: You have been tasked with shutting down the emergency pressure valve at Honeyworks Station B-34. You'd better get to work!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Honeyworks Refinement Lead via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We didn't pay for the thick-walled piping, so these pipes have burst with the pressure! An emergency valve is just across the way. Shut it off!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Honey is spraying everywhere! Get that valve shut before we drown in this sticky mess! And watch out for the buzzbing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Taxes and tariffs! Look at this mess! Who's going to clean this up? And then who's going to bottle it up and slap a price tag on it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There was quite a sizeable buzzbing over there earlier today...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm calling in sick tomorrow...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully shut down Station B-34's pumping operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Honeyworks Refinement Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can't you see we're desperate? Desperate, I say!

localizedTextIdText: You have been tasked with shutting down the emergency pressure valve at Honeyworks Station C-19. There's no time to waste!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The pipes! Honey spewing everywhere! Which means our money is spewing everywhere! Get to the emergency shut-off valves and turn those things off!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is money! Don't waste my time! Or my money! Just shut of the valves so we don't waste any more honey! Why are you laughing? This isn't funny!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was close! I feared we'd be up to our craniums in honey! It's a terrible medium to drown in, don't you know? Simply terrible!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The local wildlife has taken notice of our... delicious... incident.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Uh oh... I think I dropped the transport ship keys into the honey...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully shut down Station C-19's pumping operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you need time to rethink your answer?

localizedTextIdText: You have been tasked with shutting down the emergency pressure valve at Honeyworks Station D-7. Don't just stand there!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Honeyworks Packaging Lead via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My manager is going to have my head! These pipes have hit their maximum capacity! Find the emergency shut off valve before we drown!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hurry! You must shut down these pumping stations!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your efforts are appreciated. Do you think the consumers will notice a little bit of dirt in the honey?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful with that honey! I'm printing the price tags for it as we speak!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I need a vacation. Unfortunately, my PTO is all used up.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You better be glad I happened by.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully shut down Station D-7's pumping operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Honeyworks Packaging Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am so glad you came along when you... wait, what do you mean, no?

localizedTextIdText: The Honeyworks Extraction Lead has asked you to assist one of his employees. The unfortunate clone was attacked by buzzbings and is now stranded in the Protostar Honeyworks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Honeyworks Extraction Lead via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: No! I can see the honey shipment from here! Get down there and help that buffoon. Make sure those buzzbings don't steal any of that honey!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't waste time by speaking to me! You better understand that you are behind schedule! Now get down there and help that idiot!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Prosperity knocks! Wondrous work out there. I'm so glad the honey is safe! Oh... and I'm so glad our fellow employee is in good health, as well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sooner is better than later! Obviously!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Today has been a fine day for Protostar!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've rescued the stranded Protostar employee and saved what remained of his honey shipment.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Honeyworks Extraction Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Good help is so hard to find these days.

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has put out a call for new crafters to show their basic proficiency with Outfitting in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here. We're lookin' to mass-produce some Medium Armor. Any of you pioneers gotten up to scratch yet?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here. We're lookin' to mass-produce some Medium Armor. Any of you pioneers gotten up to scratch yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Somethin' you need?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah. this here's pretty good. I like to see you new folk takin' initiative! I'll hand these off. Nice work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done good work, $(player.name). You got my respect.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe seemed pleased with the pieces you gave him for evaluation and praised your mastery of the basics of Outfitting.
