localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the armor pieces to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Gallow have been under attack, and the militia is in dire need of Medium Armor. Acquire some and deliver it to the Logistics Officer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to the FCON Logistics Officer in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate Medium Armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate Medium Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's the word?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, it's about time! I'll get these shipped to the militia pronto! I owe ya one, pal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll get ya back for this. Promise.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This looks like a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Logistics Officer was grateful for your delivery of Medium Armor to aid in their war efforts and gave you rare praise for your efforts.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to the Gallow Logistics Officer

localizedTextIdText: Supply Officer Alcede at Leviathan's Rest is trying to recover supplies that were lost in the skeledroid attack. He wants you to hunt down Oozing Sludgeon and retrieve the supplies swallowed by the creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Supply Officer Alcede via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sludgeons made off with our supplies during the fighting. Need someone to fetch them back, I do. Mind hunting down those beasties for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you recovered any of our supplies from the sludgeons yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great work getting those supplies back from the sludgeons. They're a bit disgusting, after sitting in sludgeon's gullet, but that's still better than nothing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks, guv. We really need 'em. Lost a fair amount when the skeledroids destroyed our shuttle, we did.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll be sure Lady Zin hears of this. You have my sincerest thanks, guv!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected several $m(vitem=51) from Oozing Sludgeon on behalf of Supply Officer Alcede.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not much of a team player, are you?

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver the requested Medium Armor order to Outfitter Keynes in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering Medium Armor to Outfitter Keynes in Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You seen my contract?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey hey, glad you filled that there contract! I'll get these out to the front lines in an insta-jiffy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I reckon you done right by us today, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Outfitter Keynes was glad to see you succeeded in her contract order of Medium Armor. Your gear will help the Free Companies in their fight for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the Medium Armor to Outfitter Keynes

localizedTextIdText: The Aurin of Hivestrike Grove have erected several primal lodestones, which they use to fuel their magical abilities. Mondo Zax wants the lodestones destroyed. Go into the Grove, find the lodestones, and mark them for artillery strikes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Aurin draw power from primal lodestones. Change ecology, enhance nature. You go, mark lodestones, call in artillery strikes, dislodge Aurin. Simple.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sensors reveal lodestones still active. In turn, sensors reveal you wasting time. Hurry! Mark stones for destruction!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good, good! Lodestones in pieces! Aurin sad now. Cry big tears. Soon we make them even sadder!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Is first step to removing tree slanks from grove. Understand? Now go!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You marked the three primal lodestones in Hivestrike Grove, thus allowing Dominion artillery to destroy them and paving the way for the complete removal of Aurin parasites from Auroria.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Scouts find new plant growth. Suspect Aurin meddling. Mondo is premier expert on destroying Aurin, so Mondo get job to investigate personally.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Mondo designed Planet Reapers for Dominion. Planet Reapers turn Arboria into parking lot. See? Mondo is expert!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mondo will peel skin from your skull like kitho fruit. He will enjoy!

localizedTextIdText: The skeledroid attack was a result of a malfunction in the security core. The Caretaker has asked you to use the teleporter to travel to the security level of Exo-Lab A37 and sync his program with the Security Avatar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in Exo-Lab A37
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm afraid the skeledroid phenomenon is caused by a malfunction in the security core. Deactivation requires synchronization with the Security Avatar.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I cannot guarantee the safety of your expedition members until you travel to the security level of this exo-lab and sync the Security Avatar there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I cannot guarantee the safety of your expedition members until you travel to the security level of this exo-lab and sync with the Security Avatar there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Synchronization with Security Avatar has been confirmed. Though existing skeledroids remain hostile, augmentation protocol adjustments are now complete.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Until you do so, another skeledroid attack may be imminent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Please note: augmentors that return here will have their programs updated.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully synchronized the Caretaker with the security program. Any augmentor who returns to the exo-lab will have its code updated and will no longer be able to reanimate skeletons in Leviathan's Rest.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What were those constructs we saw up there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Those are augmentors. They are constructs designed by the Eldan to perform augmentation on creatures. A malfunction in the security core has caused them to erroneously apply the augmentation process to non-living creatures as well. A simple calibration should resolve the issue.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Augmentation is the purpose of Exo-Lab A37. The augmentors are programmed to roam the surrounding area, analyze organic life, and make the necessary structural modifications to improve the original creature.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It is a shard of my program, but with only a fraction of my awareness, as well as my virtual good looks. Alas, it is a distinct entity from me and can only be made to understand the situation by syncing its program with mine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aggressive augmentation protocols will remain active until synchronization is complete.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker is unable to produce Exo-Lab A37's files on augmentation. Its memory core has fragmented. The virtual program has asked you to travel to the information station in Exo-Lab A37 to collect its memory core fragments and sync them with the Information Avatar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker inExo-Lab A37
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lady Zin has requested access to files on Eldan augmentation. Unfortunately, my memory core has fragmented. If you gathered the pieces and synced them, however....
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I cannot produce the data on augmentation until my memory core is restored. You can do so by collecting memory core fragments in the information level and syncing them with the avatar there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I cannot produce the data on augmentation until my memory core is restored. You can do so by collecting memory core fragments in the information level and syncing them with the avatar there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Information Avatar has been synchronized with restored memory core. Access to A37 augmentation files now possible.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm afraid my memories, like this exo-lab, are not what they once were.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You restored the Caretaker's memory core and synced him with the Information Avatar. He is now able to access the files on augmentation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: As you wish. Whether Lady Zin obtains the files she requested is irrelevant to me.

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Gallow has asked you to craft Light Armor to gauge your understanding of tailoring.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe transmitting. Been practicin' yer sewing, pioneers? I've got a simple task to test yer skills!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe transmitting. Been practicin' yer sewing, pioneers? I've got a simple task to test yer skills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How can I help ya?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, well, let's have a look! That's some mighty fine sewing you've done there. I'm lookin' forward to seein' you get better!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ain't enough dedicated folks like you, friend.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I can handle this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You accomplished Crafting Trainer Thorpe's request to show your basic grasp of tailoring. He was impressed with the sample you gave him.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Light Armor pieces to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The supply line for Exile forces in Gallow is hampered by local aggressors, and the militia is in dire need of armor. Acquire some Light Armor and deliver it to the Logistics Officer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your supplies to the FCON logistics officer in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Dire equipment shortages expected. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate Light Armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Dire equipment shortages expected. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate Light Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya need somethin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, look who's got some stones! I'll get these shipped to the militia pronto! I owe ya one, pal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We owe you one, $(player.class)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've resupplied the local militia with Light Armor, and the Logistics Officer was more than happy to take your craftwork off your hands.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your supplies to the Gallow Logistics Officer

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh, I hope someone fulfills my contract!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, wow! I'm so glad to see you. And look what you did for me! I can't tell you how grateful we are for all your hard work!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep on crafting and keep on helping everyone!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This has my name all over it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've delivered Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring in Gallow, who was more than grateful to have your help.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Vectra, a member of the Exploration Society, has contacted you. Her team has been attacked and is retreating to the base of the Howling Hills. Triangulate on her signal and lend her your expertise.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Explorer Vectra at the Howling Hills
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To anyone within range of my signal, the Exploration Society requires assistance. We have been attacked... repeat... the Exploration Society requires assistance...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are too late. It is nearly over... yet there are some matters remaining that you might attend to on my behalf.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We are retreating to the base of the Howling Hills. Do not waste a moment!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have sustained damage, but it is irrelevant to my current objectives.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Explorer Vectra, but it was too late to help her team.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Should I survive this, you will find me a tenacious enemy.

localizedTextIdText: Station B-34 has more than just problems with ruptured pipes! The nearby buzzbing hive is home to the Honeyhive Queen! She's been terrorizing the Honeyworks' employees for some time, and the Honeyworks Refinement Lead wants you to eliminate her!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Honeyworks Refinement Lead via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Honeyhive Queen continues to pose a significant threat to my employees! I'm authorizing you to terminate her highness with extreme prejudice!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is the queen dead? Is there honey in her hive? Don't keep me in suspense! I simply must know!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Time is money, and with the Queen dead, we suddenly have a lot more time available. Hence, we're all rich!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you survive, take some honey samples!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we need to breed a new queen. It's a small price to pay, I guess!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have killed the Honeyhive Queen. Work can now resume at Honeyworks Station B-34!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Honeyworks Refinement Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Shall I rephrase the question with a harsher tone? Or must I beg?

localizedTextIdText: The Aquatic Affairs Worker is stranded atop his malfunctioning Aquatic Collector, and he's surrounded by ravenous Protostar Brand Thresher. Help him by collecting faulty parts and returning them to the Production Facility Manager at the Protostar Cubig Farms.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Production Facility Manager at the Protostar Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My productivity has been reduced to zero due to this Aquatic Collector's malfunction! Please assist me by taking the faulty parts to headquarters.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The faulty parts need to be collected and taken to headquarters, or I'll be stuck out here for another week!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Of course I'm aware of the malfunctioning aquatic collector. If I had some of the faulty parts, I'd know which ones to requisition for replacement.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, thank you. We'll get that collector up and running right away. If the budget permits, we'll rescue that employee, as well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch out for the threshers! They're engineered to be quite hostile!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: He's been missing for two weeks already. I doubt another day or two will hurt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned the faulty parts to the Production Facility Manager, who says he will send someone to rescue the stranded Aquatic Affairs Worker if it fits within his current budget.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I really do not appreciate your lack of empathy for my predicament.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has commanded you to kill Matria Segrey in Hivestrike Grove and retrieve the $(vitem=56). Once you have the $(vitem=56), locate the Orbital Targeting Computer and enter the codes to destroy Matria Segrey hivefort.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion firing codes lost. Gave to Assistant Wrizz, but he deceased. Aurin matria has codes now. Kill her, take codes, then blow everything up. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you here? Targeting computer up there in Hivestrike Grove. Get codes. Blow up Aurin. Very easy to accomplish for anyone, but maybe not for you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Matria dead. New hivefort destroyed. Trees on fire. Mondo think Aurin savages very sad now. Maybe Mondo squeeze out a tear. Or maybe not.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hypothesis: Plan is simple enough for any moron. You will test that hypothesis.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Matria Segrey and entered the $(vitem=56) to call an orbital strike on her hivefort. Mondo Zax really enjoyed the fireworks display.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Affirmative! Codes authorize use of artillery in Fort Glory! Turn entire grove into smoking tangle of trees and body parts. You must recover codes!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(player.name) not very bright.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion is fed up with Protostar's incompetence in managing mining activity in Mozyk Quarry. Tandus Valeris has instructed you to find several Protostar employees at the quarry and relieve them of their duties.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tandus Valeris via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar has lost control of their mining operations. The Governor is, understandably, upset. Proceed to Mozyk Quarry at once and terminate their contract.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mozyk Quarry is not far from the Protostar cubig farms. Fire all the Protostar employees. Their incompetence is an outrage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hope you took some degree of pleasure in terminating the employment of those... those... clones. I know I would have.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You must get things up and running for the Dominion. Do not fail.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now... it's time to get that quarry up and running again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that Protostar's employees are no longer running things at Mozyk Quarry, it's up to you to fix the problems that have cropped up there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not an optional duty, citizen.

localizedTextIdText: Tandus Valeris suggests that you work with the Freebots that are now running the mining operation. He indicates that Preceptor Alpha should be your point of contact with the Freebots in Mozyk Quarry.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Preceptor Alpha in Mozyk Quarry
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These so-called "Freebots" are familiar with mining operations in the quarry. I suggest you contact them and see if they can be of assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to Preceptor Alpha yet? See what that bot can do to assist you. The mine won't run itself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am known as Alpha. My neural cores overloaded with joy when I witnessed your exacting methods of dealing with Protostar's employees!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Files indicate that Preceptor Alpha is your best point of contact.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is much to do before this mine is operating at maximum efficiency.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We need to get this mine running.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After speaking with Preceptor Alpha about the state of the mining operation in Mozyk Quarry, you've both decided to work together to solve your mutual problems.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't tell a Cassian "no."

localizedTextIdText: Protostar's plan to offer housing on Nexus sounds dangerous, but it's your big chance to claim a piece of the world for your very own. If you intend to put down roots, you'd better speak to the Protostar Housing Specialist in Deradune or Ellevar as soon as you can!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist in Deradune or Ellevar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Participate in Protostar's innovative housing plan and own a piece of Nexus! The benefits of home ownership far outweigh the risks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Step right up! Protostar has the plot of land you've been waiting for, so long as you don't mind using a little elbow grease to make it livable!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist today and claim your very own slice of heaven!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Interact with the handy Housing Model to teleport to your new plot of land!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken with a Protostar Housing Specialist about your claim to land on (or, at least, above) Nexus. To pay your new slice of heaven a visit, please use Protostar's teleporter technology by activating the holographic housing model near the Protostar Housing Specialist.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist

localizedTextIdText: You found Assistant Frezemi Wrizz corpse in Hivestrike Grove, the victim of the Aurin and their minions. Wrizz's orders were to sabotage Aurin munitions crates. Given his untimely demise, perhaps you can complete his mission for Mondo Zax.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is the body of Frezemi Wrizz, Mondo Zax's unfortunate assistant. His orders say he was to plant explosive charges in Aurin munitions crates.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Frezemi Wrizz did his best, but it wasn't good enough. It's more than likely he won't be remembered by anyone, not even by Mondo Zax.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Aurin munitions destroyed yet? No? Pity if you end up like Assistant Wrizz....
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Loud explosions like music to ears! Secondary detonations even more pleasant! You make Mondo so proud!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll pick up where he left off.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed a number of Aurin munitions crates in Hivestrike Grove. Though Mondo Zax didn't seem distressed by Wrizz's death, he was pleased that you took the initiative to complete his mission.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll pick up where he left off.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The dead Chua's glazed eyes stare at you accusingly.

localizedTextIdText: The Honeyworks Refinement Lead at Station B-34 has heard about you shutting down Station A-22s emergency valve. Unsurprisingly, he also needs assistance with his own station's operations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Honeyworks Refinement Lead at Station B-34
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With each lost honey drop, I lose thousands! I hear you stopped the overflow at Station A-22? Get over here now, because I need your help here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I don't think the manager will be overly pleased with our current situation. Since you're here now, let's see if we can turn things around!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please do hurry, even if I'm not approved to pay extra for promptness!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have heeded the call of Station B-34s Lead in his time of need. Hopefully he can offer your prompt and profitable payment for your continue assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Honeyworks Refinement Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you like me to pose that question again?

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Thayd lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take your Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for armor crafted from locally available silk to support the war against the Dominion. Bring armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for light armor to support the war against the Dominion. Bring armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you'd like to lend a hand, we sure could use your Light Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is some top-notch work. It'll make some fine arcane armor. You're quite the tailor, ain't ya?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We really appreciate the help!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee has accepted the Light Armor you crafted in support of the Exiles' war effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take your Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills has put out a call for help in relieving the Exile supply shortage in Galeras. Aid the relief effort by crafting some Light Armor for Exile forces here in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Light Armor to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Shortage of armor reported! Exile tailors should donate Light Armor to support the war in Galeras. Please contact Coordinator Mills!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Shortage of armor reported! Exile tailors should donate light armor to support the war in Galeras. Please contact Coordinator Mills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We really need Light Armor for our fighters. It's not like we can send 'em out there naked!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: More light silk, eh? This'll help...a lot. You don't know what it means to the boys and girls on the front lines!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Couldn't have done it without ya, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some Light Armor for the Exile forces in Thayd and helped with the ongoing relief effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take Light Armor to Coordinator Mills

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade is offering a contract that will aid in fending off the Dominion. Help the war effort by crafting Light Armor for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivering it to Tailor Wildspring in Thayd!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft Light Armor and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft light armor and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we don't get some light armor soon, a lot of people are going to die.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look here! More light armor, and it's well-made, too. This'll save a lot of lives, make no mistake!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you so much! I'll never forget this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some Light Armor for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivered it to Tailor Wildspring.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring

localizedTextIdText: The Ikthians have been abducting Protostar employees at the Protostar Housing Initiative and must be stopped! The Prime Executive in Prosperity Junction has asked you to deal with them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Prime Executive via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Efficient violence is called for. The Ikthians are lowering our profit margins and must be stopped! You are authorized to use deadly force!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Protostar Corporation doesn't always condone violence, but when we do, we make it cost-effective! Now get out there and kill those Ikthians.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Ikthians seem to be out of the equation. I predict we'll be back on schedule any month now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now get out there and kill them... for Protostar!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm always happy to help... for money!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Ikthians were abducting Protostar employees at the Protostar Housing Initiative and the Prime Executive in Prosperity Junction asked you to deal with them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you certain? Perhaps I can offer you a 1% discount on future purchases?

localizedTextIdText: The Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead at Honeyworks Station C-19 has heard of your great deeds and also needs assistance with his station's valves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead at Honeyworks Station C-19
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is a disaster! I heard you stopped the overflow at Station B-34? Get over here! We need your help, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We do prefer our that our assigned tasks actually be completed promptly and with skill. Or, at the very least, promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you so much for coming! I am certain you will hardly be surprised by the revelation that we need your help...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We look forward to your timely arrival! So get here early!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have heeded the call of the Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead in his time of need.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Honeyworks Ultrasonication Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps I misheard you. Did you actually say "no?"

localizedTextIdText: The Honeyworks Packaging Lead at Station D-7 has heard about you shutting down other station's emergency valves. Unsurprisingly, he also needs assistance with his own station's operations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Honeyworks Packaging Lead at Honeyworks Station D-7
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Profits are plummeting! I heard you stopped the overflow at Station C-19? Get over here to D-7 and lend us a hand... or two hands if you have them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A task will rarely appear to be complete, when it is clearly incomplete. Are we clear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blinded by balance sheets! It's a splendid thing you are here finally! Things are about to go sky-high!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We will impatiently await your arrival. So get moving!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have heeded the call of the Honeyworks Packaging Lead in his time of need.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Honeyworks Packaging Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you need a moment to think on your response? Hmmmm?

localizedTextIdText: The Honeyworks Extraction Lead at Station A-22 has heard about you shutting down other station's emergency valves. Unsurprisingly, he also needs assistance with his own station's operations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Honeyworks Extraction Lead at Honeyworks Station A-22
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to shut this thing down! I heard you stopped the overflow at Station D-7? Get over here! I need your help here, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get it done! Chop chop!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank Phineas T. Rotostar you're here... we are nearly in over our heads here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't stop for anything! Get over here quick, quick, quick!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have heeded the call of the Honeyworks Extraction Lead in his time of need.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Honeyworks Extraction Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Firk ding blast! Can you reconsider?

localizedTextIdText: There was a disaster at a nearby Protostar Honey Pumping operation. The Protostar Rescue Lead is heading up the rescue efforts and has asked you to check in with one of the Protostar Station leads.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Honeyworks Extraction Lead at Pump Station A-22
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thank Rotostar you've arrived! We have a monumental honey meltdown on our hands. We need someone to report into our A-22 Station. Do hurry!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: How are those tasks working out for you? Have you reported to Station A-22? I do wish you'd hurry. Now. Please.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You seem to be... how would you say it... not finished?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew cloning the prior Rescue Lead would be advantageous! I also thank you kindly for coming! Your freelance abilities will be instrumental.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Save the honey supply! Err... I mean, save our fellow employees!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I was told you need help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have spoken to the Extraction Lead and he has brought you up to speed on the current disaster.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Honeyworks Extraction Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Be aware: I shall have to file an Insubordination Report Form.

localizedTextIdText: During the chaos caused by what is coming to be known as "the Great Honey Spill," the girrok population at the Honeyworks has been dragging off drums of honey! It's up to you to find them and then use a Proto-Lift to send them back to the appropriate station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Honeyworks Packaging Lead via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: During all the chaos, the girrok dragged off a number of our honey drums! Here, summon a Proto-Lift when you find a drum and send it back down to us!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you recovered any of our honey drums from the girrok? This task was to be completed yesterday! Why is it tomorrow already?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Splendid work! Look at those drums of honey, all lined up in a row. They're so beautiful, if I do say so myself... and you helped! So splendid!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once summoned, the Proto-Lift will handle the rest!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have located the missing honey drums dragged off by the girrok and have sent them back to their appropriate stations.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Honeyworks Packaging Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps I misheard. That was a "yes", correct?

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has ordered you to kill Aurin in Hivestrike Grove and collect $(vitem=55) from them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Aurin make plans for battle, distribute to troops. You kill Aurin troops, find plans, then send them to Mondo. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still here? Thought you had important mission gathering plans from Aurin. Suggestion - get moving!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aurin battle plans downloaded. Always funny to read. Maybe next time they learn not to give every tree-slank plans for battle.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Will be watching you closely.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected enough $(vitem=55) from the Aurin in Hivestrike Grove.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You stupid? Lazy? Or have death wish?

localizedTextIdText: Thanks to you, Exo-Lab A37 is now open to Artemis Zin and the members of her expedition. She's decided to head inside first, and she's asked you to join her inside when you're ready.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Artemis Zin inside Exo-Lab A37
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's no point in waiting for the rest of the team to arrive. I'm heading in to see what I can learn about the augmentors. Meet me there when you're ready.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What's the point of waiting for everyone else? I'll be inside the exo-lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's the point of waiting for everyone else? I'll be inside the exo-lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, there you are. Look what I've found! Isn't it marvelous? It calls itself the Caretaker, and it acts as the primary control system for this exo-lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Daring discoveries wait for no one!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Artemis Zin inside Exo-Lab A37. Now you're prepared to investigate the matter of the augmentor constructs further.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Meet Artemis Zin inside Exo-Lab A37
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Afraid of a few mechanical monstrosities?

localizedTextIdText: You've received a distress call from Camp Firewalker, Councilor Vaelen hunting camp near the Owanee River. The camp has come under attack, and the Luminai dignitary is in danger.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to Agent Lex at Camp Firewalker
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Calling the Dominion! This is Camp Firewalker! We are under attack! The councilor's life is in danger! We require immediate assistance!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are too late to save good Councilor Vaelen. What a shame. Tell me, citizen. What have you learned?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come at once! Councilor Vaelen is in danger! Repeat, the Luminai is in dan- *zzzzap!*
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nonsense. You are being illogical. You cannot deny that Mercenary Arkos is our prime suspect.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be there as soon as I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived at Camp Firewalker too late. By the time you arrived, everyone was already dead. Your investigation of the scene revealed that the situation was more complex that it seemed, but Agent Lex still insists that Mercenary Arkos is the prime suspect.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I can't tell! Half the guards are down, and I've... I've been hit! We need help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Darkness take you! We need your hel- *zzzzap!*

localizedTextIdText: Despite puzzling evidence surrounding the Luminai's death, Agent Lex has ordered you to hunt down the fugitive Granok. Follow the clues near Camp Firewalker to determine where Arkos has gone.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Enough of your doubts. It's time for you to move on. I will take care of the... evidence. My trackers found Arkos' trail. Follow it and hunt him down!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I trust you will bring this matter to a swift conclusion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My trackers have found clues to Arkos' trail. Follow those clues, and we will have our culprit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So the trail ends near the Aurin camp. Arkos chooses to hide behind his allies. How predictable!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly, before his trail grows cold!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stick with the mission, $(player.class). Do not concern yourself with details.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed Arkos' trail until it ended near Wildvine Refuge. The Granok must have sought help from his Aurin allies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do you know it was Arkos?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Arkos was brought here to be hunted by Councilor Vaelen. You can see his cage over there. It's possible that something went wrong and Councilor Vaelen was killed instead.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Mercenary Arkos is no fool. I predict he will seek out any allies he can find. Fortunately, I have agents in the field who can aid you in your pursuit.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You forget I am programmed to be prepared for any threat. Axis Pheydra made sure of that. Councilor Vaelen disregarded the risk posed by Arkos. That foolish mistake cost him his life.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are aware your refusal to assist with the investigation insinuates complicity, yes?

localizedTextIdText: Despite the fact that only one Prime Cubig exists, you've located a Cubig Sow - the Prime Cubig's mate - in Fieldclaw Hollow! Take this information to the Production Facility Manager at Protostar Cubig Farms and let him know what you've discovered.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Production Facility Manager at the Protostar Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Prime Cubig has found a mate! This explains why the Prime Cubig ran off, and what it's been up to, but it hardly explains the presence of a cubig sow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Prime Cubig has found a mate! This explains why the Prime Cubig ran off, and what it's been up to, but it hardly explains the presence of a cubig sow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A cubig sow? Is this some kind of joke? If so, I fail to comprehend it. You had best stick with your daytime occupation. Comedy does not suit you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps some Protostar Stress Reduction Formula will calm your nerves?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I swear! It's in Fieldclaw Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Production Facility Manager doesn't believe your story about the Cubig Sow you found in Fieldclaw Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Production Facility Manager

localizedTextIdText: Mercenary Arkoss last transmission has revealed that he's hiding within Wildvine Sanctum. Agent Lex has instructed you to apprehend Arkos so Dominion justice can be served.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex at Camp Firewalker
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have triangulated Arkos's last transmission. He's hiding within Wildvine Sanctum, an Aurin sanctuary beneath the roots of a large tree.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All the loose ends have been tied up neatly. You were instrumental in bringing about this optimal outcome. You have my thanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I want you to take Arkos alive, citizen. He has much to account for.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Questions are dangerous, citizen. Do not spurn the ICI's gratitude by making such inquiries.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You seem to have left out some details.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Mercenary Arkos, allowing Agent Lex to execute him for his crimes. Arkos, with his last dying breath, denied killing the Luminai. You suspect there is more to this story than is being revealed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are a fool to think you can stop right now.

localizedTextIdText: Learn the fishing hobby
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Learned how to fish
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looking for something fun to do? Why not take up a hobby like fishing?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All you'll need to do is buy a Fishing Cannon and keep an eye out for schools of fish in most bodies of water. Good luck!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have taken up the fishing hobby

localizedTextIdText: Someone must inform Guard Captain Terentius at the Protostar Honeyworks that the Aurin in Hivestrike Grove have been neutralized. Mondo Zax has chosen you for the task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Guard Captain Terentius at the Protostar Honeyworks
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Aurin invasion no longer possible. Tree-slanks crushed to pulp! Must inform Guard Captain at Honeyworks. Immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Time wasting! Go Honeyworks, tell Dominion Guard Hivestrike neutralized. Go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What have we here? Another Dominion 'agent' fresh from the front lines, I assume. Give me your report at once. I am a busy man.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Another victory for the Zax. Impressive, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mondo Zax has brought the Aurin low once again. Bravo! Now... off with you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The Hivestrike Aurin are no more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You informed Guard Captain Terentius that the Hivestrike Aurin no longer pose a threat in Auroria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Zax want to open your skull, prove that nothing inside.

localizedTextIdText: How thoughtful! The Marauders at Grimvoid Landing have placed incendiary Fuel Drum throughout their stronghold. This is a valuable opportunity to teach those poaching pirates the error of their ways.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Ari at Owanee Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This fuel drum bears the insignia of the Grimvoid Marauders, as well as decals that warn against exposing it to extreme heat, flame, or raw atmosphere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What you want? Marauders not here at Owanee Research Station.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Were you responsible for big, fiery explosions at Grimvoid Camp? Very good! May be hope for you yet!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hope Marauders burned to crispy ashes. Teach them not to poach.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I made sure only Marauders were cooked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ignited a number of Fuel Drum at Grimvoid Landing, charring many Marauders in the process.

localizedTextIdText: You've tracked Mercenary Arkos to Wildvine Refuge. Agent Lex believes that you can flush Arkos out by laying waste to the Wildvine Aurin harboring him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Draw Mercenary Arkos out of hiding
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Arkos must be hiding somewhere in Wildvine Refuge. Kill his Aurin allies. That should prompt him to reveal himself.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Each Wildvine Aurin you kill will bring Arkos that much closer to revealing himself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Enough! I'm the one you want, so leave the Aurin outta this! I'll bet you're tracing this comm already! So come and get me, ya Dommie murderers!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Arkos is a sentimental fool. He will not let you kill his allies without a fight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I ain't goin' down without a fight!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You forced Mercenary Arkos to reveal himself by attacking his Aurin allies. The hunt is finally winding to a close.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Draw Mercenary Arkos out of hiding
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Casualties can occur in any mission... including yours.

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Gallow has asked all new Technologists to craft medishots to gauge your understanding of Technologist techniques for his evaluation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medical supplies to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here. I got some pendin' requests fer medishots, and I'd like to see how you pioneers are doin' at yer Technologist skills!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here. I got some pendin' requests fer medishots, and I'd like to see how you pioneers are doin' at yer technologist skills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Found my medishot contract? How's it comin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, let's have a look... yep, these are great! Yer comin' along good! Nice to see ya takin' that initiative!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My hopes are high for ya, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe was happy to see your example of basic proficiency at Technologist techniques.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medical supplies to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Gallow are hampered by local aggressors, and the militia is in dire need of medical supplies. Craft some medishots and deliver them to the Logistics Officer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your medishots to the FCON logistics officer in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Dire medicine shortages predicted. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate medishots.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Dire medicine shortages predicted. All capable pioneers, locate Logistics Officers and donate medishots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You here to help us out with med supplies? We're practically bleedin' out here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's this? All right! Medishots! We'll get these to the front lines right away! Our medics owe you a favor, pal!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nice work, chum. I owe ya a cold one.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hope these help out your injured!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've resupplied the local militia with medical supplies. The Logistics Officer was just happy to have the help.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your medishots to the Gallow logistics officer

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver medishots to Technologist Blackwood in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering medical supplies to Technologist Blackwood in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You plannin' on helping us out with medishots?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh! Those are perfect. I'll just place them in my satch- where did I place that? Well, give them here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have a small reward for you from the... uh... ah, here it is in my bag.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is my contract, no question!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've delivered medishots to Technologist Blackwood. Once he found his satchel, he gave you a reward out of gratitude for your craftsmanship.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the medical supplies to Technologist Blackwood

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Gallow is responsible for funneling housing supplies to territories belonging to the Exiles. He needs some $m(schematic=392) and other basic architectural items.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the housing goods to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe've got a request here for some Metal Platform. We're looking for a capable architect to sort this out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe've got a request here for some Metal Platform. We're looking for a capable architect to sort this out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's that housing order comin' along? You makin' good on it, friend?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let's have a look... yes, these'll do nicely. I'm mighty grateful to ya, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is fine work, friend!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Looks like a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think they'll look pretty nice!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've supplied Crafting Trainer Thorpe with $m(schematic=392).
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the housing goods to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: Logistics officers in Gallow are looking for architects. They need $m(schematic=372) for some creative landscaping projects.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your goods to the Logistics Officer in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: REQUEST: Looking for $m(schematic=372), suitable for replanting in local landscape projects. Make all deliveries to Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: REQUEST: Looking for $m(schematic=372), suitable for replanting in local landscape projects. Make all deliveries to Gallow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, you workin' on $m(schematic=372)? We really need 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, you came through for us, pal! I'll get these shipped out right away!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You made it happen, pal. Gotta hand it to ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered <text Link="Schematic:372">$m(schematic=372)</text> to the Logistics Officer in Gallow. He was grateful to have them.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your goods to the Logistics Officer

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver housing supplies to Architect Kaspmara in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the housing supplies to Architect Kaspmara in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I await the delivery of frivolous morale-boosting items.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What wonderful things you craft for me! I become faint with delight. Actually, upon introspection, I do not.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps this trade will be more beneficial for you than for me. Take it and go.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've delivered housing supplies to Architect Kaspmara in Gallow. She was grateful to have them (in her own way) and got them shipped out quickly.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the housing supplies to Architect Kaspmara

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Thayd lists a work order request for $m(schematic=277) crafted from local omni-plasm and serpentlily to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring $m(schematic=277) to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the medishots to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for Serpentlily Medishots crafted locally to support the war against the Dominion. Bring Medishots to Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for medishots crafted locally to support the war against the Dominion. Bring them to Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If yer plannin' on helpin' out the troops, I need those Serpentlily Medishots!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work there, friend! You've no idea how badly we need these! I'm so excited, I think I might just wet my britches!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Uh. Not literally, of course. But thanks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee has happily accepted the $m(schematic=277) you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the $m(schematic=277) to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills has put out a call for help in relieving the Exile supply shortage in Galeras. Aid the relief effort by crafting some $m(schematic=278) for Exile forces here in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=278) to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Medical supply shortage reported! Requesting donations of $m(schematic=278) to support the war in Galeras. Please contact Coordinator Mills!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Medical Supply shortage reported! Requesting donations of $m(schematic=278) to support the war in Galeras. Please contact Coordinator Mills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The more fightin' we see 'round here, the more medicines we need... medicines of all kinds.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I was just thinkin' to myself, "We'd better get more medishots in here right quick." It's like my prayers have been answered!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What do they say? "Take two medishots and call me when the bleeding stops"?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some <text Link="Schematic:278">$m(schematic=278)</text> for the Exile forces in Thayd and helped with the ongoing relief effort.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade is offering a contract that will aid in fending off the Dominion. Help the war effort by crafting $m(schematic=279) for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivering them to Techsmith Praxa in Thayd!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the medishots to Techsmith Praxa in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft $m(schematic=279) and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft $m(schematic=279) and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There isn't enough medicine to treat all the wounded. I won't lie, but I'm a little bit worried.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is that what I think it is? Medishots? Hey, that's great! I got a brother on the front lines, so I appreciate this more than most folks!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lots of folks will be gettin' better now, thanks to you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some $m(schematic=279) for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivered them to Techsmith Praxa.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the medishots to Techsmith Praxa

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Thayd lists a work order request for $m(schematic=376) suitable for use as fortifications. Anyone interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Crafting Trainer Oaklee.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=376) to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for Galeras Wall for use as fortifications. Bring them to Work Order Board in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for Galeras Wall for use as fortifications. Bring them to Work Order Board in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can take your fancy force fields, but I'd trust a nice solid wall of rock over some flimsy electromagnetic fluctuations any day.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fine job makin' these walls. Portable defenses will help us advance our lines and take Galeras back from the blasted Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait to see how this holds up in a real scrap!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee has happily accepted the $m(schematic=376) you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the $m(schematic=376) to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills has put out a call to architects of Thayd for transportation containers to move supplies to the front lines of Galeras. Aid the relief effort by crafting some $m(schematic=865) for Exile forces here in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=865) to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Thayd's defense forces are seriously lacking in supplies and require Single Metal Crate to move them out quickly. Please contact Coordinator Mills!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Thayd's defense forces are seriously lacking in supplies and require Single Metal Crate to move them out quickly. Please contact Coordinator Mills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our girls and boys in camo are runnin' low out there. We need to speed up those resupply missions, and I need more Single Metal Crate to do it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I gotta say, these Single Metal Crate are mighty fine - sturdy and tough. It'll get these supplies there in an insta-jiffy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done a good thing for our soldiers. You know that, right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some <text Link="Schematic:865">$m(schematic=865)</text> for the Exile forces in Thayd and helped with the ongoing relief effort.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade is offering a contract that will aid in fending off the Dominion. Help the war effort by crafting $m(schematic=848) for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivering them to Contractor Drogor in Thayd!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=848) to Contractor Drogor in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft Wicked Fire Totem and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft Wicked Fire Totem and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without good lighting, our soldiers won't be able to tell a rock from a Dommie mortar, you know what I mean? Hop to it, pal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah, yeah. Makin' these torches isn't prestigious or nothin', but we gotta have 'em anyway. Thanks for the delivery, pal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks, pal. Good to know you got our backs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some $m(schematic=848) for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivered them to Contractor Drogor.

localizedTextIdTitle: What Is Dead May Never Spy
localizedTextIdText: You found the body of a Black Hood agent inside Stalker's Den. Take the Exile spy's datachron to an ICI agent at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Analyst Spector at Seaspine Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This mangled corpse is clothed in the uniform of a Black Hood agent. The presence of this unfortunate individual indicates the Exiles must be close.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This mangled corpse is clothed in the uniform of a Black Hood agent. The presence of this unfortunate individual indicates the Exiles must be close.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Be vigilant. Our enemies are everywhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My team will search the area for any additional spies. Now let me see the datachron.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Deciphering this will not take long. You have done well, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll let someone know about this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After locating the body of an Exile spy in Stalker's Den, you delivered his datachron to Analyst Spector for decryption.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll let someone know about this.

localizedTextIdText: You've defeated Arvin Wildvine, the infamous Aurin chronicler. Agent Lex will likely find Arvin's scribblings, known as the Wildvine Chronicle, to be informative, especially as it concerns the Aurin resistance in Deradune and Celestion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Upload the Wildvine Chronicle to Agent Lex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You hold the blood-spattered manuscript of an Aurin chronicler in your hands. Highly detailed, the document contains data on Aurin movements across Deradune.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A detailed account of Aurin movements in Deradune and Celestion? Such intel would be invaluable to the ICI. Upload it to me at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have done well.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The ICI might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You contacted Agent Lex who was pleased you were able to obtain such valuable intel for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Upload the Wildvine Chronicle to Agent Lex

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Arms Master at the Cubig Farms wants you to test the newly upgraded security system. Locate Cubig Alpha, Cubig Beta, and Cubig Gamma on the farm. Then lead them back to the starting point. If you leave the pens while attempting to complete your task, the test will fail.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protostar Arms Master at the Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's inconceivable that you were able to thwart our zapper system! We need more data to analyze, so get in there and try stealing the cubigs again!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go on, initiate the test. You have no hope of stealing three cubigs without being detected. Your chance of success is only 0.0253 percent!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This data is flawless! Precise! With no doubt as to the results... and, unfortunately, it concluded that I should be fired immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak with the Junior Security Officer to start the test. Surely, you all know the drill by now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Rubbish! More testing!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I did it once. I can do it again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: To the dismay of the Protostar Arms Master at the Cubig Farms, you managed to circumvent the security measures and avoided a grisly, electric death.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I think your odds are off.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Protostar Arms Master
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I see. Your prior success was either a sham or a fluke, hmm?

localizedTextIdText: You have recovered the stinger from the Necrohive King's corpse. You should take it back to the Protostar Purification Lead at Honeyworks Station A-22 to see if he has any use for such an exquisite item.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Necrohive King's Stinger to the Protostar Purification Lead at Honeyworks Station A-22
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The blood stained, ancient stinger is heavy and extremely sharp. The Protostar Purification Lead at Station A-22 would love to get his hands on this!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Magnificent! What a capital stinger specimen! If our finest honey wasn't being spewed into the sky, I'd give you a jar of it in return!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As it is, money will have to suffice!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully delivered the Necrohive King's stinger to the Protostar Purification Lead at Honeyworks Station A-22.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Necrohive King's Stinger to the Protostar Purification Lead

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Redfall has requested your assistance in discovering why a Dominion expedition team has gone missing. Meet him at Arcanus Base and assist him in his investigation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Sergeant Redfall at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Dominion expedition team has gone missin' and I want you to help me find out why. Interested in a little recon?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Introduce yourself to the rest of the team, then we can talk about the mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a good thing you met everyone. We're a real tight group, and we never back down. I expect you'll fit right in.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come to Arcanus Base and introduce yourself to the rest of the team.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's time to get busy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Sergeant Redfall and the rest of his team in Arcanus Base to discover why a Dominion expedition team has gone missing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: A Dominion expedition team? Why should we care?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's simple. If somethin' bad can happen to the Dommies, then it can happen to us, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't got the guts, huh? Figures.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Redfall has asked you to get the generators at Arcanus Base up and running. He hopes that doing so will reveal what happened to the Dominion Expedition team.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Redfall via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some Dominion eggheads went missin'. Take the team and see if ya can get those generators runnin'. With the lights on, maybe we can find some evidence.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why're you wastin' time? The generators you need to turn on are all around Arcanus Base. Once they're on, who knows what we'll find?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ain't that a shock? Those Dommies went runnin' off with their tails between their legs, looks like. We'll need to keep our eyes open.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I suppose the Dommies got what was comin' to 'em, but I aim to learn why.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Better them then us, I suppose.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Seems it turned out bad for them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got the generators at Arcanus Base up and running for Sergeant Redfall and uncovered a series of holographic recordings. It appears as if the Dominion expedition team was scared off by something horrible... something that may be waiting for other victims.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You just got here. You can't quit now.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Millburn is concerned about some strange readings on his holographic life sign detector and he's asked you to investigate them. They seem to be coming from the Ravenous Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Specialist Millburn at Ravenous Ravine
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My holographic life sign detector is pickin' up some awfully strange readings, boss. I can't rightly tell what it means. We should check it out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You suss out what those strange readings were all about? It gives me a queasy sort of feelin' in my guts whenever I try to figure it out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stars! What the hell is that on his face?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It just don't make any sense. I never seen readings like this before.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well I want some answers, and fast!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Specialist Millburn was concerned about some strange readings on his holographic life sign detector and asked you to investigate the signal coming from the Ravenous Ravine. Following your investigation, you discovered some strange things, indeed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's all messed up, like there's two bodies in the same place or somethin'. Whenever I try to adjust resolution, the signal goes nuts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The sarge said you'd be worth havin' along. You tellin' me he was wrong?

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Smallgrove is hoping the Dominion expedition team left behind research samples that could help Corporal Harlock, and has asked you to explore the Derelict Silo E23 to search for it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Specialist Smallgrove at Derelict Silo E23
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's no time to waste! We need to get inside and find a way to get this thing off Harlock. Maybe the Dominion team found out what these things are.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the Dominion team was in the derelict, there's a good chance they had some kind of information on that... thing. It could be Harlock's only hope!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Treesblood! I don't see anything that can help him! This is horrible!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please hurry! I don't know how much time we have to save Harlock!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't know, but we need to figure something out, quick.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Specialist Smallgrove was hoping the Dominion expedition team had left behind research samples that could help Corporal Harlock, but you were unable to find a solution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you? You monster!

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Redfall has requested your presence at Arcanus Base. He says that Corporal Harlock isn't looking too good....
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sergeant Redfall at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Got ourselves some urgent business back here at camp. Corporal Harlock... well, let's say he ain't lookin' too good...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're wastin' time friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Damn! You're too late, $(player.name). Harlock slaughtered Millburn, then he took off. Nearly killed me, too. I never thought  I'd see the day.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come see for yourself, but you better move fast.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sergeant Redfall requested your presence back at Arcanus Base, where you learned that Corporal Harlock had gone missing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Something weird latched on to his noggin', then he started actin' downright strange.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're serious? Dammit!

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Harlock has given you a mission to clear the Ravenous Ravine of all hostile alien life.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Redfall via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I don't know what killed the expedition team, but I seen some hostile creatures in the ravine that look like they're ready for a scrap. Ya with me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get movin' to the Ravenous Ravine and slag anything that so much as twitches!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I thought Harlock had you killin' aliens in the ravine. You can't be done already! That place was crawlin' with critters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's the word? You knocked out any of them slimy, disgusting aliens in the Ravenous Ravine?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yeah! Let's squash some bugs!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done good, friend.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: All those bugs have been cleared out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Corporal Harlock gave you with a mission to clear the Ravenous Ravine of hostile alien life. You dove into the fray, resulting in a nice, long dirt nap for many of the beasties.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You ain't much of a fighter. What the hell good are ya, then?

localizedTextIdText: You found some supplies left behind by the missing Dominion expedition team in the Ravenous Ravine. You should gather more supplies and take them to Sergeant Redfall at Arcanus Base.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Redfall at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It looks like the Dominion eggheads left some supplies behind. You should see if you can find more and deliver them to Sergeant Redfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It looks like the Dominion eggheads left some supplies behind. You should see if you can find more and deliver them to Sergeant Redfall.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our supplies are gettin' low. It never seems to matter how much we bring along, we end up goin' through it too fast.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where'd you get all those supplies? I'll be... they're marked as belonging to the Dominion military! And they're still sealed up tight, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We Exiles never let anything go to waste. You done good.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can find more.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They were left behind in the ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered a number of supplies that had been abandoned by the Dominion expedition team in the Ravenous Ravine and delivered them to Sergeant Redfall.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see if I can find more.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Redfall has asked you to exterminate the Derelict Silo Squirg{p:Derelict Silo Squirg} infesting Derelict Silo E23. There's no hope for them, and whatever humanity they once had has since been lost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Redfall via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those things may have been people at one point, friend, but they ain't anymore. We need to put 'em down if we're gonna keep this crap from spreading.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's the body count? You need to do your best to wipe out every stinkin' one of those things. We can't afford to let 'em spread.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have you wiped those damn things out yet? Anything that climbs on your head like that and takes control ain't natural!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Knock 'em dead, $(player.name). I'm countin' on ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's a relief!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put a lid on it, Sarge.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I put a bunch of those things down.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sergeant Redfall asked you to exterminate the Derelict Silo Squirg{p:Derelict Silo Squirg} infesting Derelict Silo E23. There was no hope for them, and whatever humanity they once had has since been lost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: They're scary. I get it. But this ain't the best time to lose your nerve.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Redfall has asked you to squash the Derelict Silo Egg infesting Derelict Silo E23 to prevent the creatures from spreading to other parts of Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Redfall via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those things lay eggs. If we let those things hatch, we're in for a world of pain. You'd better stomp the life out of any eggs you find in there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You still got eggs to squash in the derelict silo? Then what in blazes are you doin' back here? Get out there and let your boots do the stompin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll be lettin' command know what a good job you did stompin' those eggs. It's pretty gross, but it had to be done. We can't have those things spreadin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't slip in... well, whatever's in them eggs.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I'll stomp on those eggs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sergeant Redfall asked you to squash the Derelict Silo Egg infesting the Derelict Silo E23 to prevent them from spreading to other parts of Nexus. You did a great job, but you may want to clean your boots now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't like the idea of getting your feet dirty?

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Redfall has asked you to reactivate the Dominion expedition turrets around Arcanus Base to get a defensive perimeter active. He intends to be prepared in case whatever attacked the first expedition returns.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Redfall via your Datachron
