localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I don't want us endin' up like the Dominion team. Get those Dominion turrets up and runnin' so we can establish a defensive perimeter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those turrets are still inactive. What gives? I thought I told you to get them up and runnin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With those turrets active, anyone - or anything - that attacks us is goin' to be in for a shock.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure those cannons only shoot the bad guys, okay?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reactivated the Dominion expedition turrets and provided a good deal of security for the Exile camp. If whatever took the Dominion team out returns to Arcanus Base, they'll have to contend with some serious firepower.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get the turrets switched on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't get those turrets up, you'll get killed just the same as us.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Redfall has ordered you to find Corporal Harlock who, after killing Specialist Millburn, wandered off towards the Eldan structures in Arcanus Base.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sergeant Redfall at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: After he killed Millburn, Harlock ran off toward those Eldan structures. Find him and do whatever you gotta do to make sure he doesn't pose a threat.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get it done. We ain't got time to wait for Harlock to come back lookin' for more blood. He went off towards those Eldan structures.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank the stars, you're alive! Is everything okay? Where's Smallgrove?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Harlock's bad news, make no mistake. You better watch your ass out there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dammit! That settles it. We need to pull outta here, pronto.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sergeant Redfall ordered you to find Corporal Harlock who, after killing Specialist Millburn, wandered off towards the Eldan structures in Arcanus Base. When you found Harlock, you were forced to neutralize him after he killed Specialist Smallgrove.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If he comes back, he's gonna kill us all. Understand?

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide Ikthians have taken a keen interest in a giant Eldan device. Commander Durek has no idea what it is, so he's sending you to find out. Clear the way to Checkpoint Alpha by killing Darktide Ikthians on Shatter Ledge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Ikthians call themselves the Darktide. They're real interested in this weird Eldan machine, so I'm sendin' you in for recon and wreckin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Crack some Darktide skulls on Shatter Ledge as ya move to Checkpoint Alpha. Give 'em hell!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job. Ya made it and you're still alive. You're livin' up to your reputation, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You've done good work in the past, so I know I can trust ya with this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Buck up. We got you a present, courtesy of the science boys on the arkship.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared the way to Checkpoint Alpha by killing Darktide Ikthians on Shatter Ledge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You already have a team on the job?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We got no idea. I sent a group to find out what that thing is, and what the Darktide plans to do with it, but they haven't reported in yet.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: This is too important, and the lack of contact makes me think they got slagged. Ya got a reputation for gettin' things done, so I know I can count on ya.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's a bad choice to make.

localizedTextIdText: The double-threat of the Darktide and Eldan equalizers makes Sunder Flat a very difficult place to traverse. Thus, Commander Durek has taken the liberty of sending you an Exile battle suit to pilot and plow through the Darktide on your way to Checkpoint Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hold up. Sunder Flat's lookin' real bad. I'm sendin' you an Exile battle suit to pilot to Checkpoint Bravo. Enjoy the ride!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head to Checkpoint Bravo with that Exile battle suit I sent ya. Be sure to take those fish-faces and toasters down a notch on yer way there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya made it. Don't worry about the suit. It wasn't expected to last longer than one mission, anyway. It's served its purpose.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Suit up, $(player.name). It's time for some ass-kickin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ya ready? There are some good men that need yer help.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I could do that all day.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the Exile battle suit provided by Commander Durek, you plowed through the Darktide Ikthians on your way to Checkpoint Bravo.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Didn't think ya were one to disobey orders.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has received intel suggesting the Darktide have taken his original recon team captive. He's provided you with a best-guess on their whereabouts in Behavioral Research Facility 394, and has ordered you to locate and free them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got a location on that recon team that went MIA. They're somewhere in that Ikthian facility on Sunder Flat. I need ya to find 'em and free 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find my men and bring 'em home. We owe 'em that much. They're held up on Sunder Flat, near Crescent Heights.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That thing's a gun, ya say? And those fish-faces are aimin' it at us? Why ain't I surprised? Well, we ain't gonna sit here and wait for them to shoot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope they ain't hard to find, else ya could be in there a while.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We need more info, $(player.name), and you're gonna dig it up for us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and freed the original Exile team from the Darktide Ikthians. The captives imparted crucial intelligence they overheard while imprisoned regarding the Eldan device. The Ikthians refer to it as the "plasmic equalizer," and it's some kind of ancient planetary defense cannon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'd turn your back on fellow Exiles? What kinda scum are ya?

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has ordered you to find out what the Darktide plan to do with the plasmic equalizer. Hack the Darktide satellite uplinks in Crescent Heights and uncover the extent of the Darktide's plan.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Commander Durek at the Plasmic Equalizer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ya gotta hack the Darktide satellite uplinks in Crescent Heights and find out what they want that big gun for... as if that ain't obvious.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get goin'. I need you to hack those  Darktide satellite uplinks and find out what the fish-heads want with that weapon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get goin'. I need you to hack those  Darktide satellite uplinks and find out what the fish-heads want with that weapon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those blasted Ikthians are playin' dirty. We got no choice... we need to advance now and shut that damn thing down before it's too late.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm gonna hop in my ship and meet ya there. I'll call when I land.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's 'bout time I got some action in.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find out what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By hacking the Darktide satellite uplinks in Crescent Heights, you've revealed that a massive Ikthian armada is preparing to travel to Nexus. The Darktide intend to move the plasmic equalizer off-planet with the armada, and use it against both the Exiles and the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find out what I can.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find out what I can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought ya knew what you were doin'.

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide must be stopped before they use the plasmic equalizer to wipe out both Exile and Dominion forces on Nexus. Follow Commander Durek into the plasmic equalizer and help him find a way to stop the Darktide.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Durek near the Plasmic Equalizer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Follow me $(player.name)! You and I are gonna rush the plasmic equalizer and shut it down. But stick close, 'cause we'll be encounterin' resistance!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Keep it together, $(player.name)! We only got one shot at this!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Keep it together, $(player.name)! We only got one shot at this!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gah! That blasted Ironscale's a damn cheat! I almost had him, and now he's gettin' away!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This is gonna get bloody!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll be fine, but Nexus won't if we don't do somethin' quick!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After encountering Admiral Gelic Ironscale, Commander Durek broke off for a duel while you defended against waves of Darktide troops. However, Admiral Gelic Ironscale used a nasty device to bring Commander Durek to his knees, then made a break for an escape craft.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What're you? Afraid?

localizedTextIdText: With Commander Durek immobilized, it's up to you to chase Admiral Gelic Ironscale down. You must stop him from escaping or he'll lead the Ikthian armada back to the plasmic equalizer!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Forget about me! Don't let Ironscale get away! The jig's up if he leads that armada back here and gets the plasmic equalizer!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are ya waiting for? Get Ironscale before he's outta range!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it, $(player.name). Great thinkin', using the plasmic equalizer against the Ikthian fleet. That'll teach 'em to mess with the best the Exiles have!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go go go! Don't look back!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My men are comin' to dismantle this beast before someone else tries for it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The debris will be pretty on re-entry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Admiral Gelic Ironscale escaped, but you got the better of him by using the plasmic equalizer to blow his entire armada right out of the sky! Commander Durek has summoned a special unit to Farside to dismantle the ancient Eldan weapon before it falls into the wrong hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We're in too deep for you to say no.

localizedTextIdText: After killing a Darktide Ikthian on Shatter Ledge, you found a $(vitem=105) which is used to power their weapons. It could help Exile scientists better understand Ikthian technology if you collected more cells from Darktide Ikthians on Shatter Ledge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Meloll Goldglade via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This charging cell seems to be an efficient power source for Ikthian weaponry. Perhaps the XAS would be interested in studying them and how they work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ikthian technology is really weird, and their power sources are highly efficient. I wish I had some to study.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's like you read my mind! I was just thinking, "I wish I had some Ikthian charging cells to study." And look! Here you are with a bunch of them!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're my hero! But don't get any funny ideas.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected a number of $m(vitem=105) from dead Ikthians on Shatter Ledge and delivered them to Meloll Goldglade.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.

localizedTextIdTitle: Best Safecracker This Side of Nearside
localizedTextIdText: Meloll Goldglade in Stonebreaker's Stand found a strange Eldan chest. It's locked with an advanced Eldan security system and he can't open it. He's offered to share the contents with you if you can break it open. BEWARE: This is a very difficult task!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Meloll Goldglade at Stonebreaker's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eyeing that Eldan chest, huh? I've been trying to crack it for days. If you can hack through all the levels of security, I'll give you some of the loot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Like I said, hack through the levels of security on that Eldan chest and I'll share whatever's inside with you. That is, if there's anything in there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blessed matrias! You did it! And it's full of Eldan data files and blueprints! This is the best day ever!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't be upset if you can't do it. I'm real smart, and I'm still stumped.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You can have that other stuff, you earned it. Here's a title for you, too!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was difficult, but I did it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defied the odds and cracked all four security levels on the Eldan chest that Meloll Goldglade found in Stonebreaker's Stand. He was so pleased to access the Eldan documents and blueprints within that he shared a great reward with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's probably too hard for you anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Meloll Goldglade has been studying the equalizer constructs in Behavioral Research Facility 394. He lacks combat data, so he's asked you to engage and dismantle the constructs while he observes remotely and records the data.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Meloll Goldglade via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need way more combat data from the equalizer constructs on Sunder Flat. Can you mix it up with them while I watch and record from here?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can't you just destroy some of those equalizer constructs so I can see what makes them tick?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've downloaded all the data. This is amazing! I'll be analyzing this for a while. Thank you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd do it myself, but you're lots better at fighting than I am.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait to add this information to my report for the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Meloll Goldglade asked you to engage and dismantle equalizer constructs while he observed and recorded their combat data remotely. Thanks to you, he was able to collect some very interesting information.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's too bad.

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide Ikthians are using a power drills to access Eldan technology underneath Crescent Heights. To stop them, Meloll Goldglade has given you some highly-experimental elect-bombs to fry the drills' systems.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Meloll Goldglade via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Darktide armored power drills are breaching the Eldan lab under Crescent Heights. Luckily, I made some elect-bombs for just such an occasion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Slap those elect-bombs on the power drills in Crescent Heights and hit the button. It's really easy, trust me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work testing my elect-bombs on those drills. I hadn't had a chance to actually test them, so it's a good thing they actually worked as intended.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure you take cover before the elect-bombs blow.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I should patent these bombs right away, huh?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Meloll Goldglade elect-bombs worked wonders on the Ikthian power drills, causing them to short out. Now the Ikthians will be hard-pressed to reach the Eldan technology beneath Crescent Heights.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: One minute you're so brave, and the next you're a big wimp.

localizedTextIdText: A constant stream of Darktide Ikthians and Eldan constructs makes Sunder Flat a very difficult place to traverse. After you responded to a Bounty Board request, Commander Durek sent you another Exile battle suit to plow through the Darktide forces.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: HELP WANTED\nExperienced Exile battle suit pilot to patrol Sunder Flat and exterminate Ikthian threats. Hazard pay available.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: HELP WANTED\nExperienced Exile battle suit pilot to patrol Sunder Flat and exterminate Ikthian threats. Hazard pay available.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You takin' a battle suit out to clear Sunder Flat again? I don't got no problems with that. Give 'em hell!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sunder Flat fills up with fish-heads faster than the Last Man Standin' fills up with drunk Granok. Keepin' that place clear's gonna make me old.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're a slaggin' comedian, aren't ya?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used another Exile battle suit to plow through the Darktide Ikthians on Sunder Flat. Though the Flat is clear for now, there will likely be more fish-heads running around there tomorrow.

localizedTextIdText: You stumbled upon the body of a Dominion courier, apparently slain by malverines. The crate he was carrying was clearly intended for the camp at Seaspine Point. It's your duty to make sure the crate reaches its destination.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Blood-Spattered Crate to Supervisor Sernelia at the Overlook Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've stumbled upon the body of a courier slain by a malverine. His cargo was clearly intended for the overlook camp.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You've stumbled upon the body of a courier slain by a malverine. His cargo was clearly intended for the overlook camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What're you lookin' at?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Another dead courier? Bollocks! They's droppin' like flies, they is, and all due to them infernal malverines.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In any case, thanks. By Dominus, we needed these supplies, and soon!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I found this crate on the path.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the Blood-Spattered Crate to Supervisor Sernelia at the camp on Seaspine Point without incident.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Blood-Spattered Crate to Supervisor Sernelia

localizedTextIdText: Not only does the Torine Sisterhood hold sway in Wilderrun, but they have also managed to tame the ferocious pumera that prowl the dark byways of the jungle. Dorian Walker wants you to enter Giant's Wall and investigate the relationship between the pumera and their Torine mistresses.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I seen them Torine gals patrollin' the jungles with mean-lookin' pumera. Ya think ya can suss out what kinda deal they got goin' on, champ?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's a place called Giant's Wall that's damn near swimmin' in pumera. Might check there first, boss.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I guess that settles it, them women have tamed pumera, and done it well. They don't treat them cats like pets... they treat 'em like real pals.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew I could count on ya, ace. Make this old man proud, now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We better keep a good eye on the tamers and their animals. Right, kid?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the relationship between the pumera and the Torine Sisterhood on Dorian Walker behalf and learned that some sisters are tasked with training the mighty cats. From the looks of things, the Torine and their tamed pumera allies make formidable enemies... especially in tandem.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ya blind, sport? It's obvious that the Torine and the pumera got some kinda relationship. It's weird, if ya ask me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Everyone knows ya can't tame pumera. They's wild animals, slick, and they'd just as soon eat ya as maul yer head off.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't you never learned to respect your elders, kid?

localizedTextIdText: The race for the Everpool is on! Dorian Walker has asked you to explore Wilderrun, discovering landmarks and looking for signs of the fabled fountain of youth. With luck, you can stay one step ahead of Artemis Zin, and meet Dorian safe and sound once your reconnaissance is finished.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dorian Walker near the Fallen Stone Ruins
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nice to have ya on the team, hotshot. We need to hunt for the Everpool, keep an eye out for Zin, and scout out those Osun ruins. Ya savvy, doc?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't just stand there, chief. Get a move on. Wilderrun ain't gonna scout itself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I reckon we're just about done here, champ. Just up 'n' over this wall, and we'll be swimmin' in the Everpool!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You head towards them ruins over there, sport. I'll be in touch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go fallin' behind now, chief!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You scouted the length and breadth of Wilderrun, eventually meeting Dorian Walker near Fallen Stone Ruins . Next stop, the Everpool!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do we need to scout?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: You're not worried she'll find the Everpool first?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Why... it's part of what explorers do, kid. Seein' places ya never seen before, getting attacked by new 'n' interestin' critters... ayep, that's the life!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, she's out there, champ. That harridan's got it in for me, ain't that the truth. One of these days I might just gun her down, but I'm probably too much of a gentleman.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I'll be damned if I let that harlot beat me to the punch. The fountain of youth is out there, kid. And when I find it, I aim to take a nice, cold dip.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: C'mon, slick. We ain't got time to fool around.

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker believes that the Everpool is close at hand. All that remains is to fight your way through the Torine Sisters that guard the Gates of the Everpool and claim the immortal fountain for the Exiles!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dorian Walker near the Gates of the Everpool
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The gates to the Everpool ain't far from here, bucko. Get past the Torine guards 'n' we'll put in a claim on the Everpool before Artemis is any wiser!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Well? Don't just stand there! We gotta claim the Everpool before Zin gets to it! Get a wiggle on!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well? Don't just stand there! We gotta claim the Everpool before Zin gets to it! Get a wiggle on!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll be damned! Them Torine sisters got the Everpool locked down tight, don't they? Well, I guess it ain't all bad. Artemis can't get in, neither.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Now ya got me thinkin' about pie, kid. I love me a good pie!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: 'Course we will, chief. You think I got this old by givin' up? Ha!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you and Dorian Walker made it to the Gates of the Everpool, you found your way blocked by Tresayne Toria, who explained that she will only open the Gates of the Everpool to those who have completed the Torine Trials.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What if Artemis gets there first?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: What do ya think, champ? Them Torine are just gonna let us walk right up and soak our feet in their personal fountain of youth? Ha! Fat chance of that!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Then I s'pose we'll deal with her, boss. The Everpool's too important. We can't allow the Dominion to get their dirty paws on it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can either pitch in, or let 'ol Dorian take all the credit.

localizedTextIdText: The artifact known as the Focus of Life stands as a testament to Eldan elemental ingenuity in Everpool Sanctum. Having located the Focus, you have an opportunity to activate the Eldan Focal Monitor and observe its effects first-hand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Inspect the Eldan Focal Monitor near Everpool Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This control panel is somehow tied into the Focus of Life. Perhaps activating it will provide some insight into the Focus's functionality.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The terminal briefly displays records of organisms with lifespans greatly extended by the Focus of Life before shorting out.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Ah, what the heck? I'll start it up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your activation of the Eldan Focal Monitor in Everpool Sanctum, you've determined that the Focus of Life has restorative properties and is capable of greatly extending the lifespans of creatures that access its powers.

localizedTextIdText: You met an Ekose captain named Spigo. He and his partner, a Krogg named Vicious Vlogg, were on their way to deliver goods to the Halon Ring. Along the way, their ship crashed in Farside. Help Spigo recover what he can from his ship in Fatalis Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Spigo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh sure, I could use a hand. I was on a delivery run when my ship veered off course and we crashed here. Will you help me find my ship and cargo?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You, uh, locate my ship yet? There was some real valuable cargo onboard, don't you know?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yep, those traps woulda killed a lesser $(player.race), but you got real skills. Now let's get the fella that's causin' us trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I gotta stay here in case anyone, uh, shows up. You betcha.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yep, he's been a pain in my tail for some time now...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: As you investigated the trail of wreckage, you learned that someone had been laying traps to conceal the location of the crashed ship. You managed to avoid the traps and followed the trail to the wreckage.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I was on an important haul with my mate, Vicious Vlogg, to the Halon Ring when I suddenly lost control. I jumped ship before she crashed, but the cargo I was haulin' was worth a hefty tag. I lost contact with Vlogg after the crash.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You ain't gonna make a lot of friends with that attitude, that's for sure.

localizedTextIdText: After finding the destroyed remains of the Dustrunner, Spigo asked you to check on the cargo. The crash spilled most of its loftite shipment, but the most valuable crystals were kept in a code-locked box strapped inside the hull. Check on this shipment at the Dustrunner crash site to see if anyone has gotten to it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Spigo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I located my ship, darn tootin'. What's left of her, anyway. But the cargo's missing. See if you can't get your hands on it before someone else does.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The cargo is extremely important. And valuable, you betcha! I really need you to find it for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Darkspur! I knew my ol' mate was up to no good. Probably wanted me to show up and give them the code. Good thing you were there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My poor, sweet Dustrunner's haulin' for the Navigator now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Never trust a Krogg as far as you can throw him, you betcha!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Spigo old shipmate, Vicious Vlogg, staged an ambush in order to get Spigo to open the locked loftite box. Spigo shipment is safe for now, thanks to you, but you need to find Vicious Vlogg and bring him to justice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no respect for a fallen ship?

localizedTextIdText: Vicious Vlogg was the cause of the Dustrunner's crash, and he planned to steal the cargo for the Darkspur Cartel. Vicious Vlogg must be brought to justice! Find him near the Dustrunner crash site and take him out!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Inspect a Farside Starship in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My old shipmate was an ex-Cartel thug named Vicious Vlogg. Seems like he was gonna take my cargo for his old buddies, yep. Find where he's holed up.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Vicious Vlogg's a waste of cargo space. He needs to be brought down, and hard. Don't listen to a darned tootin' thing he says!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Vicious Vlogg took off in one of these ships...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Save the last punch for me. I wanna jettison his keester myself, you betcha.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Vicious Vlogg is a crafty one! He managed to give you the slip, taking off in a single-passenger spaceship. Don't let him get away!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why would Vlogg take your stuff?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I don't know, maybe he's still runnin' with the Cartel. I betcha he got back with some of his old Darkspur pals and thought he'd swindle me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me do this myself. I don't really have the guns for it.

localizedTextIdText: Vicious Vlogg is trying to make a quick escape from Farside! There are ships near the Dustrunner crash site. Hop in one, chase him down, and blast him out of the sky.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Confront Vicious Vlogg in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This weathered fighter is in serviceable condition, complete with a fully-operational battle array. If you act fast you can catch up to Vicious Vlogg.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This weathered fighter is in serviceable condition, complete with a fully-operational battle array. If you act fast you can catch up to Vicious Vlogg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alright, alright. I give up...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Frackin'...! I hit my head real hard back there... it stings a bit.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You've got nowhere else to run.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Vicious Vlogg tried to make his escape from Farside, but you were able to blast his ship out of the sky. Find Vicious Vlogg and bring him back to Spigo for his just desserts.

localizedTextIdText: Vicious Vlogg is cornered and down for the count. Escort him back to Spigo in Fatalis Fields so he can get his comeuppance. Be careful, though - a cornered animal is the most dangerous kind!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Spigo in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What's that puny Ekose gonna do to me anyways? Call me names? Hurt my feelings? Ha! I ain't scared of him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Whatcha lookin' at, chump?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I expected you to bring Vlogg back to me. I have some shiphand's justice to dispense, darn tootin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My friend, you are a $2?g/man/gal/critter; of your word - unlike this lowlife scum. Take this as gratitude and leave Vlogg to me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go ahead, take me to him. I'll teach him a thing or two.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: He's going to pay for what he's done, you betcha.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What will you do to him?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Even with all his trickery and deceit, you were able to successfully escort Vicious Vlogg back to Spigo in Fatalis Fields. Spigo thanked you for your help, and now Vlogg's fate is firmly in the Ekose's hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get outta my sight! You're just as weak as that Ekose wimp!

localizedTextIdText: The creatures on the surface of Farside are quite aggressive. It shouldn't be a problem for an adventurer like you to teach them the meaning of fear. Kill space creatures in Fatalis Fields to make the area safer for Spigo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Spigo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Clutch my cargo! These space critters make it hard to move around, you betcha. You mind clearing them out for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Busted bulkheads! This place is still crawling with critters! I can't stand alien animals. They make my skin crawl, yup. Get to killing them, okay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Navigator knows I'd be alien snacks if it weren't for you. I feel a lot safer now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll make it worth your while, darn tootin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait to get off this blasted moon, don't you know....
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I was born to kill alien critters.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: And I feel a little richer now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The creatures of Fatalis Fields haven't seen any new visitors for decades, but they've surely learned not mess with newcomers now.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I was born to kill alien critters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's easy money, you know. Your loss, friend.

localizedTextIdText: Spigo was shipping some loftite from Nexus to the Halon Ring when his ship crashed. Most of the shipment spilled out. Help him collect as much loftite as possible at the Dustrunner crash site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Via Datachorn, report to Spigo in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like my loftite shipment's gone and spilled all over the place! Don't look like much, but could you salvage what you can? I'll be grateful, you bet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This here loftite is set for delivery to the Halon Ring. Not sure why they need gravity defying crystals in space, but there you are.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well now. Seems I'd pay more in penalties for delivering half a shipment than if the whole thing got lost. I might as well keep it then, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A captain's only as good as his reputation, darned tootin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll just include it in my report. One lost shipment is small potatoes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: These might not be the most valuable loftite samples, but at least some of Spigo shipment is better than none at all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Guess you've got better things to do than make some easy money, yeah?

localizedTextIdText: You found the Dustrunner's black box and information on how the ship crashed. From the looks of the data, it seems like someone wanted the ship to crash. You should return this to Spigo in Fatalis Fields and see what he thinks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Spigo in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown:
LOG: #16357
-AUTO-PILOT ENGAGED...
-COORD: NEAREST TERRAIN...
-LANDING SEQUENCE DISENGAGED...
-ESCAPE POD READY...
-AUTHORIZED BY: *****
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted:
LOG: #16357
-AUTO-PILOT ENGAGED...
-COORD: NEAREST TERRAIN...
-LANDING SEQUENCE DISENGAGED...
-ESCAPE POD READY...
-AUTHORIZED BY: *****
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You found the Dustrunner's black box? Well... thanks. But what's done is done, yeah? No need to drag it out into the light. May as well get rid of it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's some more money. No more questions now, yeah? Keep it to yourself.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should return this to Spigo.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Dustrunner's black box and information on how the ship crashed in Farside's Fatalis Fields. Someone engaged the auto-pilot and sent the ship to the ground, as if they wanted the ship to crash. Despite this, Spigo seemed hesitant when you returned it to him.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I should return this to Spigo.

localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's some more money. No more questions now, yeah? Keep it to yourself.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should return this to Spigo.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Dustrunner's black box and information on how the ship crashed in Farside's Fatalis Fields. Someone engaged the auto-pilot and sent the ship to the ground, as if they wanted the ship to crash. Despite this, Spigo seemed hesitant when you returned it to him.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I should return this to Spigo.

localizedTextIdText: Millennial Sidus at the Farmers' Refuge has tasked you with freeing the farmers in the Toiling Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Millennial Sidus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Miss Miggins and the Red Ember Gang have taken over this farm. Our priority is extracting the farmers before they're killed or sold off as slaves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Rescue our farmers from the Red Ember Gang. Ensure that Miss Miggins is executed, because there is no alternative.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have saved the farmers, including Gummer, and ensured that Miss Miggins was terminated. My expectations have been exceeded.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: As for Miggins... if you find her, kill her. Go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is, perhaps, unfortunate that there's more that must be done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Farmer Gummer and the other farmers have been saved from the slave dens of the Toiling Fields.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Who is in charge of the gang?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Red Ember Gang is one of the Darkspur Cartel's vilest gangs.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Clugg the Crazed is the leader of the Red Ember gang. He's claimed this farm for the Darkspur Cartel and is hiding somewhere on the premises.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your answer is undesirable.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin hypothesizes that traces of Nexus's fabled fountain of youth, the Everpool, might be detected in the roots of stumpkins. Uproot Warpwood stumpkins in Fool's Hope and collect their $m(vitem=66) so that Lazarin can analyze them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Collect samples of stumpkin roots so that I might examine them in detail. The roots run deep, they may reveal traces of the Everpool's influence.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I await your delivery of stumpkin root samples... impatiently.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These roots still wriggle with sylvan vitality! Too soon was their life pruned from them by your skillful onslaught.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Everpool is our primary objective, but first it must be found.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Silence! Your struggles were satisfactory. These samples shall suffice.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What do you want me to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected an assortment of $m(vitem=66) for Victor Lazarin in Fool's Hope, risking the wrath of Warpwood Rootgrabber in the process.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get those root samples for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So the Focus of Life is in Wilderrun?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is a pool imbued by the focus of Primal Life on Nexus. Within its depths we may find immortality... and, perchance, a cure for my people's unfortunate predicament.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Of that I am quite certain. It's location, on the other hand, well... that remains to be determined.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal indicates our relationship in future may be somewhat strained.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin believes that analyzing additional water samples collected in the jungles of Wilderrun will point the way to the immortal Everpool, a body of water that holds the Focus of Life. Take the bridge out of Fool's Hope and gather samples from Wilderrun's flora.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These roots are engorged with primal life. Obviously the Everpool is here somewhere, and its effects are far-reaching. We must find the source!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Peruse plant life, both pugnacious and passive, for water samples, and watch out for watering holes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These new samples exhibit higher concentrations of primal life. Perhaps you can locate my other "assistant" and compare notes with him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Water is plentiful in Wilderrun's jungle. It will guide us to our goal!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not despair. We move ever closer to finding the Everpool.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected additional water samples from the flora in Wilderrun. In the process, you've revealed that the new samples contain even more traces of the primal life energy and its restorative properties that will lead Victor Lazarin to the Everpool.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am certain I can find another assistant who will be equally capable.

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Sanders has asked you to recover her zesty seasoning, which she was forced to leave behind, from the Toiling Fields. Understandably, she doesn't want her special recipe to be stolen by the Red Ember Gang.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Sanders via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I escaped from the fields, I did, but was forced to leave behind the last of me zesty seasoning. Would you be a love and recover it for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I left all me zesty seasoning behind in the Toiling Fields. Please get it back... it's all I've got left, it is!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a life-saver, love! You've done me a great service, you have. Best try a pinch of this here seasoning you risked your life to save. Here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I don't want all me hard work stolen by them bloody gangsters. Would you?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You'd best keep me seasoning's secrets to yourself, love.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've recovered Farmer Sanderss zesty seasoning, and it is now safe from the Red Ember Gang's questionable culinary predilections.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, yes, love! I've concocted a zesty blend of herbs and spices that's simply delectable on absolutely everything!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No zesty seasoning for you, then.

localizedTextIdText: Millennial Sidus has tasked you with halting the bingberry bootlegging operation that the Red Ember Gang has set up at the Bingberry Distillery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Millennial Sidus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Red Ember Gang has converted the bingberry fields into a makeshift distillery. Their operation must be completely destroyed. You will see to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The destruction of the Red Ember's bingberry distillery is still pending. I hope your reasons for returning to me are important.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I saw the conflagration from here, $(player.name). Superior work. The bingberry operation may be destroyed, but there are other tasks to complete.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will contact you soon. For now, set explosives on the bingberry stills.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have destroyed the Bingberry Still at the Bingberry Distillery, and you've stopped the Red Ember Gang's supply of bingberry booze. Unfortunately, you lost your eyebrows in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Dominion demands your service.

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Gummer has asked you to recover some fresh bingberries and feed them to the famished field slaves at the Bingberry Distillery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Gummer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some o' my farmers were forced to work at the bingberry distillery. They're weak, and I ain't been fed for a good span. They need your help, they do!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing back here? Those starving farmers need your help! Famished, they is! Feed 'em some bingberries and get 'em on their feet!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did my farmers a favor and got 'em out of that hellhole, guv. I appreciate it, I do! You're a fine $(player.class) in my book!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pass fresh bingberries out to them famished farmers! That should get 'em movin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's a good thing you came along, it is!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The fresh bingberries gave famished farmers the strength they needed to escape from the Darkspur Cartel's Bingberry Distillery.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm doin' fine. More worried about me mates, I am. Those gangsters are none too kind.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Me? I used to run this farm, I did! Was jolly good at it, too! Then Clugg came and took the place over. Enslaved the lot of us, he did!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me beg, mate.

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale has requested some titanium weave armor for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weave armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here, and we're in a heap o' trouble! Dominion's on us like fleas on a jabbit, and we need titanium weave armor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here, and we're in a heap o' trouble! Dominion's on us like fleas on a jabbit, and we need titanium weave armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hope you're here about that titanium weave armor, friend. Them soldiers sure need it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good day to ya, $(player.name). I'll be sure to get these weaves out to the field. We owe you one, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have my thanks, as usual.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted titanium weave armor for Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weave armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: Sabotage! Quartermaster Hillary has noticed that there are some pieces of titanium weave armor missing in Thermock Hold. Craft her some replacements while she hunts down the thieves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold the titanium weave armor you've crafted
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement titanium weave armor needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement titanium weave armor needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, you here about that stolen armor? You don't happen to have replacements, do ya, friend?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be! This'll help us replace what those dirty no-good sabotagin' splorg-slimes made off with! Thanks a bunch, friend!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll get back to the investigation. You've got my thanks, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've replaced the missing titanium weave armor requested by Quartermaster Hillary at Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weave armor to Quartermaster Hillary

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will aid Exile forces in Thermock Hold in battling the Dominion on distant battlefields. Do your part: craft Heavy Armor and take it to Armorer Thaako!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Unless you're bringin' over armor for our troops, I ain't got nothin' for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Word's getting 'round about you, $(player.name). I can see why. This is good stuff. I'll get it shipped out. Thanks, pal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You made it happen, pal. Up top.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted titanium weave armor that will keep the Free Companies fighting the Dominion. Bring our troops home safe!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weave armor to Armorer Thaako

localizedTextIdText: While exploring Wilderrun Chase, you discovered a strange, glowing mushroom seemingly imbued with primal life. Collect more Everglow Mushroom for Victor Lazarin so he can learn if the mushrooms have any alchemical qualities.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Primal Life emanates in waves from this glowing mushroom. You should collect more of these for Victor Lazarin - they might have some alchemical use.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Primal Life emanates in waves from this glowing mushroom. You should collect more of these for Victor Lazarin - they might have some alchemical use.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is it you want? Do you have anything for me... or are you merely lonely?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These mushrooms are glutted with primal life! And they continue to grow, even after being picked. Strange.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall have to research this fascinating fungus. Thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned a plethora of Everglow Mushroom to Victor Lazarin. The mushrooms continue to grow, even after being harvested, a detail that was not lost on Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll be back in a while.

localizedTextIdText: After destroying a strange Tentacular Aberration in the jungles of Wilderrun, you discovered that a small amount of Primal Energy Residue was left behind. Take the Primal Energy Residue to Victor Lazarin in Fool's Hope so that he can analyze it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This primal energy residue, taken from the remains of a strange creature in the jungles of Wilderrun, might be of interest of Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This came from a strange creature, you say? How odd. I have seen such creatures, but only in the void deep space... on asteroids and the like.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I haven't a clue, but I am curious - how did such a creature come to be on this planet's surface?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take it to Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the Primal Energy Residue to Victor Lazarin. Lazarin indicated that the creature you killed was an example of species that is commonly encountered only in deep space. This begs the question - how did it get onto the surface of Nexus?

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin sent Dorian Walker into Widerrun's Undergrove to search for the Everpool, but the aged explorer hasn't reported back yet. Lazarin has advised you to locate Dorian, for he may have valuable information on the location of the legendary pool of immortal youth in Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dorian Walker in the Undergrove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dorian Walker journeyed into the jungle days ago at my behest, yet he has been as silent as the grave. You are approaching his last known location.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why are you here? Should you not be beating the proverbial, or are they literal, bushes in search of Dorian Walker?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I been waitin' too long, skippy. What kept ya?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey there, slick! 'Bout time someone from Fool's Hope showed up. Did Lazarin send ya, or are ya here for the fun of it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If he has not fallen afoul of the forest's fauna, he may yet furnish us with further facts.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Best be on yer toes, champ. The Torine's here, and they ain't happy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Dorian Walker on his hunt for the Everpool in Wilderrun and helped him to fend off an attack by the Torine Sisterhood.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why didn't you mention Dorian before?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You sent Dorian Walker in search of the Everpool?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: To be sincere... it slipped my mind. So intent was I on your discoveries that distraction got the best of me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Well, he is an eminent Exile explorer. After rediscovering Nexus, he's continued to contravene his age by exploring its environs. You can imagine why he's interested in a pool of eternal youth, can't you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Let us say this, he is well beyond the prime age for one of such perilous predilections. I fear he is not long for this mortal coil. Unless, of course, he reaches the immortal waters of the Everpool.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Dorian will survive without you, I am certain. He is a tenacious old fossil.

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker is under attack by the pumera of the Torine Sisterhood in Wilderrun. Help Dorian survive the attack, then join him on his expedition to locate the Everpool.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dorian Walker in the Undergrove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These damn cats! The Torine're sendin' 'em to rip us up, made me drop my datachron! Can ya jump down there and grab it for me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't talk to me! Kill them pumera!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Let's get outta this mess, sport! Then we can talk!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Damn that woman! She blew up my favorite bike! Speakin' of which, are ya okay, chief? That looked like it hurt somethin' awful!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Reckon the Torine don't like us snoopin' around for the Everpool, eh, cappy?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I 'spect the two of us can work together... if ya think ya can keep up.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yeah, I'm fine. Thanks for asking.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Dorian Walker defend himself against the Torine Sisterhood during his expedition to locate the Everpool.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What's the matter sport? Ya scared of a few kitty cats?

localizedTextIdTitle: It Smells Worse on the Inside
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Oxian corpse looks very strange compared to the others. There appears to be something moving around inside the dead beast's belly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You carefully cut the beast open to reveal what's inside it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You stumbled across a strange Oxian corpse. Upon further investigation, you discovered one of the downed pilots had hidden himself inside the corpse to avoid capture.

localizedTextIdText: You've located an ancient crash site in Wilderrun. Toric Antevian is particularly interested in the site, and he has ordered you to investigate it for more clues.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What's this you've found? Some manner of crashed ship? You better take a good look around, right? See what you can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'd like to think you're here 'cause you've got something important to say... but you don't, do you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's my belief this ship may have brought the Blessed Mother, Tresayne Toria, to Nexus. But what happened after?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Looks like it's been here a while. I wonder what mysteries it's hiding...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must, for Lady Tresayne's story is the stuff of legend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After some careful searching around the ancient crash site, you salvage some items that indicate this may have once been an ancient Cassian vessel. This discovery could have deep historical significance for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me send a team to do your job for you.

localizedTextIdText: Toric Antevian believes the downed vessel may have been the ship that carried the legendary Cassian Swordmaiden Tresayne Toria. Check the Wildfall Pell encampments around the ancient crash site for any additional clues.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Wildfall Pell could be in possession of artifacts that may illuminate Lady Tresayne's past. Search their bodies for Cassian keys or baubles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Found any answers among the Pell, now? You may have to use force to get to the bottom of this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good, you have all the pieces. Scions willing, the encryption key should work even after all this time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Give no quarter. The Wildfall have damaged priceless historical artifacts.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's a miracle the key to the Dominion's past was so carefully preserved.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm surprised the Pell kept them all these years.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered the Wildfall Pell have been carrying bits of an old Cassian encryption key. The Pell treated these pieces as treasured baubles and fought ferociously to keep them, but in the end you were able to collect all the necessary pieces.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why is Tresayne Toria so important?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lady Tresayne is a Cassian legend. She was the mother of Dominus the Half-Blood, and a Swordmaiden so renowned for her martial skill and beauty that even the Eldan themselves were smitten by her charms.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Centuries ago she agreed to go with the Eldan, who promised peace and prosperity to the people of Cassus in return. Though Lady Tresayne was never heard from again, her son Dominus the Half-Blood returned and established our glorious empire. For this reason, she is revered as the Blessed Mother.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I don't know what to think, truly I don't. Could the Eldan have brought her here? To Nexus? Surely, she must be long dead by now. The legend of the Cassian Swordmaiden is hundreds of years old.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is our sacred duty to learn the fate of the Blessed Mother.

localizedTextIdText: You've managed to piece together an old Cassian encryption key. Toric Antevian has asked you to search for corresponding data terminals somewhere in Wildfall Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If the Pell held onto the encryption key for this long, surely they must have saved the data, too. See if you can find what the key unlocks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found the corresponding data terminals for the encryption key? I'm certain the Pell would have brought those back from the crash site.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So it was the crew of the Maiden's Offering that was shot down and not Lady Tresayne? That's a relief, I think. But then, what became of her?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Finally, this forgotten part of Dominion history will be revealed to us!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered holo recordings in Wildfall Commune depicting the events leading up to the tragic escape attempt by crew members of the Maiden's Offering, Lady Tresayne Toria's flagship. The ship was shot down by the Eldan, but Lady Tresayne and her followers were no longer aboard.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But we've come so far. Why give up now? This is our moment of victory!

localizedTextIdText: According to the old Cassian holo recordings, the Wildfall Pell were assigned by the Eldan to serve Lady Tresayne and her followers. He suggests you cease hostilities with the Pell and seek out High Priest Life-Bearer in the Wildfall Commune for more information.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with High Priest Life-Bearer in the Wildfall Commune
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Pell mentioned in the recordings... could they mean these Wildfall Pell? Perhaps it is time to lay aside your weapon and seek out answers directly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You've come so far, yet the answers we seek are still hidden. Press onward towards understanding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Outsider. You invade our lands, kill our people. Now you seek answers. We cannot overcome your strength, so ask what you will.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Seek out the Pell high priest or we may never know Lady Tresayne's history.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You speak of the Blademother?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will seek out the Pell leader.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you know of Tresayne Toria?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with High Priest Life-Bearer who revealed that it is the wild women of the jungle, the Torine Sisterhood, who know what happened to Lady Tresayne Toria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your lack of devotion is disappointing.

localizedTextIdText: The High Priest Life-Bearer suggests you travel to the Torine hunting grounds and seek out Freya the Handmaiden. He believes the Torine Sisterhood will know the true fate of Lady Tresayne Toria.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are but humble servants. If you would know of the Blademother, Tresayne Toria, seek out the Torine. Mistress Freya will have answers.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Seek out the Torine at their camp, for it is they whom we serve. Mistress Freya commands us all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you learned the truth of Lady Tresayne's fate? Why do you delay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Blessed Mother must have obtained her eternal youth from the Everpool. Yet there is much I still do not understand. Who is this "Goddess Vitara"?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Prove yourself to Mistress Freya. Only she can determine if you are worthy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is proof that we were destined to come to Nexus!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will find this Mistress Freya.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wonder what she's been doing all this time...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Freya the Handmaiden, but you were met with a less than enthusiastic welcome by the Torine Sisterhood. After proving your worth through single combat against Freya, she revealed that Lady Tresayne is still alive on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will find this Mistress Freya.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How long have you been in these jungles?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We are the Disciples of Life. We serve Vitara, Goddess of Life, and her chosen, the sisters of Toria. This was our task, our given duty, placed upon us by the Masters themselves
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Sisters of Toria are fierce. Their skill with the blade unmatched. Long ago they came to us. Together we guard the sacred lands of Vitara.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Long is the memory of our tribe, but longer still have we dwelled in these green lands. We were here before the Torine, and here we will stay until our Masters return to us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then you will leave us in peace? Good.

localizedTextIdText: You've located an Ancient Crash Site in Wilderrun. Dorian Walker is particularly interested in the site, and he has asked you to investigate it for more clues.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Well, I'll be damned. That crashed ship ya found's an old one, skipper. Older than me, even! Ya better take a look 'round, see what else ya can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You are still searching for clues to the ancient beacon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why ain't you scouted that ancient crash site yet? The razortails 'n' snoglugs chase ya off?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work, champ. Looks like ya found yourself a bonafide vessel of the Cassian Commonwealth. But what's it doin' here in the jungle?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pay attention, slick. Ain't no tellin' where it came from.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't ya go wussin' out on me now, hotshot.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess we'd better find out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After some careful searching around the Ancient Crash Site, you salvage some items that indicate this may have once been an ancient Cassian vessel.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm working on it. Be patient.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I was there, chief, I'd give ya a right good paddlin'!

localizedTextIdText: You investigated the crashed ship and discovered it is of ancient Cassian origin. Dorian Walker wants you to scout around the Wildfall Commune and see if the local Pell might have scavenged anything that might reveal more about the crashed ship.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Activate the Master Terminal in Wildfall Commune
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I reckon these Wildfall Pell have been here a long time, skipper. Maybe they picked stuff up from the wreck that'll tell us more about what happened here.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You find anythin' over by the Wildfall Pell, shooter? If not, keep lookin'. Explorin' is fifty percent effort, fifty percent stick-to-it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Merging data fragments... please stand by. ERROR... ERROR... ERROR....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those Pell have got real sticky fingers when it comes to lootin' technojunk.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered data terminals at the Wildfall Commune that look like they were taken from the ancient crash site. You fought your way through the hostile Pell, who deeply resented your presence in their camp, and were able to access centuries old ship data.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So what is a Cassian Commonwealth ship doing on Nexus?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Does this have anything to do with the Dominion?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Now that's a story for a chronicler to tell, but I think I can manage the gist of it. Before the Dominion came and mucked everythin' up, we humans all lived on Cassus under the banner of the Cassian Commonwealth. None of this highborn, Luminai nonsense, and we didn't have no blasted emperor! That came later.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Well, if I had my guess, it has to do with the legend of the Cassian Swordmaiden. Story goes, the Eldan showed up and demanded the Cassians turn over one of their local heroes, a girl by the name of Tresayne Toria. She took off with the Eldan and was never heard from again. I'm guessin' they came here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You bet your front teeth it does, bucko! So this fella by the name of Dominus shows up a while later, claimin' to be the son of Tresayne. Dominus the Half-Blood, they called him. He goes on to found the Dominion. And a sorrier day there never was.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What, scared of a couple of Pell? I'm ashamed to call you an Exile.

localizedTextIdText: You attempted to access the master terminal, but the ancient piece of junk requires additional power cells to function. Collect power cells from the Wildfall Data Construct in Wildfall Commune to restore the master terminal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Master Terminal in Wildfall Commune
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Additional power cells required. Unable to access file memory.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please insert power cells to access files.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Powering systems... powering systems... SUCCESS. Now accessing files.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: WARNING: Data corrupted. Final data log still available. Play file now?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After retrieving the power cells, you inserted them into the master terminal and accessed the final entries in the captain's data log. You learned that Tresayne Toria was indeed brought to Nexus aboard the ship the Maiden's Offering, but was taken away by the Eldan shortly after. The vessel was shot down by the Eldan when the crew attempted to leave the planet.

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker has asked you to persuade the Wildfall Pell to tell you what they know about Tresayne Toria. Find some Primal Life Essence and complete the ritual to summon the Pell's High Priest Life-Bearer in Wildfall Commune so you can ask him about Tresayne.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with High Priest Life-Bearer in the Wildfall Commune
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Blast it all, we still don't know what happened to Tresayne! I say it's time to ask the Pell's High Priest. Give em an offerin' of primal life essence.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Wildfall Pell ain't too keen on us bein' here, but we gotta talk to High Priest Life-Bearer, and get the answers we need.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What would you ask of me, outsider?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Outsider. You invade our lands, kill our people. Now you seek answers. We cannot overcome your strength, so ask what you will.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Never met a High Priest that could resist some good old primal life essence.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You speak of the Blademother?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I've come to ask about Tresayne Toria.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Simply asking nicely seemed to work out, and High Priest Life-Bearer grudgingly agreed to speak with you about Tresayne Toria.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about these Pell.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I sure would if I knew any more than you did! Far as I can tell, they're mostly ornery folk, don't like us newcomers much. Got a tendency to make a big fuss about scrap metal and junk, 'specially if it's Eldan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Mm, they're a tad less psychotic than most. Maybe the beauty of this jungle rubs off on 'em or somethin'. I seen some back in Galeras when I was explorin' the planet that were just downright crazy! Sacrificin' to some storm god or other! I'd keep clear of them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You young 'uns. No sense of adventure.

localizedTextIdText: The High Priest Life-Bearer suggests you travel to the Torine Hunting Grounds and seek out Freya the Handmaiden. It appears the Pell are servants of the Torine and are forbidden to answer questions about the one they call "Blademother."
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you seek to know more about the Blademother, it is not I you should speak with, but the Torine. They prepare for the hunt not far from here.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Mistress Freya commands us all. If it is questions you must ask, ask them of her. She prepares for the hunt not far from here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I bet the Everpool's kept ol' Tresayne young 'n' spry, chief. Still... I wonder who this Vitara is. A fairy tale, or somethin' more?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We are but humble servants of the Sisters of Toria.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After fighting your way through hostile Torine, you found Freya the Handmaiden and were met with a less than enthusiastic welcome. After defeating her in single combat, she revealed the surprising fact that Tresayne Toria is still alive on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How long have you been in these jungles?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We are the Disciples of Life. We serve Vitara, Goddess of Life, and her chosen, the sisters of Toria. This was our task, our given duty, placed upon us by the Masters themselves.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Sisters of Toria are fierce. Their skill with the blade unmatched. Long ago they came to us. Together we guard the sacred lands of Vitara.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Long is the memory of our tribe, but longer still have we dwelled in these green lands. We were here before the Torine, and here we will stay until our Masters return to us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then you will leave us in peace? Good.

localizedTextIdText: Finlay in wants you to find his brother Sholto. Supposedly his brother left town chasing rumors of a lost treasure and might have headed to Anu Ani, a Lopp village to the north.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Treasure Hunter Ahanu in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ahoy there! I'm looking for someone to track down my brother, Sholto. He ran off with our prospecting gear and I'm worried he's got himself into trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You find that Lopp village yet? I'm thinking my brother went north to hear more rumors from the Lopp up there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp remember strange Ekose - he ran off looking for shinies but never came back. Not surprised, only Lopp treasure hunters find best shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll pay you more than the usual rate, you bet.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess I will find him later.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While trying to find Finlay's missing brother Sholto, you found the Lopp at Anu Ani but they only confirmed that he had stopped there briefly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I saw him talking to a Lopp before he took our mining gear without even a word. Heard there's a whole village of Lopp to the north and I betcha he went there chasing rumors of that treasure.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They say a pirate crew made off with a Dominion cargo ship full of some Noble's treasure on route to Nexus. Some say they hauled it out here and hid it. Don't reckon its still here even if it is true.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your miind, I'll be here.

localizedTextIdText: The Red Ember Gang is using Bootlegger's Landing as a depot to load stolen goods onto their ships. Millennial Sidus has tasked you with disabling the gang's ability to land ships at that location.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Millennial Sidus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Red Ember gang uses a system of satellites to triangulate their landings in a nearby field. Disable that system to cripple their shipping route.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The gang's navigation system at the bootlegger's landing must be disabled. Why are you here speaking to me? You should be there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can only assume the Red Ember's leadership is growing tired of your continued success. I, on the other hand, am quite pleased by it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not fail to disable their shipping route. I will monitor your progress.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We shall now move on to the next stage of our operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disabled the Bootlegger's Landing control panels and crippled one of the Red Ember Gang's shipping routes.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm taking care of it. Really.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Prove your usefulness.

localizedTextIdText: To get the information you need about the marauders Bron Goldenhand plans on making you work for it. First Bron Goldenhand wants you to collect various debts from some bandit gangs around Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You want info on the marauders then first you're gonna do a job for me. Some folks owe me and need to pay up. I don't care what you have to do, just get my money.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I own this port. You want somethin' from me, you gotta earn it. Now get out there and collect my money.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Took you long enough! Now I'm still not sure if I can trust ya but I ain't got much choice! I got a problem that my normal hired muscle can't handle!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Can't have folk thinkin' they can snub me. Tell 'em Bron sent you and don't be askin' gently.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess I'm your new muscle then?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the debts for Bron Goldenhand from bandits around Graylight but Bron has a lot more work in store for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Who are the Fettertons?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: Are you worried about them ganging up on you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: HAHAHA! Near everyone on the cluster with me ownin' everythin' worth ownin' round here, but it's time for the Swiftfell, Blackburns, and Fettertons to pay up for for the week.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They're a bandit gang that deals mostly with slush. I let 'em set up some stills outside of town. As long as they give me my cut their stills don't seem to explode as often.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: A gang of bandits that love everythin' bout fire and blowin stuff up. They're payin' me top dollar to mine some Gravitite nearby. They say addin' it to their bombs make 'em really pop.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: They're a gang of slavers. They owe me for allowin 'em to store their... cargo round here before shippin' it elsewhere.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Na! Ya see they all hate each other! The only reason they don't just start killin'' each other is cause they know that would mess with my bottom line, and they know I run this port and it's best not to mess with my bottom line!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Better reconsider, it's the only way you're gonna get that info!

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand would like you to pick up a delivery of accelerite and deliver it to locations around Graylight. Be warned that once you get in a fight, try to mount something, or stop moving once you start moving the accelerite will explode.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got a shipment of accelerite in today that needs deliverin. Funny stuff accelerite, you start moving you gotta stay moving or it'll blow ya ta bits.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Pick up the accelerite and deliver it to my men. Like I said don't stop moving or BOOM!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work, bout time I found a decent courier. I'll let ya know when I need another shipment delivered.
