localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure you don't try gettin on some mount or in a fight.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to deliver the acelerite to the designated locations in Graylight without blowing up. Of course there will always be more shipments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Guess I have to find another expendable idiot to do some grunt work!

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand would like you to go to Goldenhand's Reach below Graylight and take inventory of his stock while clearing out any Swiftfell bandits that are causing problems.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Here's the situation. The bandits gangs joined up and busted into my cellar and my boys can't handle 'em. Now you get to deal with 'em and check my inventory.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My customers ain't gonna be happy if I have to tell 'em their goods got busted up by bandits, and that you let it happen. Get down there and take care of it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So it was the Darkspur Cartel that got 'em all workin' together! I'll give 'em credit, that was a good power play, but I'm still kickin' and they're gonna regret it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just check and see if stuffs missing. And don't get no stickyfingers either.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll make sure they don't take anything else.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went down to Goldenhand's Reach below Graylight and took inventory of his stock. Seems the Swiftfell bandits tried to plunder what they could, but you drove out the remaining bandits.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I though you said you had the gangs under control!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The kind that garners a high price. You might like to call 'em black market goods.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Normally yes. Since they hate each other so much I never thought they would join together, and my boys can't compete with all of 'em, but if half of the info I dug up on ya is right, then you can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then I don't guess you need that marauder info!

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand needs to find the Darkspur base of operations to get back his Datavault. He believes that since the Darkspur must have a way to communicate with the bandit gangs that he can hack their comm relays to find the Darkspur base. He said you can find the comm relays near the bandit leaders in the Isofringe outside of Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Darkspur hacked me so you're gonna hack them. They gotta talk with the bandits so go and hack their comms and I'll pinpoint the Darkspur's base.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We can't find the Darkspur unless you hack those comm relays in the bandit camps. Now get back out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alright I've got the location of the Darkspur base! Now ya just have to get back my Datavault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The comm relays are probably near the gang leaders.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get the Darspur's location for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You hacked the comm relays of each of the bandit gangs in the Isofringe and pinpointed the location of the Darkspur base.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why can't I just make a deal with the Darkspur for the info I need?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: HAHA! They mighta pulled one over on me, but that don't mean you can too! See the info you need weren't on my Datavault! Look, I'll even make you a deal, get back my datavault and I'll give you every last scrap of info I have on those marauders!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's what I keep all my info on! All my blackmail for keepin' the law off my back, my accounts and passwords, where all my money is, near averythin' that makes me money! Luckily it's encrypted so it will take 'em some time to get at the data!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't help me I don't help you!

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Var-Doph would like you to capture Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for his customers at On the Rocks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Var-Doph at On the Rocks in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Much like the Cosmoling, the Cosmotail are delicious. Unfortunatly, it's hard keeping a supply of Cosmotail when they float away so easily. Mind catching some for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, thank you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for Bartender Var-Doph.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess you're not hungry then.

localizedTextIdText: A Bar Patron at On the Rocks, the Exile bar in Graylight, has heard that you are seeking information about marauders in Halon Ring. He has directed you to Draxa Graystone who is known to share gossip after a long drinking session.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Bar Patron at On the Rocks in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Draxa Graystone is notorious a gossip and a bigger drunk. I say, ya pay her a visit, buy her a drink or two, and see where it gets ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you're still lookin' for Draxa Graystone, she's an On the Rocks regular. She keeps a table at other end of this bar.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hope ya got the information you were lookin' for.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Draxa don't talk to lightweights. Best be ready to drink her under the table.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nice meeting ya, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You drank Draxa Graystone into the ground at On the Rocks, the Exile bar in Graylight, in order to find out that the various marauder clans have been gathering under Redmoon's banner.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you know about the Redmoon?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nothing, and we don't talk about them around here. Try to stay out of trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, it's your choice. Was just trying to help.

localizedTextIdText: Bako handles Bron's dirty work, and would like you to take care of certain individuals that are causing issues in Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bako in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Working for Bron, eh? Then I've got a job for you, under the scanners. Got the name of someone who needs to learn a lesson. Yep, a painful lesson.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Forget who you're looking for? Well, you'll find 'em around, that's for sure. When you've done the work, I'll see to the clean up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad to see you take a job seriously. Check back from time to time. I'll have another name for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The boss runs a tight ship - any troublemaker gets in the way, they tend to... disappear.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See you 'round real soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took care of the designated target in Graylight for Bako and Bron Goldenhand.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You want me to kill someone?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Hey, not so loud, yeah? These targets are people around town, and if they get word that you're after them... well, that's trouble you and I don't want.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The target's name and location is listed in this envelope. Could be anyone, I guess.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if you don't have the heart for it, I don't need you much.

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand would like you to protect his prized brew deep inside Goldenhand's Reach under Graylight from thieving bandits.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got a tip that some Swiftfell are gonna go after the Prized Brew in my personal vault! Get down there quick! Hell, ya can even use my telepad if ya want!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get down to the cellar and protect that my prized brew. That ain't no common slush from some moonshiner's den! Ya can even use my telepad to get there quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like my source is pullin' her weight! Good work stoppin' 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do this right and maybe I'll give ya a sip.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: No one will rest a hand on that brew!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You protected Bron's Prized Brew from thieving bandits in the cellar below Graylight.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: No one will rest a hand on that brew!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe you misunderstood me. I wasn't askin'.

localizedTextIdText: The bandits in Swiftfell Ridge, Blackburn Downs, and Fetterton's Hollow used to work for Bron Goldenhand, until they stole his recipe and started undercutting his operations. Bron Goldenhand is not going to stand for it and has ordered you to kill the bandits that backstabbed him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now I understand these bandits formed an alliance and planned on undercuttin' me the whole time. Kill every last one of these brigands throughout the Isofringe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you back here talking to me? Get back out there and kill every last bandit you find in Swiftfell Ridge, Blackburn Downs and Fetterton's Hollow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that makes me feel all warm and fuzzy deep down inside. Maybe I'll have some of these thugs dipped in gold for good measure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't ya be showing any mercy now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Afraid this is just startin' up.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They won't be causing trouble now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed bandits in Swiftfell Ridge, Blackburn Downs, and Fetterton's Hollow making Bron Goldenhand a happy man, but he's not done with you yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: They're gonna pay for crossing me; don't make me add you to my list.

localizedTextIdText: You have discovered that the Swiftfell bandits of Swiftfell Ridge have setup a slush making operation. Bron Goldenhand wants you to put a stop to it by sabotaging their slush buckets and killing their leader, Cedric Swiftfell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While tracking down the Darkspur you're gonna put those gangs in their place! Start with the Swiftfell, take out their leader Cedric and bring me his hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Put an end to ol' Cedric Swiftfell. That goon betraying me will be the last thing he does! Don't forget to bring me his hand as proof!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's what happens when ya cross me! I'm sendin' in my boys to take over the Swiftfell's operations! Now it's time to take out the Blackburns!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take out some of his men while your at it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You sabotaged the Swiftfell's slush operation and took out their leader. Bron Goldenhand is looking to make some huge profits by staying ahead of the competition anyway he can.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you mean bring you his hand?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I mean kill him and chop off his hand and bring it to me! I'm gonna put it up as a warnin' to anyone who thinks they can cross me!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't no one else got the info you need!

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand wants you to destroy any stolen Graylight drills in Blackburn Downs and kill the Blackburn family's leader, Leander Blackburn.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A punk named Leander is leader of the Blackburn gang. Take him out and bring me his hand as proof! Oh yea and beat down a few of his boys too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My sources tell me Leander is still alive! You got a compellin' reason for why that is? Now get out there and finish the job!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hmm. Guess you ain't so bad after all! My boys should be there soon to take over! Now it's just the Fettertons left, I hope you got what it takes to finish this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make 'em really regret it!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Who's in charge of the Fettertons?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the stolen Graylight drills you discovered in Blackburn Downs. Bron Goldenhand was pleased to have his opposition's plans foiled.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: HA! Like you really got a choice!

localizedTextIdText: You found some dynamite that could be rigged up to the Swiftfell's supply ship in Swiftfell Ridge to destroy it. Bron Goldenhand would appreciate any damage you can inflict on his competitors.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I just got me an idea for when you get to those rotgutted Darkspur! You gather up some of that there slush and some Gravitite and keep it handy for later!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Listen for my plan to work you're gonna need that slush and some Gravitite! So get to gatherin' it up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good! With those ingredients ya should be able ta make some very flashy bombs! We'll put 'em ta good use when we find some Darkspur ships!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Darkspur gonna wish they never messed with me!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope this was worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rigged up some dynamite and lit up the Swiftfell supply ship, rendering it useless. Bron Goldenhand appreciated your initiative in protecting his profits.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: HEHEHE! A flashy one! All you need ta know now is that we need Slush and Gravitite! Now get ta work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's a special crystal that has... unique effects on gravity! The Blackburns have been minin' it for a while now, and payin' me for the privilege!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It's pretty tough stuff, but since we need this fast I suppose ya could blow up their drills. The explosions should be enough to dislodge some Gravitite.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Trust me you'll enjoy what I have in mind!

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=73614) wants you to investigate a growing Marauder threat in the Halon Ring. She's asked you to travel to Halon Ring and speak with Deadeye Brightland in the High Stakes bar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Deadeye Brightland in the High Stakes bar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hate to bother ya, sugar, but Deadeye was checkin' on Marauder activity in the Halon Ring. I haven't heard a peep from him since. Mind checkin' on him?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I'm worried! Deadeye hasn't checked in since he left for the Halon Ring. Didn't ya say you'd pay him a visit for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whaddya want? Can't ya see I'm kinda busy here, and the luck of the draw ain't doin' me any favors.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck! He's probably a few bottles deep by now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Redmoon Marauders? I'm afraid I'm in a bind, or I'd fill ya in.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Deadeye Brightland in the High Stakes bar. Unfortunately, he's occupied by an intense card game with Corrigan Doon and in no mood to talk about Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya want to rewind and try that again, sugar?

localizedTextIdText: Some refugees are trying to escape the iron grasp of Bron Goldenhand. Bron is not happy about this and wants you scare the refugees back to Graylight by drawing skug to Rockbottom Refuge with hookfoot meat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like some refugees are tryin' to pack up and leave again! Get some fresh hookfoot meat and place it in their camp to lure out some skug. That should scare 'em back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's easy, just get the hookfoot meat and place it around the refugee's camp. That will bring in some skug and scare 'em right back to Graylight.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: HAHA! I made a killin selling all the junk from that refugee camp! Not to mention all the fees I charged the refugees for moving back in to Graylight! Here your cut.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: And when their gone I'll send in my boys to "salvage" what's left of their camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll give ya a call when they try that again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The people of Rockbottom Refuge were quite stubborn and refused to move until you drew out a skug queen in the middle of town. That being the final straw the refugees moved back to Graylight.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you care about these refugees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I don't care about them, but I do care about the money they owe me! They can leave just soon as they pay me! Although I might have ta add a few plat to their markers for this little stunt!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Never expected ya to lose your backbone!

localizedTextIdText: You found a lopp captured by the Fetterton bandits in Fetterton's Hollow. Bron Goldenhand would like you to free the enslaved citizens so they can return to Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Emmeline is the leader of the Fettertons! It's the same deal as the last ones, kill her, her men, and bring me her hand! Also break them slaves free!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I really hate repetin' myself! Go kill Emmeline and her men. Don't forget to bring me her hand as a souvenir, and free those slaves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: And now the Fettertons belong to me as well! Not bad for a days work, I shoulda taken 'em over months ago!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Really bust 'em up for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disrupted the Fetteron family's plans to sell a bunch of enslaved Graylight patrons at Fetterton's Hollow.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you care about the slaves?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Some of them are Graylight regulars and I make more money with them here than there!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You better hurry up and accept before I forget the info you want!

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand wants you to use a shield disruptor to disable the barriers around the Blackburn rocket turrets around Blackburn Downs and then take their energy cells. Once you've acquired the energy cells, head back to Graylight and power up the turrets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: After all this double crossin' I'm thinkin' I need to buff up security! Use an EMP to access the Blackburn's turrets and get me their energy cells!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Make sure to use that EMP blaster to take down the shields on the rocket turrets. Then it's easy pickings from there. Take the energy cells and bring 'em here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice job. Time to configure the targeting systems and we'll be in control of the skies over Graylight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't forget ya gotta blast those shields with the EMP blaster first.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disable the Blackburn rocket turrets around Blackburn Downs and brought the energy cells back to power up turrets for Bron Goldenhand in Graylight.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want energy cells?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The last thug I hired to maintain the turrets in Graylight is no longer employed and is in no condition to do... work. So the cells in my turrets have gone bad and need to be replaced.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did ya find someone else with the info ya need?

localizedTextIdText: You found a Lopp village and were stopped by a lookout. Seems the Lopp are not very trusting and want you to report to Chief Balwa. If he confirms that you are not a threat to the Lopp of Anu Ani you should be able to discover why the Lopp are so agitated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Balwa in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Intruder! Lopp have you! If you're here to steal shinies, Lopp will be stabbing you many times. Lopp change mind if Chief Balwa gives word.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Must talk to Chieftain or Lopp have no reason welcome you to Anu Ani.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You better have something for Lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp have big problem. Bloodrock Butchers turn on Lopp and steal many shinies. So many shinies. Must get shinies back. Maybe you here to help?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You talk to chief quick or Lopp might spear you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Something must be done to get more shinies.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Fine, I'll talk to the Chief.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Stop threatening me and I'll help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Chief Balwa informs you that they've had some bad incident with a group called the Bloodrock Butchers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp not have time for you.

localizedTextIdText: Chief Balwa in Anu Ani wants you to search Bloodrock Scanners for the location of a hidden treasure and kill the Bloodrock mercs in the Bloodrock Encampment to get revenge for the Lopp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Chief Balwa via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bloodrock Butchers agree help Lopp find great lost treasure but betray us. You help Lopp kill them and find treasure? Search their scanning machines, find treasure!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go Bloodrock camp north of Anu Ani and search scanner machines for location of treasure. While there, put spear through Bloodrock guts many times!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that chief know treasure's location, chief get all the shinies for self! No Lopp or big-folk take shinies from me! ALL shinies mine!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp must have revenge and shinies!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You stay away. All shinies will be mine!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Bloodrock only recently found the location of a possible treasure cache somewhere underground. Chief Balwa managed to acquire the data and is now trying to seize the treasure for himself.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lopp know story about lost treasure hidden in cave, but scary creatures would eat Lopp. Lopp hire Bloodrock to find cave and kill scary creatures so Lopp can have new shinies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lopp hear that the Bloodrock want to forge own path.  Bloodrock don't side with Exiles.  Bloodrock help anyone for the right price.  Bloodrock help Lopp with shinies.  Bloodrock steal Lopp shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why you tease Lopp? You want to be Lopp stew?

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Kabay in Anu Ani wants you to recover their Stolen Shinies from the Bloodrock Butchers in the Bloodrock Encampment and look for his missing friend, Apprentice Nima.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Apprentice Kabay over the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp lost many shinies in fight with Bloodrock Butchers. They kill Lopp and steal our shinies. Also friend Lopp Shine-Seeker Nima still no come home.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bloodrock Butchers dead yet? Go north of Anu Ani, kill them, bring Lopp shinies back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You brought back shinies and brought Nima home! You great friend to Lopp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope Nima is okay.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You make Lopp happy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Apprentice Kabay at Anu Ani recover some of their precious shinies from the Bloodrock Butchers. You also found the missing Lopp, Apprentice Nima, and freed her from captivity.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nima is friend lopp that try to find great treasure. She could be mighty treasure hunter one day if she lives long enough... and finds many shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If not here help to Lopp, stop bothering Lopp!

localizedTextIdText: Millennial Sidus has tasked you with eliminating Lain the Oppressor. The Millennial warned that Lain the Oppressor always travels with bodyguards. You are going to need some extra firepower if you are going to challenge them - perhaps you can find something to help you in Bootlegger's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Millennial Sidus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lain the Oppressor and his bodyguards have been spotted in the area. Appropriate some of the gang's heavier weapons to neutralize him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We can speak about your next assignment when Lain the Oppressor has been executed. You may find the cartel's weapons effective against him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The odds were against you, yet you prevailed against Lain the Oppressor. Now that the Red Ember gang has been beaten back, it is your time to strike.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lain is a high-ranking cartel enforcer. Eliminate him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to eliminate Lain the Oppressor and his gang of enforcers. That Red Ember firepower has got some kick!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lain the Oppressor is one of only a few Cassians to hold significant rank within the Darkspur Cartel. He is a proud fool who is quick to cut the throat of anyone who challenges him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Explain your reluctance at once.

localizedTextIdText: Vigilant Scribe Celia met you near the landing pad in Fort Vigilance and asked you to present yourself to Toric Antevian at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings, citizen! The Vigilant Star, Toric Antevian, has requested an audience with you. You will submit to his request without delay.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Were I you, I would not keep the Vigilant Star waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can I help you, citizen?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well... if it isn't one of the Dominion's rising stars. Allow me to welcome you to Fort Vigilance, our gateway to Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will find him here, in Fort Vigilance, at his camp. Scions guide you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I feel that our strength and virtue may be tested here.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Of course I'll speak to him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At his request, you met with the leader of the Radiant Legion, Toric Antevian.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What is the leader of the Vigilant Legion doing here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What does Toric want with me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Wilderrun has immense strategic value. Toric Antevian and Lady Artemis Zin have been sent here to make sure this place remains safely in Dominion hands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Toric is looking to recruit new adventurers who embody all the Vigilant Virtues. He believes you may be a suitable candidate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Toric will hear of your cowardice.

localizedTextIdText: Dominion communications equipment is on the fritz due to Wilderrun's intense humidity. Toric Antevian has ordered you to locate and repair the four Dominion communications relays in the vicinity of Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Communications are down, and that won't do. Seamless coordination is necessary for a successful operation. Can you get our network running again?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our communications systems are still out. What's your ETA on repairing the comm relays?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! You're coming through loud and clear... but so is another signal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what I like to hear. There's no work what should be beneath us.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's affirmative... and it isn't a Dominion broadcast, either.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can fix the comm relays.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You repaired the four Dominion communications relays in Fort Vigilance for Toric Antevian, and the newly-repaired relays have revealed something out of the ordinary.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This task is likely to be the simplest you will face for some time.

localizedTextIdText: Now that all four Dominion comm relays are functional, a coded Exile signal has been discovered outside of Fort Vigilance in Wilderrun. Toric Antevian has ordered you to locate the signal's origin and decrypt the coded message it is sending.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's confirmed, we've intercepted an Exile code. Since you're already in the field, I want you to track down the signal's source and decrypt the code.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why haven't you located the source of the Exile signal? I expected more from you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My suspicions have been confirmed. The Exiles are here. I suspect things are about to get bloody.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let's find out what they're up to, yeah?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked the Exile signal to its origin, an Exile communications relay in Discovery Heights. The coded message, sent by Victor Lazarin, indicates that the Exiles are close to making a critical discovery. However, the specifics of this discovery are still clouded in mystery.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Take a hard look in the mirror and remember what you're fighting for.

localizedTextIdText: Kevo, Artemis Zin bodyguard and confidante, has lost touch with his mistress. He has asked you to proceed into Discovery Heights and search for clues that might lead you to Lady Zin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Artemis Zin in Wilderrun Chase
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have need of your skill, hunter. Artemis Zin ran off into the jungle chasing after the famed Everpool, and I could use your help in tracking her down.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lady Zin's whereabouts still remain unknown. Do you fancy yourself a hunter?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did Kevo send you? What took you so long? We have to stay ahead of that bag of bones, Dorian Walker, so the glory of the Everpool will belong to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lady Zin cannot resist leaving signs of her passage behind.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found signs of Artemis Zin that led to Wilderrun Chase where she was confronting wild cats of the jungle.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What is Artemis doing in the jungle?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lady Zin is searching for the Everpool, but I suspect she has encountered some kind of complication.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Dorian Walker, one of the Exile mongrels, also searches for the Everpool. Lady Zin would never allow him to make such a discovery first.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It is a pool imbued by the focus of Primal Life on Nexus. It is rumored to hold properties of immortal youth, for which my lady is interested.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will remember this, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: You located Artemis Zin in Wilderrun Chase, only to find her under attack by pumera. Help Artemis defend herself from the attacking creatures, then meet up with her at the rally point.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Artemis Zin at the rally point in Discovery Heights
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These damnable felids don't know when to give up! Bloody things made me drop my datachron. Can you teach them a lesson while you recover it for me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This isn't really the time, or the place, to initiate a conversation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing here? I thought I... didn't you... oh, never mind!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Quite a soirée, hm? And the lovely barbarian woman that showed up at the end? They'll need to do better than that to keep me from the Everpool!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take care, this lot looks hungry!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't worry about Dorian beating us to the Everpool. I left him a gift that should slow him down.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll drive off a few pumera.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to defend Artemis Zin from the pumera that were attacking her. Once the pumera and their Torine mistress were dealt with, you located Artemis Zin rally point in Discovery Heights and met her there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I refuse to go down there myself. It's muddy!

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon is struggling to defeat Deadeye Brightland in a game of cards at High Stakes. Attempt to distract Brightland in order to help Corrigan win the game.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Corrigan Doon at High Stakes
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is a high stakes game. We can discuss Marauders, or whatever else you'd like, but I need to win first. Think you can distract Brightland for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you going to distract Brightland? He's pretty savvy for a guy with one eye, and I can't produce an extra ace unless his attention is diverted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a relief! Don't tell Cosine, but if I'd lost, Deadeye would have a new navibot. Now... what was it you wanted, oh distracting one?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you don't get it right, there's going to be some shooting.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your successful distraction of Deadeye Brightland, which allowed Corrigan Doon to win their card game, Doon has agreed to provide you with information about the Marauders in Halon Ring so that you can get to the bottom of whatever they're up to.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you won't help me out of this bind, then I've got little to say to you.

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon wants you to talk to Ish'amel the Bloodied, one of his contacts in Deadman's Landing. Doon figures that Ish'amel should be able to shed more light on what the Marauders in Halon Ring are up to.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Ish'amel the Bloodied in Deadman's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you're keen to know what the Marauders are up to, best head to Deadman's Landing. I've got a contact there name of Ish'amel the Bloodied. Chat him up.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I thought you were looking to go to Deadman's Landing to chat with Ish'amel? Don't just stand there, mate. There's a teleporter across the spaceport.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whatever ye think I did, it wasn't me! I swear on me mother's peg leg! It were another handsome Oghra scallywag... only not named Ish'amel. Aye!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's a teleporter to Deadman's Landing outside. I'll meet you in a while.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Doon sent ye? In that case, be keepin' yer voice down!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Doon's suggestion, you met Ish'amel the Bloodied, one of his Marauder contacts, in Deadman's Landing. Hopefully Ish'amel can shed some light on what his peers are up to in Halon Ring.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, I'm not going to twist your arm. You want to stay here, then stay.

localizedTextIdText: Ish'amel the Bloodied wants you to use a disguise to infiltrate a meeting of the Marauder leadership in Holodeck Hideaway. This meeting might just help explain why the Deadstar, Grimvoid, and Redmoon Marauders aren't at each others throats and instead seem to be working together.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now's yer chance t'put that disguise to good use. Put it on, then see if ye can get into the parley 'n find out what they're up to!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't ye have a parley to get to? Make sure ye dress the part. That is to say, wear yer bloody Marauder disguise!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Any clue what the Marauders are planning? You had best speed things up. The more sober I get, the less optimistic I feel about this whole mess.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bloody hell! That was Mordechai Redmoon, risen from the dead! And if that Draken witch, Laveka, intends to bring expired Marauders back to life...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As much as I'd love to turn tail and run, I'd better lend you a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infiltrated the meeting of Marauder leadership and discovered that the Deadstar, Grimvoid, and Redmoon Marauders are all working under Mordechai Redmoon. With the help of Laveka's blood magic, Mordechai Redmoon is back from the dead and plans to use all the Marauders in his army.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ye won't find out much by walkin' away.

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon plans to fly in and provide you with some back-up. To ensure his landing is smooth, he wants you to destroy the Deadstar and Grimvoid Anti-Air Launcher in the vicinity of Deadstar Valley and Grimvoid Pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm a man of my word, I am, so I'm flying in to help you. The Marauders have set up anti-air launchers nearby, though, and I need them destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My scopes are still showing the Marauders' anti-air launchers as active. Don't tell me you haven't destroyed them yet... have you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I don't usually crash, but when I do, I run afoul of stray asteroids on my way down. At least I'm in better shape than the bloody ship is.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: After that mess, you can bet I'm entirely too sober for my own liking.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Anti-Air Launchers and cleared the skies for Corrigan Doon. Unfortunately, his ship was brought down by an asteroid in the dangerous space surrounding the Borellian Cluster.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Let me explain something. You scratch my back, I scratch yours. Get it?

localizedTextIdText: Madame Ella explains that if you're looking for work you could try your hand as a bodyguard. Halon Ring can be a rough place. She's asked that you escort a companion around Graylight while he brings in some business.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Madame Ella in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have all the companions we need but if you're looking for work you could try your hand as a bodyguard. Escort a companion through Graylight while he brings in some business.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Once you accept a job, I expect it gets done. Now my companions need an escort.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks $(player.name). You've done well, might wanna consider bodyguard as a career. Come by later and I may have some more work for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good to hear! Just don't be handling the merchandise.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you're ever looking for a companion, you know where we're at.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I can handle that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully guarded a Graylight Companion through Graylight. It seems the citizens of Graylight greatly appreciate the companions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself. Plenty more folks in Halon Ring looking for work.

localizedTextIdText: The Grimvoid Datachron you found contains a series of codes - 2431, 2353, 2077. You figure they must unlock something in Grimvoid Pass. Look around and see what you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Marauder datachron holds a series of access codes - 2431, 2353, 2077. These codes must unlock something in Grimvoid Pass.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This Marauder datachron holds a series of access codes - 2431, 2353, 2077. These codes must unlock something in Grimvoid Pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I saw some terminals in the Grimvoid camp. Might be these codes of yours could prove useful there. Why don't you give it the old Corrigan try?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I love tales about good, old-fashioned mutinies. Given the average intelligence among Marauders, I'm surprised they don't have them more often.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It must've been quite a sight.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've used the codes you found to crack the terminals in Grimvoid Pass, and this restored power to a nearby exo-lab teleporter. The data you uncovered seems to indicate there was a conflict between this band of Grimvoid Marauders and their captain over the exo-lab.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find out what the codes are for.

localizedTextIdText: You found a Marauder whose undead condition left him skinless over time. Before this development, the Marauder frequented Madame Ella's reputable establishment. Madame Ella was forced to deny him further service due to his appalling condition.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sorry, but we can no longer serve you at Ella's Orbital Lounge. Your condition is distracting to the customers and their companions. \n-Madame Ella
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sorry, but we can no longer serve you at Ella's Orbital Lounge. Your condition is distracting to the customers and their companions. \n-Madame Ella
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a Marauder whose undead condition left him skinless over time. Before this development, the Marauder frequented Madame Ella's reputable establishment. Madame Ella was forced to deny him further service due to his appalling condition.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Enclosed, find a bill for the remaining amount on your tab at Ella's Orbital Lounge. Please remit payment at your earliest convenience.

localizedTextIdText: Ish'amel the Bloodied wants you to smack Redmoon Advocate to find out what information they're spreading to the Deadstar Marauders in Deadstar Valley. It seems the Redmoon have recently started trying to recruit other Marauders to their cause.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ish'amel the Bloodied via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I seen advocates from the Redmoon Marauders talkin' to the Deadstar 'n handin' out notices. Try shakin' 'em down and see what ye can learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Redmoon advocates be handin' out notices to the Deadstar swabs. Slap 'em around 'n maybe ye can find out what they be up to.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mordechai Redmoon? Blight me soul! If I weren't stuck adrift without a ship, I'd be headin' for the Darkspur Nebula.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: C'mon, it can't be that bad.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You convinced some Redmoon Advocate to drop the information they'd been spreading and learned that the great Mordechai Redmoon is back after disappearing in Skullcano. Mordechai promises all Marauders that join the Redmoon an endless supply of plunder, loot, and power.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are the Redmoon advocates here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Grimvoid, Deadstar, 'n Redmoon Marauders be at each other's throats most've the time. The Redmoon must be up to somethin' if they want to swell their ranks with Deadstar swabs.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Redmoon were skulkin' in the shadows until recently. Might be they got a new captain. They been without a leader since 'ol Mordechai Redmoon vanished.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If ye be changin' yer mind, ye know where t'find me.

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon wants you to collect Ranged Training Core from Necrodust Urn in Redmoon Reach. After consulting with Mondo Zax, it seems a potion can be made from necrodust that might protect you from the effects of Laveka's necromancy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm not fond of Necromancy. I consulted with the Zax before I left High Stakes, and he said I might be able to make a protective potion out of necrodust.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Zax is a lunatic, but he's one of the brightest minds in the empire. I'm sure the potion will work splendidly... or it'll kill us stone dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's quite a bit of necrodust you have there. It should be more than enough for the protective potion I have in mind. Let's hope it does the trick.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Try to not die before I finish this potion. That would be bad.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Ranged Training Core in hand, Corrigan Doon plans to make a potion that he hopes will fortify the body against Laveka's powers once you're inside the Doomfarer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do you know about necrodust?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Once you found out that Laveka was involved here, I did a little bit of research into Draken necroshamans. Talk about ugly customers! The last thing I want is to rise from the dead as one of her zombie slaves. Not that I plan on dying, you understand.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't mind your bits falling off, fine. I'll do it myself.

localizedTextIdText: Necroshamans are utilizing giant Blood Cauldron to raise creatures from the dead. Corrigan Doon has asked you to investigate and shut down the cauldrons in the vicinity of Redmoon Reach.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: By the light! Laveka's necroshamans are using giant 'blood cauldrons' to create undead monsters in Redmoon Reach. Can you destroy them? My hands are full.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How about those blood cauldrons you said you'd destroy? Do us both a favor and get it done!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I commend you on your destruction of the blood cauldrons. We should try to find Laveka now so we can take her out of the equation.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take a look at those cauldrons.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disrupted the necroshamans and destroyed Blood Cauldron throughout Redmoon Reach. The cauldrons were used to reanimate the Marauders, creating undead minions for Laveka.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you certain? Laveka's undead army is the cornerstone of her plan!

localizedTextIdText: Looks like the Marauders have accumulated a large amount of treasure in Deadstar Valley. They probably won't even notice if you take some of it. You know... for safe keeping.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Ish'amel the Bloodied in Deadman's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Marauders in Deadstar Valley have accumulated quite a large amount of treasure. They probably won't even notice if you take some of it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There's still plenty of treasure for the taking. Get out there and fill your boots!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Got a wee bit o' treasure for the takin', do ye? I surely wouldn't mind a portion of the booty for me own usage, if ye catch me drift.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Acquired some treasure, eh? Y'best be leavin' some o' that treasure here with me! Least y'can do for an ol' friend, methinks.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I don't mind if I do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've taken some treasure from the Deadstar Marauders. They won't miss it, and Ish'amel the Bloodied appreciated getting a cut of the booty.

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon is planning to take the fight to Laveka the Dark-Hearted at the wreckage of the Doomfarer in Redmoon Reach, and he wants you by his side. Are you ready to rumble?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is it, sure enough. Nothing left to do but put that wicked witch out of our collective misery. Do me the kindness of not dying right away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Laveka's still alive and kicking. Last I checked, that wasn't part of our plan. Whose side are you on again?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Praise Dominus! I'm glad that's all over with. Even though she's not dead, we've put a wrinkle in Laveka's plans, we have. What say we get drunk?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That sounds like a fine idea.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Corrigan Doon found Laveka the Dark-Hearted and put a stop to her reanimation rituals. Unfortunately, Mordechai Redmoon swooped in and rescued Laveka before the final blow could be dealt.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I heard a rumor that Mordechai gave the Doomfarer to Laveka as a gift after they joined forces. I'd never figured that Marauder for being so... sentimental.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Excuse me? Do you want that witch to turn you into a zombie?

localizedTextIdText: You've located a torn journal page detailing a Marauder's confession of guilt. He's terrified of the ghost of Captain Yokuzi and suggests the captain's glass eye, pistol, and ring can be used to banish it. Unfortunately, you'll need to recover the items from the Marauders in Redmoon Reach and place them at the nearby Marauder bone pile.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ish'amel the Bloodied via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A torn journal page tells of the ghost of Captain Yokuzi. It says his stolen items - a glass eye, a pistol, and a ring - must be used to banish his spirit.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You must recover all of Captain Yokuzi's stolen items - a glass eye, a pistol, and a ring - from the Marauders in Redmoon Reach.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't know nothin' about it, but... ye really should be findin' those items if y'plan to perform that space-blasted ritual and banish Captain Yokuzi!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Banished a ghost pirate, did ye? That's a fine tale, lubber. Now that ye mention it, I may have heard 'bout a mutiny awhile back.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yeah, let's not try that again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to gather the items stolen from the deceased Captain Yokuzi and return them to a Marauder grave site. Surprisingly, placing the items near the bone pile summoned a disturbing creature of slime and bones. Once it was defeated, the Captain's ghost was banished for good.

localizedTextIdText: Necromantic items, such as Blackbone Brazier inside the Doomfarer, are overflowing with dark energy and fueling Laveka's evil spells. In order to weaken Laveka's ever-increasing power, Corrigan Doon wants you to destroy as many Blackbone Brazier as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are suspicious-looking braziers inside the Doomfarer, and they're seething with evil magic. I'd like you to destroy them, if you would.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Laveka's much more powerful than I thought she'd be. If the braziers inside the Doomfarer are boosting her power, you should ensure they're destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Laveka's much more powerful than I thought she'd be. If the braziers inside the Doomfarer are boosting her power, you should ensure they're destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Braziers destroyed? Splendid! That should throttle back Laveka's trickery for a bit. Even if it doesn't, Halon's better off without those things.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Laveka is drawing power from them, it's best that you break them all.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope we're close to being done, I do. I've been sober for far too long.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Blackbone Brazier destroyed, the Doomfarer - Laveka's base of operations - should provide less necromantic energy for Laveka's wicked spells.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would it help if I said "please"? How about "pretty please"?

localizedTextIdText: ((Craft Type II Xenocite Equipment))
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Craft Type II Xenocite Equipment

localizedTextIdText: ((Craft Type III Xenocite Equipment))
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Craft Type III Xenocite Equipment

localizedTextIdText: ((Craft Capstone V-4 Harbinger Series equipment))
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Craft Capstone V-4 Harbinger Series equipment
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Craft Capstone V-4 Harbinger Series equipment

localizedTextIdText: Millennial Sidus has ordered you to destroy the last of the Red Ember gang members around Clugg's Manor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Millennial Sidus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The last of the Red Embers have taken up sniping positions around the farmhouse. They've also deployed automated turrets. Clear them out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The remnants of the Red Ember gang and their defensive emplacements have yet to be destroyed. Why the delay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've reclaimed the farm, but there's another issue to deal with before your work is done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This is going to be difficult. Do not underestimate your foes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have killed the last of the Red Ember Gang's members around Clugg's Manor. Only their leader, Clugg the Crazed, remains to be defeated.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fear is a product of weakness.

localizedTextIdText: Fenra Skytree wants you to kill Mystwing Ravenok and rescue her Aurin and Mordesh colleagues from Bramble Trap in Greenleaf Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lucy Lazarin in Mystwood Forest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's terrible! The forest is angry, and it's trying to hurt us! Members of the expedition are trapped by brambles. And then there's the birds!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Those birds are still out there. Can't you hear them? Free my friends and drive off the ravenok before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The forest has gone mad. Its creatures are angry and aggressive. Find and free our fellow Exiles, but beware of fanged and feathered foes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am grateful. Another Exile has survived the sudden onslaught of the forest. What could have caused such sudden hostility?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Free the Aurin and Mordesh trapped in brambles and protect them from ravenok.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My father has sent me here on a mission. We must find the cause of nature's hostility.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought ravenok in Greenleaf Glade and saved Aurin and Mordesh Exiles from the Bramble Trap that waylaid them.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I won't let any harm come to them!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Slow down! Has the forest gone crazy?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Something has driven the ravenok into a frenzy, and thorny brambles have coiled up from the ground, ensnaring some of my friends! They need help!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: THE expedition, silly. We're here with Queen Myala to make Nexus our new home... only things aren't going as planned.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I don't know, but I'm sure the queen does! She's wise and powerful!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why would you abandon us? I don't understand.

localizedTextIdText: The Mordesh camp at Whisperwind Hollow has been overrun by Ravenous Mordesh. Lukas Piotrev has asked you to fight your way through the Ravenous Mordesh. Then you can put Infected Alchemist out of their misery before the Contagion overcomes them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lucy Lazarin in Mystwood Forest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many of my associates have been assailed by Ravenous Mordesh. Put them out of their misery before the Contagion conquers them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If left to the Contagion's virulence, my companions will devolve into feral, hungry beasts and spread their infection. Help them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you come from Whisperwind? What news do you bring? Are my people still suffering?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Madness governs the flora and fauna of the grove! What has caused this? We cannot be certain, yet we must forge ahead towards our goal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This Mortalus Serum will ease their agony, granting a permanent pardon from their pain.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We can mourn the fallen later. For now, we must get to the root of the grove's rage.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help them on their journey.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully made your way through the Ravenous Mordesh in Whisperwind Hollow, and you laid a number of Infected Alchemist to rest before the Contagion infected them.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll do what I have to!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Do you want your colleagues killed?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The beasts and plants of the forest rose up and smote us! It happened without warning, and it ended just as quickly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It would seem so. Our experiments were spoiled, our alchemists attacked, and our test subjects - the Ravenous - escaped into the darkest corners of the wood.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: As you must know, the Contagion turns Mordesh who succumb to its sickness into ravening creatures that hunger for warm flesh.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: There is no other choice. Either they die now and rest in peace, or they surrender to the Contagion and bolster the ranks of the Ravenous.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Outside of death, these unfortunates have no hope of salvation. Please reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has asked you to collect $m(vitem=86) from Grove Guardian east of Elderoot Refuge so he can power an espernetic interface device.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My espernetic interface lacks the power required to awaken Elderoot. I surmise I can adapt living cores from Grove Guardians to fuel the interface.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Each Grove Guardian has a living core in its center. The primal life that flows from these cores can power my espernetic interface.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Competently completed, my young comrade. We are one step closer to awakening the great tree!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then go. Stop wasting time!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us see if the living cores are compatible with Elderoot's cybernetic systems....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered $m(vitem=86) from Grove Guardian to further Victor Lazarin research into the ancient tree known as Elderoot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What will powering the device accomplish?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Victor Lazarin, an alchemist of some notoriety. You might say that my actions have saved - and condemned - more souls than you shall ever know.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: In layman's terms, it is a device which allows creatures of different physical compositions to communicate telepathically.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I fervently hope it will awaken Elderoot from his slumber. Properly awakened, he should be able to answer my questions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Our need is great. Would you stand in the way of progress?

localizedTextIdText: Ish'amel the Bloodied in Deadman's Landing wants you to assemble a Marauder disguise by collecting $(vitem=82) and $(vitem=83) in Deadstar Valley.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ish'amel the Bloodied via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There be a great parley happenin' soon, and they won't let a $(player.race) like ye in there.  If ye wish to attend, you'll be needin' a disguise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To procure yer disguise, you'll be wantin' to take Y'methu's hat and Mokov's holo-gribbon. You'll fit right in once you're properly outfitted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Methinks it weren't no easy task to get yer disguise, but ye did a fine job. Try t'clean the blood off the hat, but if ye can't... I doubt anyone'll notice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ye best be ready for a fight. Marauders don't just give their assets away!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You'll look t'be a fine Marauder in that garb!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That shouldn't be hard to get.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to best the Deadstar's lieutenants and acquired enough Marauder garb to manufacture a proper disguise. With any luck, your new outfit will get you into the great parley along with all the other Marauder leaders.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I get a disguise?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mokov the Pilferer's got a holo-gribbon what's perfect for the disguise. Then there's Y'methu Stickyfingers - he's got a right proper Marauder hat. Go get 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be wastin' me time, lubber. I be a busy fellow.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has instructed you to use the $m(vitem=86) to power the Livingroot Controller and the Lifebranch Controller, southeast of Elderoot Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I now possess power, but that is not the problem. You will need to manually reset Elderoot's controllers if we're going to awaken it from its troubled slumber.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The generator controllers are still dormant. How can we power the espernetic interface without generators?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All our careful preparations are complete, and the espernetic device is ready. I tremble with anticipation at Elderoot's awakening.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once the controllers have been reset, the espernetic interface should be ready for use.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The $m(vitem=86) have activated the Eldan generators, restoring power to Elderoot's espernetic interface device.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll power them up right away!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I expected more from you. I should be used to disappointment by now, hmm?

localizedTextIdText: With Elderoot awakening from its interminable sleep, Victor Lazarin wants you to access the espernetic interface in Elderoot Refuge so communication can be established.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Elderoot in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Since you were instrumental in this endeavor, I prefer that you should do the honors. Access the espernetic interface and free Elderoot from its nightmares.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Access the espernetic interface to awaken Elderoot. This should be fascinating, so long as Elderoot has retained its sanity.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do I still sleep? Such dreams I have had... and who are you? What are you? You are not... Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let us hope the tree's psyche is as powerful as its physical form.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Awake, am I? Yes... I feel the pain... the ache in my boughs, the withering in my roots....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Elderoot has awakened from the nightmares that have gripped it for so long. The ancient tree has chosen to speak with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps I am becoming deaf as I decompose. What was it you just said?

localizedTextIdText: Parasites are feasting on Elderoot innards. Victor Lazarin wants to learn more about these parasites and how to stop them, so he's asked you to collect their guts for analysis. Kill barkblight creatures in the Blighted Glen and Blighted Tunnels and collect their $m(vitem=88) to aid Victor in his research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are parasites in Elderoot's heart. If they are to be exterminated, we must learn what drives them. Kill them and collect their glands for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must collect more barkblight samples if you expect me to get tangible test results!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These parasites are not autonomous. They are part of a larger whole. Another beast, somewhere in Elderoot's heart, pulls their strings!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mystical forces will not save Elderoot, no! Only hard science and alchemy can do that!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: All right, if you say so.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=88) for Victor Lazarin. After analyzing their composition, Lazarin has made a startling discovery.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why, oh why, do I put up with your rubbish?

localizedTextIdText: Livingroot Keeper are tiny plant-based creatures that live in symbiosis with Elderoot. Unfortunately, the parasites that infest the Blighted Tunnel and Blighted Glen are preying upon them. Queen Myala Everstar has asked you to save as many Livingroot Keeper as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If we want to help Elderoot, we have to save his Livingroot Keepers! They will help him to heal and replenish his energies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Elderoot is dying! Can't you see that? The Livingroot Keepers are his only chance for survival, and you are their only chance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should help Elderoot feel a lot better. My connection to him is growing stronger.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The parasites that eat away at Elderoot also prey upon the Livingroot Keepers.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope it makes a difference.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued a number of Livingroot Keeper from the parasites that infest the Blighted Tunnel and Blighted Glen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Why, I'm the Aurin queen, Myala Everstar. I've brought my people to Nexus in search of a new homeworld. We can't go back to Arboria after what the Chua did to it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't you see how important this task is? Where's your sense of responsibility?

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has determined that the barkblight parasites are controlled by some higher power, perhaps a queen. He's tasked you with venturing deep into the Blighted Tunnel and killing the Barkblight Queen that lairs there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is some higher power within the bowels of Barkblight Tunnel. Find this queen. End her reign, and her vassals will follow suit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you emerged victorious from the bowels of the Blighted Tunnels? No? Then why are you wasting my time?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, excellent! What a grisly gift! And you thought to bring it to me. How flattering!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Perhaps you might return to me with some vital piece of her anatomy? To study, of course.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Victor Lazarin deep in the Blighted Tunnel and killed it. Without their queen to control them, the rest of the barkblight parasites should die off or be killed in short order.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Victor Lazarin via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I see. So you're useless, then?

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar has asked you to venture into Elderoot's heartwood within the Blighted Tunnel. Awaken the three Livingroot Mender that dwell there. Then the menders will perform the ritual that will restore Elderoot to health.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that I'm connected to Elderoot through the Weave, I can see why it's sick! You must go to its heartwood and wake up its menders. They'll know what to do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Elderoot can't start the healing process until his menders are awakened. The Blighted Tunnels will lead you to them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can feel Elderoot's relief! It was his sickness that made the forest angry. Now that he knows we mean him no harm, we can be friends!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we don't get Elderoot healed up, he won't be able to help Victor and the Mordesh.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll wake them up. Don't worry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You awakened the Livingroot Mender in Elderoot's heartwood and initiated the ritual that will speed the ancient tree's recovery.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The menders are a type of plant life created by Elderoot to help maintain him. A tree of Elderoot's size and age requires a lot of help! They keep him healthy, and in return, he passes on his life energy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That's a good question. I don't really know. Perhaps they were hibernating along with Elderoot, but now that he's awake, he needs them more than ever. You've got to wake them up!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't believe you'd say no to this. We're all in this together.

localizedTextIdText: A Livingroot Keeper wants your help replanting stands of trees around Elderoot Refuge. Find patches of Fertile Ground and summon the Livingroot Keeper to grow new trees and plants.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Trees have died. Roots eaten. Branches withered. Keepers must plant new saplings now. You find fertile ground, we grow new life there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Found fertile ground? Ready to plant new trees?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If Everstar Grove is to be healed, every living thing, big or small, has to work together to restore the forest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Even the smallest of plants are working to heal Everstar Grove! It's moments like these that make the headache of being queen worth it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find fertile ground. Then call a keeper to plant new trees. Help keepers heal our forest.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was pretty amazing, I'll admit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found several patches of Fertile Ground and asked the Livingroot Keeper to grow new trees and plants.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. New trees must grow. You help now. Use good eyes and strong legs to find fertile ground.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am a keeper. We tend to forest. Maintain balance between growth and decay. New growth needed now more than ever.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If we do not fight the decay, our forest will die.

localizedTextIdText: You took a skull from a Barkblight Horror you killed in Blighted Glen. Someone like Victor Lazarin might find the skull fascinating.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the skull to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This ghastly skull was taken from some nameless aberration in Blighted Glen. Who might be interested in such a specimen?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This ghastly skull was taken from some nameless aberration in Blighted Glen. Who might be interested in such a specimen?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What is that you hold in your hands? Can it be the cranium of some contemptible creature? Please, allow me to appraise your discovery!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This gift almost makes me merry. Thank you. I look forward to its dissection!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the Barkblight Horror skull to Victor Lazarin, and he seemed pleased with the prospect of dissecting it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the skull to Victor Lazarin

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf wants to avenge Elderoot's destruction by killing Firestorm forces in Bloodbloom Vale and Fort Firestorm. It's time for the Dominion to pay for what they've done!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We had a chance to make a home here, you know that? But now it's turned to ashes and mud right before our eyes. The Dominion's going to pay for this!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You think you're done killin' those bastards? Think again. Get back out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You gave 'em what they deserved, though no amount of revenge will fill the hole left by Elderoot's destruction.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They've got troops east of Bloodbloom Vale. Make them hurt!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took vengeance on the Dominion by defeating their troops near Bloodbloom Vale and Fort Firestorm. Though Elderoot will never be restored, you've exacted some small measure of justice on the enemies of the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you cower before the Dominion's senseless violence?

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has created a toxin from barkblight glands that's particularly effective against the Chua. He's asked you to use the toxin to sabotage Firestorm Drilldozer outside Bloodbloom Vale and Fort Firestorm.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Revenge demands that our foe's victory must be a bitter one. Take these toxic gas bombs fashioned from barkblight glands and use them on Dominion drilldozers.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I fear those mischievous Dominion rodents will be back if you don't finish administering the toxin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the toxin gas bombs I gave you to make those Chua suffer. Did the rodents really think their drilldozers could protect them from seeping toxins?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did the Dominion rodents scream as they succumbed? Did they beg for benevolence? Such sweet revenge!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: For destroying our hopes, the Dominion will die in fear and agony.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will devise more splendid torments for the Dominion... in time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The barkblight-derived toxin Victor Lazarin supplied worked wonders on the crews of the Firestorm Drilldozer you sabotaged.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Chua aren't known for their compassion. Look around you! Our citizens have suffered at the Dominion's hands today. We must return the favor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not deny my vengeance, lest I choose to exact it on a more convenient target.

localizedTextIdText: To neutralize the Dominion's offensive capability in Everstar Grove, take out their Firestorm Tank. Arwick Redleaf has ordered you to destroy the tank in Fort Firestorm before the tide turns against the Exiles!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet up with Queen Myala Everstar in Everstar Passage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Myala thinks she has a way out of this mess, but there's just one problem. A Dominion tank is in the way! Think you can do something about that?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Do you need me to destroy the tank for you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did Arwick send you to me for a reason? Or did you have something else you needed to do?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you so much for clearing the way to our escape route. Though I hate to say it, I'm afraid our time here is over. The Dominion saw to that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get it done quickly. That tank's standing between us and safety.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'd hoped we could make this place our new home....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Firestorm Tank, routing the Dominion troops and winning the day for the Exiles in Everstar Grove!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I must destroy the Dominion's tank!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Meet up with Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're really disappointing me. And by "disappointing me," I mean "pissing me off."

localizedTextIdText: You have been flown into the Gildgrass Province to aid with the defense of Gildgrass Manor against a local Skeech tribe. Lord Syrus will brief you at the Gildgrass Manor House.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lord Syrus at the Gildgrass Manor House
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have arrived just in time. Take careful strides and make your way through the battlefield to Gildgrass Manor. Lord Syrus awaits you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why are you still standing here? Go to Lord Syrus at once! The battle will not wait forever!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your presence is a welcome sight, and much has been said of your capabilities. I expect great deeds from you this day, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If the Skeech set their eyes upon you, don't be shy with those weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have a war to fight. It may be a small one, but it is ours, nonetheless.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have made it to Gildgrass Manor and have received a briefing from Lord Syrus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You had better be kidding.

localizedTextIdText: In order to end the Red Ember Gang's operations in Auroria, Millennial Sidus has instructed you to find and eliminate Clugg the Crazed, the gang's leader, inside Clugg's Manor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Millennial Sidus at Farmers' Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Clugg the Crazed is the leader of this entire operation. Eliminate him, and you'll destroy the entire gang. I believe you're up to the task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your final target is Clugg the Crazed. He can be found inside his fortified manor. Neutralize him with extreme prejudice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Clugg and his ilk are no better than vermin. You have done the work of an exterminator... a very efficient and skilled exterminator.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find a means of entry into Clugg's Manor and exterminate him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My memory banks will retain your information for future reference.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have eliminated Clugg the Crazed. In time and with lots of hard work, Farmer Gummer can rebuild his farm. More importantly, you have also amazed Millennial Sidus with your actions. Impressing a Millennial is a very difficult thing to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I had high expectations for you.

localizedTextIdText: Lord Syrus has tasked you with calibrating three defensive cannons around Gildgrass Manor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lord Syrus at Gildgrass Manor House
