localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion supply ships recently deployed the three massive cannons placed around the manor. I want you to get them operational at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't see that cannon over there firing! Did you get it ready or didn't you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: After this battle is over, if you need some more engineer work, we have machinery all around the manor that needs to be set up and properly calibrated.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Why can't things work right out of the box?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Those cannons are crucial to our survival. You did well to follow my orders.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully calibrated Gildgrass Manor's defensive cannon system.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get. Up. There. And. Calibrate. Those. Cannons!

localizedTextIdText: Bosun Jorg is offering a reward to any fighters capable of taking out an escaped arena creature known as Mortigor the Risen. Mortigor is a terrible beast that can be found in Redmoon Reach in the Borellian Cluster.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Bosun Jorg in Deadman's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED (MORE) DEAD: Mortigor the Risen is wanted dead... or more dead than it is now. Put it in the ground (again) and report to Bosun Jorg for a reward.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED (MORE) DEAD: Mortigor the Risen is wanted dead... or more dead than it is now. Put it in the ground (again) and report to Bosun Jorg for a reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Only heard tales o' the fearsome pile o' bones known as Mortigor, but I figure a seasoned lubber like ye might manage well enough.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I didn't 'spect ye t'make it back to claim the reward for Mortogor. Guess y'earned it...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Mortigor the Risen, a dangerous skeletal gorganoth, for Bosun Jorg in Deadman's Landing.

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Gummer has asked you to look for farmers who managed to escape from the Red Ember Gang. He believes they may be hiding in the forests outside Clugg's Manor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Gummer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've still got a lot of farmers who haven't come back yet. Maybe they're hiding in the forest near Clugg's Manor. Can you find 'em?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found them yet? There's still a bunch of farmers missin' out there. My belly will be in knots until you find 'em and send 'em back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank Dominus and the Scions! It's a good thing you found those blokes when you did! They'd be goners if it wasn't for you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If the Red Embers find 'em before you do, they'll be dead, they will!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're truly an inspiration to the Dominion! And a hero, too!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a number of escaped farmers in the woods near Clugg's Manor. It's a good thing you did, as they were nearly dead. You were able to resuscitate them in time and send them back to Farmer Gummer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What'll it take to get your help? What?

localizedTextIdText: Chemist Ingo wants you to retrieve $(vitem=89) samples from Viridian Boulderbacks. Ingo finds it interesting that the $m(vitem=89) seem to neutralize the poisonous effects of the Noxious Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chemist Ingo at Ingo Krup's Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Noxious Glade too noxious to investigate. Green creatures not hurt by poison gas. Hypothesis: Creatures' crystals help them. You bring me crystals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still need samples of crystals from large green creatures. Crystals possible solution to poison gas. Bring some back. Please and thank you. Go now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good samples. Very impressed! Now analyzing crystal structure, composition, inherent qualities. Hmm... interesting. Crystals neutralize toxins!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once have crystals, will analyze. Maybe crystals useful. Maybe not.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Used crystals to make air filtration unit, allow you to breathe poison gas.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You retrieved the $(vitem=89) samples from the Viridian Boulderbacks. Chemist Ingo then used the samples to create a filter that easily neutralizes the toxic effects of the Noxious Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why come if not help? Scared of noxious gas? Get in line!

localizedTextIdText: Balwa took the information you gathered and left Anu Ani to seek the lost treasure on his own. Now Apprentice Kabay wants you to find an item Balwa owned and take it to Dak-Buun and Kaysa the Wise. He hopes the shaman will have a way to track Balwa to the lost treasure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Apprentice Kabay via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Chief Balwa ran off to take all treasure for self! Find something of Balwa's and give to Kaysa the Wise. Shaman help us track crazy chief.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Bad chief Balwa still out there. Must track him and find lost treasure before he steal all shinies for self.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bad chief Balwa still out there. Must track him and find lost treasure before he steal all shinies for self.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's the place! Balwa and treasure must be inside.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go before Balwa takes all shinies.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Find Balwa!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked Balwa to the Roughrock Underground where the Lopp hope to stop Balwa from making off with all the hidden treasure that lies within.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why you hate Lopp? You want spear in guts?

localizedTextIdText: Chemist Ingo thinks that the poison cloud surrounding the Noxious Glade is due to the terminites in the area. He has asked you to exterminate the Putrid Terminites.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chemist Ingo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Terminites infest Noxious Glade. Possible source of poisonous gas. Must kill terminites, see if gas production affected. You kill bug bugs?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: No change in poison gas levels. You kill terminites yet? Would appreciate increased lethality index whenever convenient for $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Monitoring toxic gas levels. Slight change in air quality noted. Despite terminations, big bugs keep coming. Discouraging!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Terminites dangerous. Eat anything, especially $(player.race).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Must stop terminites to reduce toxicity in Noxious Glade!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have exterminated the Putrid Terminites for Chemist Ingo at the Noxious Glade. Time to see if his theory was correct.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Also scared of terminites. Don't tell Naboom. Big bugs scary!

localizedTextIdText: Chemist Ingo has asked you to piece together $m(vitem=90) using $(vitem=91) collected in the the Noxious Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chemist Ingo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Must study large relic in Noxious Glade, but relic is damaged. Have plan to repair relic. Use sticky terminite dew to assemble fragments. Then patch!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Collect relic fragments. Stick together with terminite dew. Make sticky relic. Fix big relic by adding sticky relic. Easy as paving Arboria!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You not die. Relic is fixed? So proud! Maybe find out what relic is for!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hope it works. If not, back to square one.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Big relic attracts nasty terminites! But from where?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using a relic cobbled together from fragments and terminite dew, you replaced the damaged piece of the Viridian Altar for Chemist Ingo near the Noxious Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, come on! Fixing relic could be fun! Yes?

localizedTextIdText: Chemist Ingo at Ingo Krup's Camp wants you locate the source of the terminites in the Noxious Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chemist Ingo at Ingo Krup's Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Time to kill terminites for good. Stop poison. Find source of nasty bugs. Look around carefully. Then kill them... kill them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Source of terminites still hidden? Or terminites not dead yet? Which is it? Need to find source. Kill them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name), good at job! Glad you come to Noxious Glade. Soon, not so noxious anymore!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes, yes. You kill them all. Will watch. Enjoy watching.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now study relics. Will tell Collegium about your help.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: You mean I'll kill them all.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The glade will be green again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The source of the terminites in the Noxious Glade was the Noxious Tyrant. You have killed the creature and destroyed the eggs it was protecting. In time, the Noxious Glade will be clear of the poison cloud that clings to it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Unwise! Choose another answer. Hint: "yes" better than "no!"

localizedTextIdText: Gildgrass Manor's walls are under attack from Blackheart Detonator. Their suicidal attacks are threatening to bring down the manor's defenses. Defend the structure by eliminating detonators.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lord Syrus at Gildgrass Manor House
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those beasts - the detonators - need to be stopped. They're attacking our walls, trying to bring them down. No more! Grab some explosives and let them have it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the manor's walls fall, we'll have lost our first basic defense against the vermin infesting these lands. No get out there and do your duty!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glorious, yet disgusting, work! Our walls are still standing, thanks to your efforts. I may need to commend you to the governor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Throw these at the detonators. Then do yourself a favor... and run.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully protected Gildgrass Manor's walls by destroying the Blackheart Detonator.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Reconsidering would be a very wise choice.

localizedTextIdText: You stumbled across a surface-to-air rocket launcher that a lazy Exile left laying around their camp in Jagged Rock Cove. It is exactly what you need to bring down the attack ships that are patrolling the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This surface-to-air rocket launcher is exactly what you need to bring down the Exile ships patrolling the area.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This surface-to-air rocket launcher is exactly what you need to bring down the Exile Attack Ships that are patrolling the area.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How refreshing, an agent who thinks on $2?g/his/her/his; feet. We value assets who understand how to...improvise.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is going to be fun!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Utilizing the surface-to-air rocket launcher, you managed to destroy an Exile attack ship. Agent Lex was impressed with your quick thinking and resourcefulness.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: This is going to be fun!

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar has asked you to locate her consort, Arwick Redleaf, somewhere in Bloodbloom Vale. Help him launch a counter-attack on the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf in Bloodbloom Vale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Enough is enough! I'll mourn Elderoot later. For now, I want the Dominion to pay. My First Consort, Arwick, is organizing a counterstrike against them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Arwick's leading the counter-attack against the Dominion. I'm sure he could use $i(player.class) like you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm glad you decided to show up. I need every fighter I can get! I know you can be counted on to kick some Dominion tail!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's just like Arboria all over again. Will it never end?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Glad to hear it. Now listen closely, 'cause things are about to get messy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Arwick Redleaf. He's preparing a small force to assault the Dominion troops invading Bloodbloom Vale.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Tell him I'm on the way!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Arwick Redleaf is my First Consort. He's enraged by what the Dominion's done here. He'll stop at nothing to get revenge for Elderoot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I try to be the kind of queen that pursues peace, but the Dominion has shown over and over again that they're nothing but evil thugs. I'm not afraid to fight if it means sticking up for my people!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you say no? Especially after what's happened?

localizedTextIdText: Shine-Seeker Nima wants you to find Chief Balwa in the Roughrock Underground and clean out some hostile Roughrock creatures to make it safer for the Lopp to follow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Shine-Seeker Nima inside Roughrock Underground
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Balwa must be in that cave. See his pack kurg? Treasure must be inside and he plans steal it all for self! Go kill creatures clear safe path to treasure.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Still many dangerous bug creatures between Lopp and treasure. You kill then we stop Balwa and get shiny treasure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still many dangerous bug creatures between Lopp and treasure. You kill then we stop Balwa and get shiny treasure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You caught Balwa? Much thanks $(player.race). Now shinies can go to ALL lopp in Anu Ani.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'll stop Balwa together!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Shinies almost ours!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Glad that crazy Lopp is out cold.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Chief Balwa near a pile of treasure but he was clearly driven mad by the shiny fever. A quick thump to the head put Balwa out of commission so him and the treasure are ready to haul back to Anu Ani.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why give up now when so close to shinies?

localizedTextIdText: Shine-Seeker Nima wants you to to defend the Anu Ani Pack Kurg and Lopp from Bloodrock attackers inside Roughrock Underground.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Apprentice Kabay inside Roughrock Underground
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh no, Bloodrock must've followed us! Can't leave shiny behind though, so you fight them!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Stop the bad Bloodrock thieves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can't leave treasure undefended. Must stop Bloodrock thieves at all cost!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp appreciate big-folk stop mean Bloodrock Butchers. Now we take all the shinies back to Anu Ani and lock Balwa in cage until his shiny fever is over.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You come back Anu Ani anytime!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You stopped the Bloodrock Butchers from stealing the Lopp's coveted lost treasure. Now shines should be safely hauled back to Anu Ani Village and the old chief Balwa will be locked up until his shiny fever is cured.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You regret this, Lopp promise.

localizedTextIdText: The Trial of Courage is a test of mettle and resolve meant to weed out anyone who lacks the courage to do what must be done in the name of the Vigilant Church. Vigilant Priest Decimus has invited you to begin the Trial of Courage by activating the Dominion Holotable in Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vigilant Priest Decimus in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I oversee the Trial of Courage. If you wish to proceed, please access the nearby holotable. So long as your courage is strong, you have nothing to fear.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Access the holotable to begin the Trial of Courage. Willingness to embark upon an unknown challenge is part of the test.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You possess true courage. You have demonstrated that you are willing to face any danger for the good of the Dominion, just like Tristan the Valiant.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Very well. May the Scions protect you from harm.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With that level of dedication, I expect you to pass your other trials, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed the Trial of Courage and proven your faith in the protection offered to you by the Vigilant Church.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What does the Trial of Courage involve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This trial will test your mettle and daring. Ask yourself, are you brave enough to do what must be done on behalf of the church?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine. I've no business with cowards who forsake the faith.

localizedTextIdText: The Trial of Strength is a test of prowess and martial skill that will destroy those who are unable to fight for their beliefs. Vigilant Priest Vicina has invited you to begin the Trial of Strength in Fort Vigilance, and you must survive if you are to be successful.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vigilant Priest Vicina in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I oversee the Trial of Strength. When you are ready to prove your strength, touch the sword in the middle of the arena.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must defeat your enemies if you are to complete the Trial of Strength!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have successfully completed the Trial of Strength. On this day, you have displayed the unwavering might of Azrion the Conqueror!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Prepare yourself! No quarter will be asked nor given!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Go forth with vigilance, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed the Trial of Strength, proving that you are a capable combatant who is willing to lay down their life for the Church.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What does the Trial of Strength involve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You will face enemies in combat. Should you survive, you will have proven your strength in the eyes of the gods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The weak shall be cast aside to make room for the strong.

localizedTextIdText: The Trial of Purity is a rite that will cleanse the bodies, minds, and souls of the faithful. Vigilant Priest Vatha has asked you to begin the Trial of Purity by collecting $(vitem=1066) to build the fire. You must then stand in the flickering flames of the ritual pyre until you have been absolved of your sins. Find this Trial in Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vigilant Priest Vatha in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To join the Radiant Legion, you must purify your sins within the Flames of the Righteous. Collect $(vitem=1066) to feed the flames.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Flames of the Righteous await you. Gather the $(vitem=1066) to offer as tribute. Unless you are evil, you have nothing to fear.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have successfully completed the Trial of Purity. All that you were has been cleansed, leaving behind only the pure soul of a Radiant Legionnaire.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once you have entered the flames, there can be no turning back.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed the Trial of Purity. The dark deeds of your life have been ritually burned away, leaving behind only the purity of a Radiant Legionnaire.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What does the Trial of Purity involve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I have to stand in the fire?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You must collect $(vitem=1066) to feed the Flames of the Righteous. You may then stand in the flames and allow them to purge your body, mind, and soul of darkness.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Of course. Only servants of darkness should fear the Flames of the Righteous. You are not a servant of darkness... are you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are your sins so heinous that you fear the fire?

localizedTextIdText: The Trial of Devotion is a test of your willingness to serve the greater good of the Dominion. If successfully completed, it will prove your devotion to the Scions. Vigilant Priest Aelius has directed you to listen to the recitation of the Litany of Korol at the Statue of Korol the Devout in Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vigilant Priest Aelius in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I oversee the Trial of Devotion. All I require is a simple show of faith, contemplate the recitation of the litany of Korol while praying at the feet of the statue.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kneel at the feet of the Statue of Korol and the priest will help you with the words. Go ahead and try.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Korol was an example to us all. May his legacy of devotion guide your actions on behalf of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not trouble yourself with remembering the words, child.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed the Trial of Devotion, proving to Vigilant Priest Aelius that you are a devout servant of the Scions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What does the Trial of Devotion involve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Focus your mind and spirit upon the teachings of Korol the Devout. Petition him earnestly and prove your devotion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you unable to focus for a few moments? What tragic ignorance.

localizedTextIdText: Anyone wishing to join the Radiant Legion must be willing to prosecute crimes, pursue the guilty, and dispense justice without remorse. Vigilant Priest Gallus in Fort Vigilance needs your aid in adjudicating several cases while you determine the appropriate punishments.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vigilant Priest Gallus in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I oversee the Trial of Justice, citizen. These people have committed crimes against the Empire. I leave their punishment to your judgment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please, my ledgers are filled with cases as it is! Judge their crimes so I can move forward!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have successfully completed the Trial of Justice. I daresay Bronos the Just would be impressed by your handiwork.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Follow the principles of our laws and I shall mete out the punishment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've carried out your judgments as you ordered, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed the Trial of Justice by delivering your judgment for three crimes, proving your devotion to the principles of the Dominion's system of crime and punishment.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What does the Trial of Justice involve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: To succeed in this trial, you must prove that you are canny enough to discover the thief, and ruthless enough to see him brought to justice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You care nothing for justice? Unfortunate...

localizedTextIdText: The Trial of Knowledge tests your familiarity with the history of the Dominion and the Vigilant Doctrines that guide the church. Vigilant Priest Sabina has invited you prove your worth by answering questions at her sanctuary in Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vigilant Priest Sabina in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I oversee the Trial of Knowledge. I will ask four questions, and these scribes will answer them. You must choose the correct answer in each case.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to complete the Trial of Knowledge. Are you unsure of the answers?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have successfully completed the Trial of Knowledge, and are closer to proving your worthiness to serve with the Legion. Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The pursuit of knowledge never ends. Go with the grace of Galen the Adept.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May Galen guide your steps.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed the Trial of Knowledge, proving to Vigilant Priest Sabina that you understand the origins of the Dominion and the importance of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What does the Trial of Knowledge involve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: To succeed in this trial, you must prove that you possess knowledge of the Dominion, the church, and the legion. There is no room for the ignorant here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It appears to me you truly know nothing.

localizedTextIdText: Engineer Titani has provided the technology to create a projection of a Blackheart detonator. Activate a projectionbot, create a projection of a detonator, and then run your newly acquired form right back into the Blackhearts' camp on the Gildgrass Battlefront! Boom!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Engineer Titani at the Gildgrass Manor House
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Projection making easy, yes? Now,get projectionbot and make projection of Blackheart detonator. Send projection to enemy camp and boom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Blackhearts still alive. Is problem. Solve problem with hardlight projection of Blackheart detonator. Make projection, send to camp, explode! Easy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So glad you're smart. Last assistant not so smart. Killed by hardlight projection of self. Very tragic.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Blackhearts not see this coming!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully cloned a Blackheart detonator and used it to blow up the camp it came from. The blast from the detonator should set back the Blackhearts' attack!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big mistake! I tell Lord Syrus! You executed!

localizedTextIdText: You found the partially digested remains of Finlay's brother Sholto. Looks like he made it deep into the Roughrock Underground before being torn apart by creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Finlay via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A dead Ekose and some mining equipment. One of his boarding passes confirms the identity as Sholto, Finlay's missing brother.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This Ekose is definitely dead. No signs of life at all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find Sholto?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sholto's dead? Aw, shipwrecks and blackholes! At least I know he died chasing his dreams. Maybe I'll name my prospecting company in his memory.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gave Finlay the bad news about his brother Sholto so at least he can move on knowing his brother's fate. Finlay sounds determined to continue his prospecting plans despite this setback.

localizedTextIdTitle: Idols of Gold and Illicit Fortune
localizedTextIdText: You found a golden idol stolen from Bron Goldenhand. Bron would probably want to recover as many idols as possible from Fetterton's Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The golden idol appears to have been dropped in a hasty retreat. Bron would probably like these idols returned.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You get back to the Fetterton camp and find the rest of my property! I don't want to see your ugly mug until you got every last bit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job! Still not all of it but enough for today! I suppose I'll give ya a little taste for the shippin' and all!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and retrieved several golden idols that were stolen by the Fetterton bandits. It's unclear if Bron intends to sell the idols or just decorate his elaborate store rooms with them.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Bet Bron will be glad to get this back.

localizedTextIdText: The Radiant Legion is looking for new recruits. Should you wish to join the Legion, Radiant Archivist Vestus suggests that you speak to Toric Antevian in Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Radiant Legion is looking for promising candidates to fill its ranks. Perhaps you would like to join the legion? That is, unless you are a coward.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: My records show you have not yet petitioned the Vigilant Star to join the legion. Tsk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good day to you. The Radiant Legion's in need of recruits. How 'bout you? You interested in joining up?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then speak to Toric Antevian at once, and endeavor to complete the trials. Good luck.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not so fast, eh? You'll have to complete the Trials of the Radiant Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Toric Antevian and expressed your interest in joining the Radiant Legion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll speak to him at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would decline the honor of joining the Radiant Legion? Unthinkable!

localizedTextIdText: Hunt-Master Suranti wants you to kill Cerebral, a massive orbitog that is known to wander the Spectrosphere.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hunters beware!\nBig orbitog roaming near Anu Ani - nearly squashed Hunt-Master Suranti! Don't hunt Cerebral alone, it too tough for one lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You hunting Cerebral? Take many friends or end up squashed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You hunt big orbitog? Lopp very, very grateful! That one nearly squash lopp once. Good it gone now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good luck hunting!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was nothing too big to handle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Borellian Cluster's deadliest orbitog, Cerebral, for Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani.

localizedTextIdText: As an objective outsider, Treasure Hunter Ahanu in Anu Ani has asked you to settle a dispute between two Lopp claiming ownership over the same pile of shinies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Treasure Hunter Ahanu in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pinga and Nandu young treasure seekers won't listen to reason. Now they fight and chief does nothing. Maybe outsider talk sense to them?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those two Lopp keep fighting over same shinies instead of seeking new shinies. Maybe big-folk can talk sense into Lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All Lopp will be happy now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp will be greatful to have less shouting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hopefully peaceful times come to Anu Ani.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to sort it out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You convinced Pinga and Nandu to split the shinies and stop placing blame. Now the two young Lopp may work together to hunt for more shinies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hope you help Lopp soon. Lopp tired of hearing this ruckus.

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=73615) wants you to investigate a growing Marauder threat in the Halon Ring. He's asked you to travel to Halon Ring and speak with Corrigan Doon in the High Stakes bar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Corrigan Doon in the High Stakes bar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's a disaster! Doon's drunk off his arse and about to lose our life savings! Not to mention all the Marauders! We need you in the Halon Ring!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ya been hit in the noggin or what? Doon's in trouble, and if ya don't save him from himself, no one else will! And the Marauders... oh, just get going!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I happen to be a trifle busy at the moment. If you need something, you'd better be quick about it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's no time to lose. Talk some sense into his fool head, will ya?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You bet I am! My cards aren't worth a damn, and this Exile's got me lined up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Corrigan Doon in the High Stakes bar. Unfortunately, he's occupied by an intense card game with Deadeye Brightland and in no mood to talk about Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is for Doon, ya fool! If ya don't help, we're all doomed!

localizedTextIdText: Lord Syrus has expressed concern over the discovery of Blackheart summoners in Blackheart Village. He's asked you to make your way to the village and eliminate the summoners, as well as whatever terrible beasts they're summoning.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Syrus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those Skeech shamans appear to be summoning some sort of beasts! Look! Make your way to their location and destroy whatever they are summoning!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you kill the Skeech summoners as I commanded you to do? Or are they still cavorting about like little barbarians?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Horrific, indeed! But at least you put an end to the Skeech shamans. I would expect no less from a Dominion hero of your caliber.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If it is good for them, it cannot be good for us. For the Emperor!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You dispatched the Blackheart summoners and the horrors that were inhabiting Blackheart Village.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are starting to get on my nerves, $(player.name)...

localizedTextIdText: Maggs the Maimer has asked you to prove yourself to Maggs's Maimers by hunting and killing aggressive animals in Wilderrun Chase, the Undergrove, and Discovery Heights. Girrok, pumera, ravenok, snoglugs, and razortail, found throughout Wilderrun, are all fair game.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maggs the Maimer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to Hunter's Hideaway, chum. We're here to hunt Wilderrun and make a little money on the side. How'd you like a piece of the action?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How goes the huntin'? And let's not forget the skinnin', cuttin', guttin', and poachin', neither.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's some good killin' you done there. I think you got what it takes to be one of us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Wilderrun's filled with wild beasts. Get out there and beat the crap out of 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your hunting prowess has proven to Maggs the Maimer that you're no stranger to killing dangerous animals for money.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why are you in this treehouse?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What do you want me to do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm Maggs, and these are my... associates. We're here to kill anythin' in Wilderrun's what's worth killin', and make a little money on the side.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You seen the Torine yet? Wild animals is one thing, but those ladies're somethin' else... and they don't take kindly to us huntin' on their land.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Get out there, kill some critters, and show us what you're made of. You think you got the chops, chum?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You one of them animal lovers?

localizedTextIdText: Maggs the Maimer has contacted you and asked you to hunt Mosswood Snoglugs in Wilderrun. They can be found in the marshy areas of Wilderrun Chase.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maggs the Maimer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Snoglugs're like giant, wily snails. They hide under logs and on top of rocks. Don't let 'em fool you, though... they're dangerous little suckers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got them snoglugs yet? I think I hear Furgh's Belly growlin' up here. He likes 'em sauced up 'n' spicy
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Won't your momma be proud of all the snail killin' you done today? You're really showin' them jungle beasts who's boss!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're rare critters, and mighty tasty, too, so find as many as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went hunting snoglugs in Wilderrun for Maggs the Maimer, and no mollusk could stand before you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You ain't squeamish, are ya?

localizedTextIdText: Maggs the Maimer wants you to hunt pumera for their pelts. Pumera are found in Giant's Wall, Discovery Heights, and Feralclaw Cliffs, as well as near the various Torine outposts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maggs the Maimer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pumera pelts are nice 'n' soft, great for coats 'n' rugs 'n' intimate apparel. Kill them cats 'n' skin 'em for me... I'll make it worth your while.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still waitin' on them pumera pelts you promised me. Don't keep a lady waitin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did good out there... better'n Ralph, may he rest in pieces. That's a little bit of pumera humor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Last fella I sent out for pumera pelts, Ralph, never came back.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Do you expect me to laugh?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a plethora of pumera pelts for Maggs the Maimer in Wilderrun. Now try saying that three times fast.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Hey there... don't get any funny ideas. I ain't that kinda lady.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Might wanna reconsider. I got a lotta money ridin' on this.

localizedTextIdText: Maggs the Maimer wants you to hunt down Grizzlepaw girrok in the Undergrove, Discovery Heights, and Wilderrun Chase. The large and dangerous beasts can be stripped of all sorts of useful, and lucrative, by-products, from ivory to fur to ancient remedies based on Moodie alchemical formulae.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maggs the Maimer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Girrok are a treat, believe you me. They're chock full of fur and ivory. Heck, their bits and bobs are even used in magical Moodie potions!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's the girrok huntin'? My pal Karzagg needs some o' their gall bladders. You don't wanna know why.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work on them girrok! They're like big walkin' bank vaults filled with pelts 'n' ivory 'n' guts. You made us a fortune today, chum!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If they wasn't so big 'n' smelly, they'd almost be cute 'n' cuddly. Almost.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cut a swath through Wilderrun's girrok population for Maggs the Maimer and her band of ruffians.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be like that. How 'bout I make ya a potion to get yer bravery up.

localizedTextIdText: Wildstrike Raptor are next on Maggs the Maimer hit list. She wants you to hunt and kill them in Wilderrun, specifically those found in Wilderrun Chase, near Sword Point, and collect their feathers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maggs the Maimer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Crassus is scared stiff of ravenok, 'specially the ones 'round here. Take 'em out for him and get me some of their feathers while you're at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I told Crassus you was huntin' down some ravenok for him. Don't go makin' me into a liar, now, and don't forget my feathers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at the great hunter! Barely a scratch on ya! Only a couple puncture wounds, looks like. Crassus is gonna be mighty impressed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're big bloody birds, right? What's to be scared of? Crassus is an idjit!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for the feathers too. I already have a customer lined up.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Not sure what the big deal is.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You did a number on Wilderrun's ravenok population, and Maggs the Maimer was delighted to hear the news.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: He's seen one too many vids about ravenok killin' folks and pullin' out their eyes... and worse. I don't know as he's ever seen one up close.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You scared of ravenok, just like Crassus?

localizedTextIdText: Maggs the Maimer hates the sounds that razortail make and she wants to sell their heads to the Mordesh for some quick cash. Hunt down razortails and collect their heads in the Undergrove, Feralclaw Cliffs, and Wildfall Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maggs the Maimer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Razortails are incredibly annoyin'... and the Mordesh'll pay good coin for their heads. They just love themselves some razortail brains, get me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still hear them razortail carryin' on. Didn't I tell you to shut them up and to bring me their heads?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good on you for killin' me some razortails. It's a helluva lot quieter now... and my pockets are helluva lot heavier, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I need them heads intact, now. Don't let any of the brains spill out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You silenced the razortails in the Undergrove, Feralclaw Cliffs, and Wildfall Commune and delivered their heads to Maggs the Maimer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mordesh got this thing for brains, right? Make puddin' out of 'em or somethin'. It's kinda like they're freakin' zombies, right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're jokin' with me, aren't ya? I ain't laughin', am I?

localizedTextIdText: Maggs the Maimer is impressed with all the killing you've been doing in Wilderrun. So impressed that she's challenged you to hunt down Eviscerator, a particularly nasty Torine pumera, and Barhun, the largest and meanest girrok, in the Undergrove. It's time to show Maggs's Maimers who the real king of the jungle is.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Maggs the Maimer in Hunter's Hideaway
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are a couple of nasty customers left out there: Eviscerator and Barhun. Your britches are so big, I figure you can take 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still alive? I guess that means you ain't taken those big bad beasties on yet, have you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be a razortail's auntie... you done it. I guess that makes you a real big game hunter now, don't it? As well as an honorary Maimer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you can pull this off, I'll be damned surprised and you'll be well-paid.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Of course. Welcome to the club, $(player.name). I'm proud to have ya!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll wipe the floor with them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'd prefer a little money, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Wilderrun's most dangerous creatures and proved once and for all to Maggs the Maimer that you are more than a match for any beast that walks or crawls in Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: It's only a matter of time.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That there's the meanest pumera in Wilderrun. It took the Torine all their skill to tame that one, and even then, he ain't quite friendly with 'em.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Barhun's the biggest, meanest girrok in Wilderrun. Lots of hunters've tried to take his head, and none have lived to tell the tale.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is your chance to get ahead. I can't believe you're turnin' me down.

localizedTextIdText: While hunting in Wilderrun, you killed the large and grizzled girrok known as Barhun and took his head as a trophy for Maggs the Maimer. Deliver Barhun's Head to Maggs the Maimer in Hunter's Hideaway and see if she will reward you for it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Maggs the Maimer in Hunter's Hideaway
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Barhun's head will make a handsome trophy if properly mounted. Perhaps Maggs the Maimer would be interested in taking it off your hands.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stars a-fallin'! Will you lookit the size of that thing? I knew Barhun was a big'un, but this... this is really somethin' else!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You got it, chum. I'm sure I can get a little somethin' for this...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took Barhun's Head to Maggs the Maimer. Impressed with the trophy's potential value to collectors, she gladly took it off your hands for a tidy sum of cash.

localizedTextIdText: You've found the Lopp in Anu Ani are untrusting of outsiders. You must collect Aetherwing Fledgling Glands and $(vitem=99) in order to create an Aetherbrew, a local Anu Ani beverage that should help calm their nerves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Kaysa the Wise in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some Lopp have shiny fever that makes Lopp crazy. I invent Aetherbrew to cure it. Big-folk bring ingredients and give to Lopp.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lopp need Aetherbrew to calm nerves. Hunt
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You help Lopp with shiny fever problem? Some Lopp hysterical about shinies so I invent Aetherbrew to cure them. Just need pollen and Aetherwing glands.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aetherbrew works! Knocks Lopp right out. Lopp in Anu Ani much calmer now without shiny fever.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find many ingredients for Lopp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lopp grateful.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: If you think I can help.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: At least some Lopp calmed down.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Kaysa the Wise calm down the agitated Lopp afflicted with shiny fever by serving them Aetherbrew. There were some unfortunate side effects, but for the most part it calmed them down.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Some Lopp take quest for shinies too far. They get shine-fever and stop thinking about anything but shinies. This condition not good for village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lopp need nerves calmed. I make Aetherbrew and serve to Lopp. Maybe make shine-fever subside.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk stay stranger. Lopp not trust!

localizedTextIdText: While hunting in Wilderrun, you killed Eviscerator, the fiercest and most dangerous pumera of all and took his skull for a trophy. Deliver Eviscerator's Skull to Maggs the Maimer in Hunter's Hideaway and see if she will reward you for it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Maggs the Maimer in Hunter's Hideaway
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eviscerator's skull is possibly the meanest looking pumera skull you've ever seen. Knowing Maggs the Maimer, she'd probably love to have it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the blazin' blue stars! That's a mighty nice pumera skull ya got there. I gotta have it! How much you want for it? Name yer price!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya later, friend.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Make it worth my while, Maggs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took Eviscerator's Skull to Maggs the Maimer. Impressed with the skull, she gladly took it off your hands for a tidy sum of cash.

localizedTextIdText: Vesta the Tamer has asked you to return to Everpool Sanctum with tamed Feralclaw Cub in order to begin the Torine trials.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vesta the Tamer with tamed Feralclaw Cub in the Everpool Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You think to undergo the Torine trials? They are not embarked upon lightly, outsider. Your task is simple. Gather pumera cubs and bring them to me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where are the pumera cubs? You expect to pass my trial with nothing but your cowardice?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The pumera of Wilderrun will not submit to any who do not possess superior guile and will. You have passed the Trial of the Beast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No outsider has ever undergone the Torine trials and lived.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Return to my sisters. I've no more use for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into to the pumera dens in Feralclaw Cliffs and successfully tamed Feralclaw Cub. You returned to Vesta the Tamer with the cubs, who then told you to seek out Ceris the Lifecaller to continue with the Torine trials.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How will I acquire the cubs?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Take this spiced meat and feed them. The cubs will form a bond with those that provide for them, but beware their matriarchs are fiercely protective.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The jungles of Wilderrun are not for the likes of weaklings such as you.

localizedTextIdText: As part of your pursuit of the Torine Trials, Ceris the Lifecaller has instructed you to venture into Bladesworn Caverns and forge a Lifecaller Staff. Such staffs are used by the Torine Lifecallers to amplify their mystical powers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ceris the Lifecaller at the Everpool Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I cannot yet trust an outsider. Prove yourself worthy of Vitara by forging a Lifecaller Staff. Go now to the Bladesworn Caverns and forge your staff.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I see you, but I see no Lifecaller Staff. Have you forsaken your quest?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes... this is a Lifecaller Staff, and a powerful one, too. You intrigue me, off-worlder. Few who are not children of Vitara can make such a thing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We shall see, outsider... we shall see.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: One Lifecaller Staff does not make you one of us. Other trials await you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be back with a staff for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: So am I in the club yet?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into the Bladesworn Caverns and successfully forged a Lifecaller Staff for Ceris the Lifecaller, thereby completing one of the Torine Trials.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll be back with a staff for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do I forge a Lifecaller Staff?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lifecallers, those sisters who feel the ebb and flow of the Lifeblood most acutely, use such staffs to amplify their power.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Venture into Bladesworn Caverns. Within you will find an ancient forge, as well as the materials you will require.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Nothing is easy, off-worlder, least of all the Torine Trials. I will not justify your cowardly question with an answer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The only fate that awaits an outsider in the Bladesworn Caverns is death.

localizedTextIdText: The Torine only respect outsiders who pass their Trial of the Hunt. To do so, travel to Feralclaw Cliffs and kill Seher the Blooddrinker. Take the beast's head back to Everpool Sanctum as proof of your deed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Devana the Swordmaiden at Everpool Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: TRIAL OF THE HUNT\nAll who wish to gain the respect of the Torine must complete the Trial of the Hunt by killing Seher the Blooddrinker in the Feralclaw Cliffs.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: TRIAL OF THE HUNT\nAll who wish to gain the respect of the Torine must complete the Trial of the Hunt by killing Seher the Blooddrinker in the Feralclaw Cliffs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You dare show your face to me without Seher the Blooddrinker's head? Return to the Feralclaw Cliffs or do not return at all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My, my! Such a bloody trophy you bring to me. I may have misjudged you, outsider. You are at least as capable as our greenest youngling.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I think you might even be ready to take Hella's trial.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Seher the Blooddrinker and brought its head to Devana the Swordmaiden in Everpool Sanctum.

localizedTextIdText: Hella the Deathbringer has sent you to the sacred stronghold of the Torine Sisterhood, the Blademother's Refuge, to speak with Deathbringer Sybil for your final trial. A true test of your combat prowess, you will be pitted against the finest of Tresayne's warrior maidens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Blademother Tresayne Toria at the Everpool Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: So, you passed my Sister's trials. Few outsiders are permitted to enter our Blademother's Refuge. Complete the final test and prove your worth before the Blademother.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You will be tried by our Blademother's best in the Refuge. You will be allowed passage just this once, as will all who choose to undertake the final trial.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's been a long time since we've seen outsiders here. I will permit you to take the final trial. Touch the trialstone in my Refuge when you are ready to begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hear me, my daughters. As Blademother and High Priestess of Vitara, I acknowledge the worth of $(player.name) before you all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Death will be the lot of the weak and unworthy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You may have passed our trials, but that does not mean you are welcome here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the last of the Torine combatants and stood victorious in the Blademother's Refuge. The legendary Tresayne Toria, Blademother and High Priestess of the Goddess of Life, has acknowledged your worth.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will I find in the Blademother's Refuge?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The teeth and claws of Vitara train in our Blademother's Refuge. Our finest warriors await you. Are you prepared to face them?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Know you nothing? You speak of Lady Tresayne. Show some respect.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Coward. You outsiders are all the same, soft and weak, hardly fit to carry a blade.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin wants to beat Dorian Walker to the Everpool, and capture her exploits in Wilderrun for her fans. Follow Artemis Zin through Wilderrun Chase and Giant's Wall while photographing her as she records the claiming of the Everpool, and in turn the Focus of Life, for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need someone to snap some photos of me to document this historic moment, when the famed treasure hunter finds the Everpool. Think you can keep up?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't just stand there! We have a lot of ground to cover, and my adventure has just begun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent! We'll show that I claimed the Everpool for the Dominion before those pesky Exiles. Not to mention my fans will devour this footage.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take the photos quickly and cleanly. We still have to beat that wretched old man to the Everpool!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now. On to the good part.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed Artemis Zin in search of the Everpool throughout Wilderrun and recorded her exploits as she navigated the dangerous jungle in her own inimitable fashion.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Artemis Zin via your datachron
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have never been so serious in all my life! My adventures on Nexus keep the entire Dominion informed of our progress. I must keep them entertained!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I will explore this tropical land, fighting wild beasts, and solving Eldan mysteries! You will ensure that my deeds are properly documented. On film!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Idiot! We need to finish this before the light gets any worse!

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin believes that the Everpool is close at hand. All that remains is to fight your way through the Torine Sisters that guard the Gates of the Everpool and claim the Everpool for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Artemis Zin at the Gates of the Everpool
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Sanctum of Life is not far from here. We should have little trouble making our way past the Torine so that we can claim the Everpool for Myrcalus!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? The longer you tarry, the higher the chance of Dorian getting there first!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Damn! I didn't expect to be barred from the Everpool like this! But it is of little concern... if we are locked out, so is Dorian Walker.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not keep the Torine waiting!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You bet your stars we will! Nothing stands in Artemis Zin's way for long!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you and Artemis Zin made it to the Gates of the Everpool, you found your way blocked by Deathbringer Kala. While you defeated her in combat, Deathbringer Kala death was short-lived. She then explained the way to the Everpool is blocked to all but those who have completed the Torine Trials.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What if Dorian gets there first?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, almost certainly. I wouldn't expect the Torine to let us waltz in and take it from them without a fight.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: He won't. And even in the unlikely event he does, I am certain we can deal with him... appropriately.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are such a disappointment!

localizedTextIdText: The Torine Sisterhood hold sway in Wilderrun, and have tamed the ferocious pumera that prowl the dark byways of the jungle. Artemis Zin wants you to enter Giant's Wall and put Kevo at ease by slaying the Torine and their pets that have tried to thwart Artemis Zin pursuit of the Everpool.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm sure these ruins are full of relics, but the Torine have been pestering me with their unusually violent pets. Mind dealing with them and taking a look?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am certain you will find a large concentration of pumera, as well as Torine, in Giant's Wall.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Despite the fact that pumera are notoriously difficult to tame, the Torine have done an admirable job of bringing the felids under their control.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kevo will be so glad, and do try to stay clean for the camera.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This makes the sisters doubly dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the pumera and the Torine Sisterhood on Artemis Zin behalf, and learned that some sisters are tasked with training the mighty cats. From the looks of things, the Torine and their tamed pumera allies make formidable enemies - especially in tandem.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll learn more about the pumera.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Isn't it obvious? Suffice it to say, the Torine seem to have tamed the jungle cats. If true, that is extraordinary.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Pumera do not take to taming well. The Torine must have some secret... perhaps a caste whose sole purpose is to train and control the pumera.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I believe we have been over this before. These contracts are non-negotiable.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Thayd lists a work order request for titanium weave armor crafted from local titanium to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring titanium weave armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the titanium weave armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for titanium weave armor crafted locally to support the war against the Dominion. Bring armor to Work Order Board in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for titanium weave armor crafted locally to support the war against the Dominion. Bring armor to Work Order Board in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The heavy hitters need heavy armor on the front lines. I don't suppose you could make some?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work! Heavy armor for heavy hitters, my pa always used to say. Thanks for helpin' the boys out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Can't thank you enough, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee has happily accepted the titanium weave armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the titanium weave armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills has put out a call for help in relieving the Exile supply shortage in Galeras. Aid the relief effort by crafting some titanium weave armor for Exile forces here in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weave armor to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: With the Dominion on our doorstep, able crafters are needed to relieve supply shortfalls. Please contact Coordinator Mills for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: With the Dominion on our doorstep, able crafters are needed to relieve supply shortfalls. Please contact Coordinator Mills for more information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The troops need heavy armor. Titanium weave armor will do the trick. I don't suppose you have any?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good thing you brought in this titanium weave armor. No lie, I was about to start strappin' pots 'n' pans together into suits.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for all the help, friend!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy to be a part of this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some titanium weave armor for the Exile forces in Thayd and helped with the ongoing relief effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weave armor to Coordinator Mills
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The work order lists titanium weave armor as being the primary need at the moment. Given the proximity of the Dominion to Thayd, this isn't surprising.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade is offering a contract that will aid in fending off the Dominion. Help the war effort by crafting titanium weave armor for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivering it to Armorer Thaako in Thayd!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the titanium weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft titanium weave armor and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft titanium weave armor and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know we got a war goin' on, but there's gotta be some heavy armor out there. Have you seen any?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that's the stuff I'm talkin' about! Look at how tight that titanium weave is! Almost brings a tear to my stony little eye.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time I see you at the tavern, you gotta free beer comin'. That's a fact!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some Heavy Armor for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivered it to Armorer Thaako.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the titanium weave armor to Armorer Thaako

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has ordered you to make contact with Lucy Lazarin in Fool's Hope, the Exile's foothold in Wilderrun, and offer your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lucy Lazarin in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Victor and Lucy Lazarin from the Alchemists Guild are researchin' some sorta pond in Wilderrun, and I think you'd be a good choice to help 'em out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You made contact with Lazarin yet? Why the hell not?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We seek the Everpool, a concentration of life in this lush landscape. Can you not smell its heady aroma on the sweltering, sultry air?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get a move on. If that moldy old Mordesh thinks it's important, it probably is.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You will... for you will be our willing tool in this epic endeavor!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Lucy Lazarin in Fool's Hope and offered her your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm on my way right now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can you brief me on Wilderrun?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Wilderrun's a jungle, chock fulla nasty animals. Worse, the Dominion's in the neighborhood, so keep your powder good 'n' dry.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lazarin thinks it's some kinda fountain of youth. Sounds like a buncha crap, if you ask me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Let me clean the gravel outta my ears and ask you again.

localizedTextIdText: Use the Airshroom to jump to higher locations with ease. Doing so might further the Exiles' research of Wilderrun's more unusual flora.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Galby Greenfield via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This large mushroom seems to be fueled by compressed air and inundated with kinetic energy. Perhaps if you leapt on it, it might propel you higher.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't just stand there! Jump on the airshroom and see what happens!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's these big mushrooms that use dense bursts of compressed air as a defense mechanism. Weird, huh?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hot damn! You just confirmed the rumors I've heard about them 'airshrooms'! I bet you can use 'em to move around pretty easily.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep an eye out for more airshrooms and see where they take you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Jump on a mushroom? Why not?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used $i(creature=28417) in the Undergrove to leap vast distances and jumped to places you wouldn't normally be able to reach. Galby Greenfield noted your discovery, and he seems quite interested in the Airshroom potential applications.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Jump on a mushroom? Why not?

localizedTextIdText: You have slain Queen Skralla of Roughrock Underground. Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani may be interested in your feat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The head of a Roughrock Queen would make quite a trophy. A hunter in Anu Ani Village might enjoy this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You find big tasty creature in Roughrock cave? Lopp impressed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work killing icky skug monster.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Anu Ani Village.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You slew Queen Skralla and delivered it's mighty skull to the Hunt-Master of Anu Ani. Such a monstrous trophy impressed the miniscule Lopp.

localizedTextIdText: Galby Greenfield has asked you to collect $m(vitem=101) from members of the Torine Sisterhood in the Giant's Wall. The Torine sisters won't give the artifacts up without a fight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Galby Greenfield via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm sure you've heard of the Torine Sisterhood, yeah? They're a mean bunch of ladies, but I'd love to get my hands on some of their relics.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Any luck gettin' artifacts from the Torine sisters? I only need a few of 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These artifacts are great! The craftsmanship's crude, but there's a certain... I dunno... power to 'em. I can't wait to see what they reveal!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Well... okay. Just be careful. The Torine don't usually take prisoners!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll collect Torine relics for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a number of $m(vitem=101) from members of the Torine Sisterhood for Galby Greenfield.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need Torine artifacts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'd like to know more about the Torine, like what makes 'em tick, why they do the things they do. The artifacts might give me some insight into that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, whatever you say, friend. Just asking a favor, that's all.

localizedTextIdText: Lord Syrus has tasked you with rescuing Dominion captives imprisoned by the Blackheart Skeech. You should be able to find captives in Blackheart Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Syrus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Numerous soldiers have been captured by the Skeech for some nefarious purpose. Find these captives in Blackheart Cave and free them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The rolls still list a number of our troops as unaccounted for. I expect you to free any and all captives you find in Blackheart Cave immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A fine job. Our returning troops speak of your compassion and bravery in the field. You have doubtless made the Scions proud today!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Leave no man behind, $(player.name). Especially one of noble blood.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get them out of there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully rescued numerous Dominion captives from the Blackheart Skeech in Blackheart Hollow.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get them out of there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm going to pretend I did not hear that response.

localizedTextIdText: It looks like the Pell have lived in Wilderrun for quite some time. Galby Greenfield is convinced the Pell should have some kind of land survey data in Wildfall Commune. If found, the $(vitem=102) may provide some insight into more detailed mapping of Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Galby Greenfield via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This jungle's damn thick! I have a feelin' the Pell have been here for a while... they may have some survey data that could prove useful.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without some help, I doubt we're gonna be able to get a good map of Wilderrun drawn up anytime soon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As ugly and primitive as those Pell seem to be, at least they draw pretty good maps. Thanks for trackin' 'em down for us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks for the hand, friend. I'm sure anythin' you find'll be useful!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That data's as good as ours!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered geomapping survey data from the Wildfall Pell in Wildfall Commune for Galby Greenfield.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: That data's as good as ours!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why you need to go and turn me down after I've been so nice to you?

localizedTextIdText: It looks like the Pell have lived in Wilderrun for quite some time. Radiant Archivist Vestus is convinced the Pell should have some kind of land survey data in Wildfall Commune. If found, the $(vitem=102) may provide some insight into more detailed mapping of Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Radiant Archivist Vestus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A glorious day to you, citizen! I would ask that you seek out the Pell in Wilderrun and search their camps for survey data - maps and the like. Is that clear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We still await the Pell survey data. Have you recovered any? Toric Antevian is not a patient man!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes... yes. Excellent. These maps are crude... but what would you expect from a barbarous species like the Pell?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make haste! We believe such data will be instrumental in mapping Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have performed a great deed this day. For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get the data at once!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered geomapping survey data from the Wildfall Pell in Wildfall Commune for Radiant Archivist Vestus.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get the data at once!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This comes straight from the Vigilant Star. To refuse me is to refuse him!

localizedTextIdText: Radiant Archivist Vestus has asked you to collect $m(vitem=101) from members of the Torine Sisterhood in the Giant's Wall The Torine won't give the artifacts up without a fight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Radiant Archivist Vestus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You must know of the Torine heathens by now. The Church wishes to collect some of their artifacts, and you will acquire them on my behalf.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I await delivery of the Torine artifacts. I do not approve of this interminable delay. To the field at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have received the Torine artifacts you collected. Strange... there appear to be primitive Cassian motifs worked into them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Torine Sisterhood will not give up their baubles without a fight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have my suspicions. The Dominion thanks you for your continued service.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll collect Torine relics for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a number of $m(vitem=101) from members of the Torine Sisterhood for Radiant Archivist Vestus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need Torine artifacts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We must learn more about the Torine. Their artifacts may reveal much, including where they came from and if they are linked to the Everpool.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You shall regret this.

localizedTextIdText: Lord Syrus has asked you to finish off the Blackheart Skeech by eliminating their leader, Kaarg the Divine, in Blackheart Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lord Syrus at the Gildgrass Manor House
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now to hammer the final nail into the Blackhearts' coffin. Their leader, Kaarg the Divine, must be eliminated. Find her at her ritual site.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you destroyed the Skeech leader? Kaarg the Divine, they call her... though the why of it escapes me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You deserve all the accolades I can give you, $(player.name). Time and again you have been a hero of the Dominion. Well done, indeed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I wish you luck. We will mourn your passing, should it come to that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully killed Kaarg the Divine in Blackheart Hollow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can kill. I've seen it first-hand. What makes this time so different?

localizedTextIdText: Holy Commander Toric Antevian wants to be sure that he can trust all those who serve under him at Fort Vigilance. He's requested that you undertake a modified version of the Trials of the Radiant Legion to prove that you can virtuously represent the Dominion in its endeavors.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian in Fort Vigilance via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm used to collaborating with those who are less virtuous, but we cannot leave the conquest of Wilderrun to chance. You must prove yourself worthy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you begun your Trials yet? The Vigilant priests can get you started.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Congratulations. Your trials are complete, and I'm proud to welcome you to serve within the Radiant Legion. I'm certain you'll do the Dominion proud.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Vigilant priests throughout Fort Vigilance will administer the trials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If your faith is strong, your arm shall never falter!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Congratulations! You have succeeded in completing the Trials of the Radiant Legion, and Toric Antevian has welcomed you warmly into the fold.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you mean by less virtuous?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So what are these trials for?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Can you give me any hints or tips?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: All soldiers in the Radiant Legion exemplify and honor the Vigilant Virtues above all else. We can't hold every citizen to that standard.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I'm in charge of this operation, and I must be assured that all who fight for me have at least some understanding of the Vigilant Virtues.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Just remember the church's teachings, and face the trials with a pure heart. I'm sure someone with your reputation will do just fine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am afraid I can't accept your help until you complete the trials.

localizedTextIdText: Lord Syrus has demanded that you take the fight to the Blackheart Skeech that are attacking Gildgrass Manor. To that end, find and kill all the Blackhearts you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Syrus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As you can see, these Blackheart Skeech are a fearsome bunch. They pour out of their camp in bloodthirsty droves. For the Dominion, eliminate them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have the Blackheart Skeech been eliminated? If you can't kill all of them, then at least kill most of them. They're such vile little creatures!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent news! Well done! I applaud your lethality, $(player.name). I do hope you have more where that came from.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kill them all, if you please. At the very least, kill most of them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've retaliated against the Blackheart Skeech and put many of them to death on behalf of Lord Syrus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What a disappointing answer. Please try again.

localizedTextIdText: Lord Syrus of Gildgrass Manor has tasked you with burning any bags of summoning dust that you find throughout Blackheart Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Syrus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This bag looks unusual. Something's not right about it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This bag looks unusual. Something's not right about it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That heretical dust is used by the Blackheart Skeech in their summoning rituals. I have no idea what they put in it, but it's better not to speculate.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must commend you for destroying it. Nasty stuff, that dust.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've managed to burn all the summoning dust bags throughout the Blackheart Hollow for Lord Syrus of Gildgrass Manor.

localizedTextIdText: You found the corpse of a Wildfall Pell that appeared to have died after falling from a great height. A number of Airshroom can be seen in that area... it might be worth jumping or climbing into the heights of Wilderrun's canopy to see where the dead Pell might have been going.
