localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Pell died after falling from high up in the jungle canopy. Airshrooms might help you to gain access to the jungle canopy's highest points.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Pell's eyes fail to communicate the fear he must have felt in his final, plummeting moments, as he fell from the jungle canopy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Though it is good to see you, I would prefer it if you had a legitimate reason for interrupting me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pell have taken sensory equipment from that wreck, have they? And they are using it to eavesdrop on us? Hmmm... how interesting... and disconcerting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must remain wary of the Pell. Who can say what they have learned about us?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Time to find out what he was after.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The dead Wildfall Pell you discovered plummeted from a great height while trying to gain access to an Surveillance Terminal in the wreckage of an exceptionally old starship. You accessed the data and learned that the Pell have been using the ship's sensors to spy on Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I need to get up there somehow.

localizedTextIdText: You found the corpse of a Windfall Pell that appeared to have died after falling from a great height. A number of Airshroom can be seen in that area... it might be worth jumping or climbing into the heights of Wilderrun's jungle canopy to see where the dead Pell might have been going.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Pell died after falling from high up in the jungle canopy. Airshrooms might help you to gain access to the jungle canopy's highest points.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Pell's eyes fail to communicate the fear he must have felt in his final, plummeting moments as he fell from the jungle canopy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's it you want? I haven't got time to waste on whatever it is you're peddling.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those Pell took the sensors off the wreck's hull and are using them to spy on us? Of all the confounded...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll make sure the guards are aware. Your initiative has been noted.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Time to find out what he was after.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The dead Wildfall Pell you discovered plummeted from a great height while trying to gain access to an Surveillance Terminal in the wreckage of an exceptionally old starship. You accessed the data and learned that the Pell have been using the ship's sensors to spy on Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I need to get up there somehow.

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand has listed an extermination notice for Sporidium, a heinous beast that has tainted countless stores of Bron's brew in Goldenhand's Reach. Bounty dealt on proof of deed done.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: PEST CONTROL NEEDED!\nIf Sporidium taints another barrel of my brew, I'm holding YOU responsible. Bring proof for payment.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: PEST CONTROL NEEDED!\nIf Sporidium taints another barrel of my brew, I'm holding YOU responsible. Bring proof for payment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kill that blasted fungal spore and chop its moldy limbs off. Everyone knows it's hands off the brew if ya want to keep 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Money ain't the only the price of doing business. This is for savin' my slush stores.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You exterminated Sporidium for Bron Goldenhand in Graylight.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Var-Doph would like you to capture Cosmoling Crawlers that are scattered around Graylight using the Cosmoling Cryoflash for his customers at On the Rocks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Var-Doph at On the Rocks in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Cosmolings running around are delicious, but in this atmosphere they lose their nutrition quickly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you could flash freeze some Cosmolings for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great! My customers will love these.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you could flash freeze some for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll have more work for you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They won't get away from me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Cosmoling Cryoflash to capture Cosmoling Crawlers around Graylight for Bartender Var-Doph.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then I will get help elsewhere.

localizedTextIdText: Balwa has set Booby Trap for anyone coming down the tunnel. Shine-Seeker Nima wants you to disarm some of them to make a safe route deeper into Roughrock Underground.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Shine-Seeker Nima via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Watch out for Balwa's traps or you go KABOOM! Maybe big-folk can disarm pesky traps?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: HA! Lopp knew you'd run not chance it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Tunnel still too dangerous for Lopp. You clear more traps so Lopp can reach you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp coming to you soon! If you find Balwa don't let him escape.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I hope I can keep all my digits.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared out Balwa's Booby Trap. This should make a safe path to finding Balwa and possibly the hidden treasure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You disappoint Lopp!

localizedTextIdText: The pixpox plague has infected the Exile alchemists in Fool's Hope who were working toward a cure. Other patients have sustained injuries from exploding flasks. Field Medic Gaxag could use a hand putting them all back to rights.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Field Medic Gaxag in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I don't know much about healin' Mordesh. There are so many fluids to deal with, and they leak all over the place. Think you could fix'em up for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The wounded got hurt by an explodin' flask. The others caught the pixpox plague. Use med kits on the wounded, and antiviral drugs on the sick ones.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for all your help, pal. I owe ya one. And so do those alchemists.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Some are wounded, and others got the pixpox plague. Watch where ya step.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Field Medic Gaxag with his plethora of patients in Fool's Hope, and you didn't even step in any puke.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll do what I can for them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Got some vermin spreadin' pixpox around the place. Now everyone's hurlin' their boulders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: C'mon, pal. I can't do it all myself. I'm askin' for your help, okay?

localizedTextIdText: Learn the farming hobby
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Learned how to farm
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looking for something fun to do? Why not take up a hobby like farming?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As you're exploring if you find plants you can harvest them for their seeds and plant them in your garden. Or you could buy them from me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's tougher than it looks but I wouldn't have it any other way!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have taken up the farming hobby

localizedTextIdText: You've received word from Researcher Naboom, a Collegium scientist, who is in a dire situation. His research crew has unearthed ancient Eldan security constructs, which are ruthlessly attacking them at the Collegium basecamp. Make your way there and help him in any way you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Researcher Naboom at the Collegium basecamp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Researcher Naboom here! Collegium basecamp under attack! Need help! Now now! You come, help! Collegium pay good money!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Take enough time getting here? Took too long! Researchers being killed! Research being destroyed! $(player.name) must get lead out!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not take time! Run! Run run!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have arrived at the Collegium digsite and are about to do whatever is necessary to get the situation under control.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Eldan constructs attacking! Very destructive! Very aggressive! Need help now now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I survive, I will tell superiors! Then you in trouble!

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Naboom sent you to speak with his associate, Researcher Omegus, to see how you can be of assistance to him. Omegus can be found in the Windfall Digsite.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Researcher Omegus at Windfall Digsite
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dig Site One under attack by Eldan constructs. Omegus lead researcher there. Go and speak to him. Follow his instructions. Most important, do not fail!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Researcher Omegus still waiting for you. You make me look like an idiot! Go to Dig Site One and talk to Omegus! Now now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This situation is deteriorating rapidly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If we aren't killed here, our expedition is still sure to lose all its funding. Then again, it's better to be alive and destitute than dead, hmm?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be mindful of Eldan artifacts! Cannot afford to destroy them!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In any case, it's good to see you. We need all the help we can get.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully defended injured researchers from the Eldan attackers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thought you were smart. Guess not. Too bad for you.

localizedTextIdText: Following your defeat of Deathbringer Kala, you were presented with the Deathbringer's Sword. So long as you possess the sword, you will be considered as Vitara's Chosen, and can participate in the Torine Trials. Take the sword to Vesta the Tamer in the Temple of Vitara and participate in the Torine Trials.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Give the Deathbringer's Sword to Vesta the Tamer in the Temple of Vitara
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The sword's inscription reads: "Whosoever bears this sword is Vitara's Chosen." Perhaps one of the Torine can explain this to you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The sword's inscription reads: "Whosoever bears this sword is Vitara's Chosen." Perhaps one of the Torine can explain this to you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You carry the Deathbringer's Sword, marking you as one of Vitara's Chosen. You may walk amongst our leaders, but know that many consider you an outsider.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Respect our traditions as if they were your own.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find a Torine who can explain this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your defeat of Deathbringer Kala, you delivered the Deathbringer's Sword to Vesta the Tamer. You are now permitted to participate in the Torine Trials.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find a Torine who can explain this.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Give the Deathbringer's Sword to Vesta the Tamer

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Naboom has asked you to collect augmented blood samples from XT-9 Servitor at the Windfall Digsite so that he may analyze the primal patterns of the victims and provide identification for those who have been lost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Naboom via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Researchers taken by constructs and augmented. Must find out who is who! Get blood samples, then we know primal patterns and identify researchers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Collect blood samples from augmented researchers. Must identify missing personnel. Servitors all over digsite. Deactivate them, collect blood. Go.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Many researchers augmented. Shame. Must notify next of kin now that identities known. Maybe next of kin make donation to Collegium.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Augmented researchers quite dangerous. No longer serve Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Donation used to increase security, pay your salary, et cetera. Yes?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected many samples of augmented blood to help identify the XT-9s by cataloguing their primal imprints. Researcher Naboom will be pleased with your bounty and can hopefully notify the families of the affected researchers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Request you reconsider. Find failure to comply insulting.

localizedTextIdText: You met Captain Milo on the outskirts of Endless Vigil in Deradune. The hapless captain is in a bind, as his asteroid mining settlement M-13 has been infested by strange alien life forms.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Milo on the bridge of the Steady Traveler
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Got a mine on Asteroid M-13 completely infested with alien life forms. I'm looking for some folks to go up there with me and wipe out the xenomorph menace!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you waiting for? Them aliens ain't gonna clean up by themselves. The transport's right here. Hop aboard and head for the stars!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome aboard! Let's get to work taking care of the mine, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take this transport to my ship, the Steady Traveler. I'll meet you on the bridge, ayep!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You climbed aboard the Steady Traveler and headed to the asteroid classified as Outpost M-13 to help Captain Milo with his alien problems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Strange, parasitical creatures. I haven't seen them myself, but if the distress calls are any indication, they're quite frightful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you reconsider. I can pay well for your time.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Omegus has asked you to teleport sealed containers of priceless Eldan artifacts in Windfall Digsite up to an orbital cargo ship. Eldan Constructs are attempting to reclaim their excavated property, so you'll need to send the artifacts up before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Omegus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've bundled the artifacts we excavated into sealed containers. Someone needs to teleport them to our orbital cargo ship. Do you feel up to it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you transported the artifacts to the cargo ship in orbit? I'd quite like to study them, if I can manage to get out of this place alive.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The artifacts you teleported to the Collegium cargo ship in orbit are now safe. They're being prepared for study. If only I could have gone with them!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll need to hurry before Eldan constructs take the artifacts back!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stay close. I have a feeling my survival depends on you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You teleported the priceless Eldan artifacts to an orbital cargo ship to ensure their security. Researcher Omegus is grateful for your help, as he is rather interested in studying the artifacts for himself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool! These artifacts are priceless! We can't risk their loss!

localizedTextIdText: Captain Deena is attempting to discover what has become of the Dustrunner following an emergency transmission from the ship. Search Fatalis Fields for the Dustrunner's aft compartment to learn what became of the cargo and its captain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Deena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Last I heard from the Dustrunner was a patchy distress call. Now Spigo's gone missing. Would you be a dear and look into it for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find anything out about the Dustrunner, precious? What about Spigo? That poor boy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh dear! This doesn't look good, now does it? At least you found the ship log.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I do hope the boy's alright. Couldn't hear much through the static...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let me have a look at this log for myself, dearie.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked down the location of Spigo ship, the Dustrunner, in the Fatalis Fields and managed to find the ship's log. You brought it back for Captain Deena to read.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do you think the Dustrunner crashed?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Spigo and I go way back, dearie. Why, he's been running his ship, the Dustrunner, for as long as I've been in the business. It's part of why I agreed to go in on this Nexus venture with him, wouldn't you know.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Blessed Navigator only knows, precious. She was fresh out of dry dock with a billion in repairs. If you ask me, she should've sailed smooth for some time to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I was thinking what a sweet $2?g/boy/girl/thing; you were for helping an old lady out.

localizedTextIdText: One of the holding pens at the Dustrunner's aft compartment crash site in Fatalis Fields appears to have contained a number of lunar scramblers - creatures dangerous enough to warrant additional security methods. It would be best to return them to their holding pen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Deena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This holding pen is empty. The only sign of something amiss is the deactivated containment console on one side.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This holding pen is empty. The only sign of something amiss is the deactivated containment console on one side.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know there was a whole bunch of lunar scramblers on that ship. I hope those critters don't get loose, no sir.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sure am indebted to you, you betcha. Why no one wants to deal with a pack of scramblers loose mid-flight!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dearie me. Well let's just say those critters are more about eatin' than scramblin'.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see what we can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully tracked down the lunar scramblers and returned them to their holding pen at the Dustrunner's aft compartment crash site.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let's see what we can find.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: I wonder what was in here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The shipping label reads "CONTENTS: LUNAR SCRAMBLERS. DO NOT RELEASE!"

localizedTextIdText: Upon further review of the ship's log and manifest, you learned the shipment contained a number of hookfoots - carnivorous, vile-tempered aliens with an insatiable hunger. Deena immediately ordered that you put the beasts down before they go on a rampage in Fatalis Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Deena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh my! Hookfoots are listed on the ship manifest! It's no use trying to bring them in, dontcha know - you'll have to put 'em down before they breed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got those hookfoots put down, dearie? Can't be leavin' those critters out there to run wild now can we? They'll make such a big mess.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those are a little larger than I was expecting, darned tootin'. Don't suppose there are any serviceable crates left in the wreckage?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'll just have to hope that Protostar taxidermy offer comes through.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, yeah. Didn't think so.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Those hookfoots are as good as dead.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You've got to be kidding me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The hookfoots that survived the crash landing of Spigo ship have been put down. In doing so, you not only saved Spigo and Captain Deena from a lengthy breach of contract arbitration, but you also ensured the continued existence of all other life on Farside.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Those hookfoots are as good as dead.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Vile beasts they are, yeah. Frankly, I prefer them stuffed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Take it up with Protostar, dearie. I just haul the cargo.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well now. There's no need to be gettin' snippy with me, dearie.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Deena has requested that you deliver a crate of goods to a clear landing site in the Fatalis Fields. Once there, you are to signal the client so that they know where to land.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Deena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like the gods are on my side this time. My Protostar contact is willing to pick up their shipment in person. Be a dear and deliver the crate for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you needing something, dear? That Protostar fellow isn't going to wait forever for that crate to be delivered, and I'll be ruined if it isn't.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have to hand it to you, dearie, you've turned disaster into a lucrative business opportunity, you betcha.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you arrive, send up a flare to signal the client in for landing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you're ever of a mind to get into hauling, you give ol' Deena a call.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Determined to salvage something from her probable financial ruin, Captain Deena renegotiated her hauling contract with Protostar. In accordance with the agreement, a Protostar representative took possession of the goods at the landing site.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Right. So what am I delivering?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Blessed Navigator! It's listed right here in the manifest, dear: "Large Crate, property of Protostar Housing Commission."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Afraid of Protostar? Oh, goodness no. Afraid of their lawyers? Only a fool wouldn't be.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well now. I wouldn't want to be puttin' you out, dear.

localizedTextIdText: You discovered the corpse of a creature with an anatomy closely resembling that of a gronyx in the Fatalis Fields. You've determined to pinpoint its point of origin somewhere in Farside.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Inspect the Cage Door at the Dustrunner aft compartment
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The corpse of what appears to be some sort of gronyx lies motionless in the lunar dust. How did such a creature get to Farside?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The corpse of what appears to be some sort of gronyx lies motionless in the lunar dust. How did such a creature get to Farside?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Though battered, the cage label reads: 'STONEFORM PACK - EXTREMELY DANGEROUS'. Beneath the label, in fine print, it reads: 'Do Not Expose to Lunar Surface.'
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get to the bottom of this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The gruesome discovery of a slain 'stoneform' in the Fatalis Fields led you to the site where the rear compartment of an Ekose freighter had crash landed. Though the area was choked with debris, you managed to locate the holding container in which the strange creature was held. Despite the warnings on the cage door, you were unable to locate additional stoneforms in the immediate area.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll get to the bottom of this.

localizedTextIdText: Asteroid 3C48 is on a collision course with Farside, and Corporal Garen is looking for a few good folks to take care of business.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corporal Garen at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like there's a chunk of primal earth headin' our way. I aim to blast it out of the sky before it ruins our day.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The orbitog's still on the loose. Ya gonna help me out or what?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Quit talkin' to me. Ya got other things to do, get me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Brightland's beard, ya got stones the size of Gnox! I'm glad ya came along when ya did, $(player.name), or we'd all be eatin' asteroid right now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Clock's tickin', pal. Get to my position, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hell of a good job ya did back there, pal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully destroyed Asteroid 3C48 before it could collide with Farside! Great work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: When can you send me to Asteroid 3C48?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: When Asteroid 3C48's in teleportin' range, it'll be comin' fast. So sit tight in Touchdown Site Bravo. You'll get your update when it's go-time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What a load of slag!

localizedTextIdText: An Exile technician named Matthias Black and his crew have discovered a series of coded transmissions, likely of Dominion origin. He's asked you to venture into the jungle and access the Dominion network one comm relay at a time to expose the trail that will inevitably lead you to the Dominion and their objectives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've intercepted a slew of encrypted Dominion transmissions. If you can find the comm relays that're transmitting 'em, you should be able to hack 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I hate to remind you, but the Dominion comm relays aren't here... so why in blazes are you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Whatcha lookin' at me like that for, sport? You got somethin' to say? Then spit it out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Matthias thinks you found somethin' special. Well, let 'ol Dorian Walker be the judge of that!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Each relay you find should reveal the next one in the chain.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Looks like them Dommies are plannin' a sneak attack on our forward outpost!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed the trail of Dominion communications relays to their source.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I've got nothing for you yet.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Dommies use a series of interlinked comm relays to make their transmissions harder to trace. You're going to find 'em and hack into 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What in tarnation are you even here for?

localizedTextIdText: The Mordesh value Vitalus Serum, the one thing that prevents them from completely succumbing to the Contagion. Unfortunately, it does nothing to help Mordesh who have died. Any extra serum you find on deceased alchemists should be returned to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Mordesh have adopted a "waste not, want not" philosophy towards Vitalus Serum. Extract it from the dead so the Mordesh can return it to the living.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Mordesh have adopted a "waste not, want not" philosophy towards Vitalus Serum. Extract it from the dead so the Mordesh can return it to the living.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Vitalus is no cure - far from it. Yet without it, I would not be the charming conversationalist you see before you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Each drop of Vitalus is precious! The dead have no reason to fend off the Contagion. They have been given an eternal respite from its depredations.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: At least the loss of the departed will not have been a waste of precious resources.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll extract Vitalus from the dead.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad you're happy... I think.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You salvaged Vitalus Serum from the bodies of Mordesh alchemists in Exo-Lab 71: The Arboretum and returned it to Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll try to find some more then.

localizedTextIdText: In order for the Collegium researchers to recover everything they've excavated, the Eldan power grid at the Windfall Digsite must be shut down. Researcher Omegus has asked you to shut down Eldan power nodes Alpha, Beta, and Gamma.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Omegus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We can't recover everything we'd like to until the Eldan power grid is down. You'll need to shut down three power nodes: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The power nodes are scattered throughout the dig site. Cutting the power from all three will free up our reserve technicians to recover what we need.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done! With a little luck, we should be able to recover everything we need from this accursed place before the constructs tear us to pieces.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck. You're going to need it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll shut down the power grid.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You shut down the Eldan power grid, allowing Dominion technicians to recover additional valuable artifacts and technology from the Windfall Digsite.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll shut down the power grid.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I fail to find this amusing.

localizedTextIdText: Engineer Titani has asked you to create "hardlight" projections of essential troops around Gildgrass Manor to bolster its defenses.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Engineer Titani at the Gildgrass Manor House
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Projections are last line of defense. Organic troops die like flies! Get projectionbot. Create projections of troops for defense! Go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Projectionbot does the hard work. You just press buttons! Easy enough for any minion to do. So go... go and do! Quick quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hardlight projections do the trick. Kill enemies better than real troops. Real troops obsolete. Too bad for them!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No time to lose! Must make projections, now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now for fun things! Fun fun! Blow things up!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have created numerous "hardlight" troop projections around Gildgrass Manor to help even the odds on the battlefield.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes yes! Hardlight projections! Soldier numbers low, yes? Copy soldier appearances for hardlight projections. Then projections fight for us! Infinite number of soldier projections available!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But... you get to play with the robot! You crazy?

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a Mysterious Stone Head in the Undergrove that radiates primal energy. Perhaps if you study it, you can unlock some kind of deeply meaningful ancient mystery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Jaska Ketzov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This statue crackles with primal energy. Perhaps you can learn something useful by examining it further.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The statue carries with it the strong and unmistakable smell of bananas.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sure you have something better to do than harass me, hmm?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you're just wandering the jungle messing with ancient statues that radiate power? I'm surprised you didn't awaken something much worse than razortail.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Then again, it is valuable to pursue every possible avenue of inquiry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered that the Mysterious Stone Head in the Undergrove is somehow tied to the razortails that roam Wilderrun's jungles. You reported your discovery to Jaska Ketzov, but he seemed less than thrilled by your revelation.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Hekkel asked you to destroy Eldan constructs all throughout the Windfall Digsite.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Hekkel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Broiling brackets! Eldan constructs biggest pain in tail, ever! You go, find constructs, break them! Destroy them! Smash them to pieces!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: No time for chat with $(player.class). You demolish Eldan constructs before Eldan constructs demolish us all! Is emergency!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Most constructs destroyed. Better than none, I think. You do adequate job. Will pay adequately. Next time, expect you to destroy every last construct.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good! Good! Tired of stupid constructs!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Work to do. You go away now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Windfall Digsite was infested with Eldan constructs, but you destroyed a number of them and helped secure the safety of the Dominion personnel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Good! Good! Heard you wrong. You said no? No?

localizedTextIdText: Asteroid 3C48 is on a collision course with Farside, and Private Tafu is looking for a few good folks to take care of business.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Private Tafu at Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Asteroid 3C48 on collision course! 97% chance of total extermination! Dig deep in asteroid, plant bomb. Big boom! Asteroid smaller!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Orbitog is still on loose! Why you wasting time?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Orbitog is still on the loose! Why you wasting time?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Asteroid 3C48 prime candidate for extended research. Too bad you blow it up. For science and survival, yes?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go! Go fast! Come here! Asteroid not wait for you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Results as expected. Not bad.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully destroyed Asteroid 3C48 before it could collide with Farside! Great work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: When can you send me to Asteroid 3C48?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: When Asteroid 3C48 in accurate teleport range. Know it's coming. Soon! Wait in Sovereign's Landing! Just wait not so close.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Will be adjusting life expectancy of $(player.name) now.

localizedTextIdText: According to the posted bounty, a hookfoot known as Deathclaw has been causing trouble for Exile forces in Farside's Ravenous Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Meloll Goldglade at Stonebreaker's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: BOUNTY AVAILABLE\nDeathclaw, a hookfoot of terrible reputation, is on the loose in the Ravenous Ravine. A reward is offered for Deathclaw's demise.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: BOUNTY AVAILABLE\nDeathclaw, a hookfoot of terrible reputation, is on the loose in the Ravenous Ravine. A reward is offered for Deathclaw's demise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Normally I love animals. But that hookfoot, Deathclaw, isn't worth keeping around. I don't know how many people it's killed so far. Probably a lot!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Deathclaw's dead, huh? I guess you were the one to do the deed. Regardless of how nasty that thing was, I hope it didn't, you know, suffer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Great! Here's Deathclaw's bounty. Have a good day!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Nah, it was a quick death.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully killed the hookfoot known as Deathclaw!

localizedTextIdText: According to the posted bounty, a hookfoot known as Deathclaw has been causing trouble for Dominion forces in Farside's Ravenous Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Scientist Rizz in Warbringer's Break
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: BOUNTY AVAILABLE\nDeathclaw, a hookfoot of terrible reputation, is on the loose in the Ravenous Ravine. A reward is offered for Deathclaw's demise.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: BOUNTY AVAILABLE\nDeathclaw, a hookfoot of terrible reputation, is on the loose in the Ravenous Ravine. A reward is offered for Deathclaw's demise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Deathclaw dangerous. Hookfoot species enjoy eating Chua. I prefer not being eaten. Maybe you kill Deathclaw?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Killing Deathclaw is own reward, yes? But then you prefer money to feeling of accomplishment. Fine. Here. Take money.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully killed the hookfoot known as Deathclaw!

localizedTextIdText: A bounty has been placed on the head of Grimstone following the creature's escape from a crashed Ekose freighter in Fatalis Fields. A handsome reward has been offered for proof of the beast's death.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Meloll Goldglade at Stonebreaker's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nThe beast known as Grimstone is a threat to Stonebreaker's Stand. A substantial reward is offered for proof of Grimstone's death.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED\nThe beast known as Grimstone is a threat to Stonebreaker's Stand. A substantial reward is offered for proof of Grimstone's death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Grimstone? That's one bad beast, let me tell you! From what I hear, it was cargo on an Ekose freighter that went down in the Fatalis Fields.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If that Ekose ship hadn't crash-landed, Grimstone wouldn't have gotten loose. Why'd they have it aboard, anyway? Man... some people's children!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for putting Grimstone to rest. Someone needed to do it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to destroy the mutated creature known as Grimstone in Fatalis Fields. As such, you collected a handsome reward for your trouble.

localizedTextIdText: A bounty has been placed on the head of Grimstone following the creature's escape from a crashed Ekose freighter in Fatalis Fields. A handsome reward has been offered for proof of the beast's death.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Scientist Rizz in Warbringer's Break
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nThe beast known as Grimstone is a threat to Warbringer's Break. A substantial reward is offered for proof of Grimstone's death.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED\nThe beast known as Grimstone is a threat to Warbringer's Break. A substantial reward is offered for proof of Grimstone's death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You destroy Grimstone? Very large beast. Dangerous. Take friends, destroy Grimstone. Make big money if you do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Grimstone dead? Unexpected development. Thought Grimstone would eat you. Oh, well. Win some, lose some.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take money. Go and kill more things.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to destroy the mutated creature known as Grimstone in Fatalis Fields. As such, you collected a handsome reward for your trouble.

localizedTextIdText: Major Bracken has requested your assistance in discovering why a Dominion expedition team has gone missing. Meet him at Arcanus Base and assist him in his investigation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Major Bracken at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've lost an expedition team in the Ravenous Ravine, very close to our position. I require your assistance to investigate their disappearance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to the rest of the team? I expect you to do so at once, then return to me. Time is not on our side.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Quite an eclectic team we have, hm? You certainly round it out well. Now... let us get down to business.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My team is eager to meet you. When you have spoken to them, seek me out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Major Bracken and the rest of his team in Arcanus Base to discover why a Dominion expedition team has gone missing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Service to the Dominion is compulsory. You should know this by now.

localizedTextIdText: Major Bracken has asked you to get the generators at Arcanus Base up and running. He hopes that doing so will reveal what happened to the Dominion Expedition team.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Bracken via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must find out why our first expedition team went missing. Begin by restarting those generators, then look for footage from the security systems.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The generators have yet to be restarted. Without them, the security systems will remain dark. Do you think my orders are optional?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The team apparently encountered something beyond their ability to deal with. Interesting, but not unexpected. Farside is a very dangerous place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am curious to know where our people went.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Indeed. I feel uneasy about this... but I have my orders.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Seems it turned out bad for them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got the generators at Arcanus Base up and running for Major Bracken and uncovered a series of holographic recordings. It appears as if the Dominion expedition team was scared off by something horrible... something that may be waiting for other victims.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Rethink that answer before I have the Corporal punish you.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Fifield is concerned about some strange readings on his holographic life sign detector and he's asked you to investigate them. They seem to be coming from the Ravenous Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Specialist Fifield at Ravenous Ravine
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strange readings from holographic life sign detector. Very strange. Never seen readings like this before.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You find signal source yet? No time to waste. Could be important. Or dangerous. So go find source!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This not good! Not good at all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Maybe we find out what readings mean. You go first.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Blood of Dominus! What is that thing?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Specialist Fifield was concerned about some strange readings on his holographic life sign detector and asked you to investigate the signal coming from the Ravenous Ravine. Following your investigation, you discovered some strange things, indeed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Is erratic. Fragmented. Like two bodies in same space. Resolution adjustment make signal fragment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not going alone!

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Vita is hoping the Dominion expedition team left behind research samples that could help Private Paxton, and has asked you to explore the Derelict Silo E23 to search for it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Specialist Vita at Derelict Silo E23
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Poor Paxton! We need to get that thing off him yeah? Maybe the last team left some of their research behind. Let's see what we can dig up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Paxton ain't gonna last, no sir. If the other team knew how to get those things off people, they might've left the information here somewhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, bollocks! There's nothing here to help old Paxton. We tried, though, didn't we? Maybe somethin' else will crop up, luv.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I got no idea how long poor Paxton'll last. Let's work fast!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I haven't a clue, $(player.name), but we better think of something soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Specialist Vita was hoping the Dominion expedition team had left behind research samples that could help Private Paxton, but you were unable to find a solution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, don't be like that. You've got to help me, now!

localizedTextIdText: Major Bracken has requested your presence at Arcanus Base. He says that Private Paxton isn't looking too good....
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Major Bracken at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Citizen! Return to me at once! Private Paxton is experiencing some difficulties, and believe I will require your assistance in... helping him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This mission has turned into an unmitigated disaster.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are here too late. Fifield has been killed... by Paxton. I was nearly injured during the altercation, but fortunately I avoided harm.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come with all due speed. Bracken, out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Paxton ran off. His condition has made him... stronger. More dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Major Bracken requested your presence back at Arcanus Base, where you learned that Private Paxton had gone missing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A strange organism has attached itself to his head. I am uncertain what will happen next, but I would prefer it if you were present when I find out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I do not know how long the private will last without your intervention.

localizedTextIdText: Private Paxton has given you a mission to clear the Ravenous Ravine of all hostile alien life.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Bracken via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The hunt is paramount. Dangerous alien vermin haunt the Ravenous Ravine. Do you possess the skill necessary to kill these beasts?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are you the hunter, or the prey? Return to the ravine and show me that you are $i(player.class) to be feared.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Paxton had a task for you. He expressed some concern as to your capabilities. I do hope you've completed it, or he will be disappointed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The private seems satisfied with your performance, $(player.name). I do not place much stock in the opinions of privates, but Paxton is exceptional.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Distinguish yourself and you will earn my respect.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fair enough. Carry on.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I didn't do it to impress him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Private Paxton gave you with a mission to clear the Ravenous Ravine of hostile alien life. You dove into the fray, resulting in a nice, long dirt nap for many of the beasties.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bah! It is as I thought. You are weak and pathetic!

localizedTextIdText: You found some supplies left behind by the missing Dominion expedition team in the Ravenous Ravine. You should gather more supplies and take them to Major Bracken at Arcanus Base.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Major Bracken at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion expedition team seems to have left these supplies behind. You should reclaim them for Major Bracken and the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Dominion expedition team seems to have left these supplies behind. You should reclaim them for Major Bracken and the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our supplies are dangerously low, and we are well beyond the Dominion's official supply lines. If I had a quartermaster, I'd see him executed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those are Dominion supplies, $(player.name). And brand new, from the looks of their seals. Where did you procure them?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent. My concerns about our dwindling supplies are assuaged for the moment.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can find more.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They were left behind in the ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered a number of supplies that had been abandoned by the Dominion expedition team in the Ravenous Ravine and delivered them to Major Bracken.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see if I can find more.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.

localizedTextIdText: Major Bracken has asked you to exterminate the Derelict Silo Squirg{p:Derelict Silo Squirg} infesting Derelict Silo E23. There's no hope for them, and whatever humanity they once had has since been lost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Bracken via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those alien creatures have exerted their control over others prior to our arrival. Exterminate the filth at once, for they are no longer people.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must take matters into our own hands if we are to exterminate this species at its source. We can ill afford to allow it to spread beyond Farside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very, very good. With the beasts dead, we are one step closer to being rid of them for once and for all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Rest assured that you will be doing them a kindness, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Major Bracken asked you to exterminate the Derelict Silo Squirg{p:Derelict Silo Squirg} infesting Derelict Silo E23. There was no hope for them, and whatever humanity they once had has since been lost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you prefer I put a shot through your thick skull, instead?

localizedTextIdText: Major Bracken has asked you to squash the Derelict Silo Egg infesting Derelict Silo E23 to prevent the creatures from spreading to other parts of Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Bracken via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: By the light! What sort of vile mess did you just step in? Eggs? We cannot allow those things to hatch. Crush the life out of them... all of them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you stepped on all the eggs in that horrid silo? You had best return and do your duty, else we will be overrun by those creatures.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I shall inform command of your initiative in exterminating the eggs laid by those loathsome creatures. It would not be proper to let such things live.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch your footing. I expect it will get slippery one you start in earnest.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As your reward, I shall also put in a request for a new pair of boots.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I'll stomp on those eggs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Major Bracken asked you to squash the Derelict Silo Egg infesting the Derelict Silo E23 to prevent them from spreading to other parts of Nexus. You did a great job, but you may want to clean your boots now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not be concerned about your boots. I'm certain you can get another pair.

localizedTextIdText: Major Bracken has asked you to reactivate the Dominion expedition turrets around Arcanus Base to get a defensive perimeter active. He intends to be prepared in case whatever attacked the first expedition returns.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Bracken via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If we wish to survive longer than the original team, you must reactivate the perimeter turrets. Ensure they are operational, then report back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The perimeter turrets have yet to be activated. Do you wish to invite our enemies into our camp, or hold them at bay? Hm?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our perimeter is secured. I feel a little safer now, though that is not saying much. This whole desolate place is likely cursed with misfortune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I swear by the Scions, I will not allow this team to turn out like the first.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reactivated the Dominion expedition turrets and provided a good deal of security for your camp. If whatever took the original team out returns to Arcanus Base, they'll have to contend with some serious firepower.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get the turrets switched on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Try answering again. I expect you to answer in the affirmative this time.

localizedTextIdText: Major Bracken has tasked you with finding Private Paxton, who after killing Specialist Fifield, wandered off towards the Eldan structures in Arcanus Base.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Major Bracken at Arcanus Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Paxton... or whatever he is now... ran off toward those Eldan structures. You had best find him before he returns to kill the lot of us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you succumbed to cowardice? Or are you working up to accomplishing your mission? Find Paxton and neutralize him, immediately!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By Dominus, what is your progress? Where is Specialist Vita?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kill him if you must, but ensure that he poses no further threat to us.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Blind my eyes! Now I have no choice but to pull out of this horrible place!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Major Bracken tasked you with finding Private Paxton, who after killing Specialist Fifield, wandered off towards the Eldan structures in the Arcanus Base. When you found him, you were forced to put him down after he killed Specialist Vita.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That is unacceptable. Paxton is a monster who will kill us all!

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Naboom needs you to deactivate XT-9 Administrator Tyson and shut down the Eldan Processing Core. XT-9 Administrator Tyson can be found in Windfall Cave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Researcher Naboom at the Collegium Basecamp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Prepare weapons! Old administrator is now an augmented Eldan puppet. Requires destruction. So does Eldan Processing Core. Destroy both! Eldan must fail!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Administrator dead? Processing core destroyed? Unacceptable! Go to Windfall Cave and complete objectives or I will be very cross with you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great gears of Bezgelor! You did it! Blast effect delayed, but no matter. Good step forward for Royal Collegium... and me! Ha ha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Tyson was administrator! Beware! Very cunning for such a stupid man.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you! Thank you! Will remember your help fondly!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed XT-9 Administrator Tyson and shut down the Eldan Processing Core inside Windfall Cave.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Won't you be the next administrator?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Evil! Augmented human! Very smart! Gives orders to XT-9 servitors! No more orders allowed. Tyson must die!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Succession irrelevant. Not like Naboom sent Tyson to dangerous, construct-patrolled area of dig site on purpose. Was complete accident!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Processing core control augmentation protocols. Hack processing core. Then augmentation protocols no longer valid. Very important!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Tsk. Such a failure. Maybe you end up like Tyson.

localizedTextIdText: After finding the destroyed remains of the Dustrunner, Spigo asked you to check on the cargo. The crash spilled most of its loftite shipment, but the most valuable crystals were kept in a code-locked box strapped inside the hull. Check on this shipment at the Dustrunner crash site to see if anyone has gotten to it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Spigo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I located my ship, darn tootin'. What's left of her, anyway. But the cargo's missing. See if you can't get your hands on it before someone else does.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The cargo is extremely important. And valuable, you betcha! I really need you to find it for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Darkspur! I knew my ol' mate was up to no good. Probably wanted me to show up and give them the code. Good thing you were there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My poor, sweet Dustrunner's haulin' for the Navigator now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Never trust a Krogg as far as you can throw him, you betcha!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Spigo old shipmate, Vicious Vlogg, staged an ambush in order to get Spigo to open the locked loftite box. Spigo shipment is safe for now, thanks to you, but you need to find Vicious Vlogg and bring him to justice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no respect for a fallen ship?

localizedTextIdText: Vicious Vlogg is cornered and down for the count. Escort him back to Spigo in Fatalis Fields so he can get his comeuppance. Be careful, though - a cornered animal is the most dangerous kind!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Spigo in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What's that puny Ekose gonna do to me anyways? Call me names? Hurt my feelings? Ha! I ain't scared of him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Whatcha lookin' at, chump?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I expected you to bring Vlogg back to me. I have some shiphand's justice to dispense, darn tootin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My friend, you are a $2?g/man/gal/critter; of your word - unlike this lowlife scum. Take this as gratitude and leave Vlogg to me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go ahead, take me to him. I'll teach him a thing or two.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: He's going to pay for what he's done, you betcha.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What will you do to him?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Even with all his trickery and deceit, you were able to successfully escort Vicious Vlogg back to Spigo. Spigo thanks you for your pledge to bring Vicious Vlogg to him. As for Vicious Vlogg, his fate is in this Ekose's hands now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get outta my sight! You're just as weak as that Ekose wimp!

localizedTextIdText: The Graylight Technician uses his satellite tower in Graylight to track authority patrols for anyone who pays his fees. However an asteroid has drifted in front of the satellite and is blocking its signal. The Graylight Technician wants you to turn off the Power Regulators on the satellite and assures you he can take care of the rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Graylight Technician in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That asteroid is blockin my satellite signal. If you go and turn off the Power Regulators then I can fix our little problem, and get my customers off my back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Jump up on those platforms, you should be able to reach the Power Regulators.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent! Hope I didn't scare ya with my little light show. Maybe next time I should sell tickets.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! There's not exactly a ladder, but I'm sure you'll find a way up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll give ya a call if another asteroid drifts to close.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You turned off the Power Regulators on the satellite in Graylight and a giant laser shot out and destroyed the asteroid. The Graylight Technician was quite happy with the results and everyone should now be able to avoid any authority patrols in the area.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What exactly do you do for your customers?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well everyone round here ain't exactly on the right side of the law so they pay me good money to give em warning of any authority patrols in the area.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Just wait till Bron hears you ain't pulling your weight round here.

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Kabay of Anu Ani has invited you to come back to the village to celebrate the finding of the Lost Treasure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Chief Kabay in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kabay chief now and invite big-folk to join Lopp for celebration at Anu Ani! Celebrate with lots of shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go back to Anu Ani. Then we throw big Lopp party!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You ready for celebration? Anu Ani host shiniest party in all of Halon Ring!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You help Lopp recover great treasure and save Anu Ani. Now we celebrate in big-folk's honor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp see you soon!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lopp like sparkly shinies!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned to a hero's welcome to the Lopp village of Anu Ani after finding the Lost Treasure of the Halon Ring. With the old chief locked up in disgrace, the Lopp can share their shinies in peace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You no like celebrations?

localizedTextIdText: The communications antennas in Fatalis Fields are attracting flocks of solargliders, resulting in signal interference. Fortunately, the antennas have repellent emitters installed which should keep the solargliders away. Meloll Goldglade has asked you to activate the emitters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Meloll Goldglade via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The solargliders are causing all sorts of malfunctions from our comm antennas. Can you activate the repellent emitters on the comm antennas?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those blasted solargliders are pests. They're attracted to the comm antennas, so you need to activate repellent emitters to keep them away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our comm signals are back to normal fidelity. It's hard to imagine that critters like solargliders can cause our comms to go on the fritz.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great. Those emitters should scare the solargliders away.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for the help!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Good work activating those repellent emitters! Thanks to you, the solarglider population has been frightened away from the communications antennas in Fatalis Fields.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine! Don't help, then!

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland is struggling to defeat Corrigan Doon in a game of cards at High Stakes. Attempt to distract Doon in order to help Deadeye win the game.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Deadeye Brightland at High Stakes
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm busy playin' cards, friend, 'n I'll be damned if I let this yellow-bellied Dommie beat me. Either distract Doon so I can pull a fast one, or go home.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still waitin' on you to distract Doon so I can pull this ace outta my sleeve. Get 'er done or I'll be here all blasted night.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a bit too close for comfort, but I gotta give ya credit... ya had Doon payin' more attention to you than to his own damn cards! I owe ya one.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Help me win this game and I'll tell ya all I know about the Marauders.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your successful distraction of Corrigan Doon, which allowed Deadeye Brightland to win their card game, Deadeye has agreed to provide you with information about the Marauders in Halon Ring so that you can get to the bottom of whatever they're up to.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Won't help me? Fine. I got no interest speakin' with ya, then.

localizedTextIdText: The plasmic power cells located inside the plasmic equalizer are beginning to exhibit dangerous readings. Meloll Goldglade needs your help to calibrate them before something catastrophic occurs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Meloll Goldglade via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Problem! If you're headed to the plasmic equalizer, I need you to calibrate the plasmic power cells inside it. They're heating up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you here? Go back to the plasmic equalizer and calibrate the power cells before they explode and kill us all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I didn't want to tell you, but if those plasmic power cells had gone super critical, the entire moon would've been blown out of its orbit.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we don't calibrate them soon, they could go super critical. That's bad!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll stick around and make sure the power cells remain calibrated.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You calibrated the plasmic power cells within the plasmic equalizer before a crisis could take place. Meloll Goldglade was incredibly relieved by your quick actions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You think they're going to calibrate themselves or something?

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland wants you to talk to Ish'amel the Bloodied, one of his contacts in Deadman's Landing. Deadeye figures that Ish'amel should be able to shed more light on what the Marauders in Halon Ring are up to.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Ish'amel the Bloodied in Deadman's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you wanna learn what the Marauders are up to, ya best head to Deadman's Landing. I got a contact there named Ish'amel the Bloodied. See what he knows.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ain't ya goin' to Deadman's Landing to talk to Ish'amel? There's a teleporter waitin' for you across the spaceport. Get a wiggle on!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whatever ye think I did, it wasn't me! I swear on me mother's peg leg! It were another handsome Oghra scallywag... only not named Ish'amel. Aye!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take the teleporter to Deadman's Landing. I gotta finish up a few things here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Brightland sent ye? In that case, be keepin' yer voice down!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Deadeye's suggestion, you met Ish'amel the Bloodied, one of his Marauder contacts, in Deadman's Landing. Hopefully Ish'amel can shed some light on what his peers are up to in Halon Ring.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself, friend. Don't bother me one bit if you stay or go.

localizedTextIdText: Ish'amel the Bloodied in Deadman's Landing wants you to assemble a Marauder disguise by collecting $(vitem=82) and $(vitem=83) in Deadstar Valley.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ish'amel the Bloodied via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There be a great parley happenin' soon, and they won't let a $(player.race) like ye in there.  If ye wish to attend, you'll be needin' a disguise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To procure yer disguise, you'll be wantin' to take Y'methu's hat and Mokov's holo-gribbon. You'll fit right in once you're properly outfitted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Methinks it weren't no easy task to get yer disguise, but ye did a fine job. Try t'clean the blood off the hat, but if ye can't... I doubt anyone'll notice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ye best be ready for a fight. Marauders don't just give their assets away!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That shouldn't be hard to get.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to best the Deadstar's lieutenants and acquired enough Marauder garb to manufacture a proper disguise. With any luck, your new outfit will get you into the great parley along with all the other Marauder leaders.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I get a disguise?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mokov the Pilferer's got a holo-gribbon what's perfect for the disguise. Then there's Y'methu Stickyfingers - he's got a right proper Marauder hat. Go get 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be wastin' me time, lubber. I be a busy fellow.

localizedTextIdText: You stumbled across a strange red crystal in the wreckage of a Dominion cargo ship. Bring the crystal to Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Hologram of Engineer Giba in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A strange red crystal, pulsing with powerful energy, hovers among the wreckage of a Dominion cargo ship. Something of such obvious value must be claimed for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A strange red crystal pulsing with powerful energy hovers among the wreckage of a Dominion cargo ship. Something of such obvious value must be claimed for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where is crystal? Did you lose it? Drop it? Clumsy $(player.race)! Return to crash! Find another sample. Go go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Accelerite! Just what I needed! Been looking all over. Perfect specimen! Need more minions like you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You come to me at Spearclaw Post! Now now now! Much work to do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the accelerite crystal to Engineer Giba. He was very pleased and has requested your presence at Spearclaw Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Hologram of Engineer Giba

localizedTextIdText: Ish'amel the Bloodied wants you to use your disguise to infiltrate a meeting of the Marauder leadership in Holodeck Hideaway. The outcome of this meeting may help explain why the Deadstar, Grimvoid, and Redmoon Marauders aren't at each other's throats.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to $(creature=73546) via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now's yer chance t'put that disguise to good use. Put it on, then see if ye can get into the parley 'n find out what they're up to!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't ye have a parley to get to? Make sure ye dress the part. That is to say, wear yer bloody Marauder disguise!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya ever find out what them Marauders are up to? Better step to it, 'cause old Deadeye's got a bad feelin' about what's goin' on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hellfire! That was Mordechai Redmoon, back from the grave! Marauders is bad enough, but with that Laveka raisin' the dead, this could get outta hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're gonna need some backup on this one, friend. I'm on my way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infiltrated the meeting of Marauder leadership and discovered that the Deadstar, Grimvoid, and Redmoon Marauders are all working under Mordechai Redmoon. With the help of Laveka's blood magic, Mordechai is back from the dead and plans to use all Marauders to bolster his army.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ye won't find out much by walkin' away.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland plans to fly in and provide you with some back-up. To ensure his landing is smooth, he wants you to destroy the Deadstar and Grimvoid Anti-Air Launcher in the vicinity of Deadstar Valley and Grimvoid Pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Seems I owe ya one, so I'll be flyin' in. Only problem is the anti-air launchers the Deadstar 'n Grimvoid have set up. Take 'em out so I can land safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You take care of them anti-air launchers yet? I'll be there in two shakes of a dagun's tail, and I don't need no missiles makin' things interesting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Landin' was a bit rough, thanks to that stray asteroid. At least I made it down in one piece, though my leg don't feel real hot. At least I'm breathin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Did I ever tell ya? I hate flyin' more'n I hate chompacabras.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Anti-Air Launchers and cleared the skies for Deadeye Brightland. Unfortunately, his ship was brought down by an asteroid in the dangerous space surrounding the Borellian Cluster.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I reckon you can take them Marauders out yourself, then.

localizedTextIdText: Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani wants you to bring him the innards of rockmites. He believes they could make interesting shinies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the $m(vitem=111) to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp busy seeking shinies, but Lopp sometimes must eat too. Many creatures have hard shell but Lopp thinks tasty meat hidden inside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp stomach still rumble. So hungry! You find rock crawler creatures and crack them open, see what meat inside!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very tender and delicious pieces. This will feed village for today!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp very pleased you agree.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Have good travels!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the $m(vitem=111) to Hunt-Master Suranti of Anu Ani. He seemed to be pleased with the haul.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp not have tasty food now. Lopp wait for you to change mind!

localizedTextIdText: To be accepted by the Draken of Bloodfire Village, one must first be sanctified and recognized as a Bloodfire warrior. Bloodshaman Sorkan, at the Blood Altar in Bloodfire Village, can aid supplicants who wish to submit to Bloodfire's rites of passage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Bloodshaman Sorkan at the Blood Altar in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You come to the savannah to participate in our Great Hunt? First, you must speak to Bloodshaman Sorkan at the Blood Altar. He will show you the way.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You are not yet a Bloodfire warrior. Bloodshaman Sorkan can guide you to your destiny.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Bloodfire Village. Do you seek to learn the ways of a Bloodfire warrior?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Know that there can be no acceptance by Bloodfire until our rites are observed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Listen closely. You will become a Bloodfire warrior or die trying.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Tell me what I must do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to Bloodshaman Sorkan concerning the rites of passage that you must endure before you are recognized as a true Bloodfire Warrior.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do I have to speak with Bloodshaman Sorkan?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So what do I have to do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We Draken prefer the company of our own kind. Since we joined the Dominion we tolerate the other races, but never during a sacred time such as the Great Hunt. Only those who have been sanctified by our blood rituals are allowed on our lands!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am but an acolyte, I cannot offer you what you need. Seek out Bloodshaman Sorkan if you wish to do this. Know that only the strong survive our rites...but you look like you can take care of yourself, mm?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You risk the wrath of all of Clan Bloodfire, if you do not gain acceptance through our rites.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland wants you to collect Ranged Training Core from Necrodust Urn in Redmoon Reach. After consulting with Lazarin, it seems a potion can be made from necrodust that might protect you from the effects of Laveka's necromancy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Necromancy's bad. I talked to Lazarin about it, 'n he says we can make a potion outta Laveka's necrodust. He reckons it'll protect us from her magic.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I ain't no alchemist, but Lazarin's gonna give me step-by-step instructions on how to make this necrodust potion. For all I know, I'm gonna kill us both.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If necrodust was gold, we'd be richer than Artemis Zin. Trouble is, it's not and we ain't. Hand it over so I can get to work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'll need a good bit of the stuff. Be careful ya don't breathe it in.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stay on yer toes, friend. There's plenty of nasty critters runnin' around.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Necrodust in tow, Deadeye Brightland plans to make a potion that he hopes will fortify the body against Laveka's powers once you're inside the Doomfarer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do you know about necrodust?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Normally I'd tell ya to mind yer own business, but I reckon I can trust ya. Since my wife was killed, I keep thinkin' there's gotta be some way of bringin' her back. Lazarin's been helpin' me with my research, which included us analyzin' necrodust. It won't bring Sadie back, but it might be able to give us a boost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is a grave situation, y'hear? And I ain't jokin'!

localizedTextIdText: Necroshamans are utilizing giant Blood Cauldron to raise creatures from the dead. Deadeye Brightland has asked you to investigate and shut down the cauldrons in the vicinity of Redmoon Reach.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Laveka's got necroshamans usin' giant 'blood cauldrons' to raise undead monsters in Redmoon Reach. Check 'em out for me, then make sure you destroy 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do I need to spell it out for ya? If ya don't take care of them blood cauldrons, Laveka's gonna have a lot more zombies on her side before she's done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work on them cauldrons. Now we better find out where that witch Laveka's hidin' so we can take her outta the picture once 'n for all.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stay in touch, friend. We ain't even close to bein' done here.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of the blood cauldrons.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disrupted the necroshamans and destroyed Blood Cauldron throughout Redmoon Reach. The cauldrons were used to reanimate the Marauders, creating undead minions for Laveka.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You should think about it, hard. Blood magic's some bad medicine.

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide Ikthians have taken a keen interest in a giant Eldan device. Kezrek Warbringer has no idea what it is, so he's sending you to find out. Clear the way to Checkpoint Alpha by killing Darktide Ikthians on Shatter Ledge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our prey are the Darktide Ikthians. They squat on Eldan devices of unknown potency. You will cut through their defenses and learn what these devices do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This place has not been painted with the blood of the Darktide. Go forth and slaughter them and freeze their blood in the cold of space.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. Your hunter's heart beats strong, $(player.name). But now is not the time for reverie. Our enemy has not yet been defeated.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I sense this is only the beginning.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They increase their defenses. A pity... for them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared the way to Checkpoint Alpha by killing Darktide Ikthians on Shatter Ledge.
