localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This is a mystery we share, $(player.race). A pack of scouts was sent to uncover the Darktide's intentions. They have fallen silent. We must assume they are lost. The Darktide must not gain the upper hand.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They have seen our machines of war. They have engaged our massed troops, so they believe we will attack en force. They will never expect a lone operative.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Has your shining reputation been carved from lies?

localizedTextIdText: The double-threat of the Darktide and Eldan equalizers makes Sunder Flat a very difficult place to traverse. Thus, Kezrek Warbringer has taken the liberty of sending you a Dominion battle suit to pilot and plow through the Darktide on your way to Checkpoint Beta.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I see the Darktide are eager to sacrifice themselves! I shall send you a bigger tooth with which to rip them apart. I expect you shall enjoy it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The battle suit will increase your strength and, with it, your body count. Spread a trail of their bodies and blood across this accursed moon!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A pity about the battle suit, but it has served its bloody purpose... and so have you. But I am not through with our enemies yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: See how willing they are to die? Do not disappoint them!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Ikthian blood debt remains large. Let us collect upon it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the Dominion battle suit provided by Kezrek Warbringer, you plowed through the Darktide Ikthians on your way to Checkpoint Beta.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You disobey me? You, of all my weapons, should know better.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has received intel suggesting the Darktide has taken his original sentinel team captive. He's provided you with a best-guess on their whereabouts in Behavioral Research Facility 394, and has ordered you to locate and free them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My sentinels yet live. They are close to you, captives of the Ikthian scum. Find and free them from the Darktide at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sentinels are held prisoner on Sunder Flat, yet you waste time returning to me. I am not pleased.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The fish crave a powerful Eldan weapon, do they? I am unsurprised, but I will not begrudge them their predictability. It makes them weak.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let no Ikthian stand before you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You must learn more about this weapon, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and freed the original Dominion team from the Darktide Ikthians. The captives imparted crucial intelligence they overheard while imprisoned regarding the Eldan device. The Ikthians refer to it as the "plasmic equalizer," and it's some kind of ancient planetary defense cannon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are worse than the disgraced scum who have been captured!

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to find out what the Darktide plan to do with the plasmic equalizer. Hack the Darktide satellite uplinks in Crescent Heights and uncover the extent of the Darktide's plan.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Kezrek Warbringer at the Plasmic Equalizer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Darktide satellite uplinks in Crescent Heights hold the answers we seek. Hack them and uncover the Ikthians' plans for this plasmic equalizer.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You must gain access to the Darktide satellite uplinks to learn the extent of their plans. I will be waiting for you when you are done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must gain access to the Darktide satellite uplinks to learn the extent of their plans. I will be waiting for you when you are done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The fish come to conquer Nexus, do they? Too bad their plans will never be realized. All who challenge the Dominion are destined for defeat!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will meet you personally once you have completed your task.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now that we are together, you and I will stain our hands in their blood.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find out what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By hacking the Darktide satellite uplinks in Crescent Heights, you've revealed that a massive Ikthian armada is preparing to travel to Nexus. The Darktide intend to move the plasmic equalizer off-planet with the armada and use it against both the Exiles and the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find out what I can.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find out what I can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your cowardice sickens me.

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide must be stopped before they use the plasmic equalizer to wipe out both Exile and Dominion forces on Nexus. Follow Kezrek Warbringer into the plasmic equalizer and help him find a way to stop the Darktide.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Kezrek Warbringer near the Plasmic Equalizer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Onward, $(player.name). We must stop the Darktide from putting the plasmic equalizer to use. This may be the only chance we are given.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This is it, $(player.name)! Fight without fear, for your death will be glorious!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is it, $(player.name)! Fight without fear, for your death will be glorious!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bah! Ironscale fights without honor! He has snatched victory from me!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stay close! They are prepared for our advance.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will live! If Ironscale escapes, Nexus will not!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After encountering Admiral Gelic Ironscale, Kezrek Warbringer broke off for a duel while you defended against waves of Darktide troops. However, Admiral Gelic Ironscale used a nasty device to bring Kezrek Warbringer to his knees, then made a break for an escape craft.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will go alone, then. I do not need a coward at my back!

localizedTextIdText: With Kezrek Warbringer immobilized, it's up to you to chase Admiral Gelic Ironscale down. You must stop him from escaping or he'll lead the Ikthian armada back to the plasmic equalizer!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Leave me! Follow Ironscale and ensure he is destroyed! Should he escape, he will lead his armada to Farside and claim the plasmic equalizer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you stand there? Ironscale cannot leave this moon alive!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Once more you have proven yourself to be a paragon of strength and tenacity, $(player.name). As for the weapon, it will be dismantled.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not fail, $(player.name). The fate of the Dominion is in your hands.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Such a thing is too dangerous. We cannot risk it falling into the wrong hands.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Admiral Gelic Ironscale escaped, but you got the better of him by using the plasmic equalizer to blow his entire armada right out of the sky! Kezrek Warbringer has summoned a special unit to Farside to dismantle the ancient Eldan weapon before it falls into the wrong hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is all or nothing, whelp!

localizedTextIdText: After killing a Darktide Ikthian on Shatter Ledge, you found a $(vitem=105) which is used to power their weapons. It could help Collegium scientists better understand Ikthian technology if you collected more cells from Darktide Ikthians on Shatter Ledge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Rizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This charging cell seems to be an efficient power source for Ikthian weaponry. Perhaps the Collegium would be interested in studying them and how they work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ikthian power sources efficient. Must get paws on samples for analysis. Maybe you find some, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ikthian charging cells! Many many of them! Yes! Soon I unlock secret of fishman power source efficiency. Be famous, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Very good you bring cells. Now you get reward, then leave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected a number of $m(vitem=105) from dead Ikthians on Shatter Ledge and delivered them to Scientist Rizz.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.

localizedTextIdTitle: Best Safecracker This Side of Nearside
localizedTextIdText: Scientist Rizz in Warbringer's Break found a strange Eldan chest. It's locked with an advanced Eldan security system and he can't open it. He's offered to share the contents with you if you can break it open. BEWARE: This is a very difficult task!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Rizz at the Warbringer's Break
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stupid Eldan chest! I never open it... not unless $(player.name) do it, instead! Yes! You figure out code and can share treasure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I find Eldan chest. Chest locked. $(player.name) break code, open chest. Then we share reward. Good deal, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Surprised. No expecting $(player.name) to open chest so easily. Hrm. I must honor promise and share treasure, yes?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Is only locked. No traps detected, no traps at all. I think.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fine, take treasure and title. Now go. I must examine Eldan documents.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defied the odds and cracked all four security levels on the Eldan chest that Scientist Rizz found in Warbringer's Break. He was so pleased to access the Eldan documents and blueprints within that he shared a great reward with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yes, yes. $(player.name) too stupid to open box. Is okay.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Rizz has been studying the equalizer constructs in Behavioral Research Facility 394. He lacks combat data, so he's asked you to engage and dismantle the constructs while he observes remotely and records the data.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Rizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Data, data, data. More data! What data? Combat data. You fight and destroy equalizer constructs! I get combat data. Deal? Deal!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Destroy equalizer constructs so I can get combat data. Easy peasy, Mordesh diseasy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Data! So much data received! Data needs study. Study is work! There. You see?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm no fighter. $(player.name) fighter is perfect for this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Minds of DRED? Blown!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Scientist Rizz asked you to engage and dismantle equalizer constructs while he observed and recorded their combat data remotely. Thanks to you, he was able to collect some very interesting information.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Didn't hear you. Stupid helmet not made by Chua.

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide Ikthians are using a power drills to access Eldan technology underneath Crescent Heights. To stop them, Scientist Rizz has given you some highly-experimental lit-bombs to fry the drills' systems.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Rizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fish use power drills, try opening Eldan ruins. Stupid fish and stupid idea! Use this: lit-bomb! Break armor without fire by going through armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Equation simple. Lit-bomb multiplied by power drill equals destruction! Now go and stop wasting time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lit-bomb work? Of course it work! Made by genius inventor! Lit-bomb never tested until now. You make good test. I very proud, yes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hide when lit-bomb explode or $(player.name) get cooked.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Small detail. You alive, drills broken. Should count blessings.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Scientist Rizz lit-bombs worked wonders on the Ikthian power drills, causing them to short out. Now the Ikthians will be hard-pressed to reach the Eldan technology beneath Crescent Heights.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have other idea to stop stupid fish and stupid drills? I bet it's stupid.

localizedTextIdText: A constant stream of Darktide Ikthians and Eldan constructs makes Sunder Flat a very difficult place to traverse. After you responded to a Bounty Board request, Kezrek Warbringer sent you another Dominion battle suit to plow through the Darktide forces.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: HELP REQUIRED\nExperienced Dominion battle suit pilot to patrol Sunder Flat and exterminate Ikthian threats. Hazard pay available.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: HELP REQUIRED\nExperienced Dominion battle suit pilot to patrol Sunder Flat and exterminate Ikthian threats. Hazard pay available.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There will always be more Ikthians to crush beneath our war machines. I expect you will meet your kill quota in no time at all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sunder Flat is secure for the moment. It is as if you were bred to be at the controls of a battle suit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used another Dominion battle suit to plow through the Darktide Ikthians on Sunder Flat. Though the Flat is clear for now, there will likely be more fish-heads running around there tomorrow.

localizedTextIdText: The communications antennas in Fatalis Fields are attracting flocks of solargliders, resulting in signal interference. Fortunately, the antennas have repellent emitters installed which should keep the solargliders away. Scientist Rizz has asked you to activate the emitters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Rizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Solarglider pests cause malfunction in comm antennas. You go to Fatalis Fields, activate repellant emitters, kill stupid solargliders. Okay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Comm antennas attract solargliders somehow. Solargliders cause signal interference somehow. You go, turn on repellant emitters, before I get angry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Comm signals normal. Now I download latest Tales from Beyond Fringe. Is special Artemis Zin issue! So excited! Squee!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Important signals expected soon. Require high fidelity. Complete job now!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Good work activating those repellent emitters. Thanks to you, the solarglider population has been frightened away from the communications antennas in Fatalis Fields, and Scientist Rizz can read the latest issue of TALES FROM BEYOND THE FRINGE! (featuring Artemis Zin).
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You stupid? Incompetent? Have soft spot for flying vermin?

localizedTextIdText: The plasmic power cells located inside the plasmic equalizer are beginning to exhibit dangerous readings. Scientist Rizz needs your help to calibrate them before something catastrophic occurs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Rizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(player.name)! Listen carefully! Plasmic power cells in plasmic equalizer require calibration. No calibration, no more moon. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What you want? Sensors say plasmic power cells still not calibrated. You have death wish? Go back and fix! Now now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Plasmic power cells stable, safe for moment. Must continue to monitor cells for additional problems. I not like this, not at all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be fast. If moon blows up, General Warbringer be angry.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must find replacement and leave stupid moon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You calibrated the plasmic power cells within the plasmic equalizer before a crisis could take place. Scientist Rizz was incredibly relieved by your quick actions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stupid! There is no choice! You do this or we explode!

localizedTextIdText: Zangu somewhere in the Gamma Fields wants you find him and drive off the flying Aetherwing steamgliders.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Zangu in Gamma Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Help! Lopp under attack by fiendish flying teeth monsters. Lopp only wants to watch sky shinies in peace. Big-folk come to rescue?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lopp still waiting for answers from Goda. Search high above Gamma Fields and tell Lopp who should lead Anu Ani.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go look above Gamma fields. Lopp make camp up high on fallen asteroid to be closer to sky shinies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You help Lopp so much. Now can watch sky shinies with no worries.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe I become best Lopp astronomer!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Zangu high up on a small asteroid and destroyed the swarm of Aetherwing steamgliders disturbing his camp. Now the Lopp can watch the stars or "sky shinies" in peace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp need strong fighter, maybe you no fight?

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland is planning to take the fight to Laveka the Dark-Hearted at the wreckage of the Doomfarer in Redmoon Reach, and he wants you by his side. Are you ready to rumble?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Might as well strike while the iron's hot, friend. Get yer weapons ready, 'cause I'm sure Laveka's got a lot of sorcery 'n undead in store for us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I thought ya said you was ready to take Laveka down. Ain't no time to waste! Let's get movin' and show that witch the door.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blazes! That didn't end quite the way I wanted it to, but I 'spose we took Laveka down a notch or two. She'll get hers eventually, and Mordechai, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do me a favor and don't die. I don't wanna have to shoot ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Deadeye Brightland found Laveka the Dark-Hearted and put a stop to her reanimation rituals. Unfortunately, Mordechai Redmoon swooped in and rescued Laveka before the final blow could be dealt.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Doomfarer's the ship that Mordechai Redmoon gave to Laveka when they formed their... partnership. Quite a gift, don't ya think?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I die, I reckon Laveka'll bring me back... and then I'll be after you.

localizedTextIdText: You killed the Borellian Cluster's deadliest orbitog, Cerebral, in the Gamma Fields. Deliver $(vitem=815) to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver $(vitem=815) to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A cross section of gelatinous mind-matter harvested from the deadly orbitog, Cerebral. A lopp hunt-master may appreciate such a prize.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A cross section of gelatinous mind-matter harvested from the deadly orbitog, Cerebral. A lopp hunt-master may appreciate such a prize.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Must be fierce when hunting big orbitog. No, fiercer!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You come back from hunting? Yes, yes, lopp see you have some things very nice! Lopp keep spoils safe for you... Hand them over.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good luck hunting!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Hunt-Master Suranti was impressed that you hunted down the orbitog known as Cerebral. Suranti has happily promised to keep your spoils from the hunt in Anu Ani for safe-keeping... you think.

localizedTextIdText: Exiles keep wandering onto airfield. This must be stopped, cleaning entrails out of hover intakes increases downtime.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Been doing tests on the local residents . Secret tests! Need to collect data, but be sneaky. Use  Survey-a-tron on subjects.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: ithout data, cross-contamination inevitable.

localizedTextIdText: Ish'amel the Bloodied wants you to smack Redmoon Advocate to find out what information they're spreading to the Deadstar Marauders in Deadstar Valley. It seems the Redmoon have recently started trying to recruit other Marauders to their cause.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ish'amel the Bloodied via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I seen advocates from the Redmoon Marauders talkin' to the Deadstar 'n handin' out notices. Try shakin' 'em down and see what ye can learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Redmoon advocates be handin' out notices to the Deadstar swabs. Slap 'em around 'n maybe ye can find out what they be up to.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mordechai Redmoon? Blight me soul! If I weren't stuck adrift without a ship, I'd be headin' for the Darkspur Nebula.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: C'mon, it can't be that bad.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You convinced some Redmoon Advocate to drop the information they'd been spreading and learned that the great Mordechai Redmoon is back after disappearing in Skullcano. Mordechai promises all Marauders that join the Redmoon an endless supply of plunder, loot, and power.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are the Redmoon advocates here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Grimvoid, Deadstar, 'n Redmoon Marauders be at each other's throats most've the time. The Redmoon must be up to somethin' if they want to swell their ranks with Deadstar swabs.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Redmoon were skulkin' in the shadows until recently. Might be they got a new captain. They been without a leader since 'ol Mordechai Redmoon vanished.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If ye be changin' yer mind, ye know where t'find me.

localizedTextIdText: The Grimvoid Datachron you found contains a series of codes - 2431, 2353, 2077. You figure they must unlock something in Grimvoid Pass. Look around and see what you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Marauder datachron holds a series of access codes - 2431, 2353, 2077. These codes must unlock something in Grimvoid Pass.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This Marauder datachron holds a series of access codes - 2431, 2353, 2077. These codes must unlock something in Grimvoid Pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's some terminals around the Grimvoid camp. I wonder if these codes ya found'll give ya access to 'em? There's only one way to try.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like there was a mutiny among the Grimvoid Marauders. That's damn strange. Might wanna check out the exo-lab they found and see what's inside.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've used the codes you found to crack the terminals in Grimvoid Pass, and this restored power to a nearby exo-lab teleporter. The data you uncovered seems to indicate there was a conflict between this band of Grimvoid Marauders and their captain over the exo-lab.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find out what the codes are for.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Var-Doph would like you to use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg out in Gamma Fields for his customers at On the Rocks in Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bartender Var-Doph at On the Rocks in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Cosmolings and Cosmotails are delicious, but customers pay top dollar for the rare and dangerous Cosmogrub. Would you like to find me some?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yumm! My customers will be abuzz over this delicious treat!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent. Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't be a stranger!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg in Gamma Fields for Bartender Var-Doph and his customers at On the Rocks in Graylight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The pay will make it worth your time. You'll be back.

localizedTextIdText: Merchant Torook would like you to kill and reanimate creatures found in the Isofringe of the Borellian Cluster using a Moodie Totem and then bring them back to Graylight so he can enter them in the Crater of Carnage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Merchant Torook in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm collectin creatures from the Borellian Cluster for the Crater of Carnage. I'll need you to kill some creatures and then zap them with this Moodie Totem to bring back to life for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still see empty cages. Talk to me after you've captured the targets by using the Moodie Totem on their corpses and placed them in their cages.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, here's your cut. But don't ya worry bout me I'll make all that money back by placing some bets at the Crater of Carnage.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good, you'll need to use the Moodie Totem on them quickly before they decompose!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll more work for ya tomorrow!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured the creatures from the Isofringe of the of the Borellian Cluster using the Moodie Totem. Merchant Torook was quite happy with your work but not so happy about having to pay you. However he seems quite sure he will make his money back by betting at the Crater of Carnage.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How does this Moodie Totem work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why do you want reanimated creatures?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's just a little entertainment is all. You can enter to fight all kinds of different creatures and guns for hire from all over. Last one standing takes the prize.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Beats me, I just found it laying around somewhere. Just make sure to use it right after you kill the target and it'll reanimate them for me to enter in the Crater of Carnage.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: They're harder to kill for one. And they don't get scared and run away when they get hurt neither. But enough talk it's time to work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is a job that pays extremely well, if you bring back everything on the list.

localizedTextIdText: You met an Ekose captain named Spigo. He and his partner, a Krogg named Vicious Vlogg, were on their way to deliver goods to the Halon Ring. Along the way, their ship crashed in Farside. Help Spigo recover what he can from his ship in Fatalis Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Spigo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh sure, I could use a hand. I was on a delivery run when my ship veered off course and we crashed here. Will you help me find my ship and cargo?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You, uh, locate my ship yet? There was some real valuable cargo onboard, don't you know?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yep, those traps woulda killed a lesser $(player.race), but you got real skills. Now let's get the fella that's causin' us trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I gotta stay here in case anyone, uh, shows up. You betcha.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yep, he's been a pain in my tail for some time now...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: As you investigated the trail of wreckage, you learned that someone had been laying traps to conceal the location of the crashed ship. You managed to avoid the traps and followed the trail to the wreckage.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I was on an important haul with my mate, Vicious Vlogg, to the Halon Ring when I suddenly lost control. I jumped ship before she crashed, but the cargo I was haulin' was worth a hefty tag. I lost contact with Vlogg after the crash.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You ain't gonna make a lot of friends with that attitude, that's for sure.

localizedTextIdText: Vicious Vlogg was the cause of the Dustrunner's crash, and he planned to steal the cargo for the Darkspur Cartel. Vicious Vlogg must be brought to justice! Find him near the Dustrunner crash site and take him out!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Inspect a Farside Starship in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My old shipmate was an ex-Cartel thug named Vicious Vlogg. Seems like he was gonna take my cargo for his old buddies, yep. Find where he's holed up.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Vicious Vlogg's a waste of cargo space. He needs to be brought down, and hard. Don't listen to a darned tootin' thing he says!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Vicious Vlogg took off in one of these ships...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Save the last punch for me. I wanna jettison his keester myself, you betcha.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Vicious Vlogg is a crafty one! He managed to give you the slip, taking off in a single-passenger spaceship. Don't let him get away!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why would Vlogg take your stuff?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I don't know, maybe he's still runnin' with the Cartel. I betcha he got back with some of his old Darkspur pals and thought he'd swindle me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me do this myself. I don't really have the guns for it.

localizedTextIdText: Vicious Vlogg is trying to make a quick escape from Farside! There are ships near the Dustrunner crash site. Hop in one, chase him down, and blast him out of the sky.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Confront Vicious Vlogg in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This weathered fighter is in serviceable condition, complete with a fully-operational battle array. If you act fast you can catch up to Vicious Vlogg.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This weathered fighter is in serviceable condition, complete with a fully-operational battle array. If you act fast you can catch up to Vicious Vlogg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alright, alright. I give up...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Frackin'! I hit my head real hard back there... it stings a bit.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You've got nowhere else to run.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Vicious Vlogg tried to make his escape from Farside, but you were able to blast his ship out of the sky. Find Vicious Vlogg and bring him back to Spigo for his just desserts.

localizedTextIdText: On a tranquil rock in Bloodfire Bay, you met the great Walatusk Mursu in battle and slew it. You have taken its tusks as a trophy for Huntress Kezzia to display in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return Mursu's Tusks to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The tusks of Mursu prove your victory over this mighty Walatusk. This fine trophy of the hunt should adorn Bloodfire Village!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done a great feat, $(player.name)! Let these tusks stand as a monument to the hunt!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Any Draken would appreciate this victory.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You presented the Tusks of Mursu to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.

localizedTextIdText: A tract of farmland has been beset by the Darkspur Cartel, and the Settlement Authority has requested aid. Lord Syrus has assigned you to speak to Millennial Sidus at Farmers' Refuge and offer your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Millennial Sidus at Farmers' Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mine are not the only lands beset with filth. The Settlement Authority has sent a request for aid. Proceed to Farmer's Refuge and assist Millenial Sidus.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken with Millennial Sidus yet? A being of his stature would not request aid for not good reason. To ignore him is exceedingly unwise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lord Syrus sent you to me? This is fortunate, for this land is in need of a skilled hand. However, sowing crops is not your calling, I fear.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Millennial Sidus is overseeing operations in Farmer's Refuge. He is important.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your tasks will focus on pest control, and the pests are very, very large.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Millennial Sidus of the Settlement Authority near Farmers' Refuge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Settlement Authority is the office that oversees the development of Dominion communities on planet Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Mechari who bear that title came before all others. It is said they personally served the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have come too far to turn back now.

localizedTextIdText: Millennial Sidus has asked you to speak with Researcher Naboom at the Collegium basecamp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Researcher Naboom at Collegium Basecamp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Naboom, a Chua researcher at the Collegium basecamp, is experiencing difficulties. You have done well here, so I would have you offer him your help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Chua are not a species known for their patience, $(player.name). You had best go to the Collegium basecamp at once and speak to Naboom.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Not move fast enough. Faster next time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sidus send you, yes? Sidus supposed to be smart. Know many things. Say you are very good at job. Will find out for sure if Sidus is correct.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Naboom will be near the dig site. Scions preserve you, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much to do. Pay attention. Only going to say this once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Researcher Naboom at the Collegium basecamp. It seems the camp is under attack by Eldan constructs, and the Collegium scientists and researchers require your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I came as fast as I could.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Royal Collegium is the most respected scientific organization in the Dominion. It is an honor to work for the Collegium.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I expect he and his associates unearthed something that is making life difficult for them. They may not survive without you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A foolish choice, especially given your exemplary service so far.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Naboom says that Chemist Ingo is having trouble with his research near the Noxious Glade. Find his encampment and offer him your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Chemist Ingo near the Noxious Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Chemist Ingo researcher in Noxious Glade. Requests help with research. Poison gas everwhere. You go and help, yes? Will tell him to expect you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: No fear poison, $(player.name). Poison mostly painless. Unless it not painless. Then very painful. Very painful, indeed. Chemist Ingo tell you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here to help? Good good! Hope you live long. Need all the help I can get!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry hurry, or maybe poison gas kill him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fantastic! We get right to it now! Yes!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Chemist Ingo near the Noxious Glade. You get the impression that the poison gas might have affected his personality.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Large relic found in Noxious Glade. Very old! Royal Collegium know little about relic, mostly because of poisonous fumes in area.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Chemist Ingo be disappointed. I disappointed, too.

localizedTextIdText: You have located the Bladesworn Forge within Bladesworn Caverns. Explore the caverns, locate the two parts of the staff, then return to the Bladesworn Forge to forge it anew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the pieces of the staff to the Bladesworn Forge inside Bladesworn Caverns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The forge is inscribed: "In the dark, two sundered pieces lay. Forge them anew, sounding the call of life. Complete your trial or wither in shame."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The forge is inscribed: "In the dark, two sundered pieces lay. Forge them anew, sounding the call of life. Complete your trial or wither in shame."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You place the Lifecaller haft and the Lifecaller headpiece upon the Bladesworn Forge and the two pieces meld together seamlessly into a Lifecaller Staff.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: It's time to find the pieces of the staff.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Bladesworn Caverns and forged a new Lifecaller Staff for Ceris the Lifecaller as part of your Torine Trials.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: It's time to find the pieces of the staff.

localizedTextIdTitle: Crater of Carnage: Rotterloam the Giant
localizedTextIdText: The head of Rotterloam the Giant from Halon Ring's infamous Crater of Carnage would make a great trophy. It's badly damaged, but someone in Deadman's Landing might have a use for it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The head of Rotterloam the Giant from Halon Ring's infamous Crater of Carnage would make a nice trophy, but you'd have to get it stuffed first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya don 't want this one on your wall, eh? Seems a bit terrifying to me, too, but I never turn down a job. I'll get it fixed up 'n maybe someone'll buy it.

localizedTextIdText: Queen Drezza stinger, taken from her corpse in Halon Ring's infamous Crater of Carnage, would make a great trophy. Someone in Deadman's Landing ought to have a use for it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This stinger, taken from Queen Drezza in Halon Ring's infamous Crater of Carnage, would make a great trophy. It needs a bit of polish, though.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A giant stinger, eh? Taken from Queen Drezza, I'll wager. If I clean 'n mount it, I'm sure one of these filthy Marauders'll buy it.

localizedTextIdTitle: Crater of Carnage: Zaranith the Bonecrusher
localizedTextIdText: Despite the obvious damage it's suffered, the head of Zaranith the Bonecrusher from Halon Ring's infamous Crater of Carnage would make a wonderful trophy. The taxidermist in Deadman's Landing should be able to clean it up.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The severed head of Zaranith the Bonecrusher from Halon Ring's Crater of Carnage would make a great trophy for some lucky fan. It's a bit beat up, though.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Killed the Bonecrusher, ya did. Never thought I'd see the day, I surely didn't. Leave it with me and I'll find a home for it, I will.

localizedTextIdText: You found some research notes in Derelict Silo E23. Sergeant Redfall will probably want to take a look at them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Redfall via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears one of the researchers made it up here and left their notes behind. Sergeant Redfall should know what to do with them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It appears one of the researchers made it up here and left their notes behind. Sergeant Redfall should know what to do with them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You find something in the derelict silo, $(player.name)?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These notes are probably important. I'll get them to command ASAP.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get these to the sarge.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yep. I found these research notes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found some research notes in Derelict Silo E23 and handed them off to Sergeant Redfall.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll get these to the sarge.

localizedTextIdText: You found some research notes in Derelict Silo E23. Major Bracken will probably want to take a look at them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Bracken via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears one of the researchers made it up here and left their notes behind. Major Bracken should know what to do with them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It appears one of the researchers made it up here and left their notes behind. Major Bracken should know what to do with them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's that? Did you find something in the derelict silo?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, $(player.name). I'll get these to command at once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found some research notes in Derelict Silo E23 and handed them off to Major Bracken.

localizedTextIdText: Aloysius Moon is offering payment to any fighter capable of taking out Vorlek the Vicious in Swiftfell Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Aloysius Moon in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: REWARD!\nKill Vlork the Vicious and collect the prize! But if you die while tryin' I don't want to hear about it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: REWARD!\nKill Vlork the Vicious and collect the prize! But if you die while tryin' I don't want to hear about it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Nothin' wrong with a little bloodsport here an' there. The prize is darn good if'n you're interested.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, wha'dya know? You got some real scrap about ya, kid. I'll be keepin' my eye on you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Vorlek the Vicious for Aloysius Moon of Graylight.

localizedTextIdText: Galby Greenfield has lost a number of his "Wilderrun Survival Collection" books in Fool's Hope after lending them to other Exiles in camp. Unfortunately, he can't remember exactly who he loaned the books to. If you can find all three volumes, he would be most appreciative.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Galby Greenfield in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm missin' three important books from what I call my "Wilderrun Survival Collection." Just can't remember who I loaned 'em to! Mind helpin a book-lover out?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If only I could find those books
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I loaned the books in my "Wilderrun Survival Collection" to other Exiles, so they should be somewhere in Fool's Hope. Unless they aren't.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You found my "Wilderrun Survival Collection," eh? All three of 'em? That's great! I can't thank you enough!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm fairly certain they're all here in camp... at least, I think so.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now I can try out that recipe for snoglug. I hear snoglugs are tasty!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help you find your books.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located all of Galby Greenfield lost "Wilderrun Survival Collection" books and returned them to him.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll help you find your books.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me about your lost books.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There are three of 'em, like I said. "An Explorer's Guide to Pumera Bites," "The Exalted Wilderrun: Myth and Legend," and "To Serve Snoglug."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, yeah! Excellent cook book! You ever had snoglug before? I heard that once you eat a snoglug, you'll never want to eat nothin' else!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What, you got somethin' against readin'?

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Waz-Len would like you to capture Cosmoling Crawlers that are scattered around Graylight using the Cosmoling Cryoflash for his customers at the High Orbit Lounge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Waz-Len at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Cosmolings running around are delicious, but in this atmosphere they lose their nutrition quickly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you could flash freeze some for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great! My customers will love these.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you could flash freeze some for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll have more work for you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They won't get away from me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You use the Cosmoling Cryoflash to capture Cosmoling Crawlers around Graylight for Bartender Waz-Len.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're missing out.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Waz-Len would like you to capture Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for his customers at the High Orbit Lounge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Waz-Len at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Much like the Cosmoling, the Cosmotail are delicious. Unfortunatly, it's hard keeping a supply of Cosmotail when they float away so easily. Mind catching some for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, thank you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for Bartender Var-Doph.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What else are you going to do.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Waz-Len would like you to use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg out in Gamma Fields for his customers at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bartender Waz-Len at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Cosmolings and Cosmotails are delicious, but customers pay top dollar for the rare and dangerous Cosmogrub. Would you like to find me some?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yumm! My customers will be abuzz over this delicious treat!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent. Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't be a stranger!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg in the Gamma Fields for Bartender Waz-Len and his customers at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The pay will make it worth your time. You'll be back.

localizedTextIdText: A Bar Patron at the High Orbit Lounge, the Dominion bar in Graylight, has gotten word that you are seeking information marauders in Halon Ring. He has directed you to Kezok the Guzzler, a heavy drinker with a knack for picking up rumors and rare information.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Bar Patron at High Orbit Lounge in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Okay, I help you out. Why? Maybe I nice guy. Don't ask questions. You want gossip, you talk to Kezok the Guzzler. Drink with him, and he'll start talking.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can't find Kezok? Check top level of Above the Fold. He'll be there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, you made it back. And you're still conscious! Hope you learned something useful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Only thing bigger than Kezok's mouth is his belly. Be ready to drink up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good. Now you can stop bothering me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You drank Kezok the Guzzler into the ground at the High Orbit Lounge, the Dominion bar in Graylight, in order to find out that the various marauder clans have been gathering under Redmoon's banner.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why should I meet Kezok the Guzzler?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What else have they been saying about me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Word on the street is you're looking for information. If there is any one that knows anything, he's your guy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That you can't hold your liquor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What this? You lightweight or something?

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has established a beacon of Exile freedom on Farside called Stonebreaker's Stand. He and his mercs subsequently encountered a new threat - Ikthians referring to themselves as the Darktide.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek in Stonebreaker's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen up, $(player.class). We got Ikthian clowns on the left and Dominion jokers on the right. I need you to fall in and lend a hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad you decided to show. I'll tell ya right now - it ain't gonna be a pretty picnic on this here rock.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get your butt to Stonebreaker's Stand, pronto.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let me fill ya in.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went to the aid of Commander Durek at Stonebreaker's Stand. Between the Dominion and the Darktide Ikthians, things are going to get dicey.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya ain't got time to play class clown over here.

localizedTextIdText: You played a key role in defeating the Darktide on Farside before they could unleash the Plasmic Equalizer upon the Exiles and Dominion on Nexus. Commander Durek, not short on gratitude, sends you to Thayd for your next assignment. If travel assistance to Thayd is needed, use the Ship to Thayd in Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You're done here, $(player.name). I want you to pack your stuff and make way for Thayd. I bet they got big plans for ya there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You ready to scram? They're waitin' for ya in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name)! I heard all 'bout you and what you done for us on Farside. Much obliged.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lulu Blackbush will be waiting for you in Spaceport Horizon.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hope you don't gotta rest your eyes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your played a key role in defeating the Darktide on Farside before they could unleash the Plasmic Equalizer upon the Exiles and Dominion on Nexus. Commander Durek, not short on gratitude, sent you to Thayd for your next assignment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We're your only ticket off this rock, kid.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has established a beacon of Dominion order on Farside called Warbringer's Break. He and his sentinels subsequently encountered a new threat - Ikthians referring to themselves as the Darktide.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kezrek Warbringer in Warbringer's Break
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We choke on the stench of both traitorous Exiles and bottom-feeding Ikthians. Come to Warbringer's Break immediately. A great bloodletting approaches!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have arrived at last. Once more, we will serve the Dominion's enemies with a meal of cold steel!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make haste! The hunt will not wait for the slow and indolent!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is time to cut your teeth on the scales of the enemy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went to the aid of Kezrek Warbringer at Warbringer's Break. Between the Exiles and the Darktide Ikthians, things are going to get dicey.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then you serve no purpose here.

localizedTextIdText: Your played a key role in defeating the Darktide on Farside before they could unleash the Plasmic Equalizer upon the Dominion and Exiles on Nexus. Kezrek Warbringer, not short on gratitude, sends you to Illium for your next assignment. If travel assistance is required, report to the Ship to Illium in Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have done great things here, $(player.name). It is time for you to return to Illium. There, you shall be given your next direction.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Return to Illium, $(player.race). More bloody work awaits.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name)! Been waiting for you. Not long.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get to Illium immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No rest. No, no, no. Only work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Yours was a key role in defeating the Darktide on Farside before they could set loose the Plasmic Equalizer upon the Dominion and Exiles on Nexus. Kezrek Warbringer, not short on gratitude, sent you to Illium for your next assignment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your servitude is not complete.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Hekkel has asked you to collect a piece of abandoned Collegium technology and test its effects on Eldan Protectors and Augmentors in Windfall Cave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Hekkel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Testing of Collegium technology abandoned. Must return to testing. Find abandoned Collegium tech in cave. Test on constructs. Teach constructs lesson!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Nice toy! Original prototype. See? Genius! So be careful with toy when testing on constructs! Don't break it, clumsy $(player.race)!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gears and gaskets! Data from tech test collected and collated. Collegium require better defense against active constructs. Will help in future!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful! Tech not fully proven! Possibility of malfunction!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You go now. Maybe see you again later on.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully tested the effects of the abandoned Collegium Tech on Eldan constructs, allowing Researcher Hekkel to gather valuable data.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get away before I kick you.

localizedTextIdText: Deep in the heart of Biometrics Facility Gamma, you discover a powerful Plasma Core in the central shaft. You suspect that such an artifact could have potential and resolve to gather it for yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Access the Eldan Terminal in Biometrics Facility Gamma to unlock the door
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The readings on the Plasma Core in the next room are incredible. Gathering it could prove useful for the future...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Gather the Plasma Core in the power shaft.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Touching the core to the screen, you find the entire base now humming with new life. You wonder what other potential such an artifact could have...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Looks like a job for me.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: A job well done. I say.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The core generated additional power in the base, activating an old hologram.  Now that it's in your possession, you wonder if you could find a further use for it elsewhere...

localizedTextIdText: Learn more about the Torine by collecting some of their forgeblades. Find them around the swordforge in Fallen Stone Ruins , or loot them from a sword-bearing Torine sister.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Torine Swordforge in Fallen Stone Ruins
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Swordforge seems central to the purpose of this camp. Perhaps examining Torine forgeblades will illuminate its relation to the Torine sisters.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This Swordforge seems central to the purpose of this camp. Perhaps examining Torine forgeblades will illuminate its relation to the Torine sisters.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You rest the heavy swords by the forge. If the Torine sisters can wield these in battle, their strength must be truly superhuman.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to learn that the Torine sisters of Fallen Stone Ruins are incredibly strong after examining their prized weaponry.

localizedTextIdText: Millennial Sidus has asked you to recover the stolen supplies that the Red Ember Gang has taken and stockpiled at Bootlegger's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Millennial Sidus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Red Embers are preparing one of their ships to transport a load of stolen goods off world. Recover those goods before the criminals can blast off.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The goods the Red Ember gang are preparing for transport belong to the Dominion. It's your duty to recover those goods before it's too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your work in recovering the stolen items from the Red Ember gang is commendable. I shall report your involvement to my superiors.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make haste. They have already begun loading the crates.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will distribute these goods to their rightful owners.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They were busy, that is for sure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the stolen goods from Bootlegger's Landing for Millennial Sidus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are not above suspicion of collusion with the enemy. Remember that.

localizedTextIdText: Spigo was shipping some loftite from Nexus to the Halon Ring when his ship crashed. Most of the shipment spilled out. Help him collect as much loftite as possible at the Dustrunner crash site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Via Datachron, report to Spigo in Fatalis Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like my loftite shipment's gone and spilled all over the place! Don't look like much, but could you salvage what you can? I'll be grateful, you bet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This here loftite is set for delivery to the Halon Ring. Not sure why they need gravity defying crystals in space, but there you are.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well now. Seems I'd pay more in penalties for delivering half a shipment than if the whole thing got lost. I might as well keep it then, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A captain's only as good as his reputation, darned tootin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll just include it in my report. One lost shipment is small potatoes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: These might not be the most valuable loftite samples, but at least some of Spigo shipment is better than none at all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Guess you've got better things to do than make some easy money, yeah?

localizedTextIdText: The creatures on the surface of Farside are quite aggressive. It shouldn't be a problem for an adventurer like you to teach them the meaning of fear. Kill space creatures in Fatalis Fields to make the area safer for Spigo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Spigo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Clutch my cargo! These space critters make it hard to move around, you betcha. You mind clearing them out for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Busted bulkheads! This place is still crawling with critters! I can't stand alien animals. They make my skin crawl, yup. Get to killing them, okay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Navigator knows I'd be alien snacks if it weren't for you. I feel a lot safer now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll make it worth your while, darn tootin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait to get off this blasted moon, don't you know....
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I was born to kill alien critters.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: And I feel a little richer now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The creatures of Fatalis Fields haven't seen any new visitors for decades, but they've surely learned not mess with newcomers now.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I was born to kill alien critters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's easy money, you know. Your loss, friend.

localizedTextIdText: You found Baluk's Skull Gem off the broken corpse of Baluk the Skullcracker. The gem has enough shine to it that on of the Lopp at Anu Ani might find it of value.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A rich red gem fragment from Baluk the Skullcracker skull. While not the normal Lopp treasure, it may count as a "shiny".
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hunt-Master Suranti at Anu Ani would probably like a shiny gem.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hear or see anything for Lopp yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Shiny! Shiny! Red shinies are good. Lopp keep in honor of our victory over nasty Bloodrock Butchers.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Anu Ani.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought Baluk's Skull Gem to Hunt-Master Suranti at Anu Ani. The Lopp appreciated a token that was both a "shiny" and a token representing defeat for the Bloodrock Butchers.

localizedTextIdText: Bloodshaman Sorkan has told you that to fully participate in the Great Hunt, you must first speak to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Huntress Kezzia in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have earned the right to participate in the Great Hunt, $(player.name). Speak to Huntress Kezzia, here in Bloodfire Village, and she will guide you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If you wish to fully participate in the Great Hunt, you must speak to Huntress Kezzia.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are a stranger to me. Have you completed the rites of passage at the Blood Altar?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great things are in store for you. Go now, and bring honor to Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to Huntress Kezzia about the Great Hunt.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ah, Kezzia was once a pupil of mine. But the call of the hunt drew her away from study of the old ways. She is now first among the huntresses and roams Nexus far and wide, searching for worthy prey. She leads the Great Hunt here on Bloodfire Savannah.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not delay too long, the Great Hunt waits for no one.

localizedTextIdText: After destroying a strange Tentacular Aberration in the jungles of Wilderrun, you discovered that a small amount of Primal Energy Residue was left behind. Take the Primal Energy Residue to Bozango Grazz in Fort Vigilance so that he can analyze it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Bozango Grazz in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Primal Energy Residue, taken from the remains of a strange creature in the jungles of Wilderrun, might be of interest of Bozango Grazz.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Comes from strange creature, yes? Seen such creatures before, but only in deep space. Curious.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No idea. Wouldn't tell you, anyway. Now go away!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take it to Bozango Grazz.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the Primal Energy Residue to Bozango Grazz. Grazz indicated that the creature you killed was an example of species that is commonly encountered only in deep space. This begs the question - how did it get onto the surface of Nexus?

localizedTextIdText: From the looks of a Fallen Plank you found on the forest floor, someone is building something high up in Wilderrun's canopy - perhaps a treehouse. Explore the area surrounding the plank and see if you can find a way up into the treetops.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Maggs the Maimer at Hunter's Hideaway
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This wooden plank seems out of place, as if it fell from somewhere up in the treetops. Maybe someone's building something up there?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Peering up into Wilderrun's thick canopy, you think you can make out the shape of a tree house.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in the hell're you doin' up here? You ain't got no invitation!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've passed the first test, chum - you found us. Now, assumin' you ain't here to cause a ruckus, maybe you and I can parley a bit.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to find a way up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to climb up into Wilderrun's leafy canopy, revealing an expansive tree house that is home to a number of shady individuals - including Maggs the Maimer. Hopefully, the two of you can make a mutually profitable arrangement.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll try to find a way up there.

localizedTextIdText: You have decided to try and learn more about the Torine sisters by collecting their lifewater from the Maiden Pool in order to see what kinds of properties it possesses.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the $(vitem=122) to the Torine Vitara Relic in the Maiden Pool
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This seems to be a repository for water gathered from the nearby spring. Perhaps if you examine it, you can learn more about the Everpool.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This seems to be a repository for water gathered from the nearby spring. Perhaps if you examine it, you can learn more about the Everpool.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The water does seem refreshing, even nourishing, but it's unlikely that it is the sole source of the Torine Sisterhood's eternal youth.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What about my eternal youth? Hmph.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have examined the lifewater carried by the Torine near the Maiden Pool and found no extraordinary qualities linking it to the Everpool.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Torine Vitara Relic

localizedTextIdText: Dorian wants to investigate a potential connection between the Everpool, the Focus of Life, and the Torine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dorian via the datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Torine ladies sure are tough, more 'n' ordinary humans, anyway. Think you could take a gander at their camps for me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Sisterhood has camps scattered everywhere: in the southern Osun ruins, north of the swamp, and on a plateau to the northeast.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Torine have camps scattered everywhere: Giant's Wall to the south, Maiden Pool north of the swamp, and Fallen Stone Ruins  to the northeast.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Them Torine've got the will of ancients and the beauty of babes. Reckon they've been bathin' in the Everpool for a while.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I reckon it might have somethin' to do with the Everpool. Here's hopin', right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Wonder what a dip would do for us, eh cappy?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found some hints that indicate there is some kind of connection between the unique strengths of the Torine and the Everpool.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to Dorian via the datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Makes sense that you're scared, them swords are nothin' to sneeze at.

localizedTextIdText: Governor Aluviel wants you to use the Protostar Hycrest Dispatcher to travel to Hycrest so he can discuss a matter of some importance with you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Use the Protostar Hycrest Dispatcher to travel to Hycrest and speak with Governor Aluviel
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am quite impressed with your performance, and there is another task that suits you. Seek me in Hycrest, so we can discuss it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The weather is so very nice these days. Don't you agree?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Hycrest, citizen! It is so very good to see you. Too seldom have you graced these walls with your scintillating presence.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make haste by any means available to you. That's a good $(player.race).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us have a little chat, shall we?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've traveled to Hycrest and spoken to Governor Aluviel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You do not tell me "no," $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Gildgrass Province is experiencing some problems with a hostile Skeech tribe. Governor Aluviel has ordered you to report to Aviator Ralyus at the Gildgrass Airfield. See if there is something you can do to help out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Aviator Ralyus at the Gildgrass Airfield
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Gildgrass Province, where we have established a prominent Dominion manor, is being attacked by a Skeech tribe. Go there at once and lend a hand.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't keep Lord Syrus waiting. I expect you'll be meeting with one of his underlings first. Either way, your duty lies in Gildgrass. See to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Are you the governor's miracle worker? Lord Syrus has been expecting you. Things are quickly spiraling out of control.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A shuttle is waiting to take you to Gildgrass. Give Lord Syrus my regards.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we must attend to your business....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully met up with Aviator Ralyus at the Gildgrass Airfield.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get out of my sight before I have you executed.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can take this part and imbue you with increased damage output, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned an Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster and received a temporary enhancement.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can take this part and imbue you with extra Dexterity, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned an Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster and received a temporary enhancement.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can take this part and imbue you with extra Technology, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned an Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster and received a temporary enhancement.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can take this part and imbue you with extra Magic, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned an Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster and received a temporary enhancement.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can take this part and imbue you with increased healing power, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned an Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster and received a temporary enhancement.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can take this part and imbue you with increased defense, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned an Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster and received a temporary enhancement.

localizedTextIdText: The Royal Collegium Quartermaster at the Windfall Research Station is looking for any scraps of Eldan technology you come across. The Windfall Research Station will only be operational as long as settlers continue to provide the researchers with scrap parts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster at the Windfall Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are conducting research into Eldan technology in this province. Bring me any pieces of Eldan scrap you might find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Any creature in the Gildgrass Province might be in possession of a useful scrap of Eldan technology. Keep looking!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Analysis of your sample indicates it is old, but we can make still use of it. Trade it to me for any one of the enhancements we've developed so far.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Eldan scrap has been discovered throughout Gildgrass Province.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Walk with Dominus, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you've found some Eldan scrap, you can trade it to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster in exchange for enhancements produced by their research, but only when the Windfall Research Station is operational.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take Eldan Scrap to the Royal Collegium Quartermaster
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where can I find this scrap?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Beyond the bots of the Windfall Digsite itself, Eldan scrap can be recovered from Marauders, Skeech... just about any creature in Gildgrass Province might possess it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: As you wish. You hurt no one but yourself.

localizedTextIdText: The M.A.C. in Bloodfire Village has contacted you and suggested you pay it a visit. For a modest fee, theM.A.C. can bring you up to speed and teach you new skills. Exact currency is required.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Use the M.A.C. in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is ATK-327, the ability training kiosk in Bloodfire Village. Please utilize my services to improve your skills and abilities. Everyone else does.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Proceed to my kiosk in Bloodfire Village and access my services. Being used by you is my primary function.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You can receive ability training here. State your name and specialty, and insert exact indicated currency to continue.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please note that exact currency is required. Thank you for your cooperation.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Go on. Use me and then leave... just like all the others.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You visited the M.A.C. in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: *sigh* Why is that the first thing people always fasten on? Yes! I can talk! A talking machine! Now can we please move on to the part where I teach you devastating new techniques to murder and maim your foes?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I admit you're a bit of a challenge, but I am so superbly programmed I can even teach you! Oh wait, that wasn't what you were asking, was it? I can teach you everything! Of course, I'm constrained by your physical limits, *ahem* somebody apparently needs to do a bit of grinding out on the savannah, but I'll work with what I have.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: User has declined to upgrade their core capabilities. CPU unprepared for this.

localizedTextIdText: While exploring Wilderrun Chase, you discovered a strange, glowing mushroom seemingly imbued with primal life. Collect more Everglow Mushroom for Bozango Grazz so the scientist can learn if the mushrooms have any alchemical qualities.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Bozango Grazz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Primal Life emanates in waves from this glowing mushroom. You should collect more of these for Bozango Grazz - they might have some scientific use.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Primal Life emanates in waves from this glowing mushroom. You should collect more of these for Bozango Grazz - they might have some scientific use.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What? Where mushrooms? Mushrooms must glow, idiot!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Strange mushroom species. Glowy, filled with primal life. Though picked and dead, glowy mushrooms still growing. How interesting!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Will mention you in research notes. Now go away!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned a plethora of Everglow Mushroom to Bozango Grazz. The mushrooms continue to grow, even after being harvested, a detail that was not lost on Bozango Grazz.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll be back in a while.

localizedTextIdText: After the poisoning of the Pell in Stormseeker Village, trust and treaties have been shattered and the Pell of Ellevar are retaliating. Guardian Zelcon has requested aid out at Vigilant's Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Guardian Zelcon at Vigilant's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Several of my guards have sustained damage from Pell forces. Their sudden attack was not calculated. We require immediate assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your aid is required. Use the medkit to heal any injured guards you find. Quickly, before they expire.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your aid is required. Use the medkit to heal any injured guards you find. Quickly, before they expire.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I offer you gratitude for your assistance. Chances of survival were low without your help. Now we must deal with the problem at hand.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We are located northwest of Vigilant's Stand. Make haste.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Pell's sudden hostility must be dealt with swiftly, despite their grievances.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After the poisoning of the Pell in Stormseeker Village, trust and treaties were shattered, and the Pell of Ellevar retaliated against the Dominion. Guardian Zelcon requested aid at Vigilant's Stand and you delivered it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your lack of initiative is not pleasing.

localizedTextIdText: The Stormseeker Pell of Ellevar are enraged and building up a storm to wash away Lightreach Mission. You must infiltrate the Stormseeker Commune and disable their Primal Storm Emitters to weaken the storm.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report back to Guardian Zelcon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This storm is dangerous. My scouts say there are five primal storm emitters amplifying the High-Shaman's power. Disable them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Enter the Stormseeker Commune and disable their primal storm emitters before our settlements sustain damage. Hesitation is not recommended.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your efforts were sufficient. With the emitters down, the Pell High-Shaman will take longer to build up the storm. But your work is not done yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Each one appears to be leading to the source of the storm, so follow them one by one.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Toric is gathering information concerning the High-Shaman. He will be in touch.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Stormseeker Pell of Ellevar were enraged and building up a storm to wash away Lightreach Mission. You infiltrated the Stormseeker Commune and disabled their Primal Storm Emitters, weakening the storm and saving Lightreach.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps I misheard you...

localizedTextIdText: Defending Pell in Stormseeker Commune will not take kindly to your intrusion there. Kill any Pell that get in your way so that you can complete your mission objectives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guardian Zelcon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As you advance through Stormseeker Commune, the Pell will try to stop you. Take them out so that you can complete your mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We require that you infiltrate Stormseeker Commune and exterminate any Pell that try to stop you.
