localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Enemy casualty metrics indicate you have killed a sufficient number of Pell. Impressive work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Dominion is counting on you. Do not hold back.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With time running out, I fear for the worst.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I won't let the Pell stop me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: As you pushed your way through the Stormseeker Commune to stop the raging storm in Ellevar, many of the inhabitants tried to stop you, but you overcame them.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I won't let the Pell stop me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Was that insolence, or fear?

localizedTextIdTitle: The Wrath of the High Priest
localizedTextIdText: The Stormseeker Pell of Ellevar are enraged and building up a storm to wash away Lightreach Mission. Find and kill their High Priest in the Vein of the Flow at the heart of Stormseeker Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian at Toric's Command Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Stormseeker High Priest is summoning a storm within the "Vein of the Flow," the source of their power. You must stop him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must find the "Vein of the Flow" within the heart of the Stormseeker Commune, then kill the High Priest before it's too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, $(player.name). The skies are calm once again. I fear, however, the storm in the hearts of the Pell will never be calm after this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Should you fail, this storm will succeed in wiping Lightreach Mission off the map.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dominus has blessed us with your bravery this day. I thank you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will slay the High Priest.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can see the sky again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed the Stormseeker High Priest in the heart of the Stormseeker Commune, calming the skies and saving Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will slay the High Priest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Vigilant Church does not smile upon cowards.

localizedTextIdText: Priestess Trania Lavus has asked that you destroy the Eldan constructs used by the Pell and collect the fragments of Eldan technology that are left over. The Eldan constructs can be found in Stormseeker Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Priestess Trania Lavus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What an outrage! Those filthy Pell savages attack and use Eldan technology against us! I demand you smash their drones and salvage what fragments you can!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you speaking to me? Your task is simple! Destroy the Pell's drones and retrieve the fragments of Eldan technology within. Now go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, $(player.name). The Pell have their pets, as does the Dominion. Fortunately, you proved to be the deadlier of the two.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Undertake this deed for the glory of the Dominion! And for me, too, of course.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Eldan fragments are now mine! I mean... the church's... of course.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll destroy drones and collect the fragments.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Eldan constructs in Stormseeker Commune and collected the fragments of Eldan technology that remained for Priestess Trania Lavus.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll destroy drones and collect the fragments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How dare you say no to me. No one says no to me!

localizedTextIdText: A Chua scientist named Tani Bril discovered that the phylax jars the Pell use to hold their primal water creates the energy they power their spells with. He wants you to destroy them within the Stormseeker Commune, but you must avoid the energy bursts afterwards.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tani Bril via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pell have mystic jars. Sacred water inside. Very powerful energy. You destroy jars! Deny Pell power! Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sacred water in mystic jar fuels Pell magic. Destroy jars, Pell magic go bye-bye. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pell magic weakened. Impressive work. Good thing I thought of plan. Maybe I get medal now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Energy backlash likely. Very painful. Be careful!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enough talk. Time for reward!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: A Chua scientist named Tani Bril discovered that the phylax jars the Pell use to hold their primal water creates the energy they power their spells with. He asked you to destroy them within the Stormseeker Commune, and you gladly obliged him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(player.race) lazy. You hear? Lazy!

localizedTextIdText: Priestess Trania Lavus is used to eating finer food and finds her field rations disgusting. She's ordered you to search the Larallen Highlands for wild herbs and vegetables to make her meals more palatable.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Priestess Trania Lavus of the Radiant Legion via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: How can anyone stomach these rations! My palate simply can't stand this. You there! Find me something more gourmet, such as herbs and the like.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are plenty of herbs and vegetables that grow wild in the Larallen Highlands. They can't be any worse than the slop they're forcing me to eat.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These herbs and vegetables are filthy! Yet they will do, for the time being. I nearly fainted from my lack of proper sustenance...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly now, before I waste away to nothing!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You didn't happen to find any wine out there, did you?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll look for what you need.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected wild herbs and vegetables for Priestess Trania Lavus. Though she was not impressed with the bounty of your meager harvest, Trania will still feast like a queen.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll look for what you need.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you just going to let me starve?

localizedTextIdText: The Larallen Highlands are dangerous and filled with wild animals, and there have been many reported attacks recently. Guardian Zelcon wants you to cull local wildlife, pushing them back into the wilderness to reduce the number of animal attacks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guardian Zelcon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There have been many recent reports of animal attacks. I want you to head out into the Larallen Highlands and deal with the problem.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please head out into the Larallen Highlands and slay the wildlife there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should be adequate. Hopefully, there will be fewer reported attacks now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep an eye out while you are hunting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for your service, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Larallen Highlands were dangerous and filled with wild animals, so Guardian Zelcon sent you to cull the local wildlife to reduce the number of animal attacks on Lightwatch's citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you have better things to do.

localizedTextIdText: Larallen Slank have been chewing on Tani Bril wires, and he's had enough. He's asked you to go to the Larallen Highlands and use his new De-Toothing Beam on the slanks to blast the teeth right out of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Tani Bril at Vigilant's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Slanks chew on my wires! Equipment ruined! So I invent de-toothing beam. You use beam on slanks, blast teeth right out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use de-toothing beam on slanks! Then slanks have no teeth, cannot chew wires. Is important! Go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You collect many slank teeth, make me very happy. Rodents not chew wires now. Very happy!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I stay here, guard equipment. You bring slank teeth back to me! Buahahaha!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Slank teeth have armor-piercing qualities. Could be effective! Yes!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used Tani Bril De-Toothing Beam on Larallen Slank in the Larallen Highlands. Now the slanks will have a tough time chewing through his wires without teeth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Slanks rotten, nasty rodents! You help de-tooth them or else!

localizedTextIdText: You found a fresh kill and suspicious tracks. It could only be the legendary Mistclaw, a powerful ghostly dagun that stalks the Larallen Highlands. You'd earn no small amount of fame if you could track him down and kill him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guardian Zelcon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A trail leads away from this freshly-killed animal. From the looks of the tracks, they can only belong to the legendary Mistclaw!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The shredded meat hanging from these bones is still fresh. If you can hunt Mistclaw down and kill him, it'd be well worth the bragging rights.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A deadly dagun, designated as 'Mistclaw,' stalks the Larallen Highlands with impunity. A reward is offered for proof of its destruction.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am impressed that one such as you could eliminate a dagun of Mistclaw's reputation. Here is your reward for performing such a dangerous service.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have documented the evidence of Mistclaw's demise. Walk proudly, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a fresh kill and suspicious tracks leading through the Larallen Highlands. You tracked them to the legendary Mistclaw and took the beast down.

localizedTextIdText: The Royal Collegium Researcher at the Windfall Research Station wants you to test repurposed Eldan technology against Eldan constructs in the Windfall Digsite.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Royal Collegium Researcher at the Windfall Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My research requires the intervention of an untrained asset to evaluate the quality of a new weapon. Might you be interested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If my instructions were unclear, then allow me to be more direct. Take this gun and discharge it near Eldan constructs. We must test its effects.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your results have been analyzed, $(player.name). The weapon is operating within optimal parameters. I will produce more units to test as resources allow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Test the weapon against Eldan constructs in the Windfall Digsite.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are likely to remain loyal if I reward you. Take this to the quartermaster.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have conducted a thorough field test of the repurposed weapon. Report your findings to the Royal Collegium Researcher at once.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Royal Collegium Researcher
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have repurposed technology from this region into a weapon theoretically capable of disrupting Eldan constructs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You squander a valuable opportunity.

localizedTextIdText: Pyrius Octavian has asked you to trade supplies to the Stormseeker Pell in exchange for the Eldan technology they possess. Pick up the supplies gathered across the bridge and deliver them to the Elder Spirit-Walker in Stormseeker Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Elder Spirit-Walker in Stormseeker Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears the locals - what are they called? - have access to Eldan technology, and we want it.  Take some of our supplies and offer it to them for trade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Was I not clear? It is not me you must speak to.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Trust is important to us. Trust we must have if trades we will make.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Has the trust of the elders been gained? Hmm?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will even consent to overseeing the supplies myself.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Then a trade we can make.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll talk to the Pell, then.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have done all that they asked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pyrius Octavian asked you to trade supplies with the Stormseeker Pell for the Eldan technology they possess, so you traveled to Stormseeker Village and spoke to the Elder Spirit-Walker.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll talk to the Pell, then.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have somehow managed to fall beneath my lowest expectations...

localizedTextIdText: You have gained the trust of the Elder Spirit-Walker and he has agreed to trade Eldan Technology to you. Speak with the Stormseeker Arcanist and then escort the lifter back to Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Pyrius Octavian in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Go speak with our Arcanist, he shall send you off with the relics you seek.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I sent our Arcanist to gather the relics. Speak with him when you are ready to depart.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can't possibly have returned before the task was completed? Where is the Eldan technology?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I expected you sooner, citizen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May they guide you on the path of the storm!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The gratitude of an empire is yours.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: May this be just the beginning.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gained the trust of the Elder Spirit-Walker and he agreed to trade you Eldan Technology, which you promptly delivered to Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So be it, outsider.

localizedTextIdText: Something has happened to the Stormseekers. Investigate Stormseeker Village to find out what happened to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Examine the body in Stormseeker Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What... have you done... to us? *cough*
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Spirit-Walker can no longer muster up enough strength to speak.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Spirit-Walker can no longer muster up enough strength to speak.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I curse you... outsider. *wheeze* You are our... doom!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While investigating what happened to the Stormseekers, you discovered one of their Spirit-Walkers near death. He accused you of being responsible for whatever calamity has befallen his people.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Storm... take you....

localizedTextIdText: Search Stormseeker Village for clues about what happened to the Stormseekers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Perhaps you should search Stormseeker Village and try to learn what happened here.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Search Stormseeker Village and try to learn what happened here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am very busy, citizen. Please come back later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is everything well with you, $(player.name)? Tell me what ails you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Poisoned? How...?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll search the village for clues.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You searched Stormseeker Village for clues to what happened to the Stormseekers and discovered they've been poisoned by the supplies given to you by Pyrius Octavian.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see what I can find.

localizedTextIdText: Toric Antevian has asked you to confront Pyrius Octavian in Larallen Highlands about his poisoning of the Stormseeker Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Toric Antevian in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Who is responsible for this atrocity, citizen? They must be brought to justice for their crimes!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Confront Pyrius about poisoning the Pell. He should be somewhere in Lightreach Church. Look everywhere and I will join you shortly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Confront Pyrius about poisoning the Pell. He should be somewhere in Larallen Highlands. Look everywhere and I will join you shortly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have served the Vigilant Church well by bringing Pyrius to justice. We must not let faith blind us to the evildoers hiding amongst us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I see... go, then, and confront Pyrius. I will join you shortly.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Toric Antevian asked you to confront Pyrius Octavian about poisoning the Stormseeker Pell. You found him hiding in the Larallen Highlands. He admitted to the crime, and tried to kill you to silence you, but you killed him first.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would allow the guilty to escape justice?

localizedTextIdText: The Elder Mist-Dancer wants you to prove your prowess by hunting Highland Gribbons and Broadwings outside of Stormseeker Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Elder Mist-Dancer in Stormseeker Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You seek my prowess? You must first prove your own.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You show weakness, $(player.race)? You must hunt beast of the air! Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You hunt well. I and the Masters are pleased with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kill birds. Bring back meat from the hunt. Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May the prowess of the Storm be with you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What would you have me do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Elder Mist-Dancer had you prove your prowess by hunting Highland birds for their meat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I and the Masters shall repay you in kind.

localizedTextIdText: The Elder Wave-Caller wants you to gain wisdom by aligning the spirits contained within the Primal Water Vessels located in Stormseeker Village. There is a chance they might attack, so be careful.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Elder Wave-Caller in Stormseeker Village in Ellevar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You seek my wisdom? You must first align the spirits. Summon spirits from the primal water vessels. Befriend them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you show fear, outsider? If you want my wisdom, you must summon the spirits from the primal water vessels and befriend them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have aligned the spirits. Yes, the Masters are pleased with your accomplishments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Summon the spirits of water and storm. Only then will you find enlightenment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May the wisdom of the Storm be with you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What would you have me do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Elder Wave-Caller had you gain wisdom by aligning the spirits in Stormseeker Village.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Masters do not look favorably upon those who shun their requests.

localizedTextIdText: The Elder Brood-Mother wants you to gain empathy by playing ball with the Broodlings at the Stormseeker Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Elder Brood-Mother in Stormseeker Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You seek my empathy? You must first open your heart to the youngest of us. Can you feel their joy?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you do not know joy, then you are worthless to me. Play with the Broodlings. Feel their joy as if it were your own.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have encouraged our young and proven your own heart is not void of feeling. The Masters are pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Play with the Broodlings. Lighten your heart.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May the empathy of the storm be with you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What would you have me do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Elder Brood-Mother had you gain empathy by playing with the Broodlings.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: One with such a heavy heart will not get aid from me.

localizedTextIdText: Frizz and Frazzle want you to slay the Hoarding Stemdragon so they can collect its shinies!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Frazzle in Glintrock Dale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Big scary plant need to die! You strong! You deal with scary! Then we collect shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hurry hurry! Kill scary plant!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is the scary plant gone yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You sure showed scary plant! Now we have all scary plant's shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Careful out there. Very scary plant!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Frizz and Frazzle had you slay the Hoarding Stemdragon so they could collect its shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Scared of plant? Shame!

localizedTextIdText: Dio the Grumpel has requested your assistance rounding up Escaped Ravenok{p:Escaped Ravenok} along the Mistmurk Shore. Use Splorg Bait to lure and capture them, and then return to Dio at Mistymurk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Dio the Grumpel at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears my ravenok have escaped during all this commotion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is taking so long? Catch those ravenok and bring them back here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Most wonderful!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That would be most splendid. I think they wandered down by the lake.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall spread the news of your heroic deeds.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Dio at Mistymurk Camp requested your assistance rounding up Escaped Ravenok{p:Escaped Ravenok} along the Mistmurk Shore.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll catch them and bring them back here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So much for good will. Are you sure you won't reconsider?

localizedTextIdText: Agent Varac at Mistymurk Camp in Ellevar wants you to kill Mistymurk Snoglugs near the Mistmurk Shore in search of lost Eldan remnants.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Varac at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If the spider situation were not critical enough, it appears the local snoglug population has acquired a taste for Eldan remnants.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you acquire the remnants from the snoglugs?  I would help in your hunt, but I just polished my gears...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have you acquired the $(vitem=249) I was sent to recover?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Affirmative. Kill a few Mistymurk snoglugs and you should find them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent. I don't want to spend any more time here than I have to.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can go get them for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Here are the last of them...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Agent Varac at Mistymurk Camp in Ellevar had you kill Mistymurk Snoglugs near the Mistmurk Shore in search of lost Eldan remnants.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are not afraid, are you?

localizedTextIdText: You found the Shrine of the Masters, created by the Stormseeker Pell on the edge of Stormseeker Commune. They appear to show respect to each of the six primal powers, even though they revere water above all else.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are six offerings here, one for each of the primal powers. While the Stormseeker Pell revere water, they apparently respect the others, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There are six offerings here, one for each of the primal powers. While the Stormseeker Pell revere water, they apparently respect the others, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Shrine of the Masters, created by the Stormseeker Pell on the edge of Stormseeker Commune. They appear to show respect to each of the six primal powers, even though they revere water above all else.

localizedTextIdText: Stabby the Wreckless was a brave Lopp warrior, famed for hunting Bonecrusher the Top-Heavy across the Larallen Highlands. From the looks of things, he succeeded at killing Bonecrusher. Unfortunately, the massive girrok fell on top of him and crushed him to death in his moment of victory.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This corpse and spear belong to Stabby the Wreckless, a famous Lopp hunter. Unfortunately, his last kill, Bonecrusher the Top-Heavy, got the last laugh.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This corpse and spear belong to Stabby the Wreckless, a famous Lopp hunter. Unfortunately, his last kill, Bonecrusher the Top-Heavy, got the last laugh.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Stabby the Wreckless was a brave Lopp warrior, famed for hunting Bonecrusher the Top-Heavy across the Larallen Highlands. From the looks of things, he succeeded at killing Bonecrusher. Unfortunately, the massive girrok fell on top of him and crushed him to death in his moment of victory.

localizedTextIdText: Utsah the Curious was tricked by neighboring Chua into trading Eldan Tech for a potato gun, and he isn't sure what to do with his prize. Use his Veggie Launcher to lure the Kurg Bull back to the Glitterfur Caravan in Ellevar. Stay clear of the bull, though.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Utsah the Curious at the Glitterfur Caravan
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Utsah's prized kurg way out in fields, won't come back. Utsah real worried 'bout him. You know how launcher works. Use it to bring kurg home!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If kurg not back soon Utsah will have to carry all the shinies by himself. So heavy! Please bring back Lopp's kurg bull!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Kurg back! Dance time! You smart guy. Take Utsah's best shiny. Prized kurg bull worth it! $(self.visual=739)
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't get close to grumpy kurg bull, he hurts big time. Will knock you down.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Utsah take launcher to Lopp villages. Show Lopp new way to lead kurg!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll bring the Kurg back using the launcher.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You sure you need this launcher back?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully used Utsah's Veggie Launcher to lure his prized Kurg Bull back to the Lopp Glitterfur Caravan in Ellevar. You wonder if Utsah will ever discover how unfair his trade was.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll bring the Kurg back using the launcher.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Utsah sad. Kurg far away. Scary monsters go chompy times! What Lopp do then?

localizedTextIdText: After a daring escape from Levian Bay, you've arrived in the mysterious lands of Ellevar. Toric Antevian, head of the Radiant Legion, has stationed himself in the combat house at Lightreach Mission. Introduce yourself and help him tame the wilds of Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that that nasty bit of business is over, why don't you have a chat with Toric while I get my bearings? It's an overwhelming honor, I know.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't make the mistake of being overly-familiar. Neither of the Antevians take kindly to that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you're the hero from Levian Bay I've been hearing about. Pleasure to meet you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You may recognize him by his title: the Vigilant Star.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have much to do to if this land is to be brought under our control.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The honor is mine, Vigilant Star. $(player.visual=368)
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Toric Antevian, Holy Commander of the Radiant Legion, has asked for your help in conquering this new and wild land by helping to establish Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I wouldn't dare dream of leaving before I've uncovered all of Ellevar's secrets!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you serious?

localizedTextIdText: The Vigilant Church's military arm, the Radiant Legion, is establishing Lightreach Mission to help lay a foundation for future Dominion domains. Help Guardian Villos, Woodworker Lucus, and Artemis Zin with their duties around the mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Guardian Villos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lightreach Mission is the first bastion of the Vigilant Church on Nexus. Assist the citizens of Lightreach in making it worthy of the honor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: To help Lightreach become a standing stone for the church here on Nexus, help out Guardian Villos, Woodworker Lucus, and Artemis Zin with their duties.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The integrity of Lightreach Mission is due to our unrelenting loyalty to the Six Virtues and the hard work of our military might.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If you're done with the Holy Commander's dirty work, I've got a real job for you to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: In aiding one, you strengthen us all.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Strong work, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: There may be some unrest within the Radiant Legion. A ranking officer is questioning the integrity of Holy Commander Toric Antevian. Could there be some legitimacy to these doubts?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Turning your back on all those who depend on your help? Pitiable.

localizedTextIdText: Guardian Villos has doubts of Toric's full devotion to the Vigilant Church. Seeing Toric Antevian unfit to be the Holy Commander, he seeks your help in proving his cause. Search around Lightreach Mission for any proof that may help Villos.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Guardian Villos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If Toric's devotion is called into question, the damage may be unrepairable. Investigate Toric for signs of impropriety. If he truly holds to the Six Virtues, it will do no harm.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Investigate Toric's living quarters for signs of impropriety. Emperor willing, you'll find it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So our weak-willed Commander has fled to the woods to fraternize with the shameless Lady Zin. We must act quickly!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The strength of the Vigilant Church rests upon the purity of its servants.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll see that lowborn upstart exposed for the depraved mongrel that he is!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Toric Antevian was last seen heading into the woods alone. This suspicious act warrants further investigation. Guardian Villos orders you to confront Toric in the Larallen Highlands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What makes you doubt his devotion?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Seems you don't like him much.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There's been no proof of impropriety you understand, but whenever Lady Zin is around, Toric becomes... distracted. And he's been 'distracted' a lot more recently than ever before.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That whelp was studying tactics while I was leading battalions! He has no business jumping over ranks of seasoned Primes to become Commander. You must understand, however, it is the fate of the Church which motivates me. My loyalty is absolute.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I wouldn't care to speculate on the vile things that he has gotten up to.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Go, fool. Your hesitation to take action marks you as yet another flawed vessel.

localizedTextIdText: Toric Antevian was last seen heading to the woods by himself. Confront him in the Larallen Highlands for his suspicious behavior.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Guardian Villos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Locate our flawed Commander and record whatever misdeeds you find him engaging in.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find Toric in the woods and expose him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It would seem that my concerns have been... misplaced. Remember that your actions, however repugnant, have been undertaken on behalf of the Church.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Toric is not worthy to be the Holy Commander, and now you will finally prove it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You did what you were ordered to. Let us speak of this no further.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Toric was only concerned with our welfare.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The mission was running low on supplies, so Toric personally made sure to collect additional provisions for the town. The veracity of Toric Antevian vigilance has been proven to everyone.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If he's allowed himself to stray from the Church's embrace, there's no telling. I shudder to think of the depravities that he's most certainly engaged in.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: What of her? Artemis Zin has never been a proper lady, for all that she seeks is knowledge. Nor does she care much for the widespread influence of the Vigilant Church.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Whose side are you on?

localizedTextIdText: Toric Antevian was out in the Larallen Highlands collecting supplies for the town. As you helped him return the provisions, angry wildlife, lured by the scent of the rations, attacked. Fend off the attackers and show Toric Antevian the kind of fighter you are.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Did Villos send you? He's got quite the imagination, eh? Since you're here, lend me a hand. Transport the provisions I acquired back to town.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please convey those victuals into town for me. The mission needs sustenance for the upcoming months.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please convey those victuals into town for me. The mission needs sustenance for the upcoming months.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: They were right about you. You fight with intent and passion, hallmarks of a true holy warrior. Your deeds will not go unnoticed by my eyes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm going to need to have a word with Villos.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May you be ever victorious, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll make sure these provisions make it back.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You protected the provisions and met Toric Antevian back in Lightreach Mission. Toric applauded you for your skills, and will continue to call upon you should he need your help again.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What were you doing out here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So you weren't engaging in anything... promiscuous?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The mission's food supply was going low. I wanted to personally make sure we had enough for the upcoming months, so I took it upon myself to acquire some wild game.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: When an idea gets implanted, we start to only see what we want. Villos gets distracted, but I'd want him by my side in the heart of battle any day.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps I was wrong about your devotion to our cause.

localizedTextIdText: Lightreach Mission was recently established by the Vigilant Church, and currently lacks protection against the local wildlife. Help Guardian Villos set up some defenses around the perimeter of Lightreach to discourage unwelcome guests.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Guardian Villos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Did Toric send you? While he's busy running "errands," we keep this mission safe. Be useful and ensure our defense turrets are in working order.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It is not that hard to activate the turrets. Just press the blue button a couple of times.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should stave off the wildlife for a while. I grow tired of keeping the Mission safe without the help of our great Holy Commander.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Someone has to do real work to keep this mission safe from predators.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It takes work to keep this place safe.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With defenses in place, the local wildlife will be less encouraged to wander close to Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have no time for jokes.

localizedTextIdText: Lightreach Mission is still under construction. Help Woodworker Lucus by bringing him supplies from around Eastern Highlands in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Woodworker Lucus in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sent by the great Vigilant Star, were you? I'm honored. I could use a hand in haulin' back some timber I chopped down, if you'd be so kind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If its not an inconvenience, I could use a hand in haulin' back timber from around town.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Many thanks to you, my friend. This mission'll be the shining foundation for the future of the Dominion, it will.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: An acquaintance of the Vigilant Star... can't wait to tell me wife, I can't.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have me thanks, mate.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped gather wood in the Eastern Highlands for Woodworker Lucus. In time, Lightreach will become a shining example of Dominion expansion on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind, you know where to find me.

localizedTextIdText: Lightreach Mission sits on the edge the mysterious Lake Larallen. Opposite of Lightreach Mission, there appears to be a buried ancient Eldan site. Remnants of Eldan technology may be hidden in the lake. Help Artemis Zin find traces of the elusive Eldan race.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kevo in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There must be treasure lurking around this place. And I'm feeling lucky with this lake. See if you can find me any strange artifacts.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please be a dear and take a swim in the lake. With an Eldan site so close, there has to be an interesting find in there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: For your sake, I would do what she says. I don't like it when others make her upset. Do you understand me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I will take this artifact for Little Miss. Her mind has been preoccupied as of late.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I need something to get my mind off my more... personal matters.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pieces and fragments of Eldan technology litter bottom of Lake Larallen. Though distracted, Artemis Zin will doubtless find one of these relics to be fascinating.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? Your loss.

localizedTextIdText: You ran across a caravan of Lopp - furry little traders of all things "shiny." These Lopp appear to have been trading with the people of Lightreach Mission for weapons and supplies. However, they don't seem to know how to use these tools. Show them how.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chieftain Aleli at Glitterfur Caravan
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello, friend! We are Lopp. We traders for all things shiny. We trade with big-folk in town for traps. We need furs from scary dagun. Help Lopp!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please help Lopp. We try to use, but traps no work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, so that is how Lopp can use traps. But Lopp too small to fight like that. Oh well, Lopp use traps to trade for more shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They tell Lopp these are number one traps!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll show you how to use these.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Lopp thanked you for the furs and for showing them how to fight the Dagun with their traps.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll show you how to use these.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: What you think? Lopp is Lopp! Lopp know what you are. Big dummy person for asking!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lopp big-time explorers. We hunt for treasure. For shinies! We go all over universe. Vroom!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You no like Lopp no more?

localizedTextIdText: Lopp travel to faraway places and set camp next to established areas to trade for supplies. They are skilled hunters and gatherers in their own right, but at times will need assistance. Help the Glitterfur Lopp reclaim some of their scavenged loot in the Larallen Highlands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Huntmaster Genki at Glitterfur Caravan
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp travel from faraway land to collect shinies. But wildlife think shiny food too tasty. Take all shinies when Lopp sleep. Help Lopp get shinies back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Help Lopp get back shinies. Need shinies to trade for more shinies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Big-folk great help to Lopp. Lopp will help big-folk in future. Lopp will only ask for half the shinies from you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't let creatures eat you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You retrieved most of the lost shinies for the Lopp.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What's the deal with the shinies?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lopp have nice planet called Lagos. It very nice there. Yes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lopp no have big vroom ships. We trade shinies to Protostar and Ekose to ride big vroom ships. To Nexus we go!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Nothing better than shinies. Don't you know that?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk is heartless folk!

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon is drunk in the Emperor's Crown Tavern. In order to fulfill his contract to rescue Lydia Horacos he needs to sober up, and fast! Corrigan has asked you to prepare a special remedy that gets him through situations like this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corrigan Doon in the Emperor's Crown Tavern
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lord Horacos did pay me to reshcue hish little girl... I jusht need a drink to help me wake up. It'sh a... shpecial remedy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The ingredientsh can be found around Lightreach Mission. I'll get up as shoon as the room shtopsh shpinning.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, there it ish... I'll name it the $(player.name) shurprise!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Heresh the lisht of ingredientsh. I'll jusht... shtay here and... uh... resht a while.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bottomsh up!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can't believe I'm about to go mix you a drink.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Just drink it down and get going.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You prepared the remedy that Corrigan Doon asked for in the Emperor's Crown Tavern, and he became drunker as a result. Well, at least you tried.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I can't believe I'm about to go mix you a drink.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: In that caish, I'll jusht take a nap...

localizedTextIdText: Lord Horacos' daughter has gone missing after her shuttle went down somewhere east of Lightreach Mission. Corrigan Doon was hired to locate her and has agreed to split the reward with you if you help. Summon him in the areas Northeast of Lightreach Mission to assist you. You have a tracker that should help you locate any shuttle wreckage in the Emerald Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corrigan Doon at the Emerald Plains
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm shtill drunk. Shurprise! Now you get to help me for a change! Thish tracking device will help ush locate Lydia'sh shuttle! Let'sh go!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lishten, you jusht keep looking for thoshe heat shigna... shignatures... we'll find her together!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lishten, you jusht keep looking for thoshe heat shigna... shignatures... we'll find her together!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll admit that it looksh bad, but heck, I've had worse landings and always seemed to walk away fine. *HIC*
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh look at me...! I'm not in any condition to reshcue anyone...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We can't *HIC* give up.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What do you mean? I literally just helped you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: At least we found the shuttle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed the trail of wreckage through the Emerald Plains of Ellevar, and discovered the downed shuttle that was carrying Lord Horacos's daughter. After some searching, you also located the shuttle recorder and determined that the vessel was shot down.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are you helping Lord Horacos?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mansh gotta eat, right? Hish little girl went mishin... he shent shome men on over to inveshtigate, now they ain't returning hish calls.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Hora... Horacosh paysh well. Lord'sh can afford to, what with all their money. After all I'm Corrigan Doon. I'm kind of a big deal, even out here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, c'mon! It'll be fun, I promish!

localizedTextIdText: Chemist Ingo has informed you that Major Caros at Fort Glory is in need of assistance. Proceed there with all due speed and see how you can help the Dominion military out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Major Caros at Fort Glory
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Very helpful. Good thing you came along, but now? Must go. Soldiers at Fort Glory call asking for help. You go now?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Major Caros requires help from experienced problem solvers like you. Go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Are you here to lend your strength at arms to the Dominion, or are you here to waste my time? Speak quickly! I am a busy man.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak to Major Caros. Has much responsibility!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're direct and to the point. I like that. Let's get you an assignment.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help out at Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Major Caros at Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll help out at Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe you're not so helpful after all.

localizedTextIdText: An Ekose named Adalno has requested that you help defend his roan herd from ravenok in the Emerald Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Adalno via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ahoy there! I got me a heck of an issue with ravenok runnin' wild over my roan herds nearby, you understand. You lookin' to earn some coin?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The ravenok have been nesting along the Emerald Plain. Be mindful, though. Their talons look mighty sharp, yep!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, there you are! You're a heck of a pal to do what you done, no mistake! I've transferred some funds over on account of all your hard work, ayep!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Them birds'll wipe out my whole herd, don't ya know. Gotta kill 'em first.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for the help. Can't never have too much of that, no sir.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Adalno roan herd by reducing the number of ravenok dwelling in the Emerald Plains. He seemed optimistic about your efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm not afraid of those birds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, fine then. Don't want to earn any money? Whatever.

localizedTextIdText: You found a crate of emergency supplies near the site of the shuttle crash in the Burning Wood. You decided to use the signal flares inside to frighten away Longsnout Scavenger and Longsnout Prowler that have been attracted to the wreckage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Horacos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A crate of emergency supplies lies open on the ground. What could be inside? A flare gun, maybe?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A crate of emergency supplies lies open on the ground. What could be inside? A flare gun, maybe?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hear you are working on clearing the dagun with those signal flares. How is that going?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Perhaps now that you've finished frightening those dagun, you can return to the task at hand. Stop wasting time and find my daughter!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll use the signal flares to frighten the dagun.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I frightened dagun away from the shuttle crash site.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the signal flares you found in the emergency supplies kit to frighten Longsnout dagun away from the crash site in the Burning Wood.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll use the flare gun to frighten the dagun.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm working on frightening them away.

localizedTextIdText: The shuttle crash site in the Burning Wood of Ellevar is cluttered with corpses. Corrigan Doon has asked that you identify the dead and verify that Lydia Horacos isn't among them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corrigan Doon
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You should identify the corpses and make sure Lydia isn't among them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This ship was serviced by Dominion military techs, so I can't imagine this was an engine failure. We should keep looking for Lydia.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: She isn't here. Let's take that as the positive sign that it is.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let's get started.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: But our work isn't over yet.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hopefully Lydia isn't among these corpses.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: She isn't here, that's a relief.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You identified the corpses strewn throughout the Burning Wood and didn't find Lydia among them. Corrigan took that as a good sign.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do we do if Lydia is dead?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I doubt we have anything to worry about. I mean, it's just a little crash. She might be in terrible pain somewhere, probably scared out of her mind...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: ... poor thing's probably calling for help. You know? But of course everyone around her is dead, so they can't do a dang thing...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Well hey... you asked.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Come ooon! Be reasonable!

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf would like you to speak with Tender Kaiya in Woodhaven and protect her from Draken hunters as she performs a binding with the hoogle spirit protectors surrounding the town.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Arwick Redleaf at Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to refresh the hoogle spirit totems that protect Woodhaven. Take Kaiya and protect her during the binding. She'll be very vulnerable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kaiya is the only one here who can bind with the hoogle spirit protectors. You'll need her if you plan to protect Woodhaven from Draken attack.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Woodhaven is safe now, but the rest of the forest remains in grave danger. Man, I hate the Draken!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kaiya's the only one here strong enough to bind to the hoogle spirit totems.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go too far. We've got more work to do here!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You protected Tender Kaiya as she joined with the hoogle spirit protectors to shield Woodhaven from further attacks by Draken hunters.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're a part of Celestion, and they predate our arrival. Wherever they came from, we know they've got protective properties, and I can smell the Weave on them. If anyone can bind to them and amplify their power, it's Kaiya.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: She has the makings of a matria. She's our best shot, and she's not easily replaced. Myala has gone to Sylvan Glade, but if you think I'd risk her safety for any reason, you don't know me very well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me claw you to shreds.

localizedTextIdText: To protect Woodhaven, Arwick Redleaf needs you to get Watcher Yalesh Sageroot from Sageroot's Outpost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report via Datachron to Arwick Redleaf in Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We can do this if you can persuade Watcher Sageroot to help. He knows these woods well, and he may call upon nature's allies to support us in Woodhaven's defense.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You'll find Yalesh Sageroot at Sageroot's Outpost, outside of Woodhaven. We could really use him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What do you mean he refused to join me? I just want to protect my people. Is that so hard to understand? I won't stop now. We'll do it without him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Talk to Sageroot. Watchers work alone, but I need him with us on this one.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We will fight the Dominion to the death with or without Sageroot's aid!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: To reinforce Woodhaven, you went to Sageroot's Outpost and found Watcher Yalesh Sageroot, but he wouldn't leave his post.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: His primary concern as a watcher is to protect the forest, not necessarily to protect us. Those are his morals, and if I know him, he's going to stick to them like a berryleaf.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And I thought you were an ally. Guess not.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf would like you to kill Bonerazer Draken and free the Captured Villager they've imprisoned in Cursewood.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Draken hunters are capturing Aurin out in the forest. First, warn the Mordesh in Woodhaven of the threat. Then go free our Aurin friends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Draken use Cursewood as their hunting grounds, but they're not the only ones capable of stalking prey. Rescue my brethren and make the Draken pay.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it! Though the forest speaks of bloodshed, many Aurin have made it safely back to Woodhaven. They now sing your praises.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Draken hunt in Cursewood. That's where we'll track 'em... and make 'em pay!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sometimes you have to get your claws dirty.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed Captured Villager the Bonerazer Draken captured and caged in Cursewood.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You want me to kill the captors?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where can I find the captured villagers?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That's the only way to stop 'em from killing more Aurin. It's not a pretty solution, but they picked a fight with us. Let's make 'em bleed for it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They were last seen in Cursewood. It's a dangerous place, even without those hunters sneaking around.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm not in the mood for insolence.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf would like you to destroy Bonerazer raiding equipment around their camps at Cursewood and Bonerazer Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Blood and blight! These hunters don't stop! We have to do something - take out their raiding equipment. Use this firesap on their weapons to ruin 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Thorns! Get back out there and destroy their weapon racks. They're all over Cursewood, so you should have no trouble finding 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work. If destroying their weapons doesn't slow them down - we'll just have to go at them with something else!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then I better stop chewing your ears off so you can get some work done.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is far from over.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Bonerazer raiding equipment around their camps in Cursewood and Bonerazer Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Firesap is a magical extract that acts as an incendiary when exposed to the air. It burns hotter than the sun, but it won't affect plants. It's pretty cool stuff.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What did you say? I didn't hear you...

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf would like you to kill Razen the Preyfinder, the Draken huntress and matriarch responsible for tormenting the Aurin, in Bonerazer Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bonerazer's matriarch, Razen the Preyfinder, has brought chaos and grief to our forest. She torments her victims mercilessly. Rip her to shreds!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Treesblood! If it means restoring balance to the forest, I'll kill Razen myself! Now get to Bonerazer Village and take her out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You killed the Preyfinder and avenged our fallen. Though the leaves have been stained red by our blood, you are a proven protector of the forest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Avenge my people. The forest doesn't forget, and I don't forgive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The balance is restored, but we can't ever replace the lives that were lost.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Razen the Preyfinder in Bonerazer Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What else can you tell me about her?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Razen the Preyfinder might be the most sinister Draken we've yet faced. She delights in torturing her captives, sometimes feeding them to exotic game and other... things... better left unsaid.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The leaves are turning red as blood.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Papovich would like you to assist her in an experiment to revive the Aurin murdered by Draken hunters. Bring $m(vitem=152) from Murdered Aurin{p:Murdered Aurin} in Bonerazer Village to Professor Papovich in Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Professor Papovich at Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The dead may provide a valuable resource. Bring me fresh parts from fallen Aurin, and we may yet revive the dead. Imagine a lost love... restored.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To restore life to the dead, I require you to gather body parts from murdered Aurin in Cursewood. Bring them to me when you're done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Boiling blood! This will never do! I fear Anatoli must wait in darkness for a while longer. I apologize for entangling you in this... failure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'll keep this our little secret... from Arwick. You understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May fate spare you a bit longer, but if it does not, you have my regrets.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assisted Professor Papovich in attempting to revive the Reconstructed Aurin{p:Reconstructed Aurin}, but the experiment went horribly wrong.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Don't worry. I'm working on it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Are the Aurin okay with this?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They mistrust alchemy and all things gloomier than a bouquet of flowers. They need not know the means if, in the end, it should provide life to their kin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me dissect you.

localizedTextIdText: Viralist Katoff would like you to collect $m(vitem=125) from Bonerazer Draken in Cursewood. He would like to use the samples to create a Bloodbane Toxoid for you to test against Bonerazer Draken.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Viralist Katoff via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you bring me blood samples from Draken hunters, I can concoct a crippling toxoid that should cause them to suffer a slow and painful death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Draken hunters prowl in Cursewood. You will not find any of them here. At least, I do not think so.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My tailored Bloodbane toxoid will change the tide of this war! Even the greatest hunter cannot resist his own physiology.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Convey yourself to Cursewood. Donors and test subjects abound there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May darkness claim our foes before it claims us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=125) from Bonerazer Draken in Cursewood for Viralist Katoff in Woodhaven. He then created the Bloodbane Toxoid that you tested successfully on the Bonerazer Draken.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am very disappointed. Perhaps I might have a sample of your blood?

localizedTextIdText: Viralist Katoff of Woodhaven would like you to use the decloaking grenade to draw out Bonerazer Ambusher hiding in Suspicious Bush{p:Suspicious Bushes} in Cursewood.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Viralist Katoff via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have seen Draken hunters hiding in the foliage of Cursewood, ambushing unsuspecting travelers. Draw them out to fight using this decloaking grenade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for suspicious plants in Cursewood. Then lob the decloaking grenade to reveal any ambushers in hiding. Should any emerge, execute them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The grim demise of our people, as well as that of the Aurin traveling these dusky trails, has been curtailed for a time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch for movement in the bushes in Cursewood. Then let fly your grenade!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sooner or later, death will claim us all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Bonerazer Ambusher hiding in Suspicious Bush{p:Suspicious Bushes} in Cursewood for Viralist Katoff of Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I draw them out?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are you sure it will work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: As I said, this decloaking grenade should do the trick. Best to start a safe distance, then launch the grenade at your prey.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The margin of failure is low, but they may decide to spring upon you if you get too close.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Life is short. Do not make yours any shorter.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf would like you to kill the Bonerazer elders that are responsible for leading the hunters to kill the forest creatures and the Aurin of Woodhaven. The Bonerazer elders can be found in Bonerazer Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My intel suggests Razen the Preyfinder relies on village elders to arrange her hunts. I want to take the hunt to them. Find the elders and kill 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Razen the Preyfinder relies on village elders to her arrange big-game hunts. I want you to find her elders in Bonerazer Village and end them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work, but there's a deadlier foe out there. I hope you're ready for this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm counting on you to deal a serious blow to Razen's regime.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Listen up, $(player.name). This isn't over yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Bonerazer elders that were responsible for leading the hunt in Bonerazer Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're called Marok and Dakkar. It's said that they belong to Razen, and will obey her every desire.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Marok is older than Dakkar, but he's still quite powerful and deadly. Don't let his old age make you go easy on him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Dakkar's one of Razen's newest pets. He's still older than dirt - for a Draken - but he attributes his long life to all the Aurin hearts he's devoured.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought you'd be useful.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf wants you to return to him in Woodhaven. He has a special request - one that will take you all the way to Sylvan Glade and Queen Myala Everstar side!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Arwick Redleaf in Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I want you to join Queen Myala in Sylvan Glade. She's expecting me, but I need to finish up here. Return to Woodhaven and I'll tell you more.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The trees whisper of danger near Sylvan Glade. Go there, to Queen Myala's side, and protect her. Die if you have to, just make sure she's safe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I guess you could say I've come to rely on you. I better not regret it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There's a taxi leaving here for Sylvan Glade shortly. I suggest you catch it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Arwick Redleaf asked you to return to him in Woodhaven to discuss a special request - one that will take you all the way to Sylvan Glade and Queen Myala Everstar side!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be a thorn in my tail!

localizedTextIdText: A local hive of Dazeroot buzzbings, after being weaponized by Chua scientists, are spreading hypnotic pollen to send the forest's creatures into a deep and eternal sleep. Watcher Yalesh Sageroot has asked you to gather nearby resources from Thistlewood Thicket and return to him at Sageroot's Outpost in order to construct a Horn of Heralding. He believes the horn is his only hope of restoring balance to the forest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Watcher Yalesh Sageroot at Sageroot's Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The creatures of Thistlewood have fallen prey to a deadly and unnatural slumber. To save them, I'll need sacred resources to make a Horn of Heralding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The trees speak of unnatural predation in Thistlewood. The forest is willing to provide us her resources to construct a Horn of Heralding. You will help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The forest was willing to provide us precious resources to save a great number of lives. But that doesn't make her sacrifice any less discomforting.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These resources may come at a price, but lives are hanging in the balance.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have constructed the Horn of Heralding. Use it for good... and use it wisely.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered the resources requested by Watcher Yalesh Sageroot and returned them to him at Sageroot's Outpost so that he could construct a Horn of Heralding so that balance can be restored to the forests of Celestion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where do I get the resources?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is putting the forest's creatures to sleep?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Where did the buzzbings come from?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You can find the sacred clarionberry bark in the forest, nearby. Seek the Eldan power source at Celestial Falls. The horn itself can be found on Lightkeeper, a rare and mystical creature, somewhere in Thistlewood Thicket.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Unnatural buzzbings modified by some kind of Dominion tech now roam the forest, hypnotizing and preying on the other creatures. The natural order is being destroyed and the forest suffers greatly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Dazeroot buzzbings were a local hive, natural to Pollenberry Grove. Chua that intruded upon the forest seeking to weaponize the hive for their own purposes. The Chua lost control of their experiments, and the newly-modified hive was left to terrorize the grove.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you an enemy of the forest, too?

localizedTextIdText: Enter Pollenberry Grove, an area of Thistlewood Thicket where the Dazeroot have their hive. Once there, use the Horn of Heralding to help you destroy the Dazeroot and to awaken hypnotized creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Watcher Yalesh Sageroot via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've constructed the horn to awaken the hypnotized creatures. We also need to drive out the buzzbings, so ready your weapon of choice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head out into Thistlewood Thicket. Awaken the hypnotized animals and deal with the Dazeroot buzzbings!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! The forest is responding, now that the creatures have awakened and the buzzbings are dead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head out into Thistlewood Thicket. The forest needs your help!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Finally, the healing can begin.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Horn of Heralding to awaken hypnotized creatures in Pollenberry Grove. You also killed many Dazeroot buzzbings that had begun destroying the forest. Watcher Sageroot is grateful for your help.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are the buzzbings doing this?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Chua scientists have modified them to be aggressive and deadly, whether as a challenge for Draken hunters or for use as a weapon against the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you didn't want to help, why'd you come this far?

localizedTextIdText: You have recovered the deadly stinger from Doomsting, a massive Dazeroot buzzbing in Pollenberry Grove. Watcher Yalesh Sageroot at Sageroot's Outpost would be interested in such an item. You should deliver it to him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Doomsting Stinger to Watcher Yalesh Sageroot at Sageroot's Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is Doomsting's deadly stinger. Watcher Sageroot would probably like to take a look at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is this the stinger of the king? I'd hate to let any part of an animal go to waste. I'm sure I can find a use for this. You have my thanks.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Watcher Sageroot.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Doomsting in Pollenberry Grove and delivered his stinger to Watcher Yalesh Sageroot at Sageroot's Outpost.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Doomsting Stinger to Watcher Yalesh Sageroot

localizedTextIdText: The residents of Sterling Croft have reported strange creatures in the woods - grey-skinned, long-limbed beings who are unlike any creature the Dominion is familiar with. Join Agent Cognosa in investigating these creatures and the unexplained abductions that have been plaguing eastern Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Agent Cognosa at Sterling Croft
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need to deliver Lydia to her father. You should go check on the residents of Sterling Croft. A friend of mine from the ICI will meet you there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you speak to Agent Cognosa at Sterling Croft yet? I have a bad feeling about all this...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors detected your approach, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I sure do appreciate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not good. Many abnormal events have taken place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The residents of Sterling Croft reported strange creatures in the woods - grey-skinned, long-limbed beings who were unknown to the Dominion. You joined Agent Cognosa in investigating these creatures and the unexplained abductions that plague eastern Ellevar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wouldn't say no to Corrigan Doon, would you?

localizedTextIdText: Now that you've acquired a primal sample from one of the Slenderskin Ikthians, Agent Cognosa in Sterling Croft wants you to hijack one of their transport discs in Sterlingcroft Forest and infiltrate their base in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Cognosa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The data you recovered says the Ikthians have a major base established nearby. Use the primal sample to hijack a transport disc and locate their base.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the primal sample you took from the Ikthian corpse to hijack one of their transport discs, then locate and infiltrate their base.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The odds of successfully infiltrating an Ikthian base are quite low, but I chose not to tell you. I did not want to adversely affect your morale.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You are the perfect candidate to infiltrate it. Do not fail us.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The base is larger than anticipated. I suspect they are invading Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Agent Cognosa orders, you used a primal sample from one of the Slenderskin Ikthians to hijack one of their transport discs and infiltrate their base in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Initiating first contact with a hostile alien race does not intrigue you? Curious.

localizedTextIdText: On the distant shore of Lake Sterling lies an unexplored stretch of wilderness called Sterling Reach. The Ikthians have set up base there. Agent Cognosa is counting on you to infiltrate their base and take out anything that tries to stop you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Cognosa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ikthians pose a major threat to Dominion control of Nexus. You must locate their command post and prevent their plans from being realized.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sterling Reach is beyond the lake. You must proceed there at once and locate the Ikthian command post. Wasting time here is imprudent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have discovered the entrance to the Ikthian lair. Splendid. I expect you will have little difficulty in putting an end to their invasion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hijack another one of their discs and find that command post.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have no choice but to succeed. The alternative is... undesirable.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Thanks for the vote of confidence.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While infiltrating an Ikthian base in the Sterling Reach on Agent Cognosa orders, you managed to locate their command post. Time will tell if you are able to stem the tide of their invasion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How foolish. You are the only one in a position to prevent an Ikthian victory.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Cognosa has managed to shoot down one of the Ikthian ships in Ellevar. Investigate the crash site just outside of Sterling Croft and learn the secrets of Ikthian technology.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Cognosa in Sterling Croft
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was able to shoot down an Ikthian ship, but Makum was injured in the process. Find that ship and see what you can learn about Ikthian technology.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The crashed Ikthian ship is not far from here. Locate it and see what you can discover concerning the technology they utilize.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I find it interesting that the Ikthians use their primal patterns as a form of security. I presume Makum will be even more interested than I am.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I must tend to Makum's injuries. We will await you here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must use this knowledge to our advantage.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered the Ikthians use their species' primal pattern to lock their technology. To circumvent this, you acquired a pattern sample from one of their corpses in Sterlingcroft Forest and bypassed the system, allowing you to download data from a crashed Ikthian ship.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I was capable of being nauseous, your cowardice would sicken me.

localizedTextIdText: On the Ellevar mountainside high above Sterling Reach is the entrance to the Diluvian Depths. Use the Ikthian Teleporter to gain entry, then explore the depths and find out more about the Ikthians' experiments and plans.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Cognosa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need you to investigate the Ikthian base. It is vitally important we learn what these creatures are planning.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Exploration of the Diluvian Depths is imperative! You will comply, or your file will be flagged as suspect.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your actions have resulted in the ICI receiving vital intelligence regarding the Ikthian base in the Diluvian Depths. Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Maximum efficiency is essential. Do not fail.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Ikthian Teleporter to gain entry to the Diluvian Depths, and explored them to find out more about the Ithians' experiments and plans.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Invalid response. Please rephrase.

localizedTextIdText: The Ikthians are a dangerous new foe. Agent Cognosa has ordered you to fight them and see what you can learn of their tactics. The Diluvian Depths is their base of operations in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Cognosa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ikthians are unknown to us, and we have no data on their tactics or capabilities. Fight them so that we might study their methods of war.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This interminable delay does not serve the Empire's goals in Ellevar. Seek out the Ikthians and draw them into a fight. Immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The data you have collected is interesting. Top ICI analysts will process it, searching for potential weaknesses in the Ikthian fighting arts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Every Ikthian you kill provides us with additional information.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your service has been duly noted, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope it was worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You did battle with the Ikthians at Agent Cognosa request, and revealed they are perhaps the most dangerous alien race the Dominion has encountered since arriving on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will feel differently when you are confined to a specimen tank.

localizedTextIdText: The Ikthians have been disassembling and reverse-engineering Eldan technology in the Diluvian Depths. If they manage to unlock the Eldan's secrets, they might become unstoppable. Take back all the dismantled Eldan technology they've stolen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Makum via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This crate contains Eldan technology, some of which has been delicately dissected by the Ikthians. Leaving this in their hands is probably a bad idea.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This crate contains Eldan technology, some of which has been delicately dissected by the Ikthians. Leaving this in their hands is probably a bad idea.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Give me a status report at once.
