localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your initiative is commendable, $(player.name). Allowing the Ikthians to retain any Eldan technology would be unforgivable.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You claimed a large amount of dismantled Eldan technology from the Ikthians in the Diluvian Depths.

localizedTextIdText: The Cortexes are in charge of the Ikthians' most vital operations. If you can find Cortex Breachscale lab in the Diluvian Depths and take him out, it will disrupt the Ikthians' operations in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Cognosa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The strike team is nearly ready. While they prepare, I want you to attempt to locate and exterminate the Ikthian leadership with extreme prejudice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is your situation report? Have you found and eliminated the Ikthian leadership yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With their Cortex out of the picture, the Ikthians will be more vulnerable once our strike team initiates its attack on the Diluvian Depths. Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect the Ikthian leaders are more dangerous than their rank-and-file.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I calculate this was not the sort of "wetwork" you had in mind, was it?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Cortex Breachscale in the Diluvian Depths, thereby disrupting the Ikthians' operations in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you are not as resourceful as they say you are.

localizedTextIdText: The Diluvian Depths is quickly filling with a deadly neurotoxin! Fight your way to one of the Ikthian transport discs and use it to escape before it's too late!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Cognosa at Sterling Shore
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The strike team is ready. Evacuate yourself from the Diluvian Depths and return at once to Sterling Croft. I will be awaiting your return.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Expedite your evacuation from the Diluvian Depths, $(player.name). The strike team will not wait forever.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see you have survived. I find this surprising, given the odds against you. You are more durable than my processors gave you credit for.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This is the most dangerous portion of your assignment. Try to remain alive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This incursion is nearly complete. Report to Toric Antevian for your orders.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You stole one of the Ikthian transport discs, leaving behind an Ikthian cave network quickly filling with neurotoxin. It will be some time before it is safe to enter the Diluvian Depths once again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Only a fool would want to be down there when the strike team begins its assault.

localizedTextIdText: You found and defeated the Scaleborn Leviathan, a giant Ikthian-engineered creature known as a Nerid. Return a genetic sample from the beast to Agent Cognosa in Sterling Croft.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Cognosa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This strange creature seems to have been genetically altered by the Ikthian. Maybe you should take this head back to town to be studied.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: From your initial scans, it is obvious this creature was subject to intense genetic enhancement. It must have been an extraordinary fight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My voice stress analyzer tells another story, but I shall keep your secret safe.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this back for analysis.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the giant Ikthian-engineered Nerid known as Leviathan. Analysis of its hideously manipulated biology may provide great insight into the Ikthian's advanced technology.

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon believes that Lydia may have been seen by residents of Copperworth Village in Ellevar. Corrigan recommended visiting the village to ask about her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Corrigan Doon at the Eldan Tower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a village not far from here. I think it's called Copperworth. If Lydia survived the crash, she may have gone there looking for help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Anyone in Copperworth help you get a bead on Lydia yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where is everyone? It's too damn quiet, even for a little backwater rut like Copperworth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Don't ask, I have no idea what these things are.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm sure someone there will know something.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I think I've got something though.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Alright, let's head to Copperworth Village.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The people of Copperworth Village have been taken by strange creatures near an old Eldan Tower outside of town.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Not yet, but I'm still on the case.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you know about Copperworth Village?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You seem to be sobering up at least.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Hey, if Lightreach Mission is just a speck on the underside of the universe, Copperworth is... a smaller speck. $(player.name), I'm still too drunk to create effective analogies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Well, charred corpses around a shuttle crash site tend to have that effect on me. Let's keep going, no telling where Lydia is now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But... Lydia...

localizedTextIdText: The Slenderskin Ikthians within the Diluvian Depths have somehow managed to fool the Eldan probes into not attacking them. Researcher Makum wants you to restore the probes' default settings, and he expects a full report upon task completion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Makum via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ikthians are utilizing Eldan probes. See if you can reset the probes so they recognize the Ikthians as enemies. That should annoy them, hm?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you completed the task I set you to? The Eldan probes must have their settings reversed. With luck, they will attack the Ikthians.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blind my eyes! How could the Ikthians take such complete control over Eldan machinery? This is most distressing... most distressing, indeed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even if it doesn't, we must deny the Ikthians the use of the Eldan constructs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: At least your report was exemplary. It will lead to many new finds, I'm sure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you ultimately failed to reset the Eldan probes, your actions did ensure that the technology will remain out of reach of the Slenderskin Ikthians in Ellevar. Thankfully, Researcher Makum disappointment was somewhat alleviated by your detailed report.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal to help your people is both telling and disturbing.

localizedTextIdText: The wildlife of Darkspire Wilds has been attacking the soldiers in Vigilant Heart Outpost. Help the soldiers fend off the ever-increasing attacks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Radiant Warden Vezir in Vigilant Heart Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready your blade. Dagun gnaw at our outpost day after day. Radiant Medic Vacuna was injured on her patrol. Check on her status.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not speak to me again until the darkfangs lay dead and Radiant Medic Vacuna is checked on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The darkfangs menace is ended... for now. But our wounds need mending.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: By the flames of Fazaar, the darkfangs will not break us!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must delve deeper into the woods to find out.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll check on her and kill the dagun.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: But where did they come from?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully defended the Vigilant Heart Outpost from waves of darkfangs, though the mystery of their aggression is still to be solved.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll check on her and kill the dagun.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pathetic!

localizedTextIdText: Radiant Warden Vezir tasked you with locating the members of a missing scouting party in the Darkspire Wilds. Find them... or find what's left of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Cornelius in the Darkspire Wilds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Professor Cornelius insisted on personally investigating the cause of the animal aggression, but neither he nor his scouting party have reported in.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you discovered the fate of the scouting party yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's fortunate I survived. Really.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I expected you sooner, citizen. The wildlife here exhibits a preternatural state of aggression.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be sharp. The creatures in the woods are unnaturally violent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You had best try to keep me safe. Do you understand?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find out where they are.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Looks like I showed up just in time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Professor Cornelius, the lone survivor of the Vigilant Heart scouting party that Radiant Warden Vezir sent you to find in the Darkspire Wilds of Ellevar.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You just let him run off?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Cornelius will either return from his hunt triumphant, or not at all. Such is the way that true strength is measured.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are going to abandon allies in the midst of such perils? Pathetic.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Cornelius has a theory on why the creatures of the forest are acting abnormally hostile. He thinks the river may be polluted. To prove his hypothesis, he has ordered you to investigate the creatures in the Darkspire Wilds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Cornelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The most probable cause of unusual aggression would be chemical interference. I trust you are capable of collecting the necessary samples?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you collected the necessary samples yet? I do not look kingly upon dullards and layabouts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you collected the necessary samples yet? I do not look kingly upon dullards and layabouts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Unhand me! By Dominus I shall see you ha- HELP!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I believe there some deceased rodentia floating in the river. Off with you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Before giving you a definite answer to his hypothesis that the river has been tampered with, Professor Corneliuss communication was interrupted! Radiant Warden Vezir contacted you shortly afterward to tell you to find the professor; the injured soldiers of the Vigilant Heart Outpost don't have much time left!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What about the guards Vezir sent with you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why did the Royal Collegium send you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They were obviously incompetent if he had to send you after them. No matter, I can look after myself.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I've reason to believe they're suffering from a genetic abnormality with an environmental cause. The source, I'm willing to bet, is coming from this river.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: My work regarding the native life forms of Nexus is well-regarded among the higher echelon of the Royal Collegium. Though I am a specialist, I consider it my duty to the Empire to suffer through field work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That was not a request.

localizedTextIdText: The Darkpool Mordesh were using Grimwatch Outpost in Ellevar to continue their search for a cure to the Contagion. Unfortunately, the byproducts of their experimentation contaminated the river, affecting the local wildlife. Their experimentation apparatus must be destroyed before any additional harm is done!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Cornelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that we know the root cause of the pollution, I can create a cure in no time. But first, destroy this vile place. This is not science...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Destroy this abomination to science.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Destroy this abomination to science.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I could hear the explosions from here. Well done! However, a scientist always keeps his notes in one important place... his head.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Burn it to the ground!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must destroy that place. This is going to take finesse.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With Grimwatch Outpost in flames there is only one loose end left to clean up...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: The Mordesh are poisoning the water?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Then how did they get here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Anything else I should know?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I doubt it's intentional. They must be testing on the local wildlife to find some cure to the Contagion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Contagion is why their homeworld remains under strict quarantine. Can't have packs of mindless ravaging beasts loose among the common folk!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Those Exile fools keep shuttling them through the quarantine, and this is the result!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I saw a Mordesh - Director Zarkin - giving orders to dump the entire supply into the river. They must have used up all the resources here and are planning on taking what they've learned and abandoning the rest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Watch your words, now.

localizedTextIdText: The Mordesh responsible for setting up this outpost and polluting the river is Viralist Zarkin. Though she couldn't find the cure to the Contagion here, you cannot allow her to leave with the information she has gathered. Get rid of Viralist Zarkin in Grimwatch Outpost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Radiant Warden Vezir in Vigilant Heart Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It is imperative that the Mordesh scientist in charge of operations at the Grimwatch Outpost not escape! Kill Director Zarkin at once!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are you under the impression that time is not of the essence? Do not let those Mordesh escape!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hear some Mordesh need slaughtering. Don't let them get away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our outpost shall survive, and the spilled blood of the vile Mordesh stands as a testament to their punishment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When Director Zarkin dies, her research shall die with her!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I recognize your honor. This outpost stands because of you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I made sure the Mordesh did not escape.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Viralist Zarkin has been silenced and Professor Cornelius was able to create an antidote to help the sick Radiant Legion soldiers in the Vigilant Heart Outpost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Deny me, and you deny the Emperor.

localizedTextIdText: Merchant Sani needs help with his darkfang problem by planting explosives in the Darkspire Wilds. After all, there are very few personal problems that cannot be solved through a suitable application of high explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Merchant Sani in the Darkspire Wilds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Try to move caravan, darkfangs attack. Too many darkfangs! Solution - blow them to pieces. Take explosives, plant in darkfang dens. Then, boom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did $(player.class) hear me? Blow up darkfang dens. Blow up with explosives. $(player.class) put explosives in den. Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Love sound of explosions! Even better when whimpering dagun cries in pain!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry hurry! I try not to push button until explosives placed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Help appreciated. Reward forthcoming.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Merchant Sani has dealt with his darkfang problem in the traditional Chua way - by blowing it sky high. He should be safe to move his caravan from now on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stand very still... must place explosive by $p(player.class) foot...

localizedTextIdText: Lure out Raedon the Ox Snatcher using Farmer Horato Oxian Holostation in Spirefell Glade, then kill the malverine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Horato via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got me a trick to lurin' out the rotten malverine what keeps eatin' me oxians - a holographic whatsit, that's what. Help me set it up, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Set up the holostation, then wait for the malverine to show up. Then get to killin' it quick-like, right? It's one mean beastie!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I sure am grateful you helped me get rid of Raedon. Reminded me of me mum-in-law, it did. They both gots a strikin' resemblance to the other.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When the malverine shows up, make sure you kill it quick! Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now... for the mum-in-law...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the most unconvincing hologram on Nexus to lure out Raedon the Ox Snatcher and eliminated it. It's a good things malverines aren't all that smart.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You really won't help? But... me poor oxians...

localizedTextIdText: You discovered a volume of Alchemist's notes in the Darkspire Wilds of Ellevar. If you can find the missing pages, Science Officer Wingo back at the Vigilant Heart Outpost would be very interested in your find...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Science Officer Wingo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These notes provide great detail on the experiments in the Darkspire Woods. The Collegium could make use of these...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Better have good reason for disrupting this research into combustible bandage components.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Notes? Notes on toxin tests? Hmmm... yes. Useful indeed. Transmit now. Will send to appropriate authorities.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, back to combustion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully recovered a volume of Mordesh Alchemist's notes from the Darkspire Wilds and handed it over to Science Officer Wingo at the Vigilant Heart Outpost in Ellevar.

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Brekowski outside of Woodhaven has asked you to assist Physician Boravic with his research at Grimveil Enclave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Physician Boravic in Grimveil Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A colleague of mine, Physician Boravic, is researching the Moodies at Grimveil Enclave. He requires an assistant, and could use your help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you paid Boravic a visit yet? His work requires an extra set of hands. Living ones, preferably.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My apprentice told me to expect you. I could have used you sooner, but I assumed you would be late. Such an outcome is typical of my fortune lately.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Splendid. I am certain he will be as pleased to see you as his mood permits.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enough time has been wasted on formality. Let us begin.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do to help.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do I have to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in Grimveil Enclave and offered your help to Physician Boravic.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose he will have to seek aid elsewhere.

localizedTextIdText: Assist Physician Boravic in Grimveil Enclave with his observations of his Moodie subjects. Enter the cage, then apply each test to a Moodie.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Physician Boravic in Grimveil Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My research revolves around the humble Moodie. Primitive and vicious, possessed of an alarming ambivalence towards death. Let us test their tolerance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you run the tolerance tests on our Moodie subjects yet? Time is of the essence. To waste it is inexcusable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I examined each Moodie as it endured its test. The results are interesting, but far from final.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: To your work, assistant. There can be no failure but death.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must do more if the secrets of these Moodie miscreants are to be revealed.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Not sure I'd do that again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Physician Boravic in Grimveil Enclave with his documentation of Moodie pain thresholds and anatomy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What's the third test?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Tolerances to differing sorts of pain stimuli. Extreme heat, extreme cold, electrical shock, and mechanical injury.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Extreme Heat Test will expose the test subject to dangerously high temperatures. Most life forms will be incinerated instantly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The exact opposite of the previous test, the Extreme Cold Test will cause subjects to reach a temperature so low that a simple crack may cause the subject to shatter.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Ahh, the Extreme Conduction Test. Very similar to electro-shock therapy, except there is nothing therapeutic about it. Cardiovascular systems will seize, and muscular systems will cease to operate.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: The Extreme Mechanical Test will use a specially grafted laser saw that should turn any subject into soup! Metaphorically speaking, of course.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Think of what we can learn!

localizedTextIdText: In order to continue his research, Physician Boravic in Grimveil Enclave wants you to collect organs from the Darkloam Moodies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Physician Boravic via his Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The readings from the last tests indicate interesting activity in their internal organs. I require fresh organs for a control comparison. Fetch them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have not received the full data set yet. Have you collected the Moodie organs? My research cannot continue without them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have received the organ analysis from your datachron. The results are... remarkable. But not in a good way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I do not care how you harvest the organs. Just ensure they are fresh.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is bound to be messy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can tell, this is about to get interesting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected Moodie organs for Physician Boravic research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without that set of control samples, I cannot verify my hypothesis.

localizedTextIdText: Collect $m(vitem=156) for Physician Boravic research from the graves of Moodie shamans in Darkloam Hole.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Physician Boravic via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Moodies appear to store life energy in a specialized organ, and can pass it into objects upon their deaths. To be certain, I require Moodie relics.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How can you dither here? The Moodie relics required for my research can be found in Darkloam Hole.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The essence of both life and death is infused into the Moodie relics you found. They are precisely what my research requires.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Seek the requisite relics in the Moodie burial grounds.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get you some Moodie relics.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=156) buried in the graves of Darkloam Shamans in Darkloam Hole for Physician Boravic research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My research is incomplete. To turn away now reveals your lack of reliability.

localizedTextIdText: Physician Boravic has asked you to use the $m(vitem=156) you collected in Darkloam Hole to generate his hypothesized essences of life and death.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Physician Boravic in Grimveil Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Use the relics you recovered near a focus reliquary somewhere in Darkloam hole. This should draw forth the essences of life and death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find the focus reliquary in Darkloam Hole and place the Moodie relics upon it. This should draw out the essences of life and death I have spoken of.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The revealed results indicate that Moodie spiritual memory is imprinted in the essences of life and death they produce... but how can I use this? How?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The focus reliquary should not be far from your present position.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I thank you for your help, $(player.name). I must ruminate on this further.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the $m(vitem=156) in Darkloam Hole, you released the essences of life and death and summoned a horrific Moodie spirit entity. You defeated the being, which has sufficiently cowed the remaining Darkloam Moodies.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I have a bad feeling about this...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Precisely! I hypothesize that the Moodies channel pure essences of life and death!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If this essence can be harnessed and redirected, I theorize it might be used to extend life... perhaps indefinitely!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We have come too far to stop now!

localizedTextIdText: Lord Horacos has asked you to speak to Corrigan Doon in the Emperor's Crown Tavern. Apparently Lord Horacos hired the man to track down his daughter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corrigan Doon at the Emperor's Crown Tavern
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am Lord Horacos, and you will assist me. Immediately. My daughter is missing, and the buffoon I hired to find her is drunk at the Emperor's Crown.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I've already told you to go speak to Corrigan Doon in the Emperor's Crown tavern. Now get to it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll take another... Shkleech Beach... I mean... *HIC* a Shkeech Bleach? Yeah... that one.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go to the Tavern and rouse Corrigan Doon. I'm not paying him to get drunk!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh that old blowhard? *HIC* The infamoush Corrigan Doon will get to drinking when he'sh done with reshcuing... I mean... wait...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What do you want me to do about it?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Lord Horacos wants you to get off your rear.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Corrigan Doon drinking in the Emperor's Crown Tavern. He had certainly been there a while.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why don't you just hire me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: And now he's getting drunk with your money.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Don't you have your own men to send? Why hire someone?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, if you must know. Her shuttle crashed somewhere east of our fine city. I hired Corrigan Doon to help locate her and bring her home safely.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: How impertinent. I've hired Corrigan Doon, he took the advance already.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: In a word: Yes. Now go tell him to get his useless arse out of the Emperor's Crown and into the field.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Of course I have my own men, you dolt. I already dispatched a recovery team. They have yet to return and are no longer responding to datachron calls.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Corrigan Doon is an expert at this sort of thing. He retrieved the Star of Dominus from a nebulae full of pirates, right out from under their noses. So you must excuse me if I'm inclined to use him in this... situation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Has the world gone mad? Perhaps you don't understand what's going on. I'm telling you to do something.

localizedTextIdText: Ashrynn Strongstem in Strongstem Veggie Patch has asked you to find her veggie friends. She suspects that Darkloam Hollow Moodies have taken them, but you'll need to become a veggie to find out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ashrynn Strongstem in Strongstem Veggie Patch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Help! My veggie friends have gone missing! I just know those Darkloam Moodies took them for their stew pots. You have to rescue them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found my veggie friends yet? I told you: they've been taken by the Moodies. You'll need to become a carrot to find them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You saved them! Oh, thank you! Thank you so much! These veggies are sentient. It'd be cruel to eat them!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I forgot to mention one more thing: you'll need to become a veggie to sniff them out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Veggies are friends, not food!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After turning into a carrot, you found and freed captive veggies from the stew pots of Darkloam Hollow Moodies and killed the Darkloam Cook.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you leave my friends to be eaten by those Moodies?

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Vinkov in Grimveil Enclave has asked you to use his scanbot to scan life force anomalies around Darkloam Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Vinkov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You! Yes, you! I have need of an assistant. If you're interested, use my scanbot to analyze life force anomalies in Darkloam Hollow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The life force anomalies in Darkloam Hollow must be scanned. Use my scanbot. Be careful, for it is the only bot I have left.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I received some data prior to my scanbot's destruction, but my research is far from complete. What uses could these anomalies have?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I would go myself, but Moodies are dangerous... or so I am told.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes, yes. I must procure another one. That makes five this week alone!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You finished scanning life force anomalies around Darkloam Hollow for Alchemist Vinkov. Unfortunately, his poor scanbot was destroyed in the process.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My instruments tell me there are some interesting anomalies nearby. I need a durable individual to take readings.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind, return to me.

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Laveka, a mysterious Draken, has come to Darkloam Hollow to research Celestion's Moodies. She believes that controlling the Moodies is an essential part of defending against their magic, and has devised a plan to create fetishes from mudcrawler bones and shadowroot wood. When properly assembled, Laveka thinks the fetish will keep the Moodies at bay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Apprentice Laveka via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Unless they can be controlled, Moodies are dangerous. I surmise a fear fetish made from mudcrawler bones and shadowroot wood will frighten them away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: As I said, mudcrawler bones and shadowroot wood are the primary components of the fear fetish. Collect them, then assemble the fetish and test it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It was not magic that frightened away the Moodies - it was their own superstition. Something as simple as a bunch of sticks and bones can be of great use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm honored by your willingness to aid me in my investigations. Thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You utilized mudcrawler bones and shadowroot wood to create a Moodie fear fetish for a mysterious Draken calling herself Laveka. In the end, Laveka's plan to frighten the Moodies worked perfectly, and you were able to scare the heck out of several of the beasts using the fear fetish.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you mean, a 'fear fetish'?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have been studying these Moodies. They use a complex system combining symbolism with necromancy. Using the right symbols, I think a fetish can be created which will frighten them away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Think on it. The discoveries we make together could be to everyone's benefit.

localizedTextIdText: Mesmerist Ozliam in Grimveil Enclave has asked you to assist with her Moodie cloning experiment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mesmerist Ozliam in Grimveil Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Care to aid me? If my program works, I can clone Moodies who are easily controlled and then use them to subjugate whole Moodie tribes! Just think of it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I await the data you are supposed to be collecting. These Moodies will not clone themselves... well, not in the way that I have in mind, anyway.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At least this time, the clones came out looking like Moodies! Now to work on the behavior modifications... and to keep them from dying so quickly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Perfect! I will collate data as you collect it and monitor the cloning process!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You succeeded in helping Mesmerist Ozliam with her research, even if things did end up a little bit messy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Easy! The tribes accept the cloned Moodies as their own. Then we influence the tribe's dynamic from the inside!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Just think of what we can do to prevent Moodie violence!

localizedTextIdText: Apprentice Laveka believes Moodies can be controlled by a liberal application of music. She has requested that you play a drum in Darkloam Hollow to see how easily manipulated they are by your percussive skill (or lack thereof).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Apprentice Laveka via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have witnessed Moodies lose control when stirred by their tribal music. Play the nearby drum to incite them so that I might observe the results.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have used fear to control the Moodies. Now we must swing the pendulum in the other direction. Play the drums and manipulate them with music!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's difficult to tell, what with their masks, but the Moodies seemed positively joyous as they capered about to your drumming.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Any method of control - even music - is a valuable tool in our arsenal.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll give them a beat to dance to.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your drumming, at Apprentice Laveka suggestion, inspired the Moodies of Darkloam Hollow to have a wild dance party! It also proved that Moodies can be controlled by anyone, so long as they can keep the rhythm.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll give them a beat to dance to.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is it performance anxiety? Or something else, perhaps?

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf in Glenview's Bulwark has explained that the Dominion is retreating, but not peacefully. Kill their troops in Emberwoodto finish this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've got the Dominion on the run, but not peacefully. We need you to finish 'em off!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lives are at stake here. We've got the Dominion on the run, but they aren't going peacefully. Kill the remaining Dominion forces in Emberwood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Every scar on the forest is a scar on my heart. The Dominion deserves far worse than what you gave 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We can't let those Dominion jerks get away with torching Greenbough Glen!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion's fallen back to Point Firestorm. We'll stop 'em there!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I gave 'em a few scars of their own.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed many of the Dominion troops torching Emberwood, but you can't save the forest until you put out those fires.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Be glad I've got more pressing things to deal with right now.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf in Glenview's Bulwark explained that a few Aurin sought refuge in sacred Embertrees during the fight against Dominion's forces. With the forest on fire, they've become trapped inside the trees! Clear the exits and rescue them!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some Aurin took refuge in sacred Embertrees during the fight. With the glen on fire, they've become trapped inside! Clear the exits so they can get out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Some Aurin took refuge in sacred Embertrees during the fight. With the glen on fire, they've become trapped inside! Clear the exits so they can get out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If it wasn't for you, the Dommies would have even more blood on their hands. Thank the matrias you got to those people in time!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Greenbough Glen's no more than embers now. I can't lose my people, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go anywhere. There's lots more that needs done!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll clear the way and rescue them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Arwick Redleaf request, you've rescued the Aurin trapped inside burning Embertrees.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Shrines built inside Wisdom Trees protect against evil intent, but they won't stop fire. It's a natural force of destruction. If we don't get those Aurin out, they'll die.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Emberwood used to be a part of Greenbough Glen. When the Dominion had to fall back, they torched everything they left behind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then get out of here, jerk. You're in the way.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf in Glenview's Bulwark believes the key to saving the forest is to stop the Chua's flingatrons, but you'll need some help. He asks that you use a spirit stone to call forth a Greenbough Guardian to destroy their siege equipment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You'll have to destroy the Chua's flingatrons, but you'll need help. Harmonize with this spirit stone to call forth a Greenbough Guardian.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the spirit stone I gave you to summon a Greenbough Guardian near the Chua's flingatron catapults. That'll teach 'em a lesson!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew it'd work! That guardian smashed 'em to bits! You really came through for us, $(player.class) - both you and the guardian!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make those mangy rodents pay, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You ready for more? I hope so.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: We'll stop those flingatrons from firing!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The guardian did most of the work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the help of the Greenbough Guardian, you were able to destroy the Chua flingatrons, reducing the threat the Dominion poses in Celestion.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: We'll stop those flingatrons from firing!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah, the guardians of Greenbough Glen protect the forests here. They don't care about the plight of the Exiles, but they'll surely put you in the ground if you make 'em angry.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Dominion's caused lots of damage to the glen, and, I imagine, rightly pissed off the guardians here. I think we could convince 'em to help... just this once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't have time for your fertilizer. Either help or get out of the way.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf in Glenview's Bulwark is impressed with your campaign against the Dominion arsonists. He believes that if you steal a flying water sprinkler, you can help put out those fires once and for all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've hurt the Dominion forces setting fires, and we've destroyed their fireflingers. Now we can snuff this fire out once and for all! Quick, steal a flying water sprinkler!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we're going to make a home for ourselves in Celestion, you've got to steal a sprinkler and put out this forest fire before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work, $(player.name). You put out a lot of fires. Now the Dominion won't be burning the rest of the glen, and we can safely push on toward Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring the rain, $(player.class). Nature's counting on you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm sending Myala to recoup in Sylvan Glade. I'll meet you in Woodhaven!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm just glad I could help put out those fires!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using a commandeered water sprinkler, you've stopped the Dominion from burning the rest of the glen. Excellent work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm getting really tired of your bad attitude.

localizedTextIdText: Forest fires in Emberwood have taken the lives of many woodland creatures, but there's still a chance to save the forest animals before it's too late. Catch the critters in danger and release them in a safer area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Yalum Soulbark via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The fires have taken this critter's life, but there's still a chance to save the others. Catch any critters that are in danger and release them in safer locations.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The fires have taken this critter's life, but there's still a chance to save the others. Catch any critters in danger and release them in safer locations.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So many poor animals will be killed by the fires. Maybe you can take it upon yourself to save some of them?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those critters owe their lives to you. I hope they live long and healthy lives because of you, $(player.class). You're a true hero!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your quick and conscientious thinking has helped save the lives of many innocent woodland creatures who would have otherwise been killed in Emberwood.

localizedTextIdText: Yalum Soulbark in Glenview's Bulwark is devastated by the damage done to the glen. The forest is in pain. He wants you to replant the forest in the hope that it will eventually recover.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Yalum Soulbark via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is a travesty! The forest is barren and burned. We have to replant her! Plant seeds in loose dirt and shower them with love!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: First, sow the seeds in loose mounds of dirt. Then, with a little love and luck, Emberwood will be a great green glen again in no time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've proven the forest will recover, and you've given us all hope. Sometimes all you need is a little tender love and care.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This can't be the end... it just can't be! You've got to help!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm sure we'll meet again. For friends, goodbye never means forever.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Yalum Soulbark hope has been restored, thanks to you. At his request, you attempted to replant the forest to see if life can return to its scorched and barren ground.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The forest doesn't need you. It never did!

localizedTextIdText: You found a Dominion memo hidden in a journal outlining a mission called Operation: Stinger, a plan to weaponize buzzbings and release them in Thistlewood and Pollenberry Grove. This explains the hyper-aggressive nature of the buzzbings and their ability to hypnotize creatures by merely spreading their pollen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Finish reading the Scientist Plans
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Operation Stinger: Weaponize and release buzzbings into Thistlewood Thicket. We've been assured Bonerazer clan will test buzzbings' improved deadliness.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Operation Stinger: Weaponize and release buzzbings into Thistlewood Thicket. We've been assured Bonerazer clan will test buzzbings' improved deadliness.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a Dominion memo hidden in a journal outlining a mission called Operation: Stinger, a plan to weaponize buzzbings and release them in Thistlewood and Pollenberry Grove. This explains the hyper-aggressive nature of the buzzbings and their ability to hypnotize creatures by merely spreading their pollen.

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar in Glenview's Bulwark is suffering as she feels the forest's pain. Emberwood has been desecrated by Dominion forces and left to burn and she needs you to heal the forest. Descend deep within the Embertrees to make a connection to the Weave and restore the balance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The forest has been desecrated and left to burn. Will you go deep within the Embertrees? Will you make a connection to the Weave and heal the trees?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Heed my words! The trees need our aid! We must restore balance through the Weave if this charred land is ever to regrow into Greenbough Glen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My thanks to you, $(player.name). You're a true friend of the forest. You've brought comfort to the trees... and to me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must restore the balance... and please hurry! I feel the forest's pain!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now I must retire to Sylvan Glade to regain some of my strength. Goodbye.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Queen Myala Everstar request, you descended into the Embertrees and made a connection to the Weave there, helping to restore the balance in Emberwood. Now the queen will travel to Sylvan Glade in an effort to recover after her ordeal.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will help the best I can.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Are you okay? You don't look so well.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Weave is the mystical fabric of reality and represents the connection of all living things with the natural world. We Aurin believe that when we die, our souls return to the Weave.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You were late arriving from the portal, and I'd feared you were lost. We came seeking to build a life in Celestion, but again the Dominion blocks our way and we are met with ruin and pain.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Opening the portal took its toll. Without my strength, I feel the pain of Arboria even more strongly. How the forest suffers! Now the trees of Celestion burn, too. So much pain...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you refuse to help?

localizedTextIdText: Fenosha Longbranch in the Northeastern Embertree won't leave until you find her precious Chesh. Chesh is still somewhere within the Emberwood tree, and she won't leave without him. Please find him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Fenosha Longbranch in the Northeastern Embertree
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm not leaving until you find my precious Chesh. Chesh is so dear to my heart. I can't leave without him! Please, find him for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I won't leave without my Chesh! You don't know what he means to me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've brought my Chesh back to me! He could've died without your help. I can't thank you enough!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please, hurry! I can't stand the thought of harm coming to my darling!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Chesh and I will head to safety now! Bye!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You should get out of here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've rescued Chesh for Fenosha Longbranch. You were surprised to find that Chesh was not another Aurin, but a stuffed toy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you be so heartless?

localizedTextIdText: Venra Dewflower in Greenbough Glen believes there's so much to learn about life in Celestion. She wants you to collect chlorospores from the Greenbark plant-like creatures in the area. Be careful, though - some of them bite!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Venra Dewflower in Greenbough Glen
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's lots to learn about life in Celestion. I've seen at least four different species of Greenbark flora! Maybe you can you bring me some chlorospores?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'd love some samples of the Greenbark plantlife in this area. There's just so much to learn about nature on Nexus!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for the Greenbark chlorospores. Just think of all we can learn here! I hope it wasn't too much trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch out, $(player.name)! Some of them bite!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See? Risking life and limb for knowledge is so worth it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Even though collecting chlorospores was more dangerous than you expected it to be, Venra Dewflower was very pleased with your results.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me you're scared of a few plants!

localizedTextIdText: Serra Nightbright in Sageroot's Outpost has asked you to harness the light of the forest. Collect fireflies near Celestial Falls by jumping through them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Via Datachron, report to Serra Nightbright in Sageroot's Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'd really like to harness the light of the forest's fireflies. They'll glow as bright as any fire. We could safely power our lanterns with them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We should harness nature's power to light the paths of Woodhaven at night. You can find the brightest fireflies near Celestial Falls.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have the fireflies! That's great! They'll light up the paths in Woodhaven once we give them shiny new homes in the lanterns around town.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't wait to see Woodhaven glowing at night!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bye bye for now!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected fireflies near Celestial Falls for Serra Nightbright, who believes their light could be used in lanterns around Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? That's so hurtful!

localizedTextIdText: You arrived at Research Station Tideborn only to find the missing folk from Copperworth Village littered about. Corrigan explained that he believes Lydia is inside the tower. Meanwhile, you decided to see about freeing some of the trapped villagers around the tower.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corrigan Doon by the Eldan Tower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I finally have a ping on Lydia's distress beacon. It's coming from inside this tower. I'm going to hack this control panel and get us inside!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look kid, I'm busy. Go free those villagers while I work on this door. You crowding me ain't gonna make it go any faster!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like you got a handle on those villagers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sounds good. We'll meet back here when you're done. I should be finished with this in no time.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Great. Now we just have to open this door.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After freeing the residents of Copperworth Village from the strange beings at Research Station Tideborn, you returned to the Eldan tower and found Corrigan Doon has 'hotwired' the door controls, courtesy of his favorite pistol.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What in the emperor's name are these things?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Right...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm not nearly as interested in what they are as I am in what they're doing. Looks like science equipment, not really much military hardware.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That would explain why there aren't any people in Copperworth. They may have all been taken. Maybe that's what happened to the shuttle...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Well the shuttle crashed near the tower. Maybe these creatures shot it down to make sure nobody found out about this place.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Lydia is inside. We gotta hurry if we want to collect this reward.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you going to turn your back on me now?

localizedTextIdText: Scout Tricus has asked you to help destroy the Osun weapon forging operations at the fires of Kel Voreth. Sneak past the front gate's defenses, through the Bladevault, and into the forge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Tricus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun are forging weapons, and must be stopped. Getting into the forge alive has been problematic for our men, but you... you may have a chance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must go through the Bladevault to get to the forge. The area is perilous and thick with enemies. Once inside, I will give you new instructions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Scions! I did not hope that you would make it inside! The tales of your exploits hardly do justice to the reality!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Proceed through the Bladevault. May Dominus watch over you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Are you ready? There is much to do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully entered the <text Link = "Location:23661">Kel Voreth Forge</text> and can now begin to aid the Dominion in their fight against the weapon forging operations there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: These Osun must be stopped! Their proverbial claws must be cut!

localizedTextIdText: Scout Hazira has studied the Voreth Osun and determined that the Bladevault Keeper is an incredible threat that must be destroyed. He tests every weapon against a challenger inside the Bladevault arena... and he has never been defeated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Hazira via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Bladevault Keeper uses combat to test the weapons forged in the fires of Kel Voreth. He's never lost to a challenger. Perhaps you can defeat him?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Bladevault Keeper is in the Bladevault. Go there, summon him forth, and bathe your weapons in his blood for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased by the results of your duel with the Bladevault Keeper. Without him to test their weapons, the Osun will lose precious time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Enjoy the hunt, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wish you glory and blood, hunter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Bladevault Keeper defeated, the Voreth Osun can no longer test their weapons. Killing this important Voreth figure will help put a stop to the Osun weapon forging operation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You had best find a rock to crawl beneath, coward.

localizedTextIdText: Voreth weapons have slain many Dominion troops. Thus, they should be destroyed. Search the Bladevault for Voreth weapon racks and ensure the citizens of Auroria are never threatened by these weapons again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Hazira via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Voreth blades and hammers have taken many Dominion lives. These weapons should never have another opportunity to spill Dominion blood. Destroy them!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Voreth blades and hammers have taken many Dominion lives. These weapons should never have another opportunity to spill Dominion blood. Destroy them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Voreth are excellent and brutal fighters. Without weapons, they will be ill-equipped to face the Dominion on the battlefield.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well to hinder the Osun by denying them their weapons. I have noted your deeds in my official report. I commend you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was an honor to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Scout Hazira is pleased that you took initiative against the Voreth Osun and decided to destroy their weapon racks inside the Bladevault. Auroria is a little safer now.

localizedTextIdText: Only a hammer forged from Osun steel can free the Voreth Flame from the chains that bind it. Gather materials from around the <text Link = "Location:23661">Kel Voreth Forge</text> to create an Osun hammer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Tricus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Voreth Flame is the heart of the forge. You must create a hammer from Osun steel to break the chains that hold the Flame before you can snuff it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your objective is to create a hammer capable of breaking the chains that hold the Voreth Flame. We can make a hammer from Voreth wood and scrap steel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have the materials we need? Excellent. This is only the beginning of this endeavor. Given your reputation, I have no doubt you will succeed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Gather Voreth wood and scrap steel to create the hammer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the materials at hand, there is nothing standing in your way from forging a pristine Voreth Hammer to use against the chains that hold the Flame in the <text Link = "Location:23661">Kel Voreth Forge</text>.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do I need to create a hammer?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Voreth Flame is a manifestation of primal fire that fuels Kel Voreth's forge. To destroy the Osun's forging capabilities, we will need to extinguish the flame.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Flame is suspended by chains crafted from Osun steel. We must break those chains, but it will take a hammer of Osun steel to do so.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are integral to this plan - you can't turn away now!

localizedTextIdText: These human-looking remains contain a device that allegedly captures primal energies. Use it on Voreth Ember around the forge to help the Royal Collegium understand Osun operations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chemist Ingo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An untarnished Dominion scientific device is hidden within these ashes. Its directions state: "Use on primal energies to capture them. Warning: May Explode."
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Use the scientific device you found in the ashes of primal energies, such as Voreth Embers, to prove the scientific value of those ashes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Cato left. Took Extraction Device. Sneaked into Kel Voreth to test theories. Never returned. Probably dead. That's okay. Less competition now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Collegium Extraction Device! Collects cores from primal energy sources! You found it, yes? It works, yes? Very happy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Find Cato? And he has device? Similar to me, but not as lucky.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see what this thing does.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sometimes digging through the ashes leads to a scientific discovery! You helped the Royal Collegium solve the mystery behind their missing colleague, Cato, and gathered pertinent information about Voreth Ember.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let's see what this thing does.

localizedTextIdText: Scout Hazira suggests you kill any workers you find laboring in the Kel Voreth Forge. Not only will this reduce the number of combatants facing the Dominion, but it will slow the production of Osun weaponry.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Hazira via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are a large number of hostiles in the forge. Killing them is an opportunity to reduce the Osun workforce and slow their production of weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are still a great many thralls in the forge. Weren't you planning on killing them all? Or have you discovered the task to be beyond your skill?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a fine display of martial prowess, $(player.name)! You really are something else. Perhaps we can meet for a drink sometime.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Your thirst for blood rivals my own. Go on, then, show me what you can do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will gladly kill mindless Osun slaves.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the number of forge thralls in the <text Link = "Location:23661">Kel Voreth Forge</text> reduced, the Dominion assault will be a less arduous affair.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Turning me down will not keep you from facing the enemy.

localizedTextIdText: The chainforgers guard the chains that keep the Voreth Flame imprisoned in the fires of Kel Voreth. In order to destroy the Flame, the chainforgers will need to be dealt with.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Tricus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Each chain holding the Voreth Flame is guarded by one of the chainforgers. To get near the chains, you'll need to kill their guardians.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: From what I have heard, the chainforgers are tough. Each of the four chains that restrains the Voreth Flame is guarded by one of them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The chainforgers are no more. I expected no less from you than complete success, and once again I am not disappointed. You are amazing!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can find them at the top of the forge, one near each of the chains.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the chainforgers killed, the threat of the Voreth Osun regaining control of the Voreth Flame is drastically reduced.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't hope to destroy the chains if you don't deal with their guards.

localizedTextIdText: The Voreth Flame keeps the fires of Kel Voreth alive, so you'll need to destroy this primal entity. Now that you've released it from its Osun chains, kill it to shut down the weapon forging operation at the <text Link = "Location:23661">Kel Voreth Forge.</text>
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scout Tricus at the Warherald's Way
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flame is free and the end is near. Our final task stands ahead of us. Are you ready to destroy the Voreth Flame and bring the Osun to their knees?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing out here? Shouldn't you be defeating the Voreth Flame at the fires of Kel Voreth before it escapes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Victory is yours! The Osun should now realize the Dominion is not to be trifled with! And you are not a hero to be underestimated!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can do this, $(player.name). May Dominus guide your hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will submit my report soon. The colonel will know the part you played here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Voreth Flame has been extinguished, bringing operations at the <text Link = "Location:23661">Kel Voreth Forge</text> to an end.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But you have made it this far! You cannot turn back now!

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos is convinced that the Dominion is planning an imminent attack on the Gambler's Ruin. She's compiled all her evidence on a datachron and asked you to deliver it to Commander Durek on the ship's Command Deck.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver Avra's datachron to Commander Durek on the Command Deck of the Gambler's Ruin
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This datachron contains evidence proving the Dominion is planning to attack the Gambler's Ruin. You must take it to Commander Durek on the command deck.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why do you fritter away precious time? Take the teleporter to the bridge and deliver that datachron to Commander Durek. I still have webs to spin...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm a little busy at the moment... or couldn't ya tell?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As much as I woulda liked Avra's intel a few hours ago, I'm glad to have another warm body on the bridge! You ready to fight, recruit?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Give the datachron to Commander Durek and no other. Go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good, 'cause we gotta do somethin' about these Draken. It's gettin' messy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered Avra Darkoss datachron to Commander Durek on the command deck of the Gambler's Ruin, but discovered that the Dominion has already taken the offensive. It looks like things are about to get really interesting!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver Avra's datachron to Commander Durek
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Why should I be concerned?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My inquiries are still incomplete and my attentions are required elsewhere. You have proven yourself to be trustworthy, so I thought to offer it to you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am Avra Darkos, the Widow. It is my business to know the hidden mind of our enemy so that we may counter his moves in the shadowy games we play.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Do not confuse caution with fear. The Dominion is planning something... but I cannot speak of it in such mixed company. These walls have ears.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The Dominion seeks to destroy us at every turn. Our resources are dwindling... our numbers finite. As an Exile, it is your duty to be concerned.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I had such hopes for you. You will regret disappointing me.

localizedTextIdText: Major Caros in Fort Glory has ordered you to speak with captains around the fort and compile a situation report. Deliver the completed report to Colonel Trillos.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Colonel Trillos in Fort Glory
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fort Glory has been hit hard by the Osun. I need someone to speak to the officers and gather their SitReps for Colonel Trillos. Think you can do that?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Talk to the captains here in Fort Glory and gather their SitReps. I am a major... and your superior officer. I trust you will remember that next time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This report is incomplete. It's sloppy! I expect you to collect all the SitReps from this garrison's captains and bring them to me. Move!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, it's as I feared. Fort Glory is in sorry shape. Those Osun are monsters, no doubt about it. Despite this, we have no choice but to secure victory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Step to it, then. The colonel doesn't like to be kept waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Return to me when you've finished the captain's tasks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You compiled Fort Glory's situation report and presented it to Colonel Trillos. It seems that the Colonel may have more tasks for you to do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is an abbreviation for "Situation Report." In brief, it details the situation of each captain, as well as his troops.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing an order, hmm? I could have you shot!

localizedTextIdText: Captain Hortenus at Fort Glory has given you orders to get a Warbreaker back into operational shape. You will first have to find a Bot-In-a-Box to help you with this task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Hortenus in Fort Glory
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun have been giving our Warbreakers quite a pounding, and I need help getting these damaged tanks ready for combat. Are you here to give me a hand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That Warbreaker will not repair itself, citizen. Find a Bot-In-A-Box and get to work before the Osun decide to turn Fort Glory upside down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Warbreaker you repaired purrs like a pumera now. Fine job getting it up and running! All I need now is a new pilot. The last one didn't make it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll need a Bot-In-A-Box to help you out. Find one and get to work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will have to find some volunteers. Dismissed, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the aid of a Bot-In-a-Box, you were able to get a Warbreaker back into working order. Captain Hortenus at Fort Glory was pleased with your work.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Is this your first day on the job, soldier? A Warbreaker is a battle tank. With it, we are going to stop this Osun threat once and for all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How tall are you? I was not aware they stacked waste that high.

localizedTextIdText: To make Captain Hortenus look like a fool in front of the colonel, Captain Pingo at Fort Glory wants you to recover a $(vitem=564) from an inoperable GL-03 Titan around the battlefield and place it into an unpowered one.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Pingo in Fort Glory
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hortenus thinks tanks will beat Osun. But Warbots better! Must prove she is stupid. Now go. Recover power cells from destroyed warbot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have power cells from damaged warbots? Hurry! Colonel Trillos must learn Hortenus is an idiot!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Buckets of bolts! Afraid this might happen! Energy conversion flow problem. Blame damaged power cell! Makes me look like idiot!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring power cells back. Then we have good time. Yes yes!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Does not matter! Warbots still best choice for killing Osun!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully retrieved a power cell and inserted it into a GL-03 Titan in Fort Glory. Unfortunately, the Titan malfunctioned and attacked you. Let's hope Captain Pingo doesn't ask you to do anything like that again.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Captain Hortenus! In charge of Warbreaker tanks. Thinks she is so smart! Will prove truth to colonel: Titans better than tanks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Frightened? No no no! Titans are perfect weapons!

localizedTextIdText: Captain Arkexa has ordered you to locate some GL-04 Ammo Case and reload several of the GL-04 Auto Turret that have run out of ammo around Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Arkexa at Fort Glory once the GL-04 Auto Turret are reloaded.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun assaults are constant, and our automated defenses are running low on ammunition. I require your assistance to reload the auto turrets.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your task: gather ammunition from ammo cases in Fort Glory and reload the auto turrets. Expedite this immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am showing all GL-04 auto turrets at 100% capacity. You have done well, $(player.name). I commend your service to the Dominion and Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You may proceed. Ammunition crates are available throughout the fort.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's a shooting gallery out there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Those GL-04 Auto Turret pack quite the punch! They should make the Osun think twice before assaulting Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your assistance is compulsory. Reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Colonel Trillos at Fort Glory wants you to enter Battleblood Trench and deal with the Voreth Osun you find there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Colonel Trillos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Voreth slave masters are overseeing the mining operation in Battleblood Trench. Your orders are to liquidate the Osun and their slaves in the quarry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The slave masters are your primary target. Without their leadership, the Osun mining operation will come to a halt.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your performance in Battleblood Trench was exemplary. Initial reports are quite favorable. I will ensure you are rewarded for your service.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stop their mining, and their weapon production will follow suit.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now to commence with the next phase of this operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Voreth Osun have been eliminated, but Colonel Trillos at Fort Glory has more for you to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now is not the time to shirk your duty, $(player.class).

localizedTextIdText: Colonel Trillos at Fort Glory wants you to enter Battleblood Trench and search for Dominion prisoners that have not yet been afflicted with the Soulrot Elixir.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Colonel Trillos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A number of Dominion citizens have been captured in Battleblood Trench. You must rescue them from the Osun before they are given the Soulrot Elixir.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Osun are about to turn our people into mindless thralls. Get out to Battleblood Trench and save them before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By all indications the Soulrot Elixir turns one's life into an unending nightmare. You have done well to save our people from such a horrendous fate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not allow our people to be corrupted by the horrible potion!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The time has finally come to bring this horrible chapter to a close.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed your search for prisoners in Battleblood Trench. Unfortunately, there were not many left to be saved.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Those who drink the Soulrot Elixir turn into savage, mindless brutes bound to the will of the Osun. Once transformed, the victims are beyond all hope.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would turn your back on our brothers and sisters? Swine!

localizedTextIdText: Colonel Trillos has instructed you to find and kill Magoth the Unclean in Magoth's Cave. Hopefully, her demise will spell the end of the Osun threat in Auroria.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Colonel Trillos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Magoth the Unclean is one of the Blinded. She leads the Osun of Kel Voreth. I expect you to muster all your courage and ensure the witch is killed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Has Magoth the Unclean been destroyed? It is best not to leave this chore incomplete. Our victory in Auroria hinges upon your success!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Osun are falling into disarray as we speak. It seems that Magoth was the lynchpin holding the brutes together. You've done well to take her life.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, for she is more dangerous than she appears.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Gold Legion thanks you, $(player.name). You will always be welcome here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have defeated Magoth the Unclean in Magoth's Cave, dealing a massive blow to the Osun of Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: One of the Blinded? What's that mean?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Blinded are Osun witches that serve as the spiritual guides for the village. They are powerful and dangerous foes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Cowardice can be the only excuse for your reluctance.

localizedTextIdText: Nurse Sabinec at Fort Glory has asked you to apply fresh dressings to Wounded Soldier around the fort.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nurse Sabinec via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With all of these Osun attacks, a lot of Dominion soldiers have been injured. Would you lend me a hand in bandaging their wounds?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The wounded soldiers must have their injuries bandaged. If you can find the time to help me, I would certainly appreciate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for your help. You allowed me to concentrate on the seriously-wounded soldiers, many of which faced a serious risk of death.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I appreciate your help. As you can see, my hands are full.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Nurse Sabinec at Fort Glory bandage the Dominion's Wounded Soldier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stop wasting my time, fool. Lives are at stake.

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Vezka at Fort Glory wants you to lash Draken spears to the Dominion barriers that have been set up in front of the Kel Voreth Gate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lieutenant Vezka via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our field barricades are useless, for the Osun giants walk right over them! We must make them more... threatening! Sharp bits make everything better!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you lashed those spears to the barricades near the Kel Voreth Gate? The razor-sharp blades will make our foes tread more carefully!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How glorious! More Osun blood shall be spilled this day, thanks to you! There is nothing like the feeling of driving a spear through your enemy!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Spears, lashed to the barricades, will make the giants think twice!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are $i(player.class) worthy of the Gold Legion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Lieutenant Vezka attach spears to the barriers in front of the Kel Voreth Gate, thereby slowing the Osun advance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no desire to see our enemies in agony? What kind of warrior are you?

localizedTextIdText: Scout Tricus knows the process of forging Osun steel in the fires of Kel Voreth. Using the materials you've gathered, you must now employ Osun methods to make a hammer capable of breaking the chains that hold the Voreth Flame.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Tricus via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As I mentioned, we need a hammer capable of breaking the chains that hold the Voreth Flame. You must use Osun methods to craft this hammer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Forging a Voreth hammer will require precision, strength, and - most of all - patience. All the tools you need are in the fires of Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have forged a fine hammer, $(player.name)! I knew you could do it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The implements to forge the hammer are all around you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now you must put your hammer to the test!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You forged a Voreth hammer capable of destroying the chains that hold the Voreth Flame at the fires of Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your weakness and fear condemns us all!
