localizedTextIdText: With the Dominion's assault on the Gambler's Ruin thwarted, it's time to head down to Nexus. Avra Darkos has contacted you and asked you to meet her in Terminal Junction so she can give you a proper farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Avra Darkos in Terminal Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Because of your gallantry, the Dominion's assault has been defeated. I have no doubt your skills will serve the Exiles well on the surface of Nexus.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well... this is embarrassing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Shuttles are currently leaving for Nexus. You should board one promptly if you intend to seek fame and fortune on the planet's surface.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Reactivate the teleporter in the Greenhouse and take it to Terminal Junction.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have an inkling you will be in high demand no matter where you land.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: How do I get off the Gambler's Ruin?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can't wait to get down there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your way to Terminal Junction in the Gambler's Ruin and met with Avra Darkos one last time before making the final journey to Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: More opportunities for adventure await you on Nexus. Please reconsider this decision.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Arkexa has instructed you to kill Voreth Osun and their Soulrotted Minion outside the Kel Voreth Front. She's also asked you to locate a Voreth Wall Breaker and transmit its location back to her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Arkexa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Archaic as they may be, the Osun catapults are a threat to Fort Glory's integrity. Destroy the catapults and the Osun that control them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found an Osun catapult yet? We need to test my prototype shell by destroying one of them, along with its Osun crew.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I would declare that to be a successful test. With some adjustments to my shell, the Dominion can mass-produce it for combat applications.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I appreciate your assistance. Commence with the plan.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have my gratitude.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reduced the Voreth Osun presence outside the Kel Voreth Front. You also helped to destroy a Voreth Wall Breaker despite a close call with an artillery shell.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I destroy the catapults?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have been developing a prototype artillery shell that can be fired from a Dominion cannon. I need your assistance to calibrate its targeting system using an Osun wall breaker as a target.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fort Glory won't survive for long under a steady rain of Osun projectiles.

localizedTextIdText: Colonel Trillos has instructed you to locate Scout Tricus at the fires of Kel Voreth and help him in any way you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Scout Tricus at the fires of Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Gold Legion can easily secure the quarry now. However, there are others who can use your skills. Scout Tricus can be found near the fires of Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Proceed to the fires of Kel Voreth and report to Scout Tricus at once. He requires a competent soul, and I believe you will suffice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did the Colonel send you? Forgive me, but I expected him to send more than a single $(player.class). You must be... quite skilled.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Tricus is a young officer, but a brave one. Serve him well.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're familiar to me. $(player.name), yes? I've heard of you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Scout Tricus near the fires of Kel Voreth. From the sound of it, Tricus has heard of you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Be glad that the Dominion still finds you useful. Otherwise...

localizedTextIdText: You found a sample of ore in Battleblood Trench. What are the Osun mining? Could it be they've found exanite? You should seek out more ore samples for the Dominion to analyze.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Colonel Trillos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It seems that the Osun were mining a specific mineral. Could it be they've discovered a deposit of exanite? If so, Colonel Trillos should be informed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If this material is evidence that the Osun are mining exanite, then Colonel Trillos should be told at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are those damnable beasts mining in Battleblood Trench? I hope it isn't something along the lines of exanite.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've received the data gleaned from the ore samples you took in Battleblood Trench. There are indeed traces of exanite present in the ore.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll pass this data on to the Imperial Corps of Intelligence at once. Good work!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should get some raw samples.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The samples of ore that you found in Battleblood Trench contained traces of exanite. Colonel Trillos has informed the ICI about this rare find.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I should get some raw samples.

localizedTextIdText: With the way into Research Station Tideborn open, Corrigan Doon has asked you to head inside and locate Lydia.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corrigan Doon inside Research Station Tideborn
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I think I got it. If we're going to find Lydia anywhere, she's going to be in there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Let's get a move on, then.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Little busy right now, buddy...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well... that was terrifying. I'll let Horacos know how everything played out. Here's your share. Not bad work, kid.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: After you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for all the help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lydia Horacos was found inside Research Station Tideborn being observed by an Ikthian. Corrigan Doon helped you slay the Ikthian and rescue Lydia, who seemed to be awfully rude about being rescued.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't give up now.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland has awakened you in the Cryogenics Bay of the Gambler's Ruin. Brightland has asked you to help find and revive his wife, Sadie, before she falls victim to malfunctioning bots.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin in the Medbay
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My wife's stuck in one of these cryo pods, and the bots 'round here have gone crazy. I need your help to find 'n' save her.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I ain't got time to sit here and jaw with you, friend. Them bots are puttin' Sadie's life in danger!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have no time to see to you, what with so many patients. Have a seat. Should you survive, I will see to you as soon as I am able.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This woman is suffering from acute cryosickness. Given that she appears to be with child, she is in dire straits, indeed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Her pod's over this way! Luckily, the bots haven't made it that far.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We will begin treatment immediately. However, we have other problems.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help you find your wife.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Can you do anything for her?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Deadeye Brightland locate his wife, Sadie, and together you took her to the Medbay in the Gambler's Ruin.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll help you find your wife.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Folks call me Deadeye. I used to be a gunslinger on the Fringe, but since I married Sadie I've put them violent ways behind me... for the most part, anyway.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The cryogenics bay's gone to hell. Not only is this ship older'n dirt, we got bots rippin' everything apart. We need to get to Sadie before they do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Either stuck in cryo pods, down with the cryosickness, or dead. I've been lookin' for someone to help me get past the bots, and that's how I found you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If somethin' happens to Sadie 'cause of you, there ain't nowhere you can hide.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to assess the current situation on the Western Battlefront. He's instructed you to first speak with Captain Acrie.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Captain Acrie on the Western Battlefront
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Reports indicate an outpost on the Western Battlefront was attacked by the Osun. Check it out immediately and speak with Captain Acrie.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you assessed the current situation on the Western Battlefront in Auroria? While you dither here, my soldiers are dying. Move!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Captain Acrie has been permanently deactivated by a number of heavy blows, likely inflicted by an Osun Hammer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Outpost Dawn is important to the Dominion's operations in Auroria.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Captain Acrie was dead. It looks like you will have to assess the current situation on the Western Battlefront by yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Orders are meant to be obeyed. Remember that.

localizedTextIdText: Lord Horacos has ordered you to kill Tideborn forces in and around Research Station Tideborn.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Horacos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Ikthians have no clearance to be operating in Ellevar. Theirs is an act of aggression against the Dominion! Hunt them down and kill them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So long as those creatures sully the lands of Ellevar, it is your responsibility to see them punished for their trespasses! Now go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You could never kill enough of these... Ikthians... to make them pay for stealing my little girl. All the same, this will do... for now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes! They must be taught the cost of this transgression!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sorry I couldn't do more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Tideborn forces throughout Research Station Tideborn, and the rage of Lord Horacos has been assuaged for the moment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would deny me, a lord, my vengeance? Fool!

localizedTextIdText: With Captain Acrie dead, you must perform the investigation of Outpost Dawn by yourself. Proceed to the outpost and see what condition it's in.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: According to Acrie's datachron, Outpost Dawn is only a short distance up the road. You'll have to investigate the outpost's condition by yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Captain Acrie is dead, her body brutally smashed and battered by an Osun hammer. You must investigate Outpost Dawn by yourself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you here when you should be investigating Outpost Dawn? I do not care if Captain Acrie has died! Complete your mission!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Osun scum will pay for their destruction of Outpost Dawn. Fortunately, you have shown me that it might be salvaged.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Captain Acrie's death will not have been in vain.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soon we will have our vengeance.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Osun raid destroyed quite a bit of Outpost Dawn, but it looks like the outpost can be salvaged and rebuilt for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Captain Acrie's death must be avenged.

localizedTextIdText: Chua invaders from the Dominion are burning crops in the Gambler's Ruin Greenhouse. Queen Myala Everstar has asked you to save the Veggies from the spreading flames, and to kill the attackers before the Exile food sources are completely destroyed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion has sent in Chua, and they're burning our crops! You've got to rescue our Veggies and lead them to safety!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Chua are burning everything. You need to find our Veggies and save them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great work, $(player.name)! The Chua are falling back to the asteroid, and the Veggies have been saved!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you find any Chua out there, kill them!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Commander Durek's got another mission for you. I hope you're ready.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy to help, your majesty.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You engaged the Chua attackers in the Greenhouse and saved a number of Veggies in the process. Good work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Why, I'm the Aurin queen, Myala Everstar. I've brought my people to Nexus in search of a new homeworld. We can't go back to Arboria after what the Chua did to it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Chua are sadistic creatures who harness technology for the purposes of destruction. They're the ones who crashed that asteroid into our ship!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Veggies are food, of course. They're almost too cute to eat. If you don't stop the Dominion from burning them, we may not be able to feed everyone!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't let those disgusting rodents get away with this! It's not right!

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to return the condition of Outpost Dawn back to Dominion military standards.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outpost Dawn may be salvageable, but I would not deign to drag my tail in that place. Clean it up! And make sure to hunt down those wretched dagun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By the Horns of Hazak, why are you standing here? I want that outpost presentable enough for a surprise inspection from the emperor himself! Now go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very good. You have done an admirable job returning Outpost Dawn to its former glory. I will dispatch a platoon at once to set up a defensive perimeter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you're done, I'll dispatch a platoon to man the outpost.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have made the Dominion proud.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With a little hard work, Outpost Dawn is once again presentable. A platoon of Dominion troops will be sent to take over operations and set up a perimeter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal dishonors the men and women who died defending Outpost Dawn.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to turn on the generator at Outpost Dawn.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your progress at Outpost Dawn to Kezrek Warbringer.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I want the power to Outpost Dawn restored before our troops arrive. Get the generator up and running at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the power at Outpost Dawn is still down, I will ensure that your painful death will serve as an agonizing example to my men.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Outpost Dawn is operational once more. The troops should arrive soon, and you'll be free to see to other opportunities throughout Auroria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will await your next communication. Warbringer out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be proud of your actions, $(player.name). You have done well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Power has been restored to Outpost Dawn.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will regret your insubordination.

localizedTextIdText: The supply tent at Outpost Dawn has been ravaged by the Osun of Kel Voreth and the local Fringe dagun. It might impress Kezrek Warbringer if you took the initiative and gathered any scattered supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Outpost Supplies to the Supply Tent at Outpost Dawn
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The supply tent was destroyed in the raid, but it looks like a lot of the supplies were merely scattered, not stolen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The supply tent was destroyed in the raid, but it looks like a lot of the supplies were merely scattered, not stolen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have collected quite a cache of crates. Good work!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope the General is impressed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your efforts, the soldiers will have plenty of provisions once Outpost Dawn is operational again. Hopefully Kezrek Warbringer will be pleased by your forward thinking.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Outpost Supplies to the Supply Tent

localizedTextIdText: The Osun must answer for their raid against Outpost Dawn. Deface their forged weapons by burning them and create a cloud of smoke so large that the Osun will see it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This must be one of the Osun that raided Outpost Dawn. It's time to send a signal to the Osun of Kel Voreth that these attacks will not go unpunished!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This must be one of the Osun that raided Outpost Dawn. It's time to send a signal to the Osun of Kel Voreth that these attacks will not go unpunished!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must send a signal to the Osun! Avenge the brave soldiers who died defending Outpost Dawn!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fort Glory reports that a dark cloud of smoke is rising from the vicinity of Outpost Dawn. What is the current situation there?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Osun greatly value their weapons. This insult will wound their pride!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Osun weapons were burned and defaced at Outpost Dawn, releasing a dark cloud into the air that the Osun were sure to see. Kezrek Warbringer is pleased with your raw aggression and ingenuity.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Dignitas has been observing your work at Outpost Dawn and has asked for your assistance near DREDplex: Giantcrusher. Proceed to her location at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Axis Dignitas outside of DREDplex: Giantcrusher
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have been observing your actions at Outpost Dawn. Your progress has been most satisfactory. The ICI would like access to your services.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I calculate that your presence here is confirmation that you wish to assist the ICI. Can you confirm?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Meet with me to discuss potential assignments. My coordinates are incoming.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent. I am currently in need of external assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Axis Dignitas outside of DREDplex: Giantcrusher.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It appears as if your usefulness is limited.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Dignitas outside of DREDplex: Giantcrusher has asked you investigate the facility. It was suddenly abandoned, and she needs you to recover some important intel on the Exiles that was stored there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Dignitas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This facility was actually a DREDplex. It was evacuated when Outpost Dawn was attacked. The Exile intel stored there was left behind, and the ICI wants it back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: DREDplex: Giantcrusher's data banks should contain the intel the ICI requires. Enter the facility and retrieve the data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The data banks are empty? The Exiles must have downloaded the intel and wiped the banks clean. I am displeased by this setback.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The intel was stored in one of the facility's data banks. Good luck.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Exiles are likely still in the area. Be on your guard.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: DREDplex: Giantcrusher has been infiltrated by the XAS, and they've salvaged a lot of the equipment and supplies from the abandoned facility. To make matters worse, the intel that Axis Dignitas asked you to recover is gone.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why don't you enter the facility?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The facility may be dangerous. As I am a valued member of the ICI, I am not at liberty to place myself at risk. You, on the other hand...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am disappointed. It is a most unenjoyable sensation.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Dignitas has instructed you to kill any Exile Tech Seekers you find inside DREDplex: Giantcrusher.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Dignitas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tech Seekers are ransacking the DREDplex. We can't allow them to abscond with our equipment. Ensure they pay with their lives for this trespass.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Exile Tech Seekers in DREDplex: Giantcrusher must be eliminated. Return to the facility and engage your most effective lethality protocols.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I must report this security breach to my superiors. In the meantime, continue with your present assignment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: To your work, $(player.name). I will continue to monitor your activities.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Should you encounter other Exiles, terminate them with extreme prejudice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You eliminated the intruding Exile Tech Seekers inside DREDplex: Giantcrusher on behalf of Axis Dignitas.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Tech Seekers are a subgroup of the Exile Academy of Science - the XAS. They are usually found infiltrating dangerous areas in search of technological scraps.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wetwork is required. Refusing this opportunity will have dire consequences.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion has attacked the Gambler's Ruin, sending waves of Draken soldiers and Mechari agents aboard. Commander Durek has ordered you to defend the Command Deck by killing the Dominion attackers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Queen Myala Everstar in the Greenhouse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: First order of business is gettin' these Draken and Mechari trash off my bridge! Wipe the floor with 'em, then stay tuned for further orders. Got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Commander Durek sent you, didn't he? We have a terrible problem here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what I like to hear, recruit! Now get out there and slag 'em good!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I sure hope you can help us.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They don't stand a chance, sir.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll take care of it for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assisted the Exiles in repelling the Draken and Mechari attackers on the Command Deck of the Gambler's Ruin before being contacted by Commander Durek. Still, an Exile's work is never done, and the Commander has another mission lined up for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My name's Commander Durek. I'm in charge of FCON and the rest of the Exile military.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Draken look like giant demon-lizards. With horns. Real sweethearts. The Dominion uses 'em as shock troops. Don't show 'em no mercy, 'cause they sure as hell won't show you any.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: They're fancy robot-killin' machines with crystals for brains. Rumor is they was created by the Eldan. They're good at spyin' and sabotage, and not too shabby at fightin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What are you? Some kinda pacifist or somethin'? Yer kind makes me wanna puke!

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek and FCON are being sent to Northern Wilds as part of a rescue operation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Takag for a mission update
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you endeavor to go to Northern Wilds, speak with Commander Durek. A ship has crashed there, and FCON is dropping in to rescue the survivors.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to Commander Durek?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like you made it in one piece. Hope you enjoyed the ride, because break time is over.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Northern Wilds is a cold, harsh land filled with danger and discovery. Be careful.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There's lots to do and not enough time to do it all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your adventures aboard the Gambler's Ruin, you've finally arrived on Nexus. Only time will tell what your further adventures will reveal!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Queen Myala Everstar and Victor Lazarin are seeking help in establishing a presence within Everstar Grove.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Humans and Granok are being deployed to Northern Wilds. If you so choose, you can instead journey to Everstar Grove with the Aurin and Mordesh.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wish to remain here? So be it. Should you change your mind, return to me.

localizedTextIdText: Even though Queen Myala Everstar thinks you're ready for Nexus, she wants Rhoda Wellspring to brief you before you leave the Gambler's Ruin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Scout Frostfield at the Landing Site in the Northern Wilds, or at Greenleaf Glade in Everstar Grove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You'll need to talk to Rhoda Wellspring for your mission briefing, then decide where on Nexus you wish to go. After that, you can head down to the planet.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: After the mission briefing, you'll be clear to depart to the surface of Nexus.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad to see another Exile 'round these parts. Here, take this "revolutionary rucksack." It's a Protostar pack that'll keep you well-supplied in the field.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! You'll make a huge difference.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Things have gone to hell and we need help!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can't wait to get to Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your adventures aboard the Gambler's Ruin, you've finally arrived on Nexus. Only time will tell what your further adventures will reveal!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll go talk to Professor Wellspring.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Arwick Redleaf and I are establishing an Exile presence in Everstar Grove, and we sure could use your help. Otherwise, you can join the rescue efforts in the Northern Wilds. A transport's crashed there, and we have survivors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Rhoda runs the Exile Academy of Science, or XAS for short. She's a real smart lady, and she's got a special job for you on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Arwick's my First Consort. You haven't met him yet, but I'm sure you will. He's a little temperamental, but I can't really blame him. He took Arboria's destruction pretty hard.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, you want to stay? Okay, then. If you change your mind, return to me.

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar and Arwick Redleaf are traveling to Everstar Grove to find a new home for their people.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Keeper Shyroot for a mission update
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Aurin are following Queen Myala to Everstar Grove in the hopes they can make a new home amongst its trees. She could use your help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to Queen Myala?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Always nice to see another Aurin on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I wish you luck. The forests of Everstar Grove, as well as its beasts, are dangerous.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, we're going to be busier than a jabbit chasing a spark fly!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Great to see you. Need any help?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your adventures aboard the Gambler's Ruin, you've finally arrived on Nexus. Only time will tell what your further adventures will reveal!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Deadeye Brightland is taking his contingent to Thayd. Be careful; there have been reports of Dominion activity in Northern Wilds near there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Aurin and Mordesh are traveling to Everstar Grove. You may instead choose to leave with the Granok or humans near Northern Wilds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wish to remain here? So be it. Should you change your mind, return to me.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin and his daughter are traveling to Everstar Grove in an attempt to find a cure for the Contagion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Kossvak for a mission update
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Victor Lazarin hopes to harness the primal power of Everstar Grove's forests to cure the Contagion. I am certain he would savor your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to Victor Lazarin?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have finally arrived, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Contagion is our curse, as you well know. My hopes and prayers go with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have much to accomplish, and can suffer no sloth.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your adventures aboard the Gambler's Ruin, you've finally arrived on Nexus. Only time will tell what your further adventures will reveal!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are we all heading to the same place?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Deadeye Brightland is taking his contingent to Thayd. Be careful; there have been reports of Dominion activity in Northern Wilds near there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Aurin and Mordesh are traveling to Everstar Grove. You may instead choose to leave with the Granok or humans near Northern Wilds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wish to remain here? So be it. Should you change your mind, return to me.

localizedTextIdText: Learn the cooking hobby
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Learned how to cook
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looking for something fun to do? Why not take up a hobby like cooking?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You'd be surprised what you can make with just the ingredients you're able to find here. And you can make even better food with a little bit of experimentation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have taken up the cooking hobby

localizedTextIdText: While exploring, you located the body of an Exile lancer. Why would a dead FCON soldier be in DREDplex: Giantcrusher? Search the area for more clues and see what you can learn.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Dignitas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This dead Granok is wearing the uniform of the Free Companies of Nexus, the Exiles' military arm. Where did he come from? See if you can find out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Obviously, the only good Granok is a dead one. But there are still live Granok in the area, and it might be a good idea to search for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I suspect the Exiles present more of a threat in Auroria than we previously thought.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Meadow Point is rife with Exile troops. This is most disconcerting. We cannot allow these FCON parasites to occupy a Dominion settlement.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must deal with the Exiles swiftly and decisively.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While using your tracking skills to locate the origin of the fallen lancer, you discovered an entire detachment of FCON soldiers in the village of Meadow Point.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Dignitas has instructed you to eliminate any FCON lancers that you encounter in Meadow Point. The lancers are highly skilled mercenaries in the employ of the Free Companies of Nexus, and they are commanded by a Granok known as Lorox the Lance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Dignitas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I should have deduced that FCON troopers would be close at hand to the XAS thieves. And lancers, no less. You must engage and destroy them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you leave Meadow Point to the tender mercies of the Exile lancers? Those vermin had best be destroyed soon, or I will ensure that you are.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Next time, I will bring a platoon of Gold Legion soldiers with me. There was no indication that the Exiles would be here in such force.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Their numbers are useless against your martial prowess, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your skill in wetwork is impressive.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: There's an awful lot of them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You eliminated the intruding FCON lancers in Meadow Point.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the lancers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The lancers are a part of the Free Companies of Nexus. They are led by Lorox the Lance. Should you cross his path, be wary, for he is a Gnoxian of strength and skill.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Such cowardice does not serve the empire.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Dignitas has instructed you to find the XAS leader running the operation in Meadow Point. Time is running short and that Exile intel must be recovered.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Dignitas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The intel I sent you to recover from DREDplex: Giantcrusher must be in the possession of the Exiles. Locate the XAS leader and recover it at any cost.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I cannot comprehend why you would be speaking to me while our intel remains in the hands of the Exiles. You had best return to Meadow Point... now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Despite your victory over the Exiles and their leadership in Meadow Point, our intel is still missing. It must be found!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We cannot allow the enemy to decipher that information. Be swift!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stand by a moment while I perform another scan...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Exile leader in Meadow Point and recovered the stolen intel. Axis Dignitas is pleased with your work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Such disobedience will make you suspect in the eyes of the ICI.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Cornelius was captured by unknown assailants! Whoever they are, they are most likely those responsible for contaminating the river. Thankfully, Cornelius activated his distress beacon, giving you a firm lock on his position in the Darkspire Wilds in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Professor Cornelius at Grimwatch Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Cornelius' distress beacon just activated. What's going on out there? Find the professor - we need that antidote!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find Cornelius! We need that antidote!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I see you have arrived. Finally. Now assist me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I should have suspected Mordesh interference from the start! Only a contaminated brain would consider this a sterile working environment...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stop spluttering and get moving! Our men our running out of time!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is time we shut down their work. For good. And by "we," I mean "you."
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: He had a distress beacon this whole time...?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully freed Professor Cornelius from the clutches of the Darkpool Mordesh at the Grimwatch Outpost in Ellevar, doing what you could to thin their numbers along the way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will break your bones myself!

localizedTextIdText: Utsah the Curious has a veggie gun, traded to him by neighboring Chua. Unsure what to do with it, he's asked you to take it to Watti Mozz just outside of the Glitterfur Caravan and find out how it works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Utsah the Curious at the Glitterfur Caravan
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Utsah got veggie launcher from fluffy Chua, but Utsah doesn't know how it works. You look smart. Will you talk to Chua, find out how?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please talk to fluffy Chua and find out how veggie launcher works. Utsah traded a glowy shiny for it, so Utsah just gots to know how.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You learn how to work veggie launcher? Yippie skippie! Utsah knew you could!$(self.visual=739)
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Utsah didn't want to trade his glowy shiny. But Chua used big confusing words.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Chua say veggie launcher bestest at getting grumpy kurg bull back to camp.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find out how it works.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Watti Mozz may have gotten the best of Utsah the Curious by trading him a veggie launcher for Eldan artifacts. Fortunately, Watti has shown you how to use the launcher so you can teach Utsah.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find out how it works.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where'd you get the veggie launcher?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, veggie launcher! Shoot veggies very far!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Is big-folk deaf? Utsah tell you already! Fluffy Chua trade to Utsah for glowy shiny. But Utsah not know how launcher work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Awww, who will help Utsah now?

localizedTextIdText: We must secure the footpath to Zin's Landing. Pilot Icarios has asked you to plant flares along the path and to kill Seaspine and Stormcaller beasts plaguing the route.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Wingman Volaticus near Zin's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lady Zin needs supplies, but between the weather and the wildlife, our workers are hard put. Light some flares, would you? And kill some of the nasty beasties.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Make sure you light the flares along the road. While you're at it, kill any dagun or girrok you come across. Artemis won't be happy if we lose our supplies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you shirking? Don't come back until I can see some flares on the road, and for Scion's sake, kill some dagun or girrok while you're at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not bad work there, guv, but I'm afraid you've missed the show. Lady Zin has already left for Star-Comm Station.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Can you believe we flew through this storm?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lady Zin's impulsive nature is well-known to the holo viewing public.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll lay the flares and kill the beasts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Pilot Icarioss bidding, you killed Seaspine and Stormcaller beasts and lit flares along the footpath to Zin's Landing.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll lay the flares and kill the beasts.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll lay the flares and kill the beasts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The brass doesn't tell us anything anymore, do they? All I heard is they discovered some kind of Eldan facility here in Levian Bay. Artemis Zin got wind of it, and next thing we knew, we had orders from the emperor to fly in... bad weather be damned.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lady Zin went ahead to check out the Eldan facilities. She left the lot of us behind to heave her supplies. By the Scions, I'm a pilot, not a dock worker!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you change your mind. For your sake.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Giantcrusher has informed you that DRED researchers were conducting experiments using wild animals in an attempt to develop weapons that could be used against the Osun. He wants you to gather samples of the experiments so they might be continued.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This animal looks as if it was modified in some way. What was going on at this DREDplex? Is it possible to salvage some of DRED's work for the Dominion?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This animal looks as if it was modified in some way. What was going on at this DREDplex? Is it possible to salvage some of DRED's work for the Dominion?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What what? Mondo busy! Come back later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mondo pleased with samples. Once again you make decent assistant. Maybe Mondo requisition you for permanent laboratory assignment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fine! DRED will repurpose experiments, with or without you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to find a number of failed experiments in DREDplex: Giantcrusher and take samples of them for Mondo Zax. He remains hopeful that DRED can repurpose the experiments.

localizedTextIdText: Lake Larallen holds many mysteries. This particular relic is oddly shaped compared to the others around the lake bed. It must have come from somewhere within Lake Larallen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Artemis Zin in the Water Temple
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This object looks like it came from somewhere nearby. Lake Larallen is situated next to an Eldan site, so there may be something you can unlock within the lake itself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, it's you! I see you found this ancient Eldan facility, too. I wouldn't mind some help in here if you're not too busy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's always nice to have someone competent in my employ.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should find the source of this relic.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Searching around Lake Larallen revealed a mysterious entrance. The entrance led to an underwater Eldan facility. Perhaps you can explore this mysterious water temple!

localizedTextIdText: Axis Dignitas has detected a dead Granok inside DREDplex: Giantcrusher. The discovery of a Granok inside a DREDplex is highly irregular, so she's asked you to investigate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Dignitas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strange. My scan of the complex has located what appears to be a dead Granok. The presence of a Gnoxian in this facility is highly irregular.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you located the dead Granok in the DREDplex? I must know why an Exile - albeit, a dead one - is present in our facility.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Perhaps the Gnoxian was killed by malverines, but it does not explain his presence in a Dominion facility. We must learn the truth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Contact me when you find the Gnoxian's corpse. Dignitas, out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It looks like the malverines got him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The slain Granok found by Axis Dignitass scans in DREDplex: Giantcrusher appears to be part of the Free Companies of Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you should recalculate your response.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin wants you to speak to the Caretaker in the Elder Vault and aid it any way you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Speak to the Caretaker. He's a powerful artificial intelligence. We're going to have to help him regain control of this facility if we're going to claim the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to the Caretaker at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are the sapient of which the Cassian female Artemis Zin told me. If I am to regain control of the Star-Comm Station, I will require your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Caretaker has a number of tasks well-suited to your talents.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We will soon see how reliable you can be.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll speak to him at once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to the Caretaker in the Elder Vault and offered it your services.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How foolish of you.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has also found her way into the Eldan facility beneath Lake Larallen. You will need to work together to figure out the inner workings of this area and to reveal the mysteries it is hiding.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Artemis Zin in the Water Temple
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I require another set of hands - skillful ones, like yours. Take control of a maintenance probe and redirect energy to power the nearby generator.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This facility is split into sections, but they are quarantined. I can power this transporter to another room, but I require your help redirecting power.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm guessing the Eldan were up to something dangerous down here. They intended to flood the facility if things went awry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With you on the job, this will be a snap.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As always, your assistance was instrumental in my success!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll redirect power to the generators.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Eldan were experimenting on local wildlife in this facility. The facility was constructed underwater as a fail-safe in case the experiments got out of control and it needed to be flooded to contain them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How are you going to do that?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I seem to have stumbled upon this vacated facility. I found it odd that this teleporter has been switched off. So I've decided to turn it back on.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: With your help, of course! I need a set of hands to help me control a maintenance probe from this console. We will lead it to power a generator in the other room.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't do it, I will find someone who will.

localizedTextIdText: The Bonerazer Draken use communications dishes to coordinate cage drops of weaponized buzzbings on Thistlewood Thicket. Arwick Redleaf would like you to disable the dishes around Bonerazer Village by deactivating the controls.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The comm dishes in Bonerazer Village direct the weaponized buzzbing drops in Thistlewood. Shut 'em down so we can keep the forest safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dominion's dropping weaponized buzzbings in Thistlewood. The Bonerazers use comm dishes to schedule additional cage drops. Shut those dishes down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Without those comm dishes, the Bonerazers won't be able to request more cage drops. Good thing, too - those weaponized buzzbings are real nasty!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't you hate the way the Dommies warp natural creatures? What jerks!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks to you I think we're almost through with this.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They certainly have a nasty sting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disabled the communications dishes around Bonerazer Village and prevented the Dominion from dropping more weaponized buzzbings on Thistlewood Thicket. Good work, Exile!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You bet your tail they do. It's some Dominion experiment called Operation: Stinger. The Chua probably came up with the idea... it's something only those furry freaks could think up.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What are you? Some kind of sissy? Look - the more buzzbings those losers drop on Celestion, the harder time we'll have kicking the Dominion out!

localizedTextIdText: The Pell spirit appears to have been powered by a modified Eldan relic. Perhaps one of the Vigilants in Lightreach Mission would be interested in such a find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the relic to the Vigilant Church in Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Eldan relic has been heavily modified by the Stormseeker Pell. Someone in the Vigilant Church is sure to be interested in such a find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is quite a find, $(player.name). The Stormseeker Pell had it, you say? This will be important to my own research into the Eldan mysteries.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Such possibilities... if only my brethren were not so blind.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Vigilants in Lightreach Mission were very grateful for the modified Eldan relic you found.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the relic to Lightreach Mission

localizedTextIdText: Agent Tychon of the ICI has ordered you to investigate a mysterious Mordesh ship that has appeared in orbit around planet Nexus. The ship matches the description of one that blasted its way off Grismara before vanishing without a trace. Use Captain Weir ship, the Enigmatic Tryst, parked in Lightreach Mission in Ellevar to get there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Weir aboard the Enigmatic Tryst
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A ship has appeared in orbit. It matches the description of one that blasted its way off Grismara before vanishing. You will investigate this ship.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Captain Weir, a freelance ship captain, will take you to the Mordesh ship. Board the craft behind me and it will shuttle you to his vessel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must be here to investigate that derelict. I don't much care who you work for, so long as I'm paid. Understand?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Board the craft behind me and it will take you where you need to go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Should be just another moment. I'm curious to know what you'll find in there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've reported to Captain Weir aboard his ship, the Enigmatic Tryst, and will soon be allowed to board the mysterious Mordesh derelict.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you know about this ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It appears to be derelict and is of Mordesh design. That is all we know. You will, doubtless, discover more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I was told you were reliable. It seems my source was mistaken. Pity.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Weir ship is now docked with the Mordesh derelict. Proceed aboard the derelict ship and investigate it on behalf of the ICI.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Agent Tychon in Ellevar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like we're here. I'll monitor the sensors while you explore the ship. Don't worry about a thing.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We're securely docked. Feel free to board the derelict ship whenever you're ready, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Mordesh derelict remains in orbit, yet here you stand on Nexus. Have you come to offer your life in exchange for your failure?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The captain's recordings of the events aboard Zarkhov's Shade are... intriguing. The ICI appreciates your service in this matter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go through the airlock when you're ready to disembark. And good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Remember: this never happened. I was never here.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm sure it will be exciting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully investigated the Mordesh derelict known as Zarkhov's Shade and found it to be full of horrible, terrible things.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you think I'll find in there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, it could be anything, yeah? Treasure... or valuable data... anything, really. The ship alone is worth millions in salvage credits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You want to stay here? Hey, suit yourself. I'm easy!

localizedTextIdText: Captain Weir ship is now docked with the Mordesh derelict. Proceed aboard the derelict ship and investigate it on behalf of the ICI.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Naida Zavlonov in Celestion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like we're here. I'll monitor the sensors while you explore the ship, so don't worry about a thing.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We're securely docked. Feel free to board the derelict ship whenever you're ready, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your investigation is inconclusive, $(player.name). You must study the secrets of the derelict ship... or has that slipped your senses?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've received Weir's recordings of your reconnaissance aboard Zarkhov's Shade. You have succeeded sufficiently in our service.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go through the airlock when you're ready to disembark. And good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will be in touch, should I require subsequent service from you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm sure it will be exciting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully investigated the Mordesh derelict known as Zarkhov's Shade and found it to be full of horrible, terrible things.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you think I'll find in there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, it could be anything, yeah? Treasure... or valuable data... anything, really. The ship alone is worth millions in salvage credits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You want to stay here? Hey, suit yourself. I'm easy!

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf says you'll need to call on the Greenbough Guardians at the Shrine of the Guardian in Point Firestorm. Finish off Dominion forces destroying the forest. Then meet with Arwick in Woodhaven once you've finished off the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Arwick Redleaf in Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Greenbough Guardians will finish off the Dommies destroying the forest here. Meet me in Woodhaven once you've called on the Guardians. Right?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are you going to call the Greenbough Guardians any time soon, or were you just waiting for the entire forest to burn?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you going to call the Greenbough Guardians any time soon, or were you just waiting for the entire forest to burn?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Greenbough Glen is safe, and Emberwood is regrowing into a lush glen. Now we can focus on protecting Woodhaven and its people.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We've done what we can. Now it's time to let the forest fight back.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our protection here has weakened, but there's a way to strengthen our bond.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I can handle that.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll do what I can to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that the Greenbough Guardians have destroyed the Dominion's forces, you are free to help the citizens of Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Some big hero you turned out to be. Loser.

localizedTextIdText: Radiant Defender Vacuna tasked you with reducing the numbers of the Darkfangs in the Darkspire Wilds, for the good of the Outpost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report the results to Radiant Warden Vacuna
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Darkfangs pose too much of a threat to us.  Cull their numbers, before they overrun our outpost.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Darkfangs continue to plague us.  You must cut them down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The attacks have already decreased in number.  You have my thanks, Soldier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get to work!  Our outpost cannot withstand these assaults forever!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Killing things for the greater good... yes!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They won't trouble you any longer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fulfilled Radiant Defender Vacuna's request and reduced the numbers of violent Darkfangs that were assaulting the Vigilant Heart Outpost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How dare you abandon your duty?!

localizedTextIdText: Pyrius Octavian of the Vigilant Church requires a tactful individual to fill an ambassadorial role to the Stormseeker Pell on the Dominion's behalf. Toric Antevian has asked you to report to Pyrius inside Lightreach Mission to receive your orders.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pyrius Octavian in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pyrius Octavian requires someone to play ambassador to the Stormseeker Pell, and I've chosen you. Let's see if your wits are as sharp as your blade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Pyrius Octavian isn't a patient man, $(player.name). I daresay he'll be fit to spit if you don't get to the church, and soon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is about time you showed up. Patience is not a virtue I espouse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pyrius can be found in the church. Don't keep him waiting, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I need someone with skills. Perhaps you are the $(player.class) for the job.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Toric Antevian request, you met with Pyrius Octavian and offered to support Dominion diplomacy with the Stormseeker Pell.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: To deny the Dominion your skills might be seen as an act of treason by some. You're fortunate that I'm not as strict a taskmaster as Pyrius.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Dignitas has scanned Meadow Point for the missing intel's probable location. After a few moments of careful scanning, she believes she's found it and has instructed you to retrieve it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Dignitas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My scan has detected the presence of a data transmitter using Imperial encryption codes nearby. The probability that it is our missing data is high.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I will take the intel, $(player.name). You do have it, do you not? Then why have you returned to me. Is the urgency of this situation lost on you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Brinlanya Moonstone and her Tech Seekers have been a problem for some time. I am impressed that you neutralized her and retrieved our intel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Proceed to these coordinates at once. I doubt the intel is unguarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall communicate your successes to Axis Pheydra. Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've defeated Brinlanya Moonstone and recovered the stolen intel from the Exiles in Meadow Point.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will pay for this insolence with your life.

localizedTextIdText: After defeating the Exile forces on Crimson Isle, you've arrived in the mysterious lands of Ellevar. Toric Antevian, head of the Radiant Legion, has stationed himself in the combat house at Lightreach Mission. Introduce yourself and help him tame the wilds of Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm told you did great work for the Dominion on Crimson Isle. You had best speak with Toric, our Holy Commander.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't make the mistake of being tardy meeting Toric. Neither of the Antevians take kindly to that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you're the young hero from Crimson Isle I've been hearing about. Pleasure to meet you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You may recognize him by his title: the Vigilant Star.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have much to do to if this land is to be brought under our control.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The honor is mine, Vigilant Star. $(player.visual=368)
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Toric Antevian, Holy Commander of the Radiant Legion, has asked for your help in conquering this new and wild land by helping to establish Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you even know who I am?

localizedTextIdText: Mal'Aroth is no more. His head is a symbol of the Dominion triumph over the Voreth. Bring Mal'Aroth's head to Colonel Trillos at Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return Mal'Aroth's Head to Colonel Trillos in Fort Glory
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This head, taken from the bloody corpse of Mal'Aroth, is now a Dominion trophy. Take it to Colonel Trillos!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a very large severed head, $(player.name)! I am simply... stunned! This unexpected gift summarizes our struggle in Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Put it over there, please. You have the thanks of the entire Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have triumphed over the Voreth. Mal'Aroth, the warherald, has been defeated, and you've delivered his severed head to Colonel Trillos in Fort Glory.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return Mal'Aroth's Head to Colonel Trillos

localizedTextIdText: Take Merchant Sani package to Science Officer Wingo at Vigilant Heart Outpost.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Science Officer Wingo in Vigilant Heart Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You very useful $(player.race)! Caravan not moving. Snoglug egg delivery for Wingo at Vigilant Heart late. You take to him, save me the trouble. Okay?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Take package of snoglug eggs to Wingo at Vigilant Heart. Be very careful! Broken snoglug eggs not good for much!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have snoglug eggs? Give here, now! Assumed Sani killed by dagun in forest. Too bad assumption incorrect, yes?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use care with delivery. Snoglug eggs inside. Very fragile!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now... half snoglug eggs for eating, other half for experiments. Mmmm!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered Merchant Sani package of snoglug eggs to Science Officer Wingo at the Vigilant Heart Outpost. You've found it's best not to think too hard about that.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll be careful on my way.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why does he need snoglug eggs?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Who knows? How much Wingo pay for eggs? That's what matters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Nobody notice if you not make it back... hmmm...

localizedTextIdText: Commune with the Lightkeeper Shrine and sense the presence of Lightkeeper guardian spirit.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This shrine is dedicated to the guardian of Thistlewood Thicket. Some remnant of Lightkeeper's spirit may remain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This shrine is dedicated to the guardian of Thistlewood Thicket. Some remnant of Lightkeeper's spirit may remain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You communed with the Lightkeeper Shrine and sensed the presence of Lightkeeper guardian spirit. Lightkeeper is still protecting Thistlewood Thicket.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I should make amends for his sacrifice.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I should make amends for his sacrifice.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has instructed you to destroy any evidence of the research done in DREDplex: Giantcrusher. Use the DRED Sentry{p:DRED Sentries} to sniff out fallen DRED Engineer in Meadow Point.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This odious creature drools on everything and seems to have a fascination with your lower extremities. What possible use could it have?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This odious creature drools on everything and seems to have a fascination with your lower extremities. What possible use could it have?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mondo told you. Very busy. Go away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good good! Evidence disposed of! No one ever know DRED agents hiding in village. Now... send sentry beast to Axis Dignitas. She will love having pet!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Continue mission. For science!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: It's sort of cute. Sort of.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The DRED Sentry{p:DRED Sentries} helped you find DRED Engineer that died in Meadow Point.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: It's sort of cute. Sort of.

localizedTextIdText: The Voreth Flame is suspended in <text Link = "Location:23661">the fires of Kel Voreth</text> by four chains surrounding the perimeter of the top level. Make your way to the top of the forge and destroy the chains, so you can free the Voreth Flame and extinguish it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Tricus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Voreth Flame is held at the top of the forge by giant chains. Use the hammer to destroy the chains and release the flame, so we can be rid of it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The chains are around the perimeter of the forge's top level. Get up there and destroy them with the hammer you forged so we can snuff out the Voreth Flame.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Voreth Flame has been released! It is only a matter of time before your actions secure victory for us in Kel Voreth!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Dominion is counting on you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Voreth Flame is no longer imprisoned by the Voreth Osun. Now the Dominion can destroy this primal force and put an end to the Osun's weapon-forging operation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Is there a faster way to get around?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Pipes connect various points around the forge. There should be a pipe that connects the tops of the two towers near the entrance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why did you forge the hammer if you were going to refuse to use it?

localizedTextIdText: You helped deliver Sadie Brightland to Victor Lazarin, who can cure her cryosickness. However, Victor Lazarin needs you to investigate the cause of the medbot malfunction in the Medbay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek on the Command Deck
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our medbots have gone haywire and are attacking our patients. We need someone to investigate the cause.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We need this problem solved immediately. Every moment you delay, more supplies are destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good, ya made it. I got an important mission for ya here on the front lines.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be wary. The medbots can do extensive damage.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't worry, buddy. I'll send some men to mop up the medbay, pronto.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll figure out what's happening to your medbots.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Dominion saboteurs have infiltrated the Medbay!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed the Dominion saboteurs that were sabotaging the medbots in the Medbay, and then delivered a report to Commander Durek on the Command Deck.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Victor Lazarin, an alchemist of some notoriety. You might say that my actions have saved, and condemned, more souls than you shall ever know.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is a story for another day. For now, Mrs. Brightland's life is suspended by a thread and I am her only hope.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Cryogenics are a delicate process. When a frozen subject is prematurely exposed to elevated temperatures, the results can be... liquefying.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you certain? Who knows when you may need medical attention.

localizedTextIdText: Learn about building projects from the Pioneering League Representative in Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Pioneering League Representative via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Woodhaven could well do with a concentrated area for commerce and gathering. Aid Builder Swiftcloud to complete a building project in Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find the resource? Did you take it to Builder Swiftcloud?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that I've showed you the ropes, try helping Builder Swiftcloud build his project. Keep up the good work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We knew we could count on you! First things first - all projects require supplies!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Pioneering League Representative in Woodhaven contacted you about building projects on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Pioneering League Representative
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Pioneering League refers to large scale constructions as "projects." These can be anything from the practical to the whimsical. The Pioneering League's goal is to make lives better on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You first interact with the Builder, who could be a person or some other interface. Then you find and return the resource required to build the project to the Builder.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You'll have to collect the required resource for the project and return it to the Builder.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Talk to Builder Swiftcloud if you change your mind. He could use a hand.

localizedTextIdText: A Freebot named Captain Switch has offered you some dangerous - and heroic - work. Though the details are sketchy, Captain Switch promises to detail the mission once you have boarded a nearby transport and traveled to his ship, the Positron.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Switch aboard the Positron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings! My designation is Switch. I represent the Freebots of Locus Liberty. Would you be interested in dangerous - and heroic - work?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please do not hesitate. This transport will take you to the Positron, my ship.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome aboard the Positron! You have signed on for a very important task. I am all too happy to explain it to you, once you are settled.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This transport will shuttle you to my ship, and there I will detail your task.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The assault of DU23 has begun. Allow me to explain what is happening.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Captain Switch ship, the Positron, where he will brief you on the details of your mission.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can you give me more details?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: All in good time. Suffice it to say that you will be providing a great and humanitarian service to the Freebots.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am sorry to have troubled you, then.

localizedTextIdText: The Freebots are assaulting a mining facility on asteroid DU23 in an attempt to stop the spread of a computer virus called Rage Logic. Now that you've agreed to help Captain Switch in Whitevale, you must proceed to DU23 and participate in the first wave of the Freebot assault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Switch in Whitevale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Rage Logic is infecting Freebots and turning them into killers. We have traced it to a mining facility on asteroid DU23 and are staging an assault.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The first wave has landed on DU23. Take an assault bike to the asteroid's surface. I'll maintain contact with you throughout the operation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Throughout the entire operation, and despite unforeseen difficulties, you consistently proved your superior programming. Freedom reigns once more!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take an assault bike to the surface. You'll be part of the first wave.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Locus Liberty thanks you!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad I was able to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Captain Switch in Whitevale is grateful you have succeeded in destroying Axiom, the source of the Rage Logic virus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you know about DU23?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Rage Logic is a computer virus that infects bots and turns them into sociopathic killing machines bent on murdering organic life forms.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: DU23 is an asteroid. There's a mining facility there manned by infected bots. We believe an AI is in control of the facility.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you're unwilling to help, you had best return to Nexus at once.

localizedTextIdText: The Pioneering League Representative in Woodhaven would like to speak with you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the Pioneering League Representative in Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to Woodhaven, Settler! I need to bring you up to speed on some things. Do you have a moment to speak with me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well met, Settler! I'd like to tell you all about project construction. I know it sounds boring, but it's not. Trust me!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent! Find me as soon as you can!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to the Woodhaven Pioneering League Representative.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to the Pioneering League Representative
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind you can find me in Woodhaven.

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar has opened a portal to Celestion in Everstar Grove. She has asked you to deliver one of $m(vitem=818) to her consort, Arwick Redleaf in Glenview's Bulwark after you've gone through the portal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver $(vitem=818) to Arwick Redleaf at Glenview's Bulwark in Celestion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's taking everything I've got, but I've opened up a portal to the forests of Celestion. Here, take one of Elderoot's Seeds through and give it to Arwick.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hurry! I don't know... how much longer... I can keep the portal open....
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have any of the seeds from Elderoot? I thought Myala was going to give one to you. Thorns and bracken! I hope you didn't lose it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've got a seed from Elderoot, eh? I hope it's worth the blood we lost in Everstar Grove. It looks like the Dominion's one step ahead of us here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Some queen I am, huh? Can't even protect my own people.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe those jerks will take the hint someday. Until then, I'll enjoy beating 'em bloody.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will deliver the seed, my Queen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled from Everstar Grove to Celestion through a portal Queen Myala Everstar created and delivered one of $m(vitem=818) to Arwick Redleaf.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why didn't you open a portal earlier?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What good is a seed from Elderoot?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I wish I could have! I'm afraid I haven't been myself since we left Arboria, and even then, I'm not sure I could have opened a portal this size. But now that Elderoot's dead, these caverns are flooded with the primal energies that fed him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The "caverns" we're standing in are what remain of Elderoot's root network. When he died, all that was left of him drained into these caves. Oh, Elderoot... I wish we'd had more time together.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: If taken to Celestion and carefully tended, there's a chance it could sprout into a new sapling. I'd be so happy knowing some part of Elderoot still lives on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We have no choice but to leave this place. I'm sorry you feel differently.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion calls you to service, citizen. Deradune needs your help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Dominion in Deradune needed your help and you answered the call.
