localizedTextIdText: Dominion agents have planted bombs in the Relic Room in an attempt to destroy the Exiles' accumulated knowledge and priceless artifacts, including the Nexus Datacube. Belle Walker has asked you to disarm the bombs before they detonate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Belle Walker in the Relic Room
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion's planted explosives in the Relic Room, and they're hackin' our systems! You need to find them bombs 'n' disarm 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Them bombs're fit to split, darlin', and we ain't got no way outta this room with the teleporter down. You better get busy before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya saved the day, sugar! Not to mention all the knowledge and artifacts my daddy spent his whole life collectin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You be careful now, honey. I ain't keen on bein' blown to bits!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sorry to say, your day's not over just yet...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: All in a day's work, Belle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to disarm the primal fusion device brought aboard the Gambler's Ruin by the Dominion's agents before they could use it to destroy the ship.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What's so special about this room?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Them Dommie spies are hackin' into our systems! It's all I can do to keep 'em occupied until the bombs are defused!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: This room's filled with all the knowledge my daddy, Dorian Walker, found on Nexus. If the Dominion can't have it, I reckon they'll blow it up, instead.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Stars! Have you been in cryosleep this whole time? Dorian Walker's only the most famous explorer the Exiles have ever known! And he found Nexus for us!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm havin' a hard time believin' ya got no problems with bein' blown to pieces.

localizedTextIdTitle: Crafting for the Dominion in Deradune
localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective would like to instruct you about tradeskills and their potential to benefit the Dominion's interests on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Craftmaster Tullio in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nothing is gained without the labor of many in service of the whole and you, $(player.name), have been chosen to serve. It is time you learned a trade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Dominion Victory Commission is collaborative, organized, and most of all, productive. Through mastery of commerce and craft, we shall prevail.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will teach you craftsmanship, and together we will tame this savage world.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll direct your work, and Crafting Trainer Trixion will provide instruction.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tullio invited you to the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective. Now is your chance to pick up a tradeskill or two, so that you can provide logistical support to your fellow Dominion citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare ignore my summons?

localizedTextIdTitle: Crafting for the Dominion in Ellevar
localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at the Tradeskill Hub in Lightreach Mission would like to instruct you about tradeskills and their potential to benefit the Dominion's interests on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your betters demand your service. My tradespeople will bring civilization to Nexus, one finely crafted masterpiece at a time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those of us who know the secrets of tradecraft are the Dominion's greatest strength.$(player.name), are you prepared to learn?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We shall tame this world with the sweat of our brow.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will direct your work, and Crafting Trainer Posca will provide instruction.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela summoned you to the Tradeskill Hub in Lightreach Mission. Now is your chance to pick up a tradeskill or two, so that you can provide logistical support to your fellow Dominion citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your weakness offends me. Step away.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I applaud your choice, $(player.class). Let us begin your journey to being a great armorer. Take these materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've placed the materials in your tradeskill bag. Now for the next part!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were introduced to Armorer Vospana. She offered to teach you the basics of being an armorer.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Want to make weapons? Came to right place! Take materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cozmotronic! Now pay attention.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were introduced to Weaponsmith Frugo. He offered to teach you the basics of being a weaponsmith.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You want to create light armor? I will show you the way. Take these materials so we can commence.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cloth and thread are stored in your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a tailor, Tailor Amphio has given you the materials needed to make some light armor.

localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it to Whitevale ready to help out any Exiles in need.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp need help! Whitevale need help!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it to Whitevale.  Now it's time to help the lopp.

localizedTextIdText: Assistance is needed in Whitevale and Protostar has contracted you to help out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar has a job for you! The consumers of Whitevale need your help.

localizedTextIdText: Calidor Antevian and a group of the most devoted Vigilants have discovered an exo-lab hidden deep within Ellevar. Calidor believes this site is special and asks for you to assist him in uncovering its mysteries.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Calidor Antevian in the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This area's unlike the rest. I hear the echoes of our Eldan forefathers from below. Assist me here, and we'll gain the knowledge of our creation!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's something here... I can feel it. It's right beneath our feet, waiting to be discovered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've entered a chamber long forgotten by mortal minds. What secrets are hidden in these corridors? What knowledge will we reveal here?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Follow me as I search the site. Stay close!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Together, we will solve the mysteries of this place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and Calidor Antevian have entered the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex in Ellevar. Perhaps you will help Calidor discover all the facility's mysteries.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you shrink from your destiny?

localizedTextIdText: Along with Calidor Antevian, you have entered the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex. Calidor wants to bring the facility back on-line, and this requires that you help him find power cells to get things running again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Calidor Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If we are to solve the mysteries of this place, we must bring its systems back on-line. You can help me by gathering power cells.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've seen many power cells littered about this part of the facility. Gather them so we can get things up and running.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Clearly, we have done more than return power to this facility... we've also awakened many of its constructs and defensive systems.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There are likely power cells up ahead. This shouldn't be too difficult.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Still, I am amazed by the robustness of this ancient Eldan machinery.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to the power cells you found, the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex has regained power. In addition to the facility itself, many Eldan constructs have also been activated, and they are now augmenting local canimid.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Clearly, reason is not your strong suit.

localizedTextIdText: It appears as if Bio-Mech AH47 Complex was an augmentation test facility. Calidor Antevian has asked you to observe the augmentation process in order to learn what you can about it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Calidor Antevian in the Recombination Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This facility... it's an augmentation test lab! The power's restarted an experiment in the next room! Go at once... observe and learn what you can!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The augmentation processes used by the Eldan are a mystery. We must learn what we can about them, so we must observe their processes in depth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Eldan experiments in this area are different. They deal with a process called recombination. How does this process differ from the others?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's no time to waste! Get moving!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Show no fear. We'll find the answer.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I don't like the sound of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Bio-Mech AH47 Complex was used to test a new kind of augmentation process referred to as "recombination." Calidor Antevian has descended deeper into the facility to find out more about the recombination process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm doing my best to contain my deep disappointment.

localizedTextIdText: The second level of the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex houses a prototype recombination chamber. Calidor Antevian wants to know what this process is for, and has asked you to capture a canimid and test the recombination process on it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Calidor Antevian in the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must see the recombination process in action. Prototype recombination chambers are in the next room. I want you to test them on one of the canimid.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Capture a canimid and test the recombination process on it. Such a vile beast can only be improved by the power of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Amazing... but do you... do you hear that? It calls to me from the depths... another chamber! I will go to it and transcend beyond this vulgar flesh!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I suspect our findings will be extraordinary.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soon I will walk among the Eldan!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to do what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The prototype recombination process turned the canimid into a raging monstrosity with enhanced power and physique. After witnessing the results, Calidor Antevian has decided to go through the recombination process himself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing me is akin to refusing the church.

localizedTextIdText: Calidor Antevian intends to go through the recombination process in order to transcend his physical body. After observing the process' effects on the canimid, you cannot allow Calidor to go through with it. Stop Calidor Antevian from entering the recombination chamber.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do not try to stop me. I will enter the final recombination chamber and become one with the light of the gods!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get back! I must enter the recombination chamber!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where is my brother? Where is Calidor?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've intercepted a distress call from one of the Vigilants at your location. What in the name of the Scions is going on down there? Where is Calidor?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You cannot stop my holy work!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What do you mean, "an issue"? Where is my brother?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can't let you do that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Calidor Antevian resisted your attempts to stop him from entering the recombination chamber, so you were forced to incapacitate him. Upon leaving the complex, however, Calidor managed to muster what strength he had left and entered the chamber anyway...
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I can't let you do that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You cannot possibly understand what this means!

localizedTextIdText: Calidor Antevian emerged from the Recombination Chamber a transformed bionic shell of his former self, then escaped through a teleporter. Toric Antevian wants a report on what has occurred. Report back to Toric in Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As you witnessed everything that took place, I'll be requiring a full report from you. Return to Lightreach Mission at once and seek me out. I'll be waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not Calidor... my brother is lost to me! I must... move forward. My personal feelings cannot get in the way. When the moment comes, I must face him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: On the double! I would have your report sooner rather than later.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done all you could for him. He is my responsibility now.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I will face him along with you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Calidor Antevian has undergone the Recombination Process and is now a twisted cybernetic being with enhanced affinity to Eldan technology. He escaped the Recombination Chamber and is now at large. His brother, Toric Antevian, is very upset about this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are not living up to your sacred calling, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Returning power to the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex has caused Eldan augmentor constructs to re-engage. The augmentors are augmenting canimid throughout the facility and should be destroyed before they augment the entire area!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Xenoarchaeologist Volios via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Powering up AH47 Complex has had the unforeseen side-effect of bringing the Eldan augmentor constructs online. We must bring these machines to heel.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The augmentors are injecting living creatures with unknown substances. Don't allow those machines to get close to the expedition crew!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The animals in the vicinity of the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex are being augmented by Eldan constructs. You must stop them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The augmentors, and the animals they'd been augmenting, pose less of a risk now than they might have otherwise. I thank you for your conviction.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do so. See to it that any animals they augment are killed, as well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've destroyed several augmentor constructs in the vicinity of the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex, reducing their effects on the local canimid population and saving the Vigilants from their depredations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not the time to shirk your duty to the Church.

localizedTextIdText: The Bio-Mech AH47 Complex in Ellevar appears to have been taken off-line long ago by the Eldan. Perhaps accessing some consoles throughout the facility may reveal what was going on here. Find all the consoles to learn what the Eldan were up to.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Xenoarchaeologist Volios via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What were the Eldan doing here? Why was this facility abandoned? This is the knowledge you must seek out in the consoles the Eldan left behind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Examine consoles throughout the complex. See if any of them function and, if so, glean what information you can from them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By Dominus! The Eldan abandoned this facility because their experiments had gone awry. I no longer feel safe in this place...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This place was important to them... but why? I must know!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: At least they had the wisdom to shut it all down.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can learn.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After some investigation, you learned the consoles throughout the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex recorded the Eldan research that was done there. The Eldan were experimenting with a new augmentation process, but things went wrong and they abandoned the project.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can learn.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you serve the Dominion? Or are you a traitor in disguise?

localizedTextIdText: Something has escaped this facility before. Perhaps the Spider Queen was put through this recombination process and emerged from the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex. This could explain her increased intelligence.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The remains of a canimid are stuck in webbing near this hole through the exo-lab. It looks as if something has escaped.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The remains of a canimid are stuck in webbing near this hole through the Exo-Lab. It looks as if something has escaped.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Something has escaped this facility before. Perhaps the Spider Queen was put through this recombination process and emerged from the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex. This could explain her increased intelligence.

localizedTextIdText: Radiant Legion soldiers and merchants have been captured by spiders in the Webwood Forest. Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp has asked you to rescue them from their cocoon prisons.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The spiders came without warning from the woods and carried off our people before Ringo could set up defenses. You must save them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Giant spiders took our people into the woods... you must save them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you. I feared my men were all dead. Now we can regroup and show these vermin that the Dominion does not take kindly to being attacked!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Giant spiders took them into the woods. After them!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It will have to be enough.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I saved as many as I could.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp asked you to rescue Radiant soldiers captured and cocooned in the Webwood Forest and you saved as many as you could.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll save them from the spiders!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You must be joking.

localizedTextIdText: The spiders inhabiting the Webwood Forest are exhibiting a higher level of intelligence than expected. Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp has requested you bring him spider parts from the bodies of Webwood Spiders to determine why.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Webwood spiders more intelligent than expected. Need you to get many, many spider parts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need more more more! Many many spider parts! Gather in forest! Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name) collect many spider parts? Cozmotronic! Will help with research. Spider intellect off charts!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Spider corpses good. Pieces of corpses better! You go get lots of spider parts for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not leave yet. Have more work for you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What did you have in mind?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess somebody had to do it...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp requested you bring him spider parts from the bodies of Webwood Spiders inhabiting the Webwood Forest to determine why they are exhibiting a higher level of intelligence.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get you the spider parts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You regret it when spider eats you.

localizedTextIdText: Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp wants you to use the Spiderbot Control Panel to hijack a Webwood Spider and find the lair of the Webwood Queen. Only then can an assault on the spiders be made.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Research show queen control spiders. Very intelligent, but transmission rudimentary. We hijack signal! Find source!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why still here? Go go! Study spider queen woods! Use Spiderbot Controller to control robot spider. Trick them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You find queen yet? Good good! Will squash her like bug! Big bug, but bug nonetheless!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go go. She's waiting. Go find queen! Study her!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good, good! Extermination time!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The queen nests to the south.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp asked you to use the Spiderbot Control Panel to hijack a Webwood Spider and find the lair of the Webwood Queen so an assault on the spiders can begin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Silly. Will let you think about it. Done thinking?

localizedTextIdText: It appears someone has lost their romance novels in the Webwood Forest. It would be nice of you to return the novels to them...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears someone has lost their "personal belongings" in the woods. You wonder who reads this stuff anyway...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It appears someone has lost their "personal belongings" in the woods. You wonder who reads this stuff anyway...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes? What is it? Why are you looking at me so strangely, citizen?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh dear... how embarrassing. You appear to have found my... my collection. I shall be taking those back now, if you please.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I expect you will keep your mouth shut about this. Yes?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp lost her romance novels in the Webwood Forest. You were kind enough to return the novels to her, though she seemed to be embarrassed you found them.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I should find the other books.

localizedTextIdText: Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp wants you to recalibrate the defense perimeter that Ringo Hax set up. Ringo left the operation manual somewhere inside Mistymurk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ringo tells me the defense perimeter needs to be recalibrated, but the operation manual went missing. You may need it, as Chua tech is so complicated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What else could possibly go wrong? Why aren't you recalibrating the defense perimeter? If we cannot keep the spiders away, we are done for!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the calibration of the defense perimeter complete, we have a much higher chance of surviving the spiders' attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Scions only know where that manual's gotten to... I'm sure it's lying around here somewhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your service has been noted, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was nothing I couldn't handle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp asked you to recalibrate the defense perimeter that Ringo Hax set up. Good thing you did, too, as it does a great job keeping the spiders at bay.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't possibly expect me to do it! I'm in charge here!

localizedTextIdText: Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp has assured you that getting pinched by the Webwood spiders in Webwood Forest will intimidate them. You have your doubts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have brilliant idea! If you withstand a spider's Pincer Flurry attack enough, spider will see how tough you are and back off.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What you doing here? Go test theory! You can handle few Pincer Flurry attacks from a few itsy bitsy spiders, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alive, yes? So spiders were intimidated by how well you withstood their Pincer Flurry attacks! Knew it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Of course it work! I am genius!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You do it wrong, then. Chua always right!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This seems like its going to end poorly...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ringo Hax at Mistymurk Camp assured you that getting pinched by the Webwood spiders in Webwood Forest would intimidate them. It didn't work.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Wait... you want me to get pinched by spiders on purpose?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: If you say so, but you're not the one getting pinched by spiders.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes yes! For science!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Maybe... a little. No pain, no gain!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Don't be baby. For science!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not wise. Life expectancy now shorter.

localizedTextIdText: Stopping the Webwood Spiderbot you control, a Webwood Taskmaster insists you bring him the next batch of Webwood Larvae from the Queen's Lair in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Webwood Taskmaster at the entrance of the Queen's Lair
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Queen's orders: empty nursery of excess larvae. Taskmaster will transport larvae to satellite nests.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: No larvae? Go get! Carefully.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nursery emptied. Larval load secured to Taskmaster for transport.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Larvae fragile. Do not drop.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Move along.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That was as many as I could carry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While controlling a Webwood Spiderbot, you were stopped by a Webwood Taskmaster. He wanted you to bring him the next batch of Webwood Larvae from the Queen's Lair in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You neglect the nest?

localizedTextIdText: Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp has requested you kill the Webwood Queen in her lair. Mistymurk Camp will be in danger as long as she lives, so take some friends.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Unless we eliminate the Queen, all your hard work may be for naught. But the task is perilous... do not go alone unless you be a fool.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I fear the worst is yet to come. But it may be turned around if you can kill the spider queen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I will be able to sleep all the easier tonight knowing that the spider queen will torment us no more. You have done well, citizen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Strike fast, and strike hard. Show the great spider no mercy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Blessings of Dominus be upon you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will deal with her myself.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: She will trouble you no more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp requested you kill the Webwood Queen in her lair. You were victorious and saved the people of Mistymurk Camp from her clutches.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then we are all doomed...

localizedTextIdText: Harrower Krimzon has asked you to administer Mortalus to the Infected Mordesh{p:Infected Mordesh} in Quarantine Cage at the Belabog Containment Camp. They have been consumed by the Contagion. It is too late for them to be saved.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Harrower Krimzon in the Belabog Containment Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A handful of Grimhold survivors crawled back to camp. Though quarantined, they are beyond hope. You must use doses of Mortalus to end their suffering.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Ravenous are a threat that must be destroyed. It is a mercy, both to them and to the countless others they will attempt to murder.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is a Stage Six outbreak, $(player.name). We are walking along a razor's edge, and one false step will plunge us into an apocalypse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please understand: We do this for the safety of all. We cannot falter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: More terrible deeds await you. Gird yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used Mortalus to poison Infected Mordesh{p:Infected Mordesh} at the Belabog Containment Camp, thereby ending their suffering.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can't we save the quarantined survivors?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is your operation here, exactly?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Who are you people?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: No. Administering Vitalus at this stage is insufficient to save the infected. Our entire operation could be in jeopardy if we do not act now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: An outbreak of the Contagion has overtaken Grimhold. Now her streets are filled with Mordesh driven mad by a ravenous hunger for flesh and violence. We must act quickly to contain and cleanse this cursed disease.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Grimhold was a Mordesh Enclave in Thayd, the capital city of Galeras. The Dominion destroyed precious Vitalus shipments, and now Grimhold is rife with Ravenous.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I am Harrower Krimzon, and I work with a team of Mordesh Reapers. When the Contagion breaks out, the Reapers must end it with death.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you a coward? Do you fear doing what must be done?

localizedTextIdText: Harrower Krimzon has asked you to locate Chernobog Squad in the Grimhold Quarantine Zone and determine their fate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Grim Reaper Lukov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I deployed Chernobog Squad to seal the outbreak, but their communications have gone dead. If you're going to find them in Grimhold, you'll need a hazmat suit.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Every moment you waste brings us closer to death. Join with Chernobog Squad. If they have fallen prey to the Ravenous, complete their mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Noubakov, do you copy? We are trapped! Noubakov! Wait... who is this? Krimzon sent you? Then you must finish the mission with us!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I trust you understand the danger.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While you have not located Chernobog Squad yet, you found a communicator that patched you in to their desperate leader, Grim Reaper Lukov.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Where do I get new filters?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Some areas of Grimhold are rife with contaminants, both biological and chemical. The suit is to reduce your risk of exposure to these threats.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Wear the suit and its filters should do the rest. However, due to the concentration of the contaminants, you will need to replace your suit's filters every ten minutes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You can obtain new ones from the suits of the dead. Rather morbid, yes, but they hardly need them as much as you do...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not a request, $(player.name). You risk a terrible reckoning.

localizedTextIdText: Grim Reaper Lukov has instructed you to plant Noubakov's $(vitem=248) throughout the Grimhold Containment Zone.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with Grim Reaper Lukov at Grimhold's Last Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We split up. We set a rendezvous at Grimhold's Last Stand. But now we are hemmed in! Trapped! Finish Noubakov's route! Plant any explosives he has left!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The explosives must be placed! You must block their ingress!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The explosives must be placed! You must block their ingress!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I... I am the last of Chernobog squad to live. But my time, too, is short. Stand with me, for there is Reaper's work to be done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am ordering my men to incinerate the Ravenous. Wish us good fortune!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The mission must be successful, even if it costs our lives.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following Grim Reaper Lukov orders, you placed all of Noubakov's $(vitem=248) throughout the Grimhold Containment Zone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Should I survive this skirmish, I will see that you suffer!

localizedTextIdText: You've located Grim Reaper Lukov at Grimhold's Last Stand. He's gravely wounded, and the remainder of the Chernobog Squad is dead, but he still needs to rig the detonator. Fend off the Ravenous while he works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Grim Reaper Lukov at Grimhold's Last Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ravenous are lurching toward us, but I must finish my work rigging this detonator. You must provide protection for my posterior as I work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not distract me! My loss of concentration may result in premature detonation, not to mention our explosive cremation! Attend to our attackers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The detonator is set. You fought like a true Reaper, my friend. But for now, I have one more favor to ask of you....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A joke, albeit a weak one. Just keep the Ravenous away from me!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Return to Belabog Containment Camp. Tell Krimzon what happened here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Grim Reaper Lukov in his task to rig the detonator at Grimhold's Last Stand. There's only one thing left to do: dispose of the Ravenous.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Contagion has spread beyond our control. I will rig my detonator to set off a chain reaction that will completely destroy Grimhold. I need you to defend the explosives - and me - while I work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are worthless and craven.

localizedTextIdText: Grim Reaper Lukov Vitalus tanks have ruptured, and he's quickly succumbing to the Contagion. His final request is for you to escape the Grimhold Quarantine Zone using his speeder while he remains behind and detonates the explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Harrower Krimzon in the Belabog Containment Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My Vitalus tanks have ruptured. I can feel the Contagion wearing away at my mind. Take my speeder. I must remain here and see to the detonator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Do not tarry! The Contagion's words of hunger and rage whisper in my ears!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes, $(player.name)? Report at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lukov has passed into eternal night? A shame. Few Reapers were as dedicated as he was. We will miss his devotion to duty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember us with fondness. We died so others may live.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Grimhold burns. The ashes of its people are in the wind. We must mourn them.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I won't forget you and your squad.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sorry it had to end like this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your actions and the sacrifices of Chernobog Squad, Grimhold is no more. It is little more than a smoking ruin standing as a testament to Victor Lazarin's tragic legacy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Don't be a fool! We can escape together!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I can't just leave you here!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Are you certain this is the end you want?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Alas, if only you were correct... but it is too late for me. With the loss of my Vitalus, the Contagion gnaws at my sanity... devouring my very soul....
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You can... and you will. I would like nothing more than to return to camp with you, but my damnable disease has seen those hopes destroyed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I am. I will cling to my sanity as long as I can before I trigger the explosives. You had best be far from here, for I wish no harm to come to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then perhaps you should stay and slake my impending thirst for blood....

localizedTextIdText: Though Grimhold has been destroyed, the Ravenous still threaten the Reapers that remain. Harrower Krimzon has ordered you to enter the Grimhold Quarantine Zone and reduce the number of Ravenous that are still active.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Harrower Krimzon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Though Grimhold is gone, some Ravenous still remain. See that they are destroyed. That is the best way to honor the memories of Lukov and his men.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must aid us by destroying the last remnants of Grimhold's Ravenous hordes. It is what we refer to as "mopping up."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have the makings of a fine Reaper, and I am satisfied with your work. Disaster has been averted... for the present.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May the horrors of this day come to a swift and conclusive end.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sleep soundly tonight, $(player.name). You have earned it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into the Grimhold Quarantine Zone on Harrower Krimzon orders and granted merciful deaths to a large number of Ravenous Mordesh.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dishonor the sacrifices Lukov and his squad made to save us all.

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmaster Daxag has provided you with $m(vitem=250) so you can go to town on the Ravenous in the Grimhold Quarantine Zone. Hard to turn down a Granok itching for a fight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Weaponsmaster Daxag via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ravenous? More like zombies. They're stupid and they love blinkin' lights. Wanna see some fireworks? Grab some explosive flares and light 'em up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Toss an explosive flare or three at some of them Ravenous. It'll bring a smile to yer face, lemme tell ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Zombies? Ravenous? Whatever! It's fun takin' 'em out, ain't it? You done a good job with my flares. Come back sometime and we'll do it again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm stuck here watchin' the stock. Ya might as well have some fun.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Weaponsmaster Daxag $m(vitem=250) worked surprisingly well - and you're not going to forget the fireworks soon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, c'mon. You ain't up for a little light show?

localizedTextIdText: Find the crate with the Inferno Reaper that Weaponsmaster Daxag left behind in the Grimhold Quarantine Zone, then use it on the unsuspecting Ravenous.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Weaponmaster Daxag in the Belabog Containment Camp via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We lost a crate full of the good stuff when the Ravenous pushed us back. No flint off my nose, but I'll bet you'd love to unload it on zombies, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya find my crate yet? I think you're gonna love what I stashed in there. Know what an Inferno Reaper is? Makes them zombies crackle and pop!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ha! Ya got boulders the size of ravenok eggs, kid! Only thing more fun than blowin' up zombies is settin' 'em on fire! I sure do love that smell!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ravenous. Zombies. Whatever!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't give ya more toys, but ya really kicked some ass out there, pal.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Well, glad you enjoyed it, I guess.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You torched more than enough Ravenous to impress Weaponsmaster Daxag, but his exuberance about all the smoldering corpses you left behind was a trifle worrying.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya ought to be ashamed. I don't let just anyone play with my toys.

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Katarzyna requested that you recover $m(vitem=203) from a shipment lost in the depths of the Grimhold Quarantine Zone.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Doctor Katarzyna in the Belabog Containment Camp via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In Grimhold's last hours, we attempted aid with a Vitalus drop. I've reason to believe some vials of Vitalus may be recoverable. Gather them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find the vials of Vitalus we left behind in Grimhold before the Ravenous have opportunity to destroy them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you. Vitalus serves no purpose for the fallen, but the Reapers cleaning up corpses can move in confidence.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Vitalus is life, but not for those already lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Vitalus is not in vain. It shall sustain the Reapers of Belabog.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though the people of Grimhold could not be saved by the Vitalus, you recovered enough to sustain the Mordesh who remain behind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It seems I must be more... persuasive.

localizedTextIdText: The Reapers of Belabog Containment Camp have listed a kill bill for Drugaur the Rotted, a risen Ravenous who inspires dread in any he encounters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Reaper Marya via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED DEAD (AGAIN):\nRequesting an untimely death delivered to Drugaur the Rotted who menaces our work within Grimhold! Speak to Marya for more details.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED DEAD (AGAIN):\nRequesting an untimely death delivered to Drugaur the Rotted who menaces our work within Grimhold! Speak to Marya for more details.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So, you intend to destroy Drugaur as per my listing? Our squads last spied him in Sector 2. I hope you do not plan to take him alone...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Drugaur the Rotted now rots as a corpse ought to. The Reapers can work without fear of his wretched assault. You have indeed earned your prize.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The dread of Drugaur torments our work no longer.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put him six feet under.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You dealt a swift (re)death to Drugaur the Rotted for the Reapers of Belabog Containment Camp.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll put him six feet under.

localizedTextIdText: You found a pendant on one of the Ravenous within the Quarantine Zone. You believe it may have belonged to someone in the Belabog Containment Camp. Return to the camp and find out who owns the heirloom... and break the sad news of their family's fate to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return Nadia Vosmara's Heirloom in the Belabog Containment Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This pendant is quite beautiful. It's engraved with the name "Vosmara." Perhaps someone at the Belabog Containment Camp will recognize it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is that you, Otokar? No, of course not. I am sorry. I had hoped you were someone else.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That pendant you carry... it was my husband's. Now I know he and my family are lost... forever. Thank you for bringing this to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you will excuse me... I must be alone... oh, Otoka! My love!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to find the pendant's owner.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sorry about your loved ones.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the pendant's owner, Nadia Vosmara, in the Belabog Containment Camp. As the last survivor of the Vosmara House, Nadia was saddened by news of her family's demise.

localizedTextIdText: Nerissa Artan has sent you to the newly discovered Eldan Bio-Mech Facility 498. Lead Excavator Radek Villius is waiting for you there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lead Excavator Radek Villius at Excavation Camp Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A new Eldan site has been discovered, and the lead excavator - Radek Villius - has requested help. I suggest you go confer with him at once.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I don't know Radek Villius, but I am certain he won't approve of your dawdling.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, a fresh face. And just in time, too! There is much work to do here... so much to do. You will be very useful, I can tell.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Follow the road to the dig site, and as always... be on your guard.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Smell the aroma of freshly-turned soil! It's all the sweeter for its hidden treasures!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Nerissa Artan sent you to the newly discovered Eldan Bio-Mech Facility 498 to speak with Lead Excavator Radek Villius.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Lead Excavator Radek Villius
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So much for your so-called loyalty and conviction, citizen.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin at Darkwhisper Enclave has asked you to search for Darkwhisper Prisoner in the Pools of Vitara. He wants you to search for missing alchemists who were sent to negotiate with the Torine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I sent some of our alchemists to negotiate with the Torine. We hoped we could bargain with them for the Godwood Tree's primal life, but they haven't returned.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Pools of Vitara are not far. Our alchemists were brought low by the Torine women who dwelled near the Godwood Tree. They still worship it like savages.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Every Mordesh saved from the grave is a blessing. But if we cannot obtain the Godwood's reserve of primal life, it will be the death of us all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find them... alive or, more than likely, dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dire measures may be required.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can look for the alchemists.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I've saved the ones I could.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued Darkwhisper alchemists who had been taken prisoner by the Torine. It's become clear that the Mordesh will need to use deadly force when dealing with the Torine sisters from now on.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Our alchemists were sent to negotiate with the Torine savages, but they have not returned. I fear they never will. We hoped to avoid more bloodshed with these Torine... but that time has passed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We must all serve some purpose. Perhaps your true purpose is as a test subject.

localizedTextIdText: Lead Excavator Radek Villius believes that a Datacube will hold the answer to Bio-Mech Facility 498's purpose in Ellevar. Should you be confronted by defense constructs, do not hesitate to destroy them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lead Excavator Radek Villius at Excavation Camp Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've no doubt the Eldan used this facility for something grand... but what was it? A Datacube should hold the answer. You will find one for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find me a Datacube that reveals the purpose of this facility. If there are constructs in your way, destroy them in the name of Dominus!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A Datacube! And in fine shape, too! It appears as if this facility was used to perfect a process called "augmentation." Fascinating!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Beware of Eldan defenses. They jealously guard Datacubes from intruders!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Datacube speaks of altering life. What could it mean?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You searched for and located a Datacube for Lead Excavator Radek Villius in Bio-Mech Facility 498. The Datacube revealed that the facility was used to perfect a strange process known only as "augmentation."
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to Lead Excavator Radek Villius
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The church does not look kindly on the faithless.

localizedTextIdText: Lead Excavator Radek Villius is now obsessed with learning more about the nature of augmentation. He's instructed you to search Bio-Mech Facility 498 for the location where the procedure's test subjects were being held.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lead Excavator Radek Villius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Datacube says the augmentation test subjects were being held on the far side of the facility. I must learn more! Go see what you can find there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Search the facility for test subjects. I must see the results of this holy power for myself... and I grow impatient with your lethargy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Altered creatures? Hmm. My men uncovered 'infospheres' recently. I wonder... is there a connection to augmentation in the spheres that we missed?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful what you touch. Everything here is sacred!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes... the infospheres must hold the key! We are close to a holy revelation!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While searching Bio-Mech Facility 498 for traces of augmentation test subjects, you discovered horribly-altered creatures. Could these atrocities be the result of augmentation? Villius feels that some recently-uncovered infospheres may hold the key.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Lead Excavator Radek Villius
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not say no to me or you will regret it.

localizedTextIdText: Lead Excavator Radek Villius wants to reverse-engineer the augmentation process so he can try it himself. To learn how, you must activate the four Bio-Mech Infospheres in Bio-Mech Facility 498 and see what you can find out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lead Excavator Radek Villius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The infospheres must hold the secrets of augmentation. Examine them for me and we will learn how the process can be reverse-engineered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Inspect the infospheres within this facility. Let us try reverse-engineer the augmentation process. The glory of the Eldan must be known to me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes! Of course! It's so simple! The minds of the blessed shall see the blinding light of Eldan wisdom while all others lose their sight!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Silence! The glory of the Eldan is not to be questioned. Neither are my orders.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not fear the unknown. Together we will share in the bounty of the Eldan!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That might not be a good idea.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to collect enough data in Bio-Mech Facility 498 to allow Lead Excavator Radek Villius to reverse engineer the augmentation process.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Lead Excavator Radek Villius
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: When the Eldan return, I will tell them of your cowardice.

localizedTextIdText: Lead Excavator Radek Villius grows impatient and wishes to see the Eldan augmentation process in action. He has ordered you to collect the components you need to repair the augmentation engine in Bio-Mech Facility 498 before witnessing the augmentation process firsthand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lead Excavator Radek Villius at Excavation Camp Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Let us see the holy effects of augmentation. Repair the augmentation engines in this facility, then activate one so we can see the results.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The augmentation engines must be repaired if we are to see the results of this Eldan power with our own eyes. Do not tarry here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Scions! I have never seen something so horrific! Did you... did you see that? This technology is beyond any of us... it must be contained!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am giddy with anticipation!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Greater minds than mine must decide how best to use this gift of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to repair the augmentation engine within Bio-Mech Facility 498, and then observed the augmentation process with your own eyes. The horrific result left Lead Excavator Radek Villius visibly shaken, and he has halted any further experimentation in the facility.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to Lead Excavator Radek Villius
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We have come so far. Now is not the time to turn back!

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Hrezz and his Collegium associates are being kept out of Bio-Mech Facility 498 by members of the Vigilant Church. He's asked you to collect $m(vitem=213) from bio-mech constructs inside Bio-Mech Facility 498 so that he can examine them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scientist Hrezz at Excavation Site Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan constructs fascinating. Must study construct insides. You dismantle constructs, bring me mechanisms, I pay you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need Eldan construct mechanisms. From dig site. Must study details of function. You go get mechanisms from constructs... now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So many parts! Intriguing! Must pick mechanisms apart. One by one. Learn all sciencey secrets!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Vigilants take over site. Religion not science... science is religion!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh! Look at that one... and that one. And that one, too!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a number of $m(vitem=213) for Scientist Hrezz inside Bio-Mech Facility 498, allowing him to investigate the nature of the bio-mech constructs.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why is both the Vigilant Church and the Royal Collegium here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So, you are not working together?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: So you have a plan to research around them then?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: By my whiskers, Collegium was here first! Here to study Eldan things, for science! Churchy guys want to take all glory, take credit. Push us out of the excavation!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: No way, no how! I work with church in past. They tip toe over everything, regulate what we can and can't study because it is 'sacred'. Bupkis I say!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Yeah. I has plan. One where you go get me Eldan constructs like I asked for. Shoo shoo. Go on now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lazy $(player.race) not get reward.

localizedTextIdText: Sariah Lumentis wishes to bless the mineral samples that have been taken from Bio-Mech Facility 498, but her excitement has gotten the better of her. She's asked you to gather $m(vitem=214) for her, instead.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sariah Lumentis at Excavation Site Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I wish to invoke a blessing unto this dig site, as well as the minerals and rocks within, but I'm too excited! Perhaps you can bring some to me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've seen some rock and mineral samples that glow with the holy light of the Eldan. I would prefer you bring some of those to me, if possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can see the holy Eldan power as it pours forth from these samples! Well done, $(player.class)! The Eldan themselves must have created them!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My heart is beating so fast! I've never seen anything like this before!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm so excited! I'm starting to feel... dizzy. Oh, by the Scions...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think the glow is from radiation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sariah Lumentis sent you to collect $m(vitem=214) inside Bio-Mech Facility 498 so she could bless them. You have a feeling the samples you returned to her are harboring unhealthy levels of radiation, but Sariah doesn't seem concerned.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me you're in league with those slanks from the Royal Collegium...

localizedTextIdText: Lowland Canimid{p:Lowland Canimid} are slowing the progress of Bio-Mech Facility 498's excavation. Scientist Hrezz has a plan to annoy them into leaving the dig site, but it involves you using his ultrasonic pulsing ray on the creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Hrezz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Gah! Meddlesome canimid obstruct dig efforts. No work get done! Here, use ultrasonic pulsing ray to annoy them away. Work like charm!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Shoot canimid with ultrasonic pulsing ray at dig site. Annoy them lots, maybe they leave. Excavation progress impeded otherwise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ultrasonic waves infuriating to canimid rather than annoying? Good to know! You suffer much scratching and bruising as result?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ultrasonic pulsing ray very annoying. Canimid get annoyed, then leave.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: More research on annoyance factor technologies needed.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll use the ray on the canimid.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's a good thing I'm alive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Scientist Hrezz convinced you to use his ultrasonic pulsing ray on the pesky Lowland Canimid{p:Lowland Canimid} to annoy them into leaving the dig site. Unfortunately, the plan backfired and the canimid ended up attacking you instead of leaving.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll use the ray on the canimid.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll use the ray on the canimid.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe I use ray on you. Then you get annoyed and leave.

localizedTextIdText: Maxinux, a Vigilant acolyte, feels that parts of the Eldan Bio-Mech Facility 498 should be powered up in order to speed progress. She has asked you to activate the Bio-Mech Power Pylons found all over the dig site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maxinux via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We cannot fully access and utilize this facility unless it is brought on-line. Can I count on you to activate bio-mech power pylons in the dig site?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your task is simple. Activate the facility's power pylons so it can be brought back on-line with relative ease.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: When this facility is fully functional, your contribution will be remarked upon. I express my gratitude on behalf of the Vigilant Church.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Very good. Please work with tireless efficiency and you will be rewarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is still so much more to discover here. In time...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Maxinux sent you to activate bio-mech power pylons in the Bio-Mech Facility 498 dig site in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This rejection does not bode well for you.

localizedTextIdText: The Lowland Chick you found on the shore of Lake Larallen won't last long without food. Scour the surrounding countryside for something it might like to eat. Try gathering some splorg, killing snoglugs for meat, and chat up one of the excavators at Excavation Site Alpha for any animal feed option.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Check on the Lowland Chick on the shore of Lake Larallen
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The lowland chick emits a pathetic chirp and opens its beak wide.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The lowland chick lets out a hopeful squawk and opens its beak in anticipation of food.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The lowland chick chirps happily for a few moments. Then opens its beak wide. Again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The lowland chick bounces up and down excitedly.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find some food for you, little guy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The discovery of an abandoned lowland chick on the shore of Lake Larallen in Ellevar has led to a happy, mostly stomach-filled ending.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find some food for you, little guy.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find some food for you, little guy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The lowland chick's feathers slick tightly to its skin in disappointment.

localizedTextIdText: Some especially suspicious Marauder behavior has been spotted at the Corsair's Cove, and Trocin needs someone to interfere. Stop the Marauders from leaving the transportation bay!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Trocin
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoid continually ship illegal goods to and from Corsair's Cove. Move quickly to stop the Marauders from successfully executing their mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Their scheduled time for departure is arriving soon! You must go straight to Corsair's Cove!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Once again we foil their plans for profit. Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Each time they get away, we take a step backwards in defeating them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to foil the daily operations of the Grimvoid at <text Link = "Location:25130">Corsair's Cove</text> by preventing a shipment of goods from leaving.

localizedTextIdText: A collection of stolen Dominion Hoverbikes is located inside of Corsair's Cove, the Grimvoid's main Transportation hub. Make it past their searchlights and guards to the bikes and rewire them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Fenann Greenwalk
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoid received another shipment of stolen Dominion Hoverbikes. We don't know where they keep coming from, but let's make sure they can't use them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dominion bikes in the hands of the Grimvoid makes us all look bad. Go take care of them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work! Hopefully you didn't get caught too many times.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go re-wire the bikes, and do try not to be seen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it past the Grimvoid searchlights at Corsair's Cove and rewired stolen Dominion Hoverbikes so they couldn't be used by the Marauders.

localizedTextIdText: A large number of Marauder goods continually arrive at The Cap'n's Stash that could be useful to Project Monolith. Search the goods to determine what's inside so the Coalition can send a shippingbot in later.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Brema
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Unfortunately we have no idea what sorts of goods could be inside of the stolen crates at the Grimvoid's storage facility. Scan them to find out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There could be anything in those cargo containers at The Cap'n's Stash! Go scan them and find out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sounds like you had some interesting finds. We'll send a shippingbot to gather the goods later. Thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Coalition search Marauder goods to ensure that the Grimvoid does not continue to smuggle important scientific specimens or equipment.

localizedTextIdText: Use the Plasma Saw to give the killing blow against armored Marauders at Corsair's Cove or The Cap'n's Stash. When you've killed enough Marauders with the Plasma saw, bring back your thoughts on how it works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Trocin
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've developed a new weapon for the defenders of the Project. Get the killing blow with it to see how it feels and give us your feedback.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The defenders of Project Monolith need your aid in testing an important new offensive weapon immediately!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So how'd that Plasma Saw feel? It still needs a bit of polish for it to reach its maximum killing potential.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It sure does, doesn't it? We're close to completion now....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided CoGS in the development of a new offensive weapon. Despite its effectiveness, it still needs further iteration.

localizedTextIdText: Leander Heartward at Discovery Station asked you to test out a new EMP device on Grimvoid Generator at either Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your test results to Leander Heartward at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been workin' on a new EMP device. It should help us safely knock out the Grimvoid's tech, but it still needs some testin' in the field.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's the EMP device workin' out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job, $(player.class). I'll use the data from your tests to make some improvements for future prototypes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There are generators at both Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works that would make prime targets.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tested out a new EMP device for Leander Heartward at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Leander Heartward at Discovery Station asked you to gather $vitem=191 from either Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to Leander Heartward at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoids have stolen things from all around the galaxy. I reckon there's more than a few things we could use. Go and grab us some of their loot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find anythin' good yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got us a whole heap of stuff. It'll take me some time to sort through all of it and see what we can use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Grimvoids keep most of their plunder at  Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: There was a quite a lot.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered $vitem=191 for Leander Heartward at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Jakros at Discovery Station has asked you test a new weapon against the Grimvoid Marauders at either Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your efforts to Jakros at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have created a new weapon to use against these encroaching Grimvoids. Infiltrate their bases and evaluate its effectiveness.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you finished your task already?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These weapons will be useful against the Grimvoids. I will continue production.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There are plenty of targets at both Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tested out a new weapon for Jakros at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Jakros at Discovery Station asked you to destroy any Grimvoid Part that you can find at The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your accomplishment to Jakros at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoids are repairing and upgrading their vehicles with stolen parts. Infiltrate The Skunk Works and destroy any spare parts you can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are more parts to be destroyed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Without vehicle support, the Grimvoids will be reluctant to attack us. Your actions have secured us more time to prepare.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we can keep the Grimvoids on foot, they will be easier to confront in battle.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It won't keep them down for long.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Grimvoid parts for Jakros at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Leander Heartward at Discovery Station asked you to locate buried Grimvoid treasure around Port Grimvoid.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to Leander Heartward at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've heard rumors that the Grimvoids bury their valuable treasure. Go to Port Grimvoid and have a look around for some.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found anything yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I guess the rumors were true! That's quite the haul.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I've attached a tracker to your armor that should help locate underground objects. When you get close to something, the tracker will activate.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found buried Grimvoid treasure for Leander Heartward at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Jakros has asked you to locate and assassinate the Grimvoid spy hiding in Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Jakros at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(player.name), there is a Grimvoid spy hiding inside our base. Discover who the spy is and quietly eliminate him when the opportunity arises.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you dealt with the spy yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your tracking skills impress me, $(player.name). The death of the spy should send the Grimvoids a message.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The spy is cunning. You will not be able to tell who he is by appearance alone. Use your interrogation skills.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and assassinated the Grimvoid spy hiding in Discovery Station for Jakros.

localizedTextIdText: Katarina Volosh at Discovery Station has asked you to poison the Grimvoid's food supply at The Grog Locker.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your progress to Katarina Volosh at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have been experimenting with some new food additives. Test it on the Grimvoids' rations.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you finished the testing?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This experiential additive may prove useful in the future.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sprinkle the concoction on any of their foodstuffs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You poisoned the Grimvoid's food supplies for Katarina Volosh at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Alis Severos at Discovery Station has asked you to collect $m(vitem=196) from The Grog Locker.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the $m(vitem=196) to Alis Severos at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoids have Eldan relic fragments in their possession. Take them back any way you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I require more $m(vitem=196).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Commendable work. There is much we can learn from these.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We need to study them. Those Grimvoids will probably just sell them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=196) for Alis Severos at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Alis Severos at Discovery Station has asked you to recover a Grimvoid personnel roster from The Grog Locker.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the roster to Alis Severos at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to know who we are dealing with. Sneak into the Grimvoid camp and access their personnel records.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need that personnel roster.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fantastic! With this information, we will be able to figure out just what we are up against.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You may have to steal a password from someone. Look for an easy target to pilfer it from.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope it comes in handy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the roster for Alis Severos at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Inexia at Discovery Station asked you to place communication bugs at Bosun's Watch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your progress to Inexia at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need a method to monitor the Grimvoids' activity. Sneak into their communication relay and plant bugs on their equipment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you placed all of the bugs?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the bugs planted, we will be able to take preemptive measures to deal with the Grimvoids.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This task is vital to protecting our research.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You planted communication bugs for Inexia atDiscovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Inexia at Discovery Station has asked you to recover the stolen equipment from Bosun's Watch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your progress to Inexia at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Grimvoid Warparty attacked and took some of our research equipment. Go get it back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you managed to reclaim our equipment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should teach Grimvoids a lesson. Maybe they will think twice before crossing us again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those vile Grimvoids will steal anything.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the stolen equipment from Inexia at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Praxo at the Discovery Station has asked you to steal some fuel from The Tanks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Praxo at Discovery Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are burning through fuel faster than we can restock it. Luckily for us, the Grimvoids seem to have plenty. Go get some!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our tanks are runnin' low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should hold us for a little while longer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm sure they won't give it you freely. Watch yer back.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for bustin' yer boulders for us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You procured some fuel for Praxo at the Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Praxo at Discovery Station has asked you to sabotage Grimvoid vehicles at The Tanks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Praxo at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoids are ruining this area with their vehicles. Please go and sabotage their transports.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you put a stop to the Grimvoid's joyriding yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should put a kink in their transportation!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do whatever you can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You sabotaged vehicles for Praxo at Discovery Station

localizedTextIdText: Jakros at the Main Base has asked you to destroy any Grimvoid Bouncer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your victory to Katarina Volosh at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoids are utilizing a small army of robotic soldiers. Do me a favor and turn them into scrap.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How have you faired in battle?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am impressed by your mettle.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I have seen those mechanical menaces at The Tanks, The Grog Locker, and Bosun's Watch.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Jakros at the Main Base asked you to destroy any Grimvoid Bouncer.

localizedTextIdText: Foria Whitegale at Discovery Station has asked you to find and repair probes around The Tanks and Cybernetic Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your progress to Foria Whitegale at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've sent out quite a few Surveyor Drone to survey the area. Some of their guidance systems have malfunctioned due to the cold. Repair them for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need those Surveyor Drone repaired.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent job. We've got some great data.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The lot of them should be up in the mountains.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered probes for Foria Whitegale at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Foria Whitegale at Discovery Station has asked you to use and Eldan probe to uncover artifacts near Bosun's Watch and Plasmatic Repository.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to Foria Whitegale at Discovery Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have reports of active Eldan probes scanning the site. Try and locate one. It may uncover more Eldan clues.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your tracking skills are quite impressive, I$(player.name). This collection of relics will aid our research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you find an inactive one, try to give it a kickstart.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered Eldan artifacts for Foria Whitegale at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Gomits Vanti at Discovery Station has asked you to recover soil samples around Bosun's Watch and Corsair Cove.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to Gomits Vanti at Discovery Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to examine the strat of the local terrain to determine to where to best dig. Can you go out into the field and collect some samples?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still need more samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These samples will do nicely. I'll let you know if we need any more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use these flares to mark dig locations. I'll handle the rest remotely.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered soil samples for Gomits Vanti at Discovery Station

localizedTextIdText: Gomits Vanti at Discovery Station has asked you to defrost frozen workers near The Tanks and The Grog Locker.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Gomits Vanti at Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there, $(player.name). I could use your help thawing out some frozen bots?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need more bots workin' and less bots chillin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I half expected you to come back as an ice cube.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Give them a zap with antifreeze and they should start right back up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defrosted workers for Gomits Vanti at Discovery Station.

localizedTextIdText: Use the flamethrower on Augmented spiders and Spiderwebs at the Cybernetic Gladeto thin their numbers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Cyrilia Belax
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ew! Spiders are SO icky. Especially the augmented ones. Here, take this flame thrower and clear out those unnatural ones and their webs. They are really taking over and it's gross.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you get rid of those unnatural, ugly augmented spiders yet? Well, get over to the Cybernetic Glade already!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I almost feel bad for those eldan rejects. But then I think some more, and I'm happy you turned them to a crisp!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You set augmented spiders and spiderwebs ablaze at the Cybernetic Glade to help Monolith Scientists in their efforts to research the area.

localizedTextIdText: The Coalition is fascinated with the uniqueness of the life forms at theCybernetic Glade and wishes to utilize the wildlife to help the Project.
