Augmented spiders seem to be attracted to the fluid inside of their own eggs, so you might as well pick their eggs and throw them at our enemies before they explode onto you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Vilem Lazoli
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have observed that the spiders in the Primordial Glade are attracted to the fluids inside their own eggs. Pick some up and throw them at Marauders to see what happens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Pick up a spider egg and toss it at a Marauder before it explodes, will you? I want to get some data about how the spiders react.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That looked messy, but it's fascinating to see the reaction from the spiders. For science!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh! Be careful, 'cause it might explode onto you if you hold it for too long.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Grimvoid Marauders brave enough to venture into the Cybernetic Glade found themselves covered in Spider Egg goo and being attacked by angry spiders -- all thanks to you!

localizedTextIdText: There are ancient Eldan teleporter pads scattered around the <text Link="Location:25132>Cybernetic Glade</text> that bring mutated creatures from another land. Initiate the teleporter and capture the creature before it comes to so that CoGS can investigate their importance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Fazia
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A scientist of ours recently perished when activating an ancient eldan teleportation pad. We need more able-bodied individuals to capture the creatures that arrive when activated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you activate the teleport consoles and attempt to capture the creatures inside yet? You've got to hold still as they arrive!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wow, those Eldan sure are capable of amazing things. It's a bit scary, huh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's truly fascinating -- the specimens seem to have never aged!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The teleporter pads <text Link="Location:25132>Cybernetic Glade</text> seem to bring various creatures from around the world for testing purposes! You captured various specimens for Coalition scientists.

localizedTextIdText: There is a lot left about the Eldan that CoGS wishes to discover. Use the goggles to discover hidden, buried Eldan artifacts and bring them to the surface around the <text Link ="Location:25133">Plasmatic Repository"</text>. When you're close to where one is hidden, the device will let you know, and you'll see one appear.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Vilem Lazoli
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wear these goggles to find Eldan artifacts. It tells you when you're close and attracts them to the surface for you to find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are your goggles malfunctioning? Get out there and find those eldan artifacts!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have helped the Project move closer to understanding the Eldan. Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep an eye out for the goggle's readout in the upper left of the left lens. You'll see when you're close.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the ____ goggles you discovered various unique Eldan artifacts scattered around the <text Link ="Location:25133">Plasmatic Repository"</text>.

localizedTextIdText: The Coalition knows that the Eldan once used Primal Wells to fuel the development of their experiments. In an effort to continually understand the Eldan, CoGS wishes to extract some of the primal powers from the wells scattered around the Plasmatic Repository.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Cyrilia Belax
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan Primal Wells are an amazing resource, and we should do what we can to carefully extract their powers! It's a dangerous job, though.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A bit too dangerous for you, then? What are you waiting for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice and stocked up once more! Thanks for your hard work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The primal wells scattered around the Plasmatic Repository are rich with primal powers, but extracting it has served to be quite dangerous! Despite the danger, you extracted power for the Coalition successfully.

localizedTextIdText: The Plasmatic Repository is full of dangerous activity, but somehow the Marauders have managed to stay out of the way of the Eldan defenses. Reprogram an Eldan construct and lead it to a Marauder to help us send a message.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Fazia
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Reprogram protectors at the Eldan lab to work for us. Those things are powerful, so we might as well use them to our advantage. Let it do some killing for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you have trouble retrieving a bot, then? Go activate one and have it tag along with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Didn't I say those were some pretty powerful bots?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By reprogramming Eldan Protectors at the Plasmatic Repository you have helped aid the efforts of Project Monolith by removing the Grimhaven grasp on the area.

localizedTextIdText: Inexia has been working on developing a serum to help the (operation) military see more success against the Marauders. It is still in its experimental phase, and is quite unstable. Inexia suggests going into Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works to find Marauders to inject and kill.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tamo Pil at the Main Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are at a disadvantage here, so I'm developing a serum to level the playing field. It's still unstable and needs some tweaking. Test it on some Marauders and report the results.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't worry about getting to close -- you should be able to shoot the serum at them from afar. Use it, observe its affects and kill them quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Still unstable as expected, but I think I am close to finding a solution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There are many able-bodied test subjects in the Marauder bases.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Inexia in the development of a military serum, helping her to discover that the results vary a bit too much to start giving it to Project Monolith soldiers just yet.

localizedTextIdText: Foria Whitegale sees Project Monolith benefiting from taking down the Marauders from the inside. She has asked you to sneak inside of Port Grimvoid and use a Scrambler to confuse the Marauder leaders into thinking that everything is going well for them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Adella Witchgrove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh, hey $(player.name)! Listen, I've got to make sure these Marauders don't start making some tactical moves against us. Scramble the brains of the Grimvoid higher ups?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? The more confused those nimwits are, the better for the project!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work. Hopefully none of their shipmates notice their strange behavior....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good, good. What they don't know or understand can't hurt them!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll be surprised if they don't.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped confuse leaders of the Grimvoid Marauders stationed at <text Link = "Location:25137">Port Grimvoid</text> by scrambling their brains with a special device developed by CoGS.

localizedTextIdText: Cyrilia Belax wishes to read the Grimvoid Concord, the "rulebook" of the Marauder clan. She thinks it holds information that could be valuable to the operation and has asked you to find the scattered pages around Port Grimvoid.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Adella Witchgrove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have been gathering intelligence about the Grimvoid through the scattering of pages around their crash site. Their Concord is out for grabs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Within those pages lies important secrets we can use against the Grimvoid! Take risks in your hunt.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ahh, yes! More pages for us to pick apart. We've only found a few helpful things so far, but I have hope you've got more for us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's been quite telling so far, and I believe we must keep reading more!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Grimvoid Concord is scattered around Port Grimvoid and several of its pages were successfully recovered by your efforts.

localizedTextIdText: The Grimvoid Marauders use relatively advanced weapons systems stolen from the Coalition of Galactic Scientists at their crash site, Port Grimvoid. Gomits Vanti needs help corrupting their data cores at so their weapons malfunction, but he suggests not getting caught in the act.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tamo Pil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Reprogram advanced marauder weapon systems by shoving corrupt data cores into their CPUs. I don't suggest getting caught.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Viruses! Yes. That is what you must put there. To shoot Marauders!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you see those guns turn on them? That was great.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The advanced weapons systems atPort Grimvoid were corrupted with your help.

localizedTextIdText: The Grimvoid fix their ships by scavenging and stealing anything they can find. A fast way to undermine them is to take away their supplies at The Skunk Works, but since their bases are more heavily guarded, Tamo Pil developed a way to steal without having to stop running.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tamo Pil
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That junk they've stockpiled is helping them fix their ships! We can't have that, no no no! Put this on and run around their base.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That looked fun.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You mystified the Marauders by running around The Skunk Works and grabbing up all of their junk pieces with your giant magnet.

localizedTextIdText: To extract primal life from the Godwood Tree, the Exiles will require Torinite to enhance their drilling equipment. Victor Lazarin believes that Torinite can be gained by gathering $m(vitem=190) throughout the Pools of Vitara and melting them down in one of the Torine's Grand Forges.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To tap into the Godwood Tree, we'll require drill bits imbued with Torinite. If we can melt their weapons down into ingots, they'll provide the alloy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So far, our drills have failed to bore through the ground and bark near the Godwood Tree. Metal from the Torine blades should help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My alchemists have devised a Torinite Coating created from the melted weaponry. This should prove to be the key element needed in preparing our drills.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'd rather melt the Torine blades down than have them shed Exile blood someday.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Go! Our very lives are at stake.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll collect Torine blades and smelt them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered a number of $m(vitem=190) and melted them down at the Grand Forge in the Pools of Vitara. One of the Torine's chosen appeared to challenge you, but you survived.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll collect Torine blades and smelt them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is the name I have satirically supplied to the alloy the savage women use to craft their swords. The black humor in that moniker makes me merry.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Our drills have found the ground around the Godwood Tree to be... impenetrable. The Torinite will make a coating strong enough for us to bore.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your heart is as cold as the grave, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: A scouting team looking for a reliable source of primal life has vanished into the Verdant Sanctuary. Victor Lazarin has sent you into the forest to determine their fate and possibly complete their mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Alchemist Polovic in Verdant Sanctuary
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our alchemists' expedition has not reported in. If they have failed in their search for primal life, I will expect you to carry on in their place.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We need someone to discover the fate of the alchemists who ventured into the Verdant Sanctuary. We cannot fail in our efforts. Our very existence is at stake!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am surprised to see a searcher here in this sanctuary. I bid you welcome.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am Sonya Polovic, member of the Alchemists Guild. My expedition was searching for primal life when we were attacked. Only I survived.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must find a new source of primal life, no matter what stands in our way.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Beware of the Torine! They were the cause of my team's destruction!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can find them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You joined up with Alchemist Polovic, the last surviving member of an alchemist expedition seeking primal life in the Verdant Sanctuary.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need a source of primal life?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What happens if you run out of Vitalus Serum?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Primal life is a vital ingredient in Vitalus Serum, without which we could not survive. The journey to Nexus has been long, and our reserves have reached their limit.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The consequences are indeed dire. I prefer not to converse about our curse... our wretched Contagion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What was that? Did you misspeak?

localizedTextIdText: Lucy Lazarin is worried about Darkwhisper Enclave's dwindling alchemical supplies and medicines. She's asked you to gather components from creatures at the Pools of Vitara and on the Vibrant Ascent.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucy Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My father forgets that our medical and alchemical supplies are dwindling. To replenish them, I require ingredients found near the Godwood Tree.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Steelscale gnashers, manstalkers, and vinecreepers dwell around the Godwood Tree. Hunt them down and harvest what you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We can sustain our research for the days to come with the resources you have collected. This should keep our researchers in peak condition.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go forth. Harvest what components you can to strengthen our small enclave.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be well, Exile.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get you what you need.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected enough components to bolster the camp's supplies of alchemical and medical components. Lucy Lazarin thanked you for your efforts to sustain the camp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Our alchemical supplies won't last long. You disappoint me.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Polovic believes that the Torine are the key to finding a new source of primal life in Celestion. Search their camps, in the Verdant Sanctuary, Lifegiver's Rest, and Swordstone Hill.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Polovic via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: They call themselves the Torine Sisterhood, and they have empowered themselves by channeling the forest's source of primal life. Search their camps for clues.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Torine draw power from primal life in a way I cannot yet divine. Venture into their camps. See what you can find there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We draw closer to our goal. The Torine are skilled manipulators of primal life. I believe I have located what they call the Lifeblood Pool.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must know the truth.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Lifeblood Pool is sacred to the sisters. Could this be the answer I seek?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought your way into the Torine camps and learned that they have sworn to protect a place called the Lifeblood Pool. Could this be the source of primal life the Mordesh are looking for?
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You disappoint me. I would prefer that you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Polovic has located another potential source of primal life. Find the Lifeblood Pool and help Polovic by gathering samples there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with Alchemist Polovic near the Lifeblood Pool
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Life-infused water gathers near the roots of the Godwood Tree. This is the Lifeblood Pool. I must sample the water, but I need you to watch my back.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I must take samples from the Lifeblood Pool, but I cannot do it alone. I will need you to protect me from the swordmaidens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I must take samples from the Lifeblood Pool, but I cannot do it alone. I need you to protect me from the swordmaidens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The closer we get to the Godwood Tree, the stronger the resistance becomes. It must be the source of all the primal life in the area! It must!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly, now. The Torine will not approve of my analysis.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We're getting closer, I can feel it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed Alchemist Polovic to the Lifeblood Pool, where you faced Swordmaiden Demetra.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not a good time to leave me to my death.

localizedTextIdText: Torine sisters in the Verdant Sanctuary are humans mysteriously infused with primal life. Alchemist Polovic needs more samples, both from the Torine and the local wildlife, to draw further conclusions about the local ecosystem and its relationship to primal life.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Polovic via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Preliminary data indicates these Torine are simply humans infused with primal life. We need to gather more samples, as well as analyzing the local wildlife.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We must compare primal imprint samples from the Torine Sisterhood to those of the wildlife in the area. We must know where they fit in.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must compare primal imprint samples from the Torine Sisterhood to those of the wildlife in the area. We must know where they fit in.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The more samples we gather, the more certain I become. The Torine are almost entirely human, but they're infused with large quantities of primal life.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We'll compare these Torine to other beasts in the sanctuary.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These savage humans were infused with primal life. Where could they have come from?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After analyzing the Torine and the wildlife samples, Alchemist Polovic is certain the Torine are of human descent - they might not even be from Nexus at all. Despite the samples, it remains unclear how they've come to be infused with primal life.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you will not help, then I am forced to do this without your assistance.

localizedTextIdText: Perhaps examining one of the Torine's artifacts will provide some clues to their origin. After defeating Deathbringer Cordemia, you obtained a sword that looks truly ancient. Maybe someone in Darkwhisper Enclave will be able to reveal something more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Anthropologist Liev in Darkwhisper Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This sword looks ancient. Maybe someone in Darkwhisper Enclave can help determine its origins.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This sword resembles a relic from the old Cassian Empire... but they haven't made anything like this for thousands of years. What an enigma!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If only the Torine were willing to discuss their origins with us... alas!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the savage Deathbringer Cordemia and brought her sword to Anthropologist Liev in Darkwhisper Enclave. Scans of the sword have raised as many questions as they answered. They've revealed that the weapon was made centuries ago using methods reminiscent of ancient Cassia.

localizedTextIdText: The Horizon Plateau is the highest point in the Verdant Sanctuary. From there, Alchemist Polovic will finally be able to get a clear reading on the Godwood Tree. Make your way to the plateau and climb its daunting cliffs to reach the top.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Alchemist Polovic on Horizon Plateau
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Primal life is everywhere, but its concentration is insufficient for our purposes. Let's scout from an elevated location. I'd prefer the Horizon Plateau.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Time is of the essence. Help me scout for the source of primal life atop the Horizon Plateau.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is of the essence. Help me scout for the source of primal life atop the Horizon Plateau.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for assembling the teleporter. Let us not waste any time. We must get to that tree!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall meet you there. Take care on your ascent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's be on our way. We have much to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Horizon Plateau is the highest point in the Verdant Sanctuary. After climbing its daunting cliffs to reach the top, Alchemist Polovic was finally able to get a clear reading on the Godwood Tree with your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I did not expect you to be afraid of heights.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Polovic has cloaked you with stealth and speed and asked you to make your way back to Darkwhisper Enclave to deliver her final report to Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin at Darkwhisper Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must tell Victor Lazarin that we've found an alternate source of primal life. We've been searching for the tree's heart.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We have found the source of primal life in the Godwood Tree. Go back to Darkwhisper Enclave and tell Victor Lazarin at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What? Has the search been a success? Speak!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is as I feared. The Godwood Tree is our only hope for survival. The Torine Sisterhood must be dealt with if we are to gain access to the tree's heart.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly! Take the teleporter to reach him. There's no time to waste.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This was not the ending I hoped for, but I see we have little choice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Having discovered that the Godwood Tree is truly the only viable source of primal life in Celestion, you brought that information to Victor Lazarin. Now the harvesting can begin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your apathy makes fools of us all.

localizedTextIdText: The Mordesh have arrived in Celestion, setting up a scientific installation known as Darkwhisper Enclave. Arwick Redleaf has invited you to attend a conference in Sylvan Glade before heading to the enclave to meet with Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin in Darkwhisper Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Since the Mordesh established an enclave near Sylvan Glade, the trees have been complaining. We need to hold a holo-conference with Victor Lazarin!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We need to act on behalf of the forest. That means talking to Victor Lazarin and setting things to rights.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: These are the darkest days I've experienced in some time... and trust me, I know dark days.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Aurin will never completely comprehend the horror of our plight. Without a steady supply of serum, the Contagion will rage unchecked.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Mordesh are our friends, but so is the forest!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If we do not act, the Mordesh on Nexus are doomed.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I agree, let's talk to him.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope we can resolve this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Arwick Redleaf and Victor Lazarin have conflicting ideas about how to best manage the exploration and settlement of the Verdant Sanctuary, the last untouched wilderness in Celestion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: It's as good a plan as any.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wow. You're the most reliable person I know. NOT!

localizedTextIdText: The Mordesh have carelessly trampled local vegetation while constructing Darkwhisper Enclave. Tender Thistletail wants you to help nurture delicate sproutlings into healthy plants, reducing the settlement's impact on the local ecosystem.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Tender Thistletail in Darkwhisper Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All this reckless construction is messing up the local ecosystem. There are trampled sproutlings everywhere! How'd you like to help me fix this mess?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Just give the sproutlings in the area some tender loving care to get them growing again. It's easy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's up to us settlers to show the others how it's done. We can build a life in harmony with the forest instead of carelessly wrecking it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With a little loving care, we can help things grow again!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've got a regular purple thumb, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped nurture delicate sproutlings, allowing them to grow into beautiful plants. According to Tender Thistletail, you've got a regular purple thumb!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider. Someone's got to help the little ones!

localizedTextIdText: The Verdant Sanctuary is still largely uncharted. Scanbots and mobile cameras sent into the forest don't seem to last long, but Tender Thistletail has another plan: he's equipped some local jabbits with sensors, and he wants you to release them back into the forest at key locations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tender Thistletail via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I know how we can get some cameras into the more hostile areas of the forest. We'll use mapjabbits! Release them in the forest, and they'll do the rest!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you released the mapjabbits yet? It's important that we chart all of Nexus. Just think of what's out there waiting for us in the great beyond!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've gotten a lot of great information from the mapjabbits. Those little guys are pretty thorough... and much better than scanbots!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My plan is gold! I don't know why I didn't think of it sooner!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Isn't charting Nexus great?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Put a camera on a jabbit, and you've got an extremely mobile little research station! The resulting mapjabbit charts are extremely detailed, if a little strangely focused on carrot locations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine. Be that way. See if I care. Really. See me? I'm not caring.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Polovic has asked you to kill lifeglade gliders in Lifeglade Hills, which should allow her to reach the plateau on the other side and complete her scouting mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Polovic via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Between us and our optimal vantage point lies an area full of lifeglade gliders. Perhaps if you distract them, I can sneak by with my equipment.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The sooner the lifeglade gliders are out of my way, the sooner I can convey myself to Horizon Plateau. Please, get moving.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sooner the lifeglade gliders are out of my way, the sooner I can convey myself to Horizon Plateau. Please, get moving.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks to you, I was able to make my way to Horizon Plateau. I must admit, I have a loathing for those gliders. They are truly disturbing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Consider this: death is a permanent form of distraction.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of the beasts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought your way through many lifeglade gliders, clearing the way for Alchemist Polovic to reach Horizon Plateau.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take care of the beasts.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the beasts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am impressed by your lack of spine.

localizedTextIdText: Stumpkins imbued with the power of the Godwood Tree have been discovered lingering along the Vibrant Ascent. Naturally, you've been asked to kill Infused Lifesplinter and Infused Lifewood and extract what primal life you can from them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucy Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Life-infused stumpkins grow along the Vibrant Ascent. Kill them and extract their essence. Waste not, want not - every drop of Vitalus is of use.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stumpkins infused with primal life - infused lifewood, so to speak - can be found along the Vibrant Ascent. Harvest their primal life for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The primal life you extracted from the stumpkins is too weak to be a significant source of Vitalus, yet it may be enough to delay a few deaths.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even the slightest amount of primal life might be used to delay our plight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our tasks grow no easier as time goes on, do they? What toil, this life...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The primal life extracted from the infused stumpkins was only suitable for crafting a small amount of Vitalus Serum.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your lifespan diminishes with every wasted breath.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to fix these vehicles!

localizedTextIdText: Tomas Borgoli is readying an expedition to Camp Viridian in pursuit of an Eldan AI. He would like you to attach AI Controllers to Cargo Lifter to send $(vitem=242) ahead. Then you can recruit Sylvan Explorer from the Explorers Union to join the expedition.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Tomas Borgoli at Camp Viridian
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have been contacted by an Eldan AI. The XAS and the Explorers Union are forming a joint expedition. We would appreciate your assistance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Recruit explorers from the Explorers Union to join our expedition. Then collect supplies to send to Camp Viridian.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have been awaiting your arrival. I've done all I can to keep the explorers you recruited from rushing headlong to their deaths in Exo-Site N22.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's much to do before we head to Camp Viridian. You had best get to work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The real work is still ahead of us. Let us continue.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They're explorers. What did you expect?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You sent Cargo Lifter packed with $(vitem=242) to Camp Viridian and recruited Sylvan Explorer from the Explorers Union to join the expedition.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you want me to do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We require able bodies. Recruit the nearby explorers to our cause and gather supplies. You'll also need to set AI controllers on cargo lifters, so they can make it to Camp Viridian.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You lack of curiosity deeply disappoints me.

localizedTextIdText: Tomas Borgoli would like you to access the Display Module in Camp Viridian to make contact with the AI Entity.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Tomas Borgoli at Camp Viridian
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The time for diplomacy is nigh. We must access the display module and speak with the AI that contacted us. I shall observe while you do the honors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Access the nearby display module. See if you can make contact with the Eldan AI.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Rot and ruin! We should have taken more care when contacting an unknown artificial intelligence. This Augmentation Avatar is far from friendly!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These are exciting times, but take care. You never know what you might encounter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us be more cautious going forward. Shall we?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You accessed the Display Module in Camp Viridian and summoned an Augmentation Avatar. After luring the expedition into the Augmentation Chamber, he released augmentors to steal your genetic data for creating augmented clones.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I misjudged you. Get out of my sight.

localizedTextIdText: Tomas Borgoli would like you to go to Exo-Site N22 and search for the exo-lab where the Augmentation Avatar is overseeing its operations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tomas Borgoli via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must find a way to eradicate the Augmentation Avatar and scourge these ruins of its corrupt technology. Answers may be found inside Exo-Site N22.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Be quick! Time draws short! If we are to counter the Augmentation Avatar's dark plans, we must do it from a chamber within Exo-Site N22.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The AI's identity is apparently split into two or more distinct personalities. This Safety Avatar seems trustworthy, but nonetheless, you should proceed with caution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: After a welcome like that, I suspect the avatar has underestimated your abilities.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We cannot afford to fall into another one of the Eldan AI's traps.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You deactivated Nanite Release Controller in the Nanite Repository and reloaded the Identity Module in the Identity Core Chamber. That caused the Augmentation Avatar to be replaced by the Safety Avatar.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What should I do once I'm inside?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Augmentation Avatar controls his operations in an exo-lab like the previous one, except it's much larger and well protected. Search for other entrances to labs beneath N22.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: My theory is the Augmentation Avatar uses nanites to perform rapid procedures on the flesh of his victims, taking control of them. Find a way to halt production of these nanites.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Coward! Do not abandon us to suffer this fate alone!

localizedTextIdText: The Safety Avatar would like you to find the Essential Reactor Room inside Exo-Site N22. Once there, you can transfer control of the site to the Safety Avatar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the Safety Avatar in the Essential Reactor Room
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The essential reactor powers Exo-Site N22. To transfer control of this site to me, you must shut the reactor down and then reload it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Naturally, the essential reactor is in the essential reactor room. You must shut the reactor down before I can take control of this facility.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Naturally, the essential reactor is in the essential reactor room. You must shut the reactor down before I can take control of this facility.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your performance was more impressive than I expected, $(player.race). I am now in complete control of Exo-Site N22. I thank you for your efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I wish you luck, sapient. The odds are, unfortunately, not in your favor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your labors are nearing completion, sapient. Please exhibit patience.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You deactivated Essential Core in the Essential Reactor Room, transferring control of Exo-Site N22 to the Safety Avatar. With active power restricted, the Augmentation Avatar will be vulnerable.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Honestly, you probably shouldn't. However, I am not the Augmentation Avatar. His goals and my goals are mutually exclusive.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Augmentation Avatar has perverted this facility's purpose. I merely seek to gain control of Exo-Site N22 to reconcile his errors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: No... and yes. We're both fragments of the Caretaker program - two sides of the same coin, really. The difference is that he is insane, and I am not.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A pity. I suppose it will be of no importance once your species is augmented.

localizedTextIdText: The Safety Avatar has asked you to destroy the Augmentation Avatar. To do so, make your way to Annihilator Silo N22 and destroy the last remnants of the Augmentation Avatar defenses.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tomas Borgoli at Camp Viridian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Augmentation Avatar is confined to Annihilator Silo N22. If you destroy him there, he will be permanently deleted from this exo-site's systems.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Surveillance systems indicate the Augmentation Avatar's current position is at the top of Annihilator Silo N22. Defeat his defenses and shut him down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you deleted the Augmentation Avatar yet? This is not a task you cannot ignore, $(player.name). Do your duty!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I must admit, I was careless in contacting the Eldan AI. In my excitement and, yes, hubris, I failed to see the dangers involved. I am sorry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make his demise as painless as possible. After all, he is like a brother to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wish you well, $(player.name). Perhaps we will meet again some day.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought off the Augmentation Avatar defenses and destroyed his Power Core at the top of Annihilator Silo N22.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Tomas Borgoli via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Act quickly, or you will risk reverting my control of this facility.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Shytail at Camp Viridian would like you to collect $m(vitem=239) from around Exo-Site N22.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scientist Shytail via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This place is riddled with Eldan artifacts. Collect some, bring 'em back, and they may just be useful in my research. I'll pay you, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You find me any Eldan artifacts? Like I said, if you bring 'em back to me, I'll pay you for the trouble.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These artifacts are real nice. Thanks! I've prepared some tests that should be able to give me an idea as to their composition and age.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The artifacts seem to be all over the place, keep an eye out, high and low.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's your money, friend. You earned it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=239) from around Exo-Site N22 for Scientist Shytail in Camp Viridian.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine. I don't need your help, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Tomas Borgoli would like you to kill augmented creatures in Exo-Site N22 to prevent the spread of Contagion and keep the people of Camp Viridian safe.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tomas Borgoli via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Eldan-augmented clones are a danger to all and they should be destroyed. To have our own genetic material used against us shrouds my very soul!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: These abominations are hostile! Destroy any augmented creatures that cross your path!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Feel no guilt for the lives you were forced to take this day. They were beyond saving, my friend.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes... destroy any augmented creatures that cross your path.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are all safer for your endeavors.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed augmented creatures in Exo-Site N22 to prevent the spread of Contagion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where did these augmented creatures come from?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They have used our genetic information to create clones of our individual species, then proceeded to augment them to enhance their abilities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Inaction on your part puts all of us at risk.

localizedTextIdText: Test out the effects of the $(vitem=238) on augmented creatures and constructs in Exo-Site N22.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Tomas Borgoli at Camp Viridian
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This GOOP cannon seems to be filled with nanites. You wonder what effect, if any, it would have on augmented creatures and constructs.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This GOOP cannon seems to be filled with nanites. You wonder what effect, if any, it would have on augmented creatures and constructs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have heard of GOOP cannons, but never actually seen one in use. You had best see what effects it has on the augmented creatures and constructs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The GOOP cannon's nanites are programmed to destroy a target at the molecular level! Their potential for destruction is boundless!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have made a marvelous discovery, $(player.race)!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see what I can do with this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tested the effects of the $(vitem=238) on augmented creatures and constructs in Exo-Site N22. Tomas Borgoli at Camp Viridian was quite interested in your findings.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let's see what I can do with this.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin wants you to upgrade the Primal Siphoning Drill with $(vitem=935) within the Vibrant Ascent to dig for primal life.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Without the Torinite coating, our drills failed abysmally. Drilling must resume immediately. Find drills on the bluffs, repair them, and apply the Torinite coating.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Apply the Torinite coating to our drills in the field. I won't be satisfied until we extract all the primal life we need to stave off our apocalypse.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The churning of earth and metal is music to my ears! We can finally harvest primal life from the core of the Godwood Tree... after we get inside, that is.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am saddened it has come to this, but I will not abandon my people to the Contagion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our task is almost complete.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get the drills running again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You upgraded the Primal Siphoning Drill within the Pools of Vitara with a powerful Torinite coating that that allows them to bore through the solid ground beneath the Godwood Tree.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get the drills running again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I must find another soul more suited to this grim task.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin believes that the Blooms of Vitara, found throughout Godsbreath Terrace, can be used by his alchemists to destroy the barrier warding the entrance to the Godwood Tree. Victor wants you to collect $m(vitem=829) and deliver them to his alchemists at the entrance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The entrance to the Godwood Tree is warded by a mystic barrier. To destroy it, my alchemists will need a component from the tree - vitara petals, perhaps.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Destroy Blooms of Vitara on Godsbreath Terrace and gather their petals. In this way, you might reveal the entrance to the Godwood Tree.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At long last! The Godwood Tree is within reach! My teams will await your signal to deploy the siphoning drills and seize the primal life we need.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If my theory is correct, that should suffice. I will await further updates from you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soon the primal life we require will be ours!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Very well. I'll collect vitara petals.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located a Gate to the Heart of the Godwood on Godsbreath Terrace after destroying the Vitara's Bloom.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We wither with time, yet you do nothing....

localizedTextIdText: You have been contracted by a Black Hoods recruiter to locate a missing courier somewhere in Verdant Vale. Recover the sensitive intelligence the courier was carrying and deliver it to Shroud Gloom, the Black Hoods' covert outpost in Celestion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the $(vitem=356) to Director Romavek Shroud Gloom
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Black Hoods courier dispatched from Thayd has gone missing. It is in your best interests to help us locate him... as well as the intel he carries.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Our courier is still missing, and the intel he was carrying remains at risk. Go to Verdant Vale and locate him at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My agents report you have failed to find our missing courier. I suggest you cease making light of this matter and seek him out in Verdant Vale.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have confirmed our courier's death in the field. The ICI is becoming increasingly aggressive with its intelligence sweeps.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The courier last reported in from the Verdant Vale. Do not fail to find him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You can join us to thwart whatever twisted plot they've devised.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though the Black Hoods courier you were sent to find in the Verdant Vale was dead when you found him, you were able to keep the valuable intelligence he was carrying out of the ICI's hands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What is Shroud Gloom?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: Why are the Black Hoods in Sylvan Glade?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Consider it a contract. Since the beginning, we have found your style to be intriguing. Serve as the iron fist within our velvet glove. While we creep in the shadows, you'll go in guns blazing... so to speak.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Even a provisional operative, such as yourself, should be prepared to face death and despair.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: He last reported in between the city of Thayd in Galeras and his destination, Shroud Gloom. He was carrying dispatches, consular documents, and the orbital coordinates of our arkship.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The Black Hoods' base of operations is code-named "Shroud Gloom" for its proximity to Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: We are everywhere. We watch from the shadows. Some find this disturbing. I find it... comforting.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal to help has brought your loyalty into question.

localizedTextIdText: Interrogate the Deactivated Zeta Agent by hacking her $(vitem=353) for Director Romavek in Shroud Gloom.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Director Romavek at Shroud Gloom
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have an ICI operative in custody, taken from the Eldan site beneath Shroud Gloom. Your next task is to extract valuable information from her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The ICI operative you are about to interrogate is disabled. You must reprogram her to ensure her compelled compliance with our queries.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a pity you didn't extract more information from her before her contingencies fired. Still, we gleaned enough to reveal a dark Dominion plot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You are hereby authorized to use coercive interrogation tactics.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us say my fears were well-founded... but at least we have you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I take it there's bad news?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered valuable intelligence by hacking the Deactivated Zeta Agent $(vitem=353) before her security fail-safes destroyed her body, then proceeded to give it to Director Romavek in Shroud Gloom.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Perhaps not. Be aware, however, that Mechari in ICI service are equipped with fail-safes to prevent the capture of stored intel. You had best be careful.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Must I remind you? The ICI is the Imperial Corps of Intelligence, a cadre of Dominion spies and assassins. They will stop at nothing to destroy us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would be wise to reconsider!

localizedTextIdText: The data you recovered has revealed a Dominion plot to use an Eldan superweapon to destroy the Gambler's Ruin. Director Romavek has instructed you to infiltrate the ICI base, Junction Zeta, while Marksman Mikhail provides you with sniper cover.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Romavek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI intends to use an Eldan superweapon to destroy our arkship. Infiltrate their base of operations and put an end to their plan.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Assault the ICI's bunker and leverage our sniper fire to your advantage. I will have more orders for you once you are in place.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As I mentioned, the ICI has gained control of a powerful Eldan weapon. Now that you have infiltrated Junction Zeta, it is time to turn the tables.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll assign a sniper to provide you with covering fire. Now move out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Exiles are counting on you, $(player.name). No pressure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using Marksman Mikhail sniper fire for cover, you managed to successfully infiltrate Junction Zeta, so you could attempt to foil the Dominion's plot to destroy the Gambler's Ruin with an Eldan superweapon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Expect resistance from ICI Mechari and their bots. Eliminate any and all threats. Also, keep clear of any sensor sweeps in the area. They'll alert ICI agents to your location.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If the Gambler's Ruin is destroyed, there will be a reckoning, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Director Romavek has ordered you to plant explosives inside the Junction Zeta Bunker. When the time comes, the explosives will cause a useful diversion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Romavek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI has targeted our arkship's orbital coordinates. Luckily she is still safe, but we must act in a timely fashion if we are to turn the tide.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Plant explosives inside the ICI's bunker. Seek out optimal locations and utilize any flammable or explosive substances you can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Artfully done. Those explosives will divert unnecessary attention when the time comes. For now, we must do more than protect our own ship...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: An excellent idea, $(player.name)! Explosives should do the trick.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must turn that Eldan weapon against the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What did you have in mind?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You set a number of charges inside Junction Zeta, and they should cause an effective diversion when the time comes. All that remains now is to turn the Eldan superweapon against the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is too important a threat to ignore. I suggest you rethink your decision.

localizedTextIdText: To use the Eldan weapon, you'll need to obtain the ICI spy ship's coordinates from Axis Vonotron workspace in the Junction Zeta Bunker. Then you can escape and detonate diversionary explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Romavek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Access Vonotron's telemetry display and steal the coordinates to the ICI's spy ship. Once you have them, detonate your explosives and get out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must steal the spy ship's coordinates from the ICI telemetry display, so you can blow it out of the sky. Such sweet irony!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The chaos from the explosions will cloak your final strike! Soon the ICI's spy ship will be little more than a burning wreck.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soon, you will override the Eldan weapon and use it to destroy their spy ship.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: You don't have to tell me twice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to obtain the coordinates for the ICI's spy ship from the ICI Telemetry Display before detonating the bombs inside the Junction Zeta Bunker.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: There is no time for discussion.

localizedTextIdText: The time has come to turn the Eldan weapon on the Dominion! Proceed to the Junction Zeta weapon platform and destroy the ICI spy ship in Nexus's orbit using the Eldan Defense Laser.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Director Romavek in Shroud Gloom
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your strike was swift, and the blow you dealt to our enemies was deadly. All that remains is to fire the Eldan weapon and close this chapter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The coordinates are locked in. Fire the Eldan weapon and bring the ICI's ship crashing down from the heavens!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our courier's sacrifice has brought us to this. Had the ICI not been so aggressive in their search, we might not have learned of their plot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go then, and bring victory to the Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks to your efforts, the Gambler's Ruin is safe. Until next time!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's a good thing we did.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You not only saved the Gambler's Ruin, but you also destroyed a ICI spy ship using the Eldan Defense Laser in Junction Zeta.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you putting me on? Now? Such an action at this juncture is ill-advised.

localizedTextIdText: Cryptoanalyst Ksenia has asked you to steal $(vitem=365) from ICI Aegis Interface in Junction Zeta Bunker and deliver them to Shroud Gloom Cell for decryption.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Cryptoanalyst Ksenia in Shroud Gloom
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You are in range of invaluable information, agent. Hack the ICI's aegis network and download its security files.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Knowing is not enough. Few understand how to use knowledge to its full advantage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The total volume of information you procured will require weeks to process. Is this joy I feel? Such peculiar and perplexing emotion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once the data is procured, deliver it to me for decryption.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Cryptoanalyst Ksenia of Shroud Gloom amass a significant collection of $(vitem=365) by hacking Aegis Interfaces in the ICI's Junction Zeta Bunker.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How can I decrypt the data?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Once you place it on the Cryptanalysis Station, use the Decryption Device to reverse-engineer the code. Automated systems will assist with the decryption process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pray we do not meet again!

localizedTextIdText: Operative Viktovich, a Black Hood in Shroud Gloom, has asked you to plant surveillance devices around the ICI's base of operations, Junction Zeta.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Operative Viktovich via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Can you handle a tech operation? I've got some new surveillance devices from Research and Development, and I need them placed around the ICI's junction.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need eyes and ears in that junction. Plant surveillance bugs in ICI tech devices to mask their energy imprint.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. I'm receiving feedback from Kue's devices already. I'll alert him of our success and have our cryptoanalyst begin deciphering that intel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm eager to put Inventor Kue's work to the test.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wish you well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You planted surveillance devices to spy on the ICI in Junction Zeta.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Anything I should look out for?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If an ICI Sensor Sweep spots you trying to plant a bug, you'll have to pull back and try again later.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This intel sweep is of the utmost importance. Knowing what they know is vital to our success.

localizedTextIdText: Inventor Kue in Shroud Gloom wants you to collect $m(vitem=355) and $m(vitem=227) inside the ICI Junction Zeta Bunker to facilitate his development of new spy gadgets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Inventor Kue via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I find myself covetous of covert components. Pilfer any Eldan or Mechari parts you encounter in the ICI bunker and I will weave them into my own contrivances.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I require parts to continue my developmental testing. The ICI's bunker may be rife with Eldan and Mechari components for the taking.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The components you recovered will work wondrously. You have sparked inspiration in my stifled soul.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Continued development of covert contraptions is contingent on your compliance.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=355) and $m(vitem=227) from inside the ICI Junction Zeta Bunker for Inventor Kue in Shroud Gloom to facilitate his research and development work of new and superior spy gadgets.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you lack the necessary skills to accomplish this simple task!

localizedTextIdText: The future of Project Monolith stands at the whims of the plundering Marauders. Each day defenders of the Coalition of Galactic Scientists fight against the Grimvoid at various locations around Grimhaven.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Cyrilia Belax
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Each day the Grimvoid Marauders find new ways to endanger the future of Project Monolith. We constantly need people with more combat experience. Can you help us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad to see you made it out alive. We may need you again if you can manage.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will go where I am needed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Once more the Grimvoid Marauders have been shut down by the defenders of the Coalition of Galactic Scientists thanks to your help.

localizedTextIdText: Due to Exile sabotage of the cryosleep program, some imperial citizens are waking up brainwashed and disloyal to the Dominion. After testing negative for tampering, you've awakened in Cryo-Recovery aboard the arkship, Destiny. Axis Pheydra has chosen you to root out the Exile saboteurs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Emperor Myrcalus in Cryo-Recovery
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Citizens rising from cryosleep are plagued by subversive thoughts. I require your help in weeding out the root of this sabotage.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your tasks are incomplete. Though you have proven to be a loyal citizen, I begin to question if your listed intelligence quotient is accurate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Complete Pheydra's tasks before speaking to me. She is one of my most loyal and trusted servants. Obey her, for her voice and mine are one.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pheydra sees a spark of greatness waiting to shine within you. We must feed it so that it grows into a vigilant flame.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not be afraid. Should you fail, your death will be painless.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your destiny is tied to that of the Dominion. As you prosper, so too shall the Empire.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I am honored to serve, Axis Pheydra.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Exile saboteur who brainwashed Dominion citizens as they slept in their cryo pods has been exposed as Jaillyn Sweetspur. Sweetspur is a hacker and Esper with exceptional control over her abilities. Following Jaillyn's escape, you met with Emperor Myrcalus, who approved of both your deeds and your destiny.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I am honored to serve, Axis Pheydra.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why do you want my help?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Axis Pheydra, head of the Imperial Corps of Intelligence. I have served the Dominion for more than a thousand years.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is probable that Exile saboteurs tampered with the cryosleep program, imprinting malicious thought patterns on our unconscious citizens. You will find out for certain.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Until the majority of my agents are active, I must draw from a pool of exceptionally reliable citizens. Your file indicates you are uniquely qualified for the task at hand.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have no choice. If your loyalty cannot be proven, you will be destroyed.

localizedTextIdText: Emperor Myrcalus believes that traitors to the Dominion can be cured. As such, he wants you to aid Mondo Zax in curing them using Chua technology. Proceed to Mondo's Laboratory and lend him your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax in his Lab
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Treason is a disease of the soul, $(player.name), and I believe it can be cured. I want you to assist Mondo Zax in treating these unfortunate citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The future of the Dominion may depend on citizens salvaged from sedition. Go to Mondo Zax and assist him in his work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use holding cell controls to activate cerebral rehabilitator. Watch in awe as unfaithful test subjects are made loyal once more! For science!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Subjects hurt? Burned? Shocked? Transformed into horrible monster? No big surprise! Mondo expected instability. More calibration required!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mondo Zax can be found in his lab. I will continue to monitor your progress.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, yes. Mondo has plans. Sometimes plans very simple. Most times not.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help Zax cure these traitors.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope you have another plan.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mondo's Cerebral Rehabilitator was more effective at killing the Brainwashed Citizen than at filling them with loyalty for the Dominion. Despite this setback, Mondo Zax didn't seem too concerned with the device's failure.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll help Zax cure these traitors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mondo is a great Chua scientist... possibly the greatest Chua scientist of all. He is responsible for many of the Dominion's technological advances.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes, I believe they can. Though they have betrayed me, my love for them is as strong as ever. I only wish to bring them back into the fold.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hesitation is ill-advised, $(player.name). Reconsider your choice.

localizedTextIdText: With the source of Exile brainwashing exposed, the director of DRED, Mondo Zax, has developed a cure for affected citizens. Emperor Myrcalus has decreed that you shall assist in Mondo's Lab until you are required to pursue the Exile saboteur once more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer in the Behavioral Research Facility
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mondo Zax believes he can reverse the Exile conditioning of our citizens. I would like you to assist him in his laboratory in case things go awry.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Quickly, $(player.race). Mondo Zax awaits you in his laboratory.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get to the Behavioral Research Facility, worm. Now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hail, $(player.race). Pheydra - the Emperor's Shadow - claims you are worthy to hunt down the saboteur. I will see about that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will accompany you along the way.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Tales of glory and battle await you here in the Behavioral Research Facility. You must seize them!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: During your tenure as assistant in Mondo's Lab, Jaillyn Sweetspur struck again. This time, she caused Mondo Zax brainwashing cure to transform his subjects into monstrosities. You destroyed several of them before rejoining the hunt for the Exile saboteur.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I am on my way, my emperor.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, I am Myrcalus the Vindicator of House Azrion. Many citizens refer to me as Dominus Reborn.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Mondo is the most inventive Chua ever born. He is a brilliant scientist, as well as the leader of DRED - the Dominion Research and Experimentation Division.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Do not concern yourself with the saboteur. The ICI will handle pursuit of the Aurin. Until such time as Pheydra calls upon you for further aid, remain focused on the task at hand.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps the saboteur has gotten to you... and you, too, will be dealt with accordingly.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin asked you to set up and defend three Primal Siphoning Drill within the Heart of the Godwood Tree. If the drills can be deployed, they should be the quickest way to siphon the primal life he needs from the Godwood Tree.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An astounding amount of primal life emanates from Godwood nodes within the tree! Our crews must tap into these nodes at once, and you must protect them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Godwood Tree has all the primal life we need - more than enough to create a new batch of Vitalus Serum. We cannot afford to weaken our resolve!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are drawing forth more primal energy than initially anticipated. Well done! With your help, thousands of Mordesh lives will be saved!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A sound plan, $(player.name). They will be too busy to defend themselves!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Unfortunately, there is still the matter of Grimhold to contend with.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered a great deal of primal life for Victor Lazarin to use in the development of new batches of Vitalus Serum. While your efforts will save thousands of displaced Mordesh civilians, an outbreak of the Contagion in Celestion has already claimed hundreds of lives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal will lead us all to an early - or in my case, timely - grave.

localizedTextIdText: Arwick Redleaf in Woodhaven asks that you go to Queen Myala in Sylvan Glade. A hoverbike is ready and waiting for you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Chief Chugach in Hijunga Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must ask that you go to Queen Myala in Sylvan Glade. There's a hoverbike waiting for you. May the Weave gift you with swiftness.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go see Queen Myala in Sylvan Glade. There's a hoverbike waiting for you. You really shouldn't make her wait for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Who you? Me Chugach! Me chief!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You not go to Sylvan Glade. You stay here. Stay and help Hijunga. Big dangers in Hijunga!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't keep the queen waiting.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You headed to Sylvan Glade at Arwick Redleaf request, only to be stopped at Hijunga Village. It seems like they need some help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make the mistake of thinking you can say no. I'm not in the mood.

localizedTextIdText: Chief Chugach of Hijunga Village wants you to help the village. They've been attacked by a gargantuan monster! He wants you to talk to the Hijunga villagers, so they can tell you what happened.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chief Chugach in Hijunga Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Must stop! Lopp need help! Big monster smash village, destroy Hijunga. Talk to others. They tell you the tale.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp need help. Big scary smash village, destroy Hijunga. Talk to other Lopp. They tell you what you need to know.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now you know sad story of Lopp village. Many huts destroyed. Many Lopp missing. You help now? You help Hijunga Village and be big hero?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hijunga is treasure hunter village. But Lopp not wish to hunt for this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stop big monster and save missing Lopp. Only then can Hijunga rebuild.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've talked to Hijunga villagers, listening to each account of the creature that's plaguing Hijunga Village. The Lopp village certainly seems to have gargantuan troubles!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What sort of creature are you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: A bit feisty for such a little guy, aren't you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Creature? Lopp not creature. Lopp are Lopp! Lopp from Lagos with lots of shinies, but Lopp come to Nexus for even bigger shinies. All shinies belong to Lopp!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lopp full of courage. Lopp fight you with pointy stick! Lopp not scared of anything... well, except for big monster that smash Hijunga. $(self.visual=29321)
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You not help Lopp? Then Lopp not help you!

localizedTextIdText: Chief Chugach wants you to arm traps outside Hijunga Village. It's much more dangerous for a Lopp to arm traps of that size. You may have the advantage of leverage, but be careful not to get your arm caught!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Chugach via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp set traps to catch big monster! Now Lopp send you to arm village defense. If something go wrong, you deal with big scary.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp have plan. Catch monster of Tanglewood Grove. Lopp trust you to arm traps. Some risk of death involved.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Traps armed and Lopp safer. Bet monster think twice about coming back here. You a big help to Lopp!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hope you come back alive. Maybe leave shinies with me? For safe keeping.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I can handle a few traps.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've set the traps near Hijunga Village. This should help protect the village from the creature that has been causing so much trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Let me say what Lopp think of you.

localizedTextIdText: Chief Chugach of Hijunga Village wants you to lure a big monster out. First, you're going to need bait. Catch some rowsdowers and use them to bait the creature that's troubling the Lopp village nearby.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Chugach via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's now time to attack! You bring monster out. Must lure with bait! Catch some rowsdowers. Set them as bait!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Defenses in place. Good time to attack! Lure monster with rowsdower bait. Rowsdower pens got smashed in monster rampage. Look in Tanglewood Grove.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wrong scaries! Monster seen by Lopp much, much bigger. Have fangs longer than Lopp ears!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Big scary has big appetite. Bad news for rowsdowers. But better they die than Lopp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If monster won't come to you, then you go to monster!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I figured we'd fight something larger.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rounded up some rowsdowers as bait to lure a giant creature out. Unfortunately, the creatures that took the bait weren't quite what you were expecting. Chief Chugach suggested that if the monster won't come to you, you'll have to go to the monster.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What that smell? Lopp think it must be cowardice.

localizedTextIdText: WANTED: Gormash the Lopp-Crusher, for the crushing of villages and Lopp in Hijunga Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chief Chugach in Hijunga Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: PLEASE KILL ASAP:\nGormash the Lopp-Crusher must die! Gormash crush Lopp village and Lopp too! Show Chief Chugach proof of Gormash death for shiny reward!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: PLEASE KILL ASAP:\nGormash the Lopp-Crusher must die! Gormash crush Lopp village and Lopp too! Show Chief Chugach proof of Gormash death for shiny reward!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp want Gormash the Lopp-Crusher dead. You know what dead is? Lopp can give demonstration.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gormash the Lopp-Crusher not crush Lopp no more!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure. I'll kill Gormash the Lopp-Crusher.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hijunga village should now be safe.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You dealt with the problem of Gormash the Lopp-Crusher and made the Lopp chieftain, Chief Chugach, very happy. You should know that Gormash the Lopp-Crusher had a mate. Take care not to disturb her, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: No need for that! I know what to do.

localizedTextIdText: Chief Chugach of Hijunga Village wants you to find missing Lopp. Lopp have been disappearing into Tanglemore Den, where one of the big monsters is said to have taken residence. Watch out for Denmother Burgaska!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chief Chugach in Hijunga Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Must go inside Tanglemore Den to find missing Lopp. Watch out for Denmother Burgaska. She takes Lopp, and they go squish!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Must go inside Tanglemore Den to find missing Lopp. Watch out for Denmother Burgaska. She takes Lopp and they go squish!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp are saved! Lopp can't thank you enough! You good friend to Lopp!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Many treasure hunters go in. Few come out.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I won't let Burgaska squish Lopp!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued many Lopp from Denmother Burgaska in Tanglemore Den. Apparently, she was looking for her young after her eggs were stolen. Unfortunately, the Lopp were not a good substitute for hardy Burgaska young, and many Lopp met their ends in Tanglemore Den.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I won't let Burgaska squish Lopp!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be coward. Be brave! Like Lopp!

localizedTextIdText: Trader Lukadat has found his way into Tanglemore Den. He no longer wants the loot he recovered from the den. The shinies are growling at him and making him nervous! They look like eggs. You might want to take them back to where they belong.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trader Lukadat via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Don't know about these shinies. These shinies get bigger. One shiny even growl at Lukadat. You take shinies. Take them and put them back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: These shinies no good. Bring only trouble to Lukadat. You take shinies and put them back in Tanglemore Den.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You take back shinies? Good! Lukadat relieved! Though now he has no shinies for cart.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Shinies maybe bite. So be careful.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: These look like eggs to me.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You're better off now. Trust me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've returned the eggs that Trader Lukadat had mistaken for shinies. Hopefully, Denmother Burgaska is satisfied and won't try taking Lopp as her young in the future.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not leave Lukadat with shinies! Lukadat not want!

localizedTextIdText: Trader Lukadat has spent a lot of time in Tanglemore Den. If you wish to survive, he says you must avoid the big monster and watch yourself around the small creatures with lots of teeth. If you see one, kill it quick!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trader Lukadat via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Small monsters dangerous to Lopp, too! They have many teeth. Eat Lopp up quick! You help. Fight for Lopp! Show toothy monsters we bite back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Small monsters danger to Lopp, too! They have many teeth. Eat Lopp up quick! You help. Fight for Lopp! Show toothy monsters we bite back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it! You killed toothy monsters dead! Lukadat promise to never doubt big-folk again!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lukadat catch them coming. Poke with spear! Other Lopp not so lucky.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lukadat proud to have big-folk as friend!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They're easier to kill at my size.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed a lot of chompacabras in Tanglemore Den!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You do this, or Lopp unhappy. See Lukadat frowning?

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Tuwawi in Tanglemore Den came in looking for shinies, only to find a big monster and a bunch of captured Lopp. Not much can come between a Lopp and er shinies, but this creature might be it. Find shinies for Tuwawi before she manages to get herself killed in Tanglemore Den.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Treasure Hunter Tuwawi in Tanglemore Den
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tuwawi come to den for more shinies, but find big, scary gorganoth instead. New idea! You find the shinies! Tuwawi wait here safe until then!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Tuwawi wait here while big-folk find shinies. Search for glimmer under piles of loose rocks. Just watch out for falling rocks from overhead!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good good! Couldn't leave den without shinies. What else would Tuwawi trade to get rich?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Tuwawi trade shinies, get rich quick! Pay good price, any baubles you find!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Don't you think you've found enough?
