localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found many shinies in Tanglemore Den and have given them to Treasure Hunter Tuwawi. Though she seems very happy at this find, you hope she's been successfully discouraged from returning to Tanglemore Den in the future.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No shinies for you!

localizedTextIdText: Chief Chugach of Hijunga Village has declared the village safe from gargantuan trouble. In return for your help, he has offered you one of his prized kurg to take you to Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Queen Myala Everstar in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hijunga Village safe now. Sylvan Glade not far away. But hero of Hijunga not travel on foot. You travel with honor on Lopp caravan!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hijunga Village safe now. Sylvan Glade not far away. But hero of Hijunga not travel on foot. You travel with honor on Lopp caravan!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's so nice to see you again, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You made it! I heard a rumor you ran into trouble on the road. I'm glad to see you seem none too worse for wear.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch out for kurg. They not watch underfoot for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Anyway, welcome to Sylvan Glade! There's much to do here.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: At least I made it in one piece.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After Chief Chugach declared Hijunga Village safe, he gave you his prized kurg, so you could travel to Sylvan Glade and meet with Queen Myala Everstar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You stay in Hijunga long time then? Good, Lopp friend always welcome!

localizedTextIdText: Toric Antevian wishes you to speak with his brother, Calidor Antevian, in the Cathedral of Light so that you may learn about the Vigilant Church.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Emperor Myrcalus in the Garden of the Vigilant
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that you're here, my brother Calidor will teach you about the holy principles that bind the Dominion together.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Emperor is not easily impressed, and neither am I. Go, now, and learn the ways of the church.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You still have much to learn about the Vigilant Church, $(player.name). Speak to Calidor and listen closely to his lesson.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A blessing from Varonia Cazalon is a rare gift, citizen. I judge your spirit to be pure, and I charge you to go forth and act with noble purpose.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There is none better than Calidor to instruct you in matters of the spirit.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have proven your devotion and purity. Now, you must prove your knowledge.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You received Varonia Cazalon blessing following your edification on the subject of the Six Virtues by Calidor Antevian. Your mind and soul are now prepared to undergo the journey to Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Are all citizens members of the Church?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm Toric Antevian. Some folk call me the Vigilant Star or Toric the Invincible. Believe me, friend... I'm flesh 'n' blood, just like most everyone else.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Vigilant Church is the Dominion's most prominent religious institution. It's our duty to light the darkness and defeat the wicked.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Not precisely. The Draken have their own gods, while the Chua seem to worship science itself. Still, all citizens must understand the guiding principles of the Empire's faith.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is your faith so weak that you would turn your back on the Dominion's traditions?

localizedTextIdText: Emperor Myrcalus wishes for you to proceed to the Imperial Museum and speak to Lady Artemis Zin. Lady Zin is a famous explorer whose knowledge of the galaxy and its history will be instrumental to your continued success.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Artemis Zin in the Imperial Museum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Even the pure of heart cannot walk blindly in the darkness. Go to the Imperial Museum and seek out Lady Artemis Zin. She's preparing to make an announcement.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lady Zin is waiting for you, and she is quite particular when it comes to punctuality.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I haven't any time for autographs right now. Come back later... preferably after I've left.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're the one the Emperor has been prattling on about, hmm? You don't look like much. It hardly matters. He wants you to learn, so you will learn.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You must know where you come from before you can learn where you are going.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good. I expect you to pay attention, as I haven't got all day.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've located Artemis Zin within the Imperial Museum at Emperor Myrcaluss request. Soon, the knowledge of an Empire will be yours.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Tell me about the Imperial Museum.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Artemis is one of the Dominion's most well-known celebrities. She is an adventurer and explorer of no small renown, and she knows many things.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Dominion's most valuable relics are kept in the Imperial Museum. One of these, a datacube, once belonged to Dominus himself.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It is a creation of the Eldan - a repository for knowledge. No one has been able to access it since Dominus, though Lady Zin may know of a way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Knowledge is more than just power. It is a base from which to build an Empire.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin believes in learning by doing. She's instructed you to comb the Imperial Museum for relics and lore objects.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Artemis Zin in the Imperial Museum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been asked to show you how to find and collect information. To that end, peruse the collection in the Imperial Museum for books and periodicals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the Emperor's correct, someday you may be as famous as I am. How can that be when you have yet to complete the simple task you've been given?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What you've learned today is the tip of the proverbial iceberg. Just imagine how much you'll know if you continue to develop your analytical skills.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Search high and low. You never know where your next discovery will take you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go anywhere. I could use the assistance of someone competent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've searched the Imperial Museum for books and periodicals, and learned a great deal about the way information and knowledge are stored and disseminated. Despite your success, Artemis Zin isn't through with you, though.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Aren't you supposed to teach me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm certain there are plenty of books and the like for you to read. Peer between their covers and see what you can learn.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I have an important deadline that is demanding all of my attention right now. I find the best way to learn is by doing. Now hurry along and prove me right.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Shades and Scions! You do know how to read... don't you?

localizedTextIdText: Emperor Myrcalus, pleased with your progress under the tutelage of Mondo Zax, has asked that you go to the Cathedral of Light and meet with Toric Antevian, the commander of the Radiant Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian in the Cathedral of Light
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your purity, as espoused by Evindra the Righteous, must be proved. Go to the Cathedral of Light, speak to Toric Antevian, and he will guide you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: To progress upon your path to greatness, your purity must be guaranteed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Light and glory, $(player.name). Your devotion to the Dominion, as well as to our Emperor, is without question.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall be watching you, citizen. May the light of Dominus guide you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Only the pure of spirit can light the path for the citizens of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will speak to Toric, my emperor.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Toric Antevian in the Cathedral of Light. Soon you will prove your purity of spirit.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Evindra is one of the six Scions, my kin of old. Under the guidance of both Toric and Calidor Antevian, you shall learn about the virtues each Scion exemplifies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your service is compulsory, $(player.name). Don't make me ask a second time.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin is preparing to make an announcement that she's discovered the location of the mythical Elder Cube on the surface of Nexus. Unfortunately, her producer is late following an incident in Mondo Zax lab. Help Artemis by activating her broadcast stations and chatting up her loyal fans in the Imperial Museum.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Emperor Myrcalus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My producer is late, and the broadcast stations need to be activated. Be a dear and see that they're ready, then speak to my loyal fans on my behalf.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I'm not getting a green light, $(player.name). Why am I not getting a green light? Haven't you seen to the broadcast stations yet? What about my fans?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Artemis Zin's broadcast is of great importance to the morale of the Dominion. Activate her broadcast stations and say some nice words to her fans.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are proven to possess adequate knowledge, citizen. I can tell that Artemis is quite taken with you, as well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go on, then. Shoo. I must rehearse my lines.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we must test your strength, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm happy to help, Lady Zin.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You chatted with Artemis Zin Groupie and activated broadcast stations in the Imperial Museum, allowing Lady Zin to make her important announcement about the discovery of the Elder Cube's location.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Emperor Myrcalus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Apparently there was some unfortunate incident in Mondo Zax's lab... something about cerebral rehabilitation? It's all Chua nonsense to me!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's a special news update. Don't tell anyone yet, but I've discovered the location of the Elder Cube on Nexus!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: There's no time to explain! Those broadcast stations must be activated, and my loyal fans are expecting a warm reception.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't say no to me, you little twit. Remember who you're speaking to!

localizedTextIdText: Following your work for Artemis Zin in the Imperial Museum, Emperor Myrcalus has sent you to meet Kezrek Warbringer in the Destiny's holochambers. Kezrek will test your strength, ensuring you are well-acquainted with virtual combat... as well as the Exiles themselves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kezrek Warbringer in the Destiny's Holochambers
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sadly, the Dominion must oftentimes use force in order to maintain the Empire's stability. Are you ready to prove your strength of arms, citizen?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: General Warbringer prizes strength above all things, and he does not brook failure. Find him in the holochambers and he will put you to the test.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you think yourself strong? I shall be the judge of that, worm!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What have we here? The emperor's latest prodigy? Should you fail in the holochambers, you will not be the first of Myrcalus's pets to die in training!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Warbringer will take the measure of your strength in the Destiny's holochambers.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Is that pride... or overconfidence? We shall see, $(player.name)...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the Destiny's holochambers and met with Kezrek Warbringer. The time to prove your strength is at hand.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How will I prove my strength?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Dominion utilizes state-of-the-art Chua-designed training facilities that feature holographic technology, flawlessly simulated Exile foes, and advanced artificial intelligence.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: As long as safety protocols are engaged, there is only a minimal chance of injury or death among trainees. I predict you will emerge victorious, though it will not be easy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Weakness is not a virtue. I fear you have little choice in this matter.

localizedTextIdText: Jaillyn Sweetspur was tracked to the Behavioral Research Facility before vanishing. Meanwhile, the Chief Orderly in Mordesh Observation is overdue to report in. Kezrek Warbringer thinks it's not a coincidence, and wants you to check it out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Kezrek Warbringer in the Behavioral Research Facility
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've lost the saboteur's scent and the Chief Orderly in Mordesh Observation isn't reporting in. Seek him out at once and crush all resistance!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I gave you an order to find the Chief Orderly, $(player.class). I expect you to obey without question!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have confirmed my suspicions and saved an honorable citizen. I commend you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Underestimate the Mordesh at your own peril, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The saboteur's antics pollute the Destiny. What is she playing at?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After you saved the Chief Orderly in Mordesh Observation from test subjects armed by Jaillyn Sweetspur, the saboteur fled to another area the Behavioral Research Facility.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is the Behavioral Research Facility?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am General Kezrek Warbringer. I command the Dominion legions, and I will ensure that the soil of Nexus is enriched with the blood of the Exiles.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is where we study the Exiles in their native environments in order to determine better ways to fight and conquer them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Mordesh are a pitiful race that suffer from a plague they themselves created in a vain attempt to harness immortality. That they have been accepted into the ranks of the Exiles proves the traitors' desperation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you fear unarmed prisoners, I fail to see your usefulness on a real battlefield.

localizedTextIdText: The Aurin have established a new base in Deradune at Wildwood Grove. Agent Lex has requested your assistance and has asked you to rendezvous with him near there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex near Wildwood Grove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have another assignment for you. The Aurin continue to be a problem in Deradune. They've now established a new presence in Wildwood Grove.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I am waiting for you near Wildwood Grove. Do not keep me waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Initial ICI reports indicate a large Aurin presence in Wildwood Grove. I've also made a number of alarming observations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Travel to my position immediately so we can resolve the Aurin issue. Lex, out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Agent Lex near Wildwood Grove.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your hesitation to lend aid has been duly noted.

localizedTextIdText: Jaillyn Sweetspur has hidden with her kind in Aurin Observation. Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to psychologically torture the Aurin test subjects until they give her up or she reveals herself, whichever comes first.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Kezrek Warbringer in the Behavioral Research Facility
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our quarry has gone to ground with her ilk in Aurin Observation. Persuade the tree rats with fire. Either she will show herself, or they will give her up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you deaf? The Exile saboteur takes refuge among the test subjects. Find her! I have no patience for insubordination... or cowardice!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sweetspur was trying to create diversions with rioting Exiles and brainwashed citizens. Though her diversions have failed, she perseveres...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Flush out your prey! Show the Dominion that you are a hunter!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must determine her primary objective before it is too late.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Exiles never know when to give up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You flushed Jaillyn Sweetspur out from hiding in Aurin Observation by cutting down many of the combat-ready test subjects - not for loyalty or empathy, but because they would distract the Dominion from the saboteur's primary objective...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Pathetic Aurin. Their feeble resistance against the Dominion was easily thwarted, yet they refuse to accept their fate. If they cannot defend their homeworld, then they do not deserve any claim to it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sicken me, maggot! Surrender yourself as a traitor and be out of our way.

localizedTextIdText: Jaillyn Sweetspur is in the Arkship Intellicore, hacking the Destiny's systems in an attempt to destroy it - along with tens of thousands of Dominion lives. You must stop Sweetspur before it's too late, but still keep her alive for Axis Pheydra.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Pheydra in the Imperial Sanctorium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sweetspur is running for the Arkship Intellicore. If she gains control of it, she can destroy the Destiny. You must kill her firstl!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Axis Pheydra is expecting you to fetch Jaillyn Sweetspur alive before she destroys us all. Don't keep Pheydra waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You were tasked with bringing me Sweetspur alive before she destroys us all, yet she isn't groveling at my feet. Correct your failure immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sweetspur's attack on the Destiny is an escalation in Exile activity, and the emperor is... unavailable. The Dominion needs you, now more than ever.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your next mission will involve something a little more to the point.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured Jaillyn Sweetspur in the Arkship Intellicore before she could destroy the Destiny and everyone aboard. After delivering her to Axis Pheydra, you learned that Emperor Myrcalus is only ever seen as a hologram, but you have no clue as to why.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so important about the Intellicore?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do we know about Sweetspur?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Intellicore is the Destiny's central computer. A hacker like Sweetspur can cause irreparable damage there, shutting down vital systems or initiating the ship's self-destruct.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Sweetspur is an Aurin spy with exceptional technical skills. Despite the limitations of her species, she is a respectable adversary. Use her weakness against her!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you were a hunter. I shall relish tearing out your feeble heart.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has ordered you to meet her in the Departures Terminal prior to leaving for Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Axis Pheydra in the Departures Terminal
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The time has come for you to leave the Destiny behind and claim your birthright on the planet below. Meet me in Departures at once.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I will join you in the Departures Terminal once I have concluded my business here... business that does not involve you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am certain there is something else you should be doing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The ICI is satisfied with your conduct aboard the Destiny. Let us hope you can maintain such consistent performance for the Dominion on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Always remember your responsibilities, for I will never forget.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ensure that you do. Now... let us discuss your destination.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Axis Pheydra in the Departures Terminal prior to being transported to Nexus. Pheydra is impressed with your performance thus far, and she has high hopes for your contributions to come.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You will be sent to Nexus. There you will put all you have learned here into practice for the Empire.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Being favored by the Emperor does not make you immune to the ICI's justice.

localizedTextIdTitle: What needs to be done here?
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need the supplies inside these storage units!

localizedTextIdText: Consort Yaenna of Sylvan Glade has informed you that Queen Myala Everstar is not well. Yaenna is in need of healing herbs to tend to her. Gather $m(vitem=232) in Sylvan Glade while she tends to the queen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Give the remedy to Queen Myala Everstar in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My queen is not well. I've done what I can, but that doesn't give me time to collect the healing herbs I need. Would you gather some sylvan bulbs for me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you gathered those sylvan bulbs yet? You won't have go to far. Just look around Sylvan Glade!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yaenna is making me a remedy, but she needs sylvan bulbs. Please, if you can, find some for her!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for gathering the sylvan bulbs for Yaenna. This elixir will help me regain some of my strength.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you ever so much! The bulbs can be found here in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've come to realize that she has the heart and determination of a matria.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've gathered the ingredients necessary for Consort Yaenna to mix healing herbs. Queen Myala Everstar isn't well, but this will ease her pain greatly.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Give the remedy to Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't believe you'd let the queen suffer!

localizedTextIdText: Consort Yaenna in Sylvan Glade is ready for the Sylvan Test of Spirit, but she's going to need your help. She thinks the key to finding the matria's spirit totem is transforming you into your spirit animal. Speak to Consort Yaenna to be transformed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I figure the only way to find a spirit totem is with a good sense of smell and a bit of spirit. So I'm going to transform you into your spirit animal!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You haven't found the matria's spirit totem? Well, you're going to need to take vind form for that! It'll be fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yaenna hasn't completed the Test of Spirit. It's the first of the tests she'll need to complete if she's to become a matria.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It was clever of Yaenna to use your spirit animal to locate the matria's spirit totem. The spirit totem will guide her in the trials to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hold still a moment. Don't worry... you shouldn't feel a thing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The first test is complete. Thank you so much for assisting Yaenna in this task!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Consort Yaenna complete the Sylvan Test of Spirit, the first test in the Trials of the Matria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be afraid! I'll put you back to normal later. I promise!

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar in Sylvan Glade says that Consort Yaenna second test will require great courage. Yaenna does not have the martial skills you do, but she must summon the courage needed to defeat your enemies. Meet Consort Yaenna in Sylvan Glade to begin the Test of Courage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yaenna must now complete the Test of Courage. She doesn't possess your martial prowess, so she'll need you by her side now more than ever.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yaenna hasn't completed the Test of Courage. It's the second of the tests she'll need to complete if she's to become a matria.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your courage and strength were instrumental in Yaenna's success at the Stone of Courage. I'm so proud of you both!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Help Yaenna summon the courage necessary to succeed at this test.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Only one more test remains.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Consort Yaenna complete the Sylvan Test of Courage, the second test in the Trials of the Matria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you can't help her, who will?

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar in Sylvan Glade has revealed Consort Yaenna next test: the Sylvan Test of Heart. Yaenna must summon life essence, but you must deliver it to the Elder Wisdom Tree's roots. Only the true of heart can succeed in this task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Queen Myala Everstar in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In the Test of Heart, Yaenna must summon life essence from deep within the glade. You must deliver it to the Elder Wisdom Tree's roots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yaenna hasn't completed the Test of Heart. It's the last test she'll need to complete if she's to become Sylvan Glade's matria.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Both Yaenna and I have been fortunate to have your help. Soon, she will be crowned as Sylvan Glade's matria, and it is all thanks to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be warned. Only the true of heart can accomplish the final test.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You passed the tests, as well. Under different circumstances, I'm sure you'd make a fine matria, too!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Consort Yaenna complete the Sylvan Test of Heart, the final test in the Trials of the Matria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now is not the time to turn your back on Yaenna, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: You've slain the Hillscourge Horror, a large and dangerous terminite that resided in the Hillscourge region of Deradune. Take the Claw of the Hillscourge Horror{p:Claws of the Hillscourge Horror} to Mondo Zax in Feralplain Collective and claim your reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This large and formidable terminite claw was taken from the corpse of the Hillscourge Horror. Mondo Zax might have some use for it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This large and formidable terminite claw was taken from the corpse of the Hillscourge Horror. Mondo Zax might have some use for it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you did bring Mondo sample of Hillscourge Horror! Mondo may decide to keep you around after all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Hillscourge Horror and took its claw to Mondo Zax as proof of its demise.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron

localizedTextIdText: Esora Dawning has recorded the main Mordesh database in Darkwhisper Enclave to make scientific cataloguing more fun. The Mordesh fail to see the point of the changes, and they don't understand how the new system works. Esora has asked you to show them how it's done by tapping the datapad's interface: match its color-coded buttons with time and visual cues.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Esora Dawning at Darkwhisper Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Mordesh scientists can't understand the improvements I made to their database! Can you show 'em how it works? Mining data nodes is fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Activate the datapad interface and play along. Hit the button that matches the data node in the selector reticule to mine data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All this Mordesh morbidity gets to a girl, you know? I just wanted to lighten 'em up a bit. Thanks for showing 'em how the new data system works!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I swear! These guys are so uptight!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe now they'll smile a little more as they work... but I kinda doubt it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Who knew data mining could be fun?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using Esora Dawning's datapad interface, you transferred, copied, and manipulated all kinds of cataloguing data nodes, showing Darkwhisper Enclave's Mordesh scientists that even data mining can be fun!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: That doesn't sound hard at all.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's easy! There are yellow, green, and red data nodes, and they drift from the bottom of the display to the top, crossing over the file selector reticules.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The datapad's interface has three buttons - a yellow button, a green button, and a red button - in the same order, from left to right.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You just press the colored button to mine the same color data node when that node passes over a file selector reticule! So if a yellow node is passing over a file reticule, just press the yellow button on the datapad's interface! It's as simple as that!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: It isn't! But the nodes go pretty fast, so you need to be quick!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: No way! It's completely original, I promise!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Awww! Come back! It'll be fun, I promise!

localizedTextIdText: Esora Dawning watched you ride the Big Waterspout near the Godwood Tree and was transfixed. Now she wants you to visit each of the Floating Islands above Godsbreath Terrace. Use the Vitaran Runes to launch yourself from one platform to the next.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Esora Dawning via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh, wow! You totally just rode that water... spouty thing! You should go up to one of those giant floating rocks! They look super fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get to each of those floating islands above Godsbreath Terrace.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was amazing! Did you see that last one? Everyone was just standing around my display watching you! Great work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be safe!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take care!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rode the waterspouts, flew on strange Vitaran Runes of leaping, and generally defied gravity. Esora Dawning was suitably impressed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aww, you're making me sad.

localizedTextIdText: Recover stolen Eldan Power Cells from Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Peran Moonflower and tell him you've recovered the cells.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoids are sitting on tons of old Eldan power cells. We're going to need 'em.  Go to Port Grimvoid and The Sunk Works and grab what you can!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You have to get those cells from Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works before those idiot Marauders abuse them anymore!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have to get those cells from Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works before those idiot Marauders abuse them anymore!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, not bad! The Grimvoids wouldn't know what to do with those if the Eldan themselves came back and showed 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Who knows what ancient machinery we could power with those cells?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get those Eldan Power Cells.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Peran Moonflower keep the mysterious Eldan devices at Discovery Base powered by recovering Eldan Power Cells from the Grimvoid Marauders.

localizedTextIdText: Capture Runaway Veggies near Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Peran Moonflower and tell him you've gathered the wayward veggies.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When I was preparing dinner, the veggies jumped out of the stewpot and ran away! They were headed toward Port Grimvoid and the Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please find those veggies before they get eaten by someone else! They took off toward Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please find those veggies before they get eaten by someone else! They took off toward Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're my hero! Now I'll be able to make dinner and nobody will ever know those veggies were gone...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: By the Weave, researchers get temperamental when they're hungry!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've saved everyone from going hungry at Discovery Base by gathering the veggies that escaped from the stewpot.

localizedTextIdText: Xenobiologist Karizi has created a device with which to analyze augmented creatures in the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex. You must place the device on the ground near the creature, then kill the creature for the device to function.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Xenobiologist Karizi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Augmented creatures require analysis! But I have perfect tool. Augment analyzer! You see? Kill augmented creatures near device to gather data!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Simple instructions. Put augment analyzer on ground. Kill augmented creature. Collect data. See how simple? Now go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So interesting! Augmentation potentially valuable. Could perfect many Chua if done right. Of course, I'm perfect already, but augmentation not hurt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Dead bodies best bodies for studying!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You do well. Much thanks, but you not needed now. So go.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll set the device and kill them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Maybe extend the range next time?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used Xenobiologist Karizi augment analyzer to collect information about augmented creatures. The results were particularly interesting to Karizi, who envisions a brighter future filled with augmented Chua.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll set the device and kill them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal of one with such brainpower unwise. Choose again!

localizedTextIdText: Recover Scientific Supplies from the Grimvoid Marauders at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Peran Moonflower and tell him you've recovered the missing supplies
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our latest supply drop never made it to us. The pilot dropped the cargo early and now the Marauders at Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works have it!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please find those veggies before they get eaten by someone else! They took off toward Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have to get that cargo back from the Grimvoid Marauders! Check their bases at Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thorns and bracken, you're a lifesaver. I thought our research was going to ground to a halt for sure!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Without the equipment from that drop, we can't continue our research!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I found many of the supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've recovered many of the supplies from a botched supply drop. Discovery Base will have the equipment it needs to continue its survey of Grimhaven Island.

localizedTextIdText: Help set up Perimeter Turrets, build Tent Kits, and turn on Monitoring Stations around Discovery Base.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Peran Moonflower and tell him you've helped around Discovery Base.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've already begun experiments, but there's still so much to do at the station! Would you help set up turrets, tents, and monitoring stations?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please find those veggies before they get eaten by someone else! They took off toward Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look around Discovery Station for tents, turrets, and monitoring stations that need your attention. We need everything up and running.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the matrias, we're fortunate to have your help! Every time I finish something, there's more to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's still so much to do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Discovery Base's logistics coordinator, Peran Moonflower keep the base running smoothly.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer informed you that you will be contacted by Mondo Zax, a high-ranking Chua inventor. Follow his orders until further notice.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good work. For the time being, I am placing you under the command of Mondo Zax. He is a Chua, and likely insane, but his tactical sense is sound.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Has Zax contacted you yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You the one Kezrek told me about? Don't look mighty to Mondo, no no no.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am Mondo Zax! You follow Mondo's orders now. Do not worry too much. Mondo want to keep you alive, at least until he not need you anymore.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Expect a comm call from Zax. Give him the same respect you would give me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Mondo Zax.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Not yet... at least, I don't think so.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Don't judge a book by its cover.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Zax is a Chua of some notoriety. He's been sent to the Crimson Isle to lend his technological and tactical expertise to our mission here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool!

localizedTextIdText: A Logic Core broke free from the Logic Elemental during the fray. Deliver the Logic Core to Sariah Lumentis at Excavation Site Alpha.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sariah Lumentis at Excavation Site Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Logic Core was knocked loose from one of the Logic Elementals during the fight. A discovery like this is sure to leave Sariah Lumentis breathless.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh... my! Words simply cannot express! Your pardon, but I need a moment... alone, if you wouldn't mind.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I feel faint...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is going to be good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Logic Core you recovered from the Logic Elemental in Ellevar has been successfully delivered into the hands of Sariah Lumentis at Excavation Site Alpha.

localizedTextIdText: Recover Looted Eldan Relics from the Grimvoid Marauders at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works by searching Grimvoid Footlockers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Fabia Aquilles and let her know you've recovered the Looted Eldan Relics.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'll bet those Grimvoid savages have footlockers full of priceless Eldan relics. Go to the Skunk Works and Port Grimvoid and see what you can recover.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found those missing relics? Start your search with Grimvoid footlockers at the Skunk Works and Port Grimvoid.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a relief! Any one of these artifacts could hold the key to unlocking the secrets of this island.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't let those profiteering pirates steal the relics we need for our research.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Fabia Aquilles recover priceless Eldan relics that the Grimvoid Marauders planned to sell to the highest bidder.

localizedTextIdText: Scan Grimvoid Terminals at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Fabia Aquilles and tell her you've downloaded the Grimvoid data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We should be able to make use of the Marauders' records in our work. Take your scanbot to Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works and scan their terminals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stop wasting time and scan the Marauder terminals at Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works. We might be able to use the information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: More images of Draken females than anyone needs to see in a lifetime, but it does look like there's some useful information here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You never can tell what we'll find.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Some if it will be useful.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Fabia Aquilles learn what the Grimvoid Marauders have been up to during their stay on Grimhaven Island. While they've turned up many valuable Eldan relics, their main interest has been in selling the items or using them to refit their ship.

localizedTextIdText: Scan Augmented Conifers in the forests near Port Grimvoid,The Cap'n's Stash, or the Cybernetic Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Fabia Aquilles and tell her you've completed your survey of Augmented Conifers.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have scattered reports mentioning Augmented vegetation in the evergreen forests. I need a scientist to gather real data on them. Will you help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get out there and start scanning the Augmented conifers on the eastern end of Grimhaven. I can't wait to see your data!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've been downloading the reports from your datachron. Excellent work here, scientist!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We've seen Augmented trees before, but never more than a few.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Fabia Aquilles begin her survey of Grimhaven's strange Augmented conifers. The reasons behind the creation of these trees remains unknown and many are dead or dying.

localizedTextIdText: Gather data about the genetics of Grimvoid attack animals by scanning Grimvoid Bloodseekers at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works and scanning Grimvoid Picaroons at The Grog Locker
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Fabia Aquilles and tell her you've gathered the genetic data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The dagun and razortails used by the Grimvoids are more aggressive than any I've ever seen. Scan the genomes of their bloodseekers and picaroons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have those genetic scans? Head to the Grog Locker, the Skunk Works, or Port Grimvoid to scan the Marauder dagun and razortails.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fascinating! Who would've thought those ham-fisted Marauders capable of such fine genetic manipulation?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck and don't let them eat your scanbot.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Fabia Aquilles recover priceless Eldan relics that the Grimvoid Marauders planned to sell to the highest bidder.

localizedTextIdText: Security Coordinator Lazad wants you to slay a Grimvoid Spinebreaker at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works to spread chaos among the Marauders.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Security Coordinator Lazad and tell him of your success.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Grimvoid spinebreakers keep the crews in line and dispense justice to criminals. Find one at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works and crush him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The enemy is out there at Port Grimvoid and the Skunk Works. Now, get out there and slay your target!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The blood of your enemies marks you in your success, soldier. You're an example to the rest of us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Without the spinebreakers to keep order, discipline will crumble!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've weakened the resolve of the Grimvoid Marauders of Grimhaven by defeating those responsible for keeping discipline in the ranks.

localizedTextIdText: Security Coordinator Lazad wants you to burn Grimvoid Banners at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Security Coordinator Lazad and tell him of your success.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Send a message to those stubborn Grimvoid Marauders. Burn down their banners at The Skunk Works or Port Grimvoid!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? Those banners won't burn themselves. Hurry to Port Grimvoid and the Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You smell of smoke, battle, and victory. Our message has gotten through.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Down with the Grimvoids!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've struck a blow against the morale of the Grimvoid Marauders on Grimhaven by destroying their banners.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Escort this vehicle to the cave!
Escort this vehicle to the cave!

localizedTextIdText: Security Coordinator Lazad wants you answer a distress beacon south of Discovery Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Security Coordinator Lazad and tell him of your success.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've received a signal from a distress beacon with a research team south of the base. Teach those filthy Marauders not to mess with our scientists!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That distress call is urgent. Find the beacon to the south of the base and defend the research team!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew the researchers could count on you. Nothing will stop us from uncovering the secrets of these islands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't waste any time. Those scientists need your help!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully defended a CoGS research team from attack by the Grimvoid Marauders.

localizedTextIdText: The second level of the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex contains a higher security protocol. There are security mines dispersed throughout this level. Disable them as you go along so the Vigilants don't hurt themselves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Xenoanalyst Derenia in the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Watch out! This entire area is littered with mines! If you think you can disable some of them, it will make it safer for our scribes as they move about.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you going to help disable some of these mines? So long as there are mines laying about, our crew is in danger.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's obvious that the Eldan did not desire intruders to come into this area, hence all the mines. Thank you for helping to make it safer for us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These things... they pack quite a shock! $(self.visual=17045,17046,17047)
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Blessings of Dominus, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's safer to move around now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The second level of the Bio-Mech AH47 Complex contains a higher security protocol. There are security mines dispersed throughout this level. This level houses experimental Recombination Chambers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll make sure Calidor himself hears of this.

localizedTextIdText: Security Coordinator Lazad wants you to plant Project Monolith Banners in the corpses of Grimvoid Marauders at Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Security Coordinator Lazad and tell him of your success.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoid Marauders want a fight? Fine, kill them wherever you find them and plant the Project Monolith flag in their rotting corpses!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get out there and plant banners in Grimvoid Marauder corpses... for science.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good. You've struck fear into them. That's the mark of a true hunter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show those Marauders that we're here to stay.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've made Project Monolith's presence felt on Grimhaven Island by planting banners in the corpses of slain Grimvoid Marauders.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I applaud your choice, $(player.class). You should begin honing your craft immediately. Let's begin with these materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Omni-plasm is properly stored in your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a Technologist, Craftmaster Tullio has given you the basic supplies needed to make your first medishot.

localizedTextIdText: Amon Greenston wants you to plant Project Monolith Banners in high places near Port Grimvoid or The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Amon Greenston and let him know you've claimed the territory.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Island's ours. Marauders just don't know it yet. Plant Project Monolith banners at elevated locations around the island and they'll get the idea.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't delay. Get out there and raise our flag over the high spots on the island.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nicely done, explorer. The Grimvoids know it's only a matter of time until we've consolidated our hold.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make our claim to Grimhaven plain for all to see.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Project Monolith mark its claim on Grimhaven Island by putting up its banners all over the island.

localizedTextIdText: Recruiter Emilija of the Black Hoods would like to speak with you in Sylvan Glade. Go and speak to her at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Recruiter Emilija in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When you have returned to Sylvan Glade, I must request that you seek me out so we may speak in a more secured manner.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is much to discuss. Quickly, now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We speak now, and softly. I've been expecting you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Search the shadows - for that is where I shall await you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Black Hoods wish to make a deal with you - a deal of blood and darkness.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You surreptitiously met with Recruiter Emilija in Sylvan Glade and discussed your potential assistance in a covert Black Hoods operation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Shall I inform my superiors of your refusal?

localizedTextIdText: Amon Greenston wants you to gather surveillance data from Remote Listening posts placed near the perimeter of Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Amon Greenston and let him know you've downloaded the surveillance data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're using scientific gear to record Grimvoid transmissions. I need your help gathering data from devices near Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Locate those listening posts around the perimeter of Port Grimvoid and the Skunk Works and download their data. Hurry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll get this data to our security coordinator immediately. Those Marauders won't get the drop on us again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those transmissions will let us know what the Marauders are planning.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Amon Greenston gather surveillance data about the Grimvoid Marauders and their attack plans.

localizedTextIdText: Amon Greenston wants you to gather free Primal Life energy from the forests and wild places of Grimhaven Island.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Amon Greenston and let him know you've downloaded the surveillance data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Researchers tell me primal life abounds on this island, but it seems scattered. We must find the sources of these readings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need to help the researchers get to the bottom of this mystery. Search the forests and wild places of Grimhaven for sources of primal life.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm downloading the map of your findings from your datachron. Excellent work, Explorer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Think of what we could do if we can harness these sources of energy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Amon Greenston sample sources of primal life from various parts of Grimhaven Island.

localizedTextIdText: Amon Greenston wants you to locate a treasure map on the Eternity Coast Port Grimvoid and The Skunk Works.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Amon Greenston and let him know you've downloaded the surveillance data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In a place like this, rumors of treasure are inevitable. Comb the beaches of the Eternity Strait for a map and see where it leads you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Check the coast along the Eternity Strait for a treasure map. If you find one, follow it in hopes of finding where the Grimvoids hide their loot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great work, Explorer. Wonder how much more treasure they've stashed here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Capturing some of that Marauder booty will really boost morale.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Amon Greenston investigate rumors of Grimvoid treasure buried somewhere on Grimhaven Island.

localizedTextIdText: Messenger Staenn in Grimveil Enclave was sent by Arwick Redleaf to give you message. Arwick asks that you attend to Queen Myala in Sylvan Glade. A hoverbike is ready and waiting for you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Chief Chugach in Hijunga Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Arwick Redleaf sent me with a message for you. He asks that you attend to Queen Myala in Sylvan Glade. There's a hoverbike waiting for you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why are you wasting time? Get on that hoverbike and get to the queen in Sylvan Glade!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You not go to Sylvan Glade. You stay here. Stay and help Hijunga. Big dangers in Hijunga!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The trees whisper of danger, and the queen must remain safe!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's talk. Need big help, big time!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You headed to Sylvan Glade at Arwick Redleaf request, only to be stopped at Hijunga Village. It seems like they need some help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You want to try answering that again?

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to fix these vehicles!

localizedTextIdText: Jaillyn Sweetspur attack on the Destiny points to a massive escalation by the Exiles. Axis Pheydra has ordered you to Nexus to confront the Exile menace. Your shuttle awaits in Departures Terminal B. First, Artemis Zin wants a word with you, and then Chancellor Juro Takigurian will brief you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lieutenant Ticus for a mission update
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Speak to Artemis Zin and Juro Takigurian before you depart for Nexus. Once there, take all that is rightfully ours - which is everything.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to Lady Zin and the chancellor, then proceed to Nexus. Delays are unacceptable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: About time you arrived. Here, you've been issued a "revolutionary rucksack." It's a Protostar contraption that should keep you supplied in the field.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let nothing stand in your way, citizen. Now go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In any case, there's plenty to do, so get to it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The end of the Exiles begins now.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Thanks. I'm ready for the worst.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Jaillyn Sweetspur attack on the Destiny points to a massive escalation by the Exiles. Axis Pheydra has ordered you to Nexus to confront the Exile menace. Let the retaliation commence!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where can I best serve the Dominion?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Cassians and Mechari are directed to Levian Bay with Lady Zin, while the Chua and Draken are bound for Crimson Isle. You may choose either destination.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lady Zin is the most famous of the galaxy's explorers, and her holovid show boasts billions of viewers across the Dominion. Though she seems little more than an entertainer, her knowledge and devotion to the empire cannot be denied.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The chancellor is a brilliant researcher and leader of the Royal Collegium. Though he is a man of science, he is also pious and devoted to upholding the tenants of the Vigilant Church.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am far from amused, $(player.name). Here, at the last, you disappoint me.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has instructed you to report to Agent Lex in the Departures Terminal. Lady Zin's expedition is leaving for Levian Bay, and the ICI requires qualified Mechari citizens to oversee her operation. Speak to Agent Lex before catching your shuttle to Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Infivan for a mission update
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Artemis Zin is taking an expedition to Levian Bay, and the ICI wants her activity monitored. Speak to Agent Lex, then secure transport to Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to Agent Lex, then proceed to Nexus. Delays are unacceptable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You appear to be intact. This is fortunate, for you are required to attend to a number of tasks. Immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I - or one of my many agents - will be watching you very closely. Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy your stay on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your adventures aboard the Destiny, you've finally arrived on Nexus. Only time will tell what your further adventures will reveal!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Exile forces have dug in on Crimson Isle. Mondo Zax and General Warbringer are launching a surprise attack on the island to clear them out.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Cassians and Mechari are directed to Levian Bay, while the Chua and Draken are bound for Crimson Isle. You may choose either destination.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am far from amused, $(player.name). Here, at the last, you disappoint me.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has instructed you to report to Mondo Zax in the Departures Terminal. The Zax is preparing to leave for Crimson Isle, and Axis Pheydra feels your expertise will be a valuable addition to his strike team. Speak to Mondo Zax before catching a shuttle to Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Engineer Zric for a mission update
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mondo Zax is leaving for Crimson Isle with a strike team. You will accompany him and provide support. Speak to the Zax, then secure transport to Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to Mondo Zax, then proceed to Nexus. Delays are unacceptable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name)! Been waiting for you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I - or one of my many agents - will be watching you very closely. Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good! Time to work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your adventures aboard the Destiny, you've finally arrived on Nexus. Only time will tell what your further adventures will reveal!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Artemis Zin's expedition is leaving for Levian Bay. Though details are scarce, she is likely seeking Eldan treasures on the planet's surface.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Cassians and Mechari are directed to Levian Bay, while the Chua and Draken are bound for Crimson Isle. You may choose either destination.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am far from amused, $(player.name). Here, at the last, you disappoint me.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has instructed you to report to Kezrek Warbringer in the Departures Terminal. The General is preparing to leave for Crimson Isle, and Axis Pheydra feels your expertise will be a valuable addition to his strike team. Speak to Kezrek Warbringer before catching a shuttle to Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scout Naharra for a mission update
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: General Warbringer is leading a strike force to Crimson Isle. You will join his ranks and support the assault. Speak to Kezrek, then secure transport to Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to Kezrek Warbringer, then proceed to Nexus. Delays are unacceptable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I trust you are well-rested after your journey. There is work to be done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I - or one of my many agents - will be watching you very closely. Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Prepare your weapon, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What would you have me do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following your adventures aboard the Destiny, you've finally arrived on Nexus. Only time will tell what your further adventures will reveal!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Artemis Zin's expedition is leaving for Levian Bay. Though details are scarce, she is likely seeking Eldan treasures on the planet's surface.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Cassians and Mechari are directed to Levian Bay, while the Chua and Draken are bound for Crimson Isle. You may choose either destination.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am far from amused, $(player.name). Here, at the last, you disappoint me.

localizedTextIdText: The ruins of Doctor Petrich laboratory are known as Grimhold's Hope. Doctor Petrich and his staff diligently recorded holographic datalogs during Grimhold's last days. Perhaps you could piece together a picture of what happened to Grimhold in those final hours.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Harrower Krimzon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This hologram's datalog is damaged. If you can find others like it, you may be able to learn more about this hidden, underground laboratory.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The hologram's datalog is too badly damaged to transmit any useful information. There may be others waiting to be found somewhere in this lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Beware when wandering the ruins of Grimhold. You never know what you might find... or what might find you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes. Doctor Petrich contacted me in Grimhold's waning hours. He tried so hard to contain the Contagion, but he was outmatched.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Petrich was a brave man. My people are lessened by his loss.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: There's more to this mystery than meets the eye.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though he tried to save Grimhold, Doctor Petrich was outpaced by the speed of the Contagion's spread. Before taking his own life, Petrich contacted Harrower Krimzon and requested the Reapers be dispatched to Grimhold to contain the disease before it could spread further in Celestion.

localizedTextIdText: Harrower Krimzon of the Mordesh Reapers has summoned you to the Belabog Containment Camp in Celestion. Meet with him at once to learn about the dire situation in Grimhold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Harrower Krimzon at Belabog Containment Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Contagion has taken Grimhold, and we Reapers have found ourselves... understaffed. Come to Belabog Containment Camp. We require your assistance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bring yourself to the Belabog Containment Camp at once. We cannot wait long, for the Ravenous hunger for all flesh.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is your arrival a blessing in the midst of our curse? We shall soon see. There is grim work to be done here. Are you prepared to do what must be done?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Time is our enemy. Join us swiftly, or do not join us at all.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If this outbreak is not contained, all will pay the price for our failure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Harrower Krimzon in the Belabog Containment Camp. The Grimhold situation is even more dire than you anticipated.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Contagion will not wait for one $(player.race).

localizedTextIdText: Calidor Antevian, devout member of the Vigilant Church and brother to Toric Antevian, has discovered an ancient Eldan complex deep within Ellevar. Meet Calidor near the excavation site to see what he needs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Calidor Antevian at his excavation site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've heard of your great works, $(player.name), and my brother speaks highly of you. I've discovered an Eldan site and would appreciate your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Eldan site I've discovered is likely to be filled with wonders unimaginable. I require one of your abilities to help me explore it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've uncovered something of incredible magnificence here. I can feel it in the very air that surrounds us... destiny awaits.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please make haste to my location, for destiny waits for no one.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's speak now, and together we'll begin a great adventure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the site of an ancient Eldan complex deep within Ellevar and met with Calidor Antevian to see if you might be of any assistance to him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Was my brother wrong about you? It would seem so...

localizedTextIdText: The Rime Hide Skeech have moved into Coldburrow Village and are stealing anything that isn't bolted down. The Dominion's supplies are running low and Lucretia Marius has asked you to recover the Stolen Supplies from the Skeech.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucretia Marius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are running low on supplies and the Rime Hide Skeech are stealing what little we have left. I ask you to find their camp and reclaim our provisions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What do these Skeech live on when we are not around to steal from? Each other, most likely.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am very much relieved to see our supplies returned. However, I am still concerned about the Skeech. They are desperate, and they will return.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The next supply drop is not for weeks. We need those supplies returned.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I almost feel sorry for the little beasts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While the obvious solution would be to wipe out the Rime Hide Skeech that inhabit Coldburrow Village, Lucretia Marius feels sorry for them and is content with just having the Dominion's supplies returned.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Surely you are not suggesting that we go without.

localizedTextIdText: The Rime Hide Skeech have moved into Coldburrow Village and are stealing anything that isn't bolted down. The Exiles' supplies are running low and Maude Fairvale has asked you to recover the Stolen Supplies from the Skeech.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maude Fairvale via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our supplies go fast in this cold climate. They go even faster when light-fingered Skeech steal 'em! Can ya go find their camp and return our supplies?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our remainin' supplies are spread thin as it is. If ya don't recover the ones the Skeech stole, we're gonna be up the creek without a paddle!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks a bunch, $(player.name). I was worried there, just for a bit. Still, those Rime Hides are desperate. I'm sure they'll be back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get a wiggle on. Our stocks won't be resupplied for weeks.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I feel kinda bad for those Skeech, but we don't have a morsel to spare.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While the obvious solution would be to wipe out the Rime Hide Skeech that inhabit Coldburrow Village, Maude Fairvale feels sorry for them and is content with just having the Exiles' supplies returned.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Stay warm. I'm working on it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'd rather us go hungry in the cold? That ain't nice.

localizedTextIdText: Lucretia Marius has gathered details of strange Eldan activity inside Coldburrow Cavern. Data indicates that the cavern is substantially colder than the surrounding area. She's ordered you to investigate the cavern and report on what you discover.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucretia Marius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have detected Eldan activity near Coldburrow Cavern, but our scouts have not been able to enter the cave. I trust you will have better luck.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You don't appear to have frostbite. Is there another reason why you have not investigated the cave as I ordered you to?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This information is important to my research, but I'm more interested in the Eldan pylons. What was it like communing with them? I hope there are no harmful side effects.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, $(player.name). This Eldan activity has me concerned.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No matter. Don't stray too far. I will require your services again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the Eldan presence inside Coldburrow Cavern for Lucretia Marius. After communing with the Eldan Pylon, you have the distinct impression that the icy cavern is more than just a home for the Rime Hides.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why is the cave so cold?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Temperatures in the cave are far below zero. Our scouts are not equipped to handle those conditions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We do not know. That is why I need you to investigate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Surely a little cold weather will not deter you from aiding me, will it?

localizedTextIdText: Maude Fairvale has gathered details of strange Eldan activity inside Coldburrow Cavern. Data indicates that the cavern is substantially colder than the surrounding area. She's asked you to investigate the cavern and report on what you discover.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maude Fairvale via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My explorers found signs of Eldan tech inside Coldburrow Cavern, but that cave interior's colder than deep space. Feel like doin' some recon for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well ya ain't done froze to death, but I still don't know what's in that cave. You goin' to move out, or do I need to find someone else?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Communed with some Eldan Pylons, did ya? What was it like? I find that to be the most interestin' part.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Skeech're bad enough, but ya don't need to freeze to death. Stay warm.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well, don't go too far. I may need more data.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the Eldan presence inside Coldburrow Cavern for Maude Fairvale. After communing with the Eldan Pylon, you have the distinct impression that the icy cavern is more than just a home for the Rime Hides.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Let me warm my hands first.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Our explorers have recorded temperatures far below the normal range inside that cave. We don't know what's causin' it, and it's preventin' us from enterin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya worried about catching a cold or somethin'?

localizedTextIdText: Lucretia Marius has ordered you to investigate the Rime Hide Skeech that have taken over Coldburrow Cavern. They're acting strangely, even for Skeech, and she wants to know why.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucretia Marius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Rime Hide Skeech near Coldburrow Cavern are behaving strangely, even for Skeech. Scout around and try to determine if something is amiss.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Whatever are those Skeech up to, $(player.name)? The sooner you investigate their behavior, the sooner we will know the truth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That is one less frozen thing for me to worry about today. However, knowing the Skeech, I'm sure that they'll be up to something again real soon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, $(player.name). I do not trust those beastly creatures.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We shall have to wait and see what they'll be worshipping next time.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what they are doing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After finding an Eldan teleporter deep inside Coldburrow Cavern, you've ascertained that the Rime Hide Skeech are worshipping Eldan constructs as gods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not tell me that you are afraid of a tribe of cold-loving Skeech.

localizedTextIdText: Maude Fairvale has asked you to investigate the Rime Hide Skeech that have taken over Coldburrow Cavern. They're acting strangely, even for Skeech, and she wants to know why.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maude Fairvale via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Rime Hide Skeech 'round Coldburrow Cavern have been actin' kinda funny, even for Skeech. Take a stroll around their cave and see what's going on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What have ya seen in Coldburrow Cavern so far, $(player.name)? What're them Skeech up to? Get out there and find out, alright?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for all yer help, $(player.name). You never know what you'll find when Skeech are involved.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those Skeech love the cold. I wonder what they're up to.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wonder what the Skeech'll worship next...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was a surprise to me as well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After finding an Eldan teleporter deep inside Coldburrow Cavern, you have ascertained that the Rime Hide Skeech are worshipping Eldan constructs as gods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You ain't afraid of a bunch of little Skeech, are ya $(player.name)?

localizedTextIdText: Nydra has ordered you to enter the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and rescue any Dominion troops that haven't yet been augmented by the constructs inhabiting the lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We sent troops into Exo-Lab 729 to search for threats. None have returned. Enter the lab and conduct a search for the missing troops.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The soldiers we sent into Exo-Lab 729 most likely require assistance. Do not delay any longer, for lives are on the line.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our missing troops have returned safely. Without your intervention, I hesitate to hypothesize what the other possible outcomes might have been.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: One of their last communications referred to a Kinetic Enhancement Lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must recalculate the Royal Collegium's approach to studying the lab.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and saved many Dominion soldiers from a horrible fate. With the troops saved, Nydra can think about the best way to study the lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your unwillingness to aid the Royal Collegium marks you as a traitor.

localizedTextIdText: Varynn Longstar has asked you to enter the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and rescue any Exile scouts that haven't yet been augmented by the constructs inhabiting the lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Varynn Longstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We sent some scouts into Exo-Lab 729. None have returned yet. I'm afraid something might've happened to them. Can you go and look for them?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our scouts could be in danger! They're stuck in that exo-lab, most likely in trouble, and you just stand out here in the cold? Come on!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our scouts are safe and it's all thanks to you. I don't even want to think about what would've happened if you hadn't shown up to help when you did.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The last reports mentioned something about a Kinetic Enhancement Lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll have to rethink our plan to study that lab. Hmm.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm just glad that they're safe.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and saved many Exile scouts from a horrible fate. With the troopers saved, Varynn Longstar can think about the best way to study the lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please $(player.name)! These are good Exiles that may need your help!

localizedTextIdText: Nydra has ordered you to enter the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and eradicate Eldan constructs. These constructs pose a threat to Nydra research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Kinetic Enhancement Lab is populated with Eldan constructs that pose a threat and impede my research. You will remove them for the Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Has the Kinetic Enhancement Lab been cleared of constructs? If not, please explain why you are wasting precious time here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your affinity for combat has proven useful to the Royal Collegium. You have provided us a window of opportunity to enter and study the lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The only logical course of action is to eradicate them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If the constructs return, your skills will be required once again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and eliminated Eldan constructs for Nydra. The Royal Collegium can now enter the lab and conduct research on the Eldan.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get over there right away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Either you eliminate the constructs, or I will eliminate you.

localizedTextIdText: Varynn Longstar has asked you to enter the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and eliminate Eldan constructs. These constructs pose a threat to Varynn Longstar research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Varynn Longstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exo-Lab's full of Eldan constructs. They're augmenting anything they can grab! We gotta get rid of them before we can study the Kinetic Enhancement Lab.
