localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Looks like you haven't been augmented. That's good, but is the lab still full of constructs? Is it safe to go down there yet? Don't keep me waiting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Green leaves and good luck! Now we don't have to worry about being augmented by those metal monsters! I'll call in the rest of the XAS and send them in.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you don't stop them now, they'll be coming for us next!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't sweat it. If they come back, I'll just give you a call.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The lab won't stay clear for long.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and eliminated Eldan constructs for Varynn Longstar. The Exile Academy of Science can now enter the lab and conduct research on the Eldan.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll let you know when it's clear.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You like the idea of being augmented?

localizedTextIdText: The Exiles have scattered land mines around Ghostpyre Plains just outside of Camp Icefury. Find the mines and disarm them safely before they explode.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kadu Fizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Quick quick! Exiles sneaky. Land mines outside blow you to pieces! Mines have simple mechanism, easy to disarm. You go now and disarm. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still many mines in Ghostpyre Plains. Why not disarmed yet? You lazy or silly? Remember! Cut blue wire! Or was that red wire?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Chance of land mine detonation reduced by wide margin. And $(player.name) still have all fingers and toes. Victory!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Cut red wire! Not blue wire! Now go go go!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Those mines don't stand a chance.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's safer now, thanks to me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully disarmed Exile land mines around the Ghostpyre Plains outisde of Camp Icefury.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You be very, very sorry.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion military has scattered land mines throughout the Ghostpyre Plains. Disarm the mines to help keep Darkstone's Landing safe.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dominik Kaspukov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Answer my appeal, for the Dominion has distributed demolitions throughout Ghostpyre Plains. These dangerous devices must be deactivated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The land mines have been littered liberally in Ghostpyre Plains. Their mechanism is not multifarious. You should have little trouble disarming them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Exiles appreciate your attention, $(player.name). Now we can walk freely without fear of fatalities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These land mines are lethal. Handle them with care.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Never forget what you fight for.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Disarming the Dominion's mines ensures that Exile troops arriving at Darkstone's Landing will have a much safer path to traverse inside of the Ghostpyre Plains.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have doomed our troopers to death and dismemberment.

localizedTextIdText: The Exiles have placed communication beacons and surveillance camerabots all around Ghostpyre Plains. To disable these devices, Kadu Fizz insists that you use a squirt gun to douse the spy gear in water, then let the cold of the Northern Wastes do the rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kadu Fizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exiles use spybots, comm beacons. Must break them! You spray spybots, beacons with squirt gun. Cold turn water to ice, then equipment useless!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Squirt gun filled with water. More than enough to freeze many Exile spybots, beacons. What you wait for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job with squirt gun! Exile devices frozen solid. Spy communications down seventy-eight percent! Plan work like charm!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go go! Put Exile spy gear on ice!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Exile spying and communication have dropped significantly since you froze their surveillance equipment in Ghostpyre Plains.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe Kadu talk to ICI about $(player.name). Maybe $(player.name) Exile spy.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion has placed communication beacons and surveillance camerabots all around Ghostpyre Plains. To disable these devices, Dominik Kaspukov insists that you use a squirt gun to douse the spy gear in water, then let the cold of the Northern Wastes do the rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dominik Kaspukov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: For all the Dominion's technical temerity, they refuse to realize their surveillance gear's peril. Disable their devices by dousing them with water.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The enemy's spybots and beacons remain functional. Is there a flaw with my plan to freeze them, or is the problem owing to your own apathy?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have darkened and deafened the Dominion's detestable designs. Without their spybots and beacons, they will be blind to our designs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: In this climate, water will freeze their equipment and ensure its uselessness.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Dominion spying and communication have dropped significantly since you froze their surveillance equipment in Ghostpyre Plains.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And why, may I ask, do you decline?

localizedTextIdText: A village of Moodies has taken root near Settler's Reach in Ghostpyre Plains, and the creatures have become quite a nuisance to Dominion troops. Kadu Fizz has ordered you to help eliminate the Moodies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kadu Fizz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Moodies cause trouble for military. Bring dead Exiles to life with magic fire. Is blasphemy to science! Must kill Moodies and re-kill Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Moodies pests. Ghosts, too. Go deal with them, keep Ghostpyre Plains safe for soldiers. If not, maybe you be ghost next.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Moodies all dead, yes? Kadu knew skilled $(player.class) like you be successful. If not, $(player.name) be just another ghost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Aim for head. Only way to be sure.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stick around. If Kadu know Moodies, they return again soon.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It would take more than that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Ghostpyre Moodies and their supernatural minions have been dealt with, at least for the time being. Kadu Fizz is sure they'll come back or rise from the dead, and he's asked you to stick around.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'd like to see you try.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Scared of ghosts? Is trick of light. Everyone knows ghosts not real!

localizedTextIdText: A village of Moodies has taken root near the ruins of Settler's Reach in Ghostpyre Plains, and the creatures have become quite a nuisance to Exiles. Dominik Kaspukov has ordered you to help eliminate the Moodies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dominik Kaspukov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ruins of Settler's Reach have been overrun by Moodies. The vile vermin have been raising expired Exiles from the dead. You must massacre them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our kin writhe in eternal agony beneath the Moodies' necromantic yoke, yet here you stand. Delay your duty no longer!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The heroes who sacrificed their lives in Northern Wilds are now at rest, and their Moodie masters put to the sword. Thank you, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fear not the dead. They only yearn to return to their repose.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Moodies will be back, as will their necromantic thralls. Be ready.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Ghostpyre Moodies and their supernatural minions have been dealt with, at least for the time being. Dominik Kaspukov is sure they'll come back or rise from the dead, and he's asked you to stick around.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm working on it, I swear!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Were it you, raised from death in a mockery of life, how would you feel?

localizedTextIdText: Captain Darkstone has asked you to assist the Exiles in establishing a defensive perimeter around their camp. Several turrets and security cams have been set up around Darkstone's Landing, but they must be activated. Hop to it!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Darkstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We dropped in some turrets and security cams earlier, but they need to be activated. I need ya to get out there and turn those things on, pronto.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those cams and turrets set up yet? I told ya, there's a lotta weird stuff movin' around out there. We need to establish a perimeter, now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The turrets and cams are online, five by five. I'd like to see those suckers get through our defenses now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's a lotta weird stuff movin' around out there, so watch yer keister.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stick around, pal. We ain't finished here yet.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get them up and running.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They'll be in for a surprise.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After activating the Exile defense turrets and security cams, you faced down a group of augmented survivors. If not for your valiant efforts, Darkstone's Landing might have been lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see to it right away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without a secure perimeter, we're just askin' to be overrun.

localizedTextIdText: Initial surveys of the iridescent crystals in the Northern Wastes revealed latent healing properties. A formal survey has never been completed, so the XAS has asked you to perform another round of scans. Many of the crystals can be found on the Ghostpyre Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Darkstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Initial survey data indicated the crystals in the Northern Wastes have unusual properties. The XAS requests a second round of scans to confirm those results.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Initial survey data indicated the crystals in the Northern Wastes have unusual properties. The XAS requests a second round of scans to confirm those results.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ain't you supposed to be doin' somethin' for those XAS eggheads? Somethin' to do with glowy crystals? Better get it done before they get antsy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Early results suggested those iridescent crystals enhance healin'. You've confirmed it, pal. In fact, the healing properties are even stronger now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work out there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've submitted your new scan results to the XAS for review. Not only have your findings confirmed the initial results, but you've discovered that the crystals have grown in power since the first survey.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Darkstone has asked you to eliminate the now-savage augmented creatures around Darkstone's Landing. While you're in the field, be sure to keep an eye out for some cold survival kits that missed their intended drop point.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Darkstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Between the loss of our survival kits and hostile augmentations, we're walkin' a real thin line. Find those kits, and kill some augmentations while you're at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: As if freezin' ain't bad enough, our people are bein' hurt by those damned augmentations. Find those cold survival kits and kill some of those augmented freaks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those cold survival kits are a real life-saver, and not havin' those augmentations crawlin' around hurtin' folks is even better.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we don't get those kits back, we'll be in a world of hurt.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope ya didn't get none of that augmented blood on ya... didja?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to recover the cold survival kits while eliminating several augmented creatures. Between the lack of hostile beasts and the presence of the much-needed survival kits, Exile mortality rates in the Northern Wastes should decrease.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're a real piece of work, buster.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Darkstone has requested your assistance locating several Exile explorers who were last seen near the crashed ship. In addition, a stowaway was discovered, but he's gone missing, too.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Darkstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some folks left to check out the crashed ship. Now they're missin' along with an Aurin stowaway we caught. Better find 'em before they freeze to death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You ain't found 'em all, or they're not here yet. Either way, I expect ya to get this job done before the weather gets worse.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job findin' those people, along with that filthy stowaway. Can't be too hard on him, though. He got more than he bargained for on this trip.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring 'em back here safe 'n' sound. They won't last long out there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep up the good work, chum.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the missing Exiles, as well as the stowaway, and killed a colossal beast in the process. Captain Darkstone seemed pleased by your excellent work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You talkin' to me? Then who else are you talkin' to? you talkin' to me?

localizedTextIdText: General Tusk has asked you to eliminate the now-savage augmented creatures around Camp Icefury. While you're in the field, be sure to keep an eye out for some cold survival kits that missed their intended drop point.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Tusk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Augmentations have been attacking our people, and some idiot pilot dropped our survival kits in the wrong place. Find those kits and slaughter the augmentations!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where are the cold survival kits? And why are those augmented aberrations still attacking my men? Get out there and see to your task!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The blood of the augmented turns to ice in the snow and our people are warm once more. You have done well, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The cold survival kits are imperative, as is the destruction of our enemies.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In due time, the Northern Wastes will belong to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to recover the cold survival kits while eliminating several augmented creatures. Between the lack of hostile beasts and the presence of the much-needed survival kits, Dominion mortality rates in the Northern Wastes should decrease.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I shall see you entombed in an icy grave for your insolence.

localizedTextIdText: Nydra has instructed you to extract tissue samples from augmented Exiles in Exo-Lab 729's
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan constructs from Exo-Lab 729 have augmented Exile troops. The Exiles' modifications must be studied. You will collect samples from their corpses.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can find the augmented Exiles inside the Kinetic Enhancement Lab. Waste no more time in collecting the samples I require.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These samples are sufficient for my needs. I will analyze them once I have properly rewarded you for your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This assignment should be your highest priority, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm glad to help you out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected tissue samples from Exile troops who had been augmented by the constructs in Exo-Lab 729's Kinetic Enhancement Lab and delivered them to Nydra.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I was not aware of your squeamishness. Regardless, you will do this.

localizedTextIdText: Varynn Longstar has instructed you to extract tissue samples from stranded Exiles who were augmented by Eldan constructs in Exo-Lab 729's
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Varynn Longstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A lot of Exiles were augmented by the Eldan constructs inside that exo-lab. I need samples from them to find out how long they've been that way.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can analyze tissue from the Augmented Exiles to figure out how long that lab's been unlocked, but first I need you to get those samples together.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll begin my analysis of these tissue samples right away. That you had to kill those poor Exiles to collect them is tragic, but unavoidable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: All those poor people are as good as dead. It's so sad!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected tissue samples from Exile troops who had been augmented by the constructs in Exo-Lab 729's Kinetic Enhancement Lab and delivered them to Varynn Longstar. Hopefully the data will be useful to the XAS.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, come on! Aren't you supposed to be a hero?

localizedTextIdText: Initial Exile surveys of the iridescent crystals in the Northern Wastes revealed latent healing properties. The Royal Collegium would like to perform a survey of its own, and you have been selected to seek out these crystals and scan them in the Ghostpyre Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Tusk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Initial Exile scans indicated the crystals in the Northern Wastes have unusual properties. The Collegium requests new scans to confirm the Exiles' results.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Initial Exile scans indicated the crystals in the Northern Wastes have unusual properties. The Collegium requests new scans to confirm the Exiles' results.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: From what I have been told, the Royal Collegium has given you a task to scan the crystal in the Northern Wastes. Do not keep them waiting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Collegium is pleased with your results. Not only do these crystals possess healing properties, but they are more potent than initially thought.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work, Scientist.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've submitted your scan results to the Collegium for review. Not only have your findings confirmed the Exiles' initial results, but the crystals seem to have grown in power since their original survey.

localizedTextIdText: Old supplies, lost and forgotten, litter the Northern Wastes. The Pioneering League has requested that you recover ammunition and medical supplies in Ghostpyre Plains, at the crash site, in the ruins of Settler's Reach, and in Camp Icefury.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Darkstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pioneering League has discovered caches of supplies throughout the Northern Wastes. Secure the medical supplies and ammunition before the Dominion can.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Pioneering League has discovered caches of supplies throughout the Northern Wastes. Secure the medical supplies and ammunition before the Dominion can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Pioneerin' League's waitin' on the ammo and medical supplies you told 'em you'd recover. Better move quick or the Dommies'll get to 'em first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work collectin' all that ammo, and especially the medical supplies. I'll make sure they get distributed fairly to those who need 'em most.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered ammunition and medical supplies to support the Pioneering League's efforts in the Northern Wastes. Captain Darkstone will ensure that the supplies are fairly distributed to Exile forces.

localizedTextIdText: Old supplies, lost and forgotten, litter the Northern Wastes. The Settlement Authority has ordered you to recover ammunition and medical supplies in Ghostpyre Plains, at the Crash Site, in the Ruins of Settler's Reach, and in Camp Icefury.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Tusk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Settlement Authority has detected caches of abandoned supplies throughout the Northern Wastes. Secure the medical supplies and ammunition for our use.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Settlement Authority has detected caches of abandoned supplies throughout Northern Wastes. Secure the medical supplies and ammunition for our use.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Settlement Authority requires you to collect supplies that the Exiles left behind when we drove them from this land. Collect the supplies at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The supplies you collected will be of use. More importantly, you denied them to those Exile vermin. I will notify the Settlement Authority at once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered ammunition and medical supplies to support the Settlement Authority's efforts in the Northern Wastes. General Tusk will ensure that the supplies are fairly distributed to Dominion units.

localizedTextIdText: FCON command is concerned about supply shipments that haven't been making it to the base. Some of them undoubtedly get "enjoyed" during transit, but command suspects others are being eaten by scavengers. Investigate the last known location of the missing supplies at the Crash Site and defend them if necessary.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Darkstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: FCON command reports a number of missing supply drops in the Frozen Plains region. Locate the supplies and see what is keeping them from reaching us.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: FCON command reports a number of missing supply drops in the Frozen Plains region. Locate the supplies and see what is keeping them from reaching us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Slaggin' scavengers are raidin' our supply drops near the crash site. FCON needs you to get your buns over there, find the supplies, and keep 'em safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hate yeti. They're always gettin' into our stuff, droolin' their yeti slime all over it. You did good slaggin' a few of 'em. Maybe they'll learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Anyway, FCON's happy with what you done. Keep it up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked down the missing supplies and defeated the augmented yeti scavengers who were consuming them. Yeti weren't the only ones pilfering food from FCON shipments and you discovered that a large augmented frost giant was the worst offender of them all.

localizedTextIdText: Before you can see to your duties in the Northern Wastes, you must first receive a welcome briefing from the Briefing Station in Camp Icefury. Attend to your briefing closely, then expect additional instructions from Anonius Nelles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anonius Nelles via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your expertise is required, but you are not authorized to provide support until you've been briefed. Report to the camp's Briefing Station at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To claim victory, you must be well-informed. To go ignorantly into battle ensures your demise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased by your results. The weapon data cache you recovered is more valuable than you will ever know.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Expect to hear from me once your briefing has been concluded.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is not over, $(player.name). Not by a long shot.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I do good work, don't I?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After arriving safely in Camp Icefury in the Northern Wastes, you were briefed on the region's dangers. With your briefing concluded, Anonius Nelles ordered you to locate a lost cache of weapon systems data, and was pleased by your subsequent success.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Those are words to live by.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Negativity is unpatriotic. Do you know what happens to unpatriotic citizens?

localizedTextIdText: Before you can see to your duties in the Northern Wastes, you must first receive a welcome briefing from the Briefing Station in Darkstone's Landing. Attend to your briefing closely, then wait for additional instructions from Ashlii Moonwind.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashlii Moonwind via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All newcomers need to receive a welcome briefing from the briefing station here in camp. It's not real exciting, but it should bring you up to speed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If our people aren't given the proper information about the Northern Wastes, it'll be that much harder to secure a lasting victory against the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job getting that data. If the Dominion had gotten it, they'd know a lot about our flight patterns, routes, and airborne protocols.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll be in touch when you've finished the briefing, alright?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, are you ready for something really exciting?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see to my briefing, then.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That'd be a very bad thing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After arriving safely at Darkstone's Landing in the Northern Wastes, you were briefed on the region's dangers. With your briefing concluded, Ashlii Moonwind ordered you to retrieve the onboard systems records from the crash site, and she was pleased by your subsequent success.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't you get it? I can't put you to work until you've been briefed!

localizedTextIdText: In the absence of both the Dominion and the Exiles, new threats have taken over the Northern Wastes - specifically, the Ghostpyre Moodies and the Rime Hide Skeech. Anonius Nelles has ordered you to kill their tribal leaders in Ghostpyre Plains and Coldburrow Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anonius Nelles via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This land has become infested by Moodie and Skeech parasites since we were last here. I want you to seek out their tribal leaders and eliminate them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Moodie chief cavorts with his tribe in the Ghostpyre Plains, while the Skeech matron holds court in Coldburrow Village. Kill them both.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that they are leaderless, the Skeech and Moodie tribes will descend into chaos. Well... even more chaos than normal, I should think.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The creatures are little more than beasts. Show them no mercy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've done the Dominion a great service by violently killing the Moodie and Skeech leaders in the Northern Wastes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have I misplaced my faith by entrusting it to you? Such a pity.

localizedTextIdText: In the absence of both the Dominion and the Exiles, new threats have taken over the Northern Wastes - specifically, the Ghostpyre Moodies and the Rime Hide Skeech. Ashlii Moonwind has ordered you to kill their tribal leaders in Ghostpyre Plains and Coldburrow Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashlii Moonwind at Darkstone's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a Skeech tribe called the Rime Hide in the Northern Wastes, as well as the Ghostpyre Moodies. Kill their leaders and it might take them down a notch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We can't be fighting a battle on three fronts. If you can neutralize the Moodies and Skeech, then we'll only have the Dominion to worry about.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did real good killing those monsters. If we're lucky, the Skeech and Moodie tribes will lose cohesion without their leaders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, now. Moodies and Skeech are really mean!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let me say, it's really exciting to have you here, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've done the Exiles a great service by violently killing the Moodie and Skeech leaders in the Northern Wastes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Some great hero you turned out to be!

localizedTextIdText: Long ago, the giant tower in the Atmospheric Control Facility was used by the Eldan to manipulate the weather in the the Northern Wilds. When the Exiles accessed the tower, they inadvertently opened up Exo-Lab 729. Anonius Nelles has ordered you to investigate the tower and find a way into the lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anonius Nelles in Camp Icefury
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Intel suggests the Exiles opened up an exo-lab when they entered the atmospheric control facility. Find that lab and investigate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to fully explore the exo-lab the Exiles revealed after they crashed in the Northern Wilds. You had best get to work before they discover it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done much to prove your skill, not to mention your loyalty, to the Dominion. I am proud to have you here among my operatives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I believe that lab holds many valuable Eldan secrets.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Farewell, $(player.name). I am quite certain other chores await you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Exo-Lab 729 and the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and retrieved important augmentation records. Additionally, you destroyed Augmentor KEL and lived to tell the tale, making the area much more secure for the Dominion in the Northern Wastes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you be so daft? This assignment is mandatory, $(player.name)!

localizedTextIdText: Long ago, the giant tower in the Atmospheric Control Facility was used by the Eldan to manipulate the weather in the Northern Wilds. When the Exiles accessed the tower, they inadvertently opened up Exo-Lab 729. Ashlii Moonwind has ordered you to investigate the tower and find a way into the lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashlii Moonwind via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A while back, we used the Eldan tower to end a massive storm that threatened us. I think we might've opened a door to an exo-lab, too. Can you confirm?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we did open a door into an exo-lab, it would explain all the augmentor constructs we've seen. Who knows what else might be in there?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm not sure how that lab was missed when we were here the last time. I guess they were too occupied with leaving the Northern Wilds to explore very much.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Start with the tower, but be careful. I have a feeling it's not safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for sticking your neck out so we could learn the truth.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Exo-Lab 729 and the Kinetic Enhancement Lab and retrieved important augmentation records. Additionally, you destroyed Augmentor KEL and lived to tell the tale, making the area much more secure for the Exiles in Northern Wastes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're putting us all at risk, you know.

localizedTextIdText: Supply shipments have been going missing in the Northern Wastes. The Dominion military wants them found in Ghostpyre Plains and, if necessary, defended from scavengers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Tusk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion military reports a shocking loss of supply shipments in the area. Command requests that you locate and defend one of these shipments.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Dominion military reports a shocking loss of supply shipments in the area. Command requests that you locate and defend one of these shipments.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without regular supply drops, our forces cannot expect to push the Exiles out of the Northern Wastes. Find our supplies and defend them from thieves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The yeti are simple creatures, but they are worthy prey. Destroying them may deter the beasts from stealing our supplies in the days to come.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The military thanks you for your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the missing supplies in Ghostpyre Plains and defended them from scavengers. The Dominion military is pleased with your performance.

localizedTextIdText: General Tusk has requested your assistance locating several Dominion explorers who were last seen near Camp Icefury. To make matters worse, one of the expedition's DRED agents has vanished.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Tusk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A group of explorers has gone missing along with one of our DRED agents. Search the area for them and ensure they return to camp safely.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The explorers have not returned, and the DRED agent is still missing. Search the area until they are found or I will see that you regret your indolence.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done! Our people have returned safely and your mission was a success. Obviously your blood burns hot and true in this frozen wilderness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No one but a Draken could survive long in this environment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We will speak again, $(player.name). Enjoy the hunt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the missing explorers, as well as the DRED agent. General Tusk seemed pleased by your excellent work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you afraid of the cold? You are better served fearing me, scum!

localizedTextIdText: Exile communications in the Northern Wastes are weak and spotty. Help to create a more efficient network by marking new beacon locations with flares near the Atmospheric Control Facility and in Ghostpyre Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Darkstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exile comm network in the Northern Wastes is plagued by outages and spotty performance. Light flares at locations where new beacons can be installed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Exile comm network in the Northern Wastes is plagued by outages and spotty performance. Light flares at locations where new beacons can be installed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Damned comm network! Keeps droppin' my signal! How am I supposed to get good stogies if I can put 'em on order? Answer me that, bub!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those new beacons really cleaned up our comms. I ordered my stogies and everything. If you're real nice, maybe I'll even give ya one.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What's that? Ya wanna live forever, $(player.name)?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your efforts to create a more efficient Exile communications network in the Northern Wastes were a resounding success. So long as the new beacons remain functional, the Exile network will continue to function at peak efficiency.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get some new beacons planted.

localizedTextIdText: Dominion communications in the Northern Wastes are weak and spotty. Help to create a more efficient network by marking new beacon locations with flares near the Atmospheric Control Facility and in Ghostpyre Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Tusk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion forces require a more robust communications network to secure the Northern Wastes. You will light signal flares for new beacons at key locations.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Dominion forces require a more robust communications network to secure Northern Wastes. You will light signal flares for new beacons at key locations.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The communications network in the Northern Wastes requires improvement. You will light flares at the specified locations so new beacons can be deployed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our communications signals are much stronger following the placement of new beacons. This will ensure we are connected to our troops in the field.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have ensured that our comm network will not be our weakest link.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your efforts to create a more efficient communications network for the Dominion in the Northern Wastes were a resounding success. So long as the new beacons remain functional, the Dominion network will continue to function at peak efficiency.

localizedTextIdText: General Tusk has asked you to assist the Dominion in establishing a defensive perimeter around their camp. Several turrets and security cams have been set up around Camp Icefury, but they must be repaired. For the empire!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to General Tusk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our engineers placed turrets and security cameras, but the enemy disabled these defenses. I give you the honor of bringing them back online to secure the perimeter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The cameras and turrets must be activated to establish a secure perimeter. Camp Icefury must be defended at all costs. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that our perimeter defenses are functional, the Dominion can withstand nearly any assault in the Northern Wastes. Excellent work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be warned. I have heard reports of something moving around out there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Remain close. This is far from over.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get them up and running.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They'll be in for a surprise.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After repairing the Dominion defense turrets and security cams, you faced down a group of augmented survivors. If not for your valiant efforts, Camp Icefury might have been lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see to it right away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your entrails would make a fitting decoration for our perimeter, yes?

localizedTextIdText: WANTED: Darkbite, Queen of the Nightfangs. Her ruthless destruction of Verdant Vale cannot be permitted to continue.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Geomapper Varala via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: REWARD!\nDarkbite, Queen of the Nightfangs, is wanted for her ruthless destruction of Verdant Vale. Kill her. All payments will be made by Geomapper Varala.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: REWARD!\nDarkbite, Queen of the Nightfangs, is wanted dead for her ruthless destruction of The Verdant Vale. All payments will be made by Geomapper Varala.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: In our attempts to map the surrounding area, we encountered Darkbite, Queen of the Nightfangs, deep in Verdant Vale. What a horrible beast!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for making these dangerous lands a little safer for us to explore. The Explorers Union would like to show its appreciation for your heroic efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks again, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put an end to this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Darkbite, Queen of the Nightfangs, and you ended her tyranny throughout Verdant Vale.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll put an end to this.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put an end to this.

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered some peculiar objects on your homestead. For one, there's a strange totem planted near a pile of Ancient Remains, seemingly as some kind of warning. Still, it wouldn't be respectful to leave the bones exposed... would it?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Get in touch with the housing representative on the skymap
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This strange totem stands next to a pile of ancient bones that seethe with unearthly power. Perhaps you should give them a proper burial.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This strange totem stands next to a pile of ancient bones that seethe with unearthly power. Perhaps you should give them a proper burial.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your homestead is provided to you as-is, with no guarantees expressed or implied. Enjoy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Like any enterprising landowner, you have done a fine job of ridding your homestead of undesirable rubbish and detritus. Excellent work!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Ghosts weren't mentioned in the brochure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In your attempt to give the Ancient Remains a proper burial, you unwittingly disturbed a number of restless spirits! Despite their aggressive nature, the ghosts were no match for you, and the danger they posed will no longer haunt your hovering homestead.

localizedTextIdText: Toric Antevian has requested you respond to a priority one distress call from the expedition team at Mistymurk Camp. The expedition was sent there to investigate the presence of Eldan ruins.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Nerissa Artan at Mistymurk Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Prior to the storm, an expedition was sent to investigate some Eldan ruins. There's been a distress call from their camp, and I want you to check it out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You'd best get out to Mistymurk Camp and see what all the trouble's about. We can't afford to lose that team.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, it's about bloody time! I sent that distress signal hours ago, and you're the first relief we've had. The whole camp's liable to be overrun!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Eldan ruins are a cornerstone of our work here. Secure them if you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's the spiders, $(player.class)... the giant bloody spiders!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Toric Antevian requested you respond to a priority one distress call from the expedition team at Mistymurk Camp. The expedition was sent there to investigate the presence of Eldan ruins.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm not impressed by your lack of fervor.

localizedTextIdText: Anonius Nelles wants you to offer your aid to Dominion operatives in Ghostpyre Plains, outside Coldburrow Village, and near the Kinetic Enhancement Lab. By aiding these individuals, you will be helping to claim the Northern Wastes in the name of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anonius Nelles via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've forced the Exiles to flee the Northern Wastes once before. This time will be no different. You will seek out my agents and support their efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have three operatives in the field here - Kadu Fizz, Captain Marius, and Researcher Nydra. Your orders are to find and assist them... now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My operatives have provided confirmation that you have reported in. Do the Dominion proud in your efforts to aid them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Well? Don't just stand there. Be on your way, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Anonius Nelless orders, you located Kadu Fizz, Lucretia Marius, and Nydra in the Northern Wastes and offered to assist them in their duties.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you really think you can disobey me? You have another thing coming.

localizedTextIdText: Ashlii Moonwind wants you to offer your aid to Exile agents in Ghostpyre Plains, outside Coldburrow Village, and near the Kinetic Enhancement Lab. By aiding these individuals, you will be helping to secure the Northern Wastes for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashlii Moonwind via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must keep the Dominion from conquering the Northern Wastes. I've got agents in the field, but they need your help if we're going to win this battle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to my agents yet? Dominik Kaspukov's in Ghostpyre Plains, Varynn Longstar's by that nasty exo-lab, and Maude's near Coldburrow Village.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dominik, Varynn, and Maude have informed me that you've been in touch with them. Thank you so much for helping us out!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's wonderful! Those guys need all the help they can get.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Right! If we're going to win this thing, it's going to take a team effort!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Ashlii Moonwind request, you found Dominik Kaspukov, Varynn Longstar, and Maude Fairvale in the Northern Wastes and offered to assist them in their duties.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're kidding, right? I can't believe you'd come all this way and not help!

localizedTextIdText: Your homestead is plagued by Obstructive Fyrre Tree and Rootbrute Squatter. Conveniently, you've found a crate of Protostar Detonating Dough which you can use to destroy them. To that end, use the Protostar Detonating Dough to remove the Obstructive Fyrre Tree and Rootbrute Squatter around your homestead.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protostar Housing Specialist via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Trees obstruct your homestead's view and rootbrutes hinder construction. Fortunately, you should be able to remove them with these explosives!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You still have some Protostar Detonating Dough left in this crate, as well as some trees and rootbrutes to blow up with it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How goes the Protostar Detonating Dough test? Do you still possess all of your limbs?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that you've violently removed the fyrre trees and rootbrutes from your homestead, you're well on your way to building your dream home!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I think we can consider the Protostar Detonating Dough beta test a success!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: It's time for a little demolition!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Protostar Detonating Dough to remove unsightly Obstructive Fyrre Tree and eliminate Rootbrute Squatter. You didn't even kill yourself in the process, which points to a job well done!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Protostar Housing Specialist

localizedTextIdText: Mayor Hamhorn has requested that you come view the devastation the Ravenous Mordesh have caused to District Falls.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mayor Hamhorn in District Falls
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: District Falls is a shambles! And it's all 'cause of those damnable Ravenous zombies! You gotta help! I'm beggin' you, partner! Please!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By Belle's blazin' bustier! We're in a world of hurt! Them Ravenous is causin' all kinds of trouble! Come to District Falls 'n' help us out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You came? By Brightland's eyes, you did! We're saved! At least... I hope we are! It's a mess here, worse than I ever seen!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They say you know how to handle them Ravenous! Is it true? Please say it is!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Them Ravenous is everywhere, but they mostly come out at night... mostly!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Mayor Hamhorn and viewed the damage in District Falls.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm called Hamhorn! I'm the mayor of District Falls, don't you know? And by all the blazin' stars in the sky, I really need your help!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Used to be the nicest district in Thayd! We was makin' the finest metals for the Exiles on Nexus. Then them Ravenous showed up and started eatin' folks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you say no? How? We're in dire straits! You gotta help!

localizedTextIdText: Stickypaw has been stealing all the honey from the buzzbing hives near Nibben's Ranch. Fannie Nibben has posted a rich bounty for anyone brave enough to kill the beast and bring her proof of the deed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Stickypaw's Paw to Fannie Nibben at Nibben's Ranch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: NOTICE\nAnyone who kills Stickypaw, a honey-hungry girrok, can claim a BIG reward. For more information, speak to Fannie Nibben at Nibben's Ranch.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: NOTICE\nAnyone who kills Stickypaw, a honey-hungry girrok, can claim a BIG reward. For more information, speak to Fannie Nibben at Nibben's Ranch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That damn girrok's stealin' all our honey! We'll be ruined if that beast keeps up its shenanigans!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be dipped in honey! That's got to be Stickypaw's paw! How'd you kill the beast? Oh, never mind... here's the bounty on him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No, don't thank me... you did the work, you earned the reward fair and square.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the rampaging, honey-hungry girrok known as Stickypaw and earned a healthy reward from Fannie Nibben for your trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take Stickypaw's Paw to Fannie Nibben

localizedTextIdText: Sheriff Steambolt has asked you to follow the trail of Marshal Yatish, Malgrave's greatest lawman. Speak to the Sheriff's deputies along the way and see if the Marshal needs help solving Shinysand's Dreg problem.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Marshal Yatish in the Witherdust Plains
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Marshal Yatish stopped a Dreg assault yesterday before leaving town with some of my deputies. Would you mind finding him and verifying his well-being?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Do not just stand there. Find the Marshal - and my deputies - and make sure they are functional.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You jabber at Yatish? Yatish not wish to jabber with you now. Come back later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yatish glad you here, partner. It come down to you and Yatish. Together, we end Dreg menace with hot fire and shiny blood.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yatish is an unstoppable justice dispensation machine! In organic terms.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy to help out a legend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed a trail of dead bodies and destruction, left in Marshal Yatish wake, before finally meeting him at the site of his most recent skirmish.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Aren't you a little short for a marshal?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Marshal is the most capable lawman in these parts. Why, I once saw him kill a half dozen Dreg with a single spear toss.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: He went off to find the Dreg camps the attack originated from. I get the impression he was going to give them a "good lickin'," as he would say.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Processing denial of justice dispensation. Error. Abort, retry, fail?

localizedTextIdText: Shaman Arokya has come to Farshade Vale to administer last rites to the Lopp that were killed when Darkspur gangsters crushed them with sandstones from the cliffs above. The shaman has asked you to recover his fallen brethren from beneath the sandstones.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Shaman Arokya in Farshade Vale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Glad you come. Darkspur baddies caused avalanche, crushed Lopp friends with sandstones. Can't leave dead friends behind, must give proper rites!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Destroy sandstones, find poor crushed Lopp bodies. Arokya knows, job is very sad. Evil rocks will pay for this!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now Arokya can perform the ritual of goodbyes, known as the "Stripping of the Shinies." Let me look... where this one's wallet?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring bodies back and Arokya send dead Lopp to hunt shinies in sky.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes! No want shinies to go to waste. Lopp cannot take shinies with them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Is rifling their pockets part of the ritual?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to recover the bodies of Shaman Arokya brothers and sisters that had been crushed beneath sandstones in Farshade Vale. The shaman performed the "Stripping of the Shinies" - the Lopp last rites - for each of them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then Arokya think you are faithless kurg doo-doo.

localizedTextIdText: Shaman Arokya is worried about the spikehordes that have shown up in Farshade Vale. He believes they are strengthening a dark presence and has asked you to rid the area of the twisted, evil rockshell spikehordes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Shaman Arokya in Farshade Vale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some rocks fall from sky, some rocks crawl from ground. Rocks bad in general. Big-folk must kill evil rocks that scratch and click and bite.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Walking rocks. Falling rocks. Rocks bring death to Lopp and friends. Kill Rockshell spikehordes, get revenge!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You show all the bad rocks error of ways. Show them good. Rocks not mess with Lopp anymore, I think.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Arokya always knew rocks were tricksy spies!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Shaman Arokya cleanse Farshade Vale of the evil rockshell spikehordes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Lopp small, but not afraid to break big-folk's knee caps.

localizedTextIdText: Shaman Arokya has asked you to use a thumper to flush the evil from its hiding places. If you succeed, Farshade Vale will be free of evil at last!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Shaman Arokya in Farshade Vale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Arokya gonna get revenge on evil rocks. Big-folk use ground thumper, hit 'em where they live. Maybe even draw out the rock overlord for big fight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Thumper set up near here, by the tall rocks. Tall rocks center of evil rock conspiracy, Arokya feels it in his bones. May Dak-Buun guide big-folk's hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp struggle against evil rock conspiracy is over, for now. Arokya is sure that more rocks lie in wait, afraid of $(player.race) hero!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Not silly! Believe Arokya when he say this evil plot goes deep underground!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Watch your back... rocks are everywhere.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It turns out that Shaman Arokya was right. There was, in fact, an evil presence beneath the sands of Farshade Vale. You slew the creature and finally cleansed the area of darkness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then Lopp keep shinies to themselves.

localizedTextIdText: Marshal Yatish has gone to fight the Dreg. As such, he is unable to make his usual rounds in Malgrave. Chief Gorral in Shinysand Oasis has asked you to check on the Lopp in other parts of Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Gorral via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Marshal Yatish go kill Dreg, so he have no time to check on Lopp. You strong! You make sure Lopp are safe, yes? Go talk to Rancher Rishka first!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you here? You need to check on Lopp.... Lopp who are not here! Start with Rishka!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All Lopp okay, yes? You do good job! Almost as good as Marshal Yatish!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let me know when done! Let me know Lopp are well! Now go!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With Marshal Yatish busy fighting against the Dreg, it was up to you to check on the Lopp settlers in Malgrave. Chief Gorral was happy that you were able to help.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Who do I need to check on?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Who is Treasure Hunter Pallavi?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Many Lopp live in Malgrave. Want you to check on Rancher Rishka, Shaman Arokya, and Treasure Hunter Pallavi.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Rishka take care of animals. Desert dangerous for animals... dangerous for Lopp, too! You make sure she okay!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Arokya powerful Lopp shaman. Great magic! But even powerful shaman need help sometimes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Pallavi is treasure hunter! Very good at searching for shinies, too! Maybe you help her find shinies?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk not want to help? Then Lopp not help, either.

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Pallavi is intent on taking back any and all shinies stolen by the Darkspur Cartel. To start with, she'd like you to disable the Darkspur Hauler. Collect Simple Eldan Key around the Darkspur Hauling Station, then use it to disable the Hauler's drive system.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Pallavi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Darkspur have many shinies - shinies that should be for Lopp. Lopp must take them back. You help Lopp by breaking space ship. Is easy! Just use bombs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: See space ship? Over there! Go break space ship so space ship cannot fly away! Darkspur have lots of bombs, so use bombs. Ship go boom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp love fireworks! Did plan work? Is space ship broken now?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Shinies on Darkspur ship. If ship broken, Darkspur can't take them away!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good news for Lopp! Bad news for Darkspur!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll blow that ship up good.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The ship's drive system is toast.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected Simple Eldan Key at the Darkspur Hauling Station, then used it to disable the Darkspur Hauler. Treasure Hunter Pallavi plan to take the Darkspur's shinies for the Lopp seems to be progressing rather well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am good at using spear. Want to see?

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Pallavi insists that the leader of the Darkspur hauling operation, Carmine Lucido, must be killed if the Lopp are to take possession of the map he keeps on his datapad. He can usually be found napping at Lucido's Leisure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Treasure Hunter Pallavi in Robber's Rest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Carmine Lucido is Darkspur boss, has maps on tiny computer. He lazy, sleep all day long. You wake him up and kill him for Lopp? Bring back computer?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Carmine Lucido is bad, lazy man. Sleep while other Darkspur take shinies. Find him, wake him, kill him. Easy, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You kill Lucido? Take tiny computer? Please give computer to Lopp - computer show Darkspur maps!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes! Sing him Lopp lullaby, only not so gentle.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Can't wait to see where shinies are hiding!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put him to sleep for good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You caught Carmine Lucido napping in Lucido's Leisure. You took him down once and for all before locating his datapad and returning it to Treasure Hunter Pallavi. Now the Lopp have access to the maps used by the Darkspur Cartel in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How you let Lucido live? How?

localizedTextIdText: Abandoned Mining Equipment{p: Abandoned Mining Equipment} contains many maps, each of them detailing where shinies have been buried in the Volatile Field. The only problem is that the area has been strewn with mines. Treasure Hunter Pallavi at Robber's Rest has asked you to brave the mines and recover the shinies!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Treasure Hunter Pallavi at Infiltrator's Advance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This map great! So many shinies! Only one teensy, tiny problem - shinies buried in minefield! You go to minefield, dig up shinies?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lucido wanted shinies all to himself. But Lopp will share shinies with all! Go to minefield, find shinies! Bring them back so Lopp can share!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice shinies you find. Best Lopp ever see. Not celebrating too loud, though. Darkspur still close by!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Trust Lopp! Shinies worth risk! Watch step, though - Lopp still need you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: These shinies better be worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the mines in the Volatile Field and collected a number of excellent shinies for Treasure Hunter Pallavi.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You not like shinies? You feel okay?

localizedTextIdText: Following Carmine Lucido death, Treasure Hunter Pallavi reports that the Darkspur Cartel has dispatched several Enforcers to Swindler's End to take charge of the situation. She's asked you to kill Darkspur Enforcer before they get wind of the Lopps' plans.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Pallavi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Darkspur mad that Lucido take dirt nap. They send enforcers to investigate. You must kill enforcers  before they stop Lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Darkspur enforcers still in Swindler's End. This is no good. Lopp want them dead, remember?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Enforcers all dead. You so good at killing! Make Lopp proud! Now is time to strike Darkspur camp!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You make Lopp very happy. Go now and kill enforcers. Kill them good.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Almost done, big friend! Lopp promise!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can kill a few more gangsters.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into Swindler's End and took out the Darkspur Enforcer before they could put a stop to Treasure Hunter Pallavi plan to steal back the Cartel's shinies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you too scared, you run and hide!

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Pallavi believes that the time is right to relieve the Darkspur of all their shinies. She's asked you to plant Lopp Homing Beacon near Treasure Pile in Swindler's End. The beacons will allow the Lopp to come and collect the Darkspur's loot.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Treasure Hunter Pallavi in Shinysand Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With enforcers dead, now is time to take all the Darkspur shinies! Place homing beacons near treasure piles in Darkspur camp. Quickly!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp not clear? Place homing beacon next to shinies... big people call it 'treasure.' Big people use such strange words.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The shinies are ours now! Lopp must offer you gratitude for helping to steal so many excellent shinies from bad Darkspur people!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once beacons placed, Lopp will come to steal shinies for Shinysand!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You hero to Lopp! Big hero! Now many, many Lopp children want to be just like you! Only smaller and cuter!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You placed Lopp Homing Beacon near Treasure Pile in Swindler's End, allowing the Lopp to claim the loot collected by the Darkspur Cartel in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You get no shinies if you no help Lopp.

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Agni believes that the Darkspur Cartel should respect the Eldan artifacts and not be selling them off to the highest bidder. He's asked that you collect the Eldan artifacts around Swindler's End.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Agni via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan artifacts need respecting! Darkspur selling them to anyone. Not acceptable. Gotta rescue those shinies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Swindler's end is full of treasure - Eldan artifacts everywhere. Easy to take - if you can beat up the Darkspur. I know you can do it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Agni grateful to you! Lopp will keep Eldan shinies safe, show proper respect.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't worry, Lopp will take good care of them!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I see where this is going.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Treasure Hunter Agni by recovering Eldan artifacts from Swindler's End.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If Eldan artifacts destroyed, then big-folk to blame.

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Agni thinks that a bundle could be made off the Darkspur Cartel if the Lopp could get the market data from their Halon Ring market terminals in Swindler's End.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Agni via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: New kind of shiny to steal! Darkspur keep data on Halon Ring market terminals. They all around Swindler's End, you can't miss.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp not clear? Halon Ring market terminals all around Darkspur camp. You get digital shinies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Digital shinies are the future! Data is good, Lopp corner shiny market in no time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Lopp have data, Lopp know best price for different shinies!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A share of the shinies!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Working for Treasure Hunter Agni, you lifted market data from the Darkspur Cartel's Halon Ring market terminals in Swindler's End.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So, you not smart enough to get data. Lopp find someone smarter than you.

localizedTextIdText: With all the excitement you've been causing in Swindler's End, the stage in the Speakeasy has been abandoned. Take a page from the Karaoke Song Book, grab hold of the Darkspur Microphone, and prove to the Darkspur Cartel that you can croon with the best of them!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Quit singing while you still have a head, and close the Karaoke Song Book in the Speakeasy
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Karaoke song book is filled with classic Darkspur hits, and the stage in the Speakeasy is unoccupied. It's time to show the Darkspur how to rock 'n' roll!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get up on that stage and show those intergalactic gangsters how rock 'n' roll is done!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your musical selection wasn't up to the Darkspur Cartel's questionable standards. Still, you defended your artistic integrity in true rock 'n' roll style!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I've got one shot at this. Let's rock!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You mounted the Speakeasy Stage, sang your heart out, and rocked it! Unfortunately, the Cartel didn't approve of your song selection. It seems there's no accounting for taste in music.

localizedTextIdText: You've come across an Eldan fuel rod inside of Exo-Lab X1BB. Treasure Hunter Agni called you to ask if you would be willing to teach the Lopp how to start up the fuel rods. You'd be happy to... you just need to learn how first.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Agni via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This pylon seems inactive, but still functional. How does it turn on? Who knows? But you might be able to find out with a little bit of trial and error.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This pylon seems inactive, but still functional. How does it turn on? Who knows? But you might be able to find out with a little bit of trial and error.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(player.name) find Eldan pylons in Exo-lab near Darkspur place? Getting Eldan tech to work is hard, but rewards very shiny!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This information important. Help us make most of Eldan shinies. Thank you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's try turning this thing on.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After learning the start-up sequence for the Eldan fuel rods inside of Exo-Lab X1BB, you transmitted the data to Treasure Hunter Agni.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let's try turning this thing on.

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Agni wants to know more about the Eldan constructs inExo-Lab X1BB. She's asked you to fight some to better evaluate the threat they may pose to the Lopp of Shinysand Oasis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Agni via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan machines look tough... too tough for Agni! But not too tough for strong $(player.race). Maybe you fight machines, give report to Lopp?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Eldan exo-Labs hide many secrets... like secret shinies and secret killer constructs! Maybe not best secret to find, but maybe easy to kill.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That quick! You good at fighting machines - bam, pow, smash! Maybe you teach Agni.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You show Eldan things that big-folk mean big business. So do Lopp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe Agni get strong and try machine fighting someday.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was a piece of cake.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Treasure Hunter Agni by destroying Eldan constructs located inside Exo-Lab X1BB.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Machines too tough for you too?

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Agni believes that a cunning master construct is likely running the facility. She's asked you to head deeper into the Ruins of Exo-Lab X1BB to face the construct.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Agni via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like Eldan turn on security machine. They protect Eldan shinies. Exo-lab may have big bad guard machine deep in lab! Must find and kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Exo-Lab might have scary guard machine. Eldan make machines to guard their shinies. Big strong $(player.race) fight monsters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whoa, super scary machine dead! Lopp lucky to have big-folk hero to explore and beat up monsters. You Agni's favorite $(player.race)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Eldan security very scary. Be careful!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll destroy it if it's there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the request of Treasure Hunter Agni, you destroyed the Facility X1BB administrator located in the Ruins of Exo-Lab X1BB.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp thought you were big and strong. But you smaller than Lopp.

localizedTextIdText: The Foulflesh Dreg have captured a number of innocent Lopp. Marshal Yatish will not let these poor Lopp suffer, or end up as food for the Dreg. He's asked you to free captured Lopp from the pits and sacks in the Dreg slave pens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg savages capture Lopp, place Lopp in sacks and pits. Some Lopp, Dreg eat. Others, they kill for feet. You go to pens. Make Lopp free.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Not all Lopp free. You give up? Or is big-folk scared of Dreg?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp strong, but sometimes need help. You do well to save Lopp captives before Dreg ring dinner bell. Yatish pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Dreg barbarians think Lopp feet lucky. Yatish will show them.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll free the Lopp from the Dreg.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed many Lopp from their Dreg captivity, saving them from being stewed and eaten by their cannibalistic captors. Marshal Yatish was pleased that you acted so quickly, but he will have more in store for you - and the Dreg - before the day is done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bigfolk make bad decision.

localizedTextIdText: The Foulflesh Dreg viciously defend their slave pens, eagerly awaiting intruders or escapees. Marshal Yatish wants you to brave the slave pens, taking the fight to the Dreg and weakening their defenses.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg guard slave pens, kill or capture all who come or flee. Yatish give Dreg good lickin', teach Dreg painful lesson. You help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yatish not impressed with $(player.name). Can $(player.name) do better?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good start. Much Dreg blood spilled on sand. But Dreg breed like jabbits - always more come later. Must be vigilant.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. Yatish curious to see what $(player.name) can do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: You can count on me, Marshal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the slave pens in Malgrave on Marshal Yatish orders and seriously weakened the Dreg defenses.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yatish thought you were smarter. Was wrong.

localizedTextIdText: Marshal Yatish wants you to find the leader of the Foulflesh Dreg and deliver speedy justice to him for the evils he has committed against the Lopp. You can find the Dreg leader, Pitboss Loppfoot{p:Pitboss Loppfoot}, at his tent in Foulflesh Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Marshal Yatish outside Foulflesh Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg leader is Pitboss Loppfoot. Loppfoot think he scary, strong, mean. Really just stupid and cruel. Time to kill.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Pitboss Loppfoot still alive. Yatish give you chance to kill Loppfoot, serve bloody justice on him. Go, now, before Yatish kill Loppfoot himself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Pitboss Loppfoot still alive. Yatish give you chance to kill Loppfoot, serve bloody justice on him. Go now before Yatish kill Loppfoot himself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pitboss Loppfoot so much bloody meat now. You killed him good, almost as good as Yatish would. $(player.name) very talented for big-folk!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Justice important. Will put end to Dreg plans, at least for now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks not necessary. You hero now, just like Yatish... but still more to be done.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll make sure he's brought to justice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You faced Pitboss Loppfoot{p:Pitboss Loppfoot} and soundly defeated him. Despite their leader's death, the Dreg will more than likely continue hunting Lopp. Some people never learn.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yatish smell stink of coward on big-folk.

localizedTextIdText: In order to ensure the Dreg leave the area, Marshal Yatish wants to burn their village to the ground. He has instructed you to set fire to everything in Foulflesh Village, thereby denying the Dreg shelter from Malgrave's brutal environment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Loppfoot dead, but Dreg still not leave. We must use fire to burn Dreg village. Go! Burn them out for all Lopp of Shinysand Oasis.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why you wait? Go to Dreg village. Burn all the things. Yatish grows impatient!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you wait? Go to Dreg village. Burn all the things. Yatish grows impatient!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dreg village gone. Is good. Yatish pleased. You are expert at givin' good lickin'!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yatish like fire. Fire take away bad things. And fire is shiny.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll add that to my resume.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You set Foulflesh Village alight, burning it to the ground. Without shelter from the elements, the Dreg will either leave... or die.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk not like fire? Big-folk very strange.

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg of Foulflesh Village believe that Lopp feet are lucky, so they cut off Lopp feet and keep them as souvenirs. Marshal Yatish wants you to show them that Lopp feet don't bring luck... rather, they bring bloody revenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg cut off Lopp feet. Keep feet for luck. Maybe Dreg feet lucky, too? We find out, yes? Cut off Dreg feet, bring to Yatish.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Yatish see Dreg everywhere. You blind? Take Dreg feet. Then Lopp have lucky charms.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yatish see Dreg everywhere. You blind? Take Dreg feet. Then Lopp have lucky charms.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dreg feet big, ugly, stinky. Not lucky... not lucky at all! Maybe Dreg will learn lesson about taking Lopp feet. Probably not.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp need all the luck they can get... for finding shinies.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Old Lopp law says, "Eye for eye, foot for foot." Yatish understand now.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sounds like poetic justice to me.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: But... what do I do with all these feet?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: What do you know? Dreg feet aren't lucky after all! Marshal Yatish says that killing the Dreg of Foulflesh Village will have to be its own reward.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Chopping Dreg feet makes you sick?

localizedTextIdText: Only one threat remains in Foulflesh Village: the gorganoth known as Fleshrender! Marshal Yatish has asked you to find Fleshrender and kill it before it can exact bloody revenge on the Lopp of Shinysand Oasis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Marshal Yatish in Shinysand Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Almost done! Must kill Dreg monster, "Fleshrender." If not, Fleshrender get mad, stomp Shinysand Oasis. You help?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find big Dreg monster in Foulflesh Village. That Fleshrender. Monster must die. Be careful, is big! Very big! Huge, even!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find big Dreg monster in Foulflesh Village. That Fleshrender. Monster must die. Be careful, is big! Very big! Huge, even!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fleshrender die, just like Loppfoot and other Dreg scum. Yatish very impressed! Deserve reward for all help. Take this shiny reward, Lopp friend!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soon you be real hero of Lopp, like Yatish. Only not as small and cute.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.name) will always be remembered by Lopp as Shinysand Savior!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Fleshrender and put an end to the threat posed by the Foulflesh Dreg in Malgrave. Thanks to you, the Lopp of Shinysand Oasis are safe, and Marshal Yatish has a new trophy!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: That beast won't stand a chance.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: That beast won't stand a chance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yatish think you should reconsider. Don't want to see Yatish when angry.
