localizedTextIdText: The Jr. Field Marketing Agent would do more work, but the canimid make it too difficult to extend operations beyond the Witherdust Plains. He's happy to give you a temporary pest control contract with Protostar, but only if you wipe the canimid out for good.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Jr. Field Marketing Agent at the Protostar Marketing Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You look capable. How'd you like to work as a Protostar pest control specialist? The canimid population in this region is, shall we say, unchecked.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Excuse me... but Protostar's not paying you by the hour, and the canimid aren't going to kill themselves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: For an amateur pest control specialist, you've done an admirable job! Allow me to dispense payment for services rendered, minus my own finder's fee.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I may get some work done once you take care of those dastardly creatures!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh... I'm joking, of course! Just a little Protostar humor. Ha. Ha.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the Jr. Field Marketing Agent request, you significantly reduced the number of canimid in Witherdust Plains. Maybe now he'll be able to get some real work done.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Jr. Field Marketing Agent
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You should reconsider before this goes on your permanent record.

localizedTextIdText: The Jr. Field Marketing Agent assistant has disappeared, doubtless due to the canimid that infest Witherdust Plains. He has offered you a generous reward if you can find his lost assistant (though "generous" is a somewhat subjective term when Protostar is concerned).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Jr. Field Marketing Agent at the Protostar Marketing Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Has your assistant ever wandered off into a canimid-infested wasteland and never returned? How would you like to help me locate him... for money?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found my assistant? I have no clue where that lazy clone's gotten to. Perhaps you'll find him, maybe even today?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm so pleased that you saved my assistant. I had no idea how all this work would get done without a servile mouth-breather at my beck and call.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Your compensation for the safe return of my assistant will be generous!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't spend it all in one place, unless it's at a Protostar retail outlet!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I'll find him... for money.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully located and rescued the Assistant Jr. Field Marketing Agent in Witherdust Plains, and the compensation offered by the Jr. Field Marketing Agent lived down to your expectations.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Jr. Field Marketing Agent
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You lack the decisiveness of a successful employee!

localizedTextIdText: The Assistant Jr. Field Marketing Agent has been ordered to place Protostar Marketing Kit throughout Witherdust Plains, Foulflesh Village, and the Dreg Slave Pens on the off chance that their demographics can be tapped by Protostar. Following his encounter with the canimid, he's decided to subcontract the task to you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Assistant Jr. Field Marketing Agent at the Protostar Marketing Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My superior wants me to place Protostar marketing kits in the Dreg camps and canimid burrows. After my last ordeal, I think I'd rather contract you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Activate the marketing kits in the Dreg camps and canimid burrows to set them up. This could open up a whole new market for us!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You really know how to get things done! We're already showing a market increase of one percent, with a margin of error of plus or minus two percent!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: For an individual with your predilections, it should be a snap!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm sure it will! I mean... it has to! Right?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help. How hard can it be?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Good for you. I hope it works out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You placed marketing signs in Witherdust Plains and in the nearby Dreg encampment and slave pens. The Assistant Jr. Field Marketing Agent showed his gratitude to you with a cash reward.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Assistant Jr. Field Marketing Agent
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You realize this will never work, don't you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, don't be such a pessimist. The canimid and Dreg are two vast consumer markets just waiting to be tapped!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I really need this opportunity. Look at where I am, for Phineas's sake!

localizedTextIdText: The Bounty Board at the Protostar Marketing Camp lists a substantial bounty for the death of Spidertron. The massive, augmented arachnid can be found lurking in the Silent Crevasse.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Jr. Field Marketing Agent in the Protostar Marketing Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar is proud to offer a cash reward for proof of Spidertron's death! Under no circumstances will Protostar pay for live delivery of Spidertron!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING: Spidertron is extremely dangerous! She lurks within the dramatically-named Silent Crevasse. Seek her out there... if you dare!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you angling to collect a bounty on Spidertron? Protostar does not pay for work that hasn't been done! It's bad for business, you understand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It appears as if you've done the improbable! Spidertron was a menace, and you've done her in. I'm authorized to provide you with this reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be profitable!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Spidertron? This is a joke, right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed the incredibly dangerous Spidertron and collected a substantial reward... from Protostar!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Jr. Field Marketing Agent

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Agni has asked you to stop the Darkspur Cartel from carting any more "shinies" off the planet. To do this, you'll need to whittle away at their labor force at the Darkspur Hauling Station, which consists of loaders, dockhands, mechanics, and the supervisors who boss them around.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Agni via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Darkspur load shinies on ships, ships fly away, take shinies. You kill Darkspur, they not load shinies on ships, shinies stay here. You help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Darkspur still put shinies on ships! Soon, no more shinies here. Be quick, kill Darkspur!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.race) strong! $(player.race) deadly! No more Darkspur to load shinies on ships!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That what Lopp like to hear!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lopp like cake. But Lopp like shinies more!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was a piece of cake.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It was an easy enough task to weaken the Darkspur Cartel's labor pool at the Darkspur Hauling Station. With many of the workers dead or wounded, the number of "shinies" taken from the surface of Nexus will be greatly reduced.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk nothing but big coward...

localizedTextIdTitle: So, Robo-Cultists are a Thing Now
localizedTextIdText: Many of Shinysand Oasis's Freebot residents have begun worshipping a strange robotic intelligence within Sparklemire Mine. Deputy Whirlscrew is concerned, and has asked you to destroy the Robo-Cultists before they can convert more Freebots.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deputy Whirlscrew via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Apparently, Robo-Cultists exist. Who knew? We need to stop this sectarian sickness before it turns other Freebots into fanatical killers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Robo-Cultists are down there, in Sparklemire Mine. Though it pains me, they must be disassembled for the greater good.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do not allow your guilt processors to overwhelm your sense of duty. The Robo-Cultists represented a dire threat to Freebots everywhere.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you, fellow sentient. I would go myself, but I would be converted.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sure I'll get over it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into Sparklemire Mine and destroyed a slew of Robo-Cultists on behalf of Deputy Whirlscrew. Though more Robo-Cultists remain, their ability to spread their message of destruction to other Freebots has been seriously curtailed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What is this robo-cult all about?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why don't you go do it yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They are killers. They want to kill all organic life and spread word of their corrupting faith to other Freebots. This is unacceptable.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I would, but I suspect that my processor may be overcome by the religious zeal of the cultists. I would hate to lose my Freebot freedom!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Such zealotry is not freedom! How can you ignore such a catastrophe?

localizedTextIdText: Deputy Whirlscrew has detected anomalous transmissions coming from Sparklemire Mine. He's asked you to venture into the mine and destroy any cultist paraphernalia that might be broadcasting the cult's viral signals.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deputy Whirlscrew via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Something in Sparklemire Mine is turning mild-mannered Freebots into killers! I need you to go in there and smash any cultist paraphernalia you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have detected a number of transmissions coming from the mine. I suspect they will CPU-wash me if I wander too close.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Propagandatrons, eh? Now my aural sensors have processed everything. Nevertheless, the signal has been greatly diminished. Good job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am what you would call "happy" to have your assistance, fellow sentient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent, as there is still the cultists' leader to consider....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and destroyed several Robocult Propagandatron within Sparklemire Mine. Hopefully this will reduce the power of the robo-cult's signal and prevent them from converting other Freebots.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I did not understand your answer. Was that a negative response?

localizedTextIdText: Deputy Whirlscrew has deduced that the leader of the robo-cult is somewhere deep within Sparklemire Mine. He has asked that you find this "Preacherbot" and destroy it with extreme prejudice!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Deputy Whirlscrew outside of Sparklemire Mine
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The cult's proselytizing signals indicate the cult's leader - a "Preacherbot" - is deep within Sparklemire Mine. Destroy him and the madness will end.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Triangulation of the cult transmissions indicates they originate deep within Sparklemire Mine. Find this "Preacherbot" and smash him to bits!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A giant robot head deep within the mine, you say? It must have corrupted the robo-cultists' code, making them believe they were Eldan Annihilators.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not underestimate him. Crazed battlebots are dangerous and deadly!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I concur. I will communicate with my superiors to arrange a demolition.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: He's as good as junk, Deputy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We might want to destroy that head.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully dismantled Preacherbot v.6.6.6, a crazed and zealous battlebot that had tapped into some kind of massive robot head. Now it's only a matter of time before the robo-cult fades into obscurity... you hope.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now is not the time to falter! You are the Freebots' last hope!

localizedTextIdText: The Gargleblast Marauders have set up an illegal slush-brewing operation on Slushstill Plateau, kidnapping the famous Cassian brewers, the Vinos family, to do their bidding. Marcel Vinos has asked you to take out some of the Marauders as payback.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marcel Vinos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Gargleblast Marauders have kidnapped my family and forced them to brew absolute bilge! Kill them, and I will see you are rewarded justly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Nexus will be made a better place for every Gargleblast Marauder you kill. You'll find the scum up on Slushstill Plateau.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I don't know how we will ever live down the shame of brewing... pirate slush! But the death of these Marauders certainly helps assuage the pain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Vinos name has been synonymous with fine brews for ages! Oh the shame!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can never forgive these Marauders for their dreadful brew!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took out quite a few Gargleblast Marauders, to the intense satisfaction of Marcel Vinos.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: You couldn't free your siblings?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My siblings and I travel throughout Nexus in search of rare brewing components. We'd heard of the fabled hellrose nectar and came to Malgrave in search of it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Gargleblast ruffians waylaid us on the road and took us to their brewing operation up on the plateau. They forced us to create absolute rot using the most disgusting ingredients known to living beings!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Even in the worst of situations, a brewer of my class cannot pass up the challenge of creating something worthy of drinking. My brew so intoxicated my captives, I was able to break free and run...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Alas for poor Primo, poor Secundus, and my darling little sister Marcella, I could not. I'm no fighter or master of stealth... but you look like you could handle the situation ably.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Gargleblast Marauders must be made to pay for what they've done!

localizedTextIdText: Marcel Vinos and his family were captured by the Gargleblast Marauders, who wanted to use their expertise to brew illegal slush. Marcel escaped, but the rest of his family is being held captive on Slushstill Plateau. Find them and help them escape.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marcel Vinos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Please, you must help! My family and I were traveling through Malgrave when we were kidnapped by pirates and forced to work their filthy stills.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Primo, Marcella, and Severus are being held in the camp at the top of the plateau. Distract the Marauders - in other words, kill them - and free my siblings!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bless the Scions! You may have single-handedly preserved the legacy of Dominion brewing, the Granok be damned! How can I ever thank you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You have no idea. Once, we brewed for emperors! And now... oh the shame!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought your way through Gargleblast Marauders and managed to locate the remaining Vinos siblings, freeing them from their brewing servitude.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do the Marauders want with you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Vinos family is renowned as the finest collective of artisan brewers in the Dominion. My siblings and I are responsible for brewing unique and delectable beverages fit for the emperor himself! But now...we're reduced to brewing bilge!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can you grasp the horror of creating a subpar product? It is soul crushing!

localizedTextIdText: Marcel Vinos has asked you to destroy the odious moonshine being brewed by the Gargleblast Marauders. Destroy their stills on Slushstill Plateau to put a halt to the illicit production of toxic brew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marcel Vinos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That effluvium the Gargleblast Marauders call "slush" is an insult to respectable alcohol. Destroy their stills for the sake of all our palates.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those stills up on the plateau are essentially time bombs as it is. It shouldn't take much to cause an explosion - and good riddance, I say!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, thank Dominus! The palates and livers of civilized people everywhere will thank you for that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just being on the same planet as that vile brew is enough to make me sick.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You'd be surprised...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew the Gargleblast Marauder stills sky high, putting a dent in slush production.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Gargleblast Marauders combine unspeakable ingredients to create the odious moonshine known as "slush." If they are allowed to bootleg their abomination, everyone in Malgrave will either go blind or die of liver failure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Beware of the slush. One drink and you could go blind. Or crazy. Or both.

localizedTextIdText: To bring the illicit brewing operations of the Gargleblast Marauders to a screeching halt, Marcel Vinos has asked you to take out Merciless Mek, the mastermind behind the kidnapping and slush brewing scheme. He's hiding out at his secret tasting lab on one of the smaller plateaus near Slushstill Plateau, which can be accessed only through a hidden pathway.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marcel Vinos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Merciless Mek is the leader of the Gargleblast. Nobody can get to his secret tasting lab - unless you know about the hidden pathway.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I only learned of Mek's hidden pathway when I saw him disappear from the Gargleblast brewing camp. Corner him there to put an end to this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I only learned of Mek's hidden pathway when I saw him disappear from the Gargleblast brewing camp. Corner him there to put an end to this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With that calculating little slank gone, the Marauders won't have enough brain cells left to trouble civilized people. Or their livers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do it for the brew. Avenge the honor of fine beverages everywhere!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're a credit to your kind, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Merciless Mek hidden pathway and cornered him in his hideaway high above the deserts of Malgrave. The Gargleblast brewing operations should fall apart without him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Here's your chance to put an end to this travesty, and you walk away?

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland has discovered a gang of Marauders setting up shop up on Slushstill Plateau. He's asked you to take them out as a prelude to shutting down their illegal slush brewing operation.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Gargleblast gang's runnin' a slush brewin' scheme here in Malgrave. You best flush 'em out and kill some of 'em before we shut 'em down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: These Gargleblast bootleggers got a vicious streak a light-year wide. Best be gettin' rid of 'em before they cause real trouble.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The only good Marauder's a dead Marauder, you ask me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep an eye out. Give 'em an inch, they'll slit yer damn throat.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: If the pile of corpses is any indication, there are a lot less Gargleblast Marauders left to trouble the good folk of Malgrave.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The answer to that, friend, is you don't wanna know. Cheap hooch brewed from stars only know what. Them Marauders will put just about anything into it. I know folks that've gone blind or crazy from drinkin' that stuff.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You ain't worth the dust on your boots. Now git, before I turn mean.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland sent in three of his scouts to scope out the Marauder operations on Slushstill Plateau, but they've been captured. Deadeye Brightland wants you to find and free Scouts Swifton, Millden, and Lockwood.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You ain't the first one I've sent in. Lost three of my best scouts to these blasted Marauders. Do me a favor and see if you can find 'em for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Last I heard, the Gargleblast had captured my scouts and were keepin' them alive up on Slushstill Plateau. See what you can do 'bout that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Everybody's checked in safe. Good job. Don't suppose I could ask for better.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Much obliged. Hate to lose good folk to these space scum.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to find Scouts Swifton, Millden, and Lockwood and set them free from the vile clutches of the Gargleblast Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Folk that don't help others out have a funny way of endin' in bad ways.

localizedTextIdText: The slush the Gargleblast Marauders are brewing is just as liable to kill someone as it is to make them drunk. Deadeye Brightland wants you to blow up the slush stills on Slushstill Plateau and shut down production.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I like a swig as much as anybody, but this slush is pure poison. The Gargleblast'll have a hard time makin' more of it if you blow their stills up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Brewin' ain't exactly a full-time occupation for space pirates. Blow up those stills and they'll have a hard time gettin' set back up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: When we get back to town, we'll have some decent drinks... on me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We don't want innocent folk goin' blind from drinkin' this stuff, do we?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Slush is apparently as combustible as it is toxic. With a little creative tweaking, you were able to detonate the slush stills and create a serious supply problem for the Gargleblast Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mebbe I didn't hear you. One sec, lemme get my gun out while you say that.

localizedTextIdText: It's time to shut down this slush brewing operation. Deadeye Brightland wants you to take out the Gargleblast leader, a wily Eeklu named Merciless Mek. He has a secret tasting lab that can only be accessed via a hidden pathway, near Slushstill Plateau.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've dealt with Merciless Mek before, and he's one sneaky little slank. He's got a secret tastin' lab he hides out in. I want you to find him and take him out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mek's got a thing for secret rooms and hidden pathways. Sniff him out and put an end to the little rodent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that's what I call a job well done. Without Mek, this whole slush brewin' operation oughta fall apart straight away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll be waitin' to hear from you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll be seein' you, $(player.name). Keep your powder dry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the hidden pathway and made your way to the secret tasting lab, where you made quick work of Merciless Mek. Without his brains, the whole slush brewing operation should fall apart, leaving the folks of Malgrave - as well as their livers - safe from the schemes of the Gargleblast Marauders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're in way too deep to stop now, friend.

localizedTextIdText: Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp hates vulcarrion with a passion. If you kill Sandswept Roan in the Rattlebone Sands, the Blightwing Circler should come down to feed on their remains. When they do, slaughter the filthy scavengers! Game Hunter Joresh has graciously provided you with a high powered rifle to make short work of the Sandswept Roan.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I hate vulcarrion - can't abide the filthy things. They flock to Rattlebone Sands like flies to... well, ya know. How'd ya like to do some pest control?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Them vulcarrion is rife with parasites 'n' disease. They don't do no one no good, least of all me. Best kill 'em if ya want yer reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work killin' them vulcarrion for me. I hope ya didn't get none of their guts on ya. That's how folks get sick, y'know.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lure the vulcarrion in by killin' a roan. When they land, let 'em have it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's a little somethin' for your time 'n' trouble, friend.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Nope, I'm clean as a whistle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed a lot of vulcarrion (and, consequently, roan) in the Rattlebone Sands, making Game Hunter Joresh a very happy fellow.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well, for one, they're ugly. For two, they eat dead stuff, so they're full of disease. And for three, ya can't eat 'em, so they got no purpose.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's a hard job, but I thought you had the backbone for it.

localizedTextIdText: Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp wants you to collect cactus apples in Rattlebone Sands and Gravestone Valley for Nelly, his pet Kurg. Malgrave Cacti are tough as nails, but when you crack 'em open, delicious fruit can be found inside!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got me a new kurg, named her Nelly. Would ya mind rasslin' up some cactus apples for her? My Nelly sure loves herself some cactus apples!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I ain't got time to harvest cactus apples for Nelly, which is why I was hopin' you'd lend me a hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those are some of the sweetest-lookin' cactus apples I ever seen. Nelly's gonna love 'em! Thanks, pal!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks, chum. I got a sweet deal on her in Shinysand... she's a real beaut!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here ya go, Nelly-girl! Tasty cactus apples, courtesy of $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a bounty of native cactus apples for Nelly, Game Hunter Joresh pet Kurg.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where do I get cactus apples?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ya can find 'em inside cactus plants. Just bash 'em open and pick 'em out, but mind ya don't get poked by the spines.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, come on now. You don't wanna help feed my kurg?

localizedTextIdText: Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp is looking for a bunch of Archaeology Tools{p: Archaeology Tools} to sell to Protostar. They can be taken from Red Shaleback in Rattlebone Sands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The biggest, meanest critters 'round here are red shalebacks. I kill 'em for their hooves, ya see? So how 'bout ya lend me a hand and get me some hooves?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Red shalebacks are mean. But they got four hooves each. Kill 'em, cut 'em off, profit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Will ya look at that? You just doubled my hoof-take for this trip, chum! Thanks a million!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! You're gonna make us both rich, pal!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll bring back some shaleback hooves.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered a pile of Archaeology Tools{p: Archaeology Tools} to Game Hunter Joresh, and he was quite pleased with the quality and timeliness of your delivery.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want shaleback hooves?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where can I find red shalebacks?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I sell 'em to Protostar. Those crazy clones use 'em in the manufacture of Granok furniture, if ya can believe it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That's easy. You look for 'em where they sleep - in the ground. See? Now you're an expert!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are, on occasion, a worthless sack of skin.

localizedTextIdText: Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp hates chompacabra even more than he hates vulcarrion. He wants you to hunt chompacabra along Scatterbite Ridge and kill as many of the critters as you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Them damn chompacabras took a chunk outta Nelly. Nearly took a chunk outta me, too! I want 'em dead - all of 'em! Or as many as ya care to kill.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Them chompacabras practically own Scatterbite Ridge. Head that way and you'll find plenty of 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya did a damn fine job stompin' them chompers, chum! I'd've done it myself, but I couldn't bear to leave my sweet Nelly all alone!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit! Now go on and make 'em regret ever coming near my camp!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed a number of chompacabra for Game Hunter Joresh along Scatterbite Ridge. You get the vague impression that Joresh might be just a little bit afraid of the things... but you don't dare tell him that to his face.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are ya one of them flowery varmint huggers?

localizedTextIdText: Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp intends to see the chompacabras on Scatterbite Ridge completely wiped out. He's asked you to deny them their homes by planting explosives in their mounds and blowing them sky high.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Game Hunter Joresh at Joresh's Hunting Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Chompacabras are all teeth - they ain't got no meat on 'em. I say we get rid of 'em, once 'n' for all. Let's blow up their mounds with some explosives!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for the chompers' mounds on Scatterbite Ridge and blow 'em to kingdom come!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should be the end of that! I reckon the rest of the chompers'll scamper off in no time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: 'Course it's fun! Chompers killed with explosives is like a roan's rhapsody!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I sure love me the sound of explosions. Don't you? It's music to my ears!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think they'll get the hint.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You planted explosives in Chompacabra Mound on Scatterbite Ridge, turning the voracious critters' homes into smoldering craters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got somethin' better to do out here?

localizedTextIdText: Rancher Rishka is worried about the number of girrok that appear to be hunting the dawngrazers she's supposed to be watching throughout Sunbeak Steppes. She's asked you to hunt girrok to help protect her herd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Rancher Rishka in Rancher Rishka's Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Big troubles all over Sunbeak Steppes! Bad girrok eating lovely dawngrazers. You help kill girrok? That would help keep dawngrazers safe!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Grazers are dying! To protect them, must kill girrok on Sunbeak Steppes!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You huge help! Dawngrazers would thank too if they could talk! They can't though. Sorry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Maybe we cook the girrok. See how they like it when we eat them!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You protected Rancher Rishka dawngrazer herd by slaying girrok throughout Sunbeak Steppes. Rancher Rishka explained that the dawngrazers would have thanked you if they could, but they can't because they don't talk.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You no want to help Lopp?

localizedTextIdTitle: Can't Make an Omelet Without Eggs
localizedTextIdText: Rancher Rishka at Rancher Rishka's Camp left her lunch behind in Shinysand Oasis, and could use a snack. It just so happens that her favorite food is ravenok egg omelets. She'd appreciate help getting some eggs from nests throughout the Sunbeak Steppes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Rancher Rishka in Rancher Rishka's Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Forgot lunch at home. Can't leave dawngrazers alone. Oh! Maybe you get ravenok eggs for Rishka? I love omelets! Especially with veggies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ravenok all over Sunbeak Steppes. Many nests! Many eggs! You fetch for Rishka so she can eat!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Eggs! Look at eggs! Eggs too big! But beautiful, too. Thanks! Omelets for everyone! You want omelet, too?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Many ravenok on Sunbeak Steppes. Probably why it named that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Rancher Rishka was thoroughly amazed by both the number of ravenok eggs you retrieved, as well as their size relative to her stomach.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk no like eggs? Is like little round box filled with yum!

localizedTextIdText: Rancher Rishka at her camp on the Sunbeak Steppes believes it's time to bring her Dawngrazer herd in, and she wants you to help. She's given you her "Friendmaker" tazer for use on roughback dawngrazers. Zapping them this way should send them running right back to Rishka.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Rancher Rishka in Rancher Rishka's Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Time for herd to return, but shouldn't leave camp! You help? Take Friendmaker tazer. Use it on dawngrazers, then they know to come home to Rishka!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This easy! Just use Friendmaker tazer on dawngrazers. They get hint pretty quick and come back to Rishka!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You such a hero to Rishka! Now Rishka bring dawngrazers home to Shinysand. All safe, all sound! Well, almost all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Give dawngrazers a charge and they not charge you. Funny joke, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Juice? I never find juice in tazer. Big-folk strange!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think your tazer is out of juice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned several roughback dawngrazers to Rancher Rishka using her "Friendmaker" tazer. She was very appreciative of your help!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll send them back to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not happy with big-folk now. Go away.

localizedTextIdText: You located a fragment of a burned journal in Malgrave. Once you've found all the pages, take the journal to Rancher Rishka at her camp. She may be able to tell you more about it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Rancher Rishka in Rancher Rishka's Camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many pages have been torn out of this nearly-destroyed journal. If the missing pages were gathered, it might contain some useful information!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Many pages have been torn out of this nearly-destroyed journal. If the missing pages were gathered, it might contain some useful information!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Rishka not make much of journal with so many missing pages. Find other pages, then Rishka can help big-folk read it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This very interesting! It diary. Looks like Lopp join Darkspur Cartel. He no like Darkspur, made Lopp sad, so he left. Are some funny bits too!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You put journal puzzle together. Good work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reconstructed the burned journal and gave it to Rancher Rishka. Rishka said it was a diary of a Lopp who'd joined the Darkspur Cartel, but who left after becoming ashamed of what he'd done. Whether the story is true or not, Rancher Rishka found it to be entertaining.

localizedTextIdText: High Priestess Raumia is concerned about ensuring the loyalty of the Lopp colony in Shinysand Oasis. Depart for town at once and get a feel for the more important Lopp, then report back to the High Priestess for further instructions.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to High Priestess Raumia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The will of the Empire must be seen to, even in arid cesspits like Malgrave. Speak with the Lopp population, gather intelligence, then contact me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing here? I sent you to speak to the Lopp! You had best proceed to Shinysand Oasis at once and get a feel for their loyalty.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. Commit to whatever the Lopp ask of you, ensure they view us favorably, and our presence will spread throughout Malgrave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly, now. The Exiles are likely ahead of us by now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Eldan's gift to us shall not be squandered.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: High Priestess Raumia was pleased with your work. She instructed you to further engage the Lopp at Shinysand Oasis, assisting them as required, in order to win their loyalty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare refuse the will of the Dominion?

localizedTextIdText: Sally Kettleshaw in the Exile camp needs you to meet and befriend the Lopp of Shinysand Oasis. This gesture of goodwill will hopefully ensure the Exile settler's needs are met.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sally Kettleshaw via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got a big ol' favor for you. We need friends out here, and there's a Lopp colony down the hill. Meet the locals and report back to me, ya hear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well? You finished meetin' with them Lopp yet? We gotta make friends out here, 'cause the only other neighbors we got are those Dominion slimeballs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These Lopp fellas and ladies sound like a good, solid bunch. Why don't you do some work for 'em and get us in their good graces?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good on you. I'll be here waitin' for the good word!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I got more settlin' to get to, but I'll be around!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to the Lopp in the Shinysand Oasis on behalf of Sally Kettleshaw. They seem like a good people, and with a little persuasion, they could prove helpful to the needs of Exile settlers in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Like you ain't really gonna help them.

localizedTextIdText: Fry Cook Mohini seems obsessed with making anything into a high-fat delicacy. She has asked you to venture to Chittering Reach and bring back tasty spider legs, as well as mandibles from the spikehordes of Shinysand Beach.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Fry Cook Mohini at Shinysand Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fry oil make anything taste good! Lopp have plenty fry oil, just need meat! Hunt for wild game, bring back meat! Lopp fry it up good!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp still need meat for deep fried rations. Get tastiest spider legs and yummiest spikehorde mandibles. Great for frying. Chop chop!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, goodie goodie goodie! Lopp have plenty of meat for deep fried spidery spikey dinner! Many thanks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Spiders edible, right? Spikehordes, too?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Worry not! Lopp have strong hearts!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: How can you eat that stuff?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Fry Cook Mohini was thrilled with the meat you brought her. You're not sure which is more lethal - the spider meat, or the sheer amount of frying oil. Either way, the Lopp are apparently much hardier than anyone guessed.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get the legs and mandibles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk not know just how tasty fried things are!

localizedTextIdText: Fry Cook Mohini wishes to make meals out of two mighty beasts - Pelagic the Tidebreaker, a spikehorde on Shinysand Beach, and the infamous Mr. Chitters, the arachnid lord of Chittering Reach. Kill the creatures and haul their corpses back to Fry Cook Mohini.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Fry Cook Mohini at Shinysand Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp hears of big, BIG beasts! Lots of meat! Rare! Mr. Chitters and Pelagic the Tidebreaker! Lopp want to fry them up for many, many dinners!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Got plenty of oil, but still need meat! Get Mr. Chitters and Pelagic for Lopp! Bring back bodies for slaughter and frying!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Meat! Meat! Piles of meat! Lopp make deepfried masterpiece! Thank you, strong person! Lopp give you first bite!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry, hurry! Lopp, hop, chop!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So many ways to fry, so little time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Fry Cook Mohini was satisfied with the remains of both Pelagic the Tidebreaker and Mr. Chitters. You expect she'll be cooking sandwisp and spikehorde surprise for the next month. The important thing is, you can pat yourself on the back knowing that you've contributed to the largest deep-fried dish in known space.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're missing out!

localizedTextIdText: Chief Gorral, like any right-thinking Lopp, wishes to plunder the shinies at the wrecked ship on Shinysand Beach. He's asked you to clear the beach of the "big scaries" so the Lopp can safely gather the wreck's treasures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Gorral via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Space ship crash into ocean, filled with many shinies! Lopp can't go. Too many spikehordes want to eat Lopp! You get rid of big scaries for Gorral?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kill big scaries on Shinysand Beach yet? Lopp want to get shinies from crashed ship, but spikehordes in way. Please be getting rid of them now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Happy happy! You kill all big scaries! Now wreck easier to get to without nasty spikehordes. You so strong!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go now. Hunt big scaries! Be fierce!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lopp have more to ask of strong person! You help Lopp get more shinies?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can take care of it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared Shinysand Beach of all the "big scaries," but Chief Gorral still seems less than eager to enter the ship himself. You expect that he's going to push the task of the actual plundering off on you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You big, but your heart small. This Lopp look elsewhere.

localizedTextIdText: Chief Gorral has tasked you with finding the shinies in the Wreck of the Novus. Take a swim inside and gather whatever shinies you can find and show them to him. Hopefully they're what he's looking for...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Gorral via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Beach clear of big scaries, but Lopp want good shinies from ship. Since strong person already there, maybe strong person bring back shinies?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Strong person bring back shinies from ship yet? Ship shinies? Gorral very much want shinies from wreck. More shinies always better than less.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, yes, very shiny... well worth trip! Ship empty now? Lopp get kurg ready, just need find diving suit....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, you so kind to Lopp. Lopp pay you much for this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Strong person know where Lopp find kurg-sized diving suit?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Apparently Lopp aren't terribly picky about their shinies, because Chief Gorral was practically skipping for joy at the pile of "treasure" you brought back for him. This should ingratiate him to your cause...once he's done counting them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bah! Lopp have no need of you!

localizedTextIdText: A starship has crash-landed near Shinysand Oasis. The shipwreck is filled with malfunctioning securitybots which pose a threat to the Lopp settlement. Sheriff Steambolt has asked you to "dismantle" the malfunctioning securitybots inside the Wreck of the Novus before they cause too much trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sheriff Steambolt via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Recent scans reveal hostile securitybots within the wreck of a ship that crashed near Shinysand Oasis. For public safety, the bots must be dismantled.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have the unruly securitybots in the Novus been dispatched as previously discussed?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This unit is impressed with your efficiency in destroying the Novus's securitybots. My calculations have revealed the root cause of their hostility.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Deactivation is a waste of resources, but this unit must protect the Lopp.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of the bots.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the wreck of the Novus and handily deactivated a number of malfunctioning securitybots. With the bots out of the way, all that remains is to learn the reason for their erratic - and violent - behavior.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me about the crashed ship.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The ship is called the Novus. We believe it was a Dominion vessel that malfunctioned. We have yet to determine why the ship crashed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Rejection of justice unexpected. Error. Retry query?

localizedTextIdText: Sheriff Steambolt has learned that the Novus, a starship wreck near Shinysand Oasis, was likely crashed by a rogue artificial intelligence. He's asked you to shut down the Novus's three power stations, then download the AI into your datachron so the Freebots can repair its faulty code.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sheriff Steambolt via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have determined that a rogue AI is active aboard the Novus. Shut down the ship's security and download the AI into your datachron.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Locate the ship's three security terminals and deactivate them before downloading the AI. There is not much time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I appreciate the risks you took to emancipate the Novus's AI. The Freebots will ensure it is reprogrammed to do good instead of evil.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I fear it is the only way we can salvage something from the destruction.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Freedom can have a profound effect on grumpy AIs. So long!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Um... okay, if you think that's wise.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope so. That thing isn't very nice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You shut down the Novus's power stations prior to downloading the RIX-AI into your datachron. Sheriff Steambolt rewarded you for your efforts and took possession of the AI so the Freebots can attempt to "rehabilitate" it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Wait. You want me to download the AI?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Of course! It is a sentient being, just like you and I. The Freebots can rehabilitate it, turning it into a productive member of our society.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I did not expect that AIs would upset your dispensation of justice.

localizedTextIdText: Far-Trader Sumana yearns for "shinies" within the ruins of Gravestone, a desolate ghost town. However, as the town is a literal "ghost town," she can't enter safely to hunt for the lost treasures without your help. Venture into Gravestone and assess its profitability to the Lopp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Ol' Higgins in the Town of Gravestone
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp hear of treasure in Gravestone. But bandits kill everyone. Now town full of ghosts - kurg not go near! You go, explore Gravestone for Lopp?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You explore Gravestone yet? Find shinies or ghosties? Or both?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What in tarnation are you doin' here? This is our town, 'n' we don't take kindly to no looters!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good! Talk to ghosties. Or beat up ghosties. Lopp happy either way!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It might be that yer decent folk. I can think of a few ways to prove it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I ain't afraid of no ghost.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found more than you bargained for in Gravestone. A cantankerous old ghost, Ol' Higgins, and his wife, Ma Higgins, guard the gates while ghostly bandits roam the streets. If you intend to hunt for the treasure, you'll probably need some ethereal help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp thought big-folk not scared of nobody.

localizedTextIdText: The ghost of Ol' Higgins in Gravestone has given you a chance to prove your honorable intentions. He wants you to give the remains of Gravestone's citizens proper burials, which will allow the spirits of the dead villagers to rest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ol' Higgins at the Gravestone South Gate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I want you to prove you ain't no bandit, see? All the folk in Gravestone was killed dead by Black Bret. Bury 'em proper-like, and I'll be happy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's still unburied folk in Gravestone. You think I ain't payin' attention? Get buryin', friend!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll be danged! You done buried 'em all 'n' put 'em to rest. I'm mighty grateful to you! So're the folk of Gravestone, make no mistake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You take care of them poor ol' bones, 'n' I may just start trustin' you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not so fast, whippersnapper. There's more what needs doin' in Gravestone...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: So am I on your good side now?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gave the remains of Gravestone's citizens proper burials and laid the villagers' spirits to rest. Needless to say, this pleased Ol' Higgins to no end.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: In that case, forget I asked.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Gravestone was a fine ol' place, till Black Bret's Bandits turned up. Shot everyone in town lookin' for the treasure... then they turned on each other!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Why you need to ask about that, friend? Makes me right suspicious all over again...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I got my eyes on you, partner, least until you bury my friends good 'n' proper-like.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: For someone with a body, you seem to be lackin' a spine.

localizedTextIdText: Ol' Higgins has asked you to destroy the ghosts of Black Bret lieutenants. Hunt each of them down in Gravestone and banish them back to the other side.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ol' Higgins at the Gravestone South Gate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Black Bret's lieutenants - a right nasty lot o' scum - are still on the loose. Leastways, their ghosts is. I want you to find 'em and gun 'em down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ain't you got some dead folks to kill? Or re-kill, dependin' on how you see things.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If only you'd been around when them varmints was still alive. Might've done Gravestone some good. Still, ya did a fine job cleanin' up the town.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hate that nasty band o' losers. Can't stand the sight of 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Talk to Ma now, 'n' get her blessin'. She's likely got more for you to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You sent Black Bret old lackeys packing back to the great beyond. That's one less obstacle in your path to Gravestone's treasure, but you suspect the Higgins couple probably has more for you to do before you can continue the search.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you afraid of a few dead people?

localizedTextIdText: Both Ma Higgins and her husband, Ol' Higgins, were gunned down in cold blood by Black Bret, and she's understandably upset about it. She's asked you to return the favor, both to avenge the Higgins family as well as every single person in Gravestone.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ma Higgins at the Gravestone South Gate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've got a deadeye, dearie, so I want to ask a favor. How'd you like to put an end to Black Bret, once and for all? And make it painful, too?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't keep Black Bret waiting, sweetie. Make him bleed ectoplasm out of his eyeballs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bret was such a rude little man, killing the both of us. You were a darling to put that mad dagun down. Tell my husband you've got my blessing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can find the yellow-bellied slank in the tombyard. Say hello for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I want a last look at Bret's bleak corpse before I go to my eternal rest.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Black Bret's got it coming, ma'am.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With Black Bret finally, undeniably, and irrevocably dead, Ma Higgins is more than happy - ecstatic, even - to give you her blessing. With the bandit menace taken care of once and for all, the residents of Gravestone can rest in peace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm getting angry....

localizedTextIdText: With the approval of Ol' Higgins and Ma, your mission to the town of Gravestone has been a success. Now you need to return to Far-Trader Sumana in Shinysand Oasis and let her know of your success.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Far-Trader Sumana in Shinysand Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I ain't seen Ma this happy since 'fore she died. I guess that means you 'n' your Lopp buddies can dig in Gravestone all you like... on one condition.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You tell them Lopp to leave the graves alone. Got it? They don't want to make us mad!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes, yes? Lopp hunt for haunted shinies now?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, thousand thank yous! Lopp never had ghostie shinies before! No ghosties, no scared kurg... time for Lopp to dig dig dig!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Leave the graves of the townsfolk alone. If you don't, we'll be back...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No problem! Lopp no want angry ghosties! We find lots of shinies in no time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared the ghosts of Black Bret's Bandits from the town of Gravestone, and put the spirits of Ol' Higgins and his wife, as well as the town's entire population, to rest. In gratitude, the Higgenses are glad to allow the Lopp to search Gravestone for shinies... so long as they leave the graves of the townsfolk in peace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What's the point of you comin' here, then? Don't make a lick o' sense.

localizedTextIdText: Pilot Tenzo crashed his ship in the middle of the Malgrave desert and wants your help in clearing out the sand scrab swarming the wreck. Kill any scrab you find wandering the Kohra Crash Site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Pilot Tenzo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh gee, I've been in a heap of trouble since I wrecked out here. These sand scrabs won't let me get anywhere near my ship! Help a fella out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'll handle the repairs if you'll handle those scrab. I just need you to kill enough of 'em so I can get to what's left of my ship, you know?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yep, you sure showed those scrab. Now that I can get back to my ship, I can't wait to finally brush my teeth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll make it worth your while, you betcha.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lookin' forward to good dental hygiene!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed quite a few scrab around Pilot Tenzo ship. He was grateful you took the time to help him out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh sure. Guess I'll wait till someone else comes along then.

localizedTextIdText: Pilot Tenzo crash scattered data modules all around the wreck of the Kohra. If you can find and activate the modules, he'd be "mighty grateful."
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Pilot Tenzo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hate to ask, but I was collectin' all this topographical data 'fore I crashed. I'd be mighty grateful if you'd find and activate the modules.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You know, I still need the data from those modules. Otherwise, I'm gonna have to start all over.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh sure, I would've hated to collect that data all over again. Seems like sand and scrab don't exactly agree with me. Thanks again!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, swell. Then I'll be able to recover my data, you betcha!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Glad I could be of help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found all of Pilot Tenzo data modules and turned them on. With the information recovered, Tenzo was pretty happy, "you betcha!"
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess I'll have to figure it out myself.

localizedTextIdText: After defeating Orius the Scrab King, you found his stinger remained intact and in pristine condition. You wonder if Pilot Tenzo might be interested in a souvenir of his time spent in the sands of Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Orius's Stinger to Pilot Tenzo near the Kohra Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Orius' stinger would make an impressive and distinctive souvenir. You wonder if Pilot Tenzo  might be interested in it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh hey, you need something?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh golly, just look at the size of that stinger! You know, I think I'll buy that off of ya. It'll make a nice souvenir once I get out of this desert.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh sure, this'll be a good yarn to tell my buddies at the spaceport.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pilot Tenzo was impressed by the stinger and paid you handsomely for the trophy.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take Orius's Stinger to Pilot Tenzo

localizedTextIdText: Ma Higgins wants to see the bandits that razed the town of Gravestone killed - again. It seems that death has made her both bloodthirsty and hungry for revenge. Seek out the ghosts of bandits in Gravestone and destroy them on her behalf.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ma Higgins at the Gravestone South Gate
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those bandits may be dead, but they deserve worse than what they got! Do an old woman a favor and kill every last one of them bandit ghosts - again!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you kill those bandit ghosts, child? You'd better skip to it... before I make a ghost out of you...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, dear me! I could hear every ghostly shriek! Every spectral scream! Such soul suffering does my dead heart good, dearie!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It better be! They killed all the folks in Gravestone... make them suffer!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't you worry about Ma, darling. She's happy with you... for now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ma Higgins was filled with glee by your account of the bandit ghosts' painful destruction. Hopefully, you're one step closer to claiming the treasure of Gravestone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Once dead 'aint enough for 'em. I thought you had a bit more substance.

localizedTextIdText: The Settlement Authority Representative in Bloodfire Village would like to speak with you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Settlement Authority Representative in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to Bloodfire Village, Settler! Do you have a moment to speak with me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Why hullo there, Settler! I just wanted to make sure you're informed about project construction. Got a minute?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent! Find me as soon as you can!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Settlement Authority Representative. It seems he wants to tell you about project construction.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Settlement Authority Representative
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind you can find me in Bloodfire Village.

localizedTextIdText: Learn about building projects from the Settlement Authority Representative in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact the Settlement Authority Representative via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bloodfire Village could do with the distraction that an arena could provide, no doubt. Lend a hand and help Builder Kalex complete his project.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find the resource needed and take it to Builder Kalex?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done! Now that I've informed you of the process, continue spreading the light of civilization across Nexus. For the Emperor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: First order of business: all projects require supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with the Settlement Authority Representative, who explained how building projects work on Nexus. You then made your first contribution to a building project in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Contact the Settlement Authority Representative via Datachron
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Settlement authority refers to large scale building construction as "projects." These can be just about anything. The primary goal of Settlement Authority is to strengthen Dominion presence on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You must first speak with Builder Kalex. A Builder can be an individual or some kind of interface. Then you find and return the resource required to the Builder.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You will have to collect the required resource for the project and return it to Builder Kalex in a timely fashion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Talk to Builder Kalex if you change your mind. He could use the help, he could.

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Hunter Agni is curious about the source of the Eldan shinies the Darkspur have found. He wants you to locate the Ruins of Exo-Lab X1BB and find out what's inside.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Treasure Hunter Agni via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Darkspur getting Eldan shinies from somewhere. You should find Eldan place where shinies come from. Then we can get shinies instead of Darkspur!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Many Eldan shinies around, Exo-Lab must be somewhere. Look for dead Darkspur and glowy green light!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh! Machines everywhere! Lopp can't really go inside... but strong and mighty $(player.name) should be okay!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Exo-Labs are dark and dangerous, but hide rare shinies!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Ruins of Exo-Lab X1BB at the request of Treasure Hunter Agni only to discover what was killing the Darkspur Cartel's minions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Not curious where shinies come from? Not even little bit?

localizedTextIdText: Items and Levels for Skullcano!
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Items and Levels for Skullcano!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Items and Levels for Skullcano!

localizedTextIdTitle: Ready Your Character for the Malgrave Trail
localizedTextIdText: Receive items and be leveled up for the Malgrave Trail adventure.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will prepare your character for the Malgrave Trail adventure, a level 45 group instance. YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO PLAY OTHER CONTENT ON THIS CHARACTER IF YOU TAKE THIS QUEST.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to use this character for the Malgrave Trail.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character was prepared for the Malgrave Trail adventure.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post asked you to try crafting with some of the new material resources available in this province.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weave armor to Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting Heavy Armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting Heavy Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I do hope you're not dawdling instead of crafting titanium armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bravo, $(player.name), I shall see these put to good use.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The gratitude of the empire is yours.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have crafted some armor made from titanium for Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weave armor to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post asked you to craft some titanium weave armor for the warriors of the Gold Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weave armor to Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of titanium weave armor for immediate military use. Bring all pieces to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of titanium weave armor for immediate military use. Bring all pieces to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have no need to speak - unless you've brought the titanium armor pieces I requested.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors detect you are here to donate that armor to the Gold Legion. Excellent. Take this compensation for your efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Long live the empire.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted titanium weave armor for the warriors of the Gold Legion at the behest of Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weave armor to Quartermaster Cirxi

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft titanium weave armor for Armorer Vospana in Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weave armor to Armorer Vospana in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: The Exiles are encroaching into our rightful territory. Your contribution of titanium armor shall ensure we utterly crush them in Whitevale!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: The Exiles are encroaching into our rightful territory. Your contribution of titanium armor shall ensure we utterly crush them in Whitevale!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh, $(player.name), you've come to visit me in Whitevale. Did you bring titanium armor?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This place is positively ghastly, is it not? But with your contribution, we shall chase those wretched Exiles out of Whitevale easily.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cleverly done, once again. You are fast becoming my favorite pet.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commissions request for titanium weave armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weave armor to Armorer Vospana

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It is time for you to begin your architectural work in earnest. Here are some materials. I trust you will find them suited to your task.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you wish to peruse your supply of materials, you will find them in your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an architect, Craftmaster Tullio has given you the crafting materials necessary to start your first project.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Should you change your mind, I will be here. Good luck!

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has asked you to craft weapons to aid the Queensguard in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I've got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria needs supplies, weapons included. We need someone to help us through this rough patch.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria needs supplies, weapons included. We need someone to help us through this rough patch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What're you doin' talkin' my ear off instead of getting down to work?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This looks like pretty decent work. I reckon I'll consider orderin' from you again.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've got all my thanks and then some. Glad to have you in the brigade.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've accomplished Crafting Trainer Oaklee task to supply the Queensguard.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade asked you to craft some steel weapons for the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can't wait to see what you turn out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The rate at which they lose weapons is unbelievable! I really appreciate you helping me out with this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good job! I always knew you'd come through for me!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have done as you asked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted steel weapons for the XAS at the behest of Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract to provide the Exiles with the necessary weapons to combat the Dominion in Celestion. Craft weapons for Weaponsmith Redfire in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Redfire in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Either yer ready to help folks out, or yer not. Make up yer mind and get to crafting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's some fine crafting there. I'm glad to see the art of weaponsmithing isn't gonna be lost anytime soon.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You got all my thanks and then some.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to do my part!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Exiles were in need of weapons to save Celestion from the destruction wrought by the Dominion. You crafted weapons for Weaponsmith Redfire in Sylvan Glade, who will pass them through the supply chain to where they are needed most.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Redfire

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the weapons he requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Craftmaster Tullio at the Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion weapons for the Draken that they may drive out the riffraff on the savannah.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion weapons for the Draken that they may drive out the riffraff on the savannah.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When I ask for weapons, I expect prompt delivery.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It appears that there is hope for you yet, craftsman.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tullio in Feralplain Collective by crafting weapons for him.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective has submitted a request for rudimentary steel weapons to be delivered to him. He wishes to pit the cognitive abilities of the razortail against humanoid weaponry. Diabolical!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Razortail intelligence enhancers successful. Perhaps capable of soldiering? Would be great scientific accomplishment. Bring weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Razortail intelligence enhancers successful. Perhaps capable of soldiering? Would be great scientific accomplishment. Bring weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where are weapons? Cannot test without them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You brought weapons. Good. Leave them there. Team will begin tests immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought steel weapons to Supervisor Renla so that he can begin his experiments. You ignore the murmurs of concern from his testing team.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Supervisor Renla

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Frugo at Feralplain Collective has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign against the Exiles. Craft those weapons!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you not here with weapon, then you waste time! Wasting time very dangerous... for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Talk fast. Very busy. You bring weapons?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Weapons!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Weaponsmith Frugo request for steel weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission has sent a request to test the commitment of weaponsmiths to the Dominion. Craft the weapons she requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, weaponsmiths. Prove your devotion to the empire by crafting basic weapons for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, weaponsmiths. Prove your devotion to the empire by crafting basic weapons for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't waste my time until you've crafted the weapons I asked for.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, there they are. These will do nicely. The devotion of novices can be cultivated into the greatness of masters.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is yet hope for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela by showing your grasp of the basics of weapons crafting. You expect to do better in the long run.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Rylos has requested additional resources for the Radiant Legion operating in Ellevar. He is located at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: My inventory queries reveal a weapons shortage in the Radiant Legion. I require a crafter to help me acquire the weapons I require.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: My inventory queries reveal a weapons shortage in the Radiant Legion. I require a crafter to help me acquire the weapons I require.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I do not detect a sufficient supply of the weapons I explicitly ordered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors indicate you possess the necessary weapons I requested to fill my work order. The Radiant Legion owes you a debt, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done. Your performance was exceptional.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Quartermaster Rylos' request for weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Quartermaster Rylos

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels at Lightreach Mission. Craft weapons and give them to Weaponsmith Tirexa.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Tirexa at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require further weaponry to fend off incursions from the Exiles. Do your part for the glory of the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require further weaponry to fend off incursions from the Exiles. Do your part for the glory of the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I do not detect the weapon requested in my contract. Do not return without it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors indicate you've brought the weapons I required for my contract. Leave them with me.
