localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will continue observing your progress.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for steel weapons. Weaponsmith Tirexa approved of the quality of the weapons you retrieved for her.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Tirexa

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Illium lists a work order request for weapons crafted from local titanium to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their titanium weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for weapons to support the war against the Exiles. Bring weapons to Chancellor Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for weapons to support the war against the Exiles. Bring weapons to Chancellor Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have the items I requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I greet you, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have my gratitude.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has accepted the titanium weapons you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Illium is the central hub of Dominion commerce on Nexus. The presence of the Dominion Victory Commission means a constant demand for crafted goods. Provide Lieutenant Minor with weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you filled our order yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must be $(player.name). What have you brought me, citizen?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Marcela and Tullio have done well, it seems. Your work will fetch a fine price here in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Lieutenant Minor in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Frugo in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those weapons!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have items? Give give!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good, good! I owe you one. Or two.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Weaponsmith Frugo request for weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale has requested some titanium weapons for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here, and we're in deep trouble! Dominion's makin' a push, and we need weapons to hold 'em off before it's too late!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe here, and we're in deep trouble! Dominion's makin' a push, and we need weapons to hold 'em off before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hope yer here with those weapons I ordered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, if it ain't $(player.name)! I reckon ya got some weapons fer me...yep, these'll do nicely! I'll get 'em shipped out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You saved a lot o' lives, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted titanium weapons for Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: Sabotage! Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold has noticed that there are some titanium weapons missing. Replace them while she hunts down the thieves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weapons to Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement titanium weapons needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement titanium weapons needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm up to my armpits in work, thanks to those stolen weapons! You got any replacements for me, friend?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, you just helped me out big time, friend. Now these work orders oughta get filled! Hope we catch the splorg-slime that took 'em in the first place!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't thank you enough for what you've done. You take care now, you hear?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've replaced the missing titanium weapons requested by Quartermaster Hillary at Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weapons to Quartermaster Hillary

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will aid Exile forces in Thermock Hold in battling the Dominion on distant battlefields. Do your part: craft new weaponry and take it to Weaponsmith Dunpepper!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weapons to Coordinator Dunpepper at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hope you're here with weapons for us. We sure need 'em, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be, you sure came through for us, friend! I'll get these shipped out in a jiffy! Those Imperials are gonna regret scrappin' with us!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I knew we could count on ya, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted weapons that will keep the Free Companies fighting the Dominion. Weaponsmith Dunpepper was happy to have something to make sure the troops came back alive.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weapons to Coordinator Dunpepper

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post asked you to craft some new weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting new weaponry!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting new weaponry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I do hope you're not dawdling instead of crafting titanium weaponry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bravo, $(player.name), I shall see these fine weapons are used against our foes.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Success like yours deserves to be honored.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have crafted some weapons for Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post asked you to craft some titanium weapons for the soldiers of the Gold Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weapons to Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of titanium weaponry for immediate military use. Bring them to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of titanium weaponry for immediate military use. Bring them to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have no need to speak - unless you've brought the titanium weapons I requested.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors detect you are here to donate these weapons to the Gold Legion. Excellent. Take this compensation for your efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion thanks you for your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted titanium weapons for the soldiers of the Gold Legion at the behest of Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weapons to Quartermaster Cirxi

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft titanium weapons for Weaponsmith Frugo in Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the titanium weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exiles in Whitevale, no good, no good! Titanium weapons blow them up though. Crafters make now, bring to Weaponsmith Frugo!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exiles in Whitevale, no good, no good! Titanium weapons blow them up though. Crafters make now, bring to Weaponsmith Frugo!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What? Here for weapons? Bring titanium weapons, now! Can't wait!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good good! Weapons, yes? Not bad, not bad! Blow the daylights out of pitiful Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Weapons tests commencing soon!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commissions request for titanium weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the titanium weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has asked you to bring armor to aid the Queensguard in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria need supplies, Heavy Armor included. I'd be much obliged if you'd craft some.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria need supplies, Heavy Armor included. I'd be much obliged if you'd craft some.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Come on, $(player.name), our soldiers are getting shot up out there! We need that armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This looks like pretty decent work. I reckon I'll consider orderin' from you again.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'd say we owe you one, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've accomplished Crafting Trainer Oaklee task to supply the Queensguard.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade asked you to craft some steel weave armor for the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're gonna make the best armor! And by we, I mean you. You're the best!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm not really sure where they keep losing their steel weave armor. It's not small, you know. Anyway, I really appreciate you helping me out with this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't believe you did all this for me.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have done as you asked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted steel weave armor for the XAS at the behest of Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdTitle: Steel Crazy After All These Years
localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will further FCON's ability to fight off the evil Dominion. Craft steel weave armor for Armorer Stanhope in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to the Armorer Stanhope in text Link="Location:25148">Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why, hello there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I reckon that there armor is for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged, friend. I'll make sure this gets into the right hands.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to do my part!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted steel weave armor for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Armorer Stanhope

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio in Feralplain Collective has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the steel weave armor he requires of you to prove your faithfulness as a craftsman.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion steel weave armor for Dominion troops operating in the region.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion steel weave armor for Dominion troops operating in the region.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You address me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Perhaps I have misjudged you. There may yet be hope for you as an armorer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tullio by making steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective has asked you for steel weave armor so that he and his associates may continue testing razortail ingenuity and violence potential.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Aggression Testing underway. Must check effectiveness against armored targets, but where to get heavier armor? You make steel weave and bring to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Aggression Testing underway. Must check effectiveness against armored targets, but where to get heavier armor? You make steel weave and bring to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where is armor? Testing window closing rapidly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Armor! I will send to Testers. Experimentation commences soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought steel weave armor to Supervisor Renla, allowing him to continue his razortail experimentation.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Supervisor Renla

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Vospana in Feralplain Collective has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that steel weave armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Armorer Vospana in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where is that steel armor? I've been waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glory to the Dominion! It appears you've crafted some armor for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, my pet, well done indeed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Armorer Vospana request for steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get to crafting right now.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Armorer Vospana

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the steel weave armor she requires of you to prove your faithfulness as craftsman of the empire.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring steel weave armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, armorers. Prove your skill to the empire and craft basic steel weave armor for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, armorers. Prove your skill to the empire and craft basic steel weave armor for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing here without the steel weave armor I ask for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, the armor. It looks like you worked hard on it. Yes, this will do nicely... your devotion shall bear fruit for the empire as your skill improves.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have my thanks. Go with Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela by crafting her some steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Rylos has requested additional resources for the Radiant Legion operating in Ellevar. He is located at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested heavy armor to Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: My inventory queries reveal an armor shortage in the Radiant Legion. I require a crafter to help me acquire the heavy armor I require.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: My inventory queries reveal an armor shortage in the Radiant Legion. I require a crafter to help me acquire the heavy armor I require.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you acquired the resources and crafted the heavy armor yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Say no more. I detect the armor in your possession. Your duty to the empire is fulfilled.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have proven yourself. Well done.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It will serve the empire well!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Quartermaster Rylos' request for heavy armor.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: This is a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested heavy armor to Quartermaster Rylos

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft steel weave armor and take it to Bagazi Kreng at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Bagazi Kreng at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require steel weave armor to defend ourselves from incursions by the Exiles. Do your part for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require steel weave armor to defend ourselves from incursions by the Exiles. Do your part for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You there. You finish steel weave armor yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Contract complete, yes? Good, good! Take reward for crafting! Time to ship out for new test subjects!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You? Best. Hireling. Ever!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Bagazi Kreng

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Illium lists a work order request for armor crafted from local titanium to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their titanium armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for armor crafted from local titanium to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring titanium armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for armor crafted from local titanium to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring titanium armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have the items I requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glory and wisdom.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done us a service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has accepted the titanium armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Illium is the central hub of Dominion commerce on Nexus. The presence of the Dominion Victory Commission means a constant demand for crafted goods. Provide Lieutenant Minor with armor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you filled our order yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: For all of her faults, you seem to be relatively well-trained. Your work will fetch a fine price here in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm certain we will have a chance to do business again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Vospana in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Armorer Vospana in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's my pet, $(player.name)! Are you fulfilling my armor contract?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You return to me, just as expected. And with the armor I requested as well! My, my, but you are so quick to fulfill my needs, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is no Cassia, but there are still fine things to be had, my pet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Armorer Vospana

localizedTextIdTitle: The Look and Feel of Hand-Tooled Leather
localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has asked you to bring Medium Armor to aid the Queensguard in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria need supplies, Medium Armor included. It'd be mighty big of you to craft some.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria need supplies, Medium Armor included. It'd be mighty big of you to craft some.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hope you can deliver somethin' good, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nothin' like good, old-fashioned leather, finely stitched together. I think you might have the crafter's touch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hope you'll stop by again sometime.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've accomplished Crafting Trainer Oaklee task to supply the Queensguard with Medium Armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade asked you to craft some medium armor for the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medium armor to Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of medium armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of medium armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm always interested in new outfits. That's what an outfitter does, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You'd think with all the forest animals around, medium armor would not be in short supply, but I guess not. Thanks for helping with this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Come here, I think this calls for a hug!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have done as you asked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted medium armor for the XAS at the behest of Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take Medium Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will further FCON ability to fight off the evil Dominion. Craft Medium Armor for Outfitter Halliday in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We sure could use your help with this armor situation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These are pretty darn good. I can see a bright future as an outfitter for you, $(player.name). Work like that calls for a reward.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to do my part!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted Medium Armor for Outfitter Halliday, who will make sure it gets to the Exiles who need it most.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the Medium Armor he requires of you to prove your loyalty as a craftsman.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. My friend and superior, Mareon Tateo, needs his armor replaced. I expect you to come through for me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. My friend and superior, Mareon Tateo, needs his armor replaced. I expect you to come through for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When I make an order, I expect it to be fulfilled promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am sure he will make use of this. Perhaps as a backup...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective has requested Medium Armor to protect his testers from the dangerous experiments in the test area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your Medium Armor to Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Tester injured recently. Already shorthanded. Efficiency reduced by 19.4%. Must take precautionary measures. Make Scout's armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Tester injured recently. Already shorthanded. Efficiency reduced by 19.4%. Must take precautionary measures. Make Scout's armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes? Yes? You brought me armor? No? Then why waste my time?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good armor. Will distribute to testers. Thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Supervisor Renla request for medium armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your Medium Armor to Supervisor Renla

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Hokia in Feralplain Collective has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that Medium Armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medium Armor to Outfitter Hokia in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bring me your finest leather. Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is fine armor. Your efforts do you credit.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, hunter. May your weapon always strike true.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Outfitter Hokia request for steel armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medium Armor to Outfitter Hokia

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the armor she requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, outfitters! Prove your skill to the empire and craft some armor for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, outfitters! Prove your skill to the empire and craft some armor for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't waste my time until you've crafted the armor I asked for.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, ho! Let me see this. Yes... your outfitting has improved. Your devotion as an outfitter shows. Remember this in your service to the empire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I trust my encouragement was inspiring.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Chancellor Marcela.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission has requested additional resources for the Radiant Legion operating in Ellevar. He's located at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Inventory assessments reveal a shortage of armor for the Radiant Legion in Ellevar. I require a crafter's aid to correct the shortage.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Inventory assessments reveal a shortage of armor for the Radiant Legion in Ellevar. I require a crafter's aid to correct the shortage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not waste my time unless you have brought the armor I asked for.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My readings indicate you were successful in acquiring armor for the Legion's needs. I shall add it to our inventory at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you. The empire is in your debt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Quartermaster Ryloss request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Quartermaster Rylos

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft Medium Armor and take it to Outfitter Vekia at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Outfitter Vekia at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require Medium Armor to defend ourselves from incursions by the Exiles. Do your part for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require Medium Armor to defend ourselves from incursions by the Exiles. Do your part for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Was my contract unclear? We need armor for our fortification efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, $(player.name), this armor is well crafted. Your work will serve Ellevar's hunters well.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You prove worthy of my gratitude... and the empire's.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Outfitter Vekia

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Thayd lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring the requested armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take your armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for Pathfinder's armor crafted from indigenous leather to support the war against the Dominion. Bring armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER:\nRequest for armor crafted from indigenous leather to support the war against the Dominion. Bring armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mid-range armor offers good protection with a slimmer profile. Too bad we ain't got any.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What kind of leather did you use to make this pathfinder's armor? It's so pretty, I think it's gonna blind me! Thanks for supportin' the troops!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks again, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee has happily accepted the armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take your armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills has put out a call for help in relieving the Exile supply shortage in Galeras. Aid the relief effort by crafting some armor for Exile forces here in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take your armor to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: With the Dominion on our doorstep, able crafters are needed to relieve supply shortfalls. Please contact Coordinator Mills for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: With the Dominion on our doorstep, able crafters are needed to relieve supply shortfalls. Please contact Coordinator Mills for more information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The armor we need is both light and strong, but we don't have much in stock. Can you get some for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This armor is pretty snazzy. Did you make it yourself? 'Cause if you did, I'm really impressed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Glad to have your help, friend!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy to be a part of this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some armor for the Exile forces in Thayd and helped with the ongoing relief effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take your armor to Coordinator Mills
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The work order lists armor crafted from leather as being the primary need at the moment. Given the proximity of the Dominion to Thayd, this isn't surprising.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade is offering a contract that will aid in fending off the Dominion. Help the war effort by crafting armor for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivering it to Outfitter Halliday in Thayd!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take your armor to Outfitter Halliday in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Craft armor and keep the Free Companies fighting!\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The critters of Nexus have a lot to offer us in the way of leather for armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, look at that! That's a nice suit of armor! It's liable to save some merc's hide one of these days. Thanks for bringin' it by.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You did fine work there. I won't forget it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted some armor for the Free Companies of Nexus and delivered it to Outfitter Halliday.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take your armor to Outfitter Halliday

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Illium lists a work order request for armor crafted from local leather to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for armor crafted from local leather to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for armor crafted from local leather to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring armor toCraftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have the items I requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Speak, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your success has been recorded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has accepted the Medium Armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Illium is the central hub of Dominion commerce on Nexus. The presence of the Dominion Victory Commission means a constant demand for crafted goods. Provide Lieutenant Minor with armor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for an enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you filled our order yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name), I presume. You've brought some of your work, I hope?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Very well. I'll see what price this can fetch on Illium. The Commission thanks you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought Medium Armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Vekia in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to defeat the Exiles on Nexus. Craft that armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Vekia in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of turmoil and strife, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of turmoil and strife, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When we make a request of an outfitter like you, it should not be taken lightly. This armor is vitally important, and delay means death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very nice. Quite the quality piece. I'm sure this little beauty will be soaked in the blood of our enemies very soon.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I adore the feel of freshly tanned leather armor against my skin.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Outfitter Vekia request for armor. Soon Draken troops will wear it into battle.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Vekia

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale has requested some armor for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe is here, and we're in a jam! If we don't get some armor out to the troops, the Dominion's gonna steamroll 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Thorpe is here, and we're in a jam! If we don't get some armor out to the troops, the Dominion's gonna steamroll 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got some armor? Our troops really need it, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well now, $(player.name), looks like you came through for us! This gear should keep our soldiers standin'. Thanks, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ain't enough thanks in this poor old body of mine. Next time, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted Medium Armor for Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: Sabotage! Quartermaster Hillary has noticed that there's some Pathfinder's armor missing in Thermock Hold. Replace them while she hunts down the thieves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Hillary at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement armor needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement armor needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ugh, I sure hope you're a good outfitter. We needed replacement supplies yesterday!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for comin' through for us, friend. I knew I could count on you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.class), you've done right by me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've replaced the missing armor requested by Quartermaster Hillary at Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Hillary

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will aid Exile forces in Thermock Hold as they battle the Dominion on distant battlefields. Do your part, craft armor, and take it to Outfitter Keynes!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Keynes at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part, keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Howdy, friend! You plannin' to help out with craftin' some armor?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good day to ya, $(player.class). Whatcha got for me today? Oh, is that the armor I asked for?! Well I'll be, I'm mighty grateful!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Many thanks, $(player.name). I knew you'd come through for us!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted Medium Armor that will keep the Free Companies fighting the Dominion. Bring our troops home safe!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Keynes

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post asked you to try crafting with some of the new material resources available in this province.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting new leather armor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting new leather armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I do hope you're not dawdling instead of crafting that leather armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bravo, $(player.name), I shall see these put to good use.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done a service for the Dominion, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have crafted armor for Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post asked you to craft some armor for the Gold Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of Medium Armor for immediate military use. Bring them to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of Medium Armor for immediate military use. Bring them to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have no need to speak... unless you've brought the armors I requested.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors detect the presence of armor for the Gold Legion. Excellent. Take this reward for your dedication.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion thanks you for your service.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This looks like a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted armor for the Gold Legion at the behest of Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Cirxi

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft armor for Outfitter Hokia in Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Hokia in Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This cold is making my scales tremble. Have you brought new armor, hunter?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The cold here gives me no joy, but it is good to see the armor you bring. The snow shall run red with the blood of Exile interlopers.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have my gratitude, hunter... and the Dominion's.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commissions request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the armor to Outfitter Hokia

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has asked you to bring Light Armor to aid the Queensguard in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria needs supplies, armor included. How's your sewing?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I got words for you, friend. The Queensguard here in Arboria needs supplies, armor included. How's your sewing?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What're you doin' talkin' my ear off instead of getting down to work?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This looks like pretty decent work. I reckon I'll consider orderin' from you again.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You sure did right by us, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've accomplished Crafting Trainer Oaklee task to supply the Queensguard.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade asked you to craft some armor for the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm always looking for a good tailor! If I like what you make, I'll tell all my friends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those XAS Espers are so irresponsible. Psyblades are still sharp, you know. Anyway, thanks for helping out with this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I think someone deserves a hug!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have done as you asked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted armor for the XAS at the behest of Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will further FCON ability to fight off the evil Dominion. Craft armor for Tailor Vervenko in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Vervenko in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A simple suit of sleek, sturdy fabric should be a simple task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This displays competent craftsmanship: clothes suitable to be buried in.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I give you thanks from the murky mists of melancholia.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to do my part!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted Light Armor for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Vervenko

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the Light Armor he requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Light Armor to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. There is an urgent need for Light Armor in the region. Craft some and bring it to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. There is an urgent need for Light Armor in the region. Craft some and bring them to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You address me before you have completed your task? This is disappointing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This armor shows promise. There is hope for you yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Light Armor to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective has politely requested you to provide him with new garments for his testers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring new Light Armor for Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Calamity! Clothes in shreds, fur insufficient for savannah nights. Blasted Razortail claws. Ripping! Shredding! Craft Light Armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Calamity! Clothes in shreds, fur insufficient for savannah nights. Blasted Razortail claws. Ripping! Shredding! Craft Light Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Efficiency... dropping... need new garments ASAP!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You brought new garments. Thank you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Everyone! Attention please! We have new lab coats!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That's terrible? I want to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've provided Supervisor Renla with new garments for his testers.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: That's terrible? I want to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Light Armor to Supervisor Renla

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Amphio in Feralplain Collective has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that Light Armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Measure twice, cut once. And when you cut, make sure it is clean... and final.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your cuts are precise, your hems uniform. Better than I expected.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion thanks you for your service. May the empire be preserved.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commissions request for steel light armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the armor she requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, tailors. Prove your skill to the empire and craft basic armor for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, tailors. Prove your skill to the empire and craft basic armor for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not dawdle. Craft the armor I requested at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh? Let's take a look... yes, your sewing has improved. Still a novice's work of course, but I predict great things from you if you stay focused.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have proven your faith to me. And the empire!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. She praised your progress in your tailoring skills with the piece you provided her.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: This is a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission has requested additional resources for the Radiant Legion operating in Ellevar. He is located at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Attention, my inventory process detects a lack of light armor for the Radiant Legion. I request tailors to make up the difference.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Attention, my inventory process detects a lack of light armor for the Radiant Legion. I request tailors to make up the difference.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not approach me without the light armor I requested.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I detect the requested light armor in your possession. Leave it with me - I shall see the Legion receives it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your achievements have been recognized, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Quartermaster Rylos' request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Rylos

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft armor and bring it to Tailor Livy at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Livy at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Come on then, where's that armor I asked for? Stop larking around!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By Dominus, $(player.name), this is perfect, it is! Glad you pulled through for us, mate.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done well by me, mate. And by the empire!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Livy

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Illium has request for armor crafted from local silk to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for armor crafted from local silk to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring your armor toCraftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for armor crafted from local silk to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring your armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have the items I requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You may speak.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done. This was no simple task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has accepted the armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Illium is the central hub of Dominion commerce on Nexus. The presence of the Dominion Victory Commission means a constant demand for crafted goods. Provide Lieutenant Minor with armor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring requested Light Armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you filled our order yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must be $(player.name). Welcome to Illium. Did you bring me samples?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Commission thanks you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Amphio in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you here? You have yet to finish my armor contract!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: No need to explain, citizen. My sensors detect you've already acquired the necessary supplies for my contract. Excellent work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion thanks you for your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale has requested some armor for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Aight armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Crafting Trainer Thorpe! The Dominion's closin' in on Whitevale like mites on a dawngrazer, and FCON needs some armor to stand up to 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Crafting Trainer Thorpe! The Dominion's closin' in on Whitevale like mites on a dawngrazer, and FCON needs some armor to stand up to 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You here about that armor? We're really hurtin' for it, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If it ain't $(player.name), the $(player.class) with an armful of armor! Just in time, friend. We all owe you a great debt!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted armor for Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: Sabotage! Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold has noticed that there are some pieces of armor missing. Replace them while she hunts down the thieves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement armor needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement armor needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can't talk. I need to turn up some replacement armor! Damn that no-good thief!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be! Thanks for that armor! That no-good splorg-slime ain't gonna put a dent in our war efforts now. I owe ya one!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I didn't expect anyone to help. Thanks, friend! Now to find that thief!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've replaced the missing armor requested by Quartermaster Hillary at Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Hillary

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will aid Exile forces battling the Dominion on distant battlefields in Thermock Hold. Do your part, craft armor and take it to Tailor Wildspring!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh, wow! Are you here to help with the armor order? I sure do need your help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Heya, $(player.name)! The Brigade is at it again, huh? Glad you brought these by. I'm so happy to have your help!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take care of yourself, and I hope to see you again!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted armor that will keep the Free Companies fighting the Dominion. Bring our troops home safe!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post asked you to try crafting with some of the new material resources available in this province.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting new armor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nNew provinces mean new resources. Let us exploit their strategic value for the good of the empire by crafting new armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hope you're busy sewing silk armor and not wasting my time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bravo, $(player.name)! I shall see these put to good use.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm sure you couldn't have done it without my prompting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have crafted some armor made from silk for Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdTitle: Silking It for All It's Worth
localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post asked you to craft some armor for the Espers of the Gold Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of silk armor for use by Espers. Bring it to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Gold Legion requires production of armor. Bring them to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Surely you would not approach me without the armor I requested.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors detect your completion of my request. Perhaps now the warm-blooded Espers shall cease their complaints about the cold.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion thanks you for your service, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted armor for the Espers of the Gold Legion at the behest of Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Cirxi

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft armor for Tailor Amphio in Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: The Exiles' close proximity to Palerock Post requires we strike quickly and efficiently. Silk armor is required to protect our Espers.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: The Exiles close proximity to Port Palerock requires we strike quickly and efficiently. Silk armor is required to protect our Espers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you approach me without the armor I requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent, you've brought the supplies. With this, we shall quickly crush the pitiful Exile resistance in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your progress has been updated. May the Dominion be preserved.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has asked you to bring medical supplies to aid the Queensguard in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medical supplies to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Exiles here in Celestion need supplies, medishots included. If you could craft us some meds, that'd be mighty helpful.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Exiles here in Celestion need supplies, medishots included. If you could craft us some meds, that'd be mighty helpful.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What're you doin', talking my ear off instead of getting down to work?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pretty good work, $(player.name). I reckon I'll consider orderin' from you again.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've accomplished Crafting Trainer Oaklee task to supply the Exiles in Celestion.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medical supplies to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade asked you to craft some medical supplies for the XAS.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring medishots to Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of medicines.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The safety and security of personnel remains the highest priority for XAS security attaches. They've asked me to provide them with a steady supply of medicines.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm counting on you to give this your best shot. Pun intended!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A bruise here, a poisonous vine there - there is a constant need for medishots and boosters. Thanks for helping me wrangle some up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks! This is amazing. You really are the best!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have done as you asked.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted weapons for the XAS at the behest of Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll give it my best shot.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will further FCON ability to fight off the evil Dominion. Craft some medical supplies for Techsmith Praxa in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medical supplies to Techsmith Praxa in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part and keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sure whatever you come up with will be fine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These should get the troops up to speed in no time.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You sure do good work, sweetheart.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to do my part!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted medical supplies for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medical supplies to Techsmith Praxa

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the medical supplies he requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medical supplies to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Medishots, boosters - we need them all. Craft medical supplies and bring them to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Medishots, boosters - we need them all. Craft medical supplies and bring them to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You address me before you have completed your task? This is disappointing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These will come in handy, regardless of their quality. Well done, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medical supplies to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective has requested medishots for an injured tester.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring medishots to Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: That fool, Abazi Buo! He has injured himself. Delay our research by 135,207 seconds if he is not tended to. Bring medicine!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: That fool, Abazi Buo! He has injured himself. Delay our research by 135,207 seconds if he is not tended to. Bring medicine!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need medishots for foolish test subject. Abazi not follow instructions. Now need many painful injections.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Give me the shot. Abazi strange. Shy to strangers.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will fix Abazi. Fix him good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Supervisor Renla request for medishots.

localizedTextIdText: Technologist Otha in Feralplain Collective has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those medical supplies!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medical supplies to Technologist Otha in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sorry, we do actually need medishots. Because people get hurt, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These are some top o' the line medishots, love! Good on ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Technologist Otha request for medical supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medical supplies to Technologist Otha

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the medishots she requires of you to prove your loyalty to the empire.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, Technologists. Prove your worth to the empire by crafting medishots for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, Technologists. Prove your worth to the empire by crafting medishots for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing here without the medishots I requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let's see... yes, these will do nicely. Your skill is worthy of praise, $(player.name). Keep it up and you will rise far in the Empire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Success deserves rewards.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela by crafting medishots.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Rylos has requested additional medishots for Radiant Legion troops operating in Ellevar. He is located at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medishots to Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Due to an emergency shortage in medishots, a ration is in effect. All Technologists are to prioritize efforts relieving the shortage.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Due to an emergency shortage in medishots, a ration is in effect. All Technologists are to prioritize efforts relieving the shortage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I gave strict instructions to prioritize relief of the medishot shortage!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, my sensors indicate you possess the medishots we need. I'll send out an order to end the rationing at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall notify the higher-ups of your service to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Quartermaster Ryloss request for medishots.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medishots to Quartermaster Rylos

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft medishots and take them to Technologist Corvianos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medishots to Technologist Corvianos at Lightreach Mission
