localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require medishots to keep our troops safe! Do your part for the glory of the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require medishots to keep our troops safe! Do your part for the glory of the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, mate, what are you doing here? I still need medishots for that contract!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be, $(player.name), you did me a huge favor, you did. I'll be gettin' these out. Take my thanks, mate!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hope to see you again!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for medishots.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medishots to Technologist Corvianos

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Illium lists a request for medishots crafted from local omni-plasm to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for medishots crafted from local omni-plasm to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring serpentlily medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for medishots crafted from local omni-plasm to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring serpentlily medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have the items I requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have something to say?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I trust this didn't inconvenience you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has accepted the medishots you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Illium is the central hub of Dominion commerce on Nexus. The presence of the Dominion Victory Commission means a constant demand for crafted goods. Provide Lieutenant Minor with medical supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your medicines to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), there is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for the enterprising crafter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you filled our order yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must be $(player.name). If your medishots are well dispensed, you could be a valuable asset for the empire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will pass these along. Carry on, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought medical supplies to Lieutenant Minor in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your medicines to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Technologist Corvianos in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that medicine!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your medicines to Technologist Corvianos in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well now, love, there's no chance you're done with that med contract yet!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here here, mate! You've done me a huge favor, you have! I'll make sure you're given credit. Cheers, mate!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done us a good one, mate!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your medicines to Technologist Corvianos

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale has requested some serpentlily medishots for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring medishots to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Crafting Trainer Thorpe! The Dominion's closing in on Whitevale like mites on a dawngrazer, and FCON needs medishots before they suck us dry!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Crafting Trainer Thorpe! The Dominion's closing in on Whitevale like mites on a dawngrazer, and FCON needs medishots before they suck us dry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hope you're here with a pile of medishots before the Dominion's troops bleed us out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name), our troops owe you a big debt. These will be the difference between life and death.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks, friend! I owe ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted serpentlily medishots for Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Thermock Hold in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring medishots to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: Sabotage! Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold has noticed that there are some medical supplies missing. Replace them while she hunts down the thieves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medical supplies to Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement medicines needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies missing. Foul play suspected. Replacement medicines needed urgently while investigations underway. Report to Quartermaster Hillary.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What kind of splorg-slime steals medishots?! Our troops will be dead if I can't find 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh wow, $(player.name)! You've got no idea how bad we need these. That no-good splorg-slime that stole the originals will get theirs!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged, friend. Our troops owe you a big one.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've replaced the missing medical supplies requested by Quartermaster Hillary at Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medical supplies to Quartermaster Hillary

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract that will aid Exile forces battling the Dominion on distant battlefields. Do your part, craft medishots, and take them to Technologist Blackwood in Thermock Hold!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medishots to Technologist Blackwood at Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part. Keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part. Keep the Free Companies fighting!\n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We sure need those medishots to patch up our soldiers around here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name), yer a sight for sore eyes. More to the point, those medishots are. I'll make sure the right people get 'em, but you got my thanks.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dang it, I can't find my handkerchief... where is it... *sniffle*
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted medishots that will keep the Free Companies fighting the Dominion. Bring our troops home safe!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medishots to Technologist Blackwood

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post asked you to try crafting with some of the new material resources available in this province.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medical supplies to Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nNew medical advancements await in these new horizons. Craft new medishots for the good of the empire!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nNew medical advancements await in these new horizons. Craft new medishots for the good of the empire!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do your persist in pestering me without the medishots I ordered?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bravo, $(player.name). These medical supplies possess incredible potential. I'll see you well rewarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My gratitude to your dedication, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have crafted some medical supplies made from serpentlily for Craftmaster Tullio at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medical supplies to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post asked you to craft some medical supplies for the Gold Legion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medical supplies to Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSSAGE: The Gold Legion requires the acquisition of medical supplies for military operations. Craft and deliver them to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSSAGE: The Gold Legion requires the acquisition of medical supplies for military operations. Craft and deliver them to Quartermaster Cirxi promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My sensors do not detect the medical supplies I require. Must I request them again?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My sensors detect the presence of high-quality medishots. Your dedication to the lives of the troops shall go on your record, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion thanks you for your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted medical supplies for the Gold Legion at the behest of Quartermaster Cirxi at Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medical supplies to Quartermaster Cirxi

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft medical supplies and bring them to Technologist Otha in Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medical supplies to Technologist Otha in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Technologist Otha here, love. We need all the medishots you lot can muster up so the Dominion can take Whitevale from those ruddy Exiles!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Technologist Otha here, love. We need all the medishots you lot can muster up so the Dominion can take Whitevale from those ruddy Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing here, love? You can't have finished those medishots already!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, well, let's have a look... oh, these are just lovely! You've done good work, you have. We'll have Whitevale in a week, I'll bet!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've earned my respect, love. Till we meet again!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commissions request for medical supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medical supplies to Technologist Otha

localizedTextIdText: You found a Broken Warbot, and following a quick inspection of its remains you've come to the conclusion that you could probably get the thing back in working order if you replace a few missing parts. Only trouble is, the parts are scattered across the Blasted Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mechanic Anxa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This looks like it's missing a few parts. If you replaced them, you might be able to get it up and running again for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The deactivated eyes stare off into space. This thing would be a holy terror if you could put it back together.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm not sure how many operational bots we still got in the field, but between the Dommies, the squirg, and the mutants, it ain't nearly enough.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: One of our lost warbots came back online for a second there... then it went dark again. Any idea what caused it?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You get props for tryin' to fix that. They're hard to maintain.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go find some warbot parts.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That was me. I put it back together.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you found and replaced the parts the Broken Warbot was missing, your fixer-upper only managed to take a few short steps before breaking down once again. Looks like warbots are a bit more complicated to maintain than hoverbikes...
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do to help.

localizedTextIdText: You found a Broken Ultrabot, and following a quick inspection of its remains you've come to the conclusion that you could probably get the thing back in working order if you replace a few missing parts. Only trouble is, the parts are scattered across the Blasted Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Bell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Broken Ultrabot looks like it's missing a few parts. If you replaced them, you might be able to get it up and running again for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Broken Ultrabot's deactivated eyes stare off into space. This thing would be a holy terror if you could put it back together.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I heard the major gabbin'. Says we've lost a good number of ultrabots in the field. Them bleedin' Exiles never give up, do they?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Funniest thing, guv. One of them missin' ultrabots came back online for a split second, then went dark again. Any idea what caused it?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You ain't no authorized bot tech. Stick to what ya know, you'll live longer.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should go look for the parts.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That was me. I put it back together.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you found and replaced the parts the Broken Ultrabot was missing, your fixer-upper only managed to take a few short steps before breaking down once again. Looks like warbots are a bit more complicated to maintain than hoverbikes...
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I should go look for the parts.

localizedTextIdText: After banishing the ghost of Mad Ernest Vern, his spirit dropped a golden wrench. As he was one of the townsfolk of Gravestone, you suspect that Ol' Higgins might have known him and may wish to know his fate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ol' Higgins via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ernest's ghost left a wrench behind. You wonder if maybe Ol' Higgins knew Ernest in life.  Maybe he'd want to learn Ernest's fate?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Jumping Jabbits, that's Ernest's wrench! He holed up in his basement when Bret rode in. Never saw him again! Nice to know he's still kickin'... sorta.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You know, I'm gonna have to look him up! Or dig him up. Heh!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ol' Higgins had a good laugh about Mad Ernest Vern rather comical demise, and he was glad that you told him the truth about his old friend. Ernest will probably haunt his own basement for years to come.

localizedTextIdText: Following your arrival in Malgrave, you were contacted by High Priestess Raumia. She has asked you to assist in the Dominion's occupation of Malgrave, and she expects you speak to her in Fort Dominus at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to High Priestess Raumia at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Loyal citizen! The Dominion demands your presence. We must ensure our occupation of Malgrave is both safe and profitable. Come to me at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At last, you arrive. I despise waiting, especially in this sinkhole of a camp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not keep me waiting overlong, citizen. I am not a patient woman.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Pay attention. We have much to discuss.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Like any loyal citizen, you met with High Priestess Raumia in Fort Dominus in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare refuse me? Pitiful!

localizedTextIdText: You received a call from Sally Kettleshaw asking you to head down to Redsand Station in Malgrave. It sounds like she's got some work that needs doing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sally Kettleshaw in Redsand Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there, friend! Mosey on over to Redsand Station and I'll give you a big Malgrave welcome... and some work, of course.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must like keepin' a lady waitin'! No time to waste, though. I got somethin' for you to do!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lookin' forward to meetin' ya!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This won't be hard, I promise!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Sally Kettleshaw, who was very happy to see you. Looks like the Exiles in Malgrave need a little help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't many that turn down a shot at some good work these days. Shame.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Loren has asked you to kill both the Osun and the warhounds they're breeding in Feathersquall Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Loren via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Feathersquall was as peaceful as a Murgh village could be until the Osun took over. We can't let those giants and their hounds supplant the Murgh!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are still a lot of Osun wandering around over there with their warhounds. Are you sure you got them all?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You offered no quarter and gave them no mercy! Good for you! Maybe the Osun will start to question the wisdom of this endeavor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Osun are using the Murgh as puppy chow for their war hounds. Kill 'em all!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not sure it's that simple.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed many of the Osun and their warhounds in Feathersquall Ridge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I do! They aren't as bad as everyone seems to think. Sure, they're brutal and they kill without warning, but they're just doing what comes naturally!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They're terrible creatures, bred by the Osun for war. Who knows what the giants need a pack of blood-thirsty warhounds for? It can't be good!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Think of the poor Murgh! Think of my poor colleague!

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Poul was captured by the Osun when they attacked the Murgh of Feathersquall Ridge. If he's still alive, Researcher Loren wants you to rescue him from the Osun and their mangy warhounds. Explorer Poul can be found somewhere in Feathersquall Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Explorer Poul in Feathersquall Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My colleague, Poul Harland, is an explorer without peer. He went into the village before the Osun attacked, and I fear he's been captured.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you find him? Did you find Poul? He's a prisoner up in the village!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Loren sent you, didn't she? Bless her heart! You need to help us get out of here before the Osun can regroup!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope you find him. Poul and I have been friends for twelve years, at least.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Why... this Murgh and I, of course. I call him 'Feathers.'
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into Feathersquall and located Explorer Poul, as well as his new friend - a captive Murgh he calls 'Feathers.'
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I don't find out what happened to Poul, I don't know what I'll do!

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Poul has been located, but both he and his new friend, Feathers, have been put under a binding spell by the Osun. Explorer Poul insists that the Vishal-Dagh Packmatron has the ward to break the spell. Locate the Packmatron along Feathersquall Ridge, kill her, and use the Spell Ward to free Poul and Feathers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Loren via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Feathers and I have been talking since my capture. He's not such a bad fellow, for a Murgh. If we don't free him, I won't be able to live with myself.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Feathers may not be the conversationalist you are, but he's a living being who's deserving of his freedom. Trust me! He's perfectly docile!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is Poul still chained up in the Murgh village? Why haven't you freed him yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is Poul... is he... dead? I've told him a million times, the Murgh are violent and unpredictable! How could he be so stupid?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find the Spell Ward to break our binds and free us both. The Osun Packmatron has it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed both Explorer Poul and Feathers, but the end result of his friendship with the Murgh wasn't precisely what Poul had in mind.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What have you two been talking about?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Food, mostly. Seems like the Murgh really like eating, and these Osun haven't exactly been forthcoming with the vittles, if you get my drift.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Now you sound like Loren! Look... you can't let all the other Murgh you've met ruin it for the rest of them. Feathers is as good as they come!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're not much of a humanitarian, are you?

localizedTextIdText: You found the remnants of some foul-smelling ointment inside an Osun jar. It appears as if the Osun smear the ointment on their bodies, thereby gaining the trust of their warhounds. If you can find enough $(vitem=361) in Feathersquall Ridge, you might be able to mask your scent from the warhounds, too.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Loren via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This jar contains the remains of a foul-smelling ointment used by the Osun to hide their scent. Perhaps you should find more and combine them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What... what's that horrible smell?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How interesting! That ointment is made from concentrated warhound musk. I suspect the warhounds might even mistake you for one of their own!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope this stuff washes off.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected enough $(vitem=361) to mask your natural odor from the Osun warhounds... though time and experience will tell just how effective the ointment is.

localizedTextIdText: In order to stop the Osun from breeding more of their warhounds, as well as to avenge Explorer Poul death, Researcher Loren wants you to destroy the Vishal-Dagh Alpha in Feathersquall Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Researcher Loren via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The only way to stop this breeding operation is to find the alpha warhound and kill it! You think you can do that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: They're using that hound to breed the rest of them! Kill it, and you kill the whole bloodline!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Though it didn't do Poul any good, I'm glad you came along when you did. At least the Osun won't have warhounds to bolster their numbers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It won't bring Poul back from the dead... but it'll make me feel better.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Go on. I'll gather what's left of my research notes... I won't be far behind.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was the right thing to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Vishal-Dagh Alpha, effectively putting an end to the Osun's breeding of warhounds in Feathersquall Ridge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Has anyone told you lately what a worthless idiot you are?

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Loren, an XAS researcher who is studying the Murgh of Feathersquall Ridge, is in need of help. The Osun have taken over the Murgh village, and her research colleague has been captured. Find her and offer her your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Researcher Loren at Feathersquall Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun have taken over the Murgh village on Feathersquall Ridge... and my partner has been captured. We need assistance!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for coming... I don't know how much time we have before they do something horrible to Poul!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm near the Murgh village, trying to stay out of sight. I'll be waiting!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Researcher Loren near Feathersquall Ridge and offered to help her out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Who knows what they'll do to Poul! You have to help!

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar in Sylvan Glade feels that her consort, Yaenna, has shown great skill and dedication in tending to her needs. Still, it's clear that Yaenna has a greater purpose, and Sylvan Glade is in need of a matria. Therefore, Myala would like you to help Yaenna with her trials.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Consort Yaenna in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sylvan Glade is in need of a matria, and I feel Yaenna will do well in that role. Could you help her complete the Trials of the Matria?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Yaenna is waiting for you. I just know you'll be a big help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you so much for helping me, $(player.name). I'm so nervous! I think I've got it all figured out, but I'm so glad you're here with me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The time has come for Yaenna to use her skills to help the greater good.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: First is the Test of Spirit. I must find the spirit totem.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Just tell me what to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Consort Yaenna is ready to start the Trials of the Matria, but she's going to need your help.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll go see her right now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yaenna will find the trials difficult without your help.

localizedTextIdText: Learn about building projects from the Pioneering League Representative at Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Pioneering League Representative via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tremor Ridge could well do with a concentrated area for commerce and gathering. Help Builder Gemma complete an infrastructure project in Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find the resource? Did you take it to Builder Gemma?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that I showed you the ropes, try helping Builder Gemma with the infrastructure project.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: First, let's do a dress rehearsal for the real thing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep up the good work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Pioneering League Representative contacted you about building projects on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Pioneering League Representative
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Pioneering League refers to large scale building projects as "projects." These can be anything from the practical to the whimsical. The Pioneering League's goal is to make lives better on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You first interact with the Builder, who could be a person or some other interface. Then you find and return the resource required to build the project to the Builder.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You will have to collect the required resource for the project and return it to the Builder.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Talk to Builder Gemma if you change your mind. She could use a hand.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Rescue Lead at the Protostar Honeyworks Headquarters is in need of assistance, though he won't specify why. He has asked that you travel to his location so he can discuss his requirements.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Protostar Rescue Lead at the Honeyworks Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar is in dire need of your assistance! The matter is urgent, and I prefer not to explain the details over an unsecured comm line!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We prefer our tasks to actually be completed. Efficiency is profitable, after all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Protostar graciously thanks you for your fast response to our request for aid. We will now tell you the problem: our honey production operations are falling apart.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make your way to my coordinates! And hurry!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The workers are asking questions, and I'm running out of excuses.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to the Protostar Rescue Lead, and it appears as if Protostar's honey pumping operations in Auroria are in trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Protostar Rescue Lead
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Um... please help? Please?

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker believes the Elder Cube is somewhere in northern Malgrave and he intends to find it before his rival, Artemis Zin, does. Rumor has it that a Pell outcast, the Flame-Watcher, has raved about a "cube" that's corrupted his people. The Pell can be found at the Flame-Watcher's Overlook, and Dorian thinks he may reveal more if properly approached.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Flame-Watcher at the Flame-Watcher's Overlook
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Elder Cube's out there, sport, and we need to find it. Scuttlebutt is there's a crazy old Pell who might know a thing or two about it. What do ya say?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There's this place called Flame-Watcher's Overlook, where you'll find this nutty old Pell. Talk to him friendly-like, bucky, and maybe he won't eat ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Flames burn low... the smoke thins. Why do you interrupt my exile? Has the Cube sent you to silence me?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Alright champ, but it's a long haul. Old Dorian'll keep his ears on for ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You may be able to stoke the fires of vengeance that burn in my heart.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find the Pell and talk to him.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No, but I may be able to help you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Dorian Walker request, you've located the Flame-Watcher at his camp and approached him about the Elder Cube. The old Pell is obviously one cell short of a power pack, but he doesn't seem to be immediately hostile or unwilling to parley with you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't play dumb with me, bucko. I know ya been 'round long enough to hear a thing or two about the Elder Cube. Or are ya just ignorant?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Ya might say so, boss. Artemis Zin's out there somewhere, and we gotta find the Cube before she does. Otherwise... well, I don't wanna think about it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't believe you're turnin' me down, slick.

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher is eager to learn if you have been sent to serve him. In order to do so, you must venture into the Sandstinger Wastes and purify yourself by staring into the Sacred Fire that burn there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If the Flame truly sent you to serve me, you must be purified. Go into the desert, stare into the sacred fires that burn there, and cleanse yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sacred fires have burned forever, and within their glow you can find the truth. Seek them out and you will understand my people.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Flame has spoken to you. Through it, you understand my pain. My people must be freed from the evil of the Cube. You... you will be my instrument!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Only the faithful will pass this test! If you fail, you will not survive!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Sure thing. When do we begin?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into the Sandstinger Wastes and stared into the Sacred Fire that burn there. In so doing you learned why the Flame-Watcher has been exiled from his people, and have gained some insight into the thirst for vengeance that drives him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are you out here by yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: All will be revealed in time, outsider! First you must prove your divine origins and cleanse yourself!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you will not serve the Flame-Watcher, then you do not serve the Flame. Begone!

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher has instructed you to take his holy vengeance upon the Pell of Flamedancer Commune. Though these Pell have done nothing to you, their lives stand between you and the possibility of finding the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The time has come to exact vengeance! The Flamedancer traitors must pay for their sacrilege in blood! Let the fires of retribution burn brightly!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to purge the taint from the Flamedancer Pell! Do not waste any more time! The heretics must suffer!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes! Their blood stains the sands! The fires of retribution burn brightly, indeed! You are a capable instrument... yes!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Though traitors one and all, they are still Flamedancer Pell!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Cube... of course! The cause of this misery! Soon, my weapon... soon!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Flamedancer Pell have paid a dear price for their heresy. In addition, your violent chastisement of the Pell for their blasphemies has cheered the Flame-Watcher beyond any reasonable measure. You suspect that this bloodletting is only the beginning...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Any feeling of brotherhood I may have felt for them turned to ashes the day they turned their backs on the Flame and drove me from my village!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your hands are stained with blood, yet you abandon your sacred duty? Fool!

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher explained that when the Cube first came to his people, it used a large "idol" to corrupt the Flamedancers. He has commanded you to investigate the idol in Flamedancer Commune and witness its corruption for yourself, but he warns that the Cube may attack you when it realizes the threat you pose.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When the Cube first came to us, it used an "idol" to corrupt the Flamedancers. Seek out this idol and experience this heresy for yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The idol sits on the outskirts of Flamedancer Commune. Why do you tarry here? Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I warned you the Cube would send its little machines to kill you, but you were too strong - just as I foresaw! You are truly my tool of vengeance! Ha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When the Cube recognizes you as a threat, it will attack! Be on your guard!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now is the time for revenge! They will pay the price for their blasphemy!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: This is all a bit rich, if you ask me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the "idol" and discovered it was part of an ancient Eldan construct. Despite its age, your proximity attracted a number of small constructs that attacked you, and which you fought off with admirable skill.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Not yet. I want some answers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: And what about you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Answers... yes. Ask, then. Perhaps I will answer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Once, not long ago, the Flame alone guided my people. Yet now they pursue the Cube's blasphemy without question.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Cube came to my people suddenly. It spoke to us and twisted the minds of the Flamedancers. Soon they heard only the lies of the Cube.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I remained pure, a disciple of the Flame. The Cube saw this and commanded the Flamedancers to cast me out or kill me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: To come so far, only to disobey me! You will feel the heat of my wrath!

localizedTextIdText: As you were taking vengeance on the residents of Flamedancer Commune for the Flame-Watcher, Dorian Walker contacted you via your datachron. His scans have revealed a number of Pell terminals throughout the village, and he wants you to access them and see what kind of data they contain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What's cookin', sport? I'm detectin' a lotta Pell power sources in that there village. Terminals, looks like. I want ya to check 'em out, pronto.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in tarnation ya come all this way for, sport? Get back to Flamedancer Commune and hack them terminals!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be damned, crackerjack! That's more or less a direct confirmation that the Elder Cube's somewhere in yer vicinity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit. Make it count, chief.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't get all misty eyed on me yet, kid. We ain't found the Elder Cube yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Dorian Walker orders, you hacked into the Pell terminals in Flamedancer Commune, revealing that the Elder Cube is definitely nearby. Though the Cube is still up for grabs, this minor victory lends meaning to the deeds you have done on behalf of the Flame-Watcher.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We're close, slick. If Artemis gets that Cube before us, I'll tan yer hide!

localizedTextIdText: Once again, the Flame-Watcher has sent you to enact divine punishment upon the Pell of Malgrave. This time, he has specified the Flamedancer Pyre-Caller - the leaders of the Flamedancer Pell - as those most deserving of his wrath. Proceed to Flamedancer Enclave and drive the Pyre-Callers before you!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Only the Pyre-Callers - those who saw fit to turn their backs upon the Flame - remain. Find them in Flamedancer Enclave and end their lives!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Pyre-Callers are all that remain of those who sought to drive me out of Flamedancer Commune! I demand they pay with their lives!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Pyre-Callers have been destroyed! You are truly a fearsome one, outsider, sent by the Flame to aid its most fervent disciple! I have been blessed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Beware the magic they wield, outsider! You may feel the heat before long!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now... we turn our attention to the source of this sacrilege... the Cube!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You're one lucky guy, for sure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You punished the Pell of Malgrave once again in the Flame-Watcher name, this time singling out the Flamedancers' spiritual leaders - the Flamedancer Pyre-Caller. Perhaps now the Flame-Watcher will lead you to the Elder Cube....
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: More Pell? What about the Cube?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: In time, outsider! Patience! We must burn away the Cube's defenders before we strike at its heart!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you lost your taste for death, outsider? Do you fear the Pyre-Callers?

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher has revealed that the Elder Cube was secreted away beneath Flamedancer Enclave by the Pyre-Callers. All that remains is for you to find the entrance to the Elder Cube's lair and take it far away from the Flamedancer Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your final task on my behalf also serves as your reward. Find the Cube beneath Flamedancer Enclave and remove it. Free my people from its influence!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You waste time coming to me, outsider. Your prize - the Cube - awaits beneath Flamedancer Enclave. Take it and go... I care not where!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Shouldn't ya be lookin' for the Elder Cube, chum? Or do I need to shoot ya 'n' make ya twice as useless?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the seven pillars of Rylos! It's an Exo-Lab! You've done it, kid! If the Elder Cube ain't down here, then it ain't ever gonna be found!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Pyre-Callers conceal the Cube's lair, but you will find it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well... maybe just a little bit. But all that's behind us now!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You never doubted me, did you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the entrance to the Elder Cube's lair - an ancient Exo-Lab. You were immediately contacted by Dorian Walker, who congratulated you on your discovery. Still, the quest for the Elder Cube is far from over...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Don't you want me to destroy the Cube?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ha! Even you lack the power to do that, outsider! Nothing on this world can destroy the Cube! It would be folly to try!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is the Cube not the prize you seek, outsider? Why would you deny your fate?

localizedTextIdText: After finding your way into Exo-Lab XC42, you learned that Artemis Zin is ahead of you and perilously close to claiming the Elder Cube. Dorian Walker wants you to get to the Elder Cube before Artemis Zin does, no matter the cost. You better get moving!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm gonna patch you in on a comm I picked up, killer. Zin's down there already! Ya can't let her get the Cube, so burn some boot leather before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This ain't the time to turn yer back on yer people, champ. Get back in that Exo-Lab and get that Cube!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well that didn't go so well, did it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Artemis gets the Elder Cube, it'll be real bad! Don't let her near it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ain't no point cryin' over spilled milk. Head to Area 77... we gotta talk.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Artemis Zin got to the Elder Cube before you did, and escaped with it while her newly-augmented companion, Kevo, attacked you. Though Dorian Walker isn't happy with this development, he seems to be taking the bad news pretty well.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya hear me laughin', kid? 'Cause if its some kinda joke, it ain't funny.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin and her trusty Draken cohort, Kevo, arrived in Exo-Lab XC42 just as soon as you discovered it. They are now somewhere inside the Exo-Lab, searching for the Elder Cube. You must find Artemis Zin and lend her your aid should she require it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kevo and I have arrived. I may still have a use for you, however. Delve deeper into the Exo-Lab and hook up with us at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in the deepest dark of oblivion are you doing here?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a disaster! But at least the Elder Cube and I have found each other at last.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It would not have been possible without your efforts. You will be rewarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I do not know. It has been a... a trying day...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be there as soon as I can, my lady.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though Artemis Zin has recovered the Elder Cube, she has paid quite a price for it. Kevo, her trusted guardian, has been augmented, and you were forced to defeat him so that she could teleport away with her prize.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you wish to stand there like an idiot, who am I to stop you?

localizedTextIdText: Despite your best efforts, Artemis Zin managed to get to the Elder Cube before you did. Though Dorian Walker is disappointed, his many decades of experience seems to have made him somewhat more accepting of defeat. Still, he wants to speak to you back in Area 77 just as soon as you can get there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Dorian Walker in Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I know it's quite a hike, champ, but when you get a chance come meet me back at Area 77. We'll talk things over a bit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't be so hard on yourself, slick.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's damn good to see ya, crackerjack. I was worried about ya. I know Artemis got away with the Elder Cube, but we'll get along somehow. We always do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's not like there's any big hurry, sport, but the sooner the better.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So do I, chief. So do I...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned to Area 77 and spoke to Dorian Walker about your failure to recover the Elder Cube in Exo-Lab XC42. Despite this defeat, Dorian seems to indicate it's not the end of the world. For the sake of all the Exiles, you hope he's right.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: But we lost, Dorian. It's over.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Kid, when you get as old as I am, it helps ya put things in perspective. I know it all looks bad to ya, but it can always be worse. Trust old Dorian on this one.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We all screw up... some of us more than others.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has the Elder Cube and has returned to Area 77, but at what cost? Kevo, her faithful companion, has been terribly wounded following his augmentation by the Elder Cube. Artemis Zin wishes to speak with you in person, so you had best not keep her waiting.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Artemis Zin in Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It is probably safe to say our business in Exo-Lab XC42 is concluded. Still, we should speak further. Meet me in Area 77.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I cannot decide if our mission's results have been successful... or disastrous.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Elder Cube... it is mine, at last. As promised, I am in your debt. You have done House Zin a great service... and House Zin always pays its debts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please do... and don't tarry in that place overlong. It isn't safe...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, if you'll excuse me. The Cube awaits, and I will learn its secrets...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be there as soon as I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Artemis Zin thanked you for your service to House Zin and rewarded you appropriately, but you couldn't help but feel that something was wrong with her. Is the Elder Cube having some effect on her, or is she merely upset by Kevo's condition? Time will tell...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Kevo is... alive. I understand you had little choice in defending yourself. He will have the finest medical care the Dominion can provide.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is my hope the Elder Cube can reveal how his condition might be reversed. I hope it can be.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Rot in that Exo-Lab if you will... but I am in no mood for insubordination.

localizedTextIdText: While wandering through Flamedancer Commune, you came across a discarded Flamedancer Scroll. You decided to collect these scrolls for Flame-Watcher, who insists the blasphemous heretics of his former commune are not worthy to bear them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This scroll is covered in Flamedancer runes. Perhaps you should search other Flamedancer Pell for such scrolls and return them to the Flame-Watcher.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Flamedancer scrolls, outsider? Such things are sacred! The filthy hands of the heretics defile them! Find others so that I may keep them safe, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see you have gathered many Flamedancer scrolls. Better an outsider has them than the blasphemers who once called themselves my brothers.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You do much, outsider. Much, indeed. I am... grateful.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can find other scrolls.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a sheaf of $m(vitem=387) from fallen Flamedancer Pell for the Flame-Watcher, who will use them to teach his people once they have been freed from the influence of the Cube.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find more of these scrolls.

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher has told you that the Flamedancer Pell are holding many captives near the Flamedancer Mainframe in preparation for sacrifice to the Cube. As he does not wish to see the Cube empowered any further, the Flame-Watcher has asked you to free these prisoners from Flamedancer Cage before the Flamedancer Pell can kill them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flamedancers have taken many prisoners, intending to sacrifice them to the Cube. The Cube cannot be further empowered! Free the captives at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Should the Flamedancer prisoners be sacrificed, their souls will feed the Cube, strengthening it. This cannot be allowed to happen!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Flamedancers will have to capture more prisoners if they intend to sacrifice them to the Cube... but by the time they do, it will be too late.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The prisoners await their fate, but you will find them easy enough to free.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed a good many of the Flamedancer Pell's prisoners near the Flamedancer Mainframe before they could be sacrificed to the Cube.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The prisoners' lives mean nothing to me... do they mean nothing to you?

localizedTextIdText: The Elder Cube is close, and Dorian Walker knows it. He's asked you to proceed into Flamedancer Enclave and search for evidence of the Elder Cube's presence. Augmented creatures are a sure sign that the powerful Eldan relic is nearby, and analyzing the augmetic components taken from them might just confirm it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I got an inklin' that the Cube's real close. Keep an eye out for augmented critters, and get some augmetic components from 'em. Clues, slick... clues!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need a lot of components from them augmented critters if I'm gonna analyze 'em right. Get a wiggle on, would ya?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lookin' over the components ya found, they're awful fine. It'd take more than one of them augmentors to make these. They're too perfect!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure ya don't damage 'em, champ. Look over in Flamedancer Enclave.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'd bet my last two bits it is... and we're gonna find it if it kills me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=647) from Augmented Creatures in Flamedancer Enclave. Though the components look like a bunch of gore-stained rubbish to you, Dorian Walker insists they are proof positive of the Elder Cube's proximity.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That Elder Cube ain't dumb, champ. It needs protection, so it's gonna take local critters and augment 'em. The Pell are nice and all, but it can't control 'em quite the same.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: C'mon! You gotta be pullin' my chain, crackerjack!

localizedTextIdText: You found a dead human just inside Exo-Lab XC42 that didn't survive the augmentation process. It's entirely likely that the Elder Cube is defended by Eldan constructs designed to augment organic creatures. Getting rid of those constructs will be necessary if the Elder Cube is to be claimed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This body is the product of a failed augmentation attempt by Eldan constructs. You have little doubt that such constructs will be defending the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is nothing you can do for this poor man. Better you take the fight to the Eldan constructs before they try to augment you, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Cube's defenders are metal monsters. They take living beings and corrupt them. This cannot be the will of the Masters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Cube was defended by robots, yes? You destroyed them, did you not? Good! Good! With each robot destroyed, the Cube is more vulnerable!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed a number of Eldan constructs inside Exo-Lab XC42, thereby clearing the way to the Elder Cube. Given his hatred of the Cube, the Flame-Watcher was pleased by the destruction, and he wasn't shy about letting you know it.

localizedTextIdText: You took the $(vitem=366) from the Zeta Warbot in Junction Zeta. Director Romavek in Shroud Gloom Cell would be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the $(vitem=366) to Director Romavek in Shroud Gloom
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Director Romavek may be interested in the Death Mechanism you extracted from the Dominion warbot in the ICI's Junction Zeta.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This mechanism may provide insight into the engineering of one of the Dominion's most dangerous constructs of death and destruction. I am in your debt.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our most useful weapon is knowledge.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought the $(vitem=366) from the Zeta Warbot in Junction Zeta to Director Romavek in Shroud Gloom Cell.

localizedTextIdText: The Product Research Assistant and his team have decided they no longer wish to do field research. In order to see their plan successful, they need you to repair all their surveillancebots in the Skittering Sands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Product Research Assistant just outside of Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've decided we don't wish to do field research. We'd rely on our surveillancebots, but they've all broken down and none of us wants to fix them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We'll need to observe the spiders in the Skittering Sands if we wish to research them. Ergo, we need to get eyes on the situation. Repair those bots!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our technicians are analyzing the video feed as we speak. It seems to be coming in fine... no interference at all. That's wonderful!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get the surveillancebots back online, then we'll get a scan of the area.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank Phineas! I thought we'd have to go back out there again!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hope it all works out for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've repaired all of Protostar's surveillancebots in the Skittering Sands. Now the Product Research Assistant and the rest of his crew won't have to risk being eaten by great big spiders.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Product Research Assistant
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thanks for nothing. I shall report this breach of contract at once.

localizedTextIdText: You located a faulty beacon prototype in the Skittering Sands. The beacon requested that you return it, as well as others like it, to Substation SR29.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the Product Research Assistant at Substation SR29
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Malfunction in sensor array. Datachron access disabled. Structural integrity compromised. If found, deliver this unit to Protostar test lab for repair.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This unit must be returned to Substation SR29 at once. Do not delay.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The last batch of beacon prototypes was a complete and abject failure! They are doing more harm than good out there, and my job's on the line!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I certainly hope future models include improved defenses against wildlife. Otherwise, they'll be just as useless as this garbage.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please return this prototype and similar units to Substation SR29.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The cost of returned materials will be credited to your Protostar account.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected all of the faulty beacon prototypes you could find in the Skittering Sands and returned them to the Product Research Assistant at Substation SR29.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to the Product Research Assistant
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This unit has malfunctioned. It serves no purpose as currently deployed.

localizedTextIdText: Wanderer Dallo has asked you to collect a bunch of $m(vitem=373) from Scorchbloom on the Fiera Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Wanderer Dallo on the Fiera Plains
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is an incredible red flower that grows on the Fiera Plains. If you could gather a bunch of these for me, I would be in your debt.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Everyone tells me that you're amazing. Were they wrong? Gee, I hope not. I'd really like to get a big bouquet of those flowers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These flowers are perfect! I cannot wait to show them to my family back home. Once again, you live up to your reputation, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Gather the flowers, then return and tell me about your adventure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered $m(vitem=373) for Wanderer Dallo in the untamed wilds of the Fiera Plains.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd really like to brag about meeting you, but you have disappointed me.

localizedTextIdText: Wanderer Dallo has lost a number of his diary's pages in the Fiera Plains. He's asked you to retrieve all 12 pages of his diary, which detail the stories of the people he's met while exploring Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Wanderer Dallo in the Fiera Plains
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have met so many fascinating people! I've recorded their amazing stories in my diary, but I lost several pages while admiring Malgrave's exotic flora.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you get all my missing pages together, I promise to read you some of the juiciest parts! You won't believe the stuff about that Yatish fellow!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can get started on page 13 now. Do you have any tales of adventure worthy of my collection? I promise, I'll keep it all to myself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Groovy! Search for the pages on the Fiera Plains. Watch out for the plants!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: How should I start? $(player.name) was no ordinary $(player.class)...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You should think about recording a Datachron version.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The entire works of Wanderer Dallo have been restored. Maybe he can write about this in his entry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How about I let you read my diary if you help out? You can't beat that!

localizedTextIdText: Protostar is offering a reward to anyone who can kill Grimclaw at its lair, Grimclaw's Den, in the Fiera Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Grimclaw kills all who go near its lair. Reward offered for proof of the horror's death.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Should you happen to kill Grimclaw, report to the Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager in Area 77.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I certainly hope Grimclaw never comes close to Area 77. It would be a horrible massacre!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With Grimclaw finally destroyed, I'm authorized to offer you a small but competitive remuneration for a job well done. Good show!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager in Area 77 rewarded you for destroying Grimclaw. Good work!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager

localizedTextIdText: Adomo has asked you to collect jars of buzzbing honey from the nearby honeycombs in the Sandstinger Wastes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Adomo in the Sandstinger Wastes
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Whatever you might say about buzzbings, their honey is darn good, you betcha! If you gather a few jars for me, this trip won't be a total loss, no siree.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You manage to get me some of that desert honey yet? The buzzbings are real protective of it, so don't get stung.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yep, that should do it, sure. Guess this place isn't all bad. I mean, the heat's horrid and just about every animal wants to eat you. Could be worse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh sure, some jars of desert honey oughta make up for this heat.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You harvested jar after jar of golden, delicious buzzbing honey and returned them to Adomo. Guess being stuck in the desert has its perks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself.

localizedTextIdText: Adomo has had enough of hostile buzzbings, and has asked you to exterminate Sandswarm Stalker and Sandswarm Doomsting in the Sandstinger Wastes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Adomo the Sandstinger Wastes
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Golly! They don't call this place Sandstinger Wastes for nothing, no sir. The buzzbings are so thick I can't leave this shelter! Can you give me a hand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can barely hear myself think with all this buzzing. You sure you're getting rid of these buzzbings? They're driving me crazy, don't you know.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh sure, that's much better. I forgot what silence sounded like, you betcha. Here's a little something for your trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yep, you'd be doing me a real favor, you betcha.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've engaged in a bit of anti-buzzbing pest control in the Sandstinger Wastes on behalf of Adomo.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That isn't kindly of you, not at all.

localizedTextIdText: A broken Protostar cart in the Sandstinger Wastes has asked you for help. Its mechanical systems have failed and it requires spare parts if it is to be repaired. Search for spare parts in piles of mechanical debris that are spread around the wastes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Broken Protostar Cart in the Sandstinger Wastes
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Malfunction! Error 27-Z-844! Hardware unresponsive to internal commands. Replacement parts must be acquired for systems overhaul!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Diagnostics continue to return hardware-based error protocols. Replacement parts required.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hardware responds properly to all diagnostic queries. This unit will now resume current mission objectives. Gratitude is forthcoming. Thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Battery charge low. Time remaining: unspecified. Please hurry.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You scavenged up a number of spare parts for the broken Protostar cart in the Sandstinger Wastes. With a little elbow grease, you were able to get the cart up and running again.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find you some replacement parts.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Broken Protostar Cart
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This unit may have misinterpreted your answer. Please repeat.

localizedTextIdText: You found one sweet-looking hat on the head of a nasty buzzbing. The original owner will surely be glad to have it back. See if you can find him somewhere in the Sandstinger Wastes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Adomo in the Sandstinger Wastes
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is one stylin' hat. The name "Adomo" is inscribed on the inside of the hat's brim. Maybe it belongs to somebody nearby.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is that my lucky hat? By the Navigator, you found it, yeah? A blasted buzzbing took it. Thought I was going sun-mad, don't you know.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's hoping my head cools off, yeah. I can't take much more, no sir.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That should keep the sun off.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The hat you found has been returned to an Ekose fellow named Adomo. It seems that without his lucky hat, he's gone a little sun-crazy.

localizedTextIdText: The Product Research Assistant research team has been cocooned by spiders. As a result, his productivity has plummeted. He's asked you to go to the Skittering Sands and free his team members from spider cocoons.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Product Research Assistant at Substation SR29
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Productivity has fallen drastically since the team was cocooned by the very spiders we were sent to study. Please tell me you can do something!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If my team doesn't return, I'll be stuck with their workload! You'll have to spring them from their spider cocoons fast - we have a deadline to hit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The team is back - though slightly more adhesive than expected - and is ready to roll out the reports. New product idea - Protostar Brand Spider String!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Our research was on spider-based chemical compounds, not web silicates!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: How about Protostar Brand Silly Twine! Oh, drat! That's not right, either!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed several very sticky Protostar employees from spider cocoons in the Skittering Sands. They scuttled away mumbling about spider string product ideas.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Product Research Assistant
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We're just lowly researchers! Management won't authorize a rescue!

localizedTextIdText: The Product Research Assistant has asked you to collect spider eyes from spiders in the Skittering Sands. He intends to analyze them in order to advance Protostar's optical technology.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Product Research Assistant at Substation SR29
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The spiders in Skittering Sands have exceptional eyesight. We must analyze and replicate their optical lens structure, but we need eye samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The lab is prepared, and all proper forms have been filled out. We're ready for delivery of the spider eyes just as soon as you have them all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let me analyze the lens structure of the eyes you collected. How curious... these lenses are no more effective than yours or mine! Of all the...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You collect the specimens while I fill out the proper requisition forms.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cosmic ledgers! Whose stupid idea was this, anyway? I want to fire someone!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get you some spider eyes.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Maybe you should take another look.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected spider eyes for the Product Research Assistant, but they ended up being less than optimal for his purposes.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll have the spider eyes to you soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Product Research Assistant
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Profit sharing is available for some new products. Please reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: The Product Research Assistant indicates that the chompacabras in Skittering Sands are natural predators of the Skittering spiders, but they've been webbed into their burrows. Clear the webbing away from the burrows so the chompacabras can assume their rightful position as apex predators in the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Product Research Assistant in Substation SR29
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Research reveals that chompacabras are the only natural predators of those blasted spiders, but they've been sealed in their burrows by spider webbing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The spiders still outnumber us by a wide margin. We won't last long unless you free the chompacabras from their burrows!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your fieldwork has verified our initial hypothesis. Those vicious predators didn't eat you. Instead, they went right for the spiders. Lucky you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once freed, those chompacabras should bring some balance to this ecosystem.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm writing up employment contracts for the chompacabras as we speak.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You removed the webbing covering the chompacabra burrows, allowing the vicious beasts to curtail the Skittering spider population. Luckily, the chompers were less interested in you, and more interested in the spiders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you holding out for additional life insurance?

localizedTextIdText: The Product Research Assistant at Substation SR29 has asked you to terminate the largest spider in the Skittering Sands, a beast known as Dreadfang. Hunt Dreadfang down and ensure it is eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Product Research Executive via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The largest spider has been named "Dreadfang" by one of my employees. He thinks it's funny, but I find his humor questionable. That spider must die!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We've lost another researcher to that blasted Dreadfang. I will not stand idly by and allow you to slack off. Find that spider and squash it! Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm far too important to be bothered by a mere contractor. I suggest you see to your current task before I write you up for being a nuisance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see the productivity of the spider research team at Substation SR29 is starting to pick up. I understand you're at least partly responsible.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Without that monster skittering around, we'll feel a whole lot safer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your assistance in this matter was crucial. I'll process your payment at once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the massive spider known as Dreadfang in the Skittering Sands, and you were properly compensated by the Product Research Executive in Area 77. Now the spiders will need to form a committee to choose a new leader.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't stop now. You've almost earned an entire vacation day!

localizedTextIdText: The Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager has asked you to check on a missing Lopp caravan that departed on a marketing campaign towards Scourwind Perch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Marshal Yatish at the wrecked Lopp caravan
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A group of Lopp recently left on a marketing campaign, offering promotional "shinies" to the nearby Falkrin community. I still haven't heard back.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found our missing Lopp caravan yet? They were last seen headed towards the Scourwind Falkrin perch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp come to offer friendship, trade, and shinies. But Falkrin choose to be enemies. Of course, you know this means war.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Information on the Falkrin is vital for my Malgrave demographics report.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lopp not hurt anybody. Yatish though... Yatish might hurt many somebodies.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: A war's just fine with me, Marshal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived right outside Scourwind Perch only to discover the destroyed remains of the missing Lopp caravan. You can only make a guess as to the unfortunate fate of the enthusiastic Lopp marketing strategists. Marshal Yatish has arrived to investigate the scene, vowing revenge for the violence done against Lopp-kind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your disregard for business partnerships is very discouraging!

localizedTextIdText: To teach the locals not to mess with the Lopp in Malgrave, Marshal Yatish at the wrecked Lopp caravan has asked you to head into Scourwind Perch and kill as many Scourwind Falkrin as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yatish mourn the fallen. Falkrin think friendly Lopp mean weak Lopp. They think wrong. Nobody get away with hurting Lopp on Yatish's watch. Kill them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You teach no-good Falkrin fierce lesson yet? Lopp come in peace, offer shinies, but Falkrin kill them anyway. Now you kill Falkrin. No offer shinies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Some big-folk just not listen, until you beat words into their skulls. Then they listen. Or they be dead. Either way fine with Yatish.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No-good Falkrin must learn, you mess with Lopp, you deal with the hop.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have killed a number of Falkrin and Murgh in Scourwind Perch, teaching them there will be bitter retribution for the deaths of the caravan Lopp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yatish have plenty of butt-kick to spare. Want to get on Yatish's bad side?

localizedTextIdText: You discovered the lost Lopp Shipments that were taken to Scourwind Perch by the Falkrin. Deliver them to Deputy Whirlscrew so he can return them to Shinysand Oasis and redistribute them to the Lopp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deputy Whirlscrew via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This crate contains goods stolen from the Lopp caravan by the Scourwind Falkrin. The Lopp of Shinysand Oasis would like to have them returned.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This crate contains goods stolen from the Lopp caravan by the Scourwind Falkrin. The Lopp of Shinysand Oasis would like to have them returned.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Lopp caravan was carrying precious goods, some intended as gifts of peace. The Falkrin took everything and killed them. Horrible, just horrible!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am sure the families in Shinysand will be happy to have these goods recovered. You have done them a great service.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take these goods to the Deputy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered Lopp goods that were stolen by the murderous Falkrin and returned them to Deputy Whirlscrew at the ruined caravan.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take these goods to the deputy.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll bring back their stolen goods.

localizedTextIdText: Deputy Whirlscrew has asked you to serve the Murgh and Falkrin of Scourwind Perch with subpoenas requiring them to appear in court. Due process must be respected!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deputy Whirlscrew via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Since every resident of Scourwind Perch is a witness, I have a huge stack of subpoenas to serve. As a representative of the court, I ask you to deliver them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you served the denizens of Scourwind Perch their subpoenas yet? It is very important we gather proper testimony for the upcoming trial.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Due process has been served. I doubt we will see any of those scofflaws at the hearing, but at least they will not have an excuse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Should they need representation, a registered lawbot will be assigned!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You served the subpoenas to the denizens of Scourwind Perch, but you have a sneaking suspicion they lack proper respect for the law. Either way, justice has been served - quite literally, in fact.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am unable to serve these subpoenas. I require a third party. Namely, you.

localizedTextIdText: Marshal Yatish has asked you to burn Falkrin war banners inside Scourwind Perch and give the Falkrin a chance to yield to his mercy. Neither you nor he are counting on the Falkrin to surrender.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some enemies only negotiate after show of strength. Burn Falkrin war banners. Show birdfolk we mean business.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Burn Falkrin banners in Scourwind Perch. Leave Falkrin with nothing but taste of ash and dust in their beaks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Flames burn hot and strong, like anger in Yatish's heart. Lopp never back down, never run away!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Birdfolk cross the line when they kill Lopp. Yatish leave them in ashes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You burned war banners throughout the perch, showing the Falkrin that the wrath of the Lopp is not to be taken lightly. The flames of retribution are hard to put out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yatish want you to rethink that. Try not to hurt brain.

localizedTextIdText: Marshal Yatish wants to give the Scourwind Falkrin a chance to parley and negotiate peace. Plant a Lopp banner in the upper levels of Scourwind Perch and see what happens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Marshal Yatish in Scourwind Perch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yatish want justice, not just vengeance. This means Falkrin must have chance to surrender. Plant Lopp banner - see what birdfolk have to say.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yatish allow Falkrin one chance to make peace. Place down Lopp banner, see what birdfolk do. Maybe this all misunderstanding... but Yatish doubt it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yatish gave these birdfolk a chance. Now there is no turning back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yatish have good idea what will happen. Be prepared.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They definitely didn't want to talk.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You planted the Lopp banner in Scourwind Perch and were met with only hostility and violence by the Scourwind Falkrin. This isn't going to end well - especially for the Falkrin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You give up on Lopp, Lopp give up on you.
