localizedTextIdText: Marshal Yatish is taking his vengeance on the Scourwind Falkrin to the next level. Torch Falkrin Egg in Scourwind Peak and make Malgrave safe for future Lopp generations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Falkrin start this, we finish this - by taking one step further. Burn Falkrin eggs, then there will be no new Falkrin to threaten Lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Smell of roasting eggs making Yatish hungry. Finish the job so Yatish can have lunch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yatish not want to go so far, but Falkrin force my paw.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You leave eggs to hatch and they grow into Falkrin that kill you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Falkrin showed no mercy, and were rewarded in kind. You destroyed their eggs and carried out the vengeance of the Lopp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yatish think big-folk coward. Maybe worse.

localizedTextIdText: Deputy Whirlscrew has asked you to kill the Falkrin that reside in Scourwind Peak in order to ensure they pay for their hypothetical crimes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deputy Whirlscrew via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've run out of citations and there are still Falkrin perps everywhere! I guess we're going to have to focus on the "dead" part of "dead or alive."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ordinarily I'd hesitate to take such extreme measures. The Marshal assures me that bounty hunting Falkrin perps is perfectly legal in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Statistically, I'm quite certain all of the Falkrin you killed were guilty of something. Frontier justice is so exciting!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make sure you kill these perps in a professional and courteous manner.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The life of a deputized bounty hunter isn't easy, but at least job satisfaction is through the roof. You lawfully executed a number of Falkrin perps in Scourwind Perch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I abhor violence, too, but this needs to be done.

localizedTextIdText: Justice must have due process. Deputy Whirlscrew wants you to gather evidence of Falkrin crimes from around Scourwind Peak.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deputy Whirlscrew via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are 99.99% sure the Falkrin are bad guys, but I'll need you to collect potential evidence anyway. And by potential evidence, I mean everything!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A criminal lair like Scourwind Perch must be full of evidence. Remember, just about anything could be incriminating, so collect it all just to be safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at all this evidence! I'm sure we've uncovered proof of countless Falkrin crimes!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The key to any good investigation is attention to detail!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for standing up for justice in this lawless land.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected a number of potentially incriminating pieces of evidence from around the Falkrin village. This should keep Deputy Whirlscrew busy with paperwork for months.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I should have Yatish arrest you for obstruction of justice!

localizedTextIdText: Whirlygig is a bot with a dangerous hobby - namely, BASE jumping. He intends to leap from the highest point in Malgrave, but he needs your help to make his dream a reality. Make your way to the top of Scourwind Peak while Whirlygig follows at a safe distance behind you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Whirlygig via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My personal designation is Whirlygig. My current objective is to reach the top of Scourwind Peak. If you could lead the way, I would appreciate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must get to the top of Scourwind Peak. It is so very high above the plateau! The view must be breathtaking!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here we are, gentlebeing! Is it not grand? Is it not spectacular? If only I possessed an adrenal gland!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will remain a discreet distance behind you. I am very sneaky for a bot!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You climbed to the top of Scourwind Peak ahead of Whirlygig and observed the breathtaking view. From the looks of things, Whirlygig is one crazy bot if he really intends to jump from such a height.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want to go up there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You want to jump from the peak?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ever since I achieved autonomy, I have enjoyed leaping from high places. Scourwind Peak is the highest place in Northern Malgrave!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes! It's exhilarating... and quite safe, I assure you! Even if my descent speed reduction subsystems fail, I am much more resilient than an organic being.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Crazy...? Oh! You mean to indicate I am mentally deranged! You would not be the first to question my sense of reason, my friend.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will get up there, one way or the other. The jump of a lifetime awaits!

localizedTextIdText: Marshal Yatish witnessed a lone Freebot sneaking into the Falkrin hold and heading towards Scourwind Peak. He's asked you to find this Freebot and make sure he hasn't been dismantled by the Falkrin and their elemental pets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Whirlygig near Scourwind Peak
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yatish see Freebot sneak into Falkrin hold. Not safe for Freebot. Find Freebot, learn why he go there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You find Freebot yet? Went toward Scourwind Peak. Not good place for Freebot to be.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't mind me, sentient. I'm just minding my own business. Yep!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, hello, fellow sentient! Fancy meeting you here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Freebot need help, help. You know drill. Make Yatish proud.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm just seeing the sights, climbing the heights, and avoiding the fights. Right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Marshal Yatish request, you located the Freebot, Whirlygig, near Scourwind Peak. Whirlygig is a bot with a dangerous hobby - namely, BASE jumping. He intends to leap from the highest point in Malgrave, but he needs your help to make his dream a reality.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You need good lickin', too? You not change tune, Yatish give you one.

localizedTextIdText: You found a Scourwind Banner in Scourwind Perch. It might be a good idea to replace any you find with Lopp banners instead. Marshal Yatish would definitely approve.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is a Scourwind banner. Perhaps tearing it down and replacing it with Lopp colors will send the right message to the Falkrin.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This is a Scourwind banner. Perhaps tearing it down and replacing it with Lopp colors will send the right message to the Falkrin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yatish not satisfied till spirits of bird-men crushed! Tear down Falkrin banners, replace with Lopp ones instead! Show them who boss of Malgrave!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yatish see Lopp colors flying in bird-folk village. Bring tear to eye. Honor the dead. Teach Falkrin a lesson. Kill two bird-men with one stone!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wonder what the Falkrin think.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lopp banners now fly proudly in the wind. The Falkrin better recognize that the Lopp of Malgrave are not to be trifled with!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do to improve them.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.

localizedTextIdText: Marshal Yatish wants to target the Brides of Osiric, priestesses of the Falkrin god and advisors to the perch broodlord. Burn their corpses to send a message. A grim task indeed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Brides of Osiric rule perch, tell broodlord to hurt Lopp. Kill Brides, burn their bodies, show Falkrin what we think of their priestesses.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kill Brides of Osiric. Set bodies on fire. Not complicated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Falkrin will fear my paw of justice. Show them we not afraid of tricksy Falkrin god.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust, Falkrin to fire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Smells like roast ravenok in here. Tummy growling. Still not eat lunch.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They'll think twice before attacking Lopp.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made a multitude of pyres out of the bodies of the fallen Scourwind Priestess{p:Scourwind Priestesses}. The Falkrin must know you mean business by now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You come too far. Big-folk cannot stop now.

localizedTextIdText: Now to end this campaign against the Scourwind Falkrin! Marshal Yatish wants you to blow the Challenge Horn in the Broodlord's Redoubt to summon Broodlord Morkhel, then battle him to the death.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Marshal Yatish via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Falkrin crimes lay at the Broodlord's door. As leader, must take mantle of responsibility. Deliver justice to Scourwind leader.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Deliver reckoning to Broodlord Morkhel, Scourwind leader. He must pay for his people's crimes. Blow the Challenge Horn and he will come.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yatish's work finally done. Lopp safe, justice delivered. All is good and shiny now. Thank you, big friend of the Lopp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show Falkrin that Osiric cannot save them from Yatish's justice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew the Horn of Challenge which brought the wrath of Broodlord Morkhel upon your head. You battled the powerful leader of the Scourwind Falkrin and finally delivered Marshal Yatish justice. Those who wish to harm the Lopp of Malgrave will think long and hard before making the same mistake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yatish not take no for answer.

localizedTextIdText: Whirlygig is concerned about the presence of a massive air elemental, the Windscourge, atop Scourwind Peak. He's asked you to destroy the elemental so that he can safely leap from the top of the peak.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Whirlygig on top of Scourwind Peak
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Grinding gears! Will you look at the size of that elemental? I'll never get past it... unless you destroy it. Can you do that, gentlebeing? Please...?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Windscourge has not been destroyed yet. How can I leap from Scourwind Peak if that creature destroys me first?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Windscourge has not been destroyed yet. How can I leap from Scourwind Peak if that creature destroys me first?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was amazing! Rarely have I seen a sentient being face destruction with such unwavering bravery! You are amazing!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're a true friend. I'll be in your debt if that thing doesn't kill you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll give it a try, Whirlygig.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Windscourge, thereby clearing the way for Whirlygig to plummet from the top of Scourwind Peak.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll give it a try, Whirlygig.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll give it a try, Whirlygig.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose I can wait here. Maybe the elemental will leave, but I doubt it.

localizedTextIdText: The coast is clear, and Whirlygig is ready to jump from the top of Scourwind Peak. Watch him take the plunge, then follow him... unless you're too scared.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Whirlygig in Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now's the time to leap from Scourwind Peak! What do you say? Come on and join me, $(player.name)! It will be fun!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Jumping is the hard part. Falling is easy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Jumping is the hard part. Falling is easy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was great! I loved every second of it! It is really too bad that the fall only lasted a few short seconds.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I have done this plenty of times and I'm still functional!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am fine! Thank you for asking. I just need to catch my proverbial breath.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Uh... I don't know about this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Whirlygig leapt from the top of Scourwind Peak. Though he survived the jump, he's a little worse for wear. Regardless of the outcome, you'll never forget the feeling in the pit of your stomach as you reached terminal velocity in the sky above Malgrave!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have been so brave. Are you feeling what others refer to as "fear?"

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen wants to show you how to craft architectural projects. Use the materials he's given you to craft $m(schematic=374) at a crafting station in Gallow and bring the final product to Architect Kaspmara.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished $m(schematic=374) to Architect Kaspmara at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now take the wood and supplies I gave you and get to work. You can find the $schematic=374 schematic at the Crafting Station. Shouldn't be hard!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Crafting Station is right behind me. Use it to look through your schematics, and find the one for $schematic=374. Bring the final product to Architect Kaspmara!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You cannot merely slap together a hovel and expect someone to call it a home. We must put our very soul into our crafts!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, this $schematic=374 will do perfectly. It might seem like a small thing, but it's the little things that will bring our people comfort in dark days.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you're done, bring the final product to Architect Kaspmara!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Comfort is often sought, but seldom found.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: For your first architectural project, you crafted $m(schematic=374) for Architect Kaspmara.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished $m(schematic=374) to Architect Kaspmara
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you really gonna just take the materials I've entrusted to you? Really?

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio wants to show you how to craft furniture. Use the materials he's given you to craft $m(schematic=374) at a crafting station in Feralplain Collective. When finished, take the final product to Architect Virin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished $m(schematic=374) to Architect Virin at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Take the wood and supplies I have so generously provided, and do your duty. The Crafting Station has everything else you need to craft $schematic=374.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is a Crafting Station right behind me. Look through the schematics, and find the one for $schematic=374. Take the final product to Architect Virin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's all sorts of work what needs to be done. Building $schematic=374 might not seem like much, but it's bloody important.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice to see you don't think you're above making $schematic=374. I know people's requests may seem strange, but it's up to us to oblige.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you finish, take it to Architect Virin.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With architects like you about, we'll get this place up to snuff, we will.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: For your first architecture project, you crafted $m(schematic=374) for Architect Virin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So, you are just going to take the materials I have given to you and leave?

localizedTextIdText: Sally Kettleshaw has asked you to head to the Protostar camp near Area 77. Protostar has discovered a large loftite deposit in that area and have been mining away. Sally wants you to get in good with Protostar in hopes that they'll will share the wealth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Safety and Security Supervisor in Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Word on the wire is Protostar found a big ol' buncha loftite and are minin' away. Head on over to Area 77 and see if you can get in good with 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If you head up to Area 77 and get in cahoots with Protostar, the Exiles might be able to bag some of that juicy loftite deposit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Welcome to Area 77. As you can see, I'm a bit on the busy side right now. Perhaps another clone can help you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Area 77, Protostar's state-of-the-art live-work facility in northern Malgrave. Are you interested in purchasing some of our fine products?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We need to get 'em on our side before the Dominion do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, I see. Well then, you must first pass a safety inspection.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll do my best to make friends.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Per Sally Kettleshaw instructions, you headed to Area 77 to improve Exile relations with Protostar. Hopefully, you can convince them to share their large claim of loftite.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll do my best to make friends.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Safety and Security Supervisor
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I take it you're not a real go-getter, hm?

localizedTextIdText: High Priestess Raumia has asked you to head to the Protostar camp near Area 77. Protostar has discovered a large loftite deposit in that area and have been mining away. Raumia wants you to get in good with Protostar in hopes that they'll will share the wealth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Safety and Security Supervisor in Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar has found a sizable loftite deposit in Area 77. The Dominion wants access to it. You will go there at once and offer your services to Protostar.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you doing here? Go to Area 77 at once and do your best to befriend Protostar's clones... or employees... whatever they are.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Welcome to Area 77. As you can see, I'm a bit on the busy side right now. Perhaps another clone can help you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Area 77, Protostar's state-of-the-art live-work facility in northern Malgrave. Are you interested in purchasing some of our fine products?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Exiles may already be on their way to Area 77. Make haste!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, I see. Well then, you must first pass a safety inspection.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I heard Protostar needed some help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Per High Priestess Raumia instructions, you headed to Area 77 to improve Dominion relations with Protostar. Hopefully, you can convince them to share their large claim of loftite.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Safety and Security Supervisor
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did you think I was asking?

localizedTextIdText: Security is very important to Protostar, especially with so many unsavory types around Area 77. The Safety and Security Supervisor has asked you to complete a quiz with his formbot to determine if you are, in fact, safe.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Safety and Security Supervisor in Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome, prospective employee! Please step over to the formbot and complete the new, improved security safety quiz, version 2.3.5!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I assure you, results from your test will be used to better target our product marketing. Just another way Protostar is working with you, for you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So...how did your quiz turn out?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Between you and I, it's a very simple test. I cannot fathom you failing it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I told you it was easy!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take your silly little quiz.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the security safety quiz and failed miserably, but you left that little detail out when you returned to the Safety and Security Supervisor. You have now been given "Low Security" status in Area 77, and this allows you the ability to carry out high risk tasks for insufficient monetary compensation. Congratulations!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Safety and Security Supervisor
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is the highest level you can get from the test?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Then what's the point of the test?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Yeah, you're rolling in success...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: I'll pass on the dysentery and just take the test.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The security safety quiz helps Protostar determine the level of security access for each individual.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Not to worry! There is unlimited potential for advancement regardless of experience or test score. We have a place for everyone!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: What's the point, you ask? Why, with this new test, I have improved the safety in Area 77 by 0.023%! A rousing success!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Indeed! Well, that and Protostar brand Kurg Manure Sunscreen. It keeps the duneflies away, and provides protection from solar damage! Care to purchase some? How many metric tons can I put you down for?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: If you change your mind, just let me know!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am certain other qualified candidates will present themselves.

localizedTextIdText: The Safety and Security Supervisor has asked you to spruce up Area 77. There are a number of issues with various types of equipment around the camp that need to be repaired.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Safety and Security Supervisor in Area 77
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wonderful! With your new low-level security access, you're a valuable part of the Protostar team. Your first task: routine equipment maintenance!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Confused? It's simple! Just make a circuit of the camp and repair any equipment that has stopped working. It's so easy, any clone can do it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You fixed them all without causing a single explosion? This is the first time anyone has performed with a 100% safety record. No wonder you aced the quiz!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: What a treat! A fancy-free day of repetitive manual labor!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Why, I'd calculate you increased our safety rating by almost 3.28%!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Where do you get these numbers from?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Safety and Security Supervisor by repairing the broken equipment around Area 77.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Safety and Security Supervisor
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I would hate for you to lose your low-level security access.

localizedTextIdText: With your stellar safety record, the Safety and Security Supervisor in Area 77 thinks he has the perfect job for you. He wants you to speak with the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen} down near the Maintenance Lift.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen} near the Maintenance Lift
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Loftite mining operations in Shardspire Canyon have dramatically plummeted due to an extreme lack of safety. Speak with the foreman for more details.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken with the foreman of the Shardspire operations yet? For profit's sake, why not? Our bottom line is dropping as we speak!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Profits and losses! I'm so glad you're here! We've been experiencing all sorts of safety standard violations. And absolutely none of it is my fault!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With your record, I daresay you're the $2?g/man/woman/one; for the job.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Is it true you have a flawless safety record? That's unheard of!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen}, who informed you the Shardspire mining operation has experienced serious setbacks and personnel losses.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen}
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This refusal will go into your personnel records permanently!

localizedTextIdText: The PSPN Producer in Area 77 is in dire need of help. His broadcasting equipment, which is to be used to air the Hellrose Bowl event, has been lost. He's asked you to take his backup Protostar broadcasting equipment and give it to the PSPN Associate Producer at the stadium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the PSPN Associate Producer at the Hellrose Bowl Stadium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm in something of a bind! I need you to run this broadcasting equipment to my associate producer at Hellrose Bowl Stadium. Can you lend me a hand?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you taken that equipment to my associate producer yet? This is showbiz, kid! Timing is everything! Get a move on before we miss our window!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If I don't get new broadcasting equipment, my producer will have me written up! Can you fetch the backup equipment for me? It's in Area 77!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a lifesaver! If you find more broadcasting equipment, just place it in the Collect-O-Matic 5000.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once enough equipment has been recovered, the Hellrose Bowl can begin!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We might just meet our broadcast deadline!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the backup broadcasting equipment and delivered it to the PSPN Associate Producer at the stadium in Malgrave. Once the Contain-O-Matic 5000 has been filled with enough broadcasting equipment, the Hellrose Bowl will begin!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to the PSPN Associate Producer
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What happened to your broadcasting equipment?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What's happening down at the stadium?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: That sounds exciting! Are you looking for participants?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The ship that was carrying it to the stadium blew up, scattering the equipment all over the place. Now vermin throughout Malgrave have picked up our gear!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Protostar, in conjunction with Sports Programming Network, is hosting a pay per view event! The Hellrose Bowl! We could make millions... if we can recover the equipment so people can actually pay to view it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Of course! Help get me that equipment, and I'll make you a STAR!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'll never work in this town again!

localizedTextIdText: The Shardspire Canyon mining operations have been experiencing setbacks due to malfunctioning Protostar minebots near Highbed Creek. Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen} has asked you to locate the malfunctioning units and teleport them back to him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen} at the Maintenance Lift
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our minebots have been malfunctioning due to... unsafe working conditions. We've been unable to retrieve the units for repair. That is, until now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well? What are you waiting for? We can't resume operations until our minebots have been returned for repair. Find them and teleport them to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! Requesting replacements for that many bots would have negatively impacted the department budget.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please note Protostar is not responsible for any injuries.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Highbed Creek was overrun by raging water elementals. Protostar may need to readjust its definition of "unsafe working conditions," but you were still able to teleport the malfunctioning minebots back to the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen}.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen}
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nothing to worry about! Just a minor setback! It appears Highbed Creek has transformed into a group of raging water elementals, but I'm sure it's nothing someone with your safety record can't handle.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your subpar work ethic has been noted!

localizedTextIdTitle: Up the Creek, Ready for Battle
localizedTextIdText: The Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen} Personal Assist-O-Bot has asked you to deal with the Creekwater Primordial over by Highbed Creek. He seems to believe this has something to do with the Aurin who have appeared in Shardspire Canyon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Personal Assist-O-Bot via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This unit is assigned to destroy rootbrutes and aqueous elementals in Highbed Creek. Task exceeds this unit's brutality threshold. Require organic assistance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please report on status of task. Have aqueous elementals and rootbrutes been eliminated in Highbed Creek? Awaiting response.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aqueous elementals and rootbrutes have been eliminated. This unit offers thanks for your assistance in 5... 4... 3... 2... 1.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hostile Aurin also present near creekbed. Exercise caution.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Gratitude subroutine active. Thank you. Ending subroutine.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen} Personal Assist-O-Bot by getting rid of the Creekwater Primordial and rootbrutes in Highbed Creek.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where did the water elementals come from?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Origin unknown. Aqueous elementals appeared without warning. Analysis indicates that hostile Aurin may be responsible.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Initiating begging subroutine - please. Please. Please. Please. Please.

localizedTextIdText: You found a laser mining pickaxe laying discarded near Highbed Creek. Use it to collect mineral samples from the red mineral deposits in the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Personal Assist-O-Bot via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A laser pickaxe lays discarded on the ground. Such tools are used for many standard mining tasks.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A laser pickaxe lays discarded on the ground. Such tools are used for many standard mining tasks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Chief Mineralogist still missing. Upon his return, he will appreciate delivery of mineral samples. Laser pickaxe required for task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mineral samples received. This unit will deliver them to the Chief Mineralogist when he returns to duty. Thank you for your assistance.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Maybe I can put it to use.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Here are the samples I collected.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a number of Highbed Mineral Sample from the area to be assessed for value when the Chief Mineralogist returns to duty.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Maybe I can put it to use.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll collect mineral samples with the pickaxe.

localizedTextIdText: The Shardspire Foreman{p:Shardspire Foremen} has asked you to use the Maintenance Lift to travel down to Shardspire Canyon to look for the Chief Mineralogist.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet up with the Chief Mineralogist at Security Point Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that the trivial tasks are done, we have a serious safety violation down in the canyon that needs to be addressed! The Chief Mineralogist is missing!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found the Chief Mineralogist yet? For profit's sake, just take the lift down to Shardspire Canyon and have a look!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is horrible! Quick, everyone! Panic!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that the leadership structure has been properly re-established, I believe it's time to drive these so-called Thorns of Arboria from Shardspire Canyon!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Resuming production is pointless without a mineralogist to assess value!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ran into the Shardspire Security Officer, who was playing dead, and was able to rescue the Chief Mineralogist from the Sandthorne eco-terrorists. He escaped to Security Point Alpha and may have further instructions for you there.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Meet up with the Chief Mineralogist
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about Shardspire Canyon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What can you tell me about these eco-terrorists?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: One of our most profitable operations in all of Malgrave! Loftite is a handy mineral, you know, and unsurprisingly lucrative! Of course, it doesn't help when a group of eco-terrorists move into the neighborhood...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Terrible, absolutely terrible! I was referring to our bottom line! That's the effect of these eco-terrorists, the ones who call themselves the Thorns of Arboria. They charmed our creek water away and have been raising all sorts of nasty vermin from the sands. A setback, definitely a setback! But don't let corporate know! Not yet, anyway.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm beginning to have doubts about your suitability as a contractor.

localizedTextIdText: The Chief Mineralogist is attempting to restore operations in Shardspire Canyon. His first move is to have you disarm the explosive charges set all around Western Shardspire Canyon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Mineralogist via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: First things first...do something about the explosives! They're everywhere! And at any moment, they could damage our valuable infrastructure!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Uh, hello? Explosives? Everywhere? They need to be disarmed, and in my experience, sooner is inevitably better than later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! I can see how you've achieved your 100% safety, security, and survival record. But this job isn't over yet! Oh, no!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please, save my infrastructure! My precious, precious infrastructure!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We - meaning you - must deal with these Sandthorne eco-terrorists directly!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Does this job include hazard pay?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to defuse the explosives placed by the Sandthorne eco-terrorists, thus saving the Chief Mineralogist precious mining infrastructure.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why would they have a problem?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Are you really in compliance with environmental regulations?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Sandthorne belong to a group of very unpleasant individuals who call themselves the Thorns of Arboria. Apparently they take exception to our regulation-compliant mining operations here in Malgrave. They accuse us of despoiling the pristine nature of the desert!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: An excellent question! We discovered this strange black liquid we are calling fossil fuel! A very crude but cheap means of energy! Sandthorne has been violently protesting our use of this cheap and plentiful resource to power our bots and run our equipment. Can you imagine? Ridiculous!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Of course! Why do you think the Environmental Protostar Agency exists? Does Protostar truly strike you as a soulless, money-grubbing corporation? Wait, don't answer that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Disarming a canyon full of explosives is what a safety consultant does!

localizedTextIdText: The Shardspire Security Officer has asked you to get rid of the Sandthorne eco-terrorists in Western Shardspire Canyon. The unsecured area must be secured so the mining operation can continue securely under his security detail.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Shardspire Security Officer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to secure Shardspire Canyon. And by that, I mean kill all the Sandthorne eco-terrorists that are making the area unsecure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you secured Shardspire Canyon against the recent security breach? Sandthorne eco-terrorists are a serious threat to security.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm secure in knowing you've secured the area against the hostile elements that chose to breach our security.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Any injury to eco-terrorists will not count against your safety record.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good. I'm glad to see that you take security seriously.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Sandthorne eco-terrorists in Western Shardspire Canyon in order to secure the area, so that future mining efforts can continue - that's right - securely.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Shardspire Security Officer
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Failure to secure the canyon will negatively impact your record!

localizedTextIdText: The Shardspire Security Officer is concerned that the malverine accompanying the Sandthorne eco-terrorists in Western Shardspire Canyon pose a safety hazard. Kill the beasts and collect their teeth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Shardspire Security Officer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The malverine pets of these eco-terrorists are unsafe! Sharp claws, unsanitary fur... and those teeth! A small parts hazard, to say the least!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you taken care of the malverine safety problem? No? I'll have you know, malverine teeth are considered the leading cause of malverine bites!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! You have a promising future as a highly expendable Protostar safety and security expert.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Teeth are the worst! Sharp edges, a dangerous chance of being swallowed...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took care of the small parts hazard by collecting plenty of malverine fangs. Now to dispose of them safely.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Shardspire Security Officer
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're not being very helpful in regards to the safety matter.

localizedTextIdText: The Chief Mineralogist is concerned that the Sandthorne eco-terrorists have been creating giant gronyx from the oily sands in Eastern Shardspire Canyon. Kill Sandthorne eco-terrorists, along with any Oilsand Gronyx{p:Oilsand Gronyx} you see.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Mineralogist via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Sandthorne have done it again! First, our creek! Now our fossil fuel! Consultant, do something already! We can't have oilsand giants walking around!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm not accustomed to fungible resources coming to life and stomping on investments. The eco-terrorists in the eastern canyon must be dealt with!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that the resources are back in the ground where they belong, we can focus on their upstairs management.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I wonder if R&D has considered this use of fossil fuels yet? Hmmmm.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As they say, if you have a problem, always ask to speak with the manager!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Sandthorne Sandshifter and the Oilsand Gronyx{p:Oilsand Gronyx} they've created from the oily sands.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see to it at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aren't you the safety and security expert? Because you're failing at both.

localizedTextIdText: The Sandthorne are led by Lady Briarthorn, a powerful Aurin who has made the upper loftite plateaus her headquarters. Use loftite to jump onto the floating rock plateaus in Eastern Shardspire Canyon and carry out her termination.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Chief Mineralogist at Security Point Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sandthorne upper management has taken over the upper loftite plateaus. Arrange a face-to-face with their leader, Lady Briarthorn, and terminate her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Make sure Lady Briarthorn understands our situation. The Shardspire operations really must continue. Or you can kill her. Same thing, really.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done capitalism a great service! I expect operations in Shardspire should resume soon - we may even be in the black sometime this galactic quarter!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: And please, no golden parachutes for Sandthorne executives.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Exit the canyon the same way you came, via the maintenance lift.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the request of the Chief Mineralogist, you carried out termination orders for the leader of the Sandthorne eco-terrorists, the Malgrave division of the extremist group known as the Thorns of Arboria. With her death, the remaining eco-terrorists will be cleaned up by Protostar security forces and operations will resume in Shardspire Canyon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will have to insist you reconsider our offer!

localizedTextIdText: The Shardspire Security Officer has asked you to dispense medical care to wounded Protostar workers throughout Eastern Shardspire Canyon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Shardspire Security Officer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that company infrastructure has been secured, we can take care of lower priority issues, such as dispensing medical care to wounded workers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Protostar workers are cloned for durability, but even a perfect specimen will perish without medical attention.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! In fact, I'm fairly certain we won't have to grant additional medical leave to any of our employees!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Not to worry! Protostar workers are cloned for durability!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You administered aid to the wounded workers, restoring the Protostar workforce for more hours of underpaid labor (but with fifteen minute breaks!).
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Shardspire Security Officer
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A refreshing if somewhat unpopular attitude on worker healthcare.

localizedTextIdText: You discovered formations of pure loftite crystal growing in Eastern Shardspire Canyon. The Personal Assist-O-Bot has indicated that Protostar will be willing to pay premium prices for any that you collect.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Mineralogist via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pure loftite crystal detected. The Chief Mineralogist should be notified immediately. Presenting him with multiple samples is highly recommended.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please deliver additional pure loftite samples to the Chief Mineralogist immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found more samples of pure loftite crystal? In addition to making the user go soaring into the air when they jump, it's also very valuable!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These are some very pure samples! The profit potential of these crystals is through the roof! Remind me to request a merit increase for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Loftite is valuable to Protostar's high-end clientele.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I may also be able to swing a couple hours of paid leave in Area 77.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Chief Mineralogist was ecstatic with the pure loftite crystals you collected.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal to comply with suggestion noted. Email to Chief Mineralogist dispatched.

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg have completely overrun the Savage Coast and are threatening the Dominion's security on the island. The Caretaker needs you to bring the Dominion's early warning system back online.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker at <text Link ="Location:28753">Crimson Command</text>
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your people have installed a warning system that must be fixed immediately if the Dreg are to be turned back. Supervisor Kera requires your assistance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The early warning system has yet to be reactivated. What is the delay? Have you spoken with Technical Supervisor Kera, yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nicely done, sapient. I am certain Supervisor Kera is also pleased. However, the damage caused by the Dreg is not limited to the Savage Coast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Report to Supervisor Kera. I believe she has a plan of action.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The communications towers are up and running, but the damage caused by the Dreg isn't confined to the Savage Coast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps I did not properly communicate the severity of this situation.

localizedTextIdText: Despite the Caretaker's best attempts at altering the augmentor constructs' AI, they are still freely augmenting the Dreg. Zami Tel has requested that you piece together AI cores taken from augmentors and determine what's controlling their behavior.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Despite the changes I've made to their AI cores, the augmentor constructs continue to modify the Dreg. Zami Tel is attempting to discover why.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to Zami Tel about the augmentor constructs? This situation cannot be ignored any longer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: According to Zami Tel's report, the AI cores are just as I designed them to be. However, they continue to augment the Dreg. How puzzling!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The augmentors cannot be allowed to modify additional Dreg specimens.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Something else must be driving the augmentors to target Dreg specimens.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Zami Tel determine that the AI cores of the augmentor constructs are just as he designed them. Some other outside influence must be encouraging the augmentor constructs to target the Dreg.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I must analyze your reaction, sapient. Are you fearful? Or merely indolent?

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has detected a security breach inside Exo-Lab 22. He has asked you to speak to Captain Binoxia and put her plan into motion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg have gained access to Exo-Lab 22, but I am uncertain how or why they have done this. Speak with Binoxia and put a stop to this intrusion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By virtue of her Mechari physiology, Binoxia should be capable of devising a plan to remove the Dreg from Exo-Lab 22.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Amazing! The Dreg are purposely seeking out augmentation! I am beginning to question their motives. Nevertheless, they must be stopped.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Could the Dreg be seeking out the augmentor constructs of their own accord?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for your assistance, sapient.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed the crazed Palehusk Dreglord inside Exo-Lab 22 and stopped the Dreg from destroying the Exo-Lab. The Dreg have been willingly exposing themselves to augmentation, and the Dominion will need your help to stop them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is distressing. Who knows what harm the Dreg have already inflicted?

localizedTextIdText: Megatech Station has been completely overrun by the Dreg, and augmentor constructs are everywhere. The Caretaker is concerned that the Dreg will use the station's generators to restart the Eldan Annihilator. He's asked you to speak with Specialist Matthews, who has devised a plan to stop the Dreg.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg have activated the generators in Megatech Station in an attempt to reactivate the Eldan Annihilator. Speak to Matthews and shut the generators down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the Eldan Annihilator is reactivated, it will likely destroy this island as well as all life on it. You must speak to Specialist Matthews at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The generators have been powered down, reducing the possibility of the Eldan Annihilator's reactivation. Unfortunately, the Dreg still pose a threat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Specialist Matthews is a very intelligent sapient... for a human.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You powered down the four generators the Dreg were using to charge the Eldan Annihilator at Megatech Station. Though the threat of the Eldan Annihilator has been reduced, the Dreg, if left alone, are still dangerous.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So you have no problem being destroyed along with the rest of this island?

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has detected a security breach inside Exo-Lab 22. He has asked you to speak to Ludmil Borgos and put his plan into motion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg have gained access to Exo-Lab 22, but I am uncertain how or why they have done so. Speak with Ludmil Borgos and put a stop to this intrusion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By virtue of his vast intellect, Borgos should be capable of devising a plan to remove the Dreg from Exo-Lab 22.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Amazing! The Dreg are purposely seeking out augmentation! I am beginning to question their motives. Nevertheless, they must be stopped.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Could the Dreg be seeking out the augmentor constructs of their own accord?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for your assistance, sapient.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and killed the crazed Palehusk Dreglord inside Exo-Lab 22 and stopped the Dreg from destroying the Exo-Lab. The Dreg have been willingly exposing themselves to augmentation, and the Exiles will need your help to stop them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is distressing. Who knows what harm the Dreg have already inflicted?

localizedTextIdText: Exo-Lab 22 has been permanently damaged by the Dreg. As a result, the Caretaker is no longer able to control the facility's augmentor constructs. To alleviate this problem, he has requested that you destroy augmentor constructs as well as the summoning construct in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Damage to Exo-Lab 22 prevents me from controlling the augmentor constructs. Destroy them, then disable the summoning construct that creates them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you are to destroy the augmentors and disable the summoning construct, you must first speak to Stara Galeweave.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Despite your success in deactivating those unfortunate augmentor constructs, I surmise the Dreg will remain a constant threat here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stara Galeweave will be able to give you more information. Speak to her.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I do hope I can continue to rely upon your many talents, sapient.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Dreg will not let the destruction of a few augmentor constructs keep them down for very long. If the Exiles are to prevail on Crimson Isle, they will need your continued support.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Might you reconsider? I feel so terribly useless at the moment.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion forces in the Crimson Badlands periodically receive rations from HQ. These rations are being stolen and destroyed by the Dreg. Gaetus Cricus has ordered you to defend the drop points in and around Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Gaetus Cricus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our ration drops from headquarters are being taken - or, worse, destroyed - by the Dreg. I fear we'll starve if the drops are not properly defended.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The drop points, as well as their flares, are located in Bloodstone Canyon. Do your best to defend them against the Dreg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our rations aren't the most appetizing comestibles, but they keep our bellies full nonetheless. Thank you for defending them from the Dreg.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use the flare at the drop point and both the rations and the Dreg will arrive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully defended the ration drops from the Dreg in Bloodstone Canyon, ensuring the Dominion's forces on the ground will remain well-fed.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll stop the Dreg in their tracks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool! If they are allowed to take our rations, the Dreg will starve us out!

localizedTextIdText: The Exiles in the Crimson Badlands periodically receive rations from HQ. These rations are being stolen and destroyed by the Dreg. Katya Brekarin has ordered you to defend the drop points in and around Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Katya Brekarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our ration drops from HQ are being robbed - or, worse, ravaged - by the Dreg. We will surely starve if the supplies are not safeguarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The drop points, as well as their flares, are located in Bloodstone Canyon. Do your best to defend them against the Dreg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our rations aren't the most palatable provisions, but they keep our bellies brimming. Thank you for defending them from the Dreg.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use the flare at the drop point and both the rations and the Dreg will arrive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully defended the ration drops from the Dreg in Bloodstone Canyon, ensuring the Exile forces on the ground will remain well-fed.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll stop the Dreg in their tracks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool! If they are allowed to take our rations, the Dreg will starve us out!

localizedTextIdText: The Palehusk Dreg have proven to be tenacious foes of the Dominion on Crimson Isle. In order to guarantee the Dominion's victory over these primitive savages, Captain Binoxia has requested you kill them and burn their towers to the ground in the Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Binoxia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Palehusk Dreg refuse to submit to the Dominion's rightful claim to Crimson Isle. We must teach them their place... violently, if need be.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Proceed at once to the Palehusk camp. Use fire and steel to remind them of their place in the grand scheme of things.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your reputation is well-deserved, $(player.name). I suspect even the Palehusk Dreg know your name by now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take their lives and burn their watchtowers. Leave nothing untouched.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You burned the towers in the Palehusk Camp, and killed many of the Dreg that defended them.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: The Dreg don't stand a chance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you not serve the emperor? I am starting to have doubts about your loyalty.

localizedTextIdText: The Palehusk Dreg have proven to be tenacious foes of the Exiles on Crimson Isle. In order to guarantee an Exile victory, Ludmil Borgos has requested you kill them and burn their towers to the ground in the Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ludmil Borgos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg of the Palehusk cannot be reasoned with. The only language they understand is violence. Will you send them a message of fire and death?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Proceed at once to the Palehusk camp. Use fire and steel to demonstrate the resolve of the Exiles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Palehusk Dreg will not soon forget your foray into their camp. Perhaps your name will be one they use to frighten their children...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect you will snuff out their lives as you incinerate their towers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You burned the towers in the Palehusk Camp, and killed many of the Dreg that defended them.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: The Dreg don't stand a chance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If the Dreg are not dealt with, our time here will be short-lived.

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg cook and eat their victims, including Dominion citizens and troops. Gaetus Cricus has asked you to put a stop to this cannibalistic practice by destroying the grills that the Dreg use to broil their victims in Bloodstone Canyon and the Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Gaetus Cricus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg are filthy creatures that prey on Dominion citizens and cook them over open fires. Prevent this despicable behavior by blowing up their grills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dreg prepare their "food" on grills throughout Bloodstone Canyon and in Palehusk Camp. Find these grills and blow them up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. The smell of roasting flesh no longer carries on the wind. Hopefully, the Dreg are above eating their victims raw.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Without a means to cook our citizens, perhaps the Dreg will starve!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew up several of the Dreg grills, preventing them from barbecuing unfortunate Dominion citizens. In time, perhaps this lack of sustenance will weaken the filthy creatures.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you stand idly by while such barbarism is perpetrated upon us?

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg cook and eat their victims, including the Exiles. Katya Brekarin has asked you to put a stop to this hideous practice by destroying the grills that the Dreg use to broil their victims in Bloodstone Canyon and the Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Katya Brekarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg are craven creatures that prey on Exiles and cook them over open fires. Prevent this bestial behavior by blowing up their grills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dreg cook their "food" on grills throughout Bloodstone Canyon and in Palehusk Camp. Find these grills and blow them up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The stench of roasting flesh no longer carries on the wind. I do hope the Dreg are above eating their victims raw.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Without a means to roast us, perhaps the Dreg will become famished.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew up several of the Dregs' grills, preventing them from barbecuing other unfortunate Exiles. In time, perhaps this lack of sustenance will weaken the filthy creatures.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you stand idly by while such cruelty is committed upon us?

localizedTextIdText: Pallian Cyreus wants you to offer your aid to Dominion operatives in Bloodstone Canyon, Venombite Pass, and Crimson Command. By helping these individuals out, you will aid the Dominion in its efforts to cleanse Crimson Isle of the barbarous Dreg.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Pallian Cyreus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have a number of Dominion operatives in the field that require assistance. Seek them out and lend them each a hand in Dominus' name.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you offered your assistance to our operatives? The Dreg are not about to lay down and die without a fight.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for seeking out my operatives. I can assure you, each and every one of them is pleased to have your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall inform them to expect you. Best of luck, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm happy to lend a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Pallian Cyreus request, you spoke to Supervisor Kera, Zami Tel, and Captain Binoxia on Crimson Isle.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll speak to them at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are proving less useful than I'd hoped. How unfortunate... for you.

localizedTextIdText: Lila Redkill wants you to offer your aid to Exiles in Bloodstone Canyon, Venombite Pass, and Bloodstone Landing. By helping these individuals out, you will aid the Exiles in their efforts to cleanse Crimson Isle of the barbarous Dreg.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lila Redkill via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Think you can pitch in, $(player.name)? 'Cause I got Exiles all over this island who need help. Can you lend 'em all a hand or two?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By helpin' the Exiles out there, you're helpin' me. Now get out there and help 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's what I like to hear! All my people are sayin' lots of good things about you. It's good to know I was right about you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're one of the best folks we got. I know you'll do us right.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm happy to lend a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Lila Redkill request, you spoke to Specialist Matthews, Ludmil Borgos, and Stara Galeweave on Crimson Isle.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess your good reputation is just a load of rowsdower dag, ain't it?

localizedTextIdText: Eldan constructs are augmenting the weavers of Venombite Pass. Stara Galeweave has asked you to enter the canyon and burn the Toxic Weaver and their eggs with her flamethrower.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Stara Galeweave via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan constructs are augmenting weavers and destroying their natural life cycle! These arachnid abominations are dangerous and need to be killed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please get rid of those icky augmented weavers in Venombite Pass. Try burning them with my incinerator unit. It kills bugs dead!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm glad you came along to help out, because I'm not sure I could have brought myself to burn those weavers alive like that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I don't like harming animals, but in this case I suggest fire... lots of fire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't worry, $(player.name). Nightmares aren't real.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll have nightmares for a while.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the help of Stara Galeweave flamethrower, you purged Venombite Pass of augmented weavers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But... if we don't stop these abominations now, we'll soon be overrun!

localizedTextIdText: Stara Galeweave has asked you to enter Venombite Pass and slay the Toxic Empress. She's a dangerous foe and will require help from your friends and allies to take down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Stara Galeweave via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a really nasty weaver queen, the Toxic Empress. If we want to halt the creation of these augmented weavers, we'll need to get rid of her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I almost hesitate to ask, but is the Toxic Empress dead, yet? She's probably laying her nasty eggs somewhere in Venombite Pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You killed the Toxic Empress! I know this couldn't have been an easy task, but it had to be done... and you and your friends were the ones to do it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I wouldn't face her alone, $(player.name). She's far too dangerous!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I really hope this puts an end to these icky augmented weavers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Venombite Pass and killed the Toxic Empress for Stara Galeweave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I understand if you're afraid, but this needs to be done.

localizedTextIdText: Ludmil Borgos has asked you to find and destroy Palehusk Skiff along the Bloodstone Coast by targeting them for remote strikes. He also wants you to disarm any booby traps set by the Palehusks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ludmil Borgos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have devised a different design for defeating Palehusk ambushes. If you use a targeting laser on their skiffs, I can call in a remote strike.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must train the targeting laser on the Palehusk's skiffs before I can unleash remote fury upon our foes. See to your task!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Palehusks are quite cunning. We must strive to stay ahead of their tricks and traps. Today's trials will save many lives in the days to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be wary! The sands teem with traps thanks to the treacherous Palehusk Dreg.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Palehusks are not discouraged easily. They will be back.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad to be of service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared the Bloodstone Coast of Palehusk Skiff and booby trapped corpses for Ludmil Borgos.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I need more time to handle this threat.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Palehusks assail any craft that comes too close to the shoreline.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They use their skiffs to assault the ships. Any soul that survives an attack swims to shore, where they are ensnared by Palehusk traps.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You disappoint me, $(player.name). I thought better of you.

localizedTextIdText: Eldan constructs are augmenting the weavers of Venombite Pass. Zami Tel has asked you to enter the canyon and dispatch the Toxic Weaver and their eggs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Zami Tel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan constructs augment weavers! Must kill transmogrified beasts! Must remove all trace of eggs, too! Burn them! Burn them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Weavers crackle when burning. Crackle and scream. Go see for self. Take incinerator, burn weavers and eggs. No more waiting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Surprised you make it back. Thought weavers scare you away or eat you. Glad weavers dead. Not so glad he must reward $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Have incinerator. Perfect for job. You borrow!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You not be lucky forever.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the help of Zami Tel $(vitem=378), you purged Venombite Pass of the augmented weavers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You not like burning things with fire? Silly $(player.race)!

localizedTextIdText: Zami Tel has asked you to enter Venombite Pass and slay the Toxic Empress. She's a dangerous foe and will require help from your friends and allies to take down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Zami Tel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Queen! Big weaver queen! Many augmentations! Lays eggs - augmented eggs! Augmented weavers hatching! Kill her! Kill her now now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You not kill augmented weaver queen. Why? Can't sleep or work if weaver queen alive. So you go and kill. Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Weaver queen kaput! Best news all week! Was too scared to sleep. Soon, will erase sleep debt. But now... reward!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Weaver queen big! Weaver queen scary! You not kill her alone! Take help!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hope other queen not hatch. Probably will. Then no more sleeping.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Calm down, I'll deal with her.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Venombite Pass and killed the Toxic Empress for Zami Tel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(player.name) big coward!

localizedTextIdText: Captain Binoxia has asked you to find and destroy Palehusk Skiff along the Bloodstone Coast by targeting them for remote strikes. She also wants you to disarm any booby traps set by the Palehusks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Binoxia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg ambushes along Bloodstone Coast have been costly. You will use a targeting laser on Palehusk skiffs, allowing me to call in remote strikes on them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Aim the targeting laser at the Palehusk's skiffs. I will request a remote strike on your targets and demonstrate our superiority over these Dreg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your efforts today will spare Dominion lives in the future. Yet we cannot abandon our offensive against the Dreg, for they are far too tenacious.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The coastline is rife with Palehusk traps. I suggest you tread carefully.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we wait and prepare for their inevitable counterattack...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared the Bloodstone Coast of Palehusk Skiff and booby-trapped corpses for Captain Binoxia.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I need more time to handle this threat.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Palehusks attack any ship that comes near the coast and prey on the survivors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Utilizing their skiffs, they attack the ships to disable them. Any survivors that swim to shore are snared by traps set by the Palehusks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: By aiding me, you increase your own meager life expectancy.

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Dunpepper wants to teach you how to craft a weapon. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $(schematic=5599) at the crafting station in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Dunpepper at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft a weapon you're goin' to take that ore, wiring, and power core I gave you to the craftin' station. There, you can make me a brand-new novice's training brand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The crafting station is nearby. Take the materials I've given you and make me a training brand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This brand is lookin' nice and shiny. With some practice, you'll make a fine weaponsmith!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get back to me when you're done with that training brand.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done us all a great service, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted your first weapon and brought it to Weaponsmith Dunpepper for appraisal.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Dunpepper
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ignore me, huh? Not cool. Definitely not cool.

localizedTextIdText: Biological scans of local tribesmen reveal alarmingly high levels of a potent mutagen produced by the Dreg. You've been asked to investigate this strange mutagenic substance by scanning the vats that hold it. The vats are located in Dreg villages found in Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Biological scans of Dreg tribesmen have revealed long-term use of mutagens. Locate and scan the vats containing these compounds.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: XAS and FCON are eagerly awaiting your results. Please locate vats of the mutagen in Crimson Isle and scan them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your findings are being transferred to the XAS now. You are advised to start decontamination procedures to prevent lasting side effects.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: My results are on their way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've submitted your scan results to the XAS for study. Your time in the field has shown the mutagen is not only fast-acting and potent, but volatile as well. You've documented at least three side effects of consuming the brew, and you've issued a warning to XAS personnel to avoid exposure whenever possible.

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg scavengers have their eyes set on valuable Megatech supplies and munitions at the Megatech Station. Search the various Dreg camps for those stolen munitions and return them to the Field Depot to establish a forward guard post to help turn back further Dreg incursions.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: FCON scouts have identified stolen supplies and munitions in Dreg encampments. Recover those supplies and use them to set up a forward guard post.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Pioneering League is counting on you to recover stolen ammunition from Dreg encampments in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work, Settler. The new guard post will make our enemies think twice about launching another attack.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll set up that guard post.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The post is up and running.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After reclaiming Megatech military supplies stolen by Dreg scavengers, you used the them to help set up a forward guard post to fight off both the Dreg and the Dominion.

localizedTextIdText: FCON command reports increasing Dominion activity on Crimson Isle. Command is concerned that Dominion scouting parties may have found a way to evade our perimeter sensors. Investigate the recent seismic activity near Bloodstone Canyon and eliminate any Dominion personnel you encounter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion scouts may have slipped past our perimeter security systems. FCON wants you to investigate strange seismic activity in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: FCON has ordered you to investigate seismic disturbances in Bloodstone Canyon that may indicate Dominion activity.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: FCON commends your quick thinking and rapid response. Excellent work eliminating those Dominion scouts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You intercepted and defeated a Dominion scouting party that slipped past the perimeter security system. Without your intervention they would have been able to conduct a surprise raid on the Exile base.

localizedTextIdText: Frequent Dreg raids have kept Exile personnel on their toes and impeded their mission on Crimson Isle. You've been asked to deploy a network of stealth listening devices throughout Dreg encampments in Bloodstone Canyon to help gather intelligence for FCON.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: FCON is building an early warning network to better predict Dreg raids. Place these stealth listening devices in their encampments in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your help is needed to deploy the new stealth listening devices throughout Bloodstone Canyon Dreg camps. Complete this mission with haste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: FCON reports that the connection is strong and it has started receiving data. You are to be commended on your efforts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You deployed a number of stealth listening devices throughout the numerous Dreg camps in the Bloodstone Canyon of Crimson Isle. With the information provided by the eavesdropping network, FCON will be able to predict Dreg raids.

localizedTextIdText: Biological scans of local tribesmen reveal alarmingly high levels of a potent mutagen produced by the Dreg. You've been asked to investigate this strange mutagenic substance by scanning the vats that hold it. The vats are located in Dreg villages found on the Palehusk Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Biological scans of the local Dreg tribesmen have revealed long-term use of mutagens. Locate and scan the vats containing these compounds.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Collegium is standing by for those vital results. Locate vats of the mutagen in Dreg villages on Crimson Isle and scan them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Collegium acknowledges your findings. You are strongly advised to start decontamination procedures immediately.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: My results are on the way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've submitted your scan results to the Collegium. Your time in the field has shown that mutagen is not only fast-acting and potent, but volatile as well. You've documented at least three side effects of consuming the brew and you've issued a warning to Collegium researchers to avoid exposure whenever possible.

localizedTextIdText: Since the Dominion left Crimson Isle, Dreg scavengers have been stealing Dominion munitions for their own use. Reclaim stolen Dominion munitions from Dreg encampments at Megatech Station and deposit them in a field depot to establish a forward guard post to help turn back further Dreg incursions.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stolen Dominion munitions have turned up in Dreg camps. Recover those supplies and use them to set up a forward guard post in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dominion needs you to recover stolen ammunition from Dreg in Bloodstone Canyon and establish a forward guard post.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The new guard post should deter all but the most concerted of attacks.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The post is up and running.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After helping the Dominion recover munitions stolen by the Dreg, you used the recovered supplies to help set up a forward guard post to fight off both the Dreg and the Exiles.

localizedTextIdText: Dominion command reports increasing Exile activity on Crimson Isle. Command is concerned that Exile scouting parties may have found a way to evade our perimeter sensors. Investigate the recent seismic activity near Bloodstone Canyon and eliminate any Exile personnel you encounter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
