localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exile scouts may have slipped past our perimeter security systems. Command wants you to investigate strange seismic activity in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Command has ordered you to investigate seismic disturbances in Bloodstone Canyon that may indicate Exile activity.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Dominion military commends your quick thinking and rapid response. Excellent work in eliminating those Exile scouts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You intercepted and defeated an Exile scouting party that had slipped past the perimeter security system. Without your intervention they would have been able to conduct a surprise raid on the Dominion base.

localizedTextIdText: Frequent Dreg raids have kept Dominion personnel on their toes and have impeded their mission in the Crimson Badlands. You've been asked to deploy a network of stealth listening devices throughout Dreg encampments in Bloodstone Canyon to help gather intelligence for the Dominion military.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tactical Uplink via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion is building an early warning network to better predict Dreg raids. Place stealth listening devices in Dreg encampments in Bloodstone Canyon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your help is needed to deploy the new stealth listening devices throughout Bloodstone Canyon Dreg camps. Complete this mission with haste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: High Command reports that the connection is strong and data is being received. You are to be commended on your efforts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You deployed a number of stealth listening devices throughout the numerous Dreg camps in the Bloodstone Canyon of Crimson Isle. With the information provided by the eavesdropping network, the Dominion military will be able to predict Dreg raids.

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Thaako wants to teach you how to craft heavy armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5707) at the crafting station in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished armor to Armorer Thaako at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen up! To craft heavy armor, take the ore, the framework, and power core to the crafting station. Go on and make me a training hauberk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hmph. Ya made that hauberk yet? The crafting station's over there. Come back and show me when ya do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This'll do. Keep practicin' and ya might just be a real armorer someday. To make it on Nexus, we'll need people like you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get that hauberk back to me ASAP, bud.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's a good start, but you'll have to work at it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted a $(schematic=5707) and delivered it to Armorer Thaako.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished armor to Armorer Thaako
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I oughta knock yer block off.

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Keynes wants to teach you how to craft medium armor. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $schematic=5815 at a crafting station in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished armor to Outfitter Keynes at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft medium armor, take the hide, composite, and power core straight to the craftin' station! Whip me up a training doublet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: C'mon now. Finish up that doublet at the craftin' station, then bring it back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be a rowsdower's uncle! This looks marvelous. You're goin' to be a big help to us here on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get that doublet back to me when you're done!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We need more people like you if we're goin' to make it in Algoroc, friend.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can take care of this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted medium armor for the first time. Outfitter Keynes is happy with your work.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished armor to Outfitter Keynes
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you wanted to learn. Damn shame.

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Wildspring wants to teach you how to craft light armor. Use the materials she gave you to craft a $(schematic=5923) at a crafting station in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished shawl to Tailor Wildspring at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Here we go! To craft light armor, take the cloth, thread, and power core straight to the crafting station. See if you can make a novice's training shawl.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You know what would brighten up my day? A training shawl, made with love by a newly minted tailor. A girl can dream, can't she?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This shawl looks amazing! I think I'll keep this and give away my old one. At this rate, everyone in Gallow will be stylin' in no time!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get that shawl to me as soon as you can!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm so proud of you! How about a hug?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tailored a $(schematic=5923) for the first time and delivered it to Tailor Wildspring.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished shawl to Tailor Wildspring
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you just going to walk away? That makes me MAD.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen wants to show you how to craft your first $schematic=270. Take the materials he's given you to the Crafting Station in Gallow and deliver the final product to Technologist Blackwood.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $schematic=270 to Technologist Blackwood at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Okay! To craft medical stuff, you'll need omni-plasm as a primary. Herbs can add some extra kick, but let's stick with omni-plasm for now.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Crafting Station is right behind me. Use it to look through your schematics, and find the one for $schematic=270.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hear you got tasked with making a $schematic=270. Go to the Crafting Station and see if you're up to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, good to see someone with their head on straight. I'm always trying to find more medishots, so these are much appreciated, friend.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you get to the crafting station, it's $schematic=270 you want.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You can never find a good medishot when you need one.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted your first $schematic=270 and delivered it to Technologist Blackwood.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished $schematic=270 to Technologist Blackwood
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, ignore me, huh? Not cool. Definitely not cool.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Kera has requested that you hunt the Scarhide Dreg along the Savage Coast, and she expects you to make short work of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Supervisor Kera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Scarhide Dreg are everywhere. As brutal as they are, we must be even more brutal. To that end, you are to hunt them down on the Savage Coast.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How goes the fight against the Scarhide Dreg on the Savage Coast? I expect you to make short work of those vermin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Reports of your combat effectiveness have not been exaggerated. It's a rare event when I see someone with your capabilities in the field.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Maintain a high degree of vigilance out there, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You pitched in and eliminated a number of Scarhide Dreg on the Savage Coast for Supervisor Kera and the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are quite the disappointment, you know.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Matthews has requested that you hunt the Scarhide Dreg at the Megatech facility, and she expects you to make short work of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Specialist Matthews via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Scarhide are about as bad as those Dreg devils come. Get over to the Megatech facility and put some of those bastards in the ground, pronto.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still waitin' to hear all about them dead Scarhide you done killed. 'Cept no one's tellin' me about it, so I'm assumin' it ain't happened yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work on the Scarhide, $(player.name). I'm glad to see we finally got someone 'round here with a spine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't lose your head, $(player.name), 'cause it'll most likely be fatal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Watch your back out there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You pitched in and eliminated a number of Scarhide Dreg near the Megatech facility for Specialist Matthews and the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're 'bout to get on my last nerve, "friend."

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Matthews has asked you to get defense and comm systems back online in Megatech Station. The Dreg have been salvaging and destroying this equipment as they go. Be on the lookout for them as they will likely be at these stations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Specialist Matthews via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our defense and comm systems are offline. I bet it's those damn Scarhide Dreg! Get to Megatech Station and bring that gear back online!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The defense and comm systems are still offline! What in the blue blazes are you doin' back here when you ought to be out there fixin' 'em?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Everything's comin' back online. Defense and comm systems are active. Good work out there, $(player.name). I owe you one!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're goin' to be waitin' for you, so keep your eyes open!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully restarted several cannons and radar dishes in Megatech Station for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We all need to pull our weight 'round here if we're goin' to survive.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Matthews has informed you of an alarming power surge that's been traced back to Megatech Station. She's asked you to place tracer beacons to pinpoint the source of the surge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Specialist Matthews via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A massive power surge has been detected at Megatech Station. By placin' surge beacons, you can help us triangulate on the source of the surge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we don't locate that surge, we ain't goin' to be able to shut it down. That's not good, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whew! That was too close! If them Dreg freaks had brought the annihilator back online, we'd all be dead by now. You done good!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once we know where it's comin' from, you can shut it down. Now move!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See you 'round!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully traced the source of the power surge and eliminated a force of Dreg that were attempting to power up the Eldan Annihilator. Thanks to you, Megatech station is now under Exile control.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You may be a big shot, $(player.name), but this is more important than you.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Kera has asked you to make your way to the old radar station on the Savage Coast. Once there, reactivate the power generators and get the nearby radar dish operating again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Supervisor Kera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg scavengers have deactivated the Savage Coast power generators, thereby deactivating the radar dish. You will rectify this situation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The radar dish on the Savage Coast remains inactive. There is no satisfactory excuse for your inaction.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The radar dish is functional once more. Your actions have guaranteed the Dominion's eventual success on this horrible rock of an island.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It is imperative that you succeed, $(player.name). Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For the Dominion, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully turned the power generators on and brought the Savage Coast's radar station back online.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal is unwise. I do not suffer fools lightly.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Kera wants you to retrieve stolen technology from the Dreg scavengers on the Savage Coast.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Supervisor Kera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg are salvaging technology along the Savage Coast... technology that is the rightful property of the Dominion! We must wrest it from them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you here when you should be killing the Dreg along the Savage Coast and reclaiming the treasures they have stolen from us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, how I miss field work. I might have waded into the fray like that, once. Now I carry the burden of leadership. More's the pity.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure the Dreg pay in blood for their rampant thievery.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for your service, citizen. Carry on.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully retrieved some of the stolen technology from the Dreg scavengers on the Savage Coast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am not pleased, $(player.name). Not pleased at all.

localizedTextIdText: To communicate with an ancient, sentient tree, Lucy Lazarin requires $(vitem=383). They're found within Exo-Lab 71: The Arboretum and grow on the Elderoot Deathcap who lurk there. Once acquired, give them to her father, Victor Lazarin, at his laboratory in Elderoot Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An augmented tree - Elderoot - has been discovered up ahead. My father requires psygill mushrooms to speak to it. Kindly collect them in Exo-Lab 71.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The sooner you take the psygill mushrooms to my father, the sooner he can expand his efforts to establish a link with Elderoot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I delegated my daughter, Lucy, to gather psygill mushrooms in Exo-Lab 71. Do you serve in her stead?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, you possess the psyniscient specimens. Lucy must have sent you. Excuse me while I extract the mushrooms' essence.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My father awaits the psygill mushrooms in Elderoot Refuge. Good luck.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If we are to awaken this eldritch tree, there are a few more tasks I would have you do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered $m(vitem=383) to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge. The psionic essences derived from the mushrooms can fuel an espernetic interface that can communicate with the ancient, augmented tree, Elderoot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Elderoot is a tree enhanced long ago by the Eldan. My father, Victor Lazarin, believes that it may know of a cure for the Contagion. Psygill mushrooms will fuel his espernetic device and should allow communication with Elderoot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Exo-labs are Eldan facilities where research was carried out on Nexus. Exo-Lab 71 - dubbed the "Arboretum" by my father - is the nearest, and a number of psygill mushrooms thrive there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Psygill mushrooms contain a compound which facilitates telepathic communication. We believe they were an invention of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My people wither under the weight of the Contagion's curse. You must help!

localizedTextIdTitle: Crafting for the Exiles in Celestion
localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade wants to teach you about tradeskills. Sounds like fun!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey $(player.name), it's time you got to work. Fighting is all well and good, but it's the crafters and tradespeople who will make Nexus a real home!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Crafting is all about learning what Nexus has to offer and weaving it to suit our needs. Everything we make helps us in our fight against the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm glad to see you're ready to learn something new and help make Celestion a real home! This is gonna be fun! And profitable!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we want a new home, we have to make one.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Me and Crafting Trainer Oaklee will teach you everything you need to know.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found your way to the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade. Now you can pick up a tradeskill or two to help your fellow Exiles survive the wilds of Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If we can't make new things, we might as well give up on our dreams.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now it's time for you to get excited and make things for killin' folks! Take these materials and we'll craft a weapon together!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Put those materials in your tradeskill bag, all right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were introduced to Weaponsmith Redfire. He gave you the basic materials needed to make a weapon.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You up to makin' some heavy armor? Take these materials and we'll get you started.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Materials wind up in your tradeskill bag. Don't forget it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an armorer, Armorer Stanhope has given you the materials needed to make some heavy armor.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you wanna be an outfitter, then take these materials. You're gonna need 'em to make some medium armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll just put these parts in your tradeskill bag, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were introduced to Outfitter Halliday. She gave you the basic materials needed to make medium armor.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You desire to devise light armor, do you? You shall require these materials to complement your crafting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your tradeskill bag is the perfect place to pack your materials away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a tailor, Tailor Vervenko has given you the materials needed to make some light armor.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now it's time for you to get excited and make things! Take these materials, and we'll craft your first medishot... together!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The omni-plasm will go into your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a Technologist, Supervisor Wicksprout has given you the basic supplies needed to make your first medishot.

localizedTextIdText: You defeated Aggregor the Dust Eater in Aggregor's Gulch. Among the dusty pile of chipped rocks and broken shards, you found Aggregor's Core. Explorer Rora in Bloodstone Canyon will want to see it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Explorer Rora in Bloodstone Canyon
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You took this core from the remains of Aggregor the Dust Eater. You should take it to Explorer Rora and see if she has any need for it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What have you got there, $(player.name)? Aggregor's core? I didn't think it was possible for anyone to bust that boulder up, but somehow you did it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take care of yourself, pal. I expect I'll need your stone again real soon.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Explorer Rora.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Aggregor the Dust Eater in Aggregor's Gulch and brought proof of his demise to Explorer Rora.

localizedTextIdText: You defeated Aggregor the Dust Eater in Aggregor's Gulch. Among the dusty pile of chipped rocks and broken shards, you found Aggregor's Core. Dakari the Rock Biter in Bloodstone Canyon will want to see it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dakari the Rock Biter in Bloodstone Canyon
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You took this core from the remains of Aggregor the Dust Eater. You should take it to Dakari the Rock Biter and see if she has any need for it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You bring me a gift? This appears to be an elemental core. By the size of it, it could only have come from Aggregor. Is that the case?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Amazing! Your deeds this day are worthy of both praise and song!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yep. I kicked his rocky butt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Aggregor the Dust Eater in Aggregor's Gulch and brought proof of his demise to Dakari the Rock Biter.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to Dakari the Rock Biter

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Redfire wants to teach you how to craft weapons. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5599) at the crafting station in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Redfire at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Okay! To craft a weapon, you're gonna take that ore, wirin', and power core to the craftin' station. Go make me a novice's training brand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Take those materials I gave you to the craftin' station. You can make me a training brand there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, lookee here. What've you got for me? Nice handiwork, friend. I think I'm goin' to like workin' with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring that trainin' brand by when you're done with it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You help me, I help you. It's the Exile way!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted your first weapon and turned it in to Weaponsmith Redfire.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Redfire
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't want to learn? No skin off my nose, friend.

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Stanhope wants to teach you how to craft heavy armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5707) at a crafting station in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $(schematic=5707) to Armorer Stanhope in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft heavy armor, take the ore, framework, and power core to a crafting station. You can construct a novice's training hauberk there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I reckon if you can make a decent training hauberk, you can be a real armorer. There's a crafting station over there, so give it a try.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This armor sure looks like it'll stop a blast, no problem. I'll make sure it gets to someone who needs it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get that hauberk back to me lickety-split, ya hear me?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We need gear like this to keep people safe from those blasted Dommies.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted a $(schematic=5707) and delivered it to Armorer Stanhope in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Come on, don't give up now!

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Halliday in Sylvan Glade wants to teach you how to craft medium armor. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $(schematic=5815) at a crafting station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft medium armor, take the hide, composite, and power core to the craftin' station! You got all the parts to make me a novice's training doublet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go on and make me a trainin' doublet with the parts I gave you. The craftin' station is right over there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, look at that trainin' doublet! I like what you done here with the stichin'. It almost brings a tear to my eye. Could this be love?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You bring back that doublet when you're done, you hear?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, I'm just joshin' you. Good work, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted medium armor for the first time and brought it to Outfitter Halliday.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What, hey! Everyone needs to pitch in if we're goin' to stand a chance!

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Vervenko wants to teach you how to craft light armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5823) at a crafting station in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished $(schematic=5923) to Tailor Vervenko in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft some light armor, take the cloth, thread, and power core I provided to a crafting station, then carefully create a novice's training gaze.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I despair of ever finding a student who can craft proper training gaze. There is a crafting station nearby if you would like to try.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, such deftly delicate and subtle stitching. Perhaps there is hope for the tailoring profession now that you have joined us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come back with a completed training gaze if you crave my confirmation.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: One must be properly dressed to destroy the Dominion, after all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tailored a $(schematic=5923) for the first time and delivered it to Tailor Vervenko.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Vervenko
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where would I normally get cloth?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where would I normally get thread?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Where would I normally get power cores?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Cloth is scavenged from humanoids. Just kill anybody who is wearing clothes, and there's a chance you'll get something usable!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You can buy thread at any of our convenient vendors... like the Vendbot right behind me!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Power cores are mostly found by salvaging items, though sometimes a vendor will carry some too!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: To surrender to your deficiency of skill so soon is senseless.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout wants to show you how to craft your first $schematic=270. Take the materials she's given you to the Crafting Station in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $schematic=270 to Techsmith Praxa at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Okay! To craft medical stuff, you'll need omni-plasm as a primary. Herbs can add some extra kick, but let's stick with omni-plasm for now.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Crafting Station is right behind me. Use it to look through your schematics and find the one for $schematic=270.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hear you got tasked with making a $schematic=270. Go to the Crafting Station and see if you're up to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job! People are coming in pretty banged up, so we're channeling them as many medishots as we can get. Glad to see we've got a new source.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Look for the $schematic=270 schematic at the crafting station.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A gun helps ya start a fight, but a medishot helps you finish it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted your first $schematic=270 and delivered it to Techsmith Praxa.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But we've come so far together!

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Frugo wants to show you how to craft weapons. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5599) in Feralplain Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Frugo in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now we make weapon. Take ore, wiring, and power core to crafting station. Make me a novice's training brand. Go, go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Must I repeat? Take materials. Go to crafting station. Make training brand there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not bad. This will do. I give you permission to make more! Go make more!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return when done!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Can't wait to test on stupid Exiles....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted weapon for the first time and delivered it to Weaponsmith Frugo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Frugo
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe I demonstrate how weapon feels when used on you.

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Vospana wants to teach you how to craft heavy armor. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $(schematic=5707) at the Feralplain Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished heavy armor to Armorer Vospana at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft heavy armor, take the ore, steel framework, and power core to the crafting station. Craft a novice's training hauberk for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To earn my respect, craft a training hauberk and bring it to me for appraisal. The crafting station is right there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My! Such potential in this piece. I predict great things will be created for the Dominion by your capable hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return the finished product to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The empire will crush its foes... with your help, of course.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted a $(schematic=5707) and delivered it to Armorer Vospana.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished heavy armor to Armorer Vospana
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is obvious you do not yet understand the student-teacher relationship.

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Hokia in Feralplain Collective wants to teach you how to craft medium armor. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $(schematic=5815).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished medium armor to Outfitter Hokia at the Tradeskill Hub in the Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft medium armor, take the hide, composite, and power core to the crafting station, then make a novice's training doublet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you make me wait? Take the materials I have given you to the crafting station. You can create a training doublet there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You bring something to prove yourself as an outfitter? Strong first effort. Keep honing your skills and you might rival me someday.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return to me once you are finished.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You honor yourself today, hunter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted medium armor and delivered it to Outfitter Hokia, who approved of your first effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished medium armor to Outfitter Hokia
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are no hunter, nor are you a crafter.

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Amphio wants to teach you how to craft light armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5923) at a crafting station in Feralplain Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished light armor to Tailor Amphio in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft light armor, take the cloth, thread, and power core to the crafting station. Provide me with a novice's training shawl.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The crafting station is right over there. Whether you are capable of making a proper training shawl remains to be seen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This shawl you have crafted exceeds Dominion minimum specifications. I did not expect such quality on the frontier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return to me once the piece is finished.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maintain standards at all times. It separates us from the savages.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Nothing but the best for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tailored a $(schematic=5923) for the first time and delivered it to Tailor Amphio.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished armor to Tailor Amphio
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Subjects like you should be liquidated with prejudice.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio wants to show you how to craft your first $m(schematic=270). Take the materials he's given you to the Crafting Station in Feralplain Collective. Deliver the final product to Technologist Otha.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=270) to Technologist Otha at the Tradeskill Hub at the Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Omni-plasm is the primary material for crafting medishots. Once you have mastered the basics, you can add herbs, but we should begin at the beginning.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Crafting Station is right behind me. Use it to look through your schematics and find the one for $schematic=270.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look, I want to see a proper medishot from you, and no dithering. Just go to the Crafting Station and mix one up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's pretty blazing good for your first try, $(player.name). Your medishots will be keeping blighters up and fighting for years to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The $schematic=270 schematic awaits you at the crafting station.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Clean and efficient, that's the Dominion way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted your first $m(schematic=270) and delivered it to Technologist Otha.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You test my patience.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Glory to the empire, citizen. Are you ready? Take these materials and let us commence with your education.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stand assured, citizen, I will make a worthy smith out of you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a weaponsmith, Weaponsmith Tirexa has given you the materials needed to make a weapon.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Want to make heavy armor? Take materials. Will need them for crafting. Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Pay attention! Now, now!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an armorer, Bagazi Kreng has given you the materials needed to make some heavy armor.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I trust this will be worth my time... and yours. Take these materials and we shall see how you perform.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Place these materials in your tradeskill bag for now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an outfitter, Outfitter Vekia has given you the materials needed to make some medium armor.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready to train? Take these materials and discover your true potential as a tailor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cloth and thread are stored in your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a tailor, Tailor Livy has given you the materials needed to make some light armor.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: At the very least, your eagerness shows promise. Take these materials, and we'll see if you have the brains to match.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Omni-plasm is properly stored in your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're a Technologist, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela has given you the basic supplies needed to make your first medishot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you think you're being amusing?

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Tirexa wants to teach you how to craft weapons. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $(schematic=5599) at the crafting station in Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Tirexa at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft a weapon, go to the crafting station and use the ore, wiring, and power core that I've given you. Make me a novice's training brand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head to the local crafting station to create the training brand. I have already given you the necessary materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You far exceeded my expectations... low as they were. Perhaps you will prove useful in the defense of Ellevar after all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return to me with the completed training brand.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Continue your service to the empire, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted your first weapon and delivered it to Weaponsmith Tirexa at Lightreach Mission. She believes your new skills will prove useful in the Dominion's fight to conquer Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Tirexa
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You test my patience.

localizedTextIdText: Bagazi Kreng wants to teach you how to craft heavy armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5707) at the crafting station in Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished heavy armor to Bagazi Kreng at the Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Need some ore to craft heavy armor. Need framework and power core, too. Take to crafting station, make novice's training hauberk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Talk fast. Very busy. Craft training hauberk, bring to me. Will decide if worthy. Crafting station over there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This good, very good. You armorer now. You go make more! Quick!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go crafting station. Make heavy armor. Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Work you do not so bad.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made heavy armor for the first time and had it appraised by Bagazi Kreng. He believes your craftsmanship will be a credit to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished heavy armor to Bagazi Kreng
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You annoying. Maybe you explode.

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Vekia wants to teach you how to craft medium armor. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $schematic=5815 in Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished medium armor to Outfitter Vekia at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft medium armor, take the hide, composite, and power core I gave you to a crafting station. Create a novice's training doublet for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're wasting time. Take the materials I've given you to the crafting station and create a training doublet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, that's a fine piece you've made. A hunter could wear with it pride.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return the training doublet to me when you're finished. I'll be waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Honor is yours today. Enjoy it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted medium armor for the first time and had it appraised by Outfitter Vekia. She approved of your skills.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished medium armor to Outfitter Vekia
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're useless, even as prey.

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Livy wants to teach you how to craft light armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5923) at a crafting station in Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished Light Armor to Tailor Livy at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft light armor, take the cloth, thread, 'n' power core to the crafting station. Make me a novice's training shawl, love.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's simple. The crafting station is right over there, innit? Use the materials I gave you and make me a training shawl. Easy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Strike a light! You did a fine job, mate! With more 'n' more people coming to Ellevar, we'll need good tailors like you, make no mistake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Novice's training shawl is the schematic, it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mark me words, guv - Ellevar's going to be the fashion capital of Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tailored a $(schematic=5923) for the first time and delivered it to Tailor Livy.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your Light Armor to Tailor Livy
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got me good 'n' disappointed now, love.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela wants to show you how to craft your first $m(schematic=270). Take the materials she's given you to the Crafting Station in Lightreach Mission. Deliver the finished product to Technologist Corvianos.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=270) to Technologist Corvianos at the Tradeskill Hub at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Omni-plasm is the primary material for crafting medishots. We'll begin with a basic one.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Crafting Station is right behind me. Use it to look through your schematics, and find the one for $schematic=270.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look, I want to see a proper medishot from you, and no dithering. Just go to the Crafting Station and mix one up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's pretty blazing good for your first try, $(player.name). Your medishots will be keeping blighters up and fighting for years to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The $schematic=270 schematic awaits you at the crafting station.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Clean and efficient, that's the Dominion way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted your first $m(schematic=270) and delivered it to Technologist Corvianos.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You test my patience.

localizedTextIdText: A Vengeful Mender has asked you to save Elderoot's seeds from the atrocities of the Dominion. Collect $m(vitem=382) from Elderoot Refuge while destroying the Dominion's Firestorm Assault Deforester in Bloodbloom Vale and Fort Firestorm.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Elderoot's seeds in danger! Wicked ones burn the forest, defile the seeds! You must save the seeds and destroy the fire machines!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The seeds of Elderoot cry for help from the floor of the forest! They cannot walk, so you must take them to safety!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This war's just getting started, you hear me? We're going to tear the Dominion down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You see? Even the forest hates the Dominion's guts! As long as nature's on our side, we'll never be defeated!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Save the seeds! Make the wicked ones pay! Their sap must flow!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll take those seeds. I figure Myala will know what to do with 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You saved many of Elderoot's seeds from the fires of the enemy while destroying the deforesters the Dominion brought to Everstar Grove.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you a friend of Elderoot's seeds? Or are you one of the wicked?

localizedTextIdText: Elderoot is in significant pain due to the parasites devouring him alive. Speak to Victor Lazarin and Queen Myala Everstar in Elderoot Refuge to learn how you can destroy the parasites and heal the damage they have caused to the ancient tree.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Elderoot at Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If I am to help you, you must help me first. I have imparted both Queen Myala and Victor Lazarin with the knowledge you will need to stop my pain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Something gnaws at my roots, withering leaf and branch. This must end, one way or another.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The healing has begun. The pain is diminished, but time must pass before I am restored. I will keep my promise, little one. What do you want to know?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It will be an equitable trade - the knowledge of millennia for my life.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are hungry for knowledge, are you not? Let us start at the beginning....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the parasites devouring Elderoot and used the Livingroot Keepers to initiate the ancient tree's healing process. All that remains is to speak with Elderoot in Elderoot Refuge and gain access to his extensive knowledge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why won't you tell us your secrets?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You wish to learn? Of course you do. I am in pain. I cannot teach you until my agony has ceased. Help me, heal me, and then learn from me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Something gnaws at my roots. In time, I will die if something is not done. My boughs will crack and my branches will wither.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I cannot quantify the breadth of my knowledge to a mind as small as yours. Suffice it to say, the Eldan entrusted me with limitless information.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I wither, my knowledge withers with me.

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Rora has asked you to enter Aggregor's Gulch and collect $m(vitem=390) from the Shard of Aggregor{p:Shards of Aggregor}. Rora requires the $m(vitem=390) for her research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Rora via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm researchin' the biochemical properties of the augmented gronyx in Aggregor's Gulch. To study 'em proper-like, I need to collect shards from 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well at least Aggregor hasn't crushed ya yet. Get crackin' and get me those samples, or have ya lost your nerve?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be a crag's crack... ya got all the samples I need. I owe you a brew or two, right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go get me the samples, right? And watch out for Aggregor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stick around. I'm sure I'll be needing more samples soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered the $m(vitem=390) that Explorer Rora needed for her research. She'll probably need more in the future.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've never had a Granok mad at you before, have you?

localizedTextIdText: Dakari the Rock Biter has asked you to enter Aggregor's Gulch and collect $m(vitem=390) from the Shard of Aggregor{p:Shards of Aggregor}. Dakari requires the $m(vitem=390) for her research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dakari the Rock Biter via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I require someone to enter Aggregor's Gulch and gather samples from the augmented gronyx that dwell there. I find it odd that stone can be augmented.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You still draw breath, but you have not fulfilled my request. I require samples from the augmented gronyx in Aggregor's Gulch. Waste no more time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You impress me, $(player.name). Those I sent before you failed to return from that place. I assume they did not go quietly enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Correct. Hunt quietly and ensure you do not disturb Aggregor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not wander far. I shall require your help again soon enough.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered the $m(vitem=390) that Dakari the Rock Biter needed for her research. She'll probably need more in the future.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Dakari the Rock Biter
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your decision is a poor one. I suggest you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: You met Captain Milo at the Excavation Base Camp on the outskirts of Gallow. The hapless captain is in a bind, for his asteroid mining settlement, M-13, has been infested by strange aliens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Milo on the bridge of the Steady Traveler
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My mine on Asteroid M-13's infested with aliens, don't you know? I'm looking for some folks to go up there with me and wipe out this xenomorph menace!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Whatcha waiting for, eh? Take the transport to the Stready Traveler, and get ready to stomp some bugs. That's what they call 'em, don't they? You betcha!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What're you waiting for? The transport's right here. Hop aboard and head for the stars! Navigator willing, I'll meet you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome aboard! Let's get to work taking care of the mine, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take this transport to my ship, the Steady Traveler. I'll meet ya there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You climbed aboard the Steady Traveler and headed to the asteroid classified as Outpost M-13 to help Captain Milo with his alien problems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Strange, parasitical creatures. I haven't seen them myself, but if the distress calls are any indication, they're quite frightful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you reconsider. I can pay well for your time.

localizedTextIdText: Learn the fishing hobby
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Learned how to fish
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looking for a Hobby? Want to be self-sufficient? Why not learn how to fish? I would be willing to teach you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Purchase yourself a Fishing Cannon and look for Schools of Fish in large bodies of water.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have taken up the fishing hobby

localizedTextIdText: Captain Tolben has located a wrecked X-82 cargo vessel and intends to salvage it. The captain has asked you to take a transport in Auroria to his ship, the Blue Sparrow, so that you can help investigate the wreck.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Tolben on the Blue Sparrow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've located the wreck of an X-82 drifting in orbit, and I intend to salvage her. Maybe you'd like to help me out? I could sure use a hand, yep.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Everything's all set, yeah? We just need to check out the X-82 and make sure no one's aboard who can claim ownership. Know what I mean?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Docked right into the X-82. Now let's get to work salvaging the place, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great. Take this transport up to my ship, the Blue Sparrow. I'll be along soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a transport ship located in Auroria and docked with the X-82 cargo vessel, ready to salvage its riches.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You plan to salvage the ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a cargo hauler. The X-82 series is one of the most popular ships in use today, as reliable as it is ubiquitous.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You betcha, so long as I can prove she doesn't have an owner. Everything from seat padding to alloy bulkheads can fatten a captain's purse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Let me know if you change your mind, okay?

localizedTextIdText: Yaenna in Sylvan Glade has appreciated your assistance. She suggests that you contact Ashella Sunfell, an explorer who could use the help of an adventurer like you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Ashella Sunfell in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've been more help than I could ever ask for. Still, I might know someone who could use your skills.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken with Ashella Sunfell yet? She could really use your skills. I hear she's organizing an expedition.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The wonders of Nexus await, and our expedition will discover them all first-hand. Would you like to take part? We could use someone like you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ashella Sunfell has been looking for adventurers. You should speak to her.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Speak with my partner, Tomas Borgoli. He'll get you started.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I'll go speak with her.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ashella Sunfell is working with Tomas Borgoli to gather an expedition to make great discoveries on the planet Nexus. When you made contact with Ashella, she invited you to take part, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's too bad. Ashella could have used someone like you.

localizedTextIdText: A DRED expedition was cut short when the team was attacked by Rotter the Undying. Kill Rotter the Undying and bring the DRED Datachron contents to Lila Redkill at Bloodstone Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lila Redkill via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears that this DRED expedition came to an untimely end. Something dangerous must lurk close by. You'd better be careful!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A datachron flickers on the ground.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's goin' on, $(player.name)? I ain't one to pry, but you look like you're workin' on somethin'. I can't wait to see what it is!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You say this came from a DRED expedition that was wiped out by some nasty critter? I s'pose they got what was comin' to 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll check this data out right away. I hate to think of what DRED's up to.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report this to Lila Redkill.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Rotter the Undying and brought the DRED Datachron contents to Lila Redkill at Bloodstone Landing. Hopefully she can make use of the information that it contains.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Good thing I already have this data.

localizedTextIdText: A DRED expedition was cut short when the team was attacked by Rotter the Undying. Kill Rotter the Undying and bring the DRED Datachron contents to Pallian Cyreus at Crimson Command.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Pallian Cyreus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears that this DRED expedition came to an untimely end. Something dangerous must lurk close by. You'd better be careful!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A datachron flickers on the ground.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I do hope you're on to something important on not slacking off. I cannot stand $m(player.class) that feel the need to loaf and procrastinate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our DRED team was wiped out? Traitor's blood! That's the third one this week! If you hadn't collected the data, it would have been a complete waste!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Carry on. I'll examine this data and, hopefully, retrieve something useful.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report this to Pallian Cyreus.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm so glad I could help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Rotter the Undying and brought the DRED Datachron contents to Pallian Cyreus at Crimson Command. Hopefully he can make use of the information that it contains.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Good thing I already have this data.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Cognosa of the ICI has informed you that an epidemic of plague has broken out in Auroria, in the city of Hycrest. If you are willing to help the ICI investigate the illness, travel to Hycrest and speak with Agent Marcus as well as Hycrest's governor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Marcus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A communique from Hycrest indicates a plague has broken out in Auroria. The ICI requests that you travel to Hycrest at once and speak to the Governor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Travel to Auroria at once. This plague is a dire threat to the citizens of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to the Governor? You had better do so. I am certain he has much to say about the current crisis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Governor is correct. We have very little time to get to the bottom of this situation. Every moment is precious when so many lives are at stake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak to Marcus, one of our agents, after you arrive in Auroria.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Agent Marcus in Hycrest, as well as Governor Aluviel, and learned that there is a virulent plague sweeping through Auroria. You must track the epidemic to its source, and quickly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I find your lack of initiative vexing. I strongly recommend you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Travel to Wigwalli Village and take a hover boat to the tropical Skullcano Island.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Check the Bounty Board on Skullcano Island
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: SKULLCANO CALLS!\nTravel to scenic and exotic Skullcano Island for adventure and excitement! Board the hover boat in Wigwalli Village and meet destiny!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: SKULLCANO CALLS!\nTravel to scenic and exotic Skullcano Island for adventure and excitement! Board the hover boat in Wigwalli Village and meet destiny!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Skullcano Island! Soon you will know adventure and excitement like never before!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Wigwalli Village and took a hover boat to the tropical Skullcano Island.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Papovich desires the dark heart of Grevitch the Gruesome, Cursewood's living nightmare. Payment for the heart shall be made in person and upon inspection of the goods.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Papovich in Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: Grevitch the Gruesome's heart of darkness, for its use in monstrous creation rites. Take care during delivery. Damaged goods won't suffice.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED: Grevitch the Gruesome's heart of darkness, for its use in monstrous creation rites. Take care during delivery. Damaged goods won't suffice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Cut deeply with death's blade and extract the darkness I need. Go swiftly and seek our prey in the heart of Cursewood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, yes. Let me see it now. Ah, a stunning specimen! I must confess I am quite pleased with your execution. Now to amalgamate it into the mixture....
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Soon now, my dearest... very soon....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Grevitch the Gruesome and delivered its heart of darkness to Professor Papovich for use in her monstrous experiments. The stars only know what can come of this.

localizedTextIdText: A reconnaissance group sent to seize Grim Alchemist Nekijel has gone missing. Explorer Cawley team has been searching for the Grim Alchemist, and they've requested you finish the job inside Grimbone Tomb.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Cawley via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A fallen trooper holds a wanted poster that reads: "Wanted: Grim Alchemist Nekijel. For unethical experimentation, dangerous tendencies. Dead or Alive."
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A fallen trooper holds a wanted poster that reads: "Wanted: Grim Alchemist Nekijel. For unethical experimentation, dangerous tendencies. Dead or Alive."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Weren't you off cleanin' up the mess down in Grimbone Tomb? Don't come back until you're done. We can't have that alchemist runnin' around!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If only we'd recruited you sooner. At least now those stinkin' Darkspur won't have access to powers they got no business wielding. We owe ya big time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided the Explorers Union and the Exile military in finding the Darkspur Alchemist and taking him and his minions out.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find this Grim Alchemist fellow.

localizedTextIdText: Arifo the Rascal has stolen an experimental rocket from the XAS and is hiding somewhere in Rockridge Hollow. Find him, eliminate him, and return the rocket to Lulu Blackbush at the XAS camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lulu Blackbush in Rockridge Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Chua by the name of Arifo ran off with an experimental rocket I was workin' on. I need it back! Help me out, I'll make sure it's worth your while.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You get my rocket back from Arifo yet? That damn Chua's more trouble than a bonnet full of buzzbings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My rocket! You sure are a sweet little thing, $(player.name)! I hope that little Chua didn't give you too much trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He's somewhere around here, but he's a wily little cuss. Good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Funny you should ask. Want to help this gal out one more time?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You retrieved the experimental rocket for Lulu Blackbush at the XAS camp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I figured we could help each other out. Too bad I was wrong.

localizedTextIdText: Lulu Blackbush at the XAS camp has asked you to field-test her experimental retrorocket pack. You'll need to blast yourself out of the XAS Retrofitted Cannon in order to test it out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lulu Blackbush at Rockride Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was aimin' to get this retrorocket workin', but I ain't had no luck yet. Would ya mind givin' it a test go? You'll get to shoot outta a cannon!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're not scared, are ya? Big $(player.class) like you? I hope not. Just help me test this retrorocket out. It'll be a hoot!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, that didn't go quite as I'd hoped. There's got to be a use for this thing. Give me half a second to think!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Uh... sure it is, just aim for the water! Don't forget them retrorockets!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hmmm... maybe if I adjust the rate of thrust and normalize the power....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You field tested the experimental retrorocket pack for Lulu Blackbush at the XAS camp. Surprisingly, you managed to survive the experiment.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll give it a go. I guess.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Ten seconds! That sounds awfully short!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well, once you're airborne, you can fire the rockets to control your descent. They got enough fuel for about ten seconds.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That's where the pond comes into play, silly. Land in the water and you'll be fine. You ain't never had this much fun with your clothes on!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Uhm... best advice I can give is, don't miss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be such a worry-wart. I'm pretty sure it's good 'n' safe.

localizedTextIdText: You've recovered a Soul Stone from Gloomstone's pile of rubble. Deadeye Brightland in Tremor Ridge would be very interested in seeing this stone and hearing the good news of Gloomstone's elimination.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Deadeye Brightland in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Deadeye Brightland in Tremor Ridge would probably like to hear the good news about Gloomstone's death. He might even reward you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a sight for sore eyes, friend. I mighta gone after old Gloomstone myself, but I got this... uh... problem with heights.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done good today. I'll make sure folks hear of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Somehow, you managed to make your way to the floating loftite island above Tremor Ridge. Even better, you killed Gloomstone the Stranded while you were at it. Good work!

localizedTextIdText: Lulu Blackbush at the XAS camp has asked you to recover food taken by local wildlife. For some reason, the animals store the food in high places, so she's given you a rocket pack to reach those areas.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lulu Blackbush at the XAS camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The local wildlife keeps sneakin' into our camp and stealin' our food. Would you be a dear and get it back for little ol' me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The camp's food stores are real low. The critters took off with our rations. You goin' to use that jump pack to get it back or not?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My tummy has been growlin' somethin' fierce. I'm so glad you got all that food back. I hope them critters didn't do nothin' unmentionable to it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use this jump pack to get to it. The critters keep the food up high.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You should stay and have lunch with us! I'm a heck of a field cook!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using Lulu Blackbush rocket pack, you were able to recover all the food taken by the animals. Now the scientists at the XAS campwon't go hungry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wouldn't want to see me starve, would you?

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Kara is offering a reward for Bonetalon, the savage beast of Hidden Hills. The fowl monster poses a threat to the safety of her soldiers and as such must be eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Kara via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: COMMISSIONED KILL!\nThe foulest fowl of Hidden Hills, known as Bonetalon, has taken too many of my men! Report to Sergeant Kara for debriefing!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: COMMISSIONED KILL!\nThe foulest fowl of Hidden Hills, known as Bonetalon, has taken too many of my men! Report to Sergeant Kara for debriefing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've seen soldiers torn to shreds by that blasted bird-brain, Bonetalon. Make sure you don't get sent back in ribbons, sweetheart.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya got what it takes, kid. Good work. Hidden Hills is safer for our troop movements, and I aim to take advantage of it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'd say I owe ya a drink or two.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Bonetalon, the terrorizing beast of Hidden Hills.

localizedTextIdText: One of Belle's scanbots, Bolt, wishes to aid his busy companion in the study of augmentation. Since she unintentionally "flipped a switch" in the Annihilator Silo, Bolt has been giving Belle a hard time and hopes he can redeem himself with your help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Belle's been busy studying augmentation. Rusty says I can be a bit... insensitive about her genius. But I think I can help her if you'd help me, too?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You'll find Belle's recording consoles near each of the cages taking auditory data. You can use them to signal me when you're there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I reckon you still got some work to do! Get to doin' it, honey!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hate seein' my own folk get turned into such... monsters. And it's all 'cause of my darned curiosity! There must be a way to put a stop to all this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Use Belle's recording consoles to summon me. They are near each cage.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well, aren't you just the sweetest thing?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'd be happy to help you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Bolt and Belle in their study of augmentation by accompanying Bolt out in the field. The results from the case study are disheartening for Belle, as the effects of augmentation seem deep within the psyche.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'd be happy to help you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ah, well, Doctor Belle has a way of causing trouble in her pursuit of knowledge. She tends to leave behind a mess. It just so happens that this mess is a giant robot trying to destroy us all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's a shame you won't help. I think she needs it to clean up this mess.

localizedTextIdText: You destroyed an Eldan Augmentor Construct that was somehow manipulating the elements of fire and air.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Augmentor Arm to Sue Digstone at the XAS Excavation Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This arm, taken from an augmentor construct, is of exquisite Eldan design. Perhaps someone from the XAS would be interested in studying it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, that looks like an arm from an augmentor construct? Can I have a look-see? I ain't never seen one like that before.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I got a feelin' it'll reveal somethin' new when I get it into a real lab!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the Augmentor Arm to Sue Digstone, who added it to her collection of augmentation-related artifacts.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Augmentor Arm to Sue Digstone

localizedTextIdText: The Bounty Board in Outpost Dawn has a listing that offers a reward for the death of Deathcaw, a vicious vulcarrion. When Outpost Dawn was operational, Deathcaw proved to be quite the menace.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: OUTPOST DAWN SOLDIERS:\nBeware of Deathcaw. This large vulcarrion is considered extremely dangerous and is known to attack on sight.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: OUTPOST DAWN SOLDIERS:\nBeware of Deathcaw. This large vulcarrion is considered extremely dangerous and is known to attack on sight.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not shy away from the hunt, $(player.class). Shedding the blood of our prey ensures our skills are sharp and deadly!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am told you slaughtered a mighty foe that once plagued the people of Outpost Dawn. Such a deed demands a reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have the heart of a hunter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Deathcaw, finally ridding Outpost Dawn of the flying vulcarrion menace.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll hunt on behalf of the Dominion!

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has asked you to craft $m(schematic=392) to aid the Queensguard in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested housing goods to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Queensguard in Celestion need supplies, some that might seem... unusual. We need someone to help us that won't ask too many questions.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Queensguard in Celestion need supplies, some that might seem... unusual. We need someone to help us that won't ask too many questions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Times a-wastin'. I reckon you should get to buildin'. Those Metal Platform ain't gonna build themselves.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I am tickled that you came through for me. Still not sure what they needed these Metal Platform for, but I'm just the go-fer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You got all my thanks. Carry on, Exile.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've accomplished Crafting Trainer Oaklee task to supply the Queensguard.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested housing goods to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade asked you to craft some $m(schematic=372).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=372) to Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The Sylvan Glade Beautification Committee requires aid in making the settlement more attractive. They request deliveries of $m(schematic=372).
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The Sylvan Glade Beautification Committee requires aid in making the settlement more attractive. They request deliveries of $m(schematic=372).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh, you have no idea how much we need some good old-fashioned plant life to make this place feel more like home! I believe in you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, you did it! I'm so happy, I could just explode into a cloud of butterflies and flowers! Ah, but I won't. I will give you a hug, though!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've been such a great help! I'll get these bushes to the right place!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've crafted $m(schematic=372) for the XAS at the behest of Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade.

localizedTextIdText: The Pioneering League requests housing supplies to support the colonization effort. Deliver $m(schematic=3003) to Contractor Drogor in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=3003) to Contractor Drogor in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: The Pioneering League requests housing supplies to support the colonization effort. Do your part! Take Long Fence (Granok) to Contractor Drogor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: The Pioneering League requests housing supplies to support the colonization effort. Do your part! Take Long Fence (Granok) to Contractor Drogor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You buggin' me instead of makin' those Long Fence (Granok)? It's no flint off my nose if you bail on this, but the Pioneering League ain't gonna be happy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hmph. Not bad. I'll get these to the Pioneering League. You got stones after all, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep your nose clean, chum.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered $m(schematic=3003) to Contractor Drogor in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the housing supplies to Contractor Drogor

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the $m(schematic=392)he requires of you to prove your loyalty to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=392) to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Dominion requires Metal Platform for constructing watchtowers to defend our territory. Deliver them to Craftmaster Tullio upon completion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Dominion requires Metal Platform for constructing watchtowers to defend our territory. Deliver them to Craftmaster Tullio upon completion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Metal Platform are one of the simplest things to construct - sheets of metal riveted together into a vague rectangle. Surely this is not beyond you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here we go. These are adequate to my requirements. You may go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are finished here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tullio at Feralplain Collective.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Renla at Feralplain Collective has submitted a request for small bramble bushes for use in an incredibly explosive experiment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Supervisor Renla in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Science calls! Need small bramble bushes for experiment! Hard to come by. Hirelings do it instead, bring to Supervisor Renla at once!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Science calls! Need small bramble bushes for experiment! Hard to come by. Hirelings do it instead, bring to Supervisor Renla at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: No, no, no! Haven't brought small bramble bushes yet! Stupid hireling! Don't waste time, start crafting! Science waits for no one!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You arrive with small bramble bushes! Now I hook wire up here, pour one-fourth kilo explosive mazonium there... what you want? Go away! Work to do!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nature needs more... explosions!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought several small bramble bushes to Supervisor Renla for use in his nefarious scheming. The future isn't looking too bright for dawngrazers.

localizedTextIdText: Architect Virin in Feralplain Collective has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those $m(schematic=3003)!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=3003) to Architect Virin in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The hard work always gets left up to the likes of us, don't it? Well, these fences won't build themselves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice job, mate. Feels good to know that the likes of us can contribute to the glory of the Dominion, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Blessings of Dominus to you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for <text Link="Schematic:3003">$m(schematic=3003)</text>.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the $m(schematic=392)she requires of you to prove your loyalty as a craftsman of the empire.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=392) to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, architects. Prove your worth to the empire by crafting Metal Platform for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nGreetings, architects. Prove your worth to the empire by crafting Metal Platform for me, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela. Know I am not easily impressed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes? Why are you here without the Metal Platform I asked for? We need them to construct watchtowers around the city!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah... excellent. Your devotion to the Dominion is noted. I expect great things from you in the future, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion honors your effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've proven yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela.

localizedTextIdText: Quartermaster Rylos has requested additional resources for the Radiant Legion operating in Ellevar. He is located at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=372) to Quartermaster Rylos at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Query functions indicate a shortage of proper decorative foliage in our inventory. Crafters are ordered to supply $m(schematic=372) at once.
