localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Query functions indicate a shortage of proper decorative foliage in our inventory. Crafters are ordered to supply $m(schematic=372) at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I explicitly requested a delivery of $m(schematic=372). It is not your place to determine the usefulness of my requests!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. I shall put these to use promptly. The Radiant Legion owes you a debt.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have met my expectations, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Quartermaster Rylos request.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to colonize Ellevar. Craft $m(schematic=3003) and take them to Architect Cybene at Lightreach Mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=3003) to Architect Cybene at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require housing supplies for our troops and settlers. Do your part for the glory of the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: As we fortify Ellevar, we require housing supplies for our troops and settlers. Do your part for the glory of the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I require Long Fence (Granok) for the Ellevar settlers. Granok fences have a certain quality we can study from. And turn them against the Exiles, of course.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Greetings, $(player.name). I detect the Long Fence (Granok) I requested in your inventory. Relinquish them to me, and I will ensure their distribution.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your progress is of interest to me. I will be monitoring you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for <text Link="Schematic:3003">$m(schematic=3003)</text>.

localizedTextIdText: De'Kar the Summoner is wanted for the brutal slaying of several members of the Dominion. These gruesome acts will not go unpunished. Find him in the Summoner's Den and eliminate him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Syrus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nDe'Kar is to be eliminated on sight.  His magic has caused several grisly murders here in Gildgrass. The Dominion will not allow this to continue.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED\nDe'Kar is to be eliminated on sight.  His magic has caused several grisly murders here in Gildgrass. The Dominion will not allow this to continue.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: De'Kar? He's one of the Skeech, isn't he? I'm vaguely familiar with the name... something about a reward? Kill him, and I will be happy to reward you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am certain the lowborn will sleep better at night knowing that De'Kar has been taken care of. One less bogeyman to frighten them, hm?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's your reward. Spend it in health.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully eliminated De'Kar the Summoner. No longer will his wretched magic be used against the innocents of the Dominion. Thanks to you, a quiet and swift justice has been served.

localizedTextIdText: Whirlygig is convinced he'll never make it to the top of Scourwind Peak with all the hostile air elementals in his way. He's asked you to kill the elementals so he can get to the top of Scourwind Peak in relative safety. In addition, Whirlygig would also like to know if the dust devils in the area are safe to ride.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Whirlygig via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are a lot of air elementals in my way, not to mention dust devils. I think the dust devils can be ridden, but the air elementals have got to go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'll never make it to the top of the mountain with all the air elementals around. Do you think you can destroy them before they destroy me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You see? I was right about the dust devils. Wasn't that fun? Of course, riding those things will be nothing compared to when we make our final leap!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Destroying elementals and riding dust devils, we'll get to the top soon!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By destroying the air elementals on and around Scourwind Peak, you assisted Whirlygig in his climb to the mountain's top. You also tested his theory about the dust devils, and whether or not they can be used to move from one place to another.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I do believe that is what small cyclones or tornados are called. I believe they can be harnessed for travel, and I want you to test my theory!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be like that. I cannot do this without you, my sentient friend!

localizedTextIdText: Captain Drevok needs immediate help thwarting an Exile database attack on the security system at the Gold Legion Listening Post. Access the control panel to block the Exile virus from entering communication channels.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Drevok inside the Gold Legion Listening Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A remote security breach is threatening to leak our classified information to the Exiles! Use the control panel to block the Exile virus from entering our network!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Access the control panel and neutralize the incoming virus fragments. There's no time to waste! Do it now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well, but this is not the end! Which of my men allowed this to happen? Only an outside file could be the cause! Certainly not one of mine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ravok's rage! This incident threatens my... er, our reputation!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm quite certain! I scan all my files before I access them. I'm no fool!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully blocked the Exile virus from fully entering the security system at the Gold Legion Listening Post. You've secured highly classified military information for the Dominion while upholding the post's nearly perfect reputation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Exiles have unleashed a virus that threatens to expose classified data that is routed through our network. It must be stopped!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is your blood too weak for a fight? Even a virtual fight?

localizedTextIdText: Captain Drevok believes the only way the Exile virus could have entered the security system at the Gold Legion Listening Post is through someone on the inside. Scan his team to discover the mole's identity and then eliminate that spy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Drevok at the Gold Legion Listening Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This was an inside job! Someone must have uploaded the Exile virus from behind our firewall. Take this device and scan my personnel. Find the mole!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This spy will know his time has come when you find him. He is nothing more than prey now, and he knows it! Use the scanner, find him, and kill him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well. I pride myself on the security precautions my personnel and I observe. We cannot allow Exile spies to interfere in our work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show the spy no mercy, should you find him!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was an honor to serve.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered the Exile spy inside the Gold Legion Listening Post and eliminated him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It will reveal the fear in the spy's heart! The traitor's weakness will unmask the mole!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will not rest until the Exile mole has been rooted out and crushed!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to intercept the Exile attack plans before it's too late!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Technician Bayliss at the Gold Legion Listening Post has informed you of an impending Exile attack.

localizedTextIdText: En route to the Grimvault, the ship you were flying in was violently torn apart by exanite fragments. Corrigan Doon was able to crash land your transport in the Shattered Sands, just outside the Grimvault's massive walls.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Protector Villos at the Radiant Med Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We was hit hard, we were. Ship was torn right in half, an' some of the crew must've fell a thousand feet or more. They'll need all your help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There's plenty of people what need your help a lot more than I do, $(player.name). Best not keep those poor souls waitin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have men dying out there! Make yourself useful or get out of the way!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are the $(player.class) who helped the crash victims, yes? Thank you for your aid. We will need everyone to assist Commander Toric.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: An' don't worry yourself over 'ol Corrigan. I'm a little woozy, but I'll mend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have hard times ahead of us, citizen. Mark my words.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Corrigan Doon by saving most of his crew from the wreckage of a devastating crash. Who knows what danger awaits as you go closer to the Grimvault?
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ain't exactly sure. Scanners said somethin' about exanite, but... well, I'm stymied. Figure we'll find out in good time, but I think I need a drink first.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Even I ain't heartless enough to turn my back on these people.

localizedTextIdText: The crash in the Shattered Sands left most of the Radiant Legion's troops, as well as yourself, on the other side of the wall and in hostile territory. The creatures outside the wall exhibit increased aggression, and the Legion needs help taking them down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian at the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Toric has stationed himself outside a breach in the wall, and strange creatures have been spotted. I have orders for you to cull these creatures.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You have been given a directive by our Holy Commander to destroy the monsters seen coming through the wall. You shall fulfill it at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We meet again, do we? Suits me fine. Come find me once we've put these bloody beasts down. I'll be waiting, I will.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm impressed with your work, $(player.name), as always. Unfortunately, this game's about numbers and we're on the losing end.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Holy Commander has given you a direct order. Get to it, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's time we pull the trump card, yes? What do you say?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I suppose someone's got to do it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you helped the Radiant Legion quell the hostile creatures surrounding Toric Antevian and his men, stranger enemies are still coming from the breach in the wall. The increased aggression by the local wildlife may be a result of the presence of these new foes.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll be back when I'm done.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Details are vague, but the locals have an unhealthy look. They have death in their eyes. Do not keep them waiting.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare decline a direct order from the Holy Commander?

localizedTextIdText: The nonstop assault from the creatures spilling out of the breach has proven too difficult for the Radiant Legion to contain. Toric Antevian has decided to call upon Kezrek Warbringer and the Dominion military. Mark locations for Kezrek's men to land in the Shattered Sands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kezrek Warbringer in the Shattered Sands
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These foul beasts multiply as our numbers dwindle. I've no choice but to request support from the Dominion military. Go and mark their landing zones.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Without reinforcements, we'll all die here. General Warbringer and the Dominion military will be here soon, so mark their landing zones at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The time for our defense is past! We will take the offensive and sweep our pathetic foes aside like so much refuse! For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: General Kezrek and his men are en route. Act with all due haste!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These creatures will feel pain like nothing they have experienced before!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Kezrek Warbringer and his men have arrived safely and are ready to wage war upon the creatures from the wall. Kezrek has decided the best course of action is to take the offense and assault the wall head-on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd rather die with my men here than follow your cowardly footsteps!

localizedTextIdText: To ease the pressure on the Radiant Legion, Kezrek Warbringer has sent you to strategic flanking points on higher ground where his men can place snipers. Hop onto the Flank Tank and head to the Desolate Highlands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must take control of the high ground. Ensure my tanks and men can secure the points I have marked. With enough snipers in place, victory is assured.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Radiant Legion will be nothing more than a memory if you do not act. Secure the high ground at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My men are in place, and you have proven your prowess once again. It seems the Radiant Legion's brave soldiers will survive this wretched day.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once the snipers and tanks are in place, this battle's tide will change.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to you, Dominion snipers are now in place. The time has come to press on and enter the Grimvault itself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If we are defeated due to your insubordination, I will kill you myself.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has gone into the Grimvault to establish a forward camp at Dawnbringer Outpost. Proceed to his location and regroup with his forces.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Kezrek Warbringer at Dawnbringer Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Toric and the Legion will remain here and secure the break in the wall. I must take the fight inward, and I want you to come with me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Time bleeds away, fool. We have little enough to waste as it is. Do your duty!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time bleeds away, fool. We have little enough to waste as it is. Do your duty!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew you would make it here. You are unstoppable, $(player.name). We will do well with you on our side.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am proceeding inside. Meet me here. I trust you shall survive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have met with Kezrek Warbringer inside the Grimvault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are too valuable of an asset to deny me, fool.

localizedTextIdText: The Royal Collegium has developed an intense interest in exanite, a rare, unusually durable substance. Help Exanitologist Egazz by collecting exanite samples throughout the Shattered Sands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Exanitologist Egazz via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ship hit by exanite. Valuable material, very rare. Must find samples, collect samples, analyze samples. You have time to help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need more samples of exanite. Is rare! Is valuable! More samples better than less! Now go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Interesting. Pieces have fine, contiguous edges. Means they part of much bigger piece that go "boom" in large way. Fascinating!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Exanite my specialty. Know almost everything about Exanite.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work. Collegium thankful for service. Now go away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By examining the fragments of exanite you collected in the Shattered Sands, Exanitologist Egazz deduced that an immense explosion shattered a large exanite structure in the area. The resulting shrapnel tore through your ship and made it crash.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You worthless. Better off with exanite in braincase.

localizedTextIdText: Injured soldiers in Shattered Sands need to be led to a nearby medical station. Protect them from vicious wildlife as you take them there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Protector Villos at the Radiant Med Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm not going to make it. You must help our fallen comrades. They cannot defend themselves. You must lead them to safety.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Leave me. Help the others. I am... lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go help our injured men. By Dominus! Do I have to do everything around here myself?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work. As soon as these men have been treated, they shall be thrust into the welcoming embrace of open warfare to face death once again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lead them with haste, for the local scrab... they thirst for easy blood.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Rest? In war? Preposterous! If they've still got hands, they'll fight.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Don't worry, I'll lead them to safety.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Can't they rest? Just for a while?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your aid, many of the Injured Soldier strewn across the Fractured Fields have successfully made it to a nearby medical station. As such, they have been spared from a horribly painful demise due to the area's vicious wildlife.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll bring those men to safety.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then my death will be in vain...

localizedTextIdText: You found a destroyed rifle in the ship's wreckage. The weapon needs replacement parts if it is to function again. Find replacement parts for the rifle throughout the Shattered Sands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Grudo Grozz via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This rifle seems to have been destroyed in the crash. Perhaps you can find some spare parts to put it back in working order.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This rifle seems to have been destroyed in the crash. Perhaps you can find some spare parts to put it back in working order.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you come to me with junk? DRED not interested in junk!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You build big gun from junk? Very impressive. Would have built it bigger, better. That thing okay for toy, I guess.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We need to mass-market Big Mama!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to cobble together a mess of parts into a functioning firearm. "Big Mama," as you called her, packed quite a punch, but she started to fall apart after some rough usage.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: This isn't junk! It's Big Mama!

localizedTextIdText: DRED has been rigging corpses to blow with injectable explosives. Help Grudo Grozz test this new explosive by using it on corrupted scrab in the Shattered Sands outside the walls of Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Grudo Grozz via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You help DRED. Inject explosive jelly in scrab corpses on battlefield. Will have double use - cleans battlefield and makes booby traps. Win-win!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: No need to fear scrabs. Just big bugs. When dead, make perfect vessel for explosive. Chitin shrapnel everywhere!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good, good! Very clean. Leaves room for more corpses on battlefield! The Zax always prefers a tidy working environment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not inject in self, $(player.class). Fun, but not advised.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Why you standing there? Go make more corpses!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Apparently dead bodies make good vessels for explosives. This is especially true for scrab, as their hard exoskeletons create deadly shrapnel upon detonation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't want to blow up dead things? Something wrong with you?

localizedTextIdText: You received a distress call from Tinia Pates, a lowborn Cassian girl, near the crash at Radiant Gamma Down. What's a lowborn Cassian doing in a place like this? You'd better investigate the crash site and see if you can find her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Tinia Pates in Radiant Gamma Down
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need help, I do! We was only playing around in that ship. By the Scions, we'd no idea it was set to fly off! Can you find me? I can't get out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'll never set foot on another ship so long as I live. I swear I won't!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We was just trying to have some fun, we were. Didn't mean to cause a fuss or nothing. You aren't going to... to punish me, are you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm so scared! I really, really am! Come quick! Please!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you so much... but my friends, you see. I don't know where they are!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hold tight, I'll come get you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No, I'm here to rescue you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Tinia Pates, a young lowborn Cassian, snuck aboard the transport ship along with her friends. Unfortunately, the transport ship crashed outside the walls of Grimvault. To better weather the crash, they all hid inside cryo pods. Someone needs to find them and send them home.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't want to die in here!

localizedTextIdText: Tinia Patess friends, Caelia Pycos, Cales Jureus, and her little brother, Trilius Pates, are still locked inside their cryo pods. Find their cryo pods in Radiant Gamma Down and let them out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Tinia Pates in Radiant Gamma Down
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The sirens went off and we hid in these pods. My friends are still locked up, I wager. Please help them! Caelia's wearing the same outfit as me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh, please find my little brother! Mum an' pap told me to look after him, they did!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What? Cales and Trilius weren't in their pods? I saw a cave on our way down. They must've hid in there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Cales had a blue jacket, he did. And Trilius wore his lucky red hat.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Caelia Pycos was safe and sound, but Cales Jureus and Trilius Pates are still missing. If they were able to escape their cryo pods, they may have gone to hide in a nearby cave.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are you aboard this ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We was just playin' in it, we were. Didn't think it would take off, you know? But when it did take off, we was in such a fright, we was! Hid in these pods 'till the ship came back home...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: There's four of us, there are. Caelia Pycos, Cales Jureus, and me wee little brother, Trilius...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No, you have to help us!

localizedTextIdText: Cales Jureus and Trilius Pates hid in the Ethereal Cavity, a cave in Grimvault, to escape from the strange creatures lurking outside. Go inside the cave and look for the missing boys before something terrible happens to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Cales Jureus in the Ethereal Cavity
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've done so much for us, you have, but my wee little brother and Cales are still missing. Can you go into that cave and see if they're inside?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It was my responsibility to look after Trilius, it was. Mum and pap are going to be so sad if anything happens to him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've never been so scared in all me life!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank Dominus! I thought I'd never get out of here! I surely didn't! And poor Trilius... he's hurt, he is! The lad got bit and then ran off!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm sure it's dark and scary in there, but you're a brave one. I can tell!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've reached the end of the Ethereal Cavity and found Cales Jureus shaken but alive. He informed you that Trilius Pates ran off and hid after getting bitten by one of the creatures. Someone needs to find Trilius and make sure he's okay.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't let Trilius die! You just can't!

localizedTextIdText: Cales Jureus is safe, but he's informed you that Trilius Pates has been bitten by one of the creatures in the Ethereal Cavity and run off into one of the cave's alcoves. You'd better locate Trilius and ensure he's okay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Tinia Pates outside the Ethereal Cavity
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Trilius got bit by one of those things! He was scared, so he run off into the alcoves. You need to find him, guv! You need to see if he's okay!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You found Trilius yet? He's just a wee lad, he is! By Dominus, he don't stand a chance against those monsters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find Trilius? Is he... is he in there? Is he alive? Oh, please...! *sob*
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you find Trilius? Is he... is he in there? Is he alive? Oh, please...!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You need to save him, you do! For Tinia's sake!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dead? Oh, by the Virtues! What have I done? I couldn't keep him safe!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Trilius Pates in the depths of the Ethereal Cavity, but he was beyond saving. You destroyed the thing that he'd become, and then delivered the sad news to his sister, Tinia.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'd let a boy die in here? Is savin' a lowborn lad beneath you?

localizedTextIdText: The bodies of infected soldiers are rife with whatever killed them. To prevent the disease's spread, the dead infectious soldiers in the Ethereal Cavity must be burned.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lieutenant Mikaak via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many of our brave soldiers have been killed by disease. Their bodies must be burned to honor them and prevent the plague from spreading.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is no honor in death by disease. The least you can do is allow their remains to be consumed by the flames.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have honored our dead and prevented the spread of the disease that killed them. My thanks, $(player.name). May Fazaar light your way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Send them to their ancestors, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've burned the bodies of the dead infectious soldiers in the Ethereal Cavity, thereby destroying the disease within them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dishonor them with your unwillingness to send them onward.

localizedTextIdText: A bounty has been posted for Bulgoth the Wallbreaker, a creature of incredibly sinister reputation. Should you wish to risk your life in pursuit of this beast, take some companions and search for it within the Sprawling Breach in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian at the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nBulgoth the Wallbreaker is a massive creature of singularly sinister reputation. A substantial reward is offered for proof of the beast's death.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Anyone bearing proof of Bulgoth the Wallbreaker's demise must submit it to Holy Commander Toric Antevian prior to receiving payment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Someone needs to kill that damned Bulgoth before it's too late for us. The beast draws nearer and nearer, and we're in bad enough shape as it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've bought us some time, $(player.name). Even I would've been hard-pressed bringing Bulgoth to its knees.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy your reward. It's well-earned!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the Sprawling Breach and delivered a rather messy death to the beast known as Bulgoth the Wallbreaker, earning a substantial reward for your trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Bulgoth is as good as dead.

localizedTextIdText: You've killed Bulgoth the Wallbreaker and recovered its big toe as proof of its death. Take the toe to Toric Antevian at the Vigilant Incursion and collect your reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian at the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This massive toe, once a part of Bulgoth the Wallbreaker, is sufficient proof of the beast's death. Take it to Toric Antevian and collect your reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've bought us some time, $(player.name). Even I would've been hard-pressed bringing Bulgoth to its knees.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy your reward. It's well-earned!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this toe to Toric.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the Sprawling Breach and delivered a rather messy death to the beast known as Bulgoth the Wallbreaker, earning a substantial reward for your trouble.

localizedTextIdText: Nerissa Artan, aboard the Fist of Azrion, is leading a recovery operation that is currently blocked by a Strain ambush at the entrance to the ship. She's ordered you to use flares to lure the Strain out from their positions and kill them so the operation can continue.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Nerissa Artan at the Fist of Azrion's exit
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain ambushes us when we venture into the ship to search for survivors, and it never goes well for us. Draw them out with flares and kill them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Loitering about will not save our people, $(player.name). Locate the Strain ambush site and use flares to lure the beasts out so you can kill them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The job's not over yet. With those Strain vermin out of the way, it's time to save some of our personnel before they are taken from us forever.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you destroy our ambushers, we can continue with the recovery operation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Nerissa Artan behest, you baited the Strain at the Fist of Azrion's entrance into attacking you and quelled the threat. Your actions will allow the recovery operation to move forward.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why don't you flee the ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We were bound for the Shattered Sands with reinforcements and supplies. As we entered Grimvault, the ship took a massive blast. Ringo and I were ejected and landed outside. Now we're collecting fellow survivors as we can.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're safer here under cover than outside, even if barely. There were more of us, but every attempt to flee or rescue other survivors... well, there were more of us at first. Besides, we can't hope to execute the Azrion Protocols if we're not aboard the Fist of Azrion, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The situation in Grimvault is so desperate we're under strict orders to recover all the military personnel and resources we can. But we also mustn't just allow any of it to fall into the enemy's hands. I'd prefer to just depart, but we've a job to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Our people are dying, $(player.name). Do not be a fool.

localizedTextIdText: The Fist of Azrion's remaining power is unreliable at best. Nerissa Artan has ordered you to repair and activate the auxiliary power system to help the recovery efforts and allow the still-functioning cryo pods to be opened.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ship's auxiliary power generator must be activated if we're to continue this operation. You'll also need to make repairs to its circuitry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If activating an auxiliary power generator is as simple as it sounds, why hasn't it been done yet, $(player.name)?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The lights are on, and power has stabilized. Excellent work. Now, our recovery efforts should be much more efficient.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll await word of your success. Scions guide you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Try to rein in that excitement, $(player.race).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Nerissa Artan ordered you to repair and reactivate the Fist of Azrion's auxiliary power system. Now that you've successfully restored power, further recovery efforts can be undertaken, such as attending to the passengers in the still-functioning cryo pods.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We're going to save who we can and dispose of the rest, of course. With you here, I think I might be able to make that happen. But don't let that go to your head.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If I'm not mistaken, and I seldom am, it incorporates some technology discovered on Nexus. Eldan technology. It's not the only part of the Fist of Azrion that does; however, its... dormancy is likely caused by the crash.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now is not the time to test my patience.

localizedTextIdText: Nerissa Artan has ordered you to open cryo pods in the Fist of Azrion's cryobay before their occupants are corrupted by the Strain. Should any of these unfortunates be compromised by the Strain, you are to eliminate them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Go to the Cryobay and free the legionnaires trapped inside the cryo pods there. Do it quickly, for I fear some of our men are already corrupted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's a simple matter to open the cryo pods. The hard part will be euthanizing the legionnaires who have been infected by the Strain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The survivors are well, if shaken. As for the others... it is good you spared them from a fate of insanity and painful mutation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Grant the men who have succumbed to the Strain a painless death.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must debrief these soldiers. You, however, have more work to do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I did what I needed to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed as many legionnaires as you could from the Fist of Azrion's cryobay, while simultaneously putting those who had succumbed to the Strain out of their misery.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll do what I have to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I find your decision-making abilities to be lacking.

localizedTextIdText: One of the Skurge has been detected aboard the Fist of Azrion, and Nerissa Artan has ordered you to drop everything and destroy the beast. If left to its own devices, the creature may kill what remains of the ship's passengers and crew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sensors are detecting the presence of the Skurge on the ship's second level. You must find and destroy the foul creature before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Skurge is still aboard the Fist of Azrion. Do you plan to destroy the creature, or would you prefer that we are all killed by it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the blood of Tresayne! The beast may be dead, but this ship's systems have been entirely corrupted! Can our plight be more dire?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not fail. The recovery operation cannot be stopped at this point.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Despite this news, we would be worse off if not for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I suppose. At least it's not raining.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Kothacheyah, the Star Slayer was sent to destroy you aboard the Fist of Azrion, but you were able to defeat the filthy creature quite handily.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What's so bad about the Skurge?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Skurge are agents created as a direct response to the Strain's contact with elite Dominion citizens on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: For one, they possess heightened intelligence, the ability to communicate, and they constantly evolve to overcome new threats. They are also able to act independently.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I'm unsure. So far, we've only encountered them when the Strain needs to operate sophisticated equipment. If one has been dispatched to this ship, we have obviously gained some unwanted attention.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We haven't time for humor, $(player.race).

localizedTextIdText: Nerissa Artan has ordered you to meet with Captain Sabes in the Fist of Azrion and arm the ship's self-destruct system in order to deny it to the Strain. Once you've armed the system, you must escape before the ship explodes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Fist of Azrion is beyond saving, and we cannot allow it to fall into enemy hands. Meet the captain and activate the self-destruct system.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Fist of Azrion's computer and weapons systems cannot be given over to our enemies, both Exile and Strain. Activate the self-destruct at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That you survived the explosion is a marvel. As for Captain Sabes... we shall remember him with fondness. If only we could all die so heroically.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once the self-destruct system is active, I suggest you make a hasty escape.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Farewell for now, $(player.name). I suspect we shall meet again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Captain Sabes bravely triggered the Fist of Azrion's self-destruct system while you escaped and survived the explosion by the unlikeliest of means.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The system can be activated only if it detects the captain's primal pattern and life-signs. If necessary, you must protect him as he initializes it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It won't destroy the ship's hull, but it will render the ship's valuable military assets and sensitive information systems useless to the Strain. If we are fortunate, it might even kill the lot of them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How dare you turn your back on your people now?

localizedTextIdText: Finding you to be a dependable and effective asset, Agent Lex has revealed his cloaked position on top of the Fist of Azrion. He has ordered you to find Terminal 2112 on an upper deck of the ship and transmit its data to him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am here on ICI business and must rely on you once again. Locate Terminal 2112 aboard this vessel and transmit its data to me at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Terminal 2112 is on the upper levels of this vessel. Once you locate it, transmit the data it contains to me via secure comm signal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Terminal 2112's data is coming through strong and clear. Once again, you have proven your value to the ICI.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Attend to the task at hand, and ask no questions. Now go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your tasks are far from over. Stand by for further orders, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Glad to be of service. Again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: As requested by Agent Lex, you found Terminal 2112 on an upper deck of the Fist of Azrion and uploaded its contents to him. You once again proved to be the dependable and effective asset he appraised you to be.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's the nature of the data?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That information is currently being kept on a need-to-know basis. You would do well to refrain from asking too many questions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This would be an unfortunate time to sanction you.

localizedTextIdText: The next step in Agent Lex secret mission requires that you locate and enter Department YYZ on the Fist of Azrion's top floor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This vessel's upper deck features a laboratory. Entry to Department YYZ can be found there. Find the access point and force entry, then contact me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Department YYZ has yet to be located and accessed. This delay in progress is unacceptable. I suggest you accelerate your advance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your continued longevity is a marvel to behold. I am continually surprised by your ability to withstand even the most rigorous and demanding tasks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Exercise caution. Hostile elements may very well block your progress.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is more to this operation. Much more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You breached the top-secret Department YYZ aboard the Fist of Azrion for Agent Lex. Perhaps now Lex will let you in on the nature of his current operation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Department YYZ is a classified area aboard the Fist of Azrion. ICI clearance is required to even know it exists. You should feel privileged.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your reluctance to serve the ICI is unacceptable at this juncture.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex, aboard the Fist of Azrion, has remotely deactivated most of the security systems in Department YYZ. The remaining systems must be neutralized in-person. Hack each Security Control Board to disable the system's targeting protocols so you can gain access to your next objective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Much of Department YYZ's security systems have been disabled remotely. You will need to hack the security control boards to neutralize the rest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The remaining security systems continue to flag you as a hostile intruder. The key to your advance lies in hacking the security control boards.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The security systems have been neutralized. Our continued progress is assured.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Avoid the spotlights. You are no good to the ICI dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are nearly done here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By hacking the Security Control Boards in Department YYZ aboard the Fist of Azrion, you were able to bypass the security measures that would have prevented your continued progress.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The spotlights are part of a targeting system tied to sentry guns in Department YYZ. The sentry guns will incinerate all targets with plasma bursts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Shall I reenable the security systems and ensure your destruction?

localizedTextIdText: To complete his operation aboard the Fist of Azrion, Agent Lex needs you to activate console X-1 on Department YYZ's catwalk so the Dominion can transmit command signals and control "the X-Periment."
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Access Console X-1 at once. This will allow us to control the X-Periment, which we intend to use to destroy the Strain aboard the Fist of Azrion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Console X-1 will activate the X-Periment's data receptors, allowing the ICI to take control of the creature. It is best if you do not delay.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Control has been asserted over the X-Periment. We are now preparing to open the creature's paddock so that it can confront the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soon, the Strain will be a distant memory.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hold onto your posterior and proceed to the exit.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That sounds like a good plan.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: This is going to be good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You activated console X-1 near the X-Periment's paddock aboard the Fist of Azrion. While this should have allowed the Dominion to control the beast, things did not go as planned. Big surprise, huh?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. This beast was the pride of DRED when the Fist of Azrion deployed, which means they must be at least one version ahead by now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Of course not. However, you have a much higher chance of survival if you stay out of its way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I do not lack empathy, per se, but I cannot comprehend your reasons for refusal.

localizedTextIdText: Strain corruption in the X-Periment's cognitive systems aboard the Fist of Azrion caused the Dominion to lose control of the creature. As a result, you're going to have to neutralize it before it neutralizes you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The procedure has failed. Degradation of data caused by Strain feedback has resulted in the X-Periment's corruption. We have no choice but to destroy it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The X-Periment is too powerful to be left in the hands of the Strain. Destroy it, but remember to use Console X-1 should the force field impede you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Though DRED's failure ratio is not as low as I might prefer, this mishap was caused by Strain corruption. This mission is now classified as a failure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If the malfunctioning force field impedes you, reactivate console X-1.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you were at fault, we would not be having this conversation. Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not in trouble, am I?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the X-Periment in Department YYZ aboard the Fist of Azrion before it could squash you like an insect. The nasty creature had suffered Strain corruption in its cognitive systems, preventing it from being controlled by the ICI. Good thing, too, or you might not have seen any action at all.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: No. All other possible scenarios lead to catastrophic outcomes for the Dominion units deployed to Grimvault.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes. The corruption that is spreading through the X-Periment is also present in Department YYZ's security and climate control systems. Analysis points to the Strain as the cause. You are in a very unfortunate position.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Treason, is it?

localizedTextIdText: You found sealed DRED orders in the Fist of Azrion's own Department YYZ. They should be delivered to Ringo Hax via your datachron right away!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These sealed DRED orders are obviously intended for Ringo Hax's eyes, because it says so on the envelope. You should deliver them to him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Orders from DRED? Where you find it? Give them here. Been waiting for weeks! Many weeks! Stupid courier. If not dead, I would kill him.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Orders still sealed? Good. Don't want to kill you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found sealed DRED orders in the Fist of Azrion's own Department YYZ. You delivered the data to Ringo Hax via your datachron, and the package disposed of itself without leaving even a trace of an elemental footprint. See? The ICI really does care!

localizedTextIdText: You discovered Doctor Rose's Cryo Pod, located in the Fist of Azrion's Sick Bay. The woman inside looks incredibly peaceful. Almost... too peaceful. What will happen if you try to wake her?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTENTS: Doctor Rose.\nContagion Quarantine Protocols: Engaged.\nDisengage protocols to open cryo pod.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Contagion Quarantine Protocols Disengaged.\nCryo Pod: Unlocked.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Not even I know what would happen if Doctor Rose woke up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Release Doctor Rose? Only a moron would do that! Lucky for morons, I control pod security remotely.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Contagion Quarantine Protocols: Disengaged.\nHave a nice day.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.name) too curious. Might not be so lucky next time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You nearly opened Doctor Rose's Cryo Pod in the Fist of Azrion's Sick Bay, but Ringo Hax intervened. He wouldn't say why, but he made it clear that you almost did something exceptionally stupid.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: I'm going to pull up some background info.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Subject: Doctor Rose was found drifting in space by a salvage team deployed to Farside.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Contagion Quarantine Protocols remain engaged.\nCryo pod is locked.

localizedTextIdText: Miner Vallass friend, Digger Anton, has been trapped by a particularly nasty yeti in Cragroach Cavern. Miner Vallas has asked you to find Anton and save him before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Miner Vallas inside Cragroach Cavern
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Me friend, Anton... he's been beset by a particularly vicious yeti, yeah? Mayhaps you'd lend him a hand with it? We'd all be grateful!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you saved Anton from that bloody vicious yeti yet? He's liable to be lunch if you don't do somethin' soon, what?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Smaller than the other yeti, you say? Well, there's no accountin' for size. The small ones is more vicious 'cause they need to make up for it, get me?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Whew! Thanks be to Dominus you came along. Anton won't last long!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for savin' Anton. Now the lazy sod can get some real work done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Bantam Yeti{p:Bantam Yeti} and saved Digger Anton. The miners in Cragroach Cavern should be safe... for now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thanks for nothin', guv... you bleedin' coward.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer at Dawnbringer Outpost has ordered you to destroy the creeping spawners that continue to fill the Creeping Abyss with endless waves of their Strain-ridden progeny.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain comes from spawners that produce endless streams of their filth. If we destroy these creatures, we are that much closer to victory.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Strain's numbers continue to increase. Destroy the spawners before we are overwhelmed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the spawners destroyed, we can press our offensive until the Strain is no longer a threat. Your true test is yet to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show them no mercy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Kezrek Warbringer orders, you hunted down and destroyed the creeping spawners in the Creeping Abyss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You make me sick!

localizedTextIdText: Major Caros at Dawnbringer Outpost wants you to avenge the deaths of his troops by putting down packs of Strain and other corrupted creatures in the Creeping Abyss.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Caros via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: For a soldier to die at the hands of a Strain abomination... it is such a waste! But you will level the field, $(player.name). You will avenge my men!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you avenged my men? Or do the detritus that killed them still crawl and slither within the Creeping Abyss?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My men... my poor men. Young Cassian blood has been shed by a voracious foe. But you... you have given their lives meaning. For that, I thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Summon forth a deluge of blood and death like no one has ever seen before!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must conquer here. See to it, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll gladly take vengeance in their names.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You avenged the lives of the Dominion soldiers that have been killed by the Strain in the Creeping Abyss.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Those beasts don't stand a chance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I would gladly trade a coward like you for just one of my fallen troops.

localizedTextIdText: Nurse Sabinec at Dawnbringer Outpost is creeped out by the creeping eyestalks that dot the landscape of the Creeping Abyss. She's asked you to destroy as many as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nurse Sabinec via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've seen those eyestalks? I tell you, I can feel those things staring at me. It's starting to give me the jitters. I can't stand it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can still feel those things staring at me. Why won't they stop? When will you do as you offered to do? Destroy them, please!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes... the feeling of being watched has diminished somewhat. It was such an oppressive sensation, as if a thousand eyes were on me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Would you? That would be a kind act, citizen... a kind act, indeed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I do believe your actions have made a difference. Thank you so much.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That's not far from the truth.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed a number of creeping eyestalks near Dawnbringer Outpost on behalf of Nurse Sabinec. As a result, she's much less creeped out than she used to be.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I should ask you directly next time instead of beating around the bush, hm?

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer at Dawnbringer Outpost has commanded you to find a way into Spineridge Nest and meet with Agent Lex. Lex is currently awaiting your arrival, so you'd better hurry.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Agent Lex of the ICI has demanded your assistance within Spineridge Nest. I suggest you find a way inside at once and proceed to his location.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Agent Lex is not a being you should keep waiting. He has a habit of showing up when you least expect him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The hour is late. I expect you will assist me, nonetheless.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The General sent you. Excellent. Despite his fondness for your martial prowess, even he must share you with the ICI on occasion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We will meet again, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Of course, $(player.name). It seems you are very much in demand these days.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infiltrated Spineridge Nest and met with Agent Lex. It seems as if the ICI is in need of your skills once again.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Wouldn't that save me a trip?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will inform Agent Lex of your reluctance to meet him.

localizedTextIdText: In order to access the Phage cannons, Agent Lex wants you to assassinate the Spineridge Commander at Spineridge Nest in order to gain entry to the Corrupted Installation. The Skurge commander is the only one with the proper access codes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eliminate the Skurge Commander and acquire his access codes, then enter the facility and gauge the damage caused by the techno-phage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to acquire the facility's access codes from the Spineridge commander. Without the codes, you are useless to the ICI.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My theory has been confirmed - the techno-phage has corrupted Eldan technology throughout the facility. Such a complication is unfortunate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The access codes can be used to activate the teleporter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The cannon remains my primary objective. As such, you must destroy it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assassinated the Spineridge Commander in Spineridge Nest, took his access code, and entered the Corrupted Installation. It's only a matter of time before you locate the Phage cannon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am currently initiating self-repair protocols. You will continue in my place.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Are you surprised? Even the most capable agents are damaged from time to time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are the only agent in any condition to complete this task.

localizedTextIdText: Nurse Sabinec at Dawnbringer Outpost wants you to see to the troops fighting in the Creeping Abyss and bolster their morale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nurse Sabinec at Dawnbringer Outpost
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You're a hero, $(player.name). It would mean a lot to the soldiers fighting in the Abyss if you could give them a little encouragement.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those soldiers know they might not make it home to their families in one piece, or at all. Your words will give them the will to keep fighting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done a wonderful thing today, $(player.name). It's not every day that a hero visits the troops. It means more to them than you know.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sometimes the difference between life and death is a kind word.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dominus watch over you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Of course. I'll do what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You encouraged the soldiers fighting in the Creeping Abyss and gave them the strength to fight on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I see. A little success, and you're suddenly better than everyone else?

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest wants you to destroy the Phage Cannon in the Corrupted Installation and prevent it from ever being used again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Skurge cannot be allowed to reclaim the Phage Cannon. Access the control panels in sequence to overload the cannon and destroy it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not delay. Return to the command center and ensure the Phage Cannon's destruction.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Phage Cannon has been destroyed, but the Skurge are tenacious. The probability of encountering them again is over one-hundred percent.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once the cannon is destroyed, you must escape from the installation.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This operation is classified. I trust you will speak of it to no one.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Phage Cannon in the Corrupted Installation and prevented it from ever being used again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your decision is illogical. Perhaps you can explain it under interrogation.

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Shadez has asked you to hunt Gorgegut the Necrotic in the Blighted Pass. If you can kill the creature before she does, the glory of the hunt will be yours to claim.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lieutenant Shadez via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Gorgegut the Necrotic is dangerous prey, and I have sworn to kill it. Should you slay it before I do, the honor of the kill will be yours alone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You still live... but what of Gorgegut? Does that foul creature still haunt the Blighted Pass?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Goregut is dead by your hand, $(player.name), and you have proven yourself to be a tenacious hunter. Such a quality makes you much more... desirable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Gorgegut kills you, I will remember your bravery with fondness.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Revel in your success. I will not soon forget you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have killed Gorgegut the Necrotic in the Blighted Pass and earned Lieutenant Shadez respect, as well as the glory that might have been hers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: There is no shame in refusing such a task if you do not have what it takes.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex has come to Spineridge Nest to destroy the Phage Cannon. To prepare for the operation's ultimate success, he has ordered you to gather intelligence about the Skurge in Spineridge Nest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Skurge have taken control of a weapon the call the "Phage Cannon." The ICI wishes to know how they were able to do so in such a short amount of time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must determine the objectives of the Skurge. What do they plan to do with the Phage Cannon? The empire's welfare may depend on what you learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have collected a significant amount of data which reveals the Skurge's ability to control Eldan technology with something called "techno-phage."
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect prompt delivery of this crucial information. Now go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I concur. This new threat only adds to our difficulties.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered intelligence on the Skurge for Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Strain have taken control of an Eldan weapon - known as a Phage Cannon - inside Grimvault. It must be destroyed before it can be used against us further.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: ICI field agents have determined that the Skurge are a creation of the Entity. Skurge primal patterns display a marked similarity to those of our citizens, as well as those of the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you are not with us, you are against us.

localizedTextIdText: You've helped Belle Walker, and now it's time to lend your aid to other Exiles in Farside. Proceed at once to the Cascade Cliffs, speak to Anthropologist Birchly, and learn how you might be useful.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Anthropologist Birchly at Cascade Cliffs
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As much as I'd like to keep ya all to myself, you and I gotta part ways. There's other folks in Farside who can use your help more than me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You talked to Birchly yet? That lady needs help real bad. She said somethin' about Skeech, and that's a sure sign of trouble!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Belle's supposed to send someone. That'd be you, I expect?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like Miss Walker finally got around to sendin' someone to give us a hand. Make no mistake, we got our hands full and then some!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, you know it! But don't fret, sugar. Birchly will take good care of ya!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Anthropologist Birchly at Cascade Cliffs and offered your services to her.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll find out what Birchly needs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know it's hard leavin' me behind, but ya just gotta.

localizedTextIdText: You've helped Artemis Zin, and now it's time to lend your aid to other Dominion citizens in Farside. Proceed at once to Bogwatch Post, speak to Researcher Neres, and learn how you might be useful.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Researcher Neres at Bogwatch Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It has been a pleasure working with you again, but I think our time has ended. Find Researcher Neres at Bogwatch Post and speak to her.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find Researcher Neres at Bogwatch Post. Though she's just a junior Collegium researcher, she appears ambitious. Help her realize her ambitions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Good day.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At last! Lady Zin told me to expect someone, but I had no idea it would be $(player.name). Just having you here settles my nerves somewhat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Apparently, Neres needs help with... something. Skeech, I think she said.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In a single word, "Skeech."
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Researcher Neres at Bogwatch Post and offered your services to him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I do not advise declining me again. Ever.

localizedTextIdText: An Eldan datacube was recently found and broken into fragments by the Tanglevine Skeech. Anthropologist Birchly would like to reconstruct the datacube, and has asked for your help in gathering up datacube fragments in and around Tanglevine Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anthropologist Birchly via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Tanglevine Skeech got their paws on a datacube and broke it into bits. I'd love to put it back together, but I need you to collect the pieces.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That datacube's not gonna put itself back together. You better get busy before the Skeech break the bits into smaller bits.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew you was the one for the job. These fragments should be simple enough to reassemble, assumin' we got 'em all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those Skeech're dangerous, but you got nothin' to be afraid of!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait to see what mysteries this datacube will reveal!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the dangers of Tanglevine Village and collected datacube fragments for Anthropologist Birchly. What secrets will the reassembled datacube reveal?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I expected you to help us out. I'm guessin' I was wrong.

localizedTextIdText: An Eldan datacube was recently found and broken into fragments by the Tanglevine Skeech. Researcher Neres would like to reconstruct the datacube, and has asked for your help in gathering up datacube fragments in and around Tanglevine Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Neres via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Tanglevine Skeech got their filthy hands on a datacube and broke it into bits. I must discover its contents, but I need you to collect the pieces first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to collect all of the datacube fragments. If I am to assemble the datacube, I'll need those pieces first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Putting this datacube back together should be a brief, albeit tedious, process. Let us hope the information it contains is worth our time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Someone of your caliber should have little trouble with this task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the dangers of Tanglevine Village and collected datacube fragments for Researcher Neres. What secrets will the reassembled datacube reveal?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I admit, I was not expecting you to say no.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Papovich has heard reports from an Exile explorer about a decapitated Skeech head with unusual attire. She requests that you find the rest of the Skeech's body parts around Tanglevine Village and place a decontamination shield around them so her team can gather them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Professor Papovich at the Cascade Cliffs
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I received a report of a decapitated Skeech head in the village wearing a strange device. I would like you to find the rest of its body parts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find the Skeech body parts and place a decontamination shield around them. I want to study this fascinating specimen, and perhaps return him to life.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The experiment was a success. Oh, my dear Anatoli, we will be together again! But I digress. We must learn the origins of this strange Skeech.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll want the pieces intact, so place a decontamination shield around them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: He does have quite an intriguing hat, does he not?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Skeech remains you gathered belonged to a very unique Skeech named Lucent, who you managed to bring back to life once you'd found the rest of his scattered body parts. Professor Papovich is amazed and suggests you talk to him to figure out what he's all about.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We must get to the bottom of this dismembered Skeech and his "hat."

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Neres has heard reports from a Dominion explorer about a decapitated Skeech head with unusual attire. She requests that you find the rest of the Skeech's body parts around Tanglevine Village and place a decontamination shield around them so her team can gather them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Researcher Neres at Bogwatch Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have received word of a decapitated Skeech head in the village wearing a strange device. I would like you to find the rest of its body parts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find the Skeech body parts and place a decontamination shield around them. We cannot risk them decaying any further. Freshness is key!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This Skeech is unique and intelligent, like no Skeech ever discovered. Let us study this specimen. Speak with him and act as if everything is normal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll want the pieces intact, so place a decontamination shield around them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Uh... okay, I'll talk to him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Skeech remains you gathered belonged to a very unique Skeech named Lucent, who you managed to bring back to life once you'd found the rest of his scattered body parts. Researcher Neres is amazed and suggests you talk to him to figure out where he came from.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you mean to waste all of our time, or just mine?

localizedTextIdText: Lucent believes he can convince the Tanglevine Skeech to stop their warmongering and live peaceful lives. He has requested that you play his propaganda message to the Skeech of Tanglevine Village in an attempt to enlighten them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucent via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have devised a campaign to enlighten the barbaric Tanglevine Skeech. Play this message for them and see if they will come to their senses.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have the savage Skeech heard my message? I assure you, this plan has the potential to raise my people up from barbarism!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Such barbarians! The mature Tanglevine Skeech are really quite stubborn! Perhaps there is no hope for their generation... however....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With the proper motivation, why wouldn't the Skeech want to be just like me?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The younger Skeech may still possess minds open to logic and reason!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Unfortunately, the Tanglevine Skeech have not responded well to Lucent attempts to civilize them. He now believes the older Skeech generations are beyond redemption... though the young are another matter entirely.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This is my cerebral-amplification helmet! It is the work of a genius! My creator fused this device to me so that I can communicate in an enlightened manner.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Ah, well... my creator did not discuss the minutia of the Helmet's functionality with me. Yet, because of him, I am civilized and enlightened!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will not help? But my people must break the shackles of their ignorance!

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucent via your Datachron

localizedTextIdText: Lucent believes there is hope yet for the younger generations of Tanglevine Skeech. He has requested you gather up adolescent Tanglevine Skeech by the waterfall, outside of Tanglevine Village, so he may instruct them. Poke the adolescent Tanglevine Skeech to wake them up and they will know where to go.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucent via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is hope for the Tanglevine! Wake the adolescent Tanglevines from their slumbers and send them to me! I will show them how to conduct themselves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The adolescent Skeech are indolent! They will be honored to learn from me! Wake them from their leisure by the waterfall and send them into my presence!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at these young minds, each one eager to bathe in the glory of my intellect! Oh, how I miss the days of blissful ignorance. Skeech SKEECH!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Am I not generous? Am I not enlightened?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, hmm. Pardon me! That was strange!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lucent is delighted that so many adolescent Tanglevine Skeech have come to learn from him. He hopes to influence them to his way of thinking, thus bringing civility into the society of the Tanglevine Skeech.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I hope you're ready for them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If successful, I will rid you of an implacable enemy! Can you not see?

localizedTextIdText: Lucent believes there is hope yet for the younger generations of Tanglevine Skeech. He has requested you gather up adolescent Tanglevine Skeech by the waterfall, outside of Tanglevine Village, so he may instruct them. Poke the adolescent Tanglevine Skeech to wake them up and they will know where to go.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lucent via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is hope for the Tanglevine! Wake the adolescent Tanglevines from their slumbers and send them to me! I will show them how to conduct themselves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The adolescent Skeech are indolent! They will be honored to learn from me! Wake them from their leisure by the waterfall and send them into my presence!

localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I hope you're ready for them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If successful, I will rid you of an implacable enemy! Can you not see?

localizedTextIdText: In the absence of the Eldan that created him, Lucent feels it is his duty to continue his master's work. He has requested that you meet him in the Progenitor's Hideaway, in the center of the Bio-Dome, to discuss how to further fix the Tanglevine Skeech.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anthropologist Birchly via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As the last legacy of my creator, it is my duty to continue his work! Come to his lab at once! Let me show you true brilliance!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Must I repeat myself? Meet me at my creator's lab, and we shall discuss my master plan!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If Lucent wants ya to follow him, I suggest ya do just that. Might want to be careful, though... he's actin' kind of weird.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can only reckon the Eldan experimented with Lucent a touch too much, but they couldn't get all the Skeech outta him. Too bad.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: How fitting for my master's most perfect creation to lead lesser beings to salvation!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It was only a matter of time before Lucent's true nature was revealed, and Anthropologist Birchly thinks it's pretty clear that he was little more than another failed Eldan experiment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ignorant fool! I am offering you an opportunity for enlightenment!

localizedTextIdText: In the absence of the Eldan that created him, Lucent feels it is his duty to continue his master's work. He has requested that you meet him in the Progenitor's Hideaway, in the center of the Bio-Dome, to discuss how to further fix the Tanglevine Skeech.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Neres via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As the last legacy of my creator, it is my duty to continue his work! Come to his lab at once! Let me show you true brilliance!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Must I repeat myself? Meet me at my creator's lab, and we shall discuss my master plan!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If Lucent beckons you to follow him, I suggest you do so. Be careful, though... his behavior is questionable and erratic.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The discovery of Lucent's helmet is a crowning achievement for the Dominion, even if the technology is incapable of masking a Skeech's true nature.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: How fitting for my master's most perfect creation to lead lesser beings to salvation!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It was only a matter of time before Lucent's true nature was revealed, and Researcher Neres thinks it's pretty clear that he was little more than another failed Eldan experiment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ignorant fool! I am offering you an opportunity for enlightenment!

localizedTextIdText: Tanglevine shamans pull power from primal resonating crystals located around Tanglevine Village. Researcher Shanov needs your help destroying these crystals to cripple the Tanglevine shamans and create a safer work environment for her team.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Shanov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need every advantage against these Skeech. Their shamans draw power from resonating primal crystals around the camp. You must destroy them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you destroy the three primal crystals located around Tanglevine Village? The sooner we destroy the crystals, the sooner we can weaken the Skeech.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: In time, the empowering effect of the crystals should dissipate. Once it does so, my team can return to their work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Crush the crystals and gather their energy to engineer their eradication.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully destroyed the three crystals located around Tanglevine Village. Researcher Shanov thinks it may take time for the effect to be noticeable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am not satisfied with your refusal to help.

localizedTextIdText: Tanglevine shamans pull power from primal resonating crystals located around Tanglevine Village. Biologist Dekari needs your help destroying these crystals to cripple the Tanglevine shamans and create a safer work environment for her team.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Dekari via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Skeech shamans draw power from the primal crystals around their village. We must cut off the source of their power so they do not hinder my work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you destroy the three primal crystals located around the village? This task must be done, and you have been chosen to do it.
