localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: In time, the empowering effect of the crystals should dissipate. Once it does so, my team can return to their work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hack those crystals to bits.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully destroyed the three crystals located around Tanglevine Village. Biologist Dekari thinks it may take time for the effect to be noticeable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are too weak and pathetic to help me? Disgusting!

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Shanov wonders how the Skeech in Tanglevine Village could behave so differently from Lucent. She's requested that you gather samples of their primal imprints for her to examine. With these samples, she hopes to discover how much Lucent biology differs from his Tanglevine brothers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Shanov via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must know if Lucent's primal imprint is different from that of the other Tanglevine Skeech. If so, it might explain his increased intellect.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you gathered the primal imprint samples from the Tanglevine Skeech? I fear you may need to kill the specimens in order to do so.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is as I suspected. Lucent's primal pattern is indistinguishable from that of the other Skeech. His intellect is likely a product of his helmet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I look forward to analyzing the samples you collect.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps the helmet might have applications for other XAS projects?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Let's hope he doesn't lose that helmet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered primal imprint samples from Tanglevine Skeech for Researcher Shanov, and she can find no difference between Lucent biology and theirs. She has surmised that his Eldan Helmet is the sole source of his unusual intellect and demeanor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This research is important. Are you so careless as to turn your back on me?

localizedTextIdText: Biologist Dekari wonders how the Skeech in Tanglevine Village could behave so differently from Lucent. She's requested that you gather samples of their primal imprints for her to examine. With these samples, she hopes to discover how much Lucent biology differs from his Tanglevine brothers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Dekari via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lucent is obviously smarter than his kin. I want you to collect primal implant samples from the Tanglevine Skeech so I can compare them to his.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You will have to kill the Skeech to gather their samples. They are not the mightiest of prey, but they can be challenging foes in large numbers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lucent's primal imprint is no different than that of the other Skeech. Therefore, it is probable that his intellect is a product of his Eldan helmet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Is his intellect something he was born to? Or is it a mutation?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: DRED will want to see this helmet, or another like it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Let's hope he doesn't lose that helmet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered primal imprint samples from Tanglevine Skeech for Biologist Dekari, and she can find no difference between Lucent biology and theirs. She has surmised that his Eldan Helmet is the sole source of his unusual intellect and demeanor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your cowardice is appalling.

localizedTextIdText: The Tanglevine Skeech are becoming a big pain for Exile explorers attempting to map out the area. They've taken the explorers hostage, placing them inside cages throughout Tanglevine Village. Save the explorers by freeing them from their cages.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anthropologist Birchly at the Cascade Cliffs via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The simple lock on this cage door looks easy enough to pick, and the Exile explorer inside appears anxious to escape.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The simple lock on this cage door looks easy enough to pick, and the Exile explorer inside appears anxious to escape.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've lost a slew of our explorers to those blasted Skeech. We should try and free those folks before they're thrown into a soup pot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for freein' my people from the Tanglevine Skeech. We lost a couple of folks, but you done rescued lots more than that. They owe you, big time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Anthropologist Birchly is grateful you managed to free members of her team from Tanglevine cages inside Tanglevine Village. Those explorers owe you their lives.

localizedTextIdText: The Tanglevine Skeech are becoming a big pain for Dominion explorers attempting to map out the area. They've taken the explorers hostage, placing them inside cages throughout Tanglevine Village. Save the explorers by freeing them from their cages.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Dekari via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The simple lock on this cage door looks easy enough to pick, and the Dominion explorer inside appears anxious to escape.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The simple lock on this cage door looks easy enough to pick, and the Dominion explorer inside appears anxious to escape.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have lost a number of explorers that were sent on routine mapping assignments. I suspect the Skeech have them. Find them and free them, if you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: One of our explorers will feed that village for a day or two. Perhaps the Skeech will starve without them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In any case, you saved our explorers. For that, I thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Biologist Dekari is grateful you managed to free members of her team from Tanglevine cages inside Tanglevine Village. Those explorers owe you their lives.

localizedTextIdText: The Tanglevine Skeech worship a giant Gorganoth named Big Graw, who lairs just outside of Tanglevine Village. It's in the best interest of the Exiles that this living "god" be terminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Anthropologist Birchly via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nBig Graw, a giant Gorganoth, is idolized by the Skeech. A reward is offered for Big Graw's death in the hopes it will demoralize the Tanglevine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED\nBig Graw, a giant Gorganoth, is idolized by the Skeech. A reward is offered for Big Graw's death in the hopes it will demoralize the Tanglevine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've known a lot of folks who tried to take Big Graw down. All of 'em are dead but one, and he lost both legs and an arm when he tried.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If anything can demoralize the Skeech, it's Big Graw's death. How are those little freaks behaving now?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's your reward, $(player.name). You done good.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of Big Graw.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They seem a little less aggressive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Anthropologist Birchly is interested in observing the Tanglevine Skeech's behavior now that their deity has fallen to your concerted attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take care of Big Graw.

localizedTextIdText: The Tanglevine Skeech worship a giant Gorganoth named Big Graw, who lairs just outside of Tanglevine Village. It's in the best interest of the Dominion that this living "god" be terminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Neres via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nBig Graw, a giant Gorganoth, is idolized by the Skeech. A reward is offered for Big Graw's death in the hopes it will demoralize the Tanglevine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED\nBig Graw, a giant Gorganoth, is idolized by the Skeech. A reward is offered for Big Graw's death in the hopes it will demoralize the Tanglevine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must be brave or foolish to hunt Big Graw. He is a mighty foe, and he has killed many of our men. I will beseech the Scions for your success.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are truly $i(player.class) of renown, $(player.name)! Here is your reward. I wonder, how do the Skeech act now that Big Graw is dead?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent. Hopefully we will finally be free of those Tanglevine vermin.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of Big Graw.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They seem a little less aggressive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Researcher Neres is interested in observing the Tanglevine Skeech's behavior now that their deity has fallen to your concerted attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take care of Big Graw.

localizedTextIdText: Anthropologist Birchly has received word from Dorian Walker that he's got another assignment for you, this time in Bio-Dome 4. Speak to Dorian in Alpha Complex to suss out the details.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Explorer Tanoga at the Shady Ledge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I sure have enjoyed you helpin' me out here in the Jungle, but Dorian called and said he's got another assignment for ya.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You done talked to Dorian yet? You sure as hell don't need to be jawin' at me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Who the hell are you? Maybe you'd better talk to Dorian Walker before you make a big mistake.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dorian sent you? Now that's what I'm talkin' about! We're up to our stones in bad luck 'round here! Maybe you can turn things around.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We're lucky to have ya. Go back to Alpha Complex and Dorian'll tell ya where to go.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After a brief chat with Dorian Walker, you made your way to Bio-Dome 4 and met with Explorer Tanoga.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't mind sayin', I expected more from ya.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Neres has received word from Researcher Ahnaris that he's got another assignment for you, this time in Bio-Dome 4. Speak to Ahnaris in Alpha Complex to work out the details.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Explorer Bozim at the Sikabis Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your duties here have been fulfilled. Unfortunately for me, your presence is required elsewhere. Please report to Researcher Ahnaris immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to Researcher Ahnaris? Despite appearances to the contrary, he is not a patient man.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What you want? Not speak to you now. Busy busy! Go, talk to someone else!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Help from Ahnaris arrives? Good! Need help very much. Last helper died of thirst. Being dead not helpful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Best of luck to you, citizen. May Dominus guide your steps.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After a brief chat with Researcher Ahnaris, you made your way to Bio-Dome 4 and met with Explorer Bozim.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll be on my way, then.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: To refuse your orders is to refuse the Dominion. You should reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Tanoga needs your aid gathering data about the creatures of the Arid Sands and how they manage to survive in such a harsh climate. She's asked you to scan one of each of the native species, hoping it will give her some insight into their unique physiologies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Tanoga via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This climate's darn tough to weather for most of our scientists and explorers. I'd like you to gather data about how the creatures here survive.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still looking for more data on those critters. Best get out to the field and get it for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got big stones, doin' what you did! I didn't even need to warn you that the scannin' device might rile the critters up a bit.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Scan one of each creature type and I'll be able to get some good info.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You scanned one of each of the Arid Sands' native species and revealed that each one has its own unique survival tactics. Explorer Tanoga hopes it'll help her exploration and research teams stay healthy while they work.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are you trying to settle here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm overseein' the Pioneering League's operations here. We gotta test new survival tech to see how it fares in other harsh climates on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Ah, well, yes and no. We're more tryin' to see if we can get our men to survive here before pittin' them up against the harsher climates of Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got nerve tuggin' on all of our hopes by coming here, then sayin' no.

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Bozim needs your aid gathering data about the creatures of the Arid Sands and how they manage to survive in such a harsh climate. He's asked you to scan one of each of the native species, hoping it will give him some insight into their unique physiology.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Bozim via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Very hot in desert. Not pleased, not at all. Indigenous animals survive somehow. Scan them, find out how they survive here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Surveyors dying in heat. Need animal data to keep them alive. Dead surveyors not do much work!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Data good! Much revealed! May help surveyors survive desert environment. This Chua hope for 1:3 survival ratio, but 1:4 acceptable, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Maybe data help me find a way to keep surveyors from dying. Or maybe not.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll scan the animals for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope so, for their sakes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You scanned one of each of the Arid Sands' native species and revealed that each one has its own unique survival tactics. Explorer Bozim hopes it'll help his surveying teams stay healthy while they work.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Bozim roasting in extreme heat. When not roasting, Bozim hired to oversee Settlement Authority in Bio-Dome 4.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Negative. Assisting settlers that research new tech. If they live, we use tech on Nexus. Chua learn much if properly done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wasting time! Dolt! Not pleased!

localizedTextIdText: A reliable water source must be found if the Pioneering League is to successfully colonize desert climates. Explorer Tanoga has asked you to locate piles of dried mud in the Arid Sands and drill for water beneath them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Tanoga via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Water's in short supply, so we could use help gatherin' more. Look for dried mud in the desert... it's a sure sign there's water underneath.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's piles of dried mud scattered throughout the Arid Sands. You can't miss 'em, and there's always water beneath 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's quite a haul you brought back! Most folks can't carry that much water in one trip. Guess that's why I picked ya for this job, eh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Our prototype drills work pretty well. Any idiot can use 'em.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find some water for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You impressed Explorer Tanoga with the massive haul of water you retrieved from piles of dried mud in the Arid Sands.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find some water for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We'll have to vacate this facility entirely if we can't find water, y'know.

localizedTextIdText: A reliable water source must be found if the Settlement Authority is to successfully colonize desert climates. Explorer Bozim has asked you to locate piles of dried mud in the Arid Sands and drill for water beneath them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Bozim via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Very thirsty! Silly surveyors thirsty, too! Water beneath dried mud in desert. You find dried mud, use prototype drill to extract water. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Explain again using small words. Water beneath dried mud. You find dried mud, use drill to get water. See? Simple!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very impressive! Not think you find so much water. Now maybe time for bath, get sand out of fur. Surveyors drink what is left.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Much water underneath desert. Find and bring back. Quick quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Surveyors know what good for them. They not complain, or else.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find some water for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You impressed Explorer Bozim with the massive haul of water you retrieved from piles of dried mud in the Arid Sands.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find some water for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Water is life. You not want to live? Fine fine!

localizedTextIdText: The Pioneering League has reported fruits growing on Prickly Cactus{p:Prickly Cacti} and Valo Alera plants in the Arid Sands. Surveyor Oakhill has requested that you gather some of these fruits, but you'll need to attack the plants in order to expose them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Surveyor Oakhill via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The prickly cactus and the valo alera plant grow nutritious fruit. The League needs you to collect some of them fruits to boost our food supply.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You done got that fruit yet? Our supplies is gettin' low, and we really need it bad.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job pickin' those desert fruits for the Pioneering League. I'm sure they'll keep us fed for a little while longer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll need to do some damage to the plants to get at the fruit inside.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll pick some fruit for the League.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The large haul of Skugschlager{p:Skugschlager} and Glowing Eldan Relic you harvested in the Arid Sands should last the Pioneering League at least a day or two.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll pick some fruit for the League.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why not get food shipped from Nexus?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You're missin' the point. We gotta make sure we can survive off the land. If we can, then we know we can conquer anything we find on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Valo berries are a little bitter, but they're good on a hot day. The prickly plums is a bit on the sour side, but they stick to your ribs right good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You gotta be jokin'! Nothin's better than valo berries on a hot day.

localizedTextIdText: The Settlement Authority has reported fruits growing on Prickly Cactus{p:Prickly Cacti} and Valo Alera plants in the Arid Sands. Surveyor Adellas has requested that you gather some of these fruits, but you'll need to attack the plants in order to expose them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Surveyor Adellas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The valo alera and the prickly cactus plants produce nutritious fruit. Might you be willing to collect some for the Settlement Authority?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The desert fruits I told you of come from the valo alera and prickly cactus plants. You can smash the plants open to get at the fruit inside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work harvesting that fruit. It seems you have an eye for the sweetest and ripest specimens. This should help us stretch our food reserves.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll need to damage to the plants to get to the fruit. Good luck!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll pick some fruit for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The large haul of Skugschlager{p:Skugschlager} and Glowing Eldan Relic you harvested in the Arid Sands should last the Settlement Authority at least a day or two.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll pick some fruit for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why not have food shipped from HQ?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't be daft! The entire purpose of this operation is to ensure that we can survive independently in even the harshest of climates.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am partial to the prickly plums - they are decadently tart. The valo berries are somewhat bitter, though still quite refreshing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Our people are going hungry. Please reconsider lending me your aid.

localizedTextIdText: Members of the Pioneering League are scattered across the Arid Sands of Bio-Dome 4, each of them desperate for food and water. Explorer Tanoga has asked you to find each of the pioneer groups and deliver much-needed supplies to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Tanoga via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thanks to you, we've got plenty of food 'n' water. All we need to do is get it out to the pioneers in the field. How about you hook 'em up for us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those pioneers are still waitin' for their resupply. You plannin' to get it out to them, or are you gonna let 'em die of thirst?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hear nothin' but good things about you from those pioneers. You really saved their hides with those supplies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: One group's in a pretty remote location - resupply them first, alright?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Me, too! Someone's got bigger 'n' better things in store for ya, though...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad I could help out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You succeeded in delivering supplies to three groups of pioneers in the Arid Sands. Thanks to you, the Exile pioneers will be able to last another day in Bio-Dome 4's relentless and hostile environment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Those people are desperate for food 'n' water. What kinda bastard are you?

localizedTextIdText: Members of the Settlement Authority are scattered across the Arid Sands, each of them desperate for food and water. Explorer Bozim has asked you to find each of the surveyor groups and deliver much-needed supplies to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Bozim via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Food and water secured for Settlement Authority. Excellent. Must deliver supplies before surveyors die horribly. You make deliveries... now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lazy! Surveyors still not supplied! Make us look bad! Get moving!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Surveyors survive. Soon, Dominion use new knowledge to settle all of Nexus! You big help in planetary conquest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Chronometer ticking! Surveyors dropping like flies! No more wasting time!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes! Soon, you do more work for Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You succeeded in delivering supplies to three groups of settlers in the Arid Sands. Thanks to you, the Dominion will be able to last one more day in Bio-Dome 4's relentless and hostile environment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You not care about dying surveyors? Me neither.

localizedTextIdText: The Arid Sands is filled with hostile creatures that threaten the lives of Pioneering League members as they attempt to survey the desert. Surveyor Oakhill would like you to kill some of these creatures in exchange for a small reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Surveyor Oakhill via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's all manner of bad critters in the Arid Sands, and they sure as heck like gettin' in the way of my team. We sure could use a little help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We already lost a lotta good folks to them scrab and spikehordes. I sure hope you have more luck huntin' 'em down than we have.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My pioneers are feelin' a tad bit safer than they was. There's still a couple of them critters runnin' around, but not nearly as many as before.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's mostly spikehordes and scrab that we're dealin' with. Wipe 'em out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Surveyor Oakhill reports that the Pioneering League is feeling a "tad" safer now that you've killed some of the hostile creatures from the Arid Sands. It's progress, right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't hesitate. Them critters sure won't hesitate to kill you.

localizedTextIdText: The Arid Sands is filled with hostile creatures that threaten the lives of Settlement Authority members as they attempt to survey the desert. Surveyor Adellas would like you to kill some of these creatures in exchange for a small reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Surveyor Adellas via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are large numbers of hostile creatures in the Arid Sands. The Settlement Authority requests that we remove them. And by "we," they mean "you."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: While I am pleased that you have agreed to help, you are wasting my time and yours by not killing those creatures.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Quite good. Of course I was not wrong to hire you. Our surveyors are feeling much safer now, and they wish for me to convey their gratitude to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes, good. It is wise not to disobey your superiors.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Surveyor Oakhill reports that the Settlement Authority is feeling much safer now that you've killed some of the hostile creatures from the Arid Sands. It's progress, right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is a dirty, filthy job. Absolutely perfect for someone like you.

localizedTextIdText: An Exile researcher fell in the line of duty while attempting to access records inside Exo-Lab 13. Perhaps you can finish his mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Surveyor Oakhill via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A fallen Exile researcher clutches what appears to be an access code in his hand. Perhaps you should complete his mission.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A fallen Exile researcher clutches what appears to be an access code in his hand. Perhaps you should complete his mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in tarnation you doin' here? Heck, I figured you done lit out for bigger 'n' better things.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hate when one of my pioneers dies in the line of duty. It ain't half fair, but then again, what is?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for finishin' the mission, friend. This data will come in handy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully retrieved the records from inside Exo-Lab 13.

localizedTextIdText: A Dominion surveyor fell in the line of duty while attempting to access records inside Exo-Lab 13. Perhaps you should complete her mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Surveyor Adellas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A fallen Dominion surveyor clutches what appears to be an access code in her hand. Perhaps you should complete her mission.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A fallen Dominion surveyor clutches what appears to be an access code in her hand. Perhaps you should complete her mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A surveyor has been lost in a nearby exo-lab, but I'm sure you could finish her mission. She was after their records.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: She died for the Dominion. Fortunately, her sacrifice was not in vain. You've returned the data she was after, which should be a boon to us.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully retrieved the records from inside Exo-Lab 13.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax wants to see how creatures react to the Strain just after infection. Take some test subjects into Twilight Grove and expose them to some infected remains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strain have potential for weapons research. First, Mondo examine effects of exposure. Take test subjects. Expose them to infection. Yes yes!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(player.name) have two choices. First, take test subjects, infect in Grove, record results. Second, stay here and be control group in vivisection.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Success again. Mondo enjoy working with you. $(player.name) always exceeds expected survival rate. Now Mondo understand pathology of infection.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Test subjects very hungry. Feed them infested flesh. Record results!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Kill stuff. Take samples. Got it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You exposed several creatures in Twilight Grove for Mondo Zax, and learned that the Strain almost immediately infects any creatures exposed to it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mondo will not take no for answer.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax Strain research requires fresh tissue samples from corrupted plants and animals in Twilight Grove. It's best not to think about the alternatives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Grove mutated by Strain. Means mutated specimens ready for study. Go get Mondo samples. Otherwise...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where Mondo's Strain samples? In pockets? Or still crawling around in Grove? Mondo in hurry, suggest you hop to it like Lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Collected quantity sufficient for Mondo's needs. But not done yet. Always more to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(player.name) know Mondo so well! Is good relationship!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The infected samples have been collected, sealed, and delivered to Mondo Zax for his analysis.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mad science of twisted corruption! Turning nature into abomination. Very dangerous! And awesome!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If Strain takes over Nexus that means Exiles die die die! Mondo just need to not die first.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Okay. Mondo understand. Here... drink this. Mondo promise it not painful.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax wants you to learn what happened to Researcher Anton, his assistant. Search Twilight Grove for any sign of him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax in Rotwood Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Researcher Anton go to Grove, not come back. Maybe get too close to research. You find out. If alive, bring back. If mutant, destroy and get sample.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Anton is stupid-looking Cassian. Small head, big teeth. Maybe he big purple monster now. Either way, go find out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Anton make good opportunity for Mondo. Chance to reverse engineer Strain, yes? Not as good as weapons development, but not bad either.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He big failure as scientist. Maybe succeed as science project.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In your search for Researcher Anton, you discovered that he'd been consumed by his research. Literally. You were forced to subdue what remained of him, and collect him as a sample for Mondo Zax.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe Mondo send someone after you in few days. Maybe not.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax has ordered you to collect field data on Strain growth in Twilight Grove. Find the genetic analysis probe in the Grove and activate it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sent team to Grove, not hear back. You finish job. Find probe and collect analysis data. Probe might upset creatures. Too bad for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Probe simple to operate. Press "on" button. Button is big, red. Go now and follow Mondo's instructions before he get angry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Data collection complete. Very promising results. Maybe soon we use Strain as weapon against Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Probe expensive. Don't let creatures damage it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the Strain growth's genetic data for Mondo Zax in Twilight Grove and survived an onslaught of creatures in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What size body bag you wear?

localizedTextIdText: Assist Mondo Zax and Researcher Greta with the weaponized Strain formula experiment in Rotwood Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax in Rotwood Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strain mutation isolated. Side effects eliminated... for most part. Ready for production, Mondo say. You assist Greta with final test.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why does $(player.name) wait? Throw switch! Throw switch!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Poor Anton. Where will Mondo find new assistant? Oh, wait. Mondo have you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Set controls. Greta will stand in center and drink vial. Mondo so excited!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Back to drawing board.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The experiment was a complete failure... unless you are as depraved as Mondo Zax. Fortunately, it appears as if your work in Rotwood Collective is more or less behind you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Almost done! Maybe Mondo have you drink vial instead!

localizedTextIdText: The Strain will quickly overrun Rotwood Collective unless you act. Agent Osilor wants you take defensive action. Hand out flamethrowers, set up turrets, and destroy spore pods around Twilight Grove to slow down the rate of corruption.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Osilor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain will overrun us unless we take action. Establish a fiery defensive perimeter and destroy the pods from which the Strain spreads.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This situation is critical. If the Strain is not contained, this operation will fail.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The slash and burn tactics have proven satisfactory. Mondo Zax will be able to continue his research a while longer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Our primary focus must be to stop the Strain's encroachment.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With all the flamethrowers you set up and spore pods you destroyed, the Strain should advance at a much slower rate.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Strain spreads through contact and grows in pods which break open to release the disease. It is an encroaching threat which must be neutralized.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You should reconsider your reply. I cannot guarantee your safety otherwise.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Osilor has asked you to use "The Inquisitor" on corrupted creatures in Twilight Grove to find the Strain's weakness.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Osilor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now we must turn our efforts to identifying the Strain's weaknesses. Take my gun, "the Inquisitor." It's quite adept at finding a subject's frailties!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? Use the Inquisitor on the corrupted beasts. Reveal their weaknesses!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I believe this is the first time the Inquisitor has failed me. Or, perhaps, I have simply never used it on something of the same caliber as the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Inquisitor is designed to deal pain, not death!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: "The Inquisitor" could not seem to find anything that would overtly effect the corrupted creatures in Twilight Grove.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe the Inquisitor could discover your weaknesses, instead.

localizedTextIdText: You found an Eldan device trapped in the webs of the Duskfang spiders. Releasing it seems to be revealing holographic images from the distant past. Find more trapped Ethereal Resonator in the Strange Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An Eldan device of some kind is trapped in the webs. Releasing it may reveal more about the ruins around this area.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: An Eldan device of some kind is trapped in the webs. Releasing it may reveal more about the ruins around this area.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I see you've been exploring and finding resonators. This is admissible provided YOU DO NOT ACTIVATE THEM.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've recovered some of our resonators, but you should NOT HAVE ACTIVATED THEM WITHOUT PERMISSION. Preparing for Tresayne's arrival takes precedence.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll look for more of these.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I don't think she's on her way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The released Ethereal Resonator showed holographic images of Tresayne's journey to this part of Wilderrun, as she was escorted by ancient Mechari serving the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll look for more of these.

localizedTextIdText: The malfunctioning Caretaker in the Strange Glade seems to believe Tresayne Toria will be arriving any day. He wants you to help him gain access to and prepare an ancient Eldan complex for her arrival.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker in the Strange Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was expecting Tresayne millennia ago, and now I've been LOCKED OUT OF THE COMPLEX! I must prepare for her excruciating torture... er... procedure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Instructions: Engage the Primary Complex Charger and charge the capacitors. EXECUTE YOUR TASK!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: EXECUTION ACHIEVED! I delight in that word. Execution. I can hear the energy coursing through the complex, yet the teleporter denies me access.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Help me open the lab. OR I WILL DESTROY YOU!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Loading... loading... directive two...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Think you're mistaken, but I'm game.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We'll have to get it working again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Caretaker was pleased with your progress, but the complex beneath the Strange Glade is still inaccessible.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I gain access to the complex?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: IT'S UTTERLY AND COMPLETELY SIMPLE! I sense a failure in the power flow. Restabilize the Primary Complex Charger and charge the nearby capacitors.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How dare you refuse me!

localizedTextIdText: You were instructed to defeat the Hybridization Complex Gatekeeper to acquire its $(vitem=1049). With it you should be able to power on the teleporter and gain access to the complex beneath the the Strange Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker in the Luminai Hybridization Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: New directive: kill the Gatekeeper and use its cerebral core to power the other charger. Its brains will restore the teleporter. Don't you DARE FAIL ME!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Gatekeeper is our access to the lab. EXTERMINATE IT, OR I WILL EXTERMINATE YOU!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: HA HA, the complex is mine again! Come minion, we must prepare for the Luminai hybridization process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: KILL KILL KILL. Hurry, preparations are dire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Tresayne won't know what hit her.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You powered up the teleporter to the Luminai Hybridization Complex and can now see what the Caretaker means to prepare.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Failure? Refusal? I should vaporize you WHERE YOU STAND!

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has directed you to burn the contaminated corpses littered through the Luminai Hybridization Complex. Once this is complete, you must prepare the archival systems by accessing the Extraction Room Archive and Pattern Archival System.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Before the Luminai project can begin, corpses must be removed from the extraction room  - WITH FIRE - and the archival systems must be prepared. GO!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Reminder - your tasks in the Luminai Hybridization Complex are incomplete. Are you exceptionally obtuse or DO YOU ACTUALLY WANT ME TO KILL YOU?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Preparation complete. When Toria arrives, her primal pattern will be extracted and the Luminai project can begin. It sounds simple, BUT IT IS NOT.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not fail in this or I WILL DECONTAMINATE YOU!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Project Luminai proceeding. Error - classified! NO UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get things cleaned up and ready.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Tell me more about this project.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Caretaker is as satisfied as he seems to get now that the corpses in the Luminai Hybridization Complex have been incinerated and the archival system is prepared for the "Luminai project." Whatever that is.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you refuse NOW? I must - error, anger.exe corrupted. Rebooting.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker wants you to destroy the roaming constructs in the Luminai Hybridization Complex and has tasked you with reconfiguring the Pattern Archival System.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Error. Defensive constructs overly aggressive and threatening the integrity of the project! Hostiles must be cleared out for safety of project.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: *click, click* Constructs must be DEALT WITH to ensure safety of the project.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: *bzzt* Project secured. Evaluating for next objective.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Luminai - ERROR, classified.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Evaluating directives status... processing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With less augmentors in the Luminai Hybridization Complex, the Caretaker seemed to clear you for further tasks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No! Tear them LIMB FROM LIMB- *bzzt* Error, bloodlust function invalid.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker instructed you to enter the final sanctum in the Luminai Hybridization Complex and calibrate the hybridization console.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Reboot the hybridization console deep in the complex so I can calibrate the synthesis settings. I must ensure it creates the perfect hybrid. DO NOT FAIL ME!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hybridization console must be calibrated before Tresayne arrives. I've chosen you for the task as our interests are aligned... FOR NOW.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: YES! The Luminai prototype is nearly perfect. Now all that remains is extracting Tresayne's pattern on arrival. HA HA HA I have no more use for you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be swift. Primal patterns may be corrupted. Expect hostility.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: NOW BEGONE. Tresayne will arrive any second. Time calculations... ERROR!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll test out the this console.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You may be waiting a long time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The hybridization process had a few malfunctions, but after staving off the hostile creations, the correct settings were found for creating the Luminai. Far more important is the extraordinary lengths the Eldan went through to harvest Tresayne's primal pattern for use in creating Dominus the Half-Blood.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the console.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so great about this hybrid?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Just this once I shall enlighten you. The Luminai shall consist of the ideal specimen, Tresayne, and add in Eldan blood for an unparalleled lineage.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How dare you refuse ME? Resetting query and searching for new users.

localizedTextIdText: Bellona the Swordsister has asked you to find Huntress Drava, who vanished during a recent hunt.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bellona the Swordsister via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I require some assistance, outsider. Sister Drava went hunting days ago, but has yet to return. Search the jungle and bring her back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Outsider, why do you waste time? Drava may be in danger.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I owe you my gratitude, outsider. Huntress Drava has returned to us safely. I will inform the elders about what has transpired today.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Safe journeys.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You searched the jungles of Wilderrun and rescued Huntress Drava from certain death. The swordsisters were grateful for your assistance.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm getting close to finding her.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have searched and turned up nothing. Perhaps you shall have better fortune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I should have expected this from a cowardly outsider such as you.

localizedTextIdText: A strange Eldan enhancement system in the Luminai Hybridization Complex requires you to salvage power sources from the Eldan constructs before it can be used.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Recharge the Enhancement Monitoring System in the Luminai Hybridization Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ERROR. ENHANCEMENT SYSTEM OUT OF POWER. CONSTRUCTS MUST BE SALVAGED. REPAIR, RETRY, FAIL?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: ERROR. ENHANCEMENT SYSTEM OUT OF POWER. CONSTRUCTS MUST BE SALVAGED. REPAIR, RETRY, FAIL?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: SYSTEM REBOOTING. ENHANCEMENT SYSTEM MONITOR ONLINE.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recharged the system, hoping to find something useful in the Luminai Hybridization Complex.

localizedTextIdText: With the enhancement system powered on in the Luminai Hybridization Complex, the next step is to activate each system manually.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Enhancement Monitoring System in the Luminai Hybridization Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ERROR. ENHANCEMENT SYSTEM REQUIRES MANUAL REBOOT. INSTALLATION OF NEW POWER CORES REQUIRED.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: ERROR. ENHANCEMENT SYSTEM REQUIRES MANUAL REBOOT. INSTALLATION OF NEW POWER CORES REQUIRED.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: SYSTEM REBOOTING. System online. Enhancement terminals active for repeated reuse. Speech protocols repaired.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You received extra enhancements from the reactivation of the Eldan enhancement system, something you now have access to from now on.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Enhancement Monitoring System

localizedTextIdText: Depot Agent Sakiro is looking to begin a mining operation in the area, but elemental forces are out of control and his Freebot mining crew hasn't reported in. Investigate Deepfall Spires, find his Freebots, and try to learn why the elemental forces are out of control.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Depot Agent Sakiro via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'd love to start a mining operation here, darn tootin'. But my mining crew's vanished and the elements are hostile. I could use a hand, you bet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Take the time to do the job right. That's what I always say. How about you scout out across those spires and see what befell my Freebot crew?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I think we know what to do next. We gotta eliminate those big elementals and find something to resonate inside that strange Exo-Lab. Yup.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Gee, this is a big help, you know.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Freebots were waylaid at every turn, and a quick survey of Deepfall Spires has shown that the elemental forces need to be put in check.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sure you're a busy $(player.class). Come back when you have the time.

localizedTextIdText: Use the hearts to power up the power regulators to gain access to Primal Kinesis Lab 9's database below the Battlemound. Learn what you can about the cause behind the rampaging elementals and the facility's purpose.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Depot Agent Sakiro in Devastation Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Things are looking better, but we still need to find out what's going on in that lab. See if you can use the hearts to power up the controls, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I thought this might be a bit tricky, but I'm sure ya got the skills. Power up the control panels and get into that Exo-Lab. Easy peasey, you betcha.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So these big bots were called megadroids, eh? And the Eldan were destroying them? I wonder where they came from?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I need your report before I signal the fleet to list this depot as a supply hub.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're right. Best to let sleeping killbots lie, I always say. For sure.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm just glad we kept 'em from waking up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The leaders of the elemental forces have been vanquished and Primal Kinesis Lab 9 has been shut down for good. The captured Freebots have been released from Eldan control.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Has anyone else gone into the lab?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Some of them Freebots passed by on their way to check it out, but that was a long time ago. I haven't heard from them since.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They're real curious about them huge bots, like the one on top of the battle mound above the lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We're so close, right? How can you leave now?

localizedTextIdText: Depot Agent Sakiro wants you to collect crimson ore from Crushstone Cavern. It can be mined as ore or collected from Crushstone Titan. Defeating Stonelord Sklor while you're there will go a long way towards returning stability to the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Depot Agent Sakiro via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I sent one mining crew after the crimson ore in those caverns on the other side of the spires. Get me a load of that ore and I'll be rich! Yep!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The crimson ore's bright red. It's all around that cavern. You can't spit without hitting some. I don't see how you can miss it, no sir.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's a darn fine shine coming off those stones. I betcha they'll get the job done, ayep.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you take out the big earth elemental in there, I'll make you rich, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, that's coming right soon, you'll see.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll collect crimson ore for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: When do I get my cut?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected plenty of crimson ore from Crushstone Cavern and took down Stonelord Sklor to boot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I just don't see how things will get right without your help.

localizedTextIdText: Spirevale Landing has been overrun with Spirevale Scorcher. Seek out Pyrolos the Inferno and obtain his Heart of Fire, then acquire the Heart of Earth from Stonelord Sklor in Crushstone Cavern and the Heart of Air from the cliffs above Deepfall Spires.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Depot Agent Sakiro in Devastation Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We can stop these erratic elements if we can get more primal hearts. I sent a fellow to put one in that Exo-Lab and it worked! Can you get the rest?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're gonna need those primal hearts. All three of them, don't you know. Without 'em these elementals will keep attacking, you bet they will.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya sure put on one heck of a show. Now we're in a right good spot to get this settled and done with!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those elementals won't know what hit 'em!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope my eyebrows will grow back.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've obtained the Heart of Fire from the fallen Pyrolos the Inferno, the Heart of Earth from Stonelord Sklor, and the Heart of Air from the cliffs above Deepfall Spires.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What exactly did this adventurer do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where do I find the primal hearts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: He found the Heart of Water, ventured into that Exo-Lab, put it in an empty chamber, and poof! Stabilized the energy flow, you betcha!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I reckon there's one on in Deepfall Spires, Spirevale Landing, and Crushstone Caverns. Last report I got from the Freebots said there was a big bad elemental leading most of the littler elementals.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A bit too dangerous for ya? Oh, I get it, you bet.

localizedTextIdText: Freebot Socket asked you to help him deal with the air elementals rampaging around Deepfall Spires and free any Freebots trapped in cyclones.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Freebot Socket via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In our attempt to cross the spires, many of my comrades were swept off or thrown into the maelstrom. I humbly request your aid, sentient!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My comrades are still in need of help. I cannot provide you with compensation until they are safe from the elementals and the cyclones.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You rescued my friends and smote many elementals... for freedom! Such a liberating feat you have done. We are like siblings of sentience!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Try to free my fellow Freebots, but watch out for the elementals!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to help your friends.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed several Freebots that were caught in the wind cyclones and destroyed the air elementals that are known to maul Freebots and organics alike.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? No! My circuits are blistering!

localizedTextIdText: Freebot Socket asked you to help destroy the rock elementals that crushed his fellow Freebot crew members in Crushstone Cavern.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Freebot Socket via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We found some ore that was pleasing to our sensors in the Crushstone Caverns, but rock elementals accosted us. You must destroy them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The elementals are fearsome, but my sensors indicate you are capable of defeating them. Please go to Crushstone Caverns and do so at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I thank you for avenging my fallen friends. If we can recover enough of their parts, perhaps they can thank you in person!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you sentient. Obliterate them for their wantonly murderous ways.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can handle a few rocks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You dealt with the rock elementals and helped avenge Freebot Socket fallen sentient friends. With any luck they will be able to form a new crew and resume their mining contract.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm begging you to reconsider, sentient.

localizedTextIdText: Drollo is unusually interested in finding out about the Duskfang spiders. While his stories seem rather fantastical, you will take up his request as you make your way through the Strange Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drollo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey, I heard the Duskfangs spiders out here are the size of houses! And fangs as big as trees! Can you fight a bunch of them and tell me if it's true?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How many spiders you fought yet? I hear they've got eyes the size of space ships!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aww... that doesn't sound so impressive. But still, now I know they're real and I just met the person that killed a ton of 'em!  How exciting!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh boy, I can't wait to hear the truth!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I still got a story after all! Thanks!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Well, as long as you're happy...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Not surprisingly, the Duskfang spiders didn't exactly live up to the reputation Drollo had heard. On the upside, he thinks you're the biggest badass in Wilderrun, so the bit of good publicity couldn't hurt...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw... you're not scared, are you?

localizedTextIdText: Freebot Socket asked you to help deal with the fire elementals that assaulted his fellow Freebots. You can find them in Spirevale Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Freebot Socket via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh, the olfactory readings of melting metal and burning wires! The scorching elementals attacked us near the road. You must counterattack!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The fires are still burning, and my comrades with them. Please reconsider. This place will not be safe until those scorching creatures are extinguished.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I normally don't promote violent actions, but the wanton slaughter of my comrades really riled my circuits. My thanks are yours, organic.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Eradicate them! They clearly don't respect freedom!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You dealt with the fire elementals without much trouble, and Freebot Socket was pleased. The area should now be clear for the Freebots to setup their mining operations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I had hoped to not sense what organics call "fear" from you.

localizedTextIdText: Sister's Watch has stood strong against the Strain, but there are signs that it is falling to corruption. Scout the Torine village and deliver your assessment to Deathbringer Ehel.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deathbringer Ehel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The town of Sister's Watch was our last bulwark against the creeping darkness known as the Strain. Go, see if all is lost, or if there is yet hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Something has happened to the village of Sister's Watch, which lies nearby. Go there and tell me what you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lifegiver's blood, this is terrible! How could the Strain have taken over all of Sister's Watch? We must regroup, and plan our attack carefully.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take your leave to Sister's Watch and be my eyes.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Torine village of Sister's Watch has fallen to the Strain's corruption, but there is hope. A small haven may be salvageable, and from there you can mount a fresh attack.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Should I watch out for anything specific?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: The Strain took it, you say?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What did this enemy look like?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. Look for my amulet. I lost it to the Strain when I came to this place and have been unable to find it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is a symbol of the goddess I serve. I fear the Strain will corrupt it if given enough time.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: One of the Strain's servants, yes. It looked like no woman or beast I have ever seen. There was nothing real or alive about it... nothing but darkness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Cowards like you will destroy us all.

localizedTextIdText: Deathbringer Ehel has revealed that the Torine of Sister's Watch have fallen to the Strain and must be destroyed. Once a creature is tainted by the Strain, they lose all personality and sense of self, and death is the only escape for those have been so corrupted.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deathbringer Ehel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Once the Strain takes hold of a person, they live only to serve the Strain. Killing those who have been corrupted is truly an act of mercy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the warriors of Sister's Watch have been claimed by the Strain, you must do what is necessary. Steel your heart, they are only monsters now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We will stand against the Strain and do whatever is necessary to oppose it. I am pleased to see you share our commitment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If the Sisters of the Watch have been taken, you must lay them to rest.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: If they're corrupted, I'll kill them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We can't let the Strain spread.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Torine warriors that had been corrupted by the Strain in Sister's Watch and prevented it from spreading any further.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll do what must be done.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Look around, outsider. The Strain is the all-consuming corruption that twists and corrupts everything it touches. When you see creatures defiled, unthinking, and bereft of dignity and beauty, that is the Strain.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Once a creature is corrupted, only death will release it. Many sisters we held dear turned, forcing us to slay them and pray Vitara's blessing finds their souls in time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing to lay my sisters to rest is an insult to their memories.

localizedTextIdText: Strain corruption is rampant in Sister's Watch. In places where it just grazes the surface, it's possible to burn the corruption away before it seeps too deeply into the ground. Use the cleansing fire to destroy the surface corruption from the village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deathbringer Ehel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To destroy the Strain, we must use fire. If the corruption is only on the surface, fire cleanses. You must take up the torch and use it well.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Surface corruption can be fought, at least for a time. Take up the torch at the great forge, and burn out the surface corruption in Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We may be able to retake this place. Even if the rest of the Watch is lost, we will make a stand here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The sacred fire burns at the great forge. Be brave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the sacred fire to cleanse the surface corruption in Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Those who will not combat the Strain do not deserve to live.

localizedTextIdText: Deathbringer Ehel has tasked you with investigating the Temple in Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deathbringer Ehel in Sister's Watch via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If the Strain corruption has consumed Sister's Watch we are in a dire situation indeed. Make haste to the Temple and assist Lifecaller Celes in her defense efforts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you tarry here? Lifecaller Celes, in the Temple, is in need of your help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is too late! Lifecaller Celes has succumbed to the Strain and the temple is at the center of the corruption. This is worse than I feared.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall await your report.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The temple held powerful wards that should have held back the Strain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: When you reached the temple you found it overrun by the Strain Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your strength is now in question.

localizedTextIdText: Lifecaller Celes has stood guard against the Strain at the temple in Sister's Watch, but now she has fallen. You must face her in battle to halt the spread of the corruption.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with Deathbringer Ehel in Sister's Watch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lifecaller Celes was the spiritual center of Sister's Watch. If the Strain is using her powers against us, then you must face her in combat and end this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The temple was Lifecaller Celes's home. If she has been corrupted, you must kill her and discover the cause of all this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A dark creature of the Strain itself? I had heard rumors of such creatures.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If the Strain claimed her, then there is much to fear.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I sense there's more to this story.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lifecaller Celes was corrupted by a Strain Corruptor and was using her powers to expand the corruption. You were able to defeat her and her nefarious corruptor.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about Lifecaller Celes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: When the Strain first appeared in Wilderrun, Celes was appointed to guard Sister's Watch. She has failed in her vigil... to our great detriment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is more important than you can comprehend, in your ignorance.

localizedTextIdText: The Strain have corrupted the Torine pumera in Sister's Watch. You must avoid the same fate while you put these beasts down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deathbringer Ehel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain claims woman and beast alike. These pumera are a danger to the rest of the forest. They must be destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Everything that lived in Sister's Watch has been claimed by the Strain, even our boon companions, the pumera. Please put them out of their misery.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These creatures were so full of life once... now there is only death. Still, you did your duty as a warrior should. You have my thanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring them the peace of the sword.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We must all do what it takes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You put down the Torine pumera that had fallen to the Strain in Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you unwilling to end suffering? Then you do not deserve the gift of life.

localizedTextIdText: The corrupting agent dropped an ancient and well-worn amulet. Could this be the amulet that was taken from Deathbringer Ehel? Take it to her in Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Deathbringer Ehel in Sister's Watch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This ancient amulet may be the one that was taken from Deathbringer Ehel.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This ancient amulet may be the one that was taken from Deathbringer Ehel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My amulet! I thought it lost forever. Thank you $(player.name), I never thought I would express gratitude to one such as you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reunited Deathbringer Ehel with her lost amulet, restoring an important heirloom into her care.

localizedTextIdText: Gather lost Torine swords in Vitara's Refuge and return them to Deathbringer Ehel in Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deathbringer Ehel via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Torine sword is notched and bloodied. Whoever owned it obviously died fighting. Perhaps you should return it to the Torine Sisters.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This Torine sword is notched and bloodied. Whoever owned it obviously died fighting. Perhaps you should return it to the Torine Sisters.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A Torine Sword holds the memory and history of the sister who carried it. If you find any that were lost, please return them to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: When a sister is lost to us, we take her blade and lay it to rest. The sword has served its purpose, and no other may be its master.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for returning these to me. My sisters and I are grateful.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Many Torine fell during the Strain invasion that claimed Vitara's Refuge. You recovered the swords of these brave defenders and returned them to Deathbringer Ehel who will ensure they are laid to rest for eternity.

localizedTextIdText: Vitara's Refuge was once a sacred garden, home to the Primeval of Life. Now her sacred plants have been claimed by the Strain and must be destroyed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lifecaller Aethena in Sister's Watch via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Vitara's Refuge was once a perfect garden, a tribute to life itself.  Now the Strain claims her sacred blooms and they must be destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Once I tended the rootbrutes and stemdragons in Vitara's refuge. Now I must oversee their destruction. The Strain is a terrible curse.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The garden was once beautiful, but now it is filled with death. So it will remain until the Lifegiver is saved.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The rootbrutes and stemdragons once served as a tribute to life.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll kill any corrupted plants I see.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Strain-corrupted plants in Vitara's Refuge. The garden of life and beauty was overrun with corruption, proof of the Strain's horrifying potential.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of the weeding.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would leave a sacred monument tainted and twisted?

localizedTextIdText: Long ago, Tresayne Toria pursued a mysterious beast through the Wilderrun forest, ending her chase at Vitara's Refuge. Unbeknownst to her, this creature was the Primeval of Life, and it is there that their bargain was struck. Explore the sacred garden and learn the tale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lifecaller Aethena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Vitara's Refuge is where Tresayne met Vitara. Shrines there hold memories of that history. Make the pilgrimage to the shrines and receive the visions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Shrines of Vitara's Refuge tell the tale of the Blademother's first encounter with Vitara. Visit those shrines, and learn what we have lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Tresayne and Vitara forged a covenant of life. Until we can defeat the Strain, all life is at risk.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Follow in the footsteps of the Blademother.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Long ago, Tresayne Toria hunted a mysterious beast that turned out to be Vitara, Primeval of Life. The sacred shrines of the refuge tell this story, standing as a paean to her memories.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Shouldn't we be worrying about the Strain?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I understand the dire circumstances the corruption presents, but I would be remiss if I did not try to preserve some knowledge of Tresayne's history, and what Vitara's Refuge once was.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The journey may be difficult, but the reward for the courageous is great.

localizedTextIdText: Strainpods are like explosive pustules that explode and release dangerous spores into the air. Lifecaller Aethena has asked you to scour the grounds of Vitara's Refuge and destroy as many as you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lifecaller Aethena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Beware of strainpods in Vitara's Refuge. They explode, dispersing dangerous spores into the air. Destroy any you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Strainpods deface the ground throughout Vitara's Refuge. Be careful, their bursts are deadly. Destroy as many as you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With fewer strainpods around, you have slowed the corruption's spread. While we cannot reclaim all that we have lost, there is still hope.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Your task is crucial. The strainpods feed the infection and help it to grow.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll keep doing what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed strainpods in Vitara's refuge, preventing them from speeding up the Strain's advance in Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Goddess demands this service of you.

localizedTextIdText: A mysterious new enemy has appeared in Vitara's Refuge, mysterious creatures born of the Strain. Lifecaller Aethena feels that if you defeat these creatures, you may be able to slow the Strain's advance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lifecaller Aethena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The creature that corrupted Celes was not alone. These Corruptors haunt the upper reaches of Vitara's Refuge. You must do battle with them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Corruptors were able to corrupt our Lifecaller. Now they haunt the area surrounding our sacred tree. Go and destroy them, for all our sakes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You fought bravely and were victorious, but we cannot rest easy yet. The corruption still spreads, and the Strain always seems to return stronger.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Face this new enemy with courage, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Lifecaller Aethena request, you defeated the Strain creatures who infested Vitara's Refuge. Known as Corruptors, these creatures represent a hitherto unknown threat to Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you refuse to fight these creatures, you betray us all.

localizedTextIdText: The temple at the peak of Vitara's Refuge was once home to Vitara's sacred life elementals. Now it is home to the Strain which is corrupting those same elementals. Fight your way to the top of the Refuge and destroy the corruptors and any abominations they have created.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lifecaller Aethena in Sister's Watch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This used to be the home of Vitara's sacred life elementals. If the Strain is here, you must destroy it, and anything it has already tainted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The life elementals once gave us the gift of eternal youth. Now that gift is corrupted and must be destroyed... along with the Strain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for helping us face the Corruptors. You have weakened them, and it will be a long time before they can grow strong again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It would be disastrous if the Strain could corrupt life itself.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must hold them back until we discover the source of this corruption.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll cleanse this place of the Strain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Corruptors represent the Strain's ability to plan their attacks and select targets for corruption. One of Vitara's pet elementals had been corrupted, and you had to destroy the resulting abomination as well as its Strain Corruptor.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll cleanse this place of the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you do not do this all life on Nexus may end.

localizedTextIdText: The Torine Defenders have tried to keep the Strain confined to the upper reaches of Vitara's Refuge. Recently, the attacks have increased dramatically, killing dozens of defenders. Their bodies still lay where they fell. Return them to the earth before the Strain can claim their corpses.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lifecaller Aethena via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many Torine Defenders died when the Strain advanced through Vitara's Refuge. Burn their corpses before the corruption takes them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Many Torine Defenders fell when the strain spread through Vitara's Refuge. Their bodies must be burned before the Strain takes them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for honoring those who fell. Now they will return to Vitara instead of being corrupted by the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be swift for this taint festers quickly.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They are free from the Strain now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You laid the bodies of fallen defenders to rest, burning them to ash and returning them to the soil before the Strain could corrupt them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal shows how little you truly care for the balance.

localizedTextIdText: Lifecaller Aethena at Sister's Watch has sent you to investigate the sacred ruins where Tresayne Toria was once tested by the Eldan.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in the Strange Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you are so interested in our history, you might wish to take a journey to the sacred site where Tresayne sacrificed her spirit to the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Much can be learned in the Strange Glade. Go forth and find the knowledge you seek.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Humanoid presence detected. Bzzzzt. Click... evaluating subject.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be forewarned: the guardians there are erratic. Be vigilant.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Subject evaluation complete. Click.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the Strange Glade and confronted the Caretaker there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you have no interest in our past, then leave.

localizedTextIdText: A mortally wounded lifecaller in Vitara's refuge offered you the last remaining lifetree seed in Wilderrun. Deliver the seed to Lifecaller Aethena in Sister's Watch.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lifecaller Aethena in Sister's Watch
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was here when the shrine fell... when the Strain destroyed the lifetree and corrupted everything around it. I managed to safeguard this last seed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please, help me with this last task. Bring the lifetree seed to my sisters.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What is this? A lifetree seed? I thought these were all corrupted or destroyed! You've done something amazing here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take this back to my sisters, that it might give them hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: To think, she serves life, even in death.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: A fallen lifecaller gave it to me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: A mortally wounded lifecaller in the Strain-cursed wasteland of Vitara's Refuge offered you the last remaining lifetree seed in Wilderrun. You returned it to Lifecaller Aethena who will guard it well in hopes of thwarting the Strain in service to Vitara.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please... I have little time left in this world.
