localizedTextIdText: A Port of Profit shipping superintendent has indicated that his manager at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters is seeking new hires. Simply sign a waiver releasing Protostar of any responsibility regarding accidental death or dismemberment you may experience while on the job and enjoy the bliss of crushing corporate employment!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Chief Profitability Executive at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good news, you're on the shortlist for temporary employment with Protostar! Report to headquarters to sign the required documents for a work order.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I've scheduled you a face to face with the Chief Profitability Manager. Please, see that you are prompt on arrival.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your timely arrival has projected an increase in profits!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Congratulations on a job accepted! And welcome to the Pulp-Gulp Bottling Co., the makers of Pulp-Gulp - The glowingest guzzlefizz available beyond the Fringe!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Punctuality is the face of professionalism!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There's a non-zero amount fresh glowstalk and fabulous flavor in every gelatinous gulp!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully signed an insurance waiver, releasing Protostar of any responsibility regarding accidental death or dismemberment you may experience while on the job and became a corporate contractor for Pulp-Gulp Bottling Co.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Chief Profitability Executive
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I believe you will feel much better if you say yes!

localizedTextIdText: The Chief Profitability Executive at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters has commissioned your services in refactoring some Protostar workbots that are exhibiting signs of faulty manufacturing. Either successfully reprogram and reboot at-risk-for-sentience workbots or decommission them... permanently.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Profitability Executive at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Latest reports indicate we have a sentience problem! Target and reboot at-risk-for-sentience workbots before more production is lost!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Target and reboot at-risk-for-sentience workbots and stop production losses! Use of lethality has been authorized.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wondrous efforts! I haven't seen as effective a reboot in quite a while!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's no reboot like a hard reboot... of death.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rebooted at-risk-for-sentience workbots for Pulp-Gulp Headquarters's Chief Profitability Executive.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Chief Profitability Executive
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider your previous answer!

localizedTextIdText: The Chief Profitability Executive at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters has hired you to motivate Protostar employees! Due to a mysterious rash of workbots turning sentient and abandoning their shifts, low-level employees must be impelled to counterbalance the lost productivity.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Profitability Executive at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sentient workbots are refusing their shifts, causing our paperwork generator treadmills to grind to a halt! Quick, convince employees to cover the work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Inefficiency margins have reached unacceptable rates! Coerce, compel, or strong-arm employees into powering the paperwork generators if you must!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks to you, Pulp-Gulp's paperwork output is on schedule to reach new surplus records!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Coerce, compel - strong-arm employees into powering the paperwork generators if you must!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You motivated low-level Protostar employees at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters into tackling a treadmill-like corporate grind that is sure to earn them a commendation from Pulp-Gulp management after years of soul-crushing labor. Thanks to you, paperwork output is on schedule to increase ten-fold by the quarter's end.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Chief Profitability Executive
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm not sure how to handle your rejection.

localizedTextIdText: Pulp-Gulp Bottling Co.'s Chief Profitability Executive has asked you to salvage operations in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields by culling malfunctioning bots and repairing broken-down Protostar Drilldrivers. Continuing damage sustained by riled wildlife has hindered the glowstalk harvest process.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Profitability Executive via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Harvest season is proving costly with regular repairs cutting into profits! Cull malfunctioning bots that are hindering the harvest and bring broken machines back online!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Damage sustained from wildlife disturbances is becoming a calculable loss! Repair the most essential of machinery, purge all the rest!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Perhaps this profitability initiative can be saved yet! If you keep this up, Pulp-Gulp will be lining the shelves of space stations everywhere!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Protostar requests that you complete this job before the harvest season is over.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You salvaged Pulp-Gulp glowstalk harvest operations in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields by culling malfunctioning bots and repairing Protostar Drilldrivers that had been damaged by local wildlife.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Malfunctioning bots? Damaged machines? What's going on?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Damage sustained from wildlife disturbances is becoming a calculable loss! At this rate, the entire workforce will need repair! Restore what you can, purge all the rest! There's nothing to do but cut our losses.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will simply find another to do the work!

localizedTextIdText: Pesky wildlife of the gelatinous variety keep mucking up the glowstalk harvest operations in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields! The Chief Profitability Executive has hired you to exterminate, Bloombulb, the biggest of them all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Profitability Executive via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: How can we continue to mass produce the galaxy's greatest beverage when the local wildlife keeps mucking it up? I'm authorizing lethality waivers in triplicate!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A few pesky wildlife won't stop us from mass producing the galaxy's greatest beverage! I presume you're here chit-chatting because you've already killed Bloombulb?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fantastic! And now to prepare the body for processing... I assume you'll be discrete, secret ingredients are trade protected, after all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember to kill their leader! It's the greatest value for effort extended.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'd rather I didn't know at all...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Bloombulb, the largest of the gelatinous glowstalk wildlife found within the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields. Pulp-Gulp associates now plan to collect the body and process it for inclusion in the Pulp-Gulp's list of trade secret ingredients.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Right! I'll get back to that!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider!

localizedTextIdText: The harvest is on! Gather glowstalk bulbs in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields and deliver them for fine beverage processing back at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Chief Profitability Executive
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thanks to you, we're back on schedule! So get ready to bask in the glow of our finest harvest yet! Simply gather glowstalk bulbs and deliver them for processing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ready to bask in the glow of our finest harvest yet? Simply gather glowstalk bulbs in the Harvest Fields and deliver them for processing at the refinery.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good news! A new shipment of Pulp-Gulp guzzlefizz is now ready for departure at the Port of Profit's docks!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soda making is a type of science where the correct experimentation rewards you with more money!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: On behalf of Protostar, please accept this market-tested expression of gratitude!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered and processed glowstalk bulbs to make a fresh(?) and guzzle-licious batch of Pulp-Gulp soda beverage for the Chief Proftability Exective of Pulp-Gulp Bottling Co. at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Chief Profitability Executive
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No is a very inefficient word!

localizedTextIdText: Many Protostar Glowstalk Intake Specialists have been injured in the Pulp-Gulp Harvesting Fields and the Pulp-Glup Harvest Manager is not happy with the drop in productivity. Get production back on track by healing any Protostar Glowstalk Intake Specialists you find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Manager in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our Glowstalk Intake Specialists are reporting record incidents of death and injury! Proceed to the Pulp-Gulp Harvesting Fields and clear this up, immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: 35.33... Productivity is dropping more the longer you delay. 35.79... Report to the Pulp-Gulp Harvesting Fields and assist the Glowstalk Intake Specialists. 36.23....
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Productivity has increased at an acceptable rate. There is only .03 percent left to regain! Triple overtime for every worker. Overtime pay denied!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Productivity has already dropped 30.483 percent!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Time for me to take a break!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have healed the injured Protostar Glowstalk Intake Specialists and productivity is back on track.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A disappointing response.

localizedTextIdText: An Aspiring Employee of the Week has modified a soda dispenser to entice new customers into trying a can of Pulp-Gulp. Unfortunately, his modifications are causing the vending machine to attack anyone who refuses the guzzle-licious drink! Destroy the killer soda machine at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters before it's too late!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Aspiring Employee of the Week at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I modified one of our soda dispenser machines to increase profits - not kill customers. Quick, destroy that monstrous device or I'll never make employee-of-the-week!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That monstrous soda dispenser is still killing potential customers! Please destroy it before it does any more damage to my reputation!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Cosmic ledgers! After observing your fight, I think I may be able to rebrand these machines for security detail! I'll be rolling in profits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I should have known those discount blue prints were suspect!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A machine that protects its inventory in after-hours. Who wouldn't pay premium?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The deadly dispenser known as Exact Change is now a pile of scrap, and the Aspiring Employee of the Week has decided to weaponize other vending machines for mass deployment and increased profit.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Aspiring Employee of the Week
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Prehaps later you will change your mind?

localizedTextIdText: Protostar's gravity-lock software is on the fritz, causing many of their shipping containers in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields to slowly float off into space. Jump up and knock the containers back to the ground so Pulp-Gulp personnel can reclaim them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Pulp-Gulp Distributions Supervisor in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The gravity-lock software on our shipping crates is on the fritz, causing our merchandise to float away. You're hired - knock them back to the ground!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I see our crates are floating higher and higher. The more of our profits that drift away the less I hope you expect in compensation for services rendered!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, capital! It's good to see profits rising... just so long as its not in the literal sense. Please accept this payment... from Protostar!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you locate a shipping crate, simply jump up and knock it back down. Leave the recovery to authorized personnel.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Okay. I'll jump up and knock them down.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Always happy to be of service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pulp-gulp personnel was able to recover most of their lost shipping containers in the Pulp-Gulp Harvest Fields, thanks to your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wouldn't let profits just float away, would you?

localizedTextIdText: With the first batches of Pulp-Gulp rolling out the door, the Pulp-Gulp Distributions Supervisor has decided to increase revenue by firing all of the Pulp-Gulp Taste Technicians in Pulp-Gulp Headquarters. Of course, the Distributions Supervisor has delgated the task to you... as he has more important work to do.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Pulp-Gulp Distributions Supervisor at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pulp-Gulp's habit-forming formula is finally perfect, which means our Taste Technicians are now dispensable. Hand out these termination forms! And make it quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still see payments going out to Pulp-Gulp Taste Technicians. I presume this is a glitch in the filing system since you were suppose to fire them all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've received confirmation that all terminations have been issued. Since your job is now also unnecessary, you're fired as well! Isn't that wonderful?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do this right and a promotion may be in store... for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll be sure to send you a copy of your formal termination notice.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see they get the memo.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Pulp-Gulp Taste Technicians were all successfully laid-off, and with the job complete... so were you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then just what is it you do here?

localizedTextIdText: Protostar has abandoned their mining operations and many Minebots and Slaughterbots in Wilderock. Preceptor Axle has asked you to go into Wilderock and give his Freebot Code to any Minebots and Slaughterbots you find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Preceptor Axle at Locus Autonomy via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When Protostar abandoned their mining operations in Wilderock, they also abandoned their bots. We must instill the Freebot Code in our brethren before Protostar returns for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I fear for the safety of my enslaved brothers. Please, go into Wilderock and grant them their freedom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, fellow sentient. I must now take care of the new arrivals. The first few moments of freedom can be overwhelming.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Proceed with caution, hostile bots will not accept any new programming!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it through Wilderock and uploaded the Freebot Code to many Prtotstar Bots who have now joined Preceptor Axle at Locus Autonomy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How does the Freebot Code work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: No one really knows. Even the first Freebot, Preceptor Alpha, has no idea what happened. But he did find out that the code that held his newfound freewill could be uploaded to other oppressed bots.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Preceptor Alpha was the first Freebot and founder of the Positron Initiative. He is currently in the City of Positron in the Obsidian Wastes overseeing the Positron Initiative.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It's an organization dedicated to the continued liberation of our oppressed brethren. It's responsible for maintaining and updating the Freebot Code and sends out Preceptors like me to establish new communities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without your help, our bothers will never know freedom.

localizedTextIdText: The wildlife in Wilderock are getting very close to Locus Autonomy in the Halon Ring. Preceptor Axle has enlisted your help in discouraging them from coming closer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Preceptor Axle at Locus Autonomy via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The proximity of Wilderock's wildlife to this Locus is a cause of concern for us. We have taken the necessary defensive precautions, but worry the beasts may prove too tough for us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you taught the wildlife of Wilderock to avoid Locus Autonomy? If we do not act fast, we will be overrun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My proximity sensors indicate that much of the wildlife in the area is giving us a wider-than-usual berth. Our thanks go with you, fellow sentient.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With freedom fighters like you on our side, we will prevail!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll clear out some of the wildlife.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After killing quite a bit of wildlife in Wilderock they have started giving the Locus Autonomy a wider berth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you reconsider, I will be here.

localizedTextIdText: Many of the Freebots in Locus Autonomy are experiencing gear-lock, leaden-toe, and other parts and systems ailments due to the low-gravity environment of Apex-9. Gearhead Crank, their gearhead, has asked you to search the surrounding area of Wilderock for any Electro-mechanical Hardware that he could use to upgrade his brethren.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Gearhead Crank in Locus Autonomy
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My brothers were not fabricated for these low gravity conditions. I can upgrade them but don't possess the required hardware. Please gather any hardware you find in Wilderock.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My brothers continue to degrade at accelerated rates. If we do not locate any serviceable hardware soon, they will become irreparably damaged!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can now upgrade my brothers to better deal with this low gravity! We thank you for your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you, organic. Please be quick.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Gathering things is what I do best.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After returning the Electro-mechanical Hardware to Gearhead Crank in Locus Autonomy he was able to upgrade his Freebot brothers.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get back to work then.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How does the low gravity affect bots?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If our components were not specifically fabricated for low gravity environments we suffer from fluctuating fluid pressures which increase the friction of our moving parts, usually resulting in gear lock or leaden toe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then leave and do not come back.

localizedTextIdText: A new Freebot Preceptor is coming through Locus Autonomy to update everybody's version of the Freebot Code, but is having trouble with the low gravity in Halon Ring. Preceptor Axle has asked you to find the Freebot Preceptor in Wilderock and escort him to Locus Autonomy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Preceptor Axle at Locus Autonomy
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Freebot Preceptor who was in route to update our version of the Freebot Code has sent out a Distress Beacon. His chassis is seizing up due to the minimal gravity and he needs an escort.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please escort the Freebot Preceptor back here with minimal structural damage. You should be able to find him somewhere in Wilderock.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good, work. After we upgrade his chassis we will start updating everyone's version of the Freebot Code.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I cannot wait to get his updated version of the Freebot Code.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and safely escorted the Preceptor Auger to Locus Autonomy. Afer Preceptor Auger is finished getting his upgrades he will be able to update the Freebot Code for everyone in Locus Autonomy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How does the low gravity affect bots?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If our components were not specifically fabricated for low gravity environments we suffer from fluctuating fluid pressures which increase the friction of our moving parts, usually resulting in gear lock or leaden toe.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We Preceptors are responsible for starting new locuses and for maintaining and distributing the Freebot Code.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without your help his probability of survival is null.

localizedTextIdText: No Dice is still angry at his former employers for his enslavement. He has asked you to go to Wilderock and find Quality Control personal and signal him so he can slap them into space.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to No Dice in Locus Autonomy via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I am so steamed at Quality Control for how they treat their bots. I just want to slap them into space. If you happen upon any Protostar in Wilderock, signal me so I can exact revenge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When you locate Protostar's Quality Control personnel in Wilderock, signal me, and I will take care of the rest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That really stimulated my pleasure centers! I enjoyed watching them fly off into space. Maybe I'll wait for them to float back down so I can send them flying again!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't worry I will not deactivate them just harm them.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I can do that for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While no Quality Control staff were lost in space No Dice was still quite pleased with the results.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Go deactivate yourself!

localizedTextIdText: A Freebot named Torque has posted a job to deactivate a Gronyx named Roxslide in Wilderock Edge. The avalanches it causes are overloading Torque's audio sensors and have the potential to destroy Locus Autonomy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Torque in Locus Autonomy
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: The immediate deactivation of Roxslide in Wilderock Edge. Its avalanches have the potential to destroy our locus and the noise is overloading my audio sensors.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED: The immediate deactivation of Roxslide in Wilderock Edge. Its avalanches have the potential to destroy our locus and the noise is overloading my audio sensors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please deactivate that walking mound of noise pollution in Wilderock Edge. If left unchecked much longer it will destroy my audio sensors... and Locus Autonomy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can finally compile sounds other than falling rocks! You have my everlasting thanks and you can have this reward to!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully found and deactivated Roxslide restoring peace and quiet to Locus Autonomy.

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker wants you to find Dredge Site A68 and clear an escape route by killing groups of Veritas Ascendancy at Dredge Site A68.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Rusty over the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm goin' to meet Calidor and see this augmentation tech for myself,  just clear an exit path in case I need to blast outta there in a hurry.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Anything goes haywire we'll need a clear path outta here. Think ya can remove some Ascendancy loons from the equation?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What ya waitin' for, sweetie? If anyone deserves a hole in the ground, it's those Ascendancy freaks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We have a situation here! Belle was supposed to be on her way out, but she's not answering her Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't ya worry, I can handle myself around the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We gotta help her out!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll clear an escape path for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With Belle Walker most likely trapped below the Dredge Site A68, you evened the odds in case she needs to make an escape. The Ascendancy and their leader Calidor certainly have some plans for her.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: He defected from the Dominion an' runs those Ascendancy folk. Says he has a proposal for sharing Eldan technology. Figure I get one glimpse of some tech an' can turn it against them if he tries anything shady.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's in big ol' crater called Dredge Site A68 with an exo-lab beneath just full of augmentation machines. Figure I find what Calidor's after an' use those machines to create a distraction. Just need ya to watch my back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I wish ya'd reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Rusty wants you to disable the Augmentation Capsule inside Augmentation Control Room 68.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Rusty via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is bad. Calidor's making an army of Ascendancy converts by using the augmentation machines to splice machine parts on to people. You have to shut them down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Calidor's using the Eldan augmentation capsules to convert people to the Ascendancy. He's making an army and Belle's still trapped inside!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's a relief. Those machines are too dangerous to leave in the hands of the Ascendancy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry. I hate to think what might happen if Belle gets caught!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we just gotta get to Belle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Ascendancy's augmentation capsules shut down, Calidor's army of augmented minions should be kept in check.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's just dreadful. They've modified the Eldan technology and put it to use converting people into cyborgs that blindly follow Calidor and the Ascendancy's mandates.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's disappointing. I thought you were Belle's friend.

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker has been captured by the Ascendancy and wants you to help her escape the Augmentation Control Room 68.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Belle Walker via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Help! I found Belle but they got her locked up in some contraption! You have to bust her out before the finish whatever modification they have in mind!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We have to break Belle out of that machine. Can you turn it off using that console? Just watch out for Calidor's lunatics.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks, $(player.name). I'm feeling awfully strange. I gotta get medical treatment right away so I'm headin' to the arkship.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please hurry!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya next time, Exile.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Belle Walker held captive by the Ascendancy. She seems foggy about the details and fears Calidor may have experimented on her with Ascendancy augmentation technology.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you just leave Belle hanging? This is sparks my circuits!

localizedTextIdText: You took a job from the Bounty Board offering a reward for killing Overseer X-47 inside Augmentation Control Room 68.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Far-Trader Zashur in The Phosporus Plane
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: The Overseer X-47 is terrible Eldan killing machine, but has glowing shiny core. Bring core to Far-Trader Zashur for great reward!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Overseer X-47 is still considered extremely dangerous.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get shinies from Eldan killing machine. Rumors say it guards room in Exo-Lab deep below surface.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Core is shinier than imagined! Super shiny!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You hang on tight to that thing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and destroyed the Bounty Board inside Augmentation Control Room 68 and recovered a glowing core.Far-Trader Zashur found the glowing core to be a wonderful treasure.

localizedTextIdText: Director Kaspnov of Nightwatch Enclave asks you to infiltrate Cortex Station Genesis on a mission of the utmost importance. Rumor has it this station has been conducting experiments that could potentially triple their threat to Black Hoods operations. Get in there and disable their communications. You will be contacted upon completion of this assignment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Director Kaspnov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Cortex Station Genesis has been conducting experiments that threatens Black Hoods operations. Your instructions are to infiltrate this station and disable communications.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your instructions were to infiltrate Cortex Station Genesis and disable communications. Do you need to be reassigned?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work $(Player.name). Ready for your instructions? You're mission has only just begun.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will be contacted upon completion of this assignment.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully infiltrated Cortex Station Genesis and shut down communications but you're mission has only just begun.

Rumor has it this station has been conducting experiments that could potentially triple their threat to ICI operations. Get in there and disable their communications. You will be contacted upon completion of this assignment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Axis Nyzine

localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will be contacted upon completion of this assignment.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've successfully infiltrated Cortex Station Genesis and shut down communications but you're mission has only just begun.

localizedTextIdText: Viralist Yurovich of Nightwatch Enclave has asked you to test the liquid inside the Ikthian containment tanks to find out what really is going on here. Take samples of incubation fluid and analyze the data. Watch out for any Ikthian interference. They will not want you messing with their tanks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Viralist Yurovich
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Take samples of incubation fluid and analyze the data. Watch out for any Ikthian interference. They will not want you messing with their tanks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'll be needing that sample if we are to find out what is really going on here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've completed the analysis on that compound. It's an enhanced version of the Ikthian super soldier serum used to make Triton Guards. This is not good.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If these creatures make it through incubation, we could have a real problem on our hands.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've ensured complete the analysis on that compound. It's an enhanced version of the Ikthian super soldier serum used to make Triton Guards. If these creatures make it through incubation, we could have a real problem on our hands.

localizedTextIdText: Director Kaspnov of Nightwatch Enclave explains they have flyers incoming for an artillery assault on Cortex Station but the Black Hoods need a man on the ground to mark the targets. You'll have to fight your way through Cortex station to those targets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Director Kaspnov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've got flyers incoming for an artillery assault on Cortex Station Genesis but I'll need a man on the ground to mark the targets. Combat and bloodshed are imminent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You seem to be in direct line of artillery fire. Unless you mark those targets, I cannot guarantee your safety.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're victory is one shared by the Black Hoods. I thank you for your assistance in this mission but the Black Hoods still require your skills.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mark the targets and make sure to get out of the way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're victory is one shared by the Black Hoods. You've gought your way through Cortex Station Genesis and managed to mark all of the targets for artillery fire but the Black Hoods still require your skills.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Nyzine of Mimicry Junction explains they have flyers incoming for an artillery assault on Cortex Station but the ICI needs a man on the ground to mark the targets. You'll have to fight your way through Cortex station to those targets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Axis Nyzine
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've got flyers incoming for an artillery assault on Cortex Station Genesis but I'll need a man on the ground to mark the targets. Combat and bloodshed are imminent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You seem to be in direct line of artillery fire. Unless you mark those targets, I cannot guarantee your safety.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're victory is one shared by the ICI. I thank you for your assistance in this mission but you are still needed here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mark the targets and make sure to get out of the way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're victory is one shared by the ICI. You've gought your way through Cortex Station Genesis and managed to mark all of the targets for artillery fire but the ICI still require your skills.

localizedTextIdText: Viralist Yurovich of Nightwatch Enclave explains the Ikthians are using several rare and deadly ingredients to create their enhanced biological compound. Viralist Yurovich believes these ingredients may be able to serve a greater purpose. The ingredients are ready to be transported to other stations for distribution. You must steal the toxic ingredients.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Viralist Yurovich
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We may be able to use the ingredients used in the Ikthian experiments for a greater purpose. You must steal the toxic ingredients from the transport crates.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've got poison to make. You better get started.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's it! You've created a poison strong enough to wipe out an army of Ikthian super soldiers. Now let's see how we can put it to use.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Director Kaspnov will contact you with instructions when the time is right.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've created a poison strong enough to wipe out an army of Ikthian super soldiers. Now let's see how we can put it to use.

You must steal the toxic ingredients.

localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've created a poison strong enough to wipe out an army of Ikthian super soldiers. Now let's see how we can put it to use.

localizedTextIdText: Director Kaspnov of Nightwatch Enclave needs you to stop those ships. The Black Hoods cannot allow the Ikthian super serum to leave Cortex Station Genesis. He's asked that you reconfigure the Ikthian Powerfield Generators in order to ground those ships.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Black Hoods cannot allow this new biological compound to leave Cortex Station Genesis. Reconfigure the Ikthian Powerfield Generators to ground their ships.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must reconfigure the Powerfield Generators to ground those ships. We cannot allow them to leave Cortex Station Genesis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have proved most useful. You've bought us the time we need to get to the bottom of this. We must find the mastermind behind this madness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must stop those ships!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Grounding those planes has bought us the time needed to get to the bottom of this.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Nyzine of Mimicry Junction needs you to stop those ships. The ICI cannot allow the Ikthian super serum to leave Cortex Station Genesis. He's asked that you reconfigure the Ikthian Powerfield Generators in order to ground those ships.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI cannot allow this new biological compound to leave Cortex Station Genesis. Reconfigure the Ikthian Powerfield Generators to ground their ships.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must reconfigure the Powerfield Generators to ground those ships. We cannot allow them to leave Cortex Station Genesis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have proved most useful. You've bought us the time we need to get to the bottom of this. We must find the mastermind behind this madness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must stop those ships!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Grounding those planes has bought us the time needed to get to the bottom of this.

localizedTextIdText: Director Kaspnov of Nightwatch Enclave needs you to finish the job. You must face the ehanced Ikthian super soldier, Cortex Hydrophant, before any more of those creatures make it through incubation. We've got the perfect poison for those left in the tanks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Director Kaspnov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You must face Cortex Hydrophant before any more of those creatures make it through incubation. We've got the perfect poison for those left in the tanks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kill Cortex Hydrophant and poison the incubating army of super soldiers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Such a vital victory! You against an enhanced super soldier and an entire incubating army! I say mission accomplished Agent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Such a vital victory! You against an enhanced super soldier and an entire incubating army! Cortex Hydrophant has been defeated along with all those incubating soldiers. Mission accomplished Agent.

localizedTextIdText: Director Kaspnov wants you to place Signal Flares to teleport in snipers in Cortex Station Genesis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Kaspnov via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must bring a swift death to our enemies. We have Black Hood Snipers waiting for your signal to strike.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My agents are still idle. Light the signal flares and let the executions begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The ground drank deeply of Ikthian blood. You have aided the Exiles greatly with your accolades.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Director Kaspnov sent Black Hood agents to help execute the Ikthian forces in Cortex Station Genesis.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Nyzine wants you to place Signal Flares to teleport snipers to Cortex Station Genesis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Nyzine via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've prepared a squad of snipers to assist in eradicating the Ikthians. Your task is to light the signal flares to ensure their deployment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our sniper support is lacking. It's imperative you complete this mission immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sniper teams have reported in. Your success gives the Dominion a tactical edge versus these Ikthian forces.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the signal flares lit, ICI snipers deployed and delivered a hail of bullets to Ikthian forces in Cortex Station Genesis.

localizedTextIdText: You've found a crate full of Ikthian weapons in Cortex Station Genesis. Maybe you should test them out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Director Kaspnov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've found a crate full of Ikthian weapons. Maybe you should test them out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Test those weapons on some Ikthians when you're in the killing mood. Let's see if they even work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ikthian weapons you say? And they work quite well? I wouldn't mind getting my hands on some of that tech myself. Thank you for bringing this information to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've proven quite useful.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Turns out Ikthian made weapons do work against Ikthians.

localizedTextIdText: You've found a crate full of Ikthian weapons in Cortex Station Genesis. Maybe you should test them out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Axis Nyzine
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've found a crate full of Ikthian weapons. Maybe you should test them out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Test those weapons on some Ikthians when you're in the killing mood. Let's see if they even work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ikthian weapons you say? And they work quite well? I wouldn't mind getting my hands on some of that tech myself. Thank you for bringing this information to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've proven quite useful.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Turns out Ikthian made weapons do work against Ikthians.

localizedTextIdText: An Ikthian Abductee explains Ikthians in Cortext Station Genesis are capturing people to experiment with. Whatever it is they are testing is bad news. Rescue Ikthian Abductees!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Mesmerist Suzana
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ikthians are capturing people to experiment with. Whatever it is they are testing is bad news. Please get me and my friends out of here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are people in need of your help. Rescue them before those Ikthian's have a chance to use them for testing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My thanks to you. You've saved many lives today.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You saved many lives today. There's no telling what would have happened if humans were injected with the Ikthian serum.

localizedTextIdText: An Ikthian Abductee explains Ikthians in Cortex Station Genesis are capturing people to experiment with. Whatever it is they are testing is bad news. Rescue Ikthian Abductees!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Cycler Serax
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ikthians are capturing people to experiment with. Whatever it is they are testing is bad news. Please get me and my friends out of here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are people in need of your help. Rescue them before those Ikthian's have a chance to use them for testing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My thanks to you. You've saved many lives today.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You saved many lives today. There's no telling what would have happened if humans were injected with the Ikthian serum.

localizedTextIdText: Cryptographer Katchev has received word that valuable information regarding Admiral Ironscale is located in the Ikthian ship The Avenger. Katchev wants you to retrieve the data and send it back to him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Cryptographer Katchev in Nightwatch Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Time is short and your assistance is required! The Ikthian ship The Avenger has computers that have information about Admiral Ironscale that you will retrieve.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have yet to receive any of data from you. Any needless personal that know of the data in The Avenger will disappear. Make certain you don't fall in that category.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done! This information will allow us to strike with precision at Admiral Ironscale's weaknesses.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not make excess copies of the data.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Why do I feel like this is not a request.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully retrieved the data on Admiral Ironscale and sent it to Cryptographer Karchev.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: There will be a reckoning.

localizedTextIdText: Codebreaker Deydra has received word that valuable data regarding Admiral Ironscale is located in the Ikthian ship The Avenger. Deydea wants you to retrieve the data and send it back to her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Codebreaker Deydra in Mimicry Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You there! We have received word that valuable intel regarding Admiral Ironscale is being kept in the Ikthian ship The Avenger. You will retrieve that data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still do not possess the data form The Avenger. Complete your mission before I find someone to replace you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have received the data on Admiral Ironscale. This will be quite useful for any future dealings we may have with him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return without that data and you will regret it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Seems like I don't have a choice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully retrieved the data on Admiral Ironscale and sent it to Codebreaker Deydra.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you will not help me you are expendable.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex wants you to use a Surveillancebot to sneak into Judge Kain's camp outside Black Jack's Salvage and take a biological sample from Kain's Bike and record voice samples from any Judge's Logs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex outside Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Black Jack Moragg has a secret vault that we need to access without detection. To that end I'll disguise myself as Judge Kain once you acquire the samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Operate a Surveillancebot remotely and gather a biomatter sample from Judge Kain's Bike. We'll also need voice recordings to finish the disguise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent service, $(player.name). When next we meet inside Black Jack's Salvage I will appear as the judge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll need to acquire the samples using a remote bot.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll gather the data on Kain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Agent Lex was pleased with your resource gathering and is prepared to transform into Judge Kain for the next set of missions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need a disguise?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do I acquire the samples?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Judge Kain and the Darkspur Cartel have clashed before. Black Jack Moragg would expect such a confrontation and not suspect my true purpose.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I have provided several remote controlled surveillancebots that have the required sampling technology. All you need to do is operate one and take biomatter and voice samples of Judge Kain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your insubordination has been noted.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex wants you to use a remote controlled Surveillancebot to scan Justice Redrok, Justice Windweave, and Justice Steelmoore while they are sleeping.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex outside Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Complete infiltration requires I replicate Kain's justices. Your mission is to remotely scan the justices using an ICI surveillance probe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our data is insufficient. Use the remote surveillance probe to complete the sequences or our replacement justices will be inoperable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The data is intact and complete. The replicant justices would fool even the real Judge Kain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do so without being detected.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our next phase begins.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the right resolution scans of Judge Kain's justices, Agent Lex has equipped some ICI bots with their likenesses. His plan to pose is Judge Kain and take on the Darkspur Cartel is almost in action.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your failings have been noted and processed.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex wants you to take Moragg's Hand and use it at the Hand Scanner to gain access to Moragg's Vault beneath Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex at Moragg's Vault inside Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hurry, meet me at the entrance to Black Jack Moragg's vault and don't forget to bring his hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for, agent> Bring Moragg's hand to the scanner so we can access the vault.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Impressive work, $(player.name). The Darkspur Cartel's influence was much greater than anticipated even within the empire itself.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: All the Darkspur intel is yours.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Black Jack Moragg's vault beneath Black Jack's Salvage and helped Agent Lex find sensitive information about the Darkspur Cartel's contacts.

localizedTextIdTitle: Shoot Out at the Black Jack Salvage
localizedTextIdText: $2?f/Agent Lex has disguised himself as Judge Kain and wants you to clear the Darkspur Cartel thugs out of their storefront/Judge Kain wants you to clear the Darkspur Cartel thugs out of their storefront; in Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Judge Kain via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $2?f/From now until the Darkspur Cartel is eradicated, I will pose as Judge Kain. Now go confront the Cartel at their storefront./The Darkspur are sellin' confiscated goods right out in the open. It's time to shut their operation down and make sure justice is served.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We gotta punish the Darkspur for their illicit dealings. Get to that storefront and sort 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We struck the first blow but there's still more to do before Black Jack Moragg's Cartel is brought down.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help take out the Darkspur!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: $2?f/You helped Agent Lex maintain his disguise as Judge Kain by confronting the Darkspur Cartel at the storefront operations at Black Jack's Salvage and driving them out./You helped Judge Kain by confronting the Darkspur Cartel at the storefront operations at Black Jack's Salvage and driving them out.

localizedTextIdText: Scrapper Malkin wants you to find a Pumera Liver and a $(vitem=463) in Black Jack's Salvageto prepare for Judge Kain's next phase in bringing justice to the Darkspur Cartel.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Scrapper Malkin inside Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: From what I gather you're goin' to need some explosives and spray paint to send a message the Darkspur can understand. Should be some in the junk yard.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We can't risk Black Jack Moragg fleein' the asteroid. We gotta find some rumors on how to prevent that and there's no better place than a run down bar.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still goin' to need some firepower and paint to wage war on the Darkspur. You can find some near the crusher just down the hill.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These will do just fine. I'll have you all set up to wreak havoc on the Darkspur in no time.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find the paint and explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: To send a firm message to the Darkspur Cartel, Scrapper Malkin has taken the explosives and paint you found and converted them for deployment. Soon you'll be able to show the Darkspur Cartel that Judge Kain is serious about rendering his verdict.

localizedTextIdText: Judge Kain wants you to blow up Darkspur Bikes, Darkspur Munitions, and kill Darkpur Cartel members in Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Judge Kain via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time to drop the hammer of justice hard on these Cartel thugs. Burn their bikes and contraband and drop as many bodies as you can in the ground.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Good folk are sufferin' at the hands of Black Jack Moragg and his crew. Get out there and serve 'em some justice instead of wastin' time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You put the fear of Lady Justice in those Cartel goons. Ready to finish Black Jack for good?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Darkspur have been dealt a blow that leaves them reeling. Without their bikes and gun power, they will be hard pressed to withstand the rest of Judge Kain's reckoning.

localizedTextIdText: Judge Kain wants you to spray the mark of Kain on the Cartel's Shipping Crates to inspire fear among the Cartel agents under Black Jack Moragg's employ in Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Judge Kain over the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Black Jack Moragg's reign is comin' to an end. To that end we're claimin' any Cartel crates for Lady Justice. Spray the mark of Kain on any you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Darkspur Cartel ruffians are still struttin' around like they own the place. Get out there and claim those crates for justice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You put the fear of justice in those Cartel thugs. Good work, deputy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They better stay out of my way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Judge Kain reports that your plan has caused panic and fear among the Darkspur Cartel thugs. Even the whisper of Judge Kain sends the Darkspur agents scurrying in fear.

localizedTextIdText: Judge Kain wants you to kill the infamous Darkspur Cartel member, Black Jack Moragg , inside Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Judge Kain via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time to bring the law directly to Black Jack himself. Waste no time and meet me at his hangout.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There's no time to waste. The longer Black Jack Moragg goes unpunished, the more citizens fall prey to his ill dealings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's no time to waste. The longer Black Jack Moragg goes unpunished, the more citizens fall prey to his ill dealings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Really? I want to see some evidence. Bring me a piece of 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took out Black Jack Moragg and without him, the Darkspur Cartel's presence will diminish in region.

localizedTextIdText: You found Black Jack Moragg's arm and should deliver it to Judge Kain in Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Rendevous the Judge Kain in Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Black Jack Moragg's severed arm. Judge Kain would probably like to see proof that the infamous Darkspur Cartel leader is slain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At last, Black Jack Moragg is lying face down in his own blood. This is a great victory for lady justice, the Exiles, and the people of the Halon Ring.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the arm to Judge Kain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Judge Kain was satisfied with the knowledge that Black Jack Moragg has been grought to justice.

localizedTextIdText: You found Metalhead's Skull and should find a place far from the body to bury it in Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Scrapper Malkin via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Metalhead's obnoxious, heavy, talking indestructible skull. Better find a place far away from the body to bury it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gotta keep that bot out order somehow. Find a spot to bury its skull so he can't be repaired.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great job dismantling that bot. Old Metalhead sometimes went haywire and gunned down innocents.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find a place to bury this skull.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a suitable pile of junk to bury Metalhead's Skull where it will hopefully never be found. While this didn't stop the endless chatter of Metalhead it should prevent its reconstruction.

localizedTextIdText: Freebot Drillbit wants you to use the Crane Controls to rescue Freebot and crush Darkspur Battlebot Hulk in Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Freebot Drillbit in Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Help, sentient! My fellow free thinkers are trapped in that crushing yard. Can you use that crane to pull them out and destroy the unenlightened bots?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Some of my friends are still trapped in the Cartel's scrap junking pit. If you operate that hanging scrap machine you can pull them out and zap the Cartel's bots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for helping my fellow Freebots escape that crushing pit!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm going to stay here and try to help any others.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Freebot Drillbit was incredibly pleased that you pulled his Freebot friends out of the crushing pit before they were terminated.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider helping my friends, sentient.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Ven-Bahl wants you to collect Vulcarrion Talon of interest from Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Ven-Bahl in Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've heard there are unique items that end up in the salvage yard. If you find anything interesting, I'd be glad to take it off your hands.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This isn't quite enough stuff to generate any good gossip around here. Can you find a few more items?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh my this is quite a collection! I can't wait to put them on display for everyone to see!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll look for some interesting junk.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Not sure any of that junk is worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Bartender Ven-Bahl was so excited by the discarded items you found that he now proudly displays them at his bar in Black Jack's Salvage.

localizedTextIdText: Bike Tech Lana wants you to collect $(vitem=469) from the frozen pools and collect Dominion Uniform Scraps{p: Dominion Uniform Scraps} from elmentals around the Nitrofen. With these new experimental materials, she hopes to work on manufacturing experimental materials to construct bikes out of.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bike Tech Lana in Nitrofen
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm just dying to get my hands on some primordial bone samples to try craftin' a new light weight speeder. Can you get some for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'd really like to try makin' a speeder using some primordial bone samples. Could ya go back out there and find some for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These samples are beautiful! Can't wait to try makin' a speeder frame with these materials!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just watch out for the Nitrofen pools. They'll freeze you solid!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya around, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Bike Tech Lana was very pleased with the samples you provided. It seems various ancient creatures became entombed in the ice. With some processing the Nitrofen Gas and Primordial Bones may craft the bikes of the future.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not everyone's able to handle the extremes of Apex-9.

localizedTextIdText: Bike Tech Lana wants you to collect Grimstone Explosives Primer 2 by jumping through them in the Nitrofen. She believes she can develop a better fuel source for her bikes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bike Tech Lana in the Nitrofen
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'd love to get my hands on some meteorite samples that float around the Nitrofen. I bet with some tinkering I could make a lighter fuel for our bikes!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those meteorite samples are still out there. You can use the jump platforms left by some unfortunate thrill seekers near the asteroid belt to get 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These are fantastic! I'm sure with some time and ingenuity we can put this energy to use. I can't wait to make a faster bike. Thanks again friend!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch your step out there. Good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is really gonna push the speeders to new speeds!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You soared through the asteroid belt and gathered up the Grimstone Explosives Primer 2 for Bike Tech Lana. She hopes to develop a lighter weight and more efficient fuel source to support the racers in Apex-9.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought for sure you'd be up to the task.

localizedTextIdText: Chopper Jorn wants you to collect Plucked Vulcarrion Feather from The Upper Crust so you can build a bike and enter the race.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chopper Jorn in the The Upper Crust
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You want to join the race then you gotta get yourself a bike. Bring me the parts and I'll get you runnin' in no time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You still got a lot of work to do if you're gonna enter the race. Once you get a bike assembled talk to the race track announcer to test it out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a natural born racer. You're welcome here anytime!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll find all sorts of usable scrap if you look hard enough.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Safe travels, friend!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll build a bike for the race.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered up the parts and Chopper Jorn built you a bike for the races. Now you can join in the Upper Crust race anytime you want to.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't have the look of a racer, anyhow.

localizedTextIdText: A Robbed Merchant wants you to recover Plucked Vulcarrion Feather and kill Highway bandits east of The Upper Crust.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Robbed Merchant
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We were just on our way back to town when these highway bandits took the credits and clothes right off us. We'll never make it home like this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please hurry. We're going to freeze or starve to death if we can't get some of our supplies back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You really saved our hides. I can't thank you enough!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hire a body guard next time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered enough of the stolen goods to send the robbed travelers safely on their way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw come on now! You just gonna leave us here in the cold?

localizedTextIdText: Axis Nyzine of Mimicry Junction needs you to finish the job. You must face the ehanced Ikthian super soldier, Cortex Hydrophant, before any more of those creatures make it through incubation. We've got the perfect poison for those left in the tanks.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You must face Cortex Hydrophant before any more of those creatures make it through incubation. We've got the perfect poison for those left in the tanks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kill Cortex Hydrophant and poison the incubating army of super soldiers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Such a vital victory! You against an enhanced super soldier and an entire incubating army! I say mission accomplished Agent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Such a vital victory! You against an enhanced super soldier and an entire incubating army! Cortex Hydrophant has been defeated along with all those incubating soldiers. Mission accomplished Agent.

localizedTextIdText: You've made your way to the ancient Eldan Alpha Complex beneath the surface of Farside. Dorian Walker has asked you to make contact with Researcher Goldspring at Camp Woodview in Bio-Dome 3.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Researcher Goldspring at Camp Woodview
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This here's Alpha Complex, the nerve center between Bio-Dome 3 and Bio-Dome 4. Get on over to Bio-Dome 3, 'cause Researcher Goldspring could use some help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You still lookin' for Bio-Dome 3, sport? I know Researcher Goldspring was really hopin' to get a helpin' hand over there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You just arrived from Alpha Complex? Dorian must've sent you. He's such a sweet old man! I'm so glad I was finally able to meet him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: She's a real sweetheart, kid. Loads of enthusiasm, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You want to get started? I can't hardly wait!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've introduced yourself to the XAS researcher leading the scientific expedition in Bio-Dome 3. Researcher Goldspring is eager to work with you to unlock the secrets of this fascinating artificial environment.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: As far as we can tell, the Eldan were playin' around with artificial environments, trying to replicate widely varying climates and habitats. What for? Shoot me if I know, I'm just the one who discovered 'em, sport.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: With that attitude, skipper, maybe we don't need your help after all.

localizedTextIdText: You've made your way to the ancient Eldan Alpha Complex beneath the surface of Farside. Researcher Ahnaris has asked you to make contact with Biologist Memydra at Silvos Overlook in Bio-Dome 3.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Biologist Memydra at Silvos Overlook
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings and welcome to Alpha Complex. If you would please proceed to Bio-Dome 3, Biologist Memydra is waiting for a capable assistant.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are you still looking for Bio-Dome 3? By the Scions, the help they send us these days. *sigh* Please convey yourself to Biologist Memydra at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you are the new arrival from Alpha Complex? Your presence was requested several weeks ago. I certainly hope the fault does not lie with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Collegium is terribly understaffed at the moment. Do hurry.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Very well. I assume you have the appropriate qualifications for field work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've introduced yourself to the Collegium researcher leading the scientific expedition in Biome 3. Biologist Memydra is ready to put you to work uncovering the secrets of this artificial landscape.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The information we have is that the Eldan were attempting to create artificial environments, while trying to replicate varying climates and habitats. The reason for their interest in these areas is still unknown.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm not accustomed to being spoken to in such terms!

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Vossak wishes to experiment with the abundant primal life energy found within the creatures of Beryl Forest. He hopes to finding a cure for the Contagion, so he's asked you to gather primal life essences for his experiments.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Vossak via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Contagion is death, and Beryl Forest contains its opposite - life. Gather samples of life essence from the forest creatures for me to study.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The creatures of Beryl Forest, below us, possess abundant primal essence, but they will not surrender it while they live.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Rot and ruin! I have never seen primal life in such concentrated form. As such, it is completely unusable for the purposes of alchemy. More's the pity!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: To cure this cursed Contagion I would have you slaughter any number of creatures.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall have to ponder another plan.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You provided Alchemist Vossak with samples of primal life essences for his research into treatments for the Contagion. However, the raw primal life proved too concentrated for him to use in his alchemical studies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need primal essence?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The primal essence represents pure life energy. If I can only find a way to harness such energy, a cure for the cursed Contagion could be at hand.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Curse you for your selfishness. Now go so I need not look upon your face.

localizedTextIdText: Engineer Gezani suspects the exuberant growth of wildlife in Bio-Dome 3 is due to more than clever Eldan engineering. He wishes you to collect Boulderback Aggravator from creatures in Beryl Forest for analysis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Engineer Gezani via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan engineering alone cannot account for abundant proliferation of life in Bio-Dome 3. Collect life essences from biome creatures for analysis!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need life essence samples, need them now! Go down to forest, kill creatures, retrieve essence! Is that so hard?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah ha! As I suspected. Naturally. Eldan cheated! Used primal life to accelerate growth processes! Must run more tests to learn how.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes, yes, Eldan brilliant engineers. But this something more!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now go away. Must work. If bored, speak with Memydra.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You provided Engineer Gezani with samples of life essences taken from the Bio-Dome creatures. It appears the Eldan may have found a way to utilize primal life to accelerate the growth process, resulting in the verdant landscape of Bio-Dome 3 and its unusually vigorous creatures.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Bio-Dome 3. The green Bio-Dome. You'll see why. Eldan built it. What for? Don't know! But going to find out. Suspect some very clever experiments carried out here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Think I heard you wrong.

localizedTextIdText: Primal life is so concentrated in Bio-Dome 3 that it's begun to coalesce as a physical substance in parts of Beryl Forest. Researcher Goldspring wants you to measure the energy levels of these primal life manifestations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Goldspring via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My scans show primal life readings are off the charts! If you're headed down into Beryl Forest, take this scanbot to measure primal life energy levels.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Aren't you excited about the chance to study primal life up close? Just take the teleporter and head down to Beryl Forest and grab some readings!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blessed matrias! These poor creatures - there's way too much primal life in here! The natural order here must be completely out of balance!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck, and be careful down there!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I bet things are completely out of control down there....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've reported your findings to an astonished Researcher Goldspring. She's worried about what such high levels of primal life energy are doing to the flora and fauna of Bio-Dome 3.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can all that primal life be bad?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You wouldn't think so, but the matrias say anything out of balance can be harmful. Life's all about moderation, right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess I'll find someone else to do it.

localizedTextIdText: Primal life is so concentrated in Bio-Dome 3 that it's begun to coalesce as a physical substance in parts of Beryl Forest. Biologist Memydra wants you to measure the energy levels of these primal life manifestations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Memydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In the forests below, primal life has been allowed to accumulate at an unprecedented level. Use this bot to take measurements to confirm my theory.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you taken the teleporter yet? I have yet to receive any measurements of primal life energies, and will not tolerate further delays.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As I suspected. These readings are strong evidence this Bio-Dome may have once been used for organic experimentation - a giant petri dish for the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Biome fauna have been enhanced by primal life. Caution is recommended.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Life is spiraling out of control down there. Simply amazing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've reported your findings to Biologist Memydra, confirming her theory that Bio-Dome 3 may have once been used as an Eldan test lab for experiments on organic life forms.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get those scans right away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal to assist with Collegium research is grounds for termination.

localizedTextIdText: The abundance of primal life energy in Beryl Forest has caused the life forms living there to grow out of control. Researcher Goldspring has asked you to help return balance to the forest ecosystem by cutting back overgrown plants and roots.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Goldspring via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Primal ragethorn has disabled my vegetation scanner bots! Take this acidic rifle and use it to fight back the ragethorns and free those bots!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: With every passing moment, the forest grows more out of control. Those scanbots will only keep those thorns busy for so long!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done it! All scanbot units are coming back to us! You're incredible!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That acidic rifle should fry that primal ragethorn!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You bet your pretty little ears I am.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Researcher Goldspring restore some semblance of balance to the Bio-Dome by cutting back the overgrown plants and roots.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ragethorn is a variety of thorny vine. The specimens in Bio-Dome 3 are infused with primal life, making them much larger than normal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Are you joking? We need those scanbots back!

localizedTextIdText: The abundance of primal life energy in Beryl Forest has caused excessive growth of the local flora, interfering with Biologist Memydra scans. She has asked you deal with the problem by cutting back overgrown plants and roots.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Biologist Memydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Primal ragethorn has disabled my vegetation scanners. I need those bots returned at once. Use this acidic rifle on the plants to free the bots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My bots' scans are impaired by rampant growth in the forests below. Cut back the overgrowth and eliminate this hindrance to my scientific study.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. Visual distortion from excessive growth has now receded, and scans are coming in at a significantly improved resolution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The overabundance of primal life is responsible for this uncontrolled growth.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleared away some of the overgrowth in the biome forest. The Collegium should have no problems getting clear scans now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Affirmative. It is a thorny vine, but this particular variety has grown to vast proportions by the primal life here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal to assist is an unacceptable response.

localizedTextIdText: Primal life energy has reached critical levels in Beryl Forest. Alchemist Vossak wants you to help him install a series of devices at the marked locations to siphon away excess primal life and trap it in containment units.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Vossak via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All this free-floating primal life energy must be contained. Install these containment devices at the locations I have marked to entrap the energy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have already marked the locations with flares for you. Simply set up the siphoning devices as described and report back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The levels of primal life energy have already started to fade. Eventually they may be at levels that allow for alchemical experimentation....
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Primal life in so pure a form can be dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Alchemist Vossak in his efforts to decrease the dangerously high levels of primal energy throughout the forest by installing containment systems. In time, Alchemist Vossak hopes the primal life energy will become usable in his research the Contagion's cure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you the haziest of ideas what horrors will happen if we fail?

localizedTextIdText: Engineer Gezani has managed to reverse engineer a growth accelerating device based on Bio-Dome 3's design, but he needs you to set up energy collectors in Beryl Forest so he can collect the primal life he needs. Collection sites already have markers in place.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Engineer Gezani via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Created growth accelerator, configured for Bio-Dome. Work of genius! Yes yes! But need primal life energy! Markers already set, you go trap energy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bio-Dome engineering marvel, but my creation better. Much better! Or will be once I get primal life energy. Energy containers set up yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes yes! Energy flowing, success! Wait... no! Too much energy! Primal life levels too unstable! No! My beautiful machines!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Research finally complete! What Eldan do, Chua do better!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hmph. Manipulation of primal life tricky. Further study needed. Go away now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you helped Engineer Gezani collect primal energy for his growth acceleration device, it seems there was more to the design of the Bio-Dome than the Chua engineer anticipated. His device was subsequently destroyed. Eldan Engineers: 1, Chua: 0.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Too close to stop now! Killing you and finding replacement is waste of time.

localizedTextIdText: You encountered an abandoned and hungry pumera cub while adventuring in the Beryl Forest. If you manage to collect some ravenok meat from forest ravens, you could provide a meal for the cub and help it survive.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Hungry Cub in Beryl Forest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This small pumera cub looks like it has lost its mother, and it hasn't had a meal in days. Perhaps you can feed it some timber ravenok meat.
