localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The cub looks at you weakly, its tiny body shaking with hunger. If you plan to feed it, you should hunt down some timber ravenok in Beryl Forest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The pumera cub sniffs the meat you brought, then begins to devour it, purring loudly as it eats. $(self.visual=485)
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get you some meat, little guy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped an abandoned pumera cub get its first meal in days. It has taken to following you around, believing you to be its new mother.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get you some meat, little guy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The cub imitates your vocalization and looks at you expectantly.

localizedTextIdText: You encountered an abandoned and hungry pumera cub while adventuring in the Beryl Forest. If you manage to collect some ravenok meat from forest ravens, you could provide a meal for the cub and help it survive.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Hungry Cub in Beryl Forest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This small pumera cub looks like it has lost its mother, and it hasn't had a meal in days. Perhaps you can feed it some timber ravenok meat.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The cub looks at you weakly, its tiny body shaking with hunger. If you plan to feed it, you should hunt down some timber ravenok in Beryl Forest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The pumera cub sniffs the meat you brought, then begins to devour it, purring loudly as it eats. $(self.visual=485)
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get you some meat, little guy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped an abandoned pumera cub get its first meal in days. It has taken to following you around, believing you to be its new mother.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get you some meat, little guy.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Vossak has asked you to follow the path of fungal spores in the Beryl Forest back to its source.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Alchemist Vossak at Camp Woodview
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These toxic fungal spores are becoming more prevalent in this area. Follow the spores to see where they originate. Remain wary and keep your eyes open.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you've found a cache of poisonous spores, you should locate the source. If it can be destroyed, so much the better.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I suppose that such an abundance of life is bound to give rise to potent toxins. You are fortunate to have survived this encounter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The primal life in this area has already proven to be more than dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and destroyed the source of poisonous spores in the Beryl Forest, a large fungal creature known as Banespore.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal is not the correct action.

localizedTextIdText: Engineer Gezani has asked you to follow the path of fungal spores in the Beryl Forest and trace them to their source.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Engineer Gezani at Silvos Overlook
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Spores dangerous! Toxic! More and more appear! Go, figure out where they come from! Destroy source!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Spores not hard to follow. So follow them. Find source of spores. Destroy source of spores. Important tip - do not eat spores!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very big creature! Fungal in nature, but no match for $(player.name). Exceeded expectations. Now take reward and go.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come back in one piece! Two pieces one too many!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and destroyed the source of poisonous spores in the Beryl Forest, a large fungal creature known as Banespore.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Hmph! Will find another!

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Tanoga has asked you to meet with Climatologist Skyleaf in Bio-Dome 4 near the Crystalline Waste. Skyleaf needs your help to understand the effect of excessive terraformer energy on the landscape of the waste.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Climatologist Skyleaf below Shady Ledge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Crystalline Waste is your next stop, buddy. Climatologist Skyleaf needs a helpin' hand. Since I been singin' your praises, he wants you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You checked in with Skyleaf yet? That Aurin ain't gonna wait forever. He's a little bit impulsive, if you get my drift.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm pleased to finally meet you. I'm the head of the research team exploring the Crystalline Waste. Tanoga says you're good people.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make me proud, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You introduced yourself to Climatologist Skyleaf, head of the XAS team investigating the effects of the stalled Eldan terraformer on the surface of Bio-Dome 4.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got somethin' better to do?

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Bozim has asked you to meet with Geologist Lochron in Bio-Dome 4 near the Scorched Expanse. Lochron needs your help to understand the effect of excessive terraformer energy on the landscape of the waste.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Geologist Lochron at the Sikabis Field Lab
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tired of looking at you. Go to Crystalline Wastes, speak to Geologist Lochron. He have more work to do. Need good helper. Says you will do.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Thought you went to Crystalline Wastes to see Lochron. Lochron expecting you. Mechari not good person to disappoint.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am Lochron, chief geologist. Bozim communicated your imminent arrival. I hope his estimation of your abilities is correct.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Enjoy wastes. Is big vacation spot. Very nice. Not.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You introduced yourself to Geologist Lochron, head of the Collegium team investigating the effects of the stalled Eldan terraformer on the surface of Bio-Dome 4.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Whatever. You not have to go home, but you not stay here. Shoo!

localizedTextIdText: Climatologist Skyleaf is eager to begin his team's survey of the Crystalline Waste. You can help him establish baseline readings for temperature, windspeed, and humidity by downloading data from climate beacons throughout the waste.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Climatologist Skyleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to take some baseline measurements. Download readings from climate beacons around the Crystalline Waste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: C'mon, what're you doing here? Head out into the Crystalline Waste and get those readings! The team's counting on you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blessed matrias! These are impressive readings. We're beginning to get a clear picture of how this environment works.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch your step out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There's so much more to do! Let's step up the pace.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Climatologist Skyleaf begin his climate survey of the Crystalline Waste by gathering baseline data from his team's network of climate beacons. With this data in hand, the team can begin to understand the behavior of the Eldan terraformers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Look at it out there! The Eldan terraformer must've been stuck in that position for centuries to build up that much crystal in one location.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Tooth and claw! Why'd you come out here if you don't want to help?

localizedTextIdText: Geologist Lochron is eager to begin his team's survey of the Scorched Expanse. You can help him establish baseline readings for temperature, windspeed, and humidity by downloading data from climate beacons throughout the expanse.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Geologist Lochron via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Baseline climatic measurements required. Proceed into the Scorched Expanse and download readings from climate beacons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your collection of climatic data is still pending. Return to the Scorched Expanse and download information from climate beacons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The readings you collected indicate the Terraformer is the predominant cause of climatic irregularities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Caution - ambient temperatures exceed recommended maximums for organics.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is more to be done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Geologist Lochron begin his climate survey of the Scorched Expanse by gathering baseline data from his team's network of climate beacons. With this data in hand, the team can begin to understand the behavior of the Eldan terraformers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal is not wise. Reconsider at once.

localizedTextIdText: The crystals and creatures living in the Crystalline Waste manifest concentrated primal power deposited there by the Eldan terraformer. Researcher Starland believes this power can be harnessed for scientific purposes, and she has asked you to gather elemental cores.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Starland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That Eldan terraformer has been blastin' away for centuries! I bet we could extract all kinds o' energy from the primals in the Crystalline Waste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You think the primals are gonna bring those cores to us like housewarming presents? No way! You need to get out there and take 'em for yourself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whoa! There are strong energy readin's comin' from them elemental cores. Let's put those to good use!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stars! I reckon we could power an entire city!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you have in mind?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered elemental cores from the creatures of the Crystalline Waste for Researcher Starland experiments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll find someone, don't ya worry.

localizedTextIdText: The crystals and creatures living in the Scorched Expanse manifest concentrated primal power deposited there by the Eldan terraformer. Researcher Prollos believes this power can be harnessed for scientific purposes, and she has asked you to gather elemental cores.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Prollos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Eldan terraformer has been operating for centuries. I surmise we can extract a plethora of energy from the elementals of the Scorched Expanse.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I require cores from the elementals in this wretched place. Destroy the elementals, collect their cores, and return them to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The elemental cores' power readings are off the charts. I expect we can put these to some very good use. As for you, you have my gratitude.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The power is in the elementals' cores. Get them for me.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you have in mind?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered elemental cores from the creatures of the Scorched Expanse for Researcher Prolloss experiments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did you just say "no" to me?

localizedTextIdText: Climatologist Skyleaf is concerned for the safety of his field research teams operating in the Crystalline Waste. He's asked you to help make field conditions safer by destroying some of the powerful elementals that live there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Climatologist Skyleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tooth and claw! The Crystalline Waste is a treacherous place! The elementals pose a significant  threat to my research teams. Something must be done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing? My research teams won't be safe in the Crystalline Waste until the elemental threat has been dealt with.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: No wonder my field teams were caught by their tails! It's vicious out there, but you've done a great job of creating more space for my people to work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can't do field research if the field is too dangerous to research.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Climatologist Skyleaf by destroying some of the earth and air elementals inhabiting the Crystalline Waste. It should be much safer for the XAS research teams operating there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here they told me you were tough. What a load of crap.

localizedTextIdText: Geologist Lochron is concerned for the safety of his field research teams operating in the Scorched Expanse. He's asked you to help make field conditions safer by destroying some of the powerful elementals that live there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Geologist Lochron via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Due to the elementals that inhabit the Scorched Expanse, my research team is at an increased risk of being attacked. You will eliminate the elementals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My team will not be safe until the elementals in the Scorched Expanse have been dealt with. Proceed into the Expanse and see to your assignment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The elemental threat has been significantly reduced. I approve of your brutal methods. The will of the Empire has been served.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will await your signal that all is clear.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, onto the next task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Geologist Lochron by destroying some of the elementals inhabiting the Scorched Expanse. It should be much safer for the Collegium research teams operating there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are my aural sensors faulty, or did you just refuse my command?

localizedTextIdText: With the baseline readings recorded, Climatologist Skyleaf is ready to begin delving into the composition and properties of the crystals created by the Eldan terraformer. He's asked you to take samples from the interior of the crystals in the Crystalline Waste.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Climatologist Skyleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're ready to start analyzing the crystals. That might reveal how the terraformer manipulated primal power. Take some crystal samples with this plasma saw.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can't analyze those samples until you get them. Go out into the Crystalline Waste and use the plasma saw to harvest some!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Weave! I've never seen anything like these crystals before... it's as if they were created instantaneously from pure primal energy!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I need to determine how long this area's been exposed to all that energy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Climatologist Skyleaf begin the process of gathering and testing the giant crystals created by the energy pouring from the Eldan terraformer. Perhaps the crystals will help the XAS to better understand how Eldan technology manipulates primal power.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't see why you wouldn't want to be a part of this discovery.

localizedTextIdText: With the baseline readings recorded, Geologist Lochron is ready to begin delving into the composition and properties of the fire crystals created by the Eldan terraformer. He's asked you to take samples from the crystals in the Scorched Expanse.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Geologist Lochron via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These fire crystals are perplexing. Use a plasma saw to take samples from them so that I can analyze their internal structure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the plasma saw to collect fire crystal samples in the Scorched Expanse. The sooner you do, the sooner I can analyze them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The internal structure of these crystals reveals they were formed nigh-instantaneously. Fascinating. This will require additional testing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I must know the fundamentals of how the terraformer manipulates primal power.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Geologist Lochron begin the process of gathering and testing the giant crystals created by the energy pouring from the Eldan terraformer. Perhaps the crystals will help the Collegium to better understand how Eldan technology manipulates primal power.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your chances of survival are lowered every time you refuse me.

localizedTextIdText: Climatologist Skyleaf at Crystal Spire Lab has asked you to place grounding rods in the Crystalline Waste in an effort to shield XAS researchers from lightning.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Climatologist Skyleaf via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To protect our researchers in the field, I need you to place grounding rods near primal vents. The rods should protect us from lightning strikes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We won't have a respite from the lightning in this area until you place those grounding rods. I'd appreciate it if you'd hop to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I feel better about sending my researchers into the field now that the grounding rods are in place. Thanks for risking your life to set them up.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We've suffered too many lightning-related casualties. Something must be done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You placed grounding rods in the Crystalline Waste. These fixtures are sure to prevent damage or death caused by the frequent lightning strikes in the area.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sure, I know the task is dangerous, but come on! You're tough, right?

localizedTextIdText: The heat in the field is unbearable, and Geologist Lochron researchers are at risk of succumbing to the high temperatures. He's asked you to place remote cooling units near primal vents in the Scorched Expanse to give his team some relief.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Geologist Lochron via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The elevated temperatures in the Scorched Expanse threaten my research teams. Place remote cooling units near Primal Vents to give them some relief.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sooner the remote cooling units are placed near the primal vents, the sooner my team's heat-related casualties will cease.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your actions were adequate. Though temperatures are still high, they are within the acceptable range.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure you are not incinerated. The Expanse is a deadly place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You succeeded in placing remote cooling units near the primal vents in the Scorched Expanse. Geologist Lochron has commended you on a job well done, especially given that no more of his researchers will end up "well done" as a result.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am not a patient being. I will only tolerate insubordination for so long.

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a crate with Eldan relics inside. Researcher Starland at Crystal Spire Lab would be interested in these, as well as any others you can find. Search the Crystalline Waste for more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Starland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are Eldan relics in this crate. From the looks of them, they've been here for a long, long time. You reckon Researcher Starland might want them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There are Eldan relics in this crate. From the looks of them, they've been here for a long, long time. You reckon Researcher Starland might want them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sure the Eldan probably left some goodies scattered around the Crystalline Waste. Stars, I'd love to get my hands on some of 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wow, $(player.name)! Are all these relics for me? It's like my birthday, 'cept it ain't.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're alright, ya know that?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll search the area for more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the lost relics you found to Researcher Starland at Crystal Spire Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll search the area for more.

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a crate with Eldan relics inside. Researcher Prollos at Sikabis Field Lab would be interested in these, as well as any others you can find. Search the Scorched Expanse for more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Prollos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are Eldan relics in this crate. From the looks of them, they've been here for a long, long time. You reckon Researcher Prollos might want them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There are Eldan relics in this crate. From the looks of them, they've been here for a long, long time. You reckon Researcher Prollos might want them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I would much rather be at a dig in a more comfortable locale. There'd be plenty of artifacts and relics there. I doubt such things can be found here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Why... you found these in the Expanse? And you are giving them to me? How extraordinary. I thank you as only the highborn can thank you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll search the area for more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took the lost relics you found to Researcher Prollos at Sikabis Field Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll search the area for more.

localizedTextIdText: You've found a set of abandoned emergency jetpacks normally issued to XAS researchers operating in the Crystalline Waste. You should look for trapped researchers and distribute the jetpacks to any that need help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Starland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These jetpacks are standard-issue emergency items given to XAS researchers. If you distribute them to researchers in need, you might save some lives.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If ya found any emergency jetpacks in the middle of the Crystalline Waste, there's probably a researcher or two out there who can use a rescue.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Reckon I thought I'd never see some o' them folks again. You did a good thing gettin' 'em those jetpacks. We can't leave anyone behind in this place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to rescue trapped researchers in the Crystalline Waste by making sure they had access to emergency jetpacks. If not for your help, these researchers might never have found their way back to Crystal Spire Lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find them and save them.

localizedTextIdText: You've found a set of abandoned emergency jetpacks normally issued to Collegium researchers operating in the Scorched Expanse. You should look for trapped researchers and distribute the jetpacks to any that need help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Prollos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These jetpacks are standard-issue emergency items given to Collegium researchers. If you distribute them to researchers in need, you might save some lives.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you find any emergency jetpacks in the middle of the Expanse, there are likely researchers in the vicinity that can use a rescue.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We had written off many of the researchers you rescued. Every researcher we lose weakens the Dominion's effectiveness in this beastly oven of a land.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to rescue trapped researchers in the Scorched Expanse by making sure they had access to emergency jetpacks. If not for your help, these researchers might never have found their way back to Sikabis Field Lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find them and save them.

localizedTextIdText: A massive air elemental, Stormfury, continues to absorb primal energy from the Eldan terraformer. If it's not stopped, the dangerous elemental will prevent the XAS from conducting further experiments in the Crystalline Waste.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Starland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a powerful elemental we call Stormfury. It's gettin' more powerful by the minute, and we're worried it might drive our team out of the waste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stormfury's out there, on the edge of the waste. Ya better track it down and lay it low before it comes lookin' for us!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya saved us a lotta hurt and a lotta wasted time. Without yer help, we would've had to pull out of here and abandon our research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I reckon if anyone can take that elemental out, it's you. Fingers crossed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks again. Ya been a real friend to the XAS crew out here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and defeated Stormfury before it could force the XAS research team to withdraw from the Crystalline Waste. Everyone at the XAS camp, including Researcher Starland, is incredibly relieved.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The future of our research rests on this. You can't turn your back on us!

localizedTextIdText: A massive fire elemental, Firebreather, continues to absorb primal energy from the Eldan terraformer. If it's not stopped, the dangerous elemental will prevent the Collegium from conducting further experiments in the Scorched Expanse.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Researcher Prollos at Sikabis Field Lab and let her know that you've defeated the Scorched Firebreather
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A powerful fire elemental, known as "Firebreather" by the plebs, draws power from the terraformer. You must eliminate this threat while you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That damned elemental will incinerate this camp in an instant if you are unable to destroy it. Go, now, and ensure Firebreather does not get the chance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done the work of Dominus, $(player.name). Sikabis Field Lab is in your debt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Collegium will be forced to evacuate this camp if you fail. Do not fail!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Farewell, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located and defeated Firebreather before it could force the Collegium research team to withdraw from the Scorched Expanse. Everyone at the Collegium camp, including Researcher Prollos, is incredibly relieved.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Just as I suspected originally... you are both weak and craven.

localizedTextIdText: You found an Eldan glyph fragment amongst the remains of an XT-9 augmentor. The fragment radiates energy, pulsing as you move in a specific direction. Perhaps it's a broken fragment that's part of a nearby artifact in the Windfall Digsite.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Priestess Severina at the Collegium Basecamp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This curious fragment of an Eldan glyph resonates with energy and seems to glow brighter when pointed in a specific direction. Where will it lead you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That is an Eldan glyph fragment. There should be a way to repair it by fitting it into the artifact where it belongs. Take care not to damage it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Scions be praised! This glyph is a message from the Eldan to meditate on the strength of Azrion during our vigils! You are truly a tool of the gods!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Search for other glyphs here. Each will reflect one of our six virtues.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see where it takes me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've returned the complete glyph to Priestess Severina of the Vigilant Church. Severina's convinced that the glyph reflects the Vigilant Virtue of strength, and that there may be more such glyphs in the digsite.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion military transport ship Fist of Azrion has been shot down in Grimvault by the Strain. Nerissa Artan, a survivor aboard the ship, has hailed all Dominion citizens in the area with a plea for help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Nerissa Artan inside the Fist of Azrion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Emergency! The Fist of Azrion is down! I repeat! The Fist of Azrion is down! All Dominion personnel, proceed to my coordinates immediately!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can you not see, citizen? This is a grave emergency!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased you've come, $(player.name)... and not a moment too soon. There are citizens to rescue and abominations to kill.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lives are at stake! You would do best not to tarry!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We haven't much time.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I got here as fast as I could.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The military transport ship Fist of Azrion was shot down in Grimvault by the Strain. Radiant Legionnaire Nerissa Artan survived the crash, and insisted there was rescuing and Strain-killing to do before she would leave. Luckily, these goals fell into your area of expertise.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I promise, I will hunt you down and take your head for this.

localizedTextIdText: Some of the Eldan constructs around the Windfall Digsite are carrying glyph fragments. Search any Eldan constructs you defeat, for Priestess Severina of the Vigilant Church believes each fragment represents one of the Vigilant Virtues.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Priestess Severina at the Collegium Basecamp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan constructs in the digsite may carry more of the glyph fragments you found, one for each virtue. Recover them and return them to the church.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Eldan constructs are sure to be carrying more Eldan glyph fragments. If you collect them, the church shall see them restored.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I will see these fragments restored, thus bringing the light of truth to us all. You have done the Vigilant Church a great service, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May the virtues strengthen your spirit, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Walk the path of the Scions and you will never be lost.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've recovered all six of the Eldan glyph fragments at the Windfall Digsite, one for each of the Vigilant Virtues. Priestess Severina seems grateful for your help, as the fragments certainly held powerful Eldan secrets.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not turn your back on the light of truth.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest wants you to terminate any Skurge in the area. Each of the Skurge you encounter is a threat to the Dominion that must be dealt with at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This phase of the operation is classified as wetwork. You will locate Skurge targets in Spineridge Nest and eliminate them. Is that clear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Skurge still pose a significant threat in this sector. Seek them out and destroy them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have reviewed footage of your struggles against the Skurge. Your ability has evolved since you first came to the attention of the ICI.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect you to display both swiftness and lethality in equal measure.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can assure you this mission will come to an end... but not yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You terminated any Skurge that crossed your path at Spineridge Nest, thereby earning Agent Lex acclaim for your swift and lethal actions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What are the Skurge doing in Spineridge Nest?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: These Skurge continue to show interest in the Eldan machines and devices in the area. They may be altering them somehow, but I do not know what they hope to accomplish.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your continued existence is contingent on this mission's success.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest has given you a mission to collect bio-phage samples from the Spineridge Agents and their minions infesting the Corrupted Installation. Data must be collected before proceeding further into Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We suspect the Skurge are also hosts for bio-phage, and we wish to gauge their virulence. As you work, collect bio-phage samples from them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We still need those bio-phage samples. Collect them at once or I will reconsider your value as an agent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Try not to be alarmed, but the bio-phage samples you've collected are even more virulent than those from other Strain sources.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mercy is not required. Then again, is it ever?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You had best decontaminate thoroughly when your duty here is done.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Did I get any on me?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected the $m(vitem=1073) from the Skurge in Spineridge Nest, determining that the bio-phage infecting them is even more virulent than was previously thought.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you more afraid of the Skurge? Or of me?

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest wants you to gather information about the techno-phage that has infected the Corrupted Installation. Analyzing its structure may help prevent it from spreading across Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have never encountered the techno-phage before. Collect techno-phage samples from corrupted Eldan constructs for the Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If the techno-phage can infect machinery and constructs, it may have similar effects on my people. This is a disturbing thought.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Techno-phage sample data received. The Royal Collegium plans to analyze it immediately. I find the concept of the techno-phage to be... unsettling.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Send me the data once it is collected. The Collegium is not patient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As do I. Thank you for your continued service.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope you can make something of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The techno-phage - a Strain virus capable of infecting computers and machinery - represents a potent new threat. To aid in the Dominion's analysis of the techno-phage, you collected samples for Agent Lex in the Corrupted Installation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Much as the Strain is similar to a biological virus, the techno-phage appears to be similar to a computer virus. As we have observed, it is capable of infected Eldan devices.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The answer to your query should be obvious. Should it spread to Dominion settlements, our computers, machines, and bots - and perhaps other Mechari - will turn against us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Agents have gone missing for less.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest has told you to blow up the corrupted generators powering the Corrupted Installation. Only then will the Phage Cannon stop firing at the wall.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If we are to quiet the Phage Cannon and preserve Grimvault's walls, you must locate the weapon's generators in the installation and overload them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Each shot fired at the wall may be the one that destroys it. This threat is too dire to ignore. Return at once and destroy the cannon generators.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Phage Cannon is no longer firing. You have earned a reprieve for the walls that surround Grimvault, but I gauge it is temporary at best.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Cutting the power to the cannon is our only hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Of course. Now we will put the Phage Cannon out of commission... permanently.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Then we need to do more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew up the generators in the Corrupted Facility, shutting down the Phage Cannon and preventing further attacks on the walls of Grimvault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If Grimvault's walls are destroyed due to your incompetence, I will kill you.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex at Spineridge Nest has revealed that you must gain direct access to the Corrupted Installation's command center if you plan to destroy the Phage Cannon for good.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must deny this facility to the Strain. I require you to gain access to the installation's command center so you can destroy the Phage Cannon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: From the command center, you should be able to overload the Phage Cannon. The teleporter you must take is liable to be guarded, however.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are near to taking the final steps towards this operation's inevitable conclusion. Are you ready for the final countdown?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It goes without saying that this task is critical.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is a shame it took the ICI so long to isolate your talents.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In order to gain direct access to the Corrupted Installation's command center, you defeated the corrupted command construct that barred your way. Soon this terrible place will be little more than a memory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will regret this decision.

localizedTextIdText: Before you storm the castle, you must first conquer the Kel Ulgar Courtyard. Adventurer Kiyai would like you to lay to rest the mindless Soulslaves created by the Osun.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Adventurer Kiyai via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Poor Soulslaves! Big Ulgar uglies capture travelers, use Soulrot to make them mindless. Soulslaves must be killed - no cure for dead mind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Leaving soulslaves alive is worst kind of torture. Must kill them, give them peace.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You kill soulslaves? Being mindless slave way worse than death!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Soulrot magic scary stuff, but we gotta be brave!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: It's the humane thing to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped lay to rest the mindless Soulslaves created by the Osun around the Kel Ulgar Courtyard.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What are you doing all the way out here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How's it going so far?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: What are you trying to accomplish?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We part of Marshal Yatish fan club! Step one: protect people! Step three: get shinies! Lopp... may not have figured out step two yet.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Marshal Yatish is a great Lopp Hero. He fights bad things and makes Lopp safe! We start fan club, go on adventures like great Lopp hero! Maybe pick up some shinies on the way.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Lots of Lopp in the fan club. Kiyai oversee operation from here. Sometimes leader has to be responsible first, have fun later.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Marshal Yatish is brave and has many great adventures. Adventure means danger, but friends mean help! Now that you're here, everything will be great!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Osun are dangerous for Lopp, $(player.race), everybody in Wilderrun! If Marshal Yatish were here, he'd beat them all up, make this place safe! So that's what Kiyai want to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You leave your friends with the Osun?

localizedTextIdText: The Osun have found the Lopp's greatest weakness: loud sound. Adventurer Kiyai cannot think with all that drumming racket! She's asked you to destroy the Osun drums around the Kel Ulgar Courtyard.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Adventurer Kiyai via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Osun found Lopp weakness: incessant drumming! Destroy War Drums so Kiyai can think straight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kiyai still hear drums. Why Lopp still hear drums?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whew! Much better. Now, let castle storming begin!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kiyai normally okay with loud sounds, but drums never stop!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can barely hear myself think.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Osun drums destroyed in the Kel Ulgar Courtyard, Adventurer Kiyai can plan out the storming of the castle in peace and quiet.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Because I haven't destroyed them yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sorry, Lopp not hear you because of constant drumming!

localizedTextIdText: If the Osun don't have weapons, it'll make it harder for them to fight. Adventurer Kiyai wants you to blow up Ulgar weapon racks which can be found near the forges of Kel Ulgar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Adventurer Kiyai via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Osun not so tough without big weapons. Smash Osun weapon racks into little pieces!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you not done smashing weapon racks down in big Osun fort? You get splinter? Need Lopp to get big tweezers?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Destroying weapons is a good start.  But to really slow Uglies down, Forgemaster must die.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch for splinters!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Adventurer Kiyai rattle the Osun forces by blowing up the Kel Ulgar Weapon Racks near the forges of Kel Ulgar.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing Lopp bad for your wallet.

localizedTextIdText: Adventurer Kiyai knows the best way to get at the enemy is to bruise their egos. She has asked you to kill the strongest enemies Kel Ulgar has to offer, the Skullcrushers and Bruisers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Adventurer Kiyai via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bigger tree is, harder tree fall. Skullcrushers and Bruisers are the biggest, baddest Osun in Kel Ulgar! Find biggest trees, make them fall.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You not done stabbing and killing Skullcrushers and Bruisers? Kiyai thought you were a hero.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How Skullcrushers and Bruisers doing?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp laugh in faces of big uglies... once they on the ground.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ha! Kiyai likes you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Adventurer Kiyai take down the champions of Kel Ulgar, the Skullcrushers and Bruisers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk shaking like little leaf. Don't be little leaf, be big tree cutter!

localizedTextIdText: Just breaking the weapons of the enemy is not enough. Adventurer Kiyai has asked you to kill Kel Ulgar's Forgemaster Kraagor and bring production to a halt.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Adventurer Kiyai via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Forgemaster keeps forgers working day and night making weapons. To stop weapons, must retire forgemaster. Permanently.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you get lost? Go into big fort, turn left, keep going till you see the biggest meanie with a hammer. That's forgemaster... can't miss him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You killed forgemaster? Wow, you can do anything, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Time to turn up heat!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: One pink slip, coming right up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Breaking the weapon racks of Kel Ulgar was just a stepping stone to Forgemaster Kraagor. Killing him will keep the Osun weapon production at a minimum.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll bring production to a halt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So simple, just kill one Osun. What the big deal?

localizedTextIdText: Shinequester Meechi called you to let you know that Shinequester Andro has been captured! Meechi has asked you to free Andro, preferably before he's turned into a soulslave. His cage is about halfway up the stairs inside of Kel Ulgar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Shinequester Andro on the Ulgar Skybridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Big uglies attack, have Andro locked up. You have to save friend Andro!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Big uglies come, take Andro. Friendly pumera help protect Meechi, but couldn't save Andro. Please, go find, make safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Free captives! Make sure nobody gets made into soulslaves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Andro find good hiding place, can spy on uglies and not get caught again! Glad to hear others make it out. Isn't being a hero great?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry, before big meanies make Andro soulslave!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Andro stay here, help $(player.name) by keeping a lookout.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Shinequester Andro and the other captives escape their cages and their fate as soulslaves. The Osun of Kel Ulgar will have to do their own dirty work for a change.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If Andro become soulslave, you will answer to Meechi!

localizedTextIdText: Shinequester Andro wants you to kill the Ulgar Slavemaker and Ulgar Overlord who create the soulrot slaves in Kel Ulgar so they can't hurt anyone else.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Shinequester Andro on the Ulgar Skybridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Slavemakers and Overlords must pay for evil deeds. Gotta stop uglies from hurting anyone else!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Slavemakers and Overlords are the meanest of the mean. Go, kill some more, quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: First comes blood, then comes treasure. Andro stay rich, forever and ever!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Marshal Yatish always stop bad guys when they hurt Lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Combine treasure hunt with killing big uglies. Best of both worlds.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You're a poet and didn't know it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Restitution has been delivered to Shinequester Andro in the form of blood, courtesy of a few dead Ulgar Slavemaker and Ulgar Overlord.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So this 'Marshal Yatish' fights bad guys?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Revenge is dish best served with treasure, but stopping Slavemakers and Overlords more important now! Maybe shinies come after, though.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh yes! Marshal Yatish go places where Lopp are in danger, make the danger run away! Maybe someday you go to dangerous place, meet up with him!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Andro locked up, kicked, hit, ears pulled, and you still no help Andro?!

localizedTextIdText: Adventurer Kiyai wants the icky soulrot canisters inside Kel Ulgar destroyed. She's asked you to throw grenades at them from a distance to keep out of harm's way.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Adventurer Kiyai on the Ulgar Skybridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Soulrot is nasty stuff. Stay far away, toss grenades into barrels so no one else get soulrotted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know soulrot is bad and scary, but Lopp can't let anybody else gets hurt. Destroy barrels in Kel Ulgar, be big hero!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How you feeling $(player.class)? Kiyai decided to sneak in quiet and careful, make sure you doing okay.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No worry! You come back looking like soulslave, Kiyai be sure to kill you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good! If you got hurt, Kiyai would be sad forever.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to destroy Kel Ulgar's stash of soulrot canisters with grenades. Luckily, you were safe and Adventurer Kiyai did not have to kill you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My kurg braver than you. Smarter, too.

localizedTextIdText: Adventurer Kiyai has learned that three Ulgar Brewsisters are making the soulrot up on Kel Ulgar's Castletop, near the big tree. These vile creatures must be stopped from making this strange brew!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Adventurer Kiyai via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Osun brewsisters are mixing soulrot brew! Watch out, it will stick to you. Climb to the top, and they'll be through!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Climb to the top, take out Brewsisters. Destroy source of soulrot, then everybody be safe... and Lopp be free to take treasure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You just beat the Brewsisters! What you want to do next?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They up top of castle near big tree with water all around.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lopp be waiting for you! Big hero-type adventurer, always welcome here!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Maybe I'll head back to the treehouse.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Adventurer Kiyai by killing the Ulgar Brewsisters who were on Kel Ulgar's Castletop. With these vile witches gone, no more soulrot will be brewed at Kel Ulgar.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: You sure the Osun won't find you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Kiyai wanted to do some real adventuring! Snuck all the way to the top, saw Brewsisters making nasty soulrot stuff.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Boxes good hiding places. Lopp are good at being sneaky spies, make sure Osun uglies don't spot us!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Yep yep. Osun not smart. Kiyai used box to sneak all over, find out where Osun bosses are. Now $(player.name) can kill all the biggest baddest uglies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Kiyai will not be ignored!

localizedTextIdText: Adventurer Kiyai wants you to destroy the biggest Osun in Ulgar, Drognar the Pulverizer. Defeating him will surely earn the fan club members a pat on the back from Marshal Yatish. Drognar the Pulverizer can be found on Kel Ulgar's Castletop..
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Adventurer Kiyai at Marshal's Haven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ulgar leader Drognar the Pulverizer is at top of castle. He sit high and mighty on his throne. Kiyai say grind him to dust.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Drognar not going to kill himself! Unless he slip and fall off Ulgar tower... but Lopp not that lucky! Better kill him yourself to be safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks to you! You help Lopp in BIG way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Today, we be big heroes. Mostly you, but some us!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Kiyai be sure to tell Marshal about you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the behest of Adventurer Kiyai, you ground Drognar the Pulverizer into dust. The Yatish fan club will hit the hookahs hard tonight back at Marshal's Haven in celebration of this great victory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Awww, big-folk scared of big ugly.

localizedTextIdText: Shinequester Meechi is upset about the Kel Ulgar beastmasters' cruel treatment of the pumera. She's asked you set these hungry pumera free so they can eat something... like the Osun!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Shinequester Meechi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Poor pumera! They look hungry and sad! Kitties need to eat. If $(player.name) set them free, maybe they eat mean Osun.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Done freeing kitties from uglies yet? How about now? Sad kitties are waiting for you to free them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look, Meechi got a kitty! Thank you for helping her! She so happy with lots of Osun in tummy!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ulgar uglies think twice before hurting kitties again.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Meechi name her Miss Softpaws. Was either that, or Miss Purrpurr.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I have no problem with that.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope she doesn't like eating Lopp.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Osun of Kel Ulgar were shown what happens when you deprive animals of food. Eventually, you become the meal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What are you doing in here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lopp studying to be adventuring heroes! Just beginner now. Lopp sneak in, find things that need doing. Then more experienced heroes help out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You hate kitties too? Then Lopp think you stink.

localizedTextIdText: Shinequester Andro knows that making weapons is hard work. He asks you to make work for the forgers even harder by planting explosives on the forges of Kel Ulgar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Shinequester Meechi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yatish always say fire useful, fire shiny. Andro like fire and explosions too! Made some bombs for sneakyfolk to put in forges... then boom!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Yatish always say that bad folks rely on weapons to make them feel strong and brave. Blow up forges, then the uglies not so strong!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Andro likes fire, just like Marshal Yatish! Fire distracts baddies so Lopp can start grabbing shinies. Put bombs in forges! Fun and profitable!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Something very, very bad, $(player.name)! Andro caught by Slavemakers!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Andro has a date with shinies, heh! Call Andro when you finished!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have brought weapon production to a halt in Kel Ulgar by destroying its forges.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about these bombs.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How does blowing up the forges help?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Andro made them! Put them down, set timer, hop away! Very useful for quick Lopp feet.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Osun carefully keep fire at one temperature, carefully forge metal. Bombs ruin all that!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How hard can it be? Plant bomb and then boom!

localizedTextIdText: Shinequester Andro was only caught because he was spotted by one of the guards up in the towers of Kel Ulgar. He would like you to clear out the guard posts along the wall to prevent further complications.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Shinequester Andro via Datachron and let him know that Kel Ulgar is ripe for the picking.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Andro never get caught before! Now, Andro will protect other Lopp, make sure they not get caught. Do Lopp a favor, clear out guard towers?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If Marshall Yatish were here, he'd clear out guards, make sure nobody else get caught. You're a big hero, you can do that, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wow, you did a good job! It was all like Bam! Smash! Clobber! Now all Lopp free to shinequest in peace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yatish always protects Lopp so they can shinequest in peace.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ulgar is Andro's for taking, heh!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Why are Lopp favors always so dangerous?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yeah, pretty much all dead yeah
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the guard towers clear of Osun, Shinequester Andro can do just that, shinequest. Kel Ulgar is about to get renovated the Lopp way. It's all got to go!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Shinequester Andro via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You afraid of heights?

localizedTextIdText: You have come across a barrel of Soulrot in the middle of a bunch of dead explorers in Kel Ulgar. Adventurer Kiyai has asked you to bring it back to her, the Mordesh and Chua will pay handsomely for a sample of this.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Adventurer Kiyai via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Look like explorers tried to get canister of soulrot out of Ulgar. Killed by Soulrot slaves.  Seal up leaking canister and bring to Kiyai.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can do it! I believe in you! Hurry up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Big shipment lots of canisters! Eh, so? How you feeling?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mordesh and Chua pay Lopp big shinies for this!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not soulslave? Good news!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm fine, stop looking at me like that...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to seal the leaking canister of soulrot that you found in Kel Ulgar and return it to Adventurer Kiyai.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yeah? Well you not only kurg in field.

localizedTextIdText: You've come across an explorer journal near the top of Kel Ulgar. The last entry appears to contain some of the possible ingredients used to make soulrot. Victor Lazarin has requested that you return this journal to him immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring Explorer Underwood's Journal to Victor Lazarin who is at Research Camp Echo.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The journal contains a list of ingredients used in the Osun soulrot mixture, as well as some rough notes on brewing practices.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah Soulrot, a malevolent mixture of injurious ingredients. While I am loath to delve too deeply into its secrets, all knowledge is valuable.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This journal will be carefully catalogued. For now, there are more promising avenues to explore in Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Victor Lazarin would be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned the explorer journal you recovered from Kel Ulgar to Victor Lazarin. For a second, you almost thought you saw him flash the smallest of grins. Only for a second though.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Explorer Underwood's Journal to Victor Lazarin

localizedTextIdText: You've come across an explorer journal near the top of Kel Ulgar. The last entry appears to contain some of the possible ingredients used to make soulrot. Mondo Zax has requested that you return this journal to him immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax in Rotwood Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This journal contains a list of ingredients used in the Osun soulrot mixture, as well as some rough notes on brewing practices.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This journal contains a list of ingredients used in the Osun soulrot mixture, as well as some rough notes on brewing practices.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got journal? Mondo's sure it contains all sorts of nasty Osun secrets. Time for mixing and melting and experimenting!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ha ha! Yes, Mondo has an idea or two... or fifty-seven!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Mondo Zax will probably want this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You turned over the explorer journal you recovered from Kel Ulgar to Mondo Zax. The twinkle in Zax's eyes was almost visible.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Mondo Zax will probably want this.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Goldspring is grateful for your help but has no more work for you. She's asked you to check in with Belle Walker down in Woodview Field Lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Belle Walker at the Woodview Field Lab
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've done a wonderful job! I wish you could stay, but I know Belle Walker was hoping to get some help down in the Woodview Field Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I feel like I could just chat with you all day, but I think Belle is waiting for you. You better get going.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Goldspring sent ya? Great! 'Cause I could use the help, sugar! Leapin' laserbeams, you won't believe what we've found down here...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, Belle. Knowing her, she's probably knee-deep in some kind of trouble.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What do ya know about the Eldan and primal energy?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Belle Walker who, as usual, is poking her head into Eldan technology that should really be left alone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Well, I guess someone will come along and help Belle eventually.

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker has been poking around Bio-Dome 3 and has discovered several Eldan data cores in the Adaptation Research Annex. She's asked you to aid her research by setting up a data uplink at the Geo-Analysis Node.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was pokin' around with Rusty and Bolt and we found a bunch of Eldan data core clusters. Think you can set up a data uplink to each core, honey?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Each of the data cores corresponds with a primal element. You're gonna have to set up data links with all three if I'm to get the info I need.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That uplink worked like a charm. I'm takin' a whirl through the data right now. Looks like the Eldan were doin' some fancy stuff with primal earth energy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let's start with the Geo-Analysis Node.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I guess a bio-dome is the best place to do this sorta thing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully set up a data uplink at the Geo-Analysis Node for Belle Walker. After testing the effects of the primal energy, Belle Walker thought it was best to disable the core.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If you can set up the link at the core, I can work some magic on my end and sift through all the data the Eldan have locked up in 'em. Who knows what we'll find!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sure you're here to help? 'Cause that ain't what's happenin'.

localizedTextIdText: One of Belle's bots, Rusty, has informed you that an Eldan security system in the Adaptation Research Annex may cause problems for both you and Belle Walker. Find a way to disable the security system.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Rusty via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Belle's so excited about these data cores, she might have forgot to tell you about the security system. You might want to find a way to disable it...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You disable that security system yet over by the Eldan research annex? I'd hate for someone, especially Belle, to walk into that accidentally!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The security system went into total lockdown? I'll have to keep working at it. I hope we haven't triggered anything.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks! After all, someone's got to keep an eye out for Belle.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You attempted to disable the Eldan security system, but were locked out. Rusty is going to keep working at unlocking the system, but is slightly worried this may have triggered a greater reaction from the bio-dome's defensive system.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That security system could still blast you to pieces...

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker was excited about the information that you were able to extract from the Geo-Analysis Node in the Adaptation Research Lab. Now she wants you to set a up a link at the Bio-Analysis Node.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got a lot of useful information about the Eldan from the Geo-Analysis Node. Now we need to research the Bio-Analysis Node. Can you head over there next?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You jump into any of those primal energy streams up at the Eldan research annex yet? I need that data real bad and you're the only one who'll do it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That wasn't so bad, was it? Just think, you mighta been turned into a rock or a pumera or somethin', but instead you got results for me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd do it myself, sugar, but I'm stuck monitorin' your results.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Looks like these critters have been enhanced by this energy over the years.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope it was worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully set up a data uplink at the Bio-Analysis Node for Belle Walker, personally tested the effects of the dome's primal energy, and finally disabled the core after Belle Walker had all the information she needed.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Am I? Well... I guess I'll do it, then.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey! Where's your sense of scientific exploration?

localizedTextIdText: The last data core is at the Hydro-Analysis Node in the Adaptation Research Lab. Belle Walker is eagerly awaiting the information from this core.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Well, $(player.name), there's one more core left to dig through. Head on over to the Hydro-Analysis Node and get that link up and runnin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: C'mon, $(player.name). That last link ain't gonna upload itself into my data banks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's the last of 'em, darlin'. Bless my stars, there's a lot of data! I'll be runnin' through this data for days.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These elementals are scarin' off the researchers. Can't have that.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now I'll be able to paint a picture of what the Eldan were up to in this jungle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully set up a data uplink at the Hydro-Analysis Node, tested the effects of the dome's primal energy, and then disabled the core.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, what happened to Exiles stickin' together?

localizedTextIdText: Belle Walker at the Woodview Field Lab has asked you eliminate the Bio-Dome 3 Custodian inside Primary Security Matrix E2400 and deactivate the Matrix Defense Console E.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The sudden power cut has got the attention of a big ol' custodian. That junk heap's guardin' the defense console we need to access. Wanna help me out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I got nothin' else for ya. The task ain't that complicated. We need to access that defense console, and that custodian's in our way. Take it out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That appears to be the last remainin' threat in this place. The rest of our research should be a breeze, all thanks to you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch yourself. That custodian ain't exactly a fun playmate, honey.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I owe ya a big one, sugar.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The threat inside Primary Security Matrix E2400 has been resolved. Belle Walker at the Woodview Field Lab has expressed her gratitude for all of your efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: C'mon, $(player.name)! We're all countin' on you!

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Zarok at the Woodview Field Lab has asked you to destroy elemental Embodiments in the Adaptation Research Annex.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Zarok via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These big, ugly elementals are puttin' a kink in Belle's research. We gotta show 'em that we're in charge of this place. Think ya can handle that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You ain't done yet! Get crackin'! Those elementals is trouble, buddy, and we need 'em cleared out. You got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good smashin', $(player.name). There's always more nasty crap to kill, though.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Up and at 'em, then! I want those elementals destroyed, pronto!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed elementals in the Adaptation Research Annex for Sergeant Zarok at the Woodview Field Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I ain't one for fancy words. Either shape up or ship out!

localizedTextIdText: You found an Experimental Console in the Adaptation Research Annex. Belle Walker at the Woodview Field Lab would be interested in what it's used for.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This console appears to control this massive Eldan structure. Activate the console and investigate the structure to discover its purpose.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This console appears to control this massive Eldan structure. Activate the console and investigate the structure to discover its purpose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have ya figured out what that place is used for, sugar? Try pushin' buttons or somethin' until ya figure it out. That always works for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Why would the Eldan want to synthesize hostile creatures? That's kind of weird, don't ya think?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't get snippy, $(player.name). Science can be a dangerous game.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I didn't have time to ask them questions.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You survived the onslaught of hostile creatures and reported back to Belle Walker at the Woodview Field Lab.

localizedTextIdText: Bolt at the Woodview Field Lab has asked you to use a vortex bomb to capture some of the elemental essences and aspects that are around the Adaptation Research Annex.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bolt via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Elemental essences are moving about the jungle floor. Belle wants some of those for her research. A vortex bomb should help you gather the essences.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you? Stupid or something? Just throw that vortex bomb near the elemental essences and gather them up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, look. My hero, and still alive to boot. I'm somewhat surprised you survived, but I guess that's good for you. Plus, you got the essences.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If this is like Belle's other schemes, there's a good chance you'll die.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Belle might be grateful for your work. I'm certainly not.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go round up a few.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured elemental essences and aspects for Bolt at the Woodview Field Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe you will be more inclined at another time, but I doubt it.

localizedTextIdText: You found a destroyed scanbot near the Adaptation Research Annex. Search the grounds for bots that can be repaired and utilized for Belle Walker research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This scanbot has been destroyed and is beyond repair. Perhaps there are other scanbots around the area that can still be salvaged.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This scanbot has been destroyed and is beyond repair. Perhaps there are other scanbots around the area that can still be salvaged.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're missin' a whole slew of scanbots, honey. Got no idea what happened to 'em, either. Maybe ya can go out and see if ya can find any.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, that's fantastic! These bots'll be a big help with my work here. The more the merrier, I say! Thanks, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't mention it, but Rusty gets a bit jealous when I talk to other bots.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You repaired scanbots for Belle Walker so she can use them to aid in her research.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let's see what I can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can dig up.

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Cliffbreeze has asked you to use the $(vitem=758) to reach the top of the Adaptation Research Annex and investigate the upper platform.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Cliffbreeze via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: One of our scanbots found an Eldan cache. How'd you like to go investigate it for me. Only problem is, it's located on a platform way up above us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You figure the charge retractor out? Point it at one of the charge targets and let it fly. It'll take you where you want to go. Plus, it's fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, $(player.name). That was quite a display of Exile tenacity. It doesn't pay to give up before the game is over, does it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Here's a charge retractor. Shoot a charge target with it and it'll take you there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found an Eldan cache on the upper platform of the Adaptation Research Annex. The Explorers Union is going to have a field day with it.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I haven't figured it out yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're not afraid of heights, are you?

localizedTextIdText: The XAS is leading a research effort to uncover the secrets of Alpha Complex and its associated Eldan facilities. Researcher Dunfield has asked you to meet with Dorian Walker, the leader of the Exile expedition. Travel through the teleporter at Walker's Landing and speak with Dorian Walker in Alpha Complex.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker inside Alpha Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The teleporter behind me leads down to Alpha Complex, where the XAS has set up shop. Head down there and speak with Dorian Walker, right away.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What do you mean, you haven't talked to Dorian yet? What did you come here for if you didn't intend to pitch in? Step on that teleporter pad, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Just arrived, have ya, cappy? Did Dunfield tell ya they tried to name the landing site after me? It's a nice thought and all, but it ain't necessary.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: What are you waitin' for? Head on down into Alpha Complex.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Famous? Maybe I am, but that don't mean I gotta act like the damn emperor.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've come to the surface of Farside and meet up with an XAS expedition investigating the mysterious Eldan facility known as Alpha Complex. Your contact at the landing site sent you to meet with Dorian Walker inside the complex.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll talk to him, don't worry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wait here, then. Just don't bother me none.

localizedTextIdText: Climatologist Skyleaf appreciates your help, but now he would like you to offer your assistance to Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's good you came along when you did, because we wouldn't be doing half as well if you hadn't. There's a guy at Camp Flameward you should help out next.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Camp Flameward's where you should be, and this isn't it. I already told Dominik to expect you, so you shouldn't keep him waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have never seen so many Pell in one place. How such craven creatures can continue to exist confounds me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The fellow's name is Dominik. He's Mordesh, but he's pretty cool anyway.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now that you have arrived, we must get moving.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward and discovered there are problems with a nearby Pell settlement.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Camp Flameward's in a heap of trouble. You've got to help them!

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker at Camp Flameward has instructed you to go to Flamewalker Hold and deactivate any rogue Caretaker nodes that you find. The nodes are blocking his connection to the Flamewalkers' data network.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pell are attempting to activate the terraformer. If I am to access their network, you must destroy the rogue Caretaker nodes in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is at least one rogue Caretaker node active in Flamewalker Hold. Please do me the kindness of deactivating it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that the rogue Caretaker nodes are offline, I have successfully accessed the Flamewalkers' data network. My news is not good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please be quick. The Pell may be close to flipping the proverbial switch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Flamewalkers may actually be able to start the terraformer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The rogue Caretaker nodes around Flamewalker Hold have been deactivated. The Caretaker can now turn his attention to thwarting the Flamewalkers' plan to start the terraformer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: You're the Caretaker. Can't you stop it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The terraformer is capable of transforming an entire ecosystem virtually overnight. They are powered by raw primal energy sources, usually ones found near the terrain they are terraforming.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The transformation occurs at the molecular level. Any life present during the terraform is reconstructed. We would all perish in the process.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Security protocols prevent even me from directly accessing the terraformer's network. I can monitor it, but I cannot access it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Failing to aid me will only hasten your demise.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker at Camp Flameward has instructed you to go to Flamewalker Hold and disrupt the Flamewalker summoning ritual.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flamewalkers are summoning elemental fire from their shrines. The influx of these elementals must cease. Find the shrine and halt these rituals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Flamewalkers' ritual continues. Why don't you attempt to be helpful and halt the rituals. Now, if you'd be so kind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have successfully stopped the Flamewalkers' summoning ritual. Well done. However, it may have been for naught.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The elementals are the Flamewalker's key to the terraformer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Flamewalkers have enough elemental fire to start the terraformer.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put an end to it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disrupted the Flamewalkers' summoning ritual in Flamewalker Hold. However, it appears as if your efforts were too little, too late.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I sometimes forget that your kind is combustible.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has instructed you to go to Flamewalker Hold and infect the terraformer's control points with a specially-tailored computer virus.
