localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pell have access to the terraformer grid. This cannot be permitted. Access their control points and infect them with this virus.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lacking both access and a physical body, I am unable to implant the virus. I am leaving this important task up to you. Eldan help us all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I find this amusing. Without access to the grid, the Flamewalker Pell are milling about aimlessly, as most primitive species are liable to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Spread the virus to as many control points as you can. Do be prompt.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is no sense in wasting a good opportunity to strike at them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infected the terraformer's control points in Flamewalker Hold with a computer virus. Now the Flamewalker Pell will be unable to access the terraformer.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm still looking for the control points.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How close are they to gaining control of the terraformer?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I do not know, nor do we have the luxury of waiting around to find out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This virus is paramount to stopping the Flamewalker Pell. Do not be a fool.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has ordered you to go into Flamewalker Hold, burn Flamewalker buildings, and assassinate the acolytes of the high priest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flamewalker high priest must die, but we need to kill his acolytes first. We shall also give the Pell a taste of their own fiery medicine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Set the Flamewalker buildings alight and kill the high priest's acolytes. It's simple, really. I suppose I overestimated your powers of comprehension.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Two acolytes are dead for price of one, $(player.name). Well worth the time investment. But do not put your weapons away just yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Set the buildings in Flamewalker hold on fire, but do not burn yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Flamewalker Hold, set fire to several Flamewalker buildings, and assassinated the acolytes of the high priest. The conflagration has temporarily distracted the Flamewalker Pell from their goal.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm moving as quickly as I can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Afraid of a little fire? I would have thought you would be over it by now.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has asked you to kill High Priest Flame-Guardian in Flamewalker Hold. Until he is defeated, the Flamewalker Pell will continue to pose a threat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: High Priest Flame-Guardian is the leader of these Pell. As long as he lives, the Flamewalkers will remain a threat. Your bloody task is obvious.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You confuse me, $(player.race). Is it your intention to allow the Pell to start the terraformer?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With their high priest dead, the rest of the Flamewalker Pell will scatter. I can now focus my attention on the terraformer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The high priest is formidable. Prepare for this fight or you will expire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I would offer you my heartfelt gratitude if I had a heart.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: High Priest Flame-Guardian of Flamewalker Hold is no more. With their high priest defeated, and all of the Rogue Caretaker Node deactivated, the remaining Flamewalker Pell will disperse and leave the terraformer to $~(creature=37916).
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fantastic. You have come all this way, only to fail now.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward has ordered you to go into Flamewalker Hold and eliminate Flamewalker Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Dominik via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flamewalker Pell are wicked creatures who wish to see us wither in their sacrificial fires. We must push them back while we can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are many more Flamewalkers to be extinguished. Snuff them out like candles before they mount a counterattack.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are safe... for now. There is some comfort to be taken from that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we do not strike now, we may be overrun tomorrow.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are quite capable in the ways of combat, $(player.name). Good work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Flamewalker Hold and eliminated Flamewalker Pell for Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The longer that we wait, the more dangerous our situation becomes!

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward has ordered you to go into Flamewalker Hold and use explosives to destroy Charging Flamewalker Servitor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Dominik via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flamewalkers utilize constructs to access the buried Eldan structures. Blowing them up will prevent the Pell from delving any deeper.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to use the explosives on the rest of the Flamewalker servitors. Those constructs must be destroyed or we will fail.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the servitors destroyed, the Pells' research has been drastically delayed. You have bought us valuable time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The explosives are only designed to destroy the Flamewalker servitors.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Flamewalker Hold and eliminated Charging Flamewalker Servitor for Sergeant Dominik.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Flamewalker servitors synchronize their data while they recharge, but that is when they are most vulnerable.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They must lower their defenses in order to connect to the Pell's network. They are vulnerable to the explosives during that time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lives are on the line, $(player.name). Deaths are likely if you do not help.

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Garen at Touchdown Site Bravo is in need of a competent set of hands. Head to the surface of Farside and meet up with him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corporal Garen at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey $(player.name). I heard about what ya did in that bio-dome. Not bad! I could use a skilled $(player.class) up here on the surface. Ya mind helpin'?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You're here already? That was quick.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're here already? That was quick.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to see ya. I expect you're ready for a little more action, huh? Well, this ain't the most scenic place, but it does get pretty exciting.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then get your tail up here, pronto. I'll be waitin' for ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Corporal Garen at Touchdown Site Bravo. Now it's time to get to work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Look, bub. I got some real adventure up here. You're not up for it?

localizedTextIdText: You found a Fallen Flamewalker in Flamewalker Hold. He was surrounded by broken relics that he appeared to be collecting when he was killed. Search for more Pell relics in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Dominik via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Flamewalker Pell lies here, clutching a shattered relic in his hand. Perhaps there are more relics to be found in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A Flamewalker Pell lies here, clutching a shattered relic in his hand. Perhaps there are more relics to be found in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Pell possess strange relics. Though I have little interest in such bric-a-brac, the XAS may feel differently.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These relics are interesting... but not to me. I shall pass them along to our scientists in the XAS. They may find some use in them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a collection of Flamewalker relics and took them to Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward.

localizedTextIdText: Gather a group of adventurers and kill the vile worm known as Gritmaw. Report to Sergeant Dominik at Camp Flameward when you have finished your task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Dominik via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WARNING\nThe vile worm known as Gritmaw has been spotted in Flamewalker Hold. This creature is highly dangerous and should not be faced alone.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING\nThe vile worm known as Gritmaw has been spotted in Flamewalker Hold. This creature is highly dangerous and should not be faced alone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Gritmaw is not to be taken lightly. If you wish to destroy the vile worm, you will need to find others that share your death wish.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gritmaw dead? I am skeptical... but you do appear to be somewhat worse for wear. Hm. In that case, take this reward and my congratulations.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Should I discover you have lied to me, I will find you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've vanquished the vile worm known as Gritmaw.

localizedTextIdText: It appears as if an experimental augmentation subject is now on the loose inside the XT-9 Element Augment Complex. The facility will stay locked down until the test subject has been destroyed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Open the XT-9 Facility Reserves Monitor in the XT-9 Element Augment Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WARNING: XT-9 Facility reserves will be locked down until the experimental augmentation subject is subdued. Manual subject shutdown required. Please proceed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CAUTION: Experimental augmentation subject remains active. Facility reserves will remain locked down until this situation is rectified. Please proceed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: CAUTION: Experimental augmentation subject remains active. Facility reserves will remain locked down until this situation is rectified. Please proceed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: SCANNING. Experimental augmentation subject is no longer active. Aborting lockdown. XT-9 facility reserves are now accessible.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: XT-9 facilities reserves are now at 0%. Have a pleasant day.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the experimental augmentation subject inside the XT-9 Element Augment Complex.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Destroy the experiment, get the treasure. Got it!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I guess this thing won't open until I destroy the experiment.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Open the XT-9 Facility Reserves Monitor

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Arms Master has asked you to eliminate Cuboar Mutation and Cuboar Abomination at the Protostar Cubig Farms using the new shock paddles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protostar Arms Master via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All those cuboars need to be put down. I am positive the Duplication Supervisor has asked the same. I have something to make it them die a bit easier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the shock paddles I requisitioned to kill the cuboars. I guarantee their impending deaths to be quite painless and entirely humane!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Contract fulfilled, $(player.name)! Your assistance in testing shock paddles is appreciated!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Put these shock paddles to good use. I'm sure they'll do the trick!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I never get tired of the smell of bacon. Do you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Protostar shock paddles seem to have worked well to put down the cuboars.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Protostar Arms Master
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you positive? The cuboars have to go!

localizedTextIdText: Judge Kain wants you to find Scrapper Malkin in Black Jack's Salvage and track down some supplies to help deal out the punishment to the Darkspur Cartel.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Scrapper Malkin in the Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's 'bout time to rain hell on the cartel but first we gotta round up some supplies. Let's hit the local scrapyard bar and prepare for a fight.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We can't risk the Cartel rebuildin' in these parts. We're gonna lay down the law like they never seen before. But first we need some supplies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You want to stop the Cartel you're goin' to need some serious firepower.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Scrapper Malkin at a run down bar in Black Jack's Salvage. He's generously offered to help out in the campaign to detonate the Darkpur Cartel, at least once he gets his hands on some explosives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be wastin' my time.

localizedTextIdText: Furlo Gre near Ghostwind Hollow wants you to rescue his brother, Farlo Gre, from the ooze that ate him while he was searching for Eldan relics.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Furlo Gre near Ghostwind Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stupid Farlo! Was eaten by ooze while looking for Eldan relics. Too busy. Have no time to save him. Maybe $(player.name) has time? If not, oh well.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If Farlo dies inside ooze, how will I gloat over him? Gloating more fun than attending Chua funeral.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Farlo found! Maybe he learn lesson now. Doubtful! Will take more than being eaten to teach him anything.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Farlo out there, inside ooze. Maybe digested by now, maybe not.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now time for gloating. Want to help?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued Farlo Gre, Furlo Gre brother, from the ooze that consumed him in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(player.name) too busy? Totally understand!

localizedTextIdText: Furlo Gre near Ghostwind Hollow dislikes the oozes being in such close proximity to his location. He's requested you get rid of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Furlo Gre via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oozes bad news, ate brother. Only matter of time before they eat me too. You go, kill oozes, and earn reward. Sound good?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oozes still nearby. Why they not dead yet? Oozes always hungry, prefer eating Chua most of all. So get moving!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Help appreciated. With oozes dead, risk of being consumed greatly reduced.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Have fun killing ghastly oozes!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bye bye.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the oozes that were causing Furlo Gre such discomfort near Ghostwind Hollow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe oozes come for you, too. Then you learn lesson.

localizedTextIdText: You found a half-digested Relic Fragment in Ghostwind Hollow and agreed to gather more for Farlo Gre. What he wants them for is anybody's guess...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Farlo Gre in Ghostwind Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This fragment of an Eldan relic is covered in slime and appears to be half-digested. Farlo Gre would appreciate it if you collected more for him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Only reason to come here is for Eldan relics. Oozes eat anything... like me or $m(player.class). Oozes eat relic fragments, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have relic fragments for me? Give! Even half-digested, fragments provide data about Eldan technology. Furlo not understand importance!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You find more, bring them here. Will pay you well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered half-digested Relic Fragments for Farlo Gre near Ghostwind Hollow. What he wants them for is anybody's guess...
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get Relic Fragments from oozes.

localizedTextIdText: Farlo Gre in Ghostwind Hollow wants you to activate the broken pylon with the relic fragments you gathered for him earlier. He's not sure what will happen when you do, but he seems excited.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Farlo Gre near Ghostwind Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Relic fragments come from Eldan pylon. Take fragments, fix pylon, then see what happens. Could be good. Could be bad. Could be nothing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still waiting. Use relic fragments to fix Eldan pylon. After that? Profit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Surprised you survived. Creature was very mean. Of course, experiment proves $(player.name) is difficult to kill. Not total loss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This going to be cozmotronic!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: For once I agree with you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the relic fragments you collected for Farlo Gre, you activated a broken Eldan pylon near Ghostwind Hollow. Unfortunately, it summoned a large skeletal gorganoth that you were forced to defeat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Maybe I ask Furlo to do it. He just stupid enough.

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Knoxi has asked you to prove yourself by killing some of the Strain creatures that infest the Blighted Pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lieutenant Knoxi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Size not matter. Explosives often packed into small spaces, yet very destructive. Same with Chua. Prove your prowess. Kill blighted creatures. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You kill many corrupted creatures yet? Strain make animals very strong. Must take friends with you. Otherwise Knoxi pretty sure you die.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very good killing! Makes Knoxi very proud. Maybe you join Shatterforce? Is only for elite, but $(player.name) seem qualified.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You and friends have fun. Strain make even weakest animals stronger.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bye bye!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lieutenant Knoxi near the Blighted Pass asked you to kill the Strain creatures that dwelled there. Though it was a dangerous task, you were more than able to lay the Strain to rest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Even Knoxi stronger, braver than you.

localizedTextIdText: Major Darius near the Blighted Pass has requested you collect the dog tags from fallen Shatterforce soldiers. Their sacrifices must never be forgotten.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Darius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many good soldiers fell today. If you have any courage left, I ask that you push ahead and collect dog tags from the dead so they will be remembered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How many dog tags have you collected? There are many dead in the Blighted Pass who will be forgotten unless we take pains to remember them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I will place these dog tags with the rest. Each life given for the Dominion is a worthwhile sacrifice. Now we shall know the names of the dead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Act with courage, $(player.name), so that our dead can rest in peace.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Never forget today's sacrifices, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Major Darius near the Blighted Pass asked you to collect dog tags from fallen Shatterforce soldiers so that their sacrifices will never be forgotten.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Remain here, then. There are surely others who will take your place.

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered hidden research notes concerning the creation of Drusera, referred to as the Genesis Prime.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Drusera near the Drusera Statue
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The datacube is heavily corrupted, but seems to contain research notes on the creation of Drusera - referred to as the Genesis Prime.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The datacube is heavily corrupted, but seems to contain research notes on the creation of Drusera - referred to as the Genesis Prime.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That datacube contains a lot of valuable - and dangerous - information. I hope you don't mind if I take it for safe-keeping?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Eldan thought highly of me, but in the end, not even I could save them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered hidden research notes on the creation of Drusera, referred to as the Genesis Prime. Following your discovery, Drusera herself appeared before you and took possession of the notes so they would not fall into the wrong hands.

localizedTextIdText: After activating the heart of an ancient giant robot in Grimvault and defeating its antibots, you found a giant robot circuit that might be worth something on the black market.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ryoko via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The circuit looks old, even ancient, but it is still very sophisticated. You might be able to find a buyer for it on the black market...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hear you're looking to unload that hardware you got there. Bet I can make you an offer worth your while. Interested?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's a deal. Sure is a pleasure doing business with you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see if I can find a buyer.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy as long as I make a profit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After activating the heart of an ancient giant robot and defeating its antibots, you found a giant robot circuit and sold it to Ryoko on the black market.

localizedTextIdText: Far-Trader Voshana has sent you along to meet her Lopp companions at Marshal's Haven.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Adventurer Kiyai at Marshal's Haven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I handle things here. Brave Voshana walks among big sisters. You talk to wise Lopp. See if you brave too!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You go now. Lopp not far.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must be strong if Voshana sent you here! There are some dangerous adventures afoot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We make camp in trees ahead. Just follow northwest road and you see.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Far-Trader Voshana has sent you along to meet her Lopp companions at Marshal's Haven.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Jungle is scary place. Lopp house is nice. You go see!

localizedTextIdText: Agent Osilor has ordered you to investigate a Torine settlement known as Deathbringer Hollow outside of Rotwood Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Deathbringer Ehel in Deathbringer Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My intel suggests the Strain have infected an entire Torine settlement. I require confirmation from a reliable source, so I am sending you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Seek out the Torine village Deathbringer Hollow, and discover the extent of the corruption. Any knowledge you glean will be of use to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We do not suffer strangers lightly. The danger you face by coming here is great.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Strain is an intriguing dilemma. Observe its corruption closely.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good. You will aid us in our strife, outsider.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reached Deathbringer Hollow, where the corruption appears to be wide-spread, and spoke to Deathbringer Ehel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Torine refer to it as Deathbringer Hollow. At least they remain consistent.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: With such an attitude, you may be better off elsewhere.

localizedTextIdText: Several prominent people in Spacerock Reach have ordered a crate of the new Pulp-Gulp flavor but the new delivery boy was killed in a freak unexplained explosion. The Pulp-Gulp Delivery Technician has asked you to finish the deliveries.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact the Pulp-Gulp Delivery Technician via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Large explosion... Cause unknown... I'll simply find a replacement. Would you be interested in employment? Simply deliver these Crates of Pulp-Gulp to the persons on this list.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have not received conformation that the deliveries have been made. Just take the Crates of Pulp-Gulp to the people on the list.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are receiving satisfactory ratings from all customers. Be sure to try all our new flavors.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Try not to shake the drinks to much. It may expl... ruin the delicate flavors.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Drink it quickly. Pulp-Gulp has a half-life of only five minutes.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think your marketing is a little off.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to deliver all the crates of Pulp-Gulp without exploding.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Contact the Pulp-Gulp Delivery Technician via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then you don't want the reward then.

localizedTextIdText: Several prominent people in Spacerock Reach have ordered a crate of the new Pulp-Gulp flavor but the new delivery boy was killed in a freak unexplained explosion. The Pulp-Gulp Delivery Technician has asked you to finish the deliveries.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact the Pulp-Gulp Delivery Technician via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Large explosion... Cause unknown... I'll simply find a replacement. Would you be interested in employment? Simply deliver these Crates of Pulp-Gulp to the persons on this list.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have not received conformation that the deliveries have been made. Just take the Crates of Pulp-Gulp to the people on the list.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are receiving satisfactory ratings from all customers. Be sure to try all our new flavors.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Try not to shake the drinks to much. It may expl... ruin the delicate flavors.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Drink it quickly. Pulp-Gulp has a half-life of only five minutes.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think your marketing is a little off.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to deliver all the crates of Pulp-Gulp without exploding.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Contact the Pulp-Gulp Delivery Technician via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then you don't want the reward then.

localizedTextIdText: You found the Mask of Life in cave near Vitara's Refuge and thought of someone who might want it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the Mask of Life to Archaeologist Agavo in Vitara's Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This mask appears valuable...to the right person.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh?  Whatcha got there?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh wow! This'll put me in the history books for sure, you betcha! Take this as a reward, okey dokey?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait to wear this at the celebration party! You betcha!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I know who to look for...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Archaeologist Agavo seemed pretty happy with your find.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take the Mask of Life to Archaeologist Agavo

localizedTextIdText: Biologist Memydra has asked you to report to Artemis Zin at the Silvos Field Lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin at the Silvos Field Lab
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You are familiar with Lady Zin, I presume? She requires someone of your caliber and could use your help. Proceed to the Silvos Field Lab immediately.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Silvos Field Lab, where Lady Zin is working, is directly below us. The elevator will take you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It seems as if fortune has conspired to bring us together once more, $(player.name). A good thing, too. The help around here is atrocious!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The elevator will take you to the Silvos Field Lab.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enough of the pleasantries. Let's get to work.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sure it will be fun.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Artemis Zin at the Silvos Field Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am troubled by your refusal to help Lady Zin. She will hear of it.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has discovered several Eldan data cores in the Primal Energy Lab. She's asked you to set up a data uplink at the Terra-Injection Node.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've retrieved recon images of several Eldan data core clusters in the jungle. Make your way to each one and set up a data link to our camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still waiting on those data uplinks. Why haven't you completed your assignment yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The uplinks are all set. This data should paint a pretty picture of what the Eldan were doing here. I am quite curious as to the answer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those cores most likely contain valuable information.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hmmm... there is a lot of experimental data here.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will set up the data links.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully set up a data uplink at the Terra-Injection Node for Artemis Zin. After testing the effects of the primal energy, Artemis Zin thought it best to disable the core.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm here on behalf of the Dominion to see why these bio-domes were constructed. If you set up a link, I can catalogue all of the information that they contain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Will you stop wasting my time!

localizedTextIdText: Kevo has informed you that an Eldan security system in the Primal Energy Lab may cause problems for both you and Artemis Zin. Find a way to disable the security system.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kevo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My lady is excited about these Eldan data cores. Her enthusiasm has blinded her to the dangers of Eldan security systems. You must disable it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The security system is still active. We cannot afford to lose any more time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The system is completely inaccessible. I will dispatch a science team to further investigate the problem.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful. You are no good to the little miss as a corpse.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You had best remain on your guard, as well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You attempted to disable the Eldan security system, but were locked out. Kevo is going to keep working at unlocking the system.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Deny me if you wish. The Eldan security system still threatens you.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin is interested in the information that you extracted from the Terra-Injection Node. Now she wants you to set a up another data uplink at the Vita-Injection Node which is also in the Primal Energy Lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A lot of useful information about the Eldan was gleaned from the Terra-Injection Node. We must now research the Vita-Injection Node.  Care to proceed?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Nothing bad has happened yet? You're still alive? Excellent! You see? I told you that you'd be fine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work once again. How are you feeling after all that leaping about?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Off to your task. I expect you will return to me in one piece.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stop complaining. No one said science was easy or painless.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I have a bad feeling about this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully set up a data uplink at the Vita-Injection Node for Artemis Zin, personally tested the effects of the dome's primal energy, and finally disabled the core after Lady Zin was satisfied with the data.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm glad that you... wait! You cannot tell me no!

localizedTextIdText: The last data core in the Primal Energy Lab is located in the Aqua-Injection Node. Artemis Zin is eagerly awaiting the information that this node can provide.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fantastic work so far, $(player.name). One more core to go. Let's see if you can pull off the trifecta and establish a link with the Aqua node. Ready?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: One more core to go. Why the delay? You were so punctual with the other two! I must admit, perhaps I've grown too accustomed to your successes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That is the last of them. My fans loved watching you set up those cores almost as much as they love watching me give you the orders to do so.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, come on, old bean! You haven't failed me yet. Don't start now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now on to bigger problems.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I didn't know I was being filmed...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully set up the last data uplink at the Aqua-Injection Node, tested the effects of the dome's primal energy, and then disabled the core.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Great. I'll just wait here until the camp is overrun.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin at the Silvos Field Lab has asked you to eliminate the Bio-Dome 3 Custodian inside Primary Security Matrix D2401 and deactivate the Matrix Defense Console D.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The sudden drop in power has attracted a bio-dome custodian. It guards a console that we must access. Can you be a sweetheart and destroy that thing?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you're waiting for further direction, you're wasting time. Get in there and put those weapons to good use. And do try to survive, hm.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I would say this area is completely safe now. The Collegium researchers will be along directly. You have done so very well, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I dare say this will be the most formidable foe you've faced thus far.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion owes you a favor!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of the problem.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The threat inside Primary Security Matrix D2401 has been resolved. Artemis Zin at the Silvos Field Lab has expressed her gratitude on behalf of the Dominion and House Zin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Come now. You've managed to get this far. Think of the ratings!

localizedTextIdText: Captain Makaas at the Silvos Field Lab has ordered you to destroy elemental Embodiments in the Primal Energy Lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Makaas via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This jungle teems with primal elementals. These beings are ripe for testing one's battle prowess. Hunt them down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your hunt has not yet ended. Find these elemental "embodiments" and destroy them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your hunting skills against the primals are worthy of praise and admiration. The very elements fall before you, hunter!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Prove your mettle to me!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not wander far. I will call upon you again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed elemental embodiments in the Primal Energy Lab for Captain Makaas at the Silvos Field Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hunt or be prey!

localizedTextIdText: You found an Experimental Console in the Primal Energy Lab. Artemis Zin at the Silvos Field Lab should be interested in what it's used for.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This console appears to control this massive Eldan structure. Activate the console and investigate the structure to discover its purpose.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This console appears to control this massive Eldan structure. Activate the console and investigate the structure to discover its purpose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've no idea what purpose that platform serves. Most of the Eldan machinery is a complete mystery. Perhaps we should start pushing random buttons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Scions! Why would the Eldan want to synthesize hostile creatures? I am glad you survived, though. It's so difficult to find good help these days.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: In any case, we know what they do now. Don't push any more random buttons.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You survived the onslaught of hostile creatures and reported back to Artemis Zin at the Silvos Field Lab.

localizedTextIdText: Kevo at the Silvos Field Lab has asked you to use a vortex bomb to capture some of the elemental essences and aspects that are around the Primal Energy Lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kevo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some primal entities in the jungle are smaller and purer than the larger, aggressive ones. Lady Zin asks that you retrieve some of their essences.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need more of their essence. Use the provided vortex bombs to absorb the essences from the lesser elementals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have been hard at work, $(player.name). These samples should suffice.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will await your report.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have proven to be a valuable asset, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured elemental essences and aspects for Kevo at the Primal Energy Lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My lady will not take news of your rejection well.

localizedTextIdText: You found a destroyed scanbot near the Primal Energy Lab. Search the grounds for bots that can be repaired and utilized for the Royal Collegium's research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This scanbot has been destroyed and is beyond repair. Perhaps there are other scanbots around the area that can still be salvaged.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This scanbot has been destroyed and is beyond repair. Perhaps there are other scanbots around the area that can still be salvaged.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Collegium researchers are complaining incessantly about their missing scanbots. Be a dear and see if you can find any out there in the jungle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Maybe these Collegium mummers will stop whining about their missing equipment now. They never seem to be happy unless they've something to cry about.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep up the good work. The Dominion is counting on you... as am I.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You repaired scanbots for the Royal Collegium. The researchers at the Silvos Field Lab will doubtless find innumerable uses for them.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let's see what I can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can dig up.

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Infiton has asked you to use the $(vitem=758) to reach the top of the Primal Energy Lab and investigate the upper platform.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Infiton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Collegium scanbots have found an Eldan cache far above us on an isolated platform. Utilize this charge retractor to ascend to the platform.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have not fallen to your demise, nor have you completed you assigned task. Why, in both cases, are you talking to me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Based on its inaccessibility, I would ascertain that the contents of the cache are important.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Aim the charge retractor at the charge targets, fire, and hold on tightly.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Exploration Society owes you a debt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found an Eldan cache on the upper platform of the Primal Energy Lab. The Exploration Society is going to have a field day with it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your unwillingness to aid me may lead to your untimely death.

localizedTextIdText: Director Kaspnov in Nightwatch Enclave explains they've reconfigured Ikthian transport to support your biological matter. Director Kaspnov requests you return to the enclave with speed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Director Kaspnov in Nightwatch Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've reconfigured Ikthian transport to support your biological matter. I suggest you return to the enclave with speed. You've won the battle but not the war.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're mission is complete. You've dispensed of an entire incubating army of Ikthian super soldiers and returned to Nightwatch Enclave alive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Black Hoods thank you for your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're mission is complete. You've dispensed of an entire incubating army of Ikthian super soldiers and returned to Nightwatch Enclave alive. The Black Hoods thank you for your service.

localizedTextIdText: Geologist Lochron appreciates your help, but now he would like you to offer your assistance to Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Forward Base Firestorm has communicated its requirement for assistance. I have informed Captain Rinti of your competence, and he is expecting you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Captain Rinti waits for you at Forward Base Firestorm. I will not tolerate you here while he awaits your arrival there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You $(player.name)? Lochron said you coming. Is good to have you. All resources at your disposal. Just ask!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: For the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Pell big threat. Must take care of them, quick quick!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm and discovered there are problems with a nearby Pell commune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you other tasks to see to? Very well.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker at Forward Base Firestorm has instructed you to go to Flamewalker Hold and deactivate any rogue Caretaker nodes that you find. The nodes are blocking his connection to the Flamewalkers' data network.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pell are attempting to activate the terraformer. If I am to access their network, you must destroy the rogue Caretaker nodes in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is at least one rogue Caretaker node active in Flamewalker Hold. Please do me the kindness of deactivating it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that the rogue Caretaker nodes are offline, I have successfully accessed the Flamewalkers' data network. My news is not good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please be quick. The Pell may be close to flipping the proverbial switch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Flamewalkers may actually be able to start the terraformer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The rogue Caretaker nodes around Flamewalker Hold have been deactivated. The Caretaker can now turn his attention to thwarting the Flamewalkers' plan to start the terraformer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: You're the Caretaker. Can't you stop it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The terraformer is capable of transforming an entire ecosystem virtually overnight. They are powered by raw primal energy sources, usually ones found near the terrain they are terraforming.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The transformation occurs at the molecular level. Any life present during the terraform is reconstructed. We would all perish in the process.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Security protocols prevent even me from directly accessing the terraformer's network. I can monitor it, but I cannot access it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Failing to aid me will only hasten your demise.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker at Forward Base Firestorm has instructed you to go to Flamewalker Hold and disrupt the Flamewalker summoning ritual.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flamewalkers are summoning elemental fire from their shrines. The influx of these elementals must cease. Find the shrine and halt these rituals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Flamewalkers' ritual continues. Why don't you attempt to be helpful and halt the rituals. Now, if you'd be so kind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have successfully stopped the Flamewalkers' summoning ritual. Well done. However, it may have been for naught.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The elementals are the Flamewalker's key to the terraformer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Flamewalkers have enough elemental fire to start the terraformer.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put an end to it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disrupted the Flamewalkers' summoning ritual in Flamewalker Hold. However, it appears as if your efforts were too little, too late.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I sometimes forget that your kind is combustible.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has instructed you to go to Flamewalker Hold and infect the terraformer's control points with a specially-tailored computer virus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pell have access to the terraformer grid. This cannot be permitted. Access their control points and infect them with this virus.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lacking both access and a physical body, I am unable to implant the virus. I am leaving this important task up to you. Eldan help us all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I find this amusing. Without access to the grid, the Flamewalker Pell are milling about aimlessly, as most primitive species are liable to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Spread the virus to as many control points as you can. Do be prompt.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is no sense in wasting a good opportunity to strike at them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infected the terraformer's control points in Flamewalker Hold with a computer virus. Now the Flamewalker Pell will be unable to access the terraformer.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm still looking for the control points.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How close are they to gaining control over the terraformer?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I do not know, nor do we have the luxury of waiting around to find out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This virus is paramount to stopping the Flamewalker Pell. Do not be a fool.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has ordered you to go into Flamewalker Hold, burn Flamewalker buildings, and assassinate the acolytes of the high priest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Flamewalker high priest must die, but we need to kill his acolytes first. We shall also give the Pell a taste of their own fiery medicine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Set the Flamewalker buildings alight and kill the high priest's acolytes. It's simple, really. I suppose I overestimated your powers of comprehension.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Two acolytes are dead for price of one, $(player.name). Well worth the time investment. But do not put your weapons away just yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Set the buildings in Flamewalker hold on fire, but do not burn yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Flamewalker Hold, set fire to several Flamewalker buildings, and assassinated the acolytes of the high priest. The conflagration has temporarily distracted the Flamewalker Pell from their goal.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm moving as quickly as I can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Afraid of a little fire? I would have thought you would be over it by now.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has asked you to kill High Priest Flame-Guardian in Flamewalker Hold. Until he is defeated, the Flamewalker Pell will continue to pose a threat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: High Priest Flame-Guardian is the leader of these Pell. As long as he lives, the Flamewalkers will remain a threat. Your bloody task is obvious.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You confuse me, $(player.race). Is it your intention to allow the Pell to start the terraformer?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With their high priest dead, the rest of the Flamewalker Pell will scatter. I can now focus my attention on the terraformer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The high priest is formidable. Prepare for this fight or you will expire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I would offer you my heartfelt gratitude if I had a heart.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: High Priest Flame-Guardian of Flamewalker Hold is no more. With their high priest defeated, and all of the Rogue Caretaker Node deactivated, the remaining Flamewalker Pell will disperse and leave the terraformer to $~(creature=37917).
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fantastic. You have come all this way, only to fail now.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm has ordered you to go into Flamewalker Hold and eliminate Flamewalker Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Rinti via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hate hate hate Flamewalker Pell! Pell want to burn us. Cause much trouble. You take weapon to Flamewalker Hold, kill all Pell you find. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Many Flamewalker Pell still walking. Want them dead. Then they not walk. Then they be "Flamedeader Pell."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice seeing competent $(player.class) for change. Other ones burned to crispy cinders. You do much better.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Singed my fur many times. Experience unpleasant.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stick around. I find something else for you to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Flamewalker Hold and eliminated Flamewalker Pell for Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Must have heard you wrong. You not kill Pell? Seriously?

localizedTextIdText: Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm has ordered you to go into Flamewalker Hold and use explosives to destroy Charging Flamewalker Servitor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Rinti via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Pell use servitor constructs. Constructs access buried Eldan structures. Destroy servitors. Will slow Pell's research, buy valuable time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Destroy servitor constructs with bombs. Is best way to destroy them. Plus, makes nice explosion. Love explosions!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Servitors destroyed. Pell always make more servitors later. So we hurry now to next phase of operation. Quick quick!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sorry. Bombs very loud, but only work on servitor constructs.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Flamewalker Hold and eliminated Charging Flamewalker Servitor for Captain Rinti.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Servitors synchronize data while recharging. They most vulnerable then.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Servitors lower defenses to connect to Pell network. Then $(player.name) use bombs on them! Boom!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Gave you direct order, $(player.name). Am captain, remember?

localizedTextIdText: Private Tafu at Sovereign's Landing is in need of a competent set of hands. Head to the surface of Farside and meet up with him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Private Tafu at Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You good fighter? Everyone says so. Need you on surface. Important assignment. Will expect you soon.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Too soon! You here too soon!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Too soon! You here too soon!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.name) here at last. Good good! Saves paperwork filing noncompliance report with high command.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This not request. Is order. Get up here now!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Private Tafu at Sovereign's Landing. Now it's time to get to work.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Sorry. I'll take longer next time.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Sorry. I'll take longer next time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? Guess stories about you exaggerated.

localizedTextIdText: You found a Fallen Flamewalker in Flamewalker Hold. He was surrounded by broken relics that he appeared to be collecting when he was killed. Search for more Pell relics in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Rinti via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Flamewalker Pell lies here, clutching a shattered relic in his hand. Perhaps there are more relics to be found in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A Flamewalker Pell lies here, clutching a shattered relic in his hand. Perhaps there are more relics to be found in Flamewalker Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Soldier, not scientist. Pell relics boring. Make me sleepy. Collegium might want relics, though.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Collegium analyze relics. Find useful information. Don't care. Relics boring! *yawn*
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a collection of Flamewalker relics and took them to Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm.

localizedTextIdText: Gather a group of adventurers and kill the vile worm known as Gritmaw. Report to Captain Rinti at Forward Base Firestorm when you have finished your task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Rinti via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WARNING\nThe vile worm known as Gritmaw has been spotted in Flamewalker Hold. This creature is highly dangerous and should not be faced alone.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING\nThe vile worm known as Gritmaw has been spotted in Flamewalker Hold. This creature is highly dangerous and should not be faced alone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You trying to kill Gritmaw? No! Gritmaw kill you! Eat you! Can't do your job when you're dead! Bad bad!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gritmaw dead? Really? Skeptical, but unable to verify. Fine. Take reward, have nice time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've vanquished the vile worm known as Gritmaw.

localizedTextIdText: Like any other Grumpel, Bello loves a good, juicy story, but even as a bartender he has trouble meeting people with interesting gossip. He came upon a device called the TMI-zer 2000 and needs help testing it on his friends throughout the Arid Sands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bello at the Desert Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Everyone has a story to tell, but sometimes they don't wish to share! Fortunately, I have a TMI-zer 2000! Try it on my companions and see for yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Testing of this device is so exciting! I'd be doing it myself if my friends didn't suspect anything. They know how... erm... curious I am!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My TMI-zer actually sort of worked! But I have to say, I'm not very tickled by the responses you received. I was hoping for something a bit... juicier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't wait to find out their secrets! This is so much fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes, until next time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: To Bello surprise, the TMI-zer 2000 worked perfectly! Unfortunately, it became clear to Bello that he needs friends with somewhat more varied interests.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps with a drink or two on the house, you'll change your mind?

localizedTextIdText: Ringo Hax has asked you to end "Project: Broon," a secret, teeny tiny little experiment in the Fist of Azrion's Sick Bay. It was created from a badly-wounded Dominion soldier and some Strain primal patterns in a moment of desperation, so it's probably safe.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Special, secret, teeny tiny little experiment, "Project: Broon," on loose in Sick Bay! Every minute it grows, grows, grows! Stop the growing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Done terminating Project Broon already? No! Don't think so! Go kill before project gets too big!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Project Broon terminated. Very good news. Too unstable for bio-weapon. Would all be dead if I didn't make you kill it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take friends. If you have those. Otherwise, painful death.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You terminated "Project: Broon," a special, secret, teeny tiny little experiment that was kept in the Fist of Azrion's Sick Bay. They just don't grow biological horrors like they used to, do they?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Broon! Special DRED operation to help mortally-wounded high-ranking official using Strain's primal pattern! New! Exciting! Was incubating, but Strain have... other ideas.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can $(player.name) be so stupid?

localizedTextIdText: Ringo Hax has asked you to recover ooze canisters from medical refrigerators in the Fist of Azrion's heavily-infested Sick Bay. You'd better hope no one's cleaned them out yet!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ooze canisters in Sick Bay kept in medical fridges. Collect canisters before Strain eats them. Don't know what happen if eaten by Strain!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ooze canister experiments incomplete. Collect ooze canisters from medical refrigerators before Strain makes them lunch. Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You recovered canisters. Very good! Ooze samples too valuable. No wasting them. Will save them for new experiments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Careful, careful! Everything in ship hungry. Wants to eat $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll take your word for it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the ooze canisters from the medical refrigerators in the Fist of Azrion's heavily-infested Sick Bay.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You put deadly chemicals in the medical fridges?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Must keep ooze kept cool. If not, disaster!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Bandages? Salves? For soldiers on THIS mission? And you call me crazy?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Unwise to get between Chua and science.

localizedTextIdText: Despite barely surviving a transport ship crash and being hunted by the Strain, Ringo Hax demanded you collect eggs from cryoglider eggsacs. You can find them on the Fist of Azrion's wreckage, above the giant puddle of hyperspace engine coolant in Cryomere.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: New gliders lay eggs on ship's wreckage by coolant spill. New species means new weapons! Get samples of the cryoglider eggs!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find eggs on wreckage, near coolant spill. Must have samples!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hand eggs over! Yes. Hmmm. Seem in good shape. Can't wait to get back to lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not get scrambled!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Can't wait to tinker! But first - survival!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the cryoglider eggs scattered across the wreckage of the Fist of Azrion above the giant puddle of hyperspace engine coolant in Cryomere. Things are looking up for Ringo Hax!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Aren't the eggs the least of your worries?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Hunger for knowledge and new inventions cannot be contained. Not leaving without eggs!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You too lazy. Maybe too stupid.

localizedTextIdText: Use the Airshroom to jump to higher locations with ease. Doing so might further the Dominion's research of Wilderrun's more unusual flora.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bozango Grazz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This large mushroom seems to be fueled by compressed air and inundated with kinetic energy. Perhaps if you leapt on it, it might propel you higher.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't just stand there! Jump on the airshroom and see what happens!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fungus in Wilderrun! Large fungus! Defense mechanism propels predators into air! Desire confirmation!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: 'Airshroom' rumors confirmed! Propel subjects very high, very far! Other airshrooms send subject to other places, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Find more airshrooms! Use them to jump high! Jump far! Fall to death!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Jump on a mushroom? Why not?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used $i(creature=28417) in Discovery Heights to leap vast distances and jump to places you wouldn't normally be able to reach. Bozango Grazz noted your discovery, and he seems quite interested in the Airshroom potential applications.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Jump on a mushroom? Why not?

localizedTextIdText: You've discovered a Mysterious Stone Head in Discovery Heights that appears to teem with primal energy. Perhaps if you studied it, you could unlock the mystery that surrounds it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bozango Grazz via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This statue crackles with primal energy. If you examine it, you might find that you'll discover something useful.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The statue carries with it the strong and unmistakable smell of bananas.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You know me? Know I'm busy? Then leave me alone!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Big ugly stone head calls to Wildbranch? Why bother me with this? Better things to do!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time, do not think. Do not care!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered that the Mysterious Stone Head in Discovery Heights is somehow tied to the razortails that roam Wilderrun's jungles. You reported your discovery to Bozango Grazz, but he seemed less than thrilled by your revelation.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek at Stonebreaker Post has ordered you to destroy the creeping spawners that continue to fill the Creeping Abyss with endless waves of their Strain-ridden progeny.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's plenty of spawners spittin' out Strain in the Creepin' Abyss. I need you to destroy those things before we're overwhelmed here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The spawners in the Creepin' Abyss puke out Strain like it's goin' outta style. Take a few of 'em out and it should give us some breathin' room.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work takin' those spawners out. I'm already seein' a difference in the Strain's numbers over here. Too bad that's not the end of it, though.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get 'er done, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is gonna get worse before it gets better.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Commander Durek orders, you hunted down and destroyed the creeping spawners in the Creeping Abyss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't tell me "no," recruit.

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Cragstone at Stonebreaker Post wants you to avenge the deaths of his troopers by putting down packs of Strain and other corrupted creatures in the Creeping Abyss.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sergeant Cragstone via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We lost a lotta good people today to those damn Strain and I want some payback. Might not bring back our boys, but it'd make me feel better.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You done a job on those Strain freaks yet? The Creepin' Abyss is full of 'em. Go kill 'em all. Do it for the boys we lost today.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya done our boys proud by rackin' up that many kills. Still, ya kill one of those things and two more pop up in its place. It's hardly worth it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I appreciate it, pal.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You avenged the lives of the Exile troopers that have been killed by the Strain in the Creeping Abyss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A coward like you ain't fit to be an Exile.

localizedTextIdText: Kit Brinny at Stonebreaker Post is creeped out by the creeping eyestalks that dot the landscape of the Creeping Abyss. She's asked you to destroy as many as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kit Brinny via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Them eyestalks ain't natural, ya hear me? I can feel 'em lookin' at me and it's startin' to freak me out. I'd shoot 'em myself, but that'd take forever!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hate the feelin' that I'm bein' watched. Makes my skin crawl. Then I look out and see them eyestalks starin' at me... stars! When's it gonna stop?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There's still some of them eyestalks out there, I'm sure, but that feelin', like I'm bein' watched, ain't quite as bad now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Could ya? I'd sure appreciate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for the help, friend. You're a real pal!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll kill some of those eyestalks.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I took care of a lot of them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed a number of creeping eyestalks near Dawnbringer Outpost on behalf of Kit Brinny. As a result, she's much less creeped out than she used to be.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can't ya feel it? The lookin' and watchin'? Don't it just drive ya batty?

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek at Stonebreaker Post has commanded you to find a way into Spineridge Nest and meet with Avra Darkos. Avra is currently awaiting your arrival, so you'd better hurry.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Avra Darkos wants to see ya. She's behind enemy lines, somewhere in Spineridge Nest. You'd better head over there and help her out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You made contact with Avra yet? I'm sure she'll figure you're a liability if you keep her waitin' too long.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have come to help me spin my webs, have you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I require you to do what others cannot - or will not - do. Given your prior activities on our behalf, I doubt you will have any moral objections.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful. I don't know what Avra's up to, but it's probably dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infiltrated Spineridge Nest and met with Avra Darkos. It seems as if the Black Hoods are in need of your skills once again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's the dumbest thing I've ever heard you say, and that's sayin' a lot.

localizedTextIdText: In order to access the Phage Cannon, Avra Darkos wants you to assassinate the Spineridge Commander at Spineridge Nest to gain entry to the Corrupted Installation. The Skurge commander is the only one with the proper access codes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As we are now cognizant of our conundrum's causation, you must acquire the Skurge commander's access codes, enter the facility, and assess the damage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Spineridge Commander has the teleporter access codes. If this operation is to succeed, he must be eliminated and his access codes acquired.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Eldan technology throughout the facility has been infected with the techno-phage. Without a doubt, this confirms the data you collected earlier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you have the access codes, use them to activate the teleporter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They must be destroyed, of course. I fear it will not be a trivial task.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of this task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assassinated the Spineridge Commander in Spineridge Nest, took his access code, and entered the Corrupted Installation. It's only a matter of time before you locate the Phage Cannon.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of this task.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Will you be coming with me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My wounds prevent me from progressing further. You must continue in my place.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is nothing. Even the finest agents are injured from time to time. It rewards our complacency with a painful reminder of our own mortality.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Due to our peril, I shall give you another chance to accede to my orders.

localizedTextIdText: Kit Brinny at Stonebreaker Post wants you to see to the troopers fighting in the Creeping Abyss and bolster their morale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kit Brinny via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Know what, $(player.name)? You're a hero! I know the boys in the Abyss would love to see ya. It'd do 'em good to know you're fightin' by their side.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sooner you get down there, the sooner the boys are gonna flip their lids. There ain't nothin' like havin' a real-life hero by your side!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You done good, $(player.name). A lotta boys are gonna pull through today because of you. It means a lot to 'em, and it means a lot to me, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're gonna be so psyched when you get up there! You just wait!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is one of them "feel good" moments!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Of course. I'll do what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You encouraged the troopers fighting in the Creeping Abyss and gave them the strength to fight on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So that's how it's gonna be, bigshot?

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest wants you to destroy the Phage Cannon in the Corrupted Installation and prevent it from ever being used again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nothing can prevent you from destroying the Phage Cannon now. Use the control panels in the correct sequence and set the cannon to overload.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Utilize the control panels and set the Phage Cannon for self-destruct. We have no time to consider other alternatives.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Phage Cannon is no more. This is likely a minor setback for the Strain, but for us it is an important victory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once the sequence is set, you must escape this place with your life.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Black Hoods will continue to rely upon you. Until next time....
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's one heck of a relief.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Phage Cannon in the Corrupted Installation and prevented it from ever being used again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have no patience for your petulance.

localizedTextIdText: Maximillian Angerstreet has asked you to hunt Sourgut the Necrotic in the Blighted Pass. If you can kill the creature before he does, the next round will be on him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Maximillian Angerstreet via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm spoilin' for a fight with that big fella over there. It took out half a squad already. Think you and your friends got what it takes to waste him?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That thing's still alive, and the troopers he killed are still dead. You gonna get on the case or do you plan to leave it to the professionals?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stars! You knocked that bastard down hard! Looks to me like I owe you - and anyone else that helped you - a round or two when all this is over.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The first round's on me if you can. I ain't holdin' my breath, though.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I knew you could do it. Really I did.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed Sourgut the Necrotic in the Blighted Pass and earned Maximillian Angerstreet respect - as well as a free round of brews.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, if your belly's that yellow, it's all well and good to me.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos has come to Spineridge Nest to destroy the Phage Cannon. To prepare for the operation's ultimate success, she has ordered you to gather intelligence about the Skurge in Spineridge Nest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Skurge have gained control of a powerful weapon - they call it the "Phage Cannon." You must reveal how they were able to secure it so swiftly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We know the Skurge are a threat, but what are they up to? You must gather intel concerning their purpose in purloining such a powerful weapon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fine work, Agent $(player.name). It appears the Skurge have cultivated the capability of controlling Eldan tech with something called the "techno-phage."
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do be quick. Time is short and we are not welcome here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No, it does not. A new threat has revealed itself in our darkest hour.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That doesn't sound like good news.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered intelligence on the Skurge for Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The attack on the wall was initiated by the Skurge utilizing a powerful Eldan cannon. We assume they wish to destroy the wall so the Strain may spread further afield. My mission is to neutralize this "Phage Cannon" before the Skurge wreak more havoc.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The origin of the Skurge remains an enigma, but initial analysis of their primal patterns indicates they are corrupted copies of both Exile and Dominion citizens. I find it ironic that the Entity's strongest servants may, in fact, be shadowy reflections of ourselves.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your timing is terrible.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest wants you to terminate any Skurge in the area. Each of the Skurge you encounter is a threat to the Exiles that must be dealt with at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The time has come for killing. Hunt down Skurge targets in Spineridge Nest and liquidate them. Each one you kill is one less threat to the Exiles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have a number of kills yet to make. Do not assume that since I am not with you that I do not know how you are progressing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The blood of our enemies is as foul as they are, but it is worth spilling if it brings their plans to ruin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You have been deadly before. I expect you to be twice as deadly now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have improved markedly since our first meeting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You terminated any Skurge that crossed your path at Spineridge Nest, thereby earning Avra Darkos acclaim for your swift and lethal actions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What are the Skurge doing in Spineridge Nest?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: As you can see, the Skurge appear to be altering Eldan apparatuses in this area. We have yet to reveal the reason why.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Remember this moment the next time you require something from me.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest has given you a mission to collect bio-phage samples from the Spineridge Agents and their minions infesting the Corrupted Installation. Data must be collected before proceeding further into Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Skurge are dangerous hosts for the bio-phage. The XAS would like to gauge the virulence of their contagion. Collect samples from them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where are those bio-phage samples? So long as we lack information about our enemies, we remain exposed to their exploits.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your deadly deeds have revealed a distressing development. The bio-phage harbored by the Skurge is more virulent than anything we've yet seen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Gather as much as you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ensure you apply standard decontamination protocols when you return to base.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope I didn't get any on me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected the $m(vitem=1073) from the Skurge in Spineridge Nest, determining that the bio-phage infecting them is even more virulent than was previously thought.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: An unwise decision, $(player.name). Would you care to reconsider?

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest wants you to gather information about the techno-phage that has infected the Corrupted Installation. Analyzing its structure may help prevent it from spreading across Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Phage Cannon has been infected by the techno-phage. I require you to collect techno-phage samples for XAS analysis. We must learn more.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Who knows what the limits of the techno-phage are. That is, if it has any at all. We cannot sit idly by and wait to find out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This data disturbs me. Further analysis by the XAS is warranted. It would be disastrous if such a thing infected our own computers and bots.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Transmit your data once it has been collected. Good luck.
