localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Of course not. We - or, rather, you - still have much left to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The techno-phage - a Strain virus capable of infecting computers and machinery - represents a potent new threat. To aid in the Exiles' analysis of the techno-phage, you collected samples for Avra Darkos in the Corrupted Installation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The techno-phage is apparently a breed of Strain similar to a computer virus. You and I have observed it infecting Eldan computers and constructs with the aid of the Skurge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Most assuredly. While the bio-phage infects and corrupts organic life, the techno-phage is seemingly capable of doing the same thing to inorganic forms such as machines, computers, and constructs.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I do not forget... or forgive.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest has told you to blow up the corrupted generators powering the Corrupted Installation. Only then will the Phage Cannon stop firing at the wall.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nexus is in danger so long as the Phage Cannon remains operational. Locate its generators in the corrupted Eldan facility and overload them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Each volley fired by the Phage Cannon is another that may destroy Grimvault's walls. Locate the generators and destroy them before it is too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Phage Cannon is quiet and Grimvault's walls are out of danger... for the moment. Now we must see to it that the gun never fires again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With nothing to power it, the Phage Cannon should fall silent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be prepared. All we have done has led us to this moment.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blew up the generators in the Corrupted Facility, shutting down the Phage Cannon and preventing further attacks on the walls of Grimvault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Should Grimvault's walls be destroyed due to your stupidity, you will suffer.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos at Spineridge Nest has revealed that you must gain direct access to the Corrupted Installation's command center if you plan to destroy the Phage Cannon for good.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We cannot permit the Strain to regain control of this installation. You must access the command center so that we can destroy the Phage Cannon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You had best make your way to the command center. If the Strain regains control of this installation, our cause will certainly be lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Victory is within our grasp, but there are some steps left to take. Are you prepared to do what must be done?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Waste no time. I will continue to observe your progress.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are ever a willing tool of the Black Hoods.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get to the command center, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In order to gain direct access to the Corrupted Installation's command center, you defeated the corrupted command construct that barred your way. Soon this terrible place will be little more than a memory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I want you to remember this moment as you await your execution.

localizedTextIdText: Vessa Farwander near Ghostwind Hollow wants you to rescue her lover, Nooks Barkbiter, from the ooze that ate him while he was searching for Eldan relics.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Vessa Farwander near Ghostwind Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Help! My boyfriend, Nooks, was eaten by an ooze! I told him not to go out there by himself, but he doesn't listen! He's such an idiot sometimes!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find Nooks? You can't let him discover a new definition of pain and suffering as he's slowly digested! Please save him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I know I called Nooks an idiot. I mean, he is. But he's my idiot, and I love him. Thank you for freeing him from the gullet of that disgusting ooze.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You've got to hurry before he's digested!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, if only Nooks can avoid being eaten again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued Nooks Barkbiter, Vessa Farwander lover, from the ooze that consumed him in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You rotten jerk! I know animals with more class than you!

localizedTextIdText: Vessa Farwander near Ghostwind Hollow dislikes the oozes being in such close proximity to her location. She's requested you get rid of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Vessa Farwander via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's only a matter of time before I'll be eaten by one of those nasty oozes, too! It'd be mighty kind of you to kill a few of them for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those oozes ate Nooks. I'm sure they'll eat me, too. I can't stand the idea of being devoured by one of those slimy things! Won't you help me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I feel a lot better without those oozes knocking on my proverbial door. Hopefully Nooks can find what he's looking for so we can get out of here!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll feel ever so much safer once those oozes are gone.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Want a hug? Oh, you know you do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the oozes that were causing Vessa Farwander such discomfort near Ghostwind Hollow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose I'll have to hope they don't like taste of female Aurin...

localizedTextIdText: You found a half-digested Relic Fragment in Ghostwind Hollow and agreed to gather more for Nooks Barkbiter. What he wants them for is anybody's guess...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Nooks Barkbiter in Ghostwind Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This fragment of an Eldan relic is covered in slime and appears to be half-digested. Nooks Barkbiter would appreciate it if you collected more for him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I came to find some Eldan relics. Vessa's too scared to come out here with me. It's not so bad inside those oozes. I even found a relic in there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let me see what you found. Oh, these are real nice! A little bit on the digested side, but that doesn't matter too much to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Vessa's going to be impressed. You're a life-saver... in more ways than one!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered half-digested Relic Fragments for Nooks Barkbiter near Ghostwind Hollow. What he wants them for is anybody's guess...
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get relic fragments from oozes.

localizedTextIdText: Nooks Barkbiter in Ghostwind Hollow wants you to activate the broken pylon with the relic fragments you gathered for him earlier. He's not sure what will happen when you do, but he seems excited...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Nooks Barkbiter near Ghostwind Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I figured out the relic fragments you collected for me are a part of this Eldan pylon. If you can use them to repair the pylon, anything's possible!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm still waiting. Either repair the Eldan pylon, or give me back the relic fragments.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Weave! Did you see that? Well... of course you saw it, because you had to fight it. But wow! That was pretty neat!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: What's the worst thing that could happen?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wonder if we can collect more fragments and fix the pylon again...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm not so sure about this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the relic fragments you collected for Nooks Barkbiter, you activated a broken Eldan pylon near Ghostwind Hollow. Unfortunately, it summoned a large skeletal gorganoth that you were forced to defeat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm not stupid enough to do it myself. My luck's bad enough!

localizedTextIdText: Road Warrior Thorn has asked you to prove yourself by killing some of the Strain creatures that infest the Blighted Pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Road Warrior Thorn via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Aurin may be small, but we pack a real wallop when we're worked up. Think you can do better? Go kill some of those Strain critters and prove it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You should really take some friends with you if you plan to kill some of those Strain creatures. Assuming you have any friends, that is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was pretty good, $(player.name). Is there a reason you haven't joined up with us yet? We could use a fighter like you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's not going to be easy. You'll be fine if you take some friends along.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I like being a free agent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Road Warrior Thorn near the Blighted Pass asked you to kill the Strain creatures that dwelled there. Though it was a dangerous task, you were more than able to lay the Strain to rest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've got to be joking. I thought you were supposed to be tough.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Raxen near the Blighted Pass has requested you collect the dog tags from fallen Road Warriors. Their sacrifices must never be forgotten.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Raxen via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We lost a lotta good people today, $(player.name). We need to know their names so we don't forget 'em. Go and collect their dog tags, all right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If someone doesn't bring those dog tags back, we'll never know for sure which of our Road Warriors are KIA. I expect you to take care of it, get me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll put these tags with the others. When the time comes, we'll raise a mug to all of 'em. For now, we got more work to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't go alone, if ya know what's good for ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for the help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Raxen near the Blighted Pass asked you to collect dog tags from fallen Road Warriors so that their sacrifices will never be forgotten.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: They died takin' risks. The least ya can do is risk yourself in return.

localizedTextIdText: The ship you were flying in was violently torn apart by exanite fragments en route to the Grimvault. Deadeye Brightland was able to crash land your transport in the Fractured Fields, just outside the Grimvault's massive walls.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Krull at the E-Med Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This ship's busted all to hell, and there's more wounded than I can count. You better get out there and lend a hand, friend, before it gets worse.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: People are dyin' while you're here jawin' with me. This ain't the time to drag your feet, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I got my hands full, buddy. Might as well make yourself useful until we got this situation under control.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a good thing you're here, $(player.name). This situation stinks worse than a Krogg with a bad case of dripfoot, if ya get my drift.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: People are countin' on you. I don't rightly believe you'll let 'em down.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get this show on the road.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Deadeye Brightland by saving most of his crew from the wreckage of a devastating crash. Who knows what danger awaits as you go closer to the Grimvault?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I ain't rightly sure. Last thing I saw was a blast comin' from that wall over yonder, then everything went to hell. What's important now is gettin' these people on their feet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get outta my sight or I'll put a bullet right between your beady eyes.

localizedTextIdText: The crash in the Fractured Fields left most of FCON's troopers, as well as yourself, on the other side of the wall and in hostile territory. The creatures outside the wall exhibit increased aggression, and FCON needs help taking them down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Kara at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got reports of hostile creatures causin' all sortsa trouble for our people. Get out there and drive those beasts back. Is that clear?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We got enough to worry about without a buncha animals tearin' the boys apart. Get over there and lend 'em a hand, pronto.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This place is a rock-crusher, $(player.name). Think you can give us some breathin' room?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm happy to see ya, sweetheart. Was wonderin' when you'd decide to show up. Nick of time, like always! Trouble is, we're not done yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You gotta take some of the pressure off our troopers so they can regroup.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You ready for more bad news? I ain't got much else.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though you helped FCON quell the hostile creatures surrounding Sergeant Kara and her men, stranger enemies are still coming from the breach in the wall. The increased aggression in the local wildlife may be a result of the presence of these new foes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya tellin' me no, pal? Don't make me persuade ya, 'cause ya won't like it.

localizedTextIdText: The nonstop assault from the creatures spilling out of the breach has proven too difficult for FCON to contain. Sergeant Kara has decided to call upon Commander Durek and Durek's Destroyers. Mark locations for Durek's men to land in the Fractured Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek in the Fractured Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're gonna be toast if we don't get some help. I think it's time we called in the big boys - Durek's Destroyers. You need to mark their landing zones.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We're losin' men quick. You don't get those flares down at Durek's landing zones, there won't be nobody left for them to rescue.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Playtime's over, recruit. The best defense is a good offense, right? So we're gonna push these lousy critters back into the hole they crawled out of!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Commander Durek's headed down here to crack some skulls, so get shakin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hold onto yer pantyhose, $(player.name). This is gonna get interestin'.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Durek and his men have arrived safely and are ready to wage war upon the creatures from the wall. Durek's decided the best course of action is to take the offense and assault the wall head-on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I so wanna put a bullet in the back of your cowardly head.

localizedTextIdText: To ease the pressure on Sergeant Kara men, Commander Durek has sent you to strategic flanking points on higher ground where his men can place snipers. Hop onto the Flank Tank and head to the Desolate Highlands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We gotta take the high ground and put some heavy rain on those monsters. Help my men and their tanks secure the flank points I've marked.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're leadin' the way, $(player.name). If you got a problem with that plan, that's too slaggin' bad. Now get out there and secure those flank points.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Things out here are levelin' off. Looks like it's time to head through that wall and see what's waitin' for us inside.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kara's in a bad spot, $(player.name). Do me proud.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to you, Durek's snipers are now in place. The time has come to press on and enter the Grimvault itself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yeah, no. Don't make me ask again.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has gone into the Grimvault to establish a forward camp in the Creeping Abyss. Proceed to his location and regroup with his forces.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Commander Durek in the Creeping Abyss
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kara's a big girl and she can take care of herself. You, on the other hand, gotta meet me inside Grimvault so we can bust it wide open.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This is gonna be one of the most important battles the Exiles'll fight on Nexus. Don't mess it up for us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is gonna be one of the most important battles the Exiles'll fight on Nexus. Don't mess it up for us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: When I found out you was down here, I knew we'd be okay. You're one of the best people we got, $(player.name), but don't get cocky.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My boys and I are on our way in. Step lively. We'll be waitin' for ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have met with Commander Durek inside the Grimvault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It ain't a tough choice, pal, 'cause you got no choice.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Academy of Science has developed an intense interest in exanite, a rare, unusually durable substance. Help Mineralogist Esmzov by collecting exanite samples throughout the Fractured Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mineralogist Esmzov via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shards of exanite moving at high velocities may have caused our ship's destruction. I require proof. Will you collect exanite shards for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Exanite is a most curious mineral. Meticulous examination of the substance may reveal much, but you must first collect it for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The mineral's edges are fresh, clean, and very, very sharp. Somehow, one of these exanite monoliths must have exploded with intense force. But how?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Samples of exanite can be found here in the Fractured Fields.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your assistance has been instrumental. I thank you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Beats the tar out of me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By examining the fragments of exanite you collected in the Fractured Fields, Mineralogist Esmzov deduced that an immense explosion shattered a large exanite structure in the area. The resulting shrapnel tore through your ship and made it crash.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Where did all these shards come from?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Prior to the crash, our scans revealed a large structure comprised entirely of exanite. This peculiar substance warrants further analysis.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: As you wish.

localizedTextIdText: Injured troopers in the Fractured Fields need to be led to a nearby medical station. Protect them from vicious wildlife as you take them there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Krull at the E-Med Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Friend, I ain't gonna make it. Help my buddies back on their feet. They'll get killed in their condition... you gotta show 'em the way.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I'm gonna die... nothin' you can do, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look pal, my hands are full here. If there's someone you can help, go and help 'em. We can catch up later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It takes real stone to put your neck on the line for others. You can bet these troopers are anxious to get back to work, but they need to heal up.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lead 'em to the E-Med station. Watch out for those scrab!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Don't worry. I'll lead them to safety.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Anything to help you guys out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your aid, many of the Injured Trooper strewn across the Fractured Fields have successfully made it to a nearby medical station. As such, they have been spared from a horribly painful demise due to the area's vicious wildlife.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll bring those men to safety.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Those were some words I didn't wanna hear....

localizedTextIdText: You found a destroyed rifle in the ship's wreckage. The weapon needs replacement parts if it is to function again. Find replacement parts for the rifle throughout the Fractured Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Zhanna Zarkkovian via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This rifle seems to have been destroyed in the crash. Perhaps you can find some spare parts to put it back in working order.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This rifle seems to have been destroyed in the crash. Perhaps you can find some spare parts to put it back in working order.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is a remarkable... creation. Yes. Though I am uncertain as to its intended function. Does it dry hair?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, it is clear to me now... you hold a weapon. It seems you have cobbled it together from a plethora of peculiar parts. Ingenious.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perchance we can seek a way to profit from your invention... later.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We need to mass-market Big Mama!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to cobble together a mess of parts into a functioning firearm. "Big Mama," as you called her, packed quite a punch, but she started to fall apart after some rough usage.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: This isn't a hair dryer! It's Big Mama!

localizedTextIdText: The Black Hoods have been rigging corpses to blow with injectable explosives. Help Zhanna Zarkkovian test this new explosive by using it on corrupted scrab in the Fractured Fields outside the walls of Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Zhanna Zarkkovian via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Black Hoods are testing an injectable explosive for use on the dead. Kill scrab and inject their corpses with this. Beware the shrapnel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If used appropriately, this substance can be employed for battlefield clean-up as well as insurgent and counter-insurgent activities.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have demonstrated the injectable explosive's usability. We must increase the potency further, I feel. Nevertheless, I appreciate your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If successful, such a substance will be very versatile.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Apparently dead bodies make good vessels for explosives. This is especially true for scrabs, as their hard exoskeletons create deadly shrapnel upon detonation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps we should experiment on your corpse, instead?

localizedTextIdText: Security Chief Drantor has ordered you to investigate a Torine settlement known as Deathbringer Hollow outside of Research Camp Echo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Deathbringer Ehel in Deathbringer Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Reports comin' in of Strain takin' over a Torine settlement up past Twilight Grove. Someone oughtta check into it, and that person'd be you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Got rocks in your ears or what? Go find that Torine settlement before it's nothin' but corrupted goop!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We do not suffer strangers lightly. The danger you face by coming here is great.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Strain's the real threat. Check on the spread of this corruption goop, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good. You will aid us in our strife, outsider.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reached Deathbringer Hollow, where the corruption appears to be wide-spread, and spoke to Deathbringer Ehel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I think it's called Deathbringer Hollow. Sounds pretty grim, ya ask me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I ain't sure why you'd back down now.

localizedTextIdText: The Strain will quickly overrun Research Camp Echo unless you act. Hand out flamethrowers, set up turrets, and destroy spore pods around Twilight Grove to slow down the rate of corruption.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Security Chief Drantor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain'll overrun this place if we don't stop it. Your best bet is to burn back the infection. Better take out a few spore pods, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hand out them flamethrowers and cut some spore pods down before that Strain stuff spreads any closer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nothing like the smell of burnin' slag in the afternoon. That oughta slow this stuff down a bit.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Grunts like us need to keep these eggheads safe.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With all the flamethrowers you set up and spore pods you destroyed, the Strain should advance at a much slower rate.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Blasted infection spreads through contact. And it grows some kinda pustule that oozes the disease. You stand still long enough - it'll get ya.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya think purple is a good look on you?

localizedTextIdText: Security Chief Drantor has asked you to use his very favorite gun "Vera" on corrupted creatures in Twilight Grove to find the Strain's weakness.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Security Chief Drantor via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that we slowed this stuff down, it's time to find its weakness. My gun "Vera" changes up what she shoots to find the very best way to kill stuff.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What're you still doin' here? Take Vera out and use her on those Strain creatures. We got to learn what works best on 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So you're sayin' that nothin' Vera could throw at 'em made much of a difference? That's mighty disappointin'!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Vera's got a kick, but she ain't got much bite. If you get my drift.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I guess we gotta kill 'em the old fashioned way... bash 'em till they stop movin'!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: "Vera" could not seem to find anything that would overtly effect the corrupted creatures in Twilight Grove.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sure about that, pal? Vera's gettin' mighty restless....

localizedTextIdText: The (Pulp-Gulp Distributions Supervisor) wants you to come to the Pulp-Gulp Headquarters, home of the space renowned Pulp-Gulp beverage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Pulp-Gulp Distributions Supervisor at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've heard of your enterprising nature and extend you an offer to visit the famous Pulp-Gulp Headquarters. This is a one time offer so act now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Greetings, $(player.name). It is my distinct pleasure to welcome you to the home of the universe's most profitable beverage!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Wonderful, I'll be expecting you soon!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I guess I could stop by.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Quite the operation you have here!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in the Port of Profit where Protostar has built the great Pulp-Gulp Headquarters, a producer of the most famous beverage to ever hit the Halon Ring.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Pulp-Gulp Distributions Supervisor
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Only the most revolutionary discovery in carbonated beverages since the discovery of Nexus. Using proprietary techniques we take Glow Stalks native to Halon Ring and process them into Pulp-Gulp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That answer is insufficient.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin wants to see how creatures react to the Strain just after infection. Take some test subjects into Twilight Grove and expose them to some infected remains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need to observe a creature's reaction to the Strain upon initial infestation. Give these test subjects something Strain infected to ingest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: These creatures must die so my people can live. Now go and release the test subjects upon that which is infested with the Strain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. This has brought us one step closer in our pathology to an understanding of the Strain. Are you prepared for the next step?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It is gruesome work but necessary to understand the Strain.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope it was worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You exposed several creatures in Twilight Grove for Victor Lazarin, and learned that the Strain almost immediately infects any creatures exposed to it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I expected your assistance to be applicable to my impending analysis.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin Strain research requires fresh tissue samples from corrupted plants and animals in Twilight Grove.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain saturates this grove. Collect samples of mutated flora and fauna for my research into the long term effects of this affliction.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Strain specimens from which you are sampling are quite dangerous. My experiments won't progress as well without you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A pound of flesh for an ounce of cure, eh? It is possible, I surmise, but the proof is in the pudding.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We shall see if such sickly specimens can advance our research.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can't wait to find out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The infected samples have been collected, sealed, and delivered to Victor Lazarin for his analysis.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is a corruption at the very core of nature. It is an abomination of science. And it may very well be our doom.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, yes. And desperately exciting.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Consider the consequences if we cannot stop the Strain.

localizedTextIdText: The Workbot Requisitions Adviser at Pulp-Gulp Headquarters has asked you to visit Locus Autonomy and speak to the Freebot preceptor there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Preceptor Axle at Locus Autonomy
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're running into problems recovering our workbots from the decommissioned mining operation in Wilderock. It seems a competitor is getting in the way.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Of course, Cogbot 5028 - I mean, Preceptor Axle isn't here. If he was, I wouldn't need YOU. You'll have to travel to Locus Autonomy to speak with him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Greetings, sentient!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome, organic! Might I inquire why your peregrination has brought you to our Locus? My processing system predicts your motivations to be of freewill and benevolence!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: While you're out there, tell those lazy bots to get their metal behinds back on the job before my supervisor realizes what's happened!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You may relay to Protostar that a true sentient exercises their right to deny requests from others.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Actually, Protostar wants you to return to work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Locus Autonomy and met with Preceptor Axle, leader of the Freebot community living in Wilderock.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: A competitor... vying for your workbots?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: One of our processing units, Cogbot 5028, became infected with a line of Freebot Code, and he's been haywire ever since. Now he's calling himself Preceptor Axle and has formed a community of defective machinery out in Wilderock.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you like to answer differently?

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has ordered you to collect field data from a Strain growth in Twilight Grove. Find the genetic analysis probe in the Grove and activate it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While you were occupied, I sent a team to probe data from the larger strain pustules. I've lost contact with them and need you to complete their work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The genetic analysis probe is a simple device. Even an intern can start its processes. Depress the activation stud and it will do the rest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Detailed readings have been delivered to me via my datachron. I am also happy to note that you survived your dogged defense of our device. Good show!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These probes disturb many hostile animals. Do not allow them to damage it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the Strain growth's genetic data for Victor Lazarin in Twilight Grove and survived an onslaught of creatures in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose I ask too much of you...

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin wants you to learn what happened to Researcher Anton, one of his assistants. Search Twilight Grove for any sign of him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin in Research Camp Echo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With the probe data secured I wish to find the missing team. Reports indicate that Researcher Anton is alive but has been infected. Bring him to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why do you delay? Capture Researcher Anton before it's too late. The more we delay the harder it will be to cure his condition.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you delay? Capture Researcher Anton before it's too late. The more we delay the harder it will be to cure his condition.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There may be a chance for Anton yet. If my experiment proves successful... we may be able to reverse his transmogrification on the primal level.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's possible that we may be able to cure him... after ample testing.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's a sad day for us all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In your search for Researcher Anton, you discovered that he'd been consumed by his research. Literally. You subdued what remained of him and allowed the containment specialists to take him away for further evaluation by Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: So this is a rescue mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If possible, yes. Though I fear he will not come willingly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Use caution. I do not want to have to send someone out after you, as well.

localizedTextIdText: Assist Victor Lazarin and Lucy Lazarin with the Strain-augmented experiment in Research Camp Echo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin in Research Camp Echo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The moment is nigh. I have isolated the Strain mutation and eliminated many of its deleterious side effects. We must proceed before it is too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Throw the switch! Let us find out whether this endeavor brings fortune or failure!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Anton was a dedicated researcher and a good friend. We must honor his memory by discovering a cure for the Strain. He would want no less.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Set the controls to the reconstructor, $(player.name). Do not delay!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If only we could harness the Strain's transformative power for benevolent ends.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready and willing to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Strain-augmented experiment was a complete failure. Only time will tell what affect these new creatures will have on the jungles surrounding Research Camp Echo.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your act is an insult to every Mordesh that has succumbed to the Contagion.

localizedTextIdText: You've been an invaluable asset and Director Kaspnov deeply regrets seeing you go but your skills are required elsewhere. Please report to Judge Kain at Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Judge Kain at Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've been an invaluable asset. I regret to see you go but your skills are required elsewhere. Please report to Judge Kain at Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, good to see an old face out on the edge of space. We've got some troubles 'round here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Judge Kain is happy to see you and could use your help in Black Jack's Salvage.

localizedTextIdText: You've been an invaluable asset and Axis Nyzine deeply regrets seeing you go but your skills are required elsewhere. Please report to Agent Lex in Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex in Black Jack's Salvage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've been an invaluable asset. I regret to see you go but your skills are required elsewhere. Please report to Agent Lex at Black Jack's Salvage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've been expecting you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Agent Lex is ready to brief you on the situation in Black Jack's Salvage.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Nyzine at Mimicry Junction explains they've reconfigured Ikthian transport to support your biological matter. Director Kaspnov requests you return to the enclave with speed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Axis Nyzine at Mimicry Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've reconfigured Ikthian transport to support your biological matter. I suggest you return to the enclave with speed. You've won the battle but not the war.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're mission is complete. You've dispensed of an entire incubating army of Ikthian super soldiers and returned to Mimicry Junction alive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The ICI thanks you for your service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're mission is complete. You've dispensed of an entire incubating army of Ikthian super soldiers and returned to Mimicry Junction alive. The ICI thanks you for your service.

localizedTextIdText: Preceptor Axle has received a broad band transmission requiring all able bodied members of the Dominion to report to Axis Nyzine at Mimicry Junction for assignment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Nyzine at Mimicry Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have rendered us much assistance fellow freedom fighter. We are receiving transmissions form a Axis Nyzine requiring all members of the Dominion report to Mimicry Junction.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The transmissions seemed quite clear that members of the Dominion were to report to Axis Nyzine at Mimicry Junction with all haste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So you have arrived.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Our fresh meat has finally arrived. Are you ready to fulfill your obligations to the Dominion?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall send word that you are in transit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Axis Nyzine as instructed.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Tell them I'm on my way!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Will you not help them like you helped us?

localizedTextIdText: Preceptor Axle has received an encrypted message for you from Director Kaspnov requesting your assistance at Nightwatch Enclave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Director Kaspnov at Nightwatch Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have rendered us much assistance fellow freedom fighter. We have picked up an encrypted transmission form a Director Kaspnov requesting aid at Nightwatch Enclave.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The transmissions sent form Director Kaspnov indicated that time was an important factor to consider for this request.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So you have arrived.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It seems my transmissions reached someone after all.  Are you ready to give your life for the cause?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall send word that you are in transit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Director Kaspnov as instructed.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Tell them I'm on my way!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Will you not help them like you helped us?

localizedTextIdText: You found the core from Overseer X-47 inside Augmentation Control Room 68. Far-Trader Zashur at The Phosporus Plane would probably be interested in it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Far-Trader Zashur in The Phosporus Plane
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The mangled core of the Overseer X-47 is still glowing with a beautiful light. Surely a treasure seeker would want this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get shinies from Eldan killing machine. Rumors say it guards room in Exo-Lab deep below surface.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Core is shinier than imagined! Super shiny!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Far-Trader Zashur.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You hang on tight to that thing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and destroyed the Bounty Board inside Augmentation Control Room 68 and recovered a glowing core. Far-Trader Zashur found the glowing core to be a wonderful treasure.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile military transport ship Widowmaker has been shot down in Grimvault by the Strain. Ashella Sunfell, a survivor aboard the ship, has hailed all Exiles in the area with a plea for help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Nerissa Artan inside the Widowmaker
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Emergency! Calling any Exiles in the area! The Widowmaker has been shot down! Any Exile receiving this broadcast, please head to my location immediately!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is really bad. I mean, really, really bad.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank goodness you're here, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We don't have much time! Please hurry!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It will be a tough row to hoe if we're all going to get out of here alive.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I got here as fast as I could.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The military transport ship Widowmaker was shot down in Grimvault by the Strain. Ashella Sunfell was among the Exiles who survived the crash, and she insisted there was rescuing and Strain-killing to do before she would leave. Fortunately for her, these goals fell into your area of expertise.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're our only hope! Please! Don't abandon us!

localizedTextIdText: Ashella Sunfell, aboard the Widowmaker, is leading a recovery operation that is currently blocked by a Strain ambush at the entrance to the ship. She's ordered you to use flares to lure the Strain out from their positions and kill them so the operation can continue.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ashella Sunfell at the Widowmaker's exit
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those things are lying in wait, pouncing on anyone that comes by. We need them out of the way. There's a flare you can use to lure them out of hiding.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we don't get those Strain monsters out of the way, we won't be able to save any of the ship's remaining crew. You're our only hope!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the entrance to the ship clear, we can get this recovery operation under way. Thanks so much for lending us a hand!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They're nasty customers, $(player.name). Be careful.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Ashella Sunfell behest, you baited the Strain at the Widowmaker's entrance into attacking you and quelled the threat. Your actions will allow the recovery operation to move forward.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why haven't you fled the ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lulu and I may be moving very slowly, but we're not willing to abandon everyone aboard. After all, we can't carry out our Widowmaker Contingency orders if we're not aboard the Widowmaker, right?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Everything about this situation in Grimvault is so upside down, we're under strict orders to rescue all the survivors we can, and recover as much combat gear as possible. Everything counts! But, we can't let the Strain have anything if we can help it, so there's also a... disposal element.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We could really use your help! Please don't make me beg.

localizedTextIdText: The Widowmaker's remaining power is unreliable at best. Ashella Sunfell has ordered you to repair and activate the auxiliary power system to help the recovery efforts and allow the still-functioning cryo pods to be opened.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashella Sunfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Power's failing all over the place. Auxiliary power should help, but I doubt that it survived the crash. You need to repair it, then activate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This operation will fail if you don't activate the ship's auxiliary power generator. I thought you were going to take care of that for us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're amazing! The Widowmaker's remaining systems are up and running! I think our bad luck is turning around!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can do it, $(player.name). I just know it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't sit down. There's still more to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ashella Sunfell ordered you to repair and reactivate the Widowmaker's auxiliary power system. Now that you've successfully restored power, further recovery efforts can be undertaken, such as attending to the passengers in the still-functioning cryo pods.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: These generators are Eldan tech that the XAS built into the ship. We don't really understand it too well yet. I should probably warn you that it might not react the way you'd expect it to.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: People's lives are at stake here! Mine included!

localizedTextIdText: Ashella Sunfell has ordered you to open cryo pods in the Widowmaker's cryobay before their occupants are corrupted by the Strain. Should any of these unfortunates be compromised by the Strain, you are to eliminate them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashella Sunfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've still got a bunch of troopers trapped in their cryo pods. What's worse, some of them have even succumbed to the Strain. We need to set them free.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those poor Exiles... if the Strain's gotten to them, they'll be in such terrible pain! You have no choice but to end their suffering!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Exiles you freed from the cryo pods will pull through. Thanks to you, they still have hope. As for the others... they're part of the Weave now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you encounter any corrupted Exiles... well, do what needs to be done.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hold onto your tail, because things are about to get messy.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find them and free them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I did what needed to be done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed as many Exiles as you could from the Widowmaker's cryobay, while simultaneously putting those who had succumbed to the Strain out of their misery.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Our cryo pods seem to fail a lot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah, now that you mention it, I've heard about a lot of people getting stuck in those things. I wonder if there will some kind of recall... maybe a lawsuit.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know it'll be tough, but you've got to do it.

localizedTextIdText: One of the Skurge has been detected aboard the Widowmaker, and Ashella Sunfell has ordered you to drop everything and destroy the beast. If left to its own devices, the creature may kill what remains of the ship's passengers and crew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashella Sunfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: One of our troopers has spotted one of the Skurge on the ship's second level. Those things are bad news. You need to kill it before it gets down here.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I still detect the Skurge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: No one here stands a chance against that Skurge creature except for you. It'll kill everyone. Who knows how much damage it's already done?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank the Mother Tree! I had a horrible feeling after sending you off to kill that creature. I'm so glad you made it out of that fight in one piece!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful. I'm pretty sure that thing killed a lot of the crew.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm pretty good at this stuff.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Tekli the Admonisher was sent to destroy you aboard the Widowmaker, but you were able to defeat the filthy creature quite handily.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I guess they want something - or somebody - aboard this ship pretty badly. We don't see Skurge too often. All the more reason for you to kill the thing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've killed bigger things than this Skurge... haven't you?

localizedTextIdText: Ashella Sunfell has ordered you to meet with Commander Vaxul at the Widowmaker's self-destruct system in order to deny it to the Strain. Once you've armed the system, you must escape before the ship explodes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashella Sunfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have to face facts - the Widowmaker's beyond saving. Go to the bridge and help the Commander set the self-destruct system. It's our only hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Commander can't activate the self-destruct system by himself. He needs you to help him out while I evacuate the rest of our personnel. Good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm speechless. I've never seen a ship go up like that... and poor Commander Vaxul, he was such a hero at the end. You, too, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The most we can do now is deny this ship to the enemy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take care of yourself. We'll meet again. The Weave's funny like that.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Let's not do that again anytime soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Vaxul bravely triggered the Widowmaker's self-destruct system while you escaped and survived the explosion by the unlikeliest of means.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yeah, the self-destruct system is pretty finicky, and he's the only one that's ever used one before.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're really going to try and pawn this off on someone else?

localizedTextIdText: Finding you to be a dependable and effective asset, Avra Darkos has revealed her cloaked position outside the Widowmaker. She has ordered you to find Terminal 1984 on an upper deck of the ship and transmit its data to her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Funny finding you here, $(player.name). I have need of your talents once more. Proceed to the upper deck of this ship, access Terminal 1984, and transmit its data to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you still doing here?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not delay. The importance of the data contained within Terminal 1984 is inestimable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Data received. It is precisely what I was looking for. Continue to be successful and I may let you in on a secret or two.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Discretion is of the utmost importance, as is success.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There are few things more valuable than a reliable asset, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: As requested by Avra Darkos, you found Terminal 1984 on an upper deck of the Widowmaker and uploaded its contents to her. You once again proved to be the dependable and effective asset she's appraised you to be.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Unfortunate events have a way of befalling those who disobey me.

localizedTextIdText: The next step in Avra Darkoss secret mission requires that you locate and enter Department 5150 on the Widowmaker's top floor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are not done yet. The location of a security door leading into Department 5150 has been transmitted to your datachron. Find this door and use it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The entrance to Department 5150 is somewhere aboard this ship. Seek it out, breach it, and report back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, this sheds some light upon the shadows. If you continue to survive the demands of your service, we will accomplish much.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Beware of hostiles, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Prepare for the next step.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You breached the top-secret Department 5150 aboard the Widowmaker for Avra Darkos. Perhaps now, Avra will let you in on the nature of her current operation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Depending on the results of your current task, I may provide you with more details. For now, it is best if you do not ask too many questions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You may want to rethink your response.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos, outside the Widowmaker, has remotely deactivated most of the security systems in Department 5150. The remaining systems must be neutralized in-person. Hack each Security Control Board to disable the system's targeting protocols so you can gain access to your next objective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The majority of Department 5150's security has been remotely deactivated. You must use the security control boards to disable those that endure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use the security control boards to deactivate the remaining security systems in Department 5150. You cannot proceed until you do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With the remaining security systems stymied, you can continue with your assignment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I need not mention that you should avoid the spotlights.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It will take more than one victory for us to emerge victorious.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By hacking the Security Control Boards in Department 5150 aboard the Widowmaker, you were able to bypass the security measures that would have prevented your continued progress.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: So these are the last of the security measures?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Perhaps... but their continued neutrality cannot be guaranteed. The Black Hoods are quite thorough when creating such security measures.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am displeased by your declination.

localizedTextIdText: To complete her operation aboard the Widowmaker, Avra Darkos needs you to activate Interface OU-812 on Department 5150's catwalk so the Black Hoods can transmit command signals and control "Big Baby."
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Department 5150 is home to a bio-weapons project, code-named "Big Baby." You must use Interface OU-812 to activate Big Baby and unleash it on the Strain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Interface OU-812 will open up Big Baby's comm receptors so the Black Hoods can control the beast. The longer you wait, the less difference it will make.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If the Strain have volition or intelligence, they will soon understand the mistake they have made in attacking the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once Big Baby has been activated, the tide will turn for us in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The time has come to let Big Baby run its course.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can't wait to see what it can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You activated Interface OU-812 near Big Baby paddock aboard the Widowmaker. While this should have allowed the Black Hoods to control the beast, things did not go as planned. Big surprise, huh?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: This'll take care of all the Strain?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The simulated combat capabilities of Big Baby forced us to revise our initial estimate. This beast should turn the tide of battle if unleashed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is not wise to keep me from what I desire. You should know that by now.

localizedTextIdText: Strain corruption in Big Baby cognitive systems aboard the Widowmaker caused the Black Hoods to lose control of the creature. As a result, you're going to have to neutralize it before it neutralizes you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wait... I have unfortunate news. Strain corruption has caused Big Baby's control circuits to fail. We have no choice. You must destroy it at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Big Baby must be destroyed before it wreaks havoc amongst we Exiles. There are few enough of us as it is, and Big Baby does not know friend from foe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Though our attempt to subvert the Strain has not succeeded, you have brought the situation under control. A lesser agent would have been killed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I certainly hope you are able to assert yourself over this animal!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Black Hoods never forget a job well done, $(player.name). Be well.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of Big Baby!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Big Baby in Department 5150 aboard the Widowmaker before it could squash you like an insect. The nasty creature had suffered Strain corruption in its cognitive systems, preventing it from being controlled by the Black Hoods. Good thing, too, or you might not have seen any action at all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refuse me, will you? Know that if that monster does not kill you, I will.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion is offering a reward for the destruction of Deathroll, a large garr that has been seen in the river near Honeyworks Headquarters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Guard Captain Terentius at the Honeyworks Honeyworks
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: SECURITY BULLETIN\nReward offered for the immediate removal of the large garr known locally as "Deathroll." Order signed: Guard Captain Terentius.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: SECURITY BULLETIN\nReward offered for the immediate removal of the large garr known locally as "Deathroll." Order signed: Guard Captain Terentius.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is still a flesh-hungry garr out there preying on the locals. If Deathroll isn't taken care of soon, someone is going to pay the price.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That garr was a nuisance that was tolerated for too long. I am surprised someone finally made an effort to rid us of the creature.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy your reward, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He'll make a good set of luggage.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the huge garr, Deathroll, and collected your reward.

localizedTextIdText: There is an expedition that aims to uncover the secrets of Alpha Complex and its associated Eldan facilities. Researcher Vibius has asked you to meet with Researcher Ahnaris, the leader of the expedition. Travel through the teleporter and speak with her in Alpha Complex.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Researcher Ahnaris inside Alpha Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The teleporter behind me leads into Alpha Complex and our research camp. Use it, then go speak with Researcher Ahnaris. He's a bit impatient, he is.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You ain't talked to Ahnaris yet? By Dominus, he's going to be right pissed if you don't get down there, guv.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At long last. Our "specialist" has arrived. I do hope you're as capable as the Collegium let on, or I will be quite annoyed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't keep his majesty waitin' too long, if you get me drift.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've got my eyes on you, $(player.name). Now... let's see where you're needed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've landed on the surface of Farside, only to meet up with Researcher Vibius. He sent you into Alpha Complex to speak with Researcher Ahnaris, who likely has an assignment or two for you.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll go talk to him soon enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't want to, there's nothing I can do to change your mind, wot?

localizedTextIdText: You have been contacted by Scientist Bizi, a Chua who has been captured by the Ascendancy. He's being held in Augment Facility X426 in Whitevale and has requested that you rescue him immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker in Augment Facility X426
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Most embarrassing. Was captured while researching Eldan machines. Crazy cult shredded my ears. Rescue attempt appreciated.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Cult wants to turn me into augmented freak. Please hurry!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You really should rescue your comrade. He seemed to be quite uncomfortable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do you normally risk your life for such creatures? Or was that one special in some way? How curious.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You do good deed. Rescue very important scientist. Know the Zax personally.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I've never seen him before in my life.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully rescued Scientist Bizi from the clutches of the Ascendancy and performed a valuable service for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Will kill you for this if I escapes from cult!

localizedTextIdText: The Bounty Board tells of the vicious Beastlord Renkel inside of Kel Ulgar. Renkel is responsible for untold cruelty against the wildlife of Wilderrun. He must be eliminated.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Shinequest Meechi via datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Beastlord Renkel is responsible for untold cruelty to the wildlife in Wilderrun. He must be eliminated. Do not attempt to kill him alone.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The bounty on Beastlord Renkel in Kel Ulgar has yet to be collected.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You plan to kill the big bad Beastlord? $(player.name) is very brave! Lopp wish you luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you $(player.name) for stopping evil Osun from hurting wildlife. Wilderrun is safer without Ulgar Ugly around.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be safe out there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered Kel Ulgar and eliminated Beastlord Renkel. The animals of Wilderrun will be safer for it.

localizedTextIdText: The Communications Relay you found is part of an Exile communications network in Wilderrun. Toric Antevian has ordered you to venture into the jungle and access the Exile network, one comm relay at a time, to expose the trail that will inevitably lead you to the Exiles and their objectives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exile comm relay has revealed the coordinates of another dish. Find the second relay, and so on, until you find the source of the Exile traffic.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in blazes are you doing here? You should be in the field tracking down the Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That'd be the last of the Exile relays, yeah? Good work tracking them down. We'll get to the bottom of this soon enough, I wager.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Stand by, I'm uploading the coordinates now. Scions watch over you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed the trail of Exile communications relays to their source.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Exiles use a series of interlinked comm relays to make their transmissions harder to trace. You're going to find them all, get me?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal is ill-advised.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This crate contains an item supplied by the Dominion military. It's all yours!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've received a Dominion-issued item from the supply crate.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You received a supply drop from the Dominion military.

localizedTextIdText: Following Veshek the Ravager defeat, you found his Champion's Medal. If you show it to Arena Master Que'gar at the Crater of Carnage, he might bestow the title of "Champion" on you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Arena Master Que'gar at the Crater of Carnage
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Champion's Medal, taken from the corpse of Veshek the Ravager, belongs to you now. If you show it to the arena master, you might get a reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By Yokuzi's ghost! Didn't think to see it with me own eyes! Yargil was the meanest Marauder this side o' the Darkspur Nebula, but you're the champion now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's the champion's purse, matey. Don't be spendin' it all in one place!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After defeating Veshek the Ravager in the Crater of Carnage arena, you showed his Champion's Medal to Arena Master Que'gar and earned the title of Champion... along with a hefty prize purse. Congratulations!

localizedTextIdText: Colonel Trillos at Fort Glory is pleased with your work in Auroria. He is now sending you to the snowy lands of Whitevale to aid Major Glacian Aurelius in Palerock Post. Transportation can be obtained from Captain Visia at Spaceport Alpha in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius at Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your work is done here, $(player.name). Should wish to continue your service to the Empire, speak with Major Aurelius at Palerock Post in Whitevale.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Major Aurelius is not a patient man. I've sent him complimentary news of your coming. Please do not make me out to be a liar.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have little time for conversation at the moment. I suggest you seek out my adjutant.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Trillos said you'd be coming. Welcome to the Palerock Wilds. I do hope you brought something warm to wear.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: On behalf of the Gold Legion, I thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have met with Major Glacian Aurelius in Palerock Post. Your snowy adventurers have begun!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Should you need a rest from your labors, I understand.

localizedTextIdText: You received a distress call from Samantha Dustland, a young Exile girl, near the crash at Charlie Company Crash Site. What's such a young lady doing in a place like this? You'd better investigate the crash site and see if you can find her.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Samantha Dustland at the Charlie Company Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My friends and I are in a bit of a pickle! We were just playin' around in this ship... then it took off! Now we're all trapped! Think you can help us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't want to go on any ships anymore! No siree!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank the stars you came! We didn't mean to stir up any trouble, I swear! We was just tryin' to be, ya know... adventurous... like $(player.name) is.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm locked in a cryo pod! You gotta get me out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You... you are? By Walker's biggest boil! No way!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hold tight. I'll come get you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Samantha Dustland, a young Exile girl, snuck aboard the transport ship along with her friends. Unfortunately, the transport ship crashed outside the walls of Grimvault. To better weather the crash, they all hid inside cryo pods. Someone needs to find them and send them home.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'd leave me to die here? You gotta be kiddin'!

localizedTextIdText: Samantha Dustland friends, Jesse Lockhurst, Micah Ferrystone, and her little brother Moris Dustland are still locked inside their cryo pods. Find their cryo pods in Charlie Company Crash Site and let them out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Samantha Dustland at the Charlie Company Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We were just lookin' for a bit of fun, right? But then the sirens started blarin' and we hid in these pods. Can ya find my friends and let 'em out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Moris is my little bro! You gotta find him! I told my folks I'd keep an eye on him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where are Micah and Moris? Blast it! You hafta find 'em, $(player.name)! Knowin' those two, they probably hid in this here cave...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Jesse's dressed like me, Micah's got his top hat, and Moris wore his bow tie!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh Jesse, what did we get into... this is horrible!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can find them.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not sure I like the look of that cave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Jesse Lockhurst was safe and sound, but Micah Ferrystone and Moris Dustland are still missing. If they were able to escape their cryo pods, they may have gone to hide in a nearby cave.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why were you in this ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We was just havin' a bit of fun, is all. We sneak onto these ships for a laugh. Didn't know what to do when it started up... we thought hidin' in these pods would keep us from gettin' caught.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: There are four of us. Jesse Lockhurst, Micah Ferrystone, and my little bro, Moris.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No, don't leave me! Don't leave us!

localizedTextIdText: Micah Ferrystone and Moris Dustland hid in the Ethereal Hollow, a cave in Grimvault, to escape from the strange creatures lurking outside. Go inside the cave and look for the missing boys before something terrible happens to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Micah Ferrystone in the Ethereal Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tell you what, $(player.name). Bein' as you're a hero and all, would you go into the cave and look for Micah and Moris? We'll stay right here!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If anything happens to Moris, papa's gonna tan my hide somethin' fierce.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's too dark in here! I keep hearin' noises! Slitherin'! It's horrible!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I sure am glad to see you! I thought I was monster chow for sure! But Moris got bit by one of those critters and ran off!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You just gotta find Moris. I was supposed to look out for him!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: He got bit? That can't be good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've reached the end of the Ethereal Hollow and found Micah Ferrystone shaken but alive. He informed you that Moris Dustland was bitten by one of the creatures before running off and hiding. Someone needs to find Moris and make sure he's okay.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is my little brother we're talkin' about! He's just a kid!

localizedTextIdText: Micah Ferrystone is safe, but he's informed you that Moris Dustland has been bitten by one of the creatures in the Ethereal Hollow and run off into one of the cave's alcoves. You'd better locate Moris and ensure he's okay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Samantha Dustland by the Charlie Company Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You gotta help Moris! He got bit by one of them things! I told him to run up into the alcoves. He looks bad, man! You gotta help him!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Where's Moris? Did you find him yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Any signs of Moris? I should've never let him outta my sight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Any signs of Moris? I should've never let him outta my sight!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find him, please! Bring him back to us!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dead? No! This is horrible! *sob* What have I done? I couldn't keep him safe!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Get out of here. I'll find him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Moris Dustland in the depths of the Ethereal Cavity, but he was beyond saving. You destroyed the thing that he'd become, and then delivered the sad news to his sister, Samantha.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What kinda hero are you? A bad one, that's what kind!

localizedTextIdText: The bodies of infected soldiers are rife with whatever killed them. To prevent the disease's spread, the dead infectious troopers in Ethereal Hollow must be burned.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Chioll via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many of our troopers have been killed by some kind of disease. We can't claim their remains without risking infection, so we need to burn them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The disease can't be allowed to spread, and I'll be damned if we let our people rot in that cave. Do the right thing and burn them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. It saddens me to know we've left them all behind, but it's not like we had much of a choice. At least they can rest now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Treat them with honor and let them become one with the Weave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've burned the bodies of the dead infectious troopers in the Ethereal Hollow, thereby destroying the disease within them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Man! You are such a jerk!

localizedTextIdText: A bounty has been posted for Golboth the Gatecrusher, a creature of incredibly sinister reputation. Should you wish to risk your life in pursuit of this beast, take some companions and search for it at the mouth of the Breach in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Kara at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nGolboth the Gatecrusher is a massive creature of singularly sinister reputation. A substantial reward is offered for proof of the beast's death.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Anyone bearing proof of Golboth the Gatecrusher's demise must submit it to Sergeant Kara prior to receiving payment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We ain't got the manpower to bring Golboth down. Maybe you and some of your pals can do it? Be sure to take plenty of ammo.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You actually brought that sucker down? Hot damn! I'd give you a cold one if there was any brew to be had out here. Take this reward, instead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya around, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the Breach and delivered a rather messy death to the beast known as Golboth the Gatecrusher, earning a substantial reward for your trouble.

localizedTextIdText: You've killed Golboth the Gatecrusher and recovered its finger as proof of its death. Take the digit to Sergeant Kara at the Final Stand and collect your reward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sergeant Kara at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This huge finger has a lot of nasty goop beneath its broad, broken fingernail. You'd better take it to Sergeant Kara as proof of Golboth's death.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You actually brought that sucker down? Hot damn! I'd give you a cold one if there was any brew to be had out here. Take this reward, instead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya 'round, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this finger to Kara.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You braved the Breach and delivered a rather messy death to the beast known as Golboth the Gatecrusher, earning a substantial reward for your trouble.

localizedTextIdText: Protostar's plan to offer housing on Nexus sounds dangerous, but it's your big chance to claim a piece of the world for your very own. If you intend to put down roots, you'd better speak to the Protostar Housing Specialist in Algoroc or Celestion as soon as you can!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist in Algoroc or Celestion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You there! Participate in Protostar's innovative housing plan and own a piece of Nexus! The benefits of home ownership far outweigh the risks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome back! Protostar has the plot of land you've been waiting for, so long as you don't mind using a little elbow grease to make it livable!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent! I will assist you after you review your contractual obligations!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Interact with the handy housing model to teleport to your new plot of land!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken with a Protostar Housing Specialist about your claim to land on (or, at least, above) Nexus. To pay your new slice of heaven a visit, please use Protostar's teleporter technology by activating the holographic housing model near the Protostar Housing Specialist.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist

localizedTextIdText: Protostar's plan to offer housing on Nexus sounds dangerous, but it's your big chance to claim a piece of the planet for your very own. If you intend to put down roots, you'd better speak to the Protostar Housing Specialist in Deradune or Ellevar as soon as you can!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist in Deradune or Ellevar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You there! Participate in Protostar's innovative housing plan and own a piece of Nexus! The benefits of home ownership far outweigh the risks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome back! Protostar has just the right plot of land for you! After all, who doesn't love a good fixer-upper?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent! I will be happy to assist you once you have reviewed your contractual obligations!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Interact with the handy housing model to teleport to your new plot of land!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken with a Protostar Housing Specialist about your claim to land on (or, at least, above) Nexus. To pay your new slice of heaven a visit, please use Protostar's teleporter technology by activating the holographic housing model near the Protostar Housing Specialist.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to a Protostar Housing Specialist
