localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're missing out on a once-in-a-lifetime galactic opportunity!

localizedTextIdText: Governor Aluviel contracts a great deal of his city's mining and food production to the Protostar Corporation. Unfortunately, Protostar has not been meeting its recent quotas with the Dominion in Hycrest, and Aluviel wants to know why. He has sent you to the Cubig Farms to investigate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Production Facility Manager at the Cubig Farms
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hycrest relies on Protostar contracts for many of its resources. I would like you to meet with our Protostar rep and find out why they have fallen behind.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Protostar's farms are outside of Hycrest. Attempt to learn why Protostar has not been meeting its quotas and, if possible, correct the issue.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Most efficient greetings! I assure you, this situation is unique and in no way reflects on Protostar's commitment to keeping Hycrest supplied.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Auroria is a veritable breadbasket, but we require Protostar's contributions.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps. I am not above contracting outsiders for menial tasks.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get to the bottom of it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Perhaps there's something I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've traveled to the Protostar Cubig Farms outside Hycrest and spoken to the Production Facility Manager about the recent reduction in Protostar's production.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll get to the bottom of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Production Facility Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have been patient, citizen. Such a mood cannot last long...

localizedTextIdText: The Phagelabs have been corrupted by Vorion, and the air itself carries the bio-phage throughout the facility. Prolonged exposure to the airborne bio-phage is harmful, so the Caretaker has asked you to light exanite lanterns to mitigate its effects.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Vorion has released airborne bio-phage throughout the facility. If you activate exanite lanterns, they should counteract the corruption's effects.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Exanite counteracts bio-phage at a fundamental level. By lighting exanite lanterns, you can protect yourself from the corruption.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent survival instincts, sentient. Whenever the effects of the bio-phage become unbearable, seek out an exanite lantern.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Exanite is a miraculous mineral, isn't it?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I do find it odd that there are so many lanterns about....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Exanite counteracts the effects of the airborne bio-phage, just as the Caretaker said it would. If you ever begin to feel symptoms of the bio-phage setting in, seek out an exanite lantern to ward off its effects.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: As I have explained, this is the Phagelabs. The initial experiments involving augmentation took place here, and Vorion oversaw the entire project. It appears as if he has "perfected" his processes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The air is heavily-laden with the bio-phage. If you light exanite lanterns, you should be able to stave off the effects of corruption.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Heated exanite can counter the effects of the bio-phage for a time. I suspect these lanterns were installed as a safety precaution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without those lanterns, you will be overcome by the bio-phage.

localizedTextIdText: Between the corruption of the facility's native canimid and Vorion's activation of Eldan constructs, the Phagelabs are overrun by hazards. To clear the way for your advance, the Caretaker has suggested you destroy both constructs and canimid.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Phagelabs are overrun by corrupted canimid, while Vorion has activated Eldan constructs to hunt you down. Destroy these threats at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need I remind you that the corrupted constructs must be decommissioned? Not to mention the canimid you've agreed to exterminate?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Vorion has certainly been a busy buzzbing. Without the constructs and canimid around, our attempts to confront him will be much easier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I've seen you kill. You're quite good at it, and I'm certain you'll be fine.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The numbers of hostile canimid and Eldan constructs in the Phagelabs have been reduced, but it's only a matter of time before Vorion creates more of them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's your funeral, though I suspect there won't be much left to bury.

localizedTextIdText: To prevent the airborne bio-phage from reaching the surface, the Caretaker has instructed you to destroy the exhaust vents throughout the second level of the Phagelabs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The airborne bio-phage is Vorion's attempt to deter intruders, but it may seep outside through a series of exhaust vents. Those vents must be destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You will need to expose yourself to concentrated quantities of airborne bio-phage when you destroy the exhaust vents. It is a necessary risk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Though the exhaust vents are temporarily neutralized, they will not remain so for long. We must locate the master source and shut the system down.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I need not warn you of the danger posed by this airborne bio-phage.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You will die someday, sentient, but it will not be this day... apparently.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the exhaust vents on the second level of the Phagelabs, but the reprieve is only temporary. To destroy them permanently, the entire facility must be shut down.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That is, perhaps, the most inane response I've ever gotten from you.

localizedTextIdText: The master control room inside the Phagelabs must be shut down if the facility is to cease production of corrupted constructs and airborne bio-phage. The Caretaker has instructed you to go to the control room and shut down its systems.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker on Phagelabs Level 3
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The master controls for the entire facility are near at hand. Deactivating them will shut down the system. You had better get on with it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Each panel in the master control room must be shut down to fully disengage the system. A partial shut-down will only result in your premature demise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Each panel in the master control room must be shut down to fully disengage the system. A partial shut-down will only result in your premature demise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The system is rebooting itself. Once reengaged - which will take some time - it should be fully restored.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Vorion will not leave this area undefended. Be cautious.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not so quickly, sapient. There is still the subject of Vorion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've shut down the systems in the Phagelabs' master control room, and the Caretaker is pleased with your progress. Of course, all of your efforts will be for naught if Vorion isn't destroyed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What will you do, sapient? Return to the surface?

localizedTextIdText: Vorion the Corruptor must be destroyed before he spreads his madness to the rest of Nexus. The Caretaker has ordered you to descend deeper into the Phagelabs and defeat him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Caretaker at the Divergence
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If Vorion is not killed, he will only persist in his attempts to corrupt the planet. The time has come to use your brutish talents and destroy him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Vorion has concealed himself in the very heart of the Phagelabs. Descend deeper into the facility and ensure that he is destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Vorion has concealed himself in the very heart of the Phagelabs. Descend deeper into the facility and ensure that he is destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Vorion is no more. Quite an achievement, $(player.name). He was one of the six scientists responsible for the Entity, you know.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When I say "brutish," I mean it in the most flattering way possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With him gone, there are only five more scientists to go!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to defeat Vorion the Corruptor in the depths of the Phagelabs, but these matters are rarely, if ever, that simple.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You must be experiencing "fright". Of course, "death" is permanent.

localizedTextIdText: The creatures inside the Phagelabs have been infected by the bio-phage. If you collect bio-phage samples, the Caretaker may be interested in examining them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The creatures in the Phagelabs have obviously been overcome by the bio-phage. The Caretaker may be interested in analyzing samples of the disease.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am monitoring your progress, sapient. You seem to be collecting samples of bio-phage. Why?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have little need for the samples you collected. In fact, you have risked your health by doing so. bio-phage is dangerous on the best of days.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I suggest you destroy the samples at once. I cannot afford to lose you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What should I do with it, then?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Caretaker was not interested in the bio-phage samples you collected, and suggested you destroy them.

localizedTextIdText: Once infected by the bio-phage, the host's body and mind are bent to the Strain's will. However, such creatures CAN "overdose" on the bio-phage. Toss vials of bio-phage at corrupted creatures in the Phagelabs and observe its effects.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: On second thought, I hypothesize that additional exposure to bio-phage by Strain-corrupted creatures may have destructive results. Put it to the test.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I believe subjects corrupted by the Strain can "overdose" on the bio-phage. If this occurs, I predict they will die. Messily.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I believe subjects corrupted by the Strain can "overdose" on the bio-phage. If this occurs, I predict they will die. Messily.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I find it interesting that the bio-phage - a substance with few redeeming qualities - can be used as a weapon against the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Avoid exposure to the bio-phage. You are no good to me dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must keep this in mind for future use.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You confirmed that Strain-corrupted creatures will self-destruct if over-exposed to the bio-phage.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why don't you just eat the samples then?

localizedTextIdText: The corruption that emanates from the Phagelabs is a dangerous and deadly disease. If the corruption is allowed to engulf all of Nexus, it is only a matter of time before the rest of the galaxy will succumb!
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This canimid has succumbed to the bio-phage. If the corruption gets loose, all creatures will share the canimid's fate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This canimid has succumbed to the bio-phage. If the corruption gets loose, all creatures will share the canimid's fate.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I have a bad feeling about this.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have a bad feeling about this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The corruption that emanates from the Phagelabs is a dangerous and deadly disease. If the corruption is allowed to engulf all of Nexus, it is only a matter of time before the rest of the galaxy will succumb!

localizedTextIdText: Deep within the Alpha Sector in Grimvault lies the Phagelabs. The Phagelabs was where the Eldan first experimented with their augmentation process. The Caretaker has informed you that the facility has been taken over and must be recovered. Go into the Phagelabs and learn what evil lurks within.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The most destructive of Nexus's experiments were conducted in the Phagelabs, and they are under the control of an unknown foe. We must take them back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Enter the Phagelabs. If we are to save Nexus from whatever force has usurped this facility, we must go to the source of the problem.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to the Phagelabs, sapient. In centuries prior, a species like yours would have only seen this place from inside a stasis chamber.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can access the Phagelabs via the Divergence. I will be in touch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fear not. Against the odds, we will find a way to advance.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You always send me to the nicest places.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Vorion was an Eldan scientist who experimented with the augmentation process in a facility known as the Phagelabs. Somehow, a twisted version of his former self has assumed control over the Phagelabs and corrupted the technology created long ago. If not stopped in Grimvault, Vorion's corruption will spread across Nexus like a plague.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you prefer to ignore the oncoming apocalypse, so be it.

localizedTextIdText: Mind-Walker has sent you off to Locus Fortitude, a small Freebot camp home to Gauge, the leader of the Locus and the sender of a distress call for anyone who is willing and able to help. Mind-Walker urges you to visit Gauge to determine what he needs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge at Locus Fortitude.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are more that need help. We are grateful for your aid. But there is a group of Freebots. They are led by Gauge at Locus Fortitude. They deserve justice.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please, go quickly. We urge you to help the Freebots of Locus Fortitude. Find Gauge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Greetings, traveler! You are most welcome here at Locus Fortitude, where we fight bolt and screw to remain free and true. One like us, however, calculates to enslave us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We will not forget you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Alternator, a fellow Freebot, manipulates the Darkspur Cartel into his systemic plans for profit and plunder.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Gauge in Locus Fortitude and quickly learned about the terrifying predicament the Freebots are in.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We are very disappointed. We thought you stood for truth. For justice. For Logic!

localizedTextIdText: The Alternator, an old Freebot, is capturing Freebots to use at his disposal and has a large number being held inside of the Lugwrench Brig. Gauge explained that they have each been have emergency booster rockets that could get them to safety, but the Captured Freebots need fuel to break out of their short circuiting daze.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Gauge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That traitor, Alternator, is rounding up Freebots like cattle for the slaughter. My fellow sentients are captive by him. Can you refuel them to trigger their emergency boosters?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That Alternator tricked and enslaved Freebots that need fuel to jetpack out of their cages. They're in the Brig.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those that made it back look in bad shape, but they're happy to still have their Freedom. Thank you for what you've done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It will be dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Freebots you managed to fuel made it back safely to Locus Fortitude and remain underneath the care of Gauge and his team. Perhaps now they can discover more about how The Alternator is getting away with this scheme.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Certainly a being with emotional complexities such as yourself would feel empathetic towards us victimized Freebots?

localizedTextIdText: The Lugwrench Darkspur enslave, dismember and recode Freebots into battlebots, and Gauge needs to determine whether his friends have any Freebotism left in their code. He asked you to gather AI Cores from Lugwrench Security around the Lugwrench Brig and Reassembly Line.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do these Lugwrench Securitybots still have the Freebot Code inside them? I'm not sure the best engineers could remove it. Get me their AI Cores so I can find out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't quite have enough AI Cores from the Lugwrench Securitybots to splice together the data I need.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It doesn't appear as though the Darkspur understood how to fully erase the freedom from these bots. There is still hope for my fellow sentients!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They are almost unrecognizable now, our old friends....
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is indeed!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Fully stocked with AI Cores, Gauge and his associate, Torque, determined that the Lugwrench Securitybots and all the bots converted by the Darkspur still manage to have some lines from the Freebot Code inside them, giving Locus Fortitude hope that the conversion is not permanent.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I urge you to reconsider! I can't help my fellow bot if I do not understand what is happening to them!

localizedTextIdText: The Freebots you saved from the Lugwrench Brig informed Gauge about an intelligent Darkspur engineer that goes by the name of "Rusty Wrench" Figgs. With him alive, there will be no end to the Battlebot conversion. Gauge requests that you terminate his existence to help his efforts to free the innocent Freebots inside of the Lugwrench Botworks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My friends from the Brig told me about a mean old Darkspur Engineer that goes by the name of "Rusty Wrench" Figgs. He's the mastermind behind the reprogramming and must be terminated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I believe my request for the elimination of this "Rusty Wrench" fellow requires you to find him first in his Factory, not speak with me at my home.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You executed our enemy with great skill, friend, and we all thank you for this momentous achievement. We'll see how easy it is for them to convert us without that Figgs guy, now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Steal his explosives first so we can be sure to destroy his lab, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With "Rusty Wrench" Figgs eliminated, the Freebots of Locus Fortitude can rest assured that their AI Cores will no longer be re-written. However, this is only a small step on your journey to destroying the Lugwrench Botworks operation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: With this guy alive, there's no stopping these Darkspur from turning us from Free thinkers into mindless drones!

localizedTextIdText: With "Rusty Wrench" Figgs eliminated, Gauge suggests eliminating any trace of his work by ensuring the destruction of any non-operational bots that may be stowed. He asks you to scour the Lugwrench Commons and Figg's Factory for any Dormant Securitybot to destroy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With their engineer gone we should ensure no more of his creations come to fruition. Find his Dormant Securitybots and destroy them before they wake up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My calculation indicate that you have not quite removed the right percentage of Dormant Securitybots from the Lugwrench Commons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nicely done, organic! With no more surprise bots returning to the battlefield, it will be easier for those that lend their aid to continue doing so.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you have destroyed the bots in Lugwrench Commons and Figg's Factory, it is less likely for the Darkspur to be able to continue their creation. Gauge is grateful for your help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Our efforts to eliminate their strength are futile if they can flip a switch and have more securitybots at any time!

localizedTextIdText: Scouts from the Locus Fortitude camp nearby send reports of Injured Freebots littering the Lugwrench Proving Grounds, a facility where the Lugwrench Darkspur put their new creations to a rigorous test to determine their worth. Gauge thinks there is hope for those bots if they can hear the Freebot Code once more -- perhaps then they'll return to their old, free-thinking selves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Scouts from our Locus tell of poor brainwashed Freebots subjected to a gauntlet test. There are many injured and left for dead. Inspire them to come back to the Locus!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are still many injured Freebots waiting to die that need inspiration to come back to freedom!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It will take time for those you have rescued to fully remember the Freebot Code and retrieve their sentience, but this is a great start.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once they hear the Code, they will remember they are free.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My associate, Torque, is in the Lugwrench Loading Bay waiting to meet you for our next move.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will do what I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: By projecting the Freebot Code into the "minds" of the Injured Freebots littering the Lugwrench Proving Grounds, you successfully inspired those left for dead and hopeless to free themselves from the Lugwrench Darkspur influence and return to Locus Fortitude.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We cannot leave them there when there is hope for their safe return to the Freebot Way!

localizedTextIdText: Torque, $creature41605's brilliant associate, went into the Lugwrench Loading Bay to meet up with you and aid in his plan to take out The Alternator. However, Gauge hasn't heard back from him for quite some time, and would like you to meet up with him with caution.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Torque should have called me by now to verify that he arrived in the Loading Bay. Will you go there to see if he is alright? I think something bad has happened....
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Torque hasn't returned my calls since he went into the Lugwrench Loading Bay. Search for him?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blazing Bluescreens! I cannot express my gratitude with Torque's safe return. You fought for him valiantly, great $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Torque subdued, but when you attempted to free him from "Spark Plug" Scragg's men, you were ambushed! Nonetheless, you fought off the Lugwrench lackeys and sent Torque back to Locus Fortitude.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I fear his radio silence is only a bad sign. You mean to leave him for salvage?

localizedTextIdText: One major Lugwrench that goes by the name of "Spark Plug" Scragg stands in-between you and The Alternator. Take him out so you can board his ship and end this Freebot slavery for good.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is not over. If "Spark Plug" Scragg wants a fight, he'll get one, and since he stands in the way of our arch enemy, he must be eliminated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: These Lugwrench don't care who they hurt. That Scragg still lives, and if he does then so does that traitor. Eliminate him so we can finish this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You handled this with a grace only an organic like yourself could exude while doing such a brutal task. The end is near, my friend.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I don't imagine this will be difficult for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll be glad to end it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: "With grace" you killed "Spark Plug" Scragg as you made your way to The Alternator's ship. With him out of the way, there is nothing stopping you from ending the deactivation and dismemberment of Locus Fortitude Freebots.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We have come so far and are too close to the end to give up now! Please, $(player.name), I need you.

localizedTextIdText: The end of the Locus Fortitude enslavement is near as you come close to eliminating The Alternator. Gauge is ready to see justice brought to his community.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Gauge at Locus Fortitude.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That sneaky Alternator, traitor "Freebot", completely disgraces us with his manipulation of the Lugwrench Darkspur and enslavement of my people. Time to eliminate him once and for all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You should be on Alternator's ship! What are you doing back here? Get on his ship and eliminate him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes! It is finished! You have brought justice to Locus Fortitude by eliminating that sham of a Freebot, Alternator. We couldn't  thank you enough.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought justice to Locus Fortitude and all of the Freebots of Nexus by eliminating a Freebot traitor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Never knew your kind to be the type to back out of a fight last minute!

localizedTextIdText: The technology the Lugwrench Darkspur gang uses to reprogram the Freebots is strangely advanced, but like Hinge says, all code can be hacked. He suggests you hack their reprogramming devices around the Reassembly Line to hinder their ability to do harm to the Freebots of Locus Fortitude.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Hinge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have many reports of the "reprogramming" these Darkspur are using against us. All code can be hacked, however. Hack their hacking machines!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are more consoles that need hacking! You'll find them around the Reassembly Line.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That facility is awful! I can't believe how advanced these Lugwrench knuckleheads managed to become. Your efforts should make it a bit more difficult for them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully hacked various Reprogramming Consoles around around the Reassembly Line. Hinge thinks we should see a decrease in their ability to reprogram Freebots because of your efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not much for tinkering? If you can't do it, I'll find someone else!

localizedTextIdText: Hinge knows that The Alternator is playing everyone has a fool -- tricking both the Lugwrench Darkspur and all of his Freebot victims. He wants to ruin the Lugwrench pride by destroying the banners and the holo-emitters The Alternator uses to manipulate them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Hinge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That nasty Freebot traitor plays everyone as the fool, even the Darkspur! He manipulates their morale by piping his stories into their ears. We should burn their pride and shut him up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can still hear that traitor yapping! And are their banners still standing? Get to their Commons!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, well, I can still hear his voice ringing from the rest of the camp, but at least he won't get to them while they're sleepin', eating, living their sorry lives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Burnin' the banners and shutting down the holo emitters in the Lugwrench Commons should be enough.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With their banners burned and the holo-emitters shut off, Hinge hopes that the Lugwrench Darkspur can come to their senses and see that this "Alternator" isn't quite who he claims.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider. I can't stand listening to that guy yap on any longer! You can hear it all the way at the Locus.

localizedTextIdText: Hinge hates to see his friends being tortured inside of the Lugwrench Proving Grounds only to come out the other side and explode from injuries. He wants to inspire those who made it through to come back to the Locus by building a Symbol of Freedom outside of the grounds out of the parts of those that have fallen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Hinge via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our poor brothers! They need inspiration to return from their corrupted for loops and return to Locus Fortitude! Create a statue from those that have fallen to remind them of their roots!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't let those Freebots die in vain. Collect their parts and build a statue to remind them of their sentience!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hear great things of the statue you created outside of the Proving Grounds. Is it inspiring them? It must be! Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't let them self-destruct in vain!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: In their honor, I will build.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Immediately the impact from the statue you constructed is felt among the injured Freebots running out of the Lugwrench Proving Grounds. With your efforts, more Freebots should return to Locus Fortitude.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The least we can do is put their parts to good use! Why would you let them waste away when they can be used to help our friends?

localizedTextIdText: The Lugwrench Darkspur gang keeps chompacabra as pets, and the poor creatures get treated inhumanely inside of their cages. The cages are easy enough to open.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Thought-Speaker via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Chompacabra inside of this cage looks tired, hungry and sad. The Lugwrench are keeping these feisty creatures in inhumane conditions. They should all be freed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We could feel their pain -- the poor Caged Chompacabra crying out for someone to free them. We thank you for doing the right thing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spared many Strongjaw chompacabra throughout the Lugwrench Loading Bay. They shared their gratitude with you by following and fighting beside you after you gave them their freedom.

localizedTextIdText: Perelli needs your help to eliminate Osun brothers that moved in nearby and enjoy throwing hammers down at him and his brother as a pastime.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Perelli at Perelli's Procession.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Is there anyone around? My brother and I need immediate help to take down the hammer throwing osun brothers that moved in nearby.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, I'm so glad you could make it, $(player.name). I could really use your help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully found Perelli.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: They are destroying my entire livelihood!

localizedTextIdText: Perelli needs your help finding his brother, Serillo, who ascending Zogg's Slip in order to stop the Osun atop the tower from throwing their hammers down on Perelli's home. He created platforms for his brother to use, but he hasn't heard from his brother in too long.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Perelli via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Please help! My brother went up to that tower to stop those Osun from hurling their hammers down at my garden, and I haven't heard from him. Find him?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please don't waste time! All manner of horrible things could have happened to him up there! You'll need to find your way up Zogg's Slip.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You made it to the top! Is there any sign of Serillo?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I built a path to jump up, but you'll need to gather these power-ups first. Let's test one out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank goodness he is alive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ascending Zogg's Slip to find Perelli's brother, Serillo, locked up by two osun brothers, Gorash and Borash.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, please! We went through all of this effort to save our home here, and now my whole world is falling apart!

localizedTextIdText: Perelli created various concoctions to help supplement the lack of building materials he had for the platforms he constructed for Serillo to use. His "power-ups" come from dispensers he built into the platforms. Refill them for him on your way up to find Serillo!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Perelli via the Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I made a few concoctions to supplement my lack of building materials to help Serillo get up there. While you're on your way, would you mind refilling their dispensers?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You won't be able to refill my dispensers from down here! They are located on the way up Zogg's Slip.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for refilling those! Making sure those dispensers are full enough is key to ensuring our ability to ascend Zogg's Slip.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! You'll run into them on your way anyway!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Perelli is pleased that you managed to refill his power-up dispensers around Zogg's Slip. This ensures that Perelli and his brother will be able to venture up there as they please once the Osun are taken care of.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sure? Like I said, you'll need to use them to get up to the top anyway... are you abandoning us?

localizedTextIdText: Perelli and his brother, Serillo, devised a plan to send Serillo up Zogg's Slip so he can eliminate Gorash and Borash, two bored Osun brothers that fling hammers off their tower for fun. Unfortunately they swiftly captured him, and Perelli needs your help to save him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Perelli at Perelli's Procession.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This wasn't all for nothing, though. If we're to free my brother and me from their constant terror, that Osun duo must be eliminated. Kill them and free my brother!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing all the way back here? I need you to get back up to the top of Zogg's Slip to free my brother!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Serillo just arrived! I am so happy, my dear friend, I cannot even express my joy. I hope I can manage to thank you enough.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will take care of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Without your help, brother Perelli and Serillo would still feel the wrath from the osun brothers atop Zogg's Slip, would still be separated, and overall devastated. Because of you, the brothers are reunited and can live peacefully on their small farm.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But you've made it this far! You can see my brother with your own eyes, and you're going to run away now?

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker of Observation Exo-Lab XC1 has requested your presence to deal with a systems malfunction in the sprawling, ancient site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker at Observation Exo-Lab XC1.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings, sapient. Observation Exo-Lab XC1 is experiencing a minor system failure. I could use assistance from someone with your qualifications.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome. As you can see, my facility is currently experiencing some technical difficulties. Your aid will be appreciated.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Report to the Exo-Lab grounds promptly.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You answered the Caretaker's distress call and reported to Observation Exo-Lab XC1.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have no appreciation for the scientific method.

localizedTextIdText: The holoprojectors in Observation Exo-Lab XC1 are producing too many aggressive holograms for their simulations. The Caretaker has asked you to get the population under control.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker inside Observation Exo-Lab XC1.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The simulation systems at this facility have long since spiraled out of control. You must thin the Cassian holograms down to manageable levels.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Cassian holograms issue from the outer holoprojectors. Provided your ocular capabilities are sound, you should be able to find them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You succeeded? Excellent. Unfortunately the systems within this facility continue to simulate... aggressively.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Employ the violence you life forms exemplify.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought the Nomad survivor simulation at Observation Exo-Lab XC1 back under control.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Holograms of humans from Cassius - correct. These particular specimens are derived from those who survived their ship's impact with the island. Resilient.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: This facility's objective was to observe and understand these new specimens. Test subjects were not always available in the quantities required.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This facility will not run at optimum capacity without outside intervention.

localizedTextIdText: The haywire holoprojectors are spread throughout the Observation Exo-Lab XC1 facility. Maybe by decrypting the Torine holograms, you can help the Caretaker uncover the reason.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in Observation Exo-Lab XC1.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Torine simulation was truly breathtaking before it went rogue. If you could decrypt them, I can begin analyzing the resulting data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I've encoded your primitive technology with the decryption routine. The result should disperse the violent hologram.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've encoded your primitive technology with the decryption routine. The result should disperse the violent hologram.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With this data, I should be able to rein in the more unruly simulations in time. You should not concern yourself with it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The experiment is already compromised without your interference, after all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Torine holograms decrypted, the Caretaker of Observation Exo-Lab XC1 has a great deal of data to sift through.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This data cannot be processed without your aid, sapient.

localizedTextIdTitle: Who We Shaped You To Be
localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has tasked you with clearing the Dreg chamber within Observation Exo-Lab XC1 of the excess holograms.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker at the Observation Exo-Lab XC1 Altar.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Are you fascinated yet? Perhaps when you are clearing the next chamber of unruly Dreg constructs, you can ponder the genius of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are the holograms too much for you? They are accurate simulations of the Dreg.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have prevailed yet again. Perhaps you are exactly the sort of life form I have been programmed to seek...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They made so many improvements, after all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The holographic Dreg in Observation Exo-Lab XC1 proved no match for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You have no appreciation for the works of the Eldan.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker of Observation Exo-Lab XC1 has indicated that you are the perfect specimen to undergo some form of trial at the pinnacle of the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Captain Marcellinus in Wanderer's Rest.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have passed all my tests, life form! One remains. Place your hand upon the panel at the center of the grounds and I will begin collecting new data.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The panel awaits, sapient.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thou hast truly escaped from a fate most dire! My gratitude for the tale. My people will most assuredly avoid that foul place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You narrowly escaped being the latest experiment of Observation Exo-Lab XC1. The creations of the Eldan will have to look elsewhere for a lab slank.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You cannot turn away now! Your participation in this test is required!

localizedTextIdText: The Ancient Data Archives scattered around Observation Exo-Lab XC1 hold information of Cassius. Whatever they hold could prove valuable to your people.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker at Observation Exo-Lab XC1.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This data archive is still active, and your initial glance caught something about Cassius. The information here could be valuable...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thou sayest the machines predicted the schism of our civilization? Remarkable! The very concept still leaves me flummoxed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It seems the Eldan stationed at Observation Exo-Lab XC1 accurately predicted the rift between the Dominion and the Exiles ages before it occurred!

localizedTextIdText: You discovered a monitor with a readout of data on other races. Perhaps the holoprojectors in Observation Exo-Lab XC1 will have more information.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker in Observation Exo-Lab XC1.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This monitor indicates that the nearby holoprojectors hold information on other races touched by the Eldan.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are a curious life form. The data you reviewed is accurate, according to my libraries. Those simulated in XC-01 are a mere sample of Eldan influence.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps one day your curiosity will yield answers.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wonder what else they did.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You learned a great deal about the Eldan influence on the many races of Nexus through viewing the holoprojectors in Observation Exo-Lab XC1.

localizedTextIdText: Lucy Lazarin at Forestfall has instructed you to enter the Grayfaint Thicket and retrieve samples of the Strain's corruption for her father, Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Transmit the $vitem=588 data to Lucy Lazarin at Forestfall via your Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain's corruption is seeping into the marsh around us. My father needs samples to study, but he is a little upset at the moment. Please gather some.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please gather the samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, $(player.name). This data will prove vital to my father's research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My father believes that the Strain is the key to finding a cure for the Contagion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope this will lift my father's spirits.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You retrieved samples of the Strain's corruption for Lucy Lazarin at Forestfall. The samples should make Victor Lazarin happy.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Transmit the $vitem=588 data to Lucy Lazarin
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Strain refers to the collective group of corrupted creatures, humanoids, and other living organisms who serve the dark force known as the Entity.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Entity is the evil manifestation of the darkest aspect of the six Eldan souls used to create the Genesis Prime.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin at Forestfall has instructed you to search Grayfaint Thicket for signs of "Dodger".
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report that status of "Dodger" to Victor Lazarin at Forestfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When we first arrived, we sent out one of our finest scouts to search the area. We have not heard back from her. Please discover her fate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found her yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am relieved to hear that "Dodger" is alive. Our situation may not be as dire as I had imagined.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I fear the worst for her.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be sure to ask "Dodger" about the Big Mama.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found "Dodger" in the Grayfaint Thicket. Despite a bump on the head, she seems to be alive and well.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report that status of "Dodger" to Victor Lazarin
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Were the Strain samples that I gathered useful?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Quite useful. I will continue my research. I intend to find a link between the Strain's corruption and the Contagion that will lead to a final cure.

localizedTextIdText: "Dodger" in the Grayfaint Thicket has lost the special rifle that Victor Lazarin gave her to test on the Strain. "Dodger" has asked you to take over the task given to her by Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report the good news to Victor Lazarin in Forestfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: So... Victor Lazarin rifle is missing. When I came to, all I had left of the Big Mama was the sling. Would you find it for me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please find Victor Lazarin rifle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found all of the pieces?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I applaud your efficiency, $(player.name). You have already proven yourself more useful than "Dodger".
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will head back to Forestfall in a few moments, once I get all of the cobwebs out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Listen carefully. I will now instruct you on how to reassemble the Big Mama.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Don't be too hard on "Dodger".
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found all the pieces of Victor Lazarin rifle in Grayfaint Thicket. Victor Lazarin at Forestfall can instruct you on how to repair it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report the good news to Victor Lazarin
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Dodger? That's an odd name for an Aurin.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I picked up that epithet moons ago. I attribute it to my natural dexterity bonus.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin at Forestfall has asked you to enter Broodrot Hamlet and test out the Big Mama on the corrupted malverines.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report the good news to Victor Lazarin in Forestfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that the Big Mama is back in one piece, it is time to test its capabilities. There should be plenty of "test subjects" in Broodrot Hamlet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How are the "tests" coming along?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We will consider that a successful test. With a few tweaks the Big Mama can be even more devastating.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope that you can finish what "Dodger" could not.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: How are your scavenging skills?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tested the Big Mama out for Victor Lazarin at Forestfall. With a few modifications, the Big Mama could be more powerful.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report the good news to Victor Lazarin

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin at Forestfall has asked you to enter Broodrot Hamlet and scavenge new parts for the Big Mama.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin at Forestfall via your Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Big Mama is powerful, but it can be more so. The Broodrot Hamlet use to house researchers. Scavenge the area for new parts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(player.name), I need this task finished posthaste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Big Mama was a success. I will apply everything that I have learned from the Strain to my strides to cure the Contagion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With each test, more of the Strain's secrets are revealed to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: When the Contagion is cured, it will be in thanks to you. Well, partially in thanks to you... a small part.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the new and improved Big Mama, you killed Convel the Rotten for Victor Lazarin at Forestfall. The Big Mama was a success.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin at Forestfall has been working on a new formula to cure the Contagion. He has instructed you to administer it to Mordesh volunteers around Forestfall.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to Victor Lazarin in Forestfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings, $(player.class). You are just in time to witness my newest cure for the Contagion. Administer it to my volunteers and be amazed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The cure must be administered at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It didn't work... Blood and bile! Why didn't it work?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This new formula will be a major advancement against the Contagion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Why must I be so cursed...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Victor Lazarin new formula caused deadly reactions to the unfortunate volunteers in Forestfall. The forlorn Victor Lazarin now looks to the Strain for new ideas.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report your findings to Victor Lazarin

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow has instructed you to enter the Blackbriar Thicket and retrieve samples of the Strain's corruption.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Transmit the $vitem=588 data to Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strain's corruption spreading all through forest. Destruction everwhere! Must get samples to study.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you here? Samples not here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very good, $(player.name). Will study these very closely. I am sure DRED can use this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Corruption very destructive force. That sound like something DRED can use.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now I need you for other things!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You retrieved samples of the Strain's corruption for Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Transmit the $vitem=588 data to Mondo Zax

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow has instructed you to search Blackbriar Clearing for signs of Pylo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report Pylo status to Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When we get here, we sent out best scout for reconnaissance. Not hear back from him. Need you to find out what happened.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find him yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You find our scout AND he not dead? Day just got better.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope he not dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Help Pylo.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Pylo in the Blackbriar Clearing. Despite a bump on the head, he seems to be alive and well.

localizedTextIdText: Pylo in Blackbriar Clearing has lost the special rifle that Mondo Zax gave him to test on the Strain. Pylo has asked you to take over the task given to him by Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report the good news to Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mondo Zax rifle gone. When I woke up, only had Big Mama's sling. Find rifle it for me!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find Mondo Zax rifle!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Found all pieces yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You do good work, $(player.name). Unlike incompetent Pylo!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Too groggy. Can't help you. Heading back to DREDplex.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be silent and listen as I explain how to reassemble Big Mama.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found all the pieces of Mondo Zax rifle in Blackbriar Clearing. Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow can instruct you on how to repair it.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I am still looking for them.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report the good news to Mondo Zax

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow has asked you to enter Broodrot Hamlet and test out the Big Mama on the corrupted malverines.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Pylo in Blackbriar Clearing.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Big Mama back in one piece! Now time to test it! Plenty of "test subjects" in Broodrot Hamlet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How Big Mama working?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Test go well! Think we can modify Big Mama to do even more damage!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You much better than Pylo!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Listen carefully!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tested the Big Mama out for Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow. With a few modifications, the Big Mama could be more powerful.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow has asked you to enter Broodrot Hamlet and scavenge new parts for the Big Mama.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Pylo in Blackbriar Clearing.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Rifle better now. Bigger boom needs bigger foe! Test rifle on Convel the Rotten.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Convel the Rotten dead yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Big Mama have potential to be a powerful Strain weapon. Need more tests.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lock and load!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll do tests. You can go now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the new and improved Big Mama, you killed Convel the Rotten for Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow. The Big Mama was a success.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow has instructed you to repair the small hull breaches in the DRED's landing craft.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report the state of the ship to Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You! $(player.class)! Make yourself useful to DRED. Landing craft suffered minor hull breaches on landing. Fix them right away!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Repairs done?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work. Now DRED has means to escape.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ship needs to work in case thing go bad fast!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Timing of question... impeccable.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You repaired the small breaches in the DRED's landing craft for Mondo Zax at DREDplex: Darkshadow. Now Mondo Zax has a viable means of escape.

localizedTextIdTitle: Calls for Help from the Past
localizedTextIdText: The scientists have been receiving a very weak and old distress signal from north of Gloaming Strand. The scientist, Molli Goodberry, wants you to check it out and see what you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Adamus Constantius at the Wanderer's Nest near the crashed Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there! We've been receiving some really old and very weak distress signals. Would y'all check it out for me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What ya waitin' round here for? Go find where that distress signal is comin' from.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What vision is this! Thou art no crewman of the Nomad. Stand fast and speak: art thou friend or foe?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If ya find anything out there, let me know.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be not indecisive. If thou dost wish to help us, then we accept.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After going off to investigate a very weak and old distress signal in Coralus, you find survivors of a shipcrash from many years ago at a place called Wanderer's Nest. But these people look like they have been here a while and talk very strangely. How long ago was that crash?

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for weapons to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local Craftsmen are encouraged to supply weapons!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local Craftsmen are encouraged to supply weapons!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Howdy, there. Did you bring by the weapons I asked for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be, $(player.name). After those Marauders messed us up, I wasn't sure what we were gonna do. You have my thanks, friend!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait to turn these on those Marauder scumbags!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe has accepted the weapons you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: As is customary for off-world settlements, however temporary or far-flung, there are logistical challenges that face Exile forces as they search for lost Eldan technology. Give some relief by providing weapons to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with weapons for the colony's defenses!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with weapons for the colony's defenses!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you've got time, I need new weapons to distribute to the troops!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All right, you pulled through! I owe you one. I'll get this shipped out nice and fast. You did a great job, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The settlers owe you one, pal!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've provided weapons to the Farside Quartermaster.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Quartermaster Sunleaf

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile weaponsmiths, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile weaponsmiths, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You take up that weapons contract for me? It'd take a load offa my back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, howdy, $(player.name)! Is this for my contract? I'll be hornswaggled, these are great! I'll get them out to the Free Companies in an instajiffy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't thank ya enough, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've delivered weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper

localizedTextIdText: Upon discovering survivors from a crashed ship called The Nomad, the people there are untrusting of you. To prove you are here to help and not harm, you are tasked with repairing the generators that power their cryo pods and healing the crew currently still in stasis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Adamus Constantius at the Wanderer's Nest near the crashed Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Past ruffians hath done us ill will. Proof of thou's intentions requires action in repair of our generators, and the healing of our stasis crew.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Generators suffer malfunctions from the sandy winds, and time has made our bodies exhausted and ill. Will thou aid us as thou hath promised?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are now able to survive another day. Yet is it just that; surviving, not living.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mine eyes hath seen great misdeeds against us since our crash long ago.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If it is our captain thou wisheth to meet, more work to ensure we live is required.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll repair the generators and heal the crew.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can see life on this island can be tough.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: When you first arrived at the crash site of The Nomad, the survivors were weary of you. But after lending a helping hand repairing their generators and healing the crew still in stasis, they are starting to warm up to you.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll repair the generators and heal the crew.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: To aid, or not to aid. What was thy intentions?

localizedTextIdText: A wandering member of The Nomad crew needs a little help gathering supplies needed to make tools and the like. She asks that you search the oceans near Shimmerflow Sands for the ever useful coral.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Titiana Saturnina via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The warmth of a fire; the crafting of tools. These maintain survival and sanity on these endless days. If thou art able, gather for us coral.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Tis coral we seek. If thou art able to aid us, then be it so.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Praise be it that the island is bountiful, if nothing else. Praise be it also, that thou art here to help.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The beach to the south is where thou shall find these commodities.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Warmth and sanity are are necessities, especially here.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Everyone needs help now and then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: A wandering member of The Nomad crew needed a little help gathering supplies to make tools and the like. You searched the oceans near Shimmerflow Sands and found a bounty of coral for her to use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thou flees at the sight of simple labor?

localizedTextIdText: Though the crew of The Nomad is beginning to warm up to you, they want to make sure you are truly friendly by helping them survive. They ask that you kill the nearby wild creatures that threaten their existence.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Adamus Constantius at the Wanderer's Nest near the crashed Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The beasts of the wild have proven vicious and unafraid. We are so few now, so I ask thou enter the wilderness and cut down their numbers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Safety for the few left of us demands the purging of the vicious beasts of the lands around us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The land around us feel calm and quiet. I take that thine hands twas the reckoning of the wilds, and I thank thee.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ah, to sleep the full length of the night without fear of the wilds.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No sounder sleep can be had knowing our enemies lie dead tonight.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I shall slay the creatures that threaten you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Those creatures shouldn't bother you tonight.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The crew of The Nomad is beginning to warm up to you more and more after you made their nights safer by slaying the wild animals that threaten them.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I shall slay the creatures that threaten you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I did not think thou twas cowardice.

localizedTextIdText: Though the crew of The Nomad is beginning to warm up to you, they want to make sure you are truly friendly by helping them survive. They ask that you gather meat and fruit for them from the beaches nearby.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Adamus Constantius at the Wanderer's Nest near the crashed Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The daily pangs of hunger devours our bodies and spirits. There is never enough to eat, unless thou art willing to fill our bellies and stores?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Many of us sleep in stasis, leaving fewer and fewer hands to gather precious food. Will thou aid us, traveler?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: To see such a bounty brings joy to my heart. We shall eat well for many nights to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The beaches and jungles are plentiful, yet dangerous.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is a delicate dance of storing food for later days, yet consuming it before it spoils.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I shall gather food for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The crew of The Nomad is beginning to warm up to you more and more after you gathered a bounty from the beaches for them.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I shall gather food for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then I fear we might succumb to this land some day soon.

localizedTextIdText: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has asked you to enter the Mindbreak Commune and purge the corrupted Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hear me, outsider. Our commune has been infested by the Strain. I implore you to purge our home of the corruption that has taken over.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is the deed done?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Strain's hold on us has been diminished.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Order must be clear of the Strain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Mindbreak Commune and purged the Pell contaminated by the Strain's corruption.

localizedTextIdText: After spending some time with the crew of The Nomad, you've put two and two together and figured out that they have been surviving in their cryo pods for about two thousand years. You decide it is time to reveal this hard true on the captain of the fallen ship.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Marcellinus within The Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thou hath helped us greatly. Thou hath earned the right to speak to Captain Marcellinus.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Thou hath helped us greatly. Thou hath earned the right to speak to Captain Marcellinus inside what is left of The Nomad.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A historical holodisc? This is indeed proof of what thou spoke. I have been thinking, and with this knowledge, a decision has been made.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He is within of what is left of The Nomad.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With the factions split, we have no place amongst the Dominion nor the Exiles. Everything we once knew is now dust in the universe.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be happy to speak to him.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sorry if this comes as a shock.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After spending some time with the crew of The Nomad, you put two and two together and figured out that they have been surviving in their cryo pods for about two thousand years. You decided to reveal this hard true on the captain of the fallen ship. And though it took some convincing, he realized it was true.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll be happy to speak to him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You refuse? I thought this was what thou twas working toward.

localizedTextIdText: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has asked you to enter the Mindbreak Commune and try to break the Strain's hold on the Mindbreak Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, the Strain's hold on us may not be steadfast. Use my drum on the Mindbreak to break the hold of the Strain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you finished the task?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Outsider, did the song of the Order call back the Mindbreak from the Strain?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hearing the song of the Order may call us back.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sorry, it did not work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Mindbreak Commune and used Sound-Keeper drum on the Mindbreak Pell. Unfortunately, it did nothing to break the Strain's hold on them.

localizedTextIdText: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has asked you to enter the Mindbreak Commune and burn the bodies of the fallen Mindbreak.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, our fallen cannot be left to rot in this infestation. Use the Flame of our brethren and burn the bodies of our fallen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you finished the task?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Order thanks you, outsider. Dark deeds require dark remedies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not let the Flame consume you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Mindbreak Commune and burned the bodies of the fallen Mindbreak for Sound-Keeper.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: The task is not yet complete.

localizedTextIdText: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has asked you to enter the Mindbreak Commune and kill the High Priest Shatter-Crystal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, our High Priest Shatter-Crystal has also been overtaken by the Strain. He cannot be saved and must be killed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Does the Sound-Keeper still live?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I take no joy from hearing of your success, but thank you for seeing it through. It simply could not be helped.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I fear that this corruption will let loose his power unchecked.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will kill the high priest.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: If it had to be done...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have killed the High Priest Shatter-Crystal outside of the Integral Function Lab. Sound-Keeper feared that his power combined with the Strain's corruption would be too dangerous.

localizedTextIdText: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has asked you to enter the Integral Function Lab and rescue any Mindbreak Disciple that may have fled there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some of our disciples may have sought refuge in the Integral Function Lab. Please enter and search for any that have avoided the corruption.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found any of our disciples?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It lightens my heart to know that not all have been consumed by the Strain's corruption.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When the infestation overtook us, many of our disciples fled.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I had hoped to find more.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to rescue a few Mindbreak Disciple from the Integral Function Lab.

localizedTextIdText: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has asked you to enter the Integral Function Lab and assess the spread of the Strain's corruption.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, the source of this corruption appears to be Integral Function Lab. Enter the lab and determine how far the corruption has spread.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How bad is the corruption?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I feared that the lab would be lost. If it is as you say, there is nothing that can be done to save it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The lab is important to the Mindbreak.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Strain's corruption has nearly engulfed the Integral Function Lab. Since there is little that can be done to salvage it, Sound-Keeper now contemplated what to do next.

localizedTextIdText: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has asked you to find the being responsible for spreading the corruption in the Integral Function Lab and destroy it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, there must be a prime source of this corruption. Search the lab for it and destroy it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found the beast?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With that vile beast dead, we can now turn our attention to the lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The lab may be lost, but we can at least kill the source.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the Integral Function Lab and defeated the Pitchsoul Queen. Now what to do about the lab...

localizedTextIdText: The Integral Function Lab is set for destruction. Exit the lab and meet with Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Exit the Integral Function Lab and speak to Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, the cores will soon overload and destroy the lab. You must exit before you are consumed by the corruption.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We cannot thank you enough outsider. It is not often that we deal with $m(player.race). You have bolstered good tidings between us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not tarry!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sound-Keeper at the Keenmind Shelter has thanked you for all of the aid you have provided to the Mindbreak survivors.

localizedTextIdText: After revealing just how long the crew of The Nomad has been on Coralus, the captain has decided to stop cycling people in and out of stasis, but to wake everyone up and start living their lives. The problem is the process unearths aggressive creatures from below. Hold these things off until the process is complete.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Marcellinus within The Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It is time to awaken the last of our crew and live out our lives here on the island. But the process unearths horrors sleeping below. Will thou hold them back?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To awaken the crew, the equipment must go into a certain state. This awakens the horrors below. Hold them off until the process is complete.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My crew is awake. And they shall stay that way. It is time we stopped waiting for a rescue and begin to rebuild anew.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The horrors will burrow up as soon as thou start and won't stop until it is done.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps we can make this villainous island into a tropical paradise we can call home.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will hold off the monstrosities.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope you can live happily here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After taking turns sleeping in stasis in the cryo pods for two thousand years, the crew of The Nomad has finally accepted their place in the universe and everyone is now awake and ready to live their lives on the island of Coralus.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will hold off the monstrosities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps the praise I have heard of thou twas exaggerated.

localizedTextIdText: In awe that two thousand years has passed them by, one of the crew members of The Nomad decides to share a bit of history from their time. They only have a few clips to show, but they are happy to share their history.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ludovicus Terentius at the Wanderer's Nest near the crashed Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The word spreads; we were living on the edge of eternity for two thousand years. Tis sad that all that is left of our time are a few holo-news discs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Would thou like to take a peak at the news from our time two thousand years ago?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Twas it fascinating? It makes me feel melancholy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those cryo pods are something special to have kept us all alive for so long.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps I shall start recording new holo-news discs for our future children.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Perhaps I shall check them out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In awe that two thousand years has passed them by, one of the crew members of The Nomad decided to share a bit of history from their time. They only had a few clips to show, but they were happy to share their history.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Perhaps I shall check them out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if thou art not interested...

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your Heavy Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local craftsmen are encouraged to supply armor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local craftsmen are encouraged to supply armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, friend. You got some armor for us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be, $(player.name)! After those Marauders messed us up, I wasn't sure what we were gonna do. You have my thanks, friend!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll have these sent out immediately. Thanks, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe has accepted the armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your Heavy Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: As is customary for off-world settlements, however temporary or far-flung, there are logistical challenges that face Exile forces as they search for lost Eldan technology. Give some relief by providing armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring request Heavy Armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo
