localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with armor for the colony's defenses!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with armor for the colony's defenses!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, there! You got the armor I asked for? No? How about now?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's not much to look at, but this outpost is all we got. Anyhow, I'm grateful for your help keeping it all in one piece!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks a bunch, $(player.class)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've provided armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the request Heavy Armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver armor to Armorer Thaako at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Armorer Thaako at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, pal. You got armor for us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, $(player.name)! That the armor I contracted out for? Nice job, pal. I'll get this out to the frontlines. We owe ya!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I ain't one to thank people, but if I did, I'd thank ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're delivered Heavy Armor to Armorer Thaako.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Armorer Thaako

localizedTextIdTitle: You Can Do Leather, If You Try
localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for armor crafted from indigenous leather to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Farside.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local Craftsmen are encouraged to supply armor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local Craftsmen are encouraged to supply armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Howdy, there. Did you bring by the armor I asked for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If it ain't $(player.name)! Welcome to the bleakest moon I've ever been on. Thanks for bringin' that armor by for us. I reckon these will come in handy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Carry on, then. Don't let me hold ya up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe has accepted the armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: As is customary for off-world settlements, however temporary or far-flung, there are logistical challenges that face Exile forces as they search for lost Eldan technology. Give some relief by providing Hunter's armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with armor for the colony's defenses!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with armor for the colony's defenses!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, there! You got the armor I asked for? No? How about now?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, wow! I owe you one. I'll get this shipped out nice and fast. You did a great job, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We owe you one! I'll never forget you!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hope this helps you guys out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've provided armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver armor to Outfitter Keynes at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Outfitter Keynes at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well, howdy, $(player.name). Here about that armor contract? I could sure use the help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You sure pulled through here for me, $(player.name)! I'll get this armor shipped out in an instajiffy, but you've got my thanks, friend!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Many thanks, friend. Once again, we folk are in your debt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're delivered armor to Outfitter Keynes at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Outfitter Keynes

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local craftsmen are encouraged to supply armor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local craftsmen are encouraged to supply armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Howdy there. Did you bring by the armor I asked for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hello, $(player.name). I reckon you've been busy workin' on that order for me. I'll take it off your hands. Thanks, friend!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You go on then, friend. I'll make sure these get distributed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe has accepted the Light Armor you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with Light Armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with Light Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, there! You got the armor I asked for? No? How about now?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, thanks a bunch! I'll get this shipped out nice and fast. You did a great job, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I owe you one, you know that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've provided Light Armor to the Farside Quartermaster.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Sunleaf

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver light armor to Tailor Wildspring at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Tailor Wildspring at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey there! Oh, are you working on my contract? Great! I just need armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, thank you so much for bringing this armor! You have no idea how much it will help! I thank you on behalf of the forest.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't believe you did all this! I think it calls for a hug. Come 'ere!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're delivered armor to Tailor Wildspring at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Tailor Wildspring

localizedTextIdText: Many crew members of The Nomad have passed away over the years, and a lovely spot called Lonelywind Peak is where they rest. But a vicious elemental has recently begun to wander the area. A grieving widow asks you to remove the beast from the graveyard.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Katalina Xpianus at the Wanderer's Nest near the crashed Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is an elemental roaming the graveyard, I cannot visit my late husband. Please destroy the wretched thing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: An elemental wanders the lands where our dead rest. I cannot visit my late husband anymore, not until thou abolishes the beast.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks and praise be to you. Our dead can rest once again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do the winds favor to walk among the dead?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: How much longer until I too am buried there?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get rid of the elemental.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll glad to give you some peace.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Many crew members of The Nomad have passed away over the years, and a lovely spot called Lonelywind Peak is where they rest. But a vicious elemental was roaming that land, and at a grieving widow's request, you destroyed the creature to leave the graveyard peaceful again.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get rid of the elemental.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then leave me to my sorrows.

localizedTextIdText: Eggo has informed you that $n(creature=41376) at Forestfall wishes to discuss an important matter in regards to the spreading corruption in Grimfang Forest. We must not keep him waiting, this is a matter of life and death.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to $n(creature=41376) at Forestfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain have taken their toll on the local wildlife. Seek the one named Victor Lazarin in Forestfall. He can give you more details on this matter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found Victor Lazarin yet? Hurry! He awaits your arrival in Forestfall.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have no time to waste! The corruption is spreading throughout the forest, we must take action immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have arrived just in time to help us stop this corruption.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you my friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: On to our next task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Victor Lazarin has important tasks for you to complete to stop the spread of the corruption and solve the mysteries of it's origins.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pardon? There is so much information to learn though.

localizedTextIdText: A wandering member of The Nomad crew needs a little help gathering food. She asks that you search the oceans near Shimmerflow Sands and slay the fish for their meat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Titiana Saturnina via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hunger pulls us down every day. Oh, blessed wanderer, what would I give to have a morsel of fish.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The oceans hold bounties that I cannot catch, but thou might.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Starvation will be driven away with this fish. Thou have my thanks. And this too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The ocean is full of bounties, yet they elude me every time.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, how shall I prepare these? A stew? Roasted on a stick?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: A wandering member of The Nomad crew needed a little help gathering food. You searched the oceans near Shimmerflow Sands and found a bounty of fish for her.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My pleas fall upon deaf ears. Oh woes me.

localizedTextIdText: Eggo has informed you that $n(creature=41377) at DREDplex: Darkshadow wishes to discuss an important matter. Given the nature of the corruption spreading in the forest, it is probably an important task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to $n(creature=41377) at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain have taken their toll on the local wildlife. Seek the one named Victor Lazarin in Forestfall. He can give you more details on this matter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found Victor Lazarin yet? Hurry! He awaits your arrival in Forestfall.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need answers! This corruption is causing great dismay, we have to work together to be rid of it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What took you so long?! I have been waiting! I dislike slow people!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you my friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have lots of work to do, quickly!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mondo Zax now has your assistance in the fight against the corruption as well as studying it's origins.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pardon? There is so much information to learn though.

localizedTextIdText: The scientist, Konstantin Yakin, has caught some suspicious scrambled signals. He wants you to find where they are coming from in southern Coralus and see if you can't unscramble them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Konstantin Yakin via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got a weird scrambled signal. Find out where it is coming from and what it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Didn't I tell you about the odd signal? Why are you not investigating it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So, the signal was Eldan. I appears they were monitoring someone. Perhaps the survivors of that crashed ship.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It appears to be coming from a dense jungle.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, how long ago was that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found that the scrambled signals coming from Berylleaf Grove were of Eldan origin, and after a while of deciphering, you found out the Eldan that was stationed inside that tower were observing the humans that crash landed there long, long ago.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then why are you wasting my time?

localizedTextIdText: Explorers are trying to map out the area of Grimfang Forest. With the forest now being overrun by creatures tainted by the Strain, it has become rather impossible to go forward with their research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to $n(creature=41414) at Forestfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey, $(player.name)! Grimfang Forest is in real trouble. Look at what the corruption is doing to land and it's creatures. Tooth and claw! We have to stop it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, have you killed those creatures yet? Time is a wastin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah! That's what I'm talking about! Now the forest can breathe a little easier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Swing away at those nasty Strain creatures!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall be watching from the shadows.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've kept the explorers safe in Grimfang Forest by eliminating the corrupted creatures.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Say that closer to my fist!

localizedTextIdText: Explorers are trying to map out the area of Grimfang Forest. With the forest now being overrun by creatures tainted by the Strain, it has become rather impossible to go forward with their research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Penia at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This corruption is unacceptable. There is no way to save the creatures of Grimfang Forest from the Strain. Exterminate these animals quickly and efficiently.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am not created with much patience, I have asked you to eliminate corrupted creatures in Grimfang Forest...What part of this was unclear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am rather impressed by your skills. You did not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Proceed. The Task awaits you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Proceed to the next task immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've kept the explorers safe in Grimfang Forest by eliminating the corrupted creatures.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I would not recommend this action.

localizedTextIdText: It appears things in Grimfang Forest are a lot grimmer than we thought. The creatures free of the Strain have been captured by corrupted animals. We must work diligently to save them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report back to Penia at DREDplex: Darkshadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Innocent wildlife is trapped throughout Grimfang Forest, unable to escape from the Strain. Affirmative action must take place.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This task must not be taken lightly. Our chances for dominance over the Strain lie in the creatures we save from it. Quickly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I sense you have succeeded in your task. I was correct in assigning this task to you after all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will be watching you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our work in the forest is not yet over. I compute more work ahead.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Having successfully freed the wildlife free of corruption, a chance has been given for Grimfang Forest to fight against the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That is an unwise decision.

localizedTextIdText: It appears things in Grimfang Forest are a lot grimmer than we thought. The creatures free of the Strain have been captured by corrupted animals. We must work diligently to save them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report back to Simon Papilo at Forestfall.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen, friends help each other out, right? Well friend, I need a favor. There's a number of creatures trapped by the Strain and whatever it's already corrupted. I need you to help them escape!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey friend, maybe I wasn't clear. Creatures. Trapped. Free them. Got it?!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I like you, you're not just all tooth and tail!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! Put a move on it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Call if you need something!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Having successfully freed the wildlife free of corruption, a chance has been given for Grimfang Forest to fight against the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Some friend you are!

localizedTextIdText: Inna Esmov claims that in Keenmind Shelter there is a Pell named Sound-Keeper who may be able to assist us further with the corruption spreading in Grimfang Forest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sound-Keeper at Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have a task for you. Seek out Sound-Keeper in Keenmind Shelter. He may have some vital information necessary for our success.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I have given you clear instructions to head to Keenmind Shelter. There is a pell by the name of Sound-Keeper you should seek. Now off!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is crucial in this fight against corruption and darkness, we must act now. Join our fight, outsider!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have been waiting for you, outsider.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please handle it delicately and be quick about it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We require your assistance further.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll start my journey there now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sound-Keeper has informed you of the necessary steps needed to recover important information in regards to the corruption.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You risk much if you refuse me.

localizedTextIdText: The infestation has spread in the area quickly through the pipes. Inna was insisted all the pipes leaking in the Mindbreak Commune. to be taken care of before it is too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report back to Inna Esmov at Forestfall..
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(player.name), be careful where you step! The Strain have begun leaking into the village. We must repair the leaks immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(player.name), if we don't repair these leaking pipes in Mindbreak Commune, then we have lost another to the Strain!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have prevented atrocious things from occurring, my friend.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Execute this task as swiftly as possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The quick repairs have prevented the Strain from spreading into the clean areas of the Mindbreak Commune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Choose your words wisely,$(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: The infestation has spread in the area quickly through the pipes. Inna was insisted all the pipes leaking in the Mindbreak Commune. to be taken care of before it is too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your completion to $n(creature=41359).
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(player.class), I have detected great distress in Mindbreak Commune. It appears leaking pipes are causing the Strain to spread. It is vital you repair them immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You clearly lack competency if you are still lingering here $(player.class). Those leaks in Mindbreak Commune won't fix themselves...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I was wrong about your competency after all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not return until this task is completed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have proven worthy of the Dominion name.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The quick repairs have prevented the Strain from spreading into the clean areas of the Mindbreak Commune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That is unfortunate.

localizedTextIdText: The Strain creatures have taken over the Integral Function Lab and have caused havoc. Its vital data must be retrieved before it is destroyed. With the memory core's safely retrieved from the Corrupted Eldan Probes, more information in regards to the Strain can be uncovered.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to $n(creature=41359).
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CORRUPTED DATA... SEARCHING FOR MORE MEMORY CORES IN ORDER FOR ARCHIVED INFORMATION TO BE ACCESSED. ATTEMPT TO REMOVE CORES FROM PROBE UNITS.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MISSING CORES...PLEASE RECOVER MISSING CORES FROM PROBE TO CONTINUE...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time wasted is unacceptable. Return to the lab and collect those cores from the probes immediately. That information is imperative for our fight against the corruption.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done well, $(player.class). Now I can uncover the secrets of this device.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion will prevail.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Maybe we can salvage the data.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now with the success of the core's recovery, the information can be researched and understood in hopes it will prevent further spread of the corruption.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Where is the reboot button on this thing...

localizedTextIdText: The Strain creatures have taken over the Integral Function Lab and have caused havoc. Its vital data must be retrieved before it is destroyed. With the memory core's safely retrieved from the Corrupted Eldan Probes, more information in regards to the Strain can be uncovered.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your findings to $n(creature=41358).
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CORRUPTED DATA... SEARCHING FOR MORE MEMORY CORES IN ORDER FOR ARCHIVED INFORMATION TO BE ACCESSED. ATTEMPT TO REMOVE CORES FROM PROBE UNITS.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MISSING CORES...PLEASE RECOVER MISSING CORES FROM PROBE TO CONTINUE...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What have you discovered? Were you able to recover the memory cores from the probes in the lab? Quickly before it is destroyed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This information was crucial, you have done well in retrieving these cores.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Leave me now, Exile.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Maybe we can salvage the data.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now with the success of the core's recovery, the information can be researched and understood in hopes it will prevent further spread of the corruption.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Where is the reboot button on this thing...

localizedTextIdText: The Integral Function Lab is a lost cause as the corruption continues to overrun everything. The infestation will only continue to grow unless something is done. The lab must be destroyed. With the proper tools and instructions, overloading the cores should destroy it once and for all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report the success of your mission to Sound-Keeper.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It appears we cannot save the lab. If that is the case, we must destroy it quickly. I believe there are cores in the lab that could do the job with enough power put into it...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is of the essence, this lab will be destroyed immediately once you overload those cores I mentioned.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Much appreciated, outsider. Our quest for the truth about the Strain continue.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew I could count on you, outsider. We have much to do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our paths will cross again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The lab has successfully been destroyed along with the corruption it carried inside of it. With this lab now destroyed and the information being examined, the quest to uncover more on the Strain may behind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hrm. Outsiders.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has ordered you into the Junction Legacy to destroy the Mechari who have turned away from the Dominion, as well as destroying their escape route.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Axis Pheydra via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You will be my agent in regard to the Seekers, $(player.name). Consider yourself called into service to destroy these traitors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kill the Seekers. The instructions do not need to be expanded upon further.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You were impressive in your destructions of the Seekers, but there is much work ahead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Destroy them, and their fuel supplies. They must not be allowed to flee!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed a great number of the Seekers, and destroyed their ship and fuel supplies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I do not dispute the need to destroy them, but I am curious...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The are our enemy and must be destroyed! If you are a loyal servant of the Dominion, why would you need to know more?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Seekers are a group of misguided, traitorous Mechari that have abandoned their mission to protect the Dominion. They falsely believe that the Dominion follows the wrong path. No doubt they have been corrupted and need to be eliminated totally.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I have served as head of the ICI for more than a millennium, and am willing to do whatever is necessary to ensure the security and prosperity of the Dominion. It is best to do as I say and not cross me, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: One does not refuse the ICI without consequences...

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has asked you to retrieve the data the Seekers have been accumulating in Junction Legacy. It can be found on datachrons in the area, or the Seekers themselves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Axis Pheydra via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must know what the seekers were up to. Find their research into this dig site and transmit it to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Every moment you delay means more corruption among the Mechari. To allow that is treasonous.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With luck this new data will throw a wrench in the Seekers plans. Now it is time to end the treat of this camp for good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You might find their data around the camp, but it would be more productive to take it from their corpses!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After transmitting your data to Axis Pheydra, she sent you a modified form of it which you successfully uploaded to the Seeker network.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This issue is very important to the Dominion, I suggest you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has asked you to end the threat of the Seekers on Coralus, by killing Seeker Prime, who is attempting to directly interface with the Eldan machinery in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Axis Pheydra via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The leader of this dig site, Seeker Prime, is attempting to directly interface with the Eldan machinery. Destroy his machines and then destroy him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Delaying does not earn you my favor, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have crippled the Seekers on Coralus, and for that I commend you, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Seeker Prime and ended the threat of Junction Legacy to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stopping now could be very dangerous to us all. But mostly you.

localizedTextIdText: You found a Mechari memory scanner on a Seeker Mechari Junction Legacy, and Axis Pheydra has ordered you to use in on Seekers in order to gain intelligence.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Axis Pheydra via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This appears to be a device for interfacing with a Mechari. You doubt you could use it on one that is still active, however.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This appears to be a device for interfacing with a Mechari. You doubt you could use it on one that is still active, however.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You show a lack of initiative in your delay.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You showed excellent initiative, $(player.class). I will begin analysis of this new data immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You scanned Seeker Mechari and sent the data to Axis Pheydra.

localizedTextIdText: Axis Pheydra has requested your help in infiltrating the Seeker camp at Junction Legacy. She has ordered you to find secluded areas into which she can teleport ICI agents whose mission it will be to disguise themselves and blend in with the Seekers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Axis Pheydra via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Agent, as you dismantle the Seekers, I seek something more... subtle. Find me quiet, hidden locations where I might teleport in undercover agents.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You are to serve the interestes of the Dominion and of the ICI. I suggest you cease delaying.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Already I am getting information from my embedded agents. You have done well, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: May they serve the ICI well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found locations for 4 ICI agents to teleport into Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You think I am going to speak of teleports, disguises, and ICI agents to someone not formally in the ICI? Think again. Simply know that these agents are here to work in the Dominion's best interests.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You may think I'm asking you for a favor, $(player.name), but I'm not really asking.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for medicines crafted from local omni-plasm to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their medishots to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your medishots to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local Craftsmen are encouraged to supply whimfiber light armor!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local craftsmen are encouraged to supply armor!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Howdy there. You got those medishots I asked for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Farside, $(player.name). You got somethin' for me? Oh, those are the medishots I need! You've done a good thing, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work, $(player.name). Glad you're with us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe has accepted the medishots you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your medishots to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: As is customary for off-world settlements, however temporary or far-flung, there are logistical challenges that face Exile forces as they search for lost Eldan technology. Give some relief by providing medishots to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medishots to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with medishots.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with medishots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got medishots for us? How about now? Now?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, hey, are those my medishots? Thanks, friend! You have no idea how much this is going to help us out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These people here? They owe you one!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've provided medishots to Quartermaster Sunleaf.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested medishots to Quartermaster Sunleaf

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver medishots to Technologist Blackwood at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your medishots to Technologist Blackwood at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's... uh... er... $(player.name), right? You got somethin' for that contract I posted?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Are those the medishots? Well, I'll be, you pulled through for me, friend. I thought you looked trustworthy, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent, excellent. I'll just find your reward... uh... wait...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're delivered medishots to Technologist Blackwood at Touchdown Site Bravo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your medishots to Technologist Blackwood

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for furniture crafted from local materials to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their $m(schematic=892) to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Farside.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=892) to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at Touchdown Site Bravo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local craftsmen are encouraged to supply furniture!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nMarauders have waylaid the last cargo ship to FCON forces on Farside. All local craftsmen are encouraged to supply furniture!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're sure hurtin' for furniture after that Marauder hit. I know Purple Star Pillow Pile don't sound like much, but a soft bed means a lot to us folk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, if it ain't, $(player.name) with a few crates of Purple Star Pillow Pile for us! Friend, we owe you a big debt.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done good work here, you know that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe has accepted the furniture you crafted to replace the destroyed supplies from the Marauders.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your $m(schematic=892) to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=926) to Quartermaster Sunleaf at Touchdown Site Bravo

localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Provide relief to Exile forces operating on Farside. Report to Quartermaster Sunleaf with Wall Mounted Generator.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Whoa, a craftsman! You here with that furniture I asked for? We sure need the Wall Mounted Generator as soon as possible!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey hey, nice work! I'll get these shipped out. You know we owe you one, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks a bunch, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've provided $m(schematic=926) to Quartermaster Sunleaf.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver $m(schematic=928) to Architect Kaspmara at Touchdown Site Bravo.

localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Greetings. Do you seek to be of service to my grim plea for furniture?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am amazed at your arrival. My respects, $(player.name). The furniture you brought forth shall serve Farside well.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I offer you gratitude, despite my grief.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're delivered $m(schematic=928) to Architect Kaspmara at Touchdown Site Bravo.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for weapons to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their weapons to Craftmaster Tullio in Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Craftmaster Tullio at Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Legion requires additional weapons to accomplish their objectives! Report to your nearest Victory Commission officer.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Legion requires additional weapons to accomplish their objectives! Report to your nearest Victory Commission officer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Honor and Glory! Do you come bearing weapons for the Empire?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, good work $(player.name). Your service to the Legion in Farside will be remembered!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have done a great service to the Dominion, as always, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tullio has accepted the weapons you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Legion is a beast, hungry for materiel. Weapons, armor, medicines, and bivouac equipment, these are necessary items for Operational consistency. Feed the beast at Sovereign's Landing by bringing weapons to Quartermaster Vellos.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Quartermaster Vellos at Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Weapons are needed by Dominion forces operating at Sovereign's Landing and parts beyond. All craftsmen are requested to attend Quartermaster Vellos.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Weapons are needed by Dominion forces operating at Sovereign's Landing and parts beyond. All craftsman are requested to attend Quartermaster Vellos.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you bring the weapons I asked for, hunter? Do not tarry long!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, hunter, you bear the weapons I requested. May they draw the blood of our enemies!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You serve the Legion well, hunter!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Quartermaster Vellos at Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Quartermaster Vellos

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft weapons for Weaponsmith Frugo at Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo at Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hmm? Here for contract? Go away! Too busy if you don't have weapons!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Brought weapons, yes? Yes! Now have weapons for testing! Many tests! On stupid Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Many thanks for weapons! Yes!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo

localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your reliability should be honored, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tullio has accepted the armor you crafted.

localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Very good, $(player.name). You've come through again for the Dominion.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Farside lists a work order request for furniture crafted from local materials to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their $m(schematic=892) to Craftmaster Tullio in Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=892) to Craftmaster Tullio in Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Legion requires additional housing supplies to accomplish their objectives! Report to your nearest Victory Commission officer.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Legion requires additional housing supplies to accomplish their objectives! Report to your nearest Victory Commission officer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have brought those housing supplies, yes? It wouldn't do for Dominion citizens to suffer a lack of soft places for our delicate heads.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, a taste of home for those who supply the empire. Well done, $(player.name). Your service is again recognized!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are a credit to the Dominion, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tullio has accepted the furniture you crafted.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Legion is a beast, hungry for materiel. Weapons, armor, medicines, bivouac equipment - these are necessary items for operations. Feed the beast by bringing $m(schematic=926) to Quartermaster Vellos at Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=926) to Quartermaster Vellos at Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Furniture is needed by Dominion forces operating at Sovereign's Landing and parts beyond. All craftsmen are requested to attend Quartermaster Vellos.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Furniture is needed by Dominion forces operating at Sovereign's Landing and parts beyond. All craftsmen are requested to attend Quartermaster Vellos.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hail, hunter. I ask for simple furniture for the settlers. Do you have it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your craftsmen does you proud, hunter. The Old Gods would be pleased at your dedication to even menial tasks like this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's best not to ask why the Legion needs furniture.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought <text Link="Schematic:926">$m(schematic=926)</text> to the quartermaster at Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your <text Link="Schematic:926">$m(schematic=926)</text> to the Farside Quartermaster

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft $m(schematic=928) and take it to Architect Virin at Sovereign's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=928) to Architect Virin at Sovereign's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Eh there, mate! You got that furniture contract done for me yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Cheerio, $(player.name). Oh, you brought that stuff I contracted! Good job then, mate! I'll get it all packed up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done a good job here, love!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for <text Link="Schematic:928">$m(schematic=928)</text>.

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Crafting Trainer Oaklee recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your weapons to Fool's Hope for use as training materials for future commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your weapons. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your weapons. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: All I'm lookin' for is some good weapons. Seems like nobody has time for real craftsmanship these days.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Don't got many experienced crafters. They either die or give up the craft... but I'm glad to see you're still breathin' and turnin' out top quality weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm glad you came, $(player.name). I promise your goods will not go to waste.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought the requested weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. Quartermaster Baytan has requested goods for use by Exile groups working in the region. Bring weapons crafted from local resources to the quartermaster at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested weapons to the Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: All Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups. Our logistics are unreliable for weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: All Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups. Our logistics are unreliable for weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The things in this here jungle will kill us if we don't kill them. We need weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I reckon these can put holes in the hides of some dangerous jungle beasts... which is pretty much all we need 'em to do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Put them down over there. Make your mark here, here, and here. Thanks. Next!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested weapons to Quartermaster Baytan

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver weapons to Weaponsmith Redfire at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested weapons to Weaponsmith Redfire at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Good to see another weaponsmith. Maybe you can help with my workload.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finally, somebody's crafting here in Wilderrun other than me. Hope to see more of your product soon. You do good work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Brigade thanks you for your contributions.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Exile Craftsman Brigade's request for weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested weapons to Weaponsmith Redfire

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Crafting Trainer Oaklee recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your armor to Fool's Hope for use as training materials for future Commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your armor. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your armor. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm just lookin' for some good armor: metal you put on yer body to keep all yer blood from spillin' out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm glad you're here, $(player.name). This armor will save our medics a lot of work, I reckon.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This will help us fight our way through the mess out there. You've done us a service today.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought the armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. Quartermaster Baytan has requested goods for use by Exile groups working in the region. Bring armor crafted from local resources to the quartermaster at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested armor to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups. Our logistics are unreliable for armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups. Logistics are unreliable for armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need armor. You're an armorer. I reckon it shouldn't be hard for you to figure out what to do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work. It's nice to know that somebody out here has their head on straight and can deliver when it's needed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take this. You earned it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought the requested Heavy Armor to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Quartermaster Baytan

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver armor to Armorer Stanhope at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Armorer Stanhope at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This armor might seem impractical, but it's good for... things. Some things. Just make me some, all right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What'd I tell ya? That armor is so blasted cool-lookin'. I'm sure people will be clamoring for more from you, just wait!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Reckon you done right by us, that's for certain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Exile Craftsman's Brigade's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested armor to Armorer Stanhope

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Crafting Trainer Oaklee recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your armor to Fool's Hope for use as training materials for future commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your armor. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your armor. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Leather might not seem like the best armor for a humid jungle environment, but I'm sure you'll figure out a way to make it wearable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for coming, $(player.name). You've come such a long way from those early days.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These will go to good use, I promise. We'll claim this jungle for the Exiles in no time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought the requested armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. Quartermaster Baytan has requested goods for use by Exile groups working in the region. Bring armor crafted from local resources to the quartermaster at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups. Our logistics are unreliable for armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups. Our logistics are unreliable for armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm not gonna lie to you, $(player.name). We did not bring the right gear. This place is rough, and we need gear that can stand up to it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very nice. Looks like this armor could stand up to all the claws and talons out there in the wilds. Solid work, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Quartermaster Baytan

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver armor to Outfitter Halliday at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've been looking for someone to help with the armor demand around here. You up for it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Howdy, $(player.name)! Good to see another outfitter. This'll really help us get people supplied up and ready for adventure.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I knew you'd be there when we needed you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Exile Craftsman's Brigade's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Crafting Trainer Oaklee recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your armor to Fool's Hope for use as training materials for future Commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your armor. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your armor. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Folks around here sure could use some nicely crafted clothes. Think you could help out with that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As you can see, civilization is stretched pretty thin here in Fool's hope. Nicely crafted clothes make this place feel more like home.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your contributions will go far in helping us rapidly train new crafters and pioneers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought the armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. Quartermaster Baytan has requested goods for use by Exile groups working in the region. Bring the requested armor to the quartermaster at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the armor to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need some light and airy armor, and quick. This place is hot as blazes, but so humid it feels like we're swimmin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got those new duds for me? I got first dibs, but we'll be handin' 'em out to anybody who needs 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yep, these'll do just fine.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Quartermaster Baytan

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Vervenko at Fool's Hope has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Fulfill his request and deliver the armor to him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Vervenko at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It is very important that we carefully construct clothing for those who explore the dark depths of the jungle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good tidings to you, $(player.name). I see you have generously brought me some new garments.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My gratitude is as eternal as the grave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed Tailor Vervenko request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Vervenko

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Crafting Trainer Oaklee recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your medishots to Fool's Hope for use as training materials for future Commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medishots to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your medishots. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your medishots. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm waiting for those medishots, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've come, thank the stars. You cannot know how important these will be in training new generations of frontier technologists.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought the medishots to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the $schematic=293 to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. Quartermaster Baytan has requested goods for use by Exile groups working in the region. Bring the requested medishots to the quartermaster at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medicine to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Who woulda thought an untouched wilderness would be more dangerous than a battlefield? We ran low on medishots hours after landin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got those medishots? Just in time. I swear, next time they offer me a job "away from the front lines," I'm going to ask more questions.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll keep ya in mind if we're short-handed in the future.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought medishots to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medicine to Quartermaster Baytan

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver medishots to Techsmith Praxa at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medishots to Techsmith Praxa at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm not gonna softpedal it... we need a lot of medishots. A bunch. Think of a big number, then double it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, $(player.name). Whatcha got for me? When it comes to medishots, every little bit helps.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Rock solid work, sweetheart.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Exile Craftsman's Brigade's request for medishots.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medishots to Techsmith Praxa

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Crafting Trainer Oaklee recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your furniture to Techsmith Praxa at Fool's Hope for use as training materials for future Commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the items to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your furniture. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThis is Jessamine Oaklee. The Brigade has a unique proposition for you. Please bring me some of your furniture. You'll find me at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Talk about the darkest jungles of Nexus - we could definitely use a little more closet space around here. Think you can help out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, $(player.name), I see you got my message. A girl can never have enough closet space.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll double this place's resale value in no time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought the furniture to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the items to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. Quartermaster Baytan has requested goods for use by Exile groups working in the region. Bring furniture crafted from local resources to the quartermaster at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the furniture to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract with local merchants to supply local groups. Our current suppliers are unreliable for furniture.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Any Brigade craftsmen in the vicinity of Wilderrun are invited to contract local merchants to supply local groups. Our current suppliers of furniture are unreliable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dominion think their architects are something special. I could copy their style with both hands tied behind my back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These dressers will show folks that anything they can do, we can do better. Mighty fine craftsmanship there, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Brigade is obliged to you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought furniture to Quartermaster Baytan at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the furniture to Quartermaster Baytan

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver $m(schematic=939) to Contractor Drogor at Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the furniture to Contractor Drogor at Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Folks need their privacy. A few room dividers would make this place a lot more pleasant.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you bring the room dividers? Those things are a lifesaver when yer sleepin' four to a tent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That was some damn good work. Real nice, pal.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I brought what you asked for.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Exile Craftsman's Brigade's request for <text Link="Schematic:939">$m(schematic=939)</text>.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the furniture to Contractor Drogor

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your weapons to Fort Vigilance for use as training materials for future Commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nAs you know, the Commission is constantly training new craftsmen. Please bring some of your work to me at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nAs you know, the Commission is constantly training new craftsmen. Please bring some of your work to me at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need weapons with which to tame this wilderness, and claim this land for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These weapons will be put to use immediately. The Dominion appreciates your contribution, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Chancellor Marcela at Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. The local quartermaster has requested goods for use by Dominion groups working in the region. Bring weapons to Quartermaster Trata at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Quartermaster Trata at Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The Dominion Victory Commission calls on all craftsmen in the Wilderrun region to speak to the Quartermaster there to discuss business regarding weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The Dominion Victory Commission calls on all craftsmen in the Wilderrun region to speak to the Quartermaster there to discuss business regarding weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need weapons. You should have been informed of what we currently require.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Commission business? Ah, the weapons we ordered. Good.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Commission thanks you for fulfilling your duty. Make your mark and step aside.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Quartermaster Trata at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Quartermaster Trata

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those weapons for Weaponsmith Tirexa at Fort Vigilance!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Weaponsmith Tirexa at Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: For our mission, we need weapons of the highest possible quality. Do not fail me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These will do quite nicely. You have proven your utility to our cause.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: An exceptional demonstration, citizen. The Commission thanks you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Weaponsmith Tirexa

localizedTextIdText: You've received a message from Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela recognizing your crafting ability. She requests that you bring some samples of your armor to Fort Vigilance for use as training materials for future Commission members.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Heavy Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nAs you know, the Commission is constantly training new craftsmen. Please bring some of your work to me at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nAs you know, the Commission is constantly training new craftsmen. Please bring some of your work to me at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our troops need armor to prevail in this wilderness. Bring me what you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This armor will be put to use immediately. You have done a great service to the Dominion Victory Commission and the empire at large.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Supplies are scarce in the dense forests of Wilderrun. The local quartermaster has requested goods for use by Dominion groups working in the region. Bring the requested armor to Quartermaster Trata at Fort Vigilance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Quartermaster Trata at Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: The Dominion Victory Commission calls on all  craftsmen in the Wilderrun region to speak to the Quartermaster there to discuss business regarding armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: The Dominion Victory Commission calls on all  craftsmen in the Wilderrun region to speak to the Quartermaster there to discuss business regarding armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've requested some armor. You should have been informed as to our specific needs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am authorized to collect Commission business. I see that you have some armor for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Very well, make your mark. Thank you for your service.

localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're delivered medishots to Techsmith Praxa at Redsand Station.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medishots to Techsmith Praxa

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Malgrave lists a work order request for furniture crafted from local materials to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their furniture to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Redsand Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=954) to Crafting Trainer Oaklee at Redsand Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nOur settlement in Malgrave is in dire need of resupply. Craftspeople are being urged to bring their wares to Redsand Station.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nOur settlement in Malgrave is in dire need of resupply. Craftspeople are being urged to bring their wares to Redsand Station.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you brought what we need?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp are drawn to treasure like flies to honey. I reckon there's plenty of treasure around these parts, so these'll come in useful.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll have no trouble fillin' these up. Just you wait.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought furniture to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the $m(schematic=954) to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade representative, Brigade Captain Ashgrove, is stationed in Redsand Station. This is your chance to show the Brigade what you can do. A few well-designed furniture pieces should do the trick.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=934) to Brigade Captain Ashgrove at Redsand Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: NOTIFICATION: Brigade Captains have been dispatched to remote locations to acquire and distribute the best crafted equipment. Be on the lookout and say hello!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: NOTIFICATION: Brigade Captains have been dispatched to remote locations to acquire and distribute the best crafted equipment. Be on the lookout and say hello!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you brought what we need?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah, these will be good for enhancing security around here. You're pretty clever, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for these! I'll pass 'em on to Brigade HQ.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've shared your furniture with Brigade Captain Ashgrove at Redsand Station.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the $m(schematic=934) to Brigade Captain Ashgrove

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver furniture to Contractor Drogor at Redsand Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=1042) to Contractor Drogor at Redsand Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you brought what we need?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's you, $(player.name). Start talkin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You showed up on this one, pal. Let me get you a brew sometime, eh?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You're delivered furniture to Contractor Drogor at Redsand Station.

localizedTextIdText: Drusera has requested your help in stopping the Entity from corrupting the Antechamber. She insists it's urgent, and that you must speak with the Caretaker immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker in the Antechamber
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our time's running out. You must stop the Entity from corrupting the Phagelabs. Speak to the Caretaker and he'll tell you what needs to be done.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please... you must hurry. Speak to the Caretaker and see what needs to be done. I'm not strong enough to delay the Entity any longer.
