localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Drusera told me to expect you, $(player.name). I do hope her trust has not been misplaced.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Entity poses a threat to Nexus unlike any other.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So be it. Our first task is to deal with this... infestation.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Very well. I'll speak to the Caretaker.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following Drusera plea for help, you spoke to the Caretaker in the Antechamber.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What happens if the Entity takes control?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why me? How am I supposed to stop him?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: You're not coming to help me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If the Entity wins, his corruption will spread across Nexus. The Strain will absorb everyone and everything on the planet. After that, he'll spread his corruption across the galaxy until everything is consumed!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I've been trying to fight the Entity by myself for a long time, but I can't defeat him alone. I wish I could be there to help you, but I can't...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I see greatness in you, and I know you'll find a way. I'll guide you when I can.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: This isn't my real body, it's just a projection I use. My real body is trapped... somewhere else.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: The Entity is getting stronger. Soon there'll be nothing we can do. You must hurry!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No! Don't abandon me! You're my only hope, $(player.name)!

localizedTextIdText: Drusera wants you to follow the Entity into the Techno-Core Annex and collect primal essences from his minions, which infest the installation. Drusera is convinced that all will be lost if you don't succeed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Soon the Entity will reach the Techno-Core and all will be lost! Follow him, collecting the primal essences of his minions as you go. We'll need them later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can't delay the Entity for much longer. He's too strong... and I'm growing so very weak. Collect primal essences from his minions, and go into the Core.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There is no choice now... the Entity must be confronted directly. I wish I could be by your side and help you, but... but I can't.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can do this, $(player.name)! I know you can!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wish I was, $(player.name). You're my only hope!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed the Entity into the Techno-Core Annex and collected primal essences from his minions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do I need primal essences?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Soon I'll combine the primal essences into a weapon you can use against the Entity. You must hurry!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't turn away now. This is too important!

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has requested your assistance in clearing defiled constructs and other agents of the Entity out of the Techno-Core Annex. It won't be easy, but it needs to be done.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Techno-Core Annex is filled with corrupt creatures serving the Entity. Proceed to the Annex at once and wipe them out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sure you know the Techno-Core Annex is not yet cleansed of corrupting influences. Don't waste any more time, for this task is of the utmost importance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Annex is clean. The statistical chances of our success are likely to be quite low, but I have refrained from running my usual probability analysis.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We both know you can kill. I'm certain that's why Drusera chose you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have found that the odds are not always what they are cracked up to be.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assisted the Caretaker by clearing defiled constructs and other agents of the Entity from the Core.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take care of it now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've proven to be useful before. Why do you refuse now?

localizedTextIdText: Drusera has created a $(vitem=897) from the six primal essences you collected from the Entity's shades. She has asked you to follow the Entity into the Techno-Core and use the purifier to reverse the corruption he's caused. Once this is done, she'll use whatever strength she has to help you drive him from the Core.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Drusera in the Techno-Core
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'll now combine the essences you gathered into a primal purifier. With it, you can cleanse the Core before the Entity can corrupt it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Take the purifier into the Core and cleanse the Entity's corruption so I can attempt to drive him out. It's our only hope!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wonderful! You've saved us all, $(player.name)! I knew you were the one!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once you've finished, I'll use what strength I have to drive the Entity out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Entity is gone, but the plans he set into motion must be laid to rest.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We did it! But what about the Entity?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the $(vitem=897) to reverse the corruption caused by the Entity, paving the way for Drusera to help you force him from the Core. Even though the Entity has been defeated, your job is far from over.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll do it, don't you worry.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What does the Entity want with it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What is this primal purifier you created?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Techno-Core is an encryption device that protects Eldan technology from outside control and corruption. It connects to every Eldan construct and computer system on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: He desires to use the Techno-Core to control Nexus. If the Entity uses the techno-phage to corrupt the Core, he will also corrupt every Eldan construct and facility on the planet.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Though I have tried to keep the Entity contained, he has been able to withstand me. This allows him to project his consciousness here, much as I do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The primal purifier combines the essences of six powerful elementals, as well as some of my own. With it, we should be able to dispel the Entity's projection before all is lost.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: No. Just like me, the Entity is only a projection of his true form. The Primal Purifier will simply disrupt his projection and prevent him from corrupting the Techno-Core.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then you condemn Nexus, and the rest of the galaxy, to destruction!

localizedTextIdText: Now that the Entity has been driven from the Core, Drusera has informed you that a defiled world destroyer will be unleashed on the surface if it isn't destroyed first. In order to defeat it, she's promised to infuse you with her power - giving you access to both her form and abilities!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Drusera inside the Core
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Entity does not take defeat well. He's attempting to free a defiled world destroyer on the surface. I must infuse you with my power if you're to defeat it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not fear the world destroyer, $(player.name). Step through the portal and together we'll put an end to the Entity's schemes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My strength is renewed by our victory, $(player.name). My trust in you was well-placed. I must leave now, for the Entity is still out there somewhere.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you're ready, step through the portal. We'll do this together!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are precious, and I don't want the Entity to harm you. Farewell!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Drusera infused you with her power so that you could defeat the defiled world destroyer that had been unleashed when the Entity was forced out of the Core of Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Will you be able to read my thoughts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What about this world destroyer?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You will be infused with my very essence, granting you both my form and my power.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We will be two souls sharing the same body. It will be a bit... personal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Our thoughts will be shared. I'll know your thoughts, and you'll know mine.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: That machine has remained contained and unable to escape until now. The Entity and his servants are working to free it. If they do, it will wreak destruction across Grimvault.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How? I don't understand!

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Vrizz wants you to go to The Drowned Cooperative and deploy Seismic Scanner to discover the cause of the erosion that doomed the former Cooperative.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bogbottom drowned! EVERYONE drowned! Dam broke now entire thing gone. Go deploy seismic scanners and sample debris. Zeng will process data remotely.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go now! All dead at The Drowned Cooperative. Need to find why. Go to marked coordinates, deploy seismic scanners. Technician Zeng will analyze samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This not good. Wazz barely dug any tunnels. Enemies using tunnels prepare attacks against our Cooperatives. This must be stopped!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Dangerous. Watch out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You sent the seismic data to Technician Zeng who informed you that the caverns beneath the Bogbottom and Rustbucket Cooperatives are more extensive than any being dug at Bogbottom. Zeng also believes the explosives that destroyed the dam were of Exile craftsmanship.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Bogwater Cooperative was functional Chua research site but now completely underwater! Reports are coming in that whole thing flooded and Foreman Wazz went missing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Wazz in charge of Bogbottom Cooperative. Was sent to research geothermal activity but haven't heard from him since dam broke.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Away with you. Useless bodies waste time.

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Vrizz wants you to travel to The Sinking Cooperative and rescue as many Chua Survivors as you can.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Rustbucket sinking! Exiles attacking.  Must go to sinking Cooperative now, save what Chua you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Another Cooperative is sinking! Must try stop it in time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work, minion. Many Chua safe now. Soon make Exiles pay for petty attacks.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: There is some serious water damage.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found The Sinking Cooperative overrun with terminite feeding on the supports and weakening the ground with their burrows. While the Cooperative won't be usable for some time, you managed to rescue many of the Chua Survivors in time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stay out of sight, as useless things should.

localizedTextIdText: Technician Zeng wants you to kill Tanglemire Terminite and close Gloomthorn Burrows in The Sinking Cooperative by calling in groundthumpers. With some luck and Chua engineering the Cooperative may yet be saved.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now we know Aurin using terminite burrow beneath bulidings to sink them. Must kill them. Kill them all and close burrows!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Terminite still problem at the Cooperative. You go kill faster. Take this to signal groundthumpers and close terminite burrowd for good!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: News is cozmotronic! No burrows, no terminite, no more sinking!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You halted the structural damage beneath The Sinking Cooperative by disposing of the burrows and terminite.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pity you so useless.

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Vrizz wants you to kill groups of Gloomthorn Aurin inside the . The Aurin's use of natural creatures to battle the Dominion has become too great a nuisance to leave unchecked.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Overseer Vrizz via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exile tree-slanks must die now. Go to village and kill kill kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Reports indicate Aurin enemies still alive. Your duties were exterminate them all. No more wasting time, go kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Many dead tree-slanks is good thing! You've become my most effective minion yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You vanquished many of the Gloomthorn inhabitants and their charmed creatures. With their power diminished, the Gloomthorn will be hard pressed to continue their plots against the Tanglemire Collective.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not wise refute Chua. Reconsider or life may be shorter.

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Vrizz wants you to enter the Mossthorn Bunker inside the Gloomglow Encampment and access a Data Center to see what the Watcher's orders are.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Overseer Vrizz via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tree-slanks must get orders from somewhere. Data must be kept in underground bunker. Infiltrate and extract plans before they destroy anything else!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Attacks too clever and organized for normal tree-slanks. Must find rest of their plans.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bog giants? Preposterous! You must stop this. No time to debate while Collective in danger.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Inside the bunker you found a message log of Arwick Redleaf instructing the Watcher to summon a dangerous bog giant in order to assault the dam.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Important task. Reconsider?

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Vrizz wants you to kill the Gloomthorn Bogwhisperer and destroy the Gloomthorn Bog Giant in the Gloomthorn Encampment before they can attack the dam.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Overseer Vrizz via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bog giant must die! Kill summoners, stop rituals, bury them deep!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: While summoners still live bog giant is threat. Must kill tree-slanks, summon giant, and kill kill kill.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You kill like champion! Have to keep you around but still more to do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll kill this giant and the summoners.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disrupted the summoning ritual and put the Gloomthorn Bog Giant to rest in an early grave. Without any high powered weapons remaining, the dam should be safe from direct attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Time wasting. Waste it somewhere else.

localizedTextIdText: Technician Zeng wants you to go to the Tanglemire Dam and repair the Ruptures before the whole thing collapses.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Technician Zeng at Tanglemire Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Not good. Dam leaking water very fast now. Need to block ruptures until repair team can get there. You handle it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Water pouring through dam! It can't hold much longer. Go, plug ruptures anyway possible!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're very resourceful, $(player.name). Engineers almost there to fortify dam.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You sealed the worst of the dam's ruptures and bought enough time for Technician Zeng to send out some engineers to work on a permanent fix. With the Aurin threat neutralized. the remaining Chua facilities will be safe from collapse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't give up now. Reconsider now!

localizedTextIdText: You found a Broken Lodestone on the outskirts of the Gloomthorn Encampment. By destroying the other Gloomthorn Lodestones you may break the Aurin's control over the wild creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Technician Zeng over the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A broken lodestone devoid of energy. It seems the Aurin are using these stones to control the natural creatures in the area.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Aurin still use creatures against us. Go find cause and shatter them. Break them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great work, servant! Those Exile dirt slanks and magics not be trusted. Break all the things pave way for Dominion dominance!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I don't put up with Aurin tricks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Gloomthorn Lodestones shattered, the Aurin will have a hard time controlling the terminite and other creatures of Dreadmoor. They will have to find other means to  sabotage the Dominion.

localizedTextIdText: Inventor Fruzilo wants you to use his Havokhelms on Tanglemire Prowler in the Tanglemire and test them in battle against creatures in the area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Inventor Fruzilo at the Tanglemire Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Overseer wants new weapons for battle. Well, I've invented the Havokhelm. Use on prowlers turn them deadly fighting allies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Havokhelm still not tested enough. Go use them on girrok and fight enemies then upload combat data. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Battle reports very nice! Stability still problem though. Will have to make improved version of Havokhelm for future tests.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Havokhelms were mostly a success in turning the girrok into killing machines. An unfortunate side effect of the helm is a short circuit after some time that could be fatal to the bearer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bad choice. Must be over your head.

localizedTextIdText: Inventor Fruzilo wants you to collect wild Tanglemire Vind and attach them to Sinking Objects near the The Sinking Cooperative.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Inventor Fruzilo via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The odd floating properties of these vind may be useful in keeping things from sinking below the marsh.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Vind float whil Chua buildings sink. I know! Capture vind attach to objects keep them from sinking. Genius idea.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work $(player.name). Many Chua grateful for hard work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While not a normal fixture in Chua engineering, the vind did a remarkable job of suspending objects above the mud around the text Link="Location:33415">The Sinking Cooperative</text>.

localizedTextIdText: You found the Eyes of Watcher Mossthorn and were able to find a nice capsule for them. Overseer Vrizz would be happy to receive such a trophy at Tanglemire Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Eyes of the Watcher{p:Eyes of the Watcher} to Overseer Vrizz at the Tanglemire Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A token from the slain Watcher would add a nice touch to Overseer Vrizz's collection.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The eye still needs to be delivered to Overseer Vrizz at the Tanglemire Collective.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This nice trophy! Foolish tree-slanks always blind to genius of Chua.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Overseer Vrizz put the trophy of Watcher Mossthorn's eyes on display to proudly show the Chua's dominance over their Aurin enemies.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Eyes of the Watcher{p:Eyes of the Watcher} to Overseer Vrizz
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This can wait until later.

localizedTextIdText: Operator Zrum wants you to find the missing DREDplex drill teams in the cave beneath The Sinking Cooperative. The drilldozer sensors may have flooded so he provided a homing beacon to help guide them to the surface.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Technician Zeng via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: DREDplex drilldozers lost in evacuation! Sensors flooded but should be nearby. You find signs of them use this homing beacon guide them to surface.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What waiting for? Go signal missing drill teams. Should be around here somewhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Drilldozers still missing? What you waiting for? Go locate DREDplex drilldozers because serious weapons can't be left behind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent news! Top secret weaponry saved because of you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found signs of the stuck DREDplex drills and provided the homing signal to guide them to the surface. The engineers inside fled back to the Tanglemire Collective.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Accidents happen all the time, especially in caves like this.

localizedTextIdText: A job offers a reward for killing the Gloomthorn Broodmother in the Tanglemire Tunnel beneath The Sinking Cooperative.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Overseer Vrizz via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Very large monster seen in tunnels under Bogbottom Cooperative. Kill broodmother for nice reward.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The job still stands to kill a reported broodmother seen near tunnels beneath the sinking Cooperative.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Big bug still alive. Go to tunnels and exterminate it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Broodmother dead? Impressive!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Gloomthorn Broodmother slain, the tunnels will be safer for the Chua operations and the production of terminite will decrease.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This job is best left to someone else.

localizedTextIdText: The Bogbottom scientists at Bogbottom's remote Research Site came to investigate Pell power over earth in the hopes they may raise their Drowned Cooperative from its watery grave. Aldo Frump wishes to hire you as a field technician to study the Mudwalker Pell's native habits, up close in the wild.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Scientist Zuk at the Bogbottom Research Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're from the Bogwater Cooperative. Before it was nice, now not so nice. Now drowned in water. But we are going to fix it. Ask Aldo Frump. He will tell you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You help us? Yes, yes! We study Mudwalker Pell and learn secrets of Primal Earth. We figure out Pell secrets together!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Aldo Frump not far from here. Go talk!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spoken to Aldo Frump, the lead scientist at the Bogbottom Research Site. He's determined to find the Pell's secrets of harnessing the power of Primal Earth in order to save the Drowned Cooperative.

localizedTextIdText: The Bogbottom scientists want you to measure the amount of Primal Earth energy in Mudwalker Commune. Inventor Kadum of Bogbottom Research Site has created a Primal Earth locator which should indicate the strength of Primal Earth in Mudwalker Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Inventor Kadum of Bogbottom Research Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need measuring of Primal Earth. Take this and stick it in loose rock near Mudwalker Commune. It will indicate the strength of Primal Earth energy here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still need to measure the strength of Primal Earth energy. Wasting time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Calibration complete! Readings now popping up all over Mudwalker Commune. What could it mean? Don't know.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll bring this news to Aldo Frump. He will be very pleased. Yes, yes. Very pleased.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The readings done near Mudwalker Commune all seem to point to the same place. The source of the Pell's Primal Earth seems to be in the center of the commune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Whatever. Didn't like you anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Scientist Zuk of Bogbottom Research Site wants you to gather any primal earth you might find off of the pell or earth elementals in the Mudwalker Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Scientist Zuk via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Can't control Primal Earth without some samples. Take samples from Mudwalker Pell or Golems in Mudwalker Commune.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why still here? Go gather Primal Earth samples from Mudwalker Pell and Golems!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lots of samples! Lots of samples indeed! I will begin research right away. Aldo Frump will be pleased!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've managed to collect enough samples for Scientist Zuk to begin his research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stand still. Will measure you for a body bag.

localizedTextIdText: Aldo Frump of Bogbottom Research Site has attempted to evaluate the Primal Earth samples but testing has yielded little results. He's decided the best way to learn Pell secrets is to capture them and ask them himself. He needs you to capture Mudwalker Pell in Mudwalker Commune.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have samples of Primal Earth but haven't cracked the secret to harnessing the power. I have idea, we make Pell tell us! Capture Pell and we find out secrets!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need to act now! Capture Mudwalker Pell and we find out all the secrets!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pell tell me lots. Pell make little sense and Pell talk funny. Lots of funny talk about Mudwalker elemental. Mudwalker elemental is the key!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't worry. I'll ask them nicely...at first.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've trapped enough Pell for Aldo Frump's questioning. He's been able to discern that Mudwalker, the elemental is the key to the Mudwalker Pell's power over Primal Earth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are not that smart, are you?

localizedTextIdText: Aldo Frump of Bogbottom Research Site wants you to kill Mudwalker, the elemental in Mudwalker Commune. After much Pell questioning, he has found Mudwalker to be the key to the Mudwalker Pell's power of Primal Earth.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Aldo Frump in Bogbottom Research Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kill Mudwalker elemental and research can continue. Then we find all the secrets to pell power of Primal Earth.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You are not killing Mudwalker. Why are you not killing?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mudwalker elemental dead! And you're not! Yay. Now Bogbottom scientists can learn to harness power of Primal Earth!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mudwalker is dead and the scientists at the Bogbottom Research Site can begin harnessing the power of Primal Earth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bad choice. Think again.

localizedTextIdText: This scanbot belongs to Aldo Frump of Bogbottom Research Site. It looks like he sent out alot of scanbots to gather research. That information might prove useful. Repair any disabled scanbots you find in Mudwalker Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Aldo Frump of Bogbottom Research Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This scanbot belongs to Aldo Frump. It looks like he sent out alot of scanbots to gather research. That information might prove useful. Repair any disabled scanbots you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Repair remaining disabled scanbots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Can't thank you enough. Scanbots now busy scanning. Thought they were lost for good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've repaired Aldo Frump's disabled scanbots in Mudwalker Commune. Hopefully they can assist in providing information on the Power of Earth.

localizedTextIdText: You find a piece of paper still clutched in the dead researcher's hands. It mentions the existence of several tomes written by the Pell Tome-Binders. Find the tomes off of the Tome-Binders in Mudwalker Commune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Aldo Frump of the Bogbottom Research Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You find a piece of paper still clutched in the dead researcher's hands. It mentions the existence of several tomes written by the Pell Tome-Binders. Find the tomes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You are missing some of the tomes.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Books! Oh I like books. Pell mysteries in these books. I'll take and I'll study. You take my thanks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected the Tome's off of the Tome-Binders in Mudwalker Commune. Aldo Frump could use this information in his research.

localizedTextIdTitle: By the Light of the Moon
localizedTextIdText: Farmer Aganus has noticed strange things happening in Bracken Hollow. You were also directed to contact Farmer Aganus if you found anything interesting.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Aganus at Farmer Agnus's Shack via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Something mighty strange going on in Bracken Hollow, there is. Some foul rot has taken hold of the people. Turned em feral, it has.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You need directions? Bracken Hollow is just up the road, it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I told ya, I did. The situation is worse than I thought. I'll keep poking around, maybe I'll find something useful. Meanwhile I got some work for ya.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will? Well I won't stop ya. If ya find anything interesting contact me.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take a look for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered that the villagers of Bracken Hollow have been turning into savage Direbourn. Some of them turn back into humans during the day but fewer and fewer are able to do so.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Just head back the way ya came stranger!

localizedTextIdText: The town of Bracken Hollow depends on its roan. Roan Breeder Rufina has asked you to set up traps around the Roan pens in Bracken Hollow to discourage any hungry Direbourne.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Roan Breeder Rufina at Farmer Agnus's Shack via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Roan. That's all we have of any worth, it is. By Dominus I won't let any rotten Diorebourne take them from me. Set some traps around their pens to keep the rotters out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are the traps set? Then why are you standing around? My precious roan are defenseless without those traps.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done! Those traps will give my Roan, right, good protection until we get this all sorted out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Right then, thank ya love!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The traps have been set and are keeping the Direbourne away from the roan pens.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But my precious roan.

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Aganus wants you to fix the Alarmbots around Bracken Hollow so any unaffected villagers will have warning if the Direbourne start attacking in mass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Aganus at Farmer Agnus's Shack via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Not sure what we can to for the infected, but we can try to help the others, we can. Repair the Alarmbots around town to give the villagers warning of any mass Direbourne attacks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without those Alarmbots the villagers will be in a quiet, rotten state if the Direbourne attack.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I could hear those alarms going off from clear over here, I could. Good work, mate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's not much but it's all we can do for now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Alarmbots have been fixed and now give the villagers ample warning of any incoming attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You gonna make this difficult, are ya?

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Aganus found out that there is a mineral called Sterlium that can stun the Direbourne. He wants you to find the Sterlium and a rifle in Bracken Hollow and test it against the Direbourne.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Aganus at Farmer Agnus's Shack via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I found some useful info in Xeril's Journal, I have. A mineral called Sterlium can stun those Direbourne, rotters. Grab the Sterlium for the supply tent and find a rifle in town.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? Find the Sterlium and a rifle in town and use it against the Direbourne, will ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: They don't much like that too much do they, mate! I'm betting that Sterlium will come in handy soon enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Seems like Professor Xeril know a bit too much about what's happening around here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to find some Sterlium and a rifle and found out that it works quite well for stunning the Direbourne.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Think you might reconsider?

localizedTextIdText: You have found a bunch of jars in the Direbourne Den that seem to contain the Direbourne Plague. Farmer Aganus has asked you to break the jars to stop the plague form spreading any further.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Aganus at Farmer Agnus's Shack via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those jars are just like the one form the town well, they are. They must be full of whatever it is that causes the plague. Break em and stop the spread of this for good.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Break those jars and stop this plague form spreading any further, would ya mate?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Right. Now we don't have to worry about this thing spreading to any more villages.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just try not to get any on you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That should be all of them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to break the jars containing the Direbourne Plague. There should no longer be a chance of the Plague spreading to other villages.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's a simple task,  but I guess you can't do it.

localizedTextIdText: From reading Professor Xeril's Journal, Farmer Aganus has found out that has a lab in the cave at the back of Bracken Hollow and that he is responsible for the plague. For all the horrible things that Professor Xeril has done Farmer Aganus wants you to take Professor Xeril's Corpse and so he can have it stuffed and mounted.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Farmer Aganus at Farmer Agnus's Shack
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: According to this journal Professor Xeril has a lab in the cave in town, he has. For all the corpses he's made I want his as payment, and I want it stuffed and mounted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I want Professor Xeril's Corpse, is that too difficult for you? Right, now go to his cave in town and get it for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes that corpse will look great stuffed and mounted outside my house, it will. You done right by us and I give you my thanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: His journal also mentioned he was infected as well, so be ready for a fight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So good of our friend Xeril to donate his body to science!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully managed to kill Professor Xeril and delivered his corpse to Farmer Aganus. Aganus was quite happy with your work and placed the stuffed corpse outside his house. While the cause of the Direbourne Plague has been eliminated the effects of it are still present.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you are too scared then just say so.

localizedTextIdText: Roan Breeder Rufina has told you that many villagers have died due to the Direbourne and has asked you to give these villagers a proper burial in the Bracken Hollow cemetery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Roan Breeder Rufina at Farmer Agnus's Shack via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My poor Roan were not the only ones to die due to the Direbourne. Many villagers lost their lives as well. Give them a proper burial in the town cemetery, would you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please give our fellow villagers a proper burial in the town cemetery. It's the least we can do for them now, it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank ya, love. We can all rest a little easier knowing our friends are finally at rest, we can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you. This means a lot to us, it does.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The dead villagers can now rest in peace due to your selfless efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Shades take you!

localizedTextIdText: Roan Breeder Rufina has dealt with the daugun attacking and killing her Roan for a while but now they are attacking with something else and she has had enough. Rufina wants you to go into Deadwood Copse and take retrieve Dagun Pelts as revenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Roan Breeder Rufina at Farmer Agnus's Shack
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These dagun have been harassing my roan alongside these other rotters for too long now, they have. I want revenge, three dagun pelts for every beautiful roan they have killed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do I not see a pile of pelts in front of me? Get into the forest and get it done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: They say revenge is best served cold, but I think this revenge will keep me and my roan quite warm. Thank you, love.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll use their pelts to make blankets for my beautiful roan.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Roan Breeder Rufina was quite pleased with the Dagun Pelts you brought back and is planning on making some blankets to keep her Roan warm.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine then.

localizedTextIdText: Research Lead Fento is trying to study Blackwater Bog but the Personnel he keeps sending in never come back out. Your job is to enter Blackwater Bog and rescue any Dominion Personnel you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Research Lead Fento at Bogbottom Research Site via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Me have problem. Personnel I send to study bog and miasma disappear. You go into bog find people and send back here. Miasma thick, careful you no get lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: People still not back. Need eyewitness accounts, samples, data. Go to Blackwater Bog save people send back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Data I received very troubling. Researchers I hire very dumb. Get stuck in mud they fired now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Best not to scream if get lost. Make easier for other things to find you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to brave the Miasma of Blackwater Bog and rescued many members of the Dominion. Research Lead Fento was quite displeased with his researchers and fired them for getting stuck in the swamp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sure you no want to rethink answer.

localizedTextIdText: Assistant Bazam is in charge of studying the creatures in Blackwater Bog but still needs Tissue Samples form Rootbutes and Hookfeet, and has sent you to gather the samples he requires. He does not want any living samples just dead ones are acceptable.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Assistant Bazam at Bogbottom Research Site via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Studying long-term effects of miasma on creatures from Blackwater Bog. Only need samples from Rootbrute and Hookfoot, any you find bring here. No living samples only dead ones.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fine I explain again. You go to Blackwater Bog. Kill Rootbrute. Kill Hookfoot. Bring back samples. Now go.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, yes. Seems like swamp plants don't get much light so they emit Miasma. This causes local animal life to grow and die quicker so they can get nutrients form corpses.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go go quickly. Want samples to be fresh.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got the required samples for Assistant Bazam. Shortly after receiving them he sent you away, so he could begin his work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? I don't recognize that word.

localizedTextIdText: Research Lead Fento wants you to chart a safe path through the Miasma in Blackwater Bog. Go to the locations he gave you and light the special torches he gave you to drive away some the Miasma.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Research Lead Fento at Bogbottom Research Site via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What little data I get says miasma caused by big strange plants. Me want you to burn the big ones to ash. Then miasma go away, make research easier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What you get lost? Go to swamp burn big mutant plants, stop miasma. Got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good good. Now maybe can send researchers to study bog without them getting lost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Only need to burn big big ones. Leave small ones for study.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That should be the last one.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully lit all the torches Researcher Fento set out for you this should make further exploration and study much easier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe you not big hero then.

localizedTextIdText: Research Lead Fento has found a large dracus, named Nightmire, that has been mutated by the miasma inBlackwater Bog, and Fento want samples to study.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Research Lead Fento at Bogbottom Research Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yes yes. Fascinating specimen. Big dracus in bog mutated by the miasma. Named Nightmire you go kill it bring back samples for study.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why Nightmire still alive? You go kill, bring back samples, now. Go... Now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes fascinating. Will get good data about miasma from this. You do well. Now go somewhere else.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes yes. Now go kill it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Nightmire and delivered samples from its corpse to Fento. He was quite happy with your work and feels like he can get some good data from the samples you brought back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I get tired of playing this game with you.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Zazz is studying what effects the miasma has had on the Dracus in Blackwater Bog and needs you to kill Blackwater Muckhunters and use a Sample Collector to capture the Muckhunter Nuclei that emerge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Specialist Zazz at Bogbottom Research Site via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yes yes. You do nicely. Muckhunters in Blackwater Bog unusual. Miasma makes their insides all funny. You take Sample Collector and kill Muckhunters collect what pops out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You no collect Muckhunter Nuclei yet. Then why you stand here? You should be in Blackwater Bog.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes. These will do nicely. You go now leave me to research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You still here. Go go go.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: So kill it and collect what's left. Got it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to successfully gather the Muckhunter Nuclei that live inside Blackwater Muckhunters allowing Specialist Zazz to continue his research.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes yes. Sample Collector specially designed to teleport things to special holding tanks. Great for catching slimy things that live in Muckhunters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What if I ask again?

localizedTextIdText: Giganix was overseeing the transport of Medical Supplies to Camp Fortitude when the transport ship crashed in Blackwater Bog.The crates have an auto return function that can teleport them back to Giganix but the signals are being jammed by the miasma and must be activated manually.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Giganix at Bogbottom Research Site via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Are you receiving me? We were transporting Medical Supplies when our ship crashed in that bog. You will have to manually activate a crate's auto return function to send it back to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What is taking so long? Activate a crate's auto return function to send it back to me, before that miasma contaminates the meds.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is taking so long? Activate a crate's auto return function to send it back to me, before that miasma contaminates the meds.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good all the crates have been received and they are unopened! I will get these to Camp Fortitude after I insure the miasma has not contaminated them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope this miasma has not contaminated the meds.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to successfully send back the Medical Supplies to Giganix who was quite pleased that they were still unopened and is sending the supplies off to Camp Fortitude after insuring the miasma has not contaminated them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not a request!

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer wants you to deliver supplies to Lieutenant Tiros, Lieutenant Drala, and Captain Drokok outside Camp Fortitude. Kezrek believes increasing the appearance of the offensive front will weaken the Exiles' resolve.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We must inspire our forces while shattering the resolve of our enemies. Distribute banners and supplies to the lines. Let the Exiles see our might!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The supplies have not reached their destinations. I expect you will do so soon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A small but necessary step towards our victory. The power of the Dominion must be visible to our prey.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Dominion raised banners and turrets along the lines to intimidate their Exile enemies while bolstering the morale of Dominion combatants.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Get out of my sight!

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer wants you to destroy Venomstrike Turret on Venomgrass Field and kill the Swampsnake forces. Without the automated turrets the Dominion's forces should soon gain an advantage and press the lines forward.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need someone with real Draken blood to take the fight to the Exiles. Destroy their turrets and pave the way to the water refinery.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Exiles have guns all along the plains. We need to cut their forces apart and dismantle those guns. Think you've got the hunter's instinct to do it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The plains run red with Exile blood. It's a good day for the empire.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We'll destroy them for the emperor.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Venomgrass Field is now littered with bodies and broken turrets. Soon the Swampsnake company will be a shell of its former power.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Scurry away like the vermin you are.

localizedTextIdText: A few forward medical stations are meant to harbor retreating Dominion forces but the defensive barriers have failed. Chief Surgeon Camlia wants you deploy new Defensive Barriere and to collect Medkits from Medstations or slain Swampsnake forces in Venomgrass Field.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Surgeon Camlia via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Combat medics in the field are taking heavy fire and running low on medical supplies. Can you take these defense barriers to them and raid Exile supplies?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The medics are still taking heavy fire. We need to get the defense barriers out to them and shore up their medical supplies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks, $(player.class). Your service is noted.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll set up the shields and get medkits.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We have plenty of supplies now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the collection of medical supplies the Dominion forces are less likely to be worn down by minor injuries. The combat medics have also been afforded some safety from the long range attacks, and can work in less peril.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You must be joking. Aren't you?

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer wants you to use a rocket launcher to destroy Swampsnake Convoy Tank in Venomgrass Field and collect $(vitem=618) contained within.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles use armored tanks to transport supplies to the refinery. I'm giving you this rocket launcher to strike them down and take what was theirs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We can't sit idle while the Exiles replenish their supplies right under our noses. Use these rockets to destroy the tanks and recover any supplies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These requisitions will be of use in the battles to come.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We'll make good use of their supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the transport tanks and recovered numerous supplies to bolster the Dominion's war efforts in the region.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is unwise to refuse me.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer wants you to enter the Rustbucket Water Refinery and activate a beacon, defend the demolition team, and then make it a safe distance and detonate the explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer at Camp Fortitude
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Demolition experts await the signal to strike the water refinery. Look for a beacon to set off and cover them while the explosives are deployed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without a courageous combatant the demolition team will be going to their graves. We need someone with the strength to defend them and end this battle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A great display of valor! The swampsnakes have withered under our might.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We won't rest until the refinery is in ashes!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Defeat comes naturally to the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: From a safe distance you watched as the bombs sent fire and destruction through the Swampsnake's compound. With this final act the Dominion can declare victory over the Exiles in the skirmish for Rustbucket Water Refinery.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your motives are in question.

localizedTextIdText: Chief Surgeon Camlia wants you to heal Poisoned Dominion forces in Venomgrass Field by administering an antitoxin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Chief Surgeon Camlia in Camp Fortitude
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are reports of the swampsnakes using poisons to hamper our forces. I've found some antivenom in the recovered supplies that can mend the situation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The antivenom will only help if you can get it out to those in need. Do so if it isn't too much of an inconvenience.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. Many of the healed have reported to camp and will soon be ready for active duty again.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They'll live to fight another day.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to rescue many of the poisoned Dominion combatants to eventually replenish the front lines once they are cleared for duty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're declining my request? How unusual.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has posted a job offering rewarding anyone that destroys the Swampsnake Dreadbot in Venomgrass Field. This opponent has proven to be a thorn in the Dominion's war efforts in Dreadmoor and should not be faced alone.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looking for valiant hunters or warriors to dismantle the dreadbot used by the sniveling swampsnake mercenaries. This battle is not for the meek.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The dreadbot still thrashes our troops in the field. Someone must rise to the challenge and prove their worth on the battlefield by defeating it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've brought the glory of victory in battle to the Dominion this day!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's a pile of scrap now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You dismantled the heavy dreadbot used by the Swampsnake mercenaries in Dreadmoor.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion have brought in highly advance projection tech to be used on the battlefront. Unfortunately this tech has been stolen by Dreg raiders. The Dreg may not have the wits to know what they've stolen but in the wrong hands this tech could be extremely dangerous. Apprentice Gruble of Rampart Post wants you to use the tech to send a group of yourself in to the dangerous Dreg village to retrieve the stolen tech.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Apprentice Gruble at Rampart Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our tech, it's gone! Stolen by Dreg raiders! We must get it back. I know! You look big and strong. But three of you...bigger, stronger! I have one projection box left. Use it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need to act now. Use projection box and send clones out to recover missing tech! Not later. Now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes! Projection clones will find tech. Find tech and bring it back! Hmm...maybe we should do more. I send you out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've used the Projection Systems: Clonebot Kit as Apprentice Gruble suggested. Three of your clones just ran off to the Fleshbarrow to find the missing Clonebot Kits. Hopefully no harm comes to them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Rethink. Might suffer unfortunate accident otherwise.

localizedTextIdText: Dreg raiders left in a hurry. Apprentice Gruble of Rampart Post thinks some of the Projection tech might still be nearby. If you get there quick you could still catch them. Recover the Projection tech and help anyone nearby.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Apprentice Gruble via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg raiders left in a hurry. Some of our tech might be nearby. If you get there quick you could still catch them. Recover the Projection tech and help anyone nearby.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Big problem won't fix itself. Recover Projection tech. Hurry hurry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's some of our missing tech at least. They'd be pretty angry with me if they found out I'd lost all of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've managed to secure a couple of the missing Clonebot Kits and healed some wounded soldiers along the road to the Fleshbarrow but your work here has only just begun.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Accept your fate. Say, "yes."

localizedTextIdText: After finding out the Rotflesh Dreg intend to torture and eat their captives or worse, Captain Nahmia of Rampart Post explains leaving them to that fate would be unthinkable. Save those that haven't met a horrible fate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Nahmia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'd hate to see what fate the rest of our men will come to if we don't get to them quickly. Rescue our men before they meet a terrible fate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those you rescued are fortunate to escape the atrocities of the Dreg. They are extremely thankful for your help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Those you rescued are fortunate to escape the atrocities of the Dreg. They are extremely thankful for your help.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Nahmia of Rampart Post wants to take the fight to the heart of the Rotflesh Clan. Challenge them in their own arena in the Fleshbarrow and show them that the Dominion are not to be messed with.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now we take the fight to them. Challenge the Rotflesh Clan in their own arena. That should show them we are not to be messed with!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Rotflesh Clan has tasted defeat on their own ground!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You challenged the Rotflesh Clan in their own arena. That should show them the Dominion is not to be messed with.

localizedTextIdText: With the Projection tech destroyed, we can get you out of that place. First we have one last message to send. Kill the Rotflesh Clanlord, The Dreadripper in the Fleshbarrow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With the Projection tech destroyed, we can get you out of that place. First we have one last message to send. Kill the Rotflesh Clanlord, The Dreadripper.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That should teach them. The Rotflesh Clan will think twice before raiding Dominion outposts from now on. I wish I could say the same for any poor folk that live around here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Rotflesh Clanlord and his Projection clone is dead thanks to you. The Rotflesh Clan will think twice before raiding Dominion outposts from now on.

localizedTextIdText: Want a quick ride back to Rampart Post? Steal that Dreg Transport ship in the Fleshbarrowand collect your reward for all of your help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Nahmia at Rampart Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Want a quick ride back to Rampart Post? Steal that Dreg Transport ship and collect your reward for all of your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've outdone yourself here. We are all in your debt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've made it safely out of the Fleshbarrow. Hopefully you will have no reason to pay that place a visit again.

localizedTextIdText: Xenochemist Amphuon believes that while rescuing the missing Dominion and retrieving important tech is honorable, there is a way to hit the Rotflesh Dreg at their source. He wants you to collect Stinger Venom in the Fleshbarrow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Xenochemist Amphuon of Rampart Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Honorable as your rescue missing is, why don't we hit these Dreg at their source? Collect Stinger Venom. I have a feeling it could prove quite useful.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let's let the Rotflesh Dreg do the rest of the work shall we? No need for bloodshed when you have poison. They won't last long drinking from the poisoned wells.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've collected enough Stinger Venom to poison the Dreg wells. The Rotflesh Dreg will take care of the rest. No need for bloodshed when you have poison. The Rotflesh Dreg won't last long drinking from those poisoned wells.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Nahmia has located the Slavemasters in the Fleshbarrow. These Slavemasters need to meet their end. Preferably in a painful manner.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Captain Nahmia
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What do you think about shedding some blood? Some Slavemasters need to meet their end. Isn't revenge the sweetest dish of all?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It pleases me that scum have met their end. I hope there was pain involved.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You should have a taste.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Vengeance is yours. You've killed the Rotflesh Slavemasters who have been kidnapping poor souls and subjecting them to terrible atrocities. Pustooth, Burstboil, and Cystborn are no more.

localizedTextIdText: You've found a dying captive still clinging to life in the Fleshbarrow. His dying wish is that you make the Dreg pay for taking his life. Kill the Rotflesh Dreg!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Let the Dying Captive know it's finished
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm not going to make it. Vengeance can't be mine but it must be yours. Make them pay! Kill them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can die in peace knowing that the Rotflesh Dreg have paid for my life.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've killed many Rotflesh Dreg and avenged the death of this dying captive. Now he can die in peace.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Let the Dying Captive know it's finished

localizedTextIdText: WANTED: Gutwretch - The foul abomination put together out of the skins of Rotflesh captives. Kill on site!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Private Gallus in Rampart Post for your reward
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED: Gutwretch - The foul abomination put together out of the skins of Rotflesh captives. Kill on site!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Many thanks to you. Gutwretch was an abomination. At least those souls can now be at rest.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Many thanks to you, Gutwretch is dead.  Gutwretch was an abomination put together out of the skins of Rotflesh captives. At least those souls can now be at rest.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Malgrave lists a work order request for weapons to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring the requested weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the xenocite weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly build our arsenal using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly build our arsenal using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Malgrave is dangerous. We will need all the weapons we can get.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, excellent. These weapons will do nicely. You've made a nice contribution to the war effort here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A fine haul. Glory to the empire, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the xenocite weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has dispatched Lieutenant Cryvir to Fort Dominus to scout for resources that may benefit the Empire logistically. Show your knowledge of local resources by crafting some weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Weapons to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our arsenal using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must have seen the notice - we need weapons. Get to work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Citizen, I greet you. Have you found a way to use these lands for the benefit of the Dominion? What weapons have you made?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The empire thanks you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Weapons to Lieutenant Cryvir

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Tirexa at Fort Dominus has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those weapons!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Weapons to Weaponsmith Tirexa at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We require precisely-calibrated weapons, constructed to our exacting standards. Are you up to the task?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The detailing on these weapons is exceptional. Thank you, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must all strive for excellence in our service to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Weapons to Weaponsmith Tirexa

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Malgrave lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring the requested armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela inFort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need to build up an armory if we're going to be able to confront all the challenges Malgrave has to offer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Commission business, $(player.name)? Ah, this will make an excellent addition to the armory.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Very well, citizen. You have the thanks of an empire.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has dispatched Lieutenant Cryvir to Fort Dominus to scout for resources that may benefit the Empire.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dominion needs competent crafters to resupply this outpost with armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Greetings, citizen. I see that you have fulfilled our standards.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Lieutenant Cryvir

localizedTextIdText: Bagazi Kreng at Fort Dominus has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Bagazi Kreng at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fighters using substandard armor, showing up burned, crushed, poisoned. Maybe heavy armor help. Maybe not.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you! Time to see if armor helps, or if local fighters just too stupid to live.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Would thank you, but since I hired you, I'll thank me. Ha!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Bagazi Kreng

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Malgrave lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring the requested medium armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Hunter's armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need to build up an armory if we're going to be able to confront all the challenges Malgrave has to offer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Commission business, $(player.name)? Ah, this will make an excellent addition to the armory.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are all in your debt.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has dispatched Lieutenant Cryvir to Fort Dominus to scout for resources that may benefit the Empire logistically. Show your knowledge of local resources by crafting some armor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the request Medium Armor to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I  need you to create high-quality medium armor. Come back when you have completed my request.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am happy to see that you have aptly exploited local resources to suit the Dominion's needs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Lieutenant Cryvir

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Vekia at Fort Dominus has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Vekia at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We require leather armor. Do not refuse to aid us in the service of the dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: When I heard you were on the job, I anticipated quality armor. I am pleased to see that I was correct.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I thank you for your faithful service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medium Armor to Outfitter Vekia

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Malgrave lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring the requested armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need to build up an armory if we're going to be able to confront all the challenges Malgrave has to offer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Commission business, $(player.name)? Ah, this will make an excellent addition to the armory.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is what I have come to expect from a craftsman of your caliber.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdTitle: Weaving In and Out of Focus
localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has dispatched Lieutenant Cryvir to Fort Dominus to scout for resources that may benefit the Empire logistically. Show your knowledge of local resources by crafting some armor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Fashion evolves quickly, even in the horrible desert. We must have something light and breathable, fit for visiting nobles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These clothes are extraordinary... and to think they were created from such base local materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Impressive. Very impressive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Lieutenant Cryvir

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Livy at Fort Dominus has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Livy at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Every once in a while, we get a customer 'round here who looks close at the stitching. Do what you can to make 'em something posh, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's fine, that is. I'm sure even the snottiest noble won't turn his nose up at something like that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Livy

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Malgrave lists a work order request for medicine to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need assistance in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must have medical supplies available as soon as possible.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need assistance in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must have medical supplies available as soon as possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Malgrave is dangerous. We require quality medishots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So much blood. And burns, and sand abrasion, and alcohol poisoning. Yes, Malgrave is certainly a... diverse ecosystem. Medishots are in high demand.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These will do nicely to patch them up. They owe you a bit of gratitude, I'd say.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medishots to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has dispatched Lieutenant Cryvir to Fort Dominus to scout for resources that may benefit the Empire logistically. Show your knowledge of local resources by crafting some medishots.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medishots to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need supplies in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must rapidly expand our armory using whatever we can find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sending scouts out to explore Malgrave has proven... problematic. We're getting high casualty counts, and medishots are running low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, $(player.name), it is good to know I can trust you to efficiently complete tasks you are given.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: These medishots are quite potent. I thank you for your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought medishots to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medishots to Lieutenant Cryvir

localizedTextIdText: Technologist Corvianos at Fort Dominus has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those medishots!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Medishots to Technologist Corvianos at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need medishots, the strongest you can make, and we need 'em fast. You hear me, mate?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've no idea how badly we needed these. Workin' with you is a right treat.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for medishots.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Medishots to Technologist Corvianos

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Malgrave lists a work order request for furniture crafted from local materials to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their furniture to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Fort Dominus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=954) to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need assistance in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must get ourselves properly established.
