localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need assistance in Malgrave. Our settlement here is small, and we must get ourselves properly established.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So it's come to this. We have to trade with the local Lopp to survive in Malgrave. Can you make us some treasure chests?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Are those the chests? Finally! It won't do to have all our merchandise just laying on the ground. It won't be shiny anymore.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: But you've done your part in this - we are finished here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought furniture to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Malgrave.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the $m(schematic=954) to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission has dispatched Lieutenant Cryvir to Fort Dominus to scout for resources that may benefit the empire. Show your knowledge of local resources by crafting some furniture.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=934) to Lieutenant Cryvir at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: NOTIFICATION: Cooperation is expected for any requests from marshals operating in the Malgrave region. Craftsmen are strongly encouraged to render their assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: NOTIFICATION: Cooperation is expected for any requests from marshals operating in the Malgrave region. Craftsmen are strongly encouraged to render their assistance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Security here is unforgivably lax, and I cannot be expected to monitor everything myself! Bring me something to address this situation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is definitely... something. As security systems go, it's certainly unique, but it will serve.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought furniture to Lieutenant Cryvir in Fort Dominus.

localizedTextIdText: Architect Cybene at Fort Dominus has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign in Malgrave. Craft that furniture!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=1042) to Architect Cybene at Fort Dominus
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I require a table. Something stylish, yet functional.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Elegant in form, but practical and sturdy. Yes, these tables will do nicely.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for furniture.

localizedTextIdText: While making your way through Murkmire, Mind-Walker felt your presence and now asks you to report to him at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Blood-Drinker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You there... I thought I had felt a nearby presence.  Our village is in need of your aid, please come see us.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Do not keep Blood-Drinker waiting...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do not keep me waiting...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mind-Walker told me to expect you. Thank you for coming.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May the Masters guide your way.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Shall we begin?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have made your way through Murkmire and have met with Blood-Drinker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Masters will not be pleased with this.

localizedTextIdText: Blood-Drinker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine has asked you to go into Hexcomb Hive and eliminate the Hexcomb Drones, Wardens and Aggressors.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Blood-Drinker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Flying beasts... Once tolerable, now... violent, aggressive, agitated.  You $(player.class), help us by eliminating as many as possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your hands are not yet soaked in the blood of our enemy... Why is this?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those beasts now know the cost of their actions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do this, and the Masters will know of your great deed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us continue.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have cut down the number of Hexcomb Drones, Wardens and Aggressors at Hexcomb Hive for Blood-Drinker.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You put yourself in great peril by taking that tone.

localizedTextIdText: Blood-Drinker has provided you with Logic Essence to burn at campfires throughout Hexcomb Hive this will create a blast that will destroy the three central hives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Blood-Drinker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Campfires were lit by our brethren to signal hive locations, though no one has returned.  Take this Logic Essence, burn it in the fires. The essence shall do the rest.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The air is not ripe with ash and smoke.  Do not return to me until it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The flames grow tall in the Murkmire breeze.  Fire and ash, the Masters truly were with us this day.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh... and do yourself a favor $(player.class).  After you burn that essence, stand back.  Or else you'll become part of our vengeance.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is still more to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have done as Blood-Drinker has asked, the major hives within Hexcomb Hive have been destroyed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Be gone with you.

localizedTextIdText: Soul-Singer requests your assistance in creating an antidote to the Hexcomb stinger attacks. Gather stingers for Soul-Singer at Hexcomb Hive so that he may run some initial tests.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Soul-Singer at Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These beasts stab and sting and infect their victims with a vicious poison.  I aim to create an antidote for this.  Go now, bring me back stingers from our fallen brethren.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Retrieve me those stingers, or do you need to be stung by one first to know what they look like?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have made us proud this day, this will help in the antidote research.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring them to me immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our plan will soon come to fruition.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have gathered a sufficient amount of stingers for Soul-Singer at Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: hmm... If you're on the receiving end of one of those stingers, I shall not be upset.

localizedTextIdText: Mind-Walker wants you to go further into the Hexcomb Hive Cavern and collect Eldan Data Fragments, and place two Mindbreak banners to claim the territory inside.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Mind-Walker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: High priest Star-Seer used to study Eldan technology. He mentioned Data Fragments were found in this cavern, go in, place our banners and retrieve us fragments!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I grow older and weaker, as you grow less valuable to our cause.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done us a great deed today.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be on your guard $(player.class), and be ready to cull back the beasts that live within. If only High Priest Star-Seer could be here to take part in this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our great work continues.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What else is there to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully gathered enough Eldan Data Fragments and placed Mindbreak Banners inside the Hexcomb Hive Cavern.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Disappointing, we were so close.

localizedTextIdText: Blood-Drinker has asked you to cut the problem at its source, the Augmentors. Head into the Hexcomb Hive Cavern and eliminate them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Blood-Drinker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Since High Priest Star-Seer vanished, these machines have grown in number.  Move swiftly and destroy them. The Masters' wish it done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why have you not destroyed these foul machines yet?!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The deed is done.  Hopefully these beasts can eventually be soothed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show these machines no mercy, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully cut down the Augmentors from within the Hexcomb Hive Cavern.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Masters' will not be pleased.

localizedTextIdText: Mind-Walker at Mindbreak Harmony Shrine has request you make your way into Hexcomb Hive Caverns and finish the mapping work his tribe had begun.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Mind_Walker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We had begun to map those caverns, but we fear our cartographers we're taken by these beasts. Go now... go into those caverns and complete our mapping duties.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you hear speaking with me... Back to the caverns with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Masters' have heard our cries for help $(player.class).  Excellent work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bravery, and aggression... shall aid you on your journey.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are nearly done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully finished mapping the Hexcomb Hive Caverns .
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are not worthy of this task, be gone.

localizedTextIdText: Blood-Drinker has requested that you destroy the largest augmented beast of them all, Doombing inside the Hexcomb Hive Cavern.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Blood-Drinker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That beast... The augmentation has increased his size more so than the others.  We cannot have a creature like that alive... Eliminate him $(player.class).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Has that giant beast been slain yet, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your deeds today shall be remembered for some time, outsider.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Exercise caution with this one...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have done the Masters' proud today.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully eliminated Doombing, inside <text>Link="Location:33986"> Hexcomb Hive Cavern</text>
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I urge you to rethink that response...

localizedTextIdText: Mind-Walker at Mindbreak Harmony Shrine has requested that you make your way into Hexcomb Hive Caverns and save the High Priest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Mind-Walker at the Mindbreak Harmony Shrine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have located the great High Priest Star-Seer! The mapping you did... has shown the High Priest injured down in the cavern.  Go now, save him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our High Priest is in need of your help!  Get to him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have done us a great deed this day $(player.class).  Our High Priest shall be back to lead another day.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May the Masters' be with you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May the Masters' guide you for all time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully saved the priest from theHexcomb Hive Caverns .
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What... do you mean... No?

localizedTextIdText: You have retrieved a distress comm call from Eggo, who is a member of the Apparition Apprehenders. He has requested your help in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Eggo at Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello There!  Are you looking for work?  Searching for a payday?!  Well we need your help!  Come to the Phantasmal Meadow and speak with me for more information!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you ever plan on showing up?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wonderful!  Welcome to Phantasmal Meadow!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Splendid!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, onto business!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully found and met with Eggo at the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wait until everyone hears of this!

localizedTextIdText: Eggo of the Apparition Apprehenders wants you to eliminate the ghostly figures in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Eggo at the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ghosts! Squeee! We're in the process of begining our tests, but their numbers are growing!  Too many!  Please eliminate some and cull their numbers back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're scared aren't you?  I knew it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent!  I knew our tasks were in good hands with you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm not afraid of no ghost... I'm just... busy currently!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, the next step!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully eliminated a number of ghostly figures from the the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, surely there's no story there.

localizedTextIdText: Stano has requested that you to disable the Eldan Projection Panels in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Eggo at the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Jumping Oxian, look at that! Projected holographic contained structures controlled by a networked interface panel! Sorry, got carried away... Power those down would you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still see panels up and functioning.  What's taking you so long?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What did you learn?  Did anything happen?  I must know!  Full report on my desk! Wait I don't have a desk... Full report on my sleeping bag!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let's see how those ghosts react when we cut off their phantasmal energy source!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So many more questions... Let's keep working on this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully shut down the Eldan Projection Panels, Stano in the Phantasmal Meadow is very enthused and would love to know those results
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bu... Bu... But!

localizedTextIdText: You've stumbled upon a crate of Eldan devices. The box is labeled Holo-Ooze Capsules. Venlo seems to think they'll cheer up the ghosts in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Venlo inthe Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's it going out there?  Are these crabby ghosts enjoying themselves yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Phew!  There we are, now this spooky forest isn't such a drab place to be!  I mean, who doesn't love a little lopp in their day, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe I'll borrow some of those, I broke Eggo's research kit, and I have the feeling he's in the need of a cheering up!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have discovered the Capsules release an ooze onto its target on contact. The ooze has some sort of hallucinogenic qualities. Venlo the Phantasmal Meadow was more than satisfied with the test results.

localizedTextIdText: Eggo wants you to use his Ghost Trap to catch and secure some ghost specimens for him. Make your way into the the Phantasmal Meadow and place traps, then luring injured ghosts over to it!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Eggo in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need specimens! Here, take these traps.  Lay one down, then rough up a ghosty real good, then lure them over it!  If the ghost is weak, it'll snatch them up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are those traps full yet?!  Are they are they!?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Tremendous! We need to get these over to the containment unit immediately!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't wait to hear the stories from this task!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What's next, what's next...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully captured several ghosts for Eggo in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What?! How could you not want to do this?!

localizedTextIdText: Eggo has asked you to shut down the Fear Analysis Replicator Tool in the back of the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Eggo in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Final step! In the back of the camp, there is a Fear Replicator Panel.  Shut this down, and we should rid this area of any more spooky ghosts!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you shut that panel down yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Really?  THAT was your greatest fear?  Some brave hero you are! Anyway, excellent work.  We'll begin the cleaning up of this forest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just be careful, try to... clear your mind when shutting off that panel.  Trust me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Until we meet again!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully finished off your greatest fear and found the source of the ghosts plaguing the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But!  We really need your help!

localizedTextIdText: Stano has asked you to get slimed from the ghostly explosions the ghosts make when they are defeated in battle. Head into the the Phantasmal Meadow
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Stano in the Phantasmal Meadow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't see that much slime on you...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at all that slime! Great work! Oh, here's a towel, clean yourself up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This will make such a story!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully collected and deposited enough slime specimens for Stano to test with in the Phantasmal Meadow.

localizedTextIdText: Draz Markov been investigate the Dreg in the Creature Cult Caravan. In addition to abducting the Aurin, these Dreg has been busy turning the creatures of Dreadmoor into weapons. These abomination need to be killed, starting with the scrab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Draz Markov via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are Aurin trapped in the Dreg camp behind me.  I tried to rescue them myself but there were just to many Scrab! Kill off these Dreg pets to pave the way to the hostages.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you been overrun?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is the path clear yet?  Can we get to Aurin?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope those Aurin...err our friends, are still okay.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's not delay a moment longer.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Not to worry, I'll steamroll some Scrab
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took Draz Markov's intel and put it to good use by thinning out the scrab inside of the Creature Cult Caravan.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to Draz Markov via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not deny me this

localizedTextIdText: Draz Markov believes that the Dreg are feeding themselves some type of stimulant through their tubing. He has asked you collect blood samples from Dreg throughout Creature Cult Caravan so he can determine it's origins.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the samples to Draz Markov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need blood samples from the Dreg in order to determine the origins of the blue substance they inject themselves with.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The larger the palette the more information we can gather, so go kill some more!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do you have the samples I requested?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I believe this to be the source of the Dreg's abnormal strength and aggressive tendencies.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The only thing I can tell at the moment is that the stimulant seems to have natural origins.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Samples of Dreg Juice, got it
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected Dreg blood samples inside of Creature Cult Caravans for Draz Markov. Draz is hopeful that these samples will teach him more about the blue substance the Dreg inject themselves with.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the samples to Draz Markov
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would that you knew what your words will mean...

localizedTextIdText: Draz Markov wants you to press forward into the Creature Cult Caravan in order to rescue the local Aurin who have been captured by the Dreg.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Draz Markov via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that you have a clear path it is imperative that you get to the captured Aurin as quickly as possible.  The Dreg do not wait long before eating their pray.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There could be more Aurin left, better check to be sure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've seen lots of Aurin leaving the camp.  Is that the last of them?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Search the various camps throughout the Caravan.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well then, let's see if we can evict these Dreg once and for all.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hopefully there is something left to rescue
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The last I saw alive anyway...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to move deeper into the Creature Cult Caravan and rescue the Aurin who had been kidnapped by the Dreg before they became a late night snack.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Okay, I'll see if I can find anymore
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Draz Markov via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not deny me this.

localizedTextIdText: Draz has learned that the Dreg in the Creature Cult Caravan have somehow gotten their hands on some Chua chemical weapons. These weapons must be destroyed before they can be used against the Aurin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ness Markov near the cave entrance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dreg have somehow gotten their hands on Chua chemical weapons. Meet up with Niss just outside the storage cave. She'll give you a suit that will keep you safe.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get to the cave and dispose of those chemicals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Remember to put on a suit before you go into the cave.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, you made it! I guess my brother does know what he's doing sometimes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We cannot let the Dreg use these chemicals against our Aurin friends!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well, here's to not dying!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Thank the stars! Those chemicals were nasty stuff.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the Oozing Barrels the Dreg acquired from the Chua, so you could keep the Dreg from using chemical weapons against the Aurin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not deny me this.

localizedTextIdText: Draz Markov knows that attacks on the Aurin will continue unless the "Creature Preacher," leader of the Creature Cult Caravans, is dealt with. He has asked you to, put him down...
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Drez Markov outside of the Creature Cult Caravans.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The one called, 'Creature Preacher,' must be killed or the Aurin will continue to be a source of food. Kill him, and maybe we can all live in peace.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why have you returned?  He is inside of the camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have they been euthanized yet?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: And by we...eh, I mean...well, never mind that now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That is excellent news! I hope it will be enough...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think his pet will be the challenge.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I dealt with the both of them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Draz Markov's behest, you slew the preacher and his might creature. Draz seems to be pretty happy about this, which appears to make him uncomfortable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you fear this Dreg and his beasts?

localizedTextIdText: Niss has picked up a distress call from an Aurin who is stuck inside of Creature Cult Cavern. Find him and help lead him to safety.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Niss Via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Heym $(player.class), I just got a jumbled distress call from an Aurin who is trapped inside the cavern. I'm sending you his location.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Would you rather deal with a furry copse or a walking Aurin?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice, hopefully that will earn us some bonus points.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: He's probably dead by now with no suit, but it's worth a shot!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't believe he was still alive, heh.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It appears that once again Nooks stumbled into some trouble.  You were able to clear the way to safety from inside of the text Link="Location:32635"> Creature Cult Cavern</text>.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I curse you for your cold cruelty!

localizedTextIdText: Bugsy Stillwater may not be too swift, but his Backwater Gumbo is second to none. He's asked you to get him some Garr Meat from the Tallgrass Leatherback and Mudtooths which are around outside of the Creature Cult Caravan.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Garr Meat to Bugsy Stillwater who's busy helping Ma over by their distillary
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You hungry friend? You ain't lived till you tried my Backwater Gumbo. Only problem is I"m short on Garr Meat.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hmm, I don't think that's going to feed everyone. You'd better get some more.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This right here ain't enough for a proper batch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice lookin' steaks right there!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You do the killin' and I'll do the cookin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Much obliged, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the Garr Meat for Niss Markov to Bugsy Stillwater just outside of the Creature Cult Caravan.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Okay, I'll go get some more
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Garr Meat to Bugsy Stillwater
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you'd tasted the Gumbo before, you'd be halfway done by now.

localizedTextIdTitle: Ain't no Moonshine when it's Gone
localizedTextIdText: The Stillwaters are famous for their moonshine, the problem is the Creature Cult Caravan Dreg in the area keeping stealing it all. Ma Stillwater has asked you to get the still running and protect the Stillwater Casks from being taken.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk with Ma Stillwater
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I declare, if those damn Dreg steal one more barrel of my 'shine! Start that drip runnin' and keep those filthy Dreg off my Stillwater Casks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's more comin'! Get back out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's right! Keep running you dirty sons-a-bi...WHAT?! Oh, sorry $(player.name), those Dreg really get my biscuits burnin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hesh up now and get to it! Ya hear that Bugsy?! It''s work first then drink!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ain't got time youngster.  Too much work to do, but thanks all the same for your help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In the battle of the booze you were able to drive back the Dreg and protect the precious Stillwater moonshine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Didn't reckon you for a coward.

localizedTextIdText: Trelia Starlight is appalled at the cruel treatment of splorg by the Dreg of the Creature Cult Caravan. She has asked you to removed the dynamite that has been strapped to the splorg.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Trelia Starlight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: HOW COULD THEY? Dynamite strapped to splorg! Oooo those dirty Dreg! Please $(player.name), let the critters go.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for?! There's critters dying out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you save them?!  Were you able to make it in time?!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get moving! Before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Wonderful! Oh, I didn't think I was going be able to sleep tonight I was so upset.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Splorg extracted, most of them safely...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Trelia Starlight will sleep better tonight knowing the splorg are safe from the clutches of the Dreg. You may have lost a few, but hey, at least he Dreg can't hurt them anymore...right?
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Not to worry I'm on it
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Trelia Starlight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? That really hurts my feelings!

localizedTextIdText: Kattie Stillwater wants to send a clear message to the Dreg of Creature Cult Caravan that their time here in Dreadmoor has come to an end. What better way to send that message than blowing their rides to bits.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Kattie Stillwater via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Whoooweee! Would you take a look at those rides?! Mmm mmm, cryin' shame to blow'em ta bits, but that's just what you're gonna do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know, I don't wanna smash'em up either, but we need ta send a message.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You destroy those honeywagons yet?!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I wish I could see the look on their dumb Dreg faces. They're gonna be PISSED!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That oughta send a clear enough message! Well done $(player.class)!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sad to see such pretty rides go to waste...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yup, and my dreams of riding an airboat
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The destruction of the Dreg Hoversails around Creature Cult Caravan sent a clear message that even the Dreg can understand.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Kattie Stillwater via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did you just turn me down?!

localizedTextIdText: Become Level 15
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 15.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character is now Level 15.

localizedTextIdText: Become level 20
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 20.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character was leveled up to level 20.

localizedTextIdText: Become level 30
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 30.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character was leveled up to level 30.

localizedTextIdText: Become level 40
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 40.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character was leveled up to level 40.

localizedTextIdText: Become level 50
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 50.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character was leveled up to level 50.

localizedTextIdText: The Moodies of the Haunted Fen used to be managable, never harming travelers who stayed on the road and away from their camp. Lately, people have been disappearing on the road, and the Moodies are likely to blame. Scout the road that leads through The Haunted Fen, and see if you can determine what precipitated this change.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Grand Matria Oggra
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I can sense something disturbing the weave here - strong magic, driven by a dark heart. I'm afraid you will have to walk these roads to learn more.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Crossroads are places of power. Go there, and see who you meet. You may even have to go into the Moodie camp, the very heart of the darkness.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These changes are clearly Laveka's handywork. Moodies only raise their own dead, or entrance dead creatures... this is something else entirely.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The weave connects us all. I will watch over you on your journey.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: She is a powerful sorceress, but also young and foolish.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We've got our work cut out for us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While investigating mysterious disappearances in The Haunted Fen, you learned that the powerful Draken necroshaman Laveka the Dark-Hearted is responsible for the recent troubles.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Don't Moodies already meddle with necromancy?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Who would do such a thing?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Any specific theories?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: What do you know about this Laveka?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I believe it is a form of necromancy. Something is meddling with the cycle of life and death here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: A little, but not on this scale. Whoever is doing this is trying to break the cycle entirely. I believe they are trying to raise every dead thing in Dreadmoor... and maybe kill every living thing, as well.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I have my suspicions. The power here reminds me of a Draken bloodshaman I faced off with in my younger days - but this is a wilder power, twisted and dark.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Well, I have heard stories of a wayward shaman, called Laveka the Dark-Hearted.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: She is a young sorceress, incredibly powerful. She thinks she can do what she pleases, in defiance of the Dominion, and in violation of the laws of life and death itself!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I understand your fear. It can be difficult to walk bravely into places where others have fallen.

localizedTextIdText: Laveka has set up a number of Draken Graveshrines in The Haunted Fen. A combination of sacred cairn and dark magic focus, the candles burning on the bone piles are part of some delicate and dangerous working. Snuff out the candles to thwart Laveka's plans.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Grand Matria Oggra
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wait... that shrine. It has an energy... it binds a soul to this world. Blow out the candles and sever the tether.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The candles on Laveka's Draken graveshrines are powerful tools of dark magic. Until they are extinguished, we are all in danger.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If Laveka has moved the bones of her ancestors here, she must intend to stay. We can't allow that, can we?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those are Draken bones - ancient ones, to boot. They must have come from offworld.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You extinguished Draken Graveshrines in The Haunted Fen, disturbing the inner workings of Laveka's dark plan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hmf. Young people today, so hesitant to meddle with dark forces they don't understand!

localizedTextIdText: Laveka has accomplished something strange and frightening in Dreadmoor; anyone who dies on the road through the Haunted Fen cannot pass on to the weave, but remains stranded as a ghost. Grand Matria Oggra will not let this stand. Use her gift to return spirits to the weave throughout The Haunted Fen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Grand Matria Oggra
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The deaths of these travelers is tragic. Even more troubling, Laveka has somehow prevented them from returning to the weave. We must help them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have brought peace to those who were lost. They are one with the weave again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Like all living things, you have a connection to the weave. You can show them the way.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll return them to the weave
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ghosts of many lost travelers had been trapped in Laveka's dark power, unable to return to the weave. You used Grand Matria Oggra's mystic gifts to free them and send them on their way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Tch. Afraid of a little ghost?

localizedTextIdText: Laveka has powerful undead lieutenants to assist with her dark works: a Moodie shaman and an ancient clanlord. Kill Risen Clanlord Shadowclaw and Risen Tamolo in The Haunted Fen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Grand Matria Oggra
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Laveka always has powerful undead to keep her company, a Moodie shaman and an ancient Draken clanlord. Our first step is getting rid of them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Tamolo was a powerful Shaman from the Deadwind clan, and Clanlord Shadowclaw was an infamous Draken warleader. Be careful taking them on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. Laveka must come to understand that the dead can never stand against the living. They just don't have the same motivation.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: An inability to appreciate the living is a sign that she has severed herself from the weave.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Laveka's powerful undead minions... or at least, you think you did. You're not entirely sure what will keep her from just swinging around and raising them again, but at least you put them out of commission for a while.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't want to fight ancient unspeakable herroes of history? What's wrong with you?

localizedTextIdText: Laveka has been interfering with the cycle of life and death. Confront her and kill The Great Death in The Haunted Fen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Grand Matria Oggra in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That girl seeks to unbalance life and death itself. Someone needs to give her a good talking to!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Laveka is playing with dangerous forces. Someone has to make her stop, and destroy whatever abomination she conjures to enact her bloody revenge. Have fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Laveka is playing with dangerous forces. Someone has to make her stop, and destroy whatever abomination she conjures to enact her bloody revenge. Have fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I doubt that girl will try this again here, where she knows her betters are around to take care of business.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You thwarted Laveka's plan and defeated The Great Death.

localizedTextIdText: Niss Markov has come to Dreadmoor hoping for a new start, only to find danger and death at every turn. Kill Moodies in The Haunted Fen to make her feel better about her life choices.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Niss Markov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A cursed forest, infested with Moodies... What a great place to start a new life. I don't know about curses, but Moodies die easily enough.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Death is the most efficient way to solve our problems, and it is always close at hand. Kill Grimglade Moodies, and these roads will be at least a little safer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job. Maybe those Moodies will think twice before ambushing helpless travelers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: While you're at it, please keep an eye out for my idiot brother.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I like the way you think, $(player.name)
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That seems like the best solution.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: If not, we can just kill them again
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed a bunch of Grimglade Moodies. It was pretty simple.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why should I expect you to help me? I should have known better.

localizedTextIdTitle: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
Two Can Play at this Game
localizedTextIdText: Use the potion of Deathbinding on Inert Skeletons in The Haunted Fen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Draz Markov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: At the very least, I've managed to analyze the Moodie methods for controlling the dead. I've created a device that does something similar...  temporarily.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It won't work on skeletons the Moodies have already brought back, but the inert skeletons near the rocks are a perfect target for faux resurrection.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sadly, my device provides only the illusion of life. If only manipulating life and death were so simple!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Best to only use it on animal skeletons. Ethics!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the potion of Deathbinding on Inert Skeletons to obtain some temporary undead assistance. Neat!

localizedTextIdText: Search for Aurin remains in The Haunted Fen
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver Aurin Remains to Queen Myala Everstar in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This skeleton is fairly recent. It appears to be Aurin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: More death? Well, at least I can see that they are returned to the weave with honor. Thank you, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should see this gets a proper burial
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Aurin remins in the Haunted Fen, and returned them to Queen Myala Everstar for proper burial.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver Aurin Remains to Queen Myala Everstar

localizedTextIdText: Bugsy Stillwater tasked you with something unusual - harvesting the local Mudgrub terminites for food. Apparently the swamp people are anxious for Mudgrub grub.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the steaks to Bugsy Stillwater in Mudgrub Marsh
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good to see ya! We got a hankerin' for Mudgrub Steaks, but them terminites are gettin' too thick. You can go clear out the bugs and grab some grub!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got them steaks yet? Can't hardly wait to fry up a whole pile of 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sorry fella, I had to have a steak, now! But there's too many of these Mudgrubs creepin' and crawlin' everywhere! Thanks for gettin' what ya could.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Them's good eatin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is gettin' outta hand! Hey, maybe you can help Ma out too!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got the steaks, but the swamp seemed completely overrun by the Mudgrubs.  Maybe Bugsy has something else to say?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, I'll be, you just don't appreciate fine dinin'!

localizedTextIdText: Ma Stillwater's shack in Mudgrub Marsh is overrun with the beasts. Ma had tasked Draz to fix her Bug Zapper for the sheer volume of creatures, but she hasn't heard from him. She expected you to go into the swamp and ensure "Froggy Man" is safe.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Grub Zapper to Ma Stillwater in Mudgrub Marsh
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bout' time you showed up! Those grubs'r gettin' too close to my home! I asked that Froggy man to juice my ol' Grub Zapper. Ask him what's the hold up!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did I not request that you...er..."zap all them Mudgrubs good!"
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You found ol' Froggy yet and got my Grub Zapper workin'?  No? Then git!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aw, you did all that for me?! Shucks. You tell ol' Froggy Man thanks, you hear? I gots to get this rigged and hooooeey!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I ain't gettin' any younger, here!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm all set here, but you oughtta talk to my son...see if he's got anything else for ya!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see if I can find him!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the "Grub Zapper" online again, Ma's shack seems safer, but the bugs are still dangerously overpopulated. You expected Bugsy might have another task for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return Grub Zapper to Ma Stillwater
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't you sass an old lady!

localizedTextIdText: Bugsy Stillwater, grasping for ideas, started with the easiest one and asked you to start cracking open eggs before they hatched into bigger and meaner bugs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Bugsy Stillwater in Mudgrub Marsh
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These mudgrubs are overunnin' us! Maybe if you stomp on all them eggs, we'll kill 'em before they're bigger! Give it a try!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Any luck with all them eggs?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, that didn't do it...wonder what else we can try?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't worry about the eggs, they ain't that tasty anyway!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No wait! I got it! Naw, really this time! Just listen!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though the egg smashing made something of a dent, you knew this wouldn't solve things permanently so long as there were still Mudgrubs to lay them. You contacted Bugsy for your next move.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw, what's the matter with crackin' a few good eggs?

localizedTextIdText: Still overloaded with Mudgrubs, Bugsy's last ditch solution is diving into a gooey, infested terminite warren and slaughtering the "Queenies," as he calls them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Bugsy Stillwater in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Okay, listen here. I'm thinkin'... those Queenies? Maybe if you take THEM out, we'll take care of the worst of 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You kill all them Queenies yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aww shucks, you done us good. Next time you hop by, I'll fix you a steak, fresh off the grill!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hoooooooeeey! I'll bet Queenie steaks are the best!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I like Mudgrubs and all, but I don't like 'em THAT much.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Queenies eliminated, the Mudgrubs seem to be growing at a more manageable pace.  Dreadmoor is safe from turning into a slimy wasteland.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aww, what, you're not afraid of a little blood NOW, are ya?

localizedTextIdText: Trelia Starlight is concerned about the proliferation of Mudgrubs and their effects on the local environment. She has her own unique solutions to the problem. She set you off first with the task of clearing out piles of Mudgrub corruption spewing from the earth itself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Trelia Starlight in in Mudgrub Marsh
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh, I'm so glad you've found me! I was just applying some of this Starlight Solution to those ugly Mudgrub holes corrupting the earth. Can you help me out?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you destroyed the Mudgrub Mounds with my Starlight Solution?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent! Now that you've helped the earth itself, I have another task for you that can restore the natural cycle!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My Starlight solution can cleanse the earth!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, I think you're going to like this!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of those mounds!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Anything else I can do for you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After blowing up more mounds than you could imagine, you observed that the marsh smelled at least ten percent better.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, don't you care about the earth?

localizedTextIdText: Trelia Starlight wasn't finished with you. Believing that the only natural way to resolve the environmental damage to the marsh was to restore the natural cycle of predator and prey, she gave you a pile of strange "Starlight Stem Seeds"...and told you to be very careful.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Trelia Starlight in Mudgrub Marsh
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've discovered the true problem with the Mudgrubs - they have no natural predators! Just plant these Starlight Stem Seeds and we'll set the cycle right!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh? It's far too quiet for you to have planted all those seeds yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, listen to the satisfying crunch of Stemdragon teeth as the circle of life begins anew! Thanks for all your help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't wait to hear the natural order at work!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I just love nature - especially the exciting parts!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you've filled the swamp with stemdragons, you hope that the natural cycle will police the population of insects. On the other hand, giant monsters aren't necessarily a good thing either...at least Trelia Starlight was happy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What, you're not afraid of ecology, are you?

localizedTextIdText: "The Blight" is what's left of the DRED operations destruction of Dreadmoor. You met with Pip Bloodfern, who wanted to deal with the problem head on.  He put you to work immediately with cleaning up piles of toxic goo on the beaches.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Pip Bloodfern inThe Blight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wow, perfect timing! See all this toxic goo everywhere? Okay, we gotta do something about it. You with me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm doing good with cleaning my part of the beach, what about you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Okay, that's a good start. But there's a lot more we're going to have to tackle to get this mess cleaned up.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew I could count on you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You ready to help me out some more?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I can help you out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Having made something of a dent in the toxic waste, Pip was happy with your work but seemed like he had further plans on how to resolve the destruction of The Blight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, you can't turn your back on nature!

localizedTextIdText: The pollution of the Chua's DREDplex has even more dangerous consequences for the local wildlife. Many of the creatures are now coated in toxic waste. Pip Bloodfern handed you a water tank and immediately put you to work scrubbing them down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Pip Bloodfern inThe Blight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those dirty Chua! Their toxic waste is all over the poor little woodland critters! Here, take this water tank and help me spray 'em down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, how's your half going? The little guys safe yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great! They look a lot happier now. But we gotta do something to strike back at that DREDplex or this won't make much of a difference.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Between the two of us, I think these guys will make it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Okay, listen close.  This is going to be great!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of them for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your combined efforts, you were able to wash down as many of the toxin-coated creatures as you could find.  Pip was already working up another scheme to stop the DRED's destruction of Dreadmoor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, you can't just abandon them!

localizedTextIdText: Pip Bloodfern discovered a series of overflow valves that are controlling some of the toxic waste dumping. He ran ahead on the beach for recon, leaving you to deal with the pipes.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Rendezvous with Pip Bloodfern in The Blight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, I've marked some overflow valves in your datacrhon. Shut them off and we might make a dent in the toxic dumping!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The valves are still open you know...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, glad you could meet me up here! Have you met Peg yet? Well, we've been talking, and she's got an awesome idea!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks!  I'll meet you further up the beach when you're done!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, you're going to LOVE this!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll close off all those valves!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pip met up with Peg Gladstone and her mercs. Pleased with your work, he revealed that Peg had given him some valuable insight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What, you can't possibly be afraid of a pipe!

localizedTextIdText: Pip Bloodfern instructed you to release the trapped Pumera from the Chua's dens. No doubt once freed, the angry beasts will be ready to dish out some revenge of their own.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Pip Bloodfern in The Blight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Peg says you can have this key card to the Pumera cages. If you let them all loose in the camp, they'll shut everything down! Plus they'll be free!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Release all those Pumera yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ha ha, you shoulda seen those rotten Chua's faces! There's only one thing left to shut all this down...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Man, I can't wait to see the looks on their faces!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Still with me?  Only one last thing to do!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Unleashing the beast? I'll get right on it!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: All right, how do we finish this?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the complex in chaos, Pip seemed ready to deliver the coup de grace to the DRED forces.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey now, I promise! They won't bite you!

localizedTextIdText: With the complex in chaos, the Foreman will no doubt be furious. Pip told you to go find his trailer and use the panel at the door to coax him outside. With the Foreman gone, things should calm down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Rendezvouz with Pip Bloodfern in The Blight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Foreman Hozzo is going to be mad about all those missing Pumera. You can probably coax him out of his trailer now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You found the Foreman yet? You'll need to use the panel near his trailer to coax him out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great job!  That should slow down the Dominion's corruption of Dreadmoor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just use the panel near his trailer and thump him good!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Couldn't have done it without you!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll leave you to restoring the forest then!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Chua operation was halted with the death of the Foreman. Fortunately, the damage could be repaired over time.  "The Blight" can still be saved.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, don't chicken out at the last minute!

localizedTextIdText: Kill Reapwood Security Officer and Reapwood Security Administrator.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Pip Bloodfern and report the situation.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In order to shut down the Reapwood Collective we will need to first thin out their security forces. Kill some Reapwood Security Officer and Reapwood Security Administrator so we can move forward with this operation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is still too much security over at the Reapwood Collective. Keep culling their numbers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can see that their ranks are in disarray.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, friend!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perfect! We must seize this advantage!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Reapwood Security Officers and Reapwood Security Administrators have been thinned out. The security forces are in shambles. Return to Pip Bloodfern and report the situation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am disappointed.

localizedTextIdText: Destroy Chua Enhanced Explosive Stockpile to stop the Chua from causing more devastation in the Reapwood Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Peg Gladstone to let her know the explosives have been destroyed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Chua are using enhanced explosives to accelerate their deforestation! Go perform some sabotage to buy us some time until we can shut this whole operation down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are still too many explosives over there! Sabotage a couple more and buy us some time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I could hear the explosions all the way over here. Good job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck out there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh no, I think they have called in reinforcements.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They are as good as gone.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The loss of so many explosive stockpiles should stall the Chua deforestation for now. Return to Peg Gladstone and report.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: After we've come this far? Please reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Snipers on the road are preventing our forces from moving freely on the road. The snipers are on overwatch so they can't be approached. Someone will have to draw their fire and distract them until they can be countersniped.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Inform Peg Gladstone of the Sniper situation via Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Snipers on the far side of the complex have the road locked down. Any time we attack them directly they slip away using some sort of stealth. We'll need a distraction so our snipers can catch them by surprise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Get back out there, you're doing great! Hardly a scratch on you yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those were some fancy moves out there, but it seems they have too many snipers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sometimes you're the hook and sometimes you're the bait.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There's going to be a change of plans. Pip Bloodfern will fill you in on the details.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Every time we take out a sniper another takes their place!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: There were too many snipers. Peg Gladstone will need a new plan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Can't say I blame you. But those snipers aren't going away on their own.

localizedTextIdText: Pip Bloodfern's scouts have noticed munitions being loaded into the Chua Drills. While their intentions are unknown it can't be good. Plant explosives on the drills and stop this before it becomes a threat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Pip Bloodfern via Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our scouts have noticed that munitions have been loaded on to the drills. While we don't know what they are up to, it can't be good. Go plant explosives near the drills then get out of there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you get all of the drills? We can't let a single one get away!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Brace yourself as I trigger the explosives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Its dangerous to go alone. Sorry.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That had to hurt!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll rig those drills to blow up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The drills are destroyed and the threat thwarted.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Just walk away... hero.

localizedTextIdText: After failing to defend against your relentless assaults, the Reapwood Collective are attempting to signal for reinforcements. Destroy the transmitters and cut them off from help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Pip Bloodfern.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've detected a distress call coming from transmitters in the complex. We must cut them off from receiving reinforcements. Go quickly and silence their cries for help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look for the transmitters on the main platform.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We no longer detect the distress signal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly now, we haven't much time before they can complete their transmission.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There will be no help coming for these defilers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Reapwood Collective has been cut off from reinforcements.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Why would you walk away now?

localizedTextIdText: It is time for one last heroic push into the heart of the Reapwood Collective. Against insurmountable odds you must push through the defenders and take down Lieutenant Varek and Chief Engineer Rulk.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Pip Bloodfern now that Lieutenant Varek and Chief Engineer Rulk have been eliminated.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Its time to end this. Head to the heart of the Reapwood Collective. Slay your way to the rear main factory and kill Lieutenant Varek and Chief Engineer Rulk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I can see them up on that rear walkway on the main platform.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is great news. Without Lieutenant Varek the defenses will fall into disarray and without Chief Engineer Rulkthe operations will grind to a halt.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be strong, warrior.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We can take it from here.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's done. I've killed Lieutenant Varek and Chief Engineer Rulk.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lieutenant Varek and Chief Engineer Rulk are dead. Without their leadership the Reapwood Collective defenses and operations will surely fall apart. Pip Bloodfern and Peg Gladstone should have no trouble finishing the cleanup.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Having come so far, you falter at the end?

localizedTextIdText: Peg Gladstone has enlisted your aid in defeating the Chua forces in The Blight and then joining her at the Creature Harvester for a bit of payback.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Peg Gladstone at the creature harvester in The Blight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These fuzzbuckets are gettin' on my nerves. I've got a sneaky idea on how to mess 'em up, and it involves that nasty harvester they've got. You in?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, I ain't got all day to wait for you to shove those jerks into that harvester, you dig?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh man, I heard all the yelling from over here!  I like you kid, you've got rocks! You ever want a spot in my company, you got it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They won't enjoy being on the other end of that thing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Heh heh, I'm gonna be tellin' this one at the bar for years!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can see the value of a demonstration.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think he had an accident in there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have crippled the Reapwood forces who are devastating the land and taught them a harsh lesson with the Creature Harvester.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, you're not turnin' chicken, are ya?!

localizedTextIdText: Ma Stillwater has asked you to gather up some of the ingredients that are used to make her famous Stillwater Moonishine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return all the ingredients to Ma Stillwater
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there $(player.class), yer just in time.  I got a list of things that needs gatherin' for another batch of moonshine. Be a doll and grab'em for an old lady.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The list ain't the long, so what's the hold up?!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well butter my butt and call me a biscuit, looks like you got it all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hotfoot it youngster, I'm getting older by the second!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You'll get yer fill. Now, let's make us some 'shine!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Ma Stillwater gather up the remaining ingredients she need to whip up a batch of her famour Stillwater Moonshine.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return all the ingredients to Ma Stillwater
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Teetotaler? Really?

localizedTextIdText: Ma Stillwater had barrels upon barrels of moonshine, and she needed them delivered by someone who could actually read this list of delivery customers.  You have "graciously volunteered" to take on the job of spreading shine to the swamps of Dreadmoor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ma Stillwater
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Okay, I gots a list of places that need their moonshine, but I kin't read it. Just follow the list and pass off the 'shine to everyone on it!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You find everyone yet? I know, Bugsy's a rotten speller.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya done me proud, stranger! See, I don't need no book-larnin' to do my job!  Hoooooey!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck, stranger!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Readin', who needs it?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to you, the swamps are awash in moonshine and Ma Stillwater couldn't be happier with you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nope, my son wrote this down, but now he's off chasin' Mudgrub steaks instead of helpin' out! I'll tan his hide when he gits back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aww, come on! Bugsy ain't gonna be home fer hours!

localizedTextIdText: Search for Reapwood Plans scattered about the equipment in Reapwood Collective on the hill above Wickwood Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Niss Markov in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I don't know if fumes from the plant have affected the Chua but they seem to write everything down.  Make your way to the factory and gather any Reapwood Plans that you find.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The papers are everywhere. You should not have trouble finding a few reports.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My Chua is a bit rusty, but I will work it out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Why capture and interrogate when you can just read all their secrets?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope this book has a happy ending.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to discover several Reapwood Plans. Hopefully Niss Markov will be able to discover some weakness in their operations and defenses.

localizedTextIdText: Gigalog claims that in Keenmind Shelter there is a Pell named Sound-Keeper who may be able to assist us further with the corruption spreading in Grimfang Forest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Sound-Keeper at Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Seek out a pell by the name of Sound-Keeper in Keenmind Shelter. My sources claim he may have great information for us.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your calculations are incorrect. You are speaking to the wrong individual.  I will repeat this once more, only once: Seek out Sound-Keeper in Keenmind Shelter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is crucial in this fight against corruption and darkness, we must act now. Join our fight, outsider!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have been waiting for you, outsider.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go quickly, they will be informed of your arrival.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We require your assistance further.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll start my journey there now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sound-Keeper has informed you of the necessary steps needed to recover important information in regards to the corruption.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Unfortunate. For you.

localizedTextIdText: Any attack directed towards Reapwood Collective should come from the river. The security on that side is limited to one patrol. If you defeat Sergeant Drox and Gyroclaw Mark III then the factory will be vulnerable to attack.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Peg Gladstone in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The security at the factory is focused on the threat from town. We can attack from the river if you neutralize the patrol. Eliminate Sergeant Drox and his augmented beasts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you would rather kill hundreds on the other side, that will serve just as well.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This should leave them completely exposed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They will be no match for you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can handle a few guards.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The landing along the river is now clear.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The patrol of Sergeant Drox and Gyroclaw Mark III has been removed. Report to Peg Gladstone that the way is open for espionage and attack.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: These people need fighters, not cowards.

localizedTextIdText: Peg Gladstone needs you to infliltrate the Reapwood Collective and locate the Scientific Supplies. Locate the supplies and then defend the scientists as they collect data on the unknown chemicals.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Peg Gladstone in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: They're making something in that factory that is just plain nasty. I'm not one for numbers but we've got some egg-heads nearby that can figure this out. Keep them safe while they download the data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need to know how to protect ourselves from that sludge.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You kept the team safe. Now we can learn what they are making up there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: They count the figures while you add to the body count. Got it?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The scientists did the real work. I just gave them some room.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With your protection, the science team was able to gather chemical signatures from the Reapwood Collective pipes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Someone has to keep their big brains inside their skulls.

localizedTextIdText: Niss Markov has given you a Sweetwater Flame Sprayer powered by the local moonshine. Give it a test run in Reapwood Collective
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Niss Markov in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While the Chua are busy burning down the forest, we can hit the Reapwood Collective with this flame thrower powered by the local Sweetwater Moonshine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The device does all the work. You just need to point and spray.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We have learned much while you taught them this lesson.  The fuel is most excellent.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Their suffering will be brief but well deserved.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This will heat things up a bit.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That Sweetwater is military grade fuel.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The test run of the Sweetwater powered flame thrower was a rousing success.  From what you've seen it would probably work as rocket fuel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you fear the flames?

localizedTextIdText: Nerissa Artan has heard cries for help from one of the Fist of Azrion's upper decks. She believes the cries are coming from Captain Sabes, and she's ordered you to use jump pads and beam tethers to safely navigate the verticality of the ship in order to rescue him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A legionnaire has been incessantly calling for help. Given his whining about heights, I suspect it's Captain Sabes. Use jump pads to find and save him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Despite his fear of heights, Sabes is an officer of the Dominion. If you use the ship's jump pads, you should be able to reach him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've my gratitude for delivering Captain Sabes from his perch. Not only will he help to shore up our strength, but he'll also stop his sobbing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The ship's jump pads still work... most of the time.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Something unexpected has come up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued Captain Sabes from one of the Fist of Azrion's upper decks. It only took some encouragement, jump pads, and beam tethers - not to mention lots of guts - to do it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How do I get to higher levels?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do I get down from higher levels?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why is Captain Sabes up there and not near the helm?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The ship's elevators are no longer active. You'll find glowing orange jump pads throughout the ship, though. Many of them still work correctly. Jump on them to traverse the ship's heights.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: For just such an occasion, we have beam tether anchors installed on most of the higher levels. Simply activate one and jump down in relative safety. Just don't wait too long, as they do go out, and that can get... messy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The signal's source is near the captain's quarters. He has a very... hands-off approach to his command style. I do not blame the helmsman for this disaster, however.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Leaving Sabes for the Strain is a poor idea.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Illium lists a work order request for $m(schematic=376) to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should report to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=376) to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for Galeras Wall to support the war against the Exiles. Report to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER: \nRequest for furniture to support the war against the so-called Exiles. Bring Galeras Wall to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sturdy stone walls are the difference between victory and defeat! You do understand, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. With these Galeras Wall, we shall perfectly fortify our settlements against those so-called Exiles!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work. This time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has accepted the $m(schematic=376) you crafted.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the $m(schematic=376) to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Illium is the central hub of Dominion commerce on Nexus. The presence of the Dominion Victory Commission means a constant demand for crafted goods. Provide Lieutenant Minor with $m(schematic=865).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=865) to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThere is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for an enterprising architect. Bring samples of Single Metal Crate for evaluation.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThere is an open requisition from the Dominion Victory Commission for an enterprising architect. Bring samples of Single Metal Crate for evaluation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hmph. What are you doing here? Have you filled our order yet? Surely Single Metal Crate are not beyond the skill of a proper Dominion crafter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There, see? Single Metal Crate may look simple. Inelegant. But a sturdy transport container is the difference between life and death in the field.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work, architect. I shall remember this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought $m(schematic=865) to Lieutenant Minor in Illium.

localizedTextIdText: Architect Cybene in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft $m(schematic=848) to aid them!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=848) to Architect Cybene in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: The Dominion Victory Commission seeks Wicked Fire Totem for aid in building encampments! Architects, report to Architect Cybene.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: The Dominion Victory Commission seeks Wicked Fire Totem for aid in building encampments! Architects, report to Architect Cybene.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you here without the Wicked Fire Totem I clearly requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, $(player.name). Your service to the Empire is to be commended. I'll ensure these Wicked Fire Totem are distributed swiftly and efficiently.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This conversation may be recorded for training purposes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for <text Link="Schematic:848">$m(schematic=848)</text>.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin believes the Elder Cube is somewhere in northern Malgrave and she intends to find it before her rival, Dorian Walker, does. Rumor has it that a Pell outcast, the Flame-Watcher, has raved about a "cube" that's corrupted his people. The Pell can be found at the Flame-Watcher's Overlook, and Artemis thinks he may reveal more if properly approached.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Flame-Watcher at the Flame-Watcher's Overlook
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Elder Cube is here and I intend to claim it! I have heard about a mad old Pell who raves about a magical cube, and I want you to parley with him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You can find the Pell on Flame-Watcher's Overlook. Speak to him diplomatically, and see what you can glean from him about this "magical cube."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Flames burn low... the smoke thins. Why do you interrupt my exile? Has the Cube sent you to silence me?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Pell are far from here. I will keep tabs on you... do not disappoint.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You may stoke the fires of vengeance that burn in my heart. We shall see.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No, but I may be able to help you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Artemis Zin request, you've located the Flame-Watcher at his camp and approached him about the Elder Cube. The old Pell is obviously one cell short of a power pack, but he doesn't seem to be immediately hostile or unwilling to parley with you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Surely you've heard of the Elder Cube. It contains the limitless knowledge of the Eldan. Who better to claim it for the Dominion than Artemis Zin?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is possibly the most important task you will ever undertake. My rival, the elderly Dorian Walker, is looking for it, too. We must find it before he does.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you realize who you're turning down, lout?

localizedTextIdText: As you were taking vengeance on the residents of Flamedancer Commune for the Flame-Watcher, Artemis Zin contacted you via your datachron. Her scans have revealed a number of Pell terminals throughout the village, and she wants you to access them and see what kind of data they contain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If my scans are accurate, there are a large number of Pell terminals in that village. Find them, access them, and see what data they contain.
