localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Here you stand in front of me, empty-handed, far from Flamedancer Commune. I'm tempted to let Kevo use your spine for a Draken finger puzzle...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew it! The Elder Cube is somewhere in your vicinity! The data you downloaded from the terminals verifies it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect you will get this done quickly, hm? Don't keep me waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't get too excited, citizen. I don't have the Cube yet, but it is close.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Artemis Zin orders, you hacked into the Pell terminals in Flamedancer Commune, revealing that the Elder Cube is definitely nearby. Though the Cube is still up for grabs, this minor victory lends meaning to the deeds you have done on behalf of the Flame-Watcher.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you have any idea how important this task is? Do you?

localizedTextIdText: The Elder Cube is close, and Artemis Zin knows it. She has asked you to proceed into Flamedancer Enclave and search for evidence of the Elder Cube's presence. Augmented creatures are a sure sign that the powerful Eldan relic is nearby, and analyzing the $m(vitem=647) taken from them might just confirm it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Look for signs of Eldan influence in your vicinity. Augmented beasts are one such indication. Destroy them and collect their components for analysis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How many augmetic components have you found? I require a number of them if I am to get an adequate sampling ratio.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The augmetic components you collected have been highly refined. Whatever created them must be more than a simple Eldan augmentor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you damage the components too badly, it may be difficult to analyze them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes, it is very close... I'm sure of it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: So the Elder Cube is here?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=647) from Augmented Creatures in Flamedancer Enclave. Though the components look like a bunch of gore-stained rubbish to you, Artemis Zin insists they are proof positive of the Elder Cube's proximity.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Elder Cube will want to protect itself. While the Pell are sufficient, the Cube will seek to augment local wildlife in order to provide itself with heightened security.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did you just say no to me? You should change your tune. Immediately.

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher has revealed that the Elder Cube was secreted away beneath Flamedancer Enclave by the Pyre-Callers. All that remains is for you to find the entrance to the Elder Cube's lair and take it far from away the Flamedancer Pell.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your final task on my behalf also serves as your reward. Find the Cube beneath Flamedancer Enclave and remove it. Free my people from its influence!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You waste time coming to me, outsider. Your prize - the Cube - awaits beneath Flamedancer Enclave. Take it and go... I care not where!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Elder Cube is most certainly not here, $(player.name). So why is it that you are?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the blood of Dominus! You've found an Exo-Lab! And I'll wager my family fortune that the Elder Cube is there, waiting for my arrival.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Pyre-Callers conceal the Cube's lair, but you will find it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Elder Cube is my life's ambition. You didn't think I'd leave it to you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the entrance to the Elder Cube's lair - an ancient Exo-Lab. You were immediately contacted by Artemis Zin, who congratulated you on your discovery. Still, the quest for the Elder Cube is far from over...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Don't you want me to destroy the Cube?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Ha! Even you lack the power to do that, outsider! Nothing on this world can destroy the Cube! It would be folly to try!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is the Cube not the prize you seek, outsider? Why would you deny your fate?

localizedTextIdText: Rampart Post is under attack! There might be something you could do if you get there quick.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Apprentice Gruble at Rampart Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Rampart Post is under attack! It's a raid! Terrible Rotflesh Raiders...Nooo!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Raiders! They were everywhere! Taking people and my tech. My precious tech! What will Engineer Titani think. He will be so mad!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've come to the aid of Apprentice Gruble. He's clearly upset over some missing Projection tech.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Find Apprentice Gruble at Rampart Post

localizedTextIdText: You have been ordered to shut down the Reapwood Devastators that are destroying the forest land that we now call The Blight. Get within range of these machines so that you can deactivate them with EMP grenades.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Contact Peg Gladstone via Datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion has rolled out some new machines that are swiftly turning this forest into a wasteland.  Find and disable these Reapwood Devastators.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: They are floating in the air. How can it be hard to find them?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It'll take them days to get those running again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get up close and tag 'em with a grenade.  That should do the trick.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've got better aim then I gave you credit for.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'd be glad to shut them down.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We will just break them again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have managed to disable several of the Reapwood Devastators.  This should give the Exile forces some time to prepare an attack before the land is ruined completely.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Someone has to stop these machines.

localizedTextIdText: The Product Research Analyst in Area 77 has lost contact with a group of Protostar employees in the Skittering Sands. He's ordered you to proceed to Substation SR29 in the Skittering Sands in order to check on them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Product Research Assistant at Substation SR29
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I sent a team to the Skittering Sands to research spider-based components. I haven't heard from them in a while. I'd like you to check on them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: How is the research team at Substation SR29 doing? They still haven't reported in. Go check on them before I cancel your contract.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah... I guess you're here to check on us. Well, we're in something of a bind. A really sticky situation. In fact, it's a tangled web... literally.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Falling behind schedule is bad, but failing to report is unacceptable.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Product Research Assistant at Substation SR29 in the Skittering Sands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't be afraid of paperwork. I just need them to submit their reports.

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Vrizz wants you to talk to Scientist Zuk and help with the science experiments being performed at Bogbottom Research Site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Scientist Zuk at Bogbottom Research Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sent Scientist Zuk to assist Aldo Frump in working on new experiments at Bogbottom Research Site. Suggest you go help him.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You talk to Zuk yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here to help? Excellent. Can use new minion. Much to learn from primal earth and pell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in Bogbottom Research Site and found Scientist Zuk and Aldo Frump studying the Pell in the area.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Worthless to me. Don't care if you disappear.

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher is eager to learn if you have been sent to serve him. In order to do so, you must venture into the Sandstinger Wastes and purify yourself by staring into the Sacred Fire that burn there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If the Flame truly sent you to serve me, you must be purified. Go into the desert, stare into the sacred fires that burn there, and cleanse yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sacred fires have burned forever, and within their glow you can find the truth. Seek them out and you will understand my people.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Flame has spoken to you. Through it, you understand my pain. My people must be freed from the evil of the Cube. You... you will be my instrument!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Only the faithful will pass this test! If you fail, you will not survive!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Sure thing. When do we begin?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into the Sandstinger Wastes and stared into the Sacred Fire that burn there. In so doing you learned why the Flame-Watcher has been exiled from his people, and have gained some insight into the thirst for vengeance that drives him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are you out here by yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: All will be revealed in time, outsider! First you must prove your divine origins and cleanse yourself!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you do not serve the Flame-Watcher, you do not serve the Flame. Begone!

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher explained that when the Cube first came to his people, it used a large "idol" to corrupt the Flamedancers. He has commanded you to investigate the idol in Flamedancer Commune and witness its corruption for yourself, but he warns that the Cube may attack you when it realizes the threat you pose.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When the Cube first came to us, it used an "idol" to corrupt the Flamedancers. Seek out this idol and experience this heresy for yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The idol sits on the outskirts of Flamedancer Commune. Why do you tarry here? Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I warned you the Cube would send its little machines to kill you, but you were too strong - just as I foresaw! You are truly my tool of vengeance! Ha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When the Cube recognizes you as a threat, it may attack! Be on your guard!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now is the time for revenge! They will pay the price for their blasphemy!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: This is all a bit rich, if you ask me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the "idol" and discovered it was part of an ancient Eldan construct. Despite its age, your proximity attracted a number of small constructs that attacked you, and which you fought off with admirable skill.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see this idol for myself.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Not yet. I want some answers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: And what about you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Answers... yes. Ask, then. Perhaps I will answer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Once, not long ago, the Flame alone guided my people. Yet now they pursue the Cube's blasphemy without question.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Cube came to my people suddenly. It spoke to us and twisted the minds of the Flamedancers. Soon they heard only the lies of the Cube.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I remained pure, a disciple of the Flame. The Cube saw this and commanded the Flamedancers to cast me out or kill me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool! To come so far, only to disobey me! Feel the burning of my wrath!

localizedTextIdText: The Flame-Watcher has instructed you to take his holy vengeance upon the Pell of Flamedancer Commune. Though these Pell have done nothing to you, their lives stand between you and the possibility of finding the Elder Cube.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The time has come to exact vengeance! The Flamedancer traitors must pay for their sacrilege in blood! Let the fires of retribution burn brightly!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to purge the taint from the Flamedancer Pell! Do not waste any more time! The heretics must suffer!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes! Their blood stains the sands! The fires of retribution burn bright, indeed! You are a capable instrument... yes!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Though traitors one and all, they are Flamedancer Pell! They will not give up their lives easily!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Cube... of course! The cause of this misery! Soon, my weapon... soon!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Flamedancer Pell have paid a dear price for their heresy. In addition, your violent chastisement of the Pell for their blasphemies has cheered the Flame-Watcher beyond any reasonable measure. You suspect that this bloodletting is only the beginning...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Any feeling of brotherhood I may have felt for them turned to ashes the day they turned their backs on the Flame and drove me from my village!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your hands are stained with blood, yet you abandon your sacred duty?

localizedTextIdText: Once again, the Flame-Watcher has sent you to enact divine punishment upon the Pell of Malgrave. This time, he has specified the Flamedancer Pyre-Caller - the leaders of the Flamedancer Pell - as those most deserving of his wrath. Proceed to Flamedancer Enclave and drive the Pyre-Callers before you!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Flame-Watcher via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Only the Pyre-Callers - those who saw fit to turn their backs upon the Flame - remain. Find them in Flamedancer Enclave and end their lives!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Pyre-Callers are all that remain of those who sought to drive me out of Flamedancer Commune! I demand they pay with their lives!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Pyre-Callers have been destroyed! You are truly a fearsome one, outsider, sent by the Flame to aid its most fervent disciple! I have been blessed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Beware the magic they wield, outsider! You may feel the heat before long!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now... we turn our attention to the source of this sacrilege... the Cube!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You're one lucky guy, for sure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You punished the Pell of Malgrave once again in the Flame-Watcher name, this time singling out the Flamedancers' spiritual leaders - the Flamedancer Pyre-Caller. Perhaps now the Flame-Watcher will lead you to the Elder Cube...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: More Pell? What about the Cube?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: In time, outsider! Patience! We must burn away the Cube's defenders before we strike at its heart!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you lost your taste for death, outsider? Do you fear the Pyre-Callers?

localizedTextIdTitle: Calls for Help from the Past
localizedTextIdText: The scientists have been receiving a very weak and old distress signal from north of Regalstone Waterfront. The scientist, Tilius CracoS, wants you to check it out and see what you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Adamus Constantius at the Wanderer's Nest near the crashed Nomad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You there, we have been receiving some very old and very weak distress signals. Could you investigate it for me?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting around here for? Go find where that distress signal is coming from.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A visitor? Hath thou cometh to whisk us from this villainous isle? Or is it harm thou wisheth to pursue upon us?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you discover anything of significance, inform me immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be not indecisive. If thou wisheth to help us, then we are glad of it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After going off to investigate a very weak and old distress signal in Coralus, you find survivors of a shipcrash from many years ago at a place called Wanderer's Nest. But these people look like they have been here a while and talk very strangely. How long ago was that crash?

localizedTextIdText: Something has caused the Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's endless army of augmented creatures to go rogue. The Caretaker has asked you to reestablish the facility's defenses and reboot its systems. To do so, you will need to collect materials to repair the Eldan sentry turret.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must reestablish this facility's defenses. While I can teleport a damaged sentry turret in, you will need to gather the proper parts and repair it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you collected the materials necessary to repair the turret support systems? I lack the physical body to do so, which is why I require you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Quite the "shopping list" you've gathered, $(player.name). Without too many "cooks in the kitchen," you should have little trouble with this next step.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall await your swift completion of this task, sapient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Are my euphemisms distracting you? I apologize.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Why are you talking like that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Caretaker asked you to collect materials to repair the Eldan sentry turret defense system in Bio-Mech Facility Alpha.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where can I get these parts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You must locate coolant regulators, system boards, plasma generator coils, and laser focusing lenses.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The augmented mammodin should have compatible coolant regulators integrated into their systems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: System boards can be found in piles of debris, while plasma generator coils and laser focusing lenses can be found near the emplacement.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose today is as good as any day for the world to end.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has dispatched several Eldan Repair Construct to perform the necessary repairs on the Eldan sentry turret while you protect them from an endless army of rogue augmented creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A fleet of constructs will begin rebuilding the turret once you activate the energizers. You must defend them while they work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sentry turret remains offline. This situation is no laughing matter, sapient. Do you see me laughing? Of course not.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased to hear that Eldan resources were used with maximum efficiency. My masters would be pleased if they were, in fact, here to observe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The energizers are located at the bottom of the turret's four legs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I look forward to more of your dangerous exploits.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hey, I guess that's high praise.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You protected the Caretaker's Eldan Repair Construct from a seemingly endless army of rogue augmented creatures while they repaired the Eldan sentry turret.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Are you sure about rebuilding this turret?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Could you send some constructs to fight, too?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Without stemming the tide of rogue augmentations, the chances of you reaching your second objective inside the lab is 0%. Reestablishing our defenses will increase those same chances by at least 8.18%.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Our resources and construct labor force have been reduced to minimal levels, sapient. I would much rather deal with this situation without your questionable assistance, but I cannot. No offense, of course.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You display a peculiar lack of commitment, sapient.

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar has come to Wickwood Village in hopes of finally being able to establish a stable Aurin settlement and save the nearby Wickwood tree, but troubles abound here in Dreadmoor. Speak to the citizens of the village, and learn more about the problems you must overcome.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to Dreadmoor, $(player.name). The villagers in Wickwood are having all sorts of problems, and it's my duty to find out what they are!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I think the villagers here are somewhat hesitant to burden me with their problems, but I'm their Queen... that's my job! Maybe they'll be more honest if you talk to them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh no! I knew that the Dominion were causing problems, but it seems like practically everything is falling apart here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Maybe one of these days, I won't have to ask random travelers for help... but for now, help!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There are so many problems I don't even know where to start!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what people are saying.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not going to lie to you, things are bad.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to the citizens of Wickwood Village and they gave you a laundry list of troubles: lost travelers, invasive beasts, Dreg murderers and an entire Chua encampment! You and Myala certainly have your work cut out for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know, I know... every time you go to a new place, everyone has problems they want you to solve.

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstarin Wickwood Village wants you to help Grand Matria Oggra solve the Moodie problems in The Haunted Fen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A lot of people looking for a new home on Nexus are heading to Wickwood, but travelers keep disappearing. I need someone to investigate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I arrived here recently, but Oggra's been at Wickwood  since we first landed on Nexus. You might want to follow her lead, as you continue your investigation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So, the infamous Laveka the Dark-Hearted was behind the Moodie disturbance... yet you still managed to prevail so easily!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Grand Matria Oggra said she might help out, so maybe you can meet up later!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I guess Grand Matria Oggra was right after all!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You to helped Grand Matria Oggra solve the Moodie problems in The Haunted Fen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know things seem impossible, but we can at least try our best!

localizedTextIdText: The Terminite are already causing trouble, and things will only get worse if they are allowed to breed unchecked. The Stillwater family has been living in Dreadmoor for a while, they might be willing to help solve this problem. Speak to Bugsy Stillwater and assist him with any tasks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm not certain how to deal with the Terminite incursions. One of the swamp humans has offered to help... Bugsy Stillwater is his name.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Stillwaters are an... interesting family. Still, any help we can get with the terminite problem would be much appreciated. Go speak with Bugsy, see what he has in mind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sounds like you have the Terminite situation under control. And look... the tree has begun to heal!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Grand Matria is right, we have to help our fellow exiles if we want to survive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Stillwaters solve the local Terminite problem.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If we don't do something quickly, I fear it will be too late.

localizedTextIdText: Trelia Starlight has asked you to free the jabbits that are being used as live bait for garr traps around Creature Cult Caravan.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Trelia Starlight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Is there no end to the Dreg cruelty?! Jabbits are not live bait for garr traps! Can you free them from the traps?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for?! There's critters dying out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: How are the jabbits?! Tell me they are okay!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch your fingers $(player.class), those traps look sharp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Blessed matrias! Oh, my heart can't take much more of this...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Those jabbits are as good as saved
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Not to worry, they are fine...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The jabbits,  release from their bonds, now run free through the grasses of Dreadmoor.  Trelia Starlight, and her weak heart, thank you dearly.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Trelia Starlight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That is so rude!

localizedTextIdText: The enemy has created a Clone of Stormtalon{p:Clones of Stormtalon} using primal pattern data stored by the Eldan in the Genetic Archives. When loosed upon the combined forces of the Dominion and the Exiles, it was shot out of the sky by the Eldan sentry turret... but it still lives. You will need to go to the entrance of the Conduit and destroy it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker at the teleporter into the Conduit
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Eldan sentry turret is a very powerful weapon, but it failed to destroy our enemy's latest weapon - a clone of Stormtalon. You must finish it off.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The clone of Stormtalon will not cease its rampaging until you kill it. This will require you to fight. I assumed you knew how this worked.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Obviously, my statistical calculation subroutine requires calibration. I was sure you would be obliterated by Stormtalon's clone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even at 33% capacity, I suspect this clone will challenge you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are either highly skilled or incredibly fortunate. Perhaps you are both.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad to prove you wrong.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite being injured by a blast from the Eldan sentry turret, the Clone of Stormtalon{p:Clones of Stormtalon} was still more than a match for you. Even so, you were able to overcome the creature, thereby clearing your way to enter the Spire.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Of course I know how it works.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A clone of Stormtalon. It was obviously created in the Eldan Genetic Archives by our usurpers. Luckily for us, it is imperfect.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The genetic data of all species on Nexus are mapped and stored therein, along with technology and resources to recreate a creature from said data. It's really quite simple.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose the last few hours of your pitiful life weren't a complete waste.

localizedTextIdText: The Conduit's power grid is infested with energy worms. The Caretaker has asked you to use deletion grenades on energy worms on the lower floor of the Conduit to convert them into surgelings that can then be physically destroyed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Energy worms infest the Conduit's power grid. You can use deletion grenades to give them physical form which you can then destroy conventionally.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Energy worms continue to drain the Conduit's power grid. Use the deletion grenades I have provided to give them physical form. Then, destroy them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The power grid feels so fresh and clean! You are quite an accomplished janitor... in a virtual sense, of course.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These parasites pose a significant threat to this facility's operations.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to purge the Conduit's power grid of energy worms using the deletion grenades provided to you by the Caretaker.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Of course not. Deletion grenades will remove unwanted energy parasites from the system, giving them physical form and allowing them to be destroyed permanently.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Energy worms are form of virtual life that inhabits all power systems. Though normally benign, they can become pests when their numbers are not kept in check.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you what psychiatric professionals might refer to as "insane"?

localizedTextIdText: An intruder in Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Genetic Archives has created clones of some of Nexus's most notorious denizens. They have been trapped with force fields on four of the eight large teleporter platforms. Open the force fields and kill Clone of the Darkspeaker{p:Clones of the Darkspeaker}, Clone of the Bosun{p:Clones of the Bosun}, Clone of the Forgemaster{p:Clones of the Forgemaster}, and Clone of the Invoker{p:Clones of the Invoker}.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: TERMINATE:\nFour clones created by an intruder in the Genetic Archives must be destroyed. Open the clones' containment fields and kill them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: TERMINATE:\nFour clones created by an intruder in the Genetic Archives must be destroyed. Open the clones' containment fields and kill them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am sure you are aware that there are clones in need of immediate disposal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am appalled that someone would come into this facility and co-opt its cloning facilities. Some sentients give the rest of you a bad name.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Clone of the Darkspeaker{p:Clones of the Darkspeaker}, Clone of the Bosun{p:Clones of the Bosun}, Clone of the Forgemaster{p:Clones of the Forgemaster}, and Clone of the Invoker{p:Clones of the Invoker}, which had been created by an intruder in Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Genetic Archives.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The clones have been teleported to four of the eight platforms on the surface and are currently secured via force fields.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Regrettable. I was painstakingly constructed for nothing, it seems.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has an Eldan construct spawner that can teleport reinforcements to the surface of the Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. First, you need to activate a platform for the spawner to arrive on, and then protect it until it completes its delivery of constructs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: SERVICE INQUIRY:\nGuards required. Protect Eldan construct spawner on surface of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. Proceed to surface and engage defense protocols.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: SERVICE INQUIRY:\nGuards required. Protect Eldan construct spawner on surface of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. Proceed to surface and engage defense protocols.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Reinforcement constructs are required. An Eldan construct spawner has been teleported to the facility's surface, and must be defended.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Construct spawning has been completed. Your defensive protocols have impressed me. I am still analyzing your actions for future reference.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I require this information on the off chance I must terminate you myself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defended an Eldan construct spawner for the Caretaker as it delivered reinforcement constructs to the surface of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha.

localizedTextIdText: The ICI has chosen to exploit the chaotic situation within Bio-Mech Facility Alpha by sending you to harvest secret Eldan data from the External Interface Terminals inside the Spire.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: COVERT OPERATION:\nThe ICI seeks experienced agent for retrieval of Eldan data from External Interface Terminals within Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Conduit.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: COVERT OPERATION:\nThe ICI seeks experienced agent for retrieval of Eldan data from External Interface Terminals within Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Conduit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: ICI hungry for Eldan data. Retrieve data from External Interface Terminals. Send to me. Will pass it to ICI.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have Eldan data now. Will pass it on to ICI agent. Really. Promise!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now go. And keep quiet!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected secret Eldan data from the External Interface Terminals inside Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Conduit and transferred it to Ringo Hax.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has ordered you into Junction Legacy to destroy the Mechari who have taken up residence in Coralus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are Mechari in these parts, recruit. Consider yourself called into duty to take them out. Kill them and make sure they can't escape.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Killing Mechari isn't something ya should hesitate to do, recruit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was some impressive destruction, recruit, but our job isn't near done yet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed a great number of the Mechari at Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're Mechari, recruit! That makes them against us! Now, I know, supposedly, these ones claim they're different. That they be searchin' for the ultimate truth of the Eldan or somethin'. That's bunk, recruit. Ain't no Mechari leavin' the Dominion. Don't you believe the rumors for a second.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You wouldn't want me to think you were shirking your duty, would you?

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has asked you to retrieve the data the Seekers have been accumulating in Junction Legacy. It can be found on datachrons in the area, or the Seekers themselves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Mechari are here doing somethin' recruit, and it's your job now to find out what that is. Gather intel from around the camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm waiting for that intel, exile.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I doubt it'll get too far, but that info ought to cause quite a stir in the Dominion. Great job, exile.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You might find their data around the camp, but it would be more productive to take it from their corpses!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find out what they're up to.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Durek had you gather intelligence from around the Mechari camp, and after receiving it, ordered you to transmit it to anyone and everyone that could receive it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd rethink that if I were you, recruit.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has asked you to end the threat of the Mechari on Coralus, by killing Seeker Prime, who is attempting to directly interface with the Eldan machinery in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Turns out maybe they ain't Dominion after all, but these are still Mechair and we gotta take them out. Go after their leader, exile.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is it Exile, the guy runnin' the place. What are you waitin' for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That ought to stop any designs the Mechari had on Coralus. Hell of a job, Exile.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Seeker Prime and ended the threat of Junction Legacy to Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You want to reconsider that choice, Exile. Now.

localizedTextIdText: You found a Mechari memory scanner on a Seeker Mechari Junction Legacy, and you think you can gather intelligence from Seeker corpses for Commander Durek
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This appears to be a device for interfacing with a Mechari. You doubt you could use it on one that is still active, however.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't know what that doohickey is that you found, recruit, but if it can get us Mechari intel, use it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's some real nice intel you're transmittin' to me, recruit. I'll get it in the right hands right quick.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You scanned Seeker Mechari and sent the data to Commander Durek.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has requested your help in infiltrating the Seeker camp at Junction Legacy with Protostar Probebots. He has ordered you to find secluded areas into which he can teleport Probe Bots which will stealthily observe the Seekers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek via a Seeker Holoterminal in Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Recruit, I've managed to get my hands on some Protostar Probebots... Don't ask what it cost. I need some locations to teleport them to, find me some.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do what needs to be done, Exile.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We're already hearing back from those probebots, recruit. Real fine job.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found locations for four probebots to teleport into Junction Legacy.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Think you're funny, don't ya? Let's just say I'm still trying to figure out just what it was I signed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't think I heard that right.

localizedTextIdText: With your help, the Caretaker has regained control of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's exterior. He has now asked you to teleport into the Conduit using the Eldan teleporter so that the next phase of his plan can commence.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have repaired the teleporter that will take you into the Conduit. Once there, I expect you to restore power to the System.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The teleporter into the Conduit has been restored to functionality. Utilize it and the next phase of my plan can begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is unfortunate. I did not expect the Conduit to be in such poor condition. You will certainly have your work cut out for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I do not believe in "luck," but I do hope your fortune remains consistent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Steel yourself, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get this place up and running.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hey. "Idle hands" and all that, right?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to gain access to the Conduit by using the Eldan teleport platform as requested by the Caretaker. And so begins the next phase of his plan to retake the systems in the Conduit.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why aren't these systems part of the facility?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Think of the Conduit as a "control tower" of sorts for Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. All of the facility's disparate utilities - power, transportation, security, et cetera - are based in the Conduit. Collectively, we refer to these utilities as "the System."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: My Eldan masters, in their wisdom, designed these systems to be external to Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. This prevents the facility from operating independently, which is handy in an emergency such as this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you do not do this, then all will be lost.

localizedTextIdText: Activating the Initializing Socket Panel will allow the Caretaker to teleport a new fuel rod fuse into its socket. Then you can restart the Conduit's System Core Console and purge the corrupted energy from the system.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Conduit's energy core must be reactivated. Activate the Initializing Socket Panel and the System Core Console, and I will teleport a new fuel rod into the socket.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We must restart the system core. To do this, you must activate both the Initializing Socket Panel and the System Core Console. There is little choice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The system has been purged of corrupting energy. I will continue to monitor it until I am certain the corruption will not return.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You play the part of a custodial construct quite well, sapient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is one more task before us, sapient.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Conduit's system core was restarted, and the system was purged of corrupted energy. This has allowed the Caretaker to restore the system's settings and quarantine the source of the corruption.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Simply put, once the Conduit's system core is restarted, clean energy will begin to flood the system. This should purge any corrupting energy within, allowing me to quarantine the corruption's source.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This must be done if we are to purge the system of its corruption.

localizedTextIdText: The overseers of the Conduit's corruption, Megawatt and Gigawatt, have been dramatically weakened by your reboot of the system. The Caretaker has instructed you to activate the Eldan Circuits in the Conduit so you can penetrate their force fields and dispose of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The last two obstacles, Megawatt and Gigawatt, can now be accessed. Activate the Eldan Circuits in the Conduit to destroy them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you purged Megawatt and Gigawatt from the Conduit's system yet? I can discern nothing that would prevent you from completing this task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you purged Megawatt and Gigawatt from the Conduit's system yet? I can discern nothing that would prevent you from completing this task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If I were able to experience joy, this is probably what it would feel like. Unfortunately, my range of expression is finite.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I calculate your chances of survival are well above 50%, Sapient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is always more to do, sapient. Do not leave just yet.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take those guys down a notch.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll have to be happy for both of us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The combination of your brains and brawn, as well as the Caretaker's super-brains and complete lack of brawn, proved too much for Megawatt and Gigawatt to withstand. With the Conduit free from corruption, the Caretaker has other plans for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will the Eldan Circuits do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The circuits will allow power to flow from the energy core and into the pods containing Megawatt and Gigawatt. This should purge any corrupted energy that remains, as well as disrupt their personal force fields.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Megawatt and Gigawatt are entities created during the corruption of the Conduit. They appear to be gatekeepers of a sort, and they stand in the way of our progress. They are not, however, our true enemy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Accept this task, or our control of the Conduit will slip away.

localizedTextIdText: The techno-phage has corrupted the Caretaker's protector constructs in the Techno-Core Annex. Fortunately, he installed a reboot sequence in each one that should clear their corrupted programming. Unfortunately, you'll need to force them to submit before you can reboot them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All protector constructs are equipped with a reboot sequence. If you can weaken them enough, they will reboot and cleanse their systems of the techno-phage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My protector constructs have been compromised by techno-phage. If you can initialize their reboot sequences, they might prove useful to us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am seeing a number of protector constructs active, and they appear to be functioning as intended. My reboot sequence appears to have worked.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: So long as they are active, they will not allow you to reboot them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Quite so, sapient. You have my gratitude, et cetera.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With a little elbow grease - and a lot of construct ass-kicking - you were able to reboot some of the techno-phage-afflicted protector constructs in the Techno-Core Annex.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You tempt fate, sapient. I am certainly puzzled by your behavior.

localizedTextIdText: Pattern-Seeker has an obsession with studying his Logic attunement through the crystal formations of snowflakes. However, his desire has a few roadblocks that need special attention. Help Pattern-Seeker continue to study Logic by rebooting his lab and gathering snowflakes and placing them onto his microscopes before they melt.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Pattern-Seeker inside his Recluse.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are very pleased. Access to our lab is pivotal. However, this lab needs repairs. Snow crystal creation device needs power. Then bring snowflakes to our microscopes to study.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your task is incomplete. Turn on the power. Gather the snowflakes. Then bring them to the microscope before they melt.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We are very pleased with your help today. Here we can continue to venerate Order. This is very important to us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Pattern-Seeker by restarting his snowflake studying operation. Now he can continue to study the crystal formations of Snowflakes in the privacy and safety of his secluded lab.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: At least we are in our lab again.

localizedTextIdText: The Disaster Relief Center Director is being bombarded by so many requests to obtain lost Personal Effects from The Drowned Cooperative that he can't concentrate on all the day to day operations of the Disaster Relief Center. To get some breathing room he has sent you to The Drowned Cooperative to gather any lost Personal Effects you can find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Disaster Relief Center Director in Tanglemire via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Blast, what do you want? Listen I don't have the time or manpower to send someone to the Drowned Collective to find any of your lost nick-nacks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Didn't you go out to the Drowned Collective to retrieve people's lost Personal Effects? Well if you don't want to do it then don't. Just stop talking to me and let me do my work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. Everyone has stopped pestering me and I can finally do my job. I reallocated some funds to pay you for your services.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes, yes. Just send any Personal Effects you find back here. Now let me get back to work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm sure tomorrow I'll have another bunch of requests for you to do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: This is all I could find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to gather a lot of lost Personal Effects for the victims of The Drowned Cooperative and the Disaster Relief Center Director finally has the time he needs to do his job.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Disaster Relief Center Director
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then why are you speaking to me?

localizedTextIdText: The Hellrose Bowl Equipment Manager has asked you to use shock paddles to liven up the Hellrose Bowl by zapping Moodies. Get out there and give them all a shock!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Hellrose Bowl Equipment Manager via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do you plan to participate in the Hellrose Bowl? If so, I've got an offer for you! I'm in charge of distributing shock paddles. Use them to zap Moodies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? The Hellrose Bowl - and your imminent fame - await you! Give those Moodies a zapping they won't soon forget!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You showmanship with those paddles is appreciated! Our ratings have risen 0.02% as a direct result of your performance!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful! Protostar cannot be held liable for any injuries sustained.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll light up their Moodie lives.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You utilized the shock paddles on Moodies at the Hellrose Bowl and increased the event's ratings slightly in the process.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Hellrose Bowl Equipment Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you certain? Moodies dance rather well when shocked!

localizedTextIdText: The scientist, Arozongo Zil, has caught some suspicious scrambled signals. They want you to find where the signals are coming from in southern Coralus and see if you can't unscramble them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Arozongo Zil via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got a weird scrambled signal. Find out where it is coming from and what it is.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Didn't I tell you about the odd signal? Why are you not investigating it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So, the signal was Eldan. I appears they were monitoring someone. Perhaps the survivors of that crashed ship.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It appears to be coming from a dense jungle.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, how long ago was that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found that the scrambled signals coming from Berylleaf Grove were of Eldan origin, and after a while of deciphering, you found out the Eldan that was stationed inside that tower were observing the humans that crash landed there long, long ago.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then why are you wasting my time?

localizedTextIdText: Integral Function Lab is overrun with creatures that seem to be born from the Strain itself. Sound-Keeper has advised us to find a way to eliminate them along our path to uncover more secrets of the Strain's origins in the lab.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your kill progress to $n(creature=41468).
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, we need important data in the lab however it's overrun by creatures born within the Strain. It is important you eliminate as many as you can throughout your path!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes outsider? You must have come across quite a number of Strain beings in the lab have you not? Destroy them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, outsider. Though it seems our battle was in vain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly, the lab's stability is uncertain at this point.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The data is still within the depths of the lab, find it quickly.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully killed the Strain beings that intruded the path to uncover Strain knowledge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The lab will be consumed by the Strain otherwise!

localizedTextIdTitle: Ready Your Character for Crimelords of Whitevale
localizedTextIdText: Receive items and be leveled up for Crimelords of Whitevale.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will prepare your character for the Crimelords of Whitevale adventure, a level 40 group instance. YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO PLAY OTHER CONTENT ON THIS CHARACTER IF YOU TAKE THIS QUEST.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to use this character for Crimelords of Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character was prepared for Crimelords of Whitevale.

localizedTextIdText: Draz Markov has offered to help deal with the dangerous Dreg camp that sits so close to Wickwood, but he can't take on the task alone. Find him, and assist him in any tasks he wants to undertake.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I hear that a young Mordesh name Draz Markov has offered to work with us on the Dreg problem. Please, go speak with him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Drak Markov has taken on our Dreg problem, but he can't do it alone. Go offer him whatever assistance he might need.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Dreg are no longer a threat, thanks to you and Draz. Help comes from unexpected places.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Victor Lazarin and may have our disagreements, but the Mordesh deserve a chance.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We took care of things together
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Draz Markov solve Wickwood Village's Dreg problem.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know the Mordesh can seem unapproachable, but I wish you'd at least give it a chance.

localizedTextIdText: Pip Bloodfern seems to think he can take on the entire Dominion military on his own. Fortunately, Peg Gladstone and her mercenaries are in the area as well. Help Pip and Peg take out the Chua in The Blight and the Reapwood Collective
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Young Pip Bloodfern seems determined to take out the Chua threat by himself. See if you can convince him to accept your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Pip is a good kid, but I'm learning that one person can't solve every problem by themselves! Go help him out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh my! Looks like you made quite a dent in their forces, and gathered a few new friends to boot. Good for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the help of Pip Bloodfern and Peg Gladstone, you practically demolished the Chua installation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But we've come so far! What's with the attitude all of a sudden?

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar wants you to clean up the last remnants of trouble throughout Wickwood Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak To Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that we have gathered all these new allies, it's time to take on all of Wickwood's problems... together.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go talk to everyone about their problems. Things have gotten better, but they just need a little tiny bit more work to make everything great!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: When we work together, we can accomplish anything. Thanks to you, Nexus finally feels like home!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cleaned up the last remnants of trouble in Wickwood Village.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But we're so close! Don't quit now!

localizedTextIdText: The great tree in Wickwood Village has been healed! The Wickwood Monitor will allow you to commune with it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak To Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our fellow Exiles have joined us here in our new home, and thus the weave is mended. The queen wishes to show you the tree's progress.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go look at the Wickwood Monitor, right over there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you seen the Wickwood Monitor? It'll show you the effects of your work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can hardly believe it! All of our problems are pretty much solved, and the tree has come back to life!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You have done well, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't know how you managed it, $(player.name), but you have my thanks!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You healed the great Wickwood Tree, and Wickwood Village is now a thriving settlement.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Nahmia of Rampart Post explains Rotflesh raiders came through and took a lot of dominion soldiers and scientists. Who knows what horrible fate they will come to. Find out why the Rotflesh Dreg have taken captives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Nahmia via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Locate our missing men and find out why the Rotflesh Dreg took them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You try my patience. Locate our missing men and lay to rest those unfortunate souls that met a terrible end.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Heavy is my heart with knowledge of the terrible fate so many met. We must hold out hope for survivors.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've burned the remains of those who were not lucky enough to survive the Dreg raids. They will now be at rest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? Maybe you should rethink that answer.

localizedTextIdText: Research Lead Fento has sent you to Camp Fortitude to talk with Kezrek Warbringer who needs help crushing some Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer at Camp Fortitude
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We done here. You go to Camp Fortitude help there. Big battle, lots of killing. Speak to Kezrek Warbringer.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why you still here? Camp Fortitude has work for you. Now go away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let's see if you have a bigger spine than my men shall we. I'm looking at you to end this. Can you do it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go, go, go.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have met with Kezrek Warbringer at Camp Fortitude.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Incorrect answer. You try again?

localizedTextIdText: Farmer Aganus has heard that some Exiles are giving the Dominion at Camp Fortitude some trouble, and asked you to talk with Kezrek Warbringer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer at Camp Fortitude
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Seems like the Exiles are given the Dominion some proper trouble over at Camp Fortitude, they are. Why don't ya see if you can help em out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hey now, what ya doin back here? Get over to Camp Fortitude and give them Exile rotters a proper thrashing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's the initiative I like to see, runt. Let's get you killin some Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then get to it then.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hear you need some help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have met with Kezrek Warbringer at Camp Fortitude.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sure ya don't want to help?

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide have teleported their best available fishpower into the area near the Plasmic Equalizer. Commander Durek has left you with anti-grav grenades to take out the Darktide reinforcements while he charges ahead to find Admiral Gelic Ironscale, the Ikthian leader.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commander Durek at the Plasmic Equalizer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: They know we're comin', and they're 'portin' troops in. Use these anti-grav 'nades to take care of 'em. I'm gonna find Ironscale before he escapes.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Still got them 'nades? What're you talkin' to me for? Get out there and throw 'em at the enemy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still got them 'nades? What're you talkin' to me for? Get out there and throw 'em at the enemy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: All right! That oughta put the brakes on the Ikthians and their little maneuver. You taught 'em a good lesson.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember to throw the 'nades, $(player.name). Get it done!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Watch out. I don't need to smell him to know that Ironscale's real close.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While Commander Durek charged ahead to deal with the Ikthian leader, Admiral Gelic Ironscale, you remained behind and rained anti-grav grenades upon the Darktide forces that were teleporting into the area near the plasmic equalizer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now's not the time to get scared, ya pansy.

localizedTextIdText: Herman Rottentooth
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Questionable Gelatin to Queen Myala Everstar in Wickwood Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Howdy, neighbor! We just moved in and my daughter Jeanie baked for the neighbors! Can you give it to Queen Myala? As a neighborly gesture?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You dropped it off yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh my, what is this? I see. Well, I accept the spirit in which this was given. Gelatin, was it? Yes. I shall... take good care of it, yes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hooey, thanks! I think we're gonna like this new condo!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Where did you say this came from? The sewers? Oh my...
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Take Questionable Gelatin to Queen Myala Everstar
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw, why not? Home owner's fees?

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Exile Flight Coach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ok, don't screw up and fly into anything! EVERYONE IS WATCHING YOU.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you do a barrel roll?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good, now go do a barrel roll and start the course!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Exile Flight Coach

localizedTextIdText: The Darktide have teleported their best available fishpower into the area near the Plasmic Equalizer. Kezrek Warbringer has left you with anti-grav grenades to take out the Darktide reinforcements while he charges ahead to find Admiral Gelic Ironscale, the Ikthian leader.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Kezrek Warbringer at the Plasmic Equalizer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: They grow desperate. You see? Their best soldiers come to defend against us. Use anti-gravity grenades to destroy them! Revel in the joy of battle!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Seek out the Ikthian reinforcements and rain anti-gravity grenades down upon them. Let none survive your onslaught!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You take joy in the enemy's defeat. Excellent. Work is always a pleasure when you are doing what you love to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I must find the leader of the Darktide. Find me when you are done here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Silence! Ironscale is close. Do not lower your guard.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While Kezrek Warbringer charged ahead to deal with the Ikthian leader, Admiral Gelic Ironscale, you remained behind and rained anti-grav grenades upon the Darktide forces that were teleporting into the area near the plasmic equalizer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you seen the effect an anti-gravity grenade has on $i(player.race)?

localizedTextIdText: You've been requested to report to Walker's Landing on the far side of Halon to meet with Researcher Dunfield to see just how you can assist the XAS in unraveling the mysteries of the Eldan Terraformers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Researcher Dunfield atWalker's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Adventurers are requested to report to Researcher Dunfield at Walker's Landing in Farside to aid in the research of the great Eldan terraformers!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Adventurers are requested to report to Researcher Dunfield at Walker's Landing in Farside to aid in the research of the great Eldan terraformers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Always check your helmet seals when going into a vacuum.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You here about the terraformers? It's good to see another Exile! Don't tell anyone, but bein' on this moon makes me feel like I'm goin' space crazy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have arrived and met with Researcher Dunfield at Walker's Landing on the far side of Halon.

localizedTextIdText: You've been requested to report to Virtue's Landing on the far side of Halon to meet with Researcher Vibius to see just how you can assist the Royal Collegium in unraveling the mysteries of the Eldan Terraformers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Researcher Vibius at Virtue's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Adventurers are requested to report to Researcher Vibius at Virtue's Landing in Farside to aid in the research of the great Eldan terraformers!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Adventurers are requested to report to Researcher Vibius at Virtue's Landing in Farside to aid in the research of the great Eldan terraformers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ain't you a strange sight, make no mistake.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hallo! I ain't seen a dogsbody arrive here in quite a while. I take it you're here to help out, yeah?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have arrived and met with Researcher Vibius at Virtue's Landing on the far side of Halon.

localizedTextIdText: Overseer Vrizz of Tanglemire Collective has heard reports of your work in Auroria. He is now requesting your presence in Dreadmoor to aid the chua of Tanglemire Collective.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Overseer Vrizz at Tanglemire Collective.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello hello, $(player.name)? Answer answer! Danger brewing. Need hero - you will do. Report to Tanglemire Collective. Dreadmoor needs you!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to Acolyte Maros, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Took long enough. We need to talk. Talk now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to Dreadmoor. Where ground squish when you walk.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Welcome. Now get to work.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You left Auroria and traveled to Dreadmoor to met with Overseer Vrizz of Tanglemire Collective. Your swamp-filled adventurers have begun!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wrong! Think again.

localizedTextIdText: After helping out a great deal in Celestion, Harrower Krimzon suggested taking a taxi in the Belabog Containment Camp that can get you to the Exile capital city, Thayd, in no time at all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tour Guide Jakke in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like you have done all you can here. You should make your way to the capital city, Thayd. A taxi nearby can get you there with great speed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I am no longer in need of your services. You are free to enjoy the city of Thayd at your leisure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Heh, you look dour. Just come from the Mordesh? Your time here in Thayd ought to turn that frown upside down!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We have contracted a group of Granok to show you the city and its amenities.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You ready to go on a ride?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: From Celestion you took a taxi all the way to the capital, Thayd. Being the largest Exile city around, you have all the amenities and services you'll ever need.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pity. Thayd is an excellent city.

localizedTextIdText: Consort Yaenna is anxiously awaiting the matria's crowning ceremony in Sylvan Glade. After all you've done to help her, Yaenna has asked you to attend the ceremony.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Matria Yaenna in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm so nervous! Queen Myala's going to crown me Matria of Sylvan Glade soon! After all you've done, I would really appreciate it if you'd be there.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I'm still nervous, but I feel so much better with you by my side!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've been a great help, $(player.name). I'll never forget you... or what you did for me and all the folk of Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you so much! Seriously, you're the best!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You'll always be welcome here. I promise!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'd be happy to be there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks in part to your assistance, Matria Yaenna has been crowned the new Matria of Sylvan Glade by Queen Myala Everstar!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't believe that you'd say no. That really hurts!

localizedTextIdText: Draz Markov has an idea for helping some of the Aurin you rescued from the Dreg get through their trauma. The splorg and jabbits you rescued from the camp could use a new home too.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Draz Markov
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Aurin have been through a lot. Studies have shown that pets can reduce traumatic stress. I suggest we administer such a treatment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Recovery can take time. Having a pet provides both companionship and structure. We can provide homes for these animals and help for these Aurin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I think everyone's going to be just fine, thanks to you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's fortunate we managed to rescue these animals as well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You provided the Aurin with rescued critters for pets, and they seem to be recovering nicely.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you will change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker of Augment Facility X426 has 'suggested' you return from whence you came. Find your way to the Protostar Transport Terminal in Whitevale and procure transport to the capital city of Thayd. Once you arrive, report to $~(creature=44963).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lulu Blackbush in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your performance was exemplary. This facility is now fully operational and under my control once more. I suggest you return to your point of origin.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your presence in this facility is no longer required. Perhaps your people require your services elsewhere?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What do you need? I'm a little busy at the moment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, wow! Look who's here! Where have you been hidin'? I guess you've been takin' care of hero stuff, huh? Aw... shucks. Now I'm blushin'!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will be in touch should further assistance be required.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's a good thing you came along when you did, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be on my way, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Having successfully navigated the Protostar Transportation Corridor in Whitevale, you reported to Lulu Blackbush in Thayd's Spaceport Horizon.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll be on my way, then.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No further actions are required at this time.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker of Augment Facility X426 has 'suggested' you return from whence you came. Find your way to the Protostar Transport Terminal in Whitevale and procure transport to the capital city of Illium. Once you arrive, report to Ringo Hax.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Ringo Hax in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your performance was exemplary. This facility is now fully operational and under my control once more. I suggest you return to your point of origin.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your presence in this facility is no longer required. Perhaps your people require your services elsewhere?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What what? Busy. You go away now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Was wondering where you went. Is fortunate you're here now. Many things happening. Some good, some bad. But always, things happen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will be in touch should further assistance be required.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I talk. You listen!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be on my way, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Having successfully navigated the Protostar Transportation Corridor in Whitevale, you reported to Ringo Hax in Illium's Spaceport Alpha.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll be on my way, then.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No further actions are required at this time.

localizedTextIdText: Reaper Serge in Woodhaven has asked you to use the Eliminator Paddles to thin out Greenbark creatures in Greenbough Glen.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Reaper Serge via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have you spoken to Venra Dewflower yet? I have a surplus of Eliminator Paddles that are perfect for weeding out Greenbark creatures. Interested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you tried the Eliminators on the Greenbark creatures yet? You may find the process of "weeding" to be enjoyable. Or not.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! Perhaps you should take up gardening as a hobby? I am hopeless, for my green thumbs have all turned to black.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent! The beasts will certainly be shocked by your initiative.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am joking, of course. Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the Eliminator Paddles, you were able to quickly thin out the Greenbark population in Greenbough Glen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A pity. Venra will be saddened by your callous character.

localizedTextIdText: A "stoney" Granok with a moustache told Nayita about Keyuri Catacomb, an old Lopp tomb filled with treasure. Nayita found the catacomb and needs help uncovering the buried shinies, for it appears they are guarded by dangerous obstacles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Nayita inside Keyuri Catacomb
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stoney man say Lopp tomb filled with shinies! Tomb here on moon! Lopp found it, we look for shinies, but tomb dangerous. Please help Lopp find old shinies?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You finished helping Lopp find shinies? Lopp not happy with finish. Look for more shinies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Lopp so happy big-folk help find shinies. And find Keyuri! Lopp wonder if shinies should stay with Keyuri, but Lopp love shinies too much.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful! Lopp hurt while searching. You might hurt too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ohhh, yes! It's so shiny!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You're going to keep Keyuri's corpse?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Nayita asked you to scour through Keyuri Catacomb to find shinies hidden by old Lopp Keyuri. No one expected you to find the solid gold remains of Keyuri himself, guarded by a phantom kurg.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How did the stoney man know?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Big-folk told Lopp. Big stoney man with fur on face. He said old Lopp Keyuri came to find way to make shinies. Then he disappear here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Stoney man said Lopp wanted boomy sticks to hide shinies, and during trade they talk like friends.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Tell Lopp if mind changes. Need help, especially from big-folk like you.

localizedTextIdTitle: Everything You Ever Wanted to Know
localizedTextIdText: Following your efforts to destroy the parasites feeding on his roots, Elderoot is well on his way to recovery. Without the distraction of his own suffering, Elderoot can now tell you everything you wanted to know. All that remains is for you to return to Elderoot Refuge and listen to what he has to say.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Queen Myala Everstar in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Centuries have passed since the Eldan created me. Even I cannot remember my sapling days spent mute beneath the shining sun and pouring rain.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If you wish to learn, you must be willing to sit and listen... silently.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Elderoot is willing to speak to you, so why haven't you talked to him yet? The sooner you do, the sooner we'll have our answers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can't believe it! The Dominion destroyed Elderoot! All those centuries of wisdom and knowledge... gone!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make yourself comfortable... I have much to tell....
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Everything we've been working towards... everything we've done has been in vain!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Elderoot has been destroyed! Before the ancient augmented tree could impart his knowledge, Dominion aircraft appeared and blew him apart. It would appear that Elderoot knowledge will be denied to the Exiles forever.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I'm not sure I have that much time.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am uncertain. I have never attempted to speak of so much all at once. I suspect it may take a number of your lifetimes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Perhaps we can make some arrangement. For now, we must use the resources available to us - namely, my ability to speak and your ability to listen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will never understand you small, fleshy things and your mercurial tendencies.

localizedTextIdText: Protostar's underground mining operation has gone haywire. The drillbots are under someone else's command, and relentlessly excavating the terrain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Protostar Junior SRAC in Prosperity Caverns
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those unprofitable drillbots have been hijacked! Someone has taken over Station Delta, and I need an expendable to audit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your contract terms are not yet fulfilled. Please return to your duties at your earliest possible convenience.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wonderful! The drillbots are operating as intended once more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Shut down all the power conduits to reset the turret, but be careful! They are highly unstable, and very expensive to replace.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here is an invoice for unauthorized Protostar property damage. Protostar thanks you again for your service!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Control of the drillbots has been returned to Protostar.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Protostar Junior SRAC
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Wouldn't that take the turret offline?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They've reprogrammed my AHVPUPADM. I can't get near Station Delta without sustaining serious bodily inconveniences. This is where your services are required!
