localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Protostar's newest product! Introducing the "Automated High Velocity Unauthorized Personnel Access Deterrent Module". And it's definitely not a re-purposed Dominion Turret.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Stations Alpha and Beta are down those other tunnels. You should be able to use the control panels there to cut power and reset the AHVPUPADM to Protostar's default settings.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The AHVPUPADM is an advanced prototype with 2 EBGs, or Emergency Backup Generators, but the delay during the switchover has a 23.7 percent chance of resetting the turret - well worth your risk.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: I am Protostar's Junior Subterranean Resource Acquisition Coordinator!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Unfortunately, I am not authorized to bargain contract fees.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has offered to give you a tour of Bio-Dome 3 utilizing a bio-dome observation platform.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Bio-Dome 3 observation platform is available to take another trip around this facility. Would you like a tour of my masters' incredible creation?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My records indicate you have yet to complete your tour of Bio-Dome 3. I can assure you that it is safe... more or less.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for taking a tour of Bio-Dome 3 aboard the observation platform. I hope your trip was both informative and enjoyable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please keep hands, arms, and other limb equivalents inside the platform.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to the Caretaker, you have successfully received a tour of Bio-Dome 3 aboard a bio-dome observation platform.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind, please return to me.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has offered to give you a tour of Bio-Dome 3 utilizing a bio-dome observation platform.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Bio-Dome 3 observation platform is available to take another trip around this facility. Would you like a tour of my masters' incredible creation?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My records indicate you have yet to complete your tour of Bio-Dome 3. I can assure you that it is safe... more or less.

localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please keep hands, arms, and other limb equivalents inside the platform.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to the Caretaker, you have successfully received a tour of Bio-Dome 3 aboard a bio-dome observation platform.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind, please return to me.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has offered to give you a tour of Bio-Dome 4 utilizing a bio-dome observation platform.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Bio-Dome 4 observation platform is available to take another trip around this facility. Would you like a tour of my masters' incredible creation?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to complete your tour of Bio-Dome 4. I can assure you, it is safe. We have not had a casualty for two cycles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for taking a tour of Bio-Dome 4 aboard the observation platform. I hope your trip was both informative and enjoyable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please keep hands, arms, and other limb equivalents inside the platform.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to the Caretaker, you have successfully received a tour of Bio-Dome 4 aboard a bio-dome observation platform.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind, please return to me.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has offered to give you a tour of Bio-Dome 4 utilizing a bio-dome observation platform.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Bio-Dome 4 observation platform is available to take another trip around this facility. Would you like a tour of my masters' incredible creation?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to complete your tour of Bio-Dome 4. I can assure you, it is safe. We have not had a casualty for two cycles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for taking a tour of Bio-Dome 4 aboard the observation platform. I hope your trip was both informative and enjoyable.

localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind, please return to me.

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker has requested you acquaint yourself with the goings-on inside Alpha Complex.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Dorian Walker in Alpha Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there, sport. Ya best have a look around Alpha Complex while ya got the chance. Y'know, get familiar with our gear and meet some folks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Whatcha waitin' for, slick? You need to check our operation out and make sure everything's ready to go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whadda'ya think 'bout our operation? Pretty exciting stuff, eh chief?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once you've finished lookin' around, we'll get down to business!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, let's get to it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Dorian Walker, you have investigated the goings-on inside Alpha Complex.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How did you find this place?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Caretaker contacted me and asked for our help gettin' this place back up and runnin' at peak efficiency.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What was that?  I didn't hear ya.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Ahnaris has requested you acquaint yourself with the goings-on inside Alpha Complex.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Researcher Ahnaris in Alpha Complex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that you are here, I suggest you inspect our equipment, this facility, and your fellow team members. It should bring you up to speed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How can you understand our intentions in Alpha Complex unless you familiarize yourself with our equipment, plans, and staff?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have finished. Excellent. I hope you took enough time to absorb all the information, because I will not answer any inane questions later on.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return to me when you have finished and we will get down to brass tacks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Researcher Ahnaris request, you have investigated the goings-on inside Alpha Complex.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How did you find this place?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We were contacted by the Caretaker. He wanted our help with preserving this amazing complex after it was left behind by our Eldan forebears.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What did you just say to me?

localizedTextIdText: You met Captain Tero in Sovereign's Landing on Farside. The hapless captain is in a bind. Space Station Venture is carrying some very rare and expensive chemicals. It's no longer responding to comm calls. He's hired you to board the station and help the crew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Tero in the Starchaser
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Space Station Venture's stopped responding to comm calls, and that makes me mighty worried, ayep. Can I count on you to help me investigate?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you waiting for? The transport's right here. Hop aboard and head for the stars! Just ready yourself for whatever is up there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hope the flight wasn't too rough for you. Space Station Venture's just outside those doors. Ready?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll take you up to the space station in a jiffy. Be ready for anything!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go check out what's wrong.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You boarded a transport ship in Sovereign's Landing on Farside, traveling up to help Captain Tero with the radio silent Space Station Venture.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so important about this station?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's got an extensive lab utilizing many rare and expensive chemicals, all supplied by yours truly. You betcha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you reconsider. I can pay well for your time, you bet.

localizedTextIdText: You met Captain Tero at Touchdown Site Bravo on Farside. The hapless captain is in a bind. Space Station Venture is carrying some very rare and expensive chemicals. It's no longer responding to comm calls. He's hired you to board the station and help the crew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Tero in the Starchaser
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Space Station Venture's stopped responding to comm calls, and that makes me mighty worried, ayep. Can I count on you to help me investigate?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you waiting for? The transport's right here. Hop aboard and head for the stars! Just ready yourself for whatever is up there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hope the flight wasn't too rough for you. Space Station Venture's just outside those doors. Ready?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll take you up to the space station in a jiffy. Be ready for anything!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go check out what's wrong.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You boarded a transport ship in Touchdown Site Bravo on Farside, traveling up to help Captain Tero with the radio silent Space Station Venture.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so important about this station?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's got an extensive lab utilizing many rare and expensive chemicals, all supplied by yours truly. You betcha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you reconsider. I can pay well for your time, you bet.

localizedTextIdText: Dominion forces in the Greenhouse have pinned down Arwick Redleaf. Queen Myala Everstar has asked you to go to Arwick's aid before his position can be overrun.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Arwick's gone missing! He's always getting in over his head, and I fear he's done it again. Find him and, if he's in trouble, help him out!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found Arwick? Is he okay? You must help him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Cassian troops have us pinned down! If you can overload some of their turrets and take out some of their troops, it'd be a big help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What you did out there was pretty cool! With the turrets out of the way and those Cassian jerks on the run, we can breathe a little easier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The last time I saw him, he was heading right into the thick of things!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't do that... not yet. The Dommies have something else in store for us!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to come to Arwick Redleaf aid in the Greenhouse. Though Arwick is safe for the time being, he's warned you that there is a greater threat waiting for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: And the lowborn?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Arwick Redleaf is his name. He's one of my consorts... the most military-minded of them, in fact. He said something about taking the fight to the Cassians, but I fear he might be in over his head!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Cassians are the human leaders of the Dominion. They put a lot of stake in social status, so there are both highborn and lowborn Cassians.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Exactly! They believe they've been chosen by the Eldan to rule the universe, and that everyone else is somehow inferior to them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The lowborn aren't quite as educated as their highborn masters, but they seem happy enough to follow their orders and perform menial chores.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: By turning your back on Arwick, you're turning your back on me!

localizedTextIdText: It seems like many groups of rival marauder gangs have been gathering together on the Borellian Cluster in Halon Ring, and you have been ordered to verify and deal with this development. The criminal Bron Goldenhand in Graylight on the Borellian Cluster in Halon Ring has the information you need.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Bron Goldenhand in Graylight on the Borellian Cluster
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have received reports from the Borellian Cluster that rival marauder groups have started banding together. The criminal Bron Goldenhand should have the information you need.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your assignment is to go to the Borellian Cluster of the Halon Ring and speak to Bron Goldenhand about the gathering of all the rival marauder groups.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Seems like the Dominion don't know everythin do they. Nothin goes on in the Borellian Cluster without me knowin and I'll tell ya for a price.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You are to verify and deal with this threat to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I assume it's not going to be cheap.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it to Graylight on the Borellian Cluster and spoke to Bron Goldenhand. He does have the information you need but plans on making you pay for it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Borellian Cluster is a rather large asteroid that is orbiting Nexus. It has become a haven for the criminal underworld here on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Bron Goldenhand is a criminal! He runs almost everything on the Borellian Cluster through brute force. He will have the information you seek, but the price may be quite high.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's an interesting response.

localizedTextIdTitle: Blast Off to the Borellian Cluster
localizedTextIdText: It seems like many groups of rival marauder gangs have been gathering together on the Borellian Cluster in Halon Ring, and you have been ordered to verify and deal with this development. The criminal Bron Goldenhand in Graylight on the Borellian Cluster in Halon Ring has the information you need.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Bron Goldenhand in Graylight on the Borellian Cluster
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our sources on the Borellian Cluster say that rival marauder groups have started banding together. The criminal Bron Goldenhand should have the information you need.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your mission is to go to the Borellian Cluster of the Halon Ring and speak to Bron Goldenhand about the gathering of all the rival marauder groups.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Seems like the Exiles don't know everythin do they. Nothin goes on in the Borellian Cluster without me knowin and I'll tell ya for a price.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We cannot afford a war on two fronts. This must be dealt with before it becomes a problem.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I assume it's not going to be cheap.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it to Graylight on the Borellian Cluster and spoke to Bron Goldenhand. He does have the information you need but plans on making you pay for it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Borellian Cluster is a rather large asteroid that is orbiting Nexus. It has become a haven for the criminal underworld here on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Bron Goldenhand is allied with no one! He runs almost everything on the Borellian Cluster through brute force. He will have the information you seek, but the price may be quite high.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pray we do not meet again!

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has asked you to travel to Thermock Hold in Whitevale and speak to his old friend, Brewmaster Grok. You can speak to Pilot Burke in Thayd to secure transit to Whitevale.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Brewmaster Grok at the Last Man Standing in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ya done good in Galeras, trooper, but I need someone with your chops over in Whitevale. Tell me I can count on ya.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You been to Whitevale yet? I wish I was goin'. I could use a drop of Grok's best brew right about now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Who are you again? Do I know you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Durek sent you, hmm? That hunk of granite knows good people, so I expect you won't disappoint me. And if you do, he'll hear about it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Talk to Brewmaster Grok when ya get there. He'll give ya somethin' to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Thermock Hold in Whitevale and spoke to Brewmaster Grok at Commander Durek request.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That ain't what I wanna hear, trooper.

localizedTextIdText: To communicate with an ancient, sentient tree, Lucy Lazarin requires $(vitem=383). They're found within Exo-Lab 71: The Arboretum and grow on the Elderoot Deathcap who lurk there. Once acquired, they must be given to her father, Victor Lazarin, at his laboratory in Elderoot Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An augmented tree - Elderoot - has been discovered up ahead. My father requires psygill mushrooms to speak to it. Kindly collect them in Exo-Lab 71.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The sooner you take the psygill mushrooms to my father, the sooner he can expand his efforts to establish a link with Elderoot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I delegated my daughter, Lucy, to gather psygill mushrooms in Exo-Lab 71. Do you serve in her stead?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, you possess the psyniscient specimens. Lucy must have sent you. Excuse me while I extract the mushroom essence.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My father awaits the psygill mushrooms in Elderoot Refuge. Good luck.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If we are to awaken this eldritch tree, there are a few more tasks I would have you do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered $m(vitem=383) to Victor Lazarin in Elderoot Refuge. The psionic essences derived from the mushrooms can fuel an espernetic interface, which can communicate with the ancient, augmented tree, Elderoot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Elderoot is a tree enhanced long ago by the Eldan. My father, Victor Lazarin, believes that it may know of a cure for the Contagion. Psygill mushrooms will fuel his espernetic device and should allow communication with Elderoot.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Exo-Labs are Eldan facilities where research was carried out on Nexus. Exo-Lab 71 - dubbed "the Arboretum" by my father - is the nearest, and a number of psygill mushrooms thrive there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Psygill mushrooms contain a compound which facilitates telepathic communication. We believe they were an invention of the Eldan.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: My people wither under the weight of the Contagion's curse. You must help!

localizedTextIdText: A dazed and injured Aurin named Varill Goldwood asked you to find his lost lover near the Eldan terraformer in Whitevale. He fears she may be as dazed as he is following the explosion. He's given you a holorecording of himself to show to her in case her memories are as confused as his are.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin at Raxen's Holdout
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh, my poor darling... she's here somewhere... she has to be! Please... find her! Show her this holorecording. It will prove that you know me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You're... you're back. But where is she? Where is my love? You have to find her... before something else happens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes, $(player.name)? What is it? Can you not see that I am preoccupied with the pursuit of a plethora of pernicious projects?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have you witnessed the magnitude of mutation caused by the terraformer's radiation? It is quite disturbing!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: By the Weave... thank you. Thank you so much! Just bring her back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What a somber story! Yet, in my experience, tales of love rarely have happy endings.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to find her for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Well, there was this Aurin and his lover...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to locate Varill Goldwood lover near the Eldan terraformer in Whitevale. She'd been horribly mutated by the terraformer's radiation, but she followed you (and Varill's hologram) back to his resting place. Once there, she lovingly devoured him before mutating again and turning on you.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll try to find her for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You need to see a doctor.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Does she have a name?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: No...! I can't... can't leave her. She's all alone... probably hurt, like me... confused... oh, my head!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We... we were scouting, I think. Yes... and then... an explosion... violent, burning! Where is she? Where did she go?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: She's... my partner... my lover. We loved each other... and I can't let her suffer here... all alone. You must find her!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Yes... but I can't... can't remember it. All I can remember... is her beautiful face...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lost! She's lost to me...! All I remember is an explosion... then nothing.

localizedTextIdText: You found an Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg}! Through a psychic connection, an alien mind probe, or as a result of your own insanity, the creature expressed that it desires your help in order to feed on the brains of your Dominion enemies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Communicate psychically with the Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg}
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "Together we can do great things. Together we will be unstoppable. You will help me. I will help you."
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "You have sustained me. My craving for cerebral tissue is sated. Now you will be rewarded."
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "I am hungry. I must feed. You must feed me."
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: You've got to be kidding me...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You formed a brief - if intimate - partnership with an Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg}, and you aided it in its mission to suck out and devour the brains of your Dominion enemies. After all, the enemy of your enemy is your friend... right?
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Communicate with the Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg}
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: You want their brains? That's gross!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Sure, they're my enemies, but...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: What do you have that I want?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "I am different from my brothers. I am your friend."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "I am hungry. The soft, jellied brains of your foes will satisfy me. But you must help me feed."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "Better I eat their brainwaves than yours, yes? Are they not your enemies?"
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "But nothing! All life must feed to survive. Feed me, and I shall reward you."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "I have knowledge - how to defeat your foes - how to obtain infinite power. It can be yours... if you feed me."
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "You cannot escape me. I will be watching you."

localizedTextIdText: Felis Gladedancer family was killed by the Planet Reapers on Arboria, but the Moonleaf family saved her and adopted her as one of their own. Felis has asked you to take flowers from the Arboria Memorial Arboretum in Sylvan Glade to her adoptive family and invite them to join her there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Felis Gladedancer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Moonleaf family adopted me after my family was killed by the Planet Reapers on Arboria. Will you find them and ask them to join me here?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found the Moonleaf family yet? You must ask Arvine, Fern, and Saefar to come here, to the memorial. I miss them so much!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found the Moonleaf family yet? You must ask Arvine, Fern, and Saefar to come here, to the memorial. I miss them so much!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dead...? All of them? How...? I can't believe it... with my parents killed on Arboria, I'm truly alone now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take some of these flowers for them. They're so beautiful...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thank you for trying, $(player.name)...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After searching for Felis Gladedancer family in Celestion, you discovered that they'd all been killed. You reported your discovery to Felis who was saddened by the revelation of her adoptive family's death.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My father and brother tried to stop the Planet Reapers, but they were killed. My mother went to find them and left me with the Moonleaf family, but... but she never came back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: As you wish...

localizedTextIdText: Brewmaster Greko has heard about how you saved Sadie Brightland, and he suggests you make your way around the Rockin' Rowsdower and introduce yourself to some of the other Exile passengers. While you're at it, you can hand out drinks and make some new friends.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Avra Darkos at the Rockin' Rowsdower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Word travels fast aboard the Gambler's Ruin, $(player.name). Everyone's heard about how ya saved Sadie Brightland, and they all wanna meet ya.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ya met everyone yet? We're like a big family here on the Gambler's Ruin. May as well act like it given how popular ya are!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is that drink for me? It is quite thoughtful of you, but I'm on duty... perhaps later.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that you have made some friends and rubbed elbows with Greko's clientele, perhaps you would like an assignment?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good idea, chum! Take 'em all a round of drinks while you're at it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Something sinister makes its way towards the Gambler's Ruin, and your help is needed.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be happy to meet your friends.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met a number of your fellow Exiles in the Rockin' Rowsdower, but the last one, Avra Darkos, was probably the most unusual of them all.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll be happy to meet your friends.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Who are these friends of yours?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'd start with Madeline and Vella. Oh, and that old lodestone, Durag! They're good people... thirsty, too!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bein' shy ain't never won no wars, bub. Sometimes friends is all ya got left.

localizedTextIdText: Myyn Longweed is trapped in the Arachnotorium. Explorer Faynar has asked you to find him before something terrible happens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Myyn Longweed via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My friend Myyn ran off! Now he's trapped in that exo-lab! Please, say you'll help me get him out of there before something awful happens!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I thought you were going to find Myyn and rescue him! Remember? He's my friend, and he's trapped somewhere in that exo-lab!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm grateful for your help and all, but can we get the heck out of here? Like, now?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for getting me out of that place, $(player.name). I'm sorry about being such a wimp, but I really hate spiders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks! I promised his mom I'd keep him alive, and she's mean when she's mad!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Come visit the Explorers Union in Sylvan Glade if you get the chance, okay?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Myyn Longweed get over his paralyzing fear of spiders, and you aided him in his escape from the Arachnotorium.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Oh, right. I'll go save him now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: So there are spiders in there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I overheard some of the other Aurin teasing him for being afraid of spiders. I guess he ran into the exo-lab to try to overcome his fear.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Ever hear of "exposure therapy"? It's like eating too much bingberry jam and getting so sick of it that even the smell makes you want to vomit. Just like that. But instead of bingberries, it's fear.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Oh, yeah, lots! Tons, even! He's probably cowering in a corner somewhere... if they haven't eaten him already.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Myyn's in big trouble! How can you let him die down there? How?

localizedTextIdText: You found an Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} in the Blasted Fields. Through a psychic connection, an alien mind probe, or as a result of your own insanity, the creature expressed that it desires your help in order to feed on the brains of your Exile enemies.

localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "Better I eat their brainwaves than yours, yes? Are they not your enemies?"
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "But nothing! All life must feed to survive. Feed me, and I shall reward you."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: The Odd Squirg{p:Odd Squirg} speaks directly into your mind: "I have knowledge - how to defeat your foes - how to obtain infinite power. It can be yours... if you feed me."

localizedTextIdText: A dazed and injured Draken named Fezar asked you to find his lost mate near the Eldan terraformer in Whitevale. He fears she may be as dazed as he is following the explosion. He's given you a holorecording of himself to show to her in case her memories are as confused as his are.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax at Inception's Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My mate... she is here, somewhere! She must be! You... you must find her! Show her this holorecording! It... it will prove that you know me!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You've returned, have you? But... but where is my mate? Have you not found her yet? You must! Before... before something else happens!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What what? Can't you see? Mondo is busy busy! Go away! Come back when news is important!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Radiation creates mutation! Mondo theorizes Eldan radiation useful if weaponized. Consider results of Mondo's genius!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring her back and I swear by Shezka's Blade that I will repay you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sad story. Mondo take moment to weep. There! Now go. Mondo has science to do!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to find her for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I met this Draken and his mate...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to locate Fezar mate near the Eldan terraformer in Whitevale. She'd been horribly mutated by the terraformer's radiation, but she followed you (and Fezar hologram) back to his resting place. Once there, she lovingly devoured him before mutating again and turning on you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You need to see a doctor.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Does she have a name?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Bah! My wounds are only skin deep! They will heal when I hold my mate once more!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We... we were scouting... yes. There was an explosion... white heat! Then... where is she? My mate is gone! Where did she go?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: My mate! My lover! We are bound for life... I cannot leave this place until she is found. You... you must find her for me!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Her... name. I can't... can't remember. But I remember her face... her horns... her crimson eyes...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Coward's blood! I must gather my strength... for none will aid me.

localizedTextIdTitle: This Quest Has What Raiders Crave
localizedTextIdText: Levels, Cash, and Zone to the Beta Raid Set-up Room!
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Levels, Cash, and Zone to the Beta Raid Set-up Room!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready for a repair bill!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm ready for a repair bill!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Levels, Cash, and Zone to the Beta Raid Set-up Room!

localizedTextIdText: Ashella Sunfell has heard cries for help from one of the Widowmaker's upper decks. She believes the cries are coming from Commander Vaxul, and she's ordered you to use jump pads and beam tethers to safely navigate the verticality of the ship in order to rescue him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashella Sunfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Commander Vaxul called. He's still alive, but he's stuck on one of the upper levels. You need to use the jump pads and beam tethers to reach him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where's the commander? I thought you were going to go up there and rescue him before he cries himself into a fit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for rescuing the commander. He's pretty sensitive for a Granok, but just having him here increases our chances of getting out of this alive.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Vaxul's a big old Granok, but he hates heights and is crying like a baby.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your next task could give you a shock... literally.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We're all we've got in here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rescued Commander Vaxul from one of the Widowmaker's upper decks. It only took some encouragement, jump pads, and beam tethers - not to mention lots of guts - to do it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why is Commander Vaxul up there and not near the helm?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do I get to higher levels?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How do I get down from higher levels?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The signal's source is near the commander's quarters. He has a very... hands-off approach to his command style. I don't blame the helmsman for this disaster, however.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Elevators were deactivated by the crash. You'll find glowing orange jump pads throughout the ship. Many of them still work correctly. Jump on them to traverse the ship's heights.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: For just such an occasion, we have beam tether anchors installed on the higher levels. Simply activate them and jump down in relative safety. Just don't wait too long, as they do go out, and that can get... messy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sure Vaxul will come in handy. We can't leave him up there like this.

localizedTextIdText: Learn about building projects from the Settlement Authority Representative in Lightreach Mission in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Settlement Authority Representative via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lightreach could well do with the inspiration that a statue could provide. Help Builder Lana complete a project in Lightreach.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find the resource? Did you take it to Builder Lana? Why the hells not?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that I have informed you of the process, help Builder Lana to construct her project. For the Emperor!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: First order of business - all projects require supplies. Go find them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Settlement Authority Representative contacted you about building projects on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Settlement Authority Representative
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Settlement authority refers to large scale building constructions as "projects." These can be anything from absolute necessity to the pragmatic. The primary goal of Settlement Authority is to strengthen the Dominion presence on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: First, speak with Builder Lana. Generally, a Builder will be a person or some other interface. Then you find and return the resource required to build the project to the Builder.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You will have to collect the required resource for the project and return it to Builder Lana in a timely fashion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Talk to Builder Lana if you change your mind. She could use the aid.

localizedTextIdText: You found an Eldan Microwave Hurler covered in webs and decided to see what effect it had on the spiders in the Arachnotorium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Explorer Faynar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This weapon, seemingly of Eldan design, is covered in spider webs. Plenty of tempting, unlabeled buttons and knobs protrude from its surface.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This weapon, seemingly of Eldan design, is covered in spider webs. Plenty of tempting, unlabeled buttons and knobs dominate its surface.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, is that an Eldan gun? Wow! What's it do? Have you tried it out yet? More importantly, what's it do to spiders?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That gun's seriously cool! How about you give it to me, and I'll make sure it gets displayed in the Explorers Union Discovery Archive?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Great! Wait until the other guys see what I... er, what you found!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try it out on spiders.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Eldan Microwave Hurler you found in the Arachnotorium causes spiders to swell up and pop! Though that was definitely a nice toy, you gave it to Explorer Faynar, so he could display it in the Explorers Union Discovery Archive.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll try it out on spiders.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has the access key. It will allow her to claim the wisdom of the Eldan locked away within the Elder Cube. Observe Artemis in her moment of triumph in the Elder Vault in Star-Comm Station... and perhaps gain a little Eldan wisdom for yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Artemis Zin in the Elder Vault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stand back, $(player.name). Don't get in the way of my cambots! This is the most important event you'll ever have the privilege to observe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stand back and watch! This is my show. Not yours!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Elder Cube is gone, and I was so close. The Exiles have ruined everything!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, it will be. The wisdom of the Eldan is within my grasp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: They probably spotted our ships and decided to take the offensive.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I hope it's worth all the effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Due to a surprise Exile attack on Star-Comm Station, the Elder Cube relocated itself before Artemis Zin could access it. Its new location is unknown. With Artemis's objective out of reach, your only options now are survival and revenge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Are you sure this is safe?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Of course not! The time for caution is behind us, $(player.name). Nothing will stop me now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you think I'll wait forever, you impudent little twit?

localizedTextIdText: Lothar Vondergott, Priest of the Vigilant Church, has requested that you try to convert the Lopp of Glitterfur Caravan and indoctrinate them into the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lothar Vondergott via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hail, citizen! Enjoying the glory of the statue? I require you to spread the word of the Vigilant Church. Try to convert those "creatures" in Glitterfur.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those Lopp need salvation, not I. Be off and convert them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Have you brought our word to the unenlightened Lopp souls of Glitterfur? Splendid! Let us hope they submit to the truth of the Vigilant Church.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It is our duty to bring the light of the Church to the Lopp savages.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps our efforts are wasted on such primitive little "creatures" then.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not sure they understood me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to the Lopp of Glitterfur. It remains to be seen if they will convert. The Church just needs to keep trying and sending missionaries.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is every citizen's duty to spread the word of the Vigilant Church.

localizedTextIdText: Gather a group and exterminate the Unbound Hydroguard lurking in the waterways of the Larallen Highlands. Report to Lord Horacos in Lightreach Mission when you have finished your task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lord Horacos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An unbound hydroguard has been spotted lurking around the waterways of the Larallen Highlands. It is extremely dangerous and should not be faced alone.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: An unbound hydroguard has been spotted lurking around the waterways of the Larallen Highlands. It is extremely dangerous and should not be faced alone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Be on the look-out for an unbound hydroguard. That thing has killed over a dozen people, and I expect it will kill a dozen more before it's dealt with.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. You've done the Dominion quite a favor with your heroics. I may as well pay you for your work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Try not to spend it all in one place, citizen.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will find and eliminate it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have vanquished the vile Unbound Hydroguard lurking in the waterways of the Larallen Highlands.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will find and eliminate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will find and eliminate it.

localizedTextIdText: You discovered Doctor Rose's cryo pod in the Widowmaker's Sick Bay. The woman inside looks incredibly peaceful. Almost... too peaceful. What will happen if you try to wake her?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTENTS: Doctor Rose.\nContagion Quarantine Protocols: Engaged.\nDisengage protocols to open cryo pod.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Contagion Quarantine Protocols Disengaged.\nCryo Pod: Unlocked.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Curiosity killed the Skeech, $(player.name). Don't be a Skeech.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's Doctor Rose. Just leave her be. Next time, I might not be here to prevent you from doin' the last thing you'd ever regret.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Contagion Quarantine Protocols: Disengaged.\nHave a nice day.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You nearly opened Doctor Rose's cryo pod in the Widowmaker's Sick Bay, but Lulu Blackbush intervened. She wouldn't say why, but she made it clear that you almost did something exceptionally stupid.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: I'm going to pull up some background info.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Subject: Doctor Rose was found drifting in space by a salvage team deployed to Farside.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Contagion Quarantine Protocols remain engaged.\nCryo pod is locked.

localizedTextIdText: According to the posted bounty, the Larallen Sentinel is laying waste to anything that crosses its path. The bounty poster says that the construct can be found in the Larallen Lowlands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lead Excavator Radek Villius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A bounty is hereby posted for destruction of the Eldan construct known as the Larallen Sentinel. The Larallen Sentinel is extremely dangerous.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A bounty is hereby posted for destruction of the Eldan construct known as the Larallen Sentinel. The Larallen Sentinel is extremely dangerous.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you dealt with our little construct problem yet? The damned thing needs to be destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Larallen Sentinel was a real nuisance. You have acquitted yourself well in the Dominion's eyes, $(player.name). I assume you desire your reward?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here you are, then. Minus the tithe, of course.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have deactivated the robot known as the Larallen Sentinel and collected your bounty from Lead Excavator Radek Villius.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Lead Excavator Radek Villius

localizedTextIdText: Head Researcher Septimia has requested you assist in the repair of Sim Core A-01 located deep underneath the green hills of Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in Sim Core A-01 beneath Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You look like some small part of your brain might comprehend science. Report to Holotechnician Jongo at the Sim Core site in the outskirts of Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Every moment you delay is a moment too many.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My sensors indicate this Sim Core is not yet fully operational.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It appears you have successfully reactivated the Transimulator Core. You have my thanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Science waits for no man, and neither do I...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Might I suggest a quick troubleshooting?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assisted Head Researcher Septimia in the repair of Sim Core A-01 beneath Illium.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Transimulator Core is a subterranean machine we have just recently discovered. So far, we have only succeeded in reactivating its Caretaker.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I do believe that is what I just said. Yes, he is assisting several technicians on the repair of the Sim Core.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Holotechnician Jongo informs me that it is capable of generating powerful, possibly weaponizable, holograms.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You clearly have no appreciation for important matters.

localizedTextIdText: The XAS have uncovered a Transimulator Core near the East Gate in Thayd. Site Supervisor Mercy has requested your assistance in repairing the machine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker inside Sim Core H-01
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're workin' triple shifts here at this so-called Sim Core. Sure could use an extra pair of hands over here.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Quit wastin' time. This here's urgent!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Perhaps I should find someone more suitable to completing this task.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have my gratitude for restoring this Sim Core to its former operational status.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Report to Junior Scientist Barkberry, she'll get ya sorted out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't suppose you could troubleshoot this facility's stability.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped repair Sim Core H-01. The XAS and Caretaker are both grateful for your contributions. Perhaps you should perform a test run of the machine...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What does the Sim Core do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Transimulator Core. Don't know much more'n that, but this Caretaker fella's tellin' us how to fix the darn thing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yeah, we found him underground. He started askin' us to fix the Sim Core and tellin' us how to do it. It ain't easy, I'll tell ya that.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Far as we can tell it's some sort of holographic projector. Powerful too. Maybe it's somethin' like those datacubes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Are ya kiddin' me?

localizedTextIdTitle: Sim Core: War of the Wilds
localizedTextIdText: Yelena Khollo has discovered a Sim Core near Rimewater Lake in Whitevale and needs your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Yelena Khollo inside Sim Core N-12
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have discovered a Sim Core, but the icy breath of this land is proving challenging. Perhaps you could find a way to keep our equipment from succumbing to the cold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have not secured the teleporter above? Do tell me you are joking.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew I could rely on you... more so than the buffoons I left up there at any rate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Sooner rather than later, please. We are waiting on you, after all.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped keep the teleporter to Sim Core N-12 from freezing over.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Is the Caretaker running the same simulation as before?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nothing... so far. However, this cold could shut down the generators keeping the teleporter to the Sim Core active, with us inside.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes. Though isolated, it appears to be functioning, and only requiring minimal maintenance.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I doubt it, though I have not sent any members of my team to investigate as of yet. Perhaps after you secure the generator you could run the simulation yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I shall remember this should you ever require my assistance.

localizedTextIdTitle: Sim Core: War of the Wilds
localizedTextIdText: Himp Zroc has discovered a Sim Core in Dreadmoor and needs your help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Himp Zroc inside Sim Core N-41
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I find it! Sim Core slightly damp. Get here quickly! Teleporter slightly broken.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You are delivered alive? Teleporter is fixed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry hurry!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Himp Zroc get the teleporter to Sim Core N-41 online.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Of course! Himp Zroc not second rate scientist!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Not sure. Pesky Skeech and Moodie throwing snowballs. Very distracting.

localizedTextIdTitle: Sim Core: The Siege of Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdText: Lyryan Redtail has discovered a Sim Core beneath Calmwater Lake.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with CoGS scientist, Lyryan Redtail, in Sim Core G-33 beneath Calmwater Lake
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We found another Sim Core beneath Calmwater Lake. Get your legs moving and help us out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you doing? Seal those ruptures!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a little close for comfort, but everything seems to be fine now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! We need more test subjects.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you'd like to run a simulation, we sure could use the data.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped prevent Sim Core G-33 from flooding beneath Calmwater Lake.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What does he use them for?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Where have you been?! The Caretaker's got these machines that can run all sorts of hypothetical simulations using our memories and experiences as guidelines.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It might be part of some experiment, no clue, but we might be able to use these machines to learn more about the Eldan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: My team says it's got something to do with that ongoing battle between the Exiles and Dominion in Galeras.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I won't forget this!

localizedTextIdTitle: Sim Core: The Siege of Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdText: Acilia Adronia has discovered a Sim Core in Dreadmoor.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Acilia Adronia in Sim Core G-18
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've uncovered another Sim Core. Your assistance is required.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've finally made it down here. Come now, there is still much to be done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry, now. I do not like to be made to wait.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Acilia Adronia in Sim Core G-18.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Where have you been? The Caretaker uses massive machines to generate hypothetical simulations utilizing the engaged users' memories.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We believe so that he may better understand us. However, we also hope to use these machines to learn more about the Eldan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: This particular machine is generating a simulation based upon the ongoing conflict between the Exiles and Dominion in Galeras.

localizedTextIdText: The pixpox plague has infected the Collegium researchers in Fort Vigilance who were working toward a cure. Other patients have sustained injuries from exploding flasks. Field Medic Lutton could use a hand putting them all back to rights.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chief Researcher Hawthorne in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've some patients here what need help! Pitch in and give me a hand against the pixpox, won't you love?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The wounded were hurt by an exploding flask. The others caught the pixpox plague. Use med kits on the wounded, and antiviral drugs on the sick ones.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The research team is currently, um, indisposed. Be a good citizen and help out Field Medic Lutton before we all expire.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: One never gets used to the smell of vomit, hm? Thanks to you, I don't have to. You may be on your way, content in the knowledge you made a difference.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Some are wounded, and others have the pixpox plague. Mind your step, dear!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I patched them up real good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Field Medic Lutton with her plethora of patients in Fort Vigilance, and you didn't even step in any vomit.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll do what I can for them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a right nasty sickness, it is. Got people spillin' their guts up all over the place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Me assistant up and died of the pixpox plague. I wish you'd reconsider, I do.

localizedTextIdText: Guard Chashi from Sylvan Glade called and asked you to help exterminate the spiders in Shadow Queen's Den.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guard Chashi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The spiders are out of control! They're breeding like jabbits, and what's worse, they're taking people for food! We need to wipe them out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Doesn't look to me like you've killed enough of those spiders yet. Maybe you need to kill a few more? Huh?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're alive? Wow! That's great! Whatever you did to those spiders sure seemed to work. They're pulling back and leaving folks alone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's great! Hopefully you can keep them busy for a while! Good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks from the bottom of my heart, $(player.name)! You're the best!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You put a huge dent in the spider population of the Shadow Queen's Den, and this has discouraged the spiders from attacking nearby settlements. Good work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Why are they reproducing so much?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're coming as far as Sylvan Glade, and have attacked smaller camps all over the place. It's terrible!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yeah. Sylvan Glade's pretty far from the Shadow Queen's Den, but they're still attacking us... more and more every day.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: There's been a huge spike in the spider population. They've got lots of little spiders to feed, and I guess they think us Exiles are pretty tasty. Ick!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: How should I know? I'm not exactly an expert on spiders. Maybe it's mating season or something!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: These spiders are dangerous, don't you understand? I need your help!

localizedTextIdText: Fool's Hope is a small Exile base, clinging to the edge of the untamed jungles of Wilderrun. Victor Lazarin and Dorian Walker have made their way there, to launch an expedition to find the Everpool and the Focus of Life. Travel to Wilderrun to start your new adventure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lucy Lazarin in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I suppose you want a ride to Wilderrun? Or maybe you don't. But if you do, I can take you there. They need all the help they can get.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Dorian Walker and Victor Lazarin are already in Wilderrun. With folks like that there, how can we fail?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Greetings, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This land is filled with danger and mystery. I cannot tell what is ahead of us, but I assure you it will be an adventure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If I weren't such a good pilot, I think I might've been an explorer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must ask for your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll help out any way I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it to Wilderrun, an untouched forest teeming with life and danger.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can you tell me about Wilderrun?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a jungle, sure. Loaded with lots of critters, too. Big ones and small ones, but mostly big ones. I hear Dorian Walker's already there, along with the Lazarins.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ain't you got any sense of adventure?

localizedTextIdText: Lulu Blackbush has asked you investigate what happened to Mutt, the scrappy pathologist with the can-do attitude. Look for Mutt in the Widowmaker's Sick Bay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our lucky charm, a pathologist we call "Mutt," is missin'. I'd hate to think somethin's happened to him. Can you try to find him in the Sick Bay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mutt's a good guy. He was up in the Sick Bay when we crashed. I sure hope he didn't run into anythin' unnatural.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Land sakes! Poor Mutt! We're gonna miss that little guy. Thanks for puttin' him out of his misery... I hate to think of him sufferin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If somethin' happened to him... uh, you may wanna take friends along.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If I got anything what needs doin', I'll holler at you first!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Sorry I don't have better news.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and terminated Project: Mutt in the Widowmaker's Sick Bay.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I told you, he's a pathologist. Mutt's always so damn positive all the time, encouragin' everyone, keepin' us all smilin'. It'd be a shame to lose him.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Look, you do me a favor, then I do you a favor. Understand?

localizedTextIdText: You collected an ear from Project: Mutt in the Widowmaker's Sick Bay. For what it's worth, it may be the last surviving piece of Mutt. You should send it to Lulu Blackbush to see if she has a use for it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This ear is clearly deformed, having come from poor, Strain-riddled Mutt on the Widowmaker. Maybe Lulu Blackbush can use it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What in Brightland's beard are you sendin' me, $(player.name)? It looks like... a mutated ear! What in blazes am I supposed to do with this?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's completely gross, friend! Next time you wanna send me a gift, DON'T!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You provided Mutt's ear to Lulu Blackbush, and she was suitably grossed out by it.

localizedTextIdText: Lulu Blackbush has asked you to recover tissue samples from medical refrigerators in the Widowmaker's heavily-infested Sick Bay. You'd better hope no one's cleaned them out yet!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I had to leave a slew of tissue samples in the sick bay. Would you be a champ and collect 'em for me? They should be in the medical refrigerators.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: With the power liable to cut out and all, the samples are goin' to get all rotten in those fridges. If you bring 'em to me, I can put 'em on ice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We spent a lot of time gettin' these samples, so I'm real glad you went out on a limb to scrape 'em together for me. I definitely owe you one!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Sick Bay ain't even remotely safe, so be careful.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get your samples for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the tissue samples from medical refrigerators in the Widowmaker's heavily-infested Sick Bay.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get your samples for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I need those samples, friend. Hope you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: You found a packet of sealed XAS documents aboard the Widowmaker. The documents should be delivered to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron right away!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These sealed XAS documents are intended for Lulu Blackbush's eyes - it says so right on the envelope. You should deliver them to her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where'd you find these? It's a good thing they didn't fall into the wrong hands, or I'd be in deep trouble! Nice of you to send 'em my way.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You should take better care of your documents.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a packet of sealed XAS documents in the Widowmaker and delivered the data to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron.

localizedTextIdText: Fort Vigilance is a small military installation on the coast of Wilderrun, an untouched and ancient jungle that may be home to the Focus of Life. Toric Antevian and Artemis Zin have made their way there, determined to search out the forest's secrets and claim them for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Toric Antevian in Fort Vigilance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Brave enough to travel to Wilderrun, are you? From our new base at Fort Vigilance, we'll explore the forest and claim its secrets for the empire, we will.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you know? Lady Zin and Toric Antevian are already in Wilderrun. With those two on our side, how can we lose?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Vigilance and strength, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We meet again, $(player.name). I was hoping you'd come along and pitch in. Wilderrun's an unusual place, make no mistake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hop aboard, love. I'll get you there in two wags of a dagun's tail, I will.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: First, I must ask you to undertake this sacred task.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll help out any way I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made it to Wilderrun and joined in the effort to tame the wilderness in the empire's name.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can you tell me about Wilderrun?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Wilderrun's an untouched jungle, it is. Lots of scary beasts prowlin' through the undergrowth, too. Best take care not to get lost there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stay here, then. Makes no difference to me.

localizedTextIdText: Exiles from Sylvan Glade have been disappearing into the Shadow Queen's Den. Guard Chashi has found entrances to the den. She's asked you to get the Exiles back safe and sound!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Guard Chashi via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exiles were taken into the Shadow Queen's Den... so they can be fed to the spiderlings there! They really need rescuing before they get eaten!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Aren't you supposed to be rescuing people in the Shadow Queen's Den? You better hurry, or they'll all be spider chow!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The people of Sylvan Glade are in your debt... even if they are emotionally scarred from their captivity.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful when you open up the cocoons. There could be spiders in them!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You saved a lot of lives today, $(player.name). Thanks!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I was happy to help them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped rescue Exiles who were trapped in the Shadow Queen's Den. Guard Chashi in Sylvan Glade was very pleased with your results.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why are the spiders taking people?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: With all the spider attacks lately, we've got to keep the defenses up in Sylvan Glade. As much as we'd like to save those folks, we have to defend the ones up here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: To eat them, of course. By the Weave, that's a silly question!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't save those people, the spiders will eat them! Think about it!

localizedTextIdTitle: Ready Your Character for The Siege of Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdText: Receive items and be leveled up for The Siege of Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will prepare your character for The Siege of Tempest Refuge adventure, a level 30 group instance. YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO PLAY OTHER CONTENT ON THIS CHARACTER IF YOU TAKE THIS QUEST.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to use this character for The Siege of Tempest Refuge.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character was prepared for The Siege of Tempest Refuge.

localizedTextIdText: Megatech forces have captured Dominion Soldier and imprisoned them in stasis fields near the Megatech Shield Generator. Free the Dominion Soldier by disrupting their stasis fields and weaken the Exile forces by destroying any Megatech Battlebot in the vicinity.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion soldiers captured by Megatech. Mondo just as soon leave them to die, but Kezrek insist they be rescued. Looks like perfect job for you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You see captured Dominion soldiers here with Mondo? No? Then go find them someplace else! Maybe at Megatech shield generator!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Kezrek glad you freed soldiers. Mondo think removing stupid soldiers from gene pool better idea, but... oh, well!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Megatech battlebots guard prisoners. Prove efficiency. Scrap bots, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Is fine. Mondo save soldier names for pool of future test subjects.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed many captured Dominion Soldier from the stasis fields imprisoned them, and you took vengeance upon the Exiles by destroying their Megatech Battlebot at the Megatech Shield Generator.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Prisoners trapped in stasis fields. Fields drop instantly if hit by dense mass, like head of $(player.name). Jump through field to free soldiers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mondo not like negativity. Makes him want to test giant Chua ball on $(player.name)!

localizedTextIdText: Megatech forces have captured Dominion Soldier and imprisoned them in stasis fields near the Megatech Shield Generator. Free the Dominion Soldier by disrupting stasis fields and weaken the Exile forces by destroying any Megatech Battlebot in the vicinity.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Megatech has captured a number of Dominion soldiers. With our forces stretched to the limit, we cannot afford to lose them. Set them free at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our troops are still confined to Megatech's stasis fields near the shield generator. Get your tail over there and free them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The troops you freed will spearhead our next frontal assault. If they survive, they will have absolved themselves of their disgrace.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Battlebots are guarding the captives. Destroy them, too. Let nothing stand before you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bah! I am merely pragmatic. As for you... carry on.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You freed many captured Dominion Soldier from the stasis fields where they were imprisoned. You also took vengeance on the Exiles by destroying their Megatech Battlebot at the Megatech Shield Generator.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The prisoners are held in stasis fields. To break the fields, jump through them. Once they are free, send them to the forward camp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing a direct order is grounds for summary execution. I suggest you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Justice Alastair requested your help with a mysterious situation outside town. He's waiting for you in Gallow Fields.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Justice Alastair in Gallow Fields
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Forgive my rude introduction. I have a bit of a situation outside of town. Come to the Gallow Fields and find me. There isn't much time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm glad you decided to answer my call for help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've heard a lot about you, $(player.name). Everyone's been talkin' about how good $i(player.class) you are. Apparently, you help anyone who needs it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you! Your efforts will not go unnoticed by the Regulators!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, well. I guess I better tell you what's goin' on, hmm?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Why did you call me out here?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Justice Alastair waiting for you in the Gallow Fields.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Why did you call me out here?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is important, $(player.name). You should reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Icon of Virtue in Sterling Croft will reward anyone who can locate and kill the so-called "Leviathan" and collect samples of its primal pattern for study.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Cognosa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Locals claim a "Leviathan" haunts a cave near Sterling Croft. Anyone who can kill the beast and provide samples of its primal pattern will be rewarded.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Locals claim a "Leviathan" haunts a cave near Sterling Croft. Anyone who can kill the beast and provide samples of its primal pattern will be rewarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hunting the Leviathan, are you? If it exists, it is likely to be formidable. Do not attempt to collect this bounty by yourself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: From your initial scans, it is obvious this creature was subject to intense genetic enhancement. It must have been an extraordinary fight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My voice stress analyzer tells another story, but I shall keep your secret safe.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I can handle this contract.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the giant Ikthian-engineered Nerid known as Leviathan. Analysis of its hideously manipulated biology may provide great insight into the Ikthian's advanced technology.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I think I can handle this contract.

localizedTextIdText: You found a sizable chunk of undamaged augmented tissue among the smoldering remains of the hulking test subject in Containment Facility R-12. The Royal Collegium will be interested in running some tests on this delightful sample, and Fairos in Sunstorm Village should be able to get it to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Fairos in Sunstorm Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Somehow, this large chunk of augmented tissue survived the hulking test subject's destruction. The Royal Collegium will want to run some tests on it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is nothing else located in this smoldering pile of remains.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at you! Such a big, strong $(player.race). This is a matter of great importance, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: How interesting. I shall ensure this is delivered unto the Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Fairos right away.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have an augmented tissue sample.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the augmented tissue sample to Fairos in Sunstorm Village.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll bring what I found to Fairos.

localizedTextIdText: Hunter Chiath wants you to give the hunters of Celestion something to talk about! Show off your hunting skills by killing various forest beasts while in the presence of an Aurin hunter and increase your reputation in Celestion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Provisioner Grayfur in Woodhaven or Melri Gladewalker in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hunters don't just provide food. We also provide stories of the hunt! Give a good fight in front of a fellow hunter, and they'll share your tale, too!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Want to earn a reputation in Celestion? Bag a clean kill in the presence of a fellow hunter. Impress them, and soon the whole forest will be talking!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you can impress the hunters of Celestion, you'll earn a reputation. All you need to do is claim a kill close enough for them to see you fight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your name's gotten around, $(player.name). I've got some special inventory on reserve for some of the best hunters in Celestion... including you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fight your prey close to an Aurin hunter, and they'll tell everyone how you did!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep up the good work, and I'll let you buy some of my best stock!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've started earning quite a reputation for yourself among the hunters of Celestion. It won't be long before the entire forest knows about your exploits!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Provisioner Grayfur or Melri Gladewalker
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What kind of animals do you hunt?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: So you'll tell my tale to others?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: My reputation?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a hunter's duty to provide food for nearby villages and towns. While it's sad that we have to kill animals, the hunt is part of the natural cycle of the forest.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: All kinds, but we have to respect nature and prevent over-hunting for any single species. The animal's passing should be gentle, too. The better you do, the further word will spread.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Sure! Just let your hunting abilities do the talking! The closer an Aurin hunter is to your fight, the better their story will be, and the more your reputation as a skilled hunter will grow!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Of course! Those who help us out can get special rewards honoring their skill and bravery. Once you've made a name for yourself, see Provisioner Grayfur in Woodhaven, or visit Melri Gladewalker in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't feel bad. Not everyone is cut out to be a hunter, I guess.

localizedTextIdTitle: Transport Your Character to the Core Test Hub
localizedTextIdText: Go to the Core Test Hub in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You'd like to go to the core test hub in Thayd?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to go to Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were transported to the Core Test Hub in Thayd.

localizedTextIdTitle: Transport Your Character to the Core Test Hub
localizedTextIdText: Go to the Core Test Hub in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You'd like to go to the core test hub in Illium?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I want to go to Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were transported to the Core Test Hub in Illium.

localizedTextIdText: Explorer Wennie of the Explorers Union wants you to meet her at the Rockin' Rowsdower so she can introduce herself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with Explorer Wennie at the Rockin' Rowsdower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I bet you're eager to explore every last corner of Nexus, huh? The Explorers Union can use folks like you, and I'd love to chat with you about it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's good to meet ya, friend. I'll have a mission or two for ya later, never fear. You're goin' to need some practice before you get down to Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're goin' to make one heck of an explorer, I can tell!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Glad you're aboard! The Explorers Union can use all the warm bodies it can get!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your way to the Rockin' Rowsdower and met your point of contact for the Explorers Union, Explorer Wennie. She explained that, in time, you'll receive instructions regarding your duties as an explorer. For now, don't be afraid to practice whenever you get the chance!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My name's Wennie, friend, and I'm with the Explorers Union.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're a bunch of like-minded folks who want to map every little bit of Nexus. We can't all be Dorian Walker, but we can sure as hell try!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If ya can't find me, then ya ain't cut out for explorin' Nexus... are ya?

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=48471), a scientist of the XAS, has asked you to meet him at the Rockin' Rowsdower so he can introduce himself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with $(creature=48471) at the Rockin' Rowsdower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Whispers in the shadows say you are a scientist of some skill. Can we converse? The XAS requires reliable researchers in its ranks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is agreeable to make your acquaintance. In time, I will mete out missions to you. After all, you must practice prior to planetfall.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The pursuit of knowledge should not be plagued by procrastination.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am certain you will make many new discoveries on Nexus. Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your way to the Rockin' Rowsdower and met your point of contact for the Exile Academy of Science, $(creature=48471).
