He explained that, in time, you will receive instructions regarding your duties as a scientist. For now, you should practice whenever you get the chance!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Mikael, representative of the Exile Academy of Science, also known as the XAS, and I am at your service.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We are a group of scientists and researchers who have aligned with the aspiration of learning all there is to ascertain about Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do I sense in you a lack of initiative... or of intelligence?

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=48468) of the Pioneering League has asked you to meet him at the Rockin' Rowsdower so he can introduce himself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with $(creature=48468) at the Rockin' Rowsdower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Are you a settler who's eager to travel to Nexus and put down some roots? Then you and I need to talk, friend, 'cause the Pioneering League needs you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By getting a settlement up and running, even a practice settlement, we'll be helping our fellow Exiles kick these Dommie losers off the arkship.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's good to finally meet you. There's only so much we can do to prepare for settling Nexus, but I'll have some assignments for you soon enough.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It'll be great to have you on the team!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, man! You have no idea how ready I am to get off this ship!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your way to the Rockin' Rowsdower and met your point of contact for the Pioneering League, $(creature=48468). He explained that you'll eventually receive more information regarding your League assignments. Pioneering won't be easy, but someone has to mold Nexus into a proper home.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm Vales, and I'm with the Pioneering League.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're the ladies and gents who are going to help settle Nexus for the rest of the Exiles. I sure hope I can count on you to help out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you plan to be useful once we get to Nexus, I need to explain some things.

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=48467), one of the soldiers assigned to the Free Companies of Nexus, has asked you to meet him at the Rockin' Rowsdower so he can introduce himself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with $(creature=48467) at the Rockin' Rowsdower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I hear you're a firecracker in a fight, pal. I'd like to talk to you about your place in FCON, 'cause we need soldiers like you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do I gotta repeat myself? I gave ya yer first orders to meet me at the bar. You ain't ready for this assignment?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to meet ya, Soldier. I ain't got a mission for ya yet, but I'll be makin' contact just as soon as orders come through. Be ready for some action.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's good to see another soldier on two feet! Let's keep it that way!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sooner or later, we'll be in for a fight. I'm glad you'll be on my side.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your way to the Rockin' Rowsdower and met your point of contact for the Free Companies of Nexus, $(creature=48467). He explained that you'll eventually receive orders regarding your duties as a soldier. After all, you're going to need to know how to kick ass once you hit the dirt.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Name's Benzag, and I'm with the Free Companies of Nexus. That's 'FCON,' for short.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're the boys and girls who get to pound the Dommies into a smooth, red paste on the battlefield, if ya get my drift.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Listen up, cupcake. This is an order, not a request.

localizedTextIdText: You received a call from Professor Rhoda Wellspring, the head of the XAS, requesting your assistance in investigating another strange portal that has appeared in Thayd. Travel there and find out where the portal leads.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Rhoda Wellspring in the Secret Ops Center in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hate to bother you, but looks like the XAS is gonna need your help again. Another portal's opened up in Thayd, but we can't make heads or tails of it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I must admit, I'm real curious about this portal. After all, the first one went to Alpha Sanctum. Who knows where this one'll lead?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the blazin' blue stars! You met an all-powerful being named Drusera, you say? I've got to get my team on those datacubes you found right away!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We're tearin' our hair out here, so anythin' you could find out would be great.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So exciting! I've generated an XAS report about your encounter - feel free to take a look.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the strange portal in Thayd and it took you to Exo-Lab Prime. Within the long-deserted exo-lab, you met Drusera who revealed that she was a creation of the Eldan. Though she appears to be little more than a young girl, Drusera is obviously a being of immense power who needs your help.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you hope to accomplish here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What can you tell me about the portal?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: To be honest, it's 'cause you came to my rescue in Alpha Complex. Plus, your name's at the top of a very short list of people the Exiles consider valuable. If anyone can help us, it's you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Remember the Eldan? They're gone, and we got no idea where they've gotten off to. Alpha Sanctum gave us a lot of insight into the basics of the Nexus Project, but the location of the Eldan remains a mystery. Hopefully you'll find some answers through the latest portal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Not much. Scans won't penetrate it, and we haven't had any success sendin' scanbots through. It's almost like it's waitin' for someone... someone like you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I do wish you'd change your mind. You're one of our best and we could really use your help.

localizedTextIdText: You received a request from Chancellor Juro Takigurian, the leader of the Royal Collegium, asking for your help in investigating another strange portal that has appeared. Make your way to the mysterious portal in Illium and see what you can learn.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chancellor Juro Takigurian in the Enigma Chamber in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As leader of the Royal Collegium, I find I must request your aid. Another portal has appeared in Illium that defies all our efforts at investigating it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Royal Collegium is deeply interested in this portal. I expect you to investigate its origins at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: An all-powerful being created by the Eldan? What a discovery! I will have my Collegium researchers attend to the datacubes you found at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will find the Collegium can be a most gracious and grateful ally.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A Collegium report on this encounter will be available to you in the Enigma Chamber.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the strange portal and found yourself in Exo-Lab Prime. Within the long-deserted exo-lab, you met Drusera, who revealed that she was a creation of the Eldan. Though she appears to be little more than a young girl, Drusera is obviously a being of immense power who needs your help.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why are you coming to me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you hope to accomplish here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You were instrumental in the exploration of Alpha Sanctum. Additionally, your name is frequently mentioned within the higher echelons of the Dominion. You have gained quite a reputation as someone who delivers results - in this, if nothing else, we are similar.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Eldan are missing... remember? Though Alpha Sanctum revealed a great deal about the beginnings of the Nexus Project, we are still in the dark as to where the Eldan might have gone. I suspect your investigation of the latest portal may reveal much.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Scions grant me patience! If I knew that, do you think I would be requesting your assistance? The portal defies all scientific understanding. Our probes are unable to pass through it, data collected through scanbots is inconclusive, and though I've ordered several junior researchers to attempt passage, I have been met with stubborn resistance. Researchers these days - all theory and no field experience!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusing the chancellor of the Royal Collegium is a grave mistake.

localizedTextIdText: You found a sizable chunk of undamaged augmented tissue among the smoldering remains of the hulking test subject in Containment Facility R-12. The XAS will be interested in running some tests on this delightful sample, and Dorian Walker in Sandstone Hold should be able to get it to them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Dorian Walker in Sandstone Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Somehow this large chunk of augmented tissue survived the hulking test subject's destruction. The XAS will probably want to run some tests on it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is nothing else located in this smoldering pile of remains.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Tissue samples? I'll make sure our friends in the XAS get this stuff before it gets too ripe. Ain't nothin' smells worse than rotten meat, eh cappy?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for thinkin' of the eggheads, sport. They'll have a ball with this.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take this to Dorian Walker.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the augmented tissue sample to Dorian Walker in Sandstone Hold.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll bring what I found to Dorian Walker.

localizedTextIdText: Drusera has called to request your aid. Travel to Thayd and enter the portal you find there in order to meet with Drusera.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Rhoda Wellspring in the Secret Ops Center in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello again, $(player.name). There's something I want to show you... and something I need your help with, too. I've opened up another portal for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You've heard from Drusera again? Well, what are you waitin' for? Go find out what she wants! But come see me right after, I'm dyin' to know more.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Some of my researchers reported seein' strange creatures like the Strain you described, but I didn't expect this! I'd better take a look at those datacubes.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: In this form, I'm too weak to do anything. But you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'd better let the other Exile leaders know how serious the matter is... you can read my findings in my Strain report.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the second portal and met with Drusera inside Exo-Lab X39. While exploring the lab, you learned about the Strain - creatures corrupted by a malignant force that manifested following Drusera creation by the Eldan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What is it you want to show me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There is an evil here on Nexus, more terrible than you can imagine. Even worse, it's an evil I barely understand. If you are to help me, I must show you what you're up against. With your help, hopefully we can learn more about this threat and find some way to stop it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please don't say no, $(player.name). I... I can't do this by myself.

localizedTextIdText: Drusera has called to request your aid. Travel to Illium and enter the portal you find there in order to meet with Drusera.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chancellor Juro Takigurian in the Enigma Chamber in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello again, $(player.name). There's something I want to show you... and something I need your help with, too. I've opened up another portal for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Collegium has a vested interest in this being called Drusera. I advise you heed her summons at once, but I expect a full report upon your return.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Collegium researchers have reported strange creatures like the ones you described, but I never expected this. I must analyze these new datacubes at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: In this form, I'm too weak to do anything. But you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must inform Axis Pheydra and the emperor of these findings. My report on the Strain will be available in the Enigma Chamber.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the second portal and met with Drusera inside Exo-Lab X39. While exploring the lab, you learned about the Strain - creatures corrupted by a malignant force that manifested following Drusera creation by the Eldan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What is it you want to show me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There is an evil here on Nexus, more terrible than you can imagine. Even worse, it's an evil I barely understand. If you are to help me, I must show you what you're up against. With your help, hopefully we can learn more about this threat and find some way to stop it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please don't say no, $(player.name). I... I can't do this by myself.

localizedTextIdText: Flight Recruiter Adra is looking for adventurers with an interest in charting unknown space. Are you ready? The shuttle in Wilderrun will take you to the Galactic Observer, where you'll begin your mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Flight Recruiter Adra on the Galactic Observer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You lookin' for adventure and the thrill of scientific discovery? Our ship, the Galactic Observer, is headed into deep space, and we could use someone like you for this Expedition.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You call that an Expedition? Get back to it, friend! We have space to explore.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome aboard! I bet you're just itchin' to get out to deep space, aren't ya?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just board the shuttle there, and you'll be on your way to the Galactic Observer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived on the Galactic Observer, a deep space exploration vessel, ready to explore space for the CoGS.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How long will the Expedition last?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The usual time frame of an Expedition is around seven years. Unless complications arise, of course. Can't be too sure when it comes to space travel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: When ya travel through space, there's always the risk of bumpin' into an occasional Marauder clan, an interplanetary war, an asteroid shower, an Ikthian abduction ship, a black hole, or a giant ball of flamin' gas. But I'm sure you'll prevail. You'll be explorin' in the name of science, after all!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We're scientists, of course. The Coalition of Galactic Scientists has renounced all conflict in the pursuit of scientific knowledge. Everythin' we do's in the name of science, and we don't bother with politics or other distractions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you turn down an offer like that?

localizedTextIdText: Flight Recruiter Reginald of CoGS is looking for adventurers with an interest in charting unknown space. Are you ready? The shuttle in Wilderrun will take you to the Galactic Observer, where you'll begin your mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Flight Recruiter Reginald on the Galactic Observer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I promise an adventure brimming with the thrill of cosmic discovery! Our ship, the Galactic Observer, is on an Expedition to deep space. Care to join us?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What a lackluster expeditionary effort! I must insist you return immediately! We have space to conquer - I mean, explore.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Behold the Galactic Observer. Are you prepared to make history?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then board the shuttle and be on your way to the Galactic Observer!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived on the Galactic Observer, a deep space exploration vessel, ready to explore space for the CoGS.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How long will the Expedition last?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The usual time frame of an Expedition is around seven years. Unless complications arise, of course. One can never be too sure when it comes to space travel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: When one travels through space, there's always the risk of bumping into an occasional Marauder clan, an interplanetary war, an asteroid shower, an Ikthian abduction ship, a black hole, or a giant ball of flaming gas. But I'm sure you'll prevail. You'll be exploring in the name of science, after all.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We're scientists, clearly. The Coalition of Galactic Scientists has renounced all conflict in the pursuit of scientific knowledge. Everything we do is in the name of science, and we refrain from politics or other pursuits.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Galactic Observer requires a crew. Consider this request more of a demand.

localizedTextIdText: Dominion boarders are running amok in the Gambler's Ruin Greenhouse, and they need to be stopped before they can destroy the Exiles' food supplies. Commander Durek has ordered you to proceed to the Greenhouse, meet with Queen Myala Everstar, and see what you can do to help her contain the Dominion attackers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Queen Myala Everstar in the Greenhouse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I hope you solved Belle's problem, 'cause all hell's breakin' loose. Take a teleporter to the Greenhouse and see if Queen Myala can use your help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You better have a damn good reason for talkin' to me instead of the queen. Well?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It's just like the day the Dominion came to Arboria and destroyed everything we loved.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Commander Durek said you'd come. Things are bad and getting worse. We can't let the Dominion destroy our food supplies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lock and load, recruit! You got your work cut out for ya!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's just like the day the Dominion came to Arboria and destroyed everything we loved.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm here to help, your majesty.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Commander Durek orders, you proceeded to the Gambler's Ruin Greenhouse and offered to assist Queen Myala Everstar.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That'd be the Aurin queen. When you meet her, I expect you to make a good impression. She's royalty, after all.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Dommies crashed an asteroid into the ship, that's how they got aboard, and now they're runnin' around the greenhouse, burnin' up all our crops.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't pick 'n' choose the missions you perform for me, recruit. Get used to it.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland has invited you to go to the Rockin' Rowsdower and enjoy one of the arkship's best brews on his tab as a reward for saving his wife Sadie in the Medical Bay.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Brewmaster Greko in the Rockin' Rowsdower
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You done Sadie and me a kindness, so I reckon the least I can do is buy you a drink. That'll have to do... for now.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Rowsdower's the local tavern hereabouts. They got the best brew on the ship.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Pull up a stool, chum, and get ready to be inebriated!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Brightland sent ya? Well, belly on up, then. He promised ya a drink for savin' Sadie, and I'm just the Granok to serve ya one. You're gonna like this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let Greko at the Rockin' Rowsdower know I sent you, and he'll square you away.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My pleasure, pal! It's times like this we all need heroes, and you fit the bill.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Thanks, Deadeye. I can use a drink.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Brewmaster Greko in the Rockin' Rowsdower and enjoyed one of his best brews on Deadeye Brightland tab.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll head over there for a drink, then.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusin' to accept my gratitude ain't goin' to score you no points.

localizedTextIdText: The Field Researcher are collecting valuable data against the Seekers. They have set up a scanning hub in the outskirts of their facility. It is vital they are protected along with their data.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Gosril Gruni via communicator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time we burst their bubble and show them what we're made of! Go help out those researchers in the field before the Seekers get to them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Short circuits! Go help the researchers in Temporal Quarantine 01 before the Seekers kill, kill, kill them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: No kidding? You did it! Good! They are now safe with their data back here at camp!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm counting on you to win, win, win!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You surprised me back there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have protected the Field Researcher and their data from The Seekers. With this data, we can now uncover their weaknesses and continue out fight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will regret that.

localizedTextIdText: The rifts are opening around the outskirts causing temporal disturbances. The researchers in the area seem to have gotten trapped in some of these tearing rifts while collecting data. It's vital the Trapped Field Researcher be freed from the stasis.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Gosril Gruni via communicator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Researchers trapped in the temporal fields, they need a kick out of there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still here? Just a good jump on them should force them out of the rifts their trapped in at the fields.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go, go, go!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not bad at all!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have freed the trap researchers from the rift stasis they were trap within in. Now the researchers can continue to collect their data with more precaution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Whatever, didn't like you anyway.

localizedTextIdText: It appears the Ascendancy have found a way to ride from rift to rift, enslaving anything within those temporal portals. Their minions and them must be stopped.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report you success to Gosril Gruni via communicator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bad Ascendancy! They found a way to jump rifts and disturb the peace. Kill, them and their slaves in the field!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You bungler! Go kill now! Go, go, go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wow! Close but successful!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kill, kill, kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, exceeded Gosril's expectations!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have stopped the Ascendancy and their enslaved minions causing havoc.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll make you accidentally grab the wrong wire.

localizedTextIdText: The rifts are becoming unstable, use this Time-Space Stabilizer to close the tears opening in the rifts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Gosril Gruni via communicator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Big trouble! Rifts are ripping! Here, take this and close them up, quickly!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your schematics shuffled? Rifts need to be closed, use the gun I gave you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gears and gaskets! That was a close one. You did a great job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No more wasting time! Move, move , move!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cozmotronic work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have stabilized and closed the disturbed temporal rifts in the field.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't know your wrench from your rivets.

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Zorango Drel in Camp Continuum asked me to test his latest Pell Devolution Elixir compound variant on the Pell near Temporal Quarantine 01.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Zorango Drel
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Got a good throwing arm? Need you to test my latest Pell devolution elixir variant. You go toss some flasks at Pell, near Temporal Quarantine 01, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need more results. Back to work!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, yes, yes! Hireling did well!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry along then! Need results on latest batch ASAP!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Will have new compounds to test tomorrow! You come back!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I collected sufficient Elixir results for Alchemist Alchemist Zorango Drel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not smart decision.

localizedTextIdText: Before embarking into the jungle's depths, you must learn a bit about Wilderrun. Lucy Lazarin in Fool's Hope will educate you on why the Mordesh have come to Wilderrun, as well as a bit about its fiercest inhabitants.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Avra Darkos in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wilderrun is home to a plethora of creatures, both fantastic and fierce. The acclimation protocols will bring you up to speed on this land's secrets.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The training protocols will tell you what you need to know. Depress the start button on the terminal and learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When you have completed the acclimation protocols, return to me for your briefing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have learned enough about this place to keep you somewhat safe. Now I can impart to you the situation we find ourselves mired in.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A keen choice. Come, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed Lucy Lazarin Wilderrun acclimation protocols and now are a bit wiser about your surroundings.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see you when I'm done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no desire for such data?

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Zorango Drel in Camp Continuum has asked me to search for hidden super weapon Dawngrazer Hoof{p: Dawngrazer Hooves}s that the have been hidden outside of this time continuum in Temporal Quarantine 83. The Time Shift Terminals should allow me to find them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Zorango Drel
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Seekers hide important super weapon schematics in another time continuum. Use modified Time Shift Terminals in Temporal Quarantine 83 and find Dawngrazer Hoof{p: Dawngrazer Hooves} data!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You return empty handed?!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very impressed by your work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Off you go, go, go!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Seekers never rest. Return to me soon for more work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I downloaded sufficient Dawngrazer Hoof{p: Dawngrazer Hooves} Data for Alchemist Zorango Drel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Unfortunate.

localizedTextIdText: ICI spies have planted bombs throughout Fool's Hope. Use the bomb beacon that Avra Darkos supplied you with and locate the bombs before more Exiles are killed or injured!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Avra Darkos in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The ICI has hidden bombs in Fool's Hope. We have already lost a number of agents to them. Locate the bombs so that our bomb squads can defuse them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Seek out the ICI's bombs in Fool's Hope so they can be defused. The bomb beacon will aid you in your attempts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The bombs you located have been disarmed or triggered and pose no further threat. Unfortunately, more casualties were accrued in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This bomb beacon will let you locate the explosives.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found all the explosives hidden throughout Fool's Hope, though some of the bomb squads sent to disarm them did not survive the procedure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Time is short and our need is great. You dare turn your back on duty?

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Zorango Drel in Camp Continuum wants you to scale up the Time Rocks to reach the Chronometric Manipulator and kill the Calculating Constructl who is interfering with its operational frequencies. He tells me that the Chronometric Manipulator will save me from falling to my death.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Zorango Drel
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nasty elemental Calculating Construct atop the platform is causing frequency interference with new CoGS Chronometric Manipulator atop the platform. Need you to Climb up there and take care of it! If you fall, Manipulator saves you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can't fool me! Calculating Construct is still alive. Get back out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wasn't that easy!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hope you're not afraid of heights!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Many many thanks! Have a feeling we'll be seeing more of those pests! If any more return, I know who to come to!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You weren't lying about the height.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I scaled the Time Rocks and defeated the Calculating Construct.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I say Chronometric Manipulator saves you and you're still scared?!

localizedTextIdText: Despite barely surviving a transport ship crash and being hunted by the Strain, Lulu Blackbush asked you to collect eggs from cryoglider eggsacs. You can find them on the Widowmaker's wreckage, above the giant puddle of hyperspace engine coolant in Cryomere.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our troops are reportin' that they're seein' some new type of gliders flyin' around. If you can, get me some of their eggs so I can study 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need those cryoglider eggs, $(player.name). We're in a horrible place, and I'd like to come away with somethin' instead of nothin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That ain't quite a full dozen, but it'll do. I sure hope these little suckers ain't dangerous when they hatch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let's see if we can't make lemonade outta all these lemons we got.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe these'll help me make some new medicines, or armor....
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can do that for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected the cryoglider eggs scattered across the wreckage of the Widowmaker above the giant puddle of hyperspace engine coolant in Cryomere. Things are looking up for Lulu Blackbush!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get some eggs for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, fine. You don't wanna help, I got no trouble askin' someone else.

localizedTextIdText: The Black Hoods have uncovered Dominion ICI Operatives hiding within Fool's Hope. The Black Hoods can't approach them without fear of scaring them off, but Lucy Lazarin has an idea that may allow you to get close to them undetected.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lucy Lazarin in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ICI agents have been spotted in Fool's Hope. You must dispatch them silently and swiftly. Lucy Lazarin has just the thing to help you succeed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I expect our enemies to meet their doom at your hands, $(player.name). Do not hesitate, for you are not above suspicion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have our enemies been eviscerated yet? Avra intimated that you would be the instrument of their agony.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased that you persevered long enough to destroy the Dominion pests. I will ensure that you do not expire as a result of my elixir.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not allow the intruders to escape.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You aren't one to shy away from danger, are you?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lucy Lazarin provided you with a variety of potions which transformed you into various creatures. This allowed you to approach your enemies in secret and detonate the very explosives they wished to use against your allies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What stays your hand? Is it fear, or something else?

localizedTextIdText: The feral lands of Wilderrun are ripe for the picking, and Fur Trader Starks is just the lady to pick it. With so many creatures in Wilderrun, she doesn't know where to begin. Instead, she wishes to wet her whistle with a sampling of different pelts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Fur Trader Starks via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This place is a gold mine! Well... a fur mine, actually. Bring me some good quality pelts from some of Wilderrun's creatures and I'll pay ya handsome-like.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If ya don't get out there and start skinnin', I'll never get my hands on them pelts you promised me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks fur the bundle! Get it? "Fur" the bundle? Ha! I'm one funny fur trader, yes siree!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck. Remember, I want the best pelts ya can find!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks a bundle! Maybe I oughta work on that one...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought Fur Trader Starks a sampling of pelts from various creatures throughout the wilds of Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya scared of a few small furry critters?

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has alerted you that a Dominion Eradicator Warbot is attempting to breach the bulkhead between the Greenhouse and the life support system. If the warbot isn't stopped soon, it'll destroy the Gambler's Ruin from the inside!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Queen Myala Everstar in the Docking Bay
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dommies brought a warbot with 'em in that damned asteroid! But we'll never get to it with all those Cassian troops around! Thin out their ranks first!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did ya take care of that business we discussed? I hope so, otherwise we're all up crap creek!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it! I knew that warbot wasn't your match. I think you deserve a reward. How about a one-way ticket to Nexus?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit! Don't give them Dommies any mercy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's our best shot at a new home!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I can't wait to get down there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully destroyed the Eradicator Warbot before it could destroy the Gambler's Ruin, thereby winning the day for the Exiles!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Warbots are the Dominion's heavy artillery. They're big, tough, mean, and they pack quite a punch. Worse, this one uses shield generators to restore its shields. You'd best take 'em out or you're gonna have a bad time.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Cassians are upper crust Dominion humans. The way I see it, we gotta pull 'em down off their pedestals and put 'em in their place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you a coward? I'd blow the thing up myself if I wasn't in such bad shape!

localizedTextIdText: Lucy Lazarin has been experimenting on Wilderrun's wildlife. By modifying the beasts' primal patterns, she has managed to give them new abilities and behavior. Unfortunately, the beasts have escaped from their cages and are now running amok just outside Fool's Hope.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lucy Lazarin in Fool's Hope
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My experiments have escaped. I fear they will pose a terrible threat to my fellow Exiles. Please hunt my lab animals down and euthanize them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I fear that I have unleashed a plague of pernicious pets. You must find them and destroy them before they can accomplish any harm.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My lab animals are still at large. I wish to speak with you when you have destroyed them. We have much to discuss.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I occasionally overextend my research into riskier arenas. I suppose such a habit runs in the family.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kill them quickly if you wish to spare my family further shame.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll do my best to kill them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to defeat all of Lucy Lazarin escaped experiments.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll do my best to kill them.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll do my best to kill them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I have modified their primal patterns in an attempt to establish within them new abilities and behaviors. Unfortunately, these modifications have made them malicious.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would deny me this favor after all you have done for my family?

localizedTextIdText: The feral lands of Wilderrun are ripe for the picking, and Fur Trader Fierus is just the gentleman to pick it. With so many creatures in Wilderrun, he doesn't know where to begin. Instead, he wishes to wet his whistle with a sampling of different pelts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Fur Trader Fierus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This place is a gold mine of furs! Where to begin? Let's get 'em all, I say. Bring me a good quality pelt from each of the creatures in Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Remember, I want only the finest pelts. I've an image to uphold, make no mistake!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the time I'm finished here, my pockets will be lined with fur... and gold, too! Even the lowborn can get filthy rich!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: So many creatures to kill, so much money to be made...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We all need hopes and dreams, I suppose.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought Fur Trader Fierus a sampling of pelts from various creatures throughout the wilds of Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Whatever's the matter? Afraid of some small furry critters, are you?

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You find what appears to be a datapad belonging to the deceased Exile scientist Doctor Maggy Terrell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found what appears to be the details of an attempt to recruit rowsdowers in a secluded cave. Objectively, the experiment could even be classified as a moderate success....

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You find what appears to be a datapad belonging to the late Bingo Jami.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found what appeared to be the remains of a Chua scientist's ill-advised attempt to conscript splorg as turret gunners in a secluded cave. You decided not to disturb the results.

localizedTextIdText: Retrieve supplies from misplaced capsules that have been ejected from drop ships. It appears some of the capsules already have been turned inside out by the local wildlife. They have also been wired for defense and may explode if handled incorrectly.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report any found supplies to Morana Jankovic
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The drop ships have missed their target and have scattered our supplies throughout the island. It is imperative you collect these as delicately as possible.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You are wasting time...The supplies are within the capsules that are spread throughout the island. Do not fail me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am most grateful for your efforts. I am aware I did not ask an easy task.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When you complete your task, please seek me out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done! We now have the supplies we need to continue our expedition with much more ease.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully collected the supplies within the capsules. The expedition now have enough supply resources to assist them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A very foolish decision, stranger.

localizedTextIdText: The field researchers are having some security issues while collecting data. You're being dispatched to build tech totems that will generate a shield and other various resources to assist them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your success to Morana Jankovic via communicator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have a vital task for you, Settler. Our researchers are stranded in the field without protection or resources. We need you to build the tech totems within their vicinity.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Clearly I was not clear with my instructions...The researchers are in dire need of protection, build the tech totems around their location.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am glad we have completed this task successfully.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Act quickly, friend. We have little time to waste.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That was a great victory. The researchers are protected and well, your efforts are appreciated, Settler.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully assisted the field researchers by building tech totems to protect them while they continue to collect data and material.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you should rethink your response before it is too late.

localizedTextIdText: You met Pilot Taboro in southern Malgrave. He made some vague mention of a ship under distress, and you decided to help him with his plight by traveling in his beat-up ship into orbit.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pilot Taboro in the Nightflare
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there. Don't suppose you're willing to help out a fella in a bind? Got a distress call I need to respond to, but I need more hands.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Having second thoughts? Just head on in and I'll take you up. You'll be safe in my shuttle, you bet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, she made it up here! It was touch and go for a while, there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit! I'll get the ol' girl here up and running.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I'd be happy to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rode in the shaky Nightflare piloted by Pilot Taboro to dock with a mysterious vessel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why are you out in the middle of nowhere?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: She's got a few dings, but she'll get us where we need to go, you bet.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, heh, my ship needed a few repairs. Nothing to worry about. She's shipshape.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your choice. They sounded desperate, though, that's for sure.

localizedTextIdText: It appears a Rift Primordial has emerged from the torn rift located near the coast. This time anomaly is not from this time or world, destroy it once and for all. Please be prepared to have a party of 2-3 members to complete this task successfully.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your kill success to Morana Jankovic via communicator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have sensed an entity not from our world or time. It is crucial we destroy this Rift Primordial and returning it to its own world.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is of the essence, Settler! We must eliminate this Rift Primordial before it is too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alas, we have prevented such a disaster by destroying this time-lost anomaly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This is a battle for survival, be sure you are prepared...or else.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have truly earned my respect. Your deeds have saved us all in this life and the next.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully destroyed the Rift Primordial. The Isle of Eternity is a place of distorted time, it is important to eliminate lost entities that have drifted through time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mark my words, you will feel my wrath if you choose such a foolish response again.

localizedTextIdText: Lifecaller Eleni has asked you to return the $m(vitem=867) from corrupted Torine Sisters throughout Northern Wilderrun. These idols are sacred and should not be carried by these corrupted abominations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lifecaller Eleni via datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Torine idols are very sacred to us and should only leave a sister's possession when she dies. However, these corrupted abominations should not be allowed to carry them. Kill them, and return their idols to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Return to me once you have collected enough idols from my corrupted sisters...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, $(player.class). Now the healing can begin...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once returned, I can purify them and they can be earned by other Torine Sisters.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped return the $m(vitem=867) to Lifecaller Eleni. Doing so has improved your relations with the Torine Sisterhood.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Lifecaller Eleni via datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You defile our land and then do not help to clean it up?!

localizedTextIdText: Alchemist Zorango Drel in Camp Continuum asked me to gather some $(vitem=874)es from the Pell at Temporal Quarantine 01 for his research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Alchemist Zorango Drel
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good fighter? I hope so. Need you to crack some skulls and bring me $(vitem=874)es. Go to Temporal Quarantine 01. Research demands it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Need those fetishes! Off with you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. Time for research!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kill, kill, kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May need more tomorrow. Come back soon!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I gathered the $(vitem=874)es for Alchemist Zorango Drel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Even dumber than you look.

localizedTextIdText: Soldier Akisa, an officer in the Dominion military, has requested your presence in the Garden of the Vigilant so she may introduce herself. She will help you prepare for your career as a soldier in service to the Dominion on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Soldier Akisa in the Cathedral of Light
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You're the soldier everyone's been talking about. I am Akisa, and I serve the legions. If you intend to be a soldier, you and I must talk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It warms my blood to see another soldier come to join the winning side. I welcome you into our ranks with open arms. For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will wait for you in the Garden of the Vigilant. Good hunting!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will contact you with your first mission soon. Be ready!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Soldier Akisa of the Dominion military in the Garden of the Vigilant. Be ready, for you might receive orders from her at any moment!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. The Dominion military rolls list your name. I am to welcome you into the ranks and - in time - give you your first mission.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, come now. Don't play stupid. We fight the Dominion's foes wherever they are found. We are the strong sword of Emperor Myrcalus!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do I smell fear? Cowardice is not welcome in the ranks of the legions.

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=52520), a scientist of the Royal Collegium, has requested your presence in the Garden of the Vigilant so he may introduce himself. He will help you prepare for your career as a scientist in service to the Dominion on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with $(creature=52520) in the Garden of the Vigilant
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As a representative of the Royal Collegium, I am required to prepare all scientists for the journey ahead. I ask that you meet me outside of the Cathedral of Light.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The secrets of Nexus await our analysis, $(player.name). Once we reach the planetary surface, all manner of wonders will be open to us.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. It is in your best interest to appease the Royal Collegium.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will contact you soon with instructions. Until then, farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with $(creature=52520) of the Royal Collegium in the Garden of the Vigilant. Be prepared for discovery, for you might receive instructions from him at any moment!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That is affirmative. Your name is listed as a scientist in the Collegium's records. I am to welcome you to the Collegium and, eventually, instruct you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Collegium is the scientific arm of the Dominion. We are responsible for researching the many phenomena we are sure to find on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not test my resolve. You are not the only scientist in our employ...

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=52521), an explorer with the Exploration Society, has requested your presence in the Garden of the Vigilant so he may introduce himself. He will help you prepare for an exciting career as an explorer in service to the Exploration Society on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with $(creature=52521) in the Garden of the Vigilant
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You explorer? Feh! Not trained well. $(player.name) bad explorer, very bad. Find me, then you be ready. Will show you how exploring is done! Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You pass first test, found me in Cathedral of Light. Exploration Society chart all of Nexus. Very dangerous. You may die. Be ready!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Need hint? Just outside Cathedral of Light. Will be waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Will send message soon, give you assignment. Now go!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with $(creature=52521) of the Exploration Society in the Garden of the Vigilant. Be prepared for exploration, for you might receive an assignment from him at any moment!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. Very bad. Unskilled. Inexperienced. Fodder for predators. Exploration Society send Grubozz to train you. That way, $(player.name) will have protracted death.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Is big organization for Dominion explorers. Catalogues all discoveries made by explorers. Best of all, rewards all explorers for contributions!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No no! $(player.name) need more training! Very bad explorer! Need my help!

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=52535), a settler with the Settlement Authority, has requested your presence in the Cathedral of Light so she may introduce herself. She intends to help you prepare to settle Nexus on behalf of the Settlement Authority.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with $(creature=52535) in the Cathedral of Light
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As a Settler, you will proudly serve the Dominion Settlement Authority. Come to the Cathedral of Light, for I would like to meet with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Settlement Authority will be monitoring your progress once you reach Nexus. Until then, you will coordinate assignments with me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I look forward to settling Nexus by your side, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our job will not be an easy one, but without us, the Dominion cannot succeed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with $(creature=52535) of the Settlement Authority in the Cathedral of Light. Be prepared, for you will be one of the first people to break ground on Nexus!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Of course you are! The Settlement Authority lists you amongst its members... and you have very high marks, besides. I think you will do quite well.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is an organization dedicated to the Dominion's settlement of Nexus. Our task is to pave the way for the pioneers who will follow us in the years to come.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not turn your back on your peers! You are needed on Nexus!

localizedTextIdText: Sheela Sagebrush in Camp Continuum asked me to collect samples of primal energy from elementals and affected wildlife at the Primal Capacitor Array.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sheela Sagebrush
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Primal Capacitor Array is leaking energy and affecting surrounding wildlife. Sadly, I need you to kill the elementals and infected wildlife to prevent proliferation and collect research samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Back so soon?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Despite the sacrifice of life, you've done a good thing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Your efforts will be eternally celebrated.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If the CoGS require any additional samples in the future, I will be sure to let you know!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I collected sufficient primal energy samples from each elemental type for Sheela Sagebrush.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I expected much more from you.

localizedTextIdText: Sheela Sagebrush in Camp Continuum asked me to use a Scanbot to scan samples of Fungal Slime from organisms that seem to be feeding on the leaking Primal Energy at the Primal Capacitor Array.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sheela Sagebrush
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A new type of fungus is feeding off the Primal Energy leakage at the Primal Capacitor Array. It'd be wonderful if we could harness that power to contain the leak. We could use some readings first though!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We still need more readings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am truly impressed. Hopefully we can make good use of this information and contain that leak!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Wonderful! Take this handy Scanbot with you. Mind your surroundings!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The researchers may require more samples soon so keep checking back!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll try to get those readings for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I gathered sufficient Fungal Slime data for Sheela Sagebrush.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I was afraid you'd say that.

localizedTextIdText: Sheela Sagebrush in Camp Continuum asked me to scout the Primal Synthesis Station for any Ascendancy Surveillance Devices or traps to discreetly neutralize them by phasing them into another time continuum with his Time Shifter device.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sheela Sagebrush
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We think the Ascendancy is planning an attack on the Primal Synthesis Station. Nasty Surveillance devices and hazards have been spotted in the area. Use this Time Shifter to subtly remove them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you disarmed the traps and devices?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That is wonderful to hear! The CoGS are honored by your service!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, you'll really help? Thank you so much! Please be careful.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Ascendancy won't likely give up so easily. I'm sure we will need your help again in the future. Check back with us soon!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do about it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I successfully neutralized the Ascendancy Surveillance Devices and traps.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That makes me sad. I hope you will reconsider, friend.

localizedTextIdText: Sheela Sagebrush in Camp Continuum asked me to neutralize the Radiation Leakage at the Primal Synthesis Station. I can equip these old Hazmat Suits for protection but she warned that they are not very durable.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Sheela Sagebrush
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need a brave adventurer to neutralize the Radiation Leakage at the Camp Continuum. Don't worry, these Hazmat Suits will protect you... for a bit...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Camp Continuum is still highly contaminated with Radiation Leakage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wow! You are truly brave... and you're not even glowing after all of that exposure!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The suits can't handle sustained exposure to high radiation so you'll have to neutralize the Radiation Leakage as fast as possible!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The site is still really unstable and we may need more help again soon. Don't be a stranger!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: I have neutralized Radiation Leakage at the Primal Synthesis Station.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? We can treat you for any accidental exposure here at Camp Continuum. Please reconsider!

localizedTextIdText: Technician Locruk has been experimenting with a Time-Space Cannon that can open and close rifts are will. Though it appears perhaps one of his trial tests have gone completely astray. Morana is concerned his recklessness will cause our expedition to be unsuccessful.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Morana Jankovic via communicator.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Technician Locruk is truly a mad chua! It appears this lunatic has attempted to test his Time-Space cannon without our knowing! Please go to him and ensure he doesn't destroy us all to an eternal darkness.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Were my directions unclear? This Chua has the potential to destroy us all with his foolhardiness! Go and ensure his test is successful.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am most relieved to hear this task was successful and done in a timely manner.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly, Settler! He is impatient as he is crazy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, Settler. We will monitor Technician Locruk's experiments more closely in the future to pervert a possible disaster.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully assisted Technician Locruk under Morana's orders. The rift has successfully been stabilized and the cannon is now under close observation, as is Locruk.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps your mind will change when we are all floating in a void!

localizedTextIdText: Use Discarded Holoprojector to lure Exile troops into the Strain Minefield in the Silverwaste
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Caedis at the Impelling Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These holoprojectors might be able to lure Exile troops into the Strain minefield within the Boiling Cauldron. Pick a mine and toss a projector at it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: These holoprojectors might be able to lure Exile troops into the Strain minefield within the Boiling Cauldron. Pick a mine and toss a projector at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in Dominus's name are you doing?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: While I find your antics amusing, I fear those projectors were not designed to be used in that manner.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Still, I feel a small reward for your ingenuity is called for.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You lured Exile soldiers to a mine-based demise in the Silverwaste by setting up holoprojections of their wounded comrades. It was a cunning and dastardly plan.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Let me give this a try.

localizedTextIdText: Target Strain mines in the Strain minefield in the Boiling Cauldron, then use the holoprojector to lure in some Dominion troops. With any luck, you'll fool a few into blowing themselves up.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Corporal Hauser in the Silverwaste
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These holoprojectors might be able to lure Dominion troops into the Strain minefield in the Boiling Cauldron. Find a mine and toss a projector at it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: These holoprojectors might be able to lure Dominion troops into the Strain minefield in the Boiling Cauldron. Pick a mine and toss a projector at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My stars... what in blazes are you up to?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We were given them things to fool the Strain, but foolin' the Dommies is a good use, too. Looks like it's not such a good idea no more, though.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fool 'em once, shame on you. Fool 'em twice, and they're just plain dumb.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is going to be fun.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess they learned their lesson.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You lured Dominion soldiers to their demise in the Strain minefield in the Boiling Cauldron by setting up holoprojections of their wounded comrades. It was a cunning and dastardly plan.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: This is going to be fun.

localizedTextIdText: The M.A.C. in Settler's Reach has contacted you and suggested you pay it a visit. For a modest fee, the M.A.C. can bring you up to speed and teach you new skills. Exact currency is required.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Use the M.A.C. in Settler's Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to the party, cupcake! If you plan on surviving Nexus, you're gonna need to be trained up.  Come see me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? Trust me, those Yeti's aren't going to wait to have you for supper, so get over here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, well... It's about time! I was about to scout out some burial plots for you, but... seeing as you're here. Let's get to work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: No wasting time! Who knows how long you'll survive out there without my help!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're gonna be good, kid.  Do Nexus a great favor and don't die out there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You visited the M.A.C. in Settler's Reach and used it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, it's your funeral, pal.

localizedTextIdText: You found the remnants of Corporal Hauser unit holding out against the Strain. They were missing one of their comrades, Trooper Richter. You told them to retreat, promising to go to Richter's last known location.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Hauser via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These things got the drop on us. We'd probably be dead if Richter hadn't drawn 'em off. Could you go and find him?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You found Richter yet? I want to get my wounded out of this hellhole. You'd better find him quick-like, or we'll have to leave him behind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can't thank you enough, $(player.name). I hate the thought of leavin' one of my own to die in this place all alone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll send your datachron Richter's last known coordinates.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked down Trooper Richter and fought off the creatures lurking in his vicinity. Corporal Hauser at Camp Quicken thanked you for getting everyone out alive.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I can't risk sendin' any of my troops out by themselves. We're already tryin' to defend our wounded here. I was actually gettin' ready to leave him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If that's how you want to think about it, yep. You're probably his last hope.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What part of "Exiles help each other" don't you understand?

localizedTextIdText: Pappy Grizzleston in Tremor Ridge has introduced you to the wonders of loftite. For every bit you bring to the Town Mineralogist, your reputation with the Algoroc Accord will grow ever higher. You can also improve your reputation by defeating the enemies of the Algoroc Accord: the Deadstar Marauders of Deadstar Ravine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Merchant Holdster in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The loftite 'round here can bring fame and riches! Collect enough of it, and ya might just impress the right kind o' people.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: How goes it there, $(player.name)? You dig up any of that loftite yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes? Can I help ya with somethin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've arrived, buck. As your reputation with the Algoroc Accord grows, you'll gain access to higher quality equipment. It's the Algoroc way!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Algoroc Accord is always lookin' out for the hard-workin' folk.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Please take a look at what I've got for sale.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll show you what I can do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Merchant Holdster in Tremor Ridge was so impressed by your efforts that he's extended an invitation to you to peruse his wares. If you continue collecting loftite and defeating Deadstar Marauders, you'll be beloved by the Algoroc Accord in no time.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm still trying to prove my worth.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Does the Algoroc Accord have any enemies?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Algoroc Accord is a collection of miners, prospectors, and other hard-workin' types what make a livin' off the loftite found here in Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Algoroc Accord sorta watches over Exile business in Algoroc. Not a government as such, but you'd do well to get on their good side.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Algoroc Accord takes care of the Exiles of Algoroc, the folk what live here. The more they like ya, the more they're willin' to give ya.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Well, they ain't exactly friendly with them Deadstar Marauders. If you could head down to Deadstar Ravine and put down a few of those Marauders, I'm sure the Algoroc Accord would look kindly on it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? You 'fraid of a little recognition?

localizedTextIdText: You found the remnants of Captain Caediss unit holding out against the Strain. They were missing one of their comrades, Commando Sunder. You told them to retreat, promising to go to Sunder's last known location.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Caedis via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These things have got us in a bind. If Sunder hadn't drawn off the majority of them, we'd likely be dead by now. I fear we'll have to leave him behind.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found Sunder yet? He won't stand a chance out there by himself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Bravely done, $(player.name). Sunder tends to get carried away at times. But that selfsame quality is what makes him an invaluable comrade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll send Sunder's last known location to your datachron.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was no trouble at all.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tracked down Commando Sunder and fought off the creatures lurking in his vicinity. Captain Caedis at Impelling Station thanked you for getting everyone out alive.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I won't send anyone on their own, and we are too few in number for us to defend the wounded otherwise. I was considering leaving him when you showed up.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If that's how you want to think of it, yes. You're probably his last hope.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you remember this day should you ever require a rescue.

localizedTextIdText: Kanok the Giant Slayer has posted a bounty on Hagus the Colossus, a giant outside Thermock Hold who's threatening control of Whitevale. He's willing to reward anyone willing to kill the beast for him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kanok the Giant Slayer in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This rib belonged to Hagus the Colossus, a giant that's been terrorizing the area. You should report the giant's death to Kanok the Giant Slayer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya killed the giant! Here's some money. If anyone asks ya, I was the one that killed that giant, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's a lil somethin' extra. Remember, - ix - nay on the iant-jay. Tell 'em I did it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Hagus the Colossus and reported your success to Kanok the Giant Slayer. He paid you well for your trouble, and reminded you to keep your mouth shut about helping him out on this one.

localizedTextIdText: Major Glacian Aurelius has posted a bounty on the Bounty Board in Palerock Post. A giant outside Palerock Post is threatening the Dominion's control of Whitevale, and the major is willing to reward anyone who dares to kill the beast.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Major Glacian Aurelius via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This rib belonged to Traggis the Colossus, a giant that had been the root of much strife. You should report the giant's death to Major Aurelius.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Reconnaissance units have reported the giant, Traggis, has met a swift end by your hand. Splendid. Your loyalty and bravery are worthy of commendation.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Traggis the Colossus and reported your success to Major Glacian Aurelius. The major paid you well for the deed, and commended you on your loyalty to the Dominion.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Eldan control panel seems easy to operate, although its purpose is unclear.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This Eldan control panel seems easy to operate, although its purpose is unclear.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I should see what this does.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a mysterious panel inside Exo-Lab 729 that controlled a "primal disruptor." After activating the panel, you unleashed the disruptor's terrible power on gronyx in nearby containment cells.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: What am I doing here, you ask? Ha ha! Oh, um... just exploring this wreckage here... you know... explorer stuff.... $(self.visual=25762)
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Nooks Barkbiter hiding in some debris near the crash site, neglecting his duties and enjoying the warmth of the wreckage fire instead of risking the frigid cold. He promised not to slack off again... now that he's been caught.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As you stare across the frozen land of Northern Wilds, you stand defiant. You've overcome impossible odds. Now your journey on Nexus has truly begun!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Before departing the Northern Wilds, you planted a banner in Camp Icefury. It will stand as a triumphant symbol of the tenacity of the Exiles, as well as a reminder of your first adventure on Nexus.

localizedTextIdText: You've jury-rigged a datachron to work with Eldan technology in Seaspine Forest. It should serve as a signal booster for Artemis Zin and her broadcasts. Whatever this technology was originally designed for can be investigated later, but for now, the show must go on.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Eldan technology is in an optimal location to boost Artemis Zin's broadcast signal. Maybe you can patch it together with a spare datachron.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This Eldan technology is in an optimal location to boost Artemis Zin's broadcast signal. Maybe you can patch it together with a spare datachron.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've jury-rigged a datachron to work with Eldan technology in Seaspine Forest. It should serve as a signal booster for Artemis Zin and her broadcasts. Whatever this technology was originally designed for can be investigated later, but for now, the show must go on.

localizedTextIdText: You've stumbled upon a large pile of partially digested girrok treats in Greyshore. In the middle of the pile was an important looking Exile document... but how did it end up there?
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is a large and smelly pile of what appears to be fresh girrok vomit. A scrap of chewed paper is mixed in with the partially digested meat.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is a large and smelly pile of what appears to be fresh girrok vomit. A scrap of chewed paper is mixed in with the partially digested meat.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: It's gross, but I'll grab the paper.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It's gross, but I'll grab the paper.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You stumbled upon a large pile of partially digested girrok treats in Greyshore. In the middle of the pile was an important looking Exile document... but how did it end up there?

localizedTextIdText: You've found a suspicious pile of rocks on the island of Alain's Refuge in Levian Bay. You discovered the bones of a male Cassian highborn beneath the rocks with a knife in his back. Initials on the knife's hilt read "A.G." Was this... murder?
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These rocks appear to be covering bones! Human bones!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These rocks appear to be covering bones! Human bones!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Perhaps I should move these rocks.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Perhaps I should move these rocks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a suspicious pile of rocks on the island of Alain's Refuge in Levian Bay. You discovered the bones of a male Cassian highborn beneath the rocks with a knife in his back. Initials on the knife's hilt read "A.G." Was this... murder?

localizedTextIdText: Field Medic Lutton in the De-Probing Center has asked you to help with "de-probing" citizens that have fallen victim to abduction by the alien Ikthians.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Field Medic Lutton in the De-Probing Center that you have finished your de-probing work
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mind lending me a hand, luv? So many citizens have fallen victim to the aliens, and I can't keep up with all this de-probing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: De-probe anyone yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a right piece of work, luv! Glad to see you had the stomach for it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lend a hand, then. I'm getting tired and me gloves are chafing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have done your part doing the dirty work of de-probing the citizens of Ellevar. You're not sure what's worse - getting probed or getting de-probed.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Uh... I'm working up to it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: That's right, de-probing. Those aliens been having their way with our citizens, they have.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Inserting probes in unmentionable places. Horrible, it is, and inhumane. Someone's got to get them probes out, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Those probes won't come out by themselves.

localizedTextIdText: You stumbled upon the remains of an unfortunate Mordesh alchemist in Mystwood Forest. He looks like he was exposed to a dreadfully destructive radioactive substance that pooled nearby. The liquid not only took his life, but also left his flesh so corroded that only his paramour could recognize him. Alas, the perils of alchemical curiosity ended their love too soon.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These are the remains of an unfortunate Mordesh alchemist. He looks like he was exposed to a dreadfully destructive substance that pools nearby.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These are the remains of an unfortunate Mordesh alchemist. He looks like he was exposed to a dreadfully destructive substance that pools nearby.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What a horrible way to die!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What a horrible way to die!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You stumbled upon the remains of an unfortunate Mordesh alchemist in Mystwood Forest. He looks like he was exposed to a dreadfully destructive radioactive substance that pooled nearby. The liquid not only took his life, but also left his flesh so corroded that only his paramour could recognize him. Alas, the perils of alchemical curiosity ended their love too soon.

localizedTextIdText: Fort Dominus is a missionary installation set up near the coast of the barren desert of Malgrave. The sands of Malgrave are harsh and treacherous, but several neutral factions - the Lopp and Protostar - have already begun to claim its treasures. Raumia's emissary awaits you near the landing pad.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Vigilant Acolyte Elzara at the landing pad in Shinysand Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm flying another group of troops and priests to the mission at Fort Dominus in Malgrave. Raumia needs all the hands she can get in that desert...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Priestess Raumia in Fort Dominus needs help in Malgrave. She's playing diplomat to the Lopp colony there. Find her emissary when the ship lands.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: May I help you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Greetings, $(player.name). Raumia demands your service. I've little doubt she'll contact you shortly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm sure she'll be glad for the extra help.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You should make your way to Fort Dominus, lest the sands swallow you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Malgrave? I think I can handle this.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll be waiting for her call.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You landed in Malgrave, already a hotbed of activity, and met with Vigilant Acolyte Elzara, Raumia's emissary.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can you tell me about Malgrave?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Malgrave is sand as far as the eye can see, but there's much potential.  Fort Dominus was established as a missionary and military installation.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Besides the wretched Exiles, there's a Lopp trading post near the Fort. I hear Protostar is also mining far to the north... well, and there's... hmmm...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We're not the first humans out there. There was a mining town, Gravestone, not long ago. But our records show no activity there for some time. It's a ghost town, so they say.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I've no time for the unfaithful!

localizedTextIdText: Redsand Station is the hub for Exile settlers in the deserts of Malgrave. The sandy and harsh desert is proving more than Sally Kettleshaw can handle, and she needs help ensuring the settlers' needs are met. Fly to Malgrave and see how you can help out.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Kiris Whitefeather in Shinysand Oasis near the landing pad
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good timing. Sally Kettleshaw out in Malgrave was looking for a merc to help her and the other settlers out at Redsand Station. You in?
