localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Fly out to Malgrave and meet Sally Kettleshaw's contact. I'll be she's just itchin' to have another person to bust some rocks for her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Can I help you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to see you, $(player.name)! I'll just radio Sally that you're here, if she hasn't called you up already! Glad you got here in one piece!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great, I'll radio ahead. She'll send someone to meet up with ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You can find Sally Kettleshaw over in Redsand Station. She's waiting!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Sally Kettleshaw sent you a welcoming committee in the form of Kiris Whitefeather. He radioed her, told her of your arrival, and sent you off to Redsand Station.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Can you tell me about Malgrave?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well, there's sand... hellroses... boulderbacks... and lots more sand. Not pretty. But there's probably somethin' valuable under all that sand, right?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You mean besides the damn Dominion? Well, the Lopp already set up a trading post or two. Protostar's minin' up in the north. Well, that and... uh...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Well, see, we're not the first people out here. There was a human mining town, Gravestone, bit of a while back. But it's nothing but a ghost town now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Eh, no flint off my nose...

localizedTextIdTitle: Look What the Eldan Dregged In
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've found an active Eldan control panel. Activating it should result in an interesting demonstration of Eldan technology.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see what this button does....
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Let's see what this button does....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You pressed a button in an Eldan Exo-Lab and teleported a Dreg into a nearby stasis chamber. It violently recycled the unfortunate creature.

localizedTextIdText: Though you've disarmed the Dominion's Primal F-Bomb, Belle Walker is concerned that the relics and lore stored in the Relic Room may still be in danger. She's asked you to collect several objects to ensure they'll be protected should the worst comes to pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Belle Walker in the Relic Room
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The bomb's disarmed, but the Dominion's stubborn. They'll be back if they get half a chance. Can ya help me collect up some of these relics, sugar?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I don't know how much time we got, $(player.name). Gather up them things I told you about so we can skedaddle!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great job helpin' me collect my daddy's things. This stuff's valuable! Plus, I'm hopin' ya learned a thing or two in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks, darlin'! I can't just leave 'em here with all the Dommies sniffin' around.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for all your help, sugar. I'm sure I'll see you around!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Belle Walker collect both relics and valuable lore in the Relic Room, thereby ensuring they will survive if the Dominion's plans are eventually successful.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you need me to collect?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My daddy's copy of the Galactic Explorer's Handbook, my favorite issue of TALES FROM BEYOND THE FRINGE!, and, most importantly, the Nexus Datacube.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You ain't heard of it? It's one of my favorite magazines. There's always such interestin' stories in 'em, and I always learn somethin' new when I read 'em.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It's a relic my daddy found on Nexus. It's chock full of data about the planet and the Eldan, but it brings up more questions that it really answers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought you were a real hero. I'm guessin' I was wrong.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have failed the Dominion, $(player.class). I cannot face General Warbringer with the stench of defeat upon me. Grant me the only fate acceptable for the unworthy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Tell my father... Elder Torvak... in Bloodfire Village... I died... with honor....
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: If this is what you really want....
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered a Draken prisoner in Megatech Station. Unable to face the shame of defeat and the dishonor of being captured, she asked you to put her out of her misery.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would have me live in shame?

localizedTextIdTitle: For the Glory of the Dominion
localizedTextIdText: You found the corpse of a Chua inexplicably reaching for a glob of honey near some buzzbing hives in Bloodbloom Vale. After reviewing his datachron, you learned that one of the Dominion's commanding officers sent the unfortunate Chua to retrieve some honey for his afternoon tea.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Chua's last act was to reach for a glob of buzzbing honey. Perhaps reviewing his datachron will shed light on what happened to him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This Chua's last act was to reach for a glob of buzzbing honey. Perhaps reviewing his datachron will shed light on what happened to him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the corpse of a Chua inexplicably reaching for a glob of honey near some buzzbing hives in Bloodbloom Vale. After reviewing his datachron, you learned that one of the Dominion's commanding officers sent the unfortunate Chua to retrieve some honey for his afternoon tea.

localizedTextIdText: Though the Aurin people are unusually empathetic toward the creatures of the forest, Tender Choshi was still unceremoniously trampled to death by rampaging dawngrazers in Mystwood Forest. A powerful force must be driving these normally peaceful woodland creatures to be so violently aggressive.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Aurin's satchel contains food meant to calm the dawngrazers. Perhaps she was attempting to soothe the animals when they killed her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This Aurin's satchel contains food meant to calm the dawngrazers. Perhaps she was attempting to soothe the animals when they killed her.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though the Aurin people are unusually empathetic towards the creatures of the forest, Tender Choshi was still unceremoniously trampled to death by rampaging dawngrazers in Mystwood Forest. A powerful force must be driving these normally peaceful woodland creatures to be so violently aggressive.

localizedTextIdText: It seems the ship's Relic Room is filled with enemy bombs, and Belle Walker is trapped there due to a busted teleporter. Commander Durek suspects it's the work of Dominion saboteurs, and he's ordered you to rescue Belle before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Belle Walker in the Relic Room
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Belle Walker's trapped inside the Relic Room, and the Dominion's rigged it to explode. Get yer keester down there and make sure she makes it out in one piece.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Ya ain't fumbled your way to the Relic Room yet? If those Dommie bombs harm one hair on Belle's head, I'll smoke ya myself!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh, hey... where'd ya come from, sugar? Did Durek send ya?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Commander said he'd send someone down to help me out. I guess that'd be you, hmm?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't keep Miss Walker waitin'. Ya hear me, trooper?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: So, let me ask ya a serious question. How do ya feel about bombs?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your way to the Relic Room and found Belle Walker and her two bots trapped inside.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Belle's the daughter of Dorian Walker, the explorer that discovered Nexus. She's a brilliant scientist, and she's ain't hard on the eyes, either, if ya get my drift.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya disobeyin' a direct order, recruit? 'Cause that wasn't no request.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello? Hello? You! Yes, you! Remote broken, need to turn on camera! Do it now!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a Surveillance Camera near the water. When you activated it, it turned out to be part of Mondo Zax method for disposing of assistants who have failed him... one that involves aerial bombardment and explosions. Good thing you don't work for the Zax on a permanent basis.

localizedTextIdText: A doomed treasure hunter met his end attempting to make off with a golden idol in the Ethereal Cavity. Though his identity is a mystery, maybe you can show everyone how it's done by taking the idol for yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Archaeologist Luciano in the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This poor treasure hunter met a very painful end in an attempt to snatch a golden idol. Even though he's dead, you should show him how it's done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There must be treasure in those caves. If only someone like you would brave the depths of that horrible grotto and return with its untold riches!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By Dominus, Tresayne, and all the Scions! That is the most beautiful golden idol I have ever seen! I must have it... name your price!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's yours! This belongs in a museum!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm going to take that idol.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You chose wisely and pilfered the golden idol in the Ethereal Cavity. Though you may not be rich, you were able to score a little wealth by selling the idol to Archaeologist Luciano at the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm going to take that idol.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It seems the golden idol sits on a pressure-sensitive pedestal that triggers security measures when disturbed. If you can replace the idol with a bag, you can fool the trap and escape with the treasure!

localizedTextIdText: Something has caused Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's endless army of augmented creatures to go rogue. The Caretaker has asked you to reestablish the facility's defenses and reboot its systems. To do so, you will need to collect materials to repair the Eldan sentry turret.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must reestablish this facility's defenses. While I can teleport a damaged sentry turret in, you will need to gather the proper parts and repair it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you collected the materials necessary to repair the turret support systems? I lack the physical body to do so, which is why I require you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Quite the "shopping list" you've gathered, $(player.name). Without too many "cooks in the kitchen," you should have little trouble with this next step.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I shall await your swift completion of this task, sapient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Are my euphemisms distracting you? I apologize.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Why are you talking like that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Caretaker asked you to collect materials to repair the Eldan sentry turret defense system in Bio-Mech Facility Alpha.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where can I get these parts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You must locate coolant regulators, system boards, plasma generator coils, and laser focusing lenses.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The augmented mammodin should have compatible coolant regulators integrated into their systems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: System boards can be found in piles of debris, while plasma generator coils and laser focusing lenses can be found near the emplacement.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose today is as good as any day for the world to end.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has dispatched several Eldan Repair Construct to perform the necessary repairs on the Eldan sentry turret while you protect them from an endless army of rogue augmented creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A fleet of constructs will begin rebuilding the turret once you activate the energizers. You must defend them while they work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The sentry turret remains offline. This situation is no laughing matter, sapient. Do you see me laughing? Of course not.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased to hear that Eldan resources were used with maximum efficiency. My masters would be pleased if they were, in fact, here to observe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The energizers are located at the bottom of the turret's four legs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I look forward to more of your dangerous exploits.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hey, I guess that's high praise.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You protected the Caretaker's Eldan Repair Construct from a seemingly endless army of rogue augmented creatures while they repaired the Eldan sentry turret.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Are you sure about rebuilding this turret?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Could you send some constructs to fight, too?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Without stemming the tide of rogue augmentations, the chances of you reaching your second objective inside the lab is 0%. Reestablishing our defenses will increase those same chances by at least 8.18%.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Our resources and construct labor force have been reduced to minimal levels, sapient. I would much rather deal with this situation without your questionable assistance, but I cannot. No offense, of course.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You display a peculiar lack of commitment, sapient.

localizedTextIdText: A group of XAS scientists ventured into a newly discovered cave, and Trooper Gorok believes the spiders in the cave must be responsible for their disappearance. Gorok would like you to search for the scientists in the Skittering Grotto.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Gorok via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A research team went out to investigate some cave, and I ain't heard from 'em since. You mind headin' over there and takin' a look?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found our scientists in the Skittering Grotto yet? Well, get back out there and find 'em before they're turned into spider food!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great work out there! Aside from some webs stuck to 'em, the scientists you saved are in tip-top shape. They can't say enough good things about ya.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope these here spiders didn't get the jump on our team. I hate spiders!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the captured XAS scientists in the Skittering Grotto and freed them from the spiders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That ain't the answer I'd expect from you...

localizedTextIdText: The enemy has created a Clone of Stormtalon{p:Clones of Stormtalon} using primal pattern data stored by the Eldan in the Genetic Archives. When loosed upon the combined forces of the Dominion and the Exiles, it was shot out of the sky by the Eldan sentry turret... but it still lives. You will need to go to the entrance of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha and destroy it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker at the teleporter into the Conduit
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Eldan sentry turret is a very powerful weapon, but it failed to destroy our enemy's latest weapon - a clone of Stormtalon. You must finish it off.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The clone of Stormtalon will not cease its rampaging until you kill it. This will require you to fight. I assumed you knew how this worked.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Obviously, my statistical calculation subroutine requires calibration. I was sure you would be obliterated by Stormtalon's clone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even at 33% capacity, I suspect this clone will challenge you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You are either highly skilled or incredibly fortunate. Perhaps you are both.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad to prove you wrong.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite being injured by a blast from the Eldan sentry turret, the Clone of Stormtalon{p:Clones of Stormtalon} was still more than a match for you. Even so, you were able to overcome the creature, thereby clearing your way to enter the Spire.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Of course I know how it works.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A clone of Stormtalon. It was obviously created in the Eldan Genetic Archives by our usurpers. Luckily for us, it is imperfect.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The genetic data of all species on Nexus are mapped and stored therein, along with technology and resources to recreate a creature from said data. It's really quite simple.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose the last few hours of your pitiful life weren't a complete waste.

localizedTextIdText: The Black Hoods have chosen to exploit the chaotic situation within Bio-Mech Facility Alpha by sending you to harvest secret Eldan data from the External Interface Terminals inside the Conduit.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: COVERT OPERATION:\nThe Black Hoods seek agent for retrieval of Eldan data from External Interface Terminals within Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Conduit.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: COVERT OPERATION:\nThe Black Hoods seek agent for retrieval of Eldan data from External Interface Terminals within Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Conduit.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Given the volatility of this situation, we must expedite our extraction of information from the Eldan equipment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: As always, your attempts to access information on our behalf are appreciated. I am interested to find out what, if anything, you have unearthed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As always, I will be watching you, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hopefully it was worth the effort.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected secret Eldan data from the External Interface Terminals inside Bio-Mech Facility Alpha's Conduit and transferred it to Avra Darkos.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can dig up.

localizedTextIdText: You met Captain Milo in Lightreach Mission in Ellevar. The hapless captain is in a bind, for his asteroid mining settlement, M-13, has been infested by strange aliens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Milo on the bridge of the Steady Traveler
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My mine on Asteroid M-13's infested with aliens, don't you know? I'm looking for some folks to go up there with me and wipe out the xenomorph menace!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you waiting for? The transport's right here. Hop aboard and head for the stars! Navigator willing, I'll meet you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome aboard! Let's get to work taking care of the mine, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take this transport to my ship, the Steady Traveler. I'll meet you on the bridge, ayep!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You climbed aboard the Steady Traveler and headed to the asteroid classified as Outpost M-13 to help Captain Milo with his alien problems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Strange, parasitical creatures. I haven't seen them myself, but if the distress calls are any indication, they're quite frightful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you reconsider. I can pay well for your time.

localizedTextIdText: You met Captain Milo in Belabog Containment Camp in Celestion. The hapless captain is in a bind, for his asteroid mining settlement, M-13, has been infested by strange aliens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Milo on the bridge of the Steady Traveler
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My mine on Asteroid M-13's infested with aliens, don't you know? I'm looking for some folks to go up there with me and wipe out the xenomorph menace!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What're you waiting for? The transport's right here. Hop aboard and head for the stars! Navigator willing, I'll meet you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome aboard! Let's get to work taking care of the mine, yeah?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take this transport to my ship, the Steady Traveler. I'll meet you on the bridge, ayep!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You climbed aboard the Steady Traveler and headed to the asteroid classified as Outpost M-13 to help Captain Milo with his alien problems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Strange, parasitical creatures. I haven't seen them myself, but if the distress calls are any indication, they're quite frightful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you reconsider. I can pay well for your time.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has an Eldan construct spawner that can teleport reinforcements to the surface of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. First, you need to activate a platform for the spawner to arrive on, and then protect it until it completes its delivery of constructs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: SERVICE INQUIRY:\nGuards required. Protect Eldan construct spawner on surface of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. Proceed to surface and engage defense protocols.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: SERVICE INQUIRY:\nGuards required. Protect Eldan construct spawner on surface of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha. Proceed to surface and engage defense protocols.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Reinforcement constructs are required. An Eldan construct spawner has been teleported to the facility's surface and must be defended.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Construct spawning has been completed. Your defensive protocols have impressed me. I am still analyzing your actions for future reference.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I require this information on the off chance I must terminate you myself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defended an Eldan construct spawner for the Caretaker as it delivered reinforcement constructs to the surface of Bio-Mech Facility Alpha.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin requires a clean work environment for his research into the Strain's potential effect on the Contagion. An exo-lab in the Gilded Fields has been shielded from the Strain's effects by a series of exanite pillars, and Lazarin believes it may be sterile enough to accommodate his research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Locate Lucy Lazarin in Exo-Lab Z42
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A nearby exo-lab may be the answer to my prayers for a pristine workplace. Search among the exanite pillars for the lab and see if it is suitable.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Without a sterile environment in which to attend to my endeavors, the potential of my experiment will never be realized. Find me a suitable site at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Rarely have I tried to fabricate a facility for my father's research in a place such as this. Still, I am certain I can manage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My father advised me of your impending arrival. Welcome to our new lab, such as it is. I assure you, these threadbare accommodations are temporary.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Perhaps you will see my daughter Lucy along the way.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Each new project has the potential for prosperity.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Don't be so hard on yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After traveling to Exo-Lab Z42 in the Gilded Fields, you met up with Lucy Lazarin at a crude laboratory that she'd set up for her father's use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal is not the position I would prefer you take.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin has set up an enclave deep within Blighthaven to study the Strain. He hypothesizes he can use the Strain's corruption to keep the Mordesh Contagion at bay without the necessity for Vitalus. He's asked you to help his experiments by acquiring $m(vitem=931) in the Harrowing Heights.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin at the Aurelian Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The conclusion to the Mordesh community's calamity is close at hand! I challenge you to gather samples of grimwort to further my research.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Grimwort is derived from the debased dirt beneath our very feet! Lure the perverted plants out and collect only the freshest samples for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These specimens shall suffice. Now to distill the grimwort down to its molecular components. To do so, I require a sterile scientific sanctuary.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The secret to stemming the contagion lies in the Strain's corruption.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have not yet exhausted your usefulness. There is more to do.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can dig up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=931) for Victor Lazarin in the Harrowing Heights to further his research into the Strain, but now it seems he has other plans for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get to work right away.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you have in mind?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We Mordesh are dependent on Vitalus Serum, as you should well know. Here in Blighthaven, our supplies of this panacea slowly diminish. It behooves me to look for another source.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Strain mutates and devours all things. If we can harness the Strain's destructive power to combat the Contagion, we may find some value in its malignance.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: That remains to be seen. Even if the Strain can destroy the Contagion, how do we destroy the Strain once its job is done?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no concept of the Contagion's nefarious nature? Well?

localizedTextIdText: According to Lucy Lazarin, exanite can be used as a purification agent in her father's experiments. She's asked you to collect exa-bulbs, exanite-encrusted flowers, from the Ethereal Caverns to further his research into fighting the Contagion with the Strain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin in Exo-Lab Z42
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ethereal Caverns are nearby. Exa-bulbs, exanite-encrusted flowers with purifying qualities, grow there. Go now and return with some bulbs.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The exa-bulbs are vital to our venture. Seek them out within the nearby Ethereal Caverns and collect what flowers you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you commenced with your labors on Lucy's behalf? The purest exa-bulbs are required if we are to make progress with our predicament.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that our reagents are ready and our systems have been specified, your real work will begin. Fear not, for Lucy will assist you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not despair, for the darkness is not as dreadful as death.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My heart, often stilled and lifeless, now pulses with passion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a number of exa-bulbs, as well as an efflorescent exa-bloom, from the Ethereal Caverns in order to assist Victor Lazarin with his research into curing the Contagion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Darkness is not as frightening as disease, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin equipment is set up and ready to synthesize a potential cure for the Contagion. He's asked you to control the catalyzer in the Catalyst Room while Lucy Lazarin controls the synthesizer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have assembled a catalyzer and a synthesizer within Exo-Lab Z42. You must control the catalyzer while my daughter controls the synthesizer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your task is not yet complete! Synthesis has not been achieved! How can you hope to help by returning to me prematurely?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The laboratory is lost! We must retreat and preserve our research. The Strain must sense our aspirations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Though precision is required, do not despair. I will guide you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now our chance of success rests upon the edge of a razor!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though Victor Lazarin potential cure for the Contagion has been synthesized in Exo-Lab Z42, the Strain have overrun his laboratory. Lucy Lazarin currently has the untested cure, but the job is far from finished.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is a device which introduces the correct quantities of reagents into the mixture. You must monitor the catalyzer to ensure the compounds are in proper proportion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Do not concern yourself. Lucy will oversee the synthesis reaction, and will advise you when to introduce new compounds. Then you will enter the precise amount she requires.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Very well. Your name will not be found amongst my research notes.

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin laboratory has been overrun by the Strain, and he and Lucy Lazarin have been forced to take shelter in Exo-Lab Z42's decontamination room. Follow them and defend them from the Strain outbreak before it's too late!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Victor Lazarin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain surrounds us! Lucy and I must retreat to the decontamination room, and we would appreciate your assistance!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is wrong with Lucy? What has happened to my daughter? Quickly! Help her!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My child is lost! A father should never live to see his children die! It was my fault... all of it. This never would have happened if not for my sins!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come at once! We must survive to verify the vaccine's value!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Rubbish! There is naught left to me but dust and ashes!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hold tight! I'm on my way!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite your efforts to save her, Lucy Lazarin has been terminally infected by the Strain. Though it appeared to be a promising solution to the Contagion's grip, the new Vitalus Vaccine was unstable and Lucy ultimately succumbed to the Strain's corruption.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fiend! I curse you from the depths of my despair!

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin experiment was a failure, and he lost his only daughter in the process. Find him in the Harrowing Heights and learn what he intends to do next.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin in the Harrowing Heights
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Rot and ruin are fast friends, are they not? Without Lucy, I may as well abandon my avocation. I seek your council, for I know not which course to take.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My melancholy cannot be undone! Lucy is lost, the Contagion is incurable, and my people are predestined to perish due to my pestilence.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: After much meditation, I have decided that you are correct. Abandoning my quest is unthinkable. Lucy is but one life, but millions of Mordesh remain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We shall see. My world has been laid waste and I have much to consider.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Despair will not determine my destiny.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Even though his daughter, Lucy, has been lost to him, Victor Lazarin does not intend to give up his pursuit of a cure for the Contagion. Though his experiment was a tragic failure, he thanked you for your help and sent you on your way.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Don't be such a downer, doc.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So be it. My time is done and the legacy of the Mordesh people is in ruins.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Floodbough has lost faith in the lab technicians' ability to kill Strain creatures, so he's asked you to do it. Search the area surrounding the Harrowing Heights and waste any Strain beasts you find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Floodbough via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You look tough, unlike these lab techs. The lot of 'em are worthless for killin'. But you, I reckon, can clean house around here. Care to help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Harrowin' Heights ain't safe, partner, and they're even less safe with all them Strain critters runnin' wild. Do us all a favor and wipe 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You came through for me, $(player.name), and I want to thank you proper-like. So... thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! Now get out there and give them Strain critters a whoopin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go far, now. We might need your help again real soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Captain Floodbough request, you went hunting for Strain creatures in the Harrowing Heights. Needless to say, you succeeded at killing a number of the disgusting beasts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lazarin demanded a base with a bunch of turrets out here. That's ain't goin' to be enough to keep him safe, so I want a preemptive strike. Go out there and mow some of 'em down!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're already spread too thin, friend. We need folks like you to help us out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I reckon maybe you are as worthless as these lab techs.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your results to Captain Floodbough via Datachron

localizedTextIdText: Mysterious objects have been sighted floating in the skies above the Gilded Fields. Captain Floodbough has asked you to investigate these objects and determine whether or not they're dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Floodbough via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's these things flyin' in the air over Gilded Fields. You seen 'em? We need to find out what they are, and whether or not they're bad news.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You checked out them flyin' things yet? We need to confirm whether they're hostile or not. You ask me, this whole place is one big, ugly cesspool.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those things are just a product of primal life and exanite bein' in close proximity. That's the best news I've had all stinkin' day.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Last I saw, they were clustered around a teleporter. Be careful!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good thing you were here. Weren't no one else with guts enough to go.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your investigation into the mysterious objects over the Gilded Fields revealed they are the by-product of primal life and exanite being in such close proximity to one another. As such, they present no threat to the Exiles in Blighthaven, and everyone feels much better now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You jackass. Them things could be dangerous, understand?

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax and his research team intend to weaponize the Strain for the Dominion and use its destructive power against the Exiles. He's ordered you to help his experiments by acquiring $m(vitem=931) in the Harrowing Heights.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax at the Titian Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strain will be perfect weapon to squash Exiles. Mondo wants it, so you will help. Collect base ingredients from grimwort plants. Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Use tremor devices, make ground tremble. Will bring grimwort to surface. Then smash smash smash and extract samples. No more waiting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good good! Samples still warm! Perfect for dissection and analysis. Mondo thinks this requires bigger lab. Thinks you are one to find it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mondo like you. So be fast! Get best samples! Quick quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You still alive. Skill or luck? Mondo not care, he just want results.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected $m(vitem=931) for Mondo Zax in the Harrowing Heights to further his research into the Strain, but now it seems he has other plans for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then Mondo will use $(player.name) as part of control group.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax wants to use Strain corruption to create the ultimate weapon. He requires a sterile environment where he can put the samples you've collected to good use. According to his intern, such a place might be found inside an Exo-Lab in the Auric Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Locate Furlo Gre in Exo-Lab Y23
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You seen golden plains? Gold keeps purple out, but Mondo not certain why. Go there, meet idiot intern, find good place for sterile lab space.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Find new lab yet? How about idiot intern? Mondo is not patient Chua. Results expected last week. Now move move!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lab dirty! I clean lab for the Zax. The Zax hates filth in lab almost as much as he hates me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You work for the Zax? Good good! Was waiting for new helper to come. Lab almost ready to ratchet. You think the Zax will like? Hm?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: For $p(player.name) sake, Mondo hope intern not dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Zax probably flip coin. Heads, he like lab. Tails, he explode me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Furlo Gre inside Exo-Lab Y23. He has already set up a rudimentary lab for Mondo Zax and is tidying up in preparation for his arrival.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: When Mondo create Strain super-weapon, he test it on you first.

localizedTextIdText: According to Furlo Gre, Mondo says that exanite can be used to create flasks that can securely hold Strain samples. To create these flasks, Furlo would like you to collect exa-bulbs, exanite-encrusted flowers, from the Empyreal Caverns inside Exo-Lab Y23.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax in Exo-Lab Y23
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Zax most brilliant Chua ever! Says flasks made of exanite can safely store Strain. First step, collect exa-bulbs from Empyreal Caverns!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Exa-bulbs are exanite-encrusted flowers. Finest grade of exanite, easy to work with. You go, find exa-bulbs, bring back, give me credit. Okay?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What what? Mondo busy! Go see idiot intern for next chore before Mondo reconsider keeping you around.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Exa-bulbs make perfect flasks for Strain containment. Now is time for real fun, Mondo style! You and idiot intern help Mondo, or else.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Caverns frightening. Try to be brave!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not ask. You not like answer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected a number of exa-bulbs, as well as an efflorescent exa-bloom, from the Empyreal Caverns so that Mondo Zax can create flasks capable of securing the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sure? Wouldn't go into scary cave without super laser!

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax equipment is set up and ready to synthesize his potential Strain-derived super weapon. He's asked you to control the catalyzer in the Catalyst Room while Furlo Gre controls the synthesizer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Catalyzer and synthesizer now assembled in other rooms. $(player.name) will operate catalyzer while idiot intern operates synthesizer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Not long now! Not long at all! Soon, Mondo will give Dominion the most destructive weapon on Nexus! Exiles never know what hit them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Experiment successful? Mondo not certain. But Mondo is certain that Strain has overrun lab, and is very unhappy about it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Is easy! Only hard part is not screwing up.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Mondo is fine. Unfortunately, so is idiot intern.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though Mondo Zax experimental super weapon has been synthesized in Exo-Lab Y23, the Strain has overrun his laboratory. Furlo Gre currently has the untested cure, but the job is far from finished.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'm sure nothing will go wrong.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mondo not expect $(player.name) to understand, but catalyzer used to add reagents into mixture. Add them slowly. If $(player.name) add them too fast? Explosions!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Idiot intern will track synthesis reaction. He say how much to add and when, then $(player.name) input amount in catalyzer. Simple simple!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(player.name) make big mistake. Mondo be sure you pay heavy price.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax laboratory has been overrun by the Strain, and he and Furlo Gre have been forced to take shelter in Exo-Lab Y23's recontamination room. Follow them and defend them from the Strain outbreak before it's too late!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Mondo Zax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strain is sneaky and sly. Will find Mondo and idiot intern soon. Require $p(player.name) immediate assistance. If not, Mondo will be disappointed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mondo feels fine, like always. What about idiot intern? Dead yet? If so, save internal organs for dissection and analysis.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Weapon unstable. Ineffective. Mondo did everything correctly. Must be idiot intern's fault. Good help so hard to find!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good decision. If Mondo survives, he will reward you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Must procure new intern soon. Mondo requires meat shield.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite your efforts to save him, Furlo Gre has been terminally infected by the Strain. Though Mondo Zax weapon appeared to be a promising solution to the Exile menace, he ultimately pronounced it too unstable and blamed its deficiencies on his former intern.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: By Emperor's order, Mondo is not allowed to die. Understand?

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax experimental Strain-based super weapon was a failure, and Furlo Gre, his intern, met a terrible fate. Mondo has requested you join him back at the Titian Collective to discuss his next venture.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax in the Titian Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Experiment concluded... for now. Come meet Mondo at Titian Collective. Will discuss future plans, give final reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still waiting. Mondo wondering if failed experiment was idiot intern's fault, or $p(player.name)?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mondo will not be held back by idiot intern's bumbling failure. Strain will be basis for big weapon someday, mark Mondo's words!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Clock ticking. Mondo thinks you should hurry.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Muahahahahahaha! $(self.visual=9388, 21127)
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Okay, then. I'm out of here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mondo Zax is far from discouraged by his failure, and continues to blame it upon the unfortunate Furlo Gre. He swears that a Strain-based super weapon will be created eventually, and he will be responsible for it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe failure was because of $(player.name) after all?

localizedTextIdText: Keysew Kango believes that continuous slaughter of potential enemies is the best way to maintain security in Titian Collective. He's instructed you to hunt down and kill any Strain you can, and then kill a few more for good measure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Keysew Kango via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Indiscriminate killing best way to ensure collective security. You go, take weapons, slaughter Strain beasties. Then collective be secure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You not killing enough. You expect to go far in miserable life by not killing? Killing cornerstone of Chua civilization. And science, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Killing quota achieved. You not as scared or lazy as I thought. Collective much safer now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even when done, do not stop. Keep to killing!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Secret to killing lots is not dying! So don't die!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After several bloody encounters, you managed to kill enough Strain creatures to satisfy Keysew Kango desire for security in Titian Collective, not to mention his bloodlust.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: What? You think Chua not killing machines? Science just boring middleman. Death end goal, always.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You not like killing bad beasties? You need psychiatrist!

localizedTextIdTitle: What's That Blue Thing Doing Here?
localizedTextIdText: Mysterious objects have been sighted floating in the skies above the Auric Gardens. Keysew Kango has asked you to investigate these objects, determine whether or not they're dangerous, and then kill them regardless.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Keysew Kango via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Blue objects appear near teleporter in Auric Gardens. Must know if objects are dangerous. Even if not, must find out if objects can be killed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ran out of anti-itch cream for trigger fingers. You go find new creatures to kill or else I relieve itch by shooting you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Creatures cannot be killed? Oh, the Chuamanity! This is worst news ever!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Record all details of killing new creatures. Sights, sounds, everything.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Woe is me! Trigger fingers so very, very itchy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your investigation into the mysterious objects over the Auric Gardens revealed they are the by-product of primal life and exanite being in such close proximity to one another. As such, they present no threat to the Dominion, but it still makes Keysew Kango sad.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Two kinds of creature, living and dead. You on border of latter kind.

localizedTextIdText: Test out some of the experimental "High-Impact Knives" that DRED asked Keysew Kango to put through testing while in the entrance of the Decrepit Exo-Lab Y23 in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report your results to Keysew Kango via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You stumble upon a panoply of devices. Most of them seem like things that require operational training, but there are some knives at the bottom...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those things explosive throwing knives!? And you didn't save any for Keysew!? NOOOO!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Much to Keysew Kango's dismay, the discarded knives turned out to be highly effective at killing things in an explosive manner.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report your results to Keysew Kango

localizedTextIdText: Sylphia Barkberry has lost her scanbot, Jetsome, deep within Wilderrun.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Sylphia Barkberry inside Sim Core W-28
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was investigating some strange energy readings in Wilderrun when one of my bots went missing. I think I'm onto something big, but I need your help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not only is my little Jetsome safe and sound, but we've discovered a Sim Core! Wait till I tell everyone back home about this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you so much. I knew I could count on you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now the real fun begins.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You aided Sylphia Barkberry in the recovery of her scanbot, Jetsome, and the discovery of Sim Core W-28.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm going to use my other scanbot, Floatsome, to track the same energies as before. With any luck, she'll lead us right to Jetsome.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I think it might be another Sim Core, but I'm so worried about Jetsome that I can't even enjoy this new discovery.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're just going to abandon me? How rude.

localizedTextIdText: Lyryan Redtail has discovered a Sim Core beneath Calmwater Lake.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lyryan Redtail in Sim Core G-33
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We found another Sim Core beneath Calmwater Lake. Get your legs moving and help us out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've got a few teams in there already, but we need more data! Hop to it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! We need more test subjects.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Lyryan Redtail in Sim Core G-33.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Where have you been?! The Caretaker's got these machines that can run all sorts of hypothetical simulations based on a user's memories.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It seems to be part of some ongoing experiment, but we might be able to use these machines to learn more about the Eldan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It looks like it's got something to do with that ongoing battle between the Exiles and Dominion in Galeras.

localizedTextIdText: The Entity has sent one of the Phage Lords, Elyona the Mad, to corrupt the Nursery where Drusera was trained. Drusera has asked you to stop the Phage Lord, but first you must find a way inside the facility.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was trained here. The Eldan called it the Nursery. One of the Phage Lords, sent by the Entity, has come to corrupt it. She must be stopped.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must find a way into this facility. The Phage Lord Elyona the Mad has been sent to corrupt it, and she must be stopped.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew you'd find a way inside. Unfortunately, that was the easy part. It only gets more difficult from here on out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, my friend. I'll contact you once you're inside.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't despair. I know you can do it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to find a way into the Nursery. Now you'll need to get to the Genesis Chamber where Drusera was created and confront Elyona the Mad before it's too late.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why'd the Entity send a Phage Lord here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Sounds like the Eldan were smart.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Did the Entity transform all Eldan?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: Are you and the Entity trapped on Nexus?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: In order to create me, the Eldan made a machine that combined the primal elements with the souls of six other beings. It's very powerful, the Entity wants it, and there's no telling what he'll do once he has it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, the Eldan were brilliant... but they created the Entity, an evil that might destroy the universe itself. It takes all of my power to keep him confined, and I'm growing so tired.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Elyona the Mad. She was a brilliant Eldan scientist before the Entity transformed her into a monster. She taught me to use some of my powers, but that was... before.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: No, only those he found useful. The others were destroyed trying to stop him. I couldn't save any of them. All I could do was imprison the Entity before he could leave Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Yes... for now. The Entity's getting stronger, though, and soon there will be nothing we can do to stop him from escaping.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you allow Elyona the Mad to corrupt this place?

localizedTextIdText: Drusera was confined to the Nursery following her creation, both to learn to use her powers and because the Eldan feared her. She's asked you to explore the Nursery Observation Rooms and learn what secrets you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was taught to use my abilities here. To me, it was both a classroom and a prison, for the Eldan feared me. See what you can learn before we move on.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Feel free to explore. I brought you here so you could learn more about me. The knowledge you reap today might save Nexus tomorrow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Eldan wanted to restrain me, but I wouldn't let them. Perhaps if I'd submitted to their control, none of this would have happened.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once you know more, perhaps you'll be afraid of me, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm so glad to have you on my side!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Drusera request, you explored the Nursery Observation Rooms and learned a few secrets about her past. Hopefully the knowledge will prepare you for the struggle to come.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why did the Eldan fear you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why don't you explain it to me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: It must have been lonely here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Couldn't you free yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They made me to be the ultimate creation, a being with infinite power. Unfortunately, they had no idea what that really meant.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I don't intend to keep secrets from you, but there are some things I can't tell you. Not yet, anyway.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It was, yes. Then you answered my call and now I'm no longer on my own.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: How can I be free? Even now I'm battling with the Entity, and that struggle goes on both day and night.  I fight to keep him from escaping from the prison I've put him in.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: This has been going on for a long, long time, $(player.name). I'm exhausted, and that's why I need you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can we succeed if you succumb to ignorance?

localizedTextIdText: The Nursery is infested by Pell that have been corrupted by Elyona the Mad. These pitiful creatures, who served Elyona prior to her downfall, continue to assist her as minions of the Strain. Drusera has asked you to ease their suffering by ending their lives.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pell were servants to Elyona before the Entity corrupted her. Now they're as debased as she is. Take pity upon them and end their misery.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Pell in the Nursery have been corrupted by Elyona. They live in constant agony, their bodies and minds twisted. For their own sakes, destroy them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I understand that you've taken many lives since you arrived on Nexus. Killing those corrupted Pell was a mercy. You should be proud.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you. No creature deserves to be twisted like these Pell.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Though the Pell can rest in peace, we must continue towards our goal.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm not sure "proud" is the right word.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've spared the corrupted Pell in the Nursery from endless suffering as thralls to Elyona the Mad.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: These Pell used to be like their uncorrupted brothers elsewhere on Nexus. These Pell faithfully assisted the Eldan with their projects here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Elyona is responsible for their torment. Even the Phage Lords need their servants, and Elyona knows these creatures better than most.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I can't say. Given they have become such twisted mockeries of life, I assume their memories have been consumed by their torment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no empathy for their suffering? I suppose not.

localizedTextIdText: In order to defend yourself against Elyona the Mad attacks, Drusera has instructed you to collect primal essences from each of the Primal Element Chambers in the very heart of the Nursery.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Elyona has many terrible powers. Primal essences gathered from the Primal Element Chambers should afford you some protection from them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you want to survive Elyona's attacks, you must gather primal essences from the Primal Element Chambers. There isn't much time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: And to think, the elements in those chambers were used to create me. Now you'll use them to defend yourself against Elyona the Mad.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I was born... created... in the Genesis Chamber. Let it be her tomb.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You'll emerge the victor, I know it. There's no other choice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Drusera urging, you collected primal essences from the Primal Element Chambers within the Nursery, potentially earning some protection from Elyona the Mad attacks against you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What if I don't gather essences?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Elyona will have all of the elements at her disposal. You will need to gather the Primal Essences in each of the Primal Element chambers before facing her.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I fear you'll suffer a terrible and painful death. Either that, or you'll become another of the Strain's corrupted thralls, suffering forever in constant agony and despair.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you face her now, defenseless, you'll never stand a chance.

localizedTextIdText: Drusera has sent you to defeat Elyona the Mad in the Genesis Chamber at the heart of the Nursery. You are protected from her most powerful attacks by the Primal Elements you gathered earlier. Drusera is confident you will succeed.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The moment I've been dreading is here. Elyona is inside the Genesis Chamber and she'll use everything she has against you. She must be destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must go into the Genesis Chamber and face Elyona before she can corrupt this entire facility. Everything depends on this!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm so happy you're alive! I was so worried about you, but I see that my concerns weren't justified. You defeated Elyona, and that's no easy feat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please be careful. I don't want to lose the only friend I have.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You risked your life for me once again. I'll never forget this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Drusera sent you to defeat Elyona the Mad in the Genesis Chamber at the heart of the Nursery. Protected from her most powerful attacks by the Primal Elements you gathered earlier, you defeated her and put an end to her corruption.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: You're not going to help me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Genesis Chamber is filled with highly-focused primal energy. Neither I nor the Entity can project our images there. That's why the Entity sent Elyona, and why I'm sending you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Elyona must focus her will in order to charge her attacks. That's when she's most vulnerable, so hit her as fast and as hard as you can.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If Elyona is victorious, the Entity will become even more powerful!

localizedTextIdText: M.A.C. has contacted you and suggested you pay it a visit in Elderoot Refuge. Ability Training Kiosks can bring you up to speed and teach you new skills. Payment is accepted in blood, sweat, and tears.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Use the M.A.C. in Elderoot Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm ATK-622, the ability training kiosk in Elderoot Refuge. If you're tired of gettin' your teeth kicked in, come talk to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you're tired of gettin' beat up a lot, come talk to me in Elderoot's Refuge. I'll teach ya how to roll with the punches.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a dog-eat-dog world out there, champ. Hope you're hungry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. Bring your game face and your wallet.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Make me proud, champ.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You visited the M.A.C. in Everstar Grove and used it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Never met a fella who likes losin'. Guess there's a first time for everything.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective wants you to choose your tradeskills by speaking to Crafting Trainer Trixion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Craftmaster Tullio at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Weaponsmiths, armorers, tailors, outfitters, architects, and technologists produce goods. If you're a collector, you could learn to be a miner, survivalist, or relic hunter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Crafting Trainer Trixion will provide you with basic instruction. Make your selection with confidence. You can always change your tradeskill if it bores you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am glad to see that you have dedicated yourself to productive work. If every citizen does their part, the Dominion will always prevail.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak with Crafting Trainer Trixion and make your choice. I am eager to see the results.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall have you employing those skills in short order.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You learned your first tradeskills. May your crafts be a credit to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no pride?

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade wants you to talk to Crafting Trainer Oaklee and pick out some shiny new tradeskills.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Supervisor Wicksprout in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: So many choices! You could be a weaponsmith, armorer, tailor, outfitter, architect, or technologist. Ooh! Ooh! Or a miner, survivalist, or relic hunter!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Confused? Lost? Maybe a little... scared? If you need a hug, I can help you out. If you want to learn tradeskills, talk to my friend Crafting Trainer Oaklee.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ooh, those are some shiny new skills you got there, $(player.name). Congrats on becoming a productive member of society!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just talk to Crafting Trainer Oaklee. She'll set you right up!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now it's time to put those skills to good use and help our Exile family thrive!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've learned your first tradeskills. Hopefully, they'll prove useful to the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw, why not?

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow wants you to talk to Crafting Trainer Thorpe and pick out your first tradeskills.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Supervisor Arborgreen at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If you're a maker, try weaponsmith, armorer, tailor, outfitter, architect, or technologist. Miners, survivalists, and relic hunters are supply people.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Remember, you can change tradeskills later if you want to try something else. Let Crafting Trainer Thorpe know when you're ready.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to have you on the team, $(player.name). Now it's time to put those skills to use and start helping out around here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Talk to Crafting Trainer Thorpe. He'll get you started.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have to work harder and smarter if we want to defeat the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to Supervisor Arborgreen, you learned your first tradeskills. Hopefully, they prove useful to the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What's wrong? Are you lazy or just stupid?

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Ellevar at the Tradeskill Hub in Lightreach Mission wants you to select your tradeskills by speaking to Crafting Trainer Posca.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Ellevar at the Tradeskill Hub in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Handy? Try working as a weaponsmith, armorer, tailor, outfitter, architect, or technologist. If you're a collector, try working as a miner, survivalist, or relic hunter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Crafting Trainer Posca will provide you with basic instruction. Make your selection with confidence. You can try something else later if you wish.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. Now that you have proper training, you are ready to explore the deeper mysteries of craftsmanship and logistics.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Well then, my pet, speak with Crafting Trainer Posca and make your choice.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With wisdom and perseverance, we will bend this place to our will.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You learned your first tradeskills. May your crafts be a credit to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Ellevar
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose some are content to remain ignorant.

localizedTextIdText: You found the wayward explorer, Nooks Barkbiter, up a tree in Pollenberry Grove, and together you shared a sample of delicious Pollenberry honey.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Fancy meeting another Exile up here! Care to catch your breath and share a taste of this delightful honeycomb? It's awesome!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fancy meeting another Exile up here! Care to catch your breath and share a taste of this delightful honeycomb? It's awesome!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I guess I'll give it a taste.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess I'll give it a taste.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the wayward explorer, Nooks Barkbiter, up a tree in Pollenberry Grove, and together you shared a sample of delicious Pollenberry honey.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I guess I'll give it a taste.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout has instructed you to start taking work orders. Find the Work Order Board in Sylvan Glade. The work orders it offers will be rewarding!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Examine the Work Order Board in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time to start taking work orders! Our allies need very specific items to advance the Exile mission on Nexus, and we're here to make those items!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go check out the Work Order Board. It's full of vital jobs that need doing! They're always right near all us crafters. You can't miss it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: NOTICE: Those who fulfill Work Orders will be rewarded with crafting vouchers and experience. These supplies are critical to our continued survival on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll get experience and crafting vouchers, which can be spent on useful craft stuff!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Work Order Board and learned how filling Work Orders can help your fellow Exiles on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you aren't willing to make the things people want, then you aren't going to do much good!

localizedTextIdText: A doomed treasure hunter met his end attempting to make off with a golden idol in the Ethereal Hollow. Though his identity is a mystery, maybe you can show everyone how it's done by taking the idol for yourself.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Archaeologist Vonlief at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This poor treasure hunter met a very painful end in an attempt to snatch a golden idol. Even though he's dead, you should show him how it's done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I reckon there's treasure in them caves. If only someone like you would man up and search 'em, we could all be rich!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Highborn's hide! That idol right there belongs in a museum! How much you want for it?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You got yourself a deal, friend!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm going to take that idol.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You chose wisely and pilfered the golden idol in the Ethereal Hollow. Though you may not be rich, you were able to score a little wealth by selling the idol to Archaeologist Vonlief at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm going to take that idol.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Seems like the golden idol sits on a pressure-sensitive pedestal that triggers security measures when disturbed. If you replace the idol with a bag, you can fool the trap and escape with the treasure!

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio has instructed you to start taking work orders. Find the Work Order Board in Feralplain Collective. The work orders it offers will reward you with crafting vouchers and crafting experience.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Examine the Work Order Board in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I shall teach you about work orders, so you can begin your service to the Dominion in earnest. We count on crafters for desperately needed supplies.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Wherever the crafting Chancellors are, you can find a Work Order Board. Examine it and start doing valuable work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Analysis: You have not examined the tradeskill signpost. Please examine it and return to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: NOTICE: Those who fulfill Work Orders will be rewarded with crafting vouchers and experience. The Dominion appreciates your service.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will be justly rewarded with crafting vouchers and valuable experience.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Work Order Board and learned how filling work orders can help advance the Dominion's cause.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Such an attitude betrays the legacy of your craft.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela has instructed you to start taking work orders. Find the Work Order Board in Lightreach Mission. The work orders it offers will reward you with crafting vouchers and crafting experience.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Examine the Work Order Board in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I shall teach you about work orders, so you can begin your service to the Dominion in earnest. We count on crafters for desperately needed supplies.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Wherever the crafting experts are, you can find a Work Order Board. Examine it and start doing valuable work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: NOTICE: Those who fulfill work orders will be rewarded with crafting vouchers and experience. The Dominion appreciates your service.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will be justly rewarded with crafting vouchers and valuable experience.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Work Order Board and learned how filling work orders can help advance the Dominion's cause.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Such an attitude betrays the legacy of your craft.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade wants you to go on your first survivalist mission. Grab a Novice's Laser Chainsaw from Contractor Drogor and get to work harvesting Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} from Celestion Tree.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} to Contractor Drogor in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As a survivalist, I'm counting on you to go scouting for fine hardwoods. A lot of our furniture and homes use the unique properties of local lumber!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Architects and survivalists work together all the time. Contractor Drogor really needs more Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} - we're trying to build up an entire planet!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. I'll set you up with tools, and you'll set me up with lumber. Just make sure to equip that laser chainsaw!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad to see you pulling your weight. It's going to take a lot of work to make this place livable for everybody who wants a new start.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go talk to Contractor Drogor. He'll give you a shiny new laser chainsaw.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I won't rest until everybody's got a decent place to live.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can cut down a few trees for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Chainsaw and used it to gather wood for Contractor Drogor, who builds homes and furniture for Exiles on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I can get more of that.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: So I'll be cutting down trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What else can I do as a survivalist?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What should I use to cut the trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yep, but don't worry! We've discovered several varieties of fast-growing trees that offer excellent wood, easily gathered without harming the greater forest around them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Well, survivalists are great hunters. When they take down a wild beast, they use every part of the animal, providing us with tasty meat and unique leather.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Oooh, laser chainsaws are super fantastic! Just equip one, and you'll take down trees with minimal mess. They're programmed with smart targeting: once you equip them, they will automatically enable when you go after a tree.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw, why not?

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade wants you to go on your first mining mission. Grab a Novice's Laser Pickaxe from Armorer Stanhope and get to work harvesting Iron Chunk from Iron Node in Celestion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Iron Chunk to Armorer Stanhope in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need metal for, well, pretty much everything! As a miner, that's your job. Just think of the weapons and armor we can make when you get back!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Weaponsmiths and armorers really depend on miners. So equip your laser pickaxe and chase down some iron chunks for Armorer Stanhope.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hello, $(player.name). I need some iron chunks, but they're in short supply, and I'm no good with a laser pickaxe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That iron for me? Good job. I'll get our people suited up in brand-new armor in no time, and we'll show them Dommies who's boss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Armorer Stanhope can get you started with a laser pickaxe.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll drive 'em out of Celestion and straight offa Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Pickaxe and used it to gather ore for Armorer Stanhope, who makes armor for the Exiles on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But... but why? Why break my heart?

localizedTextIdText: Agent Tychon informed you that Captain Milo is in need of some assistance. Meet him in Lightreach Mission to find out more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Milo in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Captain Milo is looking for volunteers to help with an infestation aboard his asteroid mining colony, M-13.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is about time someone showed up.  Got work if you're interested.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can find Captain Milo near his transport vessel and get briefed on the mission details.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Been looking for someone with the right skills for the job. Perhaps you're the $(player.class) for the job.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Captain Milo in Lightreach Mission requested some assistance in dealing with a problem on M-13.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have never seen such cowardice.

localizedTextIdText: Naida Zavlonov informed you that Captain Milo is in need of some assistance. Meet him in the Belabog Containment Camp in Celestion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Milo in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Captain Milo is looking for volunteers to help with an infestation aboard his asteroid mining colony, M-13.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You can find Captain Milo near his transport vessel.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's about time someone showed up. Got work if you're interested.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can find Captain Milo near his transport vessel and get briefed on the mission details.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Been looking for someone with the right skills for the job. Perhaps you're the $(player.class) for the job.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Captain Milo in Belabog Containment Camp requested some assistance in dealing with a problem on M-13.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have never seen such cowardice.

localizedTextIdText: The M.A.C. in Zin's Landing has contacted you to find it in order to begin training.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Use the M.A.C. in Zin's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there, softie! You wanna survive Nexus, you better toughen up, and quick! Know how? Come find me and we'll tussle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You didn't find me yet? Whaddaya got for eyes, rocks?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finally! Now I can make you shape up! Come and find me when you need some extra oomph and I'll teach you all the moves. You'll kill 'em!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Better hurry up! Bein' lazy gets you dead.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now get outta here, slugger, and come back when you're ready.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You visited the M.A.C. in Zin's Landing and used it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yeah, I knew someone like you couldn't hack it.

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Redfire wants to teach you about salvaging, the art of getting useful crafting materials from old weapons and armor. One of his old prototypes may have some materials that the local Aurin need. Salvage the Unusable Crafting Prototype and give the components you get to either Supplier Whispwick Moonsong in Woodhaven or Melrell Snowbell in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the items to Supplier Whispwick Moonsong in Woodhaven or Melrell Snowbell in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Every Exile should be doin' all they can to help the queen. Maybe you can salvage somethin' useful outta this ol' prototype of mine.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: That thing's useless as it is, but the parts should still be good. You should salvage it and see what you can save.
