localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our crafters are trying to repair the queen's armor, but there's not much we can do without supplies. Maybe you can salvage something?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, thank you! Arwick was just saying we needed some power cores to repair the queen's armor! And this material looks state of the art!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's old, but the parts should still be good.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll get this to our crafters right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You salvaged the unusable prototype, providing valuable resources to the Aurin in Celestion.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: That sounds like a good idea.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the items to Supplier Whispwick Moonsong or Melrell Snowbell
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If you've got weapons or armor you don't need anymore, you can break 'em down to get something useful.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Normally, you'd get some of whatever material was used to make the thing: cloth for Light Armor, leather for Medium Armor, and ore for Heavy Armor. Sometimes you'll get power cores or other useful stuff.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're leavin' a fellow Exile in the lurch?

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Redfire wants to teach you how to salvage an item, taking it apart so its materials can be reused. With your help, maybe he can provide the newly arrived Aurin with valuable resources. He'll meet you at either Woodhaven or Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Weaponsmith Redfire in Woodhaven or Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(player.name), I need somebody to help me with a project. I'm trying to salvage resources that might be useful to the queen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Salvaging is the art of taking old gear apart to get something useful out of it. You ready to try it out?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I've just made it out here to Woodhaven. I'd be obliged if you'd stop by.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hopefully, this ol' junk's still got a few working parts.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to learn how to salvage.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Weaponsmith Redfire to discuss salvaging.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's a valuable skill, but I guess some people are comfortable with their own ignorance.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout at the Tradeskill Hub in Sylvan Glade wants you to go hunting for Eldan relics. Grab a Novice's Relic Blaster from Techsmith Praxa and get to work harvesting Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} from Standard Relic Node in Celestion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} to Techsmith Praxa in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Omni-plasm is so weird! Handy, but mysterious. After the first relic hunters discovered it, technologists quickly figured out a bunch of uses.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Aren't you excited to get your Novice's Relic Blaster from Techsmith Praxa and start hunting for Standard Relic Node? I'm rooting for you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Equip that Novice's Relic Blaster and get me some omni-plasm, will ya? Never saw the stuff before we landed on Nexus. Now we can't live without it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Omni-plasm has incredible healing properties. Smearing unfathomable Eldan gunk into wounds might not seem like a bright idea, but beggars can't be choosers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get your Novice's Relic Blaster from Techsmith Praxa and start hunting for Standard Relic Node.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There's some irony in usin' Eldan tech to help drive the Dommies offa this planet.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Techsmith Praxa gave you a shiny new Novice's Relic Blaster, allowing you to extract omni-plasm from mysterious Eldan relic nodes. Nobody's quite sure how the stuff works, but it makes great medishots.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Omni-plasm is a strange goo that is found in most Eldan relics. Nobody really knows how it works, but it has all sorts of medical applications!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How could you not be excited about this?

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now it's time for you to get excited and make things! Take these materials, and we'll get you started with the art of architecture.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your supply of wood is stored in your tradeskill bag!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an architect, Supervisor Wicksprout has given you the crafting materials necessary to start your first project.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout wants to show you how to craft architectural projects. Use the materials she's given you to craft $m(schematic=374) at a crafting station in Sylvan Glade.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=374) to Contractor Drogor in Sylvan Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You've got the wood and supplies I gave you. Now it's time to build something. Look for the $schematic=374 schematic at the Crafting Station!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Crafting Station is right behind me. Use it to look through your schematics and find the one for $schematic=374.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your job is simple: when somebody needs $schematic=374, you sit down at your Crafting Station and make it. Get with the program.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work, that $schematic=374 will look mighty fine on somebody's homestead. The more we build, the stronger a hold we will have on this planet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just take the finished $schematic=374 to Contractor Drogor!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We've got a lot of work to do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: For your first architectural project, you crafted $m(schematic=374) for Contractor Drogor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you really gonna just take the materials I've entrusted to you? Really?

localizedTextIdText: A hopped-up yeti identified as the Crazed Zubblehead has been seen eating all of the Protostar's supply of ZubbleBubble Flavor Crystals! Find and kill the Crazed Zubblehead at the ZubbleBubble Crash Site.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Exotic Resources Financier in South Whitevale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nA yeti identified as "The Crazed Zubblehead" has been seen eating an expensive amount of ZubbleBubble flavor crystals. Termination required.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED\nA yeti identified as "The Crazed Zubblehead" has been seen eating an expensive amount of ZubbleBubble flavor crystals. Termination required.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That manic, spun-out yeti has been eating an expensive amount of ZubbleBubble flavor crystals! Terminate it at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have eliminated the Crazed Zubblehead? Excellent. Here are some coupons for 10% off ZubbleBubble Cola, courtesy of Protostar!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This offer only valid at select stores... on Protostar's planet, Protostar.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully eliminated the major cause of the Protostar's financial woes by killing the Crazed Zubblehead.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Exotic Resources Financier

localizedTextIdText: You have successfully eliminated the major cause of the Protostar's financial woes by killing the Crazed Zubblehead.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Exotic Resources Financier in South Whitevale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You should return this strange, slightly rotten yeti tooth to the Exotic Resources Financier at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That manic, spun-out yeti has been eating an expensive amount of ZubbleBubble flavor crystals! Terminate it at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have eliminated the Crazed Zubblehead? Excellent. Here are some coupons for 10% off ZubbleBubble Cola, courtesy of Protostar!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This offer only valid at select stores... on Protostar's planet, Protostar.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully eliminated the major cause of the Protostar's financial woes by killing the Crazed Zubblehead.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Exotic Resources Financier

localizedTextIdText: Foreman Hammerworth wants to teach you how to salvage items so their materials can be reused. Visit him in Tremor Ridge and help the local miners get the resources they need.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Foreman Hammerworth at Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(player.name), can you help me out? We're short on spare parts, so I need to teach someone how to salvage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Salvaging is the art of taking old gear apart to get something useful out of it. You ready to try it out?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come see me in Tremor Ridge, and I'll learn you a thing or two.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hopefully, this ol' junk's still got a few working parts.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to learn how to salvage.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Foreman Hammerworth to discuss salvaging.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It's a valuable skill, but I guess some people are comfortable with their own ignorance.

localizedTextIdText: Foreman Hammerworth wants to teach you how to salvage an item, taking it apart so its materials can be reused. Salvage his Unusable Crafting Prototype to provide Drillsmith Moxmay with resources to repair the mining equipment in Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the items to Drillsmith Moxmay in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Every Exile should be doin' all they can to help out. Maybe you can salvage somethin' useful outta this ol' prototype of mine for Drillsmith Moxmay.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: That thing's useless as it is, but the parts should still be good. You should salvage it, see what you can get, and give 'em to Drillsmith Moxmay.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This drill is straight busted. I think one of the cross beams has gone askew on the treadle. We're going to need a whole new power core.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, thanks, honey! With this power core, we can get her up and running again for sure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's old, but the parts should still be good.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll put this to use right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You salvaged Foreman Hammerworth unusable prototype, providing valuable resources to the miners of Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the items to Drillsmith Moxmay
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If you've got weapons or armor you don't need anymore, you can break 'em down to get something useful.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Normally you'd get some of whatever material was used to make the thing: cloth for Light Armor, leather for Medium, ore for Heavy. Sometimes you'll get power cores or other useful stuff.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're pullin' my leg, right? Seriously?

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Zeelo wants to teach you about salvaging, the art of getting useful crafting materials from old weapons and armor. Go find him at Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Researcher Zeelo in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Learn to salvage! Break old, safe things apart. Get materials to make new, deadlier things!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Salvaging simple! Take apart old useless things, repurpose into bigger, useful things! Easy, even for simple brains like yours.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come to Bloodfire, quick quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Checking old junk now, many parts, many parts!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to learn how to salvage.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Researcher Zeelo to discuss salvaging.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Accidents do happen to stupid idiots who cross me.

localizedTextIdText: Technologist Corvianos wants to teach you about salvaging. It's the art of getting useful crafting materials from old weapons and armor. Visit him in Lightreach Mission to learn more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Technologist Corvianos at the Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey there, luv, willing to help me with a little project? I can teach you how to salvage if you'll run me an errand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Salvaging is the art of taking an old piece of kit apart and using the component bits and bobs to make something new.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You'll find salvaging a valuable skill, mark my words.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Useful, innit?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to learn how to salvage.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Technologist Corvianos to discuss salvaging.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you having a laugh? You are. You're having a laugh.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Zeelo thinks that one of his old prototypes may have some materials that can be used to increase the killing power of Bloodfire Village's defense force. Salvage the Unusable Crafting Prototype and bring the resulting materials to Longshot Vydin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Longshot Vydin in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Longshot Vydin already pretty good at killing things, but could be deadlier. Salvage prototype, give him materials to make new gun, better gun!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Salvaging so easy, even you can do it! Low chance of explosion. Less than 40%. Just open bag, take prototype, and recycle!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Curse those Aurin miscreants. They've set up just outside of sniper range. If I had a better power core, they wouldn't be so smug.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With this power core, I should be able to make a rifle with greatly increased range. Those miserable Aurin won't know what hit them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good, good! Open bag, take prototype, and recycle! Easy, even for you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's always good to meet $i(player.race) who understands the value of quality materials.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You salvaged Researcher Zeelo Unusable Crafting Prototype, providing valuable materials to Longshot Vydin in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Old weapon, not deadly enough, useless! But can be taken apart, broken down to get materials.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Power cores, cloth, leather, metal, mysterious forces beyond your understanding. Components for weapons and armor development.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? You dare refuse? Better not refuse again!

localizedTextIdText: Technologist Corvianos wants to teach you about salvaging. It's the art of getting useful crafting materials from old weapons and armor. Salvage the Unusable Crafting Prototype and bring the components you get to Weaponsmith Tirexa in Lightreach Mission so she can make something new.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Weaponsmith Tirexa in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been working with Weaponsmith Tirexa on a new prototype, but I can't get the ruddy thing working. Better just salvage it and give her the parts.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go on, guv, salvage the prototype and take the parts to Weaponsmith Tirexa. Gal's not the pleasant sort when people keep her waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where are those materials Technologist Corvianos owes me? His failure to build the prototype is unacceptable. I fear he is becoming... unreliable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hmm. Thank you, $(player.name). You have done well, extracting the wheat from the chaff. These components will be employed in my next project.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thanks, love! Just take it down to her when you're all done!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Even if something appears useless, it can always be broken down and remade.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You salvaged Technologist Corvianoss Unusable Crafting Prototype, bringing the resulting materials to Weaponsmith Tirexa so she could make something new.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: If you've got weapons or armor you don't need anymore, you can break them down to get at the useful bits.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Normally, you'd get some of whatever material was used to make the thing: cloth for light armor, leather for medium, ore for heavy. Sometimes you'll get power cores or other useful bits.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey now, I thought you were a better mate than that!

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Claremont has issued a comm call warning to all Dominion citizens about an unspecified danger, as well as ordering them to proceed at once to his location at the Perilous Annex in Cankertube Swamp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Doctor Claremont at the Perilous Annex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To all Dominion citizens! Cankertube Swamp is under a black alert warning! For your own safety, proceed to the Perilous Annex at once!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Cankertube Swamp is a blemish on this filthy land!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Cankertube Swamp is a blemish on this filthy land!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Do not worry, citizen. You are safe now. You may wish to... wait! Aren't you $(player.name), the famous $(player.class)?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you cherish your life, proceed to the Perlious Annex with all due speed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Praise Dominus! You have arrived none too soon!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Doctor Claremont revealed that several Dominion teams have gone missing in Cankertube Swamp, and it looks like it will be up to you to figure out why.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Dominion citizens, scientists, and soldiers are vanishing without a trace in Cankertube Swamp! Like a true patriot, I have halted my own research to assist my fellow citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself, citizen! I will not shed tears over your loss!

localizedTextIdText: Your training aboard the Destiny is now complete! Emperor Myrcalus has invited you to the Emperor's Sanctum so that he can congratulate you for your embodiment of the Vigilant Virtues before you make the journey to Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Axis Pheydra in the Emperor's Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have proven yourself, and the time has finally come. Take a teleporter to the command deck, for I must ensure you are honored for your deeds.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: It is citizens of your caliber that will ensure the Dominion's victory over the Exiles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Speak to your emperor, $(player.class). He has much to tell you. Once he has finished, return to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you expect to meet the Emperor personally? Are you surprised he is not here? He is alive, for I have seen him... but few others have for nearly fifty years.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Complete any deeds as you must, but do not keep me waiting overlong.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This deadly secret is yours to keep, and I will know if you breach his trust.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be there soon, my lord.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On his invitation, you made your way to the Emperor's Sanctum to meet Emperor Myrcalus. Once there, the Emperor - via hologram, rather than in person - congratulated you, and thanked you for all you would accomplish on behalf of the Dominion. Afterwards, Axis Pheydra confided to you that no one has seen the Emperor personally in over fifty years - and that you had best keep the secret close to your heart.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why did you choose me, my lord?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The answer is simple. I am like your father, and you are like my child. I love you with all my heart. All I ask is that you devote yourself to the Dominion, and I will ensure that justice is yours.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It does not do to refuse an audience with your emperor, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Claremont has sent you into the depths of Cankertube Swamp to locate his Chua lab partner, Wheez Nokenti. Wheez and his team have vanished, and you must locate him before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doctor Claremont via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: One of my DRED science teams is missing in the swamp. Wheez Nokenti, my best researcher, was leading them. You must locate him at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I could have sworn I told you... Wheez Nokenti and his team are lost in the swamp. You need to find them. Immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It appears as if we are being hunted. I will send for Wheez, as he must return here at once. You, on the other hand, are needed elsewhere.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If Wheez has been lost, I will rue this day more than I already do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our lot has changed, but do not be alarmed. Dominus protects!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After exploring Cankertube Swamp in search of Wheez Nokenti and his team, you managed to locate Wheez. Unfortunately, it appears as if he was left alive by a deranged mob for no other reason than to act as bait.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Wheez is my most trusted and cooperative lab partner, outside of Dipswitch. As our current work has yet to see completion, I will not tolerate Wheez's loss.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Dipswitch is an intelligent mechanical being. He rarely leaves my side these days. You might say he is my charge, but we exchange that role from time to time. His emotional development is incomplete.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Having a negative attitude in a crisis situation is against Dominion law.

localizedTextIdText: Harmonious Balance-Finder is concerned that corrupted radiators planted throughout the Keeper's Sanctuary are radiating an aura that's weakening the barrier. Go to the five different areas and shut the radiators down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Harmonious Balance-Finder via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Quickly, outsider! There is no time! Corrupted radiators planted inside the focuses weaken the barrier! Destroy them! Destroy the radiators!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The barrier weakens! Can you not see? The corrupted radiators must be destroyed! You risk the wrath of the Masters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The barrier's strength returns. The Disciples know it was not an easy task. You have our thanks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go! Destroy them before the barrier fails!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: May meet again in time, outsider.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Harmonious Balance-Finder is pleased by the strengthening of the barriers due to your willingness to disable the corrupted radiators in the Keeper's Sanctuary. The Harmonious Pell are in your debt.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I guess I better hurry, huh?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Did you put the radiators there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: No! I suspect the radiators were planted by other Pell who were sent to explore the Nursery. Unbalanced by the Blight, they returned here to disrupt the balance!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is it too difficult a task for an outsider? Is it?

localizedTextIdText: Aberrant elementals have been emerging from the Nursery and threatening the Keeper's Sanctuary, twisting the wildlife and disrupting the elemental balance. The Harmonious Elder has asked you to put the warped wildlife out of its misery while collecting tainted ephemera from the elementals.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Harmonious Elder via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Aberrant elementals warp animals, disrupting the balance. Grant merciful deaths to the animals while you collect ephemera from the elementals.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The tainted ephemera, collected from the aberrant elementals, can be salvaged. The warped creatures, however, must be euthanized to end their pain.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Masters are surely proud of you, outsider. You have accomplished much to maintain the balance in this place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Make haste! The longer the elementals thrive, the more damage they will do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The harmony of this place is closer to being restored.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You mercifully euthanized the warped wildlife while collecting tainted ephemera from aberrant elementals in the Keeper's Sanctuary. The Harmonious Elder and the rest of the Disciples can now distill the tainted ephemera down into balanced components.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do you want the tainted ephemera?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We Disciples cannot risk contact with these inharmonious elementals. To do so is to risk elemental imbalance, and such a condition is not desirable.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Destroying aberrant elementals releases their tainted essences into the environment. Rather than allow such ephemera to twist flora and fauna, the Disciples will attempt to distill it and return it to a balanced state.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The aberrant elementals radiate waves of disharmony, which is carried by the tainted ephemera that gives them life. Such waves are damaging to simple primal patterns.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you callous or merely obtuse? Neither is forgivable.

localizedTextIdText: The rest of Wheez Nokenti team should be in close proximity to where you found him in Cankertube Swamp. Doctor Claremont has ordered you to waste no time in locating and rescuing what remains of these missing scientists.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doctor Claremont via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: By Dominus! The scientists are inside that bubble! Their vital signs indicate they are comatose... and barely alive! Go to them! Save them if you can!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well? Where are the scientists? What was that bubble? What have you learned? Do not return to me until these questions have answers!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stop! Do not touch any of the others! The scientist you roused has died, but the others still emit faint vital signs. Leave them alone for now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Steel yourself! Who knows what evil you will face inside that bubble!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This Globellum... I must deduce some method of removing its captive prey!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: What are we going to do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Wheez Nokenti research team, but were unable to save them from a creature called $~(creature=59537). The Globellum nearly drained your life, but you were able to resist its attempts to take control of your mind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It appears all the tales I heard about you in Illium were lies.

localizedTextIdText: A vacationing couple, Grandpa Oda and Granny Ness, have asked you to escort them around the Nursery so they can take in the sights. They don't seem to care that their chosen vacation spot is incredibly dangerous.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Ness via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The missus and I are taking our vacation, darn tootin'. We heard this place was something else, ayep, but we'd appreciate a tour guide. How 'bout you?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: No time to be sitting on your hind end, youngster. You going to give us a tour of this place or what?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We really appreciate you giving us the grand tour, child. You bet we do. Only I'm wondering if we'll get moving any time soon, hm?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You need to start yourself a tour guide business, really. You gave Grandpa and me our money's worth, you betcha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Of course it's not safe. We knew that already, you betcha.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time we come back, we'll ask for you again. Bye-bye!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm glad you had fun. Really.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You escorted Grandpa Oda and Granny Ness around the Nursery and kept them safe from the numerous dangers there.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll give you a tour, alright.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, ain't that a kick in the teeth, Granny? Kid can't be bothered.

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Claremont has instructed you to collect cerebral samples, cankertubling specimens, and corruptor tissue in Cankertube Swamp. With such a broad selection of samples, he hopes to determine what $~(creature=59537) is up to.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doctor Claremont via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I require you to collect samples of cerebral tissue from our wayward citizens, flora growing near the Globellum, and tissue from Strain corruptors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The list is short, yet you still forget. I require cerebral samples from wayward citizens, cankertubling specimens, and tissue from corruptors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! These samples prove that the Strain is irrelevant here! It is the Globellum itself that enthralls our people!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not let any residual guilt cloud your judgment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll not be undermined by a gelatinous spherical psychic! Never!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The different samples you collected on behalf of Doctor Claremont allowed him to determine that $~(creature=59537) is controlling the minds of sapient beings and creatures within Cankertube Swamp. Fortunately for the Dominion, Doctor Claremont isn't going to take this laying down.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want flora samples?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do you need cerebral samples?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What purpose will the corruptor tissue serve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Not just any flora! Based on ocular scans, I believe the cankertubes that grow near the Globellum are, themselves, a part of the creature.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Something must be amiss with the brains of those enthralled citizens, and I intend to find out what. To do that, I'll need samples of their cerebral tissue.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: If I am to know the truth, I must ascertain that the Strain is not behind the behavior of our brainwashed brothers and sisters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool! We must unravel the mystery before us, $(player.name)!

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow wants you to go on your first mining mission. Grab a Novice's Laser Pickaxe from Armorer Thaako and get to work harvesting Iron Chunk from Iron Node in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Armorer Thaako in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm not going to lie to you, $(player.name). We're short on ore. Our weaponsmiths and armorers can't work like this! You'd better get mining.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Weaponsmiths and armorers really depend on miners. So equip your laser pickaxe and chase down some iron chunks for Armorer Thaako.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: At this point, I'm just welding scraps to other scraps. I need some real ore, and you look like you got the stones to handle a laser pickaxe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This'll help me finish my next little project. Gotta keep our people safe from bandit scum, and I figure inch-thick steel plating is a good start.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Armorer Stanhope can get you started with a novice's laser pickaxe.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With ore like this, we'll be armed to the teeth in no time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Pickaxe and used it to gather ore for Armorer Thaako, who makes armor for the Exiles on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: No ore can hide from me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: With an attitude like that, you're really getting on my nerves.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective wants you to go on your first mining mission. Grab aNovice's Laser Pickaxe from Armorer Vospana and get to work harvesting Iron Chunk from Iron Node in Deradune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Armorer Vospana in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The crafters who supply the Dominion arsenal require a steady stream of metal for the armor and weapons they provide. As a miner, that is your duty.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your mission is to acquire a novice's laser pickaxe from Armorer Vospana, so that you may provide her with iron chunks. Do not tarry.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm looking for someone competent in the use of a laser pickaxe to provide me with ores. Are you qualified?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, I believe this will do. The ore may be rough, but it is strong and worthy of being a part of my glorious creations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Armorer Vospana can get you started with a laser pickaxe.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: When you see the legion's armor gleam in the sunlight, know you had a part in it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Pickaxe and used it to gather ore for Armorer Stanhope, who makes armor for the Exiles on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You betray the honor of your trade, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at the Tradeskill Hub in Lightreach Mission wants you to go on your first mining mission. Grab a Novice's Laser Pickaxe from Bagazi Kreng and get to work harvesting Iron Chunk from Iron Node in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bagazi Kreng in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It is with iron and steel that we strengthen the Dominion. As a miner, your ores will be crafted into arms and armor and our might will grow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please acquire a novice's laser pickaxe from Bagazi Kreng, so that you may provide him with iron chunks. Take pride in your duty, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Unless $(player.race) can hold a laser pickaxe, go away! Bagazi needs iron chunks for important science!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(player.class) bring iron chunks? Good, good, maybe not destined for scrap heap after all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bagazi Kreng will provide you with a laser pickaxe.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, the science I will do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Pickaxe and used it to gather ore for Bagazi Kreng, who makes armor for the Dominion on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you took pride in your work. How disappointing.

localizedTextIdText: Primal elementals once powered the tributary beams that created barriers around the Keeper's Sanctuary. They have since been freed and warped by their aberrant brothers. The Harmonious Elder has asked that you fetch the cores from these twisted elementals so he can restore power to the tributary beams.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Harmonious Elder via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Are you as capable as you seem, outsider? We shall soon see. I require the cores of five twisted elementals, fire, water, air, logic, and earth!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The twisted elementals reside nearby. Be wary! They have become even more dangerous in their twisted state! The Disciples demand their cores!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have surpassed the expectations of the Disciples, outsider! Well done! Well done, indeed!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With your aid we will see the threat of disharmony eliminated!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: With the cores powering the beams, there is one more step to take.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You handily defeated the five twisted elementals and retrieved their cores for the Harmonious Elder. All that remains is the core of the life elemental.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get the cores for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need these cores?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The barriers around the Keeper's Sanctuary must be powered by the pure cores of single elements. As we are a product of elemental harmony, the Disciples cannot serve such a purpose.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Very perceptive you are, outsider! In time, we will discuss the life core. For now, you must produce the others.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool! You disappoint the Masters!

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Claremont and Dipswitch have created a probe that will dispense psi-positories into the smaller gelatinous globs that comprise the Globellum. He wants you to deliver the psi-positories to $~(creature=59537) so that you can somehow enter the creature's mind.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doctor Claremont via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dipswitch and I have constructed a drone that you can use to insert probes into the Globellum's smaller... er... globs, spread across the swamp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The psi-positories must be inserted into the Globellum's weaker orifices. I hope you do not require a demonstration of how psi-positories function.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Psi-pository insertion successful! Now you will have an eighty percent chance of successfully entering the Globellum's mind every single time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The hardware being used is on loan, but my credit rating is outstanding!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope your mental fortitude stands up to the rigors of this next task!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Doctor Claremont psi-positories have been violently plunged into the smaller gelatinous bubbles that theoretically make up $~p(creature=59537) expansions. You should now be able to access the creature's mind.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Can't we just kill the Globellum?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Certainly. The drone drops special probes, psi-positories, into the Globellum's weaker orifices. They will create a conduit for you to extend your consciousness into the Globellum's and rescue our fellow citizens from the gelatinous savage!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Precisely. The larger one is more mature, and exhibits a higher resistance to my scan. The smaller, weaker ones provide more precise data. I surmise they will have a much lower resistance to the psi-positories.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: That would be too easy, $(player.name). Besides, the Dominion has other plans for the creature...
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No loyal citizen would refuse a chance to administer a psi-pository!

localizedTextIdText: Due to the successful insertion of the psi-positories, Doctor Claremont believes you can utilize the Psionic Portal Dynamo to enter the Mind of the Globellum and free the Dominion citizens held captive there with the focused totality of your will.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doctor Claremont via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Use the psionic portal dynamo to enter the Globellum's Mind, then use the focused totality of your will to free the citizens who are trapped there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I suggest you hurry. If the Globellum becomes aware of our tactical advantage, it might block you from entering its consciousness.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You freed the minds of our people from the gelatinous beast! They have been wandering back to camp in ones and twos. You have done so very well!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Should you find any Exiles, feel free to put them out of their misery.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are not done. We must show the Globellum the true meaning of control.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I guess I'll be leaving, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully entered the Mind of the Globellum and used the focused totality of your will to free the Dominion citizens who were trapped within it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You are going inside the consciousness of the Globellum! There, you will be able to disrupt the mind control of your fellow sapients with minimal risk to their lives, and maximum glory!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The focused totality of your willpower, $(player.name)! Remember when you resisted the Globellum's attempt to enslave you? When you're in its mind, you can use that power to save others!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You cannot be thinking clearly. Are you tired? You look very tired.

localizedTextIdTitle: How I Learned to Love the Globellum
localizedTextIdText: The time has come to take the fight directly to the Globellum, but Doctor Claremont wants to gain control of the creature and won't tolerate its death. You'll need to destroy $~p(creature=59537) bulbous glands, arm neural scramblers on its nerve bundles, and then trigger the neural megascrambler to finish the job.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Doctor Claremont via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Destroy the Globellum's bulbous glands, arm scramblers on its nerve bundles, and trigger my neural megascrambler! This psychic anchor should keep you safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did I stutter? Use the psychic anchor to protect yourself from the Globellum as you destroy its bulbous glands and scramble its nerve bundles.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have won control of the most powerful organic mind on Nexus, and we are once again free to continue our research in the swamp. Bravo!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With one swift stroke, the Globellum will be ours!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Time to get Dipswitch and Wheez together for some three-way analysis!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At long last, due in large part to your efforts, the Dominion has something it always wanted: a massive, life-draining, mind-controlling, gelatinous life form. Doctor Claremont and his myriad apparatuses have certainly proven that Chua aren't the Dominion's only mad inventors!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, it's one of my special devices. If I'm correct, it will protect you from the Globellum's telekinetic blasts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is our moment of triumph! How can you resign now?

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow wants you to go on your first survivalist mission. Grab a Novice's Laser Chainsaw from Architect Kaspmara, and get to work harvesting Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} from Azure Ash Tree.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Architect Kaspmara in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your job is to scout for fine hardwoods. We're building a real home here, and we can't do it without lumber!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Architects and survivalists work together all the time. Architect Kaspmara really needs more Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} - we're trying to build up an entire planet!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The laser chainsaw is a delicate and dangerous device. Wield it well while you're winnowing that wood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is good to see that you have returned, and with all your limbs intact! Mark my words, together we will build a home for everyone.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go talk to Architect Kaspmara. He'll give you a shiny new Novice's Laser Chainsaw.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I shall put this heartwood to use immediately.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can cut down a few trees for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Chainsaw and used it to gather wood for Architect Kaspmara, who builds homes and furniture for Exiles on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I can get more of that.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: So I'll be cutting down trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What else can I do as a survivalist?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What should I use to cut the trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yep, but don't worry! We've discovered several varieties of fast-growing trees that offer excellent wood, easily gathered without harming the greater forest around them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Well, survivalists are great hunters. When they take down a wild beast, they use every part of the animal, harvesting extra meat and unique leather.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Laser chainsaws are pretty great! Just equip one, and you'll take down trees with minimal mess. They're programmed with smart targeting: once you equip them, they will automatically enable when you go after a tree.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw, why not?

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective wants to send you on your first survivalist mission. Grab aNovice's Laser Chainsaw from Architect Virin and get to work harvesting Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} from Savannah Palm.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Architect Virin at Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Survivalists like yourself are our primary source for fine hardwoods. Our efforts to construct proper homes rely on a steady supply of local lumber.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Architects and survivalists are the foundation of our construction efforts. Architect Virin would greatly appreciate any Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} you can provide.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've always got me eye out for a bloke what can wield a Novice's Laser Chainsaw with some level of skill. A bit of wood's not worth losing all yer limbs over.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: By the Scions, you've got an eye on you! I'll save this lot for the next ultra-posh project I'm doing, I will.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak to Architect Virin. He will provide you with a laser chainsaw.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll get this planet up to snuff in no time.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can cut down a few trees for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Chainsaw and used it to gather wood for Architect Virin, who builds homes and furniture for the Dominion on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: So I'll be cutting down trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What else can I do as a survivalist?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What should I use to cut the trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. We've discovered several varieties of fast-growing trees that produce excellent lumber and are easily harvested.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Survivalists are superb hunters. When they take down a wild beast, they use every part of the animal, providing us with tasty meat and unique leather.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: A laser chainsaw is not a toy. Equip one, and you can dispatch trees with brutal efficiency. They're programmed with smart targeting: once you equip one, it will automatically enable when you go after a tree.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you seriously denying my request?

localizedTextIdText: Conservationist Caius has asked for your help cataloguing the creatures in Owanee Basin. You are to report to him at Owanee Research Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Conservationist Caius at Owanee Research Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My name is Caius. You've developed quite a reputation in Deradune, and I was hoping I could get your assistance. It's best you come speak with me in person.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for coming. Let's get down to business, shall we?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Wonderful. You'll find me at the research station in Owanee Basin.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We've hit a bit of a snag with equipment. Speak with Biologist Ari before we begin.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Conservationist Caius at Owanee Research Station and offered your assistance cataloguing the Emperor's herds there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I had hoped for more from someone with your reputation.

localizedTextIdText: In order to gain a life core, the Harmonious Elder must sacrifice himself and become a life elemental. Follow him to the Keeper's Sanctuary and watch over him as he performs the proper ritual.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the New Harmonious Elder on the Terrace of Harmony
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In this final process, I am duty-bound to replace the previous life elemental. You must protect me as the ritual progresses. Are you ready?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The ritual must not be interrupted! Continue your vigil!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Harmonious Elder has given himself to maintain harmony in this place. I have been made the new elder. I offer you the gratitude of the Disciples.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The ritual begins! But something is wrong... I sense the Blight!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Masters will watch over you, outsider. Always.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Harmonious Elder was able to complete the ritual despite some initial difficulties, and you were instrumental in his success. As he is now a life elemental, his position as Harmonious Elder has been undertaken by one of the other Disciples.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the New Harmonious Elder
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How can you replace a life elemental?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is simple, outsider. I will give the life within myself to create a new life elemental. I will transcend my mortal flesh and return harmony to this place.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Do not concern yourself. Another Disciple will replace me, for the balance must be maintained.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Disciples have no time for this outsider's nonsense!

localizedTextIdText: The wall surrounding Grimvault is under attack by unknown forces! Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to rendezvous with Corrigan Doon and help contend with this new threat.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corrigan Doon at the Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The wall surrounding Grimvault is under attack! We cannot allow that wall to be breached under any circumstances. Is that clear?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This crisis must be addressed before the wall suffers more damage. Get to Grimvault immediately! The Dominion demands it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hold on tight, luv... this could get a little rough.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I s'pose that's one way to make an entrance, eh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Rendezvous with Corrigan Doon. He will take you to Grimvault.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For what she's worth, welcome to Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That's one way to put it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following a mysterious attack on the wall surrounding Grimvault, you met with Corrigan Doon and proceeded to the scene. En route, however, your transport was shot down, causing you to crash land on the battlefield.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You dare question me? I have torn the lungs from others for less! Suffice it to say that the walls surrounding Grimvault cage in all manner of horrors. Should the walls fall, the rest of Nexus will suffer... and you with them!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pathetic scum! The empire requires your service!

localizedTextIdText: Grimvault's walls are under attack by unknown forces! Commander Durek has ordered you to rendezvous with Deadeye Brightland and help contend with the new threat coming from inside Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Deadeye Brightland at the Crash Site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The walls of Grimvault are under attack from somewhere inside. I want ya to meet Deadeye at the extraction site and get to Grimvault, pronto!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We're all gonna be in a world of hurt if you don't get your butt to Grimvault!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't just stand there, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya see? There's a reason I don't like flyin' no more, and it's called "crashin'."
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This is big, $(player.name), so don't be late!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lend a hand, will ya? I'm sure there's folks here who need your help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Following a mysterious attack on the walls of Grimvault, you met with Deadeye Brightland and flew to investigate. En route, however, your transport was shot down, causing you to crash land on the battlefield.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You think I'm askin'? You know me better than that, pal.

localizedTextIdText: You've touched down at the Granok landing site in Northern Wilds. Trooper Takag has instructed you to check in with Commander Durek right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek at the Granok landing site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like you survived the drop. That's good, 'cause we need all the help we can get. Check in with the commander and see what he needs done.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Talking to me ain't gonna help nobody. Report to the commander, pronto.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Made it to Nexus, did ya? About time! I expect ya to make the Granok people proud. Embarrass me, and I'll have yer hide. Got it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get movin'. Lives are on the line, and we ain't got much time.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's put you to work, recruit.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report to him right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Durek has wasted no time getting his operation up and running at the Landing Site.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusin' an order's gonna get you thrown in the stockade.

localizedTextIdText: You've arrived in Greenleaf Glade in Everstar Grove. Trooper Takag has instructed you to check in with Fenra Skytree right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Fenra Skytree in Greenleaf Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I knew there was at least one other Granok on that ship. Good thing, too, 'cause these Aurin need us. Go talk to Fenra Skytree, see what she needs done.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Go talk to Fenra. She's the one who needs help. I'm doin' just fine on my own, thanks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, wow! Are you here to help? Because I need all the help I can get!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That little lady's a bit nervous. She says the forest is angry. Weird, huh?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, where to start?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report to her right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Fenra Skytree needs your help to soothe the forests of Greenleaf Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Look, rookie. You're here, get me? So ya might as well pitch in.

localizedTextIdText: Queen Myala Everstar wants you to jump through the Weave Knot inside the Heart of the Godwood Tree in order to open portals through the Weave. Once the portals are opened, Myala's powers can halt the destruction of the Godwood Tree.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Queen Myala Everstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lazarin has no regard for nature! While his people's plight is profound, we can't allow that beautiful Godwood Tree to be destroyed! I need your help!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I've managed to send some of my power into the Godwood Tree, but it's unfocused. I need you to find and unravel Weave knots to create a the link.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now I can use my powers to heal the Godwood Tree despite Lazarin's... exploits. His people need the primal life, but not at such a heavy cost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Weave knots are the key to opening the portals! Leap through them!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done a great thing today. Thank you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help you save the tree.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Worried that Victor Lazarin men would kill the Godwood Tree as they harvested its primal life, Queen Myala Everstar used her power to ward the tree from destruction. With your help, she opened some portals to the Weave, allowing her to channel healing energy into the Godwood Tree's heart.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I can open portals in the heart of the Godwood Tree and use them to channel healing energy to it, but the Weave is so tangled up in there!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Find the glowing green weave knots and jump through them until they unravel. I know it sounds kind of weird, but it'll work! Trust me!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It saddens me to see you turn your back on the needs of this ancient tree!

localizedTextIdText: You've received a distress call from the Harmonious Elder, who can be found in the Keeper's Sanctuary. He inferred that something is disturbing the balance of the elements, and you must help the Pell to rectify the problem.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Harmonious Elder at the Keeper's Sanctuary
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Outsider, we call upon you for assistance. The balance of the elements surrounding the Keeper's Sanctuary has been disturbed. Will you help us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Disciples are gladdened by your coming. The question remains though, are you worthy of this task, outsider? You must be tested.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I await your arrival. You will be my honored guest.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Unless you are proved worthy, I fear you cannot solve our dilemma.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Wait, I have to pass a test?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the Keeper's Sanctuary and spoke to the Harmonious Elder about the disturbance that's causing his people such trouble. Unfortunately, it sounds like they want to test you first.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please reconsider. Our plight may soon spread to other areas.

localizedTextIdText: The Harmonious Elder has instructed you to commune with the elemental crystals in the Keeper's Sanctuary. Doing so will reveal how the elements can be kept in harmony with one another, and what such a balance means.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Harmonious Elder via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To aid us, you must understand elemental harmony. Commune with the five elemental crystals on the Terrace of Harmony and you will be illuminated.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The elemental crystals can be found on the Terrace of Harmony. Go to them, commune with them, and learn the ways of elemental harmony.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Disciples can see you have been changed now that you possess the knowledge of elemental harmony. It is fortunate you survived the communion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let the elements guide you and your path will never falter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps it appeared easy to you, but your survival was never guaranteed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the Harmonious Elder request, you communed with the elemental crystals in the Keeper's Sanctuary. Unlike the Pell in other regions of Nexus, the Harmonious Pell attempt to bring balance to all of the elements, rather than focusing on a single one.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Five crystals? But there are six elements.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You seem different than other Pell.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: This place isn't corrupted. How is that possible?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The sixth element, life, exists within all living things, including the Disciples. Even as we maintain the balance, we personally provide the power of the element of life.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Indeed. We are the Keepers of Harmony. We do not slavishly dedicate ourselves to a single element like other Pell. Instead, we follow in the footsteps of the Masters and bring all elements into balance.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You speak of corruption. I believe you refer to what the Disciples call the Blight. So long as we maintain our balance, the Blight has no power here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I see you care nothing for balance or harmony. Leave us, then.

localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Arborgreen at the Tradeskill Hub in Gallow wants you to go hunting for Eldan relics. Grab a Novice's Relic Blaster from Technologist Blackwood and get to work harvesting Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} from Standard Relic Node in Algoroc.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} to Technologist Blackwood in Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Relic Hunters were the first Exiles to discover omni-plasm. It ended up being so useful, our Technologists have them looking for it full-time.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Talk to Technologist Blackwood, equip your Novice's Relic Blaster, and start looking for Standard Relic Node. What are you waiting for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Omni-plasm is a heckuva lot more powerful than any doctorin' we knew before coming to Nexus. Not sure how it works, but we need more of it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We can't make heads or tails of most Eldan tech, but omni-plasm is downright obliging to technological manipulation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get a Novice's Relic Blaster from Technologist Blackwood, go look for Standard Relic Node.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get some folks patched up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Technologist Blackwood gave you a shiny new Novice's Relic Blaster, allowing you to extract omni-plasm from mysterious Eldan relic nodes. Nobody's quite sure how the stuff works, but it makes great medishots.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sometimes you can be a real jerk, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at the Tradeskill Hub in Feralplain Collective has instructed you to search for Eldan relics. Acquire an Novice's Relic Blaster from Technologist Otha and harvest Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} from Standard Relic Node in Deradune.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} to Technologist Otha in Feralplain Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Omni-plasm is a gift from the Eldan, a versatile substance that has many applications for our Technologists. You must find more relic nodes to harvest.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak with Technologist Otha, then equip your Novice's Relic Blaster so that you may properly harvest Standard Relic Node. The wealth of the Eldan awaits you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Omni-plasm is proof that the Eldan wanted us to have this planet. Easily harvestable relics just filled with miracle goop? That's got to be a sign.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, there's me omni-plasm. I'm not sure how this stuff works, but it'll bring a body back who's practically through death's airlock.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Technologist Otha will give you a Novice's Relic Blaster to use on Standard Relic Node.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The blessings of the Eldan are all around us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Technologist Otha granted you a Novice's Relic Blaster, allowing you to extract omni-plasm from mysterious Eldan relic nodes. The Eldan work in mysterious ways, and the gift of omni-plasm has allowed Dominion Technologists to make great strides in the field of medicine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not risk my wrath so lightly, you worm!

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at the Tradeskill Hub in Lightreach Mission has instructed you to search for Eldan relics. Acquire an Novice's Relic Blaster from Technologist Corvianos and harvest Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} from Standard Relic Node in Ellevar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Standard Omni-Plasm{p:Standard Omni-Plasm} to Technologist Corvianos in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: When hunters like you discovered that Eldan relic nodes yielded omni-plasm, it was the dawning of a new age of innovation for our Technologists.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak with Technologist Corvianos, then equip your Novice's Relic Blaster so that you may properly harvest Standard Relic Node. The wealth of the Eldan awaits you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Omni-plasm is proof that the Eldan wanted us to have this planet. Easily harvestable relics just filled with miracle goop? That's got to be a sign!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, there's me omni-plasm. I'm not sure how this stuff works, but it'll bring a body back who's practically through death's airlock.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Technologist Corvianos will give you a Novice's Relic Blaster to use on Standard Relic Node.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The blessings of the Eldan are all around us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Technologist Corvianos granted you a Novice's Relic Blaster, allowing you to extract omni-plasm from mysterious Eldan relic nodes. The Eldan work in mysterious ways, and the gift of omni-plasm has allowed Dominion Technologists to make great strides in the field of medicine.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would be wise not to cross me a second time, my pet.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela at the Tradeskill Hub in Lightreach Mission wants you to go on your first survivalist mission. Grab a Novice's Laser Chainsaw from Architect Cybene, and get to work harvesting Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} from Blazing Pine.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Architect Cybene at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Survivalists like yourself are our primary source for fine hardwoods. Our efforts to construct proper homes rely on a steady supply of local lumber.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Architects and survivalists are the foundation of our construction efforts. Architect Cybene would welcome any Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood} you can provide.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hello, $(player.name). I hope I can rely on you to use this Novice's Laser Chainsaw responsibly. I am counting on you for Knotted Heartwood{p:Knotted Heartwood}. Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glad to see you pulling your weight. It's going to take a lot of work to make this place livable for everybody who wants a new start.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go talk to Contractor Drogor. He'll give you a shiny new laser chainsaw.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I won't rest until everybody's got a decent place to live.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can cut down a few trees for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You got a shiny new Novice's Laser Chainsaw and used it to gather wood for Architect Cybene, who builds homes and furniture for the Dominion on Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: So I'll be cutting down trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What else can I do as a survivalist?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What should I use to cut the trees?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. We've discovered several varieties of fast-growing trees that produce excellent lumber and are easily harvested.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Survivalists are superb hunters. When they take down a wild beast, they use every part of the animal, providing us with tasty meat and unique leather.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: A laser chainsaw is not a toy. Equip one, and you can dispatch trees with brutal efficiency. They are programmed with smart targeting: once you equip one, it will automatically enable when you go after a tree.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A refusal? Perhaps I misheard you.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To do work, one requires materials. If you are ready to embark upon your first project, I will provide what you require.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you wish to examine your materials, you will find them in your tradeskill bag.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an architect, Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela has given you the crafting materials necessary to start your first project.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I have no time for fools.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela wants to show you how to craft furniture. Use the materials she's given you to craft $m(schematic=374) at a crafting station in Lightreach Mission. Deliver the resulting product to Architect Cybene.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your $m(schematic=374) to Architect Cybene in Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Take the wood and supplies I gave you and begin your assigned task. The Crafting Station has everything else you need.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is a Crafting Station right behind me. Use it to find the schematic for $schematic=374 and take the results to Architect Cybene.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must construct a $schematic=374. I trust that using a Crafting Station is not beyond your cognitive abilities?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Much to my surprise, you have performed adequately. Your contribution has been noted and will be put to use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Crafting Station has instructions for the $schematic=374 that's needed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is our duty to fulfill the wants and needs of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: For your first Architecture project, you crafted $m(schematic=374) for Architect Cybene.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: So, are you just going to take the materials I've given to you and leave? How wretched.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Chromatics Promoter has an amazing offer for you! Simply recover the Damaged Protostar Dye Collection from the Battered Protostar Dye Crate, salvage it to obtain Plurbinum Dye, and then turn that in to the Protostar Appearance Modificator to receive your complimentary sample of Protostar's state-of-the-art chromatic enhancement system! Visit Protostar's representatives in Thayd for further details.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring Plurbinum Dye to the Protostar Appearance Modificator in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have I got a deal for you! Simply help our Protostar Appearance Modificator recover his missing delivery, and we'll provide a free sample of our Protostar Chromatics System!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: One of our patented dye systems was misdelivered somewhere in Thayd. Retrieve the contents and salvage them to evaluate the damage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where could that delivery of promotional dye have gotten to? If you find it, see what you can salvage from the Damaged Protostar Dye Collection inside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Damaged in shipping, eh? Well, here's a pristine replacement, courtesy of Protostar! Be sure to visit our nearby vendor for even more chromatic options.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Act fast! Our missing package is somewhere in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy your free sample! I hear Protostar Platinum is the new black!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered a promotional dye book from Protostar, and learned how to use the Protostar Chromatics System. Now you can use your Holo-Wardrobe to color-coordinate your outfit whenever you wish. Fetching!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Salvaging sounds like something I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the book to the Protostar Appearance Modificator
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I get these pigments?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Protostar's innovative chromatic pigments put you in control of the colors of your life! It's a snap to modify your armor's color palette with our new system.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Protostar-brand chromatic enhancement goes beyond conventional dyes, allowing you to create magnificent color combinations on a single item.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Old-fashioned dyes just glop all over your armor... messy and frustrating! Protostar chromatics apply cleanly to selected areas, allowing unprecedented stylistic control.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Simply salvage any blind-boxed chromatic collection to get a manual instructing you on how to dial in a new color, then use your Holo-Wardrobe to apply it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Manuals teach you our custom code for each dye. Once you learn the code, you can use it again and again in your Holo-Wardrobe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're missing the opportunity of a lifetime!

localizedTextIdText: You received a mysterious summons from someone who claims to know Drusera. They have opened a new portal near Thayd and have asked you to meet them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Rhoda Wellspring in the Secret Ops Center in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We know much about you, $(player.name). Drusera is an... old friend. We've opened a portal for you in Thayd. Come, we have much to talk about...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't you wish to learn more about your mysterious friend Drusera? Come to us and we will share our knowledge with you. The portal will be waiting in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Looks like another portal opened up, but you say Drusera didn't summon you? I'd be lyin' if I said I didn't want you to check it out, but be careful.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This news is real concernin'. Those Eldan were messin' with some serious stuff! First the Strain, now this Entity - what'll this planet think of next?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not keep us waiting...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've already written up a report on the Entity - be sure to check it out when you have the time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the latest portal only to find yourself in a strange, subterranean space - the target of a malevolent being that called itself the Entity. After being forced to undergo several trials of strength, the Entity revealed his intention to use you to create a new, more powerful army of Strain. You barely managed to escape his lair with the help of Drusera.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A pity. Now you will never learn what it is that Drusera keeps from you.

localizedTextIdText: You received a mysterious summons from someone who claims to know Drusera. They have opened a new portal near Illium and have asked you to meet them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chancellor Juro Takigurian in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I know much about you, $(player.name). Drusera and I are... old friends. Come, there is much I must tell you. I've opened a portal for you in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't you wish to learn more about your mysterious friend Drusera? Come to us and we will share our knowledge with you. The portal will be waiting in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Another portal has appeared, yet you say you've heard nothing from Drusera? No matter, the Collegium must know what lies beyond it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Eldan were engaged in high-level experiments indeed - first the Strain, and now the Entity. The secrets this planet holds are endless.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not keep us waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: However, news of this Entity is disturbing. I believe General Warbringer must be notified. I've also filed a report.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You entered the latest portal only to find yourself in a strange, subterranean space, and the target of a malevolent being calling itself the Entity. After being forced to undergo several trials of strength, the Entity revealed his intentions to use you to create a new, more powerful army of Strain. You barely managed to escape his lair with the help of Drusera.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A pity. Now you will never learn what it is that Drusera keeps from you.

localizedTextIdText: You receive a call from Drusera asking you to meet with her again. She has promised to explain more about herself. Travel to Thayd and find out what she has to say.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Rhoda Wellspring in the Secret Ops Center in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's me again, $(player.name). I promised you explanations last time and I think it's time you heard them. I've opened a portal to a safe place.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Meet me beyond the portal. I will tell you more about me... and what it means to be the Genesis Prime.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Another portal, huh? This is dangerous business, but it's true we still don't know much about Drusera or what she is. You should go see what she has to say.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: To think the Eldan succeeded in creatin' such a powerful being... Either way, we can't let the Entity get to Drusera, or we're all in serious trouble!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll be waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll make sure the higher-ups see my finished report. They'll want to know more about Drusera and the Entity.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled beyond the Thayd portal and met up with Drusera, who explained that the Genesis Prime is a being with ultimate powers of creation. She even let you wield the powers of creation yourself. The Entity, however, somehow managed to find you both and sent his minions to corrupt the reality Drusera had created.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please give me a chance. I think you'll change your mind once you hear what I have to say.

localizedTextIdText: An insistent Granok named Rogum wants to take you on a tour of Woodhaven. Follow him around the town to learn more about its amenities and services.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Rogum in Woodhaven
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: New here? Like the town but don't like bein' lost? How's about a tour? Or, them guards love giving directions. Just ask!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Got a question or somethin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So? Whaddaya think? Woodhaven's pretty solid, right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: All right! Let's get to the tour. Just keep with me, and I'll tell you 'bout Woodhaven.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hey, lemme know if you got any questions.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: An enthusiastic Granok named Rogum took you on a tour of Woodhaven. He showed you the local mailbox, transmat terminal, and taxi vendor.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Send items and money! Get money and items from others! Hey, ya can even use it ta chat.
