localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Taxis move ya safely between kiosks. New kiosks'll unlock as ya gain more, whaddayacallit, experience.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Bind yerself to one of those things, and ya can get back in a snap, from anywheres on Nexus!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, lemme know if you ever wanna take a tour.

localizedTextIdText: You received an alarming call from Drusera, asking you to travel to the portal in Thayd. It seems that time is running out for Drusera.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Rhoda Wellspring in the Secret Ops Center in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm afraid we're running out of time, $(player.name). It's only a matter of time before the Entity wins. I've opened a portal to show you why.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We haven't much time. Meet me beyond the portal. I will show you why.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sounds like things are gettin' real bad. I just wish we knew more. See what Drusera has to tell you - I have a feelin' big things are about to happen soon.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is downright terrible news! We can't allow the Entity to escape from his prison. I've got to let the other Exile leaders know right away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please hurry. I'm afraid... and so tired...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The XAS will do everythin' it can to help Drusera stop the Entity! I've already written my report of what happened.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled with Drusera to Grimvault, where she revealed the terrible burden she has carried alone for centuries. Though she was able to contain the Entity using her powers, he is beginning to break free. Once that happens, nothing can stop him seizing the powers of the Genesis Prime for his own.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then the Entity wins and all is lost...

localizedTextIdText: You receive a call from Drusera asking you to meet with her again. She has promised to explain more about herself. Travel to Illium and find out what she has to say.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chancellor Juro Takigurian in the Enigma Chamber in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's me again, $(player.name). I promised you explanations last time and I think it's time you heard them. I've opened a portal to a safe place.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Meet me beyond the portal. I will tell you more about me... and what it means to be the Genesis Prime.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Collegium needs more information, for we still know little about Drusera and less still about the Entity. See what Drusera wants then report back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What power the Eldan had to create a being like the Drusera! Though the Entity is clearly our enemy, it is understandable why he wishes to possess the Genesis Prime.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll be waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nonetheless, the powers of the Genesis Prime must never fall into the enemy's hands. I've emphasized this in my new report on the matter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled beyond the Illium portal and met with Drusera. She explained that the Genesis Prime is a being with the ultimate power of creation. She even lent them to you so you could experience the power of creation for yourself. However, the Entity somehow managed to find you both and sent his minions to corrupt the reality Drusera had created.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please give me a chance. I think you'll change your mind once you hear what I have to say.

localizedTextIdText: You received an alarming call from Drusera, asking you to travel to the portal in Illium. It seems time is running out for Drusera.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Chancellor Juro Takigurian in the Enigma Chamber in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm afraid we're running out of time, $(player.name). It's only a matter of time before the Entity wins. I've opened a portal to show you why.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We haven't much time. Meet me beyond the portal, I will show you why.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It appears matters have reached a critical turning point. Go to Drusera - we must learn everything we can. I will prepare the Collegium for the worst.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Entity must not be allowed to escape! He may have destroyed the Eldan, but he will not be allowed to threaten the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please hurry. I'm afraid... and so tired...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will inform the emperor and the other leaders. You may read my report on the matter at any time in the Enigma Chamber.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled with Drusera to Grimvault, where she revealed the terrible burden she has carried alone for centuries. Though she was able to contain the Entity using her powers, he is beginning to break free. Once that happens, nothing can stop him seizing the powers of the Genesis Prime for his own.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then the Entity wins and all is lost...

localizedTextIdText: Sylphia Barkberry discovered a Sim Core in Southern Grimvault and needs your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Sylphia Barkberry in Sim Core M-24 in Southern Grimvault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've discovered another Sim Core, but want to map it out before going down there. I need someone to pilot my bot and scan the area.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I need more scans before I can map out the subterranean structure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need more scans before I can map out the subterranean structure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We made it! Thank you for all your hard work. I've already added this Sim Core to the CoGS databases.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's so good of you to help.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If I keep this up, I might even get my very own scientific team to explore Nexus with!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Sylphia Barkberry map the layout of Sim Core M-24.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The geological formations in this area have me worried that the structure might not be intact. I don't want to teleport down there and get trapped!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Pilot my scanbot, Jetsome, and use his Ground Penetrating Radar above the Sim Core. Once the scans come in, I'll be able to build a 3D map!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess I'll do this on my own.

localizedTextIdText: You found a remarkably detailed and seemingly ancient Pell tome. Artemis Zin would no doubt be thrilled to have it in her collection within Spaceport Alpha's museum.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Pell relic is extremely old, and seems to have been carefully transcribed from an even more ancient source.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This Pell relic is extremely old, and seems to have been carefully transcribed from an even more ancient source.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What is this? Fascinating!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, brilliant! This Stormseeker Tech-Tome will be a perfect display in the Dominion museum. This is precisely the type of artifact we are looking for.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This looks important. I'll bet someone wants to get their hands on this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Stormseeker Tech-Tome was put on display in the museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Someone will want to see this.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: This Falkrin weapon looks well-decorated and powerful, perhaps from Osiric himself. Dorian Walker requests that you take the blade to his museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Falkrin weapon looks to be a talon from Osiric himself! This is no doubt a very valuable weapon of the local tribe.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This Falkrin weapon looks to be a talon from Osiric himself! This is no doubt a very valuable weapon of the local tribe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got a relic there? Well, don't just stand there gawkin'. Put it up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's a fine piece, there! My ship's honored by havin' the Talon of Osiric on display. Keep up the good work, skipper.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Another notch in the belt.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll bet Dorian Walker would love to get his hands on this.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wonder what other relics I can find out there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a powerful Falkrin weapon and delivered the relic to the museum. Dorian Walker put the Talon of Osiric on display in the museum in Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll bet Dorian Walker would love to get his hands on this.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put it on the display, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdText: Comandant Rav asked you to collect choice cuts of roan meat for use in the next episode of "Cuisine Commando." Goldmane roan can be found in the Roan Grazing Fields in the Keeper's Sanctuary.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Comandant Rav near the Keeper's Sanctuary
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm desperately looking for someone to procure some tantalizing roan meat for my show's next episode. Interested in earning a little money?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The show will be starting very soon, so I need that roan meat posthaste. I'm sure the Keepers of Harmony have some roan you can butcher.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look at the marbling on this meat! Amazing! And so fresh, it's practically mooing. This is going to be the best episode of Cuisine Commando ever!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fear not! I believe my manager has the budget to compensate you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Wait a moment, don't go anywhere. There's one more thing!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Glad to hear it. See you later.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected several prime cuts of roan meat for Comandant Rav to prepare in his daredevil cooking show, "Cuisine Commando."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Your show? What show is that?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I can't say I've heard of your show.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Can't your assistants get the meat?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Cuisine Commando! The only daredevil cooking show in the universe! I'm Comandant Rav, of course.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Impossible! We've been broadcasting on Nexus since late last week. Every episode, we take our viewers to the most dangerous and exotic locales on the planet and risk life and limb to cook amazing culinary masterpieces!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Affirmative. Roan flesh is so versatile! A finely-cooked Roan steak is one of the premiere culinary delights of Nexus. You can barbecue it, roast it, or even make it into dessert!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: I have attempted to threaten, cajole, and reward them to no avail. They lack the hearts of true Cuisine Commandos. But their cowardice is your gain, my friend!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You do know who I am? Don't you?

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe wants to teach you about Runecrafting: using custom runes to enhance your gear. Find him in Thayd, and he'll get you started with some materials.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Find Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that you've got yer boots under you, it's time you learned how to enhance them boots... with Runecrafting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If'n yer ready, I'll give you some materials so you can craft yer first runes. How do you reckon we should begin? Maybe a health rune?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come to Thayd. I'll get you started.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For health, ya want Signs of Life, I reckon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe got you set up with some materials for Runecrafting. Now it's time to make your first rune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'll never get nowhere with an attitude like that.

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe has given you the materials to create a $(schematic=3526) for a Life Runeslot, which can be used to enhance your gear. Go to the Runecrafting Station in Thayd and get to work!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Crafting Trainer Thorpe with your completed $(schematic=3526)
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Runecrafting Station are used for makin' runes. Take that fragment and these bits of life element and get to work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go find yerself a Runecrafting Station and git to work on that $schematic=3526. Without runes, none of us are operatin' at full potential.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's a mighty nice rune, and I reckon it's likely the first of many. You did good, kid. Now you just have to put it somewhere!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fer now, just bring me back a $(schematic=3526).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That rune's of the Life element, so be sure to put it into a piece of gear with a Life slot.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Thorpe got you set up with some materials for Runecrafting, and you made your first rune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I reckon you must have misunderstood me. This is important.

localizedTextIdText: Far-Trader Sawa in Thayd wants you to modify some gear for her, using custom runes to enhance it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Far-Trader Sawa
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, now you know how to make 'em, now I know somebody who needs help setting 'em up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Far-Trader Sawa in Thayd wants you to modify some gear for her, using custom runes to enhance it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'll never get nowhere with an attitude like that.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela wants to teach you about Runecrafting, using custom runes to enhance your equipment. Find her in Illium, and she'll get you started with some materials.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet with Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time you learned how to properly enhance your items. I shall teach you the secrets of Runecrafting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If you are ready, I'll give you some materials so you can craft your first rune. Shall we begin with a health rune?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come to Illium and we shall begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: For health, it is Signs of Life we desire.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela set you up with some materials for Runecrafting. Now, it's time to make your first rune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That attitude is quite unbecoming for $i(player.race) of your station.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela has given you the materials to create a $(schematic=3526) for a Life Runeslot, which can be used to enhance your gear. Go to the Runecrafting Station in Illium, and begin crafting.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your completed $(schematic=3526) to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion provides Runecrafting Station for crafting runes. Take the rune fragment and Signs of Life I provided, and begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Crafting a simple $(schematic=3526) is not an arduous task. Simply visit the Runecrafting Station, and all will become clear.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finely wrought, $(player.name). I am glad I entrusted you with these techniques. Constructing runes is useless, however, unless you apply them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return to me with your $(schematic=3526).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That is a Life Rune. Use it with a piece of gear containing a Life slot.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela got you set up with some materials for Runecrafting, and you made your first rune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Continue to try my patience, and you shall experience my wrath.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Chromatics Promoter has an amazing offer for you! Simply recover the Damaged Protostar Dye Collection from the Battered Protostar Dye Crate, salvage it to obtain Plurbinum Dye, and then turn that in to the Protostar Appearance Modificator to receive your complimentary sample of Protostar's state-of-the-art chromatic enhancement system! Visit Protostar's representatives in Illium for further details.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring Plurbinum Dye to the Protostar Appearance Modificator in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have I got a deal for you! Simply help our Protostar Appearance Modificator recover his missing delivery, and we'll provide a free sample of our Protostar Chromatics system!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: One of our patented dye systems was misdelivered somewhere in Illium. Retrieve the contents and salvage them to evaluate the damage.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where could that delivery of promotional dye have gotten to? If you find it, see what you can salvage from the Damaged Protostar Dye Collection inside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Damaged in shipping, eh? Well, here's a pristine replacement, courtesy of Protostar! Be sure to visit our nearby vendor for even more chromatic options.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Act fast! Our missing package is somewhere in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy your free sample! I hear Protostar Platinum is the new black!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered a promotional dye book from Protostar, and learned how to use the Protostar Chromatics System. Now you can use your Holo-Wardrobe to color-coordinate your outfit whenever you wish. Fetching!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Salvaging sounds like something I can do.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the book to the Protostar Appearance Modificator
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I get these pigments?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Protostar's innovative chromatic pigments put you in control of the colors of your life! It's a snap to modify your armor's color palette with our new system.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Protostar-brand chromatic enhancement goes beyond conventional dyes, allowing you to create magnificent color combinations on a single item.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Old-fashioned dyes just glopped all over your armor... messy and frustrating! Protostar chromatics apply cleanly to selected areas, allowing you unprecedented stylistic control.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Simply salvage any blind-boxed chromatic collection to get a manual instructing you on how to dial in a new color, then use your Holo-Wardrobe to apply it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Manuals teach you our custom code for each dye. Once you learn the code, you can use it again and again in your Holo-Wardrobe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're missing the opportunity of a lifetime!

localizedTextIdText: Far-Trader Sawa in Thayd wants you to modify some gear for her, using custom runes to enhance it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Far-Trader Sawa
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, now you know how to make 'em, now I know somebody who needs help setting 'em up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Far-Trader Sawa in Thayd wants you to modify some gear for her, using custom runes to enhance it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'll never get nowhere with an attitude like that.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Clerical Associate has asked for your assistance in picking up and delivering supplies around Prosperity Junction.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Clerical Associate or the Junior Clerical Associate in Prosperity Junction
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have a mountain of paperwork. Can you do something for me? I need someone to pick up and deliver supplies around town.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Those deliveries must be completed post-haste! Don't you know? Time is money is time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those deliveries must be completed post-haste! Don't you know? Time is money is time!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great! Any later and we would've dropped below acceptable inefficiency margins. I don't know about you, but I want to keep my job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Check in with me or my subordinate. Time is money... so I'll be timing you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Protostar by picking up and delivering supplies around Prosperity Junction.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Clerical Associate or the Junior Clerical Associate
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Consider this as just another black mark on your permanent record.

localizedTextIdText: Like any other Grumpel, Bello loves a good, juicy story, but even as a bartender he has trouble meeting people with interesting gossip. He came upon a device called the TMI-zer 2000 and needs help testing it on his friends throughout the Arid Sands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bello at the Desert Oasis
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Everyone has a story to tell, but sometimes they don't wish to share! Fortunately, I have a TMI-zer 2000! Try it on my companions and see for yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Testing of this device is so exciting! I'd be doing it myself if my friends didn't suspect anything. They know how... erm... curious I am!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh my! It actually sort of worked! But I have to say, I am not very tickled by the responses you received. I was hoping for something... juicier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I can't wait to find out their secrets! This is so much fun!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yes, until next time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: To Bello surprise, the TMI-zer 2000 worked perfectly! Unfortunately, it became clear to Bello that he needs friends with somewhat more varied interests.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps with a drink or two on the house, you'll change your mind?

localizedTextIdText: Lifecaller Eleni has asked you to return the $m(vitem=867) from corrupted Torine Sisters around Sister's Watch. These idols are sacred and should not be carried by these corrupted abominations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Lifecaller Eleni via datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Torine idols are very sacred to us and should only leave a sisters possession when she dies. However, these corrupted abominations should not be allowed to carry them. Kill them, and return their idols to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Return to me once you have collected enough idols from my corrupted sisters...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, $(player.class). Now the healing can begin...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once returned, I can purify them and they can be earned by other Torine Sisters.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My sisters thank you for this service.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped to returned the $m(vitem=867) to Lifecaller Eleni. Doing so has improved your relations with the Torine Sisterhood.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with Lifecaller Eleni via datachron
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You defile our land and then do not help to clean it up?!

localizedTextIdText: The Hellrose Bowl Equipment Manager has asked you to use shock paddles to liven up the Hellrose Bowl by zapping Moodies. Get out there and give them all a shock!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Hellrose Bowl Equipment Manager via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do you plan to participate in the Hellrose Bowl? If so, I've got an offer for you! I'm in charge of distributing shock paddles. Use them to zap Moodies!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? The Hellrose Bowl - and your imminent fame - await you! Give those Moodies a zapping they won't soon forget!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You showmanship with those paddles is appreciated! Our ratings have risen 0.02% as a direct result of your performance!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful! Protostar cannot be held liable for any injuries sustained.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll light up their Moodie lives.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You utilized the shock paddles on Moodies at the Hellrose Bowl and increased the event's ratings slightly in the process.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Hellrose Bowl Equipment Manager
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you certain? Moodies dance rather well when shocked!

localizedTextIdText: A canimid infestation near the Lay of Water has resulted in the Pell losing their crops. The Harmonious Horticulturist has asked you to destroy the canimid burrows on the outskirts of the Lay of Water to put a stop to the beasts' depredations.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Harmonious Horticulturist on the outskirts of Lay of Water< /text>
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Beasts of the earth tunnel up from its depths and destroy our crops. If you deign to destroy their burrows, the Keepers will be ever in your debt.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do the canimids run in terror? Have their burrows been collapsed, sealing them away from the precious plants tended by this Keeper?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Keepers praise you, outsider. You have done well, and we are not stingy with the rewards we can offer you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let the canimids' blood flow, feeding the soil they have desecrated.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keepers, rejoice! Our crops will grow once more!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'd love to help you out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Harmonious Horticulturist by collapsing canimid burrows on the outskirts of the Lay of Water, thereby protecting the Pells' crops from the voracious beasts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bah! Outsiders are something less than useless!

localizedTextIdText: Comandant Rav has invited you to appear as a guest chef on his daredevil cooking show, "Cuisine Commando." Your opponent, Cuisinier Commando Morgunbraun, is waiting for you in the Cooking Area. There's no time to lose!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Comandant Rav near the Keeper's Sanctuary
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: How would you like to appear as a guest chef on this episode of Cuisine Commando? You could win fame and public adulation forever!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Shouldn't you be cooking something? Get to it! Time is running out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your efforts to breathe life into the culinary arts might just have won you fame and public adulation forever! Whatever the case, it was delicious!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: In the words of my producers, "Go! Kitchen!"
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: What style of cooking was that, anyway? Skeech? Moodie? Dreg?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You appeared as a guest chef on Cuisine Commando. Only time will tell if your fame and public adulation will last forever, but you still did a smash up job!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Is this going to be dangerous?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: None other than Cuisinier Commando Morgunbraun! He's a master of Nexican cuisine, and he won his last match when a cuboar gored his challenger!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I won't lie. An abject loss on my show could tarnish your reputation. Death is also a very real possibility. But I know you'll pull through splendidly!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I cannot believe you'd turn down a chance to be on Cuisine Commando!

localizedTextIdText: The Path-Finder has encountered a metal creature - probably a bot or construct of some kind - within the the Underground Cave. The bot beat the Path-Finder badly and will not allow him to explore the cave. Destroy the bot so the Pell can investigate the cave.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Path-Finder via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Disciples cannot enter that cave. A creature wrought from metal guards the way. It has soundly beaten us and will not let us pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The metal creature is within that cave. Destroy it in the Masters' name, for the wounds of the Disciples will take time to heal properly!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have pleased the Masters with your courage in the face of the metal monster. Now the Disciples can explore the cave without fear of reprisal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Disciples thank you. Be wary! The metal creature is cruel!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our wounds shall mend, outsider. Now go with our thanks.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take care of this metal creature.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located the Hermitbot 5000 inside the Underground Cave and destroyed it, allowing the Path-Finder to explore the cavern.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: A metal creature? Like a bot?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: A bot is a mechanical being.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I do not know this word you speak, "bot." What does it mean?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Curious. The Masters, too, created mechanical beings, but this one is crude and disrupts the harmony of this place. It must be destroyed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you will not beat the creature, the Disciples can never enter the cave.

localizedTextIdText: You touched down at the Granok landing site in the Northern Wilds. Scout Frostfield has instructed you to check in with Commander Durek right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek at the Exile crash site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Between the wounded, the wildlife, and the weather, we got a mess of trouble. Commander Durek is organizin' things. See if he's got somethin' for you to do.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Didn't I tell you to check in with Commander Durek? Between those damn yeti and this blizzard, we need all the help we can get.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Made it to Nexus, did ya? I expect ya to make the Exiles proud. Embarrass me, and I'll have yer hide. Got it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope we make it out of this alive. I ain't fond of freezin' to death.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's put you to work, recruit.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report to Commander Durek right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Commander Durek has wasted no time getting his operation up and running at the Landing Site.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll go talk to Commander Durek.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You bump your head or somethin', $(player.name)? You don't look well...

localizedTextIdText: You've arrived in Greenleaf Glade in Everstar Grove. Scout Frostfield has instructed you to check in with Fenra Skytree right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Fenra Skytree at Greenleaf Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey, partner. I sure am glad you're here. This place is a damn mess, no two ways about it. Go check with Fenra Skytree, 'cause she needs help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Do I look like a cute little Aurin gal to you? Go check in with Fenra before she has a heart attack!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, wow! Are you here to help? Because I need all the help I can get!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be nice to that lady. She's more than a tad bit worried.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, where to start?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report to her right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Fenra Skytree needs your help to soothe the forests of Greenleaf Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me you got somethin' better to do, 'cause all I see is trees.

localizedTextIdText: You've arrived in Greenleaf Glade in Everstar Grove. Keeper Shyroot has instructed you to check in with Fenra Skytree right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Fenra Skytree at Greenleaf Glade
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey $(player.name)! We need help getting set up here. Fenra Skytree's in charge, so you better go and see how you can pitch in.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Like I said before, go talk to Fenra. She's a little bent out of shape, what with the forest and all. Maybe you can set her mind at ease?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nexus isn't quite the home I'd envisioned, but with a little elbow grease I think we'll be able to settle in. It's so nice to have you here to help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fenra could really use some reassuring words about now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're going to come in really handy, I can tell.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report to her right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Fenra Skytree needs your help to soothe the forests of Greenleaf Glade.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fine. Go get eaten by a ravenok. See if I care.

localizedTextIdText: Your transport to Thayd has crash-landed in the Northern Wilds, and the Exiles need all the help they can get. Keeper Shyroot has instructed you to check in with Bosun Redmark at the Exile crash site right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Bosun Redmark at the Exile crash site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That was some wild ride, huh? It's a good thing you pulled through! There's a human, Bosun Redmark, getting things organized. Better go talk to him!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You talk to Redmark yet? Look... you gotta talk to him, because we need help. H-E-L-P. Help. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You here to help, friend? 'Cause I can use all the help I can get.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If this storm keeps up, my ears are gonna freeze off!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Where to start...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll report to him right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Bosun Redmark has his hands full dealing with the wounded at the Exile crash site.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't help, we're all going to freeze to death. That's bad, m'kay?

localizedTextIdText: Professor Morrison issued a comm call warning to all Exiles about "zombies" in Cankertube Swamp, and requested everyone proceed to his location at the Uncanny Advance in Cankertube Swamp at once.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Morrison at the Uncanny Advance
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Callin' all Exiles! Best get your butts to the Uncanny Advance post-haste! Cankertube Swamp's swarmin' with zombies, and it ain't safe!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: And here I thought this might be a nice place to go fishin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Somethin' in this swamp's takin' over folks' minds, and I aim to find out what it is. Wait! Ain't you $(player.name), the famous $(player.class)?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll keep the lights on for you, but you better hurry it up!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hot damn! Have I got a job for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Professor Morrison has revealed that a number of Exiles have had their minds taken over by something in Cankertube Swamp, and it looks like it'll be up to you to figure out what.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Exiles have been goin' into Cankertube Swamp, but when they come back they're changed. They babble about somethin' called the "Globellum" and have been draggin' folks away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you ain't got a problem with dyin', there ain't much more for me to say.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Morrison has sent you into the depths of Cankertube Swamp to locate his Granok lab partner, Cass Quietly. Cass and her team have vanished, and you must locate her before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Morrison via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: One of my XAS science teams is missin' in the swamp, and Cass Quietly, my best researcher, was leadin' 'em. I want you to get out there 'n' find her.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know we been over this! Cass Quietly and her team are lost in the swamp. You better find 'em before their time runs out. Got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good thing you found Cass, $(player.name). I can't afford to lose her. She's the only one here 'sides me that ain't green as grass.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd be a heck of a lot more worried if Cass weren't so tough.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I reckon someone's got it in for us... but who could it be?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After exploring Cankertube Swamp in search of Cass Quietly and her team, you managed to locate Cass. Unfortunately, it appears as if she was left alive by a deranged mob for no other reason than to act as bait.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Cass is the best 'n' brightest researcher that's come to Blighthaven with me. Losin' her would put me in a bad place. All the rest are pretty damn wet behind the ears, 'cept maybe for Override.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Override's a Freebot who joined the Exile Academy of Science. He's always... staring at me. I ain't gonna lie, the bot makes me nervous, but I don't wanna raise the alarms just yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Exiles help one another, remember? That slip your mind or somethin'?

localizedTextIdText: The rest of Cass Quietly team should in close proximity to where you found her in Cankertube Swamp. Professor Morrison has ordered you to waste no time in locating and rescuing what remains of these missing scientists.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Morrison via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Brightland's beard! Cass's research team's inside that big blob o' space puddin' over there! Their vitals are stable, but it looks like they're sleepin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gotta check on them researchers before their vitals get any lower! Whatever that big old ball of space mucus is, it can't be good!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alright, alright! That's enough of that! After that mess, we best leave them folks alone. The rest of 'em are still alive, but it don't look good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, $(player.name). I ain't got no clue what that ball of snot is!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We need to figure out how to get 'em all outta there alive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Cass Quietly research team, but were unable to save them from a creature called The Globellum. $^(creature=59537) nearly drained your life, but you were able to resist its attempts to take control of your mind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why, you lousy varmint! We can't just leave them Exiles to die!

localizedTextIdText: Professor Morrison instructed you to collect cerebral samples, cankertubling specimens, and corruptor tissue in Cankertube Swamp. With such a broad selection of samples, he hopes to determine what $~(creature=59537) is up to.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Morrison via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need you to collect samples of cerebral tissue from them poor Exiles, cankertublings growin' near the Globellum, and tissue from Strain corruptors.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The hard part is gettin' cerebral tissue from those enthralled folks. Pickin' cankertublings and smackin' down Strain corruptors is easy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The samples you got confirm it. The Strain ain't got nothin' to do with it. This mind-control business is all the Globellum's doin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It's a shame, but if I'm goin' to save most of 'em, a few of 'em got to die.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That ball o' snot messed with the wrong professor!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The different samples you collected on behalf of Professor Morrison allowed him to determine that $~(creature=59537) is controlling the minds of sapient beings and creatures within Cankertube Swamp. Fortunately for the Exiles, Professor Morrison isn't going to take this laying down.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want cankertubling samples?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do you need cerebral samples?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What purpose will the corruptor tissue serve?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I think them cankertubes that grow near the Globellum are part of it. You pick 'em for me, and I'll be able to prove it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: If I don't have some brain tissue from the enthralled victims, I won't be able to prove whether it's the Globellum or the Strain causin' their madness.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It's just another way to prove that the Strain ain't behind all this. To prove a point, sometimes you have to narrow down the options.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know it ain't easy, but can't you see? We got to do this!

localizedTextIdText: Professor Morrison and Override have created a drone that will dispense psi-positories into the smaller gelatinous globs that comprise the Globellum. He wants you to deliver the psi-positories to $~(creature=59537) so that you can somehow enter the creature's mind.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report back to Professor Morrison via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Stick with me, I've got a plan. I pieced together a drone you can use to deliver probes into the Globellum's smaller snotballs all across the swamp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Them globs may look like bits of snotty puddin', but they's all part of the Globellum. Once you insert the psi-positories into 'em, we'll be in business.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You sure did a good job shovin' them psi-positories up in the Globellum's business! Now you get to ride 'em straight into that boogerball's mind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful. Override... er... contributed some of his parts to the drone.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done all the work. As envious as I am, you've earned it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Professor Morrison psi-positories have been violently plunged into the smaller gelatinous bubbles that theoretically make up $~p(creature=59537) expansions. You should now, somehow, be able to access the creature's mind.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: This all sounds kind of dirty.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Can't we just kill the Globellum?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Long story short, the drone drops probes, psi-positories, into the Globellum's smaller globs. You'll be able to use the psi-positories to project your mind into the Globellum's so you can rescue all them poor Exiles.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Them globs is basically orifices that lead right into the critter's consciousness. The biggest one's too strong, but the little ones ain't got its resistance.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: No can do, friend. The XAS has got plans for that varmint!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey! This tech's goin' to work, trust me. Don't be such a jerk!

localizedTextIdText: Due to the successful insertion of the psi-positories, Professor Morrison believes you can utilize the Psionic Portal to enter the Mind of the Globellum and free the Exiles held captive there with the focused totality of your will.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Morrison via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The psionic portal dynamo'll get you into the critter's mind. Once you're in, use the focused totality of your will to free the Exiles trapped in there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You got to get a wiggle on, $(player.name). If that critter realizes what we're up to, it's liable to shut us out. Them folks're dependin' on you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You done the trick, friend! Exiles have been filterin' into the Uncanny Advance in ones and twos. They're free now, and it's all 'cause of you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's probably some Dommies stuck in there, too. Take 'em out if you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we're goin' to teach that hunk o' snot a lesson!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully entered the Mind of $~(creature=59537) and used the focused totality of your will to free the Exiles who were trapped within it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I told you already. Those psi-positories'll allow you to dive right into the Globellum's consciousness. Once you're in there, you can free the Exiles who're stuck there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yep! It's the same thing that saved you, back when old phlegm-butt tried to enslave you. You can turn it around and use it to free the others. Nifty, huh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey! $(player.name)! Wake up! Ain't no time to be shirkin' your duty.

localizedTextIdTitle: How I Learned to Love the Globellum
localizedTextIdText: The time has come to take the fight directly to the Globellum, but Professor Morrison wants to gain control of the creature and won't tolerate its death. You'll need to destroy $~p(creature=59537) bulbous glands, arm neural scramblers on its nerve bundles, and then trigger the neural megascrambler to finish the job.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Morrison via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Destroy the Globellum's bulbous glands, arm scramblers on its nerve bundles, and trigger the neural megascrambler. Best take this psychic anchor, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That psychic anchor'll protect you from the Globellum while you destroy its bulbous glands and scramble the thing's nerve bundles. Get 'er done!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're all right by me, $(player.name)! Not only did you free all those poor Exiles, but you bagged us one ugly specimen! Good job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That giant glob of mucus is as good as ours! Yee haw!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now we're done with that, I want a stiff drink. How 'bout you?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I do my best, every time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At long last (and due in large part to your efforts) the XAS has something it's always wanted: a massive, life-draining, mind-controlling, gelatinous life form. Professor Morrison and his myriad apparatuses have certainly proven that Mordesh aren't the Exiles' only mad scientists!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yep, it's one of my special devices. It'll protect you from the Globellum's telekinetic blasts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You tryin' to be funny, friend? 'Cause I ain't laughin', am I?

localizedTextIdText: You've touched down in Whisperwind Hollow in Everstar Grove. Alchemist Kossvak has instructed you to check in with Lukas Piotrev right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lukas Piotrev at Whisperwind Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This place is not all it appears to be, $(player.name). There is much that we must do to avert disaster. Speak with Lukas while there is still time.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lukas Piotrev is overseeing this operation. If you wish to see this calamity resolved, you must speak with him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There is a lingering darkness here that we must attempt to dispel. Are you willing to assist your people in their time of need?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May fortune favor you in these dark days.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Excellent. Listen closely....
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will report to him posthaste.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: How might I assist, Lukas Piotrev?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lukas Piotrev requires your help, for many horrible happening have taken place in Whisperwind Hollow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've come all this way... only to refuse? Are you insane?

localizedTextIdText: Your transport to Thayd has crash-landed in the Northern Wilds, and the Exiles need all the help they can get. Alchemist Kossvak has instructed you to check in with Bosun Redmark at the Exile crash site right away.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Bosun Redmark at the Exile crash site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bosun Redmark seeks capable hands. Mine shake, but yours appear steady. Speak to him at once and offer him help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why do you wait? Bosun Redmark requires aid. He is only one man, and cannot do it all by himself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You here to help, friend? 'Cause I can use all the help I can get.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I fear these hours will be our last. I wish you luck.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Where to start...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will report to him posthaste.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Bosun Redmark has his hands full dealing with the wounded at the Exile crash site.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will speak with him at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am certain this calamitous cold will sway your decision.

localizedTextIdText: You've touched down at Stormcaller Landing in Levian Bay, a gloomy location if you've ever seen one. Lieutenant Ticus has instructed you to check in with Pilot Icarios as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pilot Icarios at Stormcaller Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Best check with Pilot Icaros over there and see what he needs done. And watch out for the bloody lightning.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken to Icaros yet? Do not just stand there, $(player.name). Time is of the essence!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Don't mind the lieutenant. She's a bit stuffy, but she means well. In any case, it's an honor to meet you! Heard all about what you did on the Destiny, I did.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Enough talk. Check in with Icaros at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Look at me, prattlin' on like a  wee lad. Let's see what needs doin'.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pilot Icarios is busy figuring out how to establish the supply lines to Artemis Zin camp, and it appears as if he's got one or two things for you to do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes. The lightning here strikes like the fist of Dominus himself. We've already lost three of the lowborn porters.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you like to reconsider that decision before I call the guards?

localizedTextIdText: You have arrived at Mondo's Beachhead on Crimson Isle. Lieutenant Ticus has instructed you to check in with Mondo Zax as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax at Mondo's Beachhead
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Best speak to the Zax as soon as you are able, $(player.name). I am certain he will find some use for you. Cannon fodder, maybe.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If you fail to report to the Zax, he will have you disintegrated. Go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, look look! Mondo's new assistant, fresh from cryo. Appears weak, unintelligent. Oh, well! Mondo not look gift equivar in mouth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This war won't wait for you, and neither will the Zax.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.name) ready? Time for war!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go speak to the Zax.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mondo Zax is leading a crack team of Chua soldiers to wrest control of Crimson Isle - as well as its Eldan treasures - from the clutches of the Exiles. It appears as if he has plenty of work in store for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Zax has methods for dealing with insubordinate $m(player.class).

localizedTextIdText: The Moodie bone you found is pulsing with dark, necromantic power. Artemis Zin has asked you to take the bone to her museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This bone seems to radiate necromantic power. You shouldn't leave something like this lying around.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This bone seems to radiate necromantic power. You shouldn't leave something like this lying around.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That bone is more brittle than it seems. Be careful when you place it on its pedestal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I realize this may seem like an ordinary bone, but mark my words: it's a magnificent archaeological find! You've done well today.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This looks like a good candidate for the museum.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: May it serve the museum well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Leg Bone of Shala-Boog was put on display in the museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: This looks like a good candidate for the museum.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put the bone in its place.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: You've touched down at Jagged Covein Levian Bay, a gloomy location if you've ever seen one. Agent Infivan has instructed you to check in with Pilot Apex as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pilot Apex at Jagged Cove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are establishing a line of supply to Lady Zin's camp, further inland. Speak to Pilot Apex and see if he requires assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You should speak to Pilot Apex. I am certain he has tasks for you to perform.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have been awaiting your arrival, $(player.name). There are many tasks which we must accomplish, and the hour is already quite late.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remain vigilant. This land is as of yet untamed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pilot Apex at Jagged Cove is establishing a supply line to Artemis Zin camp in Levian Bay. He seems to have a task or two in mind for you.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall speak with him at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you like to explain yourself to Lady Zin?

localizedTextIdText: You have arrived at Mondo's Beachhead on Crimson Isle. Agent Infivan has instructed you to check in with Mondo Zax as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax at Mondo's Beachhead
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Zax has been awaiting your arrival, $(player.name). This battle is just beginning, and you will play a vital role in it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Zax may be small, but he is very intelligent for an organic being. Present yourself to him immediately and request an assignment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, look look! Mondo remember $(player.name) from lab on ship. Mondo not expect you to survive, but he will not look gift equivar in mouth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not keep the Zax waiting. He is not a patient Chua.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.name) ready? Time for war!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will go speak to him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mondo Zax is leading a crack team of Chua soldiers to wrest control of Crimson Isle - as well as its Eldan treasures - from the clutches of the Exiles. It appears as if he has plenty of work in store for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your response is illogical considering the situation. You must reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: You have arrived at Mondo's Beachhead on Crimson Isle. Engineer Zric has instructed you to check in with Mondo Zax as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax at Mondo's Beachhead
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Zax waiting nearby. He have special assignment for $(player.name). Probably $(player.name) will die. Goody!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I know you not talk to the Zax yet. He mutter under breath angrily. Wait longer and the Zax vaporize you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, look look! Mondo remember $(player.name) from lab on ship. Mondo not expect you to survive, but he will not look gift equivar in mouth.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep the Zax waiting, he will explode you. Maybe that be fun to watch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.name) ready? Time for war!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Mondo Zax is leading a crack team of Chua soldiers to wrest control of Crimson Isle - as well as its Eldan treasures - from the clutches of the Exiles. It appears as if he has plenty of work in store for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wait until I tell the Zax. Enjoy watching the Zax work.

localizedTextIdText: You've touched down at Stormcaller Landing in Levian Bay, a gloomy location if you've ever seen one. Engineer Zric has instructed you to check in with Pilot Icarios as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pilot Icarios at Stormcaller Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Go to Pilot Icarios, see if he has use for you. If not, you work for me, instead. $(player.name) like digging latrines?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why you talk to me? Is $(player.name) reporting for latrine duty? No? Then talk to Icarios before I give you shovel!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Don't mind Zric. He's a bit high strung, but he means well. In any case, it's an honor to meet you! Heard all about what you did on the Destiny, I did.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lady Zin inland already, but supply lines still pending. Now move!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Look at me, prattlin' on like a  wee lad. Let's see what needs doin'.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: No, that's okay. I'll talk to Icarios.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pilot Icarios is busy figuring out how to establish the supply lines to Artemis Zin camp, and it appears as if he's got one or two things for you to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(player.name) must serve useful purpose. If not, agony.

localizedTextIdText: You have arrived on the Savage Coast in Crimson Isle. Scout Naharra has instructed you to check in with Drezkar the Gorefang as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Drezkar the Gorefang on the Savage Coast
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This battle has begun, hunter, but you are not too late. The Gorefang is nearby, and he will have orders for you. Do not keep him waiting.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Drezkar the Gorefang waits for you. Go to him and receive your orders. There is plenty of Exile blood to spill on Crimson Isle!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This filthy little island teems with Exile scum. As a proven $(player.class), the Warbringer expects you to live up to your reputation. Do you understand?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ah, yes... the Exiles are close. Can you smell their blood?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good. Now pay attention, for I will only tell you this once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Kezrek Warbringer is leading an elite force of Draken soldiers to wrest control of Crimson Isle - as well as its Eldan treasures - from the clutches of the Exiles. It appears as if your role in this conflict will be considerable.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will speak to him at once.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would not be so insolent were you kneeling before General Kezrek.

localizedTextIdText: You've touched down at Stormcaller Landing in Levian Bay, a gloomy location if you've ever seen one. Scout Naharra has instructed you to check in with Pilot Icarios as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pilot Icarios at Stormcaller Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This place is a hunter's paradise, $(player.name). For now, however, we must work. Speak to Pilot Icarios and see what he would have you do.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Speak to Pilot Icarios. There is much to do, hunter, and you will do your best to make your people proud. Now... go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Naharra's a pretty one, eh? Like as not, she'd tear me apart. In any case, it's an honor to meet you! Heard all about what you did on the Destiny, I did.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep your claws sharp, but keep your wits sharper.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Look at me, prattlin' on like a  wee lad. Let's see what needs doin'.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pilot Icarios is busy figuring out how to establish the supply lines to Artemis Zin camp, and it appears as if he's got one or two things for you to do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not make me spill your blood in front of all these humans.

localizedTextIdText: This small crystal skull seems to have been carved from a single crystal of pure loftite. Dorian Walker requests that you put it on display at his museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This glittering crystal skull looks extremely valuable and pulses with a strange light. You're sure there's someone out there interested in it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This glittering crystal skull looks extremely valuable and pulses with a strange light. You're sure there's someone out there interested in it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Out findin' relics, eh? That's what I like to see!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's the most refined piece of loftite I've ever seen! Near perfect skull carvin', too. Belle should get a gander at this next time she's around.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Great to see that collection grow.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The loftite purity is off the charts!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It is indeed a beautiful relic.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You put the loftite crystal skull on display at the museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd. Dorian Walker was pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall take this to the museum in Thayd!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put it on the display, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdText: You found a refined Eldan lens that looks as though it's part of a larger piece. Dorian Walker requests that you put it on display at his museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This Eldan lens is unlike any construction of theirs you've come across. With some careful handling, you could haul it out of here.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This Eldan lens is unlike any construction of theirs you've come across. With some careful handling, you could haul it out of here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Got yourself a relic, eh? Welp, put it on one of the displays. Not like I can do it, bein' a hologram and all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welp, by all, that is a fancy lookin' lens. Probably focuses some sorta Eldan laser. Wouldn't want t' be caught at the end of that beam.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done good grabbing this before the Dominion could.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'd better be careful not to scratch it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You put the Eldan focusing lens on display at the museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd. Dorian Walker was pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall take this to the museum in Thayd!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put it on the display then.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdText: Found in the depths of a Grimvault exo-lab, this blackened, shriveled figure is a fascinating example of the Strain. Artemis Zin would be proud to have it in her collection in Spaceport Alpha's museum.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This blackened, shriveled figure looks to be a well-preserved example of the Strain. Surely someone will be interested in this.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This blackened, shriveled figure looks to be a well-preserved example of the Strain. Surely someone will be interested in this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That looks like a dangerous sample. We have a special container for something like that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This Preserved Strain Embryo is a fantastic find! And to think, this was once just a jabbit.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: What a unique find! I should take this... thing... back to Illium.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm just glad I'm not holding that thing anymore...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Preserved Strain Embryo was put on display in the museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I should take this... thing... back to Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: This damaged, nonfunctional chip seems like a wonderful archaeological find. Artemis Zin requests that you put it on display at her museum on Spaceport Alpha in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This damaged, nonfunctional chip looks like it's a perfect candidate for study. You think you can manage to carry it with you.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This damaged, nonfunctional chip looks like it's a perfect candidate for study. You think you can manage to carry it with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A relic? Then put it on display. I can't do it. I am merely a hologram.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That chip is quite large. Makes one wonder just how large the robot it belonged to happened to be.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The design is rather elegant, nonetheless.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: We could learn so much from this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You put the Megadroid Positronic Chip on display at the museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium. Artemis Zin was pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall take this to the museum in Illium!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put it on the display then.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: This round gem no doubt has great importance to the Pell. Dorian Walker requests that you put it on display at his museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This appears to be a large, simple gem - but clearly the Pell find it important. Acquiring it would prove fruitful.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: A relic of great importance to the Water Pell. This appears to be a large, simple gem - but shows evidence it once was a source of primal energy for unknown Eldan technology.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It that a relic you found? Then find a nice spot for it in the museum here and put it up for display.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The eye of Hydris himself, huh? Bet this thing packed a wallop in its day.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wager Belle would love to take a look at it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is heavier than it appears.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the Eye of Hydris and put it on display at the museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd. Dorian Walker was pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall take this to the museum in Thayd!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put it on the display then.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdText: The beautiful gilded feather you came across clearly belongs on display. Artemis Zin requests that you take the feather to her museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This gilded feather seems very different than the rest. The Dominion Museum in Illium would surely want to add this to their collection.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This gilded feather seems very different than the rest. The Dominion Museum in Illium would surely want to add this to their collection.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Such a delicate piece. Be careful when you set it up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That is indeed the Golden Feather of Eyria. Such a rare thing! You did the right thing by adding it to the museum's collection.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will take this to the museum.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: May it serve the museum well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Golden Feather of Eyria was put on display in the museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will put the feather on its stand.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: This ancient cracked skull appears to be different from others you've found among the Dreg. Dorian Walker requests that you take the skull to his museum on Walker's Bluff.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This skull seems far more ancient than any other in the area. The Museum in Thayd would surely want to add this to their collection.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This skull seems far more ancient than any other in the area. The Museum in Thayd would surely want to add this to their collection.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've prepared a pedestal just for your relic!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It may only look like a common skull, but I assure you, it is positively steeped in history. You have a discerning eye, I see.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will take this to the museum.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: May it serve the museum well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The ancient Dreg skull was put on display in the museum in Thayd.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will put the skull in its place.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdText: You found the Warhammer of Ugreth Foe-Breaker. Artemis Zin requests that you take the hammer to the New Imperial Museum of Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This warhammer seems far more ancient than any other in the area. The Dominion Museum in Illium would surely want to add this to their collection.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This warhammer seems far more ancient than any other in the area. The New Imperial Museum of Illium would surely want to add this to their collection.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Magnificent! A pedestal has been prepared to house that hammer. Do go set it up, won't you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I was looking for an Osun piece to add to my collection; excellent find! This will be a perfect fit.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will take this to the museum.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: May it serve the museum well.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Warhammer of Ugreth Foe-Breaker was put on display in the museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I will take this to the museum.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I will put the hammer in its place.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: You found an astounding example of Eldan ingenuity. Artemis Zin requested you bring it by her museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This piece of Eldan technology is incredibly complex and most likely valuable. Surely you can find someone interested in this.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This piece of Eldan technology is incredibly complex and most likely valuable. Surely you can find someone interested in this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A marvelous find! Put it up on display, would you? And be careful about it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What an advanced piece of technology. This showcases the advanced tech the Eldan possessed perfectly.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Another piece for the Dominion's collection!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Primal Matrix Stabilizer was put on display in the museum in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: This squirg has been cryogenically frozen; clearly it has some importance in the greater story of Nexus. Dorian Walker has asked you to deliver it to his museum in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This preserved squirg specimen appears to be very important, considering its state. You know a person or two who might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This preserved squirg specimen appears to be very important, considering its state. You know a person or two who might be interested in this.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Whoa, now there's a creepy lil feller. Go set him up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not a bad find there, slick.  Your skills at finding unique artifacts never cease to amaze!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: A great addition to the museum!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Cryogenically Frozen Squirg was put on display in the museum in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdText: You found a totem that emanates dark power, likely of Osun design. Artemis Zin requests that you put it on display at her museum on Spaceport Alpha in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This totem practically oozes dark power. Leaving it here would be unwise. There are greater uses for such a thing.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This totem practically oozes dark power. Leaving it here would be unwise. There are greater uses for such a thing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You found a dark relic. Well, put it off in the corner, somewhere where people can still see it, but well out of the way.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a haunting relic. Let us hope nothing supernatural followed you here with it, shall we?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wouldn't worry too much. Even spirits are no match for the might of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm not sure I want to touch this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the Darkwitch Totem and put it on display at the museum in Spaceport Alpha in Illium. Artemis Zin was pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I shall take this to the museum in Illium!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll find a place for it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Artemis Zin in the New Imperial Museum of Illium

localizedTextIdText: You found a small but surprisingly detailed figurine of Drusera. Perhaps Dorian Walker back in Thayd might find this interesting.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is a magnificently detailed figurine, depicting Drusera. Surely someone would love to get their hands on this!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This is a magnificently detailed figurine, depicting Drusera. Surely someone would love to get their hands on this!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go and stick that sucker on a pedestal, slick.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're gettin' pretty good at finding these relics, chief.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wish I had one of these for my house!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Genesis Prime Figurine was put on display in the museum in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdText: You found an elaborate Swordmaiden headdress deep within Wilderrun. Dorian Walker requests that you put it on display at his museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is a very distinctive piece of headgear. It's likely an important piece of Swordmaiden regalia. Surely someone would be interested...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This is a very distinctive piece of headgear. It's likely an important piece of Swordmaiden regalia. Surely someone would be interested...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That's a fancy relic you found. Let's put it up on display so all the Exiles can see what the Dommies will never have, eh?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The helm of Tresayne Toria herself, huh? We got the Dommie mama's hat! I bet they'll be steamin' if they ever find out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good idea, boss! Let's rub their filthy noses in it!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: The Exiles would love to get ahold of this.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Maybe we should let 'em know, then.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to find the helm of Tresayne Toria herself. You put it on display at the museum on Walker's Bluff in Thayd. Dorian Walker was pleased.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll take this to the museum in Thayd!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll put it on the display then.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Talk to Dorian Walker in the Blue Horizon Museum

localizedTextIdTitle: Absence Makes the Parts Grow Fonder
localizedTextIdText: The parts used to create Doctor Claremont dipdrone and its psi-positories didn't grow on trees. In fact, they were manufactured and built into a bot, Dipswitch, and he'd like to get them back. He's asked you to delve into the gelatinous bubbles of Cankertube Swamp and recover his parts so that he can walk again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dipswitch via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The dipdrone created by Doctor Claremont has served its purpose. Would you be so kind as to collect its parts and return them to me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Until my parts are recovered from the swamp, I'm little more than a disembodied head with no function. If I had tear ducts, I'd weep.
