localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Defragtastic! Huzzah! Acclamation! Ovation, even! I've reclaimed my role as a Freebot participant in scientific research!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll hitch a ride along with your personal effects, if you don't mind.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do I want to see you elsewhere on Nexus someday? Logic indicates I do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Dipswitch parts, loaned to Doctor Claremont so he could create a science probe and psi-positories, were scattered across Cankertube Swamp. Thanks to your hard work, they've been returned to the unfortunate Freebot and he can walk once more!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Null. Zero. Zilch. The Doctor thinks I'm incapable of expressing emotion. The truth is I'm simply not interested in pursuing a non-professional relationship.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Come back if you change your mind. I'm obviously not going anywhere.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has requested that you troubleshoot Sim Core A-01's systems and ensure they are operational.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in Sim Core A-01 beneath Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With this sim core operational once more, perhaps you could ensure that it functions properly. I deem your odds of survival above average.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you engaged the sim core's protocols yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You look a little worse for wear. I trust that the simulation worked perfectly?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do be sure to wear proper protective attire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The information you have provided will be added to my data banks.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully completed an Adventure and ensured that the sim core, while dangerous, is operating correctly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose it is your choice. Was I misled to believe your species had evolved a core structure with which to support yourselves.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: With this sim core operational once more, perhaps you could ensure it functions properly. I deem your odds of survival above average.

localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully completed an Adventure and ensured that the Sim Core, while dangerous, is operating correctly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose it is your choice, though I was misled to believe your species had evolved a core structure with which to support yourselves.

localizedTextIdText: Wheez Nokenti has alerted you of the presence of something big and powerful lurking in the Mind of the Globellum. Given the lack of time to properly capture, dissect, reprogram, enchant, and otherwise meddle with this beast, he's asked that you remove it from the equation entirely.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Wheez Nokenti via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You useful! Bad thing in Globellum's mind, very scary! Very dangerous! Chua not sleep at night, too many nightmares. You find bad thing and destroy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You kill bad thing? No? Why not? Stupid! No one safe as long as bad thing lives! Go back to Globellum, find bad thing, and make it dead!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Many Chua scientists killed by bad thing. But not Wheez! Safe now because of you. Have reward. Take take!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bad thing close! Too close! Shhh! Must be quiet or it hear!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe now I get sleep. No more nightmares.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No need to tell me twice.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: When Wheez Nokenti discovered Absolute Terror during your voyage into the Mind of the Globellum, he carefully weighed his options. Finding a lack of time to properly capture, dissect, reprogram, or otherwise meddle with this beast, he made the prudent call for its destruction and you obliged him.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Not certain! Strain influence controlled by Globellum, maybe. Yes! Mental corruption made flesh! Is aspect of Globellum now. Must destroy! Now now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Stupid hireling should kill. But chose to be killed. Moron.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You found Renzo's journal? He's dead? How simply horrible! We were supposed to start a new life here...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: At least I have closure. But now what do I do?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: At least I have closure. But now what do I do?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Trooper Renzo's wife in Thayd. You informed her of her husband's death in the Northern Wilds and gave her the journal you found.

localizedTextIdText: A creature known as the Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} is wreaking havoc with Wheez Nokenti seismic equipment in Cankertube Swamp and delaying his research. The Dominion is willing to pay a sizeable bounty for the beast's death, but killing it isn't likely to be a simple or easy task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Wheez Nokenti via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nDue to its interference with the Dominion's seismic equipment, the Sentinel of the Swamp must be destroyed at once! (If you need more details before you destroy it, you may contact Wheez Nokenti).
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING\nThe Sentinel of the Swamp is still at large. Operatives are required to destroy the beast at once! (If you operatives need more details before you destroy it, you may speak to Wheez Nokenti).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sentinel of Swamp always stomp stomp stomping in Cankertube! Mucks with seismic equipment, ruins research! Find Sentinel and kill kill kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Am very pleased! Seismic equipment now functions as anticipated. Surmise Sentinel of Swamp destroyed by $(player.name). Affirmative?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take reward. Do not spend all in one place, yes?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} and earned a substantial reward from Wheez Nokenti. Now Wheez is happy because he can continue his research without interference.

localizedTextIdTitle: Absence Makes the Parts Grow Fonder
localizedTextIdText: The parts used to create Professor Morrison overdrone and its psi-positories didn't grow on trees. In fact, they were manufactured and built into a bot, Override, and he'd like to get them back. He's asked you to delve into the gelatinous bubbles of Cankertube Swamp and recover his parts so that he can walk again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Override via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I donated my parts to the Professor for his overdrone, but he has no intention of returning them. I hate to ask, but perhaps you can help?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I so wish to be whole once more, my sentient friend. Please locate my wayward parts and components in Cankertube Swamp. Being a head is horrible!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I so wish to be whole once more, my sentient friend. Please locate my wayward parts and components in Cankertube Swamp. Being a head is horrible!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Infinite thanks, my sentient benefactor! With my body beneath my cranial hardpoint once more, I can return to winning the Professor's affections.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My cranial assembly doesn't take up much space. Allow me to accompany you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I wish there was some way to make him love me. I'm so lonely without him.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Override parts, loaned to Professor Morrison so he could create a science probe and psi-positories, were scattered across Cankertube Swamp. Thanks to your hard work, they've been returned to the unfortunate Freebot and he can woo the professor once more.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Maybe he's just not attracted to you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nothing, unfortunately. He must only like naughty Freebots. Or perhaps he prefers non-free bots, or humans. Perhaps he's more interested in a specific gender. I can't say!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Yes. I have attempted to display my adoration to the Professor, but he is not receptive. He shows no appreciation for my contributions. Perhaps it's true that nice bots always finish last.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Impossible! If you could see what I was before, you would be awe struck. I will never give up on love until he properly computes my worth. But first, I require you to find my parts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I brought this upon myself. I'm so scared and helpless!

localizedTextIdText: Cass Quietly has alerted you of the presence of something big and powerful lurking in the Mind of the Globellum. Given the lack of time to properly capture, dissect, reprogram, enchant, and otherwise meddle with this beast, she's asked that you remove it from the equation entirely.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Cass Quietly via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Yo, $(player.name). Ya better watch out, 'cause there's somethin' big and nasty in your vicinity. Put a cap in it before it rips you a new one.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That monster's still out there, chum. I'm readin' it on my gear, even though I don't wanna. The way it moves gives me the creeps.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That thing ya killed, it had somethin' to do with my people gettin' waxed. Don't ask me how I know, I just do. I'm gonna raise a mug to 'em all later.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Tell whatever that thing is that Cass Quietly says hi, alright?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Watch yer buns out there, buddy. Maybe I'll see ya later.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Of course I know what you're saying.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: When Cass Quietly discovered Absolute Terror during your voyage into the Mind of the Globellum, she carefully weighed her options. Finding a lack of time to properly capture, dissect, reprogram, or otherwise meddle with this beast, she made the prudent call for its destruction and you obliged her request.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Hell if I know. It reads like Strain, but there's somethin' else to it. Could be a Strain critter that the Globellum's controllin'. I'm sure we'll be better off with it dead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're a real piece of yellow-bellied work, ain't ya?

localizedTextIdText: A creature known as the Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} is wreaking havoc with Cass Quietly seismic equipment in Cankertube Swamp and delaying her research. The Exiles are willing to pay a sizeable bounty for the beast's death, but killing it isn't likely to be a simple or easy task.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Cass Quietly via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nDue to its interference with XAS seismic equipment, the Sentinel of the Swamp must be destroyed. (You may contact Cass Quietly if you want more details.)
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING\nThe Sentinel of the Swamp is still at large. Volunteers are required to destroy the beast. (You may speak to Cass Quietly if you want more details.)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dammit! My seismic sensors are goin' haywire, and I'll tell ya what's causin' it. It's that slaggin' sentinel stompin' around, that's what!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great balls of granite! You musta killed that slaggin' sentinel, yeah? 'Cause my gear's readin' as smooth as silk now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work. You look pretty proud of yerself, too. Ya should be!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I did it all for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} and earned a substantial reward from Cass Quietly. Now Cass is happy because she can continue her research without interference.

localizedTextIdText: "Dodger" is eager to tell you all about Tremor Ridge. Listen to her to learn more about the settlement.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to "Dodger" in Tremor Ridge via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hi there! If you want to know a bit more about Tremor Ridge, I'm just the Aurin to ask. There are some points that you just got to see!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you visited all the points yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, that's that bark and the branches of Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Let me add some coordinates into your datachron and then you can see it for yourself!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm always happy to help a new friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: "Dodger" has told you all about Tremor Ridge.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There's a lot more to Tremor Ridge than collecting loftite and slaying Marauders.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: There are friendly miners, helpful vendors, and I can't forget about Pappy Grizzleston. He's a Tremor Ridge fixture.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll be around if you change your mind.

localizedTextIdText: Patiria Adecus in Lightreach Mission wants to inform you about the area. You need to find the mailbox, taxi kiosk, Transmat Terminal, mount vendor, and Radiant Legion guards. She'll tell you about each one as you find them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Patiria Adecus at Lightreach Mission
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You look a little lost. I can fix that by marking key locations on the map for you to check out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go take a look at what I marked on your map. Very useful things for you to know.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I hope that helped you out a bit. These can be found in almost every town or camp. Be sure to use them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll comm call you about each one when you get to them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good luck out there!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I could use all the help I can get.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Patiria Adecus in Lightreach Mission informed you about local amenities: the mailbox, the taxi kiosk, the Transmat Terminal, the mount vendor, and the Radiant Legion guards.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if you don't want my help...

localizedTextIdText: You received a call from the M.A.C. located at the Forward Operating Base. It suggests you pay it a visit before you continue forward with your campaign against the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Visit the M.A.C. at the Forward Operating Base
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You ain't half bad, kid, but you're rough around the edges. Come see me - I'll get you trained right up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You comin' to see me or what? I didn't want to say, but you could definitely use the help. Trainin' ain't no walk in the park.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now look who showed up in time for tea? We're servin' knuckle sandwiches to go with it. Put 'em up!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't drag your knuckles on this one. A little trainin' may save your life.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's the spirit!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You visited the M.A.C. at the Forward Operating Base in Crimson Isle and learned a few new ways to deal with enemies of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Sure, everybody says they'll get their trainin' in later. Then they get pounded into the gravel their next fight.

localizedTextIdText: Become Level 25
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 25.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character is now Level 25.

localizedTextIdText: Become Level 35
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 35.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character is now Level 35.

localizedTextIdText: Become Level 45
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This quest will make you level 45.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your character is now Level 45.

localizedTextIdText: Demydra has offered to give you a brief tour of Bloodfire Village, pointing out important infrastructure along the way.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Demydra in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greetings, citizen. Your hesitant gait and bewildered expression indicate a high probability that you have recently arrived in Bloodfire Village. Perhaps a tour is in order?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you completed the tour already?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That concludes our tour. I trust you are now acquainted with the pertinent facilities?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will upload coordinates to your datachron, should you become lost.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You toured Bloodfire Village with Demydra.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yes, to familiarize you with the layout of the town and the locations of its vital infrastructure.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Strictly speaking, no. However, if you become lost, you may find the locals are not as accommodating as I am.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will remain here in the event that you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: An Exile recon party was attacked by giant spiders and taken away into the Tainted Gardens. Commander Kriton has ordered you to locate and rescue the party, including their leader, the ever spunky Kit Brinny.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Search for Kit Brinny in the Tainted Gardens
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some big-ass spiders in the Tainted Gardens have carried off Kit Brinny and her recon team. I need ya to go in there and rescue 'em, pronto.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Does this look like the Tainted Gardens to you? Wait... don't answer that. Just get out there, find Kit and her team, and get 'em back here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=40312)Trespasser! You... will pay for this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: These ain't your normal space spiders, pal. Be careful.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(self.visual=40311)Friends? Ah, yes friends. Let us... speak.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Wait! I'm looking for my friends!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While searching for Kit Brinny and the rest of her Exile recon squad in the Tainted Gardens, you encountered Syra, Queen of the Direweb instead. Things just got weird.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Recon teams rely on stealth, right? Well, Kit... ya know Kit. Ya might be able to shut her up for five minutes, but anything longer is askin' for trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Kit and her team're gonna be spider chow if someone don't help 'em.

localizedTextIdText: Due to all the help you've provided to Syra, Queen of the Direweb and her brood, she's agreed to allow you to free your friends in the Southern Brood Lair while she retires to celebrate her recent victories over the Sourhive buzzbings.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Matthias Black in the Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(self.visual=40311)You done now. Syra pleased. Take friends, leave Direweb land. Never return.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: $(self.visual=40311)Free friends. Go. No place for you here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=40311)You been had, friend. We all have! That damn spider ain't planning to free anyone! This is all some kind of damn trick!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(self.visual=40312)I leave now. Must celebrate.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(self.visual=40311)You've got to get back at that critter. It's the Exile way!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Syra, Queen of the Direweb has betrayed you! Though she assured you that you could free your friends, Kit Brinny is still missing! You can't let that eight-legged harridan get away with this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(self.visual=40312)Not want friends? Then Syra learn how tasty friends are.

localizedTextIdTitle: If It Doesn't Spoil, Nuke It
localizedTextIdText: According to Syra, Queen of the Direweb, honey pods in the Tainted Gardens give the buzzbings power. She wants you to use bug bombs - taken from the Dominion - to destroy the honey pods and weaken the Sourhive buzzbings.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb in the Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(self.visual=40311)Sourhive proud of honey pods. Pods make Sourhive strong. We take booms from your people. Use booms to destroy pods.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(self.visual=40311)Use booms on honey pods. Booms destroy them, make Sourhive weak and unhappy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=40312)Honeypods destroyed. Can smell Sourhive's weakness. Not proud now, are they? Not proud at all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(self.visual=40312)Syra watches. Syra waits. Syra patient... very patient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(self.visual=40311)Soon your friends free... yes.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I almost feel sorry for them. Almost.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used bug bombs to destroy the honey pods, weakening and insulting the buzzbings. Syra, Queen of the Direweb, is pleased by your success.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Hey. You said you were patient.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Your friends have booms. Use them to kill... explode with poison. Now Syra give booms to you. Use booms on Sourhive.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(self.visual=40312)Poor friends. You not want friends free anymore?

localizedTextIdText: Syra, Queen of the Direweb and her brood have captured Corrigan Doon and his team. Syra will release Corrigan and the other citizens, but only if you kill Chirae, Queen of the Sourhive and her buzzbing army in the Royal Hive.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb in the Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(self.visual=40311)You want friends? Syra want Chirae, Sourhive queen, dead. Kill Chirae, other buzzbings, then Syra free your friends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(self.visual=40311)Chirae queen of Sourhive. Many Direweb die from Sourhive stings. Kill her, kill her servants, and Syra will free your friends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=40312)Chirae dead. Sourhive in fear now. Good... very good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(self.visual=40312)Deal is made. Now to the killing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(self.visual=40311)Syra not understand. Does not matter.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm real good at pest control.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In an attempt to free Corrigan Doon and his team from the clutches of the Direweb spiders, you infiltrated the Royal Hive and killed Chirae, Queen of the Sourhive. Perhaps now Syra, Queen of the Direweb will set your compatriots free.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why can't your spiders kill Chirae?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why don't you kill Chirae yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Too many Direweb die already. Hive... poison. Syra think you have better chance.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Much risk. If Syra die... so do all Direweb. This cannot happen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You refuse? Direweb eat tasty friends. Maybe you be sad before Direweb eat you, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(self.visual=40312)Friends look tasty. Shame if Direweb drain them dry.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Trinette asked for your protection as she surveys Eldan constructions in the Sonic Plaza. She hopes her investigation of these ancient structures will help explain the purpose behind the large tower there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Specialist Trinette at the makeshift camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I want to survey a few structures in the area, but I need you to cover me. We got hostile constructs out there, and I'm sure there's a spy in camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're not done yet. Just keep me safe until we are, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If it wasn't for you, the ICI would've killed me for sure. What in blazes do they want with an exanite research facility, anyway?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll be usin' a stealth field, so try not to shoot me by mistake.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Heh. Good point. If you're still free, I could use another favor.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Does the Dominion need a reason?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You escorted Specialist Trinette throughout the Sonic Plaza and protected her from an apparent assassination attempt by the ICI. There may be something to her suspicions that an ICI spy is embedded somewhere in her camp.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You bet. The place is swarmin' with Eldan constructs, and they're all too happy to kill helpless researchers like me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I don't know for sure, but it always feels like I'm bein' watched. Someone's been goin' through my research notes, too, and the Dominion ain't that far away.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Whatever you want, "friend." I'll find someone else.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Trinette wants to prove her theory that the Eldan were experimenting with combining sound with exanite. She's asked you to boost the power output of the second and third pillars by activating portable generators, then protecting her specialist teams while they work.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Specialist Trinette via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To activate the tower, the pillars gotta have their outputs boosted. Turn on the generators at the pillars and protect my specialists as they work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Didn't you say you'd protect my specialists while they boost the pillars' output? Better get shakin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Both pillars are givin' off their own unique hum. I bet each one's hum is a "sound key" that'll unlock the main tower.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good luck out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We still got a bit of a ways to go yet. You ready?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to boost the power output of the two pillars in the Sonic Plaza, allowing Specialist Trinette specialists to confirm that each one produces a unique hum. She now believes that the hum created by the pillars is a unique "sound key" that can unlock the central tower.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will boosting the power output do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I've got a hunch that the Eldan were combinin' sound and exanite somehow. I aim to find out why. Turnin' up the power should provide some kind of reaction.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Without you, this operation's dead. So am I, for that matter.

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Trinette has requested that you steal the Dominion's research notes from researchers near pillars four and five. Once she has them, she can compile them with her own notes. To assist you with your task, she's also supplied you with some stun grenades.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Specialist Trinette at her rendezvous point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Use these stun grenades to stun Collegium researchers near the fourth and fifth pillars, then steal their research notes concernin' the sound keys.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you gotten the Dominion's research notes yet? They'll include information on the other sound keys. Don't forget to use those stun grenades!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you gotten the Dominion's research notes yet? They'll include information on the other sound keys. Don't forget to use those stun grenades!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks to you, I've finally got four of the six sound keys. I'll be able to unlock the control room with 'em and see what this place is all about.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those notes should contain data about the sound keys they've discovered.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've been such a big help, $(player.name). Really.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered up enough of the Dominion's research data for Specialist Trinette, bringing you that much closer to completing your mission.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: But aren't there two broken pillars?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm a scientist, and I like to find creative solutions to problems. This way, you can swipe their datapads while those Dommies are out of sorts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I told you before. You don't listen too well, do you? Anyway, the sound keys were created when the pillars were hummin'. If I combine 'em, I'm sure the tower's main controls will unlock.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You're right, there are. So long as I've got four of the six sound keys, I'm pretty sure I can fake the sounds the wrecked pillars would've made.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't pull out now, $(player.name). We're too close!

localizedTextIdText: Specialist Trinette has revealed that she was a Dominion spy all along. Following her unsuccessful attempt to kill you, she escaped to the Exanite Resonance Tower. Track her down and bring her to justice!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's only one more thing I need from you, friend. Are you ready?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is ticking away, $(player.name). Track down Trinette and ensure that she is repaid three-fold for her terrible treachery.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have performed your role flawlessly. Every pawn is precious, but it's more precious still when it progresses to the end of the playing board.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Goodbye, $(player.name). We will work together again, I promise.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm as ready as I'll ever be.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Although you killed Trinette the Renegade in return for her treachery, you also learned that you were little more than a pawn in Avra Darkos games of cat and mouse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you sure? I really need to tie off a loose end before we're done.

localizedTextIdText: Trinette the Renegade is heading to the Eldan Resonance Tower. Avra Darkos is counting on you to stop her. Don't let her down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: You put an end to Trinette's plans. And yet...
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You know where she is headed, and you know what you must do. Do not fail me, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is no time to waste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Another half-baked Dominion plot falls flat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: May your vengeance be swift and permanent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: While this plan did not come to fruition, know that there are a hundred more in motion at any given moment.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You succeeded in thwarting Trinette the Renegade's plot. But some of the things she said stirred up some uncomfortable thoughts in your mind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will want to reconsider that.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Lannellu is concerned with camp security, especially given the high number of hostile Eldan constructs surrounding resonance pillar two and the base of the resonance tower. She's asked you to destroy as many constructs as you can in order to maintain a secure perimeter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Lannellu via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got a security issue. Eldan constructs out by pillar two and the tower are posin' a threat to our people. Ya gotta clean 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What in blazes ya doin' back here? We just got another casualty in, says the Eldan constructs got him! Go and make sure it don't happen again!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did a bang-up job of turnin' those Eldan trashcans into spare parts, buddy. This place is a lot safer for it, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't just stand there. Ya got yer work cut out for ya.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll be seein' ya around, pal. Stay safe.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Eldan constructs on behalf of Captain Lannellu and made the Exile camp outside the Sonic Plaza that much safer.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I won't forget this, ya prissy little slank.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Stephanus asked for your protection as he surveys Eldan construction in the Sonic Plaza. He hopes his investigation of these ancient structures will help explain the purpose behind the large tower there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Stephanus at the makeshift camp
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must survey some structures in the area, and you will ensure my security. Hostile constructs abound, and I'm certain there's an Exile spy in camp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This expedition is far from over. You have been recruited to maintain my safety, and I expect you to live up to my exacting expectations.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Those Exile swine tried to kill me! Thanks to you, however, I remain uninjured. I have no clue why the Exiles should be interested in this place.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: To further ensure my safety, I will be employing a stealth field.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Of course they do not. Nonetheless, I have another task for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Do the Exiles need a reason?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You escorted Professor Stephanus throughout the Sonic Plaza and protected him from an apparent assassination attempt by the Black Hoods. There may be something to his suspicions that an Exile spy is embedded somewhere in his camp.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This place is thick with Eldan constructs. Were I to venture out there alone, I would not last more than a few minutes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: In actuality, I am not entirely certain. However, someone has been going through my research notes, and I have the uncanny feeling I am being watched.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare refuse me? Do you have any idea who I am?

localizedTextIdText: Professor Stephanus wants to prove his theory that the Eldan were experimenting with combining sound with exanite. He's asked you to boost the power output of the fourth and fifth pillars by activating portable generators, then protecting his specialist teams while they work.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Professor Stephanus via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need to activate the tower, so you must boost the pillars' output. Activate the generators at the pillars, then protect my teams as they work.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The generators near the pillars must be activated at once. The Exiles are liable to wipe out my specialists if you are not there to protect them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is just as I suspected. Can you hear it? The pillars are humming! It must be some sort of "sound key" that will inevitably unlock the main tower.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I expect nothing less than success.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am not finished with you, $(player.name). Take heed!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to boost the power output of the two pillars in the Sonic Plaza, as well as fend off a Black Hoods attack, allowing Professor Stephanus specialists to confirm that each one produces a unique hum. He now believes that the hum created by the pillars is a unique "sound key" that can unlock the central tower.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What'll boosting the power output do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is my hypothesis that the Eldan were combining sonic technology with exanite for some mysterious reason. Increasing the output should produce a reaction.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: By refusing me, you refuse the Dominion.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Stephanus has requested that you steal the Exiles' research notes from researchers near pillars two and three. Once he has them, he can compile them with his own notes. To assist you with your task, he's also supplied you with some stun grenades.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Professor Stephanus at his rendezvous point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This is it. Use these stun grenades on XAS researchers near the fourth and fifth pillars, then steal their research notes concerning the sound keys.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I am still awaiting delivery of the XAS research notes. They will detail the sound keys the Exiles have found. Don't forget to use your stun grenades.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I am still awaiting delivery of the XAS research notes. They will detail the sound keys the Exiles have found. Don't forget to use your stun grenades.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I finally have four of the six sound keys! Now I can unlock the control room and see what this facility's function is.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Those notes should contain data about the sound keys they have discovered.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have been quite useful, $(player.name). Quite useful, indeed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered up enough of the Exiles' research data for Professor Stephanus, bringing you that much closer to completing your mission.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: But aren't there two broken pillars?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: As much as I enjoy watching Exiles die, it is occasionally entertaining to find creative solutions to problems. Once the Exiles are stunned, you can pilfer their datapads at your leisure.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Are you stupid? Or merely ignorant? As I told you before, the sound keys were created when the pillars were humming. If I combine them, the tower's main controls will unlock.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You are correct. So long as I have four of the six sound keys, I should be able to replicate the final two using a sonic modulator unit.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is far too late for you to balk at such a task, $(player.name).

localizedTextIdText: Stephanus the Traitor has revealed that he was an Exile spy all along. Following his unsuccessful attempt to kill you, he escaped to the Exanite Resonance Tower. Track him down and bring him to justice!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Before we part ways, there is one more thing you must do. Are you prepared?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You had best locate the treacherous professor before he escapes us completely. He has fled to the Exanite resonance tower.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am quite proud of your accomplishments, primarily because you played your part just as I expected you to.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ever obedient, hm? You do not disappoint.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Try not to feel angry, $(player.name). Rather, try to feel helpless.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm as ready as I'll ever be.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Although you killed Stephanus the Traitor in return for his treachery, you also learned that you were little more than a pawn in Agent Lex game of cat and mouse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you certain? I have one more loose end to tie off.

localizedTextIdText: Stephanus the Traitor is heading to the Eldan Resonance Tower. Agent Lex is counting on you to stop him.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Lex
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have a location, and a target. Am I correct in assuming that you know the requisite solution, $(player.name)?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is no time to waste.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Tally up another loss for the Black Hoods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Exact your vengeance well.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have stopped this plot, but at any given moment I am tracking more threats to the Dominion than you can comprehend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You succeeded in thwarting Agent Lex's plot. But some of the things he said stirred up some uncomfortable thoughts in your mind.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Turning down an offer to execute an Exile spy? That is... interesting.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Vialspiller is concerned with camp security, especially given the high number of hostile Eldan constructs surrounding resonance pillar four and the base of the resonance tower. He's asked you to destroy as many constructs as you can in order to maintain a secure perimeter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Vialspiller via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Eldan constructs are as clustered by the Resonance Research Tower. I expect you to destroy them at once to protect our researchers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our researchers are still being attacked by hostile Eldan constructs. Have you failed in your task, or have you yet to begin?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your skill in battle is unquestionable, and our camp is much safer for it. I salute you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Revel in their destruction, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope you left some for the rest of us to smash.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed Eldan constructs on behalf of Captain Vialspiller and made the Dominion camp outside the Sonic Plaza that much safer.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Tell you what. Why don't you knock over a beaker, causing a catastrophic lab accident that blows off your horns, and see if anyone forgets about it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Coward! You are less than worthless!

localizedTextIdText: Syra, Queen of the Direweb has tricked you, and Kit Brinny is going to be spider food if you don't rescue her. You'd better get your butt to the Queen's Den if you're going to save Kit and teach that nasty bug a lesson!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kit Brinny in the Queen's Den
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Kit's probably hung up in that blasted spider's den, fixin' to be lunch! Quick! Use that ball of spider silk to get up the hill! Don't get stuck!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why in the hell haven't you saved Kit yet, $(player.name)? What part of "she's in the spider's den fixin' to be lunch" was unclear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for lettin' me out! I like bein' swaddled in silk, but spiders ain't exactly my idea of a good time!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go on! You've got to save Kit before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get the hell out of here, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It was a sticky situation, but you managed to kill Syra, Queen of the Direweb and save Kit Brinny before she ended up as the main course in an arachnid feast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought you was a good person and not a damn fool.

localizedTextIdText: A group of Dominion citizens has been attacked by giant spiders and several have been taken away into the Tainted Gardens. Nerissa Artan has ordered you to locate and rescue the captives, including Corrigan Doon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Venture into the Tainted Gardens and beyond in search of Corrigan Doon
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a situation that requires your attention. Several citizens - including Corrigan Doon - have been captured by giant spiders. Care to save them?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you located the citizens the spiders took into the Tainted Gardens? It's imperative you find them, else they may be consumed by the monsters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=40312)Trespasser! You... will pay for this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The spiders are quite large. They couldn't have gotten far.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(self.visual=40311)Friends? Ah, yes friends. Let us... speak.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Wait! I'm looking for my friends!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While searching for Corrigan Doon and other Dominion captives in the Tainted Gardens, you encountered Syra, Queen of the Direweb instead. Things just got bizarre.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Now is not the time to play the fool, $(player.name)! Lives are at stake!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: He was under orders to keep a low profile. Unfortunately, it seems as if he'd been drinking. It's quite typical of the sot, really.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Time is of the essence, $(player.name)! You cannot refuse your duty!

localizedTextIdText: Due to all the help you've provided to Syra, Queen of the Direweb and her brood, she's agreed to allow you to free your friends in the Northern Brood Lair while she retires to celebrate her recent victories over the Sourhive buzzbings.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Cosine in the Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(self.visual=40311)You done now. Syra pleased. Take friends, leave Direweb land. Never return.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: $(self.visual=40311)Free friends. Go. No place for you here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya daft dobby! That manky spider took ya for a ride! Don't ya know never to trust nothing with more than four legs?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(self.visual=40312)I leave now. Must celebrate.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good thing I'm made of metal, else that bug would've had me for lunch!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Syra, Queen of the Direweb has betrayed you! Though she assured you that you could free your friends, Corrigan Doon is still missing! You can't let that eight-legged harridan get away with this!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(self.visual=40312)Not want friends? Then Syra learn how tasty friends are.

localizedTextIdText: Syra, Queen of the Direweb has tricked you, and Corrigan Doon is going to be spider food if you don't rescue him. You'd better get your butt to the Queen's Den if you're going to save Corrigan and teach that nasty bug a lesson!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Corrigan Doon in the Queen's Den
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If Doon wasn't the captain, I'd leave him for the crawlies. But he is, so ya better rescue him. Use that ball o' silk to get yer fanny up that hill!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Are ya waiting for yer nails to dry? Doon won't last long in that spider's den without help! Now move it before I put a chib in yer liver!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What'sh happenin'? *hic* Where'd my coshy blanket get to? Hey, wait a shecond... thish ain't the reshearch shtation... *groan*
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This is the last time I follow his malkied arse anywhere!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I musht have. My head feelsh fit to exshplode...
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You really tied one on, Doon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: It was a sticky situation, but you managed to kill Syra, Queen of the Direweb and save Corrigan Doon before he ended up as the main course in an arachnid feast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If Doon ends up dead, I'll make damn sure you do, too!

localizedTextIdText: The primal elementals at each of the terrorformers that surround the Black Focus have been irredeemably corrupted. Drusera has asked you to destroy them before they make their way to other parts of Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The primal elementals at the terrorformers have been corrupted by the constant ebb of destruction and creation. Each of them must be destroyed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The elementals, through no fault of their own, have been negatively influenced by the terrorformers. They must be destroyed for the good of all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done destroying those elementals. If they could thank you, I'm certain they would. Perhaps they will be reborn in uncorrupted forms.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful! The elementals are dangerous, and I can't lose you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We're one step closer to foiling Koral's nefarious plans!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the corrupted primal elementals at each of the terrorformers surrounding the Black Focus, preventing them from escaping to other parts of Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The elementals have been corrupted. They are beyond redemption. If they aren't destroyed, they could travel far beyond the Defile and bring their sickness to the rest of the planet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't give up on me now!

localizedTextIdText: Many Strain creatures, as well as corrupted Eldan constructs, can be found in the vicinity of the Black Focus. Drusera feels that each and every one of them poses a threat to Nexus, and she's asked you to destroy them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The number of Strain-corrupted creatures and constructs near the Black Focus is staggering. We must do something about them! Something permanent...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Eldan constructs and Strain beasts have been created by the Black Focus. They're only the tip of the iceberg. You need to clear them out, and soon!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: After that harrowing battle, I can breathe a sigh of relief. I was really worried about you for a while. I'm so glad you made it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Yes, that would be the best way to proceed. Destroy as many as you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our battles never seem to end, do they $(player.name)?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed a number of Strain creatures, as well as corrupted Eldan constructs, in the vicinity of the Black Focus. Each one you destroy is one less blemish upon the face of Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I know it's bad news, but the number of creatures and constructs created by the Black Focus could very well be infinite.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't you understand the gravity of this situation?

localizedTextIdText: To put an end to Koral the Defiler corruption, Drusera says you must ascend the platforms beneath the Black Focus to reach the Phage Lord. The climb is liable to be treacherous, so you should endeavor to be very careful.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now's the time to deal with the true threat - Koral the Defiler. He resides under the Black Focus, and you must climb the platforms to meet him.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The climb to Koral the Defiler is long and frightening, but you must make an attempt if you wish to end his malignant influence on this place.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My heart was in my throat several times during your ascent, but I knew you wouldn't fail. After all, you haven't let me down yet!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The path to Koral is treacherous and fraught with peril. Be careful!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now's the time we've waited for - to end Koral's corruption!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: There's a first time for everything...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You climbed the platforms beneath the Black Focus in an attempt to reach Koral the Defiler location. Now you can face him and put an end to his corrupting influence.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I know it's frightening, but if anyone can make the climb, it's you!

localizedTextIdText: The time has come to confront Koral the Defiler atop the platform at the base of the Black Focus. If you don't succeed in your attempt, the Strain will be able to completely overrun Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Koral the Defiler is a terrible foe. Look! He's gathered the elements around him, so you'll need to be careful when attacking!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our enemy is awaiting your advance! Don't let him bolster his defenses any futher! Destroy him!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Koral the Defiler is no more! You're such a great hero, $(player.name)! If anyone can defeat the Entity, it's you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You can do this, $(player.name)! I know you can!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Someday, songs will be written about you! I just know it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought Koral the Defiler beneath the Black Focus and soundly defeated him. Nexus has been saved, and Drusera is beside herself with joy!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why must I face Koral without you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Can you infuse me with your power?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You are never without me, my friend. I am always with you. Together we'll defeat this monster!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I wish I could, but I grow weaker and weaker with each passing hour. I must conserve the power I have left for the final battle against the Entity.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If Koral isn't defeated, Nexus will be swallowed by the Strain!

localizedTextIdText: The Black Focus has been corrupted by Koral the Defiler, and he plans to use it to create an infinite army of Strain creatures that will overrun Nexus. To prevent his plans from succeeding, Drusera has asked you to shut down the terrorformers near the Black Focus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need you to shut down the terrorformers that power the Black Focus before Koral the Defiler uses it to create an infinite army of Strain creatures!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you shut the three terrorformers down? Koral the Defiler has already corrupted the Black Focus, and if they aren't shut down we're in big trouble!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew you could do it, $(player.name)! We're off to a geat start, but I think it will get a whole lot worse before it gets better.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It won't be easy, but I believe in you! You can do this!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let me tell you what our next step is.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Worse, huh? I can hardly wait.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to shut down the terrorformers for Drusera. You're well on your way to saving Nexus from an infinite army of the Strain's vilest servants, but there's still much to be done.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How does the Black Focus work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Did the Eldan build the Black Focus?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Koral is another Phage Lord. He was once a brilliant Eldan scientist, but now he's a slave of the Entity who only wishes to corrupt everything in his path.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Entity desires to be free from the prison I've placed him in. He intends for Koral to use the Black Focus to create an army of Strain creatures to help him escape.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Black Focus continually creates and harvests primal energy. Koral the Defiler uses the chaos that results from this process to spawn his corrupted minions. It is a dark and twisted version of the process the Eldan used to create me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: No, not in its current form. Koral the Defiler has spent a considerable amount of time to corrupting it and bending it to his horrible will.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Koral's scheme must be stopped or all of Nexus will be consumed!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The current level cap on the Nexus realm is level 36. Completing this quest will grant you enough XP to hop the "wall" that is in place. You should now be able to resume play as if the wall did not exist.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The current level cap on the Nexus realm is level 36. Completing this quest will grant you enough XP to hop the "wall" that is in place. You should now be able to resume play as if the wall did not exist.

localizedTextIdText: The Tree of Life, created and nurtured by Drusera in the Grove of Hope, purges corruption from the land and its denizens. The Strain has become aware of the Tree of Life, and Drusera wants you to defend it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera on Drusera's Terrace
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need your help again, $(player.name). The Strain's discovered the Tree of Life and it's sending its minions to destroy it. They must be stopped!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Tree of life is in the Grove of Hope. Go and defend the tree from the Strain at all costs! You and your companions are my only hope!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Tree of Life still stands thanks to you and your friends. I fear the threat is not over, though. The Strain is likely to return and try again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take some friends with you or this could get really messy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: All of Nexus owes you a great debt. Thank you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defended the Tree of Life from the Strain, ensuring that it will continue to purge northern Blighthaven of corruption. For now, the Tree is safe, but the Strain is sure to return and try again before long.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I created it as a source of life and light in Blighthaven. It purges corruption from the land, thriving as it absorbs our enemy's filth. So long as it stands, Blighthaven will never succumb to the Strain.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Look with your own eyes. You have seen purified flora and fauna since advancing through the Corridor of Corruption. That life began with the Tree of Life in the Grove of Hope. With luck, it will continue to spread throughout the rest of Blighthaven.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If the Tree of Life is destroyed, Nexus is doomed!

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=75757) detected your new acquisition and suggested you take the gauntlet to Sera Melfield in Thayd's Alchemist's Maze and see if she can provide any insight into its purpose or origins.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Sera Melfield in Thayd's Alchemist's Maze
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My databanks indicate that there is one individual with the requisite information for you - Sera Melfield, who is located in Thayd at present.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's one of the mysterious Gauntlets of the Chosen! I've heard they adapt to their owners' will. See? Yours seems to be shaping itself to your hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Eldan hid the gauntlets all across Nexus and no one knows why!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered one of the Gauntlets of the Chosen - mysterious artifacts seeded throughout Nexus by the Eldan for some unknown purpose. Tales tell of such gauntlets adapting to their owner's needs, and each is said to hold the promise of untold power.

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=75757) detected your new acquisition and suggested you take the gauntlet to Researcher Babbit in Illium's Spaceport Alpha and see if he can provide any insight on its purpose or origins.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Researcher Babbit in Illium's Spaceport Alpha
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My databanks indicate that there is one individual with the requisite information for you - Researcher Babbit, who is located in Illium at present.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Where you get glove? Is Gauntlet of the Chosen! I never see one before. See? Adapts to owner's form! Is big as hand of $(player.name) now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Eldan hide gauntlets everywhere, but I not know why... yet!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You discovered one of the Gauntlets of the Chosen - mysterious artifacts seeded throughout Nexus by the Eldan for some unknown purpose. Tales tell of such gauntlets adapting to their owner's needs, and each is said to hold the promise of untold power.

localizedTextIdText: You met with Tresayne Toria and she told you the most promising of the Eldan were granted gifts of power long ago. When the Eldan were lost, so too were their gifts. In order to complete the transformation of your gauntlet and join the ranks of the chosen, you must collect tarnished Eldan gifts from powerful Strain creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Tresayne Toria in Blademother's Refuge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those gauntlets belonged to chosen Eldan in years past. They were formidable once. Only the tarnished gifts they left behind can restore their power.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you intend to restore your gauntlet's power, slay Strain beasts and collect the tarnished Eldan gifts they possess.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Strain is a threat to us all. Every gauntlet we restore is another weapon we can use against it. We must fight to save this world.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The vilest Strain beasts possess what you require. Offer them no mercy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You were destined to take up this cause, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You faced many trials of strength and skill, destroying Strain creatures both great and small, and collected many tarnished Eldan gifts from their remains in order to restore power to your Gauntlet of the Chosen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me about the Eldan gauntlets.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Tell me about the Genetic Archives.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Tell me about the Silverblade.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: Tell me about the tarnished gifts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There were many items of power created by the Eldan, but the Gauntlets were the most enduring. They were designed to test and empower their owners.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Those chosen would be put through trials. If they fell, the gauntlet would be passed to whoever defeated them, and the cycle would continue.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I know little of that place. It was once where the Eldan stored the primal patterns of their mightiest creations, but it has since fallen to the Strain.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: It is the living soul of battle, kept deep within our sacred sanctuary. Only those who have shown exceptional competence are able to see it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: The Eldan possessed many items of great power, which they gave to their worthy. Most of these have fallen into ruin, as their bearers were claimed by the Strain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are unworthy. Crawl back to your hiding place, outsider.

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Spaceport Horizon calls for Exile volunteers to help defend the Northern Wastes against the Dominion. Speak to Venyanna Skywind in Spaceport Horizon to arrange transportation to Darkstone's Landing, then speak to Ashlii Moonwind.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Ashlii Moonwind in Darkstone's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exile troops in the Northern Wastes need reinforcements, and your assistance is crucial. Report to Ashlli Moonwind in Darkstone's Landing as soon as possible.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Locate a transport to the Northern Wastes and proceed at once to Darkstone's Landing. Speak to Venyanna Skywind to arrange your travel details.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This place is colder than a Mechari's heart!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Even though they're frozen to their heartwood, the trees of the Northern Wastes welcome you! And of course, I welcome you, too! It's good to have you here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Try to stay warm, friend. The worst thing about this place is the cold!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm happy to be here. I think.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in the Northern Wastes and spoke to Ashlii Moonwind concerning the Exiles' defense of the region. In time, you may even figure out why anyone would want to defend an icebox like this.

localizedTextIdText: You're fast approaching the final stage of your quest to imbue the Eldan gauntlet. Tresayne Toria says you must go to the Genetic Archives and complete the Live at the Archive quest if you wish to see your trials come to an end. Once you imbue your gauntlet, return to Sera Melfield in Thayd and report your victory.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sera Melfield in Thayd at the mysterious site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The end of your journey fast approaches. Return to the Genetic Archives, complete your final trial, and your gauntlet's imbuement will be completed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why do you still tarry here? Your final trial awaits you in the Genetic Archives. Horrors unseen since the days of the Eldan await you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, $(player.name)! What's shaking? From all the readings I've been getting, you're really close to getting that gauntlet imbued. I can't wait!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm so proud of you, $(player.name)! You really did it! That gauntlet is something really special, and you worked so hard to imbue it for the Exiles!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There is no margin for error. You will either succeed... or you will die.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take good care of that gauntlet! You're probably going to need it!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I did do pretty good, huh?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After much trial and toil, your Eldan gauntlet has been imbued! You can stand proud knowing that you are worthy of the honor it bestows upon you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me about the Genetic Archives.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What happens once the gauntlet is imbued?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I know little of the place, save that the Eldan stored information regarding primal patterns within it. Now it is little more than a dark place filled with untold horrors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: In such a case, the gauntlet will reveal its true power. Keep it safe and use it wisely against your enemies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is your task to complete. If you are too weak, then so be it.

localizedTextIdText: You've found an Eldan leadership talisman. The scientists are excited and have asked you to come to the Datascape Entry Hall to see what mysteries this incredibly powerful item might reveal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in the Datascape Entry Hall
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This intricately detailed talisman looks like it's designed to fit inside something else. You get the feeling it's immensely important.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Initializing... please wait.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Leadership talisman detected. Candidate found. Project: Legacy reactivated. Candidate $(player.name), please declare your weapon of choice.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Error... files unavailable. How strange. This has never happened before.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ended up taking the Eldan leadership talisman you found to the Caretaker in the Datascape and revealed the existence of an ancient Eldan weapons project that was never completed.

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Spaceport Alpha calls on Dominion citizens to join the offensive in the Northern Wastes. Speak to Captain Zanaar in Spaceport Alpha to arrange transportation to Camp Icefury, then speak to Anonius Nelles.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Anonius Nelles in Camp Icefury
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All citizens are obligated to assist in the offensive in the Northern Wastes. Locate a transport and report to Anonius Nelles in Camp Icefury at once!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Locate a transport to the Northern Wastes and proceed at once to Camp Icefury. Speak to Captain Zanaar to arrange your travel details.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If this planet isn't hotter than a bloody sun, it's colder than a Mordesh morgue!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I have been expecting you, $(player.name). The longer we stand here chatting, the longer we shall have to endure these freezing conditions.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now pay attention. You are paying attention, aren't you? Yes? Excellent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in the Northern Wastes and spoke to Anonius Nelles concerning the Dominion's offensive. If you can survive the cold, you'll probably have many exciting adventures here.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Exit the micro and speak with Quest Test - Direction Aurin

localizedTextIdText: Syra, Queen of the Direweb and her brood have captured Kit Brinny and her recon team. Syra will release Kit and the other Exiles, but only if you kill Chirae, Queen of the Sourhive and her buzzbing army in the Royal Hive.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb in the Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(self.visual=40311)You want friends? Syra want Chirae, Sourhive queen, dead. Kill Chirae, other buzzbings, then Syra free your friends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(self.visual=40311)Chirae queen of Sourhive. Many Direweb die from Sourhive stings. Kill her, kill her servants, and Syra will free your friends.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=40312)Chirae dead. Sourhive in fear now. Good... very good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(self.visual=40312)Deal is made. Now to the killing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(self.visual=40311)Syra not understand. Does not matter.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm real good at pest control.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: In an attempt to free Kit Brinny and her recon team from the clutches of the Direweb spiders, you infiltrated the Royal Hive and killed Chirae, Queen of the Sourhive. Maybe now Syra, Queen of the Direweb will set your friends free.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why can't your spiders kill Chirae?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why don't you kill Chirae yourself?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Too many Direweb die already. Hive... poison. Syra think you have better chance.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Much risk. If Syra die... so do all Direweb. This cannot happen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You refuse? Direweb eat tasty friends. Maybe you be sad before Direweb eat you, too.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(self.visual=40312)Friends look tasty. Shame if Direweb drain them dry.

localizedTextIdTitle: If It Doesn't Spoil, Nuke It
localizedTextIdText: According to Syra, Queen of the Direweb, Honey Pods in the Tainted Gardens give the buzzbings power. She wants you to use bug bombs - taken from the Exiles - to destroy the honey pods and weaken the Sourhive buzzbings.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb in the Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $(self.visual=40311)Sourhive proud of honey pods. Pods make Sourhive strong. We take booms from your people. You use booms to destroy pods.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(self.visual=40311)Use booms on honey pods. Booms destroy them, make Sourhive weak and unhappy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: $(self.visual=40312)Honeypods destroyed. Can smell Sourhive's weakness. Not proud now, are they? Not proud at all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(self.visual=40312)Syra watches. Syra waits. Syra patient... very patient.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(self.visual=40311)Soon your friends free... yes.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I almost feel sorry for them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used bug bombs to destroy the honey pods, weakening and insulting the buzzbings. Syra, Queen of the Direweb, is pleased by your success.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Hey. You said you were patient.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to Syra, Queen of the Direweb
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Your friends have booms. Use them to kill... explode with poison. Now Syra give booms to you, you use booms on Sourhive.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: $(self.visual=40312)Poor friends. You not want friends free anymore?

localizedTextIdText: Treasure Collector Rung has asked that you help find Wigwalli Lopp treasure that has been buried in Whitevale. Return anything you find to Treasure Collector Rung in Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Treasure Collector Rung in Wigwalli Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many treasures waiting to be found.  Lopp need your help!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lopp not know big-folk so slow..
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp not know big-folk so slow. Go find treasures already!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You good friend.  Be better friend and bring Lopp more shinies!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp wait in Wigwalli Village for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bye bye now.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can search for your treasure.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Treasure Collector Rung is very grateful for your assistance.  If you find any more treasure be sure to bring it back to Wigwalli Village.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Even so, I still like Lopp-folk.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I can search for your treasure.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp not like disappointment.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for weapons to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Weaponsmiths interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCalling all weaponsmiths! FCON needs weapons for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCalling all weaponsmiths! FCON needs weapons for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can't quit now, $(player.name). It's time for us to roll up our sleeves and work harder, faster, and smarter than ever before.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got some weapons for me? Well, it's a start. I expect I'll be seeing you back here tomorrow with more.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If we all put our hours in, we can make a real difference.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for weapons to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Weaponsmiths interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Weapons to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nAs we face Grimvault's many dangers, it's important to upgrade and replace weapons as often as possible. Please donate to our troops!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nAs we face Grimvault's many dangers, it's important to upgrade and replace weapons as often as possible. Please donate to our troops!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've got a big job to do, but everybody's pulling together! Weaponsmiths are working at the Crafting Station nonstop. It's so exciting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is it: the big adventure where we all pull together and save the world! And your weapons will be a part of it. Ooh, I'm so excited!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: When this is over, hugs for everybody!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought weapons to Supervisor Wicksprout in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Weapons to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for powerful weapons to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Weaponsmiths interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Weaponsmith Dunpepper at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain are the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled weaponsmith in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe are the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled weaponsmith in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: All right, it's up to you and me to make enough weapons to keep folks fightin' for as long as it takes. Let's get to work!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The first time I saw one of your weapons, I knew you'd stick with the craft until you mastered it. Glad to see I was right.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I reckon you'll be trainin' up apprentices of your own soon enough.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for armor to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Armorers interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Heavy Armor for Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCalling all armorers! FCON needs equipment for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCalling all armorers! FCON needs equipment for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can't quit now, $(player.name). It's time for us to roll up our sleeves and work harder, better, faster, and smarter than ever before.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well that's a good start, friend. Hopefully this armor keeps the Strain out. I expect to see you again tomorrow, you got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Many thanks, friend. Times are tough, but you pulled through.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Heavy Armor for Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for heavy armor to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Armorers interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Heavy Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nAs we face Grimvault's many dangers, it's important to have the finest and sturdiest armor possible. Please donate to our troops!
