localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nAs we face Grimvault's many dangers, it's important to have the finest and sturdiest armor possible. Please donate to our troops!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We've got a big job to do, but everybody's pulling together! Armorers are working at the Crafting Station nonstop. It's so exciting!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is this my armor?! Oh wow, it's wonderful! We're going to save the world here and it's all thanks to your help! I'm so excited!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, just give me a big hug before you go!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought armor to Supervisor Wicksprout in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Heavy Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for armor to support the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Anyone interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Armorer Thaako at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Heavy Armor to Armorer Thaako at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain are the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled armorer in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain are the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled armorer in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That Strain crud can get into the tiniest crack. We gotta make sure our armor is perfect - one bad weld could cost somebody their stones.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is good, solid armor... and with what our mercs are facing out there, it'd better be. Keep it coming, and we might just live through this.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You got rocks to help us out when we need it. And boy, do we need it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought the requested armor to Armorer Thaako in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Heavy Armor for Armorer Thaako

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for medium armor to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Outfitters interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCalling all outfitters! FCON needs armor for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCalling all outfitters! FCON needs armor for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You can't quit now, $(player.name). When the going gets tough, the tough get going!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for pullin' through friend. You'll be back tomorrow for the next work order, right? I know I can count on you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You pulled through for us, just like always. Thanks, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've shared your medium armor with Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for medium armor to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Outfitters interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medium Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain are the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled outfitter in the Brigade!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain are the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled outfitter in the Brigade!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know the Strain are scary, $(player.name), but we've got to fight them. I know some medium armor from the Work Order Board will make a difference!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did it, you did it! This medium armor is fantastic! I just knew you had the makings of a master outfitter in you when we first met!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No hug before you go? Come on!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've shared your medium armor with Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medium Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade representative, Outfitter Keynes is stationed in the Final Stand. This is your chance to show the Brigade what you can do. Some well-wrought armor should do the trick.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the armor to Brigade Captain Ashgrove at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled outfitter in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled outfitter in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Medium armor ain't really all that complicated to work with. Once you get the hang of it, you'll be done in an insta-jiffy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be, this armor's just what what we needed! I'll get it passed on to Brigade HQ! Glad I recruited you, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We're all that's standin' between the Exiles and obliteration!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've shared your armor with Brigade Captain Ashgrove in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the armor to Brigade Captain Ashgrove

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for light armor to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Tailors interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCalling all tailors! FCON needs weapons for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCalling all tailors! FCON needs weapons for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: No time for slackin' $(player.name). If we're gonna hold off the Strain, we gotta fill these work orders in an insta-jiffy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I knew I could trust you when I met you, friend, and here you are, with another pile of gear for our troops. See you tomorrow, you hear?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Reckon I judged right, friend. I owe you one.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought light armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for light armor to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Tailors interested in contributing should bring the requested items to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Light Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled tailor in the Brigade!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled tailor in the Brigade!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know the Strain is scary, $(player.name), but we've got to fight it. I know some light armor from the Work Order Board will make a difference!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This armor! It's beautiful! Something this beautiful won't fail against the Strain! Oh, when we met, I knew you would be a master tailor!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ohhh, just one more hug before you go! I'm so proud of you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought armor to Supervisor Wicksprout in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Light Armor to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for armor to support the war effort. Anyone interested in contributing should bring their light armor to Tailor Wildspring at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled tailor in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have ever faced. We need the cooperation of every highly skilled tailor in the Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Grimvault may be scary,  but Starloom is the best cloth ever! I've made a couple things, but I can't wait to see what you'll come up with!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whenever we're in a fix, I just know you'll come through with something absolutely lovely. Just goes to show that beauty can come from anywhere!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Fashion is passion!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought light armor to Tailor Wildspring in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for weapons to supply the Dominion in their fight against the Strain. Weaponsmiths interested in contributing should bring the requested weapons to Crafting Trainer Trixion in the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Craftmaster Tullio in the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe're losing men and supplies at an alarming rate. We must fill orders for weapons as quickly as possible, or all is lost.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe're losing men and supplies at an alarming rate. We must fill orders for weapons as quickly as possible, or all is lost.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Even in the face of gibbering, corrupted monsters, the Victory Commission does not shirk its duties. We require those weapons, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. No one can ever say that when we faced the Strain, the Victory Commission did not do our part.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Glory to the empire, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Craftmaster Tullio in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for weapons to supply the Dominion in their fight against the Strain. Weaponsmiths interested in contributing should bring the requested weapons to Crafting Trainer Trixion in the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Weapons to Crafting Trainer Trixion in the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nAs we advance thorough Grimvault, the weapons we are using must be replaced and upgraded. Our current standing orders are listed below.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nAs we advance thorough Grimvault, the weapons we are using must be replaced and upgraded. Our current standing orders are listed below.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Dominion makes calculated risks, but the situation here is far more dire than any we have formerly quantified. Weapons would help balance the equation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With a more comprehensive and varied stockpile of weapons, I can now upgrade this conflict from "intractable disaster" to "deplorable quagmire."
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It may not seem like much, but the distinction is an important one.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Crafting Trainer Trixion in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Weapons to Crafting Trainer Trixion

localizedTextIdText: Toric Antevian is in need of your help! Toric is about to begin an epic siege in the name of the Dominion and is awaiting your arrival just inside the gates of Kel Voreth
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Toric Antevian outside the gates of Kel Voreth
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lace up those boots and arm yourself. The Warherald must fall today, and I daresay that I'd like you by my side.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome, citizen. It is time. I hope you've come prepared.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Very good. Come meet me, inside the gates of Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: When shall we begin?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have successfully met Toric Antevian inside the gates of Kel Voreth. The siege can now begin!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'd suggest that you rethink that response, citizen.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for weapons to supply the Dominion in their fight against the Strain. Weaponsmiths interested in contributing should bring the requested weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo in the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo in the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: To combat the Strain, the Dominion requires high quality weaponry. Weaponsmiths are needed to supply the empire's increased demand.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: To combat the Strain, the Dominion requires high quality weaponry. Weaponsmiths are needed to supply the empire's increased demand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Casualties exceeding acceptable levels! Must have weapons with cozmotronic stopping power! You make weapons, give to me! Now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You make weapons? Must issue to new troops before sending them to be butchered by Strain. Maybe increase kill-per-death ratio. Probably not.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You make weapons? Must issue to new troops before sending them to be butchered by Strain. Maybe increase kill-per-death ratio. Probably not.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo

localizedTextIdText: Scorchwing has become hostile and poses a significant threat to the Keepers of Harmony. The Harmonious Wand-Waver has asked you to go to Scorchwing's Landing and put the creature to death in order to safeguard his people.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Harmonious Wand-Waver via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Scorchwing has become a craven beast, and the Disciples are endangered by its voraciousness. We ask that you destroy Scorchwing so we will be safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is Scorchwing slain? We ask for little more than the beast's death, outsider. It is a fearsome creature that has devoured many Disciples.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With Scorchwing destroyed, the Masters smile upon you with renewed benevolence. There will be much rejoicing!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Scorchwing is dangerous. Do not underestimate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Disciples thank you, outsider.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Scorchwing's Landing and killed Scorchwing. The Harmonious Wand-Waver is pleased that the Keepers of Harmony are now safe from the vicious creature.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We had hoped the rumors of outsider selfishness were false. Alas...

localizedTextIdText: After killing Scorchwing, you cut one of its massive wings from its bleeding corpse. Perhaps the Keepers of Harmony at Nursery Trading Post will be comforted knowing that they are finally rid of the beastly bird.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Harmonious Wand-Waver and relay the good news
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The hostile Scorchwing has been slain. This piece of it's wing might be valuable to someone.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With Scorchwing destroyed, the Masters smile upon you with renewed benevolence. There will be much rejoicing!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Disciples thank you, outsider.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll make sure the Pell get this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered Scorchwing's wing to the Harmonious Wand-Waver, who expressed the Disciples' gratitude for your courageous deed.

localizedTextIdText: A creature known as the Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} has been wreaking havoc with Cass Quietly seismic equipment in Cankertube Swamp and delaying her research. You've killed the Sentinel and can provide its heart to Cass as proof of its death. Maybe there's a reward!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Cass Quietly via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This warm and bloody heart, so massive in size, was cut from the chest of the Sentinel of the Swamp. Cass Quietly should appreciate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dammit! My seismic sensors are goin' haywire, and I'll tell ya what's causin' it. It's that slaggin' sentinel stompin' around, that's what!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great balls of granite! You musta killed that slaggin' sentinel, yeah? 'Cause my gear's readin' as smooth as silk now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good work. You look pretty proud of yerself, too. Ya should be!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I did it all for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} and earned a substantial reward from Cass Quietly. Now Cass is happy because she can continue her research without interference.

localizedTextIdText: A creature known as the Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} has been wreaking havoc with Wheez Nokenti seismic equipment in Cankertube Swamp and delaying his research. You've killed the Sentinel and can provide its heart to Wheez as proof of its death. Maybe there's a reward!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Wheez Nokenti via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This warm and bloody heart, so massive in size, was cut from the chest of the Sentinel of the Swamp. Wheez Nokenti should appreciate it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sentinel of Swamp always stomp stomp stomping in Cankertube! Mucks with seismic equipment, ruins research! Find Sentinel and kill kill kill!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nasty heart belong to Sentinel of Swamp? Good! With beast dead, seismic equipment now functions as anticipated. Am very pleased!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take reward. Do not spend all in one place, yes?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm so glad to hear it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully killed Sentinel of the Swamp{p:Sentinels of the Swamp} and earned a substantial reward from Wheez Nokenti. Now Wheez is happy because he can continue his research without interference.

localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Glory to the empire, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought heavy armor to Craftmaster Tullio in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Heavy Armor to Craftmaster Tullio

localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: When the Dominion cleanses this place of the Strain, we can finally claim our birthright. Perhaps those who claim victory will be wearing this very armor.

localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We will do our duty, and pass these on to those who need them.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=2957) to Technologist Otha in the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Dominion has encountered on Nexus. Our forces require $m(schematic=2957) of the very highest quality.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Dominion has encountered on Nexus. Our forces require $m(schematic=2957) of the very highest quality.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time to roll up your sleeves and do the best work you've got in you! Our boys are counting on us to patch 'em up, and that's what we'll do!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is a fine batch of $m(schematic=2957), and just in time! I knew you'd come through like always, luv!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll live through this, no matter what!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought $m(schematic=2957) to Craftmaster Tullio in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medishots to Technologist Otha

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m$m(schematic=1308). Architects interested in contributing should bring their wares to Craftmaster Tullio in the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1308) to Craftmaster Tullio in the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nFighting the Strain has led to some interesting infrastructure needs. We request a delivery of $m(schematic=1308) to the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nFighting the Strain has led to some interesting infrastructure needs. We request a delivery of $m(schematic=1308) to the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: It is not for us to ask why items are ordered. If the Dominion needs $m(schematic=1308), we shall provide them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: In this place of darkness, those torches will be used as beacons to guide lost citizens back to safety. Now you see the importance of all we do.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Like a lodestar, the Victory Commission is a source of hope in dark times.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought $m(schematic=1308) to Craftmaster Tullio in the Vigilant Incursion.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m(schematic=1037). Architects interested in contributing should bring their wares to Architect Virin in the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1037) to Architect Virin in the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$m(schematic=1037) needed. Do not ask questions. Simply deliver the goods to the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$m(schematic=1037) needed. Do not ask questions. Simply deliver the goods to the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look mate, they ask for a $m(schematic=1037), we build 'em a $m(schematic=1037). That's how the Dominion gets things done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's a smart looking $(schematic=1037), that is. Good to see another architect who's willing to do whatever the job calls for.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do as you're asked and get paid. It's the Dominion way!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought $m(schematic=1037) to Architect Virin in the Vigilant Incursion.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m(schematic=1307). Architects interested in contributing should bring their wares to Crafting Trainer Trixion in the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1307) to Crafting Trainer Trixion in the Vigilant Incursion
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Dominion's task in Grimvault is the most challenging we have faced, we need $m(schematic=1307) to enhance the stability of our power supply.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nFighting the Strain has led to some interesting infrastructure needs. We request a delivery of $m(schematic=1308) to the Vigilant Incursion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sometimes, an unconventional item can have surprising utility. $m(schematic=1307) provides enhanced stability for our power grid.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you for fulfilling such an unusual request. We will be installing those $m(schematic=1307) immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's a pleasure to work with those who do not question orders.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought $m(schematic=1307) to Craftmaster Tullio in the Vigilant Incursion.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m(schematic=1266) to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Technologists interested in contributing should bring medishots to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1266) to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCalling all Technologists! FCON needs $m(schematic=1266) for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCalling all Technologists! FCON needs $m(schematic=1266) for the new war against the Strain. Supplies are getting dangerously low.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm not going to sugarcoat it for you, $(player.name). If we don't get some $m(schematic=1266) soon, good people are gonna die.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Just in the nick of time, $(player.name). You saved some lives today, and that's a fact.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As long as we're in Grimvault, I'd keep churnin' those out. We'll need 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought $m(schematic=1266) to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medishots to Crafting Trainer Thorpe

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m(schematic=1270) to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Technologists interested in contributing should bring medishots to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1270) to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nAs we face Grimvault's many dangers, it's important to maintain our supply of  $m(schematic=1270). Please donate to our troops!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nAs we face Grimvault's many dangers, it's important to maintain our supply of  $m(schematic=1270). Please donate to our troops!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This is what I live for! We're out here on the front lines, collecting $m(schematic=1270) and getting them to the people who need them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is it: the big adventure where we all pull together and save the world! Your medishots will be out there keeping people alive!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stay safe out there!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought $m(schematic=1270) to Supervisor Wicksprout in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medishots to Supervisor Wicksprout

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m(schematic=2957) to supply the Exiles in their fight against the Strain. Technologists interested in contributing should bring medishots to Technologist Blackwood at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=2957) to Technologist Blackwood at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have encountered on Nexus. Our forces require $m(schematic=2957) of the very highest quality.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Strain is the greatest threat the Exiles have encountered on Nexus. Our forces require $m(schematic=2957) of the very highest quality.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need all the $m(schematic=2957) we can get our hands on, and there's no time to waste! I'm barely keeping it together as it is!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Are these... are these $m(schematic=2957)? Thank the stars! $(player.name), you're a real lifesaver!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's folks like you that are keepin' us standin', friend!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Get this to the injured, now!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've brought $m(schematic=2957) to Technologist Blackwood in Grimvault.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medishots to Technologist Blackwood

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m$m(schematic=1308). Architects interested in contributing should bring their wares to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1308) to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in the the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe need to use whatever we can get our hands on to fight the Strain. Bring $m(schematic=1308) to The Final Stand.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe need to use whatever we can get our hands on to fight the Strain. Bring $m(schematic=1308) to The Final Stand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When the power mysteriously goes out, I reckon a $(schematic=1308) would serve as a decent emergency light source.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We need light sources that don't rely on the power grid, and the Strain hate fire. Given that, $m(schematic=1308) are damned useful 'round here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If there's one thing Exiles are good at, it's improvisin'.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought $m(schematic=1308) to Crafting Trainer Thorpe in the Final Stand.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m(schematic=1037). Architects interested in contributing should bring their wares to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1037) to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$m(schematic=1037) are needed for the Exile Brigades at the Final Stand. Architects are needed at once!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$m(schematic=1037) are needed for the Exile Brigades at the Final Stand. Architects are needed at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know this sounds odd, but someone really needs a $(schematic=1037). We're their only hope!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I wish I knew why someone asked for a $(schematic=1037) in Grimvault, but they probably had a good reason. Thanks a bunch!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for helping out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought $m(schematic=1037) to Supervisor Wicksprout at the Final Stand.

localizedTextIdText: The Work Order Board in Grimvault lists a work order request for $m(schematic=1307). Architects interested in contributing should bring their wares to Architect Kaspmara at the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=1307) to Architect Kaspmara at the Final Stand
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Exiles' work in Grimvault is the most challenging we have faced, we need $m(schematic=1307) to enhance the stability of our power supply.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nFighting the Strain has led to some interesting infrastructure needs. We request a delivery of $m(schematic=1307) to the Final Stand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Freebots are quite resilient and resourceful. $m(schematic=1307) are deliberately designed  to withstand disruption.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: With these $m(schematic=1307) installed, we will be able to preserve our power in the face of the disastrous destruction of these dark days.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Incremental improvements create a sense of safety.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought $m(schematic=1307) to Architect Kaspmara at the Final Stand.

localizedTextIdText: The Tainted Gardens are crawling with giant spiders, and Ringo Hax has instructed you to squash them before they cause too much trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nThe giant spider population in the Tainted Gardens is reaching unmanageable levels and requires reduction. Contact Ringo Hax for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nThe giant spider population in the Tainted Gardens is reaching unmanageable levels and requires reduction. Contact Ringo Hax for more information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Spiders not here. Not yet, anyway. If you not kill them, they will be. Then I be upset. So go to Tainted Gardens and kill spiders.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Giant spiders finally dead. They hard to kill? Or is $p(player.name) efficiency reduced? Possible experiment in this... hmm. Remind me later.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Spiders breed. New spiders every day. Come back later for more killing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ringo Hax asked you to squash giant spiders in the Tainted Gardens, and you were all too happy to oblige him.

localizedTextIdText: Chompacabras have been eating Farmer Fieldstar crops at the Oakby Farm in Crosswind Fields, and he wants your help to harvest what's left.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Farmer Fieldstar via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Chompacabras have been eating all my crops from the roots up! Could you help me out by bringing in my vegetables before the chompers eat them all?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's the harvest coming along? You pull up any chompacabras yet? Those little beasts are a damn menace, make no mistake!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for taking care of today's harvest. The chompacabras have taken more bites out of me than I care to admit. Blazes, only got seven toes left!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch out! Sometimes those blasted chompers get pulled up with the veggies!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Come back tomorrow and help me harvest some more, okay?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Farmer Fieldstar harvest his crops despite at the Oakby Farm despite his rampant chompacabra infestation. You reckon there will be more to do tomorrow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself, then. All I wanted was some neighborly help. Jerk.

localizedTextIdText: To imbue your item with greater power, you must destroy the Dominion Ultrabot located in Camp Icefury.
The Tainted Gardens are crawling with giant spiders, and Captain Lannellu has instructed you to squash them before they cause too much trouble.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Lannellu via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nThe giant spider population in the Tainted Gardens is reaching unmanageable levels and requires reduction. Contact Captain Lannellu for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nThe giant spider population in the Tainted Gardens is reaching unmanageable levels and requires reduction. Contact Captain Lannellu for more information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Been to the Tainted Gardens yet? They're crawlin' with spiders the size of oxians, and that ain't no bull. Get out there and exterminate 'em, ASAP.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've seen what giant spiders can do to men and machines. It ain't pretty. By keepin' 'em outta here, you've really made a difference.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't be a stranger. There'll always be more spiders to squash.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Captain Lannellu asked you to squash giant spiders in the Tainted Gardens, and you were all too happy to oblige her.

localizedTextIdTitle: Warbot, What is it Good for?
localizedTextIdText: To imbue your item with greater power, you must destroy the Exile Warbot located in Greyshore.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must destroy the Firestorm Tank located in Fort Firestorm.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must destroy the Megatech Warbot located in Megatech Station.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must slay Shoveljaw Boulderback located near the Crystal Shards.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must slay Dustden Fracas and Dustden Howler throughout Rockridge Hollow.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must collect Plasma Fragment throughout Annihilator Silo 14.
FILL THIS IN
To imbue your item with greater power, you must enrage the Augmented Hookfoots before killing them inside the Bio-Mech Facility.

The Eldan scientists knew that corruption would disrupt their control groups during experiments and they avoided cross contamination at all costs. Travel to the Genetic Archives and kill Kuralak the Defiler without being hit by his corrupting telegraph attacks.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must slay Treebound Protector and Unbound Protector throughout Godsbreath Terrace.

Sera Melfield has detected a signal very similar to the one your gauntlet broadcasts coming from somewhere deep within the jungles of Wilderrun. Meet Sera there and see what you can learn about your gauntlet.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Tresayne Toria in Everpool Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wait! Your gauntlet's energy signal has changed. Not only that, but a similar signal has started broadcasting from Wilderrun in Olyssia!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The signal coming out of Wilderrun is similar to the one your gauntlet is giving off. The sooner we get there, the sooner we can solve this mystery!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you know what you are looking for, outsider? If not, how can you ever hope to find it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have found one of the Eldan gauntlets, have you? And now you wish to learn about its power. Yes, stranger... I have the answers you seek.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Count me in! Let me get my gear packed and I'll meet you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Quiet your tongue. The story is mine alone to tell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The energy Sera Melfield detected led you deep into the jungles of Wilderrun where you met Tresayne Toria. Hopefully she can provide insight into the mysteries of the Gauntlets of the Chosen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about the energy signal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's like a combination of a primal pattern and a beacon. It's painting a picture of you, and letting someone know you're out there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I'm not sure. It was probably meant to contact the Eldan. The signal is subtle... I wouldn't have detected it if the gauntlet hadn't transformed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I don't know. It's similar to yours, but not identical. It's more stable and the primal pattern is different. If you want to learn more, you'll need to investigate.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You'll never realize that gauntlet's full potential if you're lazy.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is a hastily-scrawled note on this chest. It reads, "For my friend, $(player.name). These are of no use to me, but I think you might need them."
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Drusera left you a cache of tarnished gifts to help you imbue your Eldan gauntlet.

localizedTextIdText: To imbue your item with greater power, you must slay Oxian throughout the Larallen Highlands.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must slay neutral creatures throughout Bloodfire Savannah.
The Royal Collegium has detected high levels of primal logic in The Skittering Parlor. Use your scanbot to find out more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Access the Progenitor Archive in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are getting high readings of Primal Logic in those exanite ruins nearby. Investigate these strong signals and report back with your findings.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you still doing here? There is much yet to scan and examine.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The terminal seems to be low on power.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: System Reboot...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Tread carefully, $(player.name). Few have ventured this deep into the vault and fewer still come back alive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Systems Operational.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Seems like that did the trick.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found an archive terminal that belonged to an Eldan Progenitor. After figuring out how to power it up, you gained access to the archives within.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sorry. Oh, you thought I was making a request?

localizedTextIdText: To imbue your item with greater power, you must kill skeledroids throughout Leviathan's Rest.
Gather a series of incongruous items in the West Glen of Wilderrun to imbue your item with greater power.

Researcher Babbit has detected a signal very similar to the one your gauntlet broadcasts coming from somewhere deep within the jungles of Wilderrun. Meet Babbit there and see what you can learn about your gauntlet.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Tresayne Toria in Everpool Sanctum
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Wait wait! Gauntlet energy signal different! And similar signal now being received, broadcasting from Wilderrun! Cozmotronic!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Wilderrun signal almost identical to gauntlet signal. We go, now now now! Or I take gauntlet from dead $(player.name), go alone. Understand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you know what you are looking for, outlander? If not, how can you ever hope to find it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have found one of the Eldan gauntlets, have you? And now you wish to learn about its power. Yes, stranger... I have the answers you seek.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I come too. Meet you there. Quick quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Quiet your tongue. The story is mine alone to tell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The energy Researcher Babbit detected led you deep into the jungles of Wilderrun where you met Tresayne Toria. Hopefully she can provide insight into the mysteries of the Gauntlets of the Chosen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me more about the energy signal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Is combination of primal pattern and beacon. Paints picture of you. Maybe to let someone know $(player.name) is here.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Unknown! Maybe meant to contact Eldan. Signal strange! Only detected it because gauntlet changed! And because I am genius.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Also unknown. Signal similar to yours, but not same. More stable. Primal pattern different. To learn more, must go to Wilderrun!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hold out hand. I get bone saw. It not hurt till I hit bone!

localizedTextIdText: To imbue your item with greater power, you must kill Terros Medusa throughout the Blasted Fields.
Destroy elementals in the Deepfall Spires of Wilderrun to imbue your item with greater power.
As a gauntlet bearer, you must seek out the Panel in the Genetic Archives and gain the blessing of Eldan exceptionalism. You must then destroy Experiment X-89 before the panel's blessing fades.
Imbue your item with greater power by collecting Sealed Slush from the Gargleblast Marauders roaming Slushstill Plateau in Southern Malgrave.

The Progenitor of Primal Logic, an archive terminal of Nazrek, has been discovered in the The Skittering Parlor. The encrypted data uncovered a method that allows certain sentient creatures to communicate mind to mind. These secrets seem to be highly guarded behind security systems.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the Caretaker in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nazrek's experiment files secured and moved to lab. Telepathy method information archived. Archive access restricted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Evokers crafted the Telepathy stone so that Nazrek could communicate with his sentient creations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Initializing Caretaker...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: By accessing the Telepathy stone you will be able to read the minds of certain creatures within the confines of the Gardens that have been heavily infused with primal logic.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Could I really use telepathy to communicate?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You bypassed the security and have now access to the Telepathy Stone. This stone was created by the Eldan Evokers to allow Progenitor Nazrek to communicate with his sentient creations.

localizedTextIdText: Collect Ancient Embers from the Flamewalker Pell of Flamewalker Hold in Farside to imbue your item with greater power.
Collect tails from Wooly Mammodin{p:Wooly Mammodin} in Southern Whitevale to imbue your item with greater power.

With access to the Telepathy Stone, you can communicate with certain sentient creatures in The Skittering Parlor. Maybe asking the creatures themselves will shine light on how and why they gained such knowledge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the Direweb Broodlord in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Telepathy Stone, crafted by the Eldan Evokers themselves? Most intriguing! This means there could be more sentient creations made by the Eldan than we know of. Scout around and see if you can find any of them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found anything worth reporting? If not, go and seek the spiders.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mus-s-s-t have more brain-s-s-s.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You s-s-seek knowledge, yes-s-s?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(player.name), you may be the first scientist ever to truly investigate the inner thoughts of what is usually a non-sentient species!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have knowledge, oh yes-s-s...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will give this telepathy a try.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You communicated with spiders within the confines of the exanite walls. Still, little is known about how they gained so much primal logic or how they evolved capability to calculate consequence and understand survival.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You risk the wrath of the highborn? Foolish...

localizedTextIdText: The Direweb Broodlord has requested buzzbing brains found in the Tainted Gardens. While not necessarily the most reliable source, this creature claims that they are infused with primal logic, which may further our study. Not to mention it promises to reveal some secret if you bring enough brains for it to feed on.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Direweb Broodlord in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have s-s-secret to tell you. But you do s-s-something for me firs-s-st. Buzzbing brains-s-s, I needs-s-s them. S-s-satisfy my appetite and s-s-secret is yours-s-s.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: (Incomplete)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: S-s-so hungry... Need more brains-s-s.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Many brains-s-s you bring. This-s-s will do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Us-s-se your s-s-scanbot to extract the brains-s-s carefully! Buzzbing Brains-s-s very delicate... and s-s-so delicious-s-s.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I give you this-s-s.  It holds-s-s the s-s-secret to the pas-s-st.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This secret better be worth it!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: This secret better be worth it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While the logic-infused buzzbing brains are indeed intriguing and worthy of study, you have returned them to the hungry spider in hopes that the secret was worth the effort. The hungry spider provided a web-encased object... wonder what's in there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not tes-s-st my patience-s-s.

localizedTextIdText: You have obtained an Eldan artifact that supposedly holds the secret to one of their greatest experiments. Find what secrets can be unlocked with it in the Tainted Gardens, and dive deeper into the intentions of Progenitor Nazrek.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Turn on the Holo Projector Terminal in the Tainted Gardens
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A strange Eldan artifact. It must serve some kind of purpose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Accessing secured archives...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The unique shape looks like it is made to fit somewhere.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I wonder what this is used for.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Now to find out the goal of these experiments.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The artifact unlocked a way into the Exo-lab where Progenitor Nazrek first conducted his experiments on the queen spider and queen buzzbing. The result of the added intelligence mixed with their instinctual enmity created an endless conflict between the two broods.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Turn on the Holo Projector Terminal

localizedTextIdText: The Ceremonial Fish Giblets{p: Ceremonial Fish Giblets} is an ancient sword that was once a powerful weapon. Only those who have proven themselves within the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden by earning a Silver medal on Prime difficulty can see its hiding place in the Sanctuary's Inner Sanctum.

A corrupted giant known as Gargantua wanders through the Promenade of Ruin causing lots of trouble. A kill order's been issued, and anyone who can provide proof of the beast's death is eligible for a hefty bounty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Lannellu via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nGargantua has been sighted roaming the Promenade of Ruin, inhibiting Exile movement. A hefty reward is offered for proof of the giant's death.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nTo claim your reward, present proof of Gargantua's death to Captain Lannellu, either in person or via comm call.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Looking to kill the giant, huh? Well, good luck with that, sweetheart. He's stomped plenty of folks into paste, so you won't be the first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Killed Gargantua, did you? Impressive! Now our troopers can move through the Promenade of Ruin a bit more safely.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's that reward, pal. Helluva job!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Gargantua has been killed in the Promenade of Ruin. Now the Exiles can pass through the area without worrying about the giant stomping them into giblets.

localizedTextIdText: A corrupted giant known as Gargantua wanders through the Promenade of Ruin causing lots of trouble. If you provide proof of the giant's death to Captain Lannellu, you'll earn a hefty bounty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Lannellu via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You pried this nasty tooth from Gargantua's maw after the giant had been slain. If you turn it in to Captain Lannellu, you'll be rewarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have something for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Killed Gargantua, did you? Impressive! Now our troopers can move through the Promenade of Ruin a bit more safely.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's that reward, pal. Helluva job!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get this to the captain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Gargantua has been killed in the Promenade of Ruin. Now Exile troops can pass through the area without worrying about the giant stomping them into giblets.

localizedTextIdText: A corrupted giant known as Gargantua wanders through the Promenade of Ruin causing lots of trouble. A kill order's been issued, and anyone who can provide proof of the beast's death is eligible for a hefty bounty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Vialspiller via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nGargantua has been sighted roaming the Promenade of Ruin, inhibiting Dominion movement. A reward is offered for proof of the giant's death.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nTo claim your reward, present proof of Gargantua's death to Captain Vialspiller, either in person or via comm call.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Heard about the giant in the Promenade of Ruin, have you? You'll probably die if you attempt to kill it, but at least your death will be glorious!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You killed Gargantua? You are truly a force to be reckoned with! I acknowledge your prowess with this reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now our soldiers can move freely through the Promenade. Well done!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Gargantua has been killed in the Promenade of Ruin. Now Dominion soldiers can pass through the area without worrying about the giant stomping them into giblets.

localizedTextIdText: A corrupted giant known as Gargantua wanders through the Promenade of Ruin causing lots of trouble. If you provide proof of the giant's death to Captain Vialspiller, you'll earn a hefty bounty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Vialspiller via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You pried this nasty tooth from Gargantua's maw after the giant had been slain. If you turn it in to Captain Vialspiller, you'll be rewarded.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You killed Gargantua? You are truly a force to be reckoned with! I acknowledge your prowess with this reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now our soldiers can move freely through the Promenade. Well done!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll get this to the captain.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Gargantua has been killed in the Promenade of Ruin. Now Dominion soldiers can pass through the area without worrying about the giant stomping them into giblets.

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Spaceport Alpha calls for Dominion volunteers to help investigate the Dreg in the Crimson Badlands. Speak to Captain Karaka in Spaceport Alpha to arrange transportation to Crimson Command, then speak to Pallian Cyreus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Pallian Cyreus at Crimson Command
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg activity on Crimson Isle has increased, and citizens are needed to quell the beasts. Report to Pallian Cyreus on Crimson Isle for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Dominion forces on Crimson Isle need you! Arrange transportation to Crimson Isle with Captain Karaka at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By the Scions, citizen. Can you not see how busy I am?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am told you are one of the Dominion's best and brightest. Do not expect favorable treatment as a result of your exemplary reputation, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now that that's out of the way, let's discuss your next assignment.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go to the Crimson Badlands.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in the Crimson Badlands and spoke to Pallian Cyreus concerning the Dreg problem. It looks like this is going to be an interesting assignment.

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Spaceport Horizon calls for Exile volunteers to help investigate the Dreg in the Crimson Badlands. Speak to Gus Oakby in Spaceport Horizon to arrange transportation to Bloodstone Landing, then speak to Lila Redkill.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Lila Redkill in Bloodstone Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg activity in the Crimon Badlands has increased, and Exile volunteers are needed to quell them. Report to Lila Redkill in the Crimson Badlands for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Exiles in the Crimson Badlands need you! Please arrange transportation with Gus Oakby.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You lookin' for someone?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I was hopin' you'd see our posting, $(player.name). We need all the help we can get here. The Dreg are plum out of control!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get down to business.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go to the Crimson Badlands.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in the Crimson Badlands and spoke to Lila Redkill concerning the Dreg problem. It looks like this is going to be an interesting assignment.

localizedTextIdText: The most promising Eldan on Nexus possessed many powerful gifts that were eventually corrupted by the Strain. Gather these tarnished Eldan gifts from powerful Strain creatures in Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden, the Genetic Archives, and Grimvault.
Collect $m(vitem=1002) from XT-9 Protector in Windfall Cave in Auroria to imbue your item with greater power.
Collect antidotes from Antidote Vial and by killing Toxiplast Chua at the Focus of Air Control Site to imbue your item with greater power.

You have combined the Eldan leadership talisman with a Project: Legacy weapon, but the Caretaker is experiencing technical difficulties in the Datascape and is unable to assist you. By completing the Hidden Files, Paired Programming, Data Recovery, and Subroutine Execution quests you can aid him in recovering the data required to complete your weapon.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Undiscovered Panel and speak to the Caretaker in the Datascape Entry Hall
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Error. High level project data is currently inaccessible. If you perform tasks related to your weapon, the data can be recovered.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I have continued my attempts to access the data related to Project: Legacy without success. Obviously, your tasks are far from complete.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am now able to access design specifications, schematics, and project goal data. It's a pity this project was never completed. However, there is an alert.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am uploading appropriate task data to your datachron.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A remote node that has been offline for centuries has just activated.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll do what I can to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed a number of imbuement quests and restored the Caretaker's data, allowing him to assist you in the construction of your Project: Legacy weapon. Unfortunately, there is more that must be done before it's complete.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Undiscovered Panel and speak to the Caretaker
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: But the Eldan are gone now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I get started?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Project: Legacy was established to create powerful weapons for use in the defense of the Nexus project.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Though the Eldan were unafraid of potential troublemakers, they did not wish for their research to be interrupted. Thus, a cadre of Eldan warriors was to be formed to defend the Nexus Project.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: So it would seem. The project now rests in your hands, though it remains to be seen just how capable - not to mention deserving - you are.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Project certification is required. Test components can be found throughout Nexus, but you must earn a 100% success rate to receive certification.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Of course. Many of my rogue subsystems guard encryption keys that you will find necessary, but they will not give them up without a struggle.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We cannot complete Project: Legacy without the appropriate data.

localizedTextIdText: Collect milk steaks by killing Galehorn roan in Crosswind Fields to imbue your item with greater power.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must collect Fresh Veggies in the Wildwood Grove of Deradune.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must gather Augmentor Core throughout Bio-Mech Facility AH47 in Ellevar.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must gather Bleakwing Plumage from Bleakwing ravenok near Copperworth Village in Ellevar.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must find and collect Vind Eggs around Woodhaven in Celestion.
An ancient enemy lurks deep within the Genetic Archives. Seek out Dreadphage Ohmna within the Archives and destroy it before time expires to prove you are one of the greatest heroes of Nexus.
Carry the Cassian Urn to the hilltop graveyard in Hycrest Hills to gain The Ghost of Lady Maxia blessing and imbue your item with power!
Insult the Hivestrike Protector in Hivestrike Grove before killing them to imbue your item with power!
Kill Colossal Gronyx{p:Colossal Gronyx} in Doomtide Village to imbue your item with greater power.
Pluck the Gleamrose in the Growling Forest of Galeras and kill the Roseguard to imbue your item with greater power
Gather the Wind Vortex Orb on top of the Gale Canyon in Galeras to imbue your item with greater power.
Activate all four Kel Voreth altars and open the chest inside the Kel Voreth Staging Ground. Imbue your item with ancient Osun power!
Taunt Moonstone orbitogs in Fatalis Fields in Farside and then kill them to imbue your item with greater power.
To imbue your item with greater power, incinerate the Pulsating Egg and kill any creatures that pop out of it in Southern Grimvault's Spineridge Nest.
To imbue your item with greater power, climb to the Eldan Infuser in Exo-Site N22 in Celestion.
Imbue your item with greater power by activating and defeating the Executor at the cliffs of the Sandstinger Wastes.

The Lightspire is under siege by Dreadwatcher and his Strain army! The Exiles need all the help they can get in order to turn the tide, and Commander Durek has ordered you to join the remaining forces at Hope's Dare. You'd better get moving, cupcake, 'cause there isn't much time left.\n \nThis quest can only be completed when the "Siege of the Lightspire" public event is active.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Commander Durek at Hope's Dare
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got trouble. I want all hands to make a push on Dreadwatcher and his army before they reach the Lightspire. You got that, recruit?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dreadwatcher and his army are gonna take the Lightspire if you don't get with the program. Move out and bust some heads before I bust yers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya turned Dreadwatcher back, but this ain't over yet. We still got a long road ahead of us, and it's gonna get worse before it gets better.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Fall in, trooper! And if you're gonna die, do it standin' up!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sure enough, this is a category twelve shale storm.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Due to your efforts, Dreadwatcher and his Strain army have been unable to reach the Lightspire. All that remains now is to venture to the Lightspire yourself and search for the truth behind the Strain and its relationship to Drusera.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How can they reach the Lightspire?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The XAS is tellin' me the Strain's absorbin' everything they can get their slimy tentacles on. They're usin' all that stuff to build a bridge of corrupt flesh 'n' bone over the exanite. Pretty disgustin' if ya ask me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya wanna live forever? 'Cause with an attitude like that, ya ain't gonna.

localizedTextIdText: The Strain in Havoc's Threshold is building an organic bridge made from the flesh and bone of living Exiles. The bridge will carry the Strain over the sea of exanite surrounding the Lightspire, and allow them to attack! Ashella Sunfell has asked you to rescue vulnerable Exiles before they can be absorbed into the Strain's bridge.\n \nThis quest can only be completed when the "Siege of the Lightspire" public event is active.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashella Sunfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many Exile troopers are in Havoc's Threshold - they need help! Save them before they're made into bricks for the Strain's bridge to the Lightspire!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our crisis crews need to be saved, and you're their only hope. If you don't help them, the Strain will absorb them into that horrible bridge!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A big batch of Exiles have returned to camp and they're all talking about how you saved them! Good job, $(player.name)! I knew you could do it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you see any Dominion soldiers, well... show them what mercy you can.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Once we get them patched up, they can return to the fight.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into Havoc's Threshold and rescued several members of the Exile crisis crew from being absorbed by the Strain. Ashella Sunfell is thrilled with your success, but no one is more thrilled than the men and women you saved from a fate worse than death.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You haven't heard about the bridge? The Strain's trying to reach the Lightspire, but the sea of exanite around it repels them.  So now the Strain are building a bridge made of organic matter to cross over! Apparently, it really likes using people for this. Gross, huh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You've got to be kidding me! The entire planet's at stake!

localizedTextIdText: The Dread Traverse swarms with Strain creatures, and Lulu Blackbush has asked you to do your best to kill as many of them as you can. Look for the monsters throughout the Dread Traverse - in Havoc's Threshold, the Cradle of Archfiends, Black Ultimatum, and the Dreadwatcher's Helm.\n \nThis quest can only be completed when the "Siege of the Lightspire" public event is active.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dread Traverse is swarmin' with Strain weirdoes and their gooey doohickeys. Are you willin' to get in there and mix it up with 'em?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You ain't made a dent in the Strain out in the Dread Traverse yet, have you? Better pick up the pace or our troops are goin' to feel the pinch!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'll be a pink rowsdower dipped in butter! You did it! If it weren't for all the crap the XAS has me doin', I might just join up with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do your best to kill as many of those freaks as you can, alright?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You definitely paved a road for the folks that needed it most. Thanks!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll kill the Strain for you.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'd be happy to have you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You waded into a seemingly endless ocean of Strain creatures in the Dread Traverse and killed as many as you could. Lulu Blackbush is so impressed with your work that she would probably join up with you if she didn't already have so much to do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: When did you get so bloodthirsty, Lulu?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm an Exile, friend. That means I know when someone needs a good old-fashioned ass-whoopin'. If the Strain don't get theirs soon, this whole planet's goin' belly-up and there won't be nothin' left to research. Plus - statistically - if we don't win this thing, we'll all be toast.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? You ain't willin' to do the killin'? That's real funny, "friend."

localizedTextIdText: The Lightspire is under siege by Dreadwatcher and his Strain army! The Dominion needs all the help it can get in order to turn the tide, and Kezrek Warbringer has ordered you to join his remaining forces at Final Light. You'd better get moving - there isn't much time left.\n \nThis quest can only be completed when the "Siege of the Lightspire" public event is active.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kezrek Warbringer in Final Light
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreadwatcher and his Strain army are advancing on the Lightspire. I command all Dominion troops to rally and crush Dreadwatcher's attack!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Dreadwatcher and his army are sure to take the Lightspire without our intervention. Revel in the carnage! This will be a bloodbath to remember!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have achieved a bloody victory for the Dominion! The malignant power of the Strain is no match for our legions!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This may just be the battle we've been waiting for! For the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Dreadwatcher has been destroyed, but this conflict is far from over.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Due to your efforts, Dreadwatcher and his Strain army have been unable to reach the Lightspire. All that remains now is to venture to the Lightspire yourself and search for the truth behind the Strain and its relationship to Drusera.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How can they reach the Lightspire?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Collegium reports indicate the Strain is absorbing as much organic matter - living or dead - as it can in order to build a bridge of flesh and bone over the exanite walls.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will die by my hand for this treachery, worm!

localizedTextIdText: The Strain in Havoc's Threshold is building an organic bridge made from the flesh and bone of living soldiers. The bridge will carry the Strain over the sea of exanite surrounding the Lightspire, and allow them to attack! Nerissa Artan has asked you to rescue vulnerable Dominion striketeam soldiers before they can be absorbed into the Strain's bridge.\n \nThis quest can only be completed when the "Siege of the Lightspire" public event is active.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our striketeam soldiers are sure to be transformed into grisly bricks for the Strain's bridge. Save them, then enlist their aid in saving others.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Saving our striketeams is a crucial objective. Your indolence may very well cost us the war - as well as your own, slothful life. Now go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Members of the Dominion striketeams are returning to base, and your name is on their lips. As always, you have performed admirably.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take note - Exile victims will need to be put out of their misery, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our medics will see to the wounded now. I shall speak with you later.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll save as many as I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ventured into Havoc's Threshold and rescued several members of the Dominion striketeam from being absorbed by the Strain. Nerissa Artan is thrilled with your success, but no one is more thrilled than the men and women you saved from a fate worse than death.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Late to the party, I see. The Dreadwatcher's forces are attempting to reach the Lightspire, but the sea of exanite repels the Strain. It is absorbing any organic matter it can find, especially humanoids, and using them build a bridge to the tower.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is not some small skirmish, $(player.name)! We fight for Nexus, itself!

localizedTextIdText: The Dread Traverse swarms with Strain creatures, and Ringo Hax has asked you to do your best to kill as many of them as you can. Look for the monsters throughout the Dread Traverse - in Havoc's Threshold, the Cradle of Archfiends, Black Ultimatum, and the Dreadwatcher's Helm.\n \nThis quest can only be completed when the "Siege of the Lightspire" public event is active.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many many Strain monsters in Dread Traverse, prevent our soldiers from advancing. Inefficient! You go, kill Strain beasties, pave road with corpses.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Soldiers still stalled in Dread Traverse. Not enough monsters killed yet. Is $(player.name) losing $h touch? Hurry hurry before I tell the Zax!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Strain monsters dead, all dead. Maybe some live, but most taking long dirt nap. Job done! If I not so busy, would join up with you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. Too much stress and worry already. Do not need more.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Actually, no. Joining you much too dangerous. Working for the Zax safer!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Really? You'd join up with me?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You waded into a seemingly endless ocean of Strain creatures in the Dread Traverse and killed as many as you could. Ringo Hax is so impressed with your work that he would probably join up with you if he didn't already work for Mondo Zax.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Since when are you a strategist?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: $(player.name) so insulting! Chua are best at strategy! Like science, strategy involves death. Also involves explosions. Otherwise, not so similar. Understand?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Good! War not scramble your brains. Yet. Give time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bah! Killing important element of science, you know!
