In order to get to know the Exile capital city, Thayd, you should find all the Thayd Tours Holoprojectors and listen to what they have to say about the important amenities available to you. Kit Brinny would love to guide you herself, but she is stuck doing cleaning duty for running her mouth again.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kit Brinny via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Thayd can be a big, confusin' place, and a holo-guide would be just the thing to get you acquainted. There are tour projectors all over. Go check 'em out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well whatcha waitin' for? Go check out those tour holoprojectors. Don't ya wanna know about all the amenities in Thayd?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks like you are done with your tour. What did you think of Thayd? Not half bad, huh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd guide ya 'round myself, but I got cleanin' duty for runnin' my mouth off again.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope you'll put those amenities to good use in the future. Don't forget about them, now.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the tour of Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Thayd has a lot to offer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to compete the tour of the Exile capital city, Thayd, even without Kit Brinny's help.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take the tour of Thayd.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if you feel you don't need any help...

localizedTextIdText: In order to get to know the Dominion capital city better, Illium, you should find all the Illium Tours Holoprojectors and listen to what they have to say about the important amenities available to you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Malvolio Portius via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have been tasked to guide you through our illustrious capital city here on Nexus. But I feel a holo guide should do just fine. There are tour projectors all over.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you speaking to me again for? Go find those tour holoprojectors. They can tell you all you need to know about the amenities in Illium.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see you have finished your tour of our fine capital city. I hope you can remember the amenities that were shown to you. I shan't be doing this again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I don't see why I should do it myself. I am far too busy and important for such a task.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Illium is rather impressive, though not as impressive as our cities on Cassus.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the tour of Illium.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Illium has a lot to offer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to compete the tour of the Dominion capital city, Illium, even without Malvolio Portius's help.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll take the tour of Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if you don't want to...

localizedTextIdText: Kill Stormtalon in Stormtalon's Lair.

The Grimvoid Marauders appear to be drawing power from the strange headgear they're wearing. The SCS-003 Deviser has ordered you to proceed to the Grimvoid Workshop and remove the Marauders' neuro-enhancement hats. This should weaken them and make them vulnerable to your lethal attacks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoid Marauders are drawing power from their headgear. To destroy the Marauders, you must first remove their hats. Do you understand?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Grimvoid Marauders must be weakened before they can be destroyed. To weaken them, use the hat whip to remove their neuro-enhancement hats.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So long as they wear those dastardly hats, the Grimvoid Marauders pose a significant threat. Remove the hats and kill the vermin. It isn't difficult.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Grimvoid Marauders won't last long with you around, $(player.name). Hats off to you for a job well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Caretaker will reward your assistance in this matter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, admit it. That was funny, wasn't it?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Is that some kind of joke?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The SCS-003 Deviser ordered you to remove the neuro-enhancement hats from Grimvoid Marauders in the vicinity of the Grimvoid Workshop. Doing so made the pirates vulnerable, allowing you to kill a good number of them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Response inadequate. Reconsider or you may face liquidation.

localizedTextIdText: SCS-001 Sustainer would like to analyze the purity of aquaplasm (otherwise referred to as primal water) collected from the Ikthian vents at Purewater Station.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to $~(creature=58369) via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Assistance required. Caretaker requests aquaplasm samples for purity assessment. Obtain samples from vents at Purewater Station. Affirmative?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Aquaplasm samples still required by Caretaker for analysis. Large quantities of aquaplasm present in vents at Purewater Station. Proceed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: A comprehensive analysis of the Ikthians' "aquaplasm" is vital for my studies. I had hoped you might have gathered the samples by now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The aquaplasm samples you collected will allow me to closely monitor the Ikthian invaders' progress. You have done a smashing job.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Positive response. Proceed to coordinates and collect aquaplasm samples.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am certain we will meet again, sapient.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered aquaplasm from Ikthian vents in Purewater Station so that $~(creature=58369) can analyze their purity levels.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Query received. Aquaplasm is defined as Ikthian parlance for primal water. Query addressed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Error. Negative response not approved. Rephrase.

localizedTextIdText: You have been instructed to use a signal flare to deploy a Strain analysis device inside the Collapse in order to gather Strain contamination level readings for $~(creature=58369).
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to $~(creature=58369) via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Strain contamination levels in the Collapse are rising. Use flares to signal the Strain Analysis Device, then gather contamination level readings.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Strain Analysis Device has not yet provided sufficient Strain contamination level reports in the Collapse. Rectify this deficiency at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I must analyze Strain contamination levels within the Collapse, sapient. Please use the Strain Analysis Device to isolate the appropriate readings.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The readings you gathered using the Strain Analysis Device are adequate for my needs. The Strain is spreading at controllable levels.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Protect the SAD from hostile organisms at all costs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nonetheless, I must continue to monitor the Strain. Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to deploy and defend the Strain analysis device so that you could gather Strain contamination level readings in the Collapse for $~(creature=58369).
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Error. Negative response not approved. Rephrase.

localizedTextIdText: Many of Star-Comm Station's constructs in Security Sector Prime are being controlled by the Surveillance Avatar. As such, SCS-003 Deviser has instructed you to play a message for them that should place them under $~(creature=58369) authority.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to $~(creature=58369) via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Constructs in Security Sector Prime are loyal to the Surveillance Avatar. You will play this message to them to reset their loyalty subroutines.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Error. Loyalty of constructs in Security Sector Prime is still compromised. Play the provided message to them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The SCS constructs in Security Sector Prime continue to defy me. You had best return to your labors with enthusiasm or things could go very poorly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a rather fruitless endeavor. Back to the old drawing board, as they say. I shall start by making some modifications to my transmitter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Caretaker refuses to allow rogue constructs to undermine his authority.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps we can try this once more at a later time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The message from $~(creature=58369) failed to have a positive effect on the SCS constructs in Security Sector Prime, forcing you to deactivate them instead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Error. Negative response not approved. Rephrase.

localizedTextIdText: The augmented wildlife at Star-Comm Basin in Levian Bay are threatened by the Strain. The SCS-002 Abider has instructed you to proceed to The Collapse and inject the animals' food supplies with a vaccine. The vaccine should provide the creatures with a temporary boost in their resistance to the Strain.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain threatens the augmented wildlife in Star-Comm Basin. Injecting this vaccine into the animals' foodstuffs should fortify them against infection.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You have not yet dispensed the required amount of vaccine into the food supplies of Star-Comm Basin's wildlife. The chronometer decrements as we speak.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You still have some of the vaccine left. The measurement given to you was precise! You need to use every last drop on the modified foodstuffs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Though it will not cure the Strain, nor completely prevent it, the vaccine you administered should amplify the animals' resistance for a short time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We must protect our experiments from the Strain's influence.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Like as not, we'll have to administer more at a later date.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You applied a vaccine to the food supplies of Star-Comm Basin's augmented wildlife to help the animals resist the effects of the Strain. Time will tell if it works or not.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your survival is contingent on the survival of Levian Bay's wildlife.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker at the Auxiliary Control Hub has called upon you to defend Star-Comm Basin from invading forces.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to $~(creature=58369) via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Star-Comm Basin is under constant attack by Marauders, Ikthians, and the Strain. You must lend your strength to its defense.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Were you planning to defend Star-Comm Basin from our enemies? Or are you just going to stand there and watch the destruction unfold around you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Star-Comm Basin is secure for now. Of course, it's only a matter of time before those vermin try it again, and I'll be in need of you once more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please consider what may happen to me if you fail.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take care, sapient. I may need you again relatively soon.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully defended Star-Comm Basin from invading forces.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not very forward-thinking, are you? I should have expected that.

localizedTextIdText: To imbue this item with greater power, help kill enemy players in the Halls of the Bloodsworn battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, win a match in the Halls of the Bloodsworn battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, perform or assist secondary control point captures in the Halls of the Bloodsworn battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, help kill enemy players on top of primary control points in the Halls of the Bloodsworn battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, capture primary control points in the Halls of the Bloodsworn battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, help kill enemy players in the Walatiki Temple battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, win a match in the Walatiki Temple battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, steal Moodie Masks from the enemy team's totem in the Walatiki Temple battleground.

The Ikthians at Star-Comm Basin in Levian Bay have constructed incubators to breed their own kind at Purewater Station. The SCS-001 Sustainer has requested that you release beasts within the Ikthian incubators in order to destroy the Ikthian eggs.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Ikthian invaders in Star-Comm Basin have started their breeding process. You must unleash local beasts upon the Ikthian eggs to destroy them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Ikthian breeding process can be curtailed by unleashing beasts into their incubators. Their fragile eggs cannot withstand such abuse.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The secret to ending the Ikthian breeding program in Star-Comm Basin is destroying their eggs. Use the local fauna to do the hard work for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A commendable effort. Today's Ikthian roe is tomorrow's Ikthian soldier. With fewer soldiers, the Ikthians cannot keep us from our primary objective.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quickly. The longer they incubate, the more likely they are to hatch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Ikthians will replenish their eggs quickly. You will be needed again.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This should be a piece of cake.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Many Ikthian eggs were destroyed by the beasts you unleashed in Purewater Station. In addition, you killed several unfortunate Ikthians that happened to get in your way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mission declined. Processing... processing...

localizedTextIdText: To imbue this item with greater power, perform or assist Moodie Masks captures in the Walatiki Temple battleground.
To imbue this item with greater power, help kill Moodie Mask carriers in the Walatiki Temple battleground

Star-Comm Basin has become overrun with a variety of invaders. Each invading group's leader continues to foment unrest in the area, and the SCS-543 Arbiter has instructed you to find and eliminate each one of them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to SCS-543 Arbiter via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Analysis of Strain, Ikthian, and Marauder activity pinpoints leader locations. Arbiter suggests using teamwork to guarantee confirmed kills.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Not all specified targets have been neutralized. Proceed with team to indicated coordinates and deactivate enemy leaders.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Group leaders' vital signs display as nil. Deaths confirmed. Arbiter is recording results for posterity.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Utilize datachron to locate targets and destroy each with prejudice.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your task is complete. Please move along.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The SCS-543 Arbiter instructed you to hunt down and destroy the leaders of the hostile groups that have invaded Star-Comm Basin. You tracked each of them down and killed them with gusto. Perhaps now Levian Bay will be peaceful for a while.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Arbiter assumed $(player.name) was combat model. Is this incorrect?

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract building items for homes that will keep folks warm through the cold Whitevale winter. Bring $m(schematic=844) to Supervisor Arborgreen in Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=844) to Supervisor Arborgreen in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThermock Hold is taking in casualties from all over Nexus. Additional Medical Cot (Hovering){p:Medical Cots (Hovering)} are needed ASAP.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WORK ORDER:\nThermock Hold is taking in casualties from all over Nexus. Additional Medical Cot (Hovering){p:Medical Cots (Hovering)} are needed ASAP.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Look, $(player.name) I'm not asking for knick-knacks here. We need real equipment, and we need it fast!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm betting these cots will be full as soon as we set 'em up! We've had patients sleeping on the floor till now... not exactly recuperative.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We'll have 'em rested up and ready to fight again in no time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Supervisor Arborgreen has happily accepted the $m(schematic=844) you crafted.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract building items for homes. Do your part, and bring $m(schematic=895) to Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=895) to Quartermaster Hillary in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ORDER:\nSnapping Trap are in high demand in Whitevale, for game hunting and perimeter defense. Make all deliveries to the Quartermaster.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ORDER:\nSnapping Trap are in high demand in Whitevale, for game hunting and perimeter defense. Make all deliveries to the Quartermaster.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Some no good splorg-slime has been sneakin' around causin' trouble. Let's see how sneaky he is with a Snapping Trap clamped on his foot.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Old-fashioned traps like this are mighty useful. Leaves anything that gets caught in them in good shape for eatin'... or questionin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Folks'll feel a lot safer with these set up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee has happily accepted the $m(schematic=895) you crafted.

localizedTextIdText: You've learned from the Tactical Uplink that salvaged Eldan scraps can be used to rebuild Star-Comm Basin's damaged facilities. The Caretaker has linked to your datachron in order to help you detect areas of prime salvage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Tactical Uplink at the Auxiliary Control Hub
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Star-Comm Basin facilities are damaged. Request collection of Eldan salvage so that repairs can commence. Caretaker will assist user.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Star-Comm Basin facilities are damaged. Request collection of Eldan salvage so that repairs can commence. Caretaker will assist user.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Analyzing submitted salvage. Quality is acceptable. Infuser constructor is now active for a limited time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Awaiting delivery of salvage. Repeat... awaiting delivery of salvage.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Additional salvage will soon be required.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gathered enough Eldan salvage to establish an Infuser Constructor in Star-Comm Basin.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: User declination recorded. Awaiting new user.

localizedTextIdText: Several Ikthian jammers, placed above the Collapse, are preventing communications signals from getting through. In order for Star-Comm to continue broadcasting, the Tactical Uplink needs the Ikthian jammers shut down.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Tactical Uplink at the Auxiliary Control Hub
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ikthian jammers above the Collapse are preventing station broadcast. User must climb the Collapse and deactivate the jammers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ikthian jammers above the Collapse are preventing station broadcast. User must climb the Collapse and deactivate the jammers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ikthian jammer deactivation confirmed. Station broadcasts can now commence. Thank you for your cooperation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Proceed with caution. Risk level is high.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be warned, the Ikthians may attempt to reactivate jammers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You climbed the Collapse and deactivated the Ikthian jammers for the Tactical Uplink, allowing Star-Comm to broadcast without piscine interference.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: User declination recorded. Awaiting new user.

localizedTextIdText: To access the Caretaker's secret files, you must earn a Gold medal in Stormtalon's Lair,Ruins of Kel Voreth,Skullcano Island,and the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden on Prime difficulty. Once complete, use the Undiscovered Panel and speak to the Caretaker in the Datascape to gain your certification.
The Eldan support constructs that once maintained Star-Comm Basin are currently offline. The Tactical Uplink requires to activate these constructs so that the station will be maintained.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Tactical Uplink at the Auxiliary Control Hub
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Star-Comm Basin's Eldan support constructs are currently offline. User must locate construct bays and scan them to activate Eldan support constructs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Star-Comm Basin's Eldan support constructs are currently offline. User must locate construct bays and scan them to activate Eldan support constructs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Eldan support constructs now online. Overdue maintenance scheduled. Error. Wait list exceeds length of deadline.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Maintenance levels are at critical threshold. Please expedite.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Potential requirement for additional constructs has been noted.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You activated several Eldan support constructs which are now providing Star-Comm Basin with much needed repairs and maintenance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: User declination recorded. Awaiting new user.

localizedTextIdText: Star-Comm Basin is beset on all sides by enemies such as the Strain, the Grimvoid Marauders, the Ikthians, and hostile Eldan constructs. The Caretaker has instructed you to seek out and destroy these invaders throughout Star-Comm Basin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to $~(creature=58369) via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Signals from Star-Comm Station have attracted hostile organics. Ikthian, Eldan, Strain, and Marauder forces must be eliminated. Terminate them at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I see that Star-Comm Basin is still beset on all sides by enemy forces. Be a bloodthirsty little sapient and wipe them out, would you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. I have rarely seen an individual take such pleasure in the termination of other life forms. Aside from myself, that is.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't be afraid. I'm sure you'll pull through this in splendid condition.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will be in touch. Now go find something else to kill.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've defended Star-Comm Basin from a plethora of enemies, much to $~(creature=58369) delight. Good work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you shrink from such a simple task? You can kill, can't you?

localizedTextIdText: You're fast approaching the final stage of your quest to imbue the Eldan gauntlet. Tresayne Toria says you must go to the Genetic Archive and complete the Live at the Archive quest if you wish to see your trials come to an end. Once you imbue your gauntlet, return to Dead Explorer in Illium and report your victory.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Researcher Babbit in Illium at the mysterious site
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The end of your journey fast approaches. Return to the Genetic Archives, complete your final trial, and your gauntlet's imbuement will be completed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Why do you still tarry here? Your final trial awaits you in the Genetic Archives. Horrors unseen since the days of the Eldan await you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You back so soon? Without being finished? No no no! Must go back to wherever you were, imbue gauntlet. For you! For Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Eldan great scientists. Great engineers. $(player.name) imbued gauntlet for Dominion. And me. Ergo, you must be great, too! We be famous now!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There is no margin for error. You will either succeed... or you will die.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: $(player.name) not be stingy! I helped, slightly!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After much trial and toil, your Eldan gauntlet has been imbued! You can stand proud knowing that you are worthy of the honor it bestows upon you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Tell me about the Genetic Archives.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What happens once the gauntlet is imbued?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I know little of the place, save that the Eldan stored information regarding primal patterns within it. Now it is little more than a dark place filled with untold horrors.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: In such a case, the gauntlet will reveal its true power. Keep it safe and use it wisely against your enemies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is your task to complete. If you are too weak, then so be it.

localizedTextIdText: Avatus has damaged the files related to the mysterious Project: Legacy, which holds the secrets to unlocking your new weapon. Collect Encrypted Datashard from dangerous creatures in the Datascape and take them to $~(creature=58486) so he can reconstruct them.

The Caretaker says that Eldan-engineered beasts slumber in stasis beneath the sands of the Forgotten Arena near the border of Malgrave and Grimvault. When summoned by a worthy candidate, the beasts will define the final challenge to complete the Artifact Weapon Project.
To imbue this item with greater power, win a Warplot match.
To imbue this item with greater power, win two Warplot matches.
To imbue this item with greater power, win three Warplot matches.

You collected an ear from Project: Broon in the Fist of Azrion's Sick Bay. For what it's worth, it may be the last surviving piece of Broon. You should send it to Ringo Hax to see if he has a use for it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This ear is clearly deformed, having come from a Strain-riddled experiment - Project: Broon - aboard the Fist of Azrion. Maybe Ringo Hax can use it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Why you think I want Broon's ear? Is corrupted by Strain! Very dangerous! But maybe salvage experiment, learn to control corruption....
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: No! Give it! Must salvage Project: Broon if possible!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You provided Broon's ear to Ringo Hax. Though initially skeptical about its usefulness, Ringo was able to talk himself out of destroying the specimen.

localizedTextIdText: The Fist of Azrion may be flush with the Strain, but Ringo Hax wants you to flush them out! Seriously! He wants you to kill a lot of them!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Only dead Strain is a good Strain. No! Invert statement! Only good Strain is dead Strain! Make Strain good! So very good and dead!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't see any bodies. Are you really done? Make Strain on Fist of Azrion extinct!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Strain know they not welcome here. You showed them. Soon they learn to be extinct!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Take shovel and pitchfork! Passages small, corpses big!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll make them the best, Ringo.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Ringo Hax orders, you went on a rampage against the Strain aboard the Fist of Azrion. Though there are still a lot more of them than there are of you, they definitely know they're not welcome now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Planning own funeral? Yes?

localizedTextIdText: The Widowmaker may be flush with the Strain, but Lulu Blackbush wants you to flush them out! Seriously! She wants you to kill a lot of them!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We got the Strain comin' out of the woodwork, and I want you to kill 'em. The sooner, the better. We can't get nothin' done with them runnin' around.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Drop them Strain like a bad habit. Get movin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You're a right deadly hand, $(player.name). It's a good thing, too, else you might've been killed by one of them Strain creeps. I hate those things!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Pile them bodies up, but try not to get any of their goop on you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll kill as many as I can find.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Lulu Blackbush request, you went on a rampage against the Strain aboard the Widowmaker. Though there are still a lot more of them than there are of you, they definitely know they're not welcome now.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll kill as many as I can find.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't no time to go throwin' in the towel, friend.

localizedTextIdTitle: The Things That Should Not Be
localizedTextIdText: You've discovered non-Strain creatures in Department YYZ aboard the Fist of Azrion. Despite not being corrupted, these modified beasts still want to eat you alive. Agent Lex has ordered you to exterminate these creatures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Lex via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You may have noticed the presence of modified creatures in Department YYZ. Unfortunately, we cannot salvage these experiments. Put them down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have no time to reprogram the beasts stored within Department YYZ. I have ordered you to liquidate them. What hinders your progress?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your targets of opportunity have been neutralized. Fine work as always, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be thorough, but do not allow this to interfere with your primary objective.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Agent Lex orders, you destroyed many of the modified creatures in Department YYZ aboard the Fist of Azrion..
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Your security clearance is insufficient for a complete briefing. I will only say that these creatures are the result of DRED augmentation experiments.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: These are targets of opportunity... and we must strike now.

localizedTextIdTitle: The Things That Should Not Be
localizedTextIdText: You've discovered non-Strain creatures in Department 5150 aboard the Widowmaker. Despite not being corrupted, these modified beasts still want to eat you alive. Avra Darkos has ordered you to exterminate these creatures as they cannot be salvaged.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These creatures of science have run afoul of circumstance, and we have no further use for them. Their life's blood must be wrung free by your hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We have no control over these experiments. Rather than leave them to the Strain, they must be destroyed. To do otherwise would risk too much.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your reputation remains flawless, $(player.name). With those creatures destroyed, we can concentrate on more important targets.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not spend overlong on these objectives.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On Avra Darkoss orders, you destroyed many of the modified creatures in Department 5150 aboard the Widowmaker.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Your security clearance is insufficient for a complete briefing. I will inform you, however, that these creatures were created during XAS experiments involving Eldan augmentation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I take your refusal as a personal offense.

localizedTextIdText: Cryo pods fell from the Fist of Azrion during the crash, and are scattered across Cryomere. The occupants of these pods are being attacked by Strain-corrupted humanoids. Ringo Hax has ordered you to save Dominion citizens by killing these corrupted humans.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sealed cryo pods like canned goods to Strain. Corrupted humanoids kill many citizens in Cryomere. You kill corrupted humanoids, keep citizens safe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Save citizens in cryo pods from hungry Strain. Corrupted humanoids always hungry, always looking for snack. Force-feed them death!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: People in cryo pods safe from corrupted humanoids. Strain cannot corrupt or eat them now. You do very good deed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Is like cryo pod buffet line out there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Strain is like gift no one wants that keeps on giving.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You held the Strain-corrupted humanoids in Cryomere at bay, preventing them from preying on any Dominion citizens still trapped in their cryo pods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No loyalty to people. Disgusting.

localizedTextIdText: Cryo pods fell from the Widowmaker during the crash, and are scattered across Cryomere. The occupants of these pods are being attacked by Strain-corrupted humanoids. Lulu Blackbush has asked you to save the Exiles by destroying these corrupted humans.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A bunch of sealed cryo pods fell from the Widowmaker when we crashed and now the Strain's chompin' on them. You gotta help them folks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The more of them cryo pods get cracked open by the Strain, the fewer Exiles we'll have on our side when this thing's over and done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank the stars! I figured we'd lose a whole buncha Exiles to them corrupted critters. You saved a lot of lives, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember - they ain't Exiles no more.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Unfortunately, there ain't no obvious end to the killin'.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll keep those cryo pods safe.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You held the Strain-corrupted humanoids in Cryomere at bay, preventing them from preying on any Exiles still trapped in their cryo pods.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll keep those cryo pods safe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You gotta be jokin' with me. I hope you are, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Bio-Mech Facility Alpha is filled with augmented creatures, such as stemdragons, mammodin, hookfoots, and skeletal creatures. The Caretaker wants you to destroy these creatures, as they are out of control and preventing him from securing the facility.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This facility will not be secure until the augmented creatures within it have been neutralized. I believe you are capable of removing them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The augmented creatures I spoke of are rampaging throughout the facility and damaging important subsystems. Complete this task and I will be grateful.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The odds were not in your favor, but you were able to overcome the augmented beasts on my behalf. Your antics were amusing to observe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I do hope you concentrate on making your efforts entertaining.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm so glad you were entertained.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You hunted augmented creatures in Bio-Mech Facility Alpha, destroying many of them on behalf of the Caretaker. The facility is much closer to being safe and secure.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What kinds of augmented creatures are there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Quite a few, I'm afraid. I have observed rampaging stemdragons, mammodin, hookfoots, and skeletal creatures throughout this facility. Unfortunately, they are beyond my control.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Odd. Does your species normally lack initiative, or is it just you?

localizedTextIdText: Protostar is offering a reward to anyone who can kill Grimclaw at its lair in the Fiera Plains.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You notice a tattered, blood-stained Protostar uniform stuck between the teeth of Grimclaw's massive skull.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A giant, spectral girrok? That would explain some of the recent absenteeism... I suppose I can reward you with some of their back pay.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Maybe Protostar would be interested in this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager in Area 77 rewarded you for destroying Grimclaw. Good work!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Assistant Shipping and Receiving Manager

localizedTextIdText: Agent Lex contacted you and asked you to speak to Commando Sykill in the Brazen Bulwark.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Commando Sykill at the Brazen Bulwark
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have been informed that several situations in Silverwaste require readjustment. I need you to go to the Brazen Bulwark and even the odds for us.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Proceed to the Brazen Bulwark at once and speak to Commando Sykill. The situation there must be addressed at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My unit was overrun. I returned here to await assistance... I presume that would be you?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Speak with Commando Sykill when you arrive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must get moving. This situation is time-sensitive.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Commando Sykill at the Brazen Bulwark at the request of Agent Lex. He didn't look well.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll see to it, Agent Lex.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Understand, I will find some way to make you useful.

localizedTextIdText: Captain Caedis pushed forward with a detachment of commandos. They were overrun. Commando Sykill came back to get help, only to find there was no one to spare. Go to Captain Caediss last known location and see if you can aid Commando Sykill comrades.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Captain Caedis at Impelling Station
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was assigned to Caedis's Commandos. We were pushing forward, but those things were too numerous. The captain sent me to get help.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you find my detachment yet? Captain Caedis and the others were under heavy attack when I left. Their odds of survival are slim.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need help with these hostiles! Think you can take some pressure off us?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What an impressive rescue party! Bravo, Commando Sykill. You've outdone yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Very well. I have suffered damage and must recuperate, so I will remain here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Of course it is. But as you're here, we may as well get down to business.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find your unit and lend a hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You slew a number of Strain creatures and made contact with Captain Caedis.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What did Agent Lex send you to accomplish if not to help us?

localizedTextIdText: Captain Caedis has asked you to avenge the deaths of her fallen commandos within Silverwaste.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Caedis via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Many of my men were killed by scrab and gronyx as we moved through the Boiling Cauldron. You can't bring them back, but maybe you can avenge them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How many of those damnable scrab and gronyx have you killed? Kill one of them for every commando I lost today.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is difficult to maintain a tactical viewpoint when your personal feelings interfere. Still... those things had to be punished!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Scion of Justice demands vengeance.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It may not have been a strategic victory, but I thank you nonetheless.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: They won't be hurting anyone else.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You avenged the deaths of Captain Caediss commandos who'd been ambushed by gronyx and scrab in Silverwaste.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will see you punished for this.

localizedTextIdText: Avra Darkos contacted you and asked you to speak to Trooper Stan in Fort Gritty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Trooper Stan at the Fort Gritty
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The troopers at Fort Gritty are suffering terrible casualties. Proceed to the camp at once and lend them your assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you seen to Trooper Stan's request for reinforcements? He is in Fort Gritty.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stars, have you seen those things? My friends are in a heap of trouble! The Corporal sent me back here to find help. That why you're here?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A trooper identifying himself as "Stan" has been calling for help. Seek him out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You gotta get movin', friend! They won't last much longer!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Trooper Stan at Fort Gritty at Avra Darkoss request. He didn't look well.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm on my way there now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Very well. I shall have to make a note of this in your file.

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Hauser pushed forward with a detachment of troopers and they were overrun. Trooper Stan came back to get help, only to find there was no one to spare. Go to Corporal Hauser last known location and see if you can aid Trooper Stan comrades.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Corporal Hauser at Camp Quicken
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I was part of Corporal Hauser's detachment. He told me to cheese it back to camp and find help, but there's none here. Can you help us, stranger?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Did you link up with Corporal Hauser yet? I thought you said Avra Darkos sent you to help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We're in deep puddin' here, friend. Think you can lend us a hand with these damn bugs?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stan sent you, didn't he? I knew he'd make it, but I expected him to send back more than one $(player.race). Ah, well. You're better than nothin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm goin' to take care of these wounds. Good luck findin' the corporal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for helpin' what's left of my unit.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You slew a number of Strain creatures and made contact with Corporal Hauser.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll guess I'll patch up and head back out there myself then.

localizedTextIdText: Corporal Hauser has asked you to avenge the deaths of his fallen troopers within Silverwaste.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corporal Hauser via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lots of my men were killed by scrab and gronyx as we moved through the Boilin' Cauldron. You can't bring 'em back, but maybe you can avenge 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How many of those blasted scrab and gronyx have you taken care of? Kill one of 'em for every trooper I lost today.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's hard to be a good soldier if all you can see when you close your eyes are the faces of the men you lost.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even Commander Durek likes to get a little payback once in a while.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for givin' those men - and me - some revenge.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You avenged the deaths of Corporal Hauser troopers who'd been ambushed by gronyx and scrab in Silverwaste.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You got a lot of guts to turn me down.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Rapid Acquisitions Coordinator in Prosperity Junction has asked you to pick up a shipment from Deadrock Prison. Time is of the essence.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Rapid Acquisition Coordinator via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greeetings! I am looking to contract individuals for time-based deliveries. Care to make a "fast" buck?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you here? Without those license plates!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! We'll have those plates on those starships in no time!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent! I have an order of starship license plates that need to be picked up pronto! Take the teleporter to Palerock behind me and head to Deadrock Prison. Hurry!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Rapid Acquisition Coordinator is very pleased with your speedy delivery.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Rapid Acquisition Coordinator
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I should charge you for wasting my time!

localizedTextIdText: The Grimvoid Marauders appear to be drawing power from the strange headgear they're wearing. The SCS-003 Deviser has ordered you to proceed to the Grimvoid Workshop and remove the Marauders' neuro-enhancement hats. This should weaken them and make them vulnerable to your lethal attacks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Grimvoid Marauders are drawing power from their headgear. To destroy the Marauders, you must first remove their hats. Do you understand?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Grimvoid Marauders must be weakened before they can be destroyed. To weaken them, use the hat whip to remove their neuro-enhancement hats.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So long as they wear those dastardly hats, the Grimvoid Marauders pose a significant threat. Remove the hats and kill the vermin. It isn't difficult.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Grimvoid Marauders won't last long with you around, $(player.name). Hats off to you for a job well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Caretaker will reward your assistance in this matter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Oh, admit it. That was humorous, wasn't it?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Is that some kind of joke?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The SCS-003 Deviser ordered you to remove the neuro-enhancement hats from Grimvoid Marauders in the vicinity of the Grimvoid Workshop. Doing so made the pirates vulnerable, allowing you to kill a good number of them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Response inadequate. Reconsider or you may face liquidation.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Rapid Acquisitions Coordinator in Prosperity Junction has asked you to pick up a shipment from the Gas 'n' Guzzle. Time is of the essence.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Rapid Acquisition Coordinator via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Greeetings! I am looking to contract individuals for time-based deliveries. Care to make a "fast" buck?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you here? Without those beverages!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! We'll have those drinks served in no time!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good! Take the teleporter behind me and pick up an order of beverages from the Gas 'n' Guzzle!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Rapid Acquisition Coordinator is very pleased with your speedy delivery.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to the Rapid Acquisition Coordinator
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I should charge you for wasting my time!

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Thayd is calling on Exiles to aid the Aurin of Celestion. The posting mentioned speaking with Arwick Redleaf in Glenview's Bulwark.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Arwick Redleaf in Glenview's Bulwark
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do you have what it takes to aid the Aurin of Celestion? Head into the wild woods of Alizar and lend a hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you come all the way from Thayd? Good. We need as much help as we can get!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Meet with Arwick Redleaf in Woodhaven today!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get to work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You answered the summons to Celestion and spoke with Arwick Redleaf.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This offer won't remain forever!

localizedTextIdText: You have taken a job to perform a few tasks for the medical station in the XAS Forward Camp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Let the Medical Staff know that you are done
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There is a job posted looking for someone to make rounds around the area. Light travel and possible hostiles are mentioned.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The contract is waiting to be filled by you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's the job going?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We all appreciate the work and effort you put in for the medical station. Your time helped free up the med techs so they could save lives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The contract is now taken by you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The staff at the medical station were glad that you took up the slack in their workload.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The contract will remain open.

localizedTextIdText: Bio-Mech Facility Alpha is filled with augmented creatures, such as stemdragons, mammodin, hookfoots, and skeletal creatures. The Caretaker wants you to destroy these creatures, as they are out of control and preventing him from securing the facility.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This facility will not be secure until the augmented creatures within it have been neutralized. I believe you are capable of removing them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The augmented creatures I spoke of are rampaging throughout the facility and damaging important subsystems. Complete this task and I will be grateful.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The odds were not in your favor, but you were able to overcome the augmented beasts on my behalf. Your antics were amusing to observe.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I do hope you concentrate on making your efforts entertaining.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm so glad you were entertained.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You hunted augmented creatures in Bio-Mech Facility Alpha, destroying many of them on behalf of the Caretaker. The facility is much closer to being safe and secure.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What kinds of augmented creatures are there?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Quite a few, I'm afraid. I have observed rampaging stemdragons, mammodin, hookfoots, and skeletal creatures throughout this facility. Unfortunately, they are beyond my control.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Odd. Does your species normally lack initiative, or is it just you?

localizedTextIdText: You have taken a contract to collect data from the various life forms around Feralplains. Most of the subjects are expected to resist.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Upload the samples and contact Mondo Zax.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Board has a job listing to collect bio-metric data from the various life forms around Feralplains. Most, if not all, of the subjects listed will probably not give a sample willingly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The job is contracted to you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you here? Where are my data samples?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Were subjects fresh? Mondo Zax demands freshness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The job is now under contract to you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have completed a contract to collect samples from creatures in and around Feralplains in Deradune.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The job will remain available.

localizedTextIdText: You have accepted Fashion Designer Alexxa's job offer to collect girrok skins and spikehorde shells from the Larallen Lowlands.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Deliver the skins and shells to Alexxa's Assistant in the Larallen Lowlands
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm Alexxa, the fashion designer. You've heard of me, no doubt.  I'm here looking for the next "rugged-chic" design. Mind gathering some materials?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you forget? I need those materials before Fashion week in Illium!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You don't have Alexxa's materials? She'll be mad, you better get moving!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alexxa will be pleased with these materials. I didn't think they'd smell quite so bad. No wonder she made me collect them from you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew you'd be a darling! Now off with you, fashion waits for no one!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The fashion industry is more work than I thought.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The skins and shells you collected seems to have pleased Alexxa. She expects her new designs to be hitting the streets of Illium and Hycrest soon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I can't believe I wasted my time on you. I should have expected such treatment in this backwater.

localizedTextIdText: You've found an Eldan leadership talisman. Sera Melfield is incredibly excited, and has asked you to join her in the Datascape Entry Hall to see what mysteries this incredibly powerful item might reveal.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to the Caretaker in the Datascape Entry Hall
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This talisman is intricately detailed and appears as if it's designed to fit inside something else. Whatever it is, it looks both important and valuable.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Initializing...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Leadership talisman detected. Candidate found. Project: Legacy reactivated. Candidate $(player.name), please declare your weapon of choice.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Error... files unavailable. How strange. This has never happened before.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You ended up taking the Eldan leadership talisman you found to the Caretaker in the Datascape and revealed the existence of an ancient Eldan weapons project that was never completed.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered you a contract to build items for homes that will keep folks warm through the cold Whitevale winter. Do your part; bring furniture to Architect Kaspmara in Thermock Hold!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=923) to Architect Kaspmara in Thermock Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: There seems to be a market for Marauder Lamp Post in Whitevale. Make deliveries to Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: There seems to be a market for Marauder Lamp Post in Whitevale. Make deliveries to Thermock Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ours is not to reason why; ours is but to do and die. If someone wants a Marauder Lamp Post, we provide it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done well with a sub-optimal design. Your Marauder Lamp Post are an interesting combination of crude form and practical function.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not judge your fellows; their odd proclivities keep us in business.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Architect Kaspmara has happily accepted the $m(schematic=923) you crafted.

localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: At least I have closure. But now what do I do...

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission seeks craftspeople skilled in working with the new material resources available in this province. Do your part, and bring $m(schematic=844) to Craftmaster Tullio in Palerock Post!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=844) to Craftmaster Tullio in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nPalerock Post is taking in heavy casualties from the fighting in Whitevale. Additional Medical Cot (Hovering){p:Medical Cots (Hovering)} are required.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nPalerock Post is taking in heavy casualties from the fighting in Whitevale. Additional Medical Cot (Hovering){p:Medical Cots (Hovering)} are required.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our current task to provide Medical Cot (Hovering){p:Medical Cots (Hovering)} perfectly illustrates the Victory Commission's vital logistical importance. Now get to it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work. For our victory to be assured, only top-quality medical facilities will do. Your patriotism is appreciated.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The emperor shall hear of your feats, citizen!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tullio has happily accepted the $m(schematic=844) you crafted.

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion Victory Commission seeks craftspeople skilled in working with the new material resources available in this province. Bring $m(schematic=895) to Quartermaster Cirxi in Palerock Post!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=895) to Quartermaster Cirxi in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ORDER:\nCalling all architects! The Dominion Victory Commission requires delivery of Snapping Trap for the Whitevale colonization effort.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ORDER:\nCalling all architects! The Dominion Victory Commission requires delivery of Snapping Trap for the Whitevale colonization effort.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Procure Snapping Trap for the good of Palerock Post. We've a problem with unseemly snow jabbits nipping into the food stocks.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, good work, sentient. I hope to soon detect the screams of vermin being crushed in these brutish devices. I shall amplify my sensors accordingly.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You've done the emperor's work, citizen.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Quartermaster Cirxi has happily accepted the $m(schematic=895) you crafted.

localizedTextIdText: You have been offered a contract building items for homes that will keep citizens warm through the cold Whitevale winter. Do your part, and bring $m(schematic=923) to Architect Virin in Palerock Post!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take the $m(schematic=923) to Architect Virin in Palerock Post
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: There seems to be a market for Marauder Lamp Post in Whitevale. Make deliveries to Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: There seems to be a market for Marauder Lamp Post in Whitevale. Make deliveries to Palerock Post.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There's no accounting for highborn taste. But hey, if they want a Marauder Lamp Post, we'll make them a Marauder Lamp Post.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice job, mate. I'm sure these Marauder Lamp Post will be put to good use.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't ask too many questions. It's more peaceful that way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Architect Virin has happily accepted the $m(schematic=923) you crafted.

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker wants you to report to Research Camp Echo in Twilight Grove to speak with Victor Lazarin about what he has found there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Victor Lazarin in Research Camp Echo
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're gonna have to put the Everpool on hold, cappy. Somethin' bad is goin' on up North, and it's damn scary! Best get up there and check it out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get a move on, bucky. Doc's gonna need all the help he can get.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I anticipated you might arrive.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see you share my interest in the Strain. It is quite... intriguing. I am, naturally, preparing a series of tests. Your participation would be propitious.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lazarin took a team to Twilight Grove. Ya can check in with him there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nothing but the insuperably spreading destruction of Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Victor Lazarin in Research Camp Echo to discuss the spread of a monstrous affliction he calls "the Strain".
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What the heck was that thing?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Bein' an explorer, I've seen my share of the strange and unusual. But that... that was the stuff of nightmares, kid.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You gotta be kiddin' me, scooter.

localizedTextIdText: The creatures of the Datascape hide their secrets well. To discover their hidden files, you must complete the challenges Timed Out, Avatus's Password, Blue Skies, and Defy Corruption, and then activate the Undiscovered Panel in the Datascape to imbue your weapon.

Each of the Elemental Pairs has its own secrets, and you must master them all if you are to delve further into the secrets of the Datascape and the Eldan weapons project. Complete the challenges Deep Impact, The Floor Is Lava, Cloud Computing, Whiteout, Heat Transfer, Escaping the Crystalline, Annihilation Averted, Fire Dancer, and Combinatorial Genomics, and then activate the Undiscovered Panel and speak to the Caretaker.

You've gathered all the necessary data. Now only one challenge remains, and that is to defeat Avatus with perfect precision. Only then can you claim the $(vitem=1053) that will unlock all the knowledge held in the Datascape.
Supervisor Wicksprout wants to teach you about crafting vouchers, the currency earned from work orders. Find her in Thayd, and she'll get you started with some vouchers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Supervisor Wicksprout in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have you been doing lots and lots of work orders? If so, you're probably curious about crafting vouchers. If not, I'll explain why they're so important!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ok, I'm going to give you a few vouchers, so you'll have something to spend. Don't get used to this! Ordinarily, vouchers are a reward for hard work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Come see me in Thayd! It'll be worth your while.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Hmm, maybe becoming a crafter in the first place counts as hard work?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Supervisor Wicksprout gave you some promotional crafting vouchers. Now it's time to meet the vendors who stock the relevant goods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aww, but I miss you!

localizedTextIdText: According to the Caretaker, the Forgotten Arena, on the border of Grimvault and Malgrave was created to host Project: Legacy's final challenge. He suggests you venture to the Arena and meet with your destiny, for good or for ill.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Researcher Babbit in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A remote node in Grimvault is broadcasting from the Forgotten Arena, where Project: Legacy's final challenge was to take place. You should investigate.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: According to my files, the Forgotten Arena is a foreboding place. How fitting that Project: Legacy's final challenge should take place there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: So? What happen? Tell tell! Been waiting and waiting and waiting! Patience pushed to limit!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Cozmotronic! You did it. Chosen by Eldan algorithm for special purpose. You are now protector of Dominion. I tell all my friends!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It will not be easy, and you shall likely die. I wish you luck nevertheless.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: When you rich, do not forget me. I not forget you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go check this arena out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm pretty good at this stuff.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the Forgotten Arena and successfully completed Project: Legacy's final challenge.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Sounds like such a nice place.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: According to Project: Legacy's data files, the Forgotten Arena was designed to host the project's final challenge. Candidates must face this challenge and survive.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That data is unavailable. Apparently, the challenge documentation was stored offline. How strange.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You shall earn your rightful place as an equal to the Eldan defenders that should have come before you. Of course, you aren't one of the Eldan, so such an event will be unprecedented.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your reluctance reveals a vast dearth of intellect on your part.

localizedTextIdText: Project: Legacy was designed to seek out potential leadership candidates among the races of the galaxy, and it seems it was successful. Greet your fans in Illium, and activate the Holostatue Control Panel to preserve your legacy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Activate the Holostatue Control Panel
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lady Zin has been spreading the word. Very knowledgeable about Eldan Artifacts! You may be big celebrity now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Holostatue Control Panel is ready to be activated, commemorating your accomplishment for all time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Best not keep your fans waiting!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Artemis Zin spread word of your achievements, and your name and likeness were preserved holographically, to be passed down to future generations.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin wants you to report to Rotwood Collective in Twilight Grove to speak with Mondo Zax about what he has found there.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Mondo Zax in Rotwood Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We'll have to put the Everpool on hold. Something big's happening up north, and I want the scoop! Be a love and look into it for me, will you?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Get a move on, love. I have a feeling even Mondo's going to need help with this one.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Good good! You here in one piece!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah! Another test subj... er, assistant for Strain study! Dangerous stuff, very interesting. Unlike anything ever seen. Lots of tests needed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Mondo Zax took a team to Twilight Grove. You might start there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe only end of life on Nexus? Truth of theory awaits to be seen!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Mondo Zax in Rotwood Collective to discuss the spread of a monstrous affliction he calls "the Strain".
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What the heck was that thing?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Being the famous explorer that I am, I've seen my share of the strange and unusual. But that... that was quite terrifying.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're joking, right?

localizedTextIdText: The Bounty Board in Outpost Dawn lists a message from Toric Antevian. He requests that all Dominion citizens aid the Gold Legion in the fight against the Osun of Kel Voreth. Locate Toric Antevian inside the Ruins of Kel Voreth for more information.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Locate Toric Antevian inside the Ruins of Kel Voreth
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CALL TO ACTION:\nThe Osun of Kel Voreth are attempting to reclaim the ruins of their ancient fortress. This cannot happen. Join me in the fight against the Osun.\n - Toric Antevian
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CALL TO ACTION:\nThe Osun of Kel Voreth are attempting to reclaim the ruins of their ancient fortress. This cannot happen. Join me in the fight against the Osun.\n - Toric Antevian
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have answered the call to do battle with the Osun of Kel Voreth. Are you ready?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stand strong and be vigilant, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You located Toric Antevian hologram inside the Ruins of Kel Voreth. He is leading the charge against the Osun of Kel Voreth.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Locate Toric Antevian inside the Ruins of Kel Voreth

localizedTextIdText: Depot Agent Sakiro wants you to find to him at Devastation Ridge to help him with a matter involving missing Freebots and out-of-control elementals.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Depot Agent Sakiro in Devastation Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello! Can you hear me? I got a situation that's gotten out of hand, yep. Sure could use a hand here, don't you know.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank my stars, you arrived just in time! My Freebot crew's missing and the elementals are outta control, darn tootin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Blessed Navigator! That's great news! I'll see you when you get here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Depot Agent Sakiro camp to be quite sparse, as most of his Freebot mining crew is either missing or has been destroyed by the rampant elementals in the region.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well that's a shame. If your course changes come back this way won't you?

localizedTextIdTitle: Vouchers: What Are They Good For?
localizedTextIdText: Supervisor Wicksprout has given you some crafting vouchers to purchase a Resource Wrangler 1000 from Brigade Researcher Seagarden in Thayd. Ordinarily, you might save vouchers for valuable items related to master crafting, but Supervisor Wicksprout is insistent that you buy something small.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Supervisor Wicksprout in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Vouchers can buy materials, or you can save up for recipes! Seagarden offers promotional Resource Wrangler 1000 for first time customers, so just buy one of those for now.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't worry about wasting your vouchers! Just this one time, it's about meeting people and learning stuff. You trust me, don't you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hee hee! Maybe now, you understand the real point of this little exercise! Did you see all the shiny stuff he had to offer? Start saving now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't worry, you'll have plenty of vouchers later if you work hard!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here's a little to get you started. See, you came out ahead in the end!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Brigade Researcher Seagarden in Thayd, and bought a limited edition Resource Wrangler 1000 from him. His shop was filled with impressive wares that require crafting vouchers to purchase, so perhaps it's time to start doing work orders and saving up.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why not save the vouchers, then?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Fine, I'll buy the Resource Wrangler 1000.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Vouchers can buy bags that give you crafting materials... or if you're smart, you can save 'em up for fancy recipes.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, I'm just  having you do that so you get to meet ol' Seagarden, and take a look at the good stuff that's waiting for you once you've mastered your craft.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Also, it's impolite to pester a merchant if you have absolutely no intention of buying anything!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: That's the spirit!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: There's frugal, and then there's just rude!

localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't question me. Do as I say.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope one day you will make use of what you've learned today.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Researcher Dunfield in Farside
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do you have what it takes to aid the Exile Cause in Farside? Take a ship out there and lend a hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you come all the way from Thayd? Good. We need as much help as we can get!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Meet with Researcher Dunfield in Spaceport Horizon today!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get to work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You answered the summons to Farside and spoke with Researcher Dunfield.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This offer won't remain forever!

localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We need more Exiles like you out in Wilderrun!

localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get to work!

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek in Grimvault
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do you have what it takes to aid the Exile cause in Grimvault? We need you to lend a hand!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Did you come all the way from Thayd? Good. We need as much help as we can get!
