localizedTextIdText: Depot Agent Sakiro wants you to deliver a shipment of his crimson ore to Ringo Hax in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Ringo Hax in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I found a buyer for this crimson ore, don't you know? I'd appreciate a bit of help if you've got the time. I'll pay you, too, darn tootin'.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't keep 'em waiting too long. Gotta keep my reputation as a sure salesman, I sure do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You bring crimson ore? About time! Had to wait and wait and wait for ore. Now... science happens! Will learn if ore is good for weapons or not!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's a relief, you betcha!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the shipment to Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Ringo Hax was delighted to receive the shipment and already seems to be planning nefarious uses the crimson ore.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw shucks, guess you got other plans.

localizedTextIdText: Depot Agent Sakiro wants you to deliver a shipment of his crimson ore to Lulu Blackbush in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lulu Blackbush in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I found a buyer for this crimson ore, don't you know? I'd appreciate a bit of help if you've got the time. I'll pay you, too, darn tootin'.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't keep 'em waiting too long. Gotta keep my reputation as a sure salesman, I sure do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice! I been waitin' for these ore samples. Reckon with some analysis, we can put these to some good use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's a relief, you betcha!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the shipment to Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Lulu Blackbush was delighted to receive the shipment of crimson ore you brought from Depot Agent Sakiro in Wilderrun, and she's already planning some serious research experiments for the strange material.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw shucks, guess you got other plans.

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela wants to teach you about crafting vouchers, the currency earned from work orders. Find her in Illium, and she'll get you started with some vouchers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Have you been keeping up with your work orders? If so, it's time for you to learn about crafting vouchers.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ok, I'm going to give you a few vouchers, so you don't embarrass me. Don't get used to it. Ordinarily, vouchers are a reward for real work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Visit me in Illium to begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Anyway, let's proceed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela gave you some promotional crafting vouchers. Now it's time to meet the vendors who stock the relevant goods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Yet another disappointment.

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Illium calls on Dominion citizens to aid the Zax's efforts in Blighthaven. If interested, you should proceed to Titian Collective at once and report to Mondo Zax.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Mondo Zax at Titian Collective
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: FOR SCIENCE!\nThe Zax requests an able lab assistant in Blighthaven. To apply, proceed to Titian Collective at once and report for duty.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: FOR SCIENCE!\nThe Zax requests an able lab assistant in Blighthaven. To apply, proceed to Titian Collective at once and report for duty.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes yes. Mondo remembers $(player.name). How could Mondo forget? You most durable assistant ever!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Such adventures Mondo has in store for you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Titian Collective in Blighthaven and offered your services to Mondo Zax.

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Thayd calls on Exiles to aid Victor Lazarin efforts in Blighthaven. If interested, you should proceed to Aurelian Enclave at once and report to Victor Lazarin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Victor Lazarin at Aurelian Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ASSISTANCE APPRECIATED\nDoctor Lazarin requests an able lab assistant in Blighthaven. To apply, proceed to Aurellian Enclave and report for duty.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ASSISTANCE APPRECIATED\nDoctor Lazarin requests an able lab assistant in Blighthaven. To apply, proceed to Aurellian Enclave and report for duty.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Were I capable of expressing exuberance, I would certainly smile at seeing you again. We have worked well together in the past - that must be enough.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let us seek solace in science.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Aurelian Enclave in Blighthaven and offered your services to Victor Lazarin.

localizedTextIdText: Chancellor Juro Takigurian has sent you to Auroria to retrieve the next pattern. Use the Eldan Transformer to transform yourself so you can collect the pieces of the primal pattern.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to collect all the partial primal pattern pieces by buzzing around the skies of Auroria.

localizedTextIdText: You have agreed to help the Public Works Supervisor in Thayd clear out various vermin from the Public Works Tunnels.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Let the Public Works Supervisor in Thayd know that you have helped clear out the Public Works Tunnels
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You looking for work? I've got a job that always needs to be done: extermination. You interested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How goes the extermination?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job. Tomorrow there will be more. There always is. Come back then and I can hire you again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great! Head down into the Thayd Tunnels using the hatch over there.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped put a dent into the vermin population in the Thayd Public Works Tunnels.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You heard it right. The critters down in the Works get so thick you can barely walk.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You know, slank and other dirty, scuttling, things.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you change your mind, come on back to see me.

localizedTextIdText: You defeated Elyona the Mad in the Genesis Chamber at the center of the Nursery and have collected her heart. Contact Drusera to tell her of your gruesome success!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You hold in your hands the heart of Elyona the Mad. The organ steams and seethes with untold corruption. Perhaps Drusera will know what to do with it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Is that Elyona's heart? I didn't... didn't expect you would... oh, my. It's probably better to leave it there for the time being.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You really should go and wash your hands now. Really.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Elyona the Mad in the Genesis Chamber at the heart of the Nursery and collected her heart. Drusera was pleased, albeit mortified, with your gruesome success...

localizedTextIdText: The Public Works Supervisor in Illium has asked you to reset the power system under Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Public Works Supervisor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You look able-bodied. I have a task for which you would be perfect. I trust you understand basic power engineering?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I know you have not finished your task. When do you expect to be done?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The surges will probably trip the shunts again soon. Please be available tomorrow to reset them.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent. Efficiency is what sets the Dominion above all others.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have reset the power system under<text Link="Location:45292">Illium</text.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do I have to do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We have tapped into Eldan power conduits under Illium to supplement our power needs. The system needs to be reset.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Our technicians are still diagnosing the issue. Suffice it to say, between power surges and the Eldan Constructs, the system is less than stable.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Yes. No matter how often we destroy them, they come back. Please be careful down there. I hate writing fatality reports.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am sure you will reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: The first primal pattern is being guarded by Guardian Pyralos in Kel Ulgar in Wilderrun. Defeat Guardian Pyralos and collect the primal pattern it holds.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Guardian Pyralos and collected the first Eldan primal pattern you needed. Drusera warns you it will be a long and difficult task to collect all the pieces you need to assemble a new Genesis Key.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Rhoda Wellspring sent you to Galeras to retrieve the next pattern. Use the Eldan Transformer to transform yourself so you can collect the pieces of the primal pattern.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to collect all the partial primal pattern pieces by flying around the skies of Galeras.

localizedTextIdText: You obtained the first primal pattern! However, the XAS will need time to study the pattern and figure out where to look for the next one. In the meantime, Professor Rhoda Wellspring suggested you gain Beloved reputation status with the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You attained Beloved reputation status with the Exiles and spoke with Research Assistant Bertha regarding the location of the next primal pattern.

localizedTextIdText: While the XAS studies the primal pattern you obtained from the Dominion arkship, Professor Rhoda Wellspring suggests you further your combat training. Earn a Silver medal or higher on Veteran difficulty in the Northern Wilds, Galeras, Whitevale, and Malgrave adventures.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed your adventure training and are ready for anything. Bring it!

localizedTextIdText: Buy an Eldan Primal Reconstructor from Merchant Viktosak in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You purchased an Eldan Primal Reconstructor from Merchant Viktosak in Thayd.

localizedTextIdText: You traveled to Farside on a mission to capture the next primal pattern. With the Caretaker acting as your guide, it appears you will have to fight through waves of Eldan constructs in order to disable the generators that prevent you from accessing the primal pattern.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via your datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An elaborate security system guards the primal pattern. You will have to fight through Eldan constructs and disable several generators to acquire it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The primal pattern is well guarded by Eldan defenses. You will have to fight through Eldan constructs and disable several generators if you wish to succeed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah good, you eliminated the first of the three generators. Now there should be only two left, generators Epsilon and Zeta.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Luckily, the military has seen fit to provide you with a war mech.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm ready for the next step.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed the Caretaker's directions and successfully shut down Stealth Generator Delta. There are now two more generators remaining: Stealth Generator Epsilon and Stealth Generator Zeta.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How did you end up helping us?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A simple matter, really. Your scientists activated a local node containing a copy of me, then Drusera managed the rest. In my current state, I am able to access system data regarding the Eldan defense system guarding the primal pattern on Farside, but, alas, I lack the permissions to shut them down remotely.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Drusera reprogrammed me to assist you in this task, and yet now you walk away. I will never understand sapiens.

localizedTextIdText: You obtained the first primal pattern! However, the Royal Collegium will need time to study the pattern and figure out where to look for the next one. In the meantime, Chancellor Juro Takigurian suggested you gain Beloved reputation status with the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You attained Beloved reputation status with the Dominion and spoke with Executive Assistant Kunio regarding the location of the next primal pattern.

localizedTextIdText: In order to continue with re-attunement of the Genesis Key, you must defeat Dreadphage Ohmna in the Genetic Archives raid.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Dreadphage Ohmna! You are now ready to proceed with re-attunement of the Genesis Key.

localizedTextIdText: In order to complete the last step of re-attunement for the Genesis Key and open the way to the Datascape, you must collect Partial Primal Patterns from Prime dungeons, Veteran adventures, and the Genetic Archives or purchase them from the Elder Gem vendor located in your faction's capital city.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected all the Partial Primal Patterns needed to complete re-attunement of the Genesis Key. The way to the Datascape is now open to you!

localizedTextIdText: It's time to make your way into the Datascape! Make your way to Grimvault and speak with the Caretaker.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with the Caretaker. The path into Datascape is now open to you.

localizedTextIdText: The XAS located another primal pattern. This time it's in a dangerous location in Farside. However, $~(creature=59930) has agreed to assist you in this mission. Travel to Farside and wait for his instructions.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the Exile war mech, you were able to overcome the Eldan defenses and retrieve the primal pattern.

localizedTextIdText: You've moved on to the next generator as part of your mission to retrieve the primal pattern on Farside. The Caretaker recommends you keep your EMP charged, as it will be useful for completing your mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: For this next part, simply continue with your efforts to disable the generators. Do not forget to charge your EMP blasts - they're crucial to your success.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You will have to destroy Stealth Generator Epsilon, in order to proceed with the mission.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work! You now only have one more generator to go before the primal pattern is yours.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm ready for the last step.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed the second Eldan stealth generator Epsilon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I cannot fathom why you would abandon your mission halfway through. Are all sapients as illogical as you?

localizedTextIdText: You are now faced with the final defenses between you and the primal pattern. The Caretaker has advised that you use your EMP blasts to disable the disruptor pods in the area in order to make your way to the final generator.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: In this final mission, you will need to use your EMP to disable the disruptor pods scattered in the area, before you EMP blast the last generator.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must use EMP to deal with the disruptor pods in the area. Only then will you be able to disable the final generator.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Splendid! I'm certain everyone will be pleased that you've acquired another primal pattern.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: A war mech simplifies things considerably, does it not?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready for this last one!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully dismantled Stealth Generator Zeta and have acquired the primal pattern in Farside.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you sure you wish to walk away from this mission? Drusera led me to believe that the fate of Nexus might hang in the balance...

localizedTextIdTitle: IMBUEMENT TEST: Do The Stuff 2: Do Harder

localizedTextIdText: Buy an Eldan Primal Reconstructor from Merchant Gigax in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You bought an Eldan Primal Reconstructor from Merchant Gigax in Illium.

localizedTextIdText: In order to advance your quest and re-attune the Genesis Key, you must find and defeat twelve of Nexus's most dangerous creatures. Speak with Commander Durek in the Secret Ops Center, then check your inventory for the Dangerous Creatures of Nexus list.

The Royal Collegium located another primal pattern. This time it's in a dangerous location in Farside. However, $~(creature=59930) has agreed to assist you in this mission. Travel to Farside and wait for his instructions.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Using the Dominion war mech, you were able to overcome the Eldan defenses and retrieve the primal pattern.

localizedTextIdText: While the Royal Collegium studies the primal pattern you obtained from the Exile arkship, Chancellor Juro Takigurian suggests you further your combat training. Earn a Silver medal or higher on Veteran difficulty in the Northern Wilds, Galeras, Whitevale, and Malgrave adventures.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed your adventure training and are ready for anything. Bring it!

localizedTextIdText: The Royal Collegium has located the next primal pattern, but unfortunately it's on the enemy arkship. However, the ICI has managed to gain access to the Gambler's Ruin. Axis Pheydra is waiting by a teleporter in the Enigma Chamber and will give you further instructions once you're on the enemy arkship.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infiltrated the enemy arkship and made your way to the relic room. There, you successfully extracted the primal pattern from an Eldan artifact. Mission accomplished!

localizedTextIdText: The XAS has located the next primal pattern, but unfortunately it's on the enemy arkship. However, the Black Hoods have managed to gain access to the Destiny. Avra Darkos is waiting by a teleporter in the Secret Ops Center and will give you further instructions once you're on the enemy arkship.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You infiltrated the enemy arkship and made your way to the museum. There, you successfully extracted the primal pattern from an Eldan artifact stored in the museum. Mission accomplished!

localizedTextIdText: For the next primal pattern, Drusera is sending you to the ruins of Kel Voreth to kill the Osun witch Kythria. She will only appear in Prime difficulty of the Ruins of Kel Voreth dungeon. Once you are done, travel to the entrance to the Genetic Archives and speak with the Caretaker.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Kythria and collected another primal pattern. It appears you have collected enough primal patterns to access to the Genetic Archives!

localizedTextIdText: While you were honing your skills in the dungeons of Nexus, Drusera located the next primal pattern for you. Travel to Malgrave and search for Glubglob of the Deep.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Glubglob of the Deep and collected another primal pattern.

localizedTextIdText: Pallian Cyreus calls for Dominion volunteers to help investigate the Dreg in the Crimson Badlands. Speak to Captain Karaka in Spaceport Alpha to arrange transportation to Crimson Command, then speak to Pallian Cyreus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Pallian Cyreus at Crimson Command
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg activity on the Crimson Badlands has increased, and citizens are needed to quell the beasts. Find Captain Karaka in Illium, and she'll send you to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: By the Scions, citizen. Can you not see how busy I am?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am told you are one of the Dominion's best and brightest. Do not expect favorable treatment as a result of your exemplary reputation, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now that that's out of the way, let's discuss your next assignment.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go to the Crimson Badlands.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in the Crimson Badlands and spoke to Pallian Cyreus concerning the Dreg problem. It looks like this is going to be an interesting assignment.

localizedTextIdText: Lila Redkill calls for Exile volunteers to help investigate the Dreg in the Crimson Badlands. Speak to Gus Oakby in Spaceport Horizon to arrange transportation to Bloodstone Landing, then speak to Lila Redkill.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Lila Redkill in Bloodstone Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dreg on the Crimson Badlands are outta control, and Exile volunteers are needed to quell 'em. Find Gus Oakby in Thayd, and he will send you to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You lookin' for someone?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I was hopin' you'd see our posting, $(player.name). We need all the help we can get here. The Dreg are plum out of control!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let's get down to business.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go to the Crimson Badlands.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You arrived in the Crimson Badlands and spoke to Lila Redkill concerning the Dreg problem. It looks like this is going to be an interesting assignment.

localizedTextIdText: To imbue your helm with greater power, proceed to Cankertube Swamp and kill Enthralled humanoids. Hopefully this will stop your helm from whispering to you.
Power up your item using the soul of Chowsdower. Chowsdower will only show himself if you kill his harmonious jabbit followers in the area behind the Lays of Air and Logic.
To imbue your item with greater power, you must travel into another dimension and collect essences. Enter the essence portal in the Keeper's Sanctuary and get to work.
Extract the power core from the remains of Eldridge, a highly-intelligent Eldan construct found in the Nursery. Once you have the power core, use it to imbue your item.
Kill Gilded Guardian in the Auric Gardens or Gilded Fields to imbue your item.
Kill Koral the Defiler in the Black Focus to power up your item!

You got a Sting Blade, but do you want to power it up? Use the Bing Swat ability on Sourhive Buzzbings in the Tainted Gardens in the Defile to make them drop $(vitem=1076) (and also make them furious). Then, touch the $(vitem=1076) on the ground to make it stick to your Sting Blade and harden, thus powering it up. It's that easy! Right?
Just because you're fighting the Strain doesn't mean you can't take time out to kill some Exile scum. Slaughter Exile soldiers in the Sonic Plaza to power up your item!
Enter the Strain Maw in the Black Focus and coat your item in acid to empower it!
Kill Chittering Blackfang in the Queen's Den and use their fangs to power up your item!
There's a mysterious orb hovering near the exanite outcropping in the back of the Nursery. Orbs like these have been known to have mysterious powers. Activate it and see if the tales are true.
The exanite in the equipment you found resonates with Drusera's Tree. It stands to reason that defending the tree would bestow beneficial effects upon your equipment.
Six elementals of unusual strength are roaming the subsections of the Nursery's Transfusion Chamber. Sap some of the primal power from each of them.

You sense a deep thirst for blood coming from your gloves. You must bathe your gloves in the blood of innocent creatures, such as Perfect dawngrazers in the Seraphic Wood and Yellowtail ravenok near the Nursery Trading Post.
Scorchwing, the Scourge of the Skies, is said to be filled with great power. Go to Scorchwing's Landing, kill Scorchwing, and claim the beast's power for yourself.
Rifts have opened in the area near the Exanite Resonance Tower, and your equipment reacts oddly to them. Investigate these rifts and see if you can locate their source.
The Dreadwatcher is attempting to devour Nexus. Go to the Dreadwatcher's Helm, cancel his dinner plans, and imbue your weapon with his power.
The four Archfiends of the Dreadwatcher that reside in the Cradle of Archfiends are a blight upon Nexus. Crush one of them beneath your heel and empower your footwear.
Word on the street is that Eldan constructs near the Resonance Tower carry a part that focuses primal energy, allowing for devastating attacks. Destroy some constructs and scavenge these parts.

The Terrorformer's twisting process has formed residual masses of anti-primals that have been strewn about the Terrorformer of Depravity, the Terrorformer of Decay, and the Terrorformer of Desolation. Collect these nodules, spheroids, and orbs to empower your equipment.
An Eldan facility buried deep in the hot sands of Malgrave has been discovered. Report to Fairos in Sunstorm Village immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Fairos in Sunstorm Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion researchers have unearthed an Eldan facility in northern Malgrave. Fairos is requesting assistance from all able-bodied citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Secure transport to Malgrave and report to Fairos in Sunstorm Village.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Greetings $(player.class). Containment Facility R-12 is important to the Dominion. We must do all that we can to secure it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stand at the ready, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Fairos in Sunstorm Village. Containment Facility R-12 contains a highly unstable reactor. The Dominion needs your assistance to stabilize it before it goes critical.

localizedTextIdText: An Eldan facility buried deep in the hot sands of Malgrave has been discovered. Report to Dorian Walker in Sandstone Hold immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Dorian Walker in Sandstone Hold
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exile researchers have unearthed an Eldan facility in northern Malgrave. Dorian Walker is requesting assistance from all able-bodied citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Secure transport to Malgrave and report to Dorian Walker in Sandstone Hold.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey there $(player.class). Containment Facility R-12A is an Eldan bonanza! We gotta make sure that it's stable before we can continue the research.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Stand by, squirt. Things are gonna ramp real up fast.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You reported to Dorian Walker in Sandstone Hold. Containment Facility R-12A contains a highly unstable reactor. The Exiles need your assistance to stabilize it before it goes critical.

localizedTextIdText: Before you leave for Nexus, Avra Darkos has asked you to speak with Professor Rhoda Wellspring hologram in the Docking Bay of the Gambler's Ruin for your first briefing on the mysteries of your new home.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Prior to arranging passage to the planet, you must have the necessary information. Speak to Professor Wellspring and she'll bring you up to speed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Professor Wellspring, the head of the XAS, is waiting to speak with you. Find the holoprojector in the Docking Bay and contact her at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You see? Her words are worth hearing. In dire times such as these, information is our greatest weapon. Remember that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please pay attention to all that the professor reveals. Now go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now you must vacate this vessel.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Professor Rhoda Wellspring hologram in the Docking Bay of the Gambler's Ruin for your first briefing on the mysteries of Nexus. Your top priority as an Exile is to learn what became of the Eldan. If the Exiles can solve that mystery before the Dominion, it may very well determine the future of Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What does she have to say to me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Professor Rhoda Wellspring heads the Exile Academy of Science. She is a family friend of both Dorian and Belle Walker. It was Belle Walker who convinced her to assume leadership of the XAS.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Though I know precisely why she wishes to speak to you, I will not reveal the reason. Find her hologram in the Docking Bay and learn for yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will not be permitted to depart until you've been properly briefed.

localizedTextIdText: Just because you're fighting the Strain doesn't mean you can't take time out to kill some Dominion scum. Slaughter Dominion soldiers in the Sonic Plaza to power up your item!

localizedTextIdText: Before you leave for Nexus, Axis Pheydra has asked you to speak with Chancellor Juro Takigurian hologram in the Destiny's Departures Terminal for your first briefing on the mysteries of your new home.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Pheydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You are not yet authorized to travel to Nexus. Before leaving the Destiny, you will speak to Chancellor Juro Takigurian in the Departures Terminal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The chancellor continues to wait for your arrival. Speak to his hologram in the Departures Terminal before he grows weary of waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is fortunate that the emperor has taken such a liking to you, $(player.name). You are now privy to knowledge that few others are familiar with.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The chancellor has much to say. Your life depends on how well you listen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your transportation to Nexus awaits. I will be watching you with interest.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll speak to the chancellor at once.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Chancellor Juro Takigurian hologram in the Destiny's Departures Terminal for your first briefing on the mysteries of Nexus. Your top priority as a Dominion citizen is to learn what became of the Eldan. If the Dominion can solve that mystery before the Exiles, it may very well determine the future of Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What does he have to say to me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Juro is the chancellor of the Royal Collegium. He recently gained his position following the rather mysterious death of the previous chancellor. He is not a man to be taken lightly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I strongly recommend you ask him that question. Until you have been briefed, I am not inclined to answer it in his stead.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I would rather see you liquidated than sent to Nexus unprepared.

localizedTextIdText: In order to progress re-attunement of the Genesis Key, you must hone your dungeon combat skills. Earn a Bronze medal or higher on Prime mode in Stormtalon's Lair, Ruins of Kel Voreth, Skullcano Island, and the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden .
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You earned a Bronze medal or higher on Prime mode in the four dungeons, and you may now resume your mission to re-attune the Genesis Key.

localizedTextIdText: In order to continue with re-attunement of the Genesis Key, you must defeat Dreadphage Ohmna in the Genetic Archives raid.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated Dreadphage Ohmna! You are now ready to proceed with re-attunement of the Genesis Key.

localizedTextIdText: In order to advance your quest and re-attune the Genesis Key, you must find and defeat twelve of Nexus's most dangerous creatures. Speak with Kezrek Warbringer in the Enigma Chamber, then check your inventory for the Dangerous Creatures of Nexus list.

This is a Canimid infestation just outside the Lay of Water. They have been burrowing out of the holes and eating the fruit that Harmonious Horticulturist is trying to grow on the outskirts of the Lay of Water. Harmonious Horticulturist has requested you to help him out with the problem.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Harmonious Horticulturist in the outskirts of Lay of Water< /text>to convey the good news!
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Monsters keep popping out of those burrows and destroying our crop. We require the outsider's help to take care of them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Are you done scaring them away?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We can grow our crop now. We are grateful. We will also need our staff back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This staff will help the outsider. Take it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is time to plant some seeds now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Those Canimid have been caved-in. They won't be coming out of those burrows anytime soon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The outsider is cold-hearted.

localizedTextIdText: Professor Ecto, a specialist in supernatural events, has hired you to investigate reports of "hauntings" around the Luminous Gardens. You agreed to take a look at the locations he marked in your datachron.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Professor Ecto at the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Minion needed to assist in ghost research. You get job. Reports of hauntings in Luminous Gardens. You go now and investigate. Go go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ghosts seen most often in Luminous Gardens. Strange locations for paranormal activity. You investigate, come back with news.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What $(player.name) mean, no ghosts? Only pranksters?! Bah! Stupid people are stupid! Now all worked up about hauntings.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Research should have promising results unless reports made by idiots.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Bah! Waste of time! Big waste of time! Must shoot messenger!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After a thorough ghost hunt around the Luminous Gardens, you confirmed that some people are just too easy to scare. Nary a ghost was found, but many a prankster and reveler was.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will I be looking for?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do I do when I find one?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Updated your datachron to show projection of reported hauntings. Look at hologram. In real world, will be much bigger. Now go!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Just investigate them and look for ghosts! So simple, even you can do it!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: They had better be, otherwise time is wasted! Some people just stupid, scare easily!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now you on prank list! Scared of ghosts, yes? Should be more scared of me!

localizedTextIdText: Doctor Pryzraka, a specialist in supernatural events, has hired you to investigate reports of "hauntings" around the seedier parts of Thayd, such as the Lair of the Black Hoods, the Alchemist's Maze, and the Crooked Corners. You've agreed to help, though you can't help but be a little skeptical of the reports.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Doctor Pryzraka in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Reports of harrowing hauntings are pouring in. As a supernatural specialist, I must verify the veracity of these tales.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I await your progress with patience, but even I have my limits. Seek out the hauntings and discover the terrifying truth!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Despite your deepest delves into Thayd's darkest destinations, nary a ghost was found, only pranksters. Such sadness! Yet I appreciate your assistance all the same.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The hauntings hew close to terrible trinkets and devilish dolls. Be wary!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Such wretched luck! Will I never speak to a spirit from beyond?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sorry it didn't work out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After a thorough ghost hunt around Thayd, you confirmed that some people are just too easy to scare. Nary a ghost was found, but many a prankster, drunk, or reveler was.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How will I know a haunting when I see one?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do I do when I find one?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Are you sure they're really ghosts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The locations are listed in your datachron. The spirits project an image similar to the one in the hologram next to me.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Approach the haunting sites with daring decisiveness and the spirits will surely show themselves!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I do not know, but such queries make me quiver with anticipation!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You will be to blame should a ghoulish ghost devour your indolent soul.

localizedTextIdText: You have extracted the core from the Vengeful Elemental. Perhaps it can be refined.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Vengeful Elemental Core to the Thundercall Staff
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Perhaps this core can be refined.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have refined the extracted core from the Vengeful Elemental into a powerful weapon.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Vengeful Elemental Core to the Thundercall Staff

localizedTextIdText: You have extracted the core from the Vengeful Elemental. Perhaps it can be refined.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Vengeful Elemental Core to the Spontaneous Fire
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Perhaps this core can be refined.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have refined the extracted core from the Vengeful Elemental into a powerful weapon.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return the Vengeful Elemental Core to the Spontaneous Fire

localizedTextIdText: Kill Aethros in Stormtalon's Lair.
Kill Blade-Wind the Invoker in Stormtalon's Lair.
Your purchase of a Phageform Laboratory from Protostar has proven to be more problematic than expected. The laboratory is offline and requires key materials to restart it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Use the Control Panel to reboot the Phageform Laboratory in safe mode
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Status: offline. Energy source: depleted.  Biological and technological materials required. Full system restart required.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Status: offline. Energy source: depleted.  Biological and technological materials required. Full system restart required.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Status: offline.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Status: rebooting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Status: online.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Did they say no refunds? Fixer-upper it is!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You restarted your Phageform Laboratory and then re-restarted it in safe mode.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Use the Control Panel to reboot the lab

localizedTextIdText: Lyratha Pricklethorn is studying historical drinks popular during Shade's Eve. She's asked you to help her gather nightwidow extract, succulent spiderlings, and potent ichor buds around Thayd so she can test them out for future use in holiday beverages.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lyratha Pricklethorn in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Great timing! I was just studying this old scroll of festival drinks and I thought, "Why not try one?" Can you get me the last three ingredients I need?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found enough of those ingredients around town? You know, the nightwidow extract, the succulent spiderlings, and the potent ichor buds?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a good thing I let you try it first! I mean... thanks for all your help! I'll make some notes here for next time. How're you feeling?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you so much! I'll let you have the first sip, promise!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe I should use fewer spiders next time. Oh, well!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I feel like I'm going to throw up.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite the unpleasant aftertaste it left in your mouth, you feel a little more powerful following your test of Lyratha Pricklethorn "festive" drink.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Where do I find this stuff?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Well, there's nightwidow extract... succulent spiderlings... oh, and potent ichor buds, too!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, hush! It's all natural. I need a pinch of the ichor for texture, the nightwidow extract for a strong and bitter flavor, and the spiderling venom sacks will add a little kick!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It wouldn't be much of a Shade's Eve drink if it didn't have a few surprises in it! But don't worry, it's nothing scary. I'm pretty sure of that!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Oh, that's easy-peasy! The extract's near the floating hoogle rock, the ichor buds grow near sources of light, and the spiderlings hang near the walls and foliage! You'll see!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, don't be such a cranky shadeling!

localizedTextIdText: Bloodshaman Zaari is studying historical drinks popular during Shade's Eve. She's asked you to help her gather nightwidow extract, succulent spiderlings, and potent ichor buds around Illium so she can test them out for future use in holiday beverages.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bloodshaman Zaari in the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This ancient scroll of festive Cassian drinks has piqued my curiosity. Do me the courtesy of gathering some of the ingredients, will you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I still anticipate your delivery of nightwidow extract, ichor buds, and succulent spiderlings. How long do you intend for me to wait?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your reaction reveals the drink's potency. I must make a note of this in the margins... now, on to my next batch!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Your labors will earn you a taste of this refreshing Shade's Eve libation.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time, the ingredients I require will put up a fight.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite the unpleasant aftertaste it left in your mouth, you feel a little more powerful following your test of Bloodshaman Zaari "festive" drink.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get them to you soon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Where do I find this stuff?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Nightwidow extract, succulent spiderlings, and potent ichor buds. With your reputation, finding these ingredients should be a simple task for you.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You certainly are squeamish, aren't you? It all serves a purpose. I need a pinch of the ichor for texture, the nightwidow extract for a strong and bitter flavor, and the spiderling venom sacks will add some kick.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It wouldn't be a drink deserving of Shade's Eve if it didn't have a surprise or two.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Supplies of the extract are regularly delivered to the graveyard near the spaceport. The ichor buds grow near sources of light, and the spiderlings scurry about near walls and foliage.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no sense of adventure? Such a drink hasn't been made in centuries!

localizedTextIdText: Rubin Ashwood in Shindig Hollow has asked you to take part in a Shade's Eve ritual that involves burning effigies of Jack Shade in memory of the plague victims. Join in the fun and use your torch to set fire to sinister effigies in the Arborian Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Rubin Ashwood in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lots of folks died durin' the plague, so we burn effigies of Jack Shade so we never forget the pain he caused. Here, take a torch and get to burnin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The effigies ain't goin' to burn themselves, $(player.name). You're holdin' up the show! Get out there and set them things alight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You done good, friend. The flames remind us of the plague's devastation and focus our memories on the unfortunate souls who lost their lives to it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It might sound a bit macabre, but there's folks who really get into it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's as good a way as any to stick a torch in Jack Shade's eye!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You burned effigies of Jack Shade as part of Thayd's Shade's Eve celebration. Though the act itself was a tad bit morbid, the delight of the other celebrants was readily apparent in their laughter and carefree spirits as they joyfully faced the tragedies of the past.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: During the plague, there was more dead than could be buried, so we burned 'em on funeral pyres. Today, we burn effigies of Jack Shade in memory of the folks his plague killed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Sure it is, but traditions aren't always safe. We ain't been able to light proper bonfires ever since we got driven off Cassus - fire's too dangerous aboard ship. After so long, folks are really itchin' to get the fires lit this time around.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What've you got against tradition, friend?

localizedTextIdText: Jeremiah Brand in Illium has asked you to take part in a Shade's Eve ritual that involves burning effigies of Jack Shade in memory of the plague victims. Join in the fun and use your torch to set fire to sinister effigies in Fate's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Jeremiah Brand at the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lots o' folk died from the plague, right? We burn effigies of Jack Shade so we never forget the pain he caused. You wanna play, guv? Take this torch.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Sinister effigies have been placed all 'round Fate's Landing, they have. Set 'em alight and watch 'em burn. Have a little fun for once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Had fun burning effigies, did you? That's right proper! We got to remember the victims of the plague, and this tradition makes sure we do, it does.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're a right good mate, you are. Try not to burn the city down, what?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Have a safe Shade's Eve, guv. Come back and burn more effigies later, yeah?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You burned effigies of Jack Shade as part of Illium's Shade's Eve celebration. Though the act itself was a tad bit morbid, the delight of the other celebrants was readily apparent in their laughter and carefree spirits as they joyfully faced the tragedies of the past.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: During the plague, there was more dead than could be buried, there was. They was burned on funeral pyres. Today, we burn effigies of Jack Shade to remind us of the folks his plague killed.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Dangerous? Nonsense! The fire brigade's on alert, it is. I wager we won't have no fires breaking out this year, nope.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Shhh. Best not talk about it, guv. Wouldn't want to offend any Chua, would we?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Scared of fire, are you? Burned as a child, mayhaps? Sorry to hear it, I am.

localizedTextIdText: Groups of costumed hooligans are harassing citizens at Fortune's Ground. Due to the Shade's Eve holiday, Shade Brewer Druga has asked you to let them off easy by pelting them with rotten eggs. Get out there and teach the hooligans a lesson.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Shade Brewer Druga in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There's a buncha hooligans dolled up in costumes, tryin' to rob people! I got a surprise for 'em - take these rotten eggs and teach 'em a lesson!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Those hooligans are still pickin' on folks at Fortune's Ground. Ya still got those eggs I gave ya? Get over there and put 'em to use!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya taught those hooligans a good Shade's Eve lesson, sweetheart. I can even smell those freaks from here! Phew!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember to hold your nose, pal. Those eggs are really ripe!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Have a happy Shade's Eve, pal. I got me some brewin' to do.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That was a lot of fun.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You broke up the hooligans' festivities by pelting them with a variety of very stinky rotten eggs. Those thugs will think twice before harassing other citizens this Shade's Eve.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: They'll get what's coming to them.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why don't we just kick their butts?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The guards got more important things to worry about tonight. I figure we can do this one on our own, vigilante-like.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's Shade's Eve! Tricks is all part of the fun! I'd rather teach 'em a good lesson instead of skinnin' my knuckles on their thick heads. Plus, these eggs're stinky enough to blow the rocks off a Boulderback!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya workin' with the hooligans, pal? If so, I got more than eggs for ya.

localizedTextIdText: Groups of costumed hooligans are harassing lowborn citizens along Legion's Way. Due to the holiday, Rixis - the self-imposed enforcer of Shade's Eve - has asked you to let them off easy by pelting them with rotten eggs. Get out there and teach those hooligans a lesson.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Rixis in the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hooligans are harassing lowborn citizens along Legion's Way, preventing them from enjoying Shade's Eve. You will use these eggs to dissuade the offenders.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There are still many lowborn citizens whose holiday enjoyment is being curtailed by masked hooligans along Legion's Way. Go now and egg the offenders.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The enjoyment of Shade's Eve by lowborn citizens has risen by sixteen percent. Now I can return to enforcing costume quality standards.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Handle the eggs with caution. They are well beyond their expiration dates.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is. Any citizen wearing a costume of dubious quality must be punished.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: It's been far too long since I egged someone.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You broke up the hooligans' festivities by pelting them with a variety of very stinky rotten eggs. Those thugs will think twice before harassing other lowborn citizens this Shade's Eve.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Neutralizing the hooligans would be my preference. Unfortunately, even they must have a chance to enjoy the holiday, so long as they do not do so at the expense of others.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: So long as the hooligans possess functional olfactory senses, they will find these eggs to be repugnant. Furthermore, the throwing of putrescent ova is classified by the traditions as a "holiday shenanigan."
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Crimes against lowborn citizens often go unreported to the authorities, and are generally overlooked. As I am the enforcer of Shade's Eve, I am authorized to deputize you in the pursuit of my duties.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Participation in ensuring festive joy during Shade's Eve is compulsory.

localizedTextIdText: Maestro Mundus in Shindig Hollow wants some help spreading fear throughout the city during Shade's Eve. Use the fright kit he's provided to scare folks silly in Academy Corner.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Maestro Mundus in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shade's Eve is a fusion of fun and fear, yet I feel the fear is far from frequent tonight. Use this fright kit to advocate the appropriate atmosphere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The night is strangely absent of screams and shrieks. Why have you not used the fright kit I committed to you to spread fear across the city?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Soprano shrieks! The tenors of terror! The high notes of horror! Such lovely lullabies on this dark and deranged evening, thanks to you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure that this is the most terrifically terrifying Shade's Eve ever!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have brought the fear to fruition, friend! I am deeply in your debt!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Indeed, it was a terrifying task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the behest of Maestro Mundus, you've gone forth to spread fright and fear to the citizens of Thayd during the festival of Shade's Eve. Congratulations!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want to scare people?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This dread festival memorializes a perilous plague. Revelry is important, but so is the instigation of insidious anxiety. My plan is to parlay this party into panic!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am merely a... concerned party to the events of this most evocative evening. Mua ha ha ha! Oh, don't mind me. Just some horrifying holiday humor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You obviously lack the wits and willpower to withstand frights and fear.

localizedTextIdText: Maestro Mallenus in Parade Grounds wants some help spreading fear throughout the city during Shade's Eve. Use the fright kit he's provided to scare folks silly in the Luminous Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Maestro Mallenus in Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shade's Eve is a fusion of fun and fear, yet I feel the fear is far from frequent tonight. Use this fright kit to advocate the appropriate atmosphere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The night is strangely absent of screams and shrieks. Why have you not used the fright kit I committed to you to spread fear across the city?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Soprano shrieks! The tenors of terror! The high notes of horror! Such lovely lullabies on this dark and deranged evening, thanks to you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure that this is the most terrifically terrifying Shade's Eve ever!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You have brought the fear to fruition, friend! I am deeply in your debt!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Indeed, it was a terrifying task.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At the behest of Maestro Mallenus, you've gone forth to spread fright and fear to the citizens of Illium during the festival of Shade's Eve. Congratulations!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want to scare people?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This dread festival memorializes a perilous plague. Revelry is important, but so is the instigation of insidious anxiety. My plan is to parlay this party into panic!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am merely a... concerned party to the events of this most evocative evening. Mua ha ha ha! Oh, don't mind me. Just some horrifying holiday humor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You obviously lack the wits and willpower to withstand frights and fear.

localizedTextIdText: Star-Comm Station is under threat and has retracted beneath the surface of Levian Bay. The station's Caretaker is requesting immediate assistance, and can be found at Star-Comm Basin's Auxiliary Control Hub.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with $~(creature=58369) at the Auxiliary Control Hub
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nStar-Comm Station is under siege and has retracted beneath the surface of Levian Bay. Proceed to Star-Comm Basin in Levian Bay at once and investigate.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nStar-Comm Station is under siege and has retracted beneath the surface of Levian Bay. Proceed to Star-Comm Basin in Levian Bay at once and investigate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This facility is currently under siege by Ikthians, Marauders, and elements of the Strain. I require your assistance if I'm to maintain control.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Splendid. My odds of success have risen by at least two point four percent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Star-Comm Station is simultaneously under siege by Ikthians, Marauders, and the Strain. You traveled to the station's Auxiliary Control Hub and learned that $~(creature=58369) requires your help if he is to ensure the facility doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

localizedTextIdText: Star-Comm Station is under threat and has retracted beneath the surface of Levian Bay. The station's Caretaker is requesting immediate assistance, and can be found at Star-Comm Basin's Auxiliary Control Hub.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with $~(creature=58369) at the Auxiliary Control Hub
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nStar-Comm Station is under siege and has retracted beneath the surface of Levian Bay. Proceed to Star-Comm Basin in Levian Bay at once and investigate.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nStar-Comm Station is under siege and has retracted beneath the surface of Levian Bay. Proceed to Star-Comm Basin in Levian Bay at once and investigate.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This facility is currently under siege by Ikthians, Marauders, and elements of the Strain. I require your assistance if I'm to maintain control.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Splendid. My odds of success have risen by at least two point four percent.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Star-Comm Station is simultaneously under siege by Ikthians, Marauders, and the Strain. You traveled to the station's Auxiliary Control Hub and learned that $~(creature=58369) requires your help if he is to ensure the facility doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

localizedTextIdText: Lulu Blackbush has found an Eldan mind-control device. She wants you to use it to send a telepathically-controlled squirg to attack Dominion players and personnel in the Sonic Plaza.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I found a couple of Eldan gizmos that can telepathically control squirg. I say we send some of them squirg to get the Dommies. What do you say?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Once you got one of them squirgs under your control, get it over to the Sonic Plaza and make them Dommies sorry they ever came here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good work usin' them squirg to our advantage. Those things give me nightmares, so I can imagine how the Dommies feel.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The gizmo's got limited use, so make them squirg count!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll be in touch when I find more of them Eldan gizmos!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used Lulu Blackbush Eldan mind-control device to telepathically control squirg into attacking Dominion players and personnel in the Sonic Plaza. Maybe Lulu Blackbush is on to something.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I ain't rightly sure. I think it uses sound waves or somthin'.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I tested it out on one of the squirg and it works like a charm. Doesn't last too long, but it didn't cost me nothin' so I won't complain.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, come on! You're kiddin' around, right? This is gonna be fun!

localizedTextIdText: Ringo Hax has found an Eldan mind-control device. He wants you to use it to send a telepathically-controlled squirg to attack Exile players and personnel in the Sonic Plaza.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Located Eldan mind-control gizmos. You take and use on squirg. Control squirg with brain and make them attack Exiles in Sonic Plaza. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Eldan gizmo limited-use. Employ it to control squirg. Use squirg to kill Exiles. Even minion can do it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good good! Make squishy Exiles sorry! Always knew squirg were good for something!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good! Now I not have to mind-control you into mind-controlling squirg!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Must find more Eldan mind-control gizmos. Come back later.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used Ringo Hax Eldan mind-control device to telepathically control squirg into attacking Exile players and personnel in the Sonic Plaza. Maybe Ringo Hax is on to something.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't know. Reasonably sure there are no harmful side effects for squirg. For you? Guess we find out!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Where $p(player.name) sense of adventure?

localizedTextIdText: Lulu Blackbush has detected an automated distress beacon originating from an old cryo pod just outside the Sonic Plaza, and she's asked you to investigate it. Though she seems troubled, she won't tell you why.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm pickin' up an automated distress beacon. Looks like it's comin' from an old cryo pod. I ain't sure where it came from, but I do have my suspicions.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There ain't no cryo pod here, is there? Better move out and head to the distress signal's point of origin before it goes offline. Now git!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The pod was empty? You sure about that? I guess we'll never know who or what was in it. Ah, well. It's probably for the best, anyhow.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful. You don't know what you might be gettin' into.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thanks for tryin'. I'll catch you later, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll check the cryo pod out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the cryo pod that was broadcasting the distress beacon that Lulu Blackbush detected. You found a journal within the pod, written by Doctor Rose, explaining that she had been infected by some unknown disease. After searching, you located Rose, but she swore you to secrecy concerning her mysterious condition.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Never you mind. It's probably just my imagination gettin' the better of me. The cryo pod I'm thinkin' of couldn't have possibly survived the explosion...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Shush. Just get out there and check it out and let me know what you find. And keep it quiet, understand?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? This could be important, friend. Real important.

localizedTextIdText: Ringo Hax has detected an automated distress beacon originating from an old cryo pod just outside the Sonic Plaza, and he's asked you to investigate it. Though he seems troubled, he won't tell you why.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ringo Hax via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Found automated distress beacon from old cryo pod. Don't know where pod come from. Suspicious! Very suspicious! You go investigate!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stupid! Cryo pod not here. Cryo pod out there somewhere. Find pod, investigate pod, before pod signal vanishes! Go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Pod empty? $(player.name) absolutely sure? We never know who or what was in pod now. Guess it all for best.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Careful! You not know what out there! Could be bad, could be nothing!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Work done now. Go away and let me think.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll check the cryo pod out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You investigated the cryo pod that was broadcasting the distress beacon that Ringo Hax detected. You found a journal within the pod, written by Doctor Rose, explaining that she had been infected by some unknown disease. After searching, you located Rose, but she swore you to secrecy concerning her mysterious condition.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You ask too many questions. Questions dangerous, especially questions about why cryo pod suspicious. No way cryo pod survive explosion, anyway.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I told you! Questions dangerous! You have brain? Then go find cryo pod and call with results. Keep mission very quiet, yes? Or else!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This not good time to say no to me. Not good time at all.

localizedTextIdText: You recovered a heart from one of Star-Comm Basin's guardians. Perhaps SCS-543 Arbiter at the Auxiliary Control Hub can tell you more about these beasts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to SCS-543 Arbiter at the Auxiliary Control Hub
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This heart, taken from a guardian's corpse, has been modified from its original state. Show it to the SCS-543 Arbiter and see what you can learn.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This cardio-vascular organ is heavily modified. Mutation caused by Star-Comm Basin's environment. Prognosis: Specimen creature's death was imminent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Organ sample contained. Molecular scans pending. Transaction complete.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Let's see what it can tell me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The SCS-543 Arbiter at the Auxiliary Control Hub has taken the Guardian Heart from you and explained a little about the gigantic monstrosities known as "guardians." Apparently, something about Star-Comm Basin's environment encourages mutation, but the physiological changes will ultimately result in the creature's death.

localizedTextIdText: The SCS-543 Arbiter has determined that the AI within SCS Prime has become unstable, and must be shut down. Team up with other adventurers and make your way to the center of Star-Comm Basin and eliminate it.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to SCS-543 Arbiter via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: SCS Prime has developed undesirable attributes. Intensely violent, aggressive. Current status irreversible. Deactivation by users is required.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: SCS Prime currently displays as functional. Proceed immediately to marked location and terminate SCS Prime's functions. Execute.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: SCS Prime displays as offline. Destruction of rogue unit confirmed. Task successfully completed by users.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ensure all functions of SCS Prime are terminated. Proceed.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: User's success recorded in performance database. End communication.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The SCS-543 Arbiter at the Auxiliary Control Hub reports that the SCS Prime has been successfully deactivated. Good work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Continued operation of SCS Prime in Star-Comm Basin is unacceptable.

localizedTextIdText: Following their successful performance at the Vigilant Incursion, the band known as the Blast Beat Boys are scheduled to play for the troops in Final Light. Unfortunately, they haven't arrived yet, and Jable Fong wants you to rescue them from whatever trouble they've gotten themselves into in the Promenade of Ruin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Jable Fong in Final Light
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You know of Blast Beat Boys? Chua singing group. Famous! Very famous! But even so, they late. Likely in trouble. Need you to help find them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why you not find Blast Beat Boys yet? Probably in trouble! Probably eaten by beasties! Probably under arrest! Bring them back, quick quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hmmm. New lead singer not my first choice, but whatever. You find boys, bring them back for show. Besides, singer always replaceable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You life saver. Band not start soon, soldiers tear me into tiny bits!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy show! Have blast! Try not to get burned!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find the Blast Beat Boys.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and rescued the members of the Blast Beat Boys - most of them, anyway - and allowed them to perform in Final Light. Now they can continue their rather successful tour of the Defile, bringing their own style of music to Dominion troopers, lifting their spirits in the process.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Supposed to come here by air drop. Maybe get coordinates wrong. Not surprising. Once they drop into Dreg camp by mistake. Big, big trouble! Almost eaten!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: All young Chua. Dress well, like wearing leather. Not very smart, so only use is entertainers or test subjects. Good thing they can sing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Poor young Chua, lost and alone. You leave them to die? Horrible!

localizedTextIdText: Data structures in Star-Comm Basin are under attack. You must interface with the virtual world to remove bugs and malicious programs from the system. Use virtual entry points and remove viruses before they compromise the data collection, junction, or repeater structures.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to $~(creature=58369) via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Warning! Data structures underlying Star-Comm are under electronic assault. User assistance is required to manually debug the system.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Utilize virtual entry points, then defend data structures from malicious programs. User survivability within acceptable parameters. Execute.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm currently unable to address the bugs in the station's network. Someone of your capabilities should have little trouble doing it for me. Yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The network is running splendidly, all due to your quick action and thirst for virtual blood. Thank you for your timely assistance.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Virtual entry points active. Please expedite this task immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You did quite well for an organic being. No offense.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to successfully remove the majority of the malicious programs from Star-Comm Basin's network, but with such a complex system there are always liable to be more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: User declination recorded. Awaiting new user.

localizedTextIdText: Nurton and Kaffee, two Freebot hackers, intend to exploit a potential weakness in the Strain techno-phage. They can hack the techno-phage's mainframe, but require your help to distract it. If you wish to assist them, meet the two Freebots beneath the Black Focus. Due to the volatile nature of this situation, if the process is interrupted, it's likely the three of you will have to start over.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kaffee at the Dread Traverse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My counterpart and I have a proposition for you, sentient. We intend to destroy the techno-phage, but we require your assistance. Can we count on you?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is much to do if we are to destroy the techno-phage, my free-willed friend! Please assist us in putting an end to this vile malignancy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I was there when Nurton spoke to you of ending the techno-phage's influence. We cannot do so without your undoubtedly valuable assistance!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Activating disappointment protocols! Given that the techno-phage's source code changes organically, the exploit we found was merely temporary. Drat!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Kaffee and I will await you at the base of the Black Focus. Onward!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have vowed to take the techno-phage down, and we will! Someday!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The techno-phage is a super advanced virus that changes its source code organically. Because of this, any exploit used against it only lasts for a few minutes before becoming useless. While Nurton and Kaffee have failed to destroy the techno-phage for the time being, they have sworn never to give up.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How will you stop the techno-phage?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How can I possibly help you?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Nurton, and my counterpart here is Kaffee. We are "free hackers," sworn to liberate all bionic beings from oppression. The techno-phage is a major threat to free computation, so we have vowed to destroy it!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We have studied the techno-phage for some time now. We have located its mainframe servers and hacked into its proverbial brain. With our knowledge - and your help - we can put an end to its evil!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We can acquire an exploit by combing the techno-phage's mainframe database. However, we require you to distract the techno-phage as we conduct our search.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you an ally of free thought? Or an accomplice of oppression?

localizedTextIdText: Following their successful performance at the Final Stand, the band known as the Flower Puff Girls are scheduled to play for the troops in Hope's Dare. Unfortunately, they haven't arrived yet, and Clay wants you to rescue them from whatever trouble they've gotten themselves into at the Promenade of Ruin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Clay in Hope's Dare
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ever hear of the Flower Puff Girls? They're an Aurin singing group, and they're late! They're probably in trouble. I need you to help me find them!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we don't get those girls on stage soon, we're going to have a riot on our hands! Find them and get them back here on the double!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That wouldn't have been my choice, but with the right lighting and special effects, I'm sure it'll work. Thanks for all your help!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry! The show must go on and all that!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Enjoy the show!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find the Flower Puff Girls.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and rescued the members of the Flower Puff Girls - most of them, anyway - and allowed them to perform in Hope's Dare. Now they can continue their rather successful tour of the Defile, bringing their own style of music to Exile troopers, lifting their spirits in the process.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They were supposed to air-drop in, but could've gotten their coordinates wrong. It's happened before. This one time, in Algoroc, Miss Sunbeam ended up in the middle of a Dominion formation somehow...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's all Aurin band - you can't miss them. They're all lovely young ladies, but they're not exactly the sharpest claws in the paw, if you get my drift. Who knows what sorts of trouble they've gotten into.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're going to turn your back on those beautiful young ladies? You jerk!

localizedTextIdText: Win a match in the Daggerstone Pass battleground.
Perform or assist Satellite Uplink captures in the Daggerstone Pass battleground.
Bomb the enemy reactor 5 times in the Daggerstone Pass battleground.
Bomb the enemy reactor 10 times in the Daggerstone Pass battleground.
Bomb the enemy reactor 15 times in the Daggerstone Pass battleground.

Dreadwatcher grimworms have shot down some Dominion supply ships over the Dread Traverse. The Dominion's supplies must be recovered before Exile thieves can pilfer them. Nerissa Artan has asked you to search the wreckage for fortified cartons, micro-reactor cells, and savvy gadgets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our supply ships have crashed in the Dread Traverse, scattering their supplies. I need volunteers to collect the supplies before the Exiles do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Exile troops have been spotted in the Dread Traverse. Get out there and recover our supplies, and take out some of the Exile scum while you're at it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Fine work recovering those supplies, citizen. Every piece of materiel recovered brings us that much closer to controlling the Defile.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You are "weapons hot" for this operation, $(player.name). Shoot to kill.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This operation is liable to last a while, so remain close at hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Nerissa Artan urging, you combed the wreckage of the Dominion supply ships for useful items in an effort to deny them to the Exiles in the Defile. Exile scavengers might have gotten in your way, but you held your own and succeeded in your mission.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Dreadwatcher sent four giant grimworms to the Dread Traverse to wreak havoc with our troops. The worms brought our ships down as they were on approach.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Would you rather I make this a direct order?

localizedTextIdText: Dreadwatcher grimworms have shot down some Dominion supply ships over the Dread Traverse. The Dominion supplies could be of real use to the Exiles. Ashella Sunfell has asked you to search the wreckage for fortified cartons, micro-reactor cells, and savvy gadgets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Ashella Sunfell via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Dominion supply ships have gone down in the Dread Traverse. I need to get as many folks as I can out there to grab those goods before the Dommies do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's the salvage op going? There's a lot of stuff out there that we need - fortified cartons, micro-reactor sales, and savvy gadgets. Go get 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This stuff's really going to make a difference, $(player.name). I'm probably going to send out another crew later, so check back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You better hurry up. The bad guys will be doing the same thing!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take care!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll salvage some of those supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: At Ashella Sunfell urging, you combed the wreckage of the Dominion supply ships for useful items in an effort to support the Exile occupation of the Defile. The Dominion might have gotten in your way, but you held your own and succeeded in your mission.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Dreadwatcher sent four giant grimworms to the Dread Traverse to wreak havoc with our troops. Luckily, they only brought down the Dominion ships.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We really need those supplies. Are you sure you won't help?

localizedTextIdText: A ship carrying crates of Nerissa Artan romance novels was shot down. She's asked you to recover as many of the book crates as you can. The books are located in the Sonic Plaza, at the Black Focus, and in the Promenade of Ruin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I requested several crates of my novels to be delivered, but the transport ship crashed. If they aren't recovered the lowborn will be so disappointed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My novels are still out there, waiting to be found. You can't let them fall into the wrong hands!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If I thanked you a thousand times, it would still not be enough! You have done a service for the Empire that will not soon be forgotten!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You are such a great crusader for the well-being of the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Here, have an autographed copy of my book. It's the least I can do!
