localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You collected Nerissa Artan crates of novels that were lost when their transport ship crashed. Now her fans won't be deprived of her riveting romantic tales... but is that really a good thing?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why will the lowborn be disappointed?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It was shot down, actually. The ship was overflowing with entertainment to boost the morale of our citizens. There were performers aboard, too, but they didn't survive the crash.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: While they are not quite the audience I had originally intended to write for, the lowborn took a quick liking to my work. Of course, I am simply overwhelmed by their enthusiastic support.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How can you turn your back on my fans? My poor, poor fans!

localizedTextIdText: An Imperial Services Organization transport carrying entertainment materials for the Dominion has crashed. Juliana Copil has asked you to locate the ship's cargo and alter any printed materials you can find in the Sonic Plaza, the Black Focus, and the Promenade of Ruin.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Juliana Copil via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: An ISO ship delivering romance novels to the Dominion has crashed. The Dominion will try to recover them, but you must edit them first.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Reports indicate that romance novels were aboard that ISO ship. If you edit them to my specifications, it will deal a blow to Dominion morale.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am certain your adjustments to the Dominion's shipment of romance novels have improved the quality of the writing sevenfold. Thank you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Dominion morale is already low. Hopefully this will decrease it further.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have saved copy of the novel for you so you can review your handiwork.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I've always wanted to be a writer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You rewrote the books and brought down the mood of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: One major revision coming right up.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Imperial Services Organization - the ISO - supplies entertainment services to its citizens abroad in an attempt to shore up their morale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I only possess a partial manifest. It lists several crates of tawdry romance novels, as well as a performing group. The musicians are likely deceased, so your target is the novels.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did I mistake you for someone worthy of this task? What a pity.

localizedTextIdText: Joshua Ripplesmith is running out of gourds to sell. He gets his supply from a grumple that maintains a garden this time of year at the northern tip of Thayd. Visit the grumple and see what's holding up gourd deliveries.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I ain't selling gourds 'till I got gourds to sell. You're welcome to check in with my supplier north side of town though. He's missed his last few deliveries.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: incomplete
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: receiver incomplete
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: achieved
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Reckon I can't sell gourds I don't have. These are for display only. Find my supplier and you'll find your gourds.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: on finish
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: That was weird.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thanks for nothin'. Happy Shade's Eve to you too then.

localizedTextIdText: The Darkspur Cartel has come to the Defile to intercept weapon cases containing parts for a powerful gun being developed by DRED. Ringo Hax has ordered you to find the Darkspur and retrieve the weapon parts, but watch out - the security systems on the crates are malfunctioning.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Ringo Hax in Final Light
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Crates of experimental weapon parts stolen by Darkspur Cartel! Anti-theft measures on fritz or hacked! Recover weapon parts now now now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Weapon parts in crates, understand? Darkspur gangsters stealing crates. You go, get parts back! Is not complicated!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Parts recovered? Darkspur eliminated? Hope so! Very important parts for very important project. The Zax is watching closely!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bring parts back quickly! Maybe extra reward if you not idiot.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not all parts here. Hm. Worried. Maybe look again later.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite the presence of the Darkspur Cartel, you recovered parts for a secret DRED weapons project and returned them to Ringo Hax. Your tenacity and killer instincts have once again paid off for both you and the Dominion.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Corners of Defile, waiting for pick-up. Tracking them not perfect! They use scramblers! Narrowed down to four possible locations in four parts of Defile. Good enough for you. Fan-out with hirelings!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Crates shock thieves. Zap! Also, teleport cargo back to base. Positional tracking. Some parts implode, too. Krogg hack system, escape with crates. System twitchy! Sometimes works, sometimes not. Not Chua-made. If Chua-made, would work.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Experimental weapon. Newer, bigger gun! Made by lucky moron in Grimvault. DRED replicate technology, make better. Still testing, but very powerful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Declination not option. Reconsider answer or I threaten you.

localizedTextIdText: The Darkspur Cartel has come to the Defile to intercept weapon cases containing parts for a powerful gun being developed by DRED. Lulu Blackbush has asked you to find the Darkspur and retrieve the weapon parts before the Dominion can, but watch out - the security systems on the crates are malfunctioning.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lulu Blackbush in Hope's Dare
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Darkspur Cartel's made off with some of DRED's fancy weapon cases, likely with anti-theft systems hooked up. Go get 'em before the Dominion does.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We think them Dommie weapon cases have parts in 'em - parts for an experimental DRED weapon. Go get 'em from the Darkspur, and make it fast!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You get them parts I told you about? I hope you found 'em all, else we may need to go back out there and get the rest of 'em.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you can get 'em back to me quick-like, I'll even pay you extra!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Let me take stock here. Drop on by later if you like.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite the presence of the Darkspur Cartel, you acquired parts for a secret DRED project and took them to Lulu Blackbush. Your tenacity and killer instincts have once again paid off for both you and the Exiles.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They're scattered all over the Defile, waitin' for pick-up. I'm havin' trouble trackin' 'em, 'cause they're usin' some kind of scrambler, but I got it narrowed some. You oughta take some friends and spread out for this one.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: DRED usually loads their stuff with anti-hack stuff. They can teleport back to base and are easy to track. Even the parts inside'll implode if they get stolen. The Krogg must've done somethin' to 'em - the systems ain't gone, but they ain't been turned off, neither!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Intel says DRED's been working on copyin' some ad-hoc weapon developed in Grimvault, near the Breach. This one's supposed to be a new gun made by some lucky grunt out of random parts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Idjit! We've got to deny them cases to both the Dommies and the Darkspur!

localizedTextIdText: Shatterpaw girrok pose a threat to the Exile forces that are currently occupied on the front lines. Lulu Blackbush has asked you to protect the Exile forces by killing any Shatterpaw girrok you find in the Tainted Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lulu Blackbush via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nThe Shatterpaw girrok population in the Tainted Gardens is becoming overly disruptive to military operations and requires aggressive control tactics. Contact Lulu Blackbush for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nThe Shatterpaw girrok population in the Tainted Gardens is becoming overly disruptive to military operations and requires aggressive control tactics. Contact Lulu Blackbush for more information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To protect our troopers on the front lines from the Shatterpaw girrok, someone needs to take the critters down a notch or three.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that our boys 'n' girls don't have to worry about bein' bitten in their backsides, the fightin' can start. Thanks for helpin' us out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Take good care of yourself, friend!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Shatterpaw girrok now pose less of a threat to Exile forces. Thanks to your diligent work, Lulu Blackbush piece of mind has been restored.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They's some of the fiercest killers in all the animal kingdom! They'll shred you to bits as soon as look at you!

localizedTextIdText: Shatterpaw girrok pose a threat to Dominion forces that are currently occupied on the front lines. Nerissa Artan has asked you to protect Dominion forces by killing any Shatterpaw girrok you find in the Tainted Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nerissa Artan via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED\nThe Shatterpaw girrok population in the Tainted Gardens is becoming overly disruptive to military operations and requires aggressive control tactics. Contact Nerissa Artan for more information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nThe Shatterpaw girrok population in the Tainted Gardens is becoming overly disruptive to military operations and requires aggressive control tactics. Contact Nerissa Artan for more information.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our soldiers on the front lines are in harm's way, but now they are also threatened by the Shatterpaw girrok. You must do something about the beasts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Incidents of girrok attack have declined significantly since you completed your mission. The men and women of the Dominion thank you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am sure you and I will see each other again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Shatterpaw girrok now pose less of a threat to Dominion forces. Thanks to your diligent work, Nerissa Artan piece of mind has been restored.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ya lookin' to learn how to shake things up in the kitchen? Then I got what ya need right here. Step on up and you'll be cookin' in no time!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now ya can cook, kid! You got real talent, but don't get cocky. You gotta flip a lotta burgers before you're as good as old Theok!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Chef Theok taught you how to cook, and now the culinary arts are yours to master! Will you be as fine a chef as you are $i(player.class)? Only time will tell!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You look like someone who likes good food. How'd you like to learn to cook? I've got a few minutes, I do, and I think you'd really enjoy it.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're brilliant as Galen in the kitchen, you is! I wager you'll be cookin' for the emperor someday! Remember us little folk when you do, luv!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Chef Cecilia taught you how to cook and now the culinary arts are yours to master! Will you be as fine a chef as you are $i(player.class)? Only time will tell!

localizedTextIdText: Embrace the festive spirit and win two games of Rock 'Em Shock 'Em.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Game Facilitator for a reward.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Why hello! Us bots want to celebrate Shade's Eve too. Come, partake in this splendid game I have created. If you have as much fighting spirit as your ancestors, you are sure to win!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Keep playing!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent energy ball busting! Keep playing as much as you'd like.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just start the game and attack the energy balls floating around. Good luck!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Happy Shade's Eve to you too!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will check out the game.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've won at Rock 'Em Shock 'Em twice! Let the Game Facilitator know.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do the different energy balls do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What are the giant energy beams in the sky?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Victory is achieved when the other team's champion is defeated before yours is. Attack the roaming energy balls to heal your champion and damage the opponents'.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Blue balls - Yield = 15 points health restoration. Red balls - Yield = 20 points damage. Orange balls - Yield = 40 points damage. Pink Energy - Unstable - Avoid if possible.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The energy beams are a scoreboard. If one team's champion has more health, the beam for that champion will be longer. If the beams are the same length, then the game is tied.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But but.. it's a holiday and I put sooo much work into building this game for everyone. I stand here all day just waiting for people to play..

localizedTextIdTitle: Ale's Cold in Love and War [GROUP 5+]
localizedTextIdText: Brewmeister Portolus has been tending the mini-bar at Final Light, but he's starting to run low on ale. Help him collect the necessary ingredients - barley, hops, and super-chilled cubes - in the vicinity of the Black Focus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Brewmeister Portolus at Final Light
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Me kegs is runnin' low again, and there's plenty of thirsts to quench. Might you be willin' to fetch me some ingredients? I'd be thankful, I would.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The soil near the Black Focus is right fertile, it is. Plenty of good hops and barley there, likely fed by blood and watered with tears.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh, this is the stuff. Tastes just like me dad's recipe, it does!  When I run out - and I will, by Dominus - will you come back and help me again?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Strike a light! A life saver, you is. Soldiers get testy when they's sober!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ain't you a helpful sort? May the light of the Scions be upon you, mate!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned to Brewmeister Portolus with a fresh batch of ale. Though it should last him a few days, he may need you to go on another run sometime soon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What kind of ingredients do you need?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The usual, right? Barley, hops, and ice, if you can find it. The barley and hops under the Black Focus is heady stuff, it is!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now don't go and tell me you's too high and mighty for ale, mate.

localizedTextIdTitle: Ale's Cold in Love and War [GROUP 5+]
localizedTextIdText: Brewmaster Bluno has been tending the mini-bar at Hope's Dare, but he's starting to run low on ale. Help him collect the necessary ingredients - barley, hops, and super-chilled cubes - in the vicinity of the Black Focus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Brewmaster Bluno at Hope's Dare
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My kegs're runnin' low again. I don't wanna think about what these guys'll do if I run out. You got a problem gettin' some more ingredients for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The soil around the Black Focus is pretty good, all things considered. Your best bet for ale ingredients is beneath those terrorformers. Hustle up!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You did real good, bub. I'll keep these folks nice 'n' drunk for a few more days. I'll probably run out again, so you might wanna check back soon.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're a real sport. I'll make sure ya get the first mug of the new brew!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lemme tell ya, the Defile's the last place I expected to see quality hops.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You returned to Brewmaster Bluno with a fresh batch of ale. Though it should last him a few days, he may need you to go on another run sometime soon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What kind of ingredients do you need?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Barley, hops, and maybe ice or somethin' like it. You should be able to find 'em near the Black Focus. I just hope they make good ale.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Watch your ass, pal. If I run out, I'm tellin' the troops it's your fault.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Var-Doph would like you to use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg out in Gamma Fields for his customers at On the Rocks in Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Var-Doph at On the Rocks in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Cosmolings and Cosmotails are delicious, but customers pay top dollar for the rare and dangerous Cosmogrub. Would you like to find me some?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yumm! My customers will be abuzz over this delicious treat!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent. Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't be a stranger!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg in Gamma Fields for Bartender Var-Doph and his customers at On the Rocks in Graylight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The pay will make it worth your time. You'll be back.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Waz-Len would like you to use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg out in Gamma Fields for his customers at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Waz-Len at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Cosmolings and Cosmotails are delicious, but customers pay top dollar for the rare and dangerous Cosmogrub. Would you like to find me some?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yumm! My customers will be abuzz over this delicious treat!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent. Head out to the Gamma Fields and use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to keep them fresh... to death!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't be a stranger!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You use the Cosmogrub Cryoflash to capture Cosmogrub splorg in the Gamma Fields for Bartender Waz-Len and his customers at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The pay will make it worth your time. You'll be back.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Var-Doph would like you to capture Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for his customers at On the Rocks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Var-Doph at On the Rocks in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Much like the Cosmoling, the Cosmotail are delicious. Unfortunatly, it's hard keeping a supply of Cosmotail when they float away so easily. Mind catching some for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, thank you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for Bartender Var-Doph.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess you're not hungry then.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Waz-Len would like you to capture Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for his customers at the High Orbit Lounge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Waz-Len at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Much like the Cosmoling, the Cosmotail are delicious. Unfortunatly, it's hard keeping a supply of Cosmotail when they float away so easily. Mind catching some for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you, thank you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Jump around and get close!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You captured Cosmotail Floaters floating around Graylight using the Cosmotail Cryoflash for Bartender Var-Doph.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What else are you going to do.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Var-Doph would like you to capture Cosmoling Crawlers that are scattered around Graylight using the Cosmoling Cryoflash for his customers at On the Rocks.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Var-Doph at On the Rocks in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Cosmolings running around are delicious, but in this atmosphere they lose their nutrition quickly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you could flash freeze some Cosmolings for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great! My customers will love these.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you could flash freeze some for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll have more work for you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They won't get away from me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You used the Cosmoling Cryoflash to capture Cosmoling Crawlers around Graylight for Bartender Var-Doph.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then I will get help elsewhere.

localizedTextIdText: Bartender Waz-Len would like you to capture Cosmoling Crawlers that are scattered around Graylight using the Cosmoling Cryoflash for his customers at the High Orbit Lounge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bartender Waz-Len at the High Orbit Lounge in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: These Cosmolings running around are delicious, but in this atmosphere they lose their nutrition quickly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you could flash freeze some for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Great! My customers will love these.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If you could flash freeze some for me and bring them back, that would be excellent.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll have more work for you!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They won't get away from me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You use the Cosmoling Cryoflash to capture Cosmoling Crawlers around Graylight for Bartender Waz-Len.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're missing out.

localizedTextIdText: The turrets around Graylight have run low on power again and Bron Goldenhand wants you to use a shield disruptor to disable the barriers around the Blackburn rocket turrets in the Isofringe and then take their energy cells. Once you've acquired the energy cells, head back to Graylight and power up the turrets.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I ain't gotten round ta hirin' anyone to take care of these turrets yet so your gonna have to go back to the Blackburn camp and get some more energy cells.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Make sure to use that EMP blaster to take down the shields on the rocket turrets. Then it's easy pickings from there. Take the energy cells and bring 'em here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice job. Time to configure the targeting systems and we'll be in control of the skies over Graylight. These cells don't last long, I may need ya to get more later.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't forget to blast those shields with the EMP blaster first.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You disabled the Blackburn rocket turrets around the Isofringe and brought the energy cells back to power up turrets for Bron Goldenhand in Graylight.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you want energy cells?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The last thug I hired to maintain the turrets in Graylight is no longer employed and is in no condition to do... work. So the cells in my turrets have gone bad and need to be replaced.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And I thought we was gettin' to be friends!

localizedTextIdTitle: Idols of Gold and Illicit Fortune
localizedTextIdText: Bron wants you to recover as many of his golden idols as possible from the Fetterton's Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I still don't have all my Golden Idols back from those bandits! So guess what, you're gonna go to the Fetterton camp and get them back for me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You are gonna get my prized idols back, and I mean right away! Find the rest of them in the Fetterton bandit camp and send 'em home where they belong.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good job! Still not all of it but enough for today! I suppose I'll give ya a little taste for the shippin' and all!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good answer!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and retrieved several golden idols that were stolen by the Swiftfell bandits. It's unclear if Bron intends to sell the idols or just decorate his elaborate store rooms with them.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Bet Bron will be glad to get this back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me put you on my list!

localizedTextIdText: The bandits in Swiftfell Ridge, Blackburn Downs, and Fetterton's Hollow used to work for Bron Goldenhand, until they stole his recipe and started undercutting his operations. Bron Goldenhand while happy with your previous efforts wants you to kill even more bandits in Swiftfell Ridge and Blackburn Downs to prove a point.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those bandits are gettin' uppity again, so I want ya to go out and bust em up some more! Really let em know how painful it is to cross me!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why are you back here talking to me? Get back out there and beat down every last bandit you find in the Isofringe.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now that makes me feel all warm and fuzzy deep down inside. You're almost getting me to like ya!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't ya be showing any mercy now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We're not done yet.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll teach those bandits a lesson!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think they got the picture!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed bandits in Swiftfell Ridge, Blackburn Downs, and Fetterton's Hollow making Bron Goldenhand a happy man, but he's not done with you yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll teach those bandits a lesson!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: They're gonna pay for crossing me; don't make me add you to my list.

localizedTextIdText: Hunt-Master Suranti wants you to kill Cerebral, a massive orbitog that is known to wander the Spectrosphere.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hunters beware!\nBig orbitog roaming near Anu Ani - nearly squashed Hunt-Master Suranti! Don't hunt Cerebral alone, it too tough for one lopp.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You hunting Cerebral? Take many friends or end up squashed!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You hunt big orbitog? Lopp very, very grateful! That one nearly squash lopp once. Good it gone now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good luck hunting!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It was nothing too big to handle.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Borellian Cluster's deadliest orbitog, Cerebral, for Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani.

localizedTextIdText: Requisitions Officer Drazkar wants you to rescue the Missing Worker from the Crystal Caverns.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Requisitions Officer Drazkar in DREDplex: Eclipse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our engineering and science teams went in to the mines and haven't returned. We can't face the Voidterror until we get our platform built, and for that we need bodies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without our teams there is no platform, and no chance of crushing the Voidterror. Go to the mines and find our missing workers, else our presence here is wasted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent! Your might is impressive and now we can continue work on the barrier and assault platform. Soon the Voidterror will be within our grasp.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You navigated the dangerous Crystal Caverns and freed the troubled scientists and engineers necessary to build up the Dominion's base of operations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A pity your cowardice runs so deep.

localizedTextIdText: Supply Officer Kagga wants you to rescue the Missing Worker from the Crystal Caverns
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Supply Officer Kagga in Moonwane Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our engineerin and science teams went to the mines and haven't returned. We can't face the Voidterror until we get our platform built, and for that we need bodies.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without our teams we got no chance of crushing the Voidterror. Go to the mines and find our missing workers, pronto.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Alright, you got guts. Now we can start work on the barrier and assault platform. Soon the Voidterror will be within our grasp.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You navigated the dangerous Crystal Caverns and freed the troubled scientists and engineers necessary to build up the Exile's base of operations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Didn't figure ya for such a lightweight.

localizedTextIdText: You've found the Lopp in Anu Ani are untrusting of outsiders. You must collect Aetherwing Fledgling Glands and $(vitem=99) in order to create an Aetherbrew, a local Anu Ani beverage that should help calm their nerves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Kaysa the Wise in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some Lopp have shiny fever that makes Lopp crazy. I invent Aetherbrew to cure it. Big-folk bring ingredients and give to Lopp.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Lopp need Aetherbrew to calm nerves. Hunt
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You help Lopp with shiny fever problem? Some Lopp hysterical about shinies so I invent Aetherbrew to cure them. Just need pollen and Aetherwing glands.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aetherbrew works! Knocks Lopp right out. Lopp in Anu Ani much calmer now without shiny fever.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Find many ingredients for Lopp!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Lopp grateful.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: If you think I can help.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: At least some Lopp calmed down.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Kaysa the Wise calm down the agitated Lopp afflicted with shiny fever by serving them Aetherbrew. There were some unfortunate side effects, but for the most part it calmed them down.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Some Lopp take quest for shinies too far. They get shine-fever and stop thinking about anything but shinies. This condition not good for village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Lopp need nerves calmed. I make Aetherbrew and serve to Lopp. Maybe make shine-fever subside.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big-folk stay stranger. Lopp not trust!

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax wants you to recover their $(vitem=1169) that were eaten by Irongut out in the Spectrosphere.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax in DREDplex: Eclipse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Operation to capture the Voidterror in shambles! Skug queen eat tools. Go hurt Irongut till tools pop out. Go go go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Minion has returned but my tools are still missing. Hurry, find Irongut and make it give tools back.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, Mondo chose wise minion. Now we continue construction on great project to capture the Voidterror.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the $(vitem=1169) from Irongut and brought them back to help Mondo Zax efforts to build a device capable of fighting the Voidterror and capturing it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Big space creature lurks on nearby asteroid, but particle shielding too strong to assault. Voidterror can survive in such a potent particle field, as such is specimen of great interest.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Mondo has no use for weak minions. Scram!

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin wants you to recover their $(vitem=1169) that were eaten by Irongut out in the Spectrosphere.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin in Moonwane Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our operation to capture the Voidterror is in disarray! First we must find my construction tools. Irongut ate them and ran off into the Spectrosphere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you return when you mission is still unfinished. Find my tools and return them to me. Punish the Irongut until it coughs them up.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good. With my tools here we can now begin to make progress on our mission to capture the Voidterror.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered the $(vitem=1169) from Irongut and brought them back to help Victor Lazarin efforts to build a device capable of fighting the Voidterror and capturing it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a large creature that resides on a nearby asteroid. It emits a particle shield that is far to strong to assault form a distance. A being that can generate such an anomaly is of great interist to me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: May death and dispair find you.

localizedTextIdText: Requisitions Officer Drazkar wants you to collect Holyward from Buzzbing Hive in Solarswep Pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Requisitions Officer Drazkar in DREDplex: Eclipse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's dangerous this close to the Voidterror. We need Solarswept Resin to shore up the barrier lest our scientists and engineers get ravaged.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We still need materials for the barrier. I've heard of Solarswept Resin, an adhesives far stronger than what we possess. Seek it in Solarswep Pass.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah yes, this tar will make a formidable construction material. We make excellent progress on the barrier.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Requisitions Officer Drazkar was pleased with the materials you gathered, and shored up construction on the barrier meant to protect the encampment from the Voidterror's attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If even this task daunts you, I have no use for your.

localizedTextIdText: Supply Officer Kagga wants you to collect Holyward from Buzzbing Hive in Solarswep Pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Supply Officer Kagga in Moonwane Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's downright crazy this close to the Voidterror. Go get some Solarswept Resin to shore up the barrier before our scientists and engineers get blown to bits.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where's my Solarswept Resin? Without it our barriers will fall to pieces. Get to those buzzbing hives and get it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So maybe you do know what your doin. This tar will shore up any weak points in our barriers.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Supply Officer Kagga was pleased with the materials you gathered, and shored up construction on the barrier meant to protect the encampment from the Voidterror's attacks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I wasn't exactly asking.

localizedTextIdText: Requisitions Officer Drazkar wants you to collect Blaster from Ship Plating by blasting them with Anti-Ship Rockets in Deadstar Valley.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Requisitions Officer Drazkar in DREDplex: Eclipse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need the strongest materials to see this construction through. There's a rare alloy called Nyphillium used in ship plating. Use this jetpack and collect some form Deadstar Valley.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why do you dither? We need the Nyphillium alloy or our construction efforts will be blasted to space dust! Find it in the Deadstar Valley, and bring it here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is a great haul of materials! You've done well and now we shall build up the launch catapult and barrier.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Blaster you recovered the barrier and launch platform are closer to completion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A pity. I've met more formidable slanks!

localizedTextIdText: Supply Officer Kagga wants you to collect Blaster from Ship Plating by blasting them with Anti-Ship Rockets in Deadstar Valley.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Supply Officer Kagga in Moonwane Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We still need stronger materials to make this platform. There's a rare alloy called Nyphillium used in ship plating. Take this jetpack and collect some fom Deadstar Valley.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need the Nyphillium alloy or our construction efforts will break after the fist hit! Find it in the Deadstar Valley, and bring it here.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Quite a haul! You done good, now it's time for us to get crackin on that construction.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Blaster you recovered the barrier and launch platform are closer to completion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Seems like I might have misheard that.

localizedTextIdText: Gemologist Arnaxia wants you to collect Greatsword of the Accord{p: Greatswords of the Accord} from the Crystal Caverns. She believes she can harness the energy from these to create defensive measures to combat the Voidterror.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Gemologist Arnaxia in DREDplex: Eclipse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Voidterror is protected by a vortex of powerful particles. To safely deflect these we must try processing lunacite shards into a protective coating.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well how's it coming with that lunacite? Without it you wouldn't stand a chance against that particle barrier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, these lunacite samples will prove valuable indeed. With fine-tuning we can deflect the hazardous particles and have safe passage to the Voidterror's asteroid.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Greatsword of the Accord{p: Greatswords of the Accord} were of great interest to Gemologist Arnaxia and will be immeasurable in battling the Voidterror.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought this request was well within reason.

localizedTextIdText: Researcher Waren wants you to collect Greatsword of the Accord{p: Greatswords of the Accord} from the Crystal Caverns. She believes she can harness the energy from these to create defensive measures to combat the Voidterror.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Researcher Waren in Moonwane Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Voidterror's particle barrier is quite impressive, but we have found that lunacite goes right through it. Get us that lunacite and we'll get ya up there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well how's it comin on that lunacite? Without it you wouldn't stand a chance against that particle barrier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, samples will prove valuable indeed. With some fine-tuning we can bypass that particle barrier and put ya right on the Voidterror's asteroid.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Greatsword of the Accord{p: Greatswords of the Accord} were of great interest to Researcher Waren and will be immeasurable in battling the Voidterror.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought this request was well within reason.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax wants you to collect Bacchanal Probe by falling through Primal Energy Balls after using Primal Pocket in Spectrosphere.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Mondo Zax in DREDplex: Eclipse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We need great power in a tiny space. I heard of dangerous Primal Energy nearby that could work, or destroy us all. Risk is worth it to stop strain and capture Voidterror.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We need Primal Energy. Only fuel available such short notice. Go extract it now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes! I see great promise and soon we all launch to stop Voidterror for good!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find a way to get that energy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That was not as easy as I thought.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Bacchanal Probe you harvested has been put to use in preparing the launcher for use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bad time for minion to surrender. Reconsider?

localizedTextIdText: Victor Lazarin wants you to collect Bacchanal Probe by falling through Primal Energy Balls after using Primal Pocket in Spectrosphere
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Victor Lazarin in Moonwane Enclave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our energy needs are quite substantial. I have heard that there is Primal Energy nearby that could meet our needs.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Our need for Primal Energy has not changed.  Go extract it now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah yes. I see you have retrieved the Primal Energy. I hope it was not too painfull.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll find a way to get that energy.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That was not as easy as I thought.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Bacchanal Probe you harvested has been put to use in preparing the launcher for use.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Perhaps you misunderstood the question.

localizedTextIdText: Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani wants you to bring him the innards of terminites and skug. He believes they could make interesting shinies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Exile's Jacket to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp busy seeking shinies, but Lopp sometimes must eat too. Lopp thinks terminites have tasty meat hidden inside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp stomach still rumble. So hungry! You find big bug creatures and pop them open, see what meat inside!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very slimy but delicious. This will feed village for today!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp very pleased you agree.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Have good travels!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the Exile's Jacket to Hunt-Master Suranti of Anu Ani. He seemed to be pleased with the haul.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp not have tasty food now. Lopp wait for you to change mind!

localizedTextIdText: Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani wants you to bring him the innards of medusas. He believes they could make interesting shinies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Felidax Slacks to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp busy seeking shinies, but Lopp sometimes must eat too. Lopp think medusa have tasty meat.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp stomach still rumble. So hungry! You find floaty pink creatures and see what meat inside!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Very stringy and delicious pieces. This will feed village for tday!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp very pleased you agree.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Have good travels!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the Felidax Slacks to Hunt-Master Suranti of Anu Ani. He seemed to be pleased with the haul.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp not have tasty food now. Lopp wait for you to change mind!

localizedTextIdText: Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani wants you to bring him the innards of orbitogs. He believes they could make interesting shinies.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return the Exile's Treads{p: Exile's Treads} to Hunt-Master Suranti in Anu Ani
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Lopp busy seeking shinies, but Lopp sometimes must eat too. Lopp think orbitog have tasty meat hidden inside.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Lopp stomach still rumble. So hungry! You find big jiggly brain creatures and, see what meat inside!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Still very jiggly, like jelly, very delicious. This will feed village for today!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp very pleased you agree.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Have good travels!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered the Exile's Treads{p: Exile's Treads} to Hunt-Master Suranti of Anu Ani. He seemed to be pleased with the haul.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll see what I can find.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Lopp not have tasty food now. Lopp wait for you to change mind!

localizedTextIdText: Chief Kabay in Anu Ani wants you to recover their Stolen Shinies from the Bloodrock Butchers in Bloodrock Encampment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Chief Kabay over the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bloodrock keep stealing Lopp shinies. You go and get them back, yes!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You get back shinies yet? Go north of Anu Ani, bring Lopp shinies back!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You brought back Lopp shinies! You great friend to Lopp.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please bring back all the shinies!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You make Lopp happy!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Chief Kabay at Anu Ani recover some of their precious shinies from the Bloodrock Butchers.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If not here help to Lopp, stop bothering Lopp!

localizedTextIdText: Chief Kabay in Anu Ani wants you kill the Bloodrock mercs in Bloodrock Encampment to get revenge for the Lopp.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Chief Kabay via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bloodrock Butchers betray Lopp. You help Lopp kill them?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go Bloodrock camp north of Anu Ani and, put spear through Bloodrock guts many times!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You good Lopp friend! Maybe you help hurt Bloodrock again sometime.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Lopp must have revenge and shinies!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can find out.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took out quite a few Bloodrock mercs and Chief Kabay was quite pleased with your efforts for today.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Why you tease Lopp? You want to be Lopp stew?

localizedTextIdText: Bron Goldenhand would like you to collect Smuggled Goods form a smuggler's dead drops located around Graylight. Be warned that many of them are probably booby trapped.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Some smugglers been tryin to move stuff without paying me my cut. Here's a map of his dead drop locations. Now get me my cut, which is everythin.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Go out and look in them dead drops and bring me anythin of value! How hard is that?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent work, now your a little richer and I'm a lot richer. I'll let ya know when I need another shipment found.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Watch out I'm sure he booby trapped some of those dead drops.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to collect the Smuggled Goods from the dead drops in Graylight and delivered the goods to Bron. Of course there will always be more smugglers trying to cut Bron out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Guess I have to find another expendable idiot to do some grunt work!

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Illium requests the assistance of Dominion citizens to aid Professor Stephanus's research in the Defile. If interested, you should proceed to Research Station X-22 at once and report to Professor Stephanus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Professor Stephanus at Research Station X-22
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ASSISTANCE REQUIRED\nProfessor Stephanus at Research Station X-22 is seeking a capable assistant. Proceed to the Defile at once and report for duty.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ASSISTANCE REQUIRED\nProfessor Stephanus at Research Station X-22 is seeking a capable assistant. Proceed to the Defile at once and report for duty.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You must be responding to the job posting.  If only you had arrived earlier, but there is nothing to be done about that. Are you ready to start?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Very well, let us begin.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Research Station X-22 in the Defile and offered your services to Professor Stephanus.

localizedTextIdText: A job posting in Thayd calls on Exiles to aid Specialist Trinette efforts in the Defile. If interested, you should proceed to Inspiration Point at once and report to Specialist Trinette.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Specialist Trinette at Inspiration Point
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ASSISTANCE REQUIRED\nSpecialist Trinette at Inspiration Point is seeking a capable assistant. Proceed to the Defile at once and report for duty.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ASSISTANCE REQUIRED\nSpecialist Trinette at Inspiration Point is seeking a capable assistant. Proceed to the Defile at once and report for duty.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've come about the job? That's great! I been waitin' on someone to show up for a good while now. I almost gave up completely.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're an eager one, ain't ya? Not that I mind.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Inspiration Point in the Defile and offered your services to Specialist Trinette.

localizedTextIdText: Fenyth Wildsoul is concerned by the appearance of will o' whims in the Arborian Gardens. The unusual appearance of these plants - which are related to whimfiber flowers - causes them to be confused with ghosts. Gather a few will o' whims for Fenyth Wildsoul so he can prove that they aren't ghosts, after all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Fenyth Wildsoul in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: People are panicking! They think will o' whims are ghosts, but they're really just plants. Bring me some will o' whims and maybe I can calm folks down.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I need more of those will o' whims so I can prove that they're just a type of plant. You can find them all around the Arborian Gardens.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whoa! What happened to you? So... the will o' whims can make you transparent? No wonder there's all these ghost sightings! I'll let the guards know.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We better get this taken care of before the panic gets any worse!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have no idea. Make the best of it, I say. It is Shade's Eve, after all!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though the will o' whims certainly had an effect on your personal transparency, you were able to provide Fenyth Wildsoul with the samples he wanted. Once he conveys that information to Thayd's population, the panic should die down.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get those will o' whims.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How can people be afraid of plants?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What will you do with them?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Can you describe them?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: In the dark, will o' whims look pretty freaky. Plus, it's Shade's Eve, and everyone's all worked up by tales of ghosts, plagues, and Jack Shade.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's a relative of the whimfiber flower. They're see-through, glowy, and they float, so naturally the chroniclers started calling them "will o' whims" due to some Cassian legend.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I need to prove that will o' whims are harmless plants, not ghosts. I'll use the ones you collect as samples, so people can see what they're really afraid of.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: There's one here, right next to me. It's a little on the small side, but someone brought it to me this morning, saying it was a ghost. I mean, seriously...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: They're all over the Arborian Gardens. Check on top of trees, bushes, and elevated locations. Fence posts, trees, even the hoogle rocks.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I told you! They're not ghosts, they're plants! What're you afraid of?

localizedTextIdText: Sergeant Akida is concerned by the appearance of will o' whims on Legion's Way. The unusual appearance of these plants - which are related to whimfiber flowers - causes them to be confused with shades. Gather a few will o' whims for Sergeant Akida so she can prove that they aren't shades, after all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sergeant Akida at the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The skittishness of some citizens sickens me! By Ravok, they mistake will o' whims for shades! Bring me these floating plants so I can end the panic.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Catch as many will o' whims as you can and bring them to me. Then I can prove to our more excitable citizens that they aren't shades.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wind and shadows! I can see right through you, $(player.name)! Perhaps that's why Illium's residents are reporting so many ghost sightings...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: With the way they carry on, you'd think the citizens of Illium were infants.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must take our findings to the guards before another panic breaks out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope this washes off easily.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Though the will o' whims certainly had an effect on your personal transparency, you were able to provide Sergeant Akida with the samples she wanted. Once she conveys that information to Illium's population, the panic should die down.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll bring you will o' whims.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How can people be afraid of plants?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What will you do with them?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Can you describe them?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: In the dark, will o' whims appear frightening to some. It's also Shade's Eve, and everyone is on edge due to tales of ghosts, plagues, and Jack Shade.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's a relative of the whimfiber flower. The plants are see-through, phosphorescent, and they float. The lowborn call them "will o' whims" due to some inane Cassian legend.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I must prove that will o' whims are harmless plants, not shades. I'll use the ones you collect as samples, so these grown children can see what they're really afraid of.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: There's one next to me. It's smaller than the others. A citizen brought it to me this morning, saying it was a shade. What a fool!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: Legion's Way is infested with them. Look for them atop trees, bushes, roofs, and walls.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Bah! Don't tell me you believe will o' whims are ghosts, too!

localizedTextIdText: Chronicler Witchmoss has erected a series of memorials to the Angel around FCON Headquarters as part of the annual Angel's Pilgrimage. Locate the memorials and perform the proper ritual at each one to complete your pilgrimage.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Chronicler Witchmoss in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We Exiles ain't usually spiritual types, but there's one Cassian tradition we've kept - the Angel's Pilgrimage. How'd you like to join in?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya finished the Angel's Pilgrimage yet, friend? All ya got to do is find each of the memorials and perform the proper rite at each one.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If it wasn't for the Angel, none of us humans would be here right now. Sometimes we need to put it all in perspective and remind ourselves of that.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I got some directions for ya, friend. Follow 'em exactly and you'll be fine.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Never forget - we owe the Angel our lives, and those of our ancestors.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Chronicler Witchmoss sent you to perform the Angel's Pilgrimage in Thayd. By performing the pilgrimage, you've been reminded of the devastation the plague left in its wake. You've also learned that hope can be found in even the greatest of tragedies.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Not many of us Exiles are, but this ain't no Vigilant Church nonsense. The Angel's Pilgrimage goes way back, before the Dominion was even formed. It's a way to remember what the Angel did for my people.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Pay a visit to each memorial, and perform the proper ritual at each of them. There are four memorials - the Spectre of Despair, the Font of Shed Tears, the Grave of the Masses, and the Memory of the Savior.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Let's see... you have to kneel before the Spectre of Despair, drink from the Font of Shed Tears, cry at the Grave of the Masses, and bow before the Memory of the Savior.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This ain't the Vigilant Church. No one's goin' to make ya if ya don't want to.

localizedTextIdText: The Vigilant Church in Fate's Landing erected a series of memorials to the Angel as part of the annual Angel's Pilgrimage tradition. Acolyte Vesperus instructed you on the actions to perform at each site to complete the ritual in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Acolyte Vesperus at the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All pious citizens must undergo the Angel's Pilgrimage during the Shade's Eve festival. May I guide you on your path to deeper spiritual understanding?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To complete the Angel's Pilgrimage, you must locate the four memorials and perform the proper rite at each one. Doing so will illuminate you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Angel sacrificed herself so that the Cassian people would not be extinguished by the plague. Remember that in each tragedy, there is always hope.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Heed my instructions. Shore up your faith and do exactly as I say.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Go with the light of the Scions, citizen, and be at peace.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Angel's Pilgrimage is a stark reminder of the cost that the plague left behind, but also the mercy of the Angel who gave her life for the great Cassian people.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Visit to each memorial in Fate's Landing and perform the proper ritual at each of them. There are four memorials - the Spectre of Despair, the Font of Shed Tears, the Grave of the Masses, and the Memory of the Savior.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They are simple. You must kneel before the Spectre of Despair, drink from the Font of Shed Tears, cry at the Grave of the Masses, and bow before the Memory of the Savior.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do you deny the holy nature of the Vigilant Church? For shame!

localizedTextIdText: Aloysius Moon wants you to travel to Anu Ani Village and assess whether the Lopp have found the treasure from a crashed ship.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Aloysius Moon in Graylight via Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bron's got the Bloodrock Butchers lookin' for a treasure ship that crashed somewhere in the Borellian Cluster. Problem is the Lopp are after it too so you better check it out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That treasure hasn't made it to our coffers yet. I need you to go to that trite Lopp village up north and make sure they don't have it all.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well if the Lopp don't have it and the butchers haven't paid up yet, where is it? Bah, I don't care who finds the bloody treasure just make sure we get a cut.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just make sure those long ears don't cut in to our profits.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm sure you'll get your cut.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Lopp of Anu Ani appear haven't located the treasure of the crashed ship yet. Bron Goldenhand will be satisfied as long as he gets his cut, whether from the Lopp or the Bloodrock Butchers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Some spoiled Dominion noble got his cargo ship hijacked by marauders. Only thing is they didn't reckon with flyin' through an asteroid belt. Rumor the wreckage and the treasure are nearby.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If there's treasure on this cluster then part of it is gonna be ours.

localizedTextIdText: Commander Durek has provided you with a list of the most dangerous creatures on Nexus. He intends for you to track down and kill twelve of the beasts in order to make Nexus a safer place for the Exiles. As an added bonus, you can collect their partial patterns while you're at it. It won't be easy, but if anyone can do it, it's you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Durek via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This planet's got a helluva lot of dangerous creatures crawlin' on it. If I give ya a list of 'em, can ya kill at least twelve of the bastards?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Didn't I tell ya to kill at least twelve of those critters? Not one, not four, but twelve. Ya better get yer keister in gear before I give it a kick.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya done good, kid, and made this old boulder proud. With those beasts outta the way, we'll be runnin' this planet in no time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Alright! Now get yer ass out there and make this old rock proud!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'm puttin' your name in for an honest-to-Gnox medal, kid. Good work!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and defeated twelve of the most powerful creatures on planet Nexus. Hell of a job, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought ya had a backbone. Guess I was wrong.

localizedTextIdText: Kezrek Warbringer has provided you with a list of the most dangerous creatures on Nexus. He intends for you to track down and kill twelve of the beasts in order to make Nexus a safer place for the Dominion. As an added bonus, you can collect their partial patterns while you're at it. It won't be easy, but if anyone can do it, it's you.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Kezrek Warbringer via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nexus is host to many formidable foes. The Dominion is looking for fearless hunters to track and kill them. Take this list and find the beasts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your hunt is far from over and my patience grows thin. Kill twelve of the most powerful creatures on Nexus or your name will be tarnished for generations to come.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased with your skill, $(player.name). In time you may even surpass my own prowess on the battlefield. Until then, I commend you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope you are prepared for the hunt of a lifetime, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Should that day ever come, I will not prove so easy to defeat.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: You can count on me, General.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found and defeated twelve of the most powerful creatures on planet Nexus. Hell of a job, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What a sniveling weakling you've turned out to be. Get out of my sight!

localizedTextIdTitle: IMBUEMENT TEST: Do The Stuff 3: The Undoing

localizedTextIdText: Build your renown across Nexus by earning Gold Medals in Prime Expeditions!
Prove your elitism by completing all the optional objectives of the Ultimate Protogames at least once, while wearing the Officially Licensed Ultimate Protogames Mantle.

Advertise the Officially Licensed Protogames Mantle by taking out tough enemies throughout Nexus. Killing creatures during public events should draw enough attention. Drink Protogames Beverages or emote as you defeat your foes for extra credit!

Phineas A. Rotostar has asked you to track down Protostar's Concealed Reconnaissance Bauble. Find them secretly recording encounters in Veteran Adventures and Prime Dungeons. Use the $(spell=79308) to reveal them!
Earn a Gold Medal in the Ultimate Protogames.

The Angel of Shade's Eve legend has appeared in Shindig Hollow, and has asked you to help her stop a new evil that is rising on Nexus. You must take a portal to a dark, mysterious island, discover the nature of the evil, and put an end to it before it can affect the rest of the planet.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to The Angel in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need your help, for a new evil is rising on Nexus. I don't know what it is yet, but we need to learn the truth and put a stop to it. Will you help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The evil I spoke of still looms like a shadow over the entire planet. If we can't stop it, I have a feeling that all of Nexus will be in danger!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done it, $(player.name)! You beat the Cult of the Shades and stopped their plan to spread a new Shades plague. I can't thank you enough!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The nearby portal will take you to our destination. I'll meet you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The people of Nexus will sleep easier now, and I will be watching over you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help you stop this new evil.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You're welcome. It had to be done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the village of Quiet Downs and discovered the Cult of the Shades - a mad religious sect devoted to the service of the legendary Jack Shade. The cult intended to unleash a new Shades plague upon Nexus, but with the Angel's guidance you were able to put an end to their wicked plan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You're a ghost? How can this be?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What was it like back then?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: How did they find a cure?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I can't remember my name. The legends of Cassus call me the Angel. I died when the Shades ravaged my homeworld, but my sacrifice helped put an end to the plague.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The time of the Shades plague was horrible, and many died. The strong emotions of such a terrible event remain, even after many centuries have passed. I am an echo of those emotions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: No one knows, but its first victim came to be known as Jack Shade. "Jack" was a poor man who died in terrible pain, but not before he infected many others. Though it wasn't truly his fault, myth and legend have turned Jack Shade into a bogeyman - a symbol for all the terrible things that happened so long ago.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: It was a very scary time. Everyone who caught the Shades, as it was called, died within hours. The fear of death brought out the very worst in some people... as well as the very best.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: They found the cure inside me. Somehow, I couldn't catch the plague. Doctors used my blood to make medicine that kept others from catching it, but I was so small and weak. The more of my blood they took for the medicine, the weaker I became. I didn't survive, but my sacrifice saved many, many lives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This isn't a Shade's Eve prank. Please! Something terrible is about to happen!

localizedTextIdText: The Angel of Shade's Eve legend has appeared in the Parade Grounds, and has asked you to help her stop a new evil that is rising on Nexus. You must take a portal to a dark, mysterious island, discover the nature of the evil, and put an end to it before it can affect the rest of the planet.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to The Angel in the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I need your help, for a new evil is rising on Nexus. I don't know what it is yet, but we need to learn the truth and put a stop to it. Will you help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The evil I spoke of still looms like a shadow over the entire planet. If we can't stop it, I have a feeling that all of Nexus will be in danger!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've done it, $(player.name)! You beat the Cult of the Shades and stopped their plan to spread a new Shades plague. I can't thank you enough!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The nearby portal will take you to our destination. I'll meet you there.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The people of Nexus will sleep easier now, and I will be watching over you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll help you stop this new evil.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You're welcome. It had to be done.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the village of Quiet Downs and discovered the Cult of the Shades - a mad religious sect devoted to the service of the legendary Jack Shade. The cult intended to unleash a new Shades plague upon Nexus, but with the Angel's guidance you were able to put an end to their wicked plan.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You're a ghost? How can this be?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: What was it like back then?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: How did they find a cure?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I can't remember my name. The legends of Cassus call me the Angel. I died when the Shades ravaged my homeworld, but my sacrifice helped put an end to the plague.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The time of the Shades plague was horrible, and many died. The strong emotions of such a terrible event remain, even after many centuries have passed. I am an echo of those emotions.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: No one knows, but its first victim came to be known as Jack Shade. "Jack" was a poor man who died in terrible pain, but not before he infected many others. Though it wasn't truly his fault, myth and legend have turned Jack Shade into a bogeyman - a symbol for all the terrible things that happened so long ago.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: It was a very scary time. Everyone who caught the Shades, as it was called, died within hours. The fear of death brought out the very worst in some people... as well as the very best.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: They found the cure inside me. Somehow, I couldn't catch the plague. Doctors used my blood to make medicine that kept others from catching it, but I was so small and weak. The more of my blood they took for the medicine, the weaker I became. I didn't survive, but my sacrifice saved many, many lives.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This isn't a Shade's Eve prank. Please! Something terrible is about to happen!

localizedTextIdText: In order to defeat the Entity, the Exiles must band together. You have been asked by Drusera to speak with the Exile leaders and garner their support. Travel to Thayd and speak with Commander Durek.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Commander Durek in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles must stand together if they hope to find a way to defeat the Entity. Will you go to Thayd for me and speak with the Exile leaders?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken with Durek yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You wanna know what I think? Granok don't back down from a fight. Ever. If the Entity wants a fight, we'll bring it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you, $(player.name). I only hope the others will feel the same way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Commander Durek who indicated his support for Drusera. The battle-hardened Granok seemed more than eager to jump into the fray against the Entity.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why did you hide the truth from me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you hope the Exiles will do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I couldn't tell you the truth, at least not right away. I was so lonely and I didn't want to drive away my only friend. Would you have helped me if you knew the Entity and I were one and the same?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I... I don't know. But I do know this -  since the Exiles came to Nexus I have watched them strive to make this planet their own. The courage, resourcefulness, and determination I've witnessed has given me the hope. If anybody can figure out how to deal with the Entity, it's the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But you've met the Entity, you've seen what he can do! You have to help!

localizedTextIdText: You spoke with Commander Durek, who offered his support for Drusera. Next on the list of Exile leaders to speak with is Queen Myala Everstar. She can be found in the Arborian Gardens in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Queen Myala Everstar in the Arborian Gardens
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're done runnin'. We Granok put a lot into this planet, and I ain't gonna let some Eldan science experiment screw that up. I say we back Drusera.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't you got someone else to talk to?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I had a feeling you'd be coming by. I've been trying to figure out the best thing to do for my people... And I think I've made my decision.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. Now get out of here. I got a whole new war to plan.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We can't just stand by and do nothing.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Queen Myala Everstar and asked her how she felt about the situation with Drusera.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you think our chances are against the Entity?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What about the war with the Dominion?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Do you know where the other Exile leaders are?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I beat the Dominion back on Gnox, I can beat the Entity here on Nexus. I don't fight losin' battles, kid. You know why? 'Cause I'll do whatever it takes to win.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Don't get me wrong, I ain't forgettin' about the Dominion. Those bastards are still goin' down, but takin' care of the Entity is our new priority.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Beats me, kid. Isn't it your job to run around and ask?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: What am I, Nexus Maps? Check the Arborian Gardens, Myala's usually hanging out around there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then what are you wastin' my time for? Shove off. I got wars to plan.

localizedTextIdText: You spoke with Queen Myala Everstar, who believes if the Exiles stick together, they can save Nexus and help Drusera. The next Exile leader on your list is Deadeye Brightland, who is known to frequent the bar near the Lair of the Black Hoods.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Deadeye Brightland at the bar near the Lair of the Black Hoods
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nexus is our home now. I couldn't save Arboria, but this time it's different. The Aurin aren't alone, we're here with friends. Together, I believe we can save this planet!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I thought you were done talking with me. Isn't Deadeye next on your list?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: 'Bout time you showed up. I'm ready to cast my vote. I may not be much of one, but I'm still a Brightland when all's said and done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I only wish Arwick would understand...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Deadeye Brightland and spoke with him about Drusera.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: So why not go back to Arboria?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Do you know where the other Exile leaders are?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Arwick is being... difficult. I don't know how to get through to him. He thinks I'm making a huge mistake and that we should let the others deal with the Entity. He won't stop talking about Arboria.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I couldn't do that to my people, $(player.name). We've put down roots here on Nexus - this is our home. We can't let it be destroyed, not again. Besides, if we don't stop the Entity, the whole universe will suffer, not just Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I wouldn't be surprised if Deadeye was at the bar. I'd check there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? But I thought you wanted to help Drusera...

localizedTextIdText: You spoke with Deadeye Brightland, who casts his hereditary vote as the last Brightland in favor of helping Drusera. You must speak next with Avra Darkos, who is somewhere in the Lair of the Black Hoods.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Avra Darkos in the Lair of the Black Hoods
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: If Drusera needs our help, I say we give it to her. It's the right thing to do and there's nothin' more to it.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You still here? I ain't got no more time for talkin'. You best get movin', friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I've been eagerly expecting your entrance. We must consider the complex matter of Drusera carefully...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I ain't for heroics, but sometimes a man's gotta take a stand.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There are many sides to this story.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Avra Darkos, but it appears she has a more cautious attitude towards helping Drusera.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: No offense, but how come you get a vote?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Do you know where Avra is?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Are you worried about the Entity?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: A straight shooter, ain't ya? I know I ain't lived up to the name, but I am the last Brightland. A Brightland's always had say when it comes to decisions on behalf of the Exile humans. It's past time I stepped up and lived up to the name. After all, Serrick Brightland was a hero who did what had to be done. I only aim to do the same.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Avra's a hard one to track, but I'm willin' to bet she's skulkin' around here somewhere.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: I ain't worried. It's the Entity that oughta be worryin'. Us Exiles ain't had a place to hang our hats for centuries, and now he comes along threatenin' our peace? That makes it personal. Real personal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't make me stick my guns in your face and make you do the right thing.

localizedTextIdText: You spoke with Avra Darkos, who has many misgivings about helping Drusera. However, it appears that Dorian Walker has summoned all the Exile leaders to the Secret Ops Center to decide on the matter. Travel there and speak with Dorian Walker.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Dorian Walker in the Secret Ops Center
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While the dangers of the Entity are real, I doubt Drusera has disclosed everything. This matter only distracts us from dealing death to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: My mind is made up. There is no value in dialogue.
