localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good to see you, champ. I can guess what you're here about and a good thing, too, because I'm about to call the Exile Council.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I cannot approve of aiding Drusera. The gamble is far too great.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's high time we put this question to bed and took a stand.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Glad I got here in time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Dorian Walker, who is convening the Exile Council to decide the matter of Drusera.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you oppose helping Drusera?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What about the danger of the Strain?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What do you propose we do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Do you know where the other Exile leaders are?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Drusera deceived us. She disguised the true nature of her relationship with the Entity - what proof have we that she does not deceive us now? This only serves to divert us from our true purpose, for the Dominion is our true foe!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Do not speak of the dangers of corruption to one such as I! The Mordesh know better than any what something like the bio-phage can do. The Strain is not what is suspect, it is Drusera I distrust.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We watch and wait. To rush headlong into a situation we do not fully understand is folly.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Dorian is convening the Exile Council within the Secret Operations Center. I fear I will be the only voice advocating caution.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It matters little to me whether you choose to abandon your errand for Drusera.

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker believes the Exiles should help Drusera and fight to keep Nexus their own. Attend the Exile Council to determine what should happen next.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker in the Secret Ops Center
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I spent my whole life searchin' for this place, slick. I'll be damned if I'll just sit by and watch the Entity destroy Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We ain't done decidin' what to do next, buck.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is a dangerous path you have chosen. Are you certain you're ready to take on Avatus? I suppose if anyone could do it, it would be you...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: How's 'bout we get this shindig started?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite Avra's opposition, the Exile Council voted to aid Drusera and find a way to stop the Entity. The first step is to find out more about the Nexus Project, which requires restoring the Caretaker to his former glory.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why not just leave Nexus and go somewhere else?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Listen, sparky, the only reason we're even on this planet is because of Drusera. When I was first searchin' for Nexus, I got lost out here in the Fringe. It was Drusera who brought me to, and led me here. I trusted her then and I trust her now.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Space that! Nexus is our home, dammit, and we're gonna fight to keep it.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Exiles gotta stick together, sport. It's all in or nothing, and I aim to see that we stand as one in this.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You come too far to turn back now, kid.

localizedTextIdText: In order to restore the Caretaker, you must travel to Western Grimvault and enter the Bio-Mech Facility that houses the Eldan supercomputer, OMNICore-1.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Belle Walker in OMNICore-1
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To restore my full functionality, travel to Grimvault and enter OMNICore-1. Make your way to the Cortex and use the killswitch to restart the system.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? My fractured neural core isn't going to repair itself, now is it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: C'mon, sugar, we're not done yet!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Can't keep us outta this place, eh, darlin'? Let's get to work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I confess, the idea of being restored to my former self is most appealing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Time to wrangle us a big computer.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You journeyed to Western Grimvault and met up with Belle Walker. Together, you found a way into OMNICore-1. What awaits you within?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why are we flipping a killswitch again?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, it's just your usual Eldan supercomputer. What's that? You haven't had much experience with them? If it's any consolation, I'm sure Avatus will be doing his best to stop you the whole time.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Why, a vast and complicated piece of Eldan technology that runs, among other things, the program for my existence. The OMNICore-1 is housed in the Bio-Mech Facility in Grimvault, and is also connected to the virtual world known as the Datascape.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Shall I explain in simpler terms for you? You will be performing what is called a hard restart. When the team in the Datascape has finished successful restoration of my neural core, you must physically turn the OMNICore-1 systems off and back on again. Only then will my restored programming be reinitialized.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't wish to see Nexus destroyed, you should reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: A giant effigy is being erected in Thayd as a tribute to the victims of the Shades plague. Collect effigy construction materials by performing tasks in celebration of Shade's Eve and return them to Effigy Engineer Barney in Shindig Hollow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Effigy Engineer Barney in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're buildin' an effigy, youngster, 'n' we need all the help we can get gatherin' materials. Collect 'em all 'round here, then bring 'em back to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The clock's tickin', friend. We gotta get this effigy built before Shade's Eve's over. How 'bout ya pick up the pace a little?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya done a fine job collectin' materials for this here effigy, but we can always use more. If ya get your hands on any, be sure to bring 'em here.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Once this thing's lit up, they'll be able to see it from orbit!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The entire city's much obliged for your help! Have a happy Shade's Eve!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully collected effigy construction materials and contributed them to the effigy being built in Shindig Hollow.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are we going to burn it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Shades plague killed a lot o' folks. It was contagious, see? They had to burn everyone who died so it wouldn't spread no more. This effigy reminds us 'bout all the victims who went up in smoke.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's an effigy, youngster. What do ya think we'll do with it?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Either ya help, or ya don't. I ain't got no need for your sass.

localizedTextIdText: With the Entity growing stronger, it's up to you to garner support for Drusera from Dominion leadership. You have been asked by Drusera to travel to Illium and speak with the Dominion leaders. Seek out Axis Pheydra in the Enigma Chamber and learn her opinion on the matter.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Axis Pheydra in the Enigma Chamber
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm afraid the time has come for the Dominion to decide what to do. Will you go to Illium for me and speak with Dominion leaders?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you spoken with Axis Pheydra yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I calculated a high probability that you would seek my counsel in the matter of Drusera. I find myself... ambivalent.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you, $(player.name). I only hope the others will feel the same way.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I must consider all factors carefully for the good of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke with Axis Pheydra who appears to have many misgivings about the situation with Drusera. Cautious as ever, the ICI director intends to analyze all factors first.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'm going to speak to her.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why did you hide the truth from me?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you hope the Dominion will do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I couldn't tell you the truth, at least not right away. I was so lonely and I didn't want to drive away my only friend. Would you have helped me if you knew the Entity and I were one and the same?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I... I don't know. But I do know this -  I've seen firsthand what the Dominion can accomplish, the strength and courage of all its citizens striving toward one goal... If anybody can figure out how to deal with the Entity, it's the Dominion.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But you've met the Entity, you've seen what he can do! You have to help!

localizedTextIdText: You found Axis Pheydra, who deeply distrusts Drusera and is wary of aiding her. However, it appears a temporary alliance will mutually benefit both parties... at least for now. Next on the list of Dominion leaders is Mondo Zax, who can typically be found in his workshop.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Mondo Zax in Mondo's Workshop
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I do not trust Drusera, but I feel we have no choice but to follow her lead. Rest assured, I will be monitoring her very carefully...
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Don't you have others to speak to?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Mondo fails to see problem with helping Drusera. Run tests on Strain, blow up Strain. Run tests on Entity, blow up Entity. Very simple!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If she is lying, I will not hesitate to have her eliminated along with the Entity.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Besides, everyone forgets Drusera is Genesis Prime. Endless weaponization possibilities!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Well, when you put it that way...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Mondo Zax, who seems to have a straightforward approach to the Drusera problem. Since it's Mondo, it will involve tests and many, many explosives.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you feel we have no choice?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Then why do you distrust Drusera?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Where are the other Dominion leaders?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Strain are a growing threat. This is a fact that cannot be ignored. It carries with it a high probability of the destruction of Nexus and all life forms on it - something I cannot allow. In this, I am quite certain Drusera is telling the truth.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I sense there is more she is not telling us. After all, she lied to us regarding her true nature. What other significant facts is she holding back?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: If you are looking for Mondo, he can be found in his workshop on Legion's Way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You would do well do attend to your duties to the Dominion.

localizedTextIdText: Mondo Zax appears to be more interested in blowing up the Entity and experimenting on Drusera, but is still more or less supportive. You must speak with Kezrek Warbringer in his War Room next.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Kezrek Warbringer in Kezrek's War Room
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Solution obvious. Help Drusera, help ourselves. Besides, Entity make Mondo furious! Destruction of universe reserved for Mondo alone!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Kezrek waiting for you. Or not. Mondo doesn't care!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Draken fear nothing, not even this Entity. If I must face him alone on the battlefield, so be it!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Vaporization too painless. Must consider something more excruciating. And slow-acting!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found Kezrek Warbringer in his war room, ready to take on the Entity. Looks like the general is prepared to show the Entity how the Dominion deals with threats.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Where can I find the other Dominion leaders?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Mondo have grand plans for Strain! Must admit, corruption is stroke of genius. But Mondo more brilliant! Turn Strain against Strain, fight fire with fire! Drusera not like? Too bad.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Mondo not have time to monitor location of others! Oh, but Kezrek nearby. Usually sharpening weapons in war room on Legion's Way.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh? Mondo not care either way. Entity, Drusera, let's blow them all up!

localizedTextIdText: You spoke with Kezrek Warbringer, who is prepared to fight the Entity single-handed, if need be, in defense of the Dominion. Clearly, he is in favor of aiding Drusera, if only to take on the Entity. The next leader on your list is Varonia Cazalon, who can be found ministering to the faithful in the Illuminated Cathedral.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Varonia Cazalon in the Illuminated Cathedral
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Genesis Prime is powerful, she will make a strong ally. I say we fight, and prove the might of the Dominion to the Entity!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You have wasted enough breath on me. Go speak to the others.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is difficult to know what the right decision is - only faith can guide us through these troubled times.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The Draken do not back down from anything!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Since we came to Nexus, there have been many disturbing revelations...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The high sentinel appears to be deeply troubled over the issue of Drusera, and unable to determine the best course of action.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you think the chances are against the Entity?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Where are the other Dominion leaders?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: For now, our goals are aligned - that is enough. However, it is true her fear of the Entity is strong. Such fear can lead to defeat. We must learn more about the nature of her fear!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Entity cannot prevail. As they have done for thousands of years, the Draken are prepared to defend the empire to the death. The Entity will never make it past us.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: High Sentinel Varonia will be attending her flock in the Illuminated Cathedral.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Then do not waste my time. I have blood to spill.

localizedTextIdText: Despite her belief that Drusera means the Dominion no harm, Varonia Cazalon fears the darkness surrounding Drusera may change the empire for the worse. She abstains from supporting or opposing an alliance with Drusera and advises caution. Now that you've spoken with all the Dominion leaders, it's time to speak with the emperor himself. Seek out Emperor Myrcalus in the Enigma Chamber.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Emperor Myrcalus in the Enigma Chamber
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I sense that Drusera is good, but she carries a heavy burden. I can neither approve nor condemn a course of action, only caution.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The emperor will not wait long for you. You had best go to him at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My most trusted servant, it is good to see you. You've arrived just in time to join the others in discussing a most important matter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There is truth on Nexus, but it may not be the truth we seek.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This will be a significant moment in the history of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've arrived at the Enigma Chamber just in time to attend the Imperial Council. Myrcalus has called together all his top advisors to discuss the issue of Drusera.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll go to him at once.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Do you think we can trust Drusera?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Where are the other Dominion leaders?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We must have faith and rely on the Vigilant Virtues. The Dominion will prevail over the Entity and the Strain! Drusera may have been the creation of the Eldan, but we are the Eldan's chosen.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: There is much we don't understand about the Eldan, even less about their greatest creations. While Drusera may be inherently good, we must not forget the great evil that is the Entity is also part of her being. There is more here than meets the eye...
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The emperor has called us to join with him in the Enigma Chamber. I assume he will wish to discuss the matter of Drusera.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you do not speak for Drusera, then perhaps no one will. You should consider that carefully.

localizedTextIdText: Emperor Myrcalus intends to lead the Dominion to the aid of Drusera. He believes it is his destiny as emperor. However, he has called the Imperial Council in order to hear out his trusted advisors. Attend the Imperial Court and determine what should happen next.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Caretaker in the Enigma Chamber in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I believe it is our duty to aid the Genesis Prime. For what greater purpose could the Dominion empire serve? Nevertheless, I have called the Imperial Council.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Imperial Council will commence at once. I expect you to be in attendance.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The path ahead will be fraught with many dangers. Are you certain you're ready to take on Avatus? I suppose if anyone could do it, it would be you...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Before I commit us to this path, however, let us hear what my counselors have to say.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Dominion has decided to come to the aid of Drusera, despite the uncertainty surrounding her and her relationship to the Entity. More importantly, however, the threat of the Entity must be eliminated in order to safeguard the empire. The first step is to find out more about the Nexus Project, which requires restoring the Caretaker to his former glory.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: This is matter beyond trust. Drusera is not unlike the Luminai - we were both created by the Eldan to serve a greater purpose. I feel a certain... kinship with her.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: What of it? I am Luminai! The blood of the Eldan runs through me! My people look to me to lead them to a new era of greatness. I believe that moment has come!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I am not accustomed to being refused. Do not make that mistake again.

localizedTextIdText: In order to restore the Caretaker, you must travel to Western Grimvault and enter the Bio-Mech Facility that houses the Eldan supercomputer, OMNICore-1.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Axis Pheydra in OMNICore-1
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To restore my full functionality, travel to Grimvault and enter OMNICore-1. Make your way to the Cortex and use the killswitch to restart the system.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? My fractured neural core isn't going to repair itself, now is it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have other tasks to complete. I suggest you attend to them.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We have attained ingress to OMNICore-1, but our task is not yet complete. Prepare yourself, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I confess, the idea of being restored to my former self is most appealing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The depths of OMNICore-1 await us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You journeyed to Western Grimvault and met up with Axis Pheydra. Together, you found a way into OMNICore-1. What awaits you within?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: Why are we flipping a killswitch again?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, it's just your usual Eldan supercomputer. What's that? You haven't had much experience with them? If it's any consolation, I'm sure Avatus will be doing his best to stop you the whole time.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Why, a vast and complicated piece of Eldan technology that runs, among other things, the program for my existence. The OMNICore-1 is housed in the Bio-Mech Facility in Grimvault, and is also connected to the virtual world known as the Datascape.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Shall I explain in simpler terms for you? You will be performing what is called a hard restart. When the team in the Datascape has finished successful restoration of my neural core, you must physically turn the OMNICore-1 systems off and back on again. Only then will my restored programming be re-initalized.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you don't wish to see Nexus destroyed, you should reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: Following a very close encounter with an asteroid, Corrigan Doon has crashed in the Halon Ring. Though Doon survived the impact, it appears that he's in danger and it's up to you to save his cubacon. Make your way to Corrigan's Crash Site and search for him before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Corrigan Doon outside the Crash Site in Redmoon Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shades! They'll have seen the crash for sure! It's only a matter of time before the Marauders come for me. It'd be right proper if you'd lend me a hand.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm not getting away from this crash site until the Marauders are pushing up space daisies. I'd really appreciate a hand, I would.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If not for you, I'd be dead and all the ladies in Illium would be weeping their eyes out. You've saved those poor beauties a lot of pain, you have.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hold tight. I'm on my way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Corrigan Doon fight off undead Marauders and escape the site of his crashed ship unscathed. After regrouping, Doon must consider how to stop Laveka's plan to unleash an undead Marauder horde.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm likely to wind up in a zombie's belly if you don't help me. So help.

localizedTextIdText: Following a very close encounter with an asteroid, Deadeye Brightland has crashed in the Halon Ring. Though he survived the impact, it appears that he's in danger and it's up to you to save his cubacon. Make your way to Deadeye's Crash Site and search for him before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Meet Deadeye Brightland outside the Crash Site in Redmoon Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ain't no way the Redmoon missed my crash. I'm sure there'll be a welcoming committee comin' for me any minute, so maybe you can lend me a hand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I ain't goin' nowhere until them Marauders is dealt with. I suggest ya get yer weapons ready 'n rack up some kills.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We got a real problem here, don't we? I'm gonna try 'n pick up Laveka's trail, but I got a few things I need you to take care of first.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Hold tight. I'm on my way.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Deadeye Brightland fight off undead Marauders and escape the site of his crashed ship unscathed. After regrouping, Brightland must consider how to stop Laveka's plan to unleash an undead Marauder horde.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You kiddin' with me? I ain't in a jokin' mood.

localizedTextIdText: Connoisseur Nibbles at the Parade Grounds has explained the joy of trick-or-treating, which consists of collecting - and eating - Shade's Eve candy. Visit the houses of friends and strangers alike, and collect sweets from the candy bowls they've left out for the holiday. There are eight types of candy, each represented by a holographic image. You can only collect one of each type. Make sure to purchase a candy bowl of your own from the housing vendor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Connoisseur Nibbles in the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shade's Eve scary? Bah! Much better to profit from stupid superstitions by trick-or-treating. Can collect free candy at people's houses! Then eat it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You trick-or-treat yet? Better hurry! Visit neighbors' sky plots and take candy from bowls. If not, I get all candy for self!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: So much candy, $(player.name). You share with me or maybe find bomb in goody bag. Yes?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Buy candy bowl on your own plot too! More candy for Chua!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You smart to stay on my good side! Now I not explode you!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went trick-or-treating on Shade's Eve and collected several delectable candies from bowls outside the houses of both friends and strangers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I'm supposed to take Jack Shade's candy?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Superstitious Cassians leave candy out on Shade's Eve for Jack Shade. Try to bribe him so he not make them sick. Now, candy for everyone, not just Jack Shade.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Moron! Jack Shade not real! Jack Shade is myth! But sweet, tasty, cozmotronic candy is real. Very, very real!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You not like candy? Sweet, tasty, cozmotronic candy? Shame!

localizedTextIdText: The Thundercall Pell in Stormtalon's Lair are preparing a ritual to create and unleash Stormtalon. You've been contacted by Belle Walker and she's requested that you put an end to their plans before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Belle Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen up, sugar. The Thundercall Pell are fixin' to unleash their god, Stormtalon. The Exiles need someone like you to stop 'em before it's too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Better get over to Stormtalon's Lair and put a stop to that Pell ritual before it's too late. Ya might want to take some friends with ya, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gallopin' galaxies, that was great! Ya done saved us all from a mighty bad headache. I hate to think of what mighta happened if that thing had gotten loose!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Better get your asteroids to Stormtalon's Lair! Ya ain't got no time to lose!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We owe ya one, $(player.name), and us Walkers never forget a favor.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and a small group of adventurers defeated Stormtalon and put a stop to the Thundercall Pell's dangerous ritual inside Stormtalon's Lair. Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't tell me ya done turned yellow, $(player.name). This is serious!

localizedTextIdText: The Thundercall Pell in Stormtalon's Lair are preparing a ritual to create and unleash Stormtalon. You've been contacted by Axis Pheydra and she's requested that you put an end to their plans before it's too late.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Axis Pheydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Disturbing intel indicates that the Thundercall Pell are working to summon their god, Stormtalon, in Stormtalon's Lair. They must be stopped.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Time is of the essence. Gather your allies, proceed to Stormtalon's Lair, and put an end to the Thundercall Pell and their ritual.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Given more time, Stormtalon would have posed a major threat to the Dominion. Due to your actions, we are free from such concerns... for now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Should you fail, there will be dire consequences for all of us.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The ICI will remain watchful of your activities. We will meet again.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You and a small group of adventurers defeated Stormtalon and put a stop to the Thundercall Pell's dangerous ritual inside Stormtalon's Lair. Well done!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This mission is not optional. I recommend you reconsider your decision.

localizedTextIdText: The Osun of have returned Kel Voreth to raise an army and, in the process, they've uncovered dangerous Eldan technology. The Exiles cannot allow the warlike Osun to control such power, so Avra Darkos has instructed you to proceed to the Ruins of Kel Voreth and defeat Forgemaster Trogun before the giants can consolidate their strength.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Avra Darkos via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun have returned to Kel Voreth and excavated the Eldan enigma of crafting exanite weapons. You must neutralize their forgemaster at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Osun are arming themselves with powerful weaponry while you fritter away valuable time. Go to Kel Voreth at once and do your duty.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The tide of the struggle has shifted due to your efforts. Without advanced Eldan weapons, the Osun will be unable to sustain a concerted conflict.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Hurry. If Forgemaster Trogun is not killed, his people will march to war.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You prove to be a valuable weapon once again, $(player.name). I am pleased.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On orders from Avra Darkos, you entered the Ruins of Kel Voreth and defeated Forgemaster Trogun before he could equip his people with powerful Eldan weapons. Good job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fool! If armed with exanite weapons, the Osun will be unstoppable!

localizedTextIdText: The Osun have returned to Kel Voreth to raise an army and, in the process, have uncovered dangerous Eldan technology. The Dominion cannot allow the warlike Osun to control such power, so Toric Antevian has instructed you to proceed to the Ruins of Kel Voreth and defeat Forgemaster Trogun before the giants can consolidate their strength.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Toric Antevian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun control Kel Voreth now, and they've discovered the Eldan methods of weaponscraft. Their forgemaster must be slain before it's too late.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Forgemaster Trogun in the Ruins of Kel Voreth must be killed before he can arm the Osun with Eldan weaponry. Take your friends and go at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Trogun is no more and the Dominion has you to thank for it. This development's sure to turn the tide of battle in our favor.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go. Without Trogun to manufacture their arms, the Osun will falter.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be proud, citizen. Your heroic action hasn't gone unnoticed by the Scions.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: On orders from Toric Antevian, you entered the Ruins of Kel Voreth and defeated Forgemaster Trogun before he could equip his people with powerful Eldan weapons. Good job!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Allowing Trogun to equip his people with exanite weapons is a bad idea.

localizedTextIdText: A giant effigy is being erected in Illium as a tribute to the victims of the Shades plague. Collect effigy construction materials by performing tasks in celebration of Shade's Eve and return them to Effigy Engineer Barnard in the Parade Grounds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Effigy Engineer Barnard in Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're building an effigy, we is, and we need help. Help folks out around the Parade Grounds and bring the materials they give you to me. Got it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I hates to be a bother, but have you collected any building material for the effigy? It's got to get done by the end of Shade's Eve, it does.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Made a right good contribution to our humble effigy, you did, but it isn't done yet. If you happen upon more materials, be sure to bring them to me.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're a right proper patriot, you is. I'll be waiting, guv!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I can't wait for this thing to be done. It's right big, innit?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully collected effigy construction materials and contributed them to the effigy being built in Parade Grounds.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Are we going to burn it?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The Shades plague killed lots of folks, it did. It were contagious, see? They had to burn everyone what died so it wouldn't spread no more. This effigy reminds us of the dead what burned on the pyres.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's an effigy, innit? What do you think we'll do, guv? Douse it in water?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, come on! The effigy's not going to build itself, right?

localizedTextIdText: Dorian Walker has received a distress call from the Lopp that inhabit Skullcano. It seems as if Mordechai Redmoon and his Marauder crew are causing all manner of havoc, and it's up to you and your allies to stop them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Lopp on Skullcano sent me a distress call, skipper. Mordechai Redmoon and his pirates are causin' all sortsa trouble over there. Can ya handle it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I just got another message from the Lopp on Skullcano. Redmoon and his boys are doin' all manner of horrible things. Get your butt over there, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ain't no tellin' what Redmoon would've done to them poor Lopp if you hadn't shown up. Ya done good, kid. Real good.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Great to hear it, sport. Them Lopp'll be mighty happy to see ya, too.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go trippin' over your ego there, killer. Try a little modesty.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That's just the way I roll.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed Dorian Walker suggestion and traveled to Skullcano to put a stop to the Redmoon Marauders' depredations against the island's Lopp population. In the process, you defeated Mordechai Redmoon and put an end to his wicked plans.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Someone's got to help them Lopp out, punk. May as well be you.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker informed you that a simulation to review Operation Guardian missions is now available in the Secret Ops Center.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker in the Secret Ops Center
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've collected data on past Operation Guardian efforts for purposes of training and analysis. I suggest you train by reviewing those files in the simulator.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I do hope you found your simulation instructive. I find that making repeat mistakes seems to be the preferred mode of learning for you sapients.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Unraveling the mystery of the Nexus Project is a dangerous undertaking. There is no room for error.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully completed a simulation of an Operation Guardian mission.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I cared, I would be sadly disappointed at the apathy you display towards your own self-improvement.

localizedTextIdText: Artemis Zin has received a distress call from the Lopp that inhabit Skullcano. It seems as if Mordechai Redmoon and his Marauder crew are causing all manner of havoc, and it's up to you and your allies to stop them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Artemis Zin via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Lopp on Skullcano have sent a distress call. It seems Mordecai Redmoon and his pirates are causing trouble for them, and the Lopp need some help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: My fastest growing contingent of fans on Nexus is made up of Lopp. You must get to Skullcano at once and give our furry friends a hand. Chop, chop!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My ratings with the Lopp have spiked all of the sudden, and you're the cause of it all. You added some heroic excitement to an otherwise drab episode.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: How altruistic! And of course, killing Redmoon will be great for ratings!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now, to plan a sequel and get that mask from Laveka. It'll be huge!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed Artemis Zin suggestion and traveled to Skullcano to put a stop to the Redmoon Marauders' depredations against the island's Lopp population. In the process, you defeated Mordechai Redmoon and put an end to his wicked plans.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Surely you can't be serious! Do you know how many Lopp fans I have?

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker informed you that a simulation to review Destiny Initiative missions is now available in the Enigma Chamber.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Caretaker in the Enigma Chamber
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've collected data on past Destiny Initiative efforts for purposes of training and analysis. I suggest you train by reviewing those files in the simulator.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I do hope you found your simulation instructive. I find that making repeat mistakes seems to be the preferred mode of learning for you sapients.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Unraveling the mystery of the Nexus Project is a dangerous undertaking. There is no room for error.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully completed a simulation of a Destiny Initiative mission.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If I cared, I would be sadly disappointed at the apathy you display towards your own self-improvement.

localizedTextIdText: Spiritmother Selene has fallen to the Strain that has corrupted the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden, yet her primal echo lives on. Selene's echo has contacted you and asked you to help her reclaim the Sanctuary and cleanse it of the Strain's taint.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have fallen, but my primal echo remains within the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden. Will you aid me in cleansing this holy place of the Strain's taint?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden is still tainted. The Strain's corruption rots it from within. Will you and your friends cleanse it, as was promised?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey there, sport. Ain't you got stuff you need to be doin' in the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Them Torine sisters is tough as nails, chief, but even they can't stand up to the Strain. You tried, though, and that's more than most folks can say.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I have hope that I may be restored if you succeed. We shall see.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't go gettin' all weepy on me, kid. Just be happy ya did what ya could.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wish I could've saved Seline.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Spiritmother Selene's Echo to cleanse the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden and, in the process, returned her to her original physical form. Sadly, the Strain corruption overtook Selene and you were forced to destroy her.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are too weak to aid me. I shall await someone of strength.

localizedTextIdText: Spiritmother Selene has fallen to the Strain that has corrupted the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden, yet her primal echo lives on. Selene's echo has contacted you and asked you to help her reclaim the Sanctuary and cleanse it of the Strain's taint.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Dorian Walker via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have fallen, but my primal echo remains within the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden. Will you aid me in cleansing this holy place of the Strain's taint?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: The Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden is still tainted. The Strain's corruption rots it from within. Will you and your friends cleanse it, as was promised?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How strange... I heard you were doing something or other at the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden. How's that going?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Helping the Spiritmother - or attempting to, in your case - was a lovely PR move, but it appears the Strain was much too strong for Selene. Pity.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I have hope that I may be restored if you succeed. We shall see.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't feel so down about it. We can't all be Artemis Zin, can we?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wish I could've saved Seline.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Spiritmother Selene's Echo to cleanse the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden and, in the process, returned her to her original physical form. Sadly, the Strain corruption overtook Selene and you were forced to destroy her.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You are too weak to aid me. I shall await someone of strength.

localizedTextIdText: After discovering a strange object for a Shade's Eve ritual, you get a sensation to head to the capital city, Thayd, and search for a burning memory.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Retrieve the Memory of the Burned somewhere in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This odd object has something to do with a Shade's Eve ritual you half remember. There might be more clues out there, perhaps in the capital city.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Before the cure was found, the bodies were burned in masses. Remember them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Remember...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the burning doll in Thayd. You watched it turn to ashes and remembered that this was the fate of so many who fell to the plague, long ago.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Retrieve the Memory of the Burned

localizedTextIdText: Yelena Khollo and the Coalition of Galactic Scientists aim to understand the purpose behind Sim Core N-12. They need a group of volunteers - namely you and your friends - to successfully complete the War of the Wilds simulation so they can gather functional data from within.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Yelena Khollo inside Sim Core N-12
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CoGS endeavors to pinpoint the purpose of Sim Core N-12. Will you complete the core's simulation to collect the requisite participation data?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You have failed to finish the simulation in Sim Core N-12. I cannot compensate you for an incomplete assignment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have failed to finish the simulation in Sim Core N-12. I cannot compensate you for an incomplete assignment.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You and your companions have completed the Sim Core's challenge. I commend you all. The collected data is being sorted as we speak.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will be compensated by CoGS for your contributions.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Rarely have I seen a group finish a sim core so effortlessly. Well done!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Yelena Khollo gather details about Sim Core N-12's defensive combat tactics and military operational procedures. Diving deeper into the mechanics of this simulation through volunteers like you and your comrades helps CoGS get closer to understanding the purpose of sim cores like this one.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll get it taken care of.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get it taken care of.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your refusal of my request is a wretched rebuke of the Coalition.

localizedTextIdText: Lyryan Redtail and the Coalition of Galactic Scientists aim to understand the purpose behind Sim Core G-33. They need a group of volunteers - namely you and your friends - to successfully complete the Siege of Tempest Refuge simulation so they can gather functional data from within.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Lyryan Redtail in Sim Core G-33
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Coalition needs help gathering participation data from the simulation inside Sim Core G-33. The data should help us understand G-33's purpose.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If we're going to get Sim Core G-33's participation data, you'll need to take some friends and complete its simulation. The clock's ticking!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If we're going to get Sim Core G-33's participation data, you'll need to take some friends and complete its simulation. The clock's ticking!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work! We got a lot of participation data from your run on G-33. We're collating data from other runs, too, so it'll take some time to compile.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm counting on you to get something useful, so be sure to finish it!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It was really cool to watch your simulation from here. You're a real pro!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope it was worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Lyryan Redtail gather details about Sim Core G-33's defensive combat tactics and military operational procedures. Diving deeper into the mechanics of this simulation through volunteers like you and your comrades helps CoGS get closer to understanding the purpose of sim cores like this one.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You came out here just to back out? You've got to be kidding me!

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has requested that you enter Sim Core W-28's simulation in order to ensure its systems are performing flawlessly. To do so, you must successfully complete the Crimelords of Whitevale adventure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to $~(creature=47396) inside Sim Core W-28
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must ensure Sim Core W-28 is fully functional and free of errors. Would you verify the simulation's flawless performance on my behalf?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your test of Sim Core W-28's functionality is incomplete. If you intend to provide me with the proper test results, you must finish the simulation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your test of Sim Core W-28's functionality is incomplete. If you intend to provide me with the proper test results, you must finish the simulation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. Your test run through Sim Core W-28's simulation - as well as the wounds you've sustained - prove the core's stability and effectiveness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Unless you enjoy pain, proper protective attire is recommended.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As I cannot feel pain, I am unable to empathize. I can, however, fake it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I don't mind helping out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It works too well, if you ask me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully completed Sim Core W-28's simulation, proving to $~(creature=47396) that the Crimelords of Whitevale adventure is performing flawlessly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, I suppose that's fine. I doubt you would have succeeded, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker has requested that you enter Sim Core M-24's simulation in order to ensure its systems are performing flawlessly. To do so, you must successfully complete the Malgrave Trail adventure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to $~(creature=53428) inside Sim Core M-24
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must ensure Sim Core M-24 is fully functional and free of errors. Would you verify the simulation's flawless performance on my behalf?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your test of Sim Core M-24's functionality is incomplete. If you intend to provide me with the proper test results, you must finish the simulation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your test of Sim Core M-24's functionality is incomplete. If you intend to provide me with the proper test results, you must finish the simulation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. Your test run through Sim Core M-24's simulation - as well as the wounds you've sustained - prove the core's stability and effectiveness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Unless you enjoy pain, proper protective attire is recommended.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As I cannot feel pain, I am unable to empathize. I can, however, fake it.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sure, I don't mind helping out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It works too well, if you ask me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You successfully completed Sim Core M-24's simulation, proving to $~(creature=53428) that the Malgrave Trail adventure is performing flawlessly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, I suppose that's fine. I doubt you would have succeeded, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: The XAS has detected high levels of primal logic in The Skittering Parlor. Use your scanbot to find out more.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Access the Progenitor Archive in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We are getting high readings of Primal Logic in the nearby exanite ruins. Investigate these signals and report back with your findings.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What are you still doing here? Don't you have some things to scan?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The terminal seems to be low on power.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: System Reboot.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Tread carefully, $(player.name). Few have ventured this deep into the vault and fewer still come back alive.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Systems Operational.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Seems like that did the trick.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found an archive terminal that belonged to an Eldan Progenitor. After figuring out how to power it up, you gained access to the archives within.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya gotta be kiddin' me.

localizedTextIdText: With access to the Telepathy Stone, you can communicate with certain sentient creatures in The Skittering Parlor. Maybe asking the creatures themselves will shine light on how and why they gained such knowledge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the Direweb Broodlord in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A Telepathy Stone, crafted by the Eldan Evokers themselves? Most intriguing! This means there could be more sentient creations made by the Eldan than we know of. Scout around and see if you can find any of them.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you found anything worth reporting?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mus-s-s-t have more brain-s-s-s.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You s-s-seek knowledge, yes-s-s?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: $(player.name), you may be the first scientist ever to truly investigate the inner thoughts of what is usually a non-sentient species!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We have knowledge, oh yes-s-s...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I will give this telepathy a try.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You communicated with the spiders within the confines of the exanite walls. Still, little is known about how they gained so much primal logic or how they evolved capability to calculate consequence and understand survival.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Wrong answer. You better try again.

localizedTextIdText: Cheer Coordinator in Shindig Hollow convinced you to sing festive "Joyous Jingles(tm)" to Seasonal Celebrants in the Lair of the Black Hoods in Thayd. They'll be easy to spot since they're dressed in gaudy Winterfest clothing and likely already dancing and enjoying themselves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Cheer Coordinator in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar is seeking your aid in spreading cheer and commerce by singing our Protostar Joyous Jingles(tm) to excited celebrants of our Winterfest holiday!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Remember, the best recipients for our Jingles gather in groups wearing their official Protostar Seasonal Attire!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've already recorded a 7% profit increase in the last ten minutes thanks to your siren's song of shopping! Happy Winterfest, from Protostar!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't forget to spread optimum cheer, with our Protostar Jouyous Jingles(tm)!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maximum dispensation of cheer translates to higher profits!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can Jingle all the way!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: After listening to your festive Joyous Jingles(tm), the people of Thayd already appear much happier - and much more willing to spend money by the ship load.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Protostar understands and respects your implied admission of tone deafness!

localizedTextIdText: Cheer Coordinator in the Parade Grounds convinced you to sing festive "Joyous Jingles(tm)" to seasonal celebrants in the Luminous Gardens. They'll be easy to spot since they're dressed in gaudy Winterfest clothing and likely already dancing and enjoying themselves.

localizedTextIdText: By the balance sheets, thanks to malicious Freebot code transmissions, Protostar's salesbots in Fortune's Ground in Thayd are malfunctioning and giving away merchandise for free! Hurry and repair them before Winterfest's spirit of commerce is forever ruined!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Commerce Protection Officer in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've been the victims of Freebot sabotage! They've transmitted code to our Salesbots to give away goods for... for... FOR FREE! Repair them at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please increase the speed of your repairs of our salesbots! Before the spirit of charity replaces the spirit of commerce!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Finally, the momentary lapse in profit has passed and our salesbots are once again engaging in proper commerce! Please accept this compensation!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Our potential customers must not be convinced Winterfest is a season for charity and goodwill!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: GIVING things away without the exchange of currency? Madness!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your valiant efforts, all Protostar merchandise is once again bound by the laws of the market.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Have you no respect for the value of the bottom line?

localizedTextIdText: The Gift Recoverbot has recruited you to attach and launch returns back to the SuperMall - via rocket. The returns are stacked up in Academy Corner in Thayd. Do so quickly so the unhappy customers can get their return vouchers and spend even more money!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Gift Recoverbot in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Error. This unit is required to launch Protostar Return Rockets to the SuperMall, but this unit's weapons protocol is disabled. Requesting assistance in return for compensation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Return function not completed. Requesting sentient to proceed to Academy Corner and launch Protostar Returns.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Return verification complete. Beginning distribution of return vouchers, minus 99% restocking fee.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Warning - looking directly into rocket flames may cause ocular damage.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This unit is programmed to wish you a merry Winterfest, sentient.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The sky is filled with the lovely sights of return rockets, and return vouchers are now in the pockets of customers across Thayd.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Error. Weapons malfunctions required all units to be disabled after rockets blew up seven stores in the SuperMall.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Error, denial denied. Returning to request function.

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Gift Recoverbot in the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Unit is required to locate Wayward Winterfest Gift and return them to SuperMall for re-shipping with Recovery Rockets. Unit cannot. Please help unit?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Gift recovery not completed. Requesting sentient to proceed to Spaceport Alpha and return Wayward Winterfest Gift.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Gift recovery verification complete. Updating shipment tracking information. Customer apology issuing is queued.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Warning - directing Recovery Rockets toward architecture or geography will result in forfeiture of compensation.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This unit is programmed to wish you a merry Winterfest, sentient. Wishing complete.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You assisted Gift Recoverbot with the recovery of the Wayward Winterfest Gift mistakenly scattered across Spaceport Alpha in Illium. Now they can make it to their intended recipients, Dominion military personnel deployed around Nexus, during the Winterfest season!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Infinite loop. Anti-weapons protocols are in place, preventing use of rockets. Try to use rockets for task completion, cannot use rockets because anti-weapons protocols are in place, repeat.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Returning to pleading mode.

localizedTextIdText: The Home Delivery Clerk in Shindig Hollow needs you to don a Delivery Worker's Uniform to deliver unlabeled packages to their recipients in the Arborian Gardens.. Just toss a generic package type to each recipient - you should be able to figure it out by race.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Home Delivery Clerk in Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar requests new personnel to pilot a Protostar-Patented Package Pelter for deliveries! They are unlabeled, but all creatures no doubt order the same things by race!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't worry about the lack of labeling! Protostar knows what races prefer what items, so you merely need to deliver the right type of package to the right customer!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your non-specific package delivery was a success! Should Protostar ever need your speedy delivery services, you shall be contacted promptly!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Direct all injury complaints to the Protostar Legal Department for bureaucratic dismissals!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now to shred these 112 injury complaints!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You knocked over plenty of people in Thayd to make sure they got their Protostar purchases. Once they're off the ground, they'll no doubt spend more money on MORE fine Protostar merchandise.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Protostar accepts your confession of being afraid of packages.

localizedTextIdText: Chronicler Witchmoss sent you a gourd in the mail with a verse from the old Jack Shade poem carved into the side, as well as an invitation. Perhaps the folk in Thayd can shed more light on the topic.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Visit Chronicler Witchmoss in Thayd to see Exiles inaugurate Shade's Eve on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The verse on this gourd is from the old Jack Shade poem. Maybe the sender has more information about it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, you found me! Got that gourd I sent, too! Welcome to the center of Shade's Eve activity. You should check out all the fun here in Shindig Hollow!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You go have a good time, now!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Not every day I get a gourd in the mail.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Chronicler Witchmoss brought you to the Shade's Eve festivities, and Thayd is buzzing with activity surrounding the holiday.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I must be out of my gourd.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why is a poem on the side of a gourd?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What's the poem on the gourd about?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Gourds are in season this time of year. I meant to write the verse on something else, but... I didn't. So. Free gourds, I reckon.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Well it tells the tale, or history rather, of Jack Shade and the plague that wiped out so many so many years ago. It's also a chroniclin' of the Angel that cured us all. It's also some important DOs and DON'Ts.

localizedTextIdText: You've received a plump gourd in the mail with a verse from the old Shade's Eve poem from Acolyte Vesperus. Visiting them in Illium might shed some light on the reason.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Visit Acolyte Vesperus in the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The verse on this gourd is from the old Jack Shade poem. Maybe the sender has more information about it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Piqued your interest, did I? Welcome to the Parade Grounds, where our once-macabre remembrance has become the subject of frivolous celebration.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Now that you are here, you should partake in the festivities.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It does seem a bit lighthearted.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Acolyte Vesperus brought you to the Shade's Eve festivities, and Illium is buzzing with activity surrounding the holiday.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I must be out of my gourd.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why is a poem on the side of a gourd?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What's the poem on the gourd about?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Do not question the manner in which our history is displayed to you. Be grateful for the gift.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The plague itself was personified as a dark and sinister figure known as Jack Shade, while the young girl whose blood was used to create the vaccine became known as the Angel.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Corporation wants you to take up arms with four of your friends in an exciting new event, Protogames Academy! Find a Protogames Recruiter in Sylvan Glade or Gallow to learn about how you can master group combat techniques and become a fully-functioning member of society!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with a Protogames Recruiter in Sylvan Glade or Gallow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $?c/The Protostar Corporation is offering you an exciting opportunity! Find me in a town near you to become a contestant on our combat training game show, Protogames Academy!/The Protostar Corporation is offering you an exciting opportunity! Sign up to become a contestant on our combat training game show, Protogames Academy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find me to learn all about this exciting opportunity!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a pleasure to see your enthusiasm for becoming an expert in the ways of group combat. Are you ready to be a contestant for Protogames Academy?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: We hope you, our valued customer, will flourish in any group endeavor.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Input your name on the teleporter beside me to sign up!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Protogames Recruiter and discovered the entrance to the Protogames Academy! Now you and four of your friends can team up and become one step closer to fame, fortune, and group combat glory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We hope you reconsider turning down this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

localizedTextIdText: The Meteor Response System is showing red lights in the Meteorite Shield Transmitter on Asteroid 9766, make sure to activate the transmitter and weather the possible meteor shower.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Meteor Response System to return the Meteor Response Kit.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hello, welcome to the Meteorite Response System. Meteors are incoming, please be advised, an individual is needed to check out the Meteorite Shield Transmitter.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The meteorites have struck in a few locations and caused light damage, but are within parameters.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thank you reactivating the Meteorite Shield Transmitter.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Thank you for accepting the task to check out the equipment.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Meteorite Shield Transmitter has broadcast the most recent meteor strike locations. Thank you for your assistance.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Where can I blow up some rocks!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Meteorite Shield Transmitter on Asteroid 9766 was reactivated in time, although it was just in time for a meteor shower to strike.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Return to the Meteor Response System
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Please take cover as the meteorites will be here any minute.

localizedTextIdText: An Ultimate Protogames Recruiter wants you to apply for a contestant slot on the Ultimate Protogames, the most widely viewed holo-broadcast on Nexus! Gather your strongest crew of adventurers for this once in a lifetime Protostar opportunity, and meet with the Ultimate Protogames Recruiter outside of the Hellrose Bowl.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Ultimate Protogames Recruiter outside of the Hellrose Bowl in Malgrave
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: $?c/Protostar is offering you a shot at fame, fortune and glory! Do you have what it takes to be a contestant on the Ultimate Protogames? Find me to sign up!/Protostar is offering you a shot at fame, fortune and glory! Do you have what it takes to be a contestant on the Ultimate Protogames? Sign up now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find me to learn all about this exciting opportunity!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Am I meeting the next Ultimate Protogames champion? The Protostar Corporation is excited to employ you for this holo-broadcast opportunity.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Compensation not guaranteed!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The teleporter beside me will automatically enter you as a contestant.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the Ultimate Protogames Recruiter and unlocked the ability to participate in the Ultimate Protogames, a Protostar Corporation sponsored event holo-broadcast to the galaxy. Find four like-minded adventurers and team up to take on this exciting challenge!
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Ultimate Protogames Recruiter
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: We hope you reconsider your denial of this profitable opportunity!

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon has asked you to kill Marauders in Deadstar Valley and Grimvoid Pass before they can pose a threat to Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Corrigan Doon via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've got Marauders under every bloody rock around here, and I expect more are on the way. What say you kill the blighters before they make it to Nexus?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you recall our conversation about all the Marauders around here? Perhaps, if you find the time, you could kill a few hundred of them. Pretty please?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Once you set your mind to a little bit of violence, you put on quite an impressive show. Next time I need something dead, I'm definitely calling you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You significantly reduced the Marauder population in Deadstar Valley and Grimvoid Pass, pleasing Corrigan Doon to no end.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Did you say 'no' to me? I'm... wounded. Truly.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland has asked you to kill Marauders in Deadstar Valley and Grimvoid Pass before they can pose a threat to Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Marauders are crawlin' 'round this place like flies on... well, ya get the point. We gotta wipe 'em out before they spread to Nexus. Ready to fight?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya can't spit in Deadstar Valley or Grimvoid Pass without hittin' a stinkin' Marauder. Take the fight to 'em before it's too late, y'hear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm impressed. Droppin' Marauders ain't exactly hard, but when there's so many of 'em in one place it can get pretty dicey.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You significantly reduced the Marauder population in Deadstar Valley and Grimvoid Pass, pleasing Deadeye Brightland to no end.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No need to feel guilty - or scared - about cuttin' down Marauders.

localizedTextIdText: You found a journal detailing the friendship and adventures of a man named Clem and his jabbit Missey. It's quite apparent after only reading a few lines that they care for each other very much. Bron Goldenhand even got a bit emotional and gruffly told you to leave the old man alone and to get back to work.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Missey, you member that fire in Emberwood? I burned my hands somethin awful pullin that burning log off ya. Then I woulda never got outa there without ya leading the way. They never could separate us after that.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Missey, you member that fire in Emberwood? I burned my hands somethin awful pullin that burning log off ya. Then I woulda never got outa there without ya leading the way. Ah, they never could separate us after that.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found a journal detailing the friendship and adventures of a man named Clem and his jabbit Missey. It's quite apparent after only reading a few lines that they care for each other very much. Bron Goldenhand even got a bit emotional and gruffly told you to leave the old man alone and to get back to work.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: sdsfsd

localizedTextIdText: Bosun Jorg is hoping someone can kill Acidicil and the Solarsting buzzbings, then recover his lost loot. Acidicil and the Solarsting buzzbings infest Solarswept Pass.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Bosun Jorg in Deadman's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: WANTED DEAD: Acidicil, a giant buzzbing found in Solarswept Pass. Kill Acidicil and its swarm, then return Bosun's Jorg's missing stash for a reward.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WANTED DEAD: Acidicil, a giant buzzbing found in Solarswept Pass. Kill Acidicil and its swarm, then return Bosun's Jorg's missing stash for a reward.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ye be wastin' time, scrub. Hurry 'n kill those buzzbings in Solarswept Pass, then get me gold back. Quick!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome back, mate. Good t'see ye came back with me gold. I hope ye showed that stingin' monster the color o' its own blood!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't worry 'bout me. It's just a flesh wound! I'll be plunderin' in no time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed Acidicil and the rather menacing Solarsting buzzbings in Solarswept Pass, then recovered Bosun Jorg lost loot.

localizedTextIdText: Sweet Tooth Sinsira at Shindig Hollow has explained the joy of trick-or-treating, which consists of collecting - and eating - Shade's Eve candy. Visit the houses of friends and strangers alike, and collect sweets from the candy bowls they've left out for the holiday. There are eight types of candy, each represented by a holographic image. You can only collect one of each type. Make sure to purchase a candy bowl of your own from the housing vendor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Sweet Tooth Sinsira at Shindig Hollow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Shade's Eve isn't all about being scared - it's also about trick-or-treating for candy at the houses of your friends and neighbors. You should try it!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you done any trick-or-treating yet? You'd better visit your neighbors' sky plots and get some candy before it's all gone!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That's quite a candy haul, $(player.name)! I don't suppose you'd mind sharing a piece or two with me, huh?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Only take one piece per bowl. Oo, and buy your own candy bowl on your plot, too!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're as sweet as candy! Now come here and get a big Shade's Eve hug!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: How could I say no to candy?
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have enough candy for both of us.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went trick-or-treating on Shade's Eve and collected several delectable candies from bowls outside the houses of both friends and strangers.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: I'm supposed to take Jack Shade's candy?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Yup! To keep Jack Shade away in the years following the Shades plague, people would leave out treats on Shade's Eve. They figured if Jack was too busy eating candy, he'd leave the normal folks alone.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Oh, you silly! Everyone knows there's no such thing as Jack Shade! Besides, if you don't take the candy, someone else - like me - will.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Suit yourself, grumpypants. That means more candy for the rest of us!

localizedTextIdText: Corrigan Doon has asked you to come and meet him the next time you're in Deadman's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Corrigan Doon in Deadman's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm returning to Deadman's Landing, where I will shed what little dignity I possess and drink alien rotgut until I am completely soused. Come join me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I'll be getting nice and drunk in Deadman's Landing if you need me. But first I should let Cosine know I'm still alive before he sends for more help.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It'sh sho nice to shee you, mate! Pull up a sheat and have a couple of drinksh! *hic* Don't conshern yourshelf with Laveka! She'll crop up eventually.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll catch up with you later.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Corrigan Doon in Deadman's Landing to celebrate your partial victory over Laveka the Dark-Hearted. Until Mordechai Redmoon is found, Laveka's whereabouts remain unknown.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: After all we've been through? I thought we were friends.

localizedTextIdText: Deadeye Brightland has asked you to come and meet him the next time you're in Deadman's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Deadeye Brightland in Deadman's Landing
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I'm headin' back to Deadman's Landing to get drunk 'n think things over. Come see me at High Stakes the next time you're in the neighborhood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'll be in Deadman's Landing for a while. Stop by for a drink when the mood strikes you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice to see ya made it. Ya done good work, even if Mordechai got away with Laveka. They're bound to make trouble again, so we better be ready for 'em.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met up with Deadeye Brightland in Deadman's Landing to celebrate your partial victory over Laveka the Dark-Hearted. Until Mordechai Redmoon is found, Laveka's whereabouts remain unknown.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: To hell with you, then. I've had enough of yer smart mouth, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: It seems like many groups of rival marauder gangs have been gathering together on the Borellian Cluster in Halon Ring. Do you have what it takes to take them out. The criminal Bron Goldenhand in Graylight on the Borellian Cluster in Halon Ring has information you need.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Bron Goldenhand in Graylight on the Borellian Cluster
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Sources on the Borellian Cluster say rival marauder groups are banding together. Do you have what it takes to take them out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome to MY port! So yer lookin' for info on the marauders round here, well nothin' goes on in the Borellian Cluster without me knowin' and I'll tell ya for a price.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: See Bron Goldenhand for more information on the marauders.
