localizedTextIdText: Necromantic items, such as Blackbone Brazier inside the Doomfarer, are overflowing with dark energy and fueling Laveka's evil spells. In order to weaken Laveka's ever-increasing power, Deadeye Brightland wants you to destroy as many Blackbone Brazier as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Deadeye Brightland via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All this necromancy makes me wanna puke, and I think the braziers in that ship got somethin' to do with it. Try to destroy as many of 'em as ya can.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Laveka's more powerful than I expected. I reckon them braziers in the Doomfarer are boostin' her abilities somehow. Get in there 'n wreck 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Laveka's more powerful than I expected. I reckon them braziers in the Doomfarer are boostin' her abilities somehow. Get in there 'n wreck 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I can tell ya took care of them braziers 'cause I don't feel like hurlin' my lunch all over the inside of this helmet no more. Ya done good.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With the Blackbone Brazier destroyed, the Doomfarer - Laveka's base of operations - should provide less necromantic energy for Laveka's wicked spells.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're duckin' out on me now? I won't forget it.

localizedTextIdText: Before you and Corrigan Doon face Laveka, he wants you to meet him near the Doomfarer in Redmoon Reach. Doon has used the necrodust you were able to collect earlier to create a potion that should protect you both from the worst of Laveka's necromancy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Corrigan Doon in Redmoon Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time we took care of Laveka. First, we had best partake of the necrodust potion on the off chance it can protect us. Meet me outside the Doomfarer.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Let us toast Laveka's impending demise with a glass of death juice. Don't be so squeamish! It might be the only thing that keeps us from being killed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Blind me! It tastes like something died in my mouth, it does! I've had a lot to drink in my time, but never anything like this.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope that flavor was worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Corrigan Doon near the Doomfarer and drank the deathly draught he prepared using necrodust. After drinking such a terrible tonic, it had better do something to protect you from Laveka's necromancy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, don't be such an infant. I'm certain the potion will be effective.

localizedTextIdText: Before you and Deadeye Brightland face Laveka, he wants you to meet him near the Doomfarer in Redmoon Reach. Deadeye has used the necrodust you were able to collect earlier to create a potion that should protect you both from the worst of Laveka's necromancy.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Deadeye Brightland in Redmoon Reach
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's about time we taught Laveka a lesson. Meet me outside the Doomfarer so I can give you a dose of that necrodust potion. It should protect us.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't just stand there. Let's raise a glass and drink this horrible stuff. It may be the only thing that keeps us safe from Laveka's magic.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hellfire! That stuff tastes worse than it smells! I've had some bad rotgut in my time, but this crap takes the Chua-lovin' cake. Yech!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope that flavor was worth it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with Deadeye Brightland near the Doomfarer and drank the deathly draught he prepared using necrodust. After drinking such a terrible tonic, it had better do something to protect you from Laveka's necromancy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Ya damn coward! I can't believe you'd cut out after all we been through!

localizedTextIdText: The Entity's minions are close to freeing their evil master from the Lightspire, and Drusera has begged you to thwart their efforts. To do so, you must seal the dimensional rifts at each of the six wards that surround the Lightspire.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Drusera in the Lightspire
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Strain's trying to free the Entity from the Lightspire! Please, seal the dimensional rifts they've opened or the wards holding him will be destroyed!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Please! The rifts at each of the wards have to be sealed. It's the only way we can ensure the Entity is contained within the Lightspire!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Please! The rifts at each of the wards have to be sealed. It's the only way we can ensure the Entity is contained within the Lightspire!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm sorry I didn't tell you the truth sooner. You've done so much for me... so much for all of Nexus... but I was so scared of losing you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I know you can do it, $(player.name)! I believe in you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Please... don't be angry, $(player.name). Don't hate me for what I've done.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I've got a lot to think about.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were able to prevent the Entity from escaping the Lightspire by sealing the dimensional rifts at each of the six wards surrounding the Lightspire. Nexus is safe from the Entity... for now.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to Drusera inside the Lightspire
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Tell me more about the wards.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: There is an alternate reality beyond what you can normally see. Wards were placed there to keep the Entity confined to the Lightspire. If they're destroyed, the Entity will break free.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: There are six of them. They represent the Archon and the five Orders that contributed to my creation. So long as they stand, the Entity is unable to escape the Lightspire.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I thought you were my friend. How could you doom Nexus to such a fate?

Finished Quest

localizedTextIdText: You've committed to entering the Protogames Academy, so you've already taken the first big step towards mastering group combat. The Protostar Corporation would like to ensure that you and four of your teammates see your commitment through by offering you this one-time completion certification!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Protogames Recruiter via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Congratulations on investing in your future with Protostar! Complete the Protogames Academy with four other highly committed individuals and receive your group combat certification.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You have yet to fulfill your academic requirements!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to fulfill your academic requirements!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a fabulous show! You and your teammates completed the Protogames Academy and earned a gold star for your efforts. Good job, you!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Certification received only upon successful completion of all course requirements.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Be sure to use all future income on Protostar brand merchandise and products!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You learned group combat techniques in the Protogames Academy from the Protostar Corporation, the company devoted to your continued survival as you traverse the dangers of Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I hope you reconsider investing in your combat future with Protostar!

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg are preventing the Dominion/Exiles from securing the landing zone, and are generally wreaking havoc upon everything in general. They're constantly arriving by land and by boat and tearing things up on the beach. Kill them.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll murder for you, Dorian Walker.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the Dreg!

localizedTextIdTitle: They're Gonna Need a Bigger Boat
localizedTextIdText: The Dreg have control of the waters, and that is very evidently becoming bad news for everyone. Lulu has provided you with remote controlled Sharkbots, which the player will steer into the Dreg skiffs to blow them up. The Sharkbots will have HP and will generate threat from the Shellarks and other creatures in the water, so it'll take some skill to make the bombs hit their targets.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll give them a tale of a fateful trip.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed those boats good!

localizedTextIdText: The Dreg are nothing if not thorough in their quest for death, destruction, and foodstuffs. They've set up numerous traps to catch the Dominion and Exiles, and the player must rescue the explorers trapped within them.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll take the food off their table.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: You ruined the Dreg's meal plans.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You cancelled Thanksgiving Dinner for the Dreg.

localizedTextIdText: Surveys of the island show a large technologically advanced settlement to the north, and Dorian wants the player to make first contact with the natives and arrange a diplomatic meeting. Upon arriving at the gate to the city, they will meet one of the Sleepers of the Nomad (note that the Sleeper will not be identified as a Sleeper until later) and will have a short dialog with them.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll converse the crap outta them.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You talked to a Nomad. Your kids will write stories about this day.

localizedTextIdText: The Nomad First Officer says that in order to enter the city, you need to do something for them. They inform the player of a particularly big monster roaming the forest to the west. If the player can kill it and bring back its teeth as proof of their skill, they will arrange for a diplomatic meeting.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll prove the crap outta myself!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You have shown yourself to be worthy.

localizedTextIdText: Go around the Nomad town and learn about the city.
Get on a transport ship and go to Coralus to assist Artemis Zin  in exploring this great new territory that was just revealed.

localizedTextIdText: Here's your big chance to score some bonus Elder Gems. All you need to do is group up with your friends and run Prime-level dungeons and Veteran-level adventures this week. If you can complete enough of them, you'll be sure to hit pay dirt when you get back to your capital city!

localizedTextIdText: The Darkspur are sending in a squad of attack ships to attack Graylight and slow you down. Luckily Bron knows about an advanced attack ship in Swiftfell Ridge and wants you to suit up and take out the Darkspur's fighters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Bron Goldenhand in Graylight via Datachron communicator
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Those damn Darkspur are sendin' in attack ships to Graylight! I sold the Swiftfell an advanced attack ship earlier. Find it and take out those fighters!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya ain't got time ta waste! Get that ship form the Swiftfell and intercept those Darkspur ships before they get to Graylight!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: A bit late, but I guess it coulda been a lot worse! How'd ya like my fancy little ship?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't you get all snippy with me, else the price of your info will go up!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: HAHA!... No it does't. Now get back ta work!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Fine, I'll stop the attack ships too!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You managed to save Graylight and Bron while single-handedly taking out a squad of Darkspur fighters!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Those attack ships are going down!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so advanced about this ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: How do the Anti-Ship Precision Lasers work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: How does the Anti-Ship Rocket Volley work?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: You said something about a shield to?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay04: Why would you ever sell this to the Swiftfell?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The weapon systems of course, it has Anti-Ship Precision Lasers, an Anti-Ship Rocket Volley, and a Protective Shield! Trust me they don't make 'em like this anymore!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: They only target up to two ships but they recharge fast. You got more ships than that to shoot then the Anti-Ship Rocket Volley is the way ta go.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It blows up EVERYTHING!!! You got a lock on it, then its toast! Watch out though it takes a while to reload!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Yea if ya know you're gonna take a hit then bring up the shield. It will stop their missiles cold!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText04: For money of course! I did put a kill switch in it so they can't use it against me, and sellin' it ta them let 'em get more slush past the law meanin' even more money for me!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Startin' ta wonder weather or not you really want this info!

localizedTextIdText: Papa Phineas himself is appearing at Protostar's SuperMall-in-the-Sky for Protostar's Gala Winterfest Extravaganza by Protostar. You won't want to miss out on the fun and savings, so take the teleporter in the Parade Grounds in Illium and get ready to be festive and merry and experience the random events.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Papa Phineas in the Parade Grounds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Come meet me, Papa Phineas, in person, at Protostar's SuperMall-in-the-Sky! We are holding many events and sales, so don't miss out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Just take this handy dandy teleporter and enjoy your time in Protostar's SuperMall-in-the-Sky.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I see you've had a wonderful time at Protostar's SuperMall-in-the-Sky. Your holiday shopping is our quarterly profits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just use our teleporter here to get their straight away. No traffic or parking!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I suggest you go again while you can. Once Winterfest is over, the mall will be gone too.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I can't miss out on this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Protostar's SuperMall-in-the-Sky for Protostar's Gala Winterfest Extravaganza by Protostar and had a grand ol' time, mostly. There were a few random events to work through, but all and all, it was rather enjoyable.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What is this 'SuperMall' I keep hearing about?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What will I be doing in the SuperMall?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Officially called Protostar's Gala Winterfest Extravaganza by Protostar, it is a holiday we have created to unite the various interstellar cold-weather festivals under one politically correct and highly profitable roof.

localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Why, anything from shopping sprees, to helping stores stock up or fix products, or even meeting me in person! What an honor for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Don't let this pass you by, friend. Winterfest will be over before you know it.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Protostar Prime members are now eligible for special RUSH shipping, for just a few additional credits. Register as a delivery contractor today!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What are you waiting for? Those customers in Lightreach Mission are eagerly awaiting their desireable merchandise.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: On time and under budget! Isn't timely fulfillment a rush?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head to Lightreach Mission, and step on it! "It" being our patented RUSH nodes!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You made your daily RUSH delivery. Aren't you proud?
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak to the Winterfest RUSH Facilitator - Illium to Ellevar - Q9835 [NOT TRANSLATED]
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thanks for ruining Winterfest, again.

localizedTextIdText: Freight Supervisor Lola has lost contact with one of her freighters near Halon, one of Nexus's moons. The ship is believed to have crash landed on an asteroid known as Fragment Zero. Spacers say there is some kind of derelict facility on the floating asteroid. Take Freight Supervisor Lola ship and meet with her to start your exploration.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Freight Supervisor Lola on Fragment Zero
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My husband's cargo ship didn't make its last checkpoint outside of Halon. If my Hugo's anything, he's punctual, I tell ya. Be a dear and check on him?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hugo's missed checkpoint was just outside the Halon Ring. You can use my ship to get there, darn tootin'. Quickly, off with you now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here we are on the Ring. The wreck's just down the ridge. Oh, I do hope my Hugo is all right...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd go find him myself, but these old bones can't take the strain, no sir.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Fragment Zero with Freight Supervisor Lola in search of her husband.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will you do in the meantime?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't fret, dearie. I'll do my best to help you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Oh dear... what am I going to do?

localizedTextIdText: Freight Supervisor Lola has lost contact with one of her freighters near Halon, one of Nexus's moons. The ship is believed to have crash landed on an asteroid known as Fragment Zero. Spacers say there is some kind of derelict facility on the floating asteroid. Take Freight Supervisor Lola ship and meet with her to start your exploration.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Freight Supervisor Lola on Fragment Zero
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My husband's cargo ship didn't make its last checkpoint outside of Halon. If my Hugo's anything, he's punctual, I tell ya. Be a dear and check on him?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hugo's missed checkpoint was just outside the Halon Ring. You can use my ship to get there, darn tootin'. Quickly, off with you now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here we are on the Ring. The wreck's just down the ridge. Oh, I do hope my Hugo is all right...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd go myself, but these old bones can't take the strain, no sir.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Fragment Zero with Freight Supervisor Lola in search of her husband.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will you do in the meantime?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't fret, dearie. I'll do my best to help you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Oh dear... what am I going to do?

localizedTextIdText: The Progenitor of Primal Logic, an archive terminal of Nazrek, has been discovered in the The Skittering Parlor. The encrypted data uncovered a method that allows certain sentient creatures to communicate mind to mind. These secrets seem to be highly guarded behind security systems.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to the Caretaker in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nazrek's experiment files secured and moved to lab. Telepathy method information archived. Archive access restricted.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Evokers crafted the Telepathy stone so that Nazrek could communicate with his sentient creations.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Initializing Caretaker...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: By accessing the Telepathy stone you will be able to read the minds of certain creatures, within the confines of the Gardens, that have been heavily infused with primal logic.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Could I really use telepathy to communicate?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You bypassed the security and now have access to the Telepathy Stone. This stone was created by the Eldan Evokers to allow Progenitor Nazrek to communicate with his sentient creations.

localizedTextIdText: The Direweb Broodlord has requested buzzbing brains found in the Tainted Gardens. While not necessarily the most reliable source, this creature claims that they are infused with primal logic, which may further our study. Not to mention it promises to reveal some secret if you bring enough brains for it to feed on.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the Direweb Broodlord in The Skittering Parlor
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I have s-s-secret to tell you. But you do s-s-something for me firs-s-st. Buzzbing brains-s-s, I needs-s-s them. S-s-satisfy my appetite and s-s-secret is yours-s-s.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: (Incomplete)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: S-s-so hungry... Need more brains-s-s.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Many brains-s-s you bring. This-s-s will do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Us-s-se your s-s-scanbot to extract the brains-s-s carefully! Buzzbing Brains-s-s very delicate... and s-s-so delicious-s-s.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I give you this-s-s.  It holds-s-s the s-s-secret to the pas-s-st.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This secret better be worth it!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: This secret better be worth it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: While the logic-infused buzzbing brains are indeed intriguing and worthy of study, you have returned them to the hungry spider in hopes that the secret was worth the effort. The hungry spider provided a web-encased object... wonder what's in there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not tes-s-st my patience-s-s.

localizedTextIdText: You have obtained an Eldan artifact that supposedly holds the secret to one of their greatest experiments. Find what secrets can be unlocked with it in the Tainted Gardens, and dive deeper into the intentions of Progenitor Nazrek.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Turn on the Holo Projector Terminal in the Tainted Gardens
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A strange Eldan artifact. It must serve some kind of purpose.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Accessing secured archives...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The unique shape looks like it is made to fit somewhere.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I wonder what this is used for.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Now to find out the goal of these experiments.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The artifact unlocked a way into the Exo-lab where Progenitor Nazrek first conducted his experiments on the queen spider and queen buzzbing. The result of the added intelligence mixed with their instinctual enmity created an endless conflict between the two broods.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Turn on the Holo Projector Terminal

localizedTextIdText: You've got a dangerous job to do. Fight your way through lunatic Pell cultists and kill Stormtalon, their god. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Troza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've been lookin' for a tough Exile, but I suppose you'll have to do. Stormtalon's makin' waves. Up for goin' toe-to-toe with a so-called god?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Kill any gods lately? No? What are you waiting for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey there god slayer. Ya did good. Better rest up and get ready for tomorrow's dirty work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You might want to bring an umbrella. Just sayin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Until next time, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You fought Pell cultists, survived possessed tornados, and took Stormtalon down a few notches. All in a day's work on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I guess I'll keep lookin' for that Exile since you don't fit the bill.

localizedTextIdText: Certain death lies in Stormtalon's Lair - the death of the Thundercall Pell and their god. With singular purpose, you must execute the Dominion's will and defeat Stormtalon\n \nCertain death awaits, yes, but that death will be Stormtalon. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Viydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion demands that the Thundercall Pell are kept at bay. See that Stormtalon receives a quick death or you will receive your own.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Obesrvational protocols indicate that Stormtalon has not fallen by your hand. What do you make of this?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Stormtalon death was but the first of those who oppose the Dominion. Yours is indefinitely postponed, should you continue be useful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not let fear stop you from executing this monstrosity.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you can terminate a god, you have nothing to fear from death.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: More foes will fall by my hand.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Stormtalon death marks the fall of the Thundercall Pell's plans on Nexus, and Captain Viydra is pleased with your efforts. You scoured Stormtalon's Lair on Prime difficulty and lived to bask in the glory the Dominion bestowed upon you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If fear is what rules you then you have no place within my ranks.

localizedTextIdTitle: Dungeon: Prime Ruins of Kel Voreth
localizedTextIdText: The Osun have returned to Ruins of Kel Voreth in search of exanite. Trooper Troza needs you to kill their leader, Forgemaster Trogun. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Troza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Forgemaster Trogun and his Osun pals are tearing up the Ruins of Kel Voreth looking for exanite. Get over there and stop the party.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Forgemaster Trogun and his buddies are itchin' for a fight in Kel Voreth. Head on over there and give 'em all you got.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I bet the Osun are a buncha sad sacks now that Forgemaster Trogun is toast. We can mop 'em up real easy now, and that's just what we're gonna do.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Give 'em hell, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That was some fine work $(player.name).
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took care of a big, ugly problem named Forgemaster Trogun in the Ruins of Kel Voreth on Prime difficulty. Trooper Troza appreciates you kicking some Osun ass for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Thought you were up to the task, but I guess I was wrong.

localizedTextIdTitle: Dungeon: Prime Ruins of Kel Voreth
localizedTextIdText: The Osun in the Ruins of Kel Voreth continue to dig for exanite, and it is in the best interests of the Dominion to demoralize the giants. Captain Viydra requires you to defeat Forgemaster Trogun. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Viydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Observational protocols indicate the Osun continue to strengthen their foothold in the Ruins of Kel Voreth. Forgemaster Trogun must be executed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Challenging Forgemaster Trogun brings with it a high risk of death. Do you fear facing him in the Ruins of Kel Voreth?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have proven yourself a valuable asset to the Dominion, citizen. Forgemaster Trogun death is a small relief, but there is always another enemy lurking in the shadows.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Your loyalty to the Dominion overshadows your insufferable enthusiasm.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I may require your skills later, $(player.name). Be prepared.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Your strong opposition to the Osun in the Ruins of Kel Voreth culminated in the death of Forgemaster Trogun on Prime difficulty. Captain Viydra acknowledged your efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I assumed you were a Dominion asset. My processor must require service.

localizedTextIdText: Mordechai Redmoon greed is relentless, and the Lopp on Skullcano reached out to the Exiles for help in kicking him off the island. Trooper Troza needs you to crush Mordechai Redmoon. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Troza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As if us Exiles don't got enough slagheads trying to wipe us off Nexus, Mordechai Redmoon just won't quit. Get over to Skullcano and ground that Marauder's ships for good.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Mordechai Redmoon's holed up in Skullcano, and he's just askin' for a good old fashioned Exile butt-whoopin'. What's the hold up?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Chief Kaskalak and his Lopp friends were lucky to have you fighting for 'em. You got stones, $(player.race). Nice work today.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I got a soft spot for those little long-eared fellas he's terrorizin'.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Make sure you rest your legs and check back with me tomorrow.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You showed Mordechai Redmoon and his group of buffoons the true grit of the Exiles. You defeated Mordechai Redmoon in Skullcano!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Seems you don't have the grit to take this bastard down, huh?

localizedTextIdText: Captain Viydra requires your aid against Mordechai Redmoon and his Marauders. She requests that you venture to Skullcano and defeat Mordechai Redmoon. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Viydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Mordechai Redmoon is a greedy pirate who must be brought to justice. Proceed to Skullcano and ensure he and his accomplices are punished.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: ICI surveillance reports indicate that Mordechai Redmoon still breathes. Get to Skullcano and finish your duties.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am not easily impressed, but you continue to serve Dominion well, $(player.name). I calculate a high probability that your service will be requested again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You have made a wise choice, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Redmoon was a mighty foe, even for one of your ability.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought glory to the Dominion by defeating Mordechai Redmoon in Skullcano on Prime difficulty. Only the most skilled could have endured such a task and earned the praise of Captain Viydra.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Cowards have no place within the ranks of the Dominion. Leave me.

localizedTextIdTitle: Dungeon: Prime Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden
localizedTextIdText: The Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden has been corrupted by the Strain. Spiritmother Selene's Echo seeks aid in cleansing the Strain corruption. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Troza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Do you have the stones to take on the Strain? Spiritmother Selene's Echo needs our help to cleanse her sanctuary. You ready for this, $(player.class)?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: She may be dead, but Spiritmother Selene's Echo doesn't have all day. Get moving.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Spiritmother Selene's Echo won't forget what you did for her. She's tough, so I know she hasn't given up yet. Be ready if she calls again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what I like to hear.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Strain won't rest, and neither will we.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I won't give up, at least.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Spiritmother Selene's Echo had been corrupted during her struggle to purge the Strain from the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden. You defeated her corrupted form on Prime difficulty and freed her spirit from its torment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What's wrong? You too important to do this kinda work or what?

localizedTextIdTitle: Dungeon: Prime Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden
localizedTextIdText: The Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden has been corrupted by the Strain. Spiritmother Selene's Echo seeks aid in cleansing the Strain corruption. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Viydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden has been overcome by the Strain. Spiritmother Selene's Echo requires your aid in destroying the corruption.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You are wasting time by speaking to me. The Strain will not sit idly by.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Spiritmother Selene's Echo would have been a powerful ally for the Dominion. However, like you, she is resilient, and I suspect we will hear from her again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get to Spiritmother Selene's Echo. See that the corruption is eradicated.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The fight against corruption in the Sanctuary is far from over.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The mission didn't go as planned.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Spiritmother Selene's Echo had been corrupted during her struggle to purge the Strain from the Sanctuary of the Swordmaiden. You defeated her corrupted form on Prime difficulty and free her spirit from its torment.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The Torine Sisters have more might and strength than you, it seems.

localizedTextIdText: Daggerstone Pass is a strategic area, vital to Dominion activities on Nexus. Lyza Steelford has asked for help controlling this area, and wants you to sabotage critical Dominion communications infrastructure. Such a blow could give the Exiles an opportunity for a major offensive while the enemy in disarray.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lyza Steelford via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're preppin' for a major sabotage mission in Daggerstone Pass. You'll get a little somethin' no matter the outcome. You ready to stick it to them Dommies?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Dominion troops'll be hoppin' like jabbits after that!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I hope you know a thing or two about explosives.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I bet that was a hoot!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped disrupt and destroy the enemy's commmunications infrastructure, inflicting a major blow from which the Dominion will not soon recover.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do I get if I win?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't think I heard you right. Wanna say that again?

localizedTextIdText: Commander Kolros has tasked you with taking control of Daggerstone Pass, a central hub for imperial communications on Nexus. The Exiles have established a nearby base to sabotage Dominion communications, and such an incursion is unacceptable.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kolros via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles have targeted our communications infrastructure in Daggerstone Pass. You shall defend our facilities at all costs. Do I make myself clear?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I smell the blood on your boots and sense the bloodrush in your veins. You took vengeance upon the Exiles and have trodden atop the corpses of your foes!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Should you fail, your efforts will not go unrecognized.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion will reward your loyalty.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put those Exiles in their place!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped drive the Exiles out of Daggerstone Pass, securing the Dominion's control of its vital communications infrastructure.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do I get if I win?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Show fear, and you become as prey.

localizedTextIdTitle: PvP: Battle in the Halls of the Bloodsworn
localizedTextIdText: The Halls of the Bloodsworn contain valuable information on forging exanite weapons. Lyza Steelford has tasked you with taking control of the halls to prevent the Dominion from gaining access to these Osun crafting techniques. You will earn 2 tokens for a win, and 1 token for a loss.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lyza Steelford via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Osun recorded their methods of craftin' exanite weapons in the Halls of the Bloodsworn. We can't let the Dommies get hold of it. You want to help?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm impressed, friend. You showed them Dominion scum who's boss. Now maybe us Exiles can figure out this exanite.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show 'em how a real Exile $(player.class) fights!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We owe you for that, $(player.class).
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We have claimed the Halls of the Bloodsworn!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Dominion in the Halls of the Bloodsworn, preventing valuable information on exanite weapons technology from falling into the wrong hands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do I get if I win?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Might want to think twice before you do somethin' stupid.

localizedTextIdTitle: PvP: Battle in the Halls of the Bloodsworn
localizedTextIdText: The Halls of the Bloodsworn contain valuable information on forging exanite weapons. Commander Kolros has tasked you with taking control of the halls, as this technology could be quite valuable to the Dominion. You will earn 2 tokens for a win, and 1 token for a loss.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kolros via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Osun methods for crafting exanite weapons are recorded in the Halls of the Bloodsworn. Your emperor demands you secure them for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Halls of the Bloodsworn call to you. Can you not hear the screams of the dying? Go forth and drown the Exiles with their own tears!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Wear your wounds with pride, for your enemies have fallen lifeless before you. This was a battle well-fought!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show them your true strength and revel in the carnage.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your accomplishments will be noted.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The Halls of the Bloodsworn are ours.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated the Exiles in the Halls of the Bloodsworn, preventing valuable information on exanite weapons technology from falling into the wrong hands.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do I get if I win?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You'll get 2 battleground tokens if you win, and 1 even if you return with a shameful loss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your coward's blood is a stain upon the Dominion! Get out of my sight!

localizedTextIdText: The Exiles need your help securing arcane Moodie masks in Walatiki Temple before the Dominion gets to them. Lyza Steelford is counting on you to give it your best. You will earn 2 tokens for a win, and 1 token for a loss.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lyza Steelford via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready to help the Exiles? We need you to keep the Dommies out of Walatiki Temple! You can't let 'em get their filthy hands on any of them Moodie masks!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you get them masks yet? Those scientists ain't the most patient folks. Go to Walatiki Temple and kick some Dommie butt!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice work out there, $(player.name). You sure did put it to them Dommie scumsuckers! Come on back sometime soon and I'm sure to have more assignments for you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Go get 'em!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's some mighty fine work you done.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put the Dominion in its place!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: The masks are in good hands.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Exiles collect arcane Moodie masks from Walatiki Temple. Because of your efforts, the Exiles have gained valuable insight into Moodie magic.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do I get if I win?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You'll get 2 battleground tokens if you win, and 1 if you lose. Sounds fair, right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? Scared of a little scrap? I thought you had it in you!

localizedTextIdText: The Dominion requires your aid securing arcane Moodie masks in Walatiki Temple before the Exiles get to them. Commander Kolros will reward you with 2 tokens for a win, or 1 token for a loss.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kolros via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Walatiki Temple crawls with traitors, tree-rats, and rotters looking to steal Moodie masks from the Dominion. Go now and stain the masks with their blood!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you slaughtered our enemies and relieved them of their Moodie masks? Get to Walatiki Temple at once and cut the thieves down!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Exiles flee from us like prey! Cowards and thieves, the lot of them! You have done your duty and kept the Moodie masks out of their hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Show them no mercy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The empire is in your debt.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll put those Exiles in their place!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped the Dominion collect arcane Moodie masks from Walatiki Temple. Because of your efforts, the Dominion has gained valuable insight into Moodie magic.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do I get if I win?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You'll get 2 battleground tokens if you win, and 1 even if you return with a shameful loss.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're just as cowardly as those pathetic Exiles, aren't you?

localizedTextIdText: Warplots are mobile sky fortresses packed with enough firepower to conquer a planet... and that's just what the Exiles intend! Lyza Steelford has commanded that all able-bodied Exiles should hurry to these battle stations and bring some serious hurt to the Dominion. They won't know what hit 'em!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Lyza Steelford via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready to kick this war into high gear? We got Warplots takin' to the skies, and we need you there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Find a warplot and make yourself useful, Exile! The war's not gonna wait for you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well I'll be damned! Some good news finally! You played a big part in our victory, friend. We all owe you one!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Reckon them Dommies don't stand a chance with you there!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That's one for the ages!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That's a battle they won't soon forget!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You joined the Exile Warparties and brought some serious hurt to the Dominion! Thanks to your efforts, the Exiles continue to make major strides in this war.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Big mistake, friend. This could be our chance to turn this war around.

localizedTextIdText: Warplots are mobile sky fortresses packed with enough firepower to conquer a planet - and that's just what the Dominion intends! Commander Kolros has commanded that all able-bodied citizens hurry to these battle stations and purge the Exiles from planet Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Commander Kolros via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Warbringer himself has provided us with a new battle initiative - Warplots! Get your gear and report for duty at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When I give an order, I expect you to obey without question! Report for Warplot duty at once or I'll see you eviscerated!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You see? Warplots are the future of battle! The Exiles will quake before our might! Already, your hands are wet with the blood of our enemies.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Slaughter the Exile insurgents and bring glory to the empire!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The empire owes you a debt of gratitude.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We met the Exiles in battle and it was glorious!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You joined the Dominion Warparties and brought divine justice down upon the hapless Exile troops! Soon, thanks to your efforts, the Exiles will be nothing more than a bad memory.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you will not fight then you are useless.

localizedTextIdTitle: Adventure: Veteran War of the Wilds
localizedTextIdText: Test your strategic wit and combat prowess by completing the War of the Wilds adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Petr Pudorich via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The War of the Wilds puts your strategic and combat acuity to the test. Do you have the fortitude to dodge death?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you fear the death that awaits you in the War of the Wilds? Why should one fear the inevitable?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yours were not the tactics I would have used, but you have proven to be resourceful nonetheless. Consider me impressed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You seem rather rambunctious. This just might give you an advantage.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time, try to have a little more trial and a little less error.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: They won't even see me coming!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Next time I expect a challenge!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the War of the Wilds adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose you lack the strategic acuity for such a task.

localizedTextIdTitle: Adventure: Veteran War of the Wilds
localizedTextIdText: Test your strategic wit and combat prowess by completing the War of the Wilds adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Eldon Ironmoore via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Exiles in the War of the Wilds simulation may be fabrications, but they are a fine test of your abilities. I will reward those who practice.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's wrong? The War of the Wilds awaits you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, yes... congratulations. Hopefully this has prepared you for the real thing.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Very good, then. Be sure not to fail. That would be embarrassing.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep your skills sharp. I hope your performance was not a fluke.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I've got a new strategy to try.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Next time I expect a challenge!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the War of the Wilds adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll be on my way, then.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Cannot handle a few measly procedurally-generated replicas? What a shame.

localizedTextIdTitle: Adventure: Veteran Siege of Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdText: Get some practice for a possible Dominion siege by completing the Siege of Tempest Refuge adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Petr Pudorich via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's safe to say that a siege on our fair city is inevitable. Fortunately, we have the Siege of Tempest Refuge simulation to practice for such an event.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Practice makes perfect. There is no room for error if such a siege actually takes place. Now go and practice!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your management of military resources is quite impressive. It is good to know there is someone with your capabilities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good... the Exiles appreciate your enthusiasm.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is always time for more practice.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: That was barely a warm up!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Siege of Tempest Refuge adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not everyone can handle the responsibility of defending a city.

localizedTextIdTitle: Adventure: Veteran Siege of Tempest Refuge
localizedTextIdText: Get some practice for a possible Exile siege by completing the Siege of Tempest Refuge adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Eldon Ironmoore via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: While I doubt the Exiles would be foolish enough to lay siege to our city, it is not impossible. Use the Siege of Tempest Refuge simulation to help prepare.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Come back when you have learned something useful from the Siege of Tempest Refuge simulation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Never forget what you've learned today. Such an experience is invaluable.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Best be prepared for such an occasion. Regardless of the likelihood.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You can never be too prepared.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It wasn't even a real challenge!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Siege of Tempest Refuge adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your lack of appreciation for being prepared is disappointing. Be gone!

localizedTextIdText: Adopt the lifestyle of an infamous crime lord and complete the Crimelords of Whitevale adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Petr Pudorich via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The best way to catch a criminal is to think like one. The Crimelords of Whitevale simulation seems an opportunity to experiment with such a lifestyle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Back from the Crimelords of Whitevale simulation already? Did it prove to be too much to handle?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The data you have gathered is invaluable. This should help us catch some deviants who insist on causing trouble.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Bribery, blackmail, and turf wars. Try not to get in too deep.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I am glad you did not succumb to a life of crime.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Next time will be even better!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Crimelords of Whitevale adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: A life of crime is a dangerous road to follow. This may be for the better.

localizedTextIdText: Adopt the lifestyle of an infamous crime lord and complete the Crimelords of Whitevale adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Eldon Ironmoore via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: There are heathens who seem to think they have the right to ignore our laws. The Crimelords of Whitevale simulation may give insight into their lifestyle.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: There is still much to learn in the Crimelords of Whitevale simulation. Come back when you are more informed.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done, but there is much left to do to properly deal with the miscreants getting in our way. For now, I am pleased to reward you for your efforts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Such data will be of use the next time we clean the scum from our gutters.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is always more to experience.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I have a knack for this.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Crimelords of Whitevale adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What a shame. Such information would be invaluable.

localizedTextIdText: Challenge your survival skills by completing the Malgrave Trail adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Petr Pudorich via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Our dependence on technology can leave us unprepared. The Malgrave Trail simulation will test your resourcefulness during times of trouble.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: At least try not to lose so many caravan members while participating in the Malgrave Trail simulation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your survival has both pleased and impressed me. Well done.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Different paths mean different challenges. Adaptability is key to survival.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time maybe another path... another challenge.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm tough! I can handle it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Malgrave Trail adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I suppose survival of the fittest requires that you be fit.

localizedTextIdText: Challenge your survival skills by completing the Malgrave Trail adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Eldon Ironmoore via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Dominion values strength and intelligence, and the Malgrave Trail simulation is an excellent way to test yours.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still here? Malgrave's harsh deserts thirst for your blood. Do not make them wait.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It seems you are quite the survivor! I am impressed by your resourcefulness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Don't be soft. If you are weak, the Malgrave desert will destroy you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion is fortunate to have you.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll show you I can survive!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Survival is my second nature to me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Malgrave Trail adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The emperor will not be pleased with your lack of resolve.

localizedTextIdText: Freight Supervisor Lola has lost contact with one of her freighters near Halon, one of Nexus's moons. The ship is believed to have crash landed on an asteroid known as Fragment Zero. Spacers say there is some kind of derelict facility on the floating asteroid. Take Freight Supervisor Lola ship and meet with her to start your exploration.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Freight Supervisor Lola on Fragment Zero
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My husband's cargo ship didn't make its last checkpoint outside of Halon. If my Hugo's anything, he's punctual, I tell ya. Be a dear and check on him?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Hugo's missed checkpoint was just outside the Halon Ring. You can use my ship to get there, darn tootin'. Quickly, off with you now!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Here we are on the Ring. The wreck's just down the ridge. Oh, I do hope my Hugo is all right...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'd go myself, but these old bones can't take the strain, no sir.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Fragment Zero with Freight Supervisor Lola in search of her husband.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What will you do in the meantime?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't fret, dearie. I'll do my best to help you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: No? Oh dear... what am I going to do?

localizedTextIdText: Demydra has suggested you speak with a guard in Bloodfire Village to learn how to find amenities in town.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Demydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Are you new in town? Should you become lost in Bloodfire Village, you can speak to a guard for direction. In the meantime, can I answer any questions?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Yes, citizen? Do you have other questions? Perhaps you should speak to a guard.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You see? The guards in Bloodfire Village are much more than brutes with weapons. They can also be quite informative.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Enjoy your stay, citizen. It is an exciting time to be here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You followed Demydra advice and spoke to a guard in Bloodfire Village.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What sorts of services are available?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What can you tell me about taxis?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: Transmat terminal? What's that?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The three primary services that guards can direct you to include the mailbox, our local taxi kiosk, and the nearest transmat terminal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Mailboxes allow you to send and receive mail, with or without attachments. When you receive items from the auction house or a friend, you can pick them up at any mailbox.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Taxis are automated vehicles that will take you safely between unlocked kiosks. You will automatically unlock kiosks as you become more experienced.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: You can bind your primal pattern to a single transmat terminal. This allows you to teleport to that location almost instantly from anywhere else on Nexus. It is quite convenient.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I shall remain here in the event that you reconsider your stupidity.

localizedTextIdText: In need of a bit of rest after exploring Deradune, Artemis Zin says there is a taxi in Endless Vigil that can get you to the Dominion capital city, Illium, in no time at all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Tour Guide Aexa in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like you have done all you can here. You should make your way to the capital city, Illium. A taxi in Endless Vigil can get you there with great speed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I no longer need you at this time. Feel free to visit Illium. You simply must, darling.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It is about time you arrived. Welcome to Illium, citizen. The capital city for the Dominion here on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I know a man that can offer you a tour.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is a vast city with many amenities. It will take time to see it all. Not with me of course.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll head to Illium right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a taxi from Deradune and flew all the way to the Dominion capital city, Illium. This bustling city will have all the amenities you could ever want.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Aexa
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: How dare you not take celebrity advice.

localizedTextIdText: After helping out a great deal in Ellevar, Agent Cognosa suggested taking a taxi in Mistymurk Shore that can get you to the Dominion capital city, Illium, in no time at all.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Tour Guide Aexa in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Looks like you have done all you can here. You should make your way to the capital city, Illium. A taxi at Mistymurk Shore can get you there with great speed.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I am no longer in need of your services. You are free to enjoy the city of Illium at your leisure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I heard word you were coming. Welcome to Illium, citizen. The capital city for the Dominion here on Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There is a particular person that can supply a tour.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: There is much one can do here - banking, shopping, crafting. I'm sure you will fine it very convenient.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll head to Illium right away.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: From Ellevar you took a taxi all the way to the capital, Illium. As the largest Dominion city on Nexus, it has all the amenities and services you'll ever need.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Aexa
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Pity. Illium is an excellent city.

localizedTextIdText: Word has spread about your adventures and deeds. There are people in the Dominion capital city of Illium that are eager to meet you. There are lots of ways to get there, but the easiest would be to take a taxi from either Endless Vigil or Mistymurk Shore.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with the Tour Guide Aexa in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Rumors of your deeds have reached me. Illium could use a person of your caliber. I can arrange a tour to get you settled.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I expected you sooner, citizen. I suppose a tour is in order. You will need to know all you can about Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Very well. Find a taxi and come here, immediately.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nexus is our legacy. The grand city of Illium stands as proof.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll come on by to Illium.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Illium looks like a big place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Word about your adventures and deeds has spread all the way to the Dominion capital city of Illium. You traveled there to check out the amenities and meet some people, though it's a very big place and there is so much to see.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Aexa

localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to MAC
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's combat training time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You better get to training!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You look stronger already.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head to the combat training facility.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I knew you could.

localizedTextIdText: To better know Thayd, the Exile capital city, hop on Jakke's Tour Grinder and view the Spaceport Horizon, Pilgrim's Promenade, and Academy Corner.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tour Guide Beraxa in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My pals and I do a tour gig. Perfect to get you acquainted with how big Thayd is. First up's Spaceport Horizon, Pilgrim's Promenade, and Academy Corner.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What, I gotta repeat myself? Just get on the grinder and take the tour. It ain't rocket science.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You didn't take Jakke's tour? You don't touch my bike until you finish it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: There you are. Welcome to Academy Corner. You wanna make anythin' or poke around, go ahead. I got nothin' but time.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just hop on the grinder and it'll do the tourin' for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll be waitin'. Jakke's orders.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the first tour of Thayd, the Exile capital city, and viewed the Spaceport Horizon, Pilgrim's Promenade, and Academy Corner.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Beraxa
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You're standin' in it. This is where all the ships come and go. Anywhere you wanna go, this place can get you there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: That place is lousy with scientists. You wanna make a guild, craft somethin', make your duds fancy, or sell somethin', that's your place.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: It's a quick way to get to Algoroc. Tell you what though, there's a chamber down there where the Exile leaders get together by invite only.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What? My tour too good for you, pal?

localizedTextIdText: In order to get to know Thayd, the Exile capital city, you should hop on Beraxa's Tour Grinder and get a closer look at the Traverse Tunnels, the Court of Judgment, the Arborian Gardens, Shindig Hollow, and Fortune's Ground.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tour Guide Darak in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready for the next tour? You'll be goin' through the Traverse Tunnels, the Court of Judgment, the Arborian Gardens, Shindig Hollow, and Fortune's Ground.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You did this before, remember? Just get on the grinder over there and it'll take you on the tour.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You ain't touchin' my bike until the tour's done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, here at last. Listen, you wanna do a little home stylin' or shoppin', you go ahead. I'll be waitin'.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I know that's a lotta places, but Thayd's a big place.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Thayd's great, ain't it?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to continue the tour.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the second tour of Thayd, the Exile capital city, taking a closer look at the Traverse Tunnels, the Court of Judgment, the Arborian Gardens, Shindig Hollow, and Fortune's Ground.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Darak
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What are the Arborian Gardens and Shindig Hollow?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Lil crossroads in the heart of Thayd. Got some dispatchers there that'll direct you to jobs when you've got enough experience under your belt.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It's where all the trials happen and where the judges hang out. It's entertainin', too! Sit in the stands a while.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The garden's where all the Aurin do their tree-huggin' stuff. The hollow near there is where all the parties happen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You can't just stop in the middle of a tour!

localizedTextIdText: In order to get to know Thayd, the Exile capital city, you should hop on Darak's Tour Grinder and get a closer look at the Protostar Housing Initiative, Fortune's Ground, the Lair of the Black Hoods, and FCON Headquarters.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tour Guide Jakke via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All that's left for your tour is to go through the Protostar Housin' Initiative, Fortune's Ground, the Lair of the Black Hoods, and FCON Headquarters.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This ain't hard. You did it twice already. Just get on the grinder and tour away.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: All you got left is Darak's tour. You're nearly done.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welp, that's the tour. I hope you learned somethin'. Namely, Thayd's got it all.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Got some important things for you to see.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Galeras is nearby. I hear there's lotsa action goin' on there.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to finish the tour.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the third tour of Thayd, the Exile capital city, taking a closer look at the Protostar Housing Initiative, Fortune's Ground, the Lair of the Black Hoods, and FCON Headquarters.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What's the Lair of the Black Hoods?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: They got these fancy houses in the sky. If you want one, that's where you go.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: What? You got rocks in your head? You just went through it on your way here. It's got all the merchants and stuff.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: That's where all the Mordesh are. It creeps me out. Spies are crawlin' all over the place. 'Course, they're our spies, but still.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You don't wanna miss the best part of the tour, do you?

localizedTextIdText: Can competitive combat be profitable when combatants keep dying? Help 20 players meet their end to find out!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: In order to get to know Illium, the Dominion capital city, you should hop on Aexa's Tour Hot Rod and get a closer look at Spaceport Alpha, the Parade Grounds, and the Luminous Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tour Guide Vector in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We have been authorized to provide tours of the city, starting with our industrial sectors. Climb aboard this vehicle and behold the splendor of Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your tour awaits.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You should return to Aexa and take the western tour before speaking with me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome. You may indulge in any crafting professions or housing diversions here before continuing the tour.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You will be safe, citizen. Our vehicles are well-maintained.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will be waiting.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the first tour of Illium, the Dominion capital city, taking a closer look at Spaceport Alpha, the Parade Grounds, and the Luminous Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Vector
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Spaceport Alpha is the center of transport for the Dominion. Here, you can secure passage to anywhere on or off Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The Parade Grounds are a gathering place where special events are held. Nearby sits the Enigma Chamber, a place for our leaders to converse privately.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The Luminous Gardens are a place of science and trade. If things are made in Illium, they are created within the walls of the Gardens.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I will remain here. Return when your schedule permits.

localizedTextIdText: In order to get to know Illium, the Dominion capital city, you should hop on Vector's Tour Hot Rod and get a closer look at Luminous Gardens and Legion's Way.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Tour Guide Crydax in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your next route will take you through the southeast portion of the city where you will witness the Dominion's military might.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: My vehicle is at your disposal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must complete Vector's portion of the tour before coming to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: If you are suitably impressed by our military facilities, my route will introduce you to Illium's majesty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My subroutines will control the vehicle from here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will await your return.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the second tour of Illium, the Dominion capital city, taking a closer look at the Luminous Gardens and Legion's Way.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Speak with the Tour Guide Crydax
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Legion's Way is the seat of our military. General Kezrek Warbringer oversees all matters of defense as our troops train under his watchful eye.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I do not operate on your schedule, citizen.

localizedTextIdTitle: Illium Tour: Seat of the Empire
localizedTextIdText: In order to get to know Illium, the Dominion capital city, you should hop on Crydax's Tour Hot Rod and get a closer look at Fate's Landing.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Tour Guide Aexa via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your last route awaits, citizen. Now you will see the seat of power in the empire in all its splendor. The pride of the Dominion lives in Illium.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is but one tour remaining.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have yet to complete the tour.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Now you have seen the true glory of the Dominion here on Nexus. Go forth and spread the prosperity of the empire.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: My vehicle will carry passengers effortlessly.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Do not falter.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the third tour of Illium, the Dominion capital city, taking a closer look at Fate's Landing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Fate's Landing is the seat of power within Illium. The Highborn dwell and shop within its walls, and the Vigilant Church looms over the citizenry.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Do not try my patience.

localizedTextIdText: Agent Marcus has briefed you on a plague epidemic in Hycrest. Travel there and investigate the outbreak if you're willing to help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Agent Marcus in Hycrest
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A communique from Hycrest indicates that plague has broken out in Auroria. The ICI requires your presence there at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We're almost out of time to resolve the situation. Every moment is precious with so many lives at stake.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's a vehicle you can use by the Auroria gates. I'll be waiting for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must work quickly if we are to find the source of the plague, and stop its progress.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll do all that I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You spoke to Agent Marcus in Hycrest, who briefed you on the virulent plague devastating Auroria.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I find your lack of initiative vexing. I strongly recommend you reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: The Market Research Division has determined Prestige may correlate with profits.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: The Market Research Division requires data on the economic impact of Warplot construction.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdTitle: Expedition: Prime They Came from Fragment Zero!
localizedTextIdText: Granny Adina is cleaning up after Freight Supervisor Lola again - she lost contact with one of her freighters in the Halon Ring. Search for her crew and cargo on the asteroid Fragment Zero. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That Lola's lost another freighter. Cargo's got to get to where it's bound, you know. Contracts and all. Go find it for me, would you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found Lola's freighter yet? I haven't heard from her or Hugo.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You got Hugo out safe and sound and escaped that terrible asteroid! Wonderful, sweetie.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. And bring your space helmet! Not a lot of air in the Ring, you know.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And you tell Hugo to be more careful if you see him!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The crazed Skeech of Fragment Zero were no match for you. You saved Captain Hugo and got him back to his concerned wife.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: There's always another shiphand looking for work.

localizedTextIdText: Collect market research on the potential profitability of Sim-Cores by completing an Adventure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Primal ice! Will customers buy it? Will it kill them? Does the Market Research Division care? Economic data required!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdTitle: Expedition: Prime They Came from Fragment Zero!
localizedTextIdText: Old Kess is cleaning up after Freight Supervisor Lola again - she lost contact with one of her freighters in the Halon Ring. Search for her crew and cargo on the asteroid Fragment Zero. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Old Kess via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Can't trust Lola with anything these days! She went and lost another freighter. Someone's got to recover the ship. Is that someone you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Still waiting for Lola or Hugo to report in. Have you found the freighter?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That sounds like quite the adventure! Glad to see the ship is safe. Hugo, too, I suppose.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Then grab your space helmet and ship out!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And give Lola's ear a tweak for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The crazed Skeech of Fragment Zero were no match for you. You saved Captain Hugo and got him back to his concerned wife.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: There's always another shiphand looking for work.

localizedTextIdText: Strain residue represents a unique marketing opportunity for Protostar's Bio-Weapons Division.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: The Market Research Division requires current data on exanite fragment profitability.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Granny Adina asked you to help with Captain Milo mine, Outpost M-13. Fly to Milo's asteroid to deal with the alien incursion! Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That Milo! This mine he bought turned out to be crawling with parasitic aliens! He needs shiphands to help with the mess. Up for it?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you take care of Milo's bug problem up on Outpost M-13 yet, dearie?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What a dreadful situation! You sure saved Milo's cubacon, sweetie.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what I like to hear! Ship out to the Steady Traveler, then!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time I see you, you're getting a cookie.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blasted off in the Steady Traveler, fought off thieving Marauders, and destroyed the invading aliens who had taken over Outpost M-13 as a breeding cave. Captain Milo is grateful that operations can start up again!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well! I'll just have to find another shiphand for Milo.

localizedTextIdText: Old Kess asked you to help with Captain Milo mine, Outpost M-13. Fly to Milo's asteroid to deal with the alien incursion! Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Old Kess via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Milo's investments are going to get him in trouble. Now his mine's got bugs! Got a shiphand job here to take a look, if you want.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is Outpost M-13 up and running yet? Thought you were going to step on some bugs for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Aliens! It's always aliens! Thank goodness someone has a sensible head on their shoulders.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Ship out to the Steady Traveler, and keep your head about you!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: If you see Milo, tell him to invest in livestock next time!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You blasted off in the Steady Traveler, fought off thieving Marauders, and destroyed the invading aliens who had taken over Outpost M-13 as a breeding cave. Captain Milo is grateful that operations can start up again!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you won't help Milo, I'll just have to find someone else.
