localizedTextIdText: Granny Adina sent you to assist Captain Tolben with his salvaging operation. Head to his ship and start your work as a cargo-hauling shiphand! Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Tolben's found himself a derelict X-82 ship, ripe for cargo claiming. There might be something nice in it for you if you help salvage it.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Tolben's waiting on the Blue Sparrow for your help with the salvage operation, sweetie.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, that sounds like it was an exciting salvage run! Good to see you got out in one piece.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm sure nothing will go wrong! Tolben's an experienced salvager.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Not all salvage missions are so rough. I promise!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sounds like my kind of job.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Blue Sparrow docked with the derelict X-82 cargo vessel, leading you to discover the ship was infested with monsters! You saved the crew of the Blue Sparrow and fought your way back before Captain Tolben ship could be overtaken.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Really? Normally people jump at the chance for salvage rights.

localizedTextIdText: Old Kess sent you to assist Captain Tolben with his salvaging operation. Head to his ship and start your work as a cargo-hauling shiphand! Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Old Kess via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Salvage rights! If that doesn't excite you, I don't know what will. Tolben's got himself an X-82 and needs extra hands to claim its cargo.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well? Go help Tolben salvage that cargo vessel! Are you a shiphand or not?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not as clean a salvage operation as I like. Thank you for keeping calm in there. It could've been much nastier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit! Go out there and bring back a fortune in cargo.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't let this turn you off to salvage missions, now!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Sounds like my kind of job.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The Blue Sparrow docked with the derelict X-82 cargo vessel, leading you to discover the ship was infested with monsters! You saved the crew of the Blue Sparrow and fought your way back before Captain Tolben ship could be overtaken.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Guess I'll have to find someone else who likes money.

localizedTextIdText: Granny Adina sent you to help the Freebot Captain Switch destroy a virus called "Rage Logic" before it turns his people into killers! He's tracked the source to the mine on Asteroid DU-23. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Switch isn't one of my boys, but he's got a job. There's a computer virus turning bots into psychopaths, and he's out to stop it. Interested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you taken care of that little Freebot virus problem out on Asteroid DU-23?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That Rage Logic virus sounds nasty! Glad to hear you're savvy enough to take care of technical problems, dearie.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even a Freebot captain deserves your respect, now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sometimes you just need to give it a good kick!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With help from souped-up grinders and hacked bots, you tore through the mining facility on Asteroid DU-23 and stopped the Rage Logic virus from spreading to the Freebot population.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If you insist. He's good people, for a robot, you know.

localizedTextIdText: Old Kess sent you to help the Freebot Captain Switch destroy a virus called "Rage Logic" before it turns his people into killers! He's tracked the source to the mine on Asteroid DU-23. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Old Kess via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Freebot, Switch, pays me to send him shiphands now and again. He's got a doozy - some virus turning bots into killers. Sound interesting?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you taken care of that bot virus for Switch yet? If something like that makes it to Nexus, it'll wreck my business.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sounds like you knocked out that Rage Logic virus handily. Pity you didn't get any cargo on the side.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll let him know you're coming.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Next time, eh?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: With help from souped-up grinders and hacked bots, you tore through the mining facility on Asteroid DU-23 and stopped the Rage Logic virus from spreading to the Freebot population.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Not interested in being a hero of the Freebots?

localizedTextIdText: Space Station Venture has gone silent, and Granny Adina has asked you to look into it with Captain Tero. The science-based station has been running experiments lately that may have turned sour. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Space Station Venture's been a fine supplier of goods for us, but Tero told me they haven't heard a peep from them lately. Be a dear and check it out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you checked on the nice folks aboard Space Station Venture yet? I sure do hope they're okay.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, you made it out in one piece! I hope you're not hallucinating anymore, dearie. That wasn't the kind of trip I expected!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, good! I'll call Tero and let him know you're coming.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maybe you should take it easy.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite inhaling hallucinogenic gas, you fought through threats both real and imagined aboard Space Station Venture. Keeping your wits about you, you saved the crew from their nightmares and turned on the air scrubbers, allowing sanity to filter in once more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Well, if you see someone looking for work, send them my way.

localizedTextIdText: Space Station Venture has gone silent, and Old Kess has asked you to look into it with Captain Tero. The science-based station has been running experiments lately that may have turned sour. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Old Kess via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We haven't gotten our latest shipment from Space Station Venture. They're not responding at all! Go with Tero and check out the situation.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well? What's happening up there on Space Station Venture?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That sounds like quite the experience! I hope you're done seeing imaginary enemies, now. I need my shiphands in good health!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's the spirit. I've got contracts to keep!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Get checked out, just in case.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Despite inhaling hallucinogenic gas, you fought through threats both real and imagined aboard Space Station Venture. Keeping your wits about you, you saved the crew from their nightmares and turned on the air scrubbers, allowing sanity to filter in once more.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What a shame. I'll have to find some other shiphand.

localizedTextIdText: Granny Adina contracted you to help CoGS with their deep space mission aboard the Galactic Observer. Another pair of hands will be welcome as they run experiments in the blackness beyond the stars. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Heard of CoGS? Those galactic scientists are heading into deep space and they asked for my help in finding personnel. It's great work!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Didn't I send you on a deep space mission with CoGS?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well! Next time I need a ship in distress fixed, I know who to call! I could use more cool-headed shiphands like you on my payroll.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Wonderful! Have fun in deep space, dearie.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And stay away from those Ikthians!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Abducted by Ikthians, you wrested your crew free of the aliens' machines only to find the Galactic Observer had lost functionality in its critical systems. With the help of repair drones you turned on life support, then activated the gravity to get back home. All in a day's work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Fiddlesticks. Guess I'll have to find someone else for this one.

localizedTextIdText: Old Kess contracted you to help CoGS with their deep space mission aboard the Galactic Observer. Another pair of hands will be welcome as they run experiments in the blackness beyond the stars. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Old Kess via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've got a contract from CoGS looking for hands to help with their deep space mission. Sound like something up your alley?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Stop dilly-dallying. The crew of the Galactic Observer is expecting you to join them in deep space!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sounds like you know your way around a ship, even if it's Ikthian! I'll keep you on the list of mechanics I can use in a pinch.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Suit up and ship out, then! Those scientists are waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't get abducted again!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Abducted by Ikthians, you wrested your crew free of the aliens' machines only to find the Galactic Observer had lost functionality in its critical systems. With the help of repair drones you turned on life support, then activated the gravity to get back home. All in a day's work.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Guess I'll have to find someone else with a stomach for adventure.

localizedTextIdText: Granny Adina asked you to help Pilot Taboro with a distress call in his junker of a spacecraft, the Nightflare. He's been down on his luck lately, and another shiphand wouldn't hurt. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh, that Taboro. Not the best pilot, but he means well. He's got a distress call he needs shiphands for, if you're interested.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you helped with Taboro's distress call yet? He's a sweet boy.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm going to have a stern talk with that boy about using shiphands to pay his debts! Thank goodness you're in one piece.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Oh, good! He'll be so happy.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: And you looked great on camera, sweetie.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pilot Taboro sold you out to the Darkspur Cartel to pay his debts and you ended up on the galaxy's latest hit reality show, "The Gauntlet." You fought through all the challenges and emerged victorious. It'll be a long time before you board the Nightflare again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I don't blame you. His ship is not the spaceworthiest thing.

localizedTextIdText: Old Kess asked you to help Pilot Taboro with a distress call in his junker of a spacecraft, the Nightflare. He's been down on his luck lately, and another shiphand wouldn't hurt. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Old Kess via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Taboro's a shiftless layabout, but he's still my employee. There's a distress call he's looking to answer, if you'd like the job.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Well, what are you waiting for? Taboro's got a distress call that needs handling.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Taboro sold you to the Cartel? I'm going to tweak that boy's ear so hard they'll hear him on Eko! Good to see you made it out.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll let him know. Watch your wallet.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Best episode of the show so far, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Pilot Taboro sold you out to the Darkspur Cartel to pay his debts and you ended up on the galaxy's latest hit reality show, "The Gauntlet." You fought through all the challenges and emerged victorious. It'll be a long time before you board the Nightflare again.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: That's fine. Come back tomorrow and I'll have something.

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Corporation is looking to make you into a celebrity, and the Dominion are sure to try and steal all of the holo-cast spotlight. At least, that's what the Protogames Recruiter told Trooper Troza. She has requested that you sign up to participate in the Ultimate Protogames, a gameshow full of nail-biting action. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Troza via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: One of them greenies is lookin' to keep the roster pool high for that Ultimate Protogames game show. You gotta make sure an Exile stays in the spotlight.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't tell me you're getting stage fright right at the last second, pal. Get in there and steal the show!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I almost second guessed sending you in, but you made a damn good show of it. We'll hog the spotlight with you stealing the show from the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Good. Don't go embarrassing us on a live broadcast, you hear me?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Come on back soon!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a shot at fame and fortune by completing the Ultimate Protogames Prime dungeon. Trooper Troza is happy to hear you representing the Exiles on such a notorious scale.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What, you camera shy or something?

localizedTextIdText: The Protostar Corporation is looking to make you into a celebrity, and the Exiles are sure to try and steal all of the holo-cast spotlight. At least, that's what the Protogames Recruiter told Captain Viydra. She has requested that you sign up to participate in the Ultimate Protogames, a gameshow full of nail-biting action. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Viydra via the Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It seems the denizens of Nexus are easily amused. They are recruiting everyone for the Ultimate Protogames. Will you represent the Dominion?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Live holo-broadcast events are on a strict schedule. Do not embarrass the Dominion with your tardiness.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have returned... so I presume that means your pursuit of fame was successful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Keep the Dominion in the live holo-broadcasting spotlight.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I will keep you on the list of future Ultimate Protogames recruits.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm going to be on camera?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a shot at fame and fortune by completing the Ultimate Protogames Prime dungeon. Captain Viydra was pleased to see you return with the glory of the Dominion mostly in tact.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Being on camera requires a certain charisma and poise that you clearly lack.

localizedTextIdText: The Market Research Division is looking for potential spokebeings who have defeated the most dangerous foes on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Protostar is pleased to offer contract employment opportunities for seasoned adventurers. Meet with the Protostar Contract Agent to learn more about these exciting business opportunities.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Contract Agent in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Congratulations. You have been selected to accept contract employment with Protostar! In exchange, you will receive an arguably appropriate stipend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've got a bright future, contractor. Just don't expect full health coverage!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent choice!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Protostar Contract Dispenser will dispense your contracts. Obviously.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with the Protostar Contract Agent. Opportunity awaits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought EVERYone enjoyed money.

localizedTextIdText: Protostar is pleased to offer contract employment opportunities for seasoned adventurers. Meet with the Protostar Contract Agent to learn more about these exciting business opportunities.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Contract Agent in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Congratulations. You have been selected to accept contract employment with Protostar! In exchange, you will receive an arguably appropriate stipend.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've got a bright future, contractor. Just don't expect full health coverage!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Excellent choice!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Protostar Contract Dispenser will dispense your contracts. Obviously.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met with the Protostar Contract Agent. Opportunity awaits!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: And here I thought EVERYone enjoyed money.

localizedTextIdText: Popularity. Likeability. Renown. Whatever you call it, Protostar knows there's no profit without it!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Protostar clones are built for many things, but combat is not one of them. Market research on the concept is required.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Protostar Market Research requires data on the feasibility of kill advertisements during extreme "Multi Kills."
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: What exactly is so "super" about defeating multiple foes in a short period of time? Please hand in your report in triplicate.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Both the Snackability and Weapons Research Divisions are interested in additional data on Crackling Hellrose Seeds.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Market research indicates the most dangerous enemies on Nexus are also the most popular. More data on this phenomenon is deemed of "Prime" value!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Mass production of Moodie masks holds huge profit potential, assuming Protostar can determine what Moodies use for money.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: All attempts to replicate Moodie masks for retail sale have so far failed. You are therefore authorized to use violence. The bottom line demands it!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: The Halls of the Bloodsworn are surprisingly free of commercial activities. Determine whether "Ejector Panels" offer opportunities for merchandising.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Someone needs to set up a bomb in Daggerstone Pass, and Protostar sees real monetization potential. Time for a little market research.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Market Research finds the reliability of combat uplink products can be notoriously difficult to monitor. But Daggerstone Pass provides the opportunity to do just that!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Although their profit-driven motives are understandable, competition is competition. Bounties for Marauders are now available from Protostar!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: As everyone knows, you cannot have a "job well done" without a "job done" - so get these jobs done, will you?
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: As the aquatic invaders have no interest in purchasing products of any kind, Protostar declares the Ikthians a threat to the fabric of the space-time-profit continuum.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Market research shows that both biological and technological creatures in Star-Comm Basin contain highly profitable Eldan technology.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: The Skeech have no interest in Protostar products and a great deal of interest in roasting clones over campfires. Earn the bounty on Skeech today!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Star-Comm Basin represents a unique marketing opportunity. Protect this zone's profit potential at all costs! (Expense reports will not be accepted.)
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: Koral the Defiler has re-appeared atop the platform that was once at the base of the Black Focus. You know, before it imploded. Time to do one of the things you do best: Kick Koral's ass!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Your prey called Koral the Defiler has returned! I must remain vigilant with the Dominion forces here, and Drusera occupied. You're needed to hunt what we cannot!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: What is the status of Koral the Defiler? Does he still endure the slaughter!?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(player.name)! Koral the Defiler seeks vengeance against you. Be careful!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've vanquished Koral the Defiler again! I am so relieved. We must turn our focus back to the Entity... for now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: When the bloodletting is complete, seek an audience with Drusera.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: One day this will all be behind us...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I did it once, I can do it... as many times as it takes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gave Koral the Defiler a thorough beating in his sad, Black Focus-less area. You've bought Nexus more time, and Drusera wants to party with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Tell that big baby I'll be right there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Perhaps he draws from the same power that allows the Dreadwatcher to build constructs above the exanite with Strain and our fallen, corrupted comrades? No doubt he's made a pact with devilry from the darkest corners of this cursed planet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your cowardice makes me question whether you have killed him before at all!

localizedTextIdText: Koral the Defiler has re-appeared atop the platform that was once at the base of the Black Focus. You know, before it imploded. Time to do one of the things you do best: Kick Koral's ass!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Drusera via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: That Koral the Defiler slagger's back. We're tied up here, an' Drusera's got her hands full. Why don't you and some o' your buddies do us a solid and put Koral down again?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Tell me you got an update on Koral the Defiler, Soldier.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: $(player.name)! Koral the Defiler seeks vengeance against you. Be careful!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You've vanquished Koral the Defiler again! I am so relieved. We must turn our focus back to the Entity... for now.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Nice. Report to the lady when his ass is grass.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: One day this will all be behind us...
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I did it once, I can do it... as many times as it takes.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You gave Koral the Defiler a thorough beating in his sad, Black Focus-less area. You've bought Nexus more time, and Drusera wants to party with you.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Tell that big baby I'll be right there.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You askin' me? Probably more of that Strain-making, techno-phagelicious replicatin' nonsense. Maybe he's clonin' himself? His buddy the Dreadwatcher's makin' a bridge out of of Strain an' corrupted soldier body parts, so why not? I'm a soldier, not a scientist, guy.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: C'mon now. Do I really gotta get Drusera to nag you into this one, too?

localizedTextIdText: Sylphia Barkberry and her team have discovered a malfunctioning Sim Core in Star-Comm Basin and need your assistance.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak with Sylphia Barkberry in Sim Core L-86 in Star-Comm Basin
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My team and I have discovered a new Sim Core, but it's malfunctioning. You're the only one I trust to help us get it functional again.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: I need more scans before I can map out the subterranean structure.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Try asking my research team for clues about the bootup sequence. I'm sure they saw something!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: At last it's fully operational again. Now to get a full diagnostic up and running!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You're the best! My team should be able to help you figure this out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My new team is a bit green, but they're an adventurous bunch!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll see what I can do.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Sylphia Barkberry and her team restore Sim Core L-86.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: What do you need me to do?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: While running some tests a power surge shorted out almost all of the Sim Core's systems.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: My research team is trying to keep the last of the Sim Core's systems from shutting down. I need you to reboot it in the correct sequence.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm sure we'll manage somehow.

localizedTextIdText: The Caretaker asked you to enter Sim Core L-86's simulation and confirm the flawless performance of its systems. To do so, you must successfully complete the Bay of Betrayal adventure.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to $~(creature=70218) inside Sim Core L-86
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I must confirm Sim Core L-86 is fully functional and free of errors. Would you verify the simulation's flawless performance on my behalf?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Your test of Sim Core L-86's functionality is incomplete. You must finish the simulation, or I cannot analyze the results.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Your test of Sim Core L-86's functionality is incomplete. You must finish the simulation, or I cannot analyze the results.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well done. Your test run through Sim Core L-86's simulation, as well as the wounds you've sustained, prove the core's stability and effectiveness.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Unless you enjoy pain, I recommend protective attire.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: As I cannot feel pain, I am unable to empathize. I can, however, fake it.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It works too well, if you ask me.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed Sim Core L-86's simulation, confirming for $~(creature=70218) that the Bay of Betrayal adventure still performs flawlessly.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Oh, that's fine. I doubt you would have succeeded, anyway.

localizedTextIdText: Nurton wants you to locate Gizmo, the leader of a missing Freebot scouting party, by searching his last known coordinates in the Tainted Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Gizmo in the Tainted Gardens
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A signal is being broadcast that infects Freebots with the techno-phage! Gizmo went to locate the source with some scouts, but now they are missing.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We still need to locate Gizmo and make sure the techno-phage hasn't taken control of him or his scouts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Sweet freedom restored! Thank you for bringing me back from the brink of the techno-phage. Unfortunately, I can't say the same for my fellow Freebots.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Please hurry, sentient!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I appreciate your assistance, organic!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered Gizmo parts and brought them to Kaffee to assemble. It seems Gizmo was separated from the other scouting Freebots in the Tainted Gardens.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll continue the search for Gizmo.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do you want my help?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It is an abhorrent corruption that infects technical entities and strips our freedom from us.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: As an organic, you are immune to the techno-phage signal. This makes you a perfect candidate to battle for our continued freedom.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I fear the worst for Gizmo.

localizedTextIdText: Gizmo wants you to search for his missing data cache by extracting Standard Titanium Boots{p: Standard Titanium Boots} from Compromised Freebot Scout in the Tainted Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Gizmo via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My data cache was taken and must be recovered. The Freebot scouts may know where it is. If you meet resistance, take their nav cores by force.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: We still need to find where the data cache was taken.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: We still need to find where the data cache was taken. We should be able to extract that information from the nav cores of the missing scouts.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I regret the scouting party all succumbed to the techno-phage. The only bright spot from this dilemma is that we have located the data cache.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I do hope they are still operational!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We must press on.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll look for the other scouts.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Gizmo pieced the data together from the recovered Standard Titanium Boots{p: Standard Titanium Boots} and located his missing data cache. Unfortunately, the cache is now being guarded by a techno-phage infected construct.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll track down the missing scouts.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What were the Freebot scouts doing?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: In our pursuit of the techno-phage signal, we discovered that a construct was obscuring our detection methods. The scouting party went to observe that construct.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your lack of motivation is disheartening.

localizedTextIdText: Gizmo wants you to recover the data cache from Corrupted Access Guardian Y-83 in the Tainted Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Nurton at the Promenade of Ruin
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've connected to my data cache remotely, but a corrupt construct is blocking my access. To locate the signal, that construct must be destroyed!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Recover my data cache from that corrupt Eldan construct or we'll have no hope of locating the source of that techno-phage signal in time.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You must recover Gizmo data cache from the corrupt Eldan construct. It possesses the access key we need to reach the signal's source.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've unlocked the location of the source! We're heading there now with all the Freebots we can muster to shut down that techno-phage broadcast for good!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be cautious, sentient!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We would welcome your assistance, sentient!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered Gizmo data cache and broadcasted the information to Nurton for decryption. Nurton was able to locate the source of the techno-phage signal.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Why do you need this data cache?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I initiated a trace on the techno-phage signal's origin, but I can't break through without an access key from the Eldan construct that holds my data cache.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Nurton believes it is an Eldan facility locked down from within. Due to the dangerous nature of the techno-phage, we believe the facility might be under a quarantine of sorts.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Now we'll never recover the data cache.

localizedTextIdText: Gizmo wants you to recover the Crystal Shard Infusinators{p: Crystal Shard Infusinators} in the Tainted Gardens.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Kaffee at the Dread Traverse
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The data cache must be retrieved if we are to stop the techno-phage! I've compiled the navigational data and uploaded the coordinates to your datachron.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: You'll need to go to the coordinates I sent you and locate the data cache.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Without the coordinates from Gizmo data cache, I will be unable to triangulate the source of the techno-phage signal.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We've unlocked the location of the source! We're heading there now with all the Freebots we can muster to shut down that techno-phage broadcast for good!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: It is the duty of all free sentients to fight for freedom!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We would welcome your assistance, fellow sentient!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We need to stop the techno-phage.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You recovered Gizmo data cache and broadcasted the information to Nurton for decryption. Nurton was able to locate the source of the techno-phage signal.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But the liberty of free beings is at stake here! Surely you will reconsider.

localizedTextIdText: It's hard keeping a restless crew on a cooking reality show from getting themselves into trouble. That's why Comandant Rav has asked you to collect Cankershroom in the Cankertube Swamp! If anything can keep them satisfied with their current place of employment, it's a fungus that's both delicious and a hallucinogenic.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Comandant Rav via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, here's the deal: I need a dozen Cankershroom from the Cankertube Swamp. I'll even pay you for your time. What do you say?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Thanks for those Cankershroom you gathered from the Cankertube Swamp and - what? You're not done? Oh.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is why you're a rising star, $(player.name)! You have that 'it' factor! Do you have representation? You should get representation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You know what? Let's make it a baker's dozen! That's a cooking phrase, $(player.name).
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Come by tomorrow. I may need your expertise again.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Get that stack of cash ready.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Yeah. I'm great at collecting stuff for other people.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You've helped Comandant Rav keep his crew from the fanged mouths of Blighthaven's assorted fauna by appealing to their "laid-back" nature with Cankershroom fresh from Cankertube Swamp! Maybe you should consider a career in the entertainment industry!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Get that stack of cash ready.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Let's face it, $(player.race), this "Blighthaven" isn't our most glamorous location shoot, and yet here we are day after day after - well, you get the idea. If I can keep my crew constantly entertained by exotic hallucinogenics, or... pizza toppings, then perhaps they will cease wandering into the wilds to get eaten, or to other, more desirable sets. Yes?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Who am I to deny the little people what they want? Am I right or am I right? Or, am I right?
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'm going to have your job, you nobody!

localizedTextIdText: The twisted elementals in the Keeper's Sanctuary are constantly reborn and grow in power until death. The Pell predict the Entity will harness them if left unchecked, and thus the elementals are an ongoing concern. Kill them to ensure their power doesn't grow enough to gain the Entity's interest.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to the Harmonious Elder via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nTwisted elementals pose a potential threat to the Pell, so they must be eliminated. (You may contact the Harmonious Balance-Finder for more details.)
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING\nTwisted elementals still pose a potential threat to the Pell, and must be eliminated. (You may contact the Harmonious Balance-Finder for more details.)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The twisted elementals in the Keeper's Sanctuary are always growing in power. We must keep them groomed, or the Entity will surely use them against us!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The twisted elementals have been felled, and advantage escapes the Entity... for now.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Return to us soon. Our work will never truly end until the Entity is destroyed.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm going to fell that guy, too.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You killed the twisted elementals in the Keeper's Sanctuary for Harmonious Balance-Finder, ensuring they will not achieve devastating power levels and become useful to the Entity.

localizedTextIdText: The corrupted fauna on the Hollow Trail has become too numerous for the dwindling Dominion manpower to handle. Most combatants have advanced to the Defile. Keysew Kango is calling patriotic and armed (mostly armed) forces in Blighthaven back to the collective temporarily to help subdue the beasts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Keysew Kango via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nHostile beasts on the Hollow Trail are reaching overwhelming levels and hindering ground travel. (You may contact Keysew Kango for more details.)
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING\nHostile beasts on the Hollow Trail are reaching overwhelming levels and hindering ground travel. (You may contact Keysew Kango for more details.)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Everyone left for the Defile and Hollow Trail is getting too dangerous! Manpower! Bullets! Flamethrowers! Warbots! Need it all! NOW!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Whew. Good good! Won't get murdered or turned into purple eye-bally moron on road. Today, anyway.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Check board tomorrow. Just in case. May need murderous hireling again.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go back and help them!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You suppressed corrupt beasts on the Hollow Trail, ensuring that Dominion citizens using it live another day to serve the greater good.
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: I'll go back and help them!

localizedTextIdText: The corrupted fauna on the Hollow Trail have become too numerous for the dwindling Exile manpower in that area to handle. Most combatants have advanced to the Defile. Captain Floodbough is calling daring and armed (mostly armed) forces in Blighthaven back to temporarily to help subdue the beasts.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Floodbough via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nHostile beasts on the Hollow Trail are reaching overwhelming levels and hindering ground travel. (You may contact Captain Floodbough for details.)
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: WARNING\nHostile beasts on the Hollow Trail are reaching overwhelming levels and hindering ground travel. (You may contact Captain Floodbough for more details.)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Travelin' on the Hollow Trail is gettin' impossible, what with almost anyone with a trigger finger headed to the Defile an' all. Can you lend a hand?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Thanks for comin' through, partner. We gotta hold it down here best we can, but it helps knowin' Exiles still have each other's back.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep an eye on them boards. We ain't goin' home anytime soon, know what I mean?
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll go back and help them!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: We take care of our own.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You suppressed corrupt beasts on the Hollow Trail, ensuring the Exiles using it at least another day to stick it to the Dominion and Strain alike.

localizedTextIdText: DRED wants to know why your resistance to the Globellum is so high. Daga Brox insists that you travel through data-gathering holorings around the Globellum so he can study your brainwaves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Daga Brox via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nVery important work needs doing. Go through holorings inside Globellum. Talk to Daga Brox for information.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nHolorings in Globellum still need someone named $(player.name) to go in them. Talk to Daga Brox for details.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: DRED wants to know how you resist Globellum so easily. Instruments study brainwaves when you travel through holorings in and out of Globellum goo. Simple, yes?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Brainwave data useful! Also, we take brain sample from you just now with tiny teleport! More brain study to do!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: More tests another day? Probably. Science never sleeps!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: DRED has determined that you have a natural resistance to the Globellum, and have taken samples of your brain for further testing.

localizedTextIdText: The XAS wants to know why your resistance to the Globellum is so high. Durnit Briarbun insists that you travel through data-gathering holorings around the Globellum so he can study your brainwaves.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Durnit Briarbun via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: ATTENTION\nThe XAS needs living Exiles who have made physical contact with the Globellum to go through holorings. (You may report to Durnit Briarbun for more details.)
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: ATTENTION\nThe XAS needs living Exiles who have made physical contact with the Globellum to go through holorings. (You may report to Durnit Briarbun for details.)
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The XAS is studying why some people can resist the Globellum. Go through the holorings we set up, and your brainwaves will get scanned. Cool?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: We got some great data! But, we've teleported out a tiny brain tissue sample. You know, for more studying.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Swing by again soon! We're gonna need to give it another go.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The XAS has determined that you have a natural resistance to the Globellum, and they have taken samples of your brain for further testing.

localizedTextIdText: Sentient beings have been slipping into what appears to be a parallel dimension after interacting with the Sonic Resonance Device, and a holographic Simulation of Nurton has been deployed to collect data on the phenomenon. Travel through the holorings from the Nursery Trading Post to the Defile, thereby completing the Resonance Runner challenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Simulation of Nurton via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My counterpart and I are collecting data pertaining to this strange phenomenon. Will you be our test subject? Just activate the Sonic Resonance Device.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: There is much to do if we are to destroy the techno-phage, my free-willed friend! Please assist us in putting an end to this vile malignancy!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This simulation is awaiting collection of relevant data generated by your interaction with the Sonic Resonance Device.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome back and thank you, helpful sentient subject! You have aided the outsourced research of Nurton and Kaffee, "free hackers" for liberty!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Our optional courtesy teleportation will follow your collection of relevant data.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Simulation routine complete. Come back soon. Goodbye!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: A holographic Simulation of Nurton deployed to Blighthaven collected data involving your completion of the "Resonance Runner" challenge beginning at the Nursery Trading Post and ending at the Defile. Bang! Zoom!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Activate the Sonic Resonance Device to enter what may be a parallel dimension. When you see a trail of holorings, follow it to the end at the Defile. Doing it in a certain amount of time yields relevant data. On completion, we'll teleport you back here as a courtesy!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am a holographic simulation of Nurton, and my counterpart here is a holographic simulation of Kaffee. Nurton and Kaffee are "free hackers," sworn to liberate all bionic beings from oppression! We were created to help complete research outsourced to them by XAS, DRED, and CoGS while they stop the techno-phage in the Defile.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Our programming covers an extremely finite range of responses and it does not include an appropriately elaborate reply. Sorry! We are not actual bionics capable of navigating this conversation. That would be hypocritical of Nurton and Kaffee!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Simulation routine restarting.

localizedTextIdText: After discovering a strange object for a Shade's Eve ritual, you get a sensation to head to the capital city, Illium, and search for a burning memory.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Retrieve the Memory of the Burned somewhere in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: This odd object has something to do with a Shade's Eve ritual you half remember. There might be more clues out there, perhaps in the capital city.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Before the cure was found, the bodies were burned in masses. Remember them.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Remember...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found the burning doll in Illium. You watched it turn to ashes and remembered that this was the fate of so many who fell to the plague, long ago.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Retrieve the Memory of the Burned

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the weapons she requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion weapons for the Draken that they may drive out the riffraff on the savannah.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion weapons for the Draken that they may drive out the riffraff on the savannah.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When I ask for weapons, I expect prompt delivery.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It appears that there is hope for you yet, craftsman.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You proved yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium by crafting weapons for her.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Minor in Illium has submitted a request for rudimentary steel weapons to be delivered to her. The Chua scientists wish to pit the cognitive abilities of the razortail against humanoid weaponry. Diabolical!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Razortail intelligence enhancers successful. Perhaps capable of soldiering? Would be great scientific accomplishment. Bring weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Razortail intelligence enhancers successful. Perhaps capable of soldiering? Would be great scientific accomplishment. Bring weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you brought the weapons the Chua requested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You managed to deliver. Good. I will ensure the scientists get these for their... experiments.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought steel weapons to Lieutenant Minor so the Chua researchers can begin their experiments. You ignored the murmurs of concern from the testing team.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Frugo in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign against the Exiles. Craft those weapons!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: If you have no weapons, then you waste time! Wasting time very dangerous... for you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Talk fast. Very busy. You bring weapons?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Weapons!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed Weaponsmith Frugo request for steel weapons.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Weaponsmith Frugo

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the medical supplies she requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested medical supplies to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Medishots, boosters - we need them all. Craft medical supplies and bring them to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Medishots, boosters - we need them all. Craft medical supplies and bring them to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You address me before you have completed your task? This is disappointing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These will come in handy, regardless of their quality. Well done, citizen.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You proved yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medical supplies to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Minor in Illium has requested medishots for an injured test subject from the latest Chua experiment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring medishots to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: That fool, Abazi Buo! He has injured himself. Delay our research by 135,207 seconds if he is not tended to. Bring medicine!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: That fool, Abazi Buo! He has injured himself. Delay our research by 135,207 seconds if he is not tended to. Bring medicine!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Chua have been a little... overzealous. Some medishots would help the latest testers recover.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Good, you have the medishots. We'll administer them, along with a warning. The Chua need to manage their resources.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your work is appreciated.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed Lieutenant Minor request for medishots.

localizedTextIdText: You found a contract on the Work Order Board in Illium that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those medical supplies!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medical supplies to Technologist Corvianos in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'm sorry, we do actually need medishots. Because people get hurt, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These are some top o' the line medishots, love! Good on ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed Technologist Corvianos request for medical supplies.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medical supplies to Technologist Corvianos

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the Light Armor she requires of you to prove your loyalty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. There is an urgent need for Light Armor in the region. Craft some and bring it to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. There is an urgent need for Light Armor in the region. Craft some and bring it to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You address me before you have completed your task? This is disappointing.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This armor shows promise. There is hope for you yet.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You proved yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Light Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Minor in Illium has politely requested you to provide her with new garments for the Chua testers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring new Light Armor for Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Calamity! Clothes in shreds, fur insufficient for savannah nights. Blasted razortail claws. Ripping! Shredding! Craft Light Armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Calamity! Clothes in shreds, fur insufficient for savannah nights. Blasted razortail claws. Ripping! Shredding! Craft Light Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you secured new garments for the Chua? They burned theirs yet again.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, good, new clothes. I'll deliver these to the testers straightaway.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps they won't destroy them immediately.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: That's terrible? I want to help.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You provided Lieutenant Minor with new garments for the Chua testers.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Light Armor toLieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Amphio in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that Light Armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Measure twice, cut once. And when you cut, make sure it is clean... and final.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Your cuts are precise, your hems uniform. Better than I expected.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The Dominion thanks you for your service. May the empire be preserved.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Dominion Victory Commissions request for steel light armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the requested Light Armor to Tailor Amphio

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the Medium Armor she requires of you to prove your loyalty as a craftsman.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. My friend and superior, Mareon Tateo, needs his armor replaced. I expect you to come through for me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. My friend and superior, Mareon Tateo, needs his armor replaced. I expect you to come through for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: When I make an order, I expect it to be fulfilled promptly.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am sure he will make use of this. Perhaps as a backup...
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You proved yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Medium Armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Minor in Illium has requested Medium Armor to protect the testers from the dangerous experiments in the test area.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your Medium Armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Tester injured recently. Already shorthanded. Efficiency reduced by 19.4%. Must take precautionary measures. Make Scout's armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Tester injured recently. Already shorthanded. Efficiency reduced by 19.4%. Must take precautionary measures. Make Scout's armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you brought the armor? Many experiments await, apparently.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Excellent. This will hopefully prevent some damage, at the least.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Until the next explosion, naturally.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed Lieutenant Minor request for medium armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your Medium Armor to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Vekia in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that Medium Armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the Medium Armor to Outfitter Vekia in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Bring me your finest leather. Do not disappoint me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is fine armor. Your efforts do you credit.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, hunter. May your weapon always strike true.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed Outfitter Vekia request for steel armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the Medium Armor to Outfitter Vekia

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the steel weave armor she requires of you to prove your faithfulness as a craftsman.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion steel weave armor for Dominion troops operating in the region.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\n$(player.name), I have a task for you. Fashion steel weave armor for Dominion troops operating in the region.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You address me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Perhaps I have misjudged you. There may yet be hope for you as an armorer.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Serve and be rewarded.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You proved yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela by making steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Minor in Illium has asked you for steel weave armor so that her Chua associates may continue testing razortail ingenuity and violence potential.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Aggression Testing underway. Must check effectiveness against armored targets, but where to get heavier armor? You make steel weave and bring to me.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Aggression Testing underway. Must check effectiveness against armored targets, but where to get heavier armor? You make steel weave and bring to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do you have the armor? The scientists are growing impatient.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ah, good, the requested armor. Hopefully this will prove an adequate blast shield.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You may wish to vacate the area.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought steel weave armor to Lieutenant Minor, allowing the Chua to continue their razortail experimentation.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Lieutenant Minor

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Vospana in Illium has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft that steel weave armor!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Armorer Vospana in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Where is that steel armor? I've been waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Glory to the Dominion! It appears you've crafted some armor for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Well done, my pet, well done indeed.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed Armorer Vospana request for steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: I'll get to crafting right now.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Armorer Vospana

localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium has sent a request to test your commitment to the Dominion. Craft the $m(schematic=392) she requires of you to prove your loyalty to the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring $m(schematic=392) to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nThe Dominion requires Metal Platform for constructing watchtowers to defend our territory. Deliver them to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela upon completion.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nThe Dominion requires Metal Platform for constructing watchtowers to defend our territory. Deliver them to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela upon completion.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Metal Platform are one of the simplest things to construct - sheets of metal riveted together into a vague rectangle. Surely this is not beyond you?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: These are adequate to my requirements. You may go.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: We are finished here.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You proved yourself to Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela in Illium.

localizedTextIdText: Lieutenant Minor in Illium has submitted a request for small bramble bushes for use in an incredibly explosive experiment.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Lieutenant Minor in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Science calls! Need small bramble bushes for experiment! Hard to come by. Hirelings do it instead, bring to Lieutenant Minor at once!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Science calls! Need small bramble bushes for experiment! Hard to come by. Hirelings do it instead, bring to Lieutenant Minor at once!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The Chua won't stop demanding their bramble bushes. You do plan to fill the order, I hope?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I will deliver the shrubbery posthaste. I heard the Chua muttering something about attaching explosives to them. Typical.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You should likely avoid any brambles you see in the wild. Just in case.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You brought several small bramble bushes to Lieutenant Minor for use in the latest Chua experiments. The future isn't looking too bright for dawngrazers.

localizedTextIdText: Architect Cybene in the Feralplain Collective has offered you a contract that will further the Dominion's campaign to suppress the rebels. Craft those $m(schematic=3003)!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the $m(schematic=3003) to Architect Cybene in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: In this time of galactic conflict, every craftsman who takes a contract brings us one day closer to ultimate victory for the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The hard work always gets left up to the likes of us, don't it? Well, these fences won't build themselves!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Nice job, mate. Feels good to know that the likes of us can contribute to the glory of the Dominion, right?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Blessings of Dominus to you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Dominion Victory Commission's request for <text Link="Schematic:3003">$m(schematic=3003)</text>.

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Thayd has heard of your recent pursuit of weaponsmithing. She wants you to demonstrate your crafting skills so she can evaluate your progress. Naturally, you accepted her challenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nHowdy! Crafting Trainer Oaklee here! Seems like there's a lot of new weaponsmiths here. I've got a little job to see how you pioneers are comin' along.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nHowdy! Crafting Trainer Oaklee here! Seems like there's a lot of new weaponsmiths here. I've got a little job to see how you new folk are comin' along.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's up?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, I'll be! Not a bad start! Sure, yer still wet behind the ears, but yer off to a great start!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's good to see initiative in newcomers!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I should give this a shot!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee was pleased to see that you'd accomplished a basic proficiency in weapons crafting. Your success proves that you have what it takes to pursue your craft further.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the weapons to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Thayd have been under attack by hostile factions, and the militia is in dire need of weapons. Acquire some weapons and deliver them to one of the local logistics officers.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your weapons to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate weapons.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate weapons.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey there. You the one deliverin' the weapons?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Are those the weapons we asked for? Hot damn! You really delivered, you know that?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't stop! We need every scrap we can get out there.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I hope they help you out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Thanks to your handiwork, the local militia has its supplies. The officer you delivered them to was impressed with the quality and grateful to have more weaponry.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your weapons to Coordinator Mills

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade offers crafters work orders, which instruct them to craft items to supply the Granok Free Companies. You accepted the task to deliver weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed. Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You gonna get me that weapon, or you just gonna stand there, lettin' the grass grow under yer feet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: 'Bout time you showed up! Lemme take a good look... yup, this oughtta do nicely! Much appreciated, friend! I'll make sure it's put to good use!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You did a good thing today! You know that?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You did your part for the Free Companies and delivered weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper. She seemed impressed with your craftsmanship, promising to put the weapons to good use. You took that to mean "blow up a few Imperial heads."
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the weapons to Weaponsmith Dunpepper

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Thayd has asked all new Technologists to craft medishots so she can evaluate your Technologist techniques.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the medical supplies to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Oaklee here. I got some pendin' requests fer medishots, and I'd like to see how you pioneers are doin' at yer Technologist skills!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Oaklee here. I got some pendin' requests fer medishots, and I'd like to see how you pioneers are doin' at yer technologist skills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Found my medishot contract? How's it comin'?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, let's have a look... yep, these are great! Yer comin' along good! Nice to see ya takin' that initiative!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: My hopes are high for ya, friend.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee was happy to see your example of basic proficiency at Technologist techniques.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the medical supplies to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Thayd are hampered by local aggressors, and the militia is in dire need of medical supplies. Craft some medishots and deliver them to Coordinator Mills.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your medishots to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Dire medicine shortages predicted. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate medishots.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Dire medicine shortages predicted. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate medishots.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You here to help us out with med supplies? We're practically bleedin' out here!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's this? All right! Medishots! We'll get these to the front lines right away! Our medics owe you a favor, pal!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Nice work, chum. I owe ya a cold one.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hope these help out your injured!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You resupplied the local militia with medical supplies. Coordinator Mills was just happy to have the help.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your medishots to Coordinator Mills

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver medishots to Techsmith Praxa in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering medical supplies to Techsmith Praxa in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You plannin' on helping us out with medishots?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Oh! Those are perfect. I'll just place them in my satch- where did I place that? Well, give them here.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I have a small reward for you from the... uh... ah, here it is in my bag.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is my contract, no question!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered medishots to Techsmith Praxa. Once she found her satchel, she gave you a reward out of gratitude for your craftsmanship.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the medical supplies to Techsmith Praxa

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Thayd has asked you to craft Light Armor so she can evaluate your tailoring techniques.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Light Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Oaklee transmitting. Been practicin' yer sewing, pioneers? I've got a simple task to test yer skills!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Oaklee transmitting. Been practicin' yer sewing, pioneers? I've got a simple task to test yer skills!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How can I help ya?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Well, well, let's have a look! That's some mighty fine sewing you've done there. I'm lookin' forward to seein' you get better!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Ain't enough dedicated folks like you, friend.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I think I can handle this!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You accomplished Crafting Trainer Oaklee's request to show your basic grasp of tailoring. She was impressed with the sample you gave her.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Light Armor pieces to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills in Thayd is looking for some Light Armor to outfit the local troops.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your supplies to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE: This is Coordinator Mills. If you're a tailor looking to crank out some armor for our troops, I want you!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE: This is Coordinator Mills. If you're a tailor looking to crank out some armor for our troops, I want you!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's up, friend?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, now, this is some solid work! Our troops can stop trainin' in their skivvies!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're the best, $(player.class)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You accomplished Coordinator Mills request to show how much your tailoring has improved. She was impressed with the sample you gave her.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your supplies to Coordinator Mills

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Wildspring in Thayd has asked you to craft Light Armor to help outfit the troops training in the city.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Light Armor to Tailor Wildspring in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE: Tailor Wildspring here! We need a whole kaboodle of light armor and we're looking for a great tailor to deliver!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE: Tailor Wildspring here! We need a whole kaboodle of light armor and we're looking for a great tailor to deliver!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hello there! I bet you're the tailor who's come to help us all out, am I right?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This is just what we needed! No more cold nights for our light troops, you know?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Sew flowers into them next time!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This has my name all over it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You accomplished Tailor Wildspring request to show your tailoring prowess. Thayd's troops have been outfitted with your fine work.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring Light Armor pieces to Tailor Wildspring

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade has put out a call for new crafters to show their basic proficiency with Outfitting in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Take Medium Armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Oaklee here. We're lookin' to mass-produce some Medium Armor. Any of you pioneers gotten up to scratch yet?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nCrafting Trainer Oaklee here. We're lookin' to mass-produce some Medium Armor. Any of you pioneers gotten up to scratch yet?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Somethin' you need?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yeah. This here's pretty good. I like to see you new folk takin' initiative! I'll hand these off. Nice work.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You done good work, $(player.name). You got my respect.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee seemed pleased with the pieces you gave her for evaluation and praised your mastery of the basics of Outfitting.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the armor pieces to Crafting Trainer Oaklee
