localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Gallow have been under attack, and the militia is in dire need of Medium Armor. Acquire some and deliver it to the logistics officer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your armor to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate Medium Armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate Medium Armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: What's the word?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, it's about time! I'll get these shipped to the militia pronto! I owe ya one, pal.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll get ya back for this. Promise.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This looks like a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The logistics officer was grateful for your delivery of Medium Armor to aid in their war efforts and gave you rare praise for your efforts.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your armor to Coordinator Mills

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver the requested Medium Armor order to Outfitter Halliday in Gallow.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You seen my contract?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, hey! Glad you filled that there contract! I'll get these out to the front lines in an insta-jiffy!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I reckon you done right by us today, $(player.name)!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Outfitter Halliday was glad to see you succeeded in her contract order of Medium Armor. Your gear will help the Free Companies in their fight for the Exiles.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the Medium Armor to Outfitter Halliday

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee of the Exile Craftsman's Brigade in Thayd posted a job for up-and-coming armorers to craft some basic steel weave pieces for her evaluation. Naturally, you took her up on the challenge.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the steel weave armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nHowdy, pioneers! Crafting Trainer Oaklee here, with a job for you new armorers out there! Craft a few pieces for me, and I'll see how yer comin' along!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nHowdy, pioneers! Crafting Trainer Oaklee here, with a job for you new armorers out there! Craft a few pieces for me, and I'll see how yer comin' along!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let's have a look... oh, fine work you did here! You're comin' along just fine, friend! I look forward to what you're up to next!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You earned my respect, friend. Good luck craftin'!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Crafting Trainer Oaklee seemed pleased with the pieces you gave her for evaluation and praised your mastery of the basics of armor work. You got your armor crafting career off to a strong start.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the steel weave armor to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdTitle: Class V Logistics: Steel Weave Armor
localizedTextIdText: The supply lines for Exile forces in Thayd are hampered by local aggressors, and the militia is in dire need of armor. Acquire some and deliver it to the logistics officer.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your steel weave armor to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: URGENT: Supplies needed for local militias. Catastrophic equipment shortfalls expected. All capable pioneers, locate logistics officers and donate steel weave armor.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Got somethin' for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What's that you got there? Steel weave armor? Hell, yeah! I'll get these to the front lines pronto. Man, you're rock solid, you know that?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: That was some damn good work. Real nice, pal.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: This is right up my alley!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You resupplied the local militia in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your steel weave armor to the Thayd Logistics Officer

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Complete the contract by delivering steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Don't have time for chattin'. You got any gear for me?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, hey! Nice work! I'll ship these to the front line, pronto!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I don't usually say thanks... but, uh, thanks.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Hope these help you guys out!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako in Thayd. He seemed grateful to have it.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Deliver the steel weave armor to Armorer Thaako

localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd is responsible for funneling housing supplies to territories belonging to the Exiles. She needs some $m(schematic=392) and other basic architectural items.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the housing goods to Crafting Trainer Oaklee in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: MESSAGE:\nWe've got a request here for some Metal Platform. We're looking for a capable architect to sort this out.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: MESSAGE:\nWe've got a request here for some Metal Platform. We're looking for a capable architect to sort this out.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: How's that housing order comin' along? You makin' good on it, friend?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Let's have a look... yes, these'll do nicely. I'm mighty grateful to ya, friend.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: This is fine work, friend!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Looks like a job for me!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I think they'll look pretty nice!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You supplied Crafting Trainer Oaklee with $m(schematic=392).
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the housing goods to Crafting Trainer Oaklee

localizedTextIdText: Coordinator Mills in Thayd is looking for architects. She needs $m(schematic=372) for some creative landscaping projects.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your goods to Coordinator Mills in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: REQUEST: Looking for $m(schematic=372), suitable for replanting in local landscape projects. Make all deliveries to Gallow.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: REQUEST: Looking for $m(schematic=372), suitable for replanting in local landscape projects. Make all deliveries to Gallow.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hey, you workin' on $m(schematic=372)? We really need 'em.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, you came through for us, pal! I'll get these shipped out right away!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You made it happen, pal. Gotta hand it to ya.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered $m(schematic=372) to Coordinator Mills. She was grateful to have them.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your goods to Coordinator Mills

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Craftsman's Brigade has offered contracts to crafters to fuel the war effort. Deliver housing supplies to Contractor Drogor in Thayd.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring the housing supplies to Contractor Drogor in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: CONTRACT: Exile craftsmen, your skills are needed! Do your part to keep the Free Companies fighting! \n\nEndorsed by the Exile Craftsman's Brigade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I await the delivery of frivolous morale-boosting items.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What wonderful things you craft for me! I become faint with delight. Actually, upon introspection, I do not.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Perhaps this trade will be more beneficial for you than for me. Take it and go.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You delivered housing supplies to Contractor Drogor in Gallow. He was grateful to have them (in his own way) and got them shipped out quickly.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring the housing supplies to Contractor Drogor

localizedTextIdText: Hone your ingenuity and speed against Ascendancy acolytes by completing the Bay of Betrayal adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Petr Pudorich via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We cannot afford to allow our enemies to surpass our understanding of Eldan technology. Enter the Bay of Betrayal simulation to better prepare yourself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Why haven't you completed the Bay of Betrayal simulation? Remember that attacking blindly won't do you any good.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It seems you've managed to pull it off. Hopefully you learned something.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Quick thinking and ingenuity are often superior to brute force tactics.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't expect it to be so easy next time.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I learned a trick or two.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Bay of Betrayal adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Is this task too difficult for you? Perhaps I should send a jabbit in your stead.

localizedTextIdText: Hone your ingenuity and speed against Ascendancy acolytes by completing the Bay of Betrayal adventure. Use the Content Finder to enter this adventure and complete it on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Eldon Ironmoore via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We cannot allow our enemies to surpass our understanding of Eldan technology. Enter the Bay of Betrayal simulation to better prepare yourself.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have not yet completed the Bay of Betrayal simulation. You may be required to use your brain for a change.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It seems you've managed to succeed. Perhaps we'll turn you into a tactician yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: This simulation may actually require you to think. Frightening, I know.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't expect it to be so easy next time.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I learned a trick or two.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed the Bay of Betrayal adventure on Veteran difficulty.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You refuse? I hadn't realized you were prepared for death.

localizedTextIdText: Initialization Core Y-83 has been compromised. Purge the infection within the Quarantined Core after activating the Organic Incinerator.

Anti-primal wasteoids have been appearing as a result of the battles in the Grove of Hope. A holographic Simulation of Kaffee has been deployed to collect the creatures for research. Travel to the Seraphic Wood to activate Anti-Primal Collection System Controls, put on a Anti-Primal Custodial Suit, and help catch them.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Simulation of Kaffee via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: My counterpart and I are collecting data pertaining to anti-primal wasteoids near the Grove of Hope. Can you assist in their collection?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This simulation is awaiting collection of wasteoids in the Seraphic Wood.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome back and thank you, helpful sentient! You have aided the outsourced research of Nurton and Kaffee, "free hackers" for liberty!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Activate the Anti-Primal Collection System Controls in the Seraphic Wood to begin.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Simulation routine complete. Come back soon. Goodbye!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'll be ready for next time.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: A holographic Simulation of Kaffee deployed to Blighthaven collected anti-primal Wasteoids involving your jet-packing skills in the Seraphic Wood. The world needs wasteoid collection and disposal specialists.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Activate the Anti-Primal Collection System Controls and equip the Anti-Primal Custodial Suit to collect the anti-primal wasteoids on contact without harming yourself. The suit will require recharging at the Anti-Primal Custodial Suit Charger. Wasteoids are airborne, so the suit comes with a jetpack and calming, focus-enhancing music! The Anti-Primal Containment Field is also your jetpack's boundary. Take collected wasteoids to the Anti-Primal Collection Intake. You may carry up to five at a time. Some wasteoids have more mass, and therefore value, than others!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I am a holographic simulation of Kaffee, and my counterpart here is a holographic simulation of Nurton. Kaffee and Nurton are "free hackers," sworn to liberate all bionic beings from oppression! We were created to help complete research outsourced to them by XAS, DRED, and CoGS while they stop the techno-phage in the Defile.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Our programming covers an extremely finite range of responses and it does not include an appropriately elaborate reply. Sorry! We are not actual bionics capable of navigating this conversation. That would be hypocritical of Kaffee and Nurton!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Simulation routine restarting.

localizedTextIdTitle: MC22 - Capture Script - Nexus Arrival - Planet
localizedTextIdText: /c sig 19274 <scene_number>

The M.A.C. has offered to help you learn Tanking, your class support role. Go to the Combat Training Room and learn to use support abilities to grab and hold the attention of enemies in a group fight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the M.A.C. in Bloodfire Village
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nexus is dangerous. You'll wanna group up to fight the big critters. As a Tank, you need to keep the bad guys focused on you.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You finish that trainin' yet? Well, get movin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, good work in there. We'll make a Tank outta you yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head to the Combat Trainin' Room and we'll show ya the ropes.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya around.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The M.A.C. showed you how to use support abilities to grab and hold the attention of enemies in a group fight. When your group fights against tough opponents, these skills will help you succeed!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Anybody can beat on somethin' till it dies. The trick is killin' THEM before they kill YOU. And some stuff out there needs a group to take down. In a group, good use of yer support role will put you on the winnin' side.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You're a $(player.class), so your support role is Tanking.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Tankin' is all about takin' hits. See, anybody can dish it out, but not everybody can take it. The Tank in a group keeps the bad guys occupied, so their buddies can focus on doin' the damage.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, it's your funeral, pal.

localizedTextIdText: The M.A.C. has offered to help you learn Healing, your class support role. Go to the Combat Training Room and learn to use support abilities to heal allies in a group fight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the M.A.C. in Tremor Ridge
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nexus is dangerous. You'll wanna group up to fight the big critters. As a Healer, you need to keep yer buddies on their feet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Ya finish your Healer trainin' yet? Well, get movin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Hey, good work in there. We'll make a Healer outta you yet.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head to the Combat Trainin' Room and we'll show ya the ropes.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See ya around.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The M.A.C. showed you how to use support abilities to heal allies in a group fight. When your group fights against tough opponents, these skills will help you succeed!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: What was I supposed to be learning?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Anybody can beat on somethin' till it dies. The trick is killin' THEM before they kill YOU. And some stuff out there needs a group to take down. In a group, good use of yer support role will put you on the winnin' side.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You're a $(player.class), so your support role is Healing.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: What are ya, dense? Healing is keepin' people alive in combat. See in a group, ya got a Tank to take hits, and a Healer to keep the Tank upright. Everybody else, too. Don't be stingy - spread that healin' around.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Hey, it's your funeral, pal.

localizedTextIdText: Noelia asked you to destroy holobots to verify you can defend yourself. Seems that Nexus is a dangerous place.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Noelia to report your progress
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Proper self-defense techniques are crucial if you are to survive the challenges of Nexus. Please destroy the holobots to either side of me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Does a cerebral malfunction prevent you from completing the objective?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased to see you were not virtually eviscerated by those creatures!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am confident you will survive this phase without permanent damage!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed enough holobots to satisfy Noelia and verify your self-defense capabilities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The cryo awakening procedure cannot complete unless you pass this test.

localizedTextIdTitle: MC22 - Capture Script - Nexus Arrival - Effects
localizedTextIdText: /c sig 19274 <scene_number>

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now that you're in the Explorers Union, we'll send you on missions to explore Nexus. In fact, we have four of these missions ready for you in the Northern Wilds.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Glad to see you're on the job. Good luck to ya, now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Explorer Wennie, a member of the Explorers Union. She explained that there are missions for you in the Northern Wilds. Should be simple - climbing mountains, placing beacons, and surveying the lands. Your path missions will appear in your datachron.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What would I do on these missions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I know if I have a new mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: My name's Wennie, friend, and I'm with the Explorers Union.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're like-minded folks who want to map every bit of Nexus. We can't all be Dorian Walker, but we can sure as hell try!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: The usual - climbing mountains, placing beacons, surveying the land.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Your path missions will appear in your datachron.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: As part of the XAS, you will complete missions to analyze the flora, fauna, and technology of Nexus. You will discover three of these missions in the Northern Wilds.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You will make many new discoveries on Nexus. Farewell.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Scientist Mikael, a member of the Exile Academy of Science. He explained that there are missions for you in the Northern Wilds. Should be simple - just deploy your scanbot to analyze the environment, collect samples, and hack Eldan or enemy technology. Your path missions will appear in your datachron.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What would I do on these missions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I know if I have a new mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I am Mikael, representative of the Exile Academy of Science, also known as the XAS, and I am at your service.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We are scientists and researchers who have aligned with the aspiration of learning all there is to ascertain about Nexus.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Deploy your scanbot to analyze your environment, collect samples, and on occasion, hack Eldan or enemy technology.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Your path missions will appear in your datachron.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Pioneering League could use an able body. Here in the Northern Wilds, we've got three missions, so hunt down those resources and get buildin'!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good to hear it! You can never have enough improvements. Bye now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Settler Vales, a member of the Pioneering League. He explained that there are missions for you in the Northern Wilds. Should be simple enough - the gathering of resources, the building of improvements, and the occasional big project or two. Your path missions will appear in your datachron.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What would I do on these missions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I know if I have a new mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm Vales, and I'm but one of the many settlers in the Pioneering League.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: We're going to help settle Nexus for the rest of the Exiles. I sure hope I can count on you to help out.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Why, build improvements for your fellow Exiles, of course. You gotta gather resources, then put them to use in a depot. Also, there are the occasional big projects.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Your path missions will appear in your datachron.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Glad to see a fellow soldier. The Northern Wilds has three missions with your name on 'em, so you better ruck up and move out.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Good. Now get out there and start crackin' skulls and takin' names.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm ready for my first mission!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met Soldier Benzaga, a member of the Free Companies of Nexus. She explained that there are missions for you in the Northern Wilds. Should be simple - some assassinations, rescue ops, demolitions, and holdouts. Your path missions will appear in your datachron.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What would I do on these missions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I know if I have a new mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Name's Benzaga, and I'm with the Free Companies of Nexus. That's FCON, for short.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Simple. We get to pound the Dommies into a smooth, red paste on the battlefield, if ya get my drift.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You'll find soldier beacons in the field, offering missions. You'll hold off enemy waves, assasinate high-value targets, rescue Exiles, and blow stuff up.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Your path missions will appear in your datachron.

localizedTextIdText: The M.A.C. has offered to help you learn Tanking, your class support role. Go to the Combat Training Room and learn how to use your support actions to grab and hold the attention of enemies in a group fight.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to the M.A.C. in Lightreach Mission

localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I tell if I have received a mission?

localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You must deploy your scanbot to analyze your environment, collect samples, and on occasion, hack Eldan or enemy technology.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Your path missions will appear in your datachron.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I explorer too. In Exploration Society. Plenty missions for all. You get four on Crimson Isle. So get hopping, and climbing, and hiking.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Great! Now go! Nexus not going to explore itself.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met a member of the Exploration Society, Explorer Grubozz. He explained that there are a few missions to do on Crimson Isle. Shouldn't be too hard, just the usual climbing mountains, placing beacons, and surveying the lands. Your path missions will appear in your datachron.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What do I have to do on the missions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I tell if I have received a mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: I'm Grubozz! Explorer extraordinaire. Like you, I in Exploration Society, searching high and low for adventure and glory.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: Is big organization for Dominion Explorers. Catalogues all discoveries made by Explorers. Best of all, rewards all Explorers for contributions!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Usual stuff. Climb mountains, place beacons, survey land. Not die in process.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Your path missions will appear in your datachron.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Settlement Authority has three missions for you on Crimson Isle. You must do your part to colonize Nexus in the name of the Dominion.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Our job will not be an easy one, but without us, the Dominion cannot succeed.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I'm ready to settle Nexus for the Dominion.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met a member of the Settlement Authority, Settler Decima. She explained that there are a few missions to do on Crimson Isle. localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay02: What do I have to do on the missions?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay03: How do I tell if I have received a mission?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: You may call me Decima. I am a coordinator for the Settlement Authority. It is a privilege just to meet someone of my pedigree.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: It is an organization dedicated to the Dominion's settlement of Nexus. Our task is to pave the way for the pioneers who will follow us in the years to come.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: Why, build improvements for your fellow citizens to use, of course. You must gather resources, then put them to use in a depot. Then there are the occasional big projects to do.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText03: Your path missions will appear in your datachron.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Good to see a fellow legionnaire. We have missions for you to do, currently three in Levian Bay. So get out there and do the Dominion proud.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It is good to hear. Now go, and may all your strikes be fatal.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: It is an honor to serve the military.

localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: You will find soldier beacons in the field that will brief you on your missions. You will hold off enemy waves, assasinate valuable targets, rescue your comrades, and destroy materiel, all for the Dominion's glory.

localizedTextIdTitle: MC22 - Capture Script - Nexus Arrival - Starships
localizedTextIdText: /c sig 19274 <scene_number>

The Exiles are resilient people, never too proud to get back to basics. Demonstrate your eagerness to master the rigors of group combat to Trooper Troza in the Protogames Academy. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Trooper Troza via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Exiles are tough 'cause we never let ourselves get too comfy. Ya wanna master group tactics? Then get yer butt to the Protogames Academy 'n' train hard!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Protostar tells me you haven't checked in for trainin' at the Academy. What the hell ya waitin' for?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Ya ground that Wrathbone fella into dust! It's a good thing you were up for the challenge, Exile.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what I like to hear. No Exiles goin' soft on my watch.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Keep up the good work, Sweetheart.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took on the Protostar Corporation's grab bag of baddies in the Protogames Academy on Prime difficulty! Trooper Troza was pretty impressed by your skills and willingness to get back into the classroom.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Too good for trainin'? Don't tell me you've gone soft.

localizedTextIdText: All loyal citizens must uphold Dominion values, requiring continual training and self-improvement. Demonstrate your eagerness to master the rigors of group combat to Captain Viydra in the Protogames Academy. Use the Content Finder to enter this dungeon and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Captain Viydra via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Citizens must strive to better themselves as champions of the Dominion. Proceed to the Protogames Academy and demonstrate your group combat skills.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Non-compliance with citizen self-improvement initiatives is grounds for investigation. I suggest you proceed to the Protogames Academy at once.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The results of your academy training have been received. You rendered Wrathbone ineffective and have proven your skill as a Dominion citizen.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Even General Warbringer requires a bit of practice now and then.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Your desire to succeed is admirable.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took on the Protostar Corporation's grab bag of baddies in the Protogames Academy on Prime difficulty! Captain Viydra admires your desire to succeed.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal to perfect your skills for the Dominion equates to treason.

localizedTextIdText: The Exile Academy of Science has discovered a mysterious portal in Thayd. Rhoda Wellspring has requested you support her team's exploration of the portal's ultimate destination, and has asked you to report to her in Thayd as soon as you can.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: You have survived the Alpha Sanctum Expedition, report to Rhoda Wellspring via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We've discovered a strange portal in Thayd. My team and I are goin' in, and I want you along for the ride. How soon can you get here?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This place is riddled with all sorts of secrets. Lets find them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This place is riddled with all sorts of secrets. Lets find them all!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: It's a good thing you turned up. That Curator fellow was bad news! With him out of the way, I'm sure we'll learn a lot more from Alpha Sanctum.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'm so excited! I can't wait to see what's on the other end!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've generated a report concernin' Alpha Sanctum that you can read in Secret Ops.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'll be there as soon as I can.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The teleporter discovered by the Exile Academy of Science in Thayd led to an Eldan facility known as Alpha Sanctum. Though administered by a Pell curator, Alpha Sanctum was originally created by the Eldan as a museum to document their implementation of the Nexus Project. Although the Sanctum Curator proved quite dangerous, you defeated him and rescued Rhoda Wellspring from his clutches. A new report has been generated, and you can review it in Secret Ops.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Rhoda Wellspring via your Datachron
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: We've sent some science bots through the portal. It looks like an Eldan facility.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: The bots haven't seen anything scary... yet. They can't go very far inside 'cause there's a barrier keepin' 'em back.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I'll go in without you if I've got to, but I'd rather have you here.

localizedTextIdText: The Royal Collegium has discovered a mysterious portal in Illium. Chancellor Juro Takigurian expects you to support his team's exploration of the portal's ultimate destination, and has ordered you to report to him in Illium immediately.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: You have survived the Alpha Sanctum Expedition, report to Juro Takigurian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Collegium has located a mysterious portal in Illium. Proceed to my location at once so we can document this discovery properly.
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: This facility holds the clues to our Eldan gods. We must discover all of its secrets.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: This facility holds the clues to our Eldan gods. We must discover all of its secrets.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: You have my thanks for such a timely rescue. I am certain the Eldan left Alpha Sanctum behind to guide our steps as we enact the will of the gods.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Do not keep me waiting overlong or I shall proceed without you.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: A new report has been generated. Come to the Enigma Chamber to review it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: The portal discovered by the Royal Collegium in Illium led to an Eldan facility known as Alpha Sanctum. Though administered by a Pell curator, Alpha Sanctum was originally created by the Eldan as a museum to document their implementation of the Nexus Project. Although the Sanctum Curator proved quite dangerous, you defeated him and rescued Juro Takigurian from his clutches. A new report has been generated, and you can review it in the Enigma Chamber.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Report to Juro Takigurian via your Datachron
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Science bots sent through the portal reveal an Eldan facility of some kind.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: No hostiles have been detected, but our science bots have been unable to bypass the seal in the first chamber.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Refusal to participate in this discovery precludes you from future endeavors.

localizedTextIdText: Scout Frostfield wants to give you a Protostar's Revolutionary Rucksack 1.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Scout Frostfield at the Landing Site in the Northern Wilds
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to the Northern Wilds, recruit! Before you go do the whole hero thing, I have something to give ya!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This here is a standard-issue Protostar's Revolutionary Rucksack 1, but gives out great stuff from time to time. Make sure ya don't lose it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew you would be on board!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope you like it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Scout Frostfield gave you a Protostar's Revolutionary Rucksack 1.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you sure? It's free with no strings attached.

localizedTextIdText: Scout Frostfield wants to give you a Protostar's Revolutionary Rucksack 1.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Talk to Scout Frostfield in Greenleaf Glade in Everstar Grove
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome to Everstar Grove, recruit! Before you go do the whole hero thing, I have something to give ya!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This here is a standard-issue Protostar's Revolutionary Rucksack 1, but gives out great stuff from time to time. Make sure ya don't lose it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I knew you would be on board!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I hope you like it!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Scout Frostfield gave you a Protostar's Revolutionary Rucksack 1.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Are you sure? It's free with no strings attached.

localizedTextIdText: Noelia asked you to destroy holobots to verify you can defend yourself. Seems that Nexus is a dangerous place.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Noelia to report your progress
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Proper self-defense techniques are crucial if you are to survive the challenges of Nexus. Please destroy the holobots to either side of me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Is a cerebral malfunction preventing you from completing your objective?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I am pleased to see you were not virtually eviscerated by those creatures!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I am confident you will survive this phase without permanent damage!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You destroyed enough holobots to satisfy Noelia and verify your self-defense capabilities.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The cryo awakening procedure cannot complete unless you pass this test.

localizedTextIdTitle: Expedition: Prime Evil from the Ether!
localizedTextIdText: Granny Adina asked you to help Captain Weir investigate the sudden appearance of a derelict ship, Zarkhov's Shade, around Nexus. Use the Content Finder to enter this Expedition and complete it on Prime difficulty.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Granny Adina via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Captain Weir is looking for a good crew to help him investigate and salvage a derelict ship.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you helped Weir with his mission yet? It sounded important!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Creatures from another dimension? Oh my, are you sure their wasn't a problem with the air on that ship?
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Be careful, you never know what you might find on a wreck.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You went to investigate the derelict Zarkhov's Shade, only to find it filled with ravenous, survivors driven insane, and strange creatures from another dimension! You survived and were able to acquire valuable information about the experimental drive in the process.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What a shame. I'll have to find someone else who is looking for opportunity.

localizedTextIdText: $(creature=75216) in Whitevale has detected a Mordesh cruiser in orbit above Nexus. Though the ship appears to be a derelict, its origins are mysterious. Weir has asked you to board a nearby transport to his ship, the Skyrunner, so that you can help him claim the Grismaran vessel.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to $(creature=75216) aboard the Skyrunner
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I've found a Mordesh derelict in orbit and I could use some help claiming her. If you're willing to help out, I'm willing to pay you handsomely.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: I'd like to lay claim to that ship before anyone else finds out it's there. The sooner you board my transport and come to the Skyrunner, the better.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Welcome aboard the Skyrunner. We're all ready to dock with the Grismaran ship, sure. But first, let me brief you on the situation.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: There's a transport nearby. Hop aboard and meet me on my ship, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've got a real good feeling about this one, I sure do!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to $p(creature=75216) ship, the Skyrunner, where you'll be briefed about your mission to claim the Grismaran vessel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What do you mean by 'claiming her'?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The ship needs explored, for one. Plus, I'd love to get it up and running. That way I can fly it back home and either renovate or scrap it.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: This is a golden opportunity, my friend. You'd be a fool to miss it!

localizedTextIdText: At $p(creature=75216) request, you took a transport to his ship, the Skyrunner, to discuss claiming a mysterious Mordesh cruiser floating derelict in orbit above Nexus. Weir's scans of the ship reveal strange energy readings in and around it, but he has yet to pinpoint their exact origin. For now, he's asked you to board the cruiser, explore it, and recover any interesting data you find.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Return to Captain Weir in Whitevale
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The derelict's quiet - we've had no response to our hails, no siree. Go aboard, explore her, and see if you can find any interesting technical data.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: That Mordesh ship still needs to be fully explored, you know. A captain's time is worth too much to be wasted on idle chit-chat.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was a strange to-do, wasn't it? Those drive schematics you recovered might shed some light on what went wrong. Might even be worth something, yep!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: You never can tell what you'll find on one of these babies, no sir.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yeah, I sure do feel bad for the crew, but they were beyond help. Ah, well.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Too bad about the Mordesh, huh?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You boarded the Zarkhov's Shade, a mysterious Mordesh cruiser that somehow made it through the Dominion blockade around Grismara. In the process, the vessel encountered strange and unsettling difficulties along the way and the crew either went mad or succumbed to the Contagion. Though the ship was ultimately destroyed, you were able to recover its drive schematics for $(creature=75216).
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: Why do you want technical data?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Oh, you betcha. We're getting strange energy readings from both inside and outside the ship. Once you're aboard, I'm sure I'll get it all figured out.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: I've never seen a ship like this, nope. If I'm going to salvage her - or, better yet, overhaul her - I'll need to know her technical specs. Knowing's half the battle, ayep.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What did you come all the way up here for if you're not going to help?

localizedTextIdText: This zTrack is a high-speed romp through lush, green territory controlled by Exiles in Celestion! To complete the zTrack, go to the starting line on your hoverboard. When the race begins, ride through the four checkpoints in order until you reach the finish line. Blue holorings outline the course and offer an optional, temporary, stackable boost of speed. Orange arrows will give you an additional temporary speed boost, and orange jumps will propel you over obstacles!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Report to Galian "Doc" Zemmet via your Datachron
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The hoverboard zTrack in Celestion is available. Are you ready to race?
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: Have you completed your hoverboard zTrack through Celestion?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you completed your hoverboard zTrack through Celestion?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Congratulations on completing a rip-roaring tour of Celestion, hoverboard rider!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember, do it with style!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See you next time.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to ride in Celestion!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No, thank YOU for the hoverboard, Doc!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed this high-speed romp through lush, green territory controlled by Exiles in Celestion!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Always! Dominion citizens will see some serious trouble from guards at Exile settlements if they don't steer clear! Exiles will be right at home!

localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Remember to do it with style!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: See you next time.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm ready to ride in Whitevale!
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: No, thank YOU for the hoverboard, Doc!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You completed this high-flying race across the cold, harsh peaks of Whitevale.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Both the Exiles and Dominion frequent Whitevale, so be careful! There are also Ikthians, snow tornadoes, yeti, and other things that may try to erase you from existence! Bang! Zoom!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: To complete the zTrack, go to the starting line on your hoverboard. When the race begins, ride through the four checkpoints in order until you reach the finish line. Blue holorings outline the course and offer an optional, temporary, stackable boost of speed. Orange arrows will give you an additional temporary speed boost, and the orange jumps will propel you over obstacles!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: The race isn't available forever! Have you no concept of time?

localizedTextIdText: You met Captain Milo on the bridge of the Steady Traveler. He asked you to step outside his ship and take care of the alien vermin infesting the mine on the asteroid housing Outpost M-13.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Milo on the bridge of the Steady Traveler
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome aboard! I hired you to take care of those nasty buggers crawling around my mine here on Outpost M-13. Interested?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Something holding you up? Last I remember, I brought you on board to take care of my vermin problem.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yep, you sure saved me a fortune, friend! Saved a lot of good people, too. This reward's the least I can do in return.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: That's what I like to hear! Head on into the cargo hold. Exit's just out that way!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Yep, you betcha.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You helped Captain Milo from the outskirts of the Endless Vigil thwart a Marauder raid on the Steady Traveler, and then landed on asteroid M-13. Wasting little time, you rescued the remaining miners and reclaimed the settlement from the alien parasites that infested it. Not too shabby for a day's work!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Strange, parasitical creatures. I haven't seen them myself, but if the distress calls are any indication, they're quite frightful.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Aw, shipwrecks! Did I fly you up here for nothing?

localizedTextIdTitle: Expedition: They Came from Fragment Zero!
localizedTextIdText: Freight Supervisor Lola has lost contact with one of her freighters near Halon, one of Nexus's moons. The ship is believed to have crash-landed on asteroid Fragment Zero. Spacers say there is a derelict facility on the floating asteroid. Explore the strange location and learn what happened to her crew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Freight Supervisor Lola on Fragment Zero
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Bless you for coming up here, dearie. I'm not sure what these Skeech are doing around the wreck, but go and find out!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Have you found my Hugo yet? Oh, I hope nothing terrible happened to him out on the Ring...
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm so glad my Hugo got off that darn rock. I never thought he'd get in so much trouble, don't you know. And his poor crew...
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I couldn't possibly go with you. Not with this arthritis, you know.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't blame yourself, dearie. You saved my Hugo. Together, we'll keep this ship sailing.
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: I'm off to check it out.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: I wish that I had got there sooner.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to Fragment Zero and found an Eldan facility housing hordes of Skeech and xenobites. After hacking, slashing, and blasting your way through these monstrosities, you found Captain Hugo being held by the Life-Overseer. After an epic battle with the Life-Overseer - and some clever use of Eldan technology - you made a daring escape from Fragment Zero.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: Will you be all right here?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: Don't you worry your precious head. Just take care of yourself.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: But you've come all this way! Oh, dear...

localizedTextIdText: Captain Tolben has located a wrecked X-82 cargo vessel and intends to salvage it. The captain has asked you to take a transport located near Crosswind Post to his ship, the Blue Sparrow, so that you can help.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Tolben in the Blue Sparrow
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: We're docked with a derelict X-82 cargo vessel. Head in there and salvage what you can. Finders, keepers, if you get me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You heading back so soon? There's bound to be more salvage locked up in that there vessel somewhere.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was pretty weird, huh? At least the X-82 is abandoned. I can make good money selling what's left of her.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Salvage work isn't the prettiest, but you never know what you'll find, you bet.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: You're quite right. Here you go, okay? Don't spend it all in one place.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You took a transport ship located near Crosswind Post and boarded the X-82 cargo vessel to explore it for Captain Tolben. Though the ship was empty of intelligent life, it was infested with strange and dangerous creatures.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay01: You plan to salvage the ship?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It's a cargo hauler. The X-82 series is one of the most popular ships in use today, as reliable as it is ubiquitous.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: You betcha, so long as I can prove she doesn't have an owner. Everything from seat padding to alloy bulkheads can fatten a captain's purse.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: After coming all the way up here? Where's your sense of profit?

localizedTextIdText: You boarded the Starchaser and spoke with Captain Tero. The hapless captain is in a bind. Space Station Venture holds some very rare and expensive chemicals, and it's no longer responding to comm calls. He's hired you to board the station and help the crew.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Captain Tero in the Starchaser
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Welcome aboard! Space Station Venture's just out the airlock. They've gone radio silent. Go on in there and make sure they're okay, yeah?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Did you find the problem in the space station yet? Go on and help the crew before it's too late!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The whole crew and all their research would be gone by now, if not for you. Take this. Enjoy great pay for great work!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I'll keep the ol' girl here docked for when you're done. Be careful, now!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: 'Bout time I get the next shipment set up, then. You know what I mean?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Space Station Venture was contaminated with toxic gas. Shrugging off horrible hallucinations, you grabbed a hazard suit, quelled the maddened livestock, gave masks to the crew, and purged the tainted air from the station. You then returned to Touchdown Site Bravo on Farside.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: What's so important about this station?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: It has an extensive lab utilizing many rare and expensive chemicals, all supplied by yours truly. You betcha!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Darn. Here I was, hoping I found someone to help the folk on this station.

localizedTextIdText: Flight Recruiter Adra met you on a shuttle to the Galactic Observer, a vessel set to chart the vastness of deep space. You agreed to join the science crew in their mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Flight Recruiter Adra in the Galactic Observer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: The Galactic Observer here's just waitin' for the last of the crew to come aboard; that's you! Ready to explore the vastness of deep space?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Surely you're not back so soon? Go on out there and explore!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: What an adventure that was! Captured by Ikthians, waiting to get probed or worse, escaping by the skin of our neck and racing against time to put our ship back together!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Head on inside and meet the rest of the crew! Good luck out there!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Don't you just love adventurin' in space?
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the Galactic Observer on a mission to chart deep space. Unfortunately, you and your fellow crewmates were abducted by Ikthians in deep space. However, you escaped from captivity and rescued your comrades, and you returned to Wilderrun a hero.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How long will the Expedition last?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The usual time frame of an Expedition is around seven years. Unless complications arise, of course. Can't be too sure when it comes to space travel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: When ya travel through space, there's always the risk of bumpin' into an occasional Marauder clan, an interplanetary war, an asteroid shower, an Ikthian abduction ship, a black hole, or a giant ball of flamin' gas. But I'm sure you'll prevail. You'll be explorin' in the name of science, after all!
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We're scientists, of course. The Coalition of Galactic Scientists has renounced all conflict in the pursuit of scientific knowledge. Everythin' we do's in the name of science, and we don't bother with politics or other distractions.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're missin' out on the adventure of a lifetime!

localizedTextIdText: Flight Recruiter Reginald met you on a shuttle to the Galactic Observer, a vessel set to chart the vastness of deep space. You agreed to join the science crew in their mission.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Flight Recruiter Reginald in the Galactic Observer
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: A wealth of knowledge is but a few steps away! Travel into deep space with the crew of the Galactic Observer and see the unknown!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You have hardly completed your mission yet, have you? Off with you, now - deep space awaits!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: That was quite the adventure! Captured by Ikthians, waiting to be violated or worse, only to gloriously escape and return our ship to Nexus! Thrilling!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: The crew awaits your introduction. Do not keep them waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I do hope you enjoyed our little excursion. I know I did!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You traveled to the Galactic Observer on a mission to chart deep space. Unfortunately, you and your fellow crewmates were abducted by Ikthians in deep space. However, you escaped from captivity and rescued your comrades, and you returned to Wilderrun a hero.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoSay00: How long will the Expedition last?
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText00: The usual time frame of an Expedition is around seven years. Unless complications arise, of course. One can never be too sure when it comes to space travel.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText01: When one travels through space, there's always the risk of bumping into an occasional Marauder clan, an interplanetary war, an asteroid shower, an Ikthian abduction ship, a black hole, or a giant ball of flaming gas. But I'm sure you'll prevail. You'll be exploring in the name of science, after all.
localizedTextIdMoreInfoText02: We're scientists, clearly. The Coalition of Galactic Scientists has renounced all conflict in the pursuit of scientific knowledge. Everything we do is in the name of science, and we refrain from politics or other pursuits.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Your disappointing lack of enthusiasm for science has been duly noted.

localizedTextIdText: You met Pilot Taboro in the Nightflare. He pleaded with you to help him out of a jam by handling the distress call of the neighboring vessel. He was nonspecific as to how.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Pilot Taboro in the Nightflare
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Oh hey, welcome to the Nightflare. Got a distress call that needs handling. Just through that airlock over there, yep.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Oh hey, heh... Didn't expect to see you again so soon. How about you head on back in there?
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Look, I can explain! My ship's been in a bad way and I had to get a loan from the Cartel. This is part of my payback. Sorry you ended up in there.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Just head on through. Everything's on the up-and-up here, yes sir.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I watched the episode, though. You were great, that's for sure!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Once Pilot Taboro dropped you off, you found yourself in a ship converted into a bloodsport arena run by the Darkspur Cartel. They called it the Gauntlet. You persevered through their many trials while they filmed your every move, and you eventually won free of their twisted game and returned to southern Malgrave.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You sure? Those people sounded real desperate.

localizedTextIdText: The Market Research Division inexplicably requests post-mortem data on a world boss on the continent of Alizar.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdText: The Market Research Division inexplicably requests post-mortem data on a world boss on the continent of Olyssia.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Collect your Contract Reward

localizedTextIdTitle: Weekly Elder Gem World Boss Bonus
localizedTextIdText: This bonus Elder Gem opportunity can't be beat! All you need to do is group up with your friends and track down world bosses across all of Nexus and Farside. If you can kill enough of them, you'll rake in the Elder Gems!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Claim your reward from the Weekly Bonus Board in the capital city
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Itching for some bonus Elder Gems? Grab your most elite friends and take down some of the biggest baddies this week. World bosses, beware!
localizedTextIdGiverTextAccepted: If you intend to cash in on some bonus Elder Gems this week, then you and your buddies better get out there and take down some world bosses!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Do those behemoth world bosses got you shaking in your boots? Pull it together and take them down to earn those bonus Elder Gems!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Looks as if you and your friends tackled those world bosses with no problem. Make sure you put those Elder Gems to good use!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Come back next week for a shot at more Elder Gems!
localizedTextIdAcceptResponse: Those gems are as good as mine!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You defeated enough world bosses this week to get your dirty paws on a big pile of Elder Gems. Good work! Be sure to come back next week and get some more!
localizedTextIdGiverIncompleteResponse: Those gems are as good as mine!
localizedTextIdReceiverIncompleteRespons: Those gems are as good as mine!

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready to figure out what happened to the Eldan? One of their crazy experiments is up the way, and Dr. Lazarin's all excited about it. Before you go, read this Secret Ops mission brief and give this datacube a look.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met a very excited Rhoda Wellspring in Everstar Grove after landing on Nexus. Now that you're on the ground, she hopes you can get to the bottom of what happened to the Eldan. You should start by looking into a nearby Eldan experiment that Victor Lazarin has discovered.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Ready to figure out what happened to the Eldan? One of their towers is over yonder. Go take a gander at it and see what you can find. Before you go, read this Secret Ops mission brief and give this datacube a look.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You met a very cold Rhoda Wellspring in the Northern Wilds after landing on Nexus. Now that you're on the ground, she hopes you can get to the bottom of what happened to the Eldan. An Eldan tower has been located, and Rhoda thinks you may find some clues there.

localizedTextIdText: You met Juro Takigurian on Crimson Isle after landing on Nexus. Now that you're on the ground, he expects you to solve the enigma of the Eldan disappearance.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Scans have revealed the presence of Eldan technology on this island. If you wish to solve their mysteries, I suggest you make haste. Before you go, read this Enigma Chamber mission brief and review this datacube.

localizedTextIdText: You met Juro Takigurian in Levian Bay after landing on Nexus. Now that you're on the ground, he expects you to solve the enigma of the Eldan disappearance as part of Artemis Zin's expedition.
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You have the opportunity to investigate the mystery of the Eldan disappearance. The Elder Cube should reveal much if Lady Zin can locate it. Before you go, read this Enigma Chamber mission brief and review this datacube.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: It's time you learned about runes, because they'll upgrade your equipment with a wealth of stat bonuses and buffs.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Put this rune and piece of equipment to good use, and I shall speak with you again after you arrive in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tiberia Marcela gave you a rune and a piece of gear you can slot it into. Now to make some magic happen!
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: What an unbecoming attitude for one of your station, $(player.race).

localizedTextIdText: Weaponsmith Frugo wants to teach you how to craft weapons. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5599) in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Frugo in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Now we make weapon. Take ore, wiring, and power core to crafting station. Make me a novice's training brand. Go, go!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Must I repeat? Take materials. Go to crafting station. Make training brand there!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Not bad. This will do. I give you permission to make more! Go make more!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return when done!
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Can't wait to test on stupid Exiles...
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted a weapon for the first time and delivered it to Weaponsmith Frugo.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished weapon to Weaponsmith Frugo
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Maybe I demonstrate how weapon feels when used on you.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Want to make weapons? Came to right place! Take materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Cozmotronic! Now pay attention.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were introduced to Weaponsmith Frugo. He offered to teach you the basics of being a weaponsmith.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I applaud your choice, $(player.class). Let us begin your journey to being a great armorer. Take these materials.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I've placed the materials in your tradeskill bag. Now for the next part!
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You were introduced to Armorer Vospana. She offered to teach you the basics of being an armorer.

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Vospana wants to teach you how to craft heavy armor. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $(schematic=5707) at the crafting station in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished heavy armor to Armorer Vospana at the Tradeskill Hub in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft heavy armor, take the ore, steel framework, and power core to the crafting station. Craft a novice's training hauberk for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: To earn my respect, craft a training hauberk and bring it to me for appraisal. The crafting station is right there.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: My! Such potential in this piece. I predict great things will be created for the Dominion by your capable hands.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return the finished product to me.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: The empire will crush its foes... with your help, of course.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted a $(schematic=5707) and delivered it to Armorer Vospana.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished heavy armor to Armorer Vospana
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: It is obvious you do not yet understand the student-teacher relationship.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: I trust this will be worth my time... and yours. Take these materials and we shall see how you perform.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Place these materials in your tradeskill bag for now.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Now that you're an outfitter, Outfitter Vekia has given you the materials needed to make some medium armor.

localizedTextIdText: Outfitter Vekia wants to teach you how to craft medium armor. Use the materials she's given you to craft a $schematic=5815 in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished medium armor to Outfitter Vekia in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft medium armor, take the hide, composite, and power core I gave you to a crafting station. Create a novice's training doublet for me.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: You're wasting time. Take the materials I've given you to the crafting station and create a training doublet.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: Yes, that's a fine piece you've made. A hunter could wear with it pride.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return the training doublet to me when you're finished. I'll be waiting.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Honor is yours today. Enjoy it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted medium armor for the first time and had it appraised by Outfitter Vekia. She approved of your skills.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished medium armor to Outfitter Vekia
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You're useless, even as prey.

localizedTextIdText: Tailor Amphio wants to teach you how to craft light armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5923) at a crafting station in Illium.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Bring your finished light armor to Tailor Amphio in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: To craft light armor, take the cloth, thread, and power core to the crafting station. Provide me with a novice's training shawl.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: The crafting station is right over there. Whether you are capable of making a proper training shawl remains to be seen.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This shawl you have crafted exceeds Dominion minimum specifications. I did not expect such quality on the frontier.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Return to me once the piece is finished.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Maintain standards at all times. It separates us from the savages.
localizedTextIdCompleteResponse: Nothing but the best for you.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You tailored a $(schematic=5923) for the first time and delivered it to Tailor Amphio.
localizedTextIdCompletedObjectiveShort: Bring your finished armor to Tailor Amphio
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: Subjects like you should be liquidated with prejudice.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: You want to create light armor? I will show you the way. Take these materials so we can commence.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: All right, time to get to work. I'm gonna to give ya some materials. They're for crafting heavy armor.

localizedTextIdText: Armorer Thaako wants to teach you how to craft heavy armor. Use the materials he's given you to craft a $(schematic=5707) at the crafting station in Thayd.

localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Listen up! To craft heavy armor, take the ore, the framework, and power core to the crafting station. Go on and make me a novice's training hauberk.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Hmph. Ya made that training hauberk yet? The crafting station's over there. Come back and show me when ya do.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: This'll do. Keep practicin' and ya might just be a real armorer someday. To make it on Nexus, we'll need people like you.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: Get that hauberk back to me ASAP, bud.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: It's a good start, but you'll still have to work at it.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You crafted a $(schematic=5707) for the first time and delivered it to Armorer Thaako.

localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: I oughta knock yer block off.

localizedTextIdTitle: Crafting for the Exiles in Thayd
localizedTextIdText: Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Tradeskill Hub in Thayd wants to teach you about tradeskills. Sounds like fun!
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Crafting Trainer Thorpe at the Tradeskill Hub in Thayd
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Hey $(player.name), it's time you got to work. Fighting is all well and good, but it's the crafters and tradespeople who will make Nexus a real home!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAccepted: Crafting is all about learning what Nexus has to offer and weaving it to suit our needs. Everything we make helps us in our fight against the Dominion!
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: I'm glad to see you're ready to learn something new and help make Thayd a real home! This is gonna be fun! And profitable!
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: If we want a new home, we have to make one.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: Me and Crafting Trainer Oaklee will teach you everything you need to know.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: You found your way to the Tradeskill Hub in Thayd. Now you can pick up a tradeskill or two to help your fellow Exiles survive the wilds of Nexus.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: If we can't make new things, we might as well give up on our dreams.

localizedTextIdTitle: Crafting for the Dominion in Illium
localizedTextIdText: Craftmaster Tullio at the Tradeskill Hub in Illium would like to instruct you about tradeskills and their potential to benefit the Dominion's interests on Nexus.
localizedTextIdCompletionOverride: Speak to Craftmaster Tullio in Illium
localizedTextIdGiverTextUnknown: Nothing is gained without the labor of many in service of the whole and you, $(player.name), have been chosen to serve. It is time you learned a trade.
localizedTextIdReceiverTextAchieved: The Dominion Victory Commission is collaborative, organized, and most of all, productive. Through mastery of commerce and craft, we shall prevail.
localizedTextIdGiverSayAccepted: I will teach you craftsmanship, and together we will tame this savage world.
localizedTextIdReceiverSayCompleted: I'll direct your work, and Crafting Trainer Trixion will provide instruction.
localizedTextIdCompletedSummary: Craftmaster Tullio invited you to the Tradeskill Hub in Illium. Now is your chance to pick up a tradeskill or two, so that you can provide logistical support to your fellow Dominion citizens.
localizedTextIdGiverSayDecline: You dare ignore my summons?
